english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
ekegusii: Bono Abafirisiti bakarwania Abaisraeli, na Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase bare na bagaiterwa ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

english: And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
ekegusii: Bakabeeka ebirwanero biaye ime ase Hekalu ye chinyasae chiabo, erio bagasiberania omotwe oye ase Hekalu ya Dagoni.

english: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero abanto bonsi ba Yabeshi o Gileadi baigwete aya onsi Abafirisiti bakorerete Saulo,

english: They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
ekegusii: abarwani bonsi chituoni bakagenda bakarusia omobere o Saulo na ey’abamura baye korwa ase yarenge, bakayerenta Yabesi. Erio bagatindeka amauga abo inse y’Omoaluni agwo Yabesi, erio bakeng’ata amatuko atano na abere.

english: And enquired not of the LORD : therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse .
ekegusii: na tarigetie okoraagwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase ayio Omonene akamoita, akarusia oborwoti asare, akaboa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

english: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi-shua , the sons of Saul .
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabwatia Saulo na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Abinadabu, na Malikisua, abamura ba Saulo.

english: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers .
ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.

english: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it.
ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Simora omoyio oo, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibaabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera nigo abeete nobwoba obonene. Ase ayio Saulo akabwata omoyio oye omonyene akegweria igoro yaye.

english: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ng’a Saulo okuure, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye omonyene, agakwa.

english: So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo agakwa, ere na abamura baye batato amo nabaanto baye bonsi.

english: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ase ense eria omweremo baroche ng’a abarwani ’esegi babo batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakuure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafirisiti bagacha, bakamenya ase emechie eyio.

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero Abafirisiti bachete konuura + 10:8 konuura: engencho yaye nokorusia gose ogosansora ebinto biarenge ebiengencho ebinto korwa ase emebere y’abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo amo nabamura baye bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.

english: And when they had stripped him, they took his head , and his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to carry tidings unto their idols , and to the people .
ekegusii: Bakamonuura ebinto biaye, bakanacha omotwe oye bakayoira, bakaira nebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana aya amaya ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na ase abanto.

english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron , saying , Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh .
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangerereka ase Daudi agwo Heburoni bakamoteebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo, na omobere oyomo.

english: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom , and with all Israel , to make him king , according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto abanene chituoni ba Daudi, baria bamosiirete bokong’u ase oborwoti bwaye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli.

english: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam , an Hachmonite , the chief of the captains : he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abaanto chituoni ba Daudi: Ritang’ani Yasobeamu korwa Hakimoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bwa baria batato. Ere akarwania abanto amagana atato ne ritimo riaye akabaita ase engaki eyemo.

english: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo , the Ahohite , who was one of the three mighties .
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodo, Omoahohi.

english: He was with David at Pas-dammim , and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle , where was a parcel of ground full of barley ; and the people fled from before the Philistines .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge amo na Daudi agwo Pasi‐Damimu ekero Abafirisiti basangererekanete amo, barwane esegi aase omogondo bw’esairi orenge. Ekero abanto batamete korwa ase Abafirisiti,

english: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel , and delivered it, and slew the Philistines ; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance .
ekegusii: Eleazari agatenena gati gati y’omogondo oria, akaba omokong’u akayoegera, agaaka Abafirisiti, akabaita. Omonene akabaa obobui obonene.

english: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David , into the cave of Adullam ; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo abanto batato ba baria abanene emerongo etato bagatirimboka gochia ase egetare, bakagenda ase Daudi agwo ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, ekero abasikari b’Abafilisti batoorete ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.

english: And David was then in the hold , and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth-lehem .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Daudi nigo arenge ime ase eburi, na abasikari b’Abafilisti nigo barenge Bethlehemu.

english: And David longed , and said , Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem , that is at the gate !
ekegusii: Daudi akabora ase okogania okonene, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amaache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu?”

english: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines , and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem , that was by the gate , and took it , and brought it to David : but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD ,
ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia + 11:18 bakabinya‐binyia: engencho yaye nogoeta gati yababisa noboremu egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,

english: And said , My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing : shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy ? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest .
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga ’abaanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amaache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni batato bakorete.

english: And moreover in time past , even when Saul was king , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel .
ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, nonya nekero Saulo arenge omorwoti, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobaare korwana esegi naende kobakoirana. Na Omonene, Nyasae oo, akagoteebia ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na koba omogambi igoro yabo.”

english: And Abishai the brother of Joab , he was chief of the three : for lifting up his spear against three hundred , he slew them , and had a name among the three .
ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, nigo amanyekanete ase baria batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato akabaaka ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, na igo akaba nerieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.

english: Of the three , he was more honourable than the two ; for he was their captain : howbeit he attained not to the first three .
ekegusii: Ase baria batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani.

english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel , who had done many acts ; he slew two lionlike men of Moab : also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day .
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa ase Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.

english: And he slew an Egyptian , a man of great stature , five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam ; and he went down to him with a staff , and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand , and slew him with his own spear .
ekegusii: Naende agaita Omomisiri, omonto orenge nobotambe bw’ekerengo gie chimita ibere. Omomisiri oria nigo abwate ritimo koboko kwaye, riachomeire orotanga oronene buna omwaro, korende Benaya akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riarenge koboko kwaye, akamoitera ne ritimo riria riaye omonyene.

english: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and had the name among the three mighties .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete. Nigo anyorete erieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.

english: Behold , he was honourable among the thirty , but attained not to the first three : and David set him over his guard .
ekegusii: Nonya osikire kobua baria Emerongo etato, tareng’anirie na baria batato. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’abarendi b’obogima bwaye.

english: Also the valiant men of the armies were , Asahel the brother of Joab , Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem ,
ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’abasikari nabwo aba: Asaeli momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu.

english: Shammoth the Harorite , Helez the Pelonite ,
ekegusii: Samoti korwa Harodi na Helesi korwa Peleti;

english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite , Abi-ezer the Antothite ,
ekegusii: Ira, mosinto o Ikesi korwa Tekoa, na Abieseri korwa Anatoti;

english: Sibbecai the Hushathite , Ilai the Ahohite ,
ekegusii: Sibekai korwa Husa, na Ilai korwa Ahohi;

english: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron ; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD ; and they anointed David king over Israel , according to the word of the LORD by Samuel .
ekegusii: Nabo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omorwoti agwo Heburoni; na aroro Daudi agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na barabwo bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riri’Omonene akwanete goetera ase Samweli.

english: Maharai the Netophathite , Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite ,
ekegusii: Maharai korwa Netofa, na Heledi, mosinto o Baana korwa Netofa;

english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah , that pertained to the children of Benjamin , Benaiah the Pirathonite ,
ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamini, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;

english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash , Abiel the Arbathite ,
ekegusii: Hurai korwa ase amakura ang’e na Gaasi, na Abieli korwa Ariba;

english: Azmaveth the Baharumite , Eliahba the Shaalbonite ,
ekegusii: Asimaweti korwa Gahurimu na Eliaba korwa Saalaboni;

english: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite , Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite ,
ekegusii: basinto ba Hasemu korwa Gisoni na Yonathani, mosinto o Sagee, korwa Harari;

english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite , Eliphal the son of Ur ,
ekegusii: Ahiamu, mosinto o Sakari korwa Harari, na Elifali, mosinto o Uri;

english: Hepher the Mecherathite , Ahijah the Pelonite ,
ekegusii: Heferi korwa Mekera na Ahiya korwa Peloni

english: Hezro the Carmelite , Naarai the son of Ezbai ,
ekegusii: Hesero korwa Karimeli, na Naara, mosinto bw’Esibai;

english: Joel the brother of Nathan , Mibhar the son of Haggeri ,
ekegusii: Yoel, momura omwabo Nathani, na Mibihari, mosinto o Hagiri.

english: Zelek the Ammonite , Naharai the Berothite , the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah ,
ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya;

english: Ira the Ithrite , Gareb the Ithrite ,
ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;

english: Uriah the Hittite , Zabad the son of Ahlai ,
ekegusii: Uria Omohiti na Sabadi, mosinto bw’Alai,

english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite , a captain of the Reubenites , and thirty with him,
ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, omoraai bw’abaanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;

english: Hanan the son of Maachah , and Joshaphat the Mithnite ,
ekegusii: Hanani, mosinto o Maaka na Yosafati korwa Mitani;

english: Uzzia the Ashterathite , Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite ,
ekegusii: Usia korwa Asitera; Sama na Yeieli, basinto ba Hotamu korwa Aroeri;

english: Jediael the son of Shimri , and Joha his brother , the Tizite ,
ekegusii: Yediaeli, mosinto o Simuri, na Yoha, momura omwabo, omonto o Tisi;

english: Eliel the Mahavite , and Jeribai , and Joshaviah , the sons of Elnaam , and Ithmah the Moabite ,
ekegusii: Elieli korwa Mahawa Yeribai na Yosawia, basinto b’Elinamu, na Itima korwa Moabu;

english: Eliel , and Obed , and Jasiel the Mesobaite .
ekegusii: Elieli, na Obedi, na Yaasieli korwa Soba.

english: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David , Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion , which is the city of David .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yebusi bakamoteebia, “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake.” Korende nonya naboigo, Daudi akabua eburi + 11:5 eburi: engencho yaye ’egekengero ya Sayoni, oyio noro Omochie o Daudi.

english: And David said , Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain . So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up , and was chief .
ekegusii: Daudi konya oteebire, ng’a “Monto onde bwensi orabe oyo bw’eritang’ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw’abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.

english: And David dwelt in the castle ; therefore they called it the city of David .
ekegusii: Daudi akaba okomenya ase eburi eria enkong’u, ase ayio ekarokwa Omochie o Daudi.

english: And he built the city round about , even from Millo round about : and Joab repaired the rest of the city .
ekegusii: Erio akaagacha omochie goetanana onsi korwa Milo, okaba egesingo + 11:8 egesingo: engencho yaye egetangero gtanaine omochie bwonsi kegima; na Yoabu akaroisia omochie ase konya otagokire.

english: So David waxed greater and greater : for the LORD of hosts was with him.
ekegusii: Daudi akamenta koba omonene, na koba nokobua, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo arenge amo nere. Abarwani chituoni ba Daudi (2 Sam 23:8-9)

english: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag , while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish : and they were among the mighty men , helpers of the war .
ekegusii: Daudi nigo amenyete Sikilagi, ekero arenge kwebisa korwa ase Saulo, mosinto o Kisi. Abanto chituoni abarenge komokonya ase esegi bagacha asare.

english: Mishmannah the fourth , Jeremiah the fifth ,
ekegusii: na Misimana oyo o kane, na Yeremia oyo o gatano,

english: Attai the sixth , Eliel the seventh ,
ekegusii: na Atai oyo o gatano na rimo, na Elieli oyo o gatano na kabere,

english: Johanan the eighth , Elzabad the ninth ,
ekegusii: na Yohanani oyo o gatano na gatato, na Elisabadi oyo o kianda,

english: Jeremiah the tenth , Machbanai the eleventh .
ekegusii: na Yeremia oyo o ikomi, na Makibani oyo o ikomi na rimo.

english: These were of the sons of Gad , captains of the host : one of the least was over an hundred , and the greatest over a thousand .
ekegusii: Abagadi aba nigo barenge abatang’ani b’abasikari, na oyo otarenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto rigana erimo (100), na oyorenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto elifu eyemo (1,000).

english: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month , when it had overflown all his banks ; and they put to flight all them of the valleys , both toward the east , and toward the west .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bambogete Yorodani ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, ekero orooche orwo rwaichorete goetania chingegu chinsemo chionsi, bagaseria abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’amaranya, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini na ekia Yuda

english: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David .
ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Benjamini, na ekia Yuda, bagacha ase eburi agwo ase Daudi arenge.

english: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies , seeing there is no wrong in mine hands , the God of our fathers look thereon , and rebuke it .
ekegusii: Daudi agasoka kobarotota akabateebia, “Onye igo mwachire buna abasani baane monkonye, rirorio enkoro yane nebwatane nainwe, korende onye nigo mwachire monsigane na kondua ase ababisa baane, nonya amaboko aane takorete okomocha konde gwonsi, rirorio Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito arore amang’ana ayio abae egesusuro.”

english: Then the spirit came upon Amasai , who was chief of the captains , and he said , Thine are we , David , and on thy side, thou son of Jesse : peace , peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers ; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band .
ekegusii: Erio omoika ogaacha igoro ase Amasai, omonene bw’abaanto baria Emerongo etato, nere agateeba, “Aye Daudi, intwe nigo tore abanto bao; na nigo tokobwatana amo naye, aye omwana o Yese. Omorembe obe asore, na omorembe obe ase abakogokonya, ekiagera Nyasae oo, nere okogokonya.” Erio Daudi akabanchera, akababeeka bakaba abatang’ani b’emeganda yaye y’esegi. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Manase

english: And there fell some of Manasseh to David , when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle : but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying , He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads .
ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Manase bagatama, bakagenda ase Daudi ekero arenge kogenda amo n’Abafilisti korwania Saulo. Korende Abafirisiti tibaete Daudi ribaga abakoonye, ekiagera ekero abagaambi babo bagambete amo, bagateeba, Aise kogenda amo naintwe, ande nigo arabwatane amo na Saulo, omonene oye, igo batobutore emetwe.

english: They were armed with bows , and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow , even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata, na nigo bamanyete koruta emegwe na amagena e chinduruche nokoboko gw’okorio amo nogw’okobee. Aba nigo barenge Ababenjamini, abanto bamwabo Saulo. Abanto aba nabwo aba:

english: As he went to Ziklag , there fell to him of Manasseh , Adnah , and Jozabad , and Jediael , and Michael , and Jozabad , and Elihu , and Zilthai , captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh .
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi agendete Sikilagi, abanto aba b’egesaku kia Manase bagacha asare: Adina na Yosabadi, Yediaeli na Mikaeli, Yosabadi na Elihu, na Siletai. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abaanto chilifu ba Manase.

english: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour , and were captains in the host .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagokonya Daudi korwania ebiombe bi’abasakori. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto chituoni, bakaba abatang’ani b’abasikari.

english: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host , like the host of God .
ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abasikari ba Nyasae. Omobaro bw’abarwani ba Daudi

english: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war , and came to David to Hebron , to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’emeganda y’abasikari, baria bachete ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, buna Omonene achigete, erinde bamoe oborwoti boria bwarusetigwe ase Saulo.

english: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred , ready armed to the war .
ekegusii: Abayuda ababogoretie chinguba na amatimo nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na atato (6,800), baisanerete ase okorwana esegi.

english: Of the children of Simeon , mighty men of valour for the war , seven thousand and one hundred .
ekegusii: Abasimeoni nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere, ne rigana erimo (7,100), abanto chituoni abakong’u ase esegi.

english: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: Abalawi nigo barenge chilifu inye, na amagana atano na rimo (4,600),

english: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites , and with him were three thousand and seven hundred ;
ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw’eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);

english: And Zadok , a young man mighty of valour , and of his father’s house twenty and two captains .
ekegusii: na Zadoki, omomura etuoni, amo nabaanto bamwabo abatang’ani b’esegi emerongo ebere, na babere (22).

english: And of the children of Benjamin , the kindred of Saul , three thousand : for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul .
ekegusii: Ababenjamini, abanto b’eamate ya Saulo, nigo barenge chilifu isato (3,000), nonya nase ekero ekio abange mono kobua b’abwo bagendererete kobwatana nenyomba ya Saulo.

english: The chief was Ahiezer , then Joash , the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite ; and Jeziel , and Pelet , the sons of Azmaveth ; and Berachah , and Jehu the Antothite ,
ekegusii: Ahieseri orenge omonene obo, naende Yoashi; aba babere mbasinto ba Semaa korwa Gibea; Yesieli na Peleti basinto b’Asimaweti; Beraka na Yehu korwa Anatoti;

english: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred , mighty men of valour , famous throughout the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaefraimu: chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana atano na atato (20,800), abanto chituoni ase esegi bamanyekanete ase chiamate chiabo.

english: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand , which were expressed by name , to come and make David king .
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku ekeng’ese kia Manase: chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000), baria batoretwe amarieta abo bache kobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.

english: And of the children of Issachar , which were men that had understanding of the times , to know what Israel ought to do ; the heads of them were two hundred ; and all their brethren were at their commandment .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisakaru: abanto abang’aini abamanyi ebimanyererio bie chingaki, bamanyete egento Abaisraeli bagwenerete gokora, abateneneri amagana abere (200), amo nabamwabo abarenge inse ase obochiki bwabo.

english: Of Zebulun , such as went forth to battle , expert in war , with all instruments of war , fifty thousand , which could keep rank : they were not of double heart .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abasabuloni: abarwani abakong’u baare nomoyo oyomo, baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, babwate ebirwanero biisaine, abanto chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).

english: And of Naphtali a thousand captains , and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand .
ekegusii: Korwa Abanafutali: abachiki elifu eyemo (1,000), amo nabaanto chilifu emerongo etato na isano na ibere (37,000), babwate chinguba na amatimo.

english: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abadani: abanto baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ebere na isano na isato, na amagana atano na rimo (28,600).

english: And of Asher , such as went forth to battle , expert in war , forty thousand .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaaseri: abanto abakong’u baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ene (40,000).

english: And on the other side of Jordan , of the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and of the half tribe of Manasseh , with all manner of instruments of war for the battle , an hundred and twenty thousand .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abareubeni na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, abwo bamenyete ng’umbu ya Yorodani, abanto babwate ebirwanero bionsi bi’okorwana esegi, chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000).

english: All these men of war , that could keep rank , came with a perfect heart to Hebron , to make David king over all Israel : and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king .
ekegusii: Abarwani aba bonsi baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, na bagacha agwo Heburoni, bare nomoyo oyomo kobeeka Daudi koba omorwoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi. Boigo Abaisraeli bande bonsi nigo barenge nebirengererio ebimo bi’okobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.

english: And there they were with David three days , eating and drinking : for their brethren had prepared for them.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakabeera aroro amo na Daudi ase amatuko atato, bakaba bakoria na konywa, ekiagera abamwabo konya baabaariganeirie ebinto bionsi.

english: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite , a mighty man among the thirty , and over the thirty ; and Jeremiah , and Jahaziel , and Johanan , and Josabad the Gederathite ,
ekegusii: Isimaya korwa Gibeoni, omonto etuoni naende omoraai ase egati y’abanto baria Emerongo etato; Yeremia na Yehasieli, Yohanani na Yosabadi korwa Gedera;

english: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali , brought bread on asses , and on camels , and on mules , and on oxen , and meat , meal , cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins , and wine , and oil , and oxen , and sheep abundantly : for there was joy in Israel .
ekegusii: Abaamate bamwabo abamenyete ang’e amo nabwo bamenyete ase chingongo chia Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Nafutali, abwo bakarenta chindagera babogoretie ne chitigere ne chingamia, ne chibarasi, ne chiombe; bakarenta chindagera chinyinge mono; obosie, na amabomba ’amako amomo na ay’amasabibu amomo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ekiagera Abaisraeli nigo barenge nomogooko omonene.

english: Eluzai , and Jerimoth , and Bealiah , and Shemariah , and Shephatiah the Haruphite ,
ekegusii: Elusai na Yerimoti, Bealia na Semaria, na Sefatia korwa Harufi;

english: Elkanah , and Jesiah , and Azareel , and Joezer , and Jashobeam , the Korhites ,
ekegusii: Elikana na Isia, Asareli na Yoeseri, na Yasobeamu, abarenge Abakora;

english: And Joelah , and Zebadiah , the sons of Jeroham of Gedor .
ekegusii: Yoela na Sebadia, basinto ba Yerohamu, korwa Gedori. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi

english: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might , and men of war fit for the battle , that could handle shield and buckler , whose faces were like the faces of lions , and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains ;
ekegusii: Abagadi bande bakagenda kobwatia Daudi agwo ase eburi yarenge ase erooro. Abanto aba nigo barenge chituoni, bamanyete korwana chiseegi, naende nigo bamanyete korwanera chinguba na amatimo. Amasio abo nigo arenge buna aye chindo, naende nigo barenge kominyoka buna chingabi igoro y’ebitunwa.

english: Ezer the first , Obadiah the second , Eliab the third ,
ekegusii: Eseri nere orenge omotang’ani obo na Obadia oyo o kabere, na Eliabu oyo o gatato,

english: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds , and with every leader .
ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogosemania nabanene bonsi abarenge abatang’ani b’abarwani elifu eyemo (1,000) na abe rigana erimo (100).

english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza , and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark : and there he died before God .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduki eria; na Usa agakwera aroro ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: And David was displeased , because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza : wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day .
ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa. Aase aria akarokwa Peresi‐Usa + 13:11 Ogwateka igoro ya Usa , naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

english: And David was afraid of God that day , saying , How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akairoka Nyasae, akabora, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduki ya Nyasae nka bwone?”

english: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi tairete Esanduki eria mwaye ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria akayebeka nyomba mw’Obedi‐Edomu, Omogiti.

english: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us:
ekegusii: Erio agakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi basangererekanete, akabateebia, “Onye ekororekana buya ase more, naende onye kore ogwancha kw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, tiga totome abanto gochia aaria na aaria barangerie abaminto baria batigarete ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, na abakuani na Abalawi bakare ase emechie eria ere namarisio, erinde bachiche babe amo naintwe.

english: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .
ekegusii: Erio torente naende Esanduki ya Nyasae oito ebeere amo naintwe, ekiagera ntwayetigete ase amatuko aria Saulo arenge kogamba.”

english: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .
ekegusii: Omosangererekano oria bwonsi bw’abaanto ogancha gokora amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo abeete amaronge ase abanto bonsi.

english: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab : and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart .
ekegusii: Bakarusia Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, bakayebeeka igoro ase egari enyia. Usa na Ahiyo nabwo barenge koraa egari eria.

english: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .
ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga ase obosio bwa Nyasae ne chinguru chiabo chionsi, bagotera na kobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande, na ebikonu, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga, na ebitureeri.

english: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark ; for the oxen stumbled .
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gia Kidoni, Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduki eria, ekiagera chiombe chiare kong’usa egari chiagochetwe.

english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and timber of cedars , with masons and carpenters , to build him an house .
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abatomwa ase Daudi, akamotomera ebingese bi’emete y’emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.

english: And David enquired of God , saying , Shall I go up against the Philistines ? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ? And the LORD said unto him, Go up ; for I will deliver them into thine hand .
ekegusii: Na Daudi akaboria Nyasae “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafirisiti?” Nobabeeke ase amaboko aane gose? Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda, nimbabeeke ase amaboko ao.”

english: So they came up to Baal-perazim ; and David smote them there. Then David said , God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters : therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim .
ekegusii: Daudi akagenda goika Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Nyasae okoroorire ababisa baane goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna chiooro chi’amaache are nemerindo chigokoroora.” Ase ayio bakaroka aase aria Baali‐Perasimu.

english: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment , and they were burned with fire .
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagatiga chinyasae chiabo aroro, na Daudi agachiika abanto, bachisambe nomorero.

english: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley .
ekegusii: Naende Abafirisiti bakagenda aroro eria kabere bagasakora.

english: Therefore David enquired again of God ; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aboretie Nyasae naende, Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobarwania esegi korwa aa, korende oetanane ogende obatubokere korwa magega ase emete ekorokwa balisamu ere.

english: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt go out to battle : for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines .
ekegusii: Na ekero oraigwe ebititiro bigoeta ase emete eyio igoro, erio ogende korwana esegi; omanye ng’a Nyasae ogotang’aneire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”

english: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer .
ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Nyasae amochigeete, na barabwo bagaita abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa Gibeoni goikera Geseri.

english: And the fame of David went out into all lands ; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations .
ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Daudi chigasarera ase chinse chionsi; n’Omonene akarentera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi obwoba, bakamoiroka.

english: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel , for his kingdom was lifted up on high , because of his people Israel .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akamanya ng’a Omonene omokong’irie ase okoba omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, na omoimokereirie igoro ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli.

english: And David took more wives at Jerusalem : and David begat more sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.

english: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem ; Shammua , and Shobab , Nathan , and Solomon ,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,

english: And Ibhar , and Elishua , and Elpalet ,
ekegusii: Ibuhari na Eliasama, na Elifeleti,

english: And Nogah , and Nepheg , and Japhia ,
ekegusii: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia,

english: And Elishama , and Beeliada , and Eliphalet .
ekegusii: Elisama na Beliada, na Elifeleti. Abafirisiti bakobugwa (2 Sam 5:17-25)

english: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel , all the Philistines went up to seek David . And David heard of it , and went out against them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta obeire omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi akaigwa ayio, akagenda koumerana nabarabwo ase okorwana esegi.

english: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagacha gosakora agwo ase ense omweya + 14:9 omweya: engencho yaye se arengaine y’Abarefai.

english: And David made him houses in the city of David , and prepared a place for the ark of God , and pitched for it a tent .
ekegusii: Daudi akeagachera chinyomba agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Akaroisia aase ase Esanduki ya Nyasae yare koganchwa, naende akayeteneneria eema aroro.

english: Of the sons of Uzziel ; Amminadab the chief , and his brethren an hundred and twelve .
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Usieli: Aminadabu, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112).

english: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests , and for the Levites , for Uriel , Asaiah , and Joel , Shemaiah , and Eliel , and Amminadab ,
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoel na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,

english: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites : sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren , that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Inwe nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi, echene inwe abanyene amo nabaanto bamino, mochie kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyebeke aase agwo inche nayeroiseirie.

english: For because ye did it not at the first , the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order .
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe timwayebogoretie engaki eria entang’ani, Omonene, Nyasae oito, atoete egesusuro; titwamorigetie buna atochigeete.”

english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, erinde bachie korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick , psalteries and harps and cymbals , sounding , by lifting up the voice with joy .
ekegusii: Boigo Daudi agachiika abatang’ani b’Abalawi bachore abanto bamwabo babe abateri, baranyare kobugia ebinto bigoterera ase amariogi, ababugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga ase ogoteera nomogooko.

english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel ; and of his brethren , Asaph the son of Berechiah ; and of the sons of Merari their brethren , Ethan the son of Kushaiah ;
ekegusii: Ase igo Abalawi bagachora Hemani, mosinto o Yoel, na ase abanto bamwabo Asafu, mosinto o Berekia, na ase ororeria rwa Merari abanto bamwabo Etani, mosinto o Kusaya.

english: And with them their brethren of the second degree , Zechariah , Ben , and Jaaziel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Unni , Eliab , and Benaiah , and Maaseiah , and Mattithiah , and Elipheleh , and Mikneiah , and Obed-edom , and Jeiel , the porters .
ekegusii: Ase okobakonya baria bachorire abanto bamwabo b’omooroberio o kabere: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yeieli, Uni na Eliabu, Benaya na Maaseya. Naende bagachora Matitia na Elifelehu, na Mikineya, na abarendi b’egeita Obedi‐Edomu na Yeieli.

english: So the singers , Heman , Asaph , and Ethan , were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass ;
ekegusii: Abateri baria Hemani na Asafu, na Etani babe bakobugia chisani chi’etai chikobugigwa na kwoga.

english: And Zechariah , and Aziel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Unni , and Eliab , and Maaseiah , and Benaiah , with psalteries on Alamoth ;
ekegusii: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Uni na Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya, aba babe bakobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a igoro ay’Alamoti. + 15:20 Alamoti: ring’ana rigwatora eriogi ri’ogoteera

english: And Mattithiah , and Elipheleh , and Mikneiah , and Obed-edom , and Jeiel , and Azaziah , with harps on the Sheminith to excel .
ekegusii: Korende Matitia na Elifelehu, Mikineya na Obedi‐Edomu, Yeieli na Asasia babe abaraai ase okobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a inse a Seminiti. + 15:21 Seminiti: ring’ana rigwatora eriogi ri’ogoteera

english: And Chenaniah , chief of the Levites , was for song : he instructed about the song , because he was skilful .
ekegusii: Kenania, omoraai bw’Abalawi ase amatera, abe omoteria, ekiagera namanyete emeremo eyio.

english: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark .
ekegusii: Berekia na Elikana babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria y’Omonene.

english: And Shebaniah , and Jehoshaphat , and Nethaneel , and Amasai , and Zechariah , and Benaiah , and Eliezer , the priests , did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God : and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark .
ekegusii: Sebania na Yehosafati, Netaneli na Amasai, Zakaria na Benaya, na Eliezeri, abakuani, babe bakobugia ebitureeri bosio bw’Esanduki eria ya Nyasae. Obedi‐Edomu na Yehia barabwo babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria. Esanduki y’Okobwatana ekorentwa Yerusalemu

english: So David , and the elders of Israel , and the captains over thousands , went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu bakagenda kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, bagachenga nomogooko omonene mono.

english: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams .
ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae akonyete Abalawi baria babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakarua ebing’wanso bie chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.

english: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen , and all the Levites that bare the ark , and the singers , and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers : David also had upon him an ephod of linen .
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka eanga engiya y’egatani, boigo n’Abalawi baria bonsi babogoretie Esanduki eria bakabeeka, na abateri boigo, na Kenania, omoteria bw’abateri. Daudi akabeeka negesibao ki’egatani.

english: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting , and with sound of the cornet , and with trumpets , and with cymbals , making a noise with psalteries and harps .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Bagaaka amariogi ’omochengo, bakabugia chingoma na eirombeta, ne chisani chigoakanigwa chikwoga, naende bakabugia mono namakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa.

english: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David , that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing : and she despised him in her heart .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omorwoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ore nomogooko, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.

english: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem , to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place , which he had prepared for it.
ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Yerusalemu gochia korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene gocha aase aye ayeroiseretie.

english: And David assembled the children of Aaron , and the Levites :
ekegusii: Naende agasangereria amo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni na Abalawi.

english: Of the sons of Kohath ; Uriel the chief , and his brethren an hundred and twenty :
ekegusii: Korwa ase eamate ya Kohati: Urieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120);

english: Of the sons of Merari ; Asaiah the chief , and his brethren two hundred and twenty :
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Merari: Asaia, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220);

english: Of the sons of Gershom ; Joel the chief , and his brethren an hundred and thirty :
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Gerisomu: Yoel, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130);

english: Of the sons of Elizaphan ; Shemaiah the chief , and his brethren two hundred :
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate y’Elisafani: Semaya, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere (200);

english: Of the sons of Hebron ; Eliel the chief , and his brethren fourscore :
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Heburoni Elieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo emerongo etano na etato (80);

english: So they brought the ark of God , and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God .
ekegusii: Kobarentire Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, bakayebeeka ime ase eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie, bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .
ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo ime.

english: Seek the LORD and his strength , seek his face continually .
ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie mobe ase obosio bwaye botambe.

english: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done , his wonders , and the judgments of his mouth ;
ekegusii: -13 Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Israeli, omosomba bw’Omonene, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia na amakumia aye amo nebiina anachete.

english: He is the LORD our God ; his judgments are in all the earth .
ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebiina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.

english: Be ye mindful always of his covenant ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations ;
ekegusii: Inyora botambe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, goika ebiaare elifu mobe mokoinyora ring’ana achigete,

english: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance ;
ekegusii: agateeba, “Aye ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe omwando bw’ororeria rwao.”

english: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento, nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.

english: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene.

english: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people ;
ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oborwoti obomo gochia ase obonde.

english: Saying , Touch not mine anointed , and do my prophets no harm .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe!”

english: Sing unto the LORD , all the earth ; shew forth from day to day his salvation .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene! Raria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko!

english: Declare his glory among the heathen ; his marvellous works among all nations .
ekegusii: Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!

english: For great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised : he also is to be feared above all gods .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, na airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.

english: For all the gods of the people are idols : but the LORD made the heavens .
ekegusii: Chinyasae chionsi chi’abaanto b’ebisaku nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa rioka, korende Omonene nere otongete igoro chionsi.

english: Glory and honour are in his presence ; strength and gladness are in his place .
ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na omogooko nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye.

english: Give unto the LORD , ye kindreds of the people , give unto the LORD glory and strength .
ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye!

english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness .
ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye; moche ase obosio bwaye morentane ebiegwa, mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu!

english: And he dealt to every one of Israel , both man and woman , to every one a loaf of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .
ekegusii: Naende akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, ase abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na enyama inke, ne ribomba ri’amasasabibu amomo.

english: Fear before him, all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa.

english: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice : and let men say among the nations , The LORD reigneth .
ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko na ense echenge, abanto b’ebisaku bateebigwe: “Omonene nere okogamba.”

english: Let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice , and all that is therein.
ekegusii: Tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, na emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo.

english: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD , because he cometh to judge the earth .
ekegusii: Erio emete ye rinani netere nomogooko ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere ngocha are konachera ense ekiina.

english: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation , and gather us together , and deliver us from the heathen , that we may give thanks to thy holy name , and glory in thy praise .
ekegusii: Kwana: Aye Nyasae, ogotooreka gwaito, totoorie, otosangererie amo, na otoboorie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erinde totogie erieta riao richenu, na twetogerie ogotogigwa kwao.

english: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, korwa kare na kare, na gochia kare na kare! Erio abanto bonsi bagateeba, “Amina!” Na bakamotogia Omonene. Ogosasiima ase Yerusalemu na Gibeoni

english: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day’s work required :
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiga Asafu na abanto bamwabo agwo bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene babe abakoreri asare botambe, buna okogania gwa kera rituko kwarenge.

english: And Obed-edom with their brethren , threescore and eight ; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters :
ekegusii: Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato (68). Ere Obedi‐Edomu mosinto o Yedutuni, na Hosea, bakabeekwa bakaba abarendi b’egeita.

english: And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon ,
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka Zadoki Omokuani amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, babe bagokorera Omonene ase Eema yaye agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aaria Gibeoni.

english: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD , and to record , and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel :
ekegusii: Naende agachora abanto bande b’Abalawi bakaba abakoreri bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene, bakaba bagotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na komobaka.

english: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD , which he commanded Israel ;
ekegusii: Kera emambia na omogoroba botambe babe bakorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna arigetwe ase amachiiko ari’Omonene aete Abaisraeli.

english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the LORD , because his mercy endureth for ever ;
ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge Hemani na Yedutuni, na abanto baria bachoretwe na korikwa amarieta abo ase okoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obwo bogendererete kare na kare.

english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound , and with musical instruments of God . And the sons of Jeduthun were porters .
ekegusii: Hemani na Yedutuni nigo bagachete ebitureeri ne chisani chiarenge kwoga ekero chiare goakanigwa, amo n’ebinto binde biare kobugigwa ekero amatera amaachenu agoterwa. Abanto b’eamate ya Yedutuni bagachorwa korenda egeita.

english: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed-edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals ;
ekegusii: Asafu nere orenge omotang’ani obo. Abaare komobwatia nabwo aba: Zakaria na Yeieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Matitia na Eliabu, Benaya na Obedi‐Edomu, na Yeieli, baria barenge kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu agaakania chisani chiarenge kwoga.

english: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God .
ekegusii: Benaya na Yahasieli, abakuani, bakaba bakobugia ebitureeri botambe agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire Okobwatana kwa Nyasae.

english: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren .
ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Daudi achigete ritang’ani ng’a ogoteera gw’okomoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono goterwe n’Asafu na abanto bamwabo ase enchera eyio. Ogoteera kw’ogotogia (Zab 105:1-5; 96:1-3; 106:1,47-48)

english: Give thanks unto the LORD , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .
ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono! Rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.

english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia; raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia.

english: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Daudi amenyete ase enyomba yaye agakwana na Nathani omobani, agateeba, “Rora inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake, korende Esanduki ya Nyasae ero nigo ere ase eema ime.”

english: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies . Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house .
ekegusii: korwa engaki eria nachorete abagaambi igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli. Boigo nimbue ababisa bao bonsi. Na bono nigo ngokomanyia ng’a inche Omonene ninkoagachere enyomba.

english: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons ; and I will establish his kingdom .
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao araikeranigwe na obe gokogenda korara ase chisokoro chiao chiaraarete, nimbeke oyomo bw’ororeria rwao, oyorarue ase oyomo bw’abamura bao, agambe; nainche ninkong’ie oborwoti bwaye.

english: He shall build me an house , and I will stablish his throne for ever .
ekegusii: Oyio nere orang’agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.

english: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever : and his throne shall be established for evermore .
ekegusii: Korende nimokore agenderere kobeerao botambe ase enyomba yane, na ase oborwoti bwane, na obogambi bwaye bokong’igwe kobao botari nomoerio.”

english: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na korora. Ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono gwa Daudi na ogosaba kwaye (2 Sam 7:18-29)

english: And David the king came and sat before the LORD , and said , Who am I, O LORD God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, akabora, Aye Omonene, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

english: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O LORD God .
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Omonene Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire nainche omosomba oo, igoro y’enyomba yane na amang’ana akare bosio. Ee, Omonene, gwankoreire koreng’ana nobo Mwanyabaanto, kwanyimokereirie igoro.

english: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .
ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagoteebie naende kobua ayio, ekiagera gwansikire iga? Aye nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.

english: O LORD , for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all this greatness , in making known all these great things .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho yane inche, omosomba oo, na koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao aye omonyene, gwakorire amanene aya onsi, naende kwayakorire amanyekanire.

english: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart ; for God is with thee.
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi, “Kora ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.”

english: O LORD , there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

english: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?
ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense, bare buna abanto bao Abaisraeli, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, okenyorera erieta ase engencho y’amang’ana amanene na ay’ogokumia ase ogoseria abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase obosio bw’abaanto bao baria kwabooretie korwa Misiri?

english: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever ; and thou, LORD , becamest their God .
ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.

english: Therefore now, LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .
ekegusii: Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a noyakore,

english: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
ekegusii: erinde erieta riao ribeo ritogigwe goika kare na kare. Erio abanto bateebe: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ekeene nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.

english: For thou, O my God , hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house : therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang’orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng’a nong’agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.

english: And now, LORD , thou art God , and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira gonkorera ring’ana eri rigiya.

english: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O LORD , and it shall be blessed for ever .
ekegusii: Gaki bono, koranche osesenie enyomba yane inche erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, aya gwasesenirie nigo agoseseneka kare na kare.

english: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamoteebia,

english: Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :
ekegusii: “Genda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Aye tokong’agachera enyomba imenye imeo.

english: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli goika rituko ria reero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire nkona‐kogenda korwa eyemo goika eyende, na korwa obomenyo obomo goika obonde.

english: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel , spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people , saying , Why have ye not built me an house of cedars ?
ekegusii: Aase ande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto baane ng’a nase ki atang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.

english: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the LORD of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro orateebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nateebire iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase kwarenge korisia ching’ondi, erinde obe gokogambera abanto baane Abaisraeli;

english: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
ekegusii: nainche nkaba amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogenda ngasiria ababisa bao bonsi korwa ase obosio bwao; inche ninkore erieta riao rimanyekane, buna amarieta ’abaanto abanene b’ense amanyekanete.

english: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel , and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more , as at the beginning ,
ekegusii: Ninchorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababeekere bamenye, aase abo abanyene, na abakori amabe tibakobachanda naende nonya ng’ake buna baabachandete agwo ritang’ani

english: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akaira omochie o Gati amo nebichie biaye korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.

english: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou ;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
ekegusii: agatoma Hadoramu, omomura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi komokwania na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri na omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okonakorwania Tou. Boigo Tou agatoma ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, na ebie chitaai.

english: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitaabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki.

english: And he put garrisons in Edom ; and all the Edomites became David’s servants . Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na Abaedomu bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, n’Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana esegi.

english: So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people .
ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi na akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi ayare boronge na ekeene.

english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , recorder .
ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.

english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Abimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests ; and Shavsha was scribe ;
ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Sausa nere orenge omoriki.

english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites ; and the sons of David were chief about the king .
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti; na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abanene bamoetanaine.

english: And he smote Moab ; and the Moabites became David’s servants , and brought gifts .
ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu, na barabwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakorenta ebango asare.

english: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, agwo Hamati, ekero omorwoti oria agendete gokong’ia oborwoti bwaye aaria ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

english: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots .
ekegusii: Daudi agoosa chigari elifu eyemo (1,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani abaare kogenda namagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chionsi chinteng’e otatiga chibarasi rigana erimo (100) chikaba chikong’usa chigari.

english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).

english: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus ; and the Syrians became David’s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abasikari ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.

english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Daudi agasakora chinguba chi’echitaabu chiria abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.

english: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah ;
ekegusii: Tou, omorwoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba,

english: Now it came to pass after this , that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died , and his son reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Nahasi, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, agakwa, na omomura oye akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .
ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio na magega, agachora abanto abakong’u, abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.

english: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother , and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon .
ekegusii: Abanto bande abatigari akababeeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai momura omwabo, akaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.

english: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye, korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche inchiche noboseemia.

english: Be of good courage , and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people , and for the cities of our God : and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight .
ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu! Torwanere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Na ig’Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”

english: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle ; and they fled before him.
ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka bagaika ang’e n’Abasiiria ase okorwana esegi, na Abasiiria baria bagatama korwa asare.

english: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , they likewise fled before Abishai his brother , and entered into the city . Then Joab came to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, nabarabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu akagenda Yerusalemu.

english: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto korangeria Abasiiria, abarenge ng’umbu y’Eufarati, bache batang’anwe na Sofaki, omochiki bw’abasikari ba Hadadeseri.

english: And it was told David ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, erio akagenda ase bare, akaira abarwani baye b’esegi gochia kobarwania. Ekero Daudi aroberetie abarwani baye b’esegi korwania Abasiiria, barabwo bakamorwania.

english: But the Syrians fled before Israel ; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots , and forty thousand footmen , and killed Shophach the captain of the host .
ekegusii: Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli; na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani barenge gotaara namagoro chilifu emerongo ene (40,000). Boigo agaita Sofaki, omochiki obo bw’abasikari.

english: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe na Daudi, bakebeka inse yaye. Ase ayio Abasiiria tibanchete gokonya Abaamoni naende.

english: And David said , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun , to comfort him.
ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Goika inkorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, ekiagera ise nigo arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Abasomba abwo ba Daudi bakagenda ase Hanuni agwo ase ense y’Abaamoni komoremia.

english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search , and to overthrow , and to spy out the land ?
ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani b’Abaamoni bagateebia Hanuni, “Inee! Igo okagete ng’a Daudi nigo asigete iso ase ogotoma abanto gocha gokoremia? Taibo. Abasomba baye nigo bachire koroota ense eye bayesarie.”

english: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants , and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks , and sent them away .
ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba ba Daudi akabagingira chinderu chiabo, na akabutora chianga chiabo chikaba ebimini, agachiikeria ebinema, erio akabaseria bakagenda.

english: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
ekegusii: Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota na kobateebia, “Omorwoti oteebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”

english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria-maachah , and out of Zobah .
ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bekorire koba okogechia ase Daudi, erio Hanuni na Abaamoni bagatoma chifeta chitalanta elifu eyemo goakanera chigari na abariini chibarasi chiare korwa Mesopotamia na Aramu‐Maaka, na korwa Soba.

english: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maachah and his people ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .
ekegusii: Bagasaba chigari chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000) amo nomorwoti o Maaka na abarwani baye b’esegi. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora bosio bwa Medeba. Abaamoni bagasangererigwa korwa ase emechie yabo, bagacha korwana esegi.

english: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo nabarwani bonsi chituoni b’esegi.

english: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array before the gate of the city : and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field .
ekegusii: Abaamoni bagacha bakarobera agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie, na abarwoti baria konya bachire bakabeera boka aase aarabu.

english: Adam , Sheth , Enosh ,
ekegusii: Adamu akaibora Seti, na Seti akaibora Enosu;

english: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be mighty upon the earth .
ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw’eritang’ani orenge egiata ase ense.

english: And Mizraim begat Ludim , and Anamim , and Lehabim , and Naphtuhim ,
ekegusii: Misiri nere oiborete Abaludi na Abanami, Abalehabi na Abanafutu,

english: And Pathrusim , and Casluhim , (of whom came the Philistines ,) and Caphthorim .
ekegusii: Abapaturusi na Abakasiluhi (korwa ase bare nao Abafirisiti barwete), na Abakafitori.

english: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn , and Heth ,
ekegusii: Na Kaanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,

english: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite , and the Girgashite ,
ekegusii: Abayebusi na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi;

english: And the Hivite , and the Arkite , and the Sinite ,
ekegusii: Abahivi na Abaariki, na Abasini;

english: And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite .
ekegusii: Abaarivadi na Abasemari, na Abahamati.

english: The sons of Shem ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram , and Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Meshech .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu na Asuri, Arifakisadi na Ludi, Aramu na Usi, Huli na Geteri, na Mesheki.

english: And Arphaxad begat Shelah , and Shelah begat Eber .
ekegusii: Arifakisadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.

english: And unto Eber were born two sons : the name of the one was Peleg ; because in his days the earth was divided : and his brother’s name was Joktan .
ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Oria omotangi nigo arenge korokwa Pelegi, + 1:19 Pelegi: engencho yaye: ogwatananekana ekiagera ase amatuko aye abanto b’ense baatananegete, na omomura omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Yokitani.

english: Kenan , Mahalaleel , Jered ,
ekegusii: Enosu akaibora Kenani, na Kenani akaibora Mahalaleli, na Mahalaleli akaibora Yaredi;

english: And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
ekegusii: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi na Selefu, Hasarmaweti na Yera;

english: Hadoram also, and Uzal , and Diklah ,
ekegusii: Hadoramu na Usali, na Dikila;

english: And Ebal , and Abimael , and Sheba ,
ekegusii: Ebali na Abimaeli, na Seba;

english: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab . All these were the sons of Joktan .
ekegusii: Ofiri na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yokitani.

english: Shem , Arphaxad , Shelah ,
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Aburaamu korwa ase Shemu narwo oro: Shemu akaibora Arifakisadi, na Arifakisadi akaibora Sela,

english: Eber , Peleg , Reu ,
ekegusii: na Eberi, na Pelegi, na Reu,

english: Serug , Nahor , Terah ,
ekegusii: na Serugi, na Nahori, na Tera,

english: Abram ; the same is Abraham .
ekegusii: na Aburamu nere Aburaamu. Ororeria rwa Isumaeli (Omoch 25:12-16)

english: The sons of Abraham ; Isaac , and Ishmael .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Aburaamu nabwo Isaka na Isumaeli.

english: These are their generations : The firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth ; then Kedar , and Adbeel , and Mibsam ,
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeria rwabo. Omwana omomura omotangi o Isumaeli nere Nebayoti; na abande nabwo aba: Kedari na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu;

english: Henoch , Methuselah , Lamech ,
ekegusii: Yaredi akaibora Enoku, na Enoku akaibora Metusela, na Metusela akaibora Lameki;

english: Mishma , and Dumah , Massa , Hadad , and Tema ,
ekegusii: Misima na Duma, Masa na Hadadi, na Tema,

english: Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah . These are the sons of Ishmael .
ekegusii: Yeturi na Nafisi, na Kedema. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Isumaeli.

english: Now the sons of Keturah , Abraham’s concubine : she bare Zimran , and Jokshan , and Medan , and Midian , and Ishbak , and Shuah . And the sons of Jokshan ; Sheba , and Dedan .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ketura, omokungu o sere‐sere o Aburaamu, nabwo aba: Simurani na Yokisani, Medani na Midiani, Isibaki na Sua. Abana abamura ba Yokisani nabwo Seba na Dedani.

english: And the sons of Midian ; Ephah , and Epher , and Henoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these are the sons of Keturah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa na Eferi, Hanoki na Abida, na Elidaa. Aba bonsi nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Ketura. Ororeria rwa Esau (Omoch 36:1-19)

english: And Abraham begat Isaac . The sons of Isaac ; Esau and Israel .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaibora Isaka. Abana abamura ba Isaka nabwo Esau na Israeli.

english: The sons of Esau ; Eliphaz , Reuel , and Jeush , and Jaalam , and Korah .
