ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Esau nabwo aba: Elifasi na Reueli, Yeusi na Yalamu, na Kora.

english: The sons of Eliphaz ; Teman , and Omar , Zephi , and Gatam , Kenaz , and Timna , and Amalek .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, Sefo na Gatamu, Kenasi ase Timuna, na Amaleki.

english: The sons of Reuel ; Nahath , Zerah , Shammah , and Mizzah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reueli nabwo aba: Nahati na Zera, Sama na Miza. Abanto bamenyete ase ense ya Edomu kare (Omoch 36:20-30)

english: And the sons of Seir ; Lotan , and Shobal , and Zibeon , and Anah , and Dishon , and Ezer , and Dishan .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Edomu nabwo aba: Lotani na Sobali, Sibeoni na Ana, Dishoni na Eseri, na Disani.

english: And the sons of Lotan ; Hori , and Homam : and Timna was Lotan’s sister .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Homamu; omosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.

english: Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
ekegusii: Lameki akaibora Nuhu, na Nuhu akaibora Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. + 1:4 Yafeti: nigo kerikire amarieta oka

english: The sons of Shobal ; Alian , and Manahath , and Ebal , Shephi , and Onam . And the sons of Zibeon ; Aiah , and Anah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sobali nabwo aba: Aliani na Manahati, Ebali na Sefo, na Onamu. Na abana abamura ba Sibeoni nabwo Aya na Ana.

english: The sons of Anah ; Dishon . And the sons of Dishon ; Amram , and Eshban , and Ithran , and Cheran .
ekegusii: Omwana omomura bw’Ana nere Dishoni. Abana ba Dishoni nabwo aba: Hamurani na Esibani, Itirani na Kerani.

english: The sons of Ezer ; Bilhan , and Zavan , and Jakan . The sons of Dishan ; Uz , and Aran .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseri nabwo aba: Bilihani na Sawani, na Akani. Abana abamura ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani. Abarwoti b’Abaedomu (Omoch 36:31-43)

english: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel ; Bela the son of Beor : and the name of his city was Dinhabah .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarwoti bagamberete ense y’Abaedomu, ekero omorwoti onde bwensi konya ataragambera Abaisraeli: Bela, mosinto o Beori, oyio omochie oye orenge korokwa Dinihaba.

english: And when Bela was dead , Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Ekero Bela akwete, Yobabu, mosinto o Zera, korwa Bosira, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And when Jobab was dead , Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Ekero Yobabu akwete, Husamu, bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And when Husham was dead , Hadad the son of Bedad , which smote Midian in the field of Moab , reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith .
ekegusii: Ekero Husamu akwete, Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, oria obuete Abamidiani ase ense ya Moabu, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye; na omochie oye noro Awiti.

english: And when Hadad was dead , Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Ekero Hadadi akwete, Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And when Samlah was dead , Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Ekero Samula akwete, Saulo oyo orwete Rehoboti, orenge ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And when Shaul was dead , Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akwete, Baali Hanani, mosinto bw’Akibori, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: The sons of Japheth ; Gomer , and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Tubal , and Meshech , and Tiras .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri na Magogu, Madai na Yavani, Tubali na Meseki, na Tirasi.

english: And when Baal-hanan was dead , Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai ; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel , the daughter of Matred , the daughter of Mezahab .
ekegusii: Ekero Baali‐Hanani akwete, Hadadi akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Omochie oye nigo orenge korokwa Pai, na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi o Mesahabu.

english: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah , duke Aliah , duke Jetheth ,
ekegusii: Na Hadadi agakwa. Abagaambi b’Abaedomu nabwo aba: Timuna na Alifa, na Yeteti,

english: Duke Aholibamah , duke Elah , duke Pinon ,
ekegusii: Oholibama na Ela, na Pinoni,

english: Duke Kenaz , duke Teman , duke Mibzar ,
ekegusii: Kenasi na Temani, na Mibusari,

english: Duke Magdiel , duke Iram . These are the dukes of Edom .
ekegusii: Magadieli na Iramu. Abwo nabwo barenge abagaambi b’ebisaku bia Edomu.

english: And the sons of Gomer ; Ashchenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi na Rifati, na Togarima.

english: And the sons of Javan ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.

english: The sons of Ham ; Cush , and Mizraim , Put , and Canaan .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi na Misiri, Putu na Kaanani.

english: And the sons of Cush ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabta , and Raamah , and Sabtecha . And the sons of Raamah ; Sheba , and Dedan .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba na Havila, Sabuta na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana abamura ba Raama nabwo Seba na Dedani.

english: And David took the crown of their king from off his head , and found it to weigh a talent of gold , and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head : and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarusia egutwa y’etaabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omorwoti bw’aroro, akanyora ng’a oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye, naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekwa igoro y’omotwe o Daudi. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria.

english: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Naende akabasokia abanto barenge ase omochie ime, akababetereria gokora emeremo ne chinseke, na amakombe ’ebioma, na ebisire. Naboigo Daudi akorete abanto b’emechie yonsi y’Abaamoni. Erio akairana Yerusalemu amo nabaanto baye. Abaisraeli bakorwania amamonto ’Abafilisti (2 Sam 21:15-22)

english: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines ; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai , that was of the children of the giant : and they were subdued .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi ekaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abafirisiti agwo Geseri. Sibekai Omohusa agaita Sipai, omonto bw’ororeria rw’amamonto; na igo Abafirisiti bakabugwa na kogamberwa.

english: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant .
ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba agwo Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo, oyorenge nebiara bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.

english: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
ekegusii: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, omomura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.

english: These were born unto the giant in Gath ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Abwo nigo Daudi na abanto baye baabaitete.

english: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .
ekegusii: Saitani akagania gochanda Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi ase okobara Abaisraeli.

english: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee.
ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Daudi, omoteebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ngochia kogokorera.”

english: So Gad came to David , and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Choose thee
ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Chora erimo eri oranche.

english: Either three years’ famine ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
ekegusii: Noganetie enchara echiche ase emiaka etato; gose nigo oganetie oserigwe nababisa bao ase engaki y’emetienyi etato, babe bakobabuna‐buna na kobaita nemioro; gose mochandwe n’omoro Omonene ase amatuko atato, ekero oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto borache igoro ase ense eye yaino, na omomalaika bw’Omonene ogosaria ense y’Abaisraeli? Bono nteebie aya ngochia koiraneria oria ontoma.”

english: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .
ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki bono, tiga ingwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amaabera aye namanene mono; korende ase amaboko a Mwanyabaanto tintageti ingweo.”

english: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel : and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita; Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa.

english: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying , the LORD beheld , and he repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand . And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
ekegusii: Nyasae agatoma omomalaika oye gochia ase Yerusalemu koyosaria; korende ekero omomalaika oria abeete ang’e koyosaria, Omonene akaywechandera, akaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye igoro y’obobe boria, agateebia omomalaika oria ogendererete gosaria omochie, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao!” Omomalaika oria konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Orinani + 21:15 Orinani: erieta riaye rinde: Arauna (rora boigo ebibungo 18-8) Omoyebusi.

english: And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .
ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chi’echigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

english: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee, O LORD my God , be on me, and on my father’s house ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Inee! Tari inche nachigete abanto bakabarwa? Ninche nakorire ebibe; nakorire amang’ana amabe mono. Korende ching’ondi echi, ninki chiakorire? Nagosabire aye Omonene, Nyasae one, tiga okoboko kwao kong’ake inche amo neamate ya tata; korende oborwaire tibobaisa goita abanto bao.”

english: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David , that David should go up , and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agachiika Gadi ateebie Daudi ng’a agende atenenie egesasiimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani, Omoyebusi.

english: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene koria Gadi amotebetie Daudi, Daudi agatiira.

english: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan ; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it .
ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agateebia Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abasikari, “Genda mobare Abaisraeli korwa Beeri‐Seba goika Dani, erio mondetere amang’ana imanye omobaro obo.”

english: And Ornan turned back , and saw the angel ; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat .
ekegusii: Bono Orinani nigo arenge koora engano, na agwo akeonchora akarora omomalaika, na abana baye abamura baane abarenge amo nero bakebisa.

english: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .
ekegusii: Daudi agacha ase Orinani, na ekero Orinani amorooche akarua agwo ase ekeooreri, agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase obosio bwa Daudi.

english: Then David said to Ornan , Grant me the place of this threshingfloor , that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD : thou shalt grant it me for the full price : that the plague may be stayed from the people .
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Orinani, “Ing’a ensemo eyio y’ekeooreri, ing’agachere Omonene egesasiimero, erinde oborwaire botangwe korwa ase abanto. Inche ningakane rigori riaye rionsi.”

english: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering ; I give it all.
ekegusii: Erio Orinani agateebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omorwoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi’okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”

english: And king David said to Ornan , Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamoteebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”

english: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .
ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaa Orinani etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli amagana atano na rimo agoakanera ekeooreri keria.

english: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the LORD ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .
ekegusii: Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro, akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, agasaba Omonene, nere akamoiraneria ase ogotoma omorero korwa igoro gocha ase egesasiimero keria gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.

english: And the LORD commanded the angel ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agachiika omomalaika oria, na ere akairania omoyio oye ime ase ekegoocho + 21:27 ekegoocho: engencho yaye n’ekeraro ki’omoyio .

english: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite , then he sacrificed there.
ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eria, ekero Daudi aroche ng’a Omonene oiraneirie ogosaba kwaye ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi, akarua ebing’wanso biaye aroro agwo.

english: For the tabernacle of the LORD , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .
ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eria Eema y’Omonene, eria Musa atenenetie agwo ase erooro, na egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo kiarenge agwo aase aimokererete igoro aaria Gibeoni.

english: And Joab answered , The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king , are they not all my lord’s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?
ekegusii: Yoabu agateeba, “Omonene amente abanto baye bamentekane ara rigana ase omobaro obo. Inee! Aye omorwoti, omonene one, abanto aba bonsi tibari abasomba bao? Nase ki aye omonene one okogania gokora ayio? Nase ki ogochia korenta okomocha igoro ase Abaisraeli?”

english: But David could not go before it to enquire of God : for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende Daudi tagendete ase egesasiimero keria koboria Nyasae, ekiagera nigo oboete omoyio oria bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene.

english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab . Wherefore Joab departed , and went throughout all Israel , and came to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omorwoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akaimoka akagenda ase Abaisraeli bonsi, erio akairana gocha Yerusalemu.

english: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
ekegusii: Yoabu akaa Daudi omobaro bw’abaanto. Ase Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge komanya korwana esegi nemioro nigo barenge abanto emilioni eyemo, ne chilifu rigana erimo (1,100,000), na ase Abayuda abanto chilifu amagana ane na emerongo etano na ebere (470,000).

english: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab .
ekegusii: Korende Yoabu tabarete Abalawi na Ababenjamini, ekiagera ogochika koria omorwoti aruete nigo kwamogechetie.

english: And God was displeased with this thing ; therefore he smote Israel .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akoregete akagechia Nyasae; ere akaa Abaisraeli amaakwa.

english: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing : but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant ; for I have done very foolishly .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri obonene.”

english: And the LORD spake unto Gad , David’s seer , saying ,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Gadi, omoorori o Daudi, akamoteebia,

english: Then David said , This is the house of the LORD God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .
ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Aiga nao egesasiimero ki’Omonene kerabe ase Abaisraeli bakoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.” Okwebeka ang’e ase okoagacha enyomba ya Nyasae

english: He shall build an house for my name ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .
ekegusii: Ere naagache enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane. Ere nabe omwana one, nainche nimbe ise, na inche ninkore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli kebe ne chinguru goika kare na kare.

english: Now, my son , the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God , as he hath said of thee.
ekegusii: “Bono omwana one, Omonene abe amo naye, erio obe nokogenderera okuya ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna akwanete igoro yao.

english: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God .
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene akoe obong’aini na okomanya, erio ekero orabe gokogambera Abaisraeli obwate amachiiko a Omonene, Nyasae oo.

english: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver ; and of brass and iron without weight ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared ; and thou mayest add thereto.
ekegusii: Ase ogwechanda mono nasangereirie ebinto bi’okoagachera enyomba y’Omonene. Nasangereirie chitaabu chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) ne chifeta chitalanta emilioni eyemo (1,000,000), ne chitaai amo nebioma ebinge mono, bitari korengeka. Boigo narentire chibao na amagena. Ase ebinto ebio naye omente ebinde.

english: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .
ekegusii: Nigo obwate abakori emeremo abange: abaabaachi amagena, na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, na abanto bamanyete gokora emeremo ende yonsi

english: Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the LORD be with thee.
ekegusii: ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, na etai. Imoka, ochake gokora emeremo! Omonene abe amo naye.”

english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son , saying ,
ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli ng’a babe bagokonya Sulemani, omwana oye, akabateebia,

english: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side ? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand ; and the land is subdued before the LORD , and before his people .
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari amo nainwe? Naende tabaete omorembe ase chinsemo chiaino chionsi? Ere obekire abanto abanyene ense eye ase okoboko kwane; na ense eye nkogambera yabekirwe inse y’Omonene na inse y’abanto baye.

english: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God ; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Bono beka ebirengererio biaino ne chinkoro chiaino ase okomorigia Omonene, Nyasae oino. Imoka moagache obomenyo Obochenu ase Omonene, erinde Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na ebikorero ebichenu bia Nyasae birentwe ime ase enyomba eye eraagachwe ase engencho yerieta ri’Omonene.”

english: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .
ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abamenyi abarenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli basangererigwe amo, akababeeka kobaacha amagena na koyaroisia ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings ; and brass in abundance without weight ;
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarenta ebioma ebinge bi’okoroisigwa emesumari y’ebisieri bi’ebiita amo nebibwatero, akarenta ne chitaai chinyinge chitare korengeka.

english: Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .
ekegusii: Boigo akarenta chibao chi’emecharake chitare kobareka, ekiagera Abasidoni nigo barenterete Daudi emecharake emenge mono.

english: And David said , Solomon my son is young and tender , and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical , of fame and of glory throughout all countries : I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death .
ekegusii: Daudi nigo arengereretie ng’a Sulemani, omwana oye omoke otaramanya amange, na enyomba egochia koagachwa ase Omonene goika ebe engiya mono, naende eramanyekane ase ense yonsi ng’a nigo ere nobonene; na igo ere bweka goika abeeke ebinto bionsi ang’e. Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria ebinto ebinge ekero atarakwa.

english: Then he called for Solomon his son , and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel .
ekegusii: Akarangeria Sulemani, omwana oye, akamochika aagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli enyomba.

english: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia: Aye gwaiteire amanyinga amange, naende kwarwanire chiseegi chinene; na ase engencho y’amanyinga aya amange gwaiteire ase obosio bwane tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane.

english: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest ; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about : for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days .
ekegusii: Rora noiborerwe omwana omomura oyorabe omonto bw’omorembe; inche nimoe omorembe ase ababisa baye bonsi bamoetanaine. Nigo ararokwe Sulemani, na ase amatuko aye ning’ee Abaisraeli omorembe na obotoereru.

english: And the sons of Shimei were , Jahath , Zina , and Jeush , and Beriah . These four were the sons of Shimei .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba baane: Yahati na Sina, Yeusi na Beria.

english: And Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second : but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons ; therefore they were in one reckoning , according to their father’s house .
ekegusii: Yahati nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Sisa oyo o kabere, korende Yeusi na Beria tibabwate abana abamura abange; ase ayio bakabeekeranigwa amo ase okobarwa, bakaba eamate eyemo.

english: The sons of Kohath ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba baane: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.

english: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa, omonto o Nyasae, bakabareranigwa amo negesaku kia Lawi.

english: The sons of Moses were , Gershom , and Eliezer .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa nabwo Gerisomu na Eliezeri.

english: Of the sons of Gershom , Shebuel was the chief .
ekegusii: Ase abana ba Gerisomu Sebueli nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

english: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief . And Eliezer had none other sons ; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .
ekegusii: Ase abana b’Eliezeri Rehabia nere orenge omoteneneri obo. Eliezeri tabwate abana abamura bande; korende abana abamura ba Rehabia nigo barenge abange mono.

english: Of the sons of Izhar ; Shelomith the chief .
ekegusii: Ase abana ba Isari, Selomiti nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

english: Of the sons of Hebron ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Amaria, oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu, oyo o kane.

english: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .
ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli amo nabakuani na Abalawi.

english: Of the sons of Uzziel ; Michah the first , and Jesiah the second .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo Mika, omoteneneri obo, na Isia, oyo o kabere.

english: The sons of Merari ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli ; Eleazar , and Kish .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi; na abana abamura ba Mali nabwo Eleazari na Kisi.

english: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
ekegusii: Eleazari nigo akwete atabwati abana abamura, korende nabwate abana abaiseke. Abanto bamwabo, abana abamura ba Kisi, bakanyuoma abaiseke baria.

english: The sons of Mushi ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba batato: Mali, na Ederi, na Yeremoti.

english: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD , from the age of twenty years and upward .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi ase chiamate chiabo amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiria, buna barigetwe kera oyomo ase erieta riaye. Abwo nigo barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, na nigo baisanerete gokora emeremo y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: For David said , The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :
ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oeire abanto baye obotoereru, na bono ere nigo amenyete Yerusalemu kare na kare.

english: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :
ekegusii: Ase amatuko omoerio o Daudi, Abalawi bonsi bakarikwa, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania.

english: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size ;
ekegusii: Naende babe bagotenenera emeremo y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na ey’obosie obonuke bw’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ey’emegati ere emeoo etabekiri memera, na ey’ekarangeire orogio, na ey’obosie bwochoganirie amaguta, na ey’ebirengo binde bionsi.

english: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
ekegusii: Abalawi abarenge nemiaka emerongo etato na goetania bakabarwa, na omobaro obo okaba chilifu emerongo etato na isano na isato (38,000).

english: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even ;
ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagotenenera kera rituko, mambia na mogoroba, bakoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.

english: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths , in the new moons , and on the set feasts , by number , according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD :
ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokonya ekero kende gionsi ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biarenge koruegwa ase Omonene, ase Chisabato na ase Emetienyi Emeyia, na ase Amatuko Amanene ande. Nigo baroberetigwe gokora emeremo eyio koreng’ana nomobaro oganeirie, bakagenderera koyekora botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eye mbabe bakorenda Eema y’Omosangererekano na Aase Aachenu, na bakonye abanto bamwabo ab’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: Of which , twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD ; and six thousand were officers and judges :
ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na baane (24,000) ase aba mbabe bagotenenera emeremo ye nyomba y’Omonene, na abanto chilifu isano nemo (6,000) nababe abateneneri na abagaambi ebiina;

english: Moreover four thousand were porters ; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made , said David , to praise therewith .
ekegusii: abanto chilifu inye (4,000) nababe abarendi b’ebiita na abanto chilifu inye (4,000) babe bagotogia Omonene n’ebinto ebio bikobugigwa naroisirie ase okomotogia.”

english: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

english: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan , and Shimei .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Ladani na Simei.

english: The sons of Laadan ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ladani nabwo aba batato: Yehieli, omoteneneri obo, na Setamu, na Yoel.

english: The sons of Shimei ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba batato: Selomoti na Hasieli na Harani. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani.

english: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron . The sons of Aaron ; Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebiombe bi’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.

english: The seventh to Hakkoz , the eighth to Abijah ,
ekegusii: obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Hakosi, na obwa gatano na gatato Abiya;

english: The ninth to Jeshua , the tenth to Shecaniah ,
ekegusii: obwa kianda bokagwera Yesua, na obwa ikomi Sekania;

english: The eleventh to Eliashib , the twelfth to Jakim ,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na rimo bokagwera Eliasibu, na obwa ikomi na kabere Yakimu;

english: The thirteenth to Huppah , the fourteenth to Jeshebeab ,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Hupa, na obwa ikomi na kane Yesebeabu;

english: The fifteenth to Bilgah , the sixteenth to Immer ,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera Biliga, na obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo Imeri;

english: The seventeenth to Hezir , the eighteenth to Aphses ,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere bokagwera Hesiri, na obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato Hapisesi;

english: The nineteenth to Pethahiah , the twentieth to Jehezekel ,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na kianda bokagwera Petahia, na obwa emerongo ebere Ezekieli;

english: The one and twentieth to Jachin , the two and twentieth to Gamul ,
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo bokagwera Yakini, na obwa emerongo ebere na kabere Gamuli;

english: The three and twentieth to Delaiah , the four and twentieth to Maaziah .
ekegusii: obwa emerongo ebere na gatato bokagwera Delaya, na obwa emerongo ebere na kane Maasia.

english: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD , according to their manner , under Aaron their father , as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio obo bw’obokoreri bwabo bw’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli buna Aroni, sokoro yabo, abarobereretie koreng’ana buna Omonene amochigeete. Abateneneri bande b’Abalawi

english: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram ; Shubael : of the sons of Shubael ; Jehdeiah .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abalawi bande: Subaeli bw’ororeria rw’Amuramu na Yehedia bw’ororeria rwa Subaeli;

english: Concerning Rehabiah : of the sons of Rehabiah , the first was Isshiah .
ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;

english: Of the Izharites ; Shelomoth : of the sons of Shelomoth ; Jahath .
ekegusii: Selomoti bw’ororeria rwa Isari, na Yahati bw’ororeria rwa Selomoti.

english: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , Jekameam the fourth .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria omotangi, na Amaria oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu oyo o kane;

english: Of the sons of Uzziel ; Michah : of the sons of Michah ; Shamir .
ekegusii: Mika bw’ororeria rwa Usieli, na Samiri bw’ororeria rwa Mika;

english: The brother of Michah was Isshiah : of the sons of Isshiah ; Zechariah .
ekegusii: Isia omomura omwabo Mika, na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Isia.

english: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi : the sons of Jaaziah ; Beno .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Omwana omomura o Yaasia nere Beno.

english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah ; Beno , and Shoham , and Zaccur , and Ibri .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari ase Yaasia, omwana oye omomura, nabwo aba: Beno na Sohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.

english: Of Mahli came Eleazar , who had no sons .
ekegusii: Omwana o Mali n’Eleazari; ere tabwate abana abamura.

english: Concerning Kish : the son of Kish was Jerahmeel .
ekegusii: Yerameeli nomwana omomura o Kisi.

english: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar , and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar , according to their offices in their service .
ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni na akaroberia buna bakore emeremo. Zadoki bw’ororeria rw’Eleazari na Ahimeleki bw’ororeria rwa Itamari barabwo m babete bakomokonya.

english: The sons also of Mushi ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jerimoth . These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba: Mali na Ederi, na Yerimoti. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi koreng’ana ne chiamate chiabo.

english: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king , and Zadok , and Ahimelech , and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites , even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren .
ekegusii: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, ekero Daudi omorwoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.

english: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar ; and thus were they divided . Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers , and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Eleazari bakanyorekana bare nabateneneri abange kobua abwo b’ororeria rwa Itamari. Ase ayio bakabeeka abanto ikomi na batano nomo b’ororeria rw’Eleazari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, na batano na batato b’ororeria rwa Itamari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

english: Thus were they divided by lot , one sort with another ; for the governors of the sanctuary , and governors of the house of God , were of the sons of Eleazar , and of the sons of Ithamar .
ekegusii: Igo baatananetwe ase ogoakerwa obomera, bonsi ase enchera eyemo, ekiagera abateneneri abwo b’Aase Aachenu na abwo ba Nyasae nigo bachoretwe korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari amo norwa Itamari.

english: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe , one of the Levites , wrote them before the king , and the princes , and Zadok the priest , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites : one principal household being taken for Eleazar , and one taken for Ithamar .
ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omorwoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani, na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.

english: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib , the second to Jedaiah ,
ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yehoyaribu, na obwa kabere Yedaya;

english: The third to Harim , the fourth to Seorim ,
ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;

english: The fifth to Malchijah , the sixth to Mijamin ,
ekegusii: obwa gatano bokagwera Malikia, na obwa gatano na rimo Miyamini;

english: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph , and of Heman , and of Jeduthun , who should prophesy with harps , with psalteries , and with cymbals : and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
ekegusii: Daudi amo nabatang’ani abarenge komokonya bagaatanana ase obokoreri abamura bande b’Asafu, na aba Hemani, na aba Yedutuni, baria barenge gochia kobana ase okobugia amakano ao ao, na goakania chisani chikwoga. Omoroberio bw’abaanto baria baetwe emeremo eria noro oyo.

english: The third to Zaccur , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa gatato bokagwera Sakuri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The fourth to Izri , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa kane bokagwera Isiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The fifth to Nethaniah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa gatano bokagwera Netania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The sixth to Bukkiah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na rimo bokagwera Bukia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The seventh to Jesharelah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Yesarela; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The eighth to Jeshaiah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na gatato bokagwera Yesaia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The ninth to Mattaniah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa kianda bokagwera Matania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The tenth to Shimei , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi bokagwera Simei; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The eleventh to Azareel , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na rimo (11) bokagwera Asareli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The twelfth to Hashabiah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kabere (12) bokagwera Hasabia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: Of the sons of Asaph ; Zaccur , and Joseph , and Nethaniah , and Asarelah , the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph , which prophesied according to the order of the king .
ekegusii: Ase abana abamura b’Asafu nabwo aba: Sakuri na Yusufu, Netania na Asarela. Abamura aba bakaba inse y’oboraai bw’Asafu ise, oyorenge kobana inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.

english: The thirteenth to Shubael , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatato (13) bokagwera Subaeli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The fourteenth to Mattithiah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kane (14) bokagwera Matitia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The fifteenth to Jeremoth , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera (15) Yeremoti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The sixteenth to Hananiah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo (16) bokagwera Hanania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere (17) bokagwera Yosibekasa; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The eighteenth to Hanani , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato (18) bokagwera Hanani; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The nineteenth to Mallothi , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kianda (19) bokagwera Maloti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The twentieth to Eliathah , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere (20) bokagwera Eliata; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The one and twentieth to Hothir , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo (21) bokagwera Hotiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The two and twentieth to Giddalti , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kabere (22) bokagwera Gidaliti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: Of Jeduthun : the sons of Jeduthun ; Gedaliah , and Zeri , and Jeshaiah , Hashabiah , and Mattithiah , six , under the hands of their father Jeduthun , who prophesied with a harp , to give thanks and to praise the LORD .
ekegusii: Amo na Yedutuni nigo barenge abamura baye: Gedalia na Seri, Yesaia na Simei, Hesabia na Matitia. Abamura aba batano nomo bakaba inse y’oboraai bwa Yedutuni ise, oyorenge kobana ase okobugia obokano ase okoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.

english: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve :
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na gatato (23) bokagwera Mahasioti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer , he , his sons , and his brethren , were twelve .
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kane (24) bokagwera Romamuti‐Eseri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: Of Heman : the sons of Heman ; Bukkiah , Mattaniah , Uzziel , Shebuel , and Jerimoth , Hananiah , Hanani , Eliathah , Giddalti , and Romamti-ezer , Joshbekashah , Mallothi , Hothir , and Mahazioth :
ekegusii: Amo na Hemani nigo barenge abamura baye: Bukia na Matania, Usieli na Sebueli, Yerimoti na Hanania, Hanani na Eliata, Gidaliti na Romamuti‐Eseri, Yosibekasa na Maloti, Horiti na Mahasioti.

english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God , to lift up the horn . And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters .
ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Hemani, omoorori bw’omorwoti. Nyasae amorierete eira y’okomokong’ia; ase ayio akamoa abana abamura ikomi na baane, na abaiseke batato.

english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD , with cymbals , psalteries , and harps , for the service of the house of God , according to the king’s order to Asaph , Jeduthun , and Heman .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bwa ise ekero barenge goteera agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene na goakania chisani chikwoga, amo na kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu na Yedutuni, na Hemani nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.

english: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD , even all that were cunning , was two hundred fourscore and eight .
ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

english: And they cast lots , ward against ward , as well the small as the great , the teacher as the scholar .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi, abake na abanene, aborokia na aborokigwa, bagaaka obomera ase ogwatanana emeremo yabo.

english: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph : the second to Gedaliah , who with his brethren and sons were twelve :
ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).

english: Concerning the divisions of the porters : Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore , of the sons of Asaph .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kora, Meselemia, omwana omomura o Kora bw’ororeria rw’Asafu.

english: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons ; Simri the chief , (for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief ;)
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hosa b’ororeria rwa Merari nabwo aba: Simuri, omoteneneri obo, nonya tarenge omotangi, ise akamobeka akaba omoteneneri.

english: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .
ekegusii: Hilikia nigo arenge oyo o kabere, na Tebalia oyo o gatato, na Zakaria oyo o kane. Aba nabamura ba Hosa amo nabamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batato.

english: Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebiombe ebio bi’abarendi b’ebiita amo nabatang’ani babo nigo babegetwe gokora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene buna Abalawi bamwabo barenge gokora.

english: And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .
ekegusii: Abanto ba kera eamate, enke na enene, bagaaka obomera bamanye ngeita ki baraarende.

english: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counsellor , they cast lots ; and his lot came out northward .
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Selemia ase okorenda egeita kia moocha. Naende bagaakera Zakaria, omomura oye, obomera, bokamochora korenda egeita gia sugusu. Ere nigo arenge omosemia omong’aini.

english: To Obed-edom southward ; and to his sons the house of Asuppim .
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Obedi‐Edomu, bokamochora korenda egeita kia Irianyi, na abamura baye bakaegwa korenda ebigachero.

english: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
ekegusii: Supimu na Hosea bagachorwa korenda ensemo ya bosongo, agwo ase Egeita gia Saleketi, ase enchera egotiira, na oborendi obomo bogachikana nobonde.

english: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .
ekegusii: Abarendi batano nomo nigo barenge kobeera ensemo ya moocha kera rituko, na ensemo ya sugusu mbaane kera rituko, na ensemo ya Irianyi mbaane kera rituko; na ase ebigachero babere babere.

english: At Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .
ekegusii: Ase akanyomba kaagachire ensemo ya bosongo, abarendi baane nigo barenge agwo ase enchera, na babere ase akanyomba karia.

english: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore , and among the sons of Merari .
ekegusii: Ebi nabio biarenge ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita korwa ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Kora na orwa Merari. Emeremo ende egokorwa ase Hekalu

english: And the sons of Meshelemiah were , Zechariah the firstborn , Jediael the second , Zebadiah the third , Jathniel the fourth ,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia nabwo aba: Zakaria omwana oye omotangi; Yediaeli oyo o kabere; Zebadia oyo o gatato; Yatinieli oyo o kane.

english: And of the Levites , Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God , and over the treasures of the dedicated things .
ekegusii: Ahiya oyomo bw’Abalawi nere otenenerete chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, naende nere orendete ebiatananetwe bikaba ebichenu.

english: As concerning the sons of Laadan ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
ekegusii: Abamura b’ororeria rwa Ladani, nabwo Abagerisoni, nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani Omogerisoni. Ase abwo nigo barenge Abayehieli.

english: The sons of Jehieli ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abamura babere b’Abayehieli, Setamu na Yoel momura omwabo, abwo bakaba bagotenenera chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
ekegusii: Ase ebiombe bie chinderia chi’Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli:

english: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
ekegusii: Sebueli, omomura o Gerisomu, mosinto o Musa, nere orenge omoteneneri omonene bwe chikungo chiria.

english: And his brethren by Eliezer ; Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomith his son .
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo korwa ase Eliezeri nigo barenge Rehabia, omomura oye, na Yesaia omomura oye, na Yoramu omomura oye, na Sikiri omomura oye, na Selomiti omomura oye.

english: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things , which David the king , and the chief fathers , the captains over thousands and hundreds , and the captains of the host , had dedicated .
ekegusii: Selomiti na abamwabo nabwo batenenerete chikungo chionsi chi’ebiegwa Daudi omorwoti aatananerete Omonene, amo nebio abateneneri be chiamate, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na abachiki b’abasikari baatananete bikaba ebichenu.

english: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebinto binde biasakoretwe ekero gi’esegi bigaatananwa bikaba ebiegwa ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .
ekegusii: Naboigo, nebiegwa bionsi biria Samweli omoorori, na Saulo, mosinto o Kisi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya baatananete. Ebinto bionsi bikabekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Selomiti na abamwabo. Emeremo y’Abalawi bande

english: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisari, Kenania na abamura baye bagachorwa gokora emeremo ya isiko buna abatang’ani b’emeremo ao ao, na abagaambi ebiina.

english: Elam the fifth , Jehohanan the sixth , Elioenai the seventh .
ekegusii: Elamu oyo o gatano; Yehohanani oyo o gatano na rimo; Eliehoenai oyo o gatano na kabere.

english: And of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brethren , men of valour , a thousand and seven hundred , were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD , and in the service of the king .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Hasabia na abanto b’eamate yaye, elifu eyemo na amagana atano na abere (1,700), abanto abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo, bakabeekwa ensemo ya bosongo ya Yorodani gotenenera Abaisraeli ase emeremo yonsi y’Omonene na ey’omorwoti.

english: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ene bw’okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).

english: And his brethren , men of valour , were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers , whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites , the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh , for every matter pertaining to God , and affairs of the king .
ekegusii: Abanto baria abamwabo Yeria nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na abere (2,700), abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, bamanyete korwana esegi buya. Barabwo Daudi omorwoti akababeeka bakaba abateneneri b’abaanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, na ab’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae na ey’omorwoti.

english: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him.
ekegusii: Amieli oyo o gatano na rimo; Isakaru oyo o gatano na kabere; Peuletai oyo o gatano na gatato. Nyasae nigo asesenetie Obedi‐Edomu.

english: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born , that ruled throughout the house of their father : for they were mighty men of valour .
ekegusii: Semaya, omomura oye, akaiborerwa abana abamura bakaba abateneneri be chiamate chiabo; abwo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase emeremo yabo.

english: The sons of Shemaiah ; Othni , and Rephael , and Obed , Elzabad , whose brethren were strong men , Elihu , and Semachiah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Semaya nabwo aba: Otini na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elisabadi; boigo Elihu na Semakia, abamura bamwabo Semaya, nigo barenge abamura abakong’u mono ase emeremo yabo.

english: All these of the sons of Obed-edom : they and their sons and their brethren , able men for strength for the service , were threescore and two of Obed-edom .
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge b’ororeria rw’Obedi‐Edomu. Barabwo amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u, bamanyete gokora emeremo yabo. Bonsi abwo b’Obedi‐Edomu nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo na babere.

english: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren , strong men , eighteen .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia amo nabaanto bamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batano, abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo.

english: Now the children of Israel after their number , to wit , the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds , and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses , which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year , of every course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’Abaisraeli na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo na obw’abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na obw’abateneneri b’emeremo ende yonsi ase oborwoti. Kera omotienyi ase omwaka ekeombe ki’abaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000), nigo kiarenge gokora emeremo inse y’oboraai bw’omotang’ani bw’omotienyi oyio.

english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite , of the children of Ephraim : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na kabere, Helesi, Omopeloni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite , of the Zarhites : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw’ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi-ezer the Anetothite , of the Benjamites : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o kianda, Abieseri korwa Anatoti bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kianda. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite , of the Zarhites : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi, Maharai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rwa Zera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite , of the children of Ephraim : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite , of Othniel : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na kabere, Helidai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rw’Otinieli akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli

english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel : the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri : of the Simeonites , Shephatiah the son of Maachah :
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli: Eliezeri, mosinto o Sikiri, ase Abareubeni; Sefatia, mosinto o Maaka, ase Abasimeoni;

english: Of the Levites , Hashabiah the son of Kemuel : of the Aaronites , Zadok :
ekegusii: Hasabia, mosinto o Kemueli, ase Abalawi; Zadoki ase abanto ba Aroni;

english: Of Judah , Elihu , one of the brethren of David : of Issachar , Omri the son of Michael :
ekegusii: Elihu, oyomo bw’abamura bamwabo Daudi, ase Abayuda; Omuri, mosinto o Mikaeli, ase Abaisakaru;

english: Of Zebulun , Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah : of Naphtali , Jerimoth the son of Azriel :
ekegusii: Isimaya, mosinto bw’Obadia, ase Abasabuloni; Yerimoti, mosinto bw’Asirieli, ase Abanafutali;

english: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Yasobeamu, mosinto o Sabidieli, nere otenenerete ekeombe egetang’ani, ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani; ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: Of the children of Ephraim , Hoshea the son of Azaziah : of the half tribe of Manasseh , Joel the son of Pedaiah :
ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw’Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoel, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng’ese kende ki’egesaku kia Manase;

english: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead , Iddo the son of Zechariah : of Benjamin , Jaasiel the son of Abner :
ekegusii: Ido, mosinto o Zakaria, ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, keria kiarenge agwo Gileadi; Yaasieli, mosinto bw’Abineri ase Ababenjamini;

english: Of Dan , Azareel the son of Jeroham . These were the princes of the tribes of Israel .
ekegusii: Asareli, mosinto o Yerohamu, ase Abadani. Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.

english: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel : and over the storehouses in the fields , in the cities , and in the villages , and in the castles , was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah :
ekegusii: Asimaweti, mosinto bw’Adieli, agatenenera chimonga chi’omorwoti; na Yonathani, mosinto bwa Usia, agatenenera chimonga chi’ense eria, ase emechie emenene na emeke, na ase emerobiri.

english: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub :
ekegusii: Esiri, mosinto o Kelubi, agatenenera abakori emeremo b’emegondo, abarenge koyerema.

english: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite : over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite :
ekegusii: Simei Omoramati agatenenera emegondo y’emesabibu, na Sabidi Omosifumi agatenenera edivai ase yare kogachwa.

english: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite : and over the cellars of oil was Joash :
ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani Omogederi agatenenera emezeituni na emeko agwo ase ense omweya. Na Yoashi agatenenera ebigachero bi’amaguta ’amazeituni.

english: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite : and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai :
ekegusii: Sitirai Omosaroni agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia agwo Saroni, na Safati, mosinto bw’Adilai, agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia ase amakura.

english: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge bw’ororeria rwa Peresi, na orenge omochiki bw’abatang’ani bonsi b’abasikari ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani.

english: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite : and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite :
ekegusii: Obili Omoisumaeli agatenenera chingamia, na Yedaya Omomeroni agatenenera chitigere, na

english: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite . All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s .
ekegusii: Yasisi Omohagari agatenenera ching’ondi ne chimbori. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri ba chinibo chia Daudi omorwoti. Abasemia ba Daudi

english: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor , a wise man , and a scribe : and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons :
ekegusii: Yonathani, ise moke Daudi, nere orenge omosemia; nigo arenge omonto omong’aini naende omonyasemi. Ere na Yehieli, mosinto o Hakimoni, nigo barenge abateneneri b’abana abamura b’omorwoti.

english: And Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor : and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion :
ekegusii: Ahitofeli nere orenge omosemia bw’omorwoti, na Husai Omoariki nomosani bw’omorwoti orenge.

english: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah , and Abiathar : and the general of the king’s army was Joab .
ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Benaya, na Abiatari bakabeekwa ase ribaga ri’Ahitofeli g akuure. Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abasikari b’omorwoti.

english: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite , and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler : in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Dodadi bw’ororeria rw’Ahohi nere otenenerete ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Mikiloti nere orenge omokonyi oye.

english: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , a chief priest : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ekeombe kia gatato, ase omotienyi o gatato, nere Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada Omokuani. Benaya nigo arenge omotang’ani omonene, na ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: This is that Benaiah , who was mighty among the thirty , and above the thirty : and in his course was Ammizabad his son .
ekegusii: Benaya nere orenge omonto etuoni, omanyekanete ase baria Emerongo etato, naende orenge nomochiki obo. Amisabadi, omomura oye, nere orenge komokonya ase ekeombe ekio.

english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab , and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw’ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite : and in his course were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na rimo, Ira, mosinto o Ikesi Omotekoa akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abateneneri bonsi b’Abaisraeli bache Yerusalemu. Ase ayio abateneneri b’ebisaku, na ab’ebiombe biarenge gokorera omorwoti, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na baria batenenerete chinibo chionsi chi’omorwoti ne chiombe chiaye, na echi’abana baye, amo nabateneneri b’enyomba y’omorwoti, na abanto bonsi chituoni, na abwo bonsi barenge abakong’u ase esegi, bagacha aroro.

english: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
ekegusii: Bono bwerende, ekiagera Omonene ogochorire oagache enyomba ebe Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu. Obe omokong’u na okore ayio.”

english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat ,
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaa Sulemani, omwana oye, omogwekano bw’enyomba eria enke erabe bosio bwe Hekalu, na oyo bw’ebinyomba bie Hekalu, ne chikungo chie Hekalu, na obw’ebinyomba bia irongo, na ebinyomba bia ime, na obw’akanyomba k’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

english: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the LORD , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
ekegusii: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw’ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y’okoagacha chiraaro chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi’enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi’ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.

english: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Boigo akamoa emeroberio y’ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi buna barache gokora emeremo yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinto bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro y’oborito bwe chitaabu na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa kera egekorero kegokorerwa ase Hekalu,

english: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold , and for their lamps of gold , by weight for every candlestick , and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight , both for the candlestick , and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick .
ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitaabu chi’ebibekerero bie chitaaya na echie chitaaya chiria, na obwa kera ekebekerero gie chitaaya ao ao, na oborito bw’echifeta chia kera ekebekerero gie chitaaya, ne chitaaya chiria, koreng’ana nemeremo ya kera ekebekerero,

english: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread , for every table ; and likewise silver for the tables of silver :
ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitaabu chia kera emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa chimesa chi’echifeta.

english: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason ; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver :
ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro ye chigami, ne chisani, na ebitaabo biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire na igoro ye chibakuri chi’echitaabu, na echie chifeta, na oborito bwa kera eyemo;

english: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD .
ekegusii: na igoro y’egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani, keraroisigwe korwa ase etaabu echenire. Akamotebereria boigo igoro y’omooroberio oyo bw’egari y’etaabu nero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria baramborete chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na bayetubete.

english: All this, said David , the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern .
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Sulemani, “Aya onsi Omonene nigo andikerete nokoboko kwaye, akanyorokereria buna emeremo yonsi egochia gokoreka yare kobwatekana nomogwekano orwetwe.”

english: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed : for the LORD God , even my God , will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Naende Daudi agateebia Sulemani, omwana oye, “Obe omokong’u, naende omoremu, erio okore ayio. Toiroka, gose tokwa moyo, ekiagera Omonene, oyore Nyasae one, nigo are amo naye. Omonene takogotiga obugwe, goika emeremo yonsi y’enyomba yaye eere.

english: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .
ekegusii: Rora ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi baria barakore emeremo yonsi y’enyomba ya Nyasae nao bare aa; kera omonto ore nogwancha, naende omanyete emeremo ende yonsi, nabe naye ase emeremo yonsi. Boigo abaraai bonsi amo nabaanto bonsi nababe bagokora aya onsi orabachike.”

english: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name , because thou hast been a man of war , and hast shed blood .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agankania, aganteebia: Aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera kwarwanire chiseegi na gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto.

english: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever : for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler ; and of the house of Judah , the house of my father ; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel :
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aganchora korwa ase enyomba ya tata, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Nigo achorete Abayuda bakaba abaraai, na korwa ase Abayuda agachora enyomba ya tata, na ase egati y’abana baye Omonene akagokigwa nainche, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.

english: And of all my sons , (for the LORD hath given me many sons ,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel .
ekegusii: Omonene ong’eire abamura abange, na ase abwo bonsi ochorire Sulemani aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli abw’Omonene akogambera.

english: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
ekegusii: “Omonene agakwana aganteebia: Sulemani, omomura oo, nere oraagache enyomba yane ne chiraaro chiane, ekiagera namochorire abe omwana one, na inche nimbe ise.

english: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .
ekegusii: Ninkore oborwoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kare na kare karagenderere bokong’u kobwata na koigwera amachiiko aane, na emeroberio yane echiikire, buna agokora ase engaki eye.

english: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD , and in the audience of our God , keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God : that ye may possess this good land , and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio bono aiga ase amasio ’Abaisraeli bonsi bare omosangererekano bw’Omonene, na ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito oyotoigwete, morende mono amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae onio, na koyabwatia, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye engiya na koyetigera abana baino, ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe magega yaino.

english: And thou, Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind : for the LORD searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts : if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever .
ekegusii: “Naye Sulemani, omwana one, omomanye Nyasae one inche iso, naende omokorere nenkoro yao yonsi, na ase ogwancha kwao gwonsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro chionsi, naende nigo amanyete kera omooroberio na ebirengererio bionsi. Koramorigie, ere nanche omonyoore; korende onye gokomotiga, ere nigo aragotugute kare na kare.

english: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Daudi agatogia Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi, akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, sokoro yaito, kware gotogigwa korwa kare na gochia kare na kare!

english: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all.
ekegusii: Obotenenku bwonsi na amasikani nigo bikorwa asore aye, naye okogamba igoro ase bionsi. Ase okoboko kwao chinguru na okobua nao bire; nobwate okobua kw’ogokinia na korua chinguru ase bonsi.

english: Now therefore, our God , we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name .
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae oito, twakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono na gotogia erieta riao ri’obonene.

english: But who am I, and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
ekegusii: “Korende inche ninki ing’isaine, na abanto baane ninki baisaine, goika twanyarire korua ebinto ase ogwancha buna oko? Ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asore; ase ayio ebinto biaruete ase okoboko kwao nabio twakoeire.

english: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore ase ense y’obogeni, naende nigo tore abaeti ase obosio bwao, buna chisokoro chiaito chionsi chiarenge; amatuko aito ay’okomenya ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari, na ogosemeria konde tikoiyo.

english: O LORD our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own.
ekegusii: Ee, aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebinto ebi bionsi ebinge twarure ase okoagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riao richenu nigo bikorwa ase okoboko kwao, na bionsi nebiao aye omonyene.

english: I know also, my God , that thou triest the heart , and hast pleasure in uprightness . As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people , which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
ekegusii: Nyasae one, nimanyete ng’a aye nigo okorenga enkoro, naende nigo ogokirie nayare ay’oboronge. Ase enkoro endonge narure ebinto ebio bionsi nogwancha; na bono narorire abanto bao abare aiga bagokoruera nogwancha, naende ase omogooko omonge.

english: O LORD God of Abraham , Isaac , and of Israel , our fathers , keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people , and prepare their heart unto thee:
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli chisokoro chiaito, tiga abanto bao, bagenderere koba nekerenga eke na ebirengererio ase chinkoro chiabo botambe kogenderera, naende oonchore chinkoro chiabo chibeere asore.

english: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep thy commandments , thy testimonies , and thy statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for the which I have made provision .
ekegusii: Oe Sulemani, omwana one, enkoro yeruete asore, erinde arende amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, na emeroberio yao echiikire, akore aya onsi na aagache enyomba eria y’obonene nabeire nkobeeka ebinto bionsi ang’e ase okoyeagacha.”

english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
ekegusii: Inche ase ogokora aya narenge konyara, nabekire ebinto ang’e ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae one: chitaabu ase ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta, ne chitaai ase ebinto bie chitaai, na ebioma ase ebinto bi’ebioma, ne chibao ase ebinto bi’echibao.
