Amo n’ebinto ebio narure amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande ay’ogosata, ayare nebieni ao ao, akomeka‐meka, amo namagena ande amange amarabu akomeka‐meka.

english: And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the LORD your God . And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the LORD , and the king .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia omosangererekano bwonsi, “Togia Omonene, Nyasae oino!” Na omosangererekano bwonsi ogatogia Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, na agwo abanto baria bagatureka emetwe yabo, bagasasiima Omonene naende bakaorokia amasikani ase omorwoti.

english: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD , on the morrow after that day , even a thousand bullocks , a thousand rams , and a thousand lambs , with their drink offerings , and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel :
ekegusii: Ne rituko ria kabere barabwo bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso, bakamoruera nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa; chieri elifu eyemo, ne chimingichi elifu eyemo, ne chimanwa chi’eching’ondi elifu eyemo, amo nokoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa gwachikiire amo nabirobio, naende akarua ebing’wanso ebinge ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi.

english: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakaria na konywa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase rituko riria, bakaba nomogooko omonene. Bono eria kabere bakabeeka Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akaba omorwoti obo; bakamoaka amaguta akaba omogambi ase ogokorera Omonene, na Zadoki agaakwa amaguta akaba Omokuani.

english: And all the princes , and the mighty men , and all the sons likewise of king David , submitted themselves unto Solomon the king .
ekegusii: Abaraai bonsi, na abanto chituoni, amo nabamura bonsi ba Daudi omorwoti bakaria chiira ng’a mbabwatane nomorwoti Sulemani.

english: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel , and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel .
ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani erieta rinene ase egati y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende akamoa oborwoti bore nobonene obwo ataete omorwoti onde bwensi omotang’anerete agwo ase Abaisraeli. Amang’ana ameng’e igoro y’okogamba gwa Daudi

english: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .
ekegusii: Bono Daudi, mosinto o Yese, konya ogambeire Abaisraeli bonsi.

english: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Daudi agakwa ore omogotu mono bw’amatuko amange, nigo arenge omonto omonda osikire; na Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana aria Daudi omorwoti akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerie nigo ariikire ase chibuku chia Samweli omoorori, na ase echia Nathani omobani, na ase echia Gadi omoorori.

english: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
ekegusii: Boigo naende ekiagera nanchire na kwerwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae one, narure ase enyomba eye enchenu chinibo chiane chionsi chi’echitaabu ne chifeta komenta ase ebinto ebio bionsi konya narure.

english: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him, and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .
ekegusii: Bakariika amang’ana onsi igoro y’okogamba kwaye, na okobua kwaye, na amang’ana onsi amonyorete ere amo n’Abaisraeli, na amarwoti ande onsi ay’ense.

english: Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
ekegusii: Nkorua inde chitaabu, chitalanta chilifu isato, korwa ase Ofiri, ne chifeta chichenire chitalanta amagana atano na abere ase okooma chinyasi chi’enyomba,

english: The gold for things of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers . And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD ?
ekegusii: na ase emeremo ende yonsi egochia gokorwa nabaroisia ebinto, chitaabu ase ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta. Ning’o ogochia kwerwa ase ogwancha? Oyio tiga eatanane bweka omonyene ase Omonene rituko ria reero.”

english: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king’s work , offered willingly ,
ekegusii: Erio abateneneri be chiamate chiabo bakarua ebiegwa bi’ogwancha; abaraai b’ebisaku na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na abateneneri b’emeremo y’omorwoti boigo bakarua.

english: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams , and of silver ten thousand talents , and of brass eighteen thousand talents , and one hundred thousand talents of iron .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae chitaabu chitalanta chilifu isano ne chidarikoni chilifu ikomi, ne chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi, ne chitaai chitalanta chilifu ikomi na isano na isato, na ebioma chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo.

english: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi obwate amagena e rigori rinene akayarua, na amagena ayio akabeekwa ase ekungo y’enyomba y’Omonene, inse y’oborendi bwa Yehieli Omogerisoni.

english: Then the people rejoiced , for that they offered willingly , because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD : and David the king also rejoiced with great joy .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakaba nomogooko, ekiagera bonsi nigo baruete ase ogwancha, na ase chinkoro chieruete ase Omonene. Daudi omorwoti boigo akaba nomogooko omonene. Daudi ogotogia Nyasae

english: These are the sons of Israel ; Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah , Issachar , and Zebulun ,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Israeli: Rubeni, na Simioni, Lawi na Yuda, Isakaru na Sabuloni,

english: And Ram begat Amminadab ; and Amminadab begat Nahshon , prince of the children of Judah ;
ekegusii: Ramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nahasoni, oyo orenge omotang’ani bw’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda.

english: And Nahshon begat Salma , and Salma begat Boaz ,
ekegusii: Nahasoni akaibora Salima, na Salima akaibora Boazi,

english: And Boaz begat Obed , and Obed begat Jesse ,
ekegusii: Boazi akaibora Obedi, na Obedi akaibora Yese.

english: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab , and Abinadab the second , and Shimma the third ,
ekegusii: Yese akaibora Eliabu, omwana oye omomura omotangi, na Abinadabu oyo o kabere, na Simea oyo o gatato,

english: Nethaneel the fourth , Raddai the fifth ,
ekegusii: na Netaneli oyo o kane, na Radai oyo o gatano,

english: Ozem the sixth , David the seventh :
ekegusii: Osemu oyo o gatano na rimo, na Daudi oyo o gatano na kabere.

english: Whose sisters were Zeruiah , and Abigail . And the sons of Zeruiah ; Abishai , and Joab , and Asahel , three .
ekegusii: Abaiseke bamwabo nabwo barenge Seruya na Abigaeli. Abana abamura b’omokuungu Seruya nabwo aba: Abisai na Yoabu, na Asaeli, bonsi mbatato.

english: And Abigail bare Amasa : and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite .
ekegusii: Abigaeli akaibora Amasa, na ise Amasa nere Yeteri, Omoisumaeli. Ororeria rwa Hezironi

english: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife , and of Jerioth : her sons are these; Jesher , and Shobab , and Ardon .
ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Hezironi, akanyuoma Asuba. Asuba akamoiborera Yerioti omoiseke. Na abana abamura baye nabwo aba: Yeseri na Sobabu, na Aridoni.

english: And when Azubah was dead , Caleb took unto him Ephrath , which bare him Hur .
ekegusii: Ekero Asuba akwete, Kalebu akanyuoma Efarata; ere akamoiborera Huri.

english: Dan , Joseph , and Benjamin , Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .
ekegusii: Dani na Yusufu, Benjamini na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.

english: And Hur begat Uri , and Uri begat Bezaleel .
ekegusii: Huri akaibora Uri, na Uri akaibora Besaleli.

english: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead , whom he married when he was threescore years old ; and she bare him Segub .
ekegusii: Ekero Hezironi arenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, akanyuoma omoiseke o Makiri, ise Gileadi, Omokungu oria akamoiborera Segubu.

english: And Segub begat Jair , who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead .
ekegusii: Segubu akaibora Yairi, oyio obwate emechie emerongo ebere, na etato (23), ase ense ya Gileadi.

english: And he took Geshur , and Aram , with the towns of Jair , from them, with Kenath , and the towns thereof, even threescore cities . All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead .
ekegusii: Korende Abagesuri na Abaaramu bakaira korwa asare emechie etano nomo (6), emechie ya Yairi na Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo. Abanto bonsi bamenyeteo nigo barenge b’ororeria rwa Makiri ise Gileadi,

english: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah , then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa .
ekegusii: Magega Hezironi gakuure agwo Kalebu‐Eufarata, Abiya moga Hezironi akamoiborera Asuri, ise abanto ba Tekoa. Ororeria rwa Yerameeli

english: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn , and Bunah , and Oren , and Ozem , and Ahijah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yerameeli, omomura omotangi o Hezironi, nabwo aba: Ramu, omomura oye omotangi, Buna na Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.

english: Jerahmeel had also another wife , whose name was Atarah ; she was the mother of Onam .
ekegusii: Boigo Yerameeli nabwate omokungu onde orenge korokwa Atara; nere orenge ng’ina Onamu.

english: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz , and Jamin , and Eker .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ramu, omomura omotangi o Yerameeli, nabwo aba: Maasi na Yamini, na Ekeri.

english: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai , and Jada . And the sons of Shammai ; Nadab , and Abishur .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Onamu nabwo Samai na Yada. Abana abamura ba Samai nabwo Nadabu na Abisuri.

english: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail , and she bare him Ahban , and Molid .
ekegusii: Moka Abisuri nigo arenge korokwa Abihaili, nere akamoiborera Ahabani na Molidi.

english: The sons of Judah ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah : which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess . And Er , the firstborn of Judah , was evil in the sight of the LORD ; and he slew him.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri na Onani, na Sela. Aba batato nabwo Batisua, omosubati orwete Kaanani, aiborerete Yuda. Eri, omwana omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo arenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene, n’Omonene akamoita.

english: And the sons of Nadab ; Seled , and Appaim : but Seled died without children .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nadabu nabwo Seledi na Apaimu; Seledi agakwa atabwati bana.

english: And the sons of Appaim ; Ishi . And the sons of Ishi ; Sheshan . And the children of Sheshan ; Ahlai .
ekegusii: Apaimu akaibora Ishi, na Ishi akaibora Sesani, na Sesani akaibora Alai.

english: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai ; Jether , and Jonathan : and Jether died without children .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yada, momura omwabo Sama, nabwo Yeteri na Yonathani. Yeteri agakwa atabwati bana.

english: And the sons of Jonathan ; Peleth , and Zaza . These were the sons of Jerahmeel .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yonathani nabwo Peleti na Sasa. Aba nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yerameeli.

english: Now Sheshan had no sons , but daughters . And Sheshan had a servant , an Egyptian , whose name was Jarha .
ekegusii: Sesani tabwate abana abamura, korende igo abwate abana abaiseke boka. Ere Sesani nabwate omosomba oye omomura Omomisiri orenge korokwa Yara.

english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife ; and she bare him Attai .
ekegusii: Sesani akaa Yara, omosomba oye, omoiseke oye akaba mokaye; ere akaibora omomura orenge korokwa Atai.

english: And Attai begat Nathan , and Nathan begat Zabad ,
ekegusii: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

english: And Zabad begat Ephlal , and Ephlal begat Obed ,
ekegusii: Sabadi akaibora Efilali, na Efilali akaibora Obedi;

english: And Obed begat Jehu , and Jehu begat Azariah ,
ekegusii: Obedi akaibora Yehu, na Yehu akaibora Asaria;

english: And Azariah begat Helez , and Helez begat Eleasah ,
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Helesi, na Helesi akaibora Eleasa;

english: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah . All the sons of Judah were five .
ekegusii: Tamari, moka momura o Yuda, akaiborera Yuda Peresi na Zera. Yuda nigo abwate abana abamura batano.

english: And Eleasah begat Sisamai , and Sisamai begat Shallum ,
ekegusii: Eleasa akaibora Sisimai, na Sisimai akaibora Salumu;

english: And Shallum begat Jekamiah , and Jekamiah begat Elishama .
ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Yekamia, na Yekamia akaibora Elisama. Ororeria ronde rwa Kalebu

english: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were , Mesha his firstborn , which was the father of Ziph ; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu omwabo Yerameeli nabwo aba: Mesha, omwana omomura oye omotangi, oyorenge ise Sifu, oyorenge ise Maresa, na Maresa orenge ise Heburoni.

english: And the sons of Hebron ; Korah , and Tappuah , and Rekem , and Shema .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Kora na Tapua, Rekemu na Sema.

english: And Shema begat Raham , the father of Jorkoam : and Rekem begat Shammai .
ekegusii: Sema akaibora Rahamu, ise Yorikeamu. Rekemu akaibora Samai.

english: And the son of Shammai was Maon : and Maon was the father of Beth-zur .
ekegusii: Samai akaibora Maoni, na Maoni akaibora Beti‐Suri.

english: And Ephah , Caleb’s concubine , bare Haran , and Moza , and Gazez : and Haran begat Gazez .
ekegusii: Boigo Efa, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Harani, na Moza, na Gasesi; na Harani boigo nabwate omomura orenge korokwa Gasesi.

english: And the sons of Jahdai ; Regem , and Jotham , and Geshan , and Pelet , and Ephah , and Shaaph .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yahadai nabwo aba: Regemu na Yotamu, Gesani na Peleti, Efa na Saafu.

english: Maachah , Caleb’s concubine , bare Sheber , and Tirhanah .
ekegusii: Maaka, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Seberi na Tirihana.

english: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah , Sheva the father of Machbenah , and the father of Gibea : and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah .
ekegusii: Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Saafu, ise Madimana, na Sheva, ise abanto ba Makibena na Abagibea. Omoiseke o Kalebu nigo arenge korokwa Asika.

english: The sons of Pharez ; Hezron , and Hamul .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Peresi nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.

english: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur , the firstborn of Ephratah ; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim ,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Kalebu. Abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omomura omotangi bw’Efarata, nabwo aba; Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu,

english: Salma the father of Beth-lehem , Hareph the father of Beth-gader .
ekegusii: na Salima, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Harefu, ise abanto ba Beti‐Gaderi.

english: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons ; Haroeh , and half of the Manahethites .
ekegusii: Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu, nabwate abana abamura bande: Haroe na ekeng’ese ki’abaanto ba Menuhoti.

english: And the families of Kirjath-jearim ; the Ithrites , and the Puhites , and the Shumathites , and the Mishraites ; of them came the Zareathites , and the Eshtaulites .
ekegusii: Ne chiamate chia Kiriati‐Yearimu nachio echi: Abaitiri na Abaputi, Abasumati na Abamisira. Korwa ase abanto aba nao Abasori na Abaesitaoli barwete.

english: The sons of Salma ; Beth-lehem , and the Netophathites , Ataroth , the house of Joab , and half of the Manahethites , the Zorites .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Salima nabwo abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Abaanetofa, na abanto b’Ataroti‐Beti‐Yoabu, na ekeng’ese ki’Abamanahati, nabwo Abasori,

english: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez ; the Tirathites , the Shimeathites , and Suchathites . These are the Kenites that came of Hemath , the father of the house of Rechab .
ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chi’abariki baria bamenyete agwo Yabesi, nabwo Abatirati, na Abasimeati, na Abasukati. Aba nabwo Abakeni abarwete ase Hamati, ise abanto b’enyomba ya Rekabu.

english: And the sons of Zerah ; Zimri , and Ethan , and Heman , and Calcol , and Dara : five of them in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Zera nabwo aba: Simuri na Etani, Hemani na Kalikuli, na Dara, bonsi mbatano.

english: And the sons of Ethan ; Azariah .
ekegusii: Asaria nigo arenge omwana omomura bw’Etani. Ororeria rwaikerete ase Daudi

english: The sons also of Hezron , that were born unto him; Jerahmeel , and Ram , and Chelubai .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hezironi nabwo aba: Yerameeli na Ramu, na Kelubai.

english: Now these were the sons of David , which were born unto him in Hebron ; the firstborn Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess ; the second Daniel , of Abigail the Carmelitess :
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura ba Daudi, abwo baiboretwe ekero arenge Heburoni: Amunoni, omomura oye omotangi, oiboretwe n’Ahinoamu orwete Yesireeli, na oyo o kabere Danieli, oiboretwe n’Abigaeli orwete Karimeli;

english: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam , Abia his son , Asa his son , Jehoshaphat his son ,
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;

english: Joram his son , Ahaziah his son , Joash his son ,
ekegusii: Yehosafati akaibora Yehoramu, na Yehoramu akaibora Ahasia, na Ahasia akaibora Yoashi;

english: Amaziah his son , Azariah his son , Jotham his son ,
ekegusii: Yoashi akaibora Amasia, na Amasia akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yotamu;

english: Ahaz his son , Hezekiah his son , Manasseh his son ,
ekegusii: Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia, na Hezekia akaibora Manase;

english: Amon his son , Josiah his son .
ekegusii: Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia.

english: And the sons of Josiah were , the firstborn Johanan , the second Jehoiakim , the third Zedekiah , the fourth Shallum .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.

english: And the sons of Jehoiakim : Jeconiah his son , Zedekiah his son .
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu narwo oro: Yehoyakimu akaibora Yekonia, na Yekonia akaibora Zedekia. Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu

english: And the sons of Jeconiah ; Assir , Salathiel his son ,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yekonia, oyo bwosetwe, nabwo aba: Sealitieli,

english: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah , and Shenazar , Jecamiah , Hoshama , and Nedabiah .
ekegusii: na Malikiramu, Pedaya na Senasari, Yekamia na Hosama, na Nedabia.

english: And the sons of Pedaiah were , Zerubbabel , and Shimei : and the sons of Zerubbabel ; Meshullam , and Hananiah , and Shelomith their sister :
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Pedaya nabwo Serubabeli na Simei. Abana abamura ba Serubabeli nabwo Mesulamu na Hanania, na Selomiti nere orenge omoiseke omwabo.

english: The third , Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur : the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith :
ekegusii: oyo o gatato Abisalomu, oiboretwe na Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omorwoti o Gesuri; oyo o kane Adonia, oiboretwe na Hagiti;

english: And Hashubah , and Ohel , and Berechiah , and Hasadiah , Jushab-hesed , five .
ekegusii: Abamura bande batano ba Serubabeli nabwo aba: Hasuba na Oheli, Berekia na Hasadia, na Yusabi‐Hesedi.

english: And the sons of Hananiah ; Pelatiah , and Jesaiah : the sons of Rephaiah , the sons of Arnan , the sons of Obadiah , the sons of Shechaniah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hanania nabwo Pelatia na Yesaia, naende abamura ba Refaya, na ab’Arinani, na ab’Obadia, na aba Sekania.

english: And the sons of Shechaniah ; Shemaiah : and the sons of Shemaiah ; Hattush , and Igeal , and Bariah , and Neariah , and Shaphat , six .
ekegusii: Omwana o Sekania nere Semaya, na abana baye abamura nabwo aba: Hatusi na Igali, Baria na Nearia, na Safati; bonsi mbatano nomo.

english: And the sons of Neariah ; Elioenai , and Hezekiah , and Azrikam , three .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nearia nabwo aba: Elionai na Hezekia, na Asirikamu; bonsi mbatato (3).

english: And the sons of Elioenai were , Hodaiah , and Eliashib , and Pelaiah , and Akkub , and Johanan , and Dalaiah , and Anani , seven .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere (7).

english: The fifth , Shephatiah of Abital : the sixth , Ithream by Eglah his wife .
ekegusii: oyo o gatano Sefatia, oiboretwe n’Abitali, na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu, oiboretwe n’Egila moga Daudi.

english: Ibhar also, and Elishama , and Eliphelet ,
ekegusii: Daudi nabwate abamura bande, nabwo aba: Ibuhari na Elisama, na Elifeleti;

english: And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphelet , nine .
ekegusii: Elisama na Eliada, na Elifeleti; abwo nigo barenge kianda.

english: These were all the sons of David , beside the sons of the concubines , and Tamar their sister .
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Daudi, naende nabwate abamura bande b’abakungu ba sere‐sere + 3:9 b’abakungu ba sere‐sere: enchengo yaye n’abakungu batanyuomiri ase omoroberio . Tamari nere orenge omoiseke omwabo abamura abwo. Ororeria rwa Sulemani omorwoti

english: The sons of Judah ; Pharez , Hezron , and Carmi , and Hur , and Shobal .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Peresi na Hezironi, Karimi na Huri, na Sobali.

english: And Jabez called on the God of Israel , saying , Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed , and enlarge my coast , and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil , that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested .
ekegusii: Yabesi akarangeria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Onye aye ndiria kwarenge gonsesenia naende ogareyie obomenyo bwane, naende okoboko kwao kobe amo nainche, na ondende korwa ase obororo tibobaisa gonkora bobe.” Nyasae akamwanchera aya aganetie. Emeroberio ye chiamate chinde

english: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir , which was the father of Eshton .
ekegusii: Kelubu, omomura omwabo o Suba, nere akaibora Mehiri, oria orenge ise Esitoni.

english: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha , and Paseah , and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash . These are the men of Rechah .
ekegusii: Esitoni akaibora Beti‐Rafa na Pasea, na Tehina, ise abanto b’omochie o Nahasi. Aba nabaanto bamenyete Reka.

english: And the sons of Kenaz ; Othniel , and Seraiah : and the sons of Othniel ; Hathath .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kenasi nabwo Otinieli na Seraya; na abamura b’Otinieli nabwo Hatati na Meonotai.

english: And Meonothai begat Ophrah : and Seraiah begat Joab , the father of the valley of Charashim ; for they were craftsmen .
ekegusii: Meonotai akaibora Ofura. Seraya akaibora Yoabu ise Abageharasimu. Barabwo nigo barogetwe igo, ekiagera barenge abaroisia ebinto.

english: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh ; Iru , Elah , and Naam : and the sons of Elah , even Kenaz .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, nabwo aba: Iru na Ela, na Naamu; na omwana omomura bw’Ela nere Kenasi.

english: And the sons of Jehaleleel ; Ziph , and Ziphah , Tiria , and Asareel .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yehaleleli nabwo aba: Sifu na Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.

english: And the sons of Ezra were , Jether , and Mered , and Epher , and Jalon : and she bare Miriam , and Shammai , and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ezara nabwo aba: Yeteri na Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Aba nabwo abana ba Bitia, mosubati o Farao, oria Meredi anyuomete: Omoiseke oye nigo are korokwa Miriamu, na abamura nabwo Samai na Isiba, ise abanto b’Esitemoa.

english: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor , and Heber the father of Socho , and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah . And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh , which Mered took .
ekegusii: Meredi nabwate naende omokungu Omoyuda; nere akaibora Yeredi, ise abanto ba Gedori, na Heberi, ise abanto ba Soko, na Yekutieli, ise abanto ba Sanoa.

english: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham , the father of Keilah the Garmite , and Eshtemoa the Maachathite .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hodia, mosubati omwabo Nahamu, nigo barenge babere, oyomo nigo arenge ise Keila Omogarimi, na oyo o kabere n’Esitemoa bw’Abamaaka.

english: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath ; and Jahath begat Ahumai , and Lahad . These are the families of the Zorathites .
ekegusii: Reaya, mosinto o Sobali, akaibora Yahati, na Yahati akaibora Ahumai na Lahadi. Korwa ase abwo nao Abasora barwete.

english: And the sons of Shimon were , Amnon , and Rinnah , Ben-hanan , and Tilon . And the sons of Ishi were , Zoheth , and Ben-zoheth .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shimoni nabwo aba: Amunoni na Rina, Beni‐Hanani na Tiloni. Abana abamura ba Ishi nabwo Soheti na Beni‐Soheti. Ororeria rwa Sela

english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were , Er the father of Lecah , and Laadah the father of Mareshah , and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen , of the house of Ashbea ,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sela, mosinto o Yuda, nabwo aba: Eri, ise abanto ba Leka, na Laada, ise abanto ba Maresa, na aba echiamate chi’abaroisia ebitambaa bi’egatani agwo Beti‐Asibea;

english: And Jokim , and the men of Chozeba , and Joash , and Saraph , who had the dominion in Moab , and Jashubi-lehem . And these are ancient things .
ekegusii: naende Yokimu na abanto ba Koseba, Yoashi na Sarafu, abwo barenge kogambera Abamoabu, naende Yasubi‐Lehemu. (Korende amang’ana aya namakoro.)

english: These were the potters , and those that dwelt among plants and hedges : there they dwelt with the king for his work .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaroisia chinyongo na ababiare ba Netaimu na Gedera; aba nigo bamenyete amo nomorwoti, bakaba bakomokorera emeremo. Ororeria rwa Simioni

english: The sons of Simeon were , Nemuel , and Jamin , Jarib , Zerah , and Shaul :
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Nemweli na Yamini, Yaribu na Zera, na Saulo.

english: Shallum his son , Mibsam his son , Mishma his son .
ekegusii: Saulo akaibora Salumu, na Salumu akaibora Mibusamu, na Mibusamu akaibora Misima.

english: And the sons of Mishma ; Hamuel his son , Zacchur his son , Shimei his son .
ekegusii: Misima akaibora Hamueli, na Hamueli akaibora Sakuri, na Sakuri akaibora Simei.

english: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters ; but his brethren had not many children , neither did all their family multiply , like to the children of Judah .
ekegusii: Simei nigo abwate abana abamura ikomi na batano nomo (16), na abaiseke batano nomo (6); korende abamura bamwabo tibabwate abana abange, gose chiamate chiabo chionsi tichiamentekanete buna echia Yuda.

english: And at Bilhah , and at Ezem , and at Tolad ,
ekegusii: Bilaha, na Esemu, na Toladi;

english: And these were of the father of Etam ; Jezreel , and Ishma , and Idbash : and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi :
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura b’Etamu: Yesireeli na Isima, na Idibasi, na omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Haseleliponi.

english: And at Bethuel , and at Hormah , and at Ziklag ,
ekegusii: Betueli, na Horima, na Sikilagi;

english: And at Beth-marcaboth , and Hazar-susim , and at Beth-birei , and at Shaaraim . These were their cities unto the reign of David .
ekegusii: Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susimu, na Beti‐Biri, na Saaraimu. Eye nero yarenge emechie yabo goika ekero Daudi abeete omorwoti.

english: And their villages were , Etam , and Ain , Rimmon , and Tochen , and Ashan , five cities :
ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.

english: And all their villages that were round about the same cities , unto Baal . These were their habitations , and their genealogy .
ekegusii: Boigo mbabwate ebichie biabo biaetanaine emechie eyio goikeera Baali. Obo nabwo bwarenge obomenyo bwabo. Barabwo bakarika omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo.

english: And Meshobab , and Jamlech , and Joshah the son of Amaziah ,
ekegusii: Mesobabu, na Yamuleki, na Yosha, mosinto bw’Amasia.

english: And Joel , and Jehu the son of Josibiah , the son of Seraiah , the son of Asiel ,
ekegusii: Yoel, na Yehu, mosinto o Yosibia o Seraya bw’Asieli.

english: And Elioenai , and Jaakobah , and Jeshohaiah , and Asaiah , and Adiel , and Jesimiel , and Benaiah ,
ekegusii: Elioenai na Yaakoba, Yesohaya na Asaia, Adieli na Yesimieli, na Benaya.

english: And Ziza the son of Shiphi , the son of Allon , the son of Jedaiah , the son of Shimri , the son of Shemaiah ;
ekegusii: Sisa, mosinto o Sifi bw’Aloni, o Yedaya, o Simuri, o Semaya.

english: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families : and the house of their fathers increased greatly .
ekegusii: Aba iga batoire ase amarieta abo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo. Chiamate echi chikamentekana mono.

english: And they went to the entrance of Gedor , even unto the east side of the valley , to seek pasture for their flocks .
ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bakang’anya gochia ase omochie o Gedori, ensemo ya moocha ye rikura, korigia oborisia ase chitugo chiabo.

english: And Penuel the father of Gedor , and Ezer the father of Hushah . These are the sons of Hur , the firstborn of Ephratah , the father of Beth-lehem .
ekegusii: Penueli nigo arenge ise Abagedori, na Eseri ise Abahusa. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omotangi o Efarata, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu.

english: And they found fat pasture and good , and the land was wide , and quiet , and peaceable ; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old .
ekegusii: Aroro agwo ase banyorete oborisia obuya na obonoru, ense nigo yarenge engare, na entoereru, na ey’omorembe. Abanto bamenyete agwo ritang’ani nigo barenge abanto ba Hamu.

english: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and smote their tents , and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day , and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks .
ekegusii: Abanto aba batoire ase amarieta abo bagacha ekero Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, arenge kogamba. Barabwo bagasaria chiema chi’abaanto b’aroro na bagasiria Abameuni, abanto banyorekanete aroro; bakabasiria kegima na tibaiyo nonya goika reero iga. Erio bakamenya agwo ribaga riabo, ekiagera oborisia mbwarengeo ase chitugo chiabo.

english: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon , five hundred men , went to mount Seir , having for their captains Pelatiah , and Neariah , and Rephaiah , and Uzziel , the sons of Ishi .
ekegusii: Na abanto amagana atano (500) b’egesaku gia Simioni, bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Edomu, bakaba nabaraai babo: Pelatia na Nearia, Refaya na Usieli, basinto ba Ishi.

english: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped , and dwelt there unto this day .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagasiria abanto abatigari b’Abaameleki, naende bakamenya aroro, nao bare goika reero iga.

english: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives , Helah and Naarah .
ekegusii: Asuri ise abanto ba Tekoa, nabwate abakungu babere, Hela na Naara.

english: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam , and Hepher , and Temeni , and Haahashtari . These were the sons of Naarah .
ekegusii: Naara akamoiborera Ahusamu na Heferi, Temeni na Hahasitari. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Naara.

english: And the sons of Helah were , Zereth , and Jezoar , and Ethnan .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.

english: And Coz begat Anub , and Zobebah , and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum .
ekegusii: Kosi nere orenge ise Anubu na Sobeba, na ise bwe chiamate chi’Aharibeli, mosinto o Harumu.

english: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren : and his mother called his name Jabez , saying , Because I bare him with sorrow .
ekegusii: Yabesi nigo arenge namasikani amanene kobua abamura bamwabo. Ng’ina akamoroka Yabesi, ekiagera amoiborete ase obororo.

english: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites , who fell by their hand : and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Saulo arenge kogamba bakarwana esegi n’Abahagari, bakabaita, na barabwo bakamenya ase chiema chiabo agwo ase ense yonsi moocha ya Gileadi. Ororeria rwa Gadi

english: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah :
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakamenya sugusu y’abanto b’orwa Rubeni agwo ase ense ya Basani, bagaikera omochie o Saleka.

english: Joel the chief , and Shapham the next , and Jaanai , and Shaphat in Bashan .
ekegusii: Yoel nere orenge omonene, na Safamu oyo o kabere, naende Yanai na Safati bakaba agwo Basani.

english: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were , Michael , and Meshullam , and Sheba , and Jorai , and Jachan , and Zia , and Heber , seven .
ekegusii: Na abamwabo be chiamate chiabo nabwo aba: Mikaeli na Mesulamu, Seba na Yorai, Yakani na Sia, na Eberi, bonsi mbatano na babere.

english: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri , the son of Jaroah , the son of Gilead , the son of Michael , the son of Jeshishai , the son of Jahdo , the son of Buz ;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge basinto b’Abihaili, mosinto o Huri o Yaroa, o Gileadi, o Mikaeli, o Yesisai, o Yado, o Busi.

english: Ahi the son of Abdiel , the son of Guni , chief of the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Ahi, mosinto bw’Abidieli, o Guni, nere orenge omoteneneri bwe chiamate chiabo.

english: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan , and in her towns , and in all the suburbs of Sharon , upon their borders .
ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakamenya agwo Gileadi na Basani, na ase emechie y’aroro na ase oborisia bwonsi bwa Saroni goikera chinsinyo chiaye.

english: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel .
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa ekero omobaro bwe chinderia chiabo okoretwe ase amatuko ’okogamba kwa Yotamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na aya okwa Yeroboamu, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli. Abarwani esegi b’ebisaku bia moocha

english: The sons of Reuben , and the Gadites , and half the tribe of Manasseh , of valiant men , men able to bear buckler and sword , and to shoot with bow , and skilful in war , were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore , that went out to the war .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Rubeni, na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, nigo babwate abanto chituoni barenge kobogoria chinguba na emioro, naende nigo bamanyete korasa nemegwe abanto abang’aini ase esegi. Abwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na inye, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (44,760), nigo barenge bebegete ang’e korwana esegi.

english: And they made war with the Hagarites , with Jetur , and Nephish , and Nodab .
ekegusii: Bakaba bakorwana esegi n’Abahagari abarwete ase Yeturi na Nafisi, na Nodabu.

english: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand , and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle , and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
ekegusii: Ekiagera bamwegenete Nyasae bakarera ase okonyora ogokonywa, na Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwabo, na barabwo bakabua Abahagari na abanto bonsi barenge amo nabarabwo.

english: And they took away their cattle ; of their camels fifty thousand , and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand , and of asses two thousand , and of men an hundred thousand .
ekegusii: Bagasakora chitugo chiabo: Chingamia chilifu emerongo etano (50,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano (250,000) ne chitigere chilifu ibere (2,000). Naende bagoosa abanto chilifu rigana erimo (100,000),

english: For there fell down many slain , because the war was of God . And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity .
ekegusii: na bagaita abanto abange, ekiagera esegi yarenge eya Nyasae. Erio bakamenya aase abo goika engaki y’okong’anyigwa. Abanto ba Manase abamenyete moocha

english: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land : they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir , and unto mount Hermon .
ekegusii: Abanto ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakamenya ense eria; bakamentekana mono, bakamenya korwa orobebe rwa Basani goika Baali‐Herimoni, na Seniri, na egetunwa kia Herimoni.

english: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers , even Epher , and Ishi , and Eliel , and Azriel , and Jeremiah , and Hodaviah , and Jahdiel , mighty men of valour , famous men , and heads of the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo: Eferi na Ishi, Elieli na Asirieli, Yeremia na Hodawia, na Yadieli. Abwo nabaanto chituoni bachiete nkuma ase okorwana esegi. Ebisaku bia moocha bigwoswa

english: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers , and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land , whom God destroyed before them.
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ebisaku bia moocha bagakora ogosaria ase Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakora obotayayi, bakabwatia chinyasae chi’abaanto b’ense eria, abwo Nyasae asiretie korwa ase bare.

english: The sons , I say , of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were , Hanoch , and Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki na Palu, Hezironi na Karimi.

english: Micah his son , Reaia his son , Baal his son ,
ekegusii: Simei akaibora Mika, na Mika akaibora Reaya, na Reaya akaibora Baali.

english: Beerah his son , whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites .
ekegusii: Baali akaibora Beera oria Tiligati‐Pileseri omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, aosete + 5:6 aosete: engencho yaye okoirwa obosomba , akamoira ase obosomba. Beera orenge omoteneneri bw’abaanto ba Rubeni.

english: And his brethren by their families , when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned , were the chief , Jeiel , and Zechariah ,
ekegusii: Na abamwabo ase chiamate chiabo buna barigetwe ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chi’ebiare biabo nabwo aba: Yeieli, nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Zakaria,

english: And Bela the son of Azaz , the son of Shema , the son of Joel , who dwelt in Aroer , even unto Nebo and Baal-meon :
ekegusii: na Bela, mosinto bw’Asasi o Sema, o Yoel, Barabwo nigo bamenyete agwo Aroeri goikera orobebe rwa Nebo na Baali‐Meoni.

english: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates : because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead .
ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha bakamenya goikera egesoero ki’erooro egoikera orooche rw’Eufarati, ekiagera amaicho abo nigo abuchete mono ase ense ya Gileadi.

english: The sons of Levi ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.

english: And Johanan begat Azariah , (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem :)
ekegusii: Yohanani akaibora Asaria (oyo nere orenge Omokuani ase enyomba eria Sulemani aagachete agwo Yerusalemu);

english: And Azariah begat Amariah , and Amariah begat Ahitub ,
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;

english: And Ahitub begat Zadok , and Zadok begat Shallum ,
ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Salumu;

english: And Shallum begat Hilkiah , and Hilkiah begat Azariah ,
ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Hilikia, na Hilikia akaibora Asaria;

english: And Azariah begat Seraiah , and Seraiah begat Jehozadak ,
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Yehosadaki.

english: And Jehozadak went into captivity , when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar .
ekegusii: Yehosadaki agooswa akairwa ense eng’ao, ekero Omonene aruete Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagooswa, bakairwa na Nebukadinesaro. Ororeria ronde rwa Lawi

english: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom ; Libni , and Shimei .
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana abamura ba Gerisomu: Libini na Simei.

english: And the sons of Kohath were , Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

english: The sons of Merari ; Mahli , and Mushi . And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Echi nechiamate chi’abaanto ba Lawi, chiatoire ase abaise.

english: And the sons of Kohath ; Amram , Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.

english: Of Gershom ; Libni his son , Jahath his son , Zimmah his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Gerisomu: Libini omomura oye, na Yahati omomura oye, na Sima omomura oye,

english: Joah his son , Iddo his son , Zerah his son , Jeaterai his son .
ekegusii: na Yoa omomura oye, na Ido omomura oye, na Zera omomura oye, na Yeateri omomura oye.

english: The sons of Kohath ; Amminadab his son , Korah his son , Assir his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Kohati: Aminadabu omomura oye, na Kora omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

english: Elkanah his son , and Ebiasaph his son , and Assir his son ,
ekegusii: na Elikana omomura oye, na Ebiasafu omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

english: Tahath his son , Uriel his son , Uzziah his son , and Shaul his son .
ekegusii: na Tahati omomura oye, na Urieli omomura oye, na Usia omomura oye, na Saulo omomura oye.

english: And the sons of Elkanah ; Amasai , and Ahimoth .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elikana nabwo Amasi na Ahimoti.

english: As for Elkanah : the sons of Elkanah ; Zophai his son , and Nahath his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Ahimoti: Elikana omomura oye, na Sofai omomura oye, na Nahati omomura oye,

english: Eliab his son , Jeroham his son , Elkanah his son .
ekegusii: na Eliabu omomura oye, na Yerohamu omomura oye, na Elikana omomura oye.

english: And the sons of Samuel ; the firstborn Vashni , and Abiah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Samweli nabwo Yoel, omwana oye omotangi, na Abiya, oyo o kabere.

english: The sons of Merari ; Mahli , Libni his son , Shimei his son , Uzza his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Merari: Mali omomura oye, na Libini omomura oye, na Simei omomura oye, na Usa omomura oye,

english: And the children of Amram ; Aaron , and Moses , and Miriam . The sons also of Aaron ; Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
ekegusii: Abana b’Amuramu nabwo aba: Aroni na Musa, na Miriamu omoiseke. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.

english: Shimea his son , Haggiah his son , Asaiah his son .
ekegusii: na Simea omomura oye, na Hagia omomura oye, na Asaia omomura oye. Abateri be Hekalu

english: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto Daudi abegete bakaba abateneneri b’amatera ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekero Esanduki eria yarenge nokobwatana kw’Omonene konya yabekirwe aroro.

english: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing , until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem : and then they waited on their office according to their order .
ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokora obokoreri bwabo bw’amatera agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika engaki eria Sulemani aagachete enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu; barabwo bagakora emeremo yabo ase omooroberio ochikiire.

english: And these are they that waited with their children . Of the sons of the Kohathites : Heman a singer , the son of Joel , the son of Shemuel ,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bakorete emeremo amo nororeria rwabo. Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kohati: Hemani, omonene bw’abateri, mosinto o Yoel o Samweli,

english: The son of Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Eliel , the son of Toah ,
ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yerohamu, bw’Elieli, o Toa,

english: The son of Zuph , the son of Elkanah , the son of Mahath , the son of Amasai ,
ekegusii: o Sufu, bw’Elikana, o Mahati, bw’Amasai,

english: The son of Elkanah , the son of Joel , the son of Azariah , the son of Zephaniah ,
ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yoel, bw’Asaria, o Zefania,

english: The son of Tahath , the son of Assir , the son of Ebiasaph , the son of Korah ,
ekegusii: o Tahati, bw’Asiri, bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora,

english: The son of Izhar , the son of Kohath , the son of Levi , the son of Israel .
ekegusii: o Isari, o Kohati, o Lawi, o Israeli.

english: And his brother Asaph , who stood on his right hand , even Asaph the son of Berachiah , the son of Shimea ,
ekegusii: Oyo o kabere nere Asafu, oyo bw’eamate ya Hemani. Ere nigo arenge gotenena ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio. Asafu nigo arenge mosinto o Berekia, o Simea,

english: Eleazar begat Phinehas , Phinehas begat Abishua ,
ekegusii: Eleazari akaibora Finehasi, na Finehasi akaibora Abisua;

english: The son of Michael , the son of Baaseiah , the son of Malchiah ,
ekegusii: o Mikaeli, o Baseya, o Malikia,

english: The son of Ethni , the son of Zerah , the son of Adaiah ,
ekegusii: bw’Etini, o Zera, bw’Adaya,

english: The son of Ethan , the son of Zimmah , the son of Shimei ,
ekegusii: bw’Etani, o Sima, o Simei,

english: The son of Jahath , the son of Gershom , the son of Levi .
ekegusii: o Yahati, o Gerisomu, o Lawi.

english: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand : Ethan the son of Kishi , the son of Abdi , the son of Malluch ,
ekegusii: Ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee mbarengeo abamwabo b’ororeria rwa Merari: Etani, mosinto o Kisi bw’Abidi, o Maluku,

english: The son of Hashabiah , the son of Amaziah , the son of Hilkiah ,
ekegusii: o Hasabia, bw’Amasia, o Hilikia,

english: The son of Amzi , the son of Bani , the son of Shamer ,
ekegusii: bw’Amusi, o Bani, o Semeri,

english: The son of Mahli , the son of Mushi , the son of Merari , the son of Levi .
ekegusii: o Mali, o Musi, o Merari, o Lawi.

english: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God .
ekegusii: Abalawi bamwabo bagachorwa gokora emeremo yonsi y’Eema nero enyomba ya Nyasae. Ororeria rwa Aroni

english: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering , and on the altar of incense , and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy , and to make an atonement for Israel , according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded .
ekegusii: Aroni amo nabamura b’ororeria rwaye bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso agwo ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na gosambera ubani ase egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani. Bagakora emeremo yonsi ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, naende bagakora ayaganetigwe ase okobwatania Abaisraeli na Nyasae, koreng’ana namang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, achigete.

english: And Abishua begat Bukki , and Bukki begat Uzzi ,
ekegusii: Abisua akaibora Buki, na Buki akaibora Usi;

english: And these are the sons of Aaron ; Eleazar his son , Phinehas his son , Abishua his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Aroni: Eleazari omomura oye, na Finehasi omomura oye, na Abisua omomura oye,

english: Bukki his son , Uzzi his son , Zerahiah his son ,
ekegusii: na Buku omomura oye, na Usi omomura oye, na Seraya omomura oye,

english: Meraioth his son , Amariah his son , Ahitub his son ,
ekegusii: na Merayoti omomura oye, na Amaria omomura oye, na Ahitubu omomura oye,

english: Zadok his son , Ahimaaz his son .
ekegusii: na Zadoki omomura oye, na Ahimasi omomura oye. Aase Abalawi bamenyete

english: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts , of the sons of Aaron , of the families of the Kohathites : for theirs was the lot .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chinsemo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni b’eamate ya Kohati bamenyete ase chingongo chiabo. Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokabagwera;

english: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah , and the suburbs thereof round about it.
ekegusii: ase igo bakaegwa Heburoni amo namarisio aetanaineo, agwo ase ense ya Yuda.

english: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh .
ekegusii: Korende emegondo y’omochie amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio bakaa Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.

english: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely , Hebron , the city of refuge , and Libnah with her suburbs , and Jattir , and Eshtemoa , with their suburbs ,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni bakaegwa emechie eye: Heburoni, omochie bw’obotamero, na Libuna, amo namarisio aetanaineo, Yatiri na Esitemoa amo namarisio aetanaineo,

english: And Hilen with her suburbs , Debir with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Hileni na Debiri amo namarisio aetanaineo;

english: And Ashan with her suburbs , and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs :
ekegusii: Asani na Beti‐Semesi amo namarisio aetanaineo.

english: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah , and Zerahiah begat Meraioth ,
ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

english: And out of the tribe of Benjamin ; Geba with her suburbs , and Alemeth with her suburbs , and Anathoth with her suburbs . All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Geba na Alemeti, na Anatoti, emechie eyio yonsi amo namarisio aetanaineo. Emechie yabo yonsi ase chiamate chiabo nigo yarenge ikomi na etato.

english: And unto the sons of Kohath , which were left of the family of that tribe , were cities given out of the half tribe , namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh , by lot , ten cities .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Kohati abatigarete bakaegwa emechie ikomi ase ogoakerwa obomera, bakayeegwa korwa ase eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase.

english: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisomu bakaegwa emechie ikomi na etato (13) agwo Basani korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bia Isakaru, na Aseri, na Nafutali, na Manase agwo Basani.

english: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot , throughout their families , out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abamerari bakaegwa emechie ikomi na ebere (12) korwa ase ebisaku bia Rubeni, na Gadi, na Sabuloni.

english: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs .
ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie amo namarisio aetanaineo.

english: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin , these cities , which are called by their names .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio yatoire bakabayea korwa ase ebisaku bia Yuda, na Simioni, na Benjamini ase okoyeakera obomera.

english: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim .
ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.

english: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge , Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs ; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw’obotamero ase ense y’Efraimu na Geseri,

english: And Jokmeam with her suburbs , and Beth-horon with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Yokimeamu na Beti‐Horoni,

english: And Aijalon with her suburbs , and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs :
ekegusii: Ayaloni na Gati‐Rimoni, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: Meraioth begat Amariah , and Amariah begat Ahitub ,
ekegusii: Merayoti akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;

english: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh ; Aner with her suburbs , and Bileam with her suburbs , for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abakohati abatigarete bakaegwa Aneri na Bileamu amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh , Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , and Ashtaroth with her suburbs :
ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And out of the tribe of Issachar ; Kedesh with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kedesi na Daberati,

english: And Ramoth with her suburbs , and Anem with her suburbs :
ekegusii: na Ramoti, na Anemu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And out of the tribe of Asher ; Mashal with her suburbs , and Abdon with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Masali na Abidoni,

english: And Hukok with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs :
ekegusii: na Hukoki na Rebobu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali ; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , and Hammon with her suburbs , and Kirjathaim with her suburbs .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi agwo Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriataimu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun , Rimmon with her suburbs , Tabor with her suburbs :
ekegusii: Abamerari abatigarete bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni: Rimoni na Tabori amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho , on the east side of Jordan , were given them out of the tribe of Reuben , Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs , and Jahzah with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ensemo ya moocha ya Yeriko, bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni: Beseri agwo aase ateremu, na Yahasi,

english: Kedemoth also with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs :
ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefati, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And Ahitub begat Zadok , and Zadok begat Ahimaaz ,
ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Ahimasi;

english: And out of the tribe of Gad ; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs , and Mahanaim with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti agwo Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,

english: And Heshbon with her suburbs , and Jazer with her suburbs .
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

english: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah , and Azariah begat Johanan ,
ekegusii: Ahimasi akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yohanani;

english: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yasubu, na Simuroni, bonsi mbaane.

english: The sons also of Jediael ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yediaeli nabwo aba: Bilihani amo nabana baye abamura: Yeusi, na Benjamini, na Ehudi, na Kenaana, na Setani, na Tarisisi, na Ahisahari,

english: All these the sons of Jediael , by the heads of their fathers , mighty men of valour , were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers , fit to go out for war and battle .
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo ab’ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).

english: Shuppim also, and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
ekegusii: Supimu na Hupimu nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Iri, naende Abahusi nab’ororeria rw’Aheri. Ororeria rwa Nafutali

english: The sons of Naphtali ; Jahziel , and Guni , and Jezer , and Shallum , the sons of Bilhah .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yeseri, na Salumu. Nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Bilia. Ororeria rwa Manase

english: The sons of Manasseh ; Ashriel , whom she bare : ( but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead :
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Manase nabwo aba: Asirieli, oria omokungu oye o sere‐sere, orenge Omoaramai amoiborerete. Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Makiri, ise Gileadi.

english: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister’s name was Maachah ;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .
ekegusii: Makiri akanywomeria Hupimu omokungu, boigo akanywomeria Supimu omokungu. Omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Maaka. Omwana omomura o kabere o Manase nigo arenge korokwa Selofehadi. Selofehadi nigo abwate abana abaiseke boka.

english: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .
ekegusii: Maaka, moka Makiri, akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Peresi; na momura omwabo Peresi akarokwa Seresi. Abana abamura babere ba Peresi nabwo Ulamu na Rakemu.

english: And the sons of Ulam ; Bedan . These were the sons of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh .
ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.

english: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod , and Abiezer , and Mahalah .
ekegusii: Hamoleketi omosubati omwabo Gileadi, akaibora Isi‐Hodi na Abieseri, na Mahala.

english: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian , and Shechem , and Likhi , and Aniam .
ekegusii: Abana ba Shemida nabwo aba: Ahiani, na Sekemu, na Liki, na Aniamu. Ororeria rw’Efraimu

english: And the sons of Tola ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father’s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Tola nabwo aba: Usi na Refaya, na Yerieli, na Yamai, na Ibusamu, na Semueli. Aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate chia Tola, abanto chituoni ase okorwana esegi ase ebigori biabo. Ase amatuko ’okogamba gwa Daudi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (22,600).

english: And the sons of Ephraim ; Shuthelah , and Bered his son , and Tahath his son , and Eladah his son , and Tahath his son ,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Efraimu: Sutela omomura oye, na Beredi omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye, na Eleada omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye,

english: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
ekegusii: na Sabadi omomura oye, na Sutela omomura oye. Naende Efraimu nabwate abana babere, Eseri na Eleadi; baria abanto baiboretwe ase ense ya Gadi baitete, ekiagera bachete koiba chiombe chiabo.

english: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him.
ekegusii: Efraimu ise akaba okobareera ase amatuko amange, na abamura bamwabo bagacha komoremia.

english: And when he went in to his wife , she conceived , and bare a son , and he called his name Beriah , because it went evil with his house .
ekegusii: Erio Efraimu akaba na mokaye, na ere akanyora oborito, akaibora omwana omomura. Efraimu akaroka omwana oria Beria, ekiagera amang’ana amabe achete ase enka yaye.

english: (And his daughter was Sherah , who built Beth-horon the nether , and the upper , and Uzzen-sherah .)
ekegusii: Omwana oye omoiseke nigo arenge korokwa Seera, oria oagachete Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro na eya maate, na Useni‐Seera.

english: And Rephah was his son , also Resheph , and Telah his son , and Tahan his son ,
ekegusii: Refa nigo arenge omomura bw’Efraimu, na Resefu omomura oye, na Tela omomura oye, na Tahani omomura oye,

english: Laadan his son , Ammihud his son , Elishama his son ,
ekegusii: na Ladani omomura oye, na Amihudi omomura oye, na Elisama omomura oye,

english: Non his son , Jehoshua his son .
ekegusii: na Nuni omomura oye, na Yoshua omomura oye.

english: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
ekegusii: Chingongo chiabo bamenyete nachio Beteli na ebichie biaye, na ensemo ya moocha Naarani, na ensemo ya bosongo Geseri na ebichie biaye, na Sekemu na ebichie biaye, na Aya na ebichie biaye.

english: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth-shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
ekegusii: Boigo ase ribebe ri’abaanto ba Manase mbabwate Beti‐Sehani na ebichie biaye, na Taanaki na ebichie biaye, na Megido na ebichie biaye, na Dori na ebichie biaye. Ase emechie eyio na ebichie nao abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli, bamenyete. Ororeria rw’Aseri

english: And the sons of Uzzi ; Izrahiah : and the sons of Izrahiah ; Michael , and Obadiah , and Joel , Ishiah , five : all of them chief men .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usi nabwo aba: Isiraya amo nabana baye abamura: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Yoel, na Isia, bonsi mbatano; na abwo nigo barenge abateneneri.

english: The sons of Asher ; Imnah , and Isuah , and Ishuai , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo Sera.

english: And the sons of Beriah ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi, na Malikieli, oria orenge ise Birisaiti.

english: And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .
ekegusii: Heberi nere orenge ise Yafileti, na Someri, na Hotamu, na ise omoiseke omwabo Sua.

english: And the sons of Japhlet ; Pasach , and Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafileti nabwo aba: Pasaki, na Bimuhali, na Asiwati. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Yafileti.

english: And the sons of Shamer ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Someri, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Roga, na Yehuba, na Aramu.

english: And the sons of his brother Helem ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Helemu, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Sofa, na Imuna, na Selesi, na Amali.

english: The sons of Zophah ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sofa nabwo aba: Sua, na Hareneferi, na Suali, na Beri, na Imura,

english: Bezer , and Hod , and Shamma , and Shilshah , and Ithran , and Beera .
ekegusii: na Beseri, na Hodi, na Sama, na Silisa, na Itirani, na Beera.

english: And the sons of Jether ; Jephunneh , and Pispah , and Ara .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yeteri nabwo aba: Yefune, na Pisipa, na Ara.

english: And the sons of Ulla ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .
ekegusii: Abana ba Ula nabwo aba: Ara, na Hanieli, na Risia.

english: And with them, by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate abakungu abange babaiborerete abana abamura abange. Ase igo barwete korwa ase chinderia chiabo abasikari abakong’u chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000).

english: All these were the children of Asher , heads of their father’s house , choice and mighty men of valour , chief of the princes . And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men .
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri. Nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto bamanyekanete ng’a nabakong’u ase esegi, abatang’ani b’abaraai. Abwo barigetwe korwa ase chinderia chiabo bagende korwana esegi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo (26,000).

english: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo be chiamate chionsi chia Isakaru nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Bonsi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na etato na isano na ibere (87,000), buna barigetwe ase chinderia chiabo. Ororeria rwa Benjamini

english: The sons of Benjamin ; Bela , and Becher , and Jediael , three .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Yediaeli, bonsi mbatato.

english: And the sons of Bela ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Esiboni, na Usi, na Usieli, na Yerimoti, na Iri. Aba bonsi batano nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto abakong’u ase esegi. Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na emerongo etato, na baane (22,034).

english: And the sons of Becher ; Zemira , and Joash , and Eliezer , and Elioenai , and Omri , and Jerimoth , and Abiah , and Anathoth , and Alameth . All these are the sons of Becher .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bekeri nabwo aba: Semira, na Yoashi, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Yerimoti, na Abiya, na Anatoti, na Alemeti. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Bekeri.

english: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations , heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour , was twenty thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiabo, nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase esegi, abanto chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana abere (20,200).

english: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn , Ashbel the second , and Aharah the third ,
ekegusii: Benjamini nere orenge ise Bela, omwana oye omomura omotangi na Asibeli oyo o kabere, na Ahara oyo o gatato,

english: And Jeuz , and Shachia , and Mirma . These were his sons , heads of the fathers .
ekegusii: Yeusi na Sakia, na Mirima. Abana aba baye nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

english: And of Hushim he begat Abitub , and Elpaal .
ekegusii: Naende Husimu akamoiborera abamura babere, nabwo Abitubu na Elipali.

english: The sons of Elpaal ; Eber , and Misham , and Shamed , who built Ono , and Lod , with the towns thereof:
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elipali nabwo Eberi na Misamu, naende Semedi, oria oagachete emechie ya Omo na Lodi amo nebichie biabo. Ababenjamini abamenyete Gati na Ayaloni

english: Beriah also, and Shema , who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon , who drove away the inhabitants of Gath :
ekegusii: Beria na Sema nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’abaanto bamenyete agwo Ayaloni, nabwo baseretie abanyene ense ya Gati.

english: And Ahio , Shashak , and Jeremoth ,
ekegusii: Ahiyo na Sasaki, na Yeremoti,

english: And Zebadiah , and Arad , and Ader ,
ekegusii: Sebadia na Aradi, na Ederi,

english: And Michael , and Ispah , and Joha , the sons of Beriah ;
ekegusii: Mikaeli, na Isipa, na Yoha; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Beria. Ababenjamini abamenyete Yerusalemu

english: And Zebadiah , and Meshullam , and Hezeki , and Heber ,
ekegusii: Sebadia na Mesulamu, Hisiki na Heberi,

english: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah , and Jobab , the sons of Elpaal ;
ekegusii: Isimerai na Isilia, na Yobabu; aba nigo barenge abana abamura b’Elipali.

english: And Jakim , and Zichri , and Zabdi ,
ekegusii: Yakimu na Sikiri, na Sabidi,

english: Nohah the fourth , and Rapha the fifth .
ekegusii: na Noha oyo o kane, na Rafa oyo o gatano.

english: And Elienai , and Zilthai , and Eliel ,
ekegusii: Elinai na Siletai, na Elieli,

english: And Adaiah , and Beraiah , and Shimrath , the sons of Shimhi ;
ekegusii: Adaya na Beraya, na Simurati; aba nigo baare abana abamura ba Simei.

english: And Ishpan , and Heber , and Eliel ,
ekegusii: Isipani na Eberi, na Elieli,

english: And Abdon , and Zichri , and Hanan ,
ekegusii: Abidoni na Sikiri, na Hanani,

english: And Hananiah , and Elam , and Antothijah ,
ekegusii: Hanania na Elamu, na Anitotia,

english: And Iphedeiah , and Penuel , the sons of Shashak ;
ekegusii: Ifudia na Penueli; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Sasaki.

english: And Shamsherai , and Shehariah , and Athaliah ,
ekegusii: Samiserai na Seharia, na Atalia,

english: And Jaresiah , and Eliah , and Zichri , the sons of Jeroham .
ekegusii: Yaresia na Elija, na Sikiri; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yerohamu.

english: These were heads of the fathers , by their generations , chief men . These dwelt in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu. Ababenjamini abamenyete Gibeoni na Yerusalemu

english: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon ; whose wife’s name was Maachah :
ekegusii: Ise Abagibeoni nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni; omokungu oye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.

english: And the sons of Bela were, Addar , and Gera , and Abihud ,
ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Adari na Gera, na Abihudi,

english: And his firstborn son Abdon , and Zur , and Kish , and Baal , and Nadab ,
ekegusii: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,

english: And Gedor , and Ahio , and Zacher .
ekegusii: Gedori na Ahiyo, na Sekeri,

english: And Mikloth begat Shimeah . And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem , over against them .
ekegusii: na Mikiloti (nere orenge ise Simea). Aba nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabaanto bamwabo agwo Yerusalemu. Eamate y’omorwoti Saulo

english: And Ner begat Kish , and Kish begat Saul , and Saul begat Jonathan , and Malchi-shua , and Abinadab , and Esh-baal .
ekegusii: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, na Abinadabu, na Esi‐Baali.

english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal ; and Merib-baal begat Micah .
ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Yonathani nere Meribu‐Baali; ere akaibora Mika.

english: And the sons of Micah were , Pithon , and Melech , and Tarea , and Ahaz .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, na Tarea, na Ahasi.

english: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah ; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth , and Azmaveth , and Zimri ; and Zimri begat Moza ,
ekegusii: Ahasi akaibora Yehoada, na Yehoada akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri, na Simuri akaibora Moza.

english: And Moza begat Binea : Rapha was his son , Eleasah his son , Azel his son :
ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea; Rafa nigo arenge omomura oye, na Eleasa omomura oye, na Aseli omomura oye.

english: And Azel had six sons , whose names are these, Azrikam , Bocheru , and Ishmael , and Sheariah , and Obadiah , and Hanan . All these were the sons of Azel .
ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, naya naro amarieta abo: Asirikamu na Bokeru, Isumaeli na Searia, Obadia na Hanani. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura b’Aseli.

english: And the sons of Eshek his brother were , Ulam his firstborn , Jehush the second , and Eliphelet the third .
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseki, momura omwabo, nabwo aba: Ulamu, omwana oye omotangi, na Yeusi, oyo o kabere, na Elifeleti, oyo o gatato.

english: And Abishua , and Naaman , and Ahoah ,
ekegusii: Abisua na Naamani, na Ahoa,

english: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour , archers , and had many sons , and sons’ sons , an hundred and fifty . All these are of the sons of Benjamin .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ulamu nigo barenge abanto chituoni ase esegi, bamanyete koruta emegwe. Nigo babwate abana abamura na abachokoro abamura abange, bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini.

english: And Gera , and Shephuphan , and Huram .
ekegusii: Gera na Sefufani, na Huramu.

english: And these are the sons of Ehud : these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba , and they removed them to Manahath :
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.

english: And Naaman , and Ahiah , and Gera , he removed them, and begat Uzza , and Ahihud .
ekegusii: Abamura abwo nabwo aba: Naamani na Ahiya, na Gera, oyio obairete aroro. Abana abamura baye nabwo Usa na Ahihudi.

english: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab , after he had sent them away ; Hushim and Baara were his wives .
ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.

english: And he begat of Hodesh his wife , Jobab , and Zibia , and Mesha , and Malcham ,
ekegusii: Hodesi mokaye akamoiborera abana abamura, nabwo aba: Yobabu na Zibia, na Mesa, na Malikamu,

english: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies ; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah , who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa koreng’ana ne chinderia chiabo, na amang’ana abo nigo anyorekanete ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Abayuda nigo baosetwe + 9:1 baosetwe: engencho yaye bairetwe obosomba bakairwa Babiloni, ekiagera tibarenge abegenwa.

english: And of the priests ; Jedaiah , and Jehoiarib , and Jachin ,
ekegusii: Abakuani aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Yedaya na Yehoyaribu, na Yakini;

english: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Zadok , the son of Meraioth , the son of Ahitub , the ruler of the house of God ;
ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Hilikia o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Meraioti, bw’Ahitubu, omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham , the son of Pashur , the son of Malchijah , and Maasiai the son of Adiel , the son of Jahzerah , the son of Meshullam , the son of Meshillemith , the son of Immer ;
ekegusii: Naende Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu o Pasuri, o Malikia; na Maasai, mosinto bw’Adieli o Yasera, o Mesulamu, o Mesilemiti, o Imeri.

english: And their brethren , heads of the house of their fathers , a thousand and seven hundred and threescore ; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God .
ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge abamwabo, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,760). Bonsi nigo barenge abamanyi ase ogokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Abalawi abamenyete Yerusalemu

english: And of the Levites ; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub , the son of Azrikam , the son of Hashabiah , of the sons of Merari ;
ekegusii: Abalawi aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia korwa ase eamate y’Abamerari;

english: And Bakbakkar , Heresh , and Galal , and Mattaniah the son of Micah , the son of Zichri , the son of Asaph ;
ekegusii: Bakibakari na Heresi, Galali na Matania, mosinto o Mika o Sikiri, bw’Asafu;

english: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah , the son of Galal , the son of Jeduthun , and Berechiah the son of Asa , the son of Elkanah , that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites .
ekegusii: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abaanetofa. Abarendi b’ebiita bie Hekalu abamenyete Yerusalemu

english: And the porters were , Shallum , and Akkub , and Talmon , and Ahiman , and their brethren : Shallum was the chief ;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita bamenyete Yerusalemu: Salumu na Akubu, Talimoni na Ahimani, na abanto bande bamwabo. Salumu nere orenge omoteneneri obo.

english: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward : they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaba bakorenda agwo ase Egeita ki’Omorwoti, ensemo ya moocha, goika engaki eye. Kare nabwo barenge abarendi b’egetwori ki’Abalawi.

english: And Shallum the son of Kore , the son of Ebiasaph , the son of Korah , and his brethren , of the house of his father , the Korahites , were over the work of the service , keepers of the gates of the tabernacle : and their fathers , being over the host of the LORD , were keepers of the entry .
ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Kore bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora, amo nabaanto bande b’eamate yaye, nabwo Abakora, nigo barenge abateneneri bokorenda ase Ebiita bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano, buna chisokoro chiabo chiarenge korenda ase egesoero ki’egetwori ki’Omonene.

english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past , and the LORD was with him.
ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, nere orenge omogambi agwo kare, n’Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.

english: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Zakaria, mosinto o Meselemia, nere orenge omorendi bw’egeita agwo ase egesoero ki Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve . These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages , whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office .
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi amagana abere, na ikomi na babere (212) nigo bachoretwe bakaba abarendi b’ebisoero bi’ebiita. Bakabarwa na korikwa ase chinderia chiabo. Daudi na Samweli omoorori bakababeeka ase emeremo, ekiagera babegenete.

english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD , namely , the house of the tabernacle , by wards .
ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo amo nabamura be chinderia chiabo bakagenderera korenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene, nero Eema eria.

english: In four quarters were the porters , toward the east , west , north , and south .
ekegusii: Abarendi baria b’ebiita bakabeera aria korenda chinsemo chia moocha, na bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi.

english: And their brethren , which were in their villages , were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo abarenge ase emechie yabo bakabetererigwa gocha koba amo nabarabwo ase kera rituko ria gatano na kabere ase engaki yachikiire.

english: For these Levites , the four chief porters , were in their set office , and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God .
ekegusii: Abalawi baria baane abarenge abateneneri b’emeremo y’okorenda ebiita nabwo batenenerete ebinyomba ne chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: And they lodged round about the house of God , because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakobeera isiko bagaetanana enyomba ya Nyasae, ekiagera emeremo y’oborendi nigo yabegetwe igoro ase bare, naende nabwo barenge koigora enyomba eria kera emambia. Abalawi bande

english: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels , that they should bring them in and out by tale .
