english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .
ekegusii: Naki omosacha oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho ya mokaye, na omokungu oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho y’omosaacha oye. Onye taibo, abana baino anga tibaaba abachenu; korende buna ere bono, babeire abachenu.

english: But if the unbelieving depart , let him depart . A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace .
ekegusii: Korende oria otegeneti karaganie gotigana, tiga atigane. Oyominto omosacha gose oyominto omokungu tasibiri ase amang’ana buna ayio, korende Nyasae obarangeirie ase omorembe.

english: For what knowest thou , O wife , whether thou shalt save thy husband ? or how knowest thou , O man , whether thou shalt save thy wife ?
ekegusii: Aye omokungu, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omosacha oo? Gose aye omosacha, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omokungu oo?

english: But as God hath distributed to every man , as the Lord hath called every one , so let him walk . And so ordain I in all churches .
ekegusii: Kera omonto agenderere ase obogima obw’Omonene amogabeire na ase obwo Nyasae amorangereirie. Naboigo nachigete ase chikanisa chionsi.

english: Is any man called being circumcised ? let him not become uncircumcised . Is any called in uncircumcision ? let him not be circumcised .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orangerigwe na Nyasae ekero aikire kwaroka, tekora buna tarogeti, na monto onde bwensi orangerigwe otarogeti, taroka.

english: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but the keeping of the commandments of God .
ekegusii: Okwaroka tai gento, na ogotaroka tai gento, korende nokobwata amachiiko a Nyasae.

english: Nevertheless , to avoid fornication , let every man have his own wife , and let every woman have her own husband .
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amateemwa ay’ogokora obotomani kera omosacha abe na mokaye omonyene, na kera omokungu abe nomosaacha oye omonyene.

english: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called .
ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga abe buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe.

english: Art thou called being a servant ? care not for it : but if thou mayest be made free , use it rather .
ekegusii: Inee! Igo kwarangeretigwe kore omosomba? Torora ng’a mbobe; korende koranyare gosiborwa, mbuya obe bo.

english: For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord’s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ’s servant .
ekegusii: Naki oyorangeretigwe ase Omonene kare omosomba, nomosibore ase Omonene. Naboigo noyorangeretigwe osiboire, nomosomba o Kristo.

english: Ye are bought with a price ; be not ye the servants of men .
ekegusii: Mokagorwa ase rigori, timoba abasomba b’abaanto.

english: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .
ekegusii: Kera omonto, baminto, buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe, tiga aikaranse boigo ase Nyasae.

english: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’abaiseke abekungi, tindi nogochika korwa ase Omonene, korende nabateebirie buna ndoche inche, buna oyonyorire amaabera korwa ase Omonene koba omwegenwa.

english: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .
ekegusii: Narorire ng’a ring’ana eri nerigiya ase engencho y’emechando eye tore nero, ng’a mbuya omonto abe buna are.

english: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .
ekegusii: Inee! Gwasibirwe ase omokungu? Torigia gosiborwa. Nosiboire? Torigia omokungu.

english: But and if thou marry , thou hast not sinned ; and if a virgin marry , she hath not sinned . Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh : but I spare you .
ekegusii: Korende koranyuome, tari ebibe gwakora; na omoiseke omwekungi karanyuomwe, tari ebibe akora. Korende abanto abwo nababe nemechando y’ense eye, na inche ninyanchete ng’a timosoa ase emechando eyio.

english: But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;
ekegusii: Korende baminto, nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekero getigarete negeke; gaki korwa bono baria bare nabakungu, tiga babe buna tibaabwati;

english: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .
ekegusii: Omosacha ae omokungu oye ekemogwenerete; naboigo nomokuungu ae omosacha oye ekemogwenerete.

english: And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;
ekegusii: na baria bakorera babe buna tibari korera; na baria bagogete babe buna tibagogeti: na baria bakogora babe buna tibari na gento;

english: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
ekegusii: na baria bagokorera ense eye babe buna tibari koyekorera, ekiagera ense buna ere bono ngoeta ere.

english: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng’a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

english: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .
ekegusii: korende oyonyuomire nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense eye, buna aragwenere mokaye;

english: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin . The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord , that she may be holy both in body and in spirit : but she that is married careth for the things of the world , how she may please her husband .
ekegusii: igo obeire nogwatananekana. Omoiseke omwekungi nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aranyare koba omochenu ase omobere na ase omoika, korende oyonyuomirwe nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense, buna aragwenere omosacha oye.

english: And this I speak for your own profit ; not that I may cast a snare upon you , but for that which is comely , and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction .
ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobakonya; tari ng’a nkobabeekera nde egetango, korende ase engencho y’ayio abagwenerete, erinde monyare gokorera Omonene motang’usiri namang’ana ande.

english: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi kararore ng’a takorereti omoiseke oye omwekungi ayamogwenerete, na onye omoiseke oyio oeteire obuya bw’obosae bwaye, onye negwenerete, tiga omonto oyio akore buna arigetie; tari ebibe akora, amotige anyuomwe.

english: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .
ekegusii: Korende oyotenenire noboremu ase enkoro yaye, na tari nokorigia, korende anyare kogambera okogania kwaye, naende orengereirie enkoro yaye ime amotige buna omoiseke oye omwekungi, nakore buya.

english: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .
ekegusii: Gaki oyoranyuome omoiseke omwekungi nakore buya; na oyotamonyuome okorire buya kobua.

english: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth ; but if her husband be dead , she is at liberty to be married to whom she will ; only in the Lord .
ekegusii: Omokungu nigo asibire ase omosacha oye ekero omosacha oye are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe; nanyare konyuomwa na monto onde bwensi oyo aranche, korende nase Omonene oka.

english: The wife hath not power of her own body , but the husband : and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body , but the wife .
ekegusii: Omokungu tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomosaacha oye; naboigo nomosaacha tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomokuungu oye.

english: But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .
ekegusii: Korende anga mbuya kobua karabe buna are. Nigo ndoche inche; na inche narengereirie ng’a ninde n’Omoika o Nyasae.

english: Defraud ye not one the other , except it be with consent for a time , that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer ; and come together again , that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency .
ekegusii: Timorinana otatiga mwancheranire ase egeka egeke, erinde monyare kwerua ase ogosaba; naende mobe amo, Saitani tacha kobateema ekiagera motanyare gwetanga.

english: But I speak this by permission , and not of commandment .
ekegusii: Aya nigo nkobateebia buna ndoche; tindi korua ogochika.

english: For I would that all men were even as I myself . But every man hath his proper gift of God , one after this manner , and another after that .
ekegusii: Ayanyanchete naro aya, ng’a abanto bonsi babe buna inche omonyene inde. Korende kera omonto nare nekeegwa kiaye omonyene gekorwa ase Nyasae, oyomo iga, na oyonde iga.

english: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows , It is good for them if they abide even as I .
ekegusii: Bono nkobateebia nde baria bataranyuoma, na ababoraka, mbuya babe buna inche inde.

english: But if they cannot contain , let them marry : for it is better to marry than to burn .
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakonyara gwetanga, tiga banyuome, ekiagera mbuya konyuoma kobua gosambwa nokogania.

english: Now as touching things offered unto idols , we know that we all have knowledge . Knowledge puffeth up , but charity edifieth .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “intwe twensi ntore ne chisemi.” “Chisemi” nigo chikorenta oboenenu, korende obwanchani nigo bokoagacha.

english: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple , shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols ;
ekegusii: Naki omonto karakorore aye, omonto ore nobong’aini, goikaransete ase endagera ime ase Hekalu y’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, Inee, onye enkoro yaye ekobugwa bwango, takonyora oboremu goika arie ebinto bikoruegwa ebingwanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa?

english: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish , for whom Christ died ?
ekegusii: Ase igo oria omoreu nigo agosirigwa ase engencho y’obong’aini bwao, nere oyominto Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.

english: But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, komorakorere abamino ebibe na goichania chinkoro chiria chikobugwa bwango, igo mwakoreire Kristo ebibe.

english: Wherefore , if meat make my brother to offend , I will eat no flesh while the world standeth , lest I make my brother to offend .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, endagera keragere oyominto agwe, rirorio tinkoria enyama nonya ng’ake, timbaisa kogera oyominto agwe.

english: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing , he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know .
ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a namanyete ring’ana rinde rionsi, oyio taramanya nonya mbono buna emogwenerete amanye.

english: But if any man love God , the same is known of him .
ekegusii: Korende omonto kamwanchete Nyasae, oyio omanyirwe nere.

english: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols , we know that an idol is nothing in the world , and that there is none other God but one .
ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana ay’okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”

english: For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many ,)
ekegusii: Gaki, nonya chire echinde chikorokwa chinyasae igoro gose ense (buna chire “chinyasae” chinyinge, na “abanene” abange)

english: But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
ekegusii: korende ase tore intwe Nyasae noyomo bweka, oyore Tata, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asare, na intwe nigo tore moyo asare. Naende nare Omonene oyomo, nere Yeso Kristo, na ebinto bionsi nere obitongete, naboigo naintwe nere ototongete. Okorenda chinkoro chi’abaminto echi chikobugwa bwango

english: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge : for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol ; and their conscience being weak is defiled .
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini obo tibori ime ase abanto bonsi. Abande, ekiagera bakwenaria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa goika bono, bakoria endagera buna egento kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, na ekiagera chinkoro chiabo chikobugwa bwango, nigo chikobekwa ogotacheneka.

english: But meat commendeth us not to God : for neither , if we eat , are we the better ; neither , if we eat not , are we the worse .
ekegusii: Korende endagera tegotorenta ang’e ase Nyasae. Totarieti, titogosiria gento, na toisa koria, tegotomenta gento.

english: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak .
ekegusii: Korende rigereria ng’a obosibore boria bwaino tibocha kobagocha baria bare abareu.

english: Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche tindi omosibore? Inche tindi omotomwa? Tinaroche Yeso, Omonene oito? Inwe timori okwama kw’emeremo yane ase Omonene?

english: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
ekegusii: Inee! Tateebete ayio ase engencho yaito yoka? Ee, nigo ariikire ase engencho yaito; ekiagera oyokorema nagwenerete korema ase ogosemeria, na ere oyokoora nigo akoora ase ogosemeria konyora ensemo yaye y’endagera.

english: If others be partakers of this power over you , are not we rather ? Nevertheless we have not used this power ; but suffer all things , lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ .
ekegusii: Onye abande banyorire ensemo ebatungetie korwa ase more, Inee, intwe titokoyenyora kobua mono? Korende titorakorera oboronge obo; korende nigo tokoremereria amang’ana onsi, titobaisa gotanga enchiri ya Kristo.

english: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .
ekegusii: Korende tindakorera amang’ana aya nonya ndimo. Gose tinyarigeti aya erinde abe boigo ase ’nde; naki mbuya ninkwa kobua omonto onde bwensi kong’ura ogwetogia kwane.

english: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel !
ekegusii: Naki onye nkorandia enchiri, tindi neri ingwetogeria, ekiagera okobetererigwa kwabekirwe ase ’nde. Obobe nobwane ntarandeti enchiri!

english: For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .
ekegusii: Naki onye ngokora emeremo eye ase ogwancha kwane, ninde neng’eria; korende onye tari ase ogwancha kwane, nonya nabo negenirwe noborendi.

english: What is my reward then ? Verily that , when I preach the gospel , I may make the gospel of Christ without charge , that I abuse not my power in the gospel .
ekegusii: Gaki eng’eria yane ninki? Neye, ng’a ndandie enchiri ya Kristo ntari konyora ebintungetie, na tinsaba ebiaboronge biane ase okorandia enchiri. Omokia o Paulo bw’okorenta abanto ase Kristo

english: For though I be free from all men , yet have I made myself servant unto all , that I might gain the more .
ekegusii: Naki nonya inde nobosibore korwa ase abanto bonsi, nekorire omosomba o bonsi, erinde ndete abanto abange kobua.

english: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .
ekegusii: Naki onye inche tindi omotomwa ase abande, korende nomotomwa inde ase more inwe. Inwe nigo more ekemanyererio ki’obotomwa bwane ase Omonene.

english: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;
ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi nkaba buna Omoyahudi, erinde mbarente Abayahudi; ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko nkaba buna oyore inse y’amachiiko (nonya inche omonyene tindi inse y’amachiiko) erinde mbarente baria bare inse y’amachiiko.

english: To them that are without law , as without law , ( being not without law to God , but under the law to Christ ,) that I might gain them that are without law .
ekegusii: Ase baria batari namachiiko nkaba buna oyo otari namachiiko (tari buna tindi namachiiko ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende nigo inde inse y’amachiiko a Kristo) erinde mbarente baria batari namachiiko.

english: To the weak became I as weak , that I might gain the weak : I am made all things to all men , that I might by all means save some .
ekegusii: Ase abare abareu nkaba omoreu, erinde mbarente abareu. Igo nkaba n’echingencho chionsi ase abanto bonsi, erinde inyare kobatooria abanto ase chinchera chionsi.

english: And this I do for the gospel’s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .
ekegusii: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye. Omokia ogwenerete ase obobui

english: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a abwo bakoamererania ase okominyoka chimbero, nigo bakominyoka bonsi, korende noyomo bweka okonyora eng’eria? Minyoka boigo, erinde moyenyore.

english: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
ekegusii: Na kera oyokoamererania ase chigosori nigo agwetanga ase onsi. Na abwo nigo bagokora bo, erinde banyore egutwa egosareka, korende intwe tonyore eye etagosareka.

english: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :
ekegusii: Nonya ninche nkominyoka nde chimbero ntari gotiting’ara; naboigo inkorwanera chinkundi, tari buna oyokorwana nembeo.

english: But I keep under my body , and bring it into subjection : lest that by any means , when I have preached to others , I myself should be a castaway .
ekegusii: Korende nigo ngochanda omobere one na koyokoria buna omosomba, erinde konarandeirie abande, inche timba omonto ogocha kwangwa.

english: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this ,
ekegusii: Oko nakwo okoiraneria kwane ase baria bakomboria.

english: Have we not power to eat and to drink ?
ekegusii: Inee! Titori ne ribaga ri’okoria na konywa?

english: Have we not power to lead about a sister , a wife , as well as other apostles , and as the brethren of the Lord , and Cephas ?
ekegusii: Titori ne ribaga koira amo naintwe omokungu ore oyominto ase okwegena buna abatomwa bande, na abamwabo Omonene, na Kefa bakorete?

english: Or I only and Barnabas , have not we power to forbear working ?
ekegusii: Gose ninche bweka na Barnaba totari ne ribaga ri’ogotiga emeremo ya kera rituko?

english: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?
ekegusii: Morwani ki okogenda ase esegi kero kende gionsi na kweakanera ere omonyene? Moremi ki otakoria amasabibu ’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu? Gose ning’o okorisia riicho, otakonywa amabeere aye?

english: Say I these things as a man ? or saith not the law the same also ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ngokwana aya buna Mwanyabaanto? Gose amachiiko tari goteeba boigo?

english: If we say that we have not sinned , we make him a liar , and his word is not in us .
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titokoreti ebibe, twakorire Nyasae koba omonyaborimo, gose ring’ana riaye tiriri ime yaito.

english: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you , that ye also may have fellowship with us : and truly our fellowship is with the Father , and with his Son Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Eri twarorire na koigwa, eri naboigo tokobaraareria inwe, erinde nainwe monyare kobwatana naintwe. Okobwatana gwaito nigo kore amo na Tata na Omwana oye Yeso Kristo.

english: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
ekegusii: Nkobariikera tore aya, erinde omogooko oito oikeranigwe. Nyasae nomobaso

english: This then is the message which we have heard of him , and declare unto you , that God is light , and in him is no darkness at all .
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobaraareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.

english: If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a twabwatanire nere, naende togendererete ase omosunte, igo twatebiire oborimo, gose ayare ay’ekeene titori koyakora.

english: But if we walk in the light , as he is in the light , we have fellowship one with another , and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin .
ekegusii: Korende onye tokogenda ase omobaso, buna ere are ase omobaso, rirorio twabwatanire intwe ase intwe, na amanyinga a Yeso, Omwana oye, nigo agotosibia ebibe biaito bionsi.

english: If we say that we have no sin , we deceive ourselves , and the truth is not in us .
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titori na bibe, iga tokweng’aina, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaito.

english: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
ekegusii: Gatorabiorokie ebibe biaito, ere nomwegenwa na omonyene oboronge, natwabere ebibe biaito, na atosibie korwa ase ogotaba boronge gwonsi.

english: My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, nkobariikera nde aya, erinde timokora ebibe. Korende onye omonto okorire ebibe, ntore n’Omosaberi ase Tata, nere Yeso Kristo, Omonyene Oboronge.

english: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
ekegusii: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.

english: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .
ekegusii: Korende ere oyogechete oyomwabo nigo are ase omosunte ime, naende nigo akogenda ase omosunte, na tamanyeti nonya nase agochia, ekiagera omosunte omoukoirie amaiso aye.

english: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake .
ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y’erieta riaye.

english: I write unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I write unto you , young men , because ye have overcome the wicked one . I write unto you , little children , because ye have known the Father .
ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobariikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.

english: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .
ekegusii: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.

english: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
ekegusii: Timwancha ense eye, nonya n’ebinto bire ase ense. Omonto karanche ense eye, obwanchani bwa Tata tibori ime yaye.

english: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .
ekegusii: Naki bionsi ebire ase ense eye, okogania okobe kw’omobere, na okogania okobe kw’amaiso, na oboenenu bw’obogima obo, tibiri korua ase Tata, korende nigo bikorua ase ense.

english: And the world passeth away , and the lust thereof : but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever .
ekegusii: Na ense eye nigo egoeta, na okogania kwaye, korende ere oyogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo akoba moyo goika kare na kare. Omobisa o Kristo

english: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists ; whereby we know that it is the last time .
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney’omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng’a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng’a engaki eye ney’omoerio.

english: They went out from us , but they were not of us ; for if they had been of us , they would no doubt have continued with us : but they went out , that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us .
ekegusii: Abwo basokire korwa ase tore, korende tibarenge abaito. Naki onye nabaito baare, anga mbabete amo naintwe. Korende barureo, erinde emanyekane ng’a tari bonsi barenge abaito.

english: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .
ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.

english: But ye have an unction from the Holy One , and ye know all things .
ekegusii: Na inwe mwaakirwe amaguta nere oyore Omochenu, na mwamanyire onsi.

english: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
ekegusii: Tinabarikerete inwe, ekiagera motamanyeti ekeene, korende nekiagera mokemanyete, naende momanyete ng’a borimo bonde tibori bokorwa ase ekeene.

english: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
ekegusii: Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokaana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokaana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.

english: Whosoever denieth the Son , the same hath not the Father : [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokana Omwana tari na Ise. Ere oyokomobera Omwana kirori nigo are na Ise boigo.

english: Let that therefore abide in you , which ye have heard from the beginning . If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you , ye also shall continue in the Son , and in the Father .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, tiga aikaranse ime yaino. Onye amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani aikaransete ime yaino, erio nainwe namomenye ime ase Omwana, na ime ase Ise.

english: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
ekegusii: Eye nero eira atorierete intwe, ng’a tonyore obogima bwa kare na kare.

english: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .
ekegusii: Nabarikeire amang’ana aya igoro y’abwo bakorigia kobasiria.

english: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you , and ye need not that any man teach you : but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things , and is truth , and is no lie , and even as it hath taught you , ye shall abide in him .
ekegusii: Korende ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang’ana onsi, naende kore ogw’ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.

english: And now , little children , abide in him ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
ekegusii: Na bono inwe abana baane, menya ime asare, erinde ekero akoorokigwa tobe noboremu, titoba nobosooku ase obosio bwaye ekero arachiche.

english: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
ekegusii: Onye mwamanyire ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naboigo mobe nobomaene ng’a kera oyogokora boronge, oyio oiboirwe nere.

english: And hereby we do know that we know him , if we keep his commandments .
ekegusii: Onye tobwatete amachiiko aye, ntore nobomaene ng’a ntomomanyete.

english: He that saith , I know him , and keepeth not his commandments , is a liar , and the truth is not in him .
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba, “Nimomanyete,” na tabwateti amachiiko aye, oyio nomonyaborimo, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaye.

english: But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .
ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatete ring’ana riaye, ime ase oyio obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaikeranigwe ekeene ekeene. Ase eri ntore nobomaene ng’a nigo tore ime asare:

english: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo amenyete ime asare, nagwenerete kogenda ere omonyene buna Yeso arenge kogenda. Ogochika okoyia

english: Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .
ekegusii: Naende nkobariikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw’ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw’ekeene oikire kobara.

english: He that saith he is in the light , and hateth his brother , is in darkness even until now .
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,

english: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .
ekegusii: Ase eri abana ba Nyasae nigo bare maiso marore, na abana ba Saitani boigo: Onde bwensi otari gokora boronge tarueti ase Nyasae, nonya noyo otancheti oyomwabo. Twanchane intwe ase intwe

english: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .
ekegusii: Timokumia, baminto, onye abanto b’ense bakobagecha.

english: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer : and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogechete oyomwabo oyio nomoiti, na inwe momanyete ng’a omoiti tari nobogima bwa kare na kare ime yaye.

english: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us : and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren .
ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.

english: But whoso hath this world’s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?
ekegusii: Korende oyore n’ebinto bi’ense, na arore oyomwabo oremeire, gotamororera amaabera, Inee, naki obwanchani bwa Nyasae borabe ime asare oyio?

english: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue ; but in deed and in truth .
ekegusii: Abana baane, titwancha ase amang’ana gose ase ogokwana, korende ase ogokora, na ase ekeene. Oboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae

english: And hereby we know that we are of the truth , and shall assure our hearts before him .
ekegusii: Ase eri natomanye ng’a nigo tore ab’ekeene, na ase obosio bwaye natoremie chinkoro chiaito.

english: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him ; for we shall see him as he is .
ekegusii: Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe ntogwekane nere, ekiagera natomoorore buna are.

english: For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .
ekegusii: Onye chinkoro chiaito chigotogambia, Nyasae nomonene kobua chinkoro chiaito, na ere nigo amanyete onsi.

english: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
ekegusii: Abanchani, onye chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, rirorio ntore noboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae,

english: And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .
ekegusii: na rinde rionsi togosaba nigo tokorinyora korwa asare, ekiagera ntobwatete amachiiko aye, naende igo tokoyakora ayakomogwenera.

english: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him , and he in him . And hereby we know that he abideth in us , by the Spirit which he hath given us .
ekegusii: Na bonsi ababwatete amachiiko aye nigo bamenyete ime asare na ere ime ase bare. Na igo twamanyire ng’a ere nigo amenyete ime ase tore, twayamanyire korwa ase Omoika oria atoeire.

english: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself , even as he is pure .
ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi omosemeretie nigo agwechena buna Kristo are omochenu.

english: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law : for sin is the transgression of the law .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, nigo agosaria amachiiko, ekiagera ebibe nogosaria kw’amachiiko.

english: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi omenyete ime asare tagokora ebibe; onde bwensi ogokora ebibe tamorochi, nonya nkomomanya tamomanyeti.

english: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
ekegusii: Abana baane, monto onde tabaisa kobang’aina. Ere oyogokora oboronge nigo are omonyene oboronge, buna Kristo are omonyene oboronge.

english: He that committeth sin is of the devil ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .
ekegusii: Ere oyogokora ebibe noyo o Saitani, ekiagera Saitani nigo akorete ebibe korwa omochakano. Ekiagerete Omwana o Nyasae akaorokigwa neke, ng’a asarie emeremo ya Saitani.

english: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .
ekegusii: Kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, ekiagera oroiboro rwa Nyasae ndotigarete ime yaye, gose takonyara gokora ebibe, ekiagera oiboirwe na Nyasae.

english: Beloved , believe not every spirit , but try the spirits whether they are of God : because many false prophets are gone out into the world .
ekegusii: Abanchani, timwegena kera omoika, moteeme emeika onye neya Nyasae, ekiagera ababani b’oborimo abange basokire gochia ase ense.

english: Herein is love , not that we loved God , but that he loved us , and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins .
ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani, tari ng’a nintwe twamwanchete Nyasae, korende nere otwanchete intwe, agatoma Omwana oye koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito.

english: Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .
ekegusii: Abanchani, onye Nyasae otwanchete igo, netogwenerete naintwe boigo gwanchana intwe ase intwe.

english: Hereby know we that we dwell in him , and he in us , because he hath given us of his Spirit .
ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire ng’a ntomenyete ime asare, nere ime ase tore: Ere otoeire Omoika oye.

english: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world .
ekegusii: Na intwe twarorire, naende twabeire birori ng’a Ise otomire Omwana oye koba Omotooria bw’ense.

english: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi okoorokia ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime asare, na ere ime ase Nyasae.

english: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .
ekegusii: Na intwe twamanyire obwanchani obo Nyasae are naborobwo ase tore, na kobwegena. Nyasae nobwanchani, na ere oyomenyete ase obwanchani nigo amenyete ime ase Nyasae, na Nyasae ime asare.

english: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .
ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwaikeranigwe ime yaito, erinde tobe noboremu ase rituko ri’ekiina, ekiagera buna ere are, naboigo naintwe tore ase ense eye.

english: There is no fear in love ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .
ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nobwoba, korende obwanchani oboikeranu nigo bogoseria obwoba gochia isiko. Naki obwoba mbore negesusuro, na oyore nobwoba taikeraniri ase obwanchani.

english: We love him , because he first loved us .
ekegusii: Intwe twanchire, ekiagera ere natwanchete intwe ritang’ani.

english: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God : Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God :
ekegusii: Ase eri nario moramanye Omoika o Nyasae: Kera omoika oyokoorokia Yeso Kristo, ng’a ochire ase omobere, oyio noyo o Nyasae,

english: If a man say , I love God , and hateth his brother , he is a liar : for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen , how can he love God whom he hath not seen ?
ekegusii: Omonto karatebe, “Nimwanchete Nyasae,” naende ogechete oyomwabo, oyio nomonyaborimo. Ere oyotamwancheti oyomwabo oyio aroche, takonyara komwancha Nyasae oyio atarochi.

english: And this commandment have we from him , That he who loveth God love his brother also .
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika twaeirwe nere: Ere oyomwanchete Nyasae anche noyomwabo boigo.

english: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come ; and even now already is it in the world .
ekegusii: korende kera omoika otakoorokia Yeso igo, oyio tori oyo o Nyasae. Oyio noro omoika bw’omobisa o Kristo; oyio mwaigure ng’a ngocha are, na bono oikire gocha ase ense ime.

english: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .
ekegusii: Abana baane, inwe naba Nyasae more, naende mwabuire baria, ekiagera ere oyore ime ase more nomonene kobua ere oyore ime ase ense.

english: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
ekegusii: Abwo nab’ense bare. Ase ayio, ayabagokwana nay’ense, na ense igo ekobaigwa.

english: We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore aba Nyasae. Ere oyomanyete Nyasae nigo agotoigwa, na ere oyotari o Nyasae tagotoigwa. Ase eri twamanyire gwatanana Omoika bw’ekeene, na omoika bw’ogosira. Nyasae nobwanchani

english: Beloved , let us love one another : for love is of God ; and every one that loveth is born of God , and knoweth God .
ekegusii: Abanchani, twanchane, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bokorwa ase Nyasae, na kera oyobwanchire oiboirwe na Nyasae, naende namomanyete Nyasae.

english: He that loveth not knoweth not God ; for God is love .
ekegusii: Oyotancheti, tamomanyeti Nyasae, ekiagera Nyasae nobwanchani.

english: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwarorekanire ase tore: Nyasae otomire Omwana oye omomoima ase ense, erinde tonyore obogima asare.

english: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God : and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him .
ekegusii: Kera omonto oyobwegenete ng’a Yeso nere Kristo oiboirwe na Nyasae, na kera oyoramwanche omoibori, omwanchire na oyoiboirwe nere.

english: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself : he that believeth not God hath made him a liar ; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son .
ekegusii: Ere oyomwegenire Omwana o Nyasae nare noborori obwo ime yaye. Ere oyotamwegeneti Nyasae omokorire koba omonyaborimo, ekiagera tegeneti oborori boria Nyasae aorokirie igoro y’Omwana oye.

english: He that hath the Son hath life ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .
ekegusii: Ere oyore n’Omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n’Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima. Okomanya obogima bwa kare na kare

english: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .
ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe amang’ana aya, erinde momanye ng’a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri’Omwana o Nyasae.

english: And this is the confidence that we have in him , that , if we ask any thing according to his will , he heareth us :
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo asare, ng’a gatoramosabe gento kende gionsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye, nigo aratoigwe.

english: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .
ekegusii: Na gatomanyete ng’a nigo agotoigwa ase kende gionsi togosaba, twamanyire ng’a twanyorire keria twasabire korwa asare.

english: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death , he shall ask , and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death . There is a sin unto death : I do not say that he shall pray for it .
ekegusii: Omonto kararore oyomwabo ogokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri, amosabere, na Nyasae namoe obogima; aya nase abwo bagokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri. Mbireo ebibe bi’amakweri; tintebeti ng’a asabe ase engencho y’ebio.

english: All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
ekegusii: Bionsi ebitari ebiaboronge nebibe, korende mbireo ebibe bitari ebi’amakweri.

english: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, korende oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akwerenda, na oria omobe takomokuna.

english: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a nigo tore aba Nyasae, na ense yonsi nigo ere inse y’okobua kw’oria omobe.

english: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
ekegusii: Ase ring’ana eri twamanyire ng’a twabanchire abana ba Nyasae ekero twamwanchire Nyasae, na kobwata amachiiko aye.

english: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Omwana o Nyasae oikire gocha, na ere otoeire ebirengererio bi’okomanya ere oyore bw’ekeene. Na intwe nigo tore ime asare ere oyore bw’ekeene, ime ase Omwana oye Yeso Kristo. Oyio nere ore Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende obogima bwa kare na kare.

english: Little children , keep yourselves from idols . Amen .
ekegusii: Abana baane, erende inwe abanyene korwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.

english: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .
ekegusii: Kera oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akobua ense, na oko nakwo okobua korabue ense, okwegena gwaito.

english: Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?
ekegusii: Oyorabue ense ning’o, otatiga ere oyobwegenire ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae? Oborori igoro y’Omwana o Nyasae

english: This is he that came by water and blood , even Jesus Christ ; not by water only , but by water and blood . And it is the Spirit that beareth witness , because the Spirit is truth .
ekegusii: Yeso Kristo, nere oyo ochete ase amaache na amanyinga, tari ase amaache oka, korende ase amaache na amanyinga.

english: For there are three that bear record in heaven , the Father , the Word , and the Holy Ghost : and these three are one .
ekegusii: Na Omoika noro obeire kirori, ekiagera Omoika noro ekeene.

english: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
ekegusii: Mbire birori bitato: Omoika, na amaache, na amanyinga, na ebi bitato nigo bikorua oborori obomo.

english: If we receive the witness of men , the witness of God is greater : for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son .
ekegusii: Onye togwancha oborori bwa Mwanyabaanto, oborori bwa Nyasae nobonene kobua, na oborori bwa Nyasae nobo, ng’a oikire kobeera Omwana oye kirori.

english: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices very great store , and precious stones : there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon .
ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria akaa omorwoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitaabu chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Naende ebinsari tibiarentetwe kero kende gionsi ebinge koreng’ana buna biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omorwoti Sulemani.

english: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .
ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Hiramu, chiria chiarentete chitaabu korwa Ofiri, chikarenta naende korwa aroro chibao chi’emete ekorokwa alumugu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene.

english: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD , and for the king’s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .
ekegusii: Korwa ase chibao chi’alumugu omorwoti akaroisia ebinto bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omorwoti, naende akaroisia amakano na ebinto binde bikobugigwa nabateri. Chibao chi’emete buna eyio tichiana kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense eye.

english: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie na aboretie aegwe. Amo n’ebinto ebio Sulemani akamoa ebinto binde ebinge buna omorwoti anarete korua ebiegwa. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye. Obotenenku bw’omorwoti Sulemani (2 Amg 9:13-29)

english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold ,
ekegusii: Etaabu yaare korentwa ase Sulemani kera omwaka nigo yarenge goetania chikiro chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000).

english: Beside that he had of the merchantmen , and of the traffick of the spice merchants , and of all the kings of Arabia , and of the governors of the country .
ekegusii: Boigo chitaabu chikarentwa korwa ase abaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria baarenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, na korwa ase abarwoti bonsi b’Arabia na abagabana bande baarenge goakana ebango ase omorwoti.

english: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaroisia chinguba amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya nigo yarenge koira chitaabu chikiro isato na ekeng’ese.

english: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
ekegusii: Naende akagoncha chinguba amagana atato agachiooma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba nigo yarenge koira chitaabu ang’e chikiro ibere. Omorwoti agachibeeka ime ase Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.

english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaroisia ekerogo ki’oborwoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu na agakeooma netaabu echenire.

english: The throne had six steps , and the top of the throne was round behind : and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat , and two lions stood beside the stays .
ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’oborwoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo; ensemo ya magega ekerogo keria nigo kiamurumuntire igoro. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.

english: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
ekegusii: Agacha Yerusalemu amo nabasomba baye abange baarenge kogenda komo; boigo nabwate chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari ne chitaabu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamoteebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.

english: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps : there was not the like made in any kingdom .
ekegusii: Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ebere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera egetambokero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo buna ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogaambi bonde bwonsi.

english: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omorwoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitaabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitaabu chichenire; binde tibiarenge bie chifeta. Ase amatuko a Sulemani efeta tiyabarire ng’a negento kie rigori.

english: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tharshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
ekegusii: Omorwoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitaabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi’ebieni ebiya.

english: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abarwoti bonsi b’ense ase obonda na obong’aini.

english: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
ekegusii: Abanto korwa ase chinse chionsi bagacha ase Sulemani, erinde baigwe obong’aini boria Nyasae abegete ime yaye.

english: And they brought every man his present , vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and garments , and armour , and spices , horses , and mules , a rate year by year .
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye, ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, ne chibarasi, ne chibarasi, ebinto ebinge mono, omwaka ase omwaka.

english: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , did they bring them out by their means .
ekegusii: Kera egari yarenge korentwa korwa Misiri nigo yarenge goakanerwa rigori rie chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana atano na rimo, na ebarasi nigo yarenge goakanerwa chisekeli rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Na goetera ase abaonchoreria b’omorwoti abarwoti bonsi b’Abahiti na ab’Abasiiria nigo baarenge kogora chigari ne chibarasi.

english: And Solomon told her all her questions : there was not any thing hid from the king , which he told her not.
ekegusii: Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase omorwoti, igo amanyete onsi na komoyorokia.

english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom , and the house that he had built ,
ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana eria ya Seba akoorire korora obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,

english: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.
ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na buna abakoonyi baye bamenyete, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga chiabo babeegete, na buna ababogoria babogoretie ebikombe, naende akarora buna omorwoti arenge gosamba ebing’wanso biaye ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumata.

english: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .
ekegusii: Eting’ana eria egateebia omorwoti: “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene bori.

english: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio nare koigwa goika ekero nachicha aa na kwerorera namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinateebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’amang’ana aya. Obong’aini bwao, na obotenenku bwao biaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.

english: Happy are thy men , happy are these thy servants , which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom .
ekegusii: Abanto bao na abasomba bao aba bagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao na obong’aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.

english: Blessed be the LORD thy God , which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the LORD loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na okobekire ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli. Ekiagera Omonene anchete Abaisraeli botambe, agakobeeka okaba omorwoti, erinde onyare konacha ekeene na oboronge.”

english: And had commanded him concerning this thing , that he should not go after other gods : but he kept not that which the LORD commanded .
ekegusii: naende konya amochikiire ase ring’ana erio, ng’a tabaisa gotunyana chinyasae chinde. Korende Sulemani tarenda amang’ana ayio Omonene amochiigete.

english: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agateebia Sulemani, “Ekiagera gwakorire ayio, na tikwabwatete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, gose amachiiko aane aya nagochiigete, goika ntandorane na ndusie oborwoti korwa asore, imboe omosomba oo.

english: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son .
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho ya Daudi ise tingokora ayio ase amatuko ao, korende nigo ndabotandorane korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oo.

english: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, tinkorusia oborwoti bwonsi korwa ase omwana oo, nimoe egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, naende ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete.” Ababisa ba Sulemani

english: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon , Hadad the Edomite : he was of the king’s seed in Edom .
ekegusii: Omonene akarentera Sulemani omobisa, na omobisa oyio nere Hadadi, omonto bw’enyomba y’oborwoti bwa Edomu.

english: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom , and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain , after he had smitten every male in Edom ;
ekegusii: Ase engaki Daudi arenge agwo Edomu, Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akagenda gotindeka baria baitetwe.

english: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel , until he had cut off every male in Edom :)
ekegusii: Joabu amo na Abaisraeli bonsi baarenge komo bagatigara agwo Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo, bagaita na gosiria kegima kera omosacha bw’aroro.

english: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt ; Hadad being yet a little child .
ekegusii: Korende Hadadi agatama gochia Misiri amo nabaanto bande b’Edomu, abasomba ba ise. Na ekero keria Hadadi nigo arenge omosae omoke.

english: And they arose out of Midian , and came to Paran : and they took men with them out of Paran , and they came to Egypt , unto Pharaoh king of Egypt ; which gave him an house , and appointed him victuals , and gave him land .
ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.

english: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
ekegusii: Hadadi akanyora ogwancherwa okonene ase obosio bwa Farao, na Farao akamonyuomeria mokoyoye, omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi mokaye, oyio orenge eting’ana.

english: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son , whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house : and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Na omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi akaiborera Hadadi Genubati, omwana omomura. Tapenesi agatacha omwana oyio agwo ase enyomba ya Farao, na Genubati akabeera ase enyomba ya Farao amo nabana abamura ba Farao.

english: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the host was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , Let me depart , that I may go to mine own country .
ekegusii: Hadadi, ekero arenge ase ense ya Misiri, akaigwa ng’a Daudi orarire ase chisokoro chiaye chiaraarete, naende ng’a Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, nere okuure agateebia Farao: “Ing’a ribaga ngende ase ense yane.”

english: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country ? And he answered , Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise .
ekegusii: Korende Farao akamobooria: “Ngento ki kwaremeirwe aiga ase ’nde ekiagera okoboria ribaga ogende ase ense yao?” Hadadi akamoiraneria: “Aye ntiga rioka, ngende.”

english: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akarentera Sulemani omobisa onde, na omobisa oyio nere Resoni, mosinto bw’Eliada, oria konya otamire korwa ase omonene oye Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba.

english: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band , when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus , and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus .
ekegusii: Agwo kare ekero Daudi akoorire ogoita koria okonene ase egati yabo, oyio Resoni agasangereria abanto asare, na akaba omotang’ani bw’ekeombe keria ki’abaomboganu. Barabwo bakagenda Damesiki, bakaba bakogaambera abanto b’aroro.

english: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .
ekegusii: Resoni nigo abeete omobisa bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi aya Sulemani arenge kogamba, agakora ogosaria okonene buna Hadadi akorete; akagechia Abaisraeli, akaba okogaambera Abasiiria. Eira ya Nyasae ase Yeroboamu

english: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat , an Ephrathite of Zereda , Solomon’s servant , whose mother’s name was Zeruah , a widow woman , even he lifted up his hand against the king .
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo arenge korokwa Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Omoefarati o Sereda. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Serua, ere nigo arenge omoboraka. Yeroboamu akaanga koigwera omorwoti.

english: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king : Solomon built Millo , and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father .
ekegusii: Aya naro agerete Yeroboamu akaba mamincha y’omorwoti. Sulemani nigo aagachete Milo, na agaticha egetongo kiarenge ase Omochie o Daudi ise.

english: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .
ekegusii: Omonto oria Yeroboamu nigo arenge omonto ore nomokia mono, na ekero Sulemani amorooche ng’a nigo arenge omokong’u ase emeremo yaye, akamobeka akaba omoteneneri igoro ase emeremo eria abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu baarenge kobetererigwa gokora.

english: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way ; and he had clad himself with a new garment ; and they two were alone in the field :
ekegusii: Na ase engaki eria, ekero Yeroboamu agendete isiko korwa Yerusalemu, omobani Ahiya korwa Silo akanyorana nere inchera. Ahiya igo ambarete egetambaa ekeyia; bono abanto aba babere bakaba boka aase aarabu.

english: And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .
ekegusii: Igo anyuomete abakungu amagana atano na abere, naende nabwate abakungu ba sere‐sere amagana atato. Abakungu baria baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye, erinde agatiga Omonene.

english: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces :
ekegusii: Ahiya akabwata egetambaa keria ekeyia ambarete, akagetandora ebing’ese ikomi na bibere,

english: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel , Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee:
ekegusii: agateebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebiire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oborwoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.

english: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel :)
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani ere atware egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, na ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli.

english: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .
ekegusii: Aya nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bantigire na basasimire Asitaroti, enyasae enkuungu y’Abasidoni, na Kemosi, enyasae y’Abamoabu, na Milikomu, enyasae y’Abaamoni, gose tibabwateti chinchera chiane na tibakorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bwane ase okorenda emeroberio yane echiikire na amachiiko aane, buna Daudi ise akorete.

english: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo tinkorusia oborwoti bwonsi korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, korende nimobeke abe omogambi ase engaki y’amatuko aye onsi are moyo. Aya ninkore ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, oria nachorete, oria orendete amachiiko aane amaachenu na emeroberio yane echiikire.

english: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand , and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes .
ekegusii: Nindusie oborwoti korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,

english: And unto his son will I give one tribe , that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem , the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
ekegusii: korende omwana oye nimoe egesaku ekemo, erio Daudi, omosomba one, botambe atware etaya ekomoreka ase obosio bwane agwo Yerusalemu, omochie nachorire mbeeke erieta riane aroro.

english: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .
ekegusii: Ninkobeke ogambe igoro ase bionsi buna omoyo oo oganetie, naye nobe omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.

english: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did ; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee.
ekegusii: Koranyigwere na okore onsi aya nagochikiire na obwatie chinchera chiane, na okore ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane ase okorenda emeroberio yane na amachiiko aane buna Daudi, omosomba one, akorete, rirorio nimbe amo naye. Naende ningotenenerie egesaku kegendererete, buna nateneneretie Daudi, ninkobeke ogambere Abaisraeli.

english: And I will for this afflict the seed of David , but not for ever .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninchande abanto b’ororeeria rwa Daudi, korende tekoba igo kogenderera botambe.”

english: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God , as was the heart of David his father .
ekegusii: Ee, ekero Sulemani konya agotire, abakungu baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye gochia ase chinyasae chinde, na ere tabeete omwegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi ise arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa.

english: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam . And Jeroboam arose , and fled into Egypt , unto Shishak king of Egypt , and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon .
ekegusii: Sulemani akarigia goita Yeroboamu, korende Yeroboamu akaimoka, agatama gochia Misiri, ase Sisaki, omorwoti o Misiri, akamenya agwo Misiri goika ekero Sulemani akwete. Ogokwa gwa Sulemani (2 Amg 9:29)

english: And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Sulemani, na aya onsi akorete, na obong’aini bwaye bwonsi nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora gwa Sulemani.

english: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years .
ekegusii: Engaki Sulemani agambete agwo Yerusalemu igoro ase Abaisraeli nemiaka emerongo ene.

english: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omomura oye, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga ria ise.

english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
ekegusii: Sulemani igo atunyaanete na gokorera Asitaroti, enyasae enkuungu y’Abasidoni, na Milikomu, okogechia kw’Abaamoni.

english: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD , and went not fully after the LORD , as did David his father .
ekegusii: Sulemani agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, tamotunyanete ase obwegenwa, buna Daudi ise arenge gokora.

english: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .
ekegusii: Moocha ya Yerusalemu Sulemani akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro ase Kemosi, okogechia kw’Abamoabu, na ase Moleki, okogechia kw’Abaamoni, chinyasae chiria, chiarenge agosasimerwa.

english: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .
ekegusii: Naboigo aroiseretie abakungu baye bonsi baria anyuomete korwa ase ebisaku ebiaao; barabwo bagasamba ubani na bakarua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chiabo.

english: And the LORD was angry with Solomon , because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel , which had appeared unto him twice ,
ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase Sulemani, ekiagera enkoro yaye yaonchogete korwa asare ere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oria omoorokerete ara kabere,

english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeeka abe omorwoti.

english: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying , Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins .
ekegusii: Abamura baria bakinete komo bakamoteebia: “Aya naro orateebie abanto abwo bakoboretie ng’a bwororobie rikorogoto riria iso akorete ririto: Ekiara gi’okoboko kwane nigo kere ekenetu kobua ekebono gia tata

english: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababeekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabe nkobang’wania ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”

english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .
ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabaanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu rituko ria gatato, buna omorwoti abateebeetie ng’a bakore.

english: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;
ekegusii: Omorwoti akairaneria abanto baria amang’ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.

english: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , and I will add to your yoke : my father also chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateeba: “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”

english: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people ; for the cause was from the LORD , that he might perform his saying , which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
ekegusii: Ase ayio omorwoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abaanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete n’Omonene, erinde ere anyare goikerania ring’ana riaye riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.

english: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu agatigwa okogaambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda yoka.

english: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu agatoma Adorama, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, gochia ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo bonsi bakamoaka amagena, agakwa; na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.

english: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli babeire bare mamincha na gosaria igoro ase enyomba ya Daudi goika reero iga.

english: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt ;)
ekegusii: Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia korwa ase omorwoti Sulemani.

english: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete ng’a Yeroboamu oiranire, bagatoma abanto bamorangerie ache ase omosangererekano, bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli. Omonto onde tari otunyanete abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, otatiga abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda boka. Semaya okorenta amang’ana ay’Omonene amoete (2 Amg 11:1-4)

english: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem , he assembled all the house of Judah , with the tribe of Benjamin , an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men , which were warriors , to fight against the house of Israel , to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon .
ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na egesaku kia Benjamini, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagende korwania Abaisraeli na bairanie oborwoti ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani.

english: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God , saying ,
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae,

english: Speak unto Rehoboam , the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,
ekegusii: rikamoteebia: “Teebia Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, otebie nabaanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na aba eya Benjamini, na abanto bande abatigari ng’a:

english: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house ; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD , and returned to depart , according to the word of the LORD .
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene atebiire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abateebeetie. Yeroboamu ogotiga Omonene

english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel .
ekegusii: Erio Yeroboamu akaagacha omochie Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akamenya aroro, naende akarua agwo, akagenda akaagacha Penueli.

english: And Jeroboam said in his heart , Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David :
ekegusii: Yeroboamu akarengereria ase enkoro yaye ime: “Bono oborwoti igo borabaise koirana bogende ase enyomba ya Daudi.

english: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .
ekegusii: Abanto aba baise kona kogenda korua ebing’wanso ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, chinkoro chiabo nigo chiramoiranere omonene obo Rehoboamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na kobaramoiranere nigo barang’ite.”

english: And he set the one in Beth-el , and the other put he in Dan .
ekegusii: Akabeeka eyemo Beteli na eya kabere agwo Dani.

english: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
ekegusii: Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu, na ere amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagateebia Rehoboamu,

english: And this thing became a sin : for the people went to worship before the one , even unto Dan .
ekegusii: Egento eke gekagera bagakora ebibe, ekiagera abanto igo bagendete nonya ngoika Dani gosasiima enyasae eyemo y’echio.

english: And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .
ekegusii: Naende Yeroboamu akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agachora abakuani korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi abwo batarenge Abalawi. Ogosasiima agwo Beteli kogokanwa

english: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi achorete ere omonyene, akagenda ase egesasiimero aroisetie, agatwara Rituko Rinene ase Abaisraeli na akariina ase egesasiimero gosamba ubani.

english: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter , and we will serve thee.
ekegusii: “Iso igo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe natogokorere.”

english: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days , then come again to me. And the people departed .
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akabateebia: “Genda inwe, na magega y’amatuko atato moirane gocha aa ase ’nde.” Ase ayio abanto bakagenda.

english: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men , that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , and said , How do ye advise that I may answer this people ?
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu akabooria ogosemia korwa ase abagaaka baria baarenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria: “Ngosemia ki mokong’a, erinde imbairanerie abanto aba?”

english: And they spake unto him, saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever .
ekegusii: Abagaaka bakamoiraneria: “Onye koganetie gokorera abanto aba bono, oigwe okoboria kwabo na okwane amang’ana amaya ase bare, erio barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”

english: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
ekegusii: Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria na akarigia ogosemia korwa ase abamura baria bakinete komo, na bono baarenge komokorera.

english: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people , who have spoken to me, saying , Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter ?
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a inyororobie chigurube chiria tata ababeekerete?”

english: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Beth-el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .
