english: Elihoreph and Ahiah , the sons of Shisha , scribes ; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , the recorder .
ekegusii: Elihorefu na Ahiya, basinto ba Sisa, nabwo baarenge abariki. Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.

english: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country , and all the wisdom of Egypt .
ekegusii: Obong’aini bwa Sulemani nigo bwabuete obw’abaanto bonsi ba Moocha na obw’Abamisiri bonsi.

english: And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .
ekegusii: Ere nigo areenge goteeba igoro y’emete yonsi, emenene buna emecharake ya Lebanoni na ebimeri ebike buna hisopo eyekomera ase chindwaki. Boigo agateeba igoro ye ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura, ne chinswe.

english: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon , from all kings of the earth , which had heard of his wisdom .
ekegusii: Abanto bakarwa ase chinse chionsi, bagacha koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense bagatoma abanto bagachia komoigwa.

english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omochiki bw’abasikari. Zadoki na Abiatari, nabwo baarenge abakuani.

english: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers : and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer , and the king’s friend :
ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge omoteneneri igoro ase abanene baria. Zabudi, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge Omokuani, naende nigo areenge omosani bw’omorwoti.

english: And Ahishar was over the household : and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute .
ekegusii: Ahisari, nere otenenerete enyomba y’obogaambi. Adoniramu, mosinto o Abuda, nere otenenerete emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.

english: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .
ekegusii: Sulemani nachorete abanto abanene ikomi na babere abaarenge gosangereria endagera na koyerentera omorwoti amo nab’enyomba yaye. Kera oyomo ase aba ikomi na babere nigo areenge korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka.

english: And these are their names : The son of Hur , in mount Ephraim :
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abaanto abwo. Beni‐Huri agatenenera ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu.

english: The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth-shemesh , and Elon-beth-hanan :
ekegusii: Beni‐Dekeri agatenenera emechie ya Makasi, na Shaalabimu, na Beti‐Semesi, na Eloni, na Beti‐Hanani.

english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo ekero aigwete ng’a Sulemani oakirwe amaguta na obeire omorwoti ribaga ria ise, agatoma abasomba baye asare, ekiagera Hiramu botambe igo anchete Daudi.

english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire .
ekegusii: Hiramu akaa Sulemani emete, emecharake na emetarakwa buna Sulemani aganetie.

english: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .
ekegusii: Sulemani akaa Hiramu obosie bw’engano ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000) koba endagera ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni chilita chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana abere (7,200). Ebinto ebio Sulemani akaba okoa Hiramu ase kera omwaka.

english: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon ; and they two made a league together .
ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani obong’aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw’okoigwana.

english: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agakora omooroberio bw’abaanto chilifu emerongo etato (30,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akababeeka bakore emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.

english: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens , and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains ;
ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) abaarenge kobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) abaarenge kobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa.

english: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work , three thousand and three hundred , which ruled over the people that wrought in the work .
ekegusii: Naende Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu isato na amagana atato (3,300) batenenerete abanto baarenge gokora emeremo.

english: And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
ekegusii: Omorwoti akabachika baabaache amagena amanene aye rigori rinene, erinde oboroso bw’enyomba bobekwe amagena abaachire buya.

english: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .
ekegusii: Naboigo abaagachi ba Sulemani, na aba Hiramu amo nabaanto b’omochie o Gebali bagakora emeremo y’okobaacha na gosenia amagena na koroisia chibao ase oboagacho boria.

english: And Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,
ekegusii: Na Sulemani agatoma amang’ana ase Hiramu, akabora,

english: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet .
ekegusii: “Nomanyete ng’a Daudi tata tanyarete koagacha enyomba ase ogosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera ababisa nigo baarenge komorwania chiseegi chinsemo chionsi, goika ekero Omonene ababeegete inse ase obogaambi bwa Daudi.

english: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .
ekegusii: Korende bono Omonene, Nyasae one, ong’eire obotoereru korwa ase kera ensemo; ababisa tibari aande, gose amabe ande onsi.

english: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .
ekegusii: Na bono aye, chiika abanto bangechere emete emecharake ya Lebanoni. Abasomba baane mbabwatane nabasomba bao ase emeremo eyio, na inche ning’akane abasomba bao eng’eria ende yonsi orabeeke. Nomanyete ng’a abanto baane tibamanyeti kogecha emete buna abanto ba Sidoni.”

english: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the LORD this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
ekegusii: Ekero Hiramu aigwete amang’ana a Sulemani, akaba nomogooko omonene, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe rituko ria reero, oyo oeire Daudi omwana omomura omong’aini agambere abanto aba abange.”

english: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .
ekegusii: Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Sulemani, agateeba: “Naigure amang’ana gwatomire ase ’nde; igo inde ang’e gokora onsi aya oganetie ase amang’ana ’emete emecharake na emetarakwa.

english: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .
ekegusii: Abasomba baane mbayetirimbokie korwa ase Lebanoni gochia ase enyancha, nainche ninyebeke amo inyesibe, eirwe nenyancha echeng’enenete, goika aase oganetie. “Aase agwo nao erasansorerwe, na aye oyerusieo. Erio ong’isanekerie okogania kwane ase okobaa abanto baane endagera yabo.”

english: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt , in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel , in the month Zif , which is the second month , that he began to build the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana ane, na emerongo etano na etato, magega Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, noro omwaka o kane bw’okogaamba gwa Sulemani igoro y’Abaisraeli, ase omotienyi o Sivu, omotienyi o kabere, Sulemani agachaaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene.

english: And then he built chambers against all the house , five cubits high : and they rested on the house with timber of cedar .
ekegusii: Oboagacho bw’enyomba inse nigo bwatunyaine Hekalu, na kera rirongo nigo riareenge nobotambe gochia igoro ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Oboagacho obwo nigo bwabwateranetigwe ne Hekalu ne chibao chi’emecharake.

english: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon , saying ,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Sulemani, rikamoteebia,

english: Concerning this house which thou art in building , if thou wilt walk in my statutes , and execute my judgments , and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father :
ekegusii: “Amang’ana igoro y’enyomba eye okong’agachera bono nigo arabe iga: Korabwatie emeroberio yane echiikire na koigwera amachiiko aane onsi na koyakora, erio nainche ning’ikeranie ring’ana riane asore, riria nakwanete na Daudi iso:

english: And I will dwell among the children of Israel , and will not forsake my people Israel .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ndamenye aroro ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tingotiga abanto baane Abaisraeli.” Okoroisia Hekalu ime (2 Amg 3:8-14)

english: So Solomon built the house , and finished it.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaagacha enyomba eria na akayekoora buna iga:

english: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar , both the floor of the house , and the walls of the cieling : and he covered them on the inside with wood , and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir .
ekegusii: Agatuba chinyasi chia ime y’enyomba yonsi korwa inse goika igoro ne chibao chi’emecharake, na inse y’enyomba akayetuba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa.

english: And the house , that is , the temple before it, was forty cubits long .
ekegusii: Ensemo y’enyomba yareenge Hekalu enyene nigo yareenge y’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ene.

english: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers : all was cedar ; there was no stone seen .
ekegusii: Chibao chi’emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiareenge nemegwekano y’ebirandi, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.

english: And the oracle he prepared in the house within , to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ime ye Hekalu bosio kegima nigo aroisetie akanyomba aase Esanduki y’Okobwatana y’Omonene yareenge kobekwa.

english: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD , the length thereof was threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof twenty cubits , and the height thereof thirty cubits .
ekegusii: Enyomba eria omorwoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yareenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

english: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length , and twenty cubits in breadth , and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold ; and so covered the altar which was of cedar .
ekegusii: Obotambe bw’akanyomba karia ka ime nigo bwareenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; naboigo obogare bwaye na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, naende nigo kaoomire netaabu echenire. Bosio bw’akanyomba karia egesasiimero gekaroisigwa, kegatubwa ne chibao chi’emecharake.

english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold : and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle ; and he overlaid it with gold .
ekegusii: Sulemani akaooma Hekalu ime netaabu engiya. Chingataare chiaoomire netaabu chikabekwa ase egesieri bosio bw’akanyomba ka ime.

english: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub , and five cubits the other wing of the cherub : from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera orobaaba rwa kera oyomo nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko atano; korwa ensinyo y’orobaaba oromo goika ey’oronde nigo bwareenge obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi.

english: And the other cherub was ten cubits : both the cherubims were of one measure and one size .
ekegusii: Omokerubi oria onde boigo nigo areenge bw’ekerengo ekio ekio. Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere nigo baarenge bareng’aine kegima ase ekerengo na bagwekaine ase ekieni.

english: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits , and so was it of the other cherub .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko ikomi.

english: And he set the cherubims within the inner house : and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims , so that the wing of the one touched the one wall , and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall ; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakabeekwa ase akanyomba karia bosio ime ye Hekalu. Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire; orobaaba oromo rw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba oyomo rogaika enyasi ensemo eyemo, na oromo rw’oyonde rogaika enyasi ensemo ende; gati‐gati y’enyomba orobaaba ronde rwa kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba rogakunana.

english: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere bakaoomwa netaabu.

english: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers , within and without .
ekegusii: Sulemani agachabera chinyasi chionsi chie Hekalu, na echi’akanyomba ka ime, nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio.

english: And the porch before the temple of the house , twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house ; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house .
ekegusii: Enyomba eria yaagachetwe bosio bwe Hekalu enyene nigo yareenge iga: Obotambe bwaye gochia ime nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, nigo bwareng’aine nobogare bwe Hekalu.

english: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold , within and without .
ekegusii: Inse ase ebinyomba ebio bibere akaooma netaabu.

english: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree : the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall .
ekegusii: Ebisieri bibere bikaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni bikabekwa ase egesoero gi’akanyomba ka ime. Emetobwa nigo yatenenirie ensemo eyemo ya isano y’enyasi.

english: The two doors also were of olive tree ; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers , and overlaid them with gold , and spread gold upon the cherubims , and upon the palm trees .
ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bionsi bibere bi’emezeituni bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Akaooma bionsi netaabu; boigo agasiarera ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba amo ne chibao chi’emekendo netaabu.

english: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree , a fourth part of the wall .
ekegusii: Naende emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu enyene ekaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni ere ne chikoona inye,

english: And the two doors were of fir tree : the two leaves of the one door were folding , and the two leaves of the other door were folding .
ekegusii: na ebisieri bibere bi’emetarakwa; kera egesieri nigo kiareenge ebing’ese bibere biare konyara koigorwa biaringanigwa.

english: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers : and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work .
ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio, bikaoomwa buya netaabu igoro y’emegwekano eyio.

english: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone , and a row of cedar beams .
ekegusii: Naende Sulemani akaagacha chindwaki chi’eraaro ya ime. Chindwaro isato chie chindwaki echio agachiagacha namagena abaachire, na orwaro oromo akaroagacha ne chibao chi’emecharake.

english: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid , in the month Zif :
ekegusii: Oboroso bwe Hekalu bokabekwa ase omotienyi o Sivu, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogaamba gwa Sulemani.

english: And in the eleventh year , in the month Bul , which is the eighth month , was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
ekegusii: Na ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi o Bulu, ase omwaka o ikomi nomo, oboagacho bwe Hekalu bokaera buna yaroberetigwe. Ase igo Sulemani akaira emiaka etano na ebere ase okoagacha enyomba eria.

english: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights .
ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ase enyomba eria ebibao bi’emete; ebibao ebio tibiareenge koigorwa.

english: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about , against the walls of the house round about , both of the temple and of the oracle : and he made chambers round about :
ekegusii: Naende akaagacha chinyomba chinde inse, chinyasi chiaye chichomeranirie ne chinyasi chi’enyomba enyene ase amakere na magega, akanachana ebinyomba imeo.

english: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad , and the middle was six cubits broad , and the third was seven cubits broad : for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about , that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house .
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ebinyomba bia inse nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na ebie rirongo ria kabere amaboko atano na rimo, na ebie rirongo ria gatato amaboko atano na abere. Nigo akorete ebitambokero bikabwatana nenyasi ye Hekalu ase kera rirongo, erinde emeriibo egosiira kera rirongo etoorere ase ebitambokero ebio, etari gosoigwa ase enyasi.

english: And the house , when it was in building , was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house , while it was in building .
ekegusii: Ekero enyomba yaagachetwe, igo yaagachetwe namagena aseneirie agwo aase areenge kobaacherwa, erinde eriogi ri’enyundo, gose eri’egesire, gose eri’egekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma tikeigugwa ase Hekalu ekero yaagachetwe.

english: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house : and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber , and out of the middle into the third .
ekegusii: Egesoero kegosoera ebinyomba bia inse nigo kiareenge ensemo ya Irianyi ye Hekalu na goetera ase ebiriinero abanto nigo baarenge koriina gochia ase rirongo ria kabere, na korwa aroro bariina gochia ase rirongo ria gatato.

english: So he built the house , and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar .
ekegusii: Naboigo Sulemani akaagacha Hekalu, akayekoora. Akaroisia risang’ina ri’enyomba ne chibao chi’emecharake.

english: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years , and he finished all his house .
ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka ikomi na etato ase okoagacha enyomba yaye omonyene na koyekoora.

english: And the foundation was of costly stones , even great stones , stones of ten cubits , and stones of eight cubits .
ekegusii: Amagena ’oboroso nigo areenge aye rigori rinene, amagena amanene na amarito, ayande ay’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi, na ayande ay’amaboko atano na atato.

english: And above were costly stones , after the measures of hewed stones , and cedars .
ekegusii: Igoro y’oboroso nareengeo amagena ande e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, amo nemeriibo y’emecharake.

english: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones , and a row of cedar beams , both for the inner court of the house of the LORD , and for the porch of the house .
ekegusii: Orwaki rw’eraaro enene igo rwaagachetwe namagena abaachire, abekire chindwaro isato gochia igoro, ne chibao chi’emecharake orwaro oromo. Naboigo norwaki rw’eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene amo nenyomba yareenge bosio bw’aroro. Emeremo ya Hiramu

english: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akarangeria Hiramu achiche korwa Turo.

english: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali , and his father was a man of Tyre , a worker in brass : and he was filled with wisdom , and understanding , and cunning to work all works in brass . And he came to king Solomon , and wrought all his work .
ekegusii: Hiramu nigo areenge omwana bw’omokuungu omoboraka bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, na ise nigo areenge omonto o Turo, omoturi bwe chitaai. Hiramu omonyene nigo areenge nobong’aini obonge amo ne chisemi, omanyete gotura ebinto binde bionsi bie chitaai. Ere agacha ase Sulemani, akamokorera emeremo yaye yonsi. Chisiiro ibere chi’etai (2 Amg 3:15-17)

english: For he cast two pillars of brass , of eighteen cubits high apiece : and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about .
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia chisiiro ibere chi’etai; obotambe bwa kera esiiro eyemo nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere egaetanana kera esiiro.

english: And he made two chapiters of molten brass , to set upon the tops of the pillars : the height of the one chapiter was five cubits , and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits :
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebisure bibere bi’etai enyititoire na kobombwa, akabibeeka igoro ye chisiiro; obotambe gochia igoro bwa kera egesure nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko atano.

english: And nets of checker work , and wreaths of chain work , for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars ; seven for the one chapiter , and seven for the other chapiter .
ekegusii: Kera egesure igoro ye chisiiro nigo giachabeire nebichanga bitano na bibere biasisire goetanana.

english: And he made the pillars , and two rows round about upon the one network , to cover the chapiters that were upon the top , with pomegranates : and so did he for the other chapiter .
ekegusii: Akarosia emegwekano y’amakomomanga, akayebeeka ase chindwaro ibere igoro y’ebichanga biareenge ase ebisure biria.

english: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch , four cubits .
ekegusii: Ebisure igoro ye chisiiro chiareenge ime y’enyomba ya bosio, nigo biabombire bigwekaine ebisicha; obotambe bwabo nobw’amaboko ane.

english: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon ; the length thereof was an hundred cubits , and the breadth thereof fifty cubits , and the height thereof thirty cubits , upon four rows of cedar pillars , with cedar beams upon the pillars .
ekegusii: Akaagacha enyomba ekorokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato. Ero nigo yaagachetwe amo ne chisiiro chi’emecharake chindwaro inye. Igoro ase chisiiro echio emiamba y’emecharake yabaachetwe ekabekwa.

english: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above , over against the belly which was by the network : and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter .
ekegusii: Ebisure ebio nigo biareenge igoro ase chisiiro chiria ibere na igoro ye chinsemo chiatambeete gochia isiko. Emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana abere yareenge ase chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure.

english: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple : and he set up the right pillar , and called the name thereof Jachin : and he set up the left pillar , and called the name thereof Boaz .
ekegusii: Hiramu akabeeka chisiiro chiria ase enyomba bosio bwe Hekalu; esiiro yabegetwe ensemo ya Irianyi akayeroka Yakini, na eyabegetwe ensemo ya sugusu akayeroka Boazi.

english: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work : so was the work of the pillars finished .
ekegusii: Ebisure nigo biabombire buna ebisicha nigo biareenge igoro ase chisiiro. Na igo emeremo ye chisiiro ekaera. Egetuba ekenene keroisirie korwa ase etai (1 Amg 4:2-5)

english: And he made a molten sea , ten cubits from the one brim to the other : it was round all about , and his height was five cubits : and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about .
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia egetuba ekenene korwa ase etai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiareenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato ekanyara goetanana egetuba ekio.

english: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit , compassing the sea round about : the knops were cast in two rows , when it was cast .
ekegusii: Ang’e nomogo emegwekano y’amasosa iyareengeo, ikomi ase kera ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, yarandete ekeringero ekegima. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge chindwaro ibere, yabombire ase egento ekemo negetuba keria.

english: It stood upon twelve oxen , three looking toward the north , and three looking toward the west , and three looking toward the south , and three looking toward the east : and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward .
ekegusii: Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y’emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia Irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia magega chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y’egetuba keria.

english: And it was an hand breadth thick , and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup , with flowers of lilies : it contained two thousand baths .
ekegusii: Obonetu bw’etai yaroiseretigwe egetubwa keria, nigo bwarenge obw’obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko, na omogo okaroisigwa buna oyo bw’egekombe, gose obw’egesicha. Egetuba keria nigo kiarenge kobekwa amaache aisaine ang’e chilita chilifu emerongo etano (50,000). Ebibekerero bi’ebituba bikoroisigwa korwa ase etai

english: And he made ten bases of brass ; four cubits was the length of one base , and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
ekegusii: Naende Hiramu akaroisia ebibekerero ikomi bi’ebituba korwa ase chitaai. Obotambe bwa kera ekebekerero nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atato.

english: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders , and the borders were between the ledges :
ekegusii: Ebibekerero biria nigo biakoretwe iga: Chinsingo nchiarenge ase chinsemo chiabo ase egati ye chinsingo chie chikoona.

english: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions , oxen , and cherubims : and upon the ledges there was a base above : and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work .
ekegusii: Ase chinsingo echio yarengeo emegwekano ye chindo, na eye chieri, na ey’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba; naboigo nase chinsingo chie chikoona igoro. Igoro na inse y’emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge emegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisirie chingata.

english: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams , that lay on forty five pillars , fifteen in a row .
ekegusii: Enyomba nigo yareenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.

english: And every base had four brasen wheels , and plates of brass : and the four corners thereof had undersetters : under the laver were undersetters molten , at the side of every addition .
ekegusii: Kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge namagoro ane aroisetigwe korwa ase etai. Ase chikoona chi’ekebekerero ebisiirero mbiarengeo. Ebisiirero ebio nigo biabombire nemegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisetigwe chingata ase kera ekemo.

english: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit : but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base , a cubit and an half : and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders , foursquare , not round .
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’ekebekerero nigo orenge igoro ime y’orosingo rw’obotambe gochia igoro okoboko okomo. Omonwa oyio orenge egesingo otambeete gochia inse, obotambe bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, nao ebiechabero biarenge. Emetobwa yaye nigo yarenge ne chikoona, tiyarenge egesingo.

english: And under the borders were four wheels ; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base : and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit .
ekegusii: Amagoro aye ane nigo abegetwe inse ye chinsingo chiaye, ne rinyongo riaye nigo ribwateranirie nekebekerero. Obotambe bwa kera okogoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel : their axletrees , and their naves , and their felloes , and their spokes , were all molten .
ekegusii: Amagoro ayio nigo aroisetigwe buna aye chigari. Amagoro amagima nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase etai yanyititoire na kobombwa. Boigo amanyongo, ne chingata, na ebitingiro biaroisetigwe.

english: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base : and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
ekegusii: Ebisiirero bine mbiarenge ase kera ekebekerero ase chikoona chiaye; biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nekebekerero.

english: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high : and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
ekegusii: Igoro kegima ase kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge orosingo rw’obogare bw’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo; na igoro ase orosingo orwo nigo biarenge ebisiirero amo ne chinsingo chie chinsemo. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nebisiirero.

english: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims , lions , and palm trees , according to the proportion of every one , and additions round about .
ekegusii: Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.

english: After this manner he made the ten bases : all of them had one casting , one measure , and one size .
ekegusii: Naboigo akaroisia ebibekerero bionsi ikomi. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase etai enyititoire na kobombwa; nigo biareng’aine na nigo biagwekaine.

english: And he put five bases on the right side of the house , and five on the left side of the house : and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south .
ekegusii: Akabeeka ebibekerero bitano ensemo ya Irianyi ye Hekalu, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu, na egetuba keria ekenene agakebeeka ensemo ya Irianyi ya moocha. Ebikorero bie Hekalu (2 Amg 4:11—5:1)

english: And there were windows in three rows , and light was against light in three ranks .
ekegusii: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

english: And Hiram made the lavers , and the shovels , and the basons . So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD :
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia ebituba, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Naboigo agakoora emeremo yonsi eyaetwe na Sulemani ng’a akore ase enyomba y’Omonene.

english: The two pillars , and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars ; and the two networks , to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars ;
ekegusii: Akaroisia chisiiro ibere, na ebisure bibere biabegetwe igoro ye chisiiro, na ebichanga bisisire biaetanaine, bigatuba chinsemo chi’ebisure echiatambeete gochia isiko,

english: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks , even two rows of pomegranates for one network , to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars ;
ekegusii: na emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana ane eyabegetwe igoro y’ebichanga ebio, chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure kiarenge igoro ye chisiiro, erinde ensemo y’ebisure biria yatambeete etubwe.

english: And the ten bases , and ten lavers on the bases ;
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba ikomi biaterekereireo,

english: And one sea , and twelve oxen under the sea ;
ekegusii: na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere ekabekwa inse y’egetuba keria,

english: And the pots , and the shovels , and the basons : and all these vessels , which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD , were of bright brass .
ekegusii: ne chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaatoire nigo biare ebibekerero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, Hiramu aroiseretie omorwoti Sulemani. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai chisibirie buya.

english: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omorwoti akabibomba korwa ase etai enyititoire, ime ase esike ebombire agwo egati ya Sukoti na Saretani ase Riranya ria Yorodani.

english: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed , because they were exceeding many : neither was the weight of the brass found out .
ekegusii: Sulemani agatiga korenga ebinto ebi bionsi, ekiagera biarenge ebinge mono. Oborito bw’etai eria tibwamanyekanete buna bwang’ana.

english: And all the doors and posts were square , with the windows : and light was against light in three ranks .
ekegusii: Ebisoero bionsi na ebibao nigo biareenge ne chikoona inye, na ebibao nigo biarigereranetie bire ase chindwaro isato.

english: And the bowls , and the snuffers , and the basons , and the spoons , and the censers of pure gold ; and the hinges of gold , both for the doors of the inner house , the most holy place, and for the doors of the house , to wit , of the temple .
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chisani ne chigami, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chimbata chi’ebisieri bi’akanyomba ka ime, Aase Aachenu Mono, na echi’ebisieri bie Hekalu enyene. Ebinto ebio bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

english: And he made a porch of pillars ; the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth thereof thirty cubits : and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
ekegusii: Boigo akaagacha eero ye chisiiro. Obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etato. Bosio bw’enyomba eyio akaagacha egesona, na bosio aroro chisiiro chire nekerama.

english: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge , even the porch of judgment : and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other .
ekegusii: Naende akaagacha Enyomba y’ekerogo ki’Oborwoti, eye ekarokwa naende Enyomba y’ekegambero aase areenge kogaambera ebiina. Eye nigo yatubetwe ne chibao chi’emecharake korwa inse goika igoro.

english: All these were of costly stones , according to the measures of hewed stones , sawed with saws , within and without , even from the foundation unto the coping , and so on the outside toward the great court .
ekegusii: Echio chionsi nigo chiagachetwe namagena amaya ye rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, akanachwa nemesumeno chinsemo chionsi korwa oboroso goika rigasio ri’enyasi. Amagena onsi nigo aroisetigwe bo, nonya naya e risiko amo nay’orwaki rw’eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud : for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: na igo abakuani tibaarenge konyara kogenderera nobokoreri bwabo ase engencho ye riire riria, ekiagera obonene bw’Omonene bwaichorete ase enyomba y’Omonene.

english: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
ekegusii: Bono nakoagacheire enyomba ebe obomenyo bwao, aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.” Sulemani ogokwana ase abanto (2 Amg 6:3-11)

english: And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : (and all the congregation of Israel stood ;)
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akeonchora akarigereria abanto, agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ekero oteneine,

english: And he said , Blessed be the LORD God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,
ekegusii: agateeba, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ere oyoikeranirie nokoboko kwaye aya arierete Daudi tata eira nomonwa oye, ogoteeba:

english: And the LORD said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya, okabeeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.

english: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the LORD promised , and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel .
ekegusii: “Bono Omonene oikeranirie eira eria ariete, ekiagera inche natenenire ribaga ria Daudi tata, na ngoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene ariete eira, naende naagacheire erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.

english: And I have set there a place for the ark , wherein is the covenant of the LORD , which he made with our fathers , when he brought them out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Naende aroro agwo naroisirie aase Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene ekobeera. Okobwatana kori’Omonene akorete ne chisokoro chiaito, ekero aching’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.” Ogosaba gwa Sulemani (2 Amg 6:12-42)

english: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasiimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,

english: And he said , LORD God of Israel , there is no God like thee, in heaven above , or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :
ekegusii: agakwana, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Nyasae onde tari akogwekaine, igoro nonya ninse aa ase ense, aye bweka nigo okorenda okobwatana kw’ogotianania, naende nigo okoorokia obwanchani botari koera ase abasomba bao baria bare abegenwa asore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.

english: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth , and hast fulfilled it with thine hand , as it is this day .
ekegusii: Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria reero.

english: And now, O God of Israel , let thy word , I pray thee, be verified , which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga ring’ana riao riria gwatebeetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.

english: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O LORD my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, na oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche omosomba oo nkogosaba bono iga.

english: And all the elders of Israel came , and the priests took up the ark .
ekegusii: Ekero abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bachete, abakuani bakaimokia Esanduki y’Omonene,

english: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .
ekegusii: Naende aye oigwe okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo inche, omosomba oo, na okw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli ekero bagosaba barigereretie aase aiga. Ee, oigwe aye korwa igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore, na ekero okoigwa bwabere.

english: If any man trespass against his neighbour , and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear , and the oath come before thine altar in this house :
ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasiimero kiao ase enyomba eye,

english: Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .
ekegusii: aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore ogokora kwao, onachere abasomba bao ekiina kia boronge. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omooronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.

english: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto bao Abaisraeli barabe babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,

english: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abaanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.

english: When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them:
ekegusii: “Ekero igoro erabe esiekire na embura tetwa, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, kobarasabe barigereretie aase aiga, naende batogie erieta riao na baonchoke batige ebibe biabo, ekero aye orabae egesusuro,

english: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .
ekegusii: rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, okoborokereria enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende otwerie ense yao embura, ense eria kwaeire abanto bao ekaba omwando obo.

english: If there be in the land famine , if there be pestilence , blasting , mildew , locust , or if there be caterpiller ; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities ; whatsoever plague , whatsoever sickness there be;
ekegusii: “Kerabe enchara erache ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw’ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi,

english: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man , or by all thy people Israel , which shall know every man the plague of his own heart , and spread forth his hands toward this house :
ekegusii: oigwe ogosaba kwabo. Omonto onde bwensi, gose abanto bao bonsi Abaisraeli kobaragosabe na gokoboria ase oboitongo, kera oyomo omanyete emechando ere ase enkoro yaye, naende barambore amaboko abo gochia ase enyomba eye,

english: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest ; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men ;)
ekegusii: obaigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore. Bwabere, okore ogokora kwao, okorere kera oyomo koreng’ana nogokora kwaye, (ekiagera naye bweka omanyete chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto bonsi,)

english: And they brought up the ark of the LORD , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
ekegusii: bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebikorero bionsi ebichenu biarenge ime ase Eema eria. Abakuani na Abalawi nabwo barentete ebinto ebio.

english: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .
ekegusii: erinde banyare gokoiroka amatuko onsi bamenyete ase ense eria kwaete chisokoro chiaito.

english: Moreover concerning a stranger , that is not of thy people Israel , but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;
ekegusii: “Boigo onye omogeni korwa ase ense y’aare, oria otari bw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli, okoigwa chinkuma chi’erieta riao rinene,

english: (For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm ;) when he shall come and pray toward this house ;
ekegusii: (ekiagera abanto inabaigwe igoro y’erieta riao rinene, naende baigwe igoro y’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru koramboire,) onye omogeni oyio ogocha aa kogosaba origereretie enyomba eye,

english: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee, as do thy people Israel ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.

english: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :
ekegusii: “Abanto bao kobaragende ase esegi korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,

english: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo, na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.

english: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near ;
ekegusii: “Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase ayio baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu ase bare na kobabeeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo baboose na kobaira ase ense y’ababisa ere aare gose ang’e, obaigwe.

english: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness ;
ekegusii: Kobararore okomocha kwabo ekero bare ase ense eria boosirwe gochia, beitie na koonchoka, naende bakogosaba ase oboitongo na koorokia ng’a bakorire ebibe na obokayayu, obaigwe.

english: And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
ekegusii: Onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, baria baboosete, na aroro bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasiima erieta riao,

english: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place , and maintain their cause ,
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo.

english: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, baria basangererekanete amo nere bagatenena bosio bw’Esanduki eria, bakaruera aroro ebing’wanso bie ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono chitaare konyara kobareka.

english: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive , that they may have compassion on them:
ekegusii: Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire baabarorere amabeebe.

english: For they be thy people , and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt , from the midst of the furnace of iron :
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabaanto bao, na omwando oo, oria kwarusetie korwa Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko ri’ekebemberi ki’omorero.

english: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant , and unto the supplication of thy people Israel , to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
ekegusii: “Tiga amaiso ao abe atorigereretie namaabera, inche omosomba oo amo nabaanto bao Abaisraeli, otoigwe ekero kende gionsi togokorangeria ase oboitongo.

english: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord GOD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo kwabaatananete korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense babe omwando oo, buna gwateebete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo, ekero keria kwarusetie chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri.” Ogosaba kw’omoerio

english: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD , he arose from before the altar of the LORD , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Sulemani akoorete ogosaba oko gwonsi na okobori’Omonene ase oboitongo, akaimoka korwa ase egesasiimero ki’Omonene aase atung’amete namaru aye inse oramborete amaboko aye gochia igoro,

english: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
ekegusii: agatenena agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana neriogi rinene, akabora,

english: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers : let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe naintwe buna abeete ne chisokoro chiaito; tabaisa gototiga gose gotwanga,

english: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .
ekegusii: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.

english: And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD , be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require:
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aane nasabire ase oboitongo, tiga Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe okoyainyora omobaso na obotuko, naende ae abanto baye Abaisraeli oboronge bwabo koreng’ana buna okogania gwa kera rituko kore.

english: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place , into the oracle of the house , to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims .
ekegusii: Erio abakuani bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakayesoyia aase aye ase akanyomba ka ime, agwo Aase Aachenu Mono, bakayebeka inse ye chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

english: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God , and that there is none else.
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ense yonsi banyare komanya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae, naende enyasae ende teri.

english: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga chinkoro chiaino chionsi chibe echi’ekeene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mobwatie emeroberio yaye echiikire na mobwate amachiiko aye buna mwakorire ase rituko ria reero.” Ogwatananwa gwe Hekalu (2 Amg 7:4-10)

english: And the king , and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti na abanto bonsi amo nere bakarua ekeng’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the LORD , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase Omonene, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, ne ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere. Naboigo omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba y’Omonene.

english: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omorwoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi’etai ekiarenge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.

english: And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him, a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the LORD our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Sulemani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi mbabwate Amatuko Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, naende ase amatuko ande atano na abere, amatuko onsi nikomi na ane. Omosangererekano omonene nigo orenge gosangerereka korwa egesoero kia Hamati goika akarooche ka Misiri.

english: On the eighth day he sent the people away : and they blessed the king , and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant , and for Israel his people .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato agatiga abanto bakagenda, na barabwo bagasesenia omorwoti, bakagenda chinka chiabo bare nomogooko na omosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo ase engencho y’obuya bwonsi bori’Omonene akorerete Daudi, omosomba oye, na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.

english: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark , and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo nigo baramborete chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’aase aria Esanduki eria yarenge, bagatuba Esanduki eria amo nemiaro yaye yaare kobogorerigwa.

english: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .
ekegusii: Emiaro eria nigo yarenge emetambe, ne chinsinyo chiabo chikarorekana korwa Aase Aachenu ase oyo oteneine bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, korende tiyarenge kororekana korwa isiko; nero nao ere agwo goika reero iga.

english: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD , and the king’s house , and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do ,
ekegusii: Ekero Sulemani konya akoorire koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’oborwoti, na aande onsi ase anchete koagacha,

english: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , when Solomon had built the two houses , the house of the LORD , and the king’s house ,
ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka emerongo ebere ase okoagacha chinyomba chiria ibere, enyomba y’Omonene na ey’oborwoti.

english: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire ,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, konya oeire Sulemani chibao chi’emecharake, na echi’emetarakwa, amo ne chitaabu ase ekerengo aganetie. Magega y’ayio omorwoti Sulemani akaa Hiramu emechie emerongo ebere yarenge ase ense ya Galili.

english: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Hiramu achete korwa Turo korora emechie eria, tiyamogogetie.

english: And he said , What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother ? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day .
ekegusii: Akabora: “Emechie eye kwang’eire, oyominto, naki ere?” Ase eyio igo ekorokwa ense ya Kabuli goika reero iga.

english: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold .
ekegusii: Hiramu konya otomeire omorwoti chitaabu chikiro chilifu inye (4,000). Amang’ana ande Sulemani akorete (1 Amg 8:3-18)

english: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised ; for to build the house of the LORD , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’emeremo Sulemani abeetereretie abanto bakore: Akababeeka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba yaye omonyene, na Milo, na orwaki rwaetanaine Yerusalemu, na emechie ya Hasori, na Megido, na Geseri,

english: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon’s wife .
ekegusii: (Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, konya ochire korwania Geseri na koyosakora, naende akayosamba nomorero. Agaita abanto ba Kaanani baria bamenyete aroro, na koyorua buna ekeegwa ki’ogosokia omoiseke oye abe moga Sulemani.

english: And Solomon built Gezer , and Beth-horon the nether ,
ekegusii: Bono Sulemani akaagacha Geseri naende). Boigo akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya maate,

english: And Baalath , and Tadmor in the wilderness , in the land ,
ekegusii: na Baalati, na Tamari ore ase erooro, ase ense eria,

english: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots , and cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .
ekegusii: na emechie yonsi ye chikungo, eria Sulemani abwate, na emechie ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi, na oboagacho bonde bwonsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu, na agwo Lebanoni na ase ense yonsi y’oborwoti bwaye.

english: And all the people that were left of the Amorites , Hittites , Perizzites , Hivites , and Jebusites , which were not of the children of Israel ,
ekegusii: Abanto aba Sulemani abetereretie gokora emeremo, nigo baarenge abe chinderia chi’abaanto b’ense ya Kaanani, abwo Abaisraeli batanyarete kobua na gosiria kegima.

english: Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibaarenge Abaisraeli. Nigo baarenge Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Abanto abwo bakagenderera koba abasomba, nabo bare goika reero iga.

english: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba. Barabwo nigo baarenge abarwani b’esegi, na abakoonyi b’oborwoti, na abachiki baye b’abarwani, na abatang’ani b’abarwani, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.

english: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .
ekegusii: Abateneneri abanene igoro y’emeremo ya Sulemani nigo baarenge abanto amagana atano, na emerongo etano; abwo nigo batenenerete abanto baarenge gokora emeremo eria.

english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo .
ekegusii: Korende mosubati o Farao akarua ase Omochie o Daudi, agatiira gochia komenya ase enyomba yaye eria Sulemani konya amoagacheire; magega y’ayio Sulemani akaagacha Milo.

english: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaroisia chimeeri agwo Esioni‐Geberi ere ang’e na Eloti, ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, ase ense ya Edomu.

english: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants , shipmen that had knowledge of the sea , with the servants of Solomon .
ekegusii: Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang’ana nabaanto ba Sulemani.

english: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri, bakarenta korwa aroro chitaabu, chikiro chilifu ikomi na inye, na amagana atano (14,500), bakairera omorwoti Sulemani.

english: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao na okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo. Naatananire na gochena enyomba eye kwaagachire, nabekire erieta riane ribe aroro kare na kare. Amaiso aane na enkoro yane mbibe aroro ase chingaki chionsi.

english: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked , in integrity of heart , and in uprightness , to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments :
ekegusii: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, buna Daudi iso achibwatetie, ase enkoro endonge na ase obwegenwa; na onye kogokora onsi aya nagochikiire, na kobwata emeroberio yonsi echiikire;

english: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods , and worship them:
ekegusii: Korende inwe na abanto be chinderia chiaino komoreonchore na montige, naende timorenda amachiiko aane na emeroberio yane nabaeire, korende mogende gokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima,

english: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :
ekegusii: rirorio ninsirie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense eria nabaeire, na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetige, tinkoyerigereria namaiso aane. Abaisraeli nababe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

english: And they shall answer , Because they forsook the LORD their God , who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt , and have taken hold upon other gods , and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil .
ekegusii: Nigo barairanerie: Nekiagera barabwo batigete Omonene, Nyasae obo, oria orusetie chisokoro chiabo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, naende bakabwatana ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasiima na gochikorera. Amang’ana ayio agerire Omonene orentire amabe aya onsi igoro ase bare.” Sulemani okoa Hiramu emechie (2 Amg 8:1-2)

english: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, gochia ase abachore ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.

english: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently , who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you :
ekegusii: Igoro ase amang’ana ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria baabaanete obuya obo borache kobacheera, bakariga‐rigia na kounenkia.

english: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .
ekegusii: Bakarigia nkero ki, naende nkero kenga buna kere ki, Omoika o Kristo, oyorenge ime yabo, oorogetie, ekero otang’anete koba kirori igoro y’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na obonene obwo borache koba magega y’ayio.

english: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven ; which things the angels desire to look into .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo abamaanorerete ng’a baabakorere inwe ase amang’ana ayio, gose tari barabwo abanyene. Ayio bono araaretigwe ase more nabaria baabaranderetie inwe enchiri ase Omoika Omochenu, oyotometwe korwa igoro. Amang’ana ayio abamalaika bare namaiga kona‐koyasiomeria. Okorangeria gw’okoba norogendo oroochenu

english: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong’u ebinema bi’ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria moraarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

english: As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :
ekegusii: Buna abana ba Nyasae abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kw’eritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,

english: But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation ;
ekegusii: korende buna ere, oyobarangeirie, are omochenu, naboigo nainwe mobe abachenu ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi,

english: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :
ekegusii: Onye mokomooroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.

english: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers ;
ekegusii: Momanye ng’a nigo mwaboorigwe korwa ase orogendo rwaino rotagwenereti, orwo mwanyorete korwa ase chisokoro chiaino, tari ase ebinto bigosareka, buna chifeta gose chitaabu,

english: But with the precious blood of Christ , as of a lamb without blemish and without spot :
ekegusii: korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay’emanwa y’eng’ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.

english: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng’ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n’Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke ase oboikeranu bwonsi. Ogosemeria kore moyo

english: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,
ekegusii: Ere nigo achoretwe na Nyasae korwa kare, ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio ase engencho yaino.

english: Who by him do believe in God , that raised him up from the dead , and gave him glory ; that your faith and hope might be in God .
ekegusii: Goetera asare ere mwamwegenire Nyasae, oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure na akamoa obonene, erinde okwegena kwaino na ogosemeria kwaino kobe ase Nyasae.

english: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren , see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently :
ekegusii: Komwaikire gwechena emioyo yaino ase okoigwera ekeene, goikera obwanchani bw’abamino botari nobong’ainereria, gaki bono mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe bokorwa ase enkoro y’ekeene,

english: Being born again , not of corruptible seed , but of incorruptible , by the word of God , which liveth and abideth for ever .
ekegusii: ekiagera mwaiboirwe eria kabere, tari ase embusuro egosareka, korende ase eyetari gosareka, goetera ase ring’ana ria Nyasae rinyene obogima, erikobao goika kare na kare.

english: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .
ekegusii: korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchiri eye mwaranderetigwe.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead ,
ekegusii: Abakwe Nyasae, ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo! Ase amaabera aye amange atoiboire eria kabere, erinde tonyore ogosemeria kore moyo goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo korwa ase abakuure,

english: To an inheritance incorruptible , and undefiled , and that fadeth not away , reserved in heaven for you ,
ekegusii: ase igo intwe ntonyore omwando oyio Nyasae agacherete abanto baye aaria igoro. Omwando oyio otagosareka, otari na komocha, otari gosiria obonene bwaye,

english: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time .
ekegusii: inwe abamorendire nokobua kwa Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena, monyore ogotooreka kore ang’e koorokigwa ase ekero ki’omoerio.

english: Wherein ye greatly rejoice , though now for a season , if need be , ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations :
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.

english: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etaabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

english: Whom having not seen , ye love ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
ekegusii: Ere oyo mwamwanchire, nonya timomoorochi, mwamwegenire, nonya timoramorora, na igo moragoke ase omogooko otari gotebeka oichire nobonene,

english: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
ekegusii: ekero moranyore oboikeranu bw’okwegena kwaino, engencho yaye ogotooreka kw’emioyo yaino.

english: Wherefore laying aside all malice , and all guile , and hypocrisies , and envies , and all evil speakings ,
ekegusii: Gaki, beka are obobe bwonsi, na obong’ainereria bwonsi, na oborianania, na emoko, na oboitania bwonsi.

english: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul ;
ekegusii: Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.

english: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles : that , whereas they speak against you as evildoers , they may by your good works , which they shall behold , glorify God in the day of visitation .
ekegusii: Mobe norogendo oruya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde nonya bakobang’acha ng’a nabakori amabe more, banyare korora ogokora kwaino okuya na gotogia Nyasae rituko riria agocha kobacheera.

english: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme ;
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’Omonene mwebeke inse ya kera ekegochikwa na Mwanyabaanto, onye nomorwoti oyore omonene,

english: Or unto governors , as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers , and for the praise of them that do well .
ekegusii: gose abagabana, abatomirwe nere, erinde bae abakori amabe egesusuro, na gotogia abakori amaya,

english: For so is the will of God , that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men :
ekegusii: ekiagera oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a ase ogokora kwaino okuya mokirie abanto abariri ase ogotamanya kwabo.

english: As free , and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness , but as the servants of God .
ekegusii: Mobe abanto abasibore, korende timokorera obosibore bwaino ase okobiserera obobe, korende mobe norogendo rogwenerete abasomba ba Nyasae.

english: Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
ekegusii: Mosike abanto bonsi. Mwanche abamino. Moiroke Nyasae. Mosike omorwoti. Ekiorokererio ki’ogochandwa gwa Kristo

english: Servants , be subject to your masters with all fear ; not only to the good and gentle , but also to the froward .
ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase okoiroka gwonsi, tari abwo boka abare abaya gose abororo, korende na abwo bare abatindi boigo.

english: For this is thankworthy , if a man for conscience toward God endure grief , suffering wrongfully .
ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto karaaremererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.

english: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :
ekegusii: Buna abana ebing’werere baiborwa reero iga, moganie amabeere ’ekeene ay’omoika, erinde monyare gokina ase aro, na goikera ogotooreka,

english: For what glory is it , if , when ye be buffeted for your faults , ye shall take it patiently ? but if , when ye do well , and suffer for it , ye take it patiently , this is acceptable with God .
ekegusii: Naki ngotogigwa ki more nakwo komoraaremererie ase ogoakwa chinkundi ekero mogokora ebibe? Korende komoraaremererie ogochandwa ekero mogokora amaya, oko nakwo ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :
ekegusii: Ase ayio naro mwarangereretigwe, ekiagera Kristo nere nigo achandetwe ase engencho yaino, obatigeire ekiorokererio, erinde mobwatie chimbaratero chiaye.

english: For ye were as sheep going astray ; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls .
ekegusii: Naki nigo mware buna ching’ondi chiasirire, korende bono mwairanire ase Omorisia na Omorendi bw’emioyo yaino.

english: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
ekegusii: Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.

english: Ye also , as lively stones , are built up a spiritual house , an holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God by Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.

english: Let him eschew evil , and do good ; let him seek peace , and ensue it .
ekegusii: Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.

english: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous , and his ears are open unto their prayers : but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil .
ekegusii: Naki amaiso Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”

english: And who is he that will harm you , if ye be followers of that which is good ?
ekegusii: Ning’o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?

english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts : and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear :
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene Kristo acheneke ase chinkoro chiaino ime. Botambe mobe ang’e koiraneria kera omonto oyokobaboria amang’ana ogosemeria okore ime yaino, korende kora ayio ase obwororo na ase okoiroka.

english: Having a good conscience ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .
ekegusii: Na inwe renda chinkoro chiaino tichibagambia, erinde ekero mogokwanwa bobe, abwo bakobarama ase orogendo rwaino oruya ase Kristo, basookigwe.

english: For it is better , if the will of God be so , that ye suffer for well doing , than for evil doing .
ekegusii: Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.

english: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :
ekegusii: Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y’ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho y’abatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. Omobere oye ogaitwa, korende omoika oye ogakorwa koba moyo.

english: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison ;
ekegusii: Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.

english: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .
ekegusii: kobakorora orogendo rwaino oruya rore nokoiroka.

english: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us ( not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God ,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’amang’ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeeka aare riko ri’omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,

english: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .
ekegusii: oyosoete igoro, na bono nao are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae. Abamalaika, na okobua, ne chinguru nigo bibekire inse yaye.

english: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
ekegusii: korende kobe ogw’enkoro y’omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw’obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
