ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli bakageenda ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamoteebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayaamo na omobere oyomo.

english: And David went on , and grew great , and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
ekegusii: Daudi akamentekana mono koba ne chinguru, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, arenge amo nere.

english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abanto ase Daudi. Abwo bakamoirera emete y’emecharake. Boigo agatoma abaabaachi, na abaagachi, na barabwo bakamoagaachera enyomba.

english: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akamanya ng’a Omonene omokong’irie ase okoba omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, na oimokereirie igoro oborwoti bwaye ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli.

english: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
ekegusii: Magega karuure Heburoni, Daudi akamenta koira abakungu ba sere‐sere na abakungu bande korwa Yerusalemu; akaiborerwa abana bande abange, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’abana abwo baiboretwe ase are agwo Yerusalemu; Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani;

english: Ibhar also, and Elishua , and Nepheg , and Japhia ,
ekegusii: Ibuhari na Elisua, Nefegi na Yafia;

english: And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphalet .
ekegusii: Elisama, na Eliada, na Elifeleti. Abafirisiti Bakobugwa (1 Amg 14:8-17)

english: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .
ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta koba omorwoti bwa Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi kaigure ayio, agatirimboka gochia ase eburi ime,

english: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
ekegusii: na Abafirisiti bagaacha bagesiarera ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.

english: And David enquired of the LORD , saying , Shall I go up to the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ? And the LORD said unto David , Go up : for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand .
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabori’Omonene, “Inee! Ndageenda korwania Abafirisiti, nobabeeke ase amaboko ane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee geenda, nimbabeeke ase amaboko ao.”

english: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .
ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, ekero Saulo arenge omorwoti oito, naye kwareenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobakogeenda korwana esegi, naende kobakoirana. Omonene konya ogoteebirie ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na obe omogambi obo.”

english: And David came to Baal-perazim , and David smote them there, and said , The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim .
ekegusii: Daudi akabachiera agwo Baali‐Perasimu akababua. Erio akabora, “Omonene okoroorire ababisa bane buna ogotaagora gwe chiooro chi’amaache are n’emerindo.” Ase igo aase aria akarokwa Baali‐Perasimu + 5:20 Baali‐Perasimu: engencho yaye “ogotaagora gwe chiooro chi’amaache are n’emerindo” .

english: And there they left their images , and David and his men burned them.
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagatiga emegwekano yabo y’ogosasiimwa aroro, na Daudi na abanto baye bakayerusiao na koyeira.

english: And the Philistines came up yet again , and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
ekegusii: Naende Abafirisiti bakageendao eria kabere, bagesiarera ase rikura ri’Abarefai.

english: And when David enquired of the LORD , he said , Thou shalt not go up ; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabori’Omonene, nere akamokania, akamoteebia, “Tobaumokera korwa aa, korende ogeende obanaarie korwa magega, erio obatubokere korwa ase emete ereo ekorokwa balisamu.

english: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines .
ekegusii: Ekero oraigwe eriogi ri’ebititiro bigoeta igoro ase emete eyio, erio bwebeeke ang’e, omanye ng’a inche Omonene nasookire, nagotang’anire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”

english: And David did so , as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer .
ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Omonene amoteebetie, agaita Abafirisiti korwa Geba goika Geseri.

english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD : and they anointed David king over Israel .
ekegusii: Ase igo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagaacha ase Daudi omorwoti agwo Heburoni; ere agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Heburoni.

english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .
ekegusii: Agwo Heburoni akagaambera Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka etan’ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo, naende agwo Yerusalemu akagaambera Abaisraeli bonsi amo n’Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etato, n’etato.

english: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .
ekegusii: Korende Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyo n’oro Omochie o Daudi. Omochie o Daudi|alt="City of David [City of David=Omochie o Daudi Bethlehemu=Betelemu Plan of Jerusalem=omoroberio o Jerusalemu later extension of the city=okogareigwa konde kw’omochie]." src="HK-041B.TIF" size="col" loc="2 Samuel 5.7" copy="Horace Knowles" ref="5:7"

english: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David’s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .
ekegusii: Daudi agakwana ase rituko riria, “Onde bwensi otagete goita Abayebusi, tiga atiire gochia ase omotaro bw’amaache, aite emeuko eyio na ebirema ebio inche Daudi ’ngeechete.” Ase ayio abanto nigo bagoteeba, “Emeuko na ebirema tibakonyaara gosoa ase enyomba.”

english: So David dwelt in the fort , and called it the city of David . And David built round about from Millo and inward .
ekegusii: Daudi akamenya ase eburi eyio, akayeroka “Omochie o Daudi.” Agwo Daudi akaagacha omochie oyeetanaine, gochaakera korwa Milo na goikera ime ase eburi yarenge.

english: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .
ekegusii: Naende Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi abachooretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

english: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David : but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite .
ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi tancha koira Esanduki eria y’Omonene ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria na koyebeeka nyomba mwa Obedi‐Edomu o Gati.

english: And it was told king David , saying , The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom , and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God . So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness .
ekegusii: Daudi agateebigwa ng’a, ase engencho y’Esanduki eria y’Omonene osesenirie abanto b’enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, amo nebiinto bionsi abwate. Erio akageenda akoyia Esanduki eria korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, akayerenta ase omochie oye ore n’omochengo omonene.

english: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Omonene bageendire ebitambokero bitano na kemo, Daudi akanyenya eng’ombe eyemo, na emori eyemo enoru, chikaba ekeng’wanso.

english: And David danced before the LORD with all his might ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogotenga ne chinguru chiaye chionsi ase obosio bw’Omonene, obeegete egesibao kiaroisirie korwa ase egataani.

english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .
ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduki y’Omonene, bakaba bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko na kobugia egetuureri.

english: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David , Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD ; and she despised him in her heart .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduki eria y’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omorwoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ase obosio bw’Omonene, akamochaaya ase omoyo oye ime.

english: And they brought in the ark of the LORD , and set it in his place , in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto baria baare korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene, bakayebeeka aase aye eema ime, eema eria Daudi ateneneretie. Erio Daudi akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ebing’wanso biria, agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emegaanda.

english: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi airanete inka bwoye gosesenia abanto baye, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, agasoka korotota Daudi, akabora, “Mbonene ki omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli akwenyorera reero ekero aorokirie obogetirianda bwaye ase abaiseke b’abasomba baye buna omonto omoriri.”

english: And David said unto Michal , It was before the LORD , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD , over Israel : therefore will I play before the LORD .
ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Mikali, “Nigo narenge gotenga na kogooka ase obosio bw’Omonene, oyo onchorete inche ribaga ria iso, na enyomba yaye yonsi, ’nkaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, goika ’ngenderere gochenga ase Omonene.

english: And I will yet be more vile than thus , and will be base in mine own sight : and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour .
ekegusii: Naende ninganetie nyekeyie goetania buna nakora aiga reero, imbe omoitongo. Nonya aye kogonchaaya, abaiseke abwo b’abasomba gwakwana, barawo ’mbansike mono.”

english: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .
ekegusii: Na Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, taiborete mwana nonya noyomo goika ogokwa kwaye.

english: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
ekegusii: Kobayerusirie korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu agwo ekegoro igoro, Ahiyo nere oyetang’aine.

english: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .
ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga na goteera ase ogotogia Omonene; bakabugia amakano, na ebibangarara, ne chindege, na ebinto binde bi’ogochengera.

english: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor , Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God , and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it .
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo baikire ase ekeooreri kia Nakoni, chiombe chiarenge kong’usa egari eria chikarichanigwa. Ase igo Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduki eyio ya Nyasae.

english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah ; and God smote him there for his error ; and there he died by the ark of God .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, na Usa agakwera agwo agwo.

english: And David was displeased , because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah : and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day .
ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa, na igo akaroka aase aria Peresi‐Usa + 6:8 Peresi‐Usa: engencho yaye “Ogwokerwa kw’endamwamu (y’Omonene) ase Usa” ; naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

english: And David was afraid of the LORD that day , and said , How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akoboa Omonene, akaboria, “Inaki rende ’ndakore imbe noboremu ’ndete Esanduki y’Omonene bwone”?

english: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house , and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies ;
ekegusii: Bono omorwoti Daudi nigo amenyete ase enyomba yaye, n’Omonene konya omoeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baye bonsi, abwo bamoetanaine.

english: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel , and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more , as beforetime ,
ekegusii: Ninyorere abanto bane Abaisraeli ase ’ndababeeke bamenye ase obotoereru. Abanto ababe tibakobachaanda naende, buna baabachaandete kare.

english: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house .
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nachorete abagaambi bagaambere abanto bane Abaisraeli. Ninkoe obotoereru korwa ase ababisa bao bonsi. Kobua ayio onsi, inche Omonene nigo ’nkogoteebia ng’a ninkoroiserie enyomba.

english: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .
ekegusii: Ere naagaachere erieta riane enyomba, nainche ninkong’ie oborwoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kogenderera botambe.

english: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before thee.
ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane botari koera tinkoborusia ase are buna naborusetie ase Saulo oyio natigeretie korwa ase obosio bwao.

english: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD , and he said , Who am I, O Lord GOD ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene, inche inki ’ng’isaine, na eamate y’ane inki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

english: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord GOD ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord GOD ?
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende ase ore, aye Omonene. Boigo gwakwanire igoro y’ororeeria rw’ane, inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha. Ee, aye Omonene, amang’ana ayio igo kwayakwanire ase Mwanyabaanto.

english: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now, I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Nathani, omobani, “Rora, inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagaachire nemecharake korende Esanduki ya Nyasae ero nigo emenyete ime ase eema.”

english: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD , knowest thy servant .
ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagoteebie naende kobua ayio? Aye Omonene, nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.

english: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’eira yao na koreng’ana nogwancha kwao, aye Omonene, gwankoreire amanene ayio onsi, naende kwayamanyekanirie ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.

english: Wherefore thou art great , O LORD God : for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, igo ore omonene, aye Omonene! Onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari, otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.

english: And now, O LORD God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .
ekegusii: “Gaki bono, Omonene Nyasae, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro y’ane na ase ororeria rw’ane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a nokore,

english: And let thy name be magnified for ever , saying , The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel : and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
ekegusii: erinde erieta ria’o ritogigwe kare na kare. Erio abanto bariatore botambe, bagoteeba: Omonene bw’Emegaanda, nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.

english: For thou, O LORD of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emegaanda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, kwang’orokeirie inche, omosomba oo, aya onsi, kogoteeba: Ninkoagaachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro y’ane kogosaba ogosaba oko.

english: And now, O Lord GOD , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, na amang’ana ao naro ekeene, na kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira ng’a onkorere ring’ana eri rigiya.

english: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD , hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .
ekegusii: Gaki boono, koranche osesenie enyomba y’ane, inche omosomba oo, erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, kwariete eira eyio. Ase igo enyomba y’ane, inche omosomba oo, esesenigwe kare na kare nogosesenigwa kwao.”

english: And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart ; for the LORD is with thee.
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia omorwoti, “Geenda okore ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Omonene nigo are amo naye.”

english: And it came to pass that night , that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan , saying ,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase Nathani, rikamoteebia,

english: Go and tell my servant David , Thus saith the LORD , Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in ?
ekegusii: “Geenda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Inee! Nong’agaachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?

english: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri goika rituko ria reero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire ’nkogeenda aande onsi imenyete ase eema.

english: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying , Why build ye not me an house of cedar ?
ekegusii: Aase aande onsi nabeire ’nkona‐kogeenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogaambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabeegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto bane, nase ki otang’agaachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.

english: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the LORD of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , from following the sheep , to be ruler over my people , over Israel :
ekegusii: “Gaki bono naende kwana n’omosomba one Daudi, omoteebie amang’ana aya: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase oborisia aase kware gotunyana ching’ondi, ’ngakobeeka okaba omogambi bw’abaanto bane Abaisraeli.

english: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
ekegusii: Nigo n’are kogeenda amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogeenda na kobaseeria gochia aare ababisa bao korwa ase obosio bwao. Ninkore erieta ria’o ribe rinene, buna amarieta y’abanto bande bare abanene ase ense.

english: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akabua nomochie obo omonene akayobeeka inse y’obogaambi bwaye.

english: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
ekegusii: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi’etaabu, na ebi’efeta, na ebi’etai.

english: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued ;
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omorwoti Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chitaai ne chitaabu chiria arusetie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku biria abuete:

english: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .
ekegusii: Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki. Boigo agaatananera Omonene ebisakorwa arusetie korwa ase Hadadeseri, mosinto o Rehobu, omorwoti o Soba.

english: And he put garrisons in Edom ; throughout all Edom put he garrisons , and all they of Edom became David’s servants . And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na barabwo bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, n’Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogeenda korwana.

english: And David reigned over all Israel ; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people .
ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli bonsi, akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi oboronge na ekeene.

english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder ;
ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu oria Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emegaanda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.

english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests ; and Seraiah was the scribe ;
ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Seraya nere orenge omoriki;

english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites ; and David’s sons were chief rulers .
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti, na Abapeleti, na basinto ba Daudi nigo barenge Abakuani nabwo barenge abasemia b’oborwoti.

english: And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David’s servants , and brought gifts .
ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu. Akabachiika barare inse ase chindwaro. Erio akarengia + 8:2 akarengia: engencho yaye agapima chindwaro ibere chi’abaanto, agachiika abwo baitwe bakwe, na abanto b’orwaro oromo agachiika batigwe babe moyo. Bono Abamoabu bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango.

english: David smote also Hadadezer , the son of Rehob , king of Zobah , as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates .
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri mosinto o Rehobu, omorwoti o Soba, ekero ere agendete kogareyia obogaambi bwaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

english: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .
ekegusii: Daudi agoosa abariini chibarasi elifu eyemo, na amagana atan’abere (1,700), na abarwani abaare kogendera amagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chinteng’e, korende agatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chibe chikong’usa chigari.

english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki baachete gokoonya Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).

english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus : and the Syrians became servants to David , and brought gifts . And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abarwani ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase are kogeenda korwana.

english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Daudi agasakora chinguba chi’echitaabu, echio abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.

english: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .
ekegusii: Naende omorwoti Daudi akaira chitaai chinyinge mono korwa Bera na Berotai, emechie Hadadeseri arenge kogaambera.

english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
ekegusii: Toi, omorwoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri,

english: Thou therefore, and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master’s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
ekegusii: Aye, amo n’abana bao na abasomba bao ’mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omoochokoro bw’omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omoochokoro bw’omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa y’ane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.

english: Then said Ziba unto the king , According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant , so shall thy servant do . As for Mephibosheth , said the king , he shall eat at my table , as one of the king’s sons .
ekegusii: Erio Siba akairaneria omorwoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachiikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi Omonene oye, akaba buna oyomo bw’abana b’omorwoti.

english: And Mephibosheth had a young son , whose name was Micha . And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth .
ekegusii: Mefiboseti nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Mika. Abanto bonsi abarengeo Siba bakaba abasomba ba Mefiboseti.

english: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem : for he did eat continually at the king’s table ; and was lame on both his feet .
ekegusii: Mefiboseti akaba okomenya Yerusalemu, ekiagera nigo arenge koragera ase emesa y’omorwoti. Ere nigo aremarete amagoro aye onsi abere.

english: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .
ekegusii: Narengeo omosomba oyomo bw’enyomba ya Saulo, orenge korokwa Siba. Abanto bakamorangeria ageende ase Daudi. Omorwoti akamobooria, “N’aye Siba?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche omosomba oo.”

english: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold, he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo-debar .
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Ng’ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”

english: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo-debar .
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agatoma abanto bagachia komwoyia korwa o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.

english: Now when Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan , the son of Saul , was come unto David , he fell on his face , and did reverence . And David said , Mephibosheth . And he answered , Behold thy servant !
ekegusii: Ekero Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, achete ase Daudi, akagwa inse, maumama ase okoorokia amasikani. Daudi akamorangeria, “Mefiboseti!” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, inche omosomba oo!”

english: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .
ekegusii: Daudi akamoteebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera ningokorere amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani iso. Ninkoiranerie emegondo yonsi ya Saulo, sokoro yao, naye n’obe gokoragera ase emesa y’ane botambe.”

english: And he bowed himself, and said , What is thy servant , that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?
ekegusii: Mefiboseti agatung’ama inse naende, akabora, “Inche inde buna esese ekwete. Ninki ing’isaine orankorere amaya buna ayio?”

english: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul’s servant , and said unto him, I have given unto thy master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akarangeria Siba, omosomba o Saulo, akamoteebia, “Ebinto bionsi ebiarenge bia Saulo, na bionsi ebia nyomba mw’aye, nabieire omoochokoro bw’omonene oo.

english: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe ( because our testimony among you was believed ) in that day .
ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y’abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.

english: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo tokobasabera botambe, erio Nyasae oito ababare ng’a mwagweneire okorangeria kwaye. Ere aikeranie kera okogania kw’obuya, na kera emeremo y’okwegena, ase okobua kwaye,

english: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: erinde erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso ritogigwe ime yaino, na inwe ime yaye, koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae oito, na Omonene Yeso Kristo.

english: Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ekiina ase ekero ki’ogocha gwa Kristo

english: We are bound to thank God always for you , brethren , as it is meet , because that your faith groweth exceedingly , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth ;
ekegusii: Abaminto, netogwenerete komoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, buna ere boronge, ekiagera okwegena kwaino gwakiinire mono, na obwanchani bwa kera oyomo oino ase oyonde nigo bogendererete komentekana.

english: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.

english: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
ekegusii: Eke nakio ekiorokererio, ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae mboronge kere. Erio mobarwe koba abamwagweneire oborwoti bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ase engencho y’obwo mwachandirwe.

english: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae ororire boronge kobaakana emechando baria bakobachanda inwe,

english: And to you who are troubled rest with us , when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels ,
ekegusii: na kobaa inwe abamwachandirwe ogotimokigwa amo naintwe. Aya nigo arakoreke ekero Omonene Yeso agocha koorokigwa korwa igoro amo nabamalaika n’okobua kwaye ase ekebemberi ki’omorero,

english: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God , and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: na kobaakana egesiomba abwo batamomanyeti Nyasae, na bataigwereti enchiri y’Omonene oito Yeso.

english: Now we beseech you , brethren , by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , and by our gathering together unto him ,
ekegusii: Bono baminto, ase amang’ana y’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, na ogosangererekana gwaito ase obosio bwaye, twababoririe,

english: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
ekegusii: na ase obong’ainereria bwonsi bw’ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.

english: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw’echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay’oborimo,

english: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .
ekegusii: erinde bagambigwe bonsi abwo bateegenete ekeene, korende baare kwegokia ase ayatari ay’oboronge. Mwachorirwe ase okonyora ogotooreka

english: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
ekegusii: Korende baminto, netogwenerete koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, inwe abamwanchire n’Omonene, ekiagera Nyasae abachorete korwa omochakano, erinde monyore ogotooreka ase ogochenwa kogokorwa n’Omoika, na kwegena ekeene.

english: Whereunto he called you by our gospel , to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Ase aya naro abarangereretie inwe goetera ase enchiri eye twabaranderetie, erinde monyore obonene bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

english: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .
ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana y’emenwa yaito, gose nase riruube riaito.

english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself , and God , even our Father , which hath loved us , and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace ,
ekegusii: Bono Omonene oito Yeso Kristo omonyene, na Nyasae Tata oito, oyotwanchete na otoete okoremia gwa kare na kare, na ogosemeria okuya ase obuya bwaye,

english: Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .
ekegusii: aremie chinkoro chiaino, na abakong’ie mokore ayare boronge ase kera ogokora okuya, na amang’ana amaya.

english: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .
ekegusii: timotengechigwa bwango na gotiga ebirengererio biaino, gose timoichanigwa na moika onde, gose namang’ana, gose ne riruube rigokagwa ng’a nkorwa ase tore riarure, erigoteeba ng’a rituko ri’Omonene riaikire kobao.

english: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;
ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase enchera ende yonsi, ekiagera rituko riria tirigocha ogwatananekana na ogotaigwera gotaracha, na omosaria bw’amachiiko, omwana bw’obosiru, aorokigwe.

english: Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
ekegusii: Inee! Timware koinyora ng’a ekero narenge amo nainwe inabateebeetie ayio?

english: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time .
ekegusii: Na bono, erimotangete morimanyete, erio ekero engaki yaye eraike anyare koorokigwa.

english: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .
ekegusii: Naki obobisi boria bw’ogosaria amachiiko bwachaakire gokora emeremo bono, na oria ore kobotanga bono goika arusigweo.

english: Finally , brethren , pray for us , that the word of the Lord may have free course , and be glorified , even as it is with you :
ekegusii: Omoerio, baminto, tosabere erinde ring’ana ri’Omonene rirande na gotogigwa buna riakorire ase egati yaino,

english: For even when we were with you , this we commanded you , that if any would not work , neither should he eat .
ekegusii: Ekiagera nonya nekero keria twarenge amo nainwe ntwabachiigete ring’ana eri, ng’a onye omonto tarigeti gokora emeremo, taegwa endagera.

english: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
ekegusii: Naki twaigure ng’a mbare abanto ase more bare aboro, batari gokora emeremo, korende nigo bakona‐gotuka amang’ana y’abaanto bande.

english: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ , that with quietness they work , and eat their own bread .
ekegusii: Nabo abanto banga buna abwo twabachikiire na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso Kristo, ng’a bakore emeremo ase obotoereru, na koria endagera yabo abanyene.

english: But ye , brethren , be not weary in well doing .
ekegusii: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.

english: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .
ekegusii: Onye monto onde bwensi okwanga koigwera ring’ana eri tokwanete ase riruube eri, erusananie korwa ase omonto oyio, na timosanga nere; tiga arore obosooku.

english: Yet count him not as an enemy , but admonish him as a brother .
ekegusii: Timomobara buna omobisa, korende momokuurere buna oyomino. Amang’ana omoerio

english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means . The Lord be with you all .
ekegusii: Bono Omonene bw’omorembe omonyene abae omorembe ase chingaki chionsi, na ase chinchera chionsi. Omonene abe amo nainwe mwensi.

english: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand , which is the token in every epistle : so I write .
ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Eke nakio ekemanyerio ase kera riruube riane; naboigo nkoriika.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen . The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

english: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men : for all men have not faith .
ekegusii: ng’a totoorigwe korwa ase abanto batari abaronge, na abare ababe, ekiagera tai bonsi bare nokwegena.

english: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nomwegenwa, nere orababeeke chinguru na kobarenda korwa ase oria omobe.

english: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
ekegusii: Ase Omonene ntore nogosemeria igoro yaino, ng’a ngokora more ayatwabachiigete, naende mogenderere koyakora.

english: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .
ekegusii: Omonene atang’ane chinkoro chiaino, erinde momanye obwanchani bwa Nyasae, na oboremereria bwa Kristo. Ogokuurera kw’ogokora emeremo

english: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .
ekegusii: Bono baminto, twabachikiire ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, mweatanane korwa ase oyomino oyore omworo, oyotabwateti chingencho echio mweorokereretie korwa ase tore.

english: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene momanyete buna ebagwenerete motwege; titwabeete aboro ekero twarenge amo nainwe,

english: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :
ekegusii: gose titwariete endagera ya monto onde bwensi bosa, totaakaneti, korende nase obokong’u amo nogwechanda togakora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titoraarereria monto onde oino.

english: Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
ekegusii: Tari ng’a eyio tiyatotungetie, korende igo twekorete abanyene koba ekiorokererio ekiya ase more, erinde motwege.

english: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ase engencho y’eira y’obogima bore ase Kristo Yeso,

english: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
ekegusii: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchiri.

english: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanyoorire emechando eye. Korende tinkorora obosooku, inaki nimomanyete ere oyonyegenete, naende ninde nobomaene ng’a goika Rituko riria ere nanyare korenda keria angacherete.

english: Hold fast the form of sound words , which thou hast heard of me , in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Bwatia amang’ana ayare ay’obogima, ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde, abe ekiorokererio ogotunyana ase okwegena na obwanchani bire ase Kristo Yeso.

english: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .
ekegusii: Renda keria ekiya kwaetwe, okegache, okerende ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu, oyomenyete ime yaito.

english: This thou knowest , that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me ; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes .
ekegusii: Kwamanyire ng’a bonsi abare Asia bantigire, na ase abwo mbareo Figelo na Hermogene.

english: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus ; for he oft refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain :
ekegusii: Omonene abarorere amaabera abwo bare ab’enyomba y’Onesiforo, ekiagera ekero ase ekero nigo are gontimokia, gose t’are korora obosooku ase engencho y’obosibwa bwane.

english: But , when he was in Rome , he sought me out very diligently , and found me .
ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.

english: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .
ekegusii: Omonene namwanchere anyoore amaabera korwa ase Omonene Rituko riria. Aye kwamanyire buya buna are gokora emeremo emenge aria Efeso.

english: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;
ekegusii: Nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, oyo ngokorera nenkoro etari kongaambia, buna chisokoro chiane chiare gokora, nigo ngokoinyora botambe ase ogosaba kw’ane obotuko na omobaso.

english: Greatly desiring to see thee , being mindful of thy tears , that I may be filled with joy ;
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amariga ao nigo nkoba namaiga gokorora, erinde ing’ichorwe nomogooko.

english: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God , which is in thee by the putting on of my hands .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiaruure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobeekerete amaboko aane,

english: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .
ekegusii: ekiagera omoika twaetwe na Nyasae tari oyo bw’obwoba, korende oyo bw’echinguru na obwanchani, na omoika bw’okwerenga intwe abanyene.

english: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord , nor of me his prisoner : but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God ;
ekegusii: Gaaki, torora obosooku kobeera Omonene oito kirori, gose tondorera inche, omosibwa oye, obosooku, korende nonya naye oremererie emechando ase engencho y’enchiri, ase okobua kwa Nyasae,

english: Who hath saved us , and called us with an holy calling , not according to our works , but according to his own purpose and grace , which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began ,
ekegusii: oyototooretie na agatorangeria ase okorangeria ogochenu, tari ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito korende koreng’ana nokorigia kwaye omonyene, na obuya bwaye. Obuya obo twaetwe ase Kristo Yeso korwa agwo kare

english: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Gaaki, aye omwana one, obe ne chinguru ase obuya bore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes , that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory .
ekegusii: Ase ayio naremereirie onsi ase engencho y’abachoore, erinde nabarabwo banyoore ogotooreka kore ase Kristo Yeso amo nobonene bwa kare na kare.

english: It is a faithful saying : For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene: Onye twakwete amo nere, inatobe moyo amo nere boigo.

english: If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he can not deny himself .
ekegusii: onye titori abegenwa, ere nigo are omwegenwa, ekiagera takonyara gwekaana ere omonyene. Omokori emeremo bwancheirwe

english: Of these things put them in remembrance , charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit , but to the subverting of the hearers .
ekegusii: Obainyorie ayio, na kobakuurera ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tibaaba nokoamererania ase amang’ana, okwo gotanyaare gokoonya kende, korende nigo gokobasiria abagokoigwa.

english: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .
ekegusii: Kora buna oranyaare kweorokia ase obosio bwa Nyasae buna oyobwancheirwe nere, buna omokori emeremo oyotagwenereti gosookigwa, ogwatanana boronge ring’ana ri’ekeene.

english: But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .
ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari y’obonyasae, na atari nengeencho. Inaki ase ayio abanto nigo barageenderere komenteka ase chingeencho chitari chi’obonyasae.

english: And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo nigo akoria buna rikwege ri’esiria. Ase abwo mbareo Himenayo na Fileto.

english: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .
ekegusii: Abwo basireriigwe korwa ase ekeene, bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa gwaikire kobao, na igo bakoonchorana okwegena kw’abaanto baande.

english: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
ekegusii: Na ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde ase amasio y’abarori abange oyabeeke ase abanto abegenwa, abaranyare kworokereria abaande boigo.

english: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .
ekegusii: Ase enyomba enene tibirio ebinto bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta bioka, korende mbireo ebinto bi’emete na ebi’amaroba boigo; ebinde nebi’ogosika, na ebinde tibiri ebi’ogosika.

english: If a man therefore purge himself from these , he shall be a vessel unto honour , sanctified , and meet for the master’s use , and prepared unto every good work .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye omonto origetie gwesibia ere omonyene ase ogweatanana korwa ase ebinto buna ebio, nabe egento ki’ogosika, giancheirwe, keragwenere Omonene, kiaroisiigwe ase kera emeremo emiya.

english: Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .
ekegusii: Tama okogania okobe kw’obosae, rigia oboronge, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na omorembe, amo nabwo bakomorangeri’Omonene ase chinkoro chindabu.

english: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .
ekegusii: Korende bwange amaborio y’oboriri atari aye chiseemi. Kwamanyire ng’a ayio nigo ararente eriomana.

english: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
ekegusii: Naende tegwenereti omosomba Omonene koba omonyariomana, korende abe omwororo ase abanto bonsi, abe oy’omanyete kworokereria buya, na abe omoremereria,

english: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves ; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth ;
ekegusii: oyorabateebererie ase obwororo abwo bakoamererania nere. Aande Nyasae nabaonchore, erinde bamanye ekeene gionsi,

english: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .
ekegusii: erio banyare gotaboboka na korua ase omoeto o Saitani kobasakoirwe nere goika bakore ogwancha kwaye.

english: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.

english: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life ; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier .
ekegusii: Morwani onde tari, oyokogeenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang’ana ande onsi y’ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomoriigete.

english: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .
ekegusii: Omoamereria bwe chigosori takoegwa egutwa y’obobui ataamereraneti koreng’ana namachiiko.

english: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits .
ekegusii: Omoremi oyobwechandeire emeremo, ere nemogwenerete abe oyo bw’eritang’ani konyora ensemo y’okwama.

english: Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .
ekegusii: Rengereria mono ayio ngokwana, ekiagera Omonene nakoe okomanya ase amang’ana onsi.

english: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
ekegusii: Moinyore Yeso Kristo, oy’oboogete korwa ase abakuure, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Daudi, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia inche.

english: Where in I suffer trouble , as an evil doer , even unto bonds ; but the word of God is not bound .
ekegusii: Ase enchiri eyio ngachaandwa goika ngasibwa ne chingataare buna omokori amabe. Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae tirikobeegeka chingataare.

english: This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
ekegusii: Gaaki, manya ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko y’omoerio inachibe chingaki chi’obokong’u.

english: But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,
ekegusii: Korende aye kwabwatire okworokereria kw’ane, na orogeendo rw’ane, na okorigia kw’ane ase obogima obo, na okwegena kw’ane, na oboremereria bwane, na obwanchani bwane, na okoganya kw’ane,

english: Yea , and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .
ekegusii: Ekeene, aba bonsi baganetie koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ase Kristo Yeso inabachaandwe.

english: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .
ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe na abang’ainereria mbamentekane kobua ase obobe, bakong’aina na kong’aineka.

english: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of , knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;
ekegusii: Korende aye, ogenderere ase ayakworokereretigwe na koyaenekia, gokomanya ng’a nkorwa ase ng’o kweorokereretie.

english: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Inaki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariiko amaachenu, ayaraanyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.

english: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :
ekegusii: Kera ririiko riutire n’Omoika o Nyasae, nario riranyare gotworokereria, na gotokuurera, na gotorongeyia, na gototang’ana ase oboronge,

english: That the man of God may be perfect , throughly furnished unto all good works .
ekegusii: erinde omonto o Nyasae abe oikeranigwe, oisanerigwe, anyare gokora kera ogokora okuya.

english: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
ekegusii: Inaki abanto inababe bakweancha barabwo abanyene, abanchete chitaabu, abetogia, abaenenu, abarami, abatari koigwera abaibori babo, abatari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abatari abachenu,

english: Without natural affection , trucebreakers , false accusers , incontinent , fierce , despisers of those that are good ,
ekegusii: abatancheti abanto baande, abatarigeti kobwatana, abang’aachi, abatari gwetanga ase rinde rionsi, abatiindi, abageechete ayare amaya,

english: Traitors , heady , highminded , lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God ;
ekegusii: abarua abaande, abatancheti gokanigwa, abamwenu, abanchete kwegokia kobua komwancha Nyasae,

english: Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .
ekegusii: abakororekana ng’a mbare ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, korende bakaana okobua gwe chingeencho echio. Bweatanane korwa ase abwo.

english: For of this sort are they which creep into houses , and lead captive silly women laden with sins , led away with divers lusts ,
ekegusii: Inaki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi’abaanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi’ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao.

english: Ever learning , and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth .
ekegusii: Abakungu abwo nigo bakweorokereria botaambe, korende tibakonyara goikera chiseemi chi’ekeene.

english: But they shall proceed no further : for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was .
ekegusii: korende tibakogeenderera mono, ekiagera oboriri bwabo naboorokigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi, buna yabeete ase baria babere. Ogochika kw’omoerio

english: I charge thee therefore before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom ;
ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, oyoraache kogaambia abare moyo na abakuure, na ase okooroka kwaye, na oborwoti bwaye.

english: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus .
ekegusii: Namotomire - 4:12: Ogok 20:4; Abaef 6:21,22; Abakol 4:7,8 Efeso.

english: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
ekegusii: Aye bwerende korwa ase are, ekiagera nigo aengereretie okworokereria gwaito.

english: At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
ekegusii: Ase ogwekengera kw’ane kw’eritang’ani onde tarenge otenenete amo nainche, korende bonsi bagantiga. Nasabire ng’a tibaabarerwa ebibe ase ring’ana erio.

english: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatenena amo nainche, akambeeka chinguru, erinde goetera ase ’nde okoraria kwe ring’ana goikeranigwe goika abanto bonsi b’Ebisaku bakoigwe. Na inche nigo natooretigwe korwa ase omonwa bw’endo.

english: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
ekegusii: Omonene nansibore korwa ase amabe onsi, na antoorie goika nsoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro. Ogotogigwa nokwaye kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania y’ogokoorera

english: Preach the word ; be instant in season , out of season ; reprove , rebuke , exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine .
ekegusii: Randia Ring’ana ria Nyasae, kora omokia ase engaki ekogwenerete, na ase eyetakogwenereti, kuurera na togonyera, na gosorora ase oboremereria bwonsi, na ase okworokereria.

english: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .
ekegusii: Teema buna oranyaare gocha ritang’ani etoigo etaracha. Eubulu ogokwanirie, naboigo Pudente na Lino, na Klaudia, na abaminto bonsi.

english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit . Grace be with you . Amen . The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
ekegusii: Omonene abe amo n’omoyo oo. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

english: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;
ekegusii: Na engaki neche, ekero abanto barange okworokereria kw’obogima, na ase okogania kwabo okobe benyorere aborokia abange mono, ekiagera amato abo are nebiagaso.

english: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .
ekegusii: Barabwo mbeatanane korwa ase okoigwa ayare ay’ekeene, na koonchokera emegano ao ao.

english: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .
ekegusii: Korende aye, bweriite ase amang’ana onsi, oremererie emechando, kora emeremo y’oborandia, ikerania ogokora kw’obosomba bwao.

english: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
ekegusii: Inaki inche bono naikire koumorwa buna okoruegwa gw’ekenyuugwa na engaki y’ane y’ogokwa yaikire.

english: I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
ekegusii: Narwanire esegi ere engiya, nakoorire orogeendo, narendire okwegena.

english: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya nagacheirwe egutwa y’oboronge, eye Omonene, omogambi bw’oboronge, arang’e ase Rituko riria gose tari inche bweka arae, korende nabaanto bonsi abanchete okoorokigwa kwaye. Ogotebereria ase Timotheo omonyene

english: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :
ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha ase ’nde bwango.

english: Wherefore , if I come , I will remember his deeds which he doeth , prating against us with malicious words : and not content therewith , neither doth he himself receive the brethren , and forbiddeth them that would , and casteth them out of the church .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kondache ning’inyore ogokora kwaye are gokora, buna are gokwana amang’ana amabe igoro ase tore. Ere taisanegeti nayio, ere omonyene tari koroisia abaminto, naende atanga baria barigetie kobaroisia, na aosokia barabwo korwa ase ekanisa.

english: Beloved , follow not that which is evil , but that which is good . He that doeth good is of God : but he that doeth evil hath not seen God .
ekegusii: Omwanchani, tibwega obobe, korende bwege ekere ekiya. Ere oyogokora amaya noyo o Nyasae, korende ere oyogokora amabe tarochi Nyasae.

english: Demetrius hath good report of all men , and of the truth itself : yea , and we also bear record ; and ye know that our record is true .
ekegusii: Demeturio obereirwe kirori nabaanto bonsi, naende nekeene ekenyene, ng’a nomuya are. Na intwe boigo twarorire, na aye kwamanyire ng’a oborori bwaito nobw’ekeene. Amakwania ogokoorera

english: I had many things to write , but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee :
ekegusii: Nabwate amang’ana amange nanga nakoriikera, korende tindigeti gokoriikera ase ewino na ekaramu.

english: But I trust I shall shortly see thee , and we shall speak face to face . Peace be to thee . Our friends salute thee . Greet the friends by name .
ekegusii: Ninsemeretie kororana naye, na igo tokwane komo obosio ase obosio.

english: Beloved , I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health , even as thy soul prospereth .
ekegusii: Omwanchani, nasabire ng’a ogenderere buya ase amang’ana onsi, naende obe nobogima obuya, buna omoyo oo ore buya.

english: For I rejoiced greatly , when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee , even as thou walkest in the truth .
ekegusii: Naki igo nagogete mono ekero abaminto bachete baganteebia igoro y’obwegenwa bwao ore nabwo ase ekeene, na buna ogendererete ase ekeene.

english: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth .
ekegusii: Tindi nomogooko onde omonene kobua oyo, koigwa ng’a abana baane mbagendererete ase ekeene. Gayo ogotogigwa

english: Beloved , thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren , and to strangers ;
ekegusii: Omwanchani, igo ore omwegenwa ase onsi ayagwakoreire abwo bare abaminto, nonya bare abamenyi.

english: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church : whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort , thou shalt do well :
ekegusii: Barabwo babeire kirori ase ekanisa igoro y’obwanchani bwao. Nokore buya korabakonye ase orogendo rwabo, buna egwenerete ase okomokorera Nyasae.

english: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth , taking nothing of the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho y’erieta ria Yeso bagasooka isiko, tibaira gento korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku.

english: We therefore ought to receive such , that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth .
ekegusii: Nabo etogwenerete intwe koroisia abanto bare buna abwo, erinde tobe abakori emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ekeene. Dioterefe na Demeturio

english: I wrote unto the church : but Diotrephes , who loveth to have the preeminence among them , receiveth us not .
ekegusii: Nabarikerete abekanisa amang’ana, korende Dioterefe, oyobwanchete koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase bare, tatwancheti.

english: There was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
ekegusii: Ase Kaisaria narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana bw’ekeombe ekemo ki’abarwani kiare korokwa Abaitalia.

english: And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,
ekegusii: Akaba nenchara, akagania endagera arie. Korende ekero barenge koyeroisia, akabwatwa nobogondereria,

english: And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :
ekegusii: akarora igoro amaanokire, na egento kegoika, kere buna egetambaa ekenene, kebwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa gocha inse.

english: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
ekegusii: Ime yaye nigo biarengeo ebisaku bionsi bie ching’iti chire namagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro.

english: And there came a voice to him , Rise , Peter ; kill , and eat .
ekegusii: Eriogi rikamocheera, rikamoteebia: “Petero, imoka onyenye orie!”

english: But Peter said , Not so , Lord ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akabora: “Yay’Omonene, ekiagera tinana koria nonya ng’ake egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi.”

english: And the voice spake unto him again the second time , What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
ekegusii: Eriogi rikamochera eria kabere, rikamoteebia: “Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.”

english: This was done thrice : and the vessel was received up again into heaven .
ekegusii: Eri rigakoreka ara gatato, na egento keria gekabogorigwa gochia igoro naende.

english: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house , and stood before the gate ,
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u ase omoyo oye ime ase okorora okwo aroche, engencho yaye inki, rora, abanto baria batometwe na Kornelio, kobaboririe enyomba ya Simioni, bagatenena geita.

english: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
ekegusii: Bakarangeria neriogi bakabooria gose Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero, nao are ime.

english: While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .
ekegusii: Na Petero, karengereretie okorora koria, Omoika okamoteebia: “Rora, abanto batato bagokorigia.

english: A devout man , and one that feared God with all his house , which gave much alms to the people , and prayed to God alway .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, nere amo n’abanto b’enyomba yaye bonsi nigo bamoirogete Nyasae. Nigo are koa abanto ebiegwa ebinge n’omoyo oyomo na kogenderera gosaba Nyasae botambe.

english: Arise therefore , and get thee down , and go with them , doubting nothing : for I have sent them .
ekegusii: Imoka, oike, ogende amo nabarabwo, toba ne chitang’u‐tang’u ekiagera ninche nabatoma.”

english: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?
ekegusii: Petero agaika ase abanto baria, agateeba: “Ninche ere oyo mokorigia. Igo mwacha ase engencho ki?”

english: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nigo twatomirwe na Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, omonto omooronge, omoirogete Nyasae, oyogokwanwa buya negesaku gionsi ki’Abayahudi. Nateebigwa n’omomalaika omochenu ng’a atome abanto ase ore gokorangeria ogende bwoye, anyare koigwa amang’ana korwa ase ore.”

english: Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .
ekegusii: Erio Petero akabateebia basoe nyomba, babe abageni baye. Rituko rikobwatia akaimoka akagenda amo nabarabwo, na abande bamwabo korwa Yopa bakagenda amo nere.

english: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea . And Cornelius waited for them , and had called together his kinsmen and near friends .
ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.

english: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .
ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia gosoa omochie, Kornelio agasoka komoorotota, akagwa inse ase amagoro aye, akamosasiima.

english: But Peter took him up , saying , Stand up ; I myself also am a man .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoimokia, akamoteebia: “Tenena! Inche boigo Mwanyabaanto inde.”

english: And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .
ekegusii: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.

english: And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .
ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Mwamanyire ng’a tari boronge omonto Omoyahudi abwatane nomonto ore bw’egesaku ekeao, nonya nokomochiera, korende Nyasae onyorokirie ng’a timoroka onde bwensi ng’a tari omochenu, gose tachenegeti.

english: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying , as soon as I was sent for : I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me ?
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero narangeretigwe ngacha, tinaanga. Nkoboria nde: Ing’ana ki mwandangereretie?”

english: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .
ekegusii: Ang’e chinsa kianda iga chia mobaso akaba buna oy’okorota erio akarora omomalaika O Nyasae okomoochera, akamoteebia: “Kornelio!”

english: And Cornelius said , Four days ago I was fasting until this hour ; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house , and , behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing ,
ekegusii: Kornelio akamoiraneria: “Reero nerituko ria kane, korwa ekero narenge gosaba nyomba mwane chinsa buna echi, chinsa kianda. Ani! Omonto nateneine bosio bwane obekeire chianga chikomeka‐meka.

english: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
ekegusii: Aganteebia: Kornelio, ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na ebiegwa biao biainyoirwe ase Nyasae.

english: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .
ekegusii: Ase igo, toma abanto Yopa, orangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero; ere nomogeni are nyomba mwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao, nigo amenyete ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.

english: Immediately therefore I sent to thee ; and thou hast well done that thou art come . Now therefore are we all here present before God , to hear all things that are commanded thee of God .
ekegusii: Erio bwango ngatoma abanto orangerigwe, na aye gwakorire buya gwachire. Na bono twensi nao tore aiga ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tonyare koigwa aya onsi Omonene agochikiire gokwana.” Ogokwana gwa Petero

english: But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
ekegusii: korende ase kera egesaku omonto omoirogete na gokora oboronge nigo agwancherwa nere.

english: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all :)
ekegusii: Agatoma ring’ana eri ase Abaisraeli, akarandia amang’ana amaya ay’omorembe korwa ase Yeso Kristo, oyore Omonene o bonsi.

english: That word , I say , ye know , which was published throughout all Judæa , and began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached ;
ekegusii: Inwe momanyete, ng’a ring’ana eri riaraaretigwe ase Boyahudi yonsi, rigachaakera Galili magega y’ebatiso eria Yohana arandetie,

english: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil ; for God was with him .
ekegusii: igoro ya Yeso o Nazareti, buna Nyasae amoete Omoika Omochenu ne chinguru, na buna ataarete na gokora emeremo emiya, na kogwenia bonsi abaregetwe na Saitani, ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge amo nere.

english: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews , and in Jerusalem ; whom they slew and hanged on a tree :
ekegusii: Na intwe nigo tore kirori b’amang’ana onsi aya arenge gokora ase ense y’Abayahudi na ime ya Yerusalemu. Bakamoita, bakamosunga ase omote,

english: And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .
ekegusii: Akamorigereria mono, akairoka, akamobooria: “Naki Omonene?” Akamoiraneria: “Ogosaba kwao na ebiegwa biao biaikire igoro, na biabeire ekeinyorio ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly ;
ekegusii: korende Nyasae akamobokia ase rituko ria gatato, akamwanchera kooroka,

english: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
ekegusii: tari ase abanto bonsi, korende nasetore, abatwachoretwe na Nyasae tobe kirori. Intwe nigo tware koria na konywa amo nere magega y’okoboka kwaye.

english: And he commanded us to preach unto the people , and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead .
ekegusii: Agatochiika toranderie abanto, na tobe kirori ng’a nere ochoretwe na Nyasae abe omogambi bw’abare moyo na abakuure.

english: To him give all the prophets witness , that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins .
ekegusii: Oyo ababani bonsi baberete kirori, ng’a onde bwensi omwegenire nigo aranyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe ase erieta riaye.” Abanto b’Ebisaku bakonyora Omoika Omochenu na ebatiso

english: While Peter yet spake these words , the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word .
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge gokwana aya Omoika Omochenu ogaikera bonsi abaigwete amang’ana aya.

english: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished , as many as came with Peter , because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Abegenete korwa ase abaarogete abachete amo na Petero, bagakumia, ekiagera nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku banyorire ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.

english: For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,
ekegusii: Naki baabaigwete bagokwana ase emenwa ao ao, bagotogia Nyasae. Erio Petero akabora,

english: Can any man forbid water , that these should not be baptized , which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto nanyare kobatanga abanto aba, tibaabatiswa ase amache? Abanto abwo nabarabwo banyorire Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana buna intwe?”

english: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .
ekegusii: Agachiika baabatiswe ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Erio bakamobooria amente komenya amo nabarabwo amatuko atari make.

english: And now send men to Joppa , and call for one Simon , whose surname is Peter :
ekegusii: Gaki, bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.

english: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
ekegusii: Ere nomogeni bw’omonto oyomo okorokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao; enyomba yaye nigo ere ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.”

english: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually ;
ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika, oria okwanete nere, aimoka korwa aroro, Kornelio akarangeria abasomba baye babere na omorwani oyomo osigete Nyasae korwa ase baria bare komokorera botambe,

english: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
ekegusii: akabateebia amang’ana onsi, erio akabatoma Yopa.

english: On the morrow , as they went on their journey , and drew nigh unto the city , Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour :
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia, ekero baare kogenda, kobaikire ang’e nomochie, Petero akariina kerama igoro gochia gosaba koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo chia mobaso.

english: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
ekegusii: Naende abatomwa na abaminto abarenge Boyahudi bakaigwa ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku nabarabwo banyorire ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.

english: And , behold , immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was , sent from Cæsarea unto me .
ekegusii: Ani! Ekero ekio abanto batato baikire ase enyomba eria namenyete, na barabwo nigo batometwe ase ’nde korwa Kaisaria.

english: And the Spirit bade me go with them , nothing doubting . Moreover these six brethren accompanied me , and we entered into the man’s house :
ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu oganteebia ngende amo nabarabwo, timbaisa koba ne chitang’u‐tang’u. Na abaminto aba batano nomo bakagenda amo nainche, togasoa ase enyomba y’omonto oria;

english: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house , which stood and said unto him , Send men to Joppa , and call for Simon , whose surname is Peter ;
ekegusii: ere agatoteebia buna aroche omomalaika oteneine mwaye, na komoteebia: Toma abanto bagende Yopa, barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.

english: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
ekegusii: Nere oragoteebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.

english: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
ekegusii: Ekero nachaagete gokwana, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera buna otoikerete intwe agwo ritang’ani.

english: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us , who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ ; what was I , that I could withstand God ?
ekegusii: Gaki, onye Nyasae obaeire barabwo ekeegwa keria keria atoete intwe, ekero twamwegenete Omenene oito Yeso Kristo, inche ninche ng’o, ndanyaare koamereria Nyasae?”

english: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagakira‐kiri. Na barabwo bagatogia Nyasae, bagoteeba: “Gaki, Nyasae oeire abanto b’Ebisaku boigo okoonchoka okwo gokorenta obogima.” Ekanisa y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase Antiokia

english: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,
ekegusii: Erio ekero Petero achete ase Yerusalemu, baria abare ensemo y’okwaroka bakaamererania nere,

english: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene , which , when they were come to Antioch , spake unto the Grecians , preaching the Lord Jesus .
ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo ase egati yabo abanto ba Kuporo na Kurene, barabwo ekero bachia goika Antiokia bagakwana n’Abagiriki, bakabaranderia amang’ana amaya igoro y’Omonene Yeso.

english: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nabarabwo; abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene, na komoonchokera.

english: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ekanisa ya Yerusalemu bakaigwa amang’ana aya, bagatoma Barnaba agende Antiokia.
