english: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
ekegusii: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.

english: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, oichire n’Omoika Omochenu na okwegena. Abanto abange bakamenteka ase Omonene.

english: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus , for to seek Saul :
ekegusii: Barnaba akarua agwo, akagenda Tariso korigia Saulo,

english: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .
ekegusii: na ekero amonyorete akamorenta Antiokia. Ase engaki y’omwaka omogima bagasangererekana amo ase ekanisa na kworokereria abanto abange. Agwo Antiokia nao aborokigwa batang’anete korokwa Abakristo. Obotomwa bwa Barnaba na Saulo gochia Yerusalemu

english: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ababani bagatirimboka korwa Yerusalemu gochia Antiokia.

english: Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa :
ekegusii: Na aborokigwa baria, kera oyomo koreng’ana buna okonyara kwaye, bakang’ea gotoma ogokonywa ase abamwabo abamenyete Boyahudi.

english: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .
ekegusii: bakamoteebia: “Aye ngwasoa ase abanto batarogeti, okaragera amo nabarabwo!”

english: Which also they did , and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul .
ekegusii: Bagakora bo, bagatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka ase amaboko a Barnaba na Saulo.

english: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning , and expounded it by order unto them , saying ,
ekegusii: Korende Petero agachaaka kobateebia amang’ana onsi buna abeete,

english: I was in the city of Joppa praying : and in a trance I saw a vision , A certain vessel descend , as it had been a great sheet , let down from heaven by four corners ; and it came even to me :
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge ase omochie okorokwa Yopa, ngosaba nare, nkaba buna oyobwatire nobogondereria, nkarora ase okorora egento kere buna egetambaa kiabwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa korwa igoro gocha ase ’nde.

english: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
ekegusii: Ngakerigereria mono, nkarora ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, amo n’echikwagura, n’chinyoni chia igoro.

english: And I heard a voice saying unto me , Arise , Peter ; slay and eat .
ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Petero, imoka, onyenye orie!

english: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
ekegusii: Korende nkabora: Yay’Omonene, ekiagera egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi, tibiana gosoa ase omonwa one nonya ng’ake.

english: But the voice answered me again from heaven , What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
ekegusii: Eriogi riganteebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.

english: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
ekegusii: Nabo ase engaki eria, omorwoti Herode akarambora amaboko aye agachanda abanto bande b’ekanisa.

english: When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goetania ensemo ye ritang’ani na ensemo ya kabere ase abarendi barendete, bagaika egeita ki’ebioma kegosoerwa omochie ime. Eke gekabaigokera, na barabwo bagaeta ase enchera eyemo. Erio kegima omomalaika oria agatiga Petero.

english: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia komanya, agateeba: “Bono namanyire bori ng’a Omonene nere otoma omomalaika oye ochia kondusia ase okoboko kwa Herode, na korwa ase ogosemeria gwonsi kw’abaanto b’Abayahudi.”

english: And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John , whose surname was Mark ; where many were gathered together praying .
ekegusii: Erio kayarengereretie aya, agaika ase enyomba ya Mariamu ng’ina Yohana, oyokorokwa naende Mariko; na abanto abange nao basangererekanete gosaba.

english: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .
ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agaacha koigwa.

english: And when she knew Peter’s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .
ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogooko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabateebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.

english: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nebarimo ore!” Korende akaamereria mono, agateeba ng’a naboigo are. Bakaboora: “Nomomalaika oye!”

english: But Peter continued knocking : and when they had opened the door , and saw him , they were astonished .
ekegusii: Petero akagenderera gokong’onta egesieri. Erio bakamoigorera, bakamorora, bagakumia.

english: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace , declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison . And he said , Go shew these things unto James , and to the brethren . And he departed , and went into another place .
ekegusii: Ere akabakania nokoboko, ng’a bakire, tibakwana, akabateebereria buna Omonene amosokia korwa ase echela. Akabora: “Genda, moteebie Yakobo na abaminto amang’ana aya.” Agasoka, akagenda ensemo ende.

english: Now as soon as it was day , there was no small stir among the soldiers , what was become of Peter .
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia abarendi bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge igoro ya Petero, naki abeete.

english: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea , and there abode .
ekegusii: Herode akamorigia, tamonyora. Akana‐kounia abarendi, agachiika ng’a baitwe. Erio agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi, akagenda Kaisaria, akamenya aroro. Ogokwa kwa Herode

english: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword .
ekegusii: Agaita Yakobo omwabo Yohana nomoyio o birende.

english: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend , desired peace ; because their country was nourished by the king’s country .
ekegusii: Herode nigo abeete mono abanto ba Turo na Sidoni. Korende barabwo bakamochiera ase obomo, na ekero baebereirie Blasto, oyorenge korenda enyomba y’omorwoti, bakarigia omorembe, ekiagera ense yabo nigo yare konyora endagera korwa ase ense y’omorwoti.

english: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo eriabekire, Herode akeboyia chianga chi’oborwoti, agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti, agakwana ase bare.

english: And the people gave a shout , saying, It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .
ekegusii: Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Eri neriogi ri’enyasae, tari eri’omonto!”

english: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
ekegusii: Erio bwango omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoaka ekiagera atasigete Nyasae; akariegwa namakonde, agatweka mo.

english: But the word of God grew and multiplied .
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rikagenderera komentekana.

english: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem , when they had fulfilled their ministry , and took with them John , whose surname was Mark .
ekegusii: Barnaba na Saulo, ekero bakoorire obotomwa bwabo, bakairana korwa Yerusalemu, bakarentana Yohana ore korokwa Mariko.

english: And because he saw it pleased the Jews , he proceeded further to take Peter also . ( Then were the days of unleavened bread .)
ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng’a aya agweneire Abayahudi, akagenderera, Petero nere akabwatwa. Amatuko ayio naro amatuko emegati etabekiri memera.

english: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .
ekegusii: Nabo Petero arendetwe ase echela ime, abanto b’ekanisa bakamosabera ase Nyasae nomoyo bw’omokia.

english: And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria bwatang’anerete rituko riria Herode arengereretie komoira ase ekegambero, Petero nigo arenge oraire gati y’abarendi babere, osibire nebinyuri bibere, na abarwani nigo barenge gesieri barendete echela.

english: And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .
ekegusii: Na rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera, na amasase akamoreka akanyomba ime. Omomalaika oria agaaka Petero rikere riaye, akamotura, agateeba: “Imoka bwango!” Ebinyuri bigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.

english: And the angel said unto him , Gird thyself , and bind on thy sandals . And so he did . And he saith unto him , Cast thy garment about thee , and follow me .
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia: “Eboyie, obeke ebikoroto biao.” Agakora bo. Naende akamoteebia: “Beka eganchwa yao, ontunyane!”

english: And he went out , and followed him ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel ; but thought he saw a vision .
ekegusii: Agasoka, akamotunyana, gose tamanyete ng’a ayakoretwe nomomalaika nay’ekeene, korende agakaga ng’a nokorora arorire.

english: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers ; as Barnabas , and Simeon that was called Niger , and Lucius of Cyrene , and Manaen , which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch , and Saul .
ekegusii: Ase ekanisa ya Abantiokia mbarengeo ababani amo aborokia: Barnaba na Simioni, oyo ore korokwa Nigeri, na Lukio Omokurene, na Manaeni oyo orereretwe amo nomorwoti Herode, na Saulo.

english: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?
ekegusii: “Aye omwana o Saitani omobisa bw’oboronge bwonsi, oichire nobong’ainereria n’obobe bwonsi, torigeti gotiga gokora bogeka chinchera chia Nyasae Omobui chire boronge?

english: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .
ekegusii: Rora bono, okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kore igoro ase ore, aye nobe omouko, torora erioba ase engaki.” Erio kegima akabwatwa norotutu na omosunte, agataba‐taba akarigia abanto bamobwate okoboko bamoraae.

english: Then the deputy , when he saw what was done , believed , being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord .
ekegusii: Ekero gabana achia korora ayakoreka, akeegena, agakumia ase okworokereria kw’Omonene. Ase Antiokia ya Pisidia. Okorandia gwa Paulo ase Abayahudi

english: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Erio Paulo na abamwabo bakamanora n’emeeri korwa Pafo, bagaika Perga ase Pamfulia. Yohana akabatiga, akairana Yerusalemu,

english: But when they departed from Perga , they came to Antioch in Pisidia , and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and sat down .
ekegusii: korende barabwo bakarua Perga, bakagenda Antiokia, omochie o Pisidia. Rituko ria Esabato bagasoa ase esinagogi, bagaikaransa aroro.

english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .
ekegusii: Magega kabasomire amachiiko na egetabu y’ababani, abatang’ani b’esinagogi bagatoma amang’ana ase bare kobateebia: “Abaminto, onye more ne ring’ana ri’okoremia, rikwane!”

english: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .
ekegusii: Paulo agatenena, akarambora okoboko, agakwana: Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, na inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ntegerera.

english: As they ministered to the Lord , and fasted , the Holy Ghost said , Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them .
ekegusii: Aba iga, ekero barenge gosasiima Omonene, na kweng’ata, Omoika Omochenu agateeba: “Nchorere Barnaba na Saulo ase emeremo eria nabarangereretie bayekore.”

english: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
ekegusii: Korwa ase oroiboro rw’omonto oyio Nyasae orenteire Abaisraeli Omotooria, nere Yeso. Nabo abarierete eira.

english: Men and brethren , children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you feareth God , to you is the word of this salvation sent .
ekegusii: Abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, amo nabande ase more inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ring’ana ri’ogotooreka riatomirwe ase tore.

english: For they that dwell at Jerusalem , and their rulers , because they knew him not , nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day , they have fulfilled them in condemning him .
ekegusii: Naki abamenyete Yerusalemu, na abanene babo tibamomanyete, ekiagera tibamanyete nonya namang’ana y’ababani. Ase okomogambia baikeranirie ayare gosomwa ase chibuku chi’ababani kera Esabato.

english: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .
ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire okweng’ata na ogosaba bakababeekera amaboko, bakabatiga bagende. Barnaba na Saulo ase Kuporo

english: But God raised him from the dead :
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure.

english: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children , in that he hath raised up Jesus again ; as it is also written in the second psalm , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee .
ekegusii: Aya Nyasae atoikeraneirie intwe abana babo ase okobokia Yeso. Naende buna ariikire ase Zaburi ibere: Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.

english: For David , after he had served his own generation by the will of God , fell on sleep , and was laid unto his fathers , and saw corruption :
ekegusii: Naki Daudi, ekero akoorire gokorera ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase ekegori kiaye, agakwa, agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, akarora ogosareka.

english: But he, whom God raised again , saw no corruption .
ekegusii: Korende oyo obogetigwe na Nyasae taroche ogosareka.

english: Be it known unto you therefore , men and brethren , that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins :
ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, tiga amanyekane ase more ng’a goetera ase oyio nigo mokoranderigwa okwaberwa kw’ebibe,

english: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .
ekegusii: na asere kera oyomwegenire nigo akobarerwa oboronge ase amang’ana aria atakonyarekana kobarerwa oboronge ase amachiiko a Musa.

english: So they , being sent forth by the Holy Ghost , departed unto Seleucia ; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .
ekegusii: Abwo babere bagatomwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagatirimboka gochia Selukia, na korwa agwo bakaamboka n’emeeri gochia Kuporo.

english: Beware therefore , lest that come upon you , which is spoken of in the prophets ;
ekegusii: Gaki, erende, tabaisa kobaikera amang’ana aria akwanetwe nababani:

english: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue , the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath .
ekegusii: Kabasokire, abanto bakabasorora bache kobateebia amang’ana aya Esabato ya kabere.

english: Now when the congregation was broken up , many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas : who , speaking to them , persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
ekegusii: Ekero omosangererekano bw’esinagogi oera, Abayahudi abange na abegeni b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete bakabwatana na Paulo na Barnaba, abakwanete nabarabwo, na kobaremia bagenderere ase obuya bwa Nyasae. Abatomwa bakogenda ase abanto b’Ebisaku

english: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .
ekegusii: Ase Esabato ya kabere abanto abange, ang’e omochie bwonsi, bagasangererekana baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes , they were filled with envy , and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul , contradicting and blaspheming .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bachia korora emeganda, bagaichorwa ne ribero, bagakaana amang’ana ayare gokwanwa na Paulo, bakamorama.

english: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bagakwana noboremu, bagateeba: Igo yagwenerete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae rikwanwe ase more ritang’ani. Korende ekiagera mwarisukeirie are mwenacheire inwe abanyene ng’a timogwenereti obogima bwa kare na kare, tweonchoreire abanto b’Ebisaku.

english: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Ebisaku bachia koigwa ayio bakagoka, bagatogia ring’ana ri’Omonene, na abwo bachiikeretwe konyora obogima bwa kare na kare bakeegena.

english: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region .
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda ase ense eria yonsi.

english: And when they were at Salamis , they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews : and they had also John to their minister .
ekegusii: Bagaika Salami, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chisinagogi chi’Abayahudi, na barabwo nigo barenge na Yohana okobakonya.

english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaburukania abakungu abamoirogete Nyasae, abasikire n’abanto, na abanene b’omochie, bakagenka abanto bachande Paulo na Barnaba, na kobaseria korwa ensemo yabo.

english: And the disciples were filled with joy , and with the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Na aborokigwa bagaichorwa nomogooko na Omoika Omochenu.

english: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar-jesus :
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire goeta gati‐gati y’egesinka gionsi goika Pafo, bakanyora aroro omonto oyomo Omoyahudi omoriingoria, omobani bw’oborimo, ore korokwa Bar-Yeso.

english: Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge amo na gabana Sergio Paulo, omonto bw’obong’aini. Ere akarangeria Barnaba na Saulo bache asare, akarigia koigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
ekegusii: Korende Elima, oria omoringoria (okoonchorwa kw’erieta riaye nakwo oko) akaamererania nabarabwo, akarigia koonchora gabana oria atige okwegena.

english: Then Saul , ( who also is called Paul ,) filled with the Holy Ghost , set his eyes on him ,
ekegusii: Korende Saulo, oyokorokwa naende Paulo, agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akamotogoreria amaiso, akabora,

english: And it came to pass in Iconium , that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spake , that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed .
ekegusii: Aaria Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba bagasoa esinagogi amo buna engencho yarenge, bagakwana n’oboikeranu goika abanto abange b’Abayahudi na b’Ebisaku bakeegena.

english: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .
ekegusii: agakwana neriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tenena boronge namagoro ao.” Agatenena bwango, agataarataara.

english: And when the people saw what Paul had done , they lifted up their voices , saying in the speech of Lycaonia , The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men .
ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yachia korora aya Paulo akora, bagaaka amariogi abo, bagakwana ase Ekelukania: “Chinyasae chiatoikeire ase emegwekano ya Mwanyabaanto!”

english: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .
ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.

english: Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .
ekegusii: Omokuani o Zeu, oyo Hekalu yaye yarenge isiko y’omochie, akarenta chieri na ebisembe bi’ebisicha goika ase ebiita; ere amo n’abanto bakarigia korua ekeng’wanso.

english: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,
ekegusii: Korende abatomwa Barnaba na Paulo, ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ayio bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakaayerera, bagasoa ase omoganda, bagaaka egeturi, bagoteeba,

english: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways .
ekegusii: Kare ase ebigori biaetire nigo atigete ebisaku bionsi bitaare ase chinchera chiabo abanyene,

english: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness .
ekegusii: korende ere omonyene tetigete atari na kirori. Ere nigo are gokora amaya na kobaa embura korwa igoro, ne chingaki chi’erigesa, agaisanekia chinkoro chiaino nendagera na omogooko.”

english: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people , that they had not done sacrifice unto them .
ekegusii: Na ase amang’ana aya bagatanga abanto baria bokong’u, tibaabaruseria ebing’wanso.

english: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium , who persuaded the people , and , having stoned Paul , drew him out of the city , supposing he had been dead .
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,

english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi abategenete bakaburukania emioyo y’abanto b’Ebisaku na gosaria emioyo yabo igoro ase abaminto.

english: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bamoetananire ase chinsemo chionsi, agatenena, agasoa omochie ime, ne rituko ria kabere riaye agasoka, akagenda Deribe amo na Barnaba. Okoirana ase Antiokia

english: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
ekegusii: Magega kobarandirie amang’ana amaya ase omochie oria, na kobakorire abange koba aborokigwa, bakairana goika Listra, na Ikonio, na Antiokia,

english: Confirming the souls of the disciples , and exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: bakabeeka emioyo yaborokigwa chinguru na kobaremia bagenderere ase okwegena, bakabateebia ng’a: “Netogwenerete gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’emechando emenge.”

english: And when they had ordained them elders in every church , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , on whom they believed .
ekegusii: Erio kobachorire abagaaka ase kera ekanisa ase ogosaba na okweng’ata, bakababeeka ase amaboko y’Omonene, oyio begenete.

english: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia , they came to Pamphylia .
ekegusii: Bagaeta gati ya Pisidia, bagasoa Pamfulia.

english: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :
ekegusii: Na magega kobarandirie ring’ana ase Perga, bagatirimboka gochia Atalia,

english: And thence sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled .
ekegusii: na korwa agwo bakairwa n’emeeri ase enyancha, bagaika Antiokia. Agwo nao babeekeretwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae ase emeremo eria banyarete goikerania.

english: And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika aroro bagasangereria ekanisa amo, bakaorokia amang’ana onsi Nyasae akorete nabarabwo, na buna aigoreire abanto b’Ebisaku egesieri gi’okwegena.

english: And there they abode long time with the disciples .
ekegusii: Bakaba agwo amatuko atai make amo naborokigwa.

english: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .
ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya aroro, bagakwana noboremu igoro ase Omonene, oyorenge koorokia ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye na kobanchera ebikone na amakumia bikoreke ase amaboko abo.

english: But the multitude of the city was divided : and part held with the Jews , and part with the apostles .
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’omochie oria bagaatananekana. Abande bakabwatana n’Abayahudi na abande nabatomwa.

english: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles , and also of the Jews with their rulers , to use them despitefully , and to stone them ,
ekegusii: Ekero okong’orerwa + 14:5 okong’orerwa: engencho yaye ogwatananwa kw’ogochaya kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku na Abayahudi amo n’abanene babo gwakoretwe igoro y’abatomwa ase okobakorera amabe na kobaaka amagena,

english: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
ekegusii: barabwo bakanyora amang’ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang’e.

english: And there they preached the gospel .
ekegusii: Aroro bakagenderera korandia enchiri. Ase Listra

english: And there sat a certain man at Lystra , impotent in his feet , being a cripple from his mother’s womb , who never had walked :
ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng’ake.

english: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,
ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaigwa Paulo kagokwana. Paulo akamobeta amaiso, akarora ng’a nare nokwegena gw’okogwenigwa,

english: Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?
ekegusii: Gaki, bono inaki mogoteema Nyasae na kobeeka rikorogoto igoro ase amagoti ’aborokigwa, eri chisokoro chiaito chitanyarete kobogoria, nonya nintwe totanyaare.

english: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved , even as they .
ekegusii: Korende twegenire ng’a ase amaabera a Yeso, Omonene intwe natotoorigwe buna barabwo.”

english: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi ogakira, ogategerera Barnaba na Paulo, ekero baare koraria amang’ana igoro y’ebikone na amakumia Nyasae akorete goetera ase bare ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku.

english: And after they had held their peace , James answered , saying , Men and brethren , hearken unto me :
ekegusii: Kobakoorire gokwana, Yakobo akairaneria: Abaminto, ntegerera.

english: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles , to take out of them a people for his name .
ekegusii: Simioni otworokirie buna Nyasae ritang’ani acheire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde achore abanto korwa ase bare babogorie erieta riaye.

english: And to this agree the words of the prophets ; as it is written ,
ekegusii: Na amang’ana ’ababani nigo abwataine nayio, buna ariikire,

english: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .
ekegusii: erinde Mwanyabaanto abatigaire barigie Omonene amo n’abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, aba narangeirie ase erieta riane.

english: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .
ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene agoteeba, oyo oorogetie aya korwa kare.

english: Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanachire iga, ng’a titochanda abanto baria b’Ebisaku abaonchokeire Nyasae,

english: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akarenta ogwatananekana okonene, na Paulo na Barnaba bakaamererania n’abanto aba. Erio Paulo, na Barnaba, na abande korwa ase egati yabo bagachiikwa batiire gochia Yerusalemu ase abatomwa na abagaaka ase engencho y’okoamererania okwo.

english: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .
ekegusii: Naki korwa ebigori bia kare Musa narenge n’abanto baare korandia amang’ana aye, na ase kera omochie nigo are gosomwa kera Esabato ase chisinagogi. Riruube ase Abakristo b’Ebisaku

english: Then pleased it the apostles and elders , with the whole church , to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas ; namely , Judas surnamed Barsabas , and Silas , chief men among the brethren :
ekegusii: Erio akagwenera abatomwa na abagaaka amo na ekanisa yonsi gochora abanto korwa ase egati yabo na kobatoma Antiokia amo na Paulo na Barnaba. Bagatoma Yuda ore korokwa Barsaba, na Sila, abatang’ani b’abamwabo,

english: And they wrote letters by them after this manner ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
ekegusii: bakabaa baire riruube ririikire iga: “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.

english: Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :
ekegusii: Twaigure ng’a abanto baruure aa ase tore abaabachandire ase amang’ana abo na koonchorana emioyo yaino, na intwe titwabachiigete ng’a bakore bo.

english: It seemed good unto us , being assembled with one accord , to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, intwe twarorire buya ase omosangererekano oito gochora abanto na kobatoma ase more amo nabanchwa baito Barnaba na Paulo,

english: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: abanto ababekire obogima bwabo ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who shall also tell you the same things by mouth .
ekegusii: Ase ayio twatomire Yuda na Sila, abaranyare kobateebia amang’ana ayio ayio ase emenwa yabo.

english: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost , and to us , to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things ;
ekegusii: Iga yarorekanete buya ase Omoika Omochenu amo naintwe, titobatweka egurube ende otatiga eyio egwenerete:

english: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .
ekegusii: Mweatanane korwa ase ebinto biruure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani. Kamoretange nayio, namokore buya. Motigare buya.”

english: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phenice and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
ekegusii: Bagatomwa ekanisa, bagaeta gati ya Foiniki na Samaria, bakararia amang’ana ’okoonchoka kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku, bakagokia abaminto bonsi.

english: So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :
ekegusii: Ekero baria baegwa ribaga, bagatirimboka gochia Antiokia, bagasangereria abanto b’ekanisa y’aroro, bakabaa riruube riria.

english: Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .
ekegusii: Na barabwo kobarisomire, bakagoka ase engencho y’okoremigwa okwo.

english: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y’abaminto ase amang’ana amange, bakababeeka chinguru.

english: And after they had tarried there a space , they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles .
ekegusii: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai ’nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete. [

english: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still .
ekegusii: Korende Sila akarora buya atigare aroro.]

english: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .
ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya agwo Antiokia amo n’abanto bande abange, bakaba bakworokereria na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene. Paulo na Barnaba bagwatananekana

english: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas , Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord , and see how they do .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Paulo agateebia Barnaba: “Toirane, tochie korora abaminto ase kera omochie twarandirie ring’ana ri’Omonene, gose mbuya bare.”

english: And Barnabas determined to take with them John , whose surname was Mark .
ekegusii: Barnaba agancha koirana Yohana, ore korokwa Mariko, amo nabarabwo.

english: And the contention was so sharp between them , that they departed asunder one from the other : and so Barnabas took Mark , and sailed unto Cyprus ;
ekegusii: Erio eriomana rigatuboka ase egati yabo goika bagaatananekana. Barnaba akaira Mariko, akagenda n’emeeri gochia Kuporo,

english: And when they were come to Jerusalem , they were received of the church , and of the apostles and elders , and they declared all things that God had done with them .
ekegusii: Ekero baigete Yerusalemu bakaroisigwa n’ekanisa amo n’Abatomwa na abagaaka, bakaboorokia amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorete nabarabwo.

english: And Paul chose Silas , and departed , being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God .
ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila, na ekero abegeni bamobekeire amaboko, akaimoka akagenda.

english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia , confirming the churches .
ekegusii: Agaeta ase Siiria na Kilikia, akabeeka Ekanisa chinguru.

english: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed , saying , That it was needful to circumcise them , and to command them to keep the law of Moses .
ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai, abwo begenete, bagatenena, bagateeba: “Negwenerete kobaorokia na kobachiika babwate amachiiko a Musa.” Omosangererekano ore Yerusalemu

english: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
ekegusii: Abatomwa na abagaaka bagasangererekana amo, erinde banyare korengereria igoro ye ring’ana erio.

english: And put no difference between us and them , purifying their hearts by faith .
ekegusii: gose takorete gwatananekana ase egati yaito na barabwo, korende agasibia chinkoro chiabo ase okwegena.

english: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timotheus , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed ; but his father was a Greek :
ekegusii: Agaika Deribe na Listra, ase omworokigwa oyomo amenyete, erieta riaye Timotheo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omoyahudi, korende ise n’Omogiriki orenge.

english: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .
ekegusii: Magega y’okorora koria, erio bwango kegima tokarigia kogenda Makedonia, ekiagera twaroche ekeene ng’a Nyasae otorangeirie tobaranderie enchiri. Paulo okwamboka gochia Makedonia Ase Filipi

english: Therefore loosing from Troas , we came with a straight course to Samothracia , and the next day to Neapolis ;
ekegusii: Tokamanoria emeeri korwa Teroa, tokagenda boronge goika Samotraki. Rituko rikobwatia togaika Neapoli,

english: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .
ekegusii: na korwa aroro togaika Filipi, omochie ore omonene ase ensemo ya Makedonia, ense yare kogamberwa n’Abarumi. Tokamenya ase omochie oyo amatuko amake.

english: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side , where prayer was wont to be made ; and we sat down , and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria Esabato togasoka isiko y’egeita ase orooche mbarabare, ase ensemo twarengereretie ng’a tonyore aase togosabera. Togaikaransa, togakwana nabakungu abasangererekanete aria.

english: And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasiimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Omokungu oyo nigo arenge omosasiima o Nyasae. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro y’omokuungu oria, erinde akaigwa na gwancha amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.

english: And when she was baptized , and her household , she besought us , saying , If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house , and abide there . And she constrained us .
ekegusii: Goika omokungu oria ochia kobatiswa, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye, agatosorora na gotobetereria ogoteeba: “Onye mwandorire ng’a n’omwegeni nde ase Omonene, soa nyomba mwane, moikaranse.”

english: And it came to pass , as we went to prayer , a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us , which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying :
ekegusii: Riruko erimo, ekero tware kogenda aase aria tware gosabera, tokaumerana n’omoiseke omosomba oyobwatire n’ekerecha ki’oboringoria. Omoiseke oyio nigo arenge konyorera abanene baye enibo enyinge ase oboringoria bwaye.

english: The same followed Paul and us , and cried , saying , These men are the servants of the most high God , which shew unto us the way of salvation .
ekegusii: Omoiseke oyio agatunyana Paulo amo naintwe, ogoaka eriogi ogoteeba: “Abanto aba nabasomba ba Nyasae more, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakoranderia inwe enchera y’ogotooreka.”

english: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .
ekegusii: Akana‐gokora ayio amatuko amange. Korende Paulo agakoona, akeonchora, agateebia ekerecha keria: “Nagochikiire ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Karue ase omoiseke oyo!” Gekamorua ensa eria eria. Paulo na Sila bagosibwa na gosiborwa

english: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone , they caught Paul and Silas , and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero abanene baye bachia korora ng’a ogosemeria kw’enibo yabo gwasirire, bakabwata Paulo na Sila, bakabakurura goika echiiro ase obosio bw’abanene b’omochie.

english: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge gokwanwa buya nabaminto abamenyete Listra na Ikonio.

english: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
ekegusii: Bakabaira ase abagaambi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba basaririe omochie oito, na barabwo n’Abayahudi.

english: And teach customs , which are not lawful for us to receive , neither to observe , being Romans .
ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng’a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n’Abarumi tore.”

english: And the multitude rose up together against them : and the magistrates rent off their clothes , and commanded to beat them .
ekegusii: Omoganda okabwatana ase okobogerera, na abagaambi bakabatandorera chianga chiabo na gochirusia, bagachiika ng’a baakwe ne chinyimbo.

english: And when they had laid many stripes upon them , they cast them into prison , charging the jailor to keep them safely :
ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachiika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.

english: Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .
ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.

english: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
ekegusii: Korende ekero kia botuko gati Paulo na Sila nigo barenge gosaba Nyasae na komoterera amatera, na abasibwa bande nigo babategererete.

english: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one’s bands were loosed .
ekegusii: Erio mobosokano omotengecho omonene okaba aroro, goika amaroso ’echela agatengechigwa; bwango ebisieri bionsi bikaigoka, na ebisibo bia bonsi bigasansoka.

english: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep , and seeing the prison doors open , he drew out his sword , and would have killed himself , supposing that the prisoners had been fled .
ekegusii: Omorendi bw’echela akaboka na akarora ebisieri bi’echela biaigokire, akang’usa omoyio o birende, akarigia gweita, ekiagera akagete ng’a abasibwa mbatamire.

english: But Paul cried with a loud voice , saying , Do thyself no harm : for we are all here .
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaaka eriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tibweita, ekiagera intwe twensi nao tore aa.”

english: Then he called for a light , and sprang in , and came trembling , and fell down before Paul and Silas ,
ekegusii: Akarigia chitaaya chirentwe, akarindoka gochia ime, okoiguswa ase obwoba, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Paulo na Sila;

english: Him would Paul have to go forth with him ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .
ekegusii: Paulo agancha Timotheo agende nere, erio akamoira, akamwarokia ase engencho y’Abayahudi abarenge chinsemo chiria, ekiagera bonsi mbamanyete ng’a ise n’Omogiriki orenge.

english: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?
ekegusii: akabarenta isiko, akababoria: “Abaanene baane, inki ndakore ntooreke?”

english: And they said , Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ , and thou shalt be saved , and thy house .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Mwegene Omonene Yeso, na aye notooreke amo nab’enyomba yao.”

english: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .
ekegusii: Bagakwana ring’ana ri’Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.

english: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
ekegusii: Akabaroisia ensa eria ya botuko, akabasibia chingoma chiabo, akabatiswa ekero ekio, ere na abanto bonsi ba mwaye.

english: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .
ekegusii: Akabaira mwaye, akabarageria, akagoka mono amo na bonsi b’enyomba yaye, ekiagera konya bamwegenire Nyasae. english: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaambi bagatoma abanyanyimbo, bagoteeba: “Tiga abanto abwo bagende!”

english: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
ekegusii: Omorendi oria bw’echela akairera Paulo amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Abagaambi batomire amang’ana ng’a mosiborwe; gaki bono, soka isiko, mogende nomorembe!”

english: But Paul said unto them , They have beaten us openly uncondemned , being Romans , and have cast us into prison ; and now do they thrust us out privily ? nay verily ; but let them come themselves and fetch us out .
ekegusii: Korende Paulo akabateebia: “Bagatosusura maiso marore bataratogambia kina, na intwe n’Abarumi tore, naende bagatoruta echela ime. Inee! Bono barigetie gotosokia bobisi? Yaya! Tari bo; tiga baache abanyene batosokie.”

english: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates : and they feared , when they heard that they were Romans .
ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo bakairera abagaambi amang’ana aya, na barabwo bakoboa ekero baigwa ng’a Paulo na Sila n’Abarumi bare.

english: And they came and besought them , and brought them out , and desired them to depart out of the city .
ekegusii: Bagaacha bakabasaba okwaberwa. Erio kobaabasokirie isiko bakababoria barue ase omochie oria.

english: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Nabo, ekero barenge goeta egati y’emechie eria, bakabaa amachiiko aria achiigetwe nabatomwa n’abagaaka abarenge Yerusalemu, erinde bayabwate.

english: And they went out of the prison , and entered into the house of Lydia : and when they had seen the brethren , they comforted them , and departed .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagasooka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.

english: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
ekegusii: Nabo, Chikanisa chikabekwa chinguru ase okwegena; omobaro obo okamentekana kera rituko. Orogendo rwa Paulo goetera Asia Enke

english: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia , and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia ,
ekegusii: Paulo na Timotheo bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo ase ense y’Asia.

english: After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika chimbebe chi’ense ya Misia, bagateema kogenda Bitinia, korende Omoika o Yeso tobaa ribaga;

english: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas .
ekegusii: ase igo, bagaeta ime ya Misia, bagatirimbokera gochia Teroa.

english: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .
ekegusii: Ase obotuko Paulo akaorokerwa n’endoto, akarora omonto o Makedonia oteneine okomosorora, okomoteebia: “Koranche, amboka gocha aa Makedonia otokoonye.”

english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
ekegusii: Erio kobaetire egati y’Amfipoli na Apolonia, bagaika Tesaloniki aase esinagogi y’Abayahudi yarenge.

english: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
ekegusii: Erio bwango kegima ase obotuko boria abaminto bagatoma Paulo na Sila gochia Beroya. Kobaikire aroro, bagasoa ase esinagogi y’Abayahudi.

english: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .
ekegusii: Abayahudi aba nigo baare abaya ase ogotegerera kobua baria ba Tesaloniki; nigo babwatete Ring’ana ase obwanchani, bare kona‐koriga‐rigia amariiko kera rituko, erinde barore gose amang’ana ayio nabo are.

english: Therefore many of them believed ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .
ekegusii: Abange b’abaanto korwa ase bare bakeegena amo nabakungu Abagiriki abaare abasike, na abasacha batari bake.

english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi ba Tesaloniki, ekero baigwete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae riarandigwe na Paulo ase Beroya, bakagenda aroro bakaburukania abanto na kobarubania.

english: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea : but Silas and Timotheus abode there still .
ekegusii: Erio kegima abaminto baria bagatoma Paulo agende goika nyancha, korende Sila na Timotheo bagatigara aroro.

english: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed , they departed .
ekegusii: Baria bakoobete Paulo bakamoikia Atene, na ekero banyorire ogochika koirera Sila na Timotheo ng’a bache asare bwango buna eranyarekane, bakarua aroro. Ase Atene

english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo abaganyete aria Atene, akarora buna omochie oria oichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, akaigwa bobe ase omoika oye.

english: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .
ekegusii: Nabo ase esinagogi agakwana n’Abayahudi na abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, na kera rituko ase echiiro nabaria abaare gocha aroro.

english: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
ekegusii: Abande abanyasemi b’Abaepikurio na Abastoiki bakaamererania nere. Abande bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nomonyamang’ana mange, inki arigetie goteeba?” Na abande: “Ororekanire ng’a nigo are buna omorandia bw’amang’ana e chinyasae chingeni”, ekiagera nigo arenge korandia amang’ana a Yeso na okobokigwa kw’abakuure.

english: And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira goika Areopago, bakamobooria: “Inee! Nonyare gototeebia engencho y’okworokereria okwo okoyia ogokwana?

english: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,
ekegusii: Na Paulo, buna anarete, agasoa ime aase barenge. Agwo ase Chisabato isato agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana korwa ase amariiko,

english: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .
ekegusii: Nigo okorenta amang’ana amageni ase amato aito; gaki ntorigetie komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”

english: ( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing .)
ekegusii: Abaatene bonsi na abamenyi abamenyete agwo tibarenge ne ribaga ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ogokwana na gotegerera amang’ana amayia. Ogokwana gwa Paulo ase Areopago

english: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .
ekegusii: Paulo agatenena gati‐gati y’Areopago, akabora: Inwe abasacha b’Atene! Narorire ng’a nigo more abanto abamorengereretie mono amang’ana e chinyasae,

english: For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
ekegusii: ekiagera ekero narenge goetanana aria na aria, na korora ebisasimero biaino, nkarora egesasiimero keriikire amang’ana aya: GOCHIA ASE NYASAE ORIA OTAMANYEKANETI. Gaki inche nigo nkobaraareria chingencho chiaye ere oria inwe mogosasiima motamanyeti.

english: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things ;
ekegusii: gose tari gokorerwa namaboko a Mwanyabaanto, buna oyo oremeire gento, ekiagera nere okobaa bonsi obogima na omoika, na ebinto bionsi.

english: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation ;
ekegusii: Korwa ase omonto oyomo nere otongete kera egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto kemenye ase ense engima, akababeekera chingaki ne chimbebe chi’Obomenyo bwabo,

english: That they should seek the Lord , if haply they might feel after him , and find him , though he be not far from every one of us :
ekegusii: erinde barigie Nyasae, nonya nase ogotaba‐taba bamonyore. Nonya nigo tari are korwa ase kera oyomo oito,

english: For in him we live , and move , and have our being ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .
ekegusii: ekiagera: Ime asare nigo tore moyo, na togotaara, naende nigo tore nobogima bwaito; koreng’ana buna abarenti chingero bande baino bakwanete: Naki intwe twensi nigo tore ababiare baye.

english: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God , we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold , or silver , or stone , graven by art and man’s device .
ekegusii: Gaki, onye tore ababiare ba Nyasae, tetogwenereti gokaga ng’a obonyasae nigo bonga buna omogwekano bw’etaabu, gose efeta, gose rigena, buna ebinto bibaachire ase chisemi na obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto.

english: Opening and alleging , that Christ must needs have suffered , and risen again from the dead ; and that this Jesus , whom I preach unto you , is Christ .
ekegusii: akaborokereria na kobateebereria ng’a Kristo nagwenerete gochandwa na koboka korwa ase abakuure, agateeba: “Yeso, oyo nkobaraareria inwe amang’ana igoro yaye, nere Kristo.”

english: And the times of this ignorance God winked at ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
ekegusii: Ebiro biria bi’ogotamanya Nyasae nigo aombetie buna tarochi, korende bono nkoranderia are abanto bonsi ba kera aase baonchoke,

english: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
ekegusii: ekiagera obekire rituko eri agocha konachera abanto b’ense ekiina ase oboronge ase omonto oria aragete. Ase ayio oeire abanto bonsi ogosemeria ase okomobokia korwa ase abakuure.

english: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead , some mocked : and others said , We will hear thee again of this matter .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ’okobokigwa kw’abakuure abande bagasekereria, na abande bagateeba: “Inatogotegerere naende ase amang’ana ayio.”

english: So Paul departed from among them .
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaimoka akabatiga.

english: Howbeit certain men clave unto him , and believed : among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .
ekegusii: Abasacha bande bakabwatana nere, bakeegena, na ase abwo narengeo Dionuso, oyomo bw’ekegambero ki’Areopago, naende omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Damari, na abande amo nabarabwo.

english: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .
ekegusii: Abande bakang’useka, bakabwatana na Paulo na Sila, naboigo Abagiriki abange abasigete Nyasae amo nabakungu abasike batari bake.

english: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi bakaba ne ribero, bakaira abanto ababe korwa ase abaomboganu, bagasangereria omoganda, na bagakora eburu‐buru ase omochie. Bagachiera abanto b’enyomba ya Yasoni, bakarigia koira Paulo na Sila isiko ase abanto.

english: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also ;
ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b’omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,

english: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .
ekegusii: na Yasoni akabaroisia. Barabwo bonsi nigo bagokora chingencho chire mamincha ya Kaisari, bagoteeba ng’a omorwoti onde nareo, okorokwa Yeso.”

english: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city , when they heard these things .
ekegusii: Omoganda oria na abanene b’omochie bagaichana ekero baigwete aya.

english: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
ekegusii: Na barabwo kobanyorire eira y’okobatenenera korwa ase Yasoni na abamwabo, bakabatiga bagende. Ase Beroya

english: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth ;
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Paulo akarua Atene, akagenda Korinto.

english: For I am with thee , and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee : for I have much people in this city .
ekegusii: ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, nonya monto onde tari oragoochere, erinde agokore bobe. Naki inche nigo inde n’abanto abange ase omochie oyo.”

english: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .
ekegusii: Akamenya agwo omwaka oyomo na emetienyi etano nomo, akoborokereria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase egati yabo. Galio na Paulo

english: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia , the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul , and brought him to the judgment seat ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero Galio arenge gabana bw’Akaya, Abayahudi bakarindokera Paulo ase obomo, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero,

english: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .
ekegusii: bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo akoebereria abanto ng’a basasiime Nyasae mamincha y’amachiiko.”

english: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :
ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agateebia Abayahudi: “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring’ana ri’okorega gose okong’ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,

english: But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it ; for I will be no judge of such matters .
ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”

english: And he drave them from the judgment seat .
ekegusii: Akabaseria korwa ase ekegambero.

english: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes , the chief ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . And Gallio cared for none of those things .
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakabwata Sostene, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, bakamoaka ase obosio bw’ekegambero. Korende Galio tarora ng’a amang’ana ayio gose ngento. Paulo okoirana Siiria

english: And he came to Ephesus , and left them there : but he himself entered into the synagogue , and reasoned with the Jews .
ekegusii: Bagaika Efeso, akabatiga agwo; ere omonyene agasoa esinagogi, agakwana n’Abayahudi.

english: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla ; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome :) and came unto them .
ekegusii: Akanyora Omoyahudi oyomo, erieta riaye Akwila, omobiare o Ponto. Ere nigo achete korwa ase ense ya Italia ase amatuko a bwango amo na Priskila mokaye, ekiagera Klaudio konya ochiikire Abayahudi bonsi barue Rumi. Paulo agaika ase bare,

english: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them , he consented not ;
ekegusii: Ekero bamoboretie amente amatuko ande komenya amo nabarabwo, akaanga.

english: But bade them farewell , saying , I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem : but I will return again unto you , if God will . And he sailed from Ephesus .
ekegusii: Korende ekero agotigana nabarabwo agateeba: “Ning’irane ase more naende, Nyasae karanche.” Akamanora korwa Efeso, akagenda n’emeeri.

english: And when he had landed at Cæsarea , and gone up , and saluted the church , he went down to Antioch .
ekegusii: Gaikire Kaisaria, agatiira gochia gokwania abanto b’ekanisa. Erio agatirimboka gochia Antiokia.

english: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .
ekegusii: Magega kamenyire amatuko atai make akaimoka, agaeta egati y’ense ya Galatia na Furugia, agasoa omochie ase omochie, na gokong’ia aborokigwa bonsi. Apolo ase Efeso

english: And a certain Jew named Apollos , born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , and mighty in the scriptures , came to Ephesus .
ekegusii: Nabo Omoyahudi oyomo, ore korokwa Apolo, omobiare bw’Aleksanderia, agaika Efeso. Ere nigo arenge omonto omanyete gokwana buya, naende nigo arenge omonto omanyete amariiko buya kegima.

english: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
ekegusii: Omonto oyo konya bworokererigwe enchera y’Omonene. Ase ayio omoika oye nigo orenge gwoka, agakwana na kworokereria boronge amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, korende ere nigo amanyete ebatiso ya Yohana yoka.

english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .
ekegusii: Agachaaka gokwana noboremu ase esinagogi. Korende ekero Priskila na Akwila bachia komoigwa bakamoira mwabo, bakamworokia enchera ya Nyasae boronge kegima.

english: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :
ekegusii: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakariikera aborokigwa b’aroro riruube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,

english: For he mightily convinced the Jews , and that publickly , shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ .
ekegusii: ekiagera abuete Abayahudi kegima maiso marore, okoborokia korwa ase amariiko ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

english: And because he was of the same craft , he abode with them , and wrought : for by their occupation they were tentmakers .
ekegusii: na ekiagera emeremo yaye na emeremo yabo neyemo, akamenya nabarabwo, bagakora emeremo eye y’okoroisia chiema.

english: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .
ekegusii: Akaborokereria ase chisinagogi kera Esabato, agateema koebereria Abayahudi na Abagiriki.

english: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia , Paul was pressed in the spirit , and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Sila na Timotheo bachia gotirimboka korwa Makedonia, Paulo agasukigwa mono ase okorandia ring’ana na koorokia ase Abayahudi nomokia ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

english: And when they opposed themselves , and blasphemed , he shook his raiment , and said unto them , Your blood be upon your own heads ; I am clean : from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamusa chianga chiaye, akabateebia: “Amanyinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”

english: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man’s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agasoa enyomba y’omonto ore korokwa Tito Yusto, omosasiimi Nyasae. Mwaye nigo yasinyaine nesinagogi.

english: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
ekegusii: Krispo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamwege n’Omonene amo nab’enyomba yaye bonsi; na Abakorinto abange kobachia koigwa Paulo, bakeegena, bakabatiswa.

english: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision , Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Paulo botuko ase okorora: “Toiroka, korende kwana, tokira,

english: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Apolo arenge Korinto, Paulo agaeta egati y’ense ya rogoro, agaika Efeso. Aroro akanyorana naborokigwa batari bake.

english: And this continued by the space of two years ; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus , both Jews and Greeks .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.

english: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul :
ekegusii: Nyasae agakora ebikone ebinene mono ase amaboko a Paulo,

english: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .
ekegusii: goika chianga na ebitambaa ebiakunete omobere oye bikairwa ase abarwaire, na igo bakagwenigwa amarwaire abo, na emeika emebe ekarua ase bare.

english: Then certain of the vagabond Jews , exorcists , took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus , saying , We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth .
ekegusii: Abande b’Abayahudi, abaseria b’emeika emebe, abarenge abaetanani, bagateema gwatora erieta ri’Omonene Yeso igoro y’ababwatire nebirecha ebibe, bagoteeba: “Twabitianirie ase Yeso oria okorandigwa na Paulo.”

english: And there were seven sons of one Sceva , a Jew , and chief of the priests , which did so .
ekegusii: Abakorete ayio nabamura batano na babere ba Sikewa, Omoyahudi orenge Omokuani omonene.

english: And the evil spirit answered and said , Jesus I know , and Paul I know ; but who are ye ?
ekegusii: Omoika oria omobe okabairaneria: “Yeso nimomanyete, na Paulo namomanyire, korende inwe mbarabi?”

english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .
ekegusii: Na omonto oria obwatire n’Omoika omobe akabarindokera, akabanyara, akababua, goika bagatama korwa ase enyomba eria getirianda, bare ne chingoma baakirwe.

english: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akamanyekana ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi abamenyete Efeso; obwoba bokabasoa bonsi, na erieta ri’Omonene Yeso rikabakwa.

english: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .
ekegusii: Abange babo, abachaagete kwegena, bagaacha, bakaorokia chingencho chiabo chimbe baare gokora.

english: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .
ekegusii: Abange ase baria abaare gokora chingencho chi’oboragori, bagasangereria ebitabu biabo, bakabisamba ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi. Kobakorire omobaro bw’erigori ri’ebitabu ebio, bakanyora ng’a mbiisanete chiropia chi’echifeta chilifu emerongo etano.

english: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mwanyorete Omoika Omochenu ekero mwegenete?” Bakamoiraneria: “Yaya, titwana koigwa nonya ng’ake ng’a Omoika Omochenu noreo.”

english: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .
ekegusii: Nabo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda, rikabua. Emeroberio ya Paulo

english: After these things were ended , Paul purposed in the spirit , when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia , to go to Jerusalem , saying , After I have been there , I must also see Rome .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya achia koera, Paulo akarengereria ase omoika oye ime goeta egati ya Makedonia na Akaya gochia Yerusalemu, ogoteeba: “Magega konabeire agwo ningwenerete korora omochie o Rumi noro.”

english: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him , Timotheus and Erastus ; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season .
ekegusii: Agatoma abanto babere korwa ase baria baare komokoonya bagende Makedonia, nabwo Timotheo na Erasto. Ere omonyene agatigara Asia ase engaki enke. Eburu‐buru ase Efeso

english: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio eburu‐buru etari nke ekaimoka ase amang’ana ’enchera y’Omonene.

english: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera omonto oyomo ore korokwa Demeturio, omoturi bw’echifeta, oyorenge gokora ebie Hekalu bie chifeta bi’Aritemi + 19:24 Aritemi: erieta ri’Ekegiriki ri’enyasae yarenge gosasimwa agwo Asia Enke , nigo arenge konyorera abaroisia eniibo enyinge.

english: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation , and said , Sirs , ye know that by this craft we have our wealth .
ekegusii: Akabasangereria abwo amo nabande ab’emeremo eria, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, mwamanyire ng’a obotenenku bwaito nigo bokorwa ase emeremo eye.

english: Moreover ye see and hear , that not alone at Ephesus , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people , saying that they be no gods , which are made with hands :
ekegusii: Naende mwarorire na koigwa ng’a Paulo, oyio oebereirie abanto na kobaonchora, tari ase Efeso oka, korende nonya nase Asia yonsi pi, okobateebia ng’a chinyasae chigokorwa namaboko tari chirochio chinyasae.

english: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
ekegusii: Nabo ere aakong’u ase tore, tari ng’a nemeremo yaito yoka erachaywe, korende nonya ne Hekalu y’Aritemi, enyasae enkuungu ere enene, nigo erabarwe ng’a teri gento. Naende enyasae eria, egosasimwa n’abanto b’Asia yonsi na ab’ense yonsi nigo eraurwe obonene bwaye.”

english: And when they heard these sayings , they were full of wrath , and cried out , saying , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya bagaichorwa nendamwamu, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”

english: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul’s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .
ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogaichorwa neburu‐buru, bakabwata Gayo na Aristariko, abanto ba Makedonia, baare gotaara amo na Paulo, bakabakurura na bakaminyoka amo gochia aase chigosori chigokorerwa.

english: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John’s baptism .
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mbatiiso ki mwabatisetwe?” Bakamoiraneria: “Ase ebatiiso ya Yohana.”

english: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people , the disciples suffered him not .
ekegusii: Na Paulo akarigia gosoa ase egati y’abanto, korende aborokigwa tibamwanchera.

english: And certain of the chief of Asia , which were his friends , sent unto him , desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre .
ekegusii: Abande b’abanene b’Asia, abarenge abasani baye, bagatoma abanto asare, bakamosorora tabaisa kweorokia omonyene aase chigosori chigokorerwa.

english: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .
ekegusii: Bono abande nigo barenge korera iga, na abande iga, ekiagera omosangererekano oria konya obeire neburu‐buru. Abange ase bare tibamanyete nase ki basangererekanete amo.

english: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . And Alexander beckoned with the hand , and would have made his defence unto the people .
ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Alekisanda, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso ’abaanto. Alekisanda akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.

english: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
ekegusii: Korende ekero bamomanya ng’a ere n’Omoyahudi, bagakuura bonsi amo ase egeka ki’ang’e chinsa ibere chingima, bakorera: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”

english: And when the townclerk had appeased the people , he said , Ye men of Ephesus , what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana , and of the image which fell down from Jupiter ?
ekegusii: Omoriki bw’omochie agakiria abanto agateeba: “Inwe abasacha b’Efeso, monto ki ore aa otamanyeti ng’a omochie bw’Abaefeso noro omorendi bwe Hekalu y’Aritemi eria enene, na obw’omogwekano oria ogwete korwa igoro?

english: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against , ye ought to be quiet , and to do nothing rashly .
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera amang’ana aya takonyara gokanwa, mogwenerete gokira, timokora ring’ana ria bwango.

english: For ye have brought hither these men , which are neither robbers of churches , nor yet blasphemers of your goddess .
ekegusii: Naki iga mwarenta abanto aba bataibeti ebinto bie Hekalu gose korama enyasae yaito enkuungu.

english: Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .
ekegusii: Ase igo, onye Demeturio na ababaachi abare amo nere bare ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto, amatuko ’yokogambigwa nare, na abagaambi mbareo, tiga basoerane.

english: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters , it shall be determined in a lawful assembly .
ekegusii: Korende onye more namang’ana ande, nigo araroisigwe nabagaambi ba botambe.

english: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day’s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .
ekegusii: Ekeene obokong’u mbore ase tore, aande mbarigetie gotosoera ase engencho y’eburu‐buru eye ya reero. Karabe igo, rirorio titokonyaara gwekengera ase engencho y’omosangererekano oyo.”

english: And when he had thus spoken , he dismissed the assembly .
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya, akaa omosangererekano ribaga ogende.

english: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bakabatiiswa ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.

english: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo abekire amaboko aye igoro ase bare, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera; bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa na kobana.

english: And all the men were about twelve .
ekegusii: Na bonsi nigo barenge abasacha koreng’ana ikomi na babere. Paulo ase Efeso

english: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Agasoa ase esinagogi ime, agakwana noboremu, akaorokereria abanto engaki y’emetienyi etato, okobaebereria ase amang’ana y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: But when divers were hardened , and believed not , but spake evil of that way before the multitude , he departed from them , and separated the disciples , disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus .
ekegusii: Korende ekero abande bakong’etie chinkoro chiabo, na tibegena, na bagakwana bobe igoro y’Enchera y’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano, akaimoka akabatiga, akarusanania aborokigwa, akaba nkoborokereria are kera rituko ase enyomba y’amorokererio ya Tiriano.

english: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up , behold , two men stood by them in white apparel ;
ekegusii: Kobarigereretie mono gochia igoro, ekero are kogenda, rora, abasacha babere, babeekeire chianga chindabu, bagatenena ang’e nabarabwo,

english: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .
ekegusii: bakaboora: “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie gochia igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa as more kogenda igoro, naboigo naende arairane koreng’ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.” Ogochoorwa kw’omotomwa o ikomi na kabere

english: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day ’ s journey .
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bakairana gochia Yerusalemu korwa ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, ekio kiarenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, oboare bw’orogendo rw’ekiromita eyemo.

english: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication , with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .
ekegusii: Aba iga bonsi nigo bagendererete n’ogosaba ase omoyo oyomo, amo nabakungu bande, na Mariamu ng’ina Yeso, na bamura bamwabo Yeso.

english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty ,)
ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko make gokaba okoumerana kw’abeegeni, abwo barenge ange (omobaro bw’abaanto ang’e rigana erimo na emerongo ebere) akabora,
