english: Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
ekegusii: Abeegeni baminto, negwenerete ririiko erio riikeranigwe, eri Omoika Omochenu okwanete kare ase omonwa o Daudi igoro ya Yudasi, oyotang’anete abanto abwo babwatete Yeso.

english: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .
ekegusii: Naki Yudasi konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y’obokoreri amo naitwe.

english: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem ; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue , Aceldama , that is to say , The field of blood .
ekegusii: Ayio akamanyekana n’abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, goika omogondo oria okarokwa ase omonwa obo Akeldama, engencho yaye: Omogondo bw’Amanyinga.)

english: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :
ekegusii: goika rituko riria abogoretigwe gochia igoro. Ritang’ani ri’ayio agachiika goetera ase Omoika Omochenu abatomwa baria achoorete.

english: Beginning from the baptism of John , unto that same day that he was taken up from us , must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection .
ekegusii: korwa ase okobatisa kwa Yohana goika rituko riria Yeso abogoretigwe korwa ase tore gochia igoro.

english: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .
ekegusii: Bagaatora babere, Yusufu ore korokwa Barsaba, naende erieta rinde Yusto, na Matia.

english: And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,
ekegusii: Bagasaba, bakaboora: “Aye omonene, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, tworokie ning’o gwachorire ase aba iga babere

english: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place .
ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y’ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudasi atigete, akagenda aase aye.”

english: And they gave forth their lots ; and the lot fell upon Matthias ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .
ekegusii: Bakabarutera obomera, na obomera bokagwera Matia; erio ere agachorwa koba amo nabatomwa ikomi nomo.

english: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs , being seen of them forty days , and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God :
ekegusii: Magega y’ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia ase bare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng’a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?
ekegusii: Erio ekero basangererekanete amo, bakamobooria: “Omonene, ekero eke nakio okoiraneria Abaisraeli oborwoti bwabo?” Okobogorigwa kwa Yeso gochia igoro|alt="Jesus is taken up to heaven" src="Gw-135.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 1:6-12" copy="Graham Wade" ref="1:5"

english: And he said unto them , It is not for you to know the times or the seasons , which the Father hath put in his own power .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria: “Tari igoro yaino komanya ebiro gose chingaki. Tata obibeekire ase okobua kwaye omonyene.

english: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .
ekegusii: Eburu‐buru eria egachia koera, Paulo akarangeria aborokigwa, akabaremia, agatigana nabarabwo, akaimoka akagenda Makedonia.

english: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves ; for his life is in him .
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”

english: When he therefore was come up again , and had broken bread , and eaten , and talked a long while , even till break of day , so he departed .
ekegusii: Paulo akariina igoro naende, agasamunyora omogati akaria, agakwana nabarabwo goika bogakia mambia. Erio akaimoka, akagenda.

english: And they brought the young man alive , and were not a little comforted .
ekegusii: Bakarenta omomura oria, ore moyo, bakaba nokoremigwa okonene. Orogendo gochia Mileto

english: And we went before to ship , and sailed unto Assos , there intending to take in Paul : for so had he appointed , minding himself to go afoot .
ekegusii: Korende intwe togatang’ana kogenda n’emeeri, tokagenda goika Asosi. Tokarengereria ng’a ntonyore Paulo aria, ekiagera ere nabo achiigete. Ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda namagoro.

english: And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .
ekegusii: Ekero achia gotoikeera aaria Asosi, tokamosoyia ase emeeri, togaika Metilene.

english: And we sailed thence , and came the next day over against Chios ; and the next day we arrived at Samos , and tarried at Trogyllium ; and the next day we came to Miletus .
ekegusii: Tokamanora korwa agwo, ne rituko ria kabere togaika kororia Kio. Rituko ria gatato togaika Samo, tokabeera Torogilo, ne rituko ria kane togaika Mileto.

english: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .
ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa goteebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane. Paulo ogoakera abagaaka ba Efeso ng’a batigare buya

english: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .
ekegusii: Korwa Mileto Paulo agatoma abanto kogenda Efeso barangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa.

english: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
ekegusii: Bagachia goika asare, akabateebia. “Inwe abanyene mwamanyire buna narenge egati yaino ekero gionsi korwa rituko rie ritang’ani nachaagete gotacha aiga Asia,

english: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind , and with many tears , and temptations , which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews :
ekegusii: buna nakorerete Omonene ase obokanyeku bwonsi, na ase amariga, na ase amateemwa nanyorete ase ogotega kw’Abayahudi.

english: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,
ekegusii: Erio gaetire chinsemo chiria na gokwana amang’ana amange ase okobaremia, agaika Bogiriki.

english: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,
ekegusii: Inche tinabisete ring’ana rinde rionsi eriranyare kobakonya, korende inaborogetie inwe maiso marore enyomba ase enyomba,

english: Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: na ngakuurera Abayahudi na Abagiriki baonchokere Nyasae, na komwegen’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

english: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
ekegusii: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n’Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie konyoora aaria,

english: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
ekegusii: otatiga ng’a Omoika Omochenu nigo okoorokia omochie ase omochie ng’a ogosibwa na emechando mbinganyete.

english: And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .
ekegusii: Bono rora, namanyire ng’a timokondora obosio bwane naende, inwe mwensi aba nabeire ngotaara ase egati yaino na kobaranderia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabaorokeirie bonsi ase rituko ria reero, ng’a inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga a monto onde bwensi,

english: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God .
ekegusii: ekiagera tinangete kobaranderia amang’ana ’okworokereria gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

english: Take heed therefore unto yourselves , and to all the flock , over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers , to feed the church of God , which he hath purchased with his own blood .
ekegusii: Mwerende inwe abanyene amo ne riicho riria Omoika Omochenu obabegete mobe abarendi korisia ekanisa ya Nyasae, eye enyorerete namanyinga aye omonyene.

english: For I know this , that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you , not sparing the flock .
ekegusii: Namanyire inche ng’a magega ase okoimoka kwane chisese chi’orosana chintindi nachiche ase more, tichirorera riicho amaabera,

english: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
ekegusii: Akamenya aroro emetienyi etato. Ekiagera Abayahudi bamoboerete, konya omanoire kogenda ase enyancha gochia Siiria, agachoora koiranera goetera Makedonia.

english: Also of your own selves shall men arise , speaking perverse things , to draw away disciples after them .
ekegusii: naende korwa ase egati yaino abanto mbaimoke bagokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, bang’use aborokigwa babatunyane.

english: Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .
ekegusii: Ase ayio renda, moinyore ng’a ase emiaka etato, obotuko na omobaso, tinatigete gokuurera kera omonto ase amariga.

english: And now , brethren , I commend you to God , and to the word of his grace , which is able to build you up , and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified .
ekegusii: Gaki bono nababekire ase amaboko a Nyasae, na ase ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye, asare ere oyoranyaare kobaagacha na kobaa omwando amo nabwo bonsi abachenirwe.

english: I have coveted no man’s silver , or gold , or apparel .
ekegusii: Tinaganetie efeta, nonya netaabu gose chianga.

english: Yea , ye yourselves know , that these hands have ministered unto my necessities , and to them that were with me .
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a amaboko aya aane ankoreire okorigia kwane, na okw’abwo barenge amo nainche.

english: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said , It is more blessed to give than to receive .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya onsi nabaorokeirie ng’a ase ogokora emeremo iga, nebagwenerete mokonye abatari ne chinguru, na koinyora amang’ana ’Omonene Yeso, buna akwanete omonyene: Nasesenirie oyokorua kobua oyokonyoora.”

english: And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya agatung’ama inse, agasaba amo nabarabwo bonsi.

english: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul’s neck , and kissed him ,
ekegusii: Na bonsi bakaiyeria amariga, bakaboania Paulo rigoti riaye, bakamonyunyunta.

english: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .
ekegusii: Bagaichana kobua ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye, ateebete ng’a: “Timokondora obosio bwane naende.” Bakamokooba goika ase emeeri.

english: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea ; and of the Thessalonians , Aristarchus and Secundus ; and Gaius of Derbe , and Timotheus ; and of Asia , Tychicus and Trophimus .
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda nere: Sopater Omoberoya, mosinto o Piro, Aristariko na Sekundo, abanto ba Tesaloniki, na Gayo, omonto o Deribe, na Timotheo, na abanto b’Asia, Tukiko na Torofimo.

english: These going before tarried for us at Troas .
ekegusii: Abanto aba bagatang’ana, bagatoganyera Teroa.

english: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days ; where we abode seven days .
ekegusii: Intwe tokarua Filipi n’emeeri magega y’amatuko y’Emegati etabekiri memera, tokagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atano, tokabaikeera Teroa. Tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere. Eutiko

english: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow ; and continued his speech until midnight .
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, ekero twasangererekanete ase ogosamunyora omogati, Paulo agakwana nabarabwo, agachiererera namang’ana aye goika botuko gati, ekiagera arengereretie komanora rituko ria kabere.

english: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.

english: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .
ekegusii: Omomura oyomo, erieta riaye Eutiko, oikaransete ase ekebao, akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito ekero Paulo agendererete gokwana; akabugwa ne chitoro chinyinge akagwa korwa rirongo ria gatato, akabogorigwa konya okuure.

english: And it came to pass , that after we were gotten from them , and had launched , we came with a straight course unto Coos , and the day following unto Rhodes , and from thence unto Patara :
ekegusii: Ekero twatananekire nabarabwo na komanora n’emeeri, tokagenda boronge goika Kosi, na ase rituko ria kabere togaika Rodo, na korwa aroro togaika Patara.

english: And when he was come unto us , he took Paul’s girdle , and bound his own hands and feet , and said , Thus saith the Holy Ghost , So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle , and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Agaacha ase tore, akabogoria orokini rwa Paulo, agesibera amagoro na amaboko, akabora: “Omoika Omochenu oteebire iga: Naboigo Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu barache gosiba omonto omonyene orokini oro, na barabwo nabamobeke ase amaboko ’abaanto b’Ebisaku.”

english: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Togachia koigwa aya, intwe na abanto baria tokamosorora tabaisa gotiira gochia Yerusalemu.

english: Then Paul answered , What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart ? for I am ready not to be bound only , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus .
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akairaneria: “Inki eke mogokora, mokorera na kong’ita omoyo? Nigo inde ang’e, tari ase ogosibwa gwoka, korende nonya nogoitwa ase Yerusalemu ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.”

english: And when he would not be persuaded , we ceased , saying , The will of the Lord be done .
ekegusii: Erio kangire amang’ana aito togakira togateeba: “Ogwancha kw’Omonene tiga gokoreke.” Goika Yerusalemu

english: And after those days we took up our carriages , and went up to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Magega ase amatuko ayio tokeebeka ang’e togatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

english: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cæsarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .
ekegusii: Abande baborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.

english: And when we were come to Jerusalem , the brethren received us gladly .
ekegusii: Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu abaminto bagatoroisia ase omogooko. Omokia o Paulo bw’okobwatana n’Abakristo b’Abayahudi

english: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James ; and all the elders were present .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Paulo agasoa mwa Yakobo amo naintwe, na abagaaka bonsi nao barenge.

english: And when he had saluted them , he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry .
ekegusii: Kabakwanirie, akaborokia amang’ana onsi erimo erimo, aya Nyasae akorire ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase obosomba bwaye.

english: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .
ekegusii: Tokanyoora emeeri eyeranyaare kwamboka goika Foiniki, tokariina emeeri eria, tokagenda.

english: And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe ; and they are all zealous of the law :
ekegusii: Barabwo, ekero bachia koigwa, bagatogia Nyasae, bakamoteebia: “Oyominto, kwarorire ng’a Abayahudi chilifu chinyinge begenire; na barabwo bonsi nigo bare nomokia ng’a amachiiko abwatwe.

english: And they are informed of thee , that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses , saying that they ought not to circumcise their children , neither to walk after the customs .
ekegusii: Na barabwo mbateebetigwe ng’a kworokereirie Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ng’a batige Musa, gokobakania tibarokia abana babo, gose tibabwatia chingencho chiaito.

english: What is it therefore ? the multitude must needs come together : for they will hear that thou art come .
ekegusii: Inki rende kegwenerete gekorwe? Ekeene, nabo baraigwe ng’a gwachire aiga.

english: Them take , and purify thyself with them , and be at charges with them , that they may shave their heads : and all may know that those things , whereof they were informed concerning thee , are nothing ; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly , and keepest the law .
ekegusii: Ira abanto aba okore buna engencho y’ogwesibia ere amo nabarabwo, obaakanere chitaabu, erinde bakigite chitukia chiabo. Igo abanto bonsi banyare komanya ng’a amang’ana aria bateebetigwe igoro yao tari ay’ekeene, korende aye omonyene nigo okogenderera buya na kobwata amachiiko.

english: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaira abasacha baria, ne rituko ria kabere agakora buna engencho yare y’ogwesibia amo nabarabwo. Erio agasoa Hekalu ime, ase okoraria amang’ana ’ogwesibia na engaki y’okorua esadaka ase engencho ya kera oyomo obo. Eburu‐buru yabeete Yerusalemu, na okobwatwa gwa Paulo

english: And when the seven days were almost ended , the Jews which were of Asia , when they saw him in the temple , stirred up all the people , and laid hands on him ,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria atano na abere achia koba ang’e goikeranigwa Abayahudi abarwete Asia bakamorora ase Hekalu ime, bagaseegeta abanto bonsi, bakamobwata,

english: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
ekegusii: bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, tokonye! Omonto oyo nere oria okworokereria abanto ase kera ensemo mamincha y’egesaku giaito, na amachiiko, na aase aiga. Kobua ase aya orentire Abagiriki ase Hekalu ime ogindirie Aase aiga Aachenu riko.”

english: Now when we had discovered Cyprus , we left it on the left hand , and sailed into Syria , and landed at Tyre : for there the ship was to unlade her burden .
ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.

english: And all the city was moved , and the people ran together : and they took Paul , and drew him out of the temple : and forthwith the doors were shut .
ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogatitira, na abanto bakaminyoka gocha amo, bakabwata Paulo, bakamokurura, bakamosokia korwa ase Hekalu. Erio ebisieri bigasiekwa.

english: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .
ekegusii: Ekero bateemire komoita, amang’ana agaikera omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu ng’a omochie omogima o Yerusalemu osarekire.

english: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions , and ran down unto them : and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers , they left beating of Paul .
ekegusii: Erio bwango akaira abarwani na abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akaminyoka gochia ase bare. Na barabwo bagachia korora omotang’ani oria omonene na abarwani, bagatiga goaka Paulo.

english: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agaika aroro, akamobwata, agachiika asibwe nebinyuri bibere. Akababoria: “Nere ng’o oyo, naende inki akora?”

english: And some cried one thing , some another , among the multitude : and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult , he commanded him to be carried into the castle .
ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagaaka eriogi bagoteeba iga, na abande iga. Ekero atanyarete komanya oboronge bw’amang’ana aria ase engencho y’egeturi keria, agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba y’abarwani.

english: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .
ekegusii: Nabo agachia goika ase ebiriinero akabogorigwa nabarwani ase engencho y’obotindi bw’omoganda,

english: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .
ekegusii: ekiagera omoganda bw’abaanto omotunyanete, ogoaka egeturi, ogateba: “Morusieo oyo!”

english: And as Paul was to be led into the castle , he said unto the chief captain , May I speak unto thee ? Who said , Canst thou speak Greek ?
ekegusii: Na Paulo, ekero aikigwe ang’e gosoigwa ime ase enyomba y’abarwani, akaboria omotang’ani oria omonene: “Ninyore ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana?” Omotang’ani oria akabora: “Inee! Nomanyete Ekegiriki?

english: Art not thou that Egyptian , which before these days madest an uproar , and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers ?
ekegusii: Aye tori Omomisiri oria, ere reero iga oseegeta abanto baria Abaiti chilifu inye, akabatang’ana gochia ase erooro?”

english: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, omonto o Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, omobiare bw’omochie otari moke; nagosabire ong’e ribaga nkwane n’abanto aba.”

english: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Gatwanyorire aborokigwa, tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere. Na barabwo bagateebia Paulo ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu tatiira gochia Yerusalemu.

english: And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio ekero amoete ribaga, Paulo agatenena ase ebiriinero igoro, akabakiria nokoboko abanto baria. Kabakiririe kegima, agakwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, agateeba.

english: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.

english: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship ; and they returned home again .
ekegusii: Gatwatebanirie ng’a motigare buya, intwe tokariina emeeri, na barabwo bakairana gochia sobo. Goika Kaisaria

english: And when we had finished our course from Tyre , we came to Ptolemais , and saluted the brethren , and abode with them one day .
ekegusii: Gotwachia gokoora orogendo rwaito korwa Turo, togaika Tolemai, togakwania abaminto, togaikaransa nabarabwo rituko erimo.

english: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .
ekegusii: Omonto oyo narenge nabaiseke bane abekungi, baare kobana.

english: Men , brethren , and fathers , hear ye my defence which I make now unto you .
ekegusii: “Inwe abaminto, na abatata, ntegerera aya ngwekengera omonyene ase more bono.”

english: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me , Arise , and go into Damascus ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .
ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo noteebigwe onsi aya gwachiikirwe oyakore.

english: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .
ekegusii: Na ekero nasinyetwe korora ase engencho y’oborabu bw’amasase aria, nkaraagwa namaboko abo abarenge amo nainche, ngaika Damesiki.

english: And one Ananias , a devout man according to the law , having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there ,
ekegusii: “Erio omonto oyomo ore korokwa Anania, omoiroki Nyasae ase ogotunyana amachiiko, ore gokwanwa buya n’Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete agwo,

english: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
ekegusii: aganchichera agatenena ang’e nainche, aganteebia: Oyominto Saulo, nyora okorora. Ase ensa eria eria nkanyora okorora, nkamorora.

english: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
ekegusii: Aganteebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito ogochorire onyare komanya ogwancha kwaye, na korora Omonyene Oboronge, na koigwa eriogi rikorwa ase omonwa oye.

english: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .
ekegusii: Naki nomobeere kirori ase abanto bonsi igoro y’amang’ana aya kwarorire na koyaigwa.

english: And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .
ekegusii: Gaki bono, inki ogotebanera? Tenena obatiswe, bwesibie ebibe biao, orangerie erieta riaye.

english: And it came to pass, that , when I was come again to Jerusalem , even while I prayed in the temple , I was in a trance ;
ekegusii: “Ekero nairanete Yerusalemu, ngosaba narenge ase Hekalu ime, nkabwatwa nobogondereria,

english: And saw him saying unto me , Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .
ekegusii: nkarora Omonene aroro, ogonteebia: Ayerera, karue Yerusalemu bwango, ekiagera tibagwancha oborori bwao igoro yane.

english: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Omonene, barabwo mbamanyete ng’a nigo narenge gosiba baria bakwegenete na kobaaka ase chisinagogi chionsi.

english: ( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith ,)
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia koigwa ng’a nigo agokwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, bakamenta gokira. Agakwana.

english: And he said unto me , Depart : for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Nere aganteebia: Genda, ekiagera inche ningotome aare ase abanto b’Ebisaku.” Paulo ogoteeba ng’a n’Omorumi are

english: And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .
ekegusii: Bagategerera Paulo goika ring’ana riria rigakwanwa. Erio bagaaka eriogi riabo, bagateeba: “Morusieo oyo ase ense, ekiagera tagwenereti abe moyo.”

english: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
ekegusii: Bagachia kona‐goaka egeturi na gotandora chianga chiabo na gosiara‐siara ebuse gochia igoro.

english: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle , and bade that he should be examined by scourging ; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba enene y’abarwani, agachiika aborigwe amang’ana aye ase okong’wanigwa emecharichi, erinde amanye engencho bakomwogerera eriogi buna eri.

english: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?
ekegusii: Korende ekero bamosibire engori, Paulo akaboria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, oyo oteneine ang’e nere: “Inee! Mboronge kong’wania omonto Omorumi emecharichi, na ere ataranacherwa ekiina?”

english: When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akoorokia omotang’ani oria omonene, akabora: “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n’Omorumi are.”

english: Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene agacha, akamoteebia: “Nteebia, n’Omorumi ore?” Agateeba: “Ee.”

english: And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria, omonene akairaneria: “Inche nigo nagorete obobiare obo ase chitaabu chinyinge.” Paulo agateeba: “Inche n’Omorumi omobiare.”

english: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him : and the chief captain also was afraid , after he knew that he was a Roman , and because he had bound him .
ekegusii: Erio baria barenge ang’e komoboria bakaimoka, bakamotiga bwango, na oria omotang’ani omonene akoboa ekero aigwa ng’a n’Omorumi are, na konya omosibire. Ogwekengera gwa Paulo bosio bw’ekegambero

english: On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akarengereria komanya boronge nase engencho ki asoeirwe n’Abayahudi, akamosibora, agachiika abakuani abanene na abanto b’ekegambero bonsi bache. Agatirimbokia Paulo, akamobeka ase amasio abo.

english: As also the high priest doth bear me witness , and all the estate of the elders : from whom also I received letters unto the brethren , and went to Damascus , to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem , for to be punished .
ekegusii: buna Omokuani omonene na abagaaka bonsi b’ekegambero bare kirori ase ’nde. Naetwe amarube nabarabwo ing’ire ase abaminto abarenge Damesiki, erio mbarente abarenge agwo, mbaire Yerusalemu basibire erinde baegwe egesusuro.

english: And it came to pass, that , as I made my journey , and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon , suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me .
ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang’e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.

english: And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me , Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
ekegusii: Nkagwa inse, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire?

english: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me , I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
ekegusii: Nkairaneria: Naye ng’Omonene? Aganteebia: Ninche Yeso o Nazareti oyogwachandire aye.

english: And they that were with me saw indeed the light , and were afraid ; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me .
ekegusii: Na baria barenge amo nainche mbaroche amasase aria, korende tibaigwete eriogi ri’oria ore gokwana nainche.

english: And Paul , earnestly beholding the council , said , Men and brethren , I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day .
ekegusii: Paulo akarigereria mono abanto b’ekegambero, akabora: “Baminto, nabeireo ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika reero iga, na enkoro yane tekongambia.”

english: And when there arose a great dissension , the chief captain , fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them , commanded the soldiers to go down , and to take him by force from among them , and to bring him into the castle .
ekegusii: Ekero eriomana rinene riachia kooroka, omotang’ani oria omonene akoboa ng’a Paulo nabaise kobutoranwa nabarabwo, agachiika abarwani baike na komotaboria korwa ase amaboko abo, na komorenta ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.

english: And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said , Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .
ekegusii: Obotuko bori’Omonene agatenena ang’e nere, akamoteebia: “Remia enkoro, ekiagera buna kwamberete kirori Yerusalemu, nekogwenerete kombera boigo Rumi.” Okobwatana kw’Abayahudi komoboera Paulo

english: And when it was day , certain of the Jews banded together , and bound themselves under a curse , saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul .
ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka, Abayahudi bakabwatana komoboera Paulo, bagatianania ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire.

english: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy .
ekegusii: Abwo batiananetie nigo barenge abanto kobua emerongo ene.

english: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka, bakaboora: “Ntwatiananetie bokong’u ng’a titoria gento goika twaitire Paulo.

english: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .
ekegusii: Gaki bono inwe amo nab’ekegambero moteebie omotang’ani oria omonene amotirimbokie gocha ase more, buna inwe morigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua; na intwe nigo tore ang’e komoita ritang’ani ataraika ase more.”

english: And when Paul’s sister’s son heard of their lying in wait , he went and entered into the castle , and told Paul .
ekegusii: Omoigwa o Paulo akaigwa amang’ana igoro y’okoboera kwabo, akagenda, agasoa ime ase enyomba enene, akamanyia Paulo amang’ana ayio.

english: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said , Bring this young man unto the chief captain : for he hath a certain thing to tell him .
ekegusii: Paulo akarangeria oyomo bw’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akamoteebia: “Ira omomura oyo ase omotang’ani omonene, ekiagera nabwate ring’ana akomoteebia.”

english: So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .
ekegusii: Erio akamoimokia, akamoira ase omotang’ani oria omonene, akamoteebia: “Paulo, oria omosibwa nandangeria, omboria nkorentere omomura oyo, ekiagera nare ne ring’ana akogoteebia.”

english: Then the chief captain took him by the hand , and went with him aside privately , and asked him , What is that thou hast to tell me ?
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene akamobwata okoboko, akagenda nere ensemo, akamobooria bobisi: “Ing’ana ki obwate origetie gonteebia?”

english: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth .
ekegusii: Anania, Omokuani omonene, agachiika baria bateneine ang’e nere bamoake omonwa oye.

english: And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .
ekegusii: Akabora: “Abayahudi babwatanire kogosaba otirimbokie Paulo gochia bosio bw’ekegambero ankio, buna igo barigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua.

english: But do not thou yield unto them : for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men , which have bound themselves with an oath , that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him : and now are they ready , looking for a promise from thee .
ekegusii: Gaki aye tibwancha, ekiagera abanto kobua emerongo ene bamoboeire, batiananirie ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire; na barabwo nigo bare ang’e baganyete eira korwa ase ore.”

english: So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agatiga omomura oria agende, akamoteebia: “Toteebia monto onde ng’a kwamanyirie aya.” Paulo okoirwa goika Kaisaria

english: And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cæsarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night ;
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akarangeria babere b’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akabateebia: “Beka ang’e abarwani amagana abere, na abarwani abariini chibarasi emerongo etano na ebere, na abare namatimo amagana abere ase okogenda Kaisaria chinsa isato chia botuko.

english: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
ekegusii: Naende beka ang’e chibarasi bariinie Paulo, momoire buya ase Feliki, gabana.”

english: And he wrote a letter after this manner :
ekegusii: Akarika riruube iga:

english: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting .
ekegusii: “Ase omosike gabana Feliki. Inche Klaudio Lisia, nagokwanirie.

english: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .
ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo abwatwa n’Abayahudi, na barabwo bakaba ang’e komoita. Erio ngacha nomoganda bw’abarwani, nkamotooria, konya nanyorire amang’ana ng’a n’Omorumi are.

english: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :
ekegusii: Naende nkarigia komanya engencho yaye bakomosoera, nkamotirimbokia na komobeka bosio bw’ekegambero kiabo.

english: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .
ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a nigo asoeirwe ase engencho y’amaborio ’amachiiko abo, korende tasoeiri ase ring’ana rigwenerete agoitwa nonya ngosibwa.

english: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
ekegusii: Ekero nanyora amang’ana ng’a Abayahudi bamoboereire omonto oyo, ngachora komotoma ase ore erio kegima, ngachiika abamosoeri bache bakwane amang’ana igoro yaye ase obosio bwao.”

english: Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .
ekegusii: Erio abarwani baria bakaimokia Paulo buna bachiigetwe, bakamoira gochia Antipatiri ase obotuko boria.

english: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him , and returned to the castle :
ekegusii: Ekero bwakia mambia bagatiga abarwani be chibarasi bagenderere norogendo na Paulo, na barabwo abanyene bakairana ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.

english: Who , when they came to Cæsarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .
ekegusii: Abarwani baria be chibarasi bagachia goika Kaisaria, bakaa gabana riruube riria, bakabeeka na Paulo ase obosio bwaye.

english: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia ;
ekegusii: Ekero arisomire, akaboria: “Omonto oyo noyo bw’ense ki?” Ekero aigwete ng’a nomonto o Kilikia, agateeba,

english: I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod’s judgment hall .
ekegusii: “Ninche nyigwe amang’ana ao ekero abagosoeri bao barache.” Agachiika arendwe ase enyomba y’ekegambero kia Herode.

english: And they that stood by said , Revilest thou God’s high priest ?
ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang’e nere bakaboora: “Inee! Naye okorama Omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”

english: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .
ekegusii: Erio gakwanire aya, ogwatananekana gokaba egati y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai, na omosangererekano ogaatananekana.

english: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees’ part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
ekegusii: Bikaba ebituri ebinge; aborokia b’amariiko b’ensemo y’Abafarisai bagatenena, bakamobuna, bagoteeba: “Titorochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo. Aande onye n’Omoika gose omomalaika okwanire nere?”

english: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano, Anania, Omokuani omonene, agatirimboka amo nabande b’abagaaka na Omokuani oyomo, Teritulo; barabwo bagateebereria gabana amang’ana igoro ya Paulo.

english: Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
ekegusii: Erio gabana akarutera Paulo okoboko erinde akwane. Paulo akairaneria, “Amaene namanyire ng’a aye kwabeire omogambi ase egesaku eke ase ekero ki’emiaka emenge, igo ninyare gwekengera ase omoyo bw’omosasoko.

english: Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .
ekegusii: Naki buna oranyare komanya, amatuko taraeta kobua ikomi na abere korwa ekero natiirete kogenda Yerusalemu gosasiima.

english: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man , neither raising up the people , neither in the synagogues , nor in the city :
ekegusii: Abanto aba tibanyoreti nkoamererania na monto, gose koburukania omosangererekano ase Hekalu ime, nonya nase chisinagogi gose ase omochie ime.

english: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me .
ekegusii: Gose tibakonyara koorokia amang’ana aya bansoera bono ng’a namaene are.

english: But this I confess unto thee , that after the way which they call heresy , so worship I the God of my fathers , believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets :
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri ndaorokie ase ore, ng’a ase enchera eyio bakoroka ensemo y’ogweatanana, inche nigo nkomosaisima Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, na kwegena ayariikire ase amachiiko na ase chibuku chi’ababani.

english: And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .
ekegusii: Ninde nogosemeria ase Nyasae buna barabwo bare nakorokwo, ng’a okobokigwa kw’abakuure nakobe ase abanyene oboronge, na ase abatari abanyene oboronge boigo.

english: And herein do I exercise myself , to have always a conscience void of offence toward God , and toward men .
ekegusii: Inche boigo nateemire koba nenkoro etari kongambia ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase obosio bw’abaanto.

english: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .
ekegusii: Ekero narenge gokora aya, bakaanyora ime ase Hekalu nesibirie, timbeti nomoganda gose rirorooche. Korende Abayahudi bande, abarwete Asia mbarengeo.

english: Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .
ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete koba aiga ase obosio bwao na gonsoera, onye bare ne ring’ana igoro ase ’nde.

english: And when he was called forth , Tertullus began to accuse him , saying , Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness , and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence ,
ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaaka komosoera, agateeba: “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,

english: Or else let these same here say , if they have found any evil doing in me , while I stood before the council ,
ekegusii: Gose abanto aba bare aa abanyene bateebe nkomocha ki banyorete ase ’nde ekero natenena ase ekegambero,

english: And when Felix heard these things , having more perfect knowledge of that way , he deferred them , and said , When Lysias the chief captain shall come down , I will know the uttermost of your matter .
ekegusii: Korende Feliki, ekiagera amanyete boronge amang’ana ’Enchera eria, agatiga ekiina keraare, akabora: “Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani karatirimboke, rirorio ninyigwe amang’ana aino.”

english: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul , and to let him have liberty , and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him .
ekegusii: Agachiika omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana arende Paulo, korende amoe ribaga rike, gose tamokania nonya noyomo bw’abasani baye komokorera, gose gocha komorora.

english: And after certain days , when Felix came with his wife Drusilla , which was a Jewess , he sent for Paul , and heard him concerning the faith in Christ .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atari make, Feliki agaika na Durusila mokaye, oyorenge Omoyahudi. Akarangeria Paulo, akamoigwa ogokwana amang’ana igoro y’okomwegena Kristo Yeso.

english: And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo are gokwana amang’ana igoro y’oboronge, na okweriita, na ekiina kegochi‐gocha, Feliki akaba nobwoba, akamoteebia: “Ase ekero eke bono, karagenda; ekero ndanyore ribaga, ninkorangerie naende.”

english: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul , that he might loose him : wherefore he sent for him the oftener , and communed with him .
ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo asemeretie ng’a naegwe chifeta na Paulo. Nabo akana‐komorangeria ekero ase ekero gokwana nere.

english: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix’ room : and Felix , willing to shew the Jews a pleasure , left Paul bound .
ekegusii: Korende emiaka ebere koyaerire, Porikio Festo agasoa obogambi ribaga ria Feliki; na Feliki akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, agatiga Paulo osibire.

english: We accept it always , and in all places , most noble Felix , with all thankfulness .
ekegusii: gaki iga tokobinyora kera ekero na kera aase, na gokoakera ng’a mbuya mono.

english: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .
ekegusii: Korende tinkogochanda kobua, nagosoroire ototegerere ase amang’ana amake ase ogwancha kwao.

english: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :
ekegusii: Naki twanyorire omonto oyo ng’a nomochege are, na omochaaki bw’eriomana ase Abayahudi abare ase ense yonsi, naende nomotang’ani bw’ekeombe ki’Abanazareti.

english: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple : whom we took , and would have judged according to our law .
ekegusii: Naende nigo ateemete kogindia Hekalu riko. Ase ayio tokamobwata, [tokarigia komogambia ase amachiiko aito.

english: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
ekegusii: Korende Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani, agaika, akamorusia ase amaboko aito ne chinguru,

english: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee : by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things , whereof we accuse him .
ekegusii: agachiika abamosoeri baria bache ase ore.] Aye omonyene nonyare komoboria, onyore engencho y’amang’ana onsi twamosoereire intwe.”

english: And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .
ekegusii: Abayahudi nabarabwo bakamosoera, bakaboora ng’a amang’ana ayio naboigo are.

english: Now when Festus was come into the province , after three days he ascended from Cæsarea to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Bono Festo gasoire ase obogambi bwaye, magega y’amatuko atato agatiira gochia Yerusalemu korwa Kaisaria.

english: Then said Paul , I stand at Cæsar’s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agateeba: “Inche nigo nteneine aiga bosio bw’ekegambero gia Kaisari, ase ngwenerete kogamberigwa; timochereti Abayahudi ring’ana buna aye omanyete buya.

english: For if I be an offender , or have committed any thing worthy of death , I refuse not to die : but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me , no man may deliver me unto them . I appeal unto Cæsar .
ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring’ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring’ana eri bansoereire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”

english: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Cæsar ? unto Cæsar shalt thou go .
ekegusii: Erio Festo agachia gokoora gokwana n’abanto b’ekegambero, akairaneria: “Norigetie ekiina kiao keirwe ase Kaisari, nabo oragende ase Kaisari.” Agripa na Bereniki

english: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cæsarea to salute Festus .
ekegusii: Amatuko atai make gaetire, Agripa omorwoti na Bereniki bagaika Kaisaria gokwania Festo.

english: And when they had been there many days , Festus declared Paul’s cause unto the king , saying , There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix :
ekegusii: Na ekero baikaransire aroro amatuko amange, Festo agateebia omorwoti amang’ana igoro ya Paulo, agateeba: “Nare aa omonto oyomo omosibwa, otigetwe na Feliki.

english: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .
ekegusii: Ekero narenge Yerusalemu, abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’Abayahudi baganteebia amang’ana igoro yaye, bakarigia agambigwe.

english: To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .
ekegusii: Nkabairaneria ng’a tari engencho y’Abarumi korua omonto onde bwensi aitwe ritang’ani omonto oria omosoerwa atararorana nabamosoeri baye obosio ase obosio, na koegwa ribaga gwekengera ase ogosoerwa kwaye.

english: Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .
ekegusii: Ase igo ekero basangererekanete aiga, tintebaaneti, korende rituko ria kabere ngaikaransa ase ekerogo kiane gi’ekegambero, ngachiika omonto oyo arentwe.

english: Against whom when the accusers stood up , they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed :
ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,

english: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .
ekegusii: korende iga barenge namaborio gete, okoamererania igoro asare ase edini yabo abanyene, na ase amang’ana igoro y’omonto oyomo, Yeso, oyoikire gokwa, korende oyo Paulo akona‐goteeba ng’a moyo are.

english: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na abanene b’Abayahudi bakamomanyia amang’ana igoro ya Paulo. Bagasorora Festo,

english: And because I doubted of such manner of questions , I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these matters .
ekegusii: Inche ngasinywa komanya buna nkorigia ekeene ki’amang’ana aya, nkamobooria gose narigetie kogenda Yerusalemu agamberigwe aroro ase amang’ana aya.

english: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus , I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Cæsar .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo arigia ng’a arendwe goika agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, ngachiika arendwe goika inyare komoira ase Kaisari.”

english: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Nainche omonyene nindigetie koigwa omonto oyio.” Akabora: “Noche omoigwe ankio.”

english: And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus’ commandment Paul was brought forth .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Agripa agaacha amo na Bereniki ase obonene obonge, bagasoa ase ekegambero amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani elifu na abanto abanene b’omochie. Festo akarua ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe ime.

english: And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .
ekegusii: Festo agateeba: “Omorwoti Agripa, na inwe mwensi abamore aa amo naintwe, mwarorire omonto oyo! Ase engencho yaye omogaanda bwonsi bw’Abayahudi aaria Yerusalemu na aiga mbamboria mbakoonye, bagaaka eriogi ng’a temogwenereti abe moyo.

english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus , I have determined to send him .
ekegusii: Korende ngachia korora ng’a takoreti gento ekebe kegwenerete aitwe; na ere omonyene karigetie agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, nkarengereria komotoma asare.

english: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord . Wherefore I have brought him forth before you , and specially before thee , O king Agrippa , that , after examination had , I might have somewhat to write .
ekegusii: Na inche tindi ne ring’ana ri’ekeene nkoriikera omonene one igoro asare. Ase ayio namorentire aiga ase obosio bwaino, kobua mono ase obosio bwao, aye omorwoti Agripa, erinde gotwakoorire komobooria, inyore ring’ana nkorika.

english: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .
ekegusii: Naki narorire ng’a nering’ana ritari boronge koira omosibwa otatiga koorokia amasoerwa aria asoereire.”

english: And desired favour against him , that he would send for him to Jerusalem , laying wait in the way to kill him .
ekegusii: na bakamosaba abanchere, arue ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe Yerusalemu, konya barobeirie komoboera na komoitera nchera.

english: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Cæsarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .
ekegusii: Festo akairaneria ng’a Paulo narendire aria Kaisaria; ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda aroro bwango.

english: Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .
ekegusii: Agakwana: “Baria bare nokobua ase egati yaino, tiga batirimboke amo nainche, onye ring’ana rire riibe ase omonto oria, bamosoere.”

english: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Cæsarea ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
ekegusii: Ekero abeire amo nabarabwo tari kobua amatuko atano na atato gose ikomi, agatirimboka gochia Kaisaria; ne rituko ria kabere agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegambero, agachiika Paulo arentwe.

english: And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng’a mboronge are.

english: While he answered for himself , Neither against the law of the Jews , neither against the temple , nor yet against Cæsar , have I offended any thing at all .
ekegusii: Paulo agekengera iga: “Inche timocheti ring’ana igoro ase amachiiko ’Abayahudi, gose ase Hekalu, nonya nase Kaisari.”

english: But Festus , willing to do the Jews a pleasure , answered Paul , and said , Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these things before me ?
ekegusii: Korende Festo akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, akaboria Paulo: “Norigetie kogenda Yerusalemu ogamberigwe aroro ase obosio bwane?”

english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Nore ne ribaga gokwana amang’ana ao.” Erio Paulo akarambora okoboko kwaye, agekengera:

english: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem : and many of the saints did I shut up in prison , having received authority from the chief priests ; and when they were put to death , I gave my voice against them .
ekegusii: Ngakora aya aria Yerusalemu: Ngasiba abachenu abange ase echela, ekero naeirwe okobua nabakuani abanene; tari ayio oka, korende kobagoitwa, nigo narenge gwancha abe bo ase bare.

english: And I punished them oft in every synagogue , and compelled them to blaspheme ; and being exceedingly mad against them , I persecuted them even unto strange cities .
ekegusii: Nkabasusura ebiro ebinge ase chisinagogi chionsi, naende mbabetereria korama, nkababwaterwa endamwamu enene mono, nkabatunya na kobachanda goika emechie y’ense engeni.

english: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
ekegusii: “Nabo ase emeremo eyio nigo narenge kogenda Damesiki, nigo naetwe okobua na amachiiko korwa ase abakuani abanene.

english: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, ekero kia mobaso gati, kande enchera kogenda, nkarora amasase akorwa igoro abuete okobara kw’erioba, akambarera chinsemo chionsi amo nabaria barenge amo nainche.

english: And when we were all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice speaking unto me , and saying in the Hebrew tongue , Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
ekegusii: Tokagwa inse twensi, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire? Naakong’u ase ore goaka ensonga y’esimisi chintacho.

english: And I said , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said , I am Jesus whom thou persecutest .
ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Naye ng’Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Ninche Yeso, oyogwachandire aye.

english: But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee ;
ekegusii: Korende imoka, otenene namagoro ao, ekiagera nakoorokeire ase engencho eye: nkobeke obe omokori na kirori bw’amang’ana aya kwarora, na amang’ana ayio ndeorokerie ase ore.

english: Delivering thee from the people , and from the Gentiles , unto whom now I send thee ,
ekegusii: Ningotoorie korwa ase abanto bao, na korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku, ase abwo ndagotome.

english: To open their eyes , and to turn them from darkness to light , and from the power of Satan unto God , that they may receive forgiveness of sins , and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me .
ekegusii: Nigo oraramokie amaiso abo baonchoke korwa ase omosunte, bache ase omobaso, batige okobua gwa Saitani na baonchokere Nyasae, banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo, na omwando ase egati yabo abachenirwe ase okonyegena.

english: Whereupon , O king Agrippa , I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision :
ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti Agripa! Ase ayio tinare kwanga koigwera okorora koria kwarwete igoro,

english: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :
ekegusii: “Omorwoti Agripa, nerorire omonyene ng’a ninde negesio, ekiagera ninyekengere ase obosio bwao reero, ase amang’ana aria onsi nasoerwa n’Abayahudi.

english: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple , and went about to kill me .
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio Abayahudi bakambwatera ime ase Hekalu, bagateema kong’ita.

english: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
ekegusii: Goika reero iga nanyorire ogokonywa korwa ase Nyasae. Ase igo ninteneine na koba kirori ase abake na abanene. Tindi gokwana amang’ana ande otatiga aria ababani na Musa bakwanete ng’a nabe,

english: And as he thus spake for himself , Festus said with a loud voice , Paul , thou art beside thyself ; much learning doth make thee mad .
ekegusii: Agachia gwekengera iga, Festo agakwana neriogi rinene: “Paulo, nebarimo ore! Ogosoma kwao okonge kwaonchoire obong’aini bwao.”

english: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agakwana: “Omosike Festo, tindi ebarimo, korende nigo ngokwana amang’ana ’ekeene na ay’obong’aini kegima.

english: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him ; for this thing was not done in a corner .
ekegusii: Naki omorwoti namanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya, naende ninyare gokwana nere ntari nokoiroka, ekiagera namanyire mono ng’a ring’ana tiriri nonya nerimo ase ayio otamanyeti, ekiagera erio tiriakoregete bobisi.

english: King Agrippa , believest thou the prophets ? I know that thou believest .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Agripa, Inee, mbwegenete ababani? Namanyire ng’a nobegenete.”

english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Ase amang’ana amake norigetie gonkora imbe Omokristo.”

english: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .
ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Nasabire Nyasae ng’a ase amang’ana amake, gose amange, tari aye bweka, korende naba bonsi abantegererete reero, babe buna inche otatiga ase ebinyuri ebi.”

english: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews : wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera aye kwamanyire mono chingencho chionsi na amaborio onsi Abayahudi bare naro, nagosabire ontegerere ase oboremereria.

english: And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti, na gabana, na Bereniki, na baria baikaransete amo nabarabwo bagatenena,

english: And when they were gone aside , they talked between themselves , saying , This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds .
ekegusii: bakagenda are ake, bagateebania, bakaboora: “Omonto oyo takoreti ring’ana rigwenerete ogokwa gose ogosibwa.”

english: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Cæsar .
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Omonto oyo nanga nasiborwa onye atarigia ekiina kiaye keirwe ase Kaisari.”

english: My manner of life from my youth , which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem , know all the Jews ;
ekegusii: “Abayahudi bonsi mbamanyete obogima bwane korwa obosae bwane buna bwarenge korwa omochakano, ase egesaku kiane na ase Yerusalemu.

english: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :
ekegusii: Na bono ninteneine aiga ngambigwe ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’eira eria chisokoro chiaito chiaetwe na Nyasae,

english: Unto which promise our twelve tribes , instantly serving God day and night , hope to come . For which hope’s sake , king Agrippa , I am accused of the Jews .
ekegusii: eira eyio eyio ebisaku biaito ikomi na bibere biasemeretie koyeikera, kobiragenderere komosasiima Nyasae obotuko na omobaso. Aye omorwoti! Ase engencho y’ogosemeria okwo nasoereirwe n’Abayahudi.

english: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you , that God should raise the dead ?
ekegusii: Nase ki motari gwancha nga Nyasae nkobabookia are abakuure?

english: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy , they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius , a centurion of Augustus’ band .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana achiikwa ng’a togende n’emeeri goika Italia, bakabeeka Paulo na abasibwa bande ase amaboko a Yulio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ase ekeombe ki’abarwani ki’omogambi Augusto.

english: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .
ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha, narorire ng’a orogendo oro narobe nemechando na ogosira okonge, tari ase chigurube na emeeri bioka, korende nonya nase obogima bwaito boigo.”

english: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship , more than those things which were spoken by Paul .
ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akaigwera omoraai na omonyene emeeri kobua aya Paulo akwanete.

english: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in , the more part advised to depart thence also , if by any means they might attain to Phenice , and there to winter ; which is an haven of Crete , and lieth toward the south west and north west .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ekiambokero eke tikiarenge ekiya ase abanto komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo, abange babo bakarigia mono korua aroro, erinde keranyarekane, baike Foiniki na kobeera aroro ekero ki’obokendu. Na kerokio nekiambokero gia Kirete, kerigereretie gati ya Irianyi ya bosongo na sugusu ya bosongo.

english: And when the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , loosing thence , they sailed close by Crete .
ekegusii: Naende embeo ya Irianyi egachia kogusa ake, bagakaga ng’a banyorire eki barigetie konyora, bakang’usa ekeroochi, bakagenda ang’e na Kirete, ang’e mono nengegu.

english: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .
ekegusii: Magega ase ekero egeke omwaga bw’echinguru okorokwa Eurakilo, ore gocha buna ekembugu‐mbugu ogaaka emeeri.

english: And when the ship was caught , and could not bear up into the wind , we let her drive .
ekegusii: Ekero emeeri yatwometwe na tiyare konyara goeta ase omwaga, tokayetiga etoire ase ekoirwa gochia.

english: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :
ekegusii: Togaeta togakengana ase egesinka egeke gekorokwa Kilaudia, tokanyara ase obokong’u kobogoria obwato oboke.

english: Which when they had taken up , they used helps , undergirding the ship ; and , fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands , strake sail , and so were driven .
ekegusii: Magega kobakoorire kobotiria bakabogoria chingori chi’ogokonya, bagachietanania emeeri. Bakairoka ng’a tibaabaisa korateera ase omokenye okorokwa Siriti, bagasibora ebitambaa, bakairwa bosa.

english: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest , the next day they lightened the ship ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera konya twatwomirwe mono nomwaga oria, rituko ria kabere bagachaaka gotuguta chigurube nyancha ime.

english: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship .
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagatuguta ebinto bi’emeeri namaboko abo abanyene.

english: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium , we launched , meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia ; one Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica , being with us .
ekegusii: Togasoa ase emeeri y’Aderamiti eyarenge ang’e kogenda goika emechie ye chingegu chi’Asia, tokaimoka. Aristariko, Omomakedonia o Tesaloniki, nigo arenge amo naintwe.

english: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .
ekegusii: Ekero erioba ne ching’enang’eni bitarorekanete ase amatuko amange, na omwaga omonene mono ogatotuba, tokerusia moyo ase ogotooreka.

english: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them , and said , Sirs , ye should have hearkened unto me , and not have loosed from Crete , and to have gained this harm and loss .
ekegusii: Bagachia koba ekero egetambe batari koria endagera, Paulo agatenena gati‐gati yabo, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, onye mwanyigwerete timorua Kirete, nanga titwanyora emechando na ogosira buna oko.

english: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer : for there shall be no loss of any man’s life among you , but of the ship .
ekegusii: Bono nabateebirie, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera monto tagosira, otatiga emeeri yoka.

english: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
ekegusii: Ekiagera obotuko obo bwa reero omomalaika o Nyasae, oria inche inde omonto oye, naende nere ngosasiima,

english: Saying , Fear not , Paul ; thou must be brought before Cæsar : and , lo , God hath given thee all them that sail with thee .
ekegusii: natenenete ang’e nainche aganteebia: Paulo toiroka, nogwenerete gotenena ase obosio bwa Kaisari. Naende rora, Nyasae okoeire abanto bonsi, abakogenda amo naye.

english: Wherefore , sirs , be of good cheer : for I believe God , that it shall be even as it was told me .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abasacha, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ninde nokwegena ase Nyasae, ng’a nabe buna natebetigwe.

english: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .
ekegusii: Korende netogwenerete goikigwa ase egesinka gete.”

english: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country ;
ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.

english: And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .
ekegusii: Bakaruta ekerengo, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko emerongo ebere. Bakagenderera ake, bakaruta ekerengo naende, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na bitano.

english: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks , they cast four anchors out of the stern , and wished for the day .
ekegusii: Bakoboa ng’a mbaabaise gotwomerigwa ase ebitare, bakaruta ebirochi bine bia magega, bagasaba ng’a bokie.

english: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia togaika Sidoni. Yulio akarenda Paulo buya, akamoa ribaga agende ase abasani baye akonywe nabarabwo.

english: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship , when they had let down the boat into the sea , under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship ,
ekegusii: Naende abagendia bagachia korigia gotama na gotiga emeeri, bagaikia obwato oboke gochia nyancha, bakang’ainereria buna mbarigetie koruta ebirochi korwa bosio bw’emeeri.

english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .
ekegusii: Paulo agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, na abarwani: “Aba bataikaranseti ase emeeri ime timokonyara gotooreka.”

english: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat , and let her fall off .
ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakanacha chingori chi’obwato, bakabotiga bogwe amaache ime.

english: And while the day was coming on , Paul besought them all to take meat , saying , This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting , having taken nothing .
ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka Paulo agasorora bonsi barie endagera, akabora: “Reero nerituko ria ikomi na kane moganyete na mogendererete motana koria gento.

english: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire morie endagera, nebe ase ogotooreka kwaino; naki tikagosira nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe bw’oyomo oino.”

english: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya, akabogoria omogati akairaneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Nyasae ase amasio abo bonsi, akayosamunyora, agachaaka koria.

english: Then were they all of good cheer , and they also took some meat .
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakagonkomoka + 27:36 bakagonkomoka: engencho yaye kobaa omoyo , na barabwo bakaria endagera.

english: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .
ekegusii: (Na ase emeeri ime nigo twarenge abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano nomo.)

english: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .
ekegusii: Kobaigotire bakagusuyia emeeri ase ogotuguta engano ase enyancha ime.

english: And when it was day , they knew not the land : but they discovered a certain creek with a shore , into the which they were minded , if it were possible , to thrust in the ship .
ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagateebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.

english: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo tokagenda ase enyancha, togakengana ase egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, ekiagera chimbeo chiarenge korua bosio.

english: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoised up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .
ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakaororobia chingori chi’ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.

english: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .
ekegusii: Bagaika aase chinsanganio chie chinyancha ibere, bakaroria emeeri aroro goika ekarateera; obosio bw’emeeri bogasensema omokenye, ekabwatwa kegima, korende korwa magega egatagorwa ne chinguru chi’emerindo.

english: And the soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners , lest any of them should swim out , and escape .
ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abarwani nigo orenge ng’a baite abasibwa, omonto tareema abaise gotama.

english: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :
ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabataanga, tibakora buna barengereretie. Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabatanga, tibakora buna barengereretie|alt="But the leader wanted to save Paulo,he ordered those who were able to swim to throw themselves into the water and get over to the dry land" src="Gw-195.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 27:33-44" copy="Graham Wade" ref="27:43" Agachiika baria baranyare komura berute nyancha ime, bagende ense enyomo.

english: And the rest , some on boards , and some on broken pieces of the ship . And so it came to pass , that they escaped all safe to land .
ekegusii: Abaratigare bagende, abande ase chibao, na abande ase ebinto binde bi’emeeri. Naboigo abanto bonsi bagaika ase ense enyomo buya.

english: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .
ekegusii: Togaeta enyancha ensemo ya Kilikia na Pamfulia, togaika Mira, omochie o Likia.

english: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy ; and he put us therein .
ekegusii: Aria omotang’ani oria akanyora emeeri y’Aleksanderia eyarenge ang’e kogenda gochia Italia, agatoriinia.

english: And when we had sailed slowly many days , and scarce were come over against Cnidus , the wind not suffering us , we sailed under Crete , over against Salmone ;
ekegusii: Tokagenda ng’ora ase ekero ki’amatuko amange, togaika Kinido ase obokong’u, na ekiagera embeo yatotangete, togaeta ang’e na Kirete maate, erinde tokengane embeo ang’e na Salimone.

english: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
ekegusii: Togaeta ase obokong’u engegu ase engegu, togaika aase akorokwa Ebiambokero Ebiya. Ang’e nagwo norengeo omochie ore korokwa Lasaya. Gochia Melita. Omwaga na ogotagorwa kw’emeeri

english: Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,
ekegusii: Naende ekero ekenge konya giaetire, na orogendo rwabeire nobokong’u, ekiagera amatuko ’okweng’ata konya aetire, Paulo akabateebia,

english: And when they were escaped , then they knew that the island was called Melita .
ekegusii: Gatwatoorekire twensi, erio tokamanya ng’a egesinka keria nigo kiare korokwa Melita.

english: Who also honoured us with many honours ; and when we departed , they laded us with such things as were necessary .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagatosika ase ogosika okonene; naende ekero twachia gosoa emeeri bagatoa ebinto biria twaremeire. Orogendo gochia Rumi rogendererete

english: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria , which had wintered in the isle , whose sign was Castor and Pollux .
ekegusii: Magega y’emetienyi etato tokagenda n’emeeri y’Aleksanderia, eyabegetwe kobeera aria ase egesinka ekero gi’etoigo, na ekemanyererio kiaye kiarenge Diosikuri (engencho yaye abamura chibarongo).

english: And landing at Syracuse , we tarried there three days .
ekegusii: Togaika Sirakusa, tokamenyao amatuko atato.

english: And from thence we fetched a compass , and came to Rhegium : and after one day the south wind blew , and we came the next day to Puteoli :
ekegusii: Korwa agwo togaetanana, togaikera Regiumu. Magega ye rituko erimo embeo ya Irianyi ekagusa; rituko ria kabere togaika Puteoli.

english: Where we found brethren , and were desired to tarry with them seven days : and so we went toward Rome .
ekegusii: Agwo tokanyora abaminto, bagatosorora tomenye amo nabarabwo amatuko atano, na abere; erio togaika Rumi.

english: And from thence , when the brethren heard of us , they came to meet us as far as Appii forum , and The three taverns : whom when Paul saw , he thanked God , and took courage .
ekegusii: Abaminto b’aroro, ekero baigwete amang’ana igoro yaito, bagacha goika Apioforo na Tiretaberne gotorototera aroro. Paulo ekero achia kobarora, akamobaka Nyasae, akaremigwa.

english: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
ekegusii: Ekero twasoa Rumi, Paulo akaegwa ribaga komenya ere bweka, amo nomorendi ore komorenda. Paulo ogokwana n’Abayahudi agwo Rumi
