english: And it came to pass , that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together : and when they were come together , he said unto them , Men and brethren , though I have committed nothing against the people , or customs of our fathers , yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato, akarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi amo. Ekero basangererekanire akabateebia: “Baminto, nonya tinkoreti ring’ana riibe ase abanto baito, gose ring’ana riatananegete korwa ase chingencho chie chisokoro chiaito, korwa Yerusalemu nkabekwa ase amaboko ’Abarumi buna omosibwa.

english: Who , when they had examined me , would have let me go , because there was no cause of death in me .
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire komboria bakarigia gonsibora, ekiagera tibanyorete engencho ende yonsi yangwenerete ng’itwe.

english: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness : for they kindled a fire , and received us every one , because of the present rain , and because of the cold .
ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria bagatokorera obuya boetete engencho, ekiagera bagatoutera omorero, bagatoroisia intwe twensi, ekiagera embura yatwete na obokendu mbwarenge.

english: For this cause therefore have I called for you , to see you , and to speak with you : because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain .
ekegusii: Nabo ase engencho eyio nero nabarangereirie, erinde mbarore, na gokwana nainwe, ekiagera nasibirwe ase ekenyuri eke ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli.”

english: And they said unto him , We neither received letters out of Judæa concerning thee , neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee .
ekegusii: Baria bakamoteebia: “Intwe titwana konyora amarube ande agokwana amang’ana igoro yao korwa Boyahudi, gose onde ominto tari nonya noyomo oikire aiga na gototeebia amang’ana, gose okwanire ring’ana riibe igoro yao.

english: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest : for as concerning this sect , we know that every where it is spoken against .
ekegusii: Korende ntorigetie koigwa korwa ase ore buna orooche aye, ekiagera ase ekeombe keria twamanyire ng’a giakwanirwe bobe kera aase.”

english: And when they had appointed him a day , there came many to him into his lodging ; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God , persuading them concerning Jesus , both out of the law of Moses , and out of the prophets , from morning till evening .
ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang’ana igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang’ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang’ana ’amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.

english: And some believed the things which were spoken , and some believed not .
ekegusii: Abande bagancha ayakwanete, abande tibayaancha.

english: And when they agreed not among themselves , they departed , after that Paul had spoken one word , Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers ,
ekegusii: Ekiagera batabwatanete barabwo ase barabwo, bakagenda ekero Paulo akwanete ring’ana eri erimo ng’a: Omoika Omochenu nokwanete buya ne chisokoro chiaito goetera ase omonwa bw’omobani Isaya, ogoteeba,

english: For the heart of this people is waxed gross , and their ears are dull of hearing , and their eyes have they closed ; lest they should see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and understand with their heart , and should be converted , and I should heal them .
ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abaanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo, gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.

english: Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .
ekegusii: Naki amanyekane ase more ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.

english: And when he had said these words , the Jews departed , and had great reasoning among themselves .
ekegusii: [Ekero akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, Abayahudi bakagenda, bakaamererania amang’ana amange barabwo ase barabwo.] Enchiri ekorandigwa ase Rumi etari gotangwa

english: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks , and laid them on the fire , there came a viper out of the heat , and fastened on his hand .
ekegusii: Paulo nigo arenge gosangereria chinko na gochibeka ase omorero, eng’iti egasoka ase engencho y’omorero oria, ekamwenarerera okoboko kwaye.

english: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house , and received all that came in unto him ,
ekegusii: Paulo akamenya engaki y’emiaka ebere ase enyomba amenyete, eye are goakanera, akaba okoroisia abanto bonsi abarenge komochiera,

english: Preaching the kingdom of God , and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ , with all confidence , no man forbidding him .
ekegusii: okorandia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na kworokereria abanto amang’ana igoro y’Omonene Yeso Kristo noboremu obonge, takanigwa na monto.

english: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand , they said among themselves , No doubt this man is a murderer , whom , though he hath escaped the sea , yet vengeance suffereth not to live .
ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria, ekero barora eng’iti eria esung’unaine ase okoboko kwaye, bagateebania: “Takomocha omonto oyo koba omoiti, nonya otooregete korwa ase enyancha, oboronge tibokomotiga abe moyo.”

english: And he shook off the beast into the fire , and felt no harm .
ekegusii: Korende akayesamunsera riko, taba na bobe bonde.

english: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen , or fallen down dead suddenly : but after they had looked a great while , and saw no harm come to him , they changed their minds , and said that he was a god .
ekegusii: Bakamorigereria mono, bagakaga ng’a nabimbe, gose nagwe inse na gokwa bwango, korende ekero baganya engaki entambe, na bobe bonde tibomonyooreti, bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora ng’a ere nenyasae.

english: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island , whose name was Publius ; who received us , and lodged us three days courteously .
ekegusii: Ang’e nase aria yarengeo emegondo y’omonene bw’egesinka keria, erieta riaye Pubilio. Omonto oyo agatoroisia ase omoyo bw’obosani, tokaba abageni baye ase ekero ki’amatuko atato.

english: And it came to pass , that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux : to whom Paul entered in , and prayed , and laid his hands on him , and healed him .
ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a ise Publio narenge omonyareku ase esosera na gosaa amanyinga. Paulo agasoa asare akamosabera, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro yaye, akamogwenia.

english: So when this was done , others also , which had diseases in the island , came , and were healed :
ekegusii: Ayio agachia gokoreka, abande ase egesinka keria, abarenge namarwaire, bagacha, bakagwenigwa.

english: Phrygia , and Pamphylia , in Egypt , and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene , and strangers of Rome , Jews and proselytes ,
ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,

english: Cretes and Arabians , we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God .
ekegusii: Abayahudi na abanto b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete, Abakirete na Abaarabu, intwe twensi twaigure aba iga bagokwana ase emenwa yaito igoro y’ogokora gwe chinguru kwa Nyasae.”

english: And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania: “Amang’ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”

english: Others mocking said , These men are full of new wine .
ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteeba: “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.” Ogokwana gwa Petero ekero gia Pentekosti

english: But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice , and said unto them , Ye men of Judæa , and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem , be this known unto you , and hearken to my words :
ekegusii: Korende Petero agatenena amo na baria ikomi nomo, agaaka eriogi riaye, akabateebia: “Inwe abasacha ba Boyahudi, na inwe mwensi abamomenyete Yerusalemu, tiga ring’ana eri rimanyekane ase more, tegerera amang’ana aane.

english: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .
ekegusii: Taibo buna mokagete; abanto aba tibatindeti, ekiagera bono nechinsa isato chioka chia mobaso,

english: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel ;
ekegusii: korende ring’ana eri ndiria riakwanetwe nomobani Yoel:

english: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit ; and they shall prophesy :
ekegusii: Naboigo, ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one, na barabwo inababane.

english: And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :
ekegusii: Ning’orokie amakumia ase igoro, na ebikone ase ense inse, amanyinga na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.

english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .
ekegusii: Mobosokano okogusa kogaacha korwa igoro, okogusa buna ogw’ekerambauti gekogusa ne chinguru, kogaichora enyomba yonsi aase baikaransete.

english: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :
ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyinga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene ritaracha, rituko erire rinene, na erire maiso marore.

english: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved .
ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe”.

english: Ye men of Israel , hear these words ; Jesus of Nazareth , a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs , which God did by him in the midst of you , as ye yourselves also know :
ekegusii: Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, igwa amang’ana aya, Yeso o Nazareti, omonto o orogetigwe ase more na Nyasae ase ogokora gwe chinguru, na amakumia, na ebikone ebi Nyasae akorete nere egati yaino, buna inwe abanyene momanyete,

english: Therefore did my heart rejoice , and my tongue was glad ; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope :
ekegusii: Ase ayio enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasooko, oromeme rwane narogooke; na kobua, omobere one noro notimoke ase ogosemeria,

english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
ekegusii: ekiagera aye togotiga omoyo one agwo aase abakuure, gose togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.

english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .
ekegusii: Kwanyorokereirie chinchera chi’obogima; nong’ichorie omogooko ase obosio bwao.

english: Men and brethren , let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David , that he is both dead and buried , and his sepulchre is with us unto this day .
ekegusii: Abaminto, ninyare gokwana nainwe maiso marore igoro y’omogaka oito o kare, Daudi, ng’a nigo akwete, naende agatindekwa, na embeera yaye nao ere aiga goika reero.

english: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .
ekegusii: Chimeme buna echi’omorero chikabaorokera, chikabaatananekera, naende chikabaikaransera kera oyomo obo. Chimeme buna echi’omorero chikabaorokera, chikabaatananekera, naende chikabaikaransera kera oyomo obo.|alt="Flames of fire came and settled on each one of them" src="Gw-139.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 2:1-13" copy="Graham Wade" ref="2:3"

english: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ , that his soul was not left in hell , neither his flesh did see corruption .
ekegusii: agatang’ana korora aya, agakwana igoro y’okoboka kwaye Kristo, ng’a tagotigwa agwo aase abakuure, nonya nomobere oye tokorora ogosareka.

english: This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
ekegusii: Oyo Yeso Nyasae akamobokia na ase aya intwe twensi nigo tore kirori.

english: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kaimokererigwe igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende kanyorire korwa ase Tata Omoika Omochenu oria arieretwe eira oiteire ayamwarorire na koyaigwa.

english: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .
ekegusii: goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”.

english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly , that God hath made that same Jesus , whom ye have crucified , both Lord and Christ .
ekegusii: Naboigo, tiga enyomba yonsi ya Israeli emanye ekeene ng’a Nyasae obekire Yeso, oyio mwabambete, obeire Omonene naende Kristo.

english: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasambwa ase chinkoro chiabo, bakabooria Petero na abatomwa bande: “Abaminto, inki torakore?”

english: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Petero akabairaneria: “Onchoka, mobatiswe kera oyomo ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaino, na inwe inamoegwe ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.

english: For the promise is unto you , and to your children , and to all that are afar off , even as many as the Lord our God shall call .
ekegusii: Naki eira eye nigo ere ase more na ase abana baino, na ase abanto bonsi abare aare, na bonsi abarangerigwe n’Omonene nyasae oito.”

english: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and began to speak with other tongues , as the Spirit gave them utterance .
ekegusii: Bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.

english: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
ekegusii: Petero akabaorokeria ase amang’ana ande amange na kobakuurera, ogoteeba: “Etoorie korwa ase ekegori eke getari ekeronge.”

english: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
ekegusii: Na barabwo abanchete ring’ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato.

english: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenderera ase okworokereria kw’abatomwa na ase obomo, ase ogosamunyora omogati na ase ogosaba. Obogima bw’ekeombe ki’Abakristo

english: And fear came upon every soul : and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles .
ekegusii: Kera omonto agasogwa nomoondoko, na amakumia amange na ebikone bigakorwa nabatomwa.

english: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .
ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.

english: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread from house to house , did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart ,
ekegusii: Kera rituko bakagenderera gosangererekana amo ase Hekalu ime, bagosamunyora emegati enyomba ase enyomba na koragerera amo ase omogooko na ase chinkoro chi’oboitongo,

english: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .
ekegusii: bakomotogia Nyasae na kogwenera abanto bonsi. Omonene akabamentera kera rituko ase okorenta baria barenge gotoorigwa.

english: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .
ekegusii: Mbamenyete Yerusalemu Abayahudi abasigete Nyasae, abanto korwa ase kera egesaku inse y’erioba.

english: Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
ekegusii: Ekero eriogi eri riaigwetwe, omoganda ogasangererekana amo, okaba nogokumia, ekiagera kera oyomo abaigwete bagokwana ase omonwa oye omonyene.

english: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilæans ?
ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi na goichana, bagateebania: “Inee! Aba bonsi bagokwana, tibari Abagalili?

english: And how hear we every man in our own tongue , wherein we were born ?
ekegusii: Naki yaba iga, intwe toigwete kera egento bagokwana kera oyomo ase omonwa oye aiboretwe noro?

english: Parthians , and Medes , and Elamites , and the dwellers in Mesopotamia , and in Judæa , and Cappadocia , in Pontus , and Asia ,
ekegusii: Abapariti, Abamedi na Abaelamiti, na abwo bamenyete Mesopotamia, Boyahudi na Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,

english: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer , being the ninth hour .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Petero na Yohana nigo barenge gotiira gochia ase Hekalu chinsa chi’ogosaba, chinsa kianda.

english: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .
ekegusii: Bakamomanya ng’a nere oria orenge goikaransa na gosaba ebiegwa aria ase Egesieri Ekiya gie Hekalu. Erio bagaichorwa nogokumia na ogoichana ase amang’ana aria akoregete asare.

english: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John , all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s , greatly wondering .
ekegusii: Ekero are kobwata‐bwata Petero na Yohana, abanto bonsi ase ogokumia bakaminyoka na gosangererekana amo ase bare ase egesona kiare korokwa Egesona gia Sulemani. Ogokwana gwa Petero ase Hekalu ime

english: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki inwe mogotobeta amaiso, ng’a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?

english: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead ; whereof we are witnesses .
ekegusii: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

english: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong , whom ye see and know : yea , the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .
ekegusii: Na ase okwegena kw’erieta riaye, erieta riaye riamobekire chinguru omonto oyo mwarorire aiga na komomanya; na okwegena koria kore ase enchera ya Yeso kwamonyoreire obogima oboikeranu, buna mwarorire mwensi.

english: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .
ekegusii: “Na bono baminto, namanyire ng’a nigo mwakorete aya ase ogotamanya kwaino, buna abanene baino bakorete.

english: But those things , which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he hath so fulfilled .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaikereania amang’ana aya akwanete ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi, ng’a Kristo Omwana oye nachandwe, oyio oyaikeranirie ase enchera eye.

english: Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka, moirane, erinde ebibe biaino bitinyigwe, erio chingaki chi’ogotimokigwa chinyare gocha korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene,

english: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple ;
ekegusii: Na omonto oyomo, orenge rigata korwa okoiborwa kwaye, ore kobogorigwa n’abanto na kobeekwa kera rituko ase egesieri gie Hekalu kiare korokwa Egesieri Ekiya, erinde asabe ebiegwa ase abwo baare gosoa ase Hekalu.

english: And he shall send Jesus Christ , which before was preached unto you :
ekegusii: anyare gotoma Yeso, oria mwarageretwe korwa kare, nere Kristo.

english: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things , which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began .
ekegusii: Ere igoro yagwenerete komonyoora, goika chichiche chingaki chi’ebinto bionsi bigokorwa ebiyia, ebiakwanetwe na Nyasae ase emenwa y’ababani baaye abachenu korwa kare.

english: Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .
ekegusii: Na ababani bonsi abakwanete korwa Samweli, na baria bachete korwa magega yaye, bakararia igoro yaria agokoreka ase amatuko aya.

english: Unto you first God , having raised up his Son Jesus , sent him to bless you , in turning away every one of you from his iniquities .
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae abogetie Omosomba oye, + 3:26 Omosomba oye: Nere Kristo akamotoma ase more ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”

english: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio agachia korora Petero na Yohana kobagosoa Hekalu ime, agasaba bamoe ebiegwa.

english: And Peter , fastening his eyes upon him with John , said , Look on us .
ekegusii: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora: “Torigererie intwe!”

english: And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .
ekegusii: Akabarigereria, osemeretie ng’a naegwe egento korwa ase bare.

english: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Efeta timbwati, nonya netaabu, korende eki mbwate nakio ngokoa Efeta timbwati, nonya netaabu, korende eki mbwate nakio ngokoa|alt="Peter said to him, silver or gold I don’t have, but I shall give that which I have" src="Gw-142.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 3:1-10" copy="Graham Wade" ref="3:6" : Ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo o Nazareti, tenena ogende!”

english: And he took him by the right hand , and lifted him up : and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength .
ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko gw’okorio, akamoimokia igoro. Erio kegima amagoro aye ne chinengo chi’amagoro aye bikanyora chinguru.

english: And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .
ekegusii: Akaimoka bwango, agatenena, agachaaka kogenda, agasoa Hekalu ime amo nabarabwo, ogotaara na gotuma‐tuma, na komotogia Nyasae.

english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God :
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamorora ogotaara na komotogia Nyasae.

english: And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
ekegusii: Ekero barenge gokwana n’abanto, abakuani abanene, na omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu, na Abasadukai bagaacha.

english: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
ekegusii: tiga emanyekane ase more mwensi, amo nase abanto bonsi ba Israeli, buna omonto oyo nigo ateneine bosio bwaino ore omogima kegima ase chinguru chi’erieta ria Yeso Kristo omo Nazareti—oria inwe mwabambete, nere oyio Nyasae abogetie korwa ase abakuure.

english: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .
ekegusii: Ogotoreka nigo gokonyorekana ase are ere bweka; nase ase ense engima onde taiyo naende oyio Nyasae aruure oranyare gototoria.

english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .
ekegusii: Abagaaka b’ekegambero bakegosa mono korora buna Petero na Yohana batenenete ase oboremu na boigo kwemanyia buna barabwo n’abanto batachiete ande kemasomo. Erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a Petero na Yohana noo barenge amo na Yeso ase orogendo rwaye.

english: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia korora omonto oria ogwenetigwe, oteneine amo nabarabwo, tibaaba na ing’ana rinde rionsi bagokwana.

english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
ekegusii: Bakabachiika basoke korwa ase ekegambero, erio bagachaaka gokwana barabwo ase barabwo.

english: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem ; and we can not deny it .
ekegusii: Bagoteeba: “Inki torakorere abanto aba? Ekiagera egekone eke giakorirwe nabarabwo kere maiso marore ase abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, titokonyara kogekaana.

english: But that it spread no further among the people , let us straitly threaten them , that they speak henceforth to no man in this name .
ekegusii: Korende gokiria ring’ana eri tiricha gosiarerwa egati y’abanto; tiga tobagose, tibakwana na monto onde bwensi ase erieta ria Yeso.”

english: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .
ekegusii: Bakabarangeria, bakabatianera tibaabaisa gokwana gose kworokereria ase erieta ria Yeso.

english: But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .
ekegusii: Korende Petero na Yohana bakabairaneria: “nacha inwe abanyene ndiriri rironge ase obosio bwa Nyasae—-kobaigwera inwe gose komoigwera Nyasae.

english: Being grieved that they taught the people , and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead .
ekegusii: Bakabea ase engencho abatomwa abwo babere nigo bare kworokereria abanto ng’a Yeso nabogete korwa ase abakuure, eyio ekworokia ng’a abanto bakuure mbabokigwe babe moyo.

english: For we can not but speak the things which we have seen and heard .
ekegusii: Ekiagera intwe titokonyara gotiga gokwana ayatweroreire na kweigwera.”

english: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
ekegusii: Erio ekegambero gekabatianera n’echinguru erio bakabaigorera bagende. Barobwo bakanyora buna tekonyarekana babae egesusuro ekiagera abanto bonsi nigo bagendererete gotogia Nyasae ase ogokora koria kwabete.

english: For the man was above forty years old , on whom this miracle of healing was shewed .
ekegusii: Emiaka y’omonto oria egekone eke giokogwenigwa kiaberete nigo yarenge goetania emerongo ene. Abeegeni Bagasaba baegwe oboremu

english: And being let go , they went to their own company , and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them .
ekegusii: Erio kegima ekero Petero na Yohana baigoreretwe, barabwo bakairana goika ase omoganda erio bakabateebia aria abakuani abanene na abagaaka baabateebetie.

english: The kings of the earth stood up , and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord , and against his Christ .
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bakebeeka ang’e, na abagaambi nigo baumeranete amo erio barwanie Omonene amo na Kristo oye.

english: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .
ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana gokora kera ring’ana erio goetera ase chinguru amo n’ogwancha kwao kwaroberetie korwa omochakano anyare koba.

english: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
ekegusii: Ase igo bono, aye Omonene, rora ogotianerwa okwo kwabeire, erio aye otwanchere, intwe abasomba bao tokwane ring’ana riao n’oboremu bwonsi.

english: And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakababwata, bakababeeka echela ime goika rituko riare kobwatia ekiagera konya riagorobire.

english: By stretching forth thine hand to heal ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao, naende ancha buna ebikone binyare gokorekana goetera ase erieta ri’Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso.

english: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo bakorete gosaba ase agwo barabwo basangerekanete agatengechigwa. Barobwo bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu na boigo bagachaaka gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae noboremu. Abegeeni bagosanga ebire ebiabo

english: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakagenderera koba kirori igoro y’okoboka kwa Yeso Kristo na Omonene akabaitororera bonsi obotenenku bw’ogosesenigwa kwaye.

english: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
ekegusii: Na monto onde tarenge ase egati yabo oyorenge nokoremerwa, ekiagera abanto bonsi abarenge nemegondo ne chinyomba nigo babioonetie, bakarenta chitaabu chi’ebinto biria biaoonetigwe,

english: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet : and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need .
ekegusii: bagachibeeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa; na kera omonto akagaberwa koreng’ana buna aremeire.

english: And Joses , who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas , ( which is , being interpreted , The son of consolation ,) a Levite , and of the country of Cyprus ,
ekegusii: Na Yusufu ore korokwa nabatomwa Barnaba (engencho yaye: “Omwana bw’Oboremia”), Omolawi, omonto o Kuporo,

english: Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles’ feet .
ekegusii: akaonia omogondo oye, akarenta chitaabu, agachibeeka ase amagoro yabatomwa.

english: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .
ekegusii: Korende abange ase abwo abaigwete amang’ana aya bakeegena; na omobaro bw’abasaacha nigo obete koreng’ana chilifu isano.

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , that their rulers , and elders , and scribes ,
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia rituko riare kobwatia, abarai ba Abayahudi, abanene, amo n’Aborokia b’amachiiko bagasangererekana ime ya Yerusalemu.

english: And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana na Anasi Omokuani omonene, na Kayafa, na Yohana, na Alekisanda, na bonsi abarenge b’eamate y’Omokuani omonene.

english: And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?
ekegusii: Bakababeka abatomwa batenene ase obosio bwabo, erio bakababoria “’ngaki mwanyara gokora aya? Ase kobua ki gose nase erieta riango mwarangeria?”

english: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,
ekegusii: Erio Petero oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akabateebia: Abaanene b’abaanto, na abagaaka,

english: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole ;
ekegusii: onye intwe tokoborigwa reero iga ase ogokora okuya gwakorekana ase omonto oyo ekerema naende ng’aki abwenigwa,

english: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
ekegusii: Korende narenge omosacha oyomo ore korokwa Anania, oyio amo na mokaye Sabira baoonetie ensemo y’omogondo obo.

english: Then fell she down straightway at his feet , and yielded up the ghost : and the young men came in , and found her dead , and , carrying her forth , buried her by her husband .
ekegusii: Erio kegima akagwa ase amagoro aye, agakwa. Abamura baria bagasoa, bakamonyora okuure. Erio bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka ase omosacha oye ensemo.

english: And great fear came upon all the church , and upon as many as heard these things .
ekegusii: Omoondoko omonene okabwata ekanisa yonsi na abanto bonsi abaigwete aya. Ebikone na amakumia

english: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch .
ekegusii: Ebikone ebinge na amakumia bikagenderera gokoreka ase egati y’abanto amo n’abatomwa. Ebegeeni bonsi bagasangererekana amo ase Egesona gia Sulemani.

english: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .
ekegusii: Onde tarenge korwa isiko obete noboremu kobwatana nabarabwo, korende abanto bakabasika ogosika okonene.

english: And believers were the more added to the Lord , multitudes both of men and women .)
ekegusii: Korende abanto abange bakamentwa ase abegeeni omoganda omonene bw’abasacha na’abakuungu abwo begenete omonene.

english: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .
ekegusii: Goetera ase emeremo eye abatomwa bare gokora, abarwaire nigo barenge kobogorigwa isiko ase amarere n’ebisero biabo erinde ekero Petero agoeta, omorengari oye okune abande b’abwo.

english: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .
ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto korwa ase emechie eria yaetanaine Yerusalemu bagesangereria, bakarenta abarwaire amo nabwo babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na bonsi bakagwenigwa. Abatomwa bagochandwa

english: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , (which is the sect of the Sadducees ,) and were filled with indignation ,
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero rinene ase Abatomwa ase igo bakaroberia kobaimokeria egetambokero.

english: And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .
ekegusii: Bakabwata abatomwa, bakababeeka ime ase echela y’abanto bonsi ime.

english: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko boria omomalaika bw’Omonene akaigora ebisieri bi’echela, akabasokia isiko, erio akabateebia,

english: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles’ feet .
ekegusii: Korende ere ase ogwancherana na mokaye akabisa ensemo ye chitaabu echio baonetie, erio akaa abatomwa ensemo eria yatigarete.

english: Go , stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life .
ekegusii: “Genda, motenene ase Hekalu ime, moteebie abanto bonsi amang’ana onsi igoro y’Obogima obo oboyia.”

english: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning , and taught . But the high priest came , and they that were with him , and called the council together , and all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakaigwera, mambia kobogokiamoka bagasoa Hekalu ime bagachaaka kworokereria. Omokuani omonene n’ababwatani baye bakarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi goika ase omosangererekano goika ase ekegambero ki’abaanto bonsi; erio bagatoma ogochika gochia ase echela erinde barente abatomwa baria ase ekegambero.

english: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero abarendi bachia goika, tibaabanyora echela ime. Bakairana, bagateeba,

english: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .
ekegusii: “Echela nigo twayenyora esiekire buya kegima, na abarendi bateneine bisieri, korende twachia koigora ebiita titwanyora monto onde ime.”

english: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
ekegusii: Na ekero omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu na abakuani abanene bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasogwa nomoichano omonene ase engencho yabo, naki arabe amang’ana aya.

english: Then came one and told them , saying , Behold , the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple , and teaching the people .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo agaacha, akabateebia: “Rora, abanto baria mwabeegete echela ime nigo bateneine ase Hekalu ime kworokereria abanto.”

english: Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .
ekegusii: Erio omonene bw’abarendi akagenda amo n’abanto baaye, bakabarenta, korende tari ase chinguru, ekiagera barenge nobwoba ng’a mbaakwe amagena n’abanto.

english: And when they had brought them , they set them before the council : and the high priest asked them ,
ekegusii: Ekero baabarentire bakababeeka ase ekegambero. Omokuani omonene akababoria,

english: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .
ekegusii: Korende Petero na abatomwa bande bakairaneria: “Goika intwe toigwere Nyasae kobua Mwanyabaanto.

english: But Peter said , Ananias , why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost , and to keep back part of the price of the land ?
ekegusii: Erio Petero akamobooria: “Anania, nase ki ogwancha Saitani gokobogoria okong’aina Omoika Omochenu na kobisa ensemo ye chitaabu kwanyora korwa ase omogondo?

english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .
ekegusii: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito nigo abogetie Yeso korwa ase amakweri, nyuma inwe mwamoitire ase okomosunga ase omosalaba.

english: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna Omoraai na Omotooria, erinde abae abanto ba Israeli ribaga riokoonchoka erinde banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.

english: And we are his witnesses of these things ; and so is also the Holy Ghost , whom God hath given to them that obey him .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore kirori ase amang’ana aya onsi—intwe amo n’Omoika Omochenu, oyio ore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase baria bonsi bakomoigwera ere.”

english: When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria b’ekegambero bachia koigwa aya bakagechigwa, bakarigia goita abatomwa bakwe.

english: Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space ;
ekegusii: Korende Omofarisai oyomo ore korokwa Gamalieli, oyomo bw’ekegambero, omworokia bw’amachiiko, omonto osikire n’abanto bonsi, agachiika ng’a abanto aba babekwe isiko ake,

english: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .
ekegusii: erio agakwana ase ekegambero keria, “Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, erende buna morakorere abanto aba.

english: For before these days rose up Theudas , boasting himself to be somebody ; to whom a number of men , about four hundred , joined themselves : who was slain ; and all , as many as obeyed him , were scattered , and brought to nought .
ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko aetire Theuda naimoka, agetogia ng’a ere nomonto omonene; abanto koreng’ana amagana ane bakabwatana nere, korende ere agaitwa, na abatunyani baye bonsi bagaserebekana, n’ekeombe kiaye kegasira.

english: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .
ekegusii: Magega yaye, Yudasi Omogalili nere akaimoka ase amatuko aria ekero abanto baare koriikwa, akang’usa abanto abange bamotunyane. Nere boigo agasira, na bonsi abamotunyanete bagaserebekana.

english: And now I say unto you , Refrain from these men , and let them alone : for if this counsel or this work be of men , it will come to nought :
ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie, timobaisa koira getambokero kende gionsi ase abanto aba. Batige! Ekiagera onye ring’ana eri, gose emeremo eye, neya Mwanyabaanto, nesarigwe,

english: But if it be of God , ye can not overthrow it ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .
ekegusii: korende onye neya Nyasae, timokonyaara koyesaria nonya ng’ake; mobaise kororekana ng’a Nyasae mokorwania!”

english: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
ekegusii: Nyuma otaraonia omogondo oyo noyoo orenge; Na ekero oonetigwe chitaabu nechiao chiarenge. Nase ki kwarengereretie gokora ring’ana eri? Totebeti Mwanyabaanto oborimo, korende Nyasae.”

english: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .
ekegusii: Bagancha amang’ana aye, na ekero barangeretie abatomwa, bakabachwata, bakabachiika tibakwana ase erieta ria Yeso. Erio bakabatiga bagende.

english: And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakarua ase ekegambero keria, bagogete ekiagera konya baabarirwe ng’a bagweneire korenterwa obosooku ase engencho y’Erieta ria Yeso.

english: And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Na kera rituko, ase Hekalu ime na ase chinyomba chiabo tibatigete kworokereria na korandia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso, oyio ore Kristo.

english: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .
ekegusii: Ekero Anania achia koigwa amang’ana aya, agaaka inse, agakwa. Omoondoko omonene ogasoa ase abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.

english: And the young men arose , wound him up , and carried him out , and buried him .
ekegusii: Abamura bagacha bagatuba omobere oye egetambaa, bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka.

english: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .
ekegusii: Magega ye chinsa isato mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.

english: And Peter answered unto her , Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much ? And she said , Yea , for so much .
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Nteebia, eri nario rigori aye n’omosacha oo mwaonetie omogondo ase?” Akairaneria: “Ee, ase rigori oino.”

english: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Naki abeete aye n’omosacha oo mogancherana goteema Omoika bw’Omonene? Abasacha abwo batindeka omosacha oo nao bare agwo gesieri, na barabwo nabakobogorie aye gochia isiko.”

english: And in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplied , there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration .
ekegusii: Bono ase amatuko aria, ekero aborokigwa barenge komentekana omobaro obo, nkwabeete okwemurungania kw’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki igoro ase Abayahudi baria barenge gokwana Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ababoraka baabo bebetwe ase okogaberwa gwa kera rituko.

english: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake .
ekegusii: Korende tibanyara kobua obong’aini na Omoika oyo are gokwana noro.

english: Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .
ekegusii: Goika bakagenka abanto bateebe: “Ntwaigwa omonto oyo ogokwana amang’ana ’oborami igoro ya Musa na Nyasae.”

english: And they stirred up the people , and the elders , and the scribes , and came upon him , and caught him , and brought him to the council ,
ekegusii: Bagaseega abanto na abagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, bagachiera Stefano bakamobwata, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero.

english: And set up false witnesses , which said , This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place , and the law :
ekegusii: Bagatenenia kirori b’oborimo abaare goteeba: “Omonto oyo tatigeti gokwana bobe igoro y’aase Aa Aachenu na igoro y’amachiiko.

english: For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
ekegusii: Naki ntwamoigwa ogoteeba ng’a Yeso oyio o Nazareti inasarie aase aa, na koonchora chingencho echi twaetwe na Musa.”

english: And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi, abaikaransete ase ekegambero eke, bakamobeta amaiso, bakarora obosio bwaye ng’a nigo bwabeire buna obosio bw’omomalaika.

english: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateeba: “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.

english: Wherefore , brethren , look ye out among you seven men of honest report , full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom , whom we may appoint over this business .
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, chora abanto batano na babere korwa ase egati yaino, abamanyekanete ng’a nabaya, baichire n’Omoika na obong’aini, erinde tobabeeke ase emeremo eye.

english: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer , and to the ministry of the word .
ekegusii: Korende intwe inatogenderere ase ogosaba na gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae.”

english: And the saying pleased the whole multitude : and they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip , and Prochorus , and Nicanor , and Timon , and Parmenas , and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch :
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rikagwenera omosangererekano bwonsi. Bagachora Stefano, omonto oichire nokwegena na Omoika Omochenu, na Filipo, na Prokoro, na Nikanora, na Timoni, na Parmena, na Nikolao bw’Antiokia, omonto oonchogete.

english: Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
ekegusii: Bakababeeka bosio bw’abatomwa, na barabwo bakabasabera na kobabeekera amaboko.

english: And the word of God increased ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .
ekegusii: Ring’ana ria Nyasae rikaranda, na omobaro bw’aborokigwa okamentekana mono ase Yerusalemu, na abakuani abange bakaigwera okwegena. Ogosoerwa gwa Stefano

english: And Stephen , full of faith and power , did great wonders and miracles among the people .
ekegusii: Na Stefano, oichire obuya na okobua, nigo arenge gokora amakumia amanene na ebikone egati y’abanto.

english: Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .
ekegusii: Korende abanto bande b’esinagogi yare korokwa Esinagogi y’Abasibore, aba nigo barenge Abakuurene na Abaaleksanderia, na baria korwa ase Kilikia na Asia, bakaimoka bakaamererania na Stefano.

english: Then said the high priest , Are these things so ?
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaboria Stefano: “Inee! Amang’ana ayio naboigo are?”

english: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt , he sent out our fathers first .
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo gachia koigwa ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, agatoma chisokoro chiaito aroro ase orogendo rwe ritang’ani.

english: Till another king arose , which knew not Joseph .
ekegusii: goika omorwoti onde akabeekwa Misiri, oyotamomanyete Yusufu.

english: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
ekegusii: Musa akaorokererigwa chiseemi chionsi chia Misiri, akaba omokong’u ase amang’ana na ase ogokora.

english: And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :
ekegusii: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n’Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.

english: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .
ekegusii: Nigo akagete ng’a abamwabo mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nabae obosibore goetera ase okoboko kwaye, korende tibamanya.

english: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren ; why do ye wrong one to another ?
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akaorokera Abaisraeli babere ekero baare korwana, akarigia kobatorania agateeba: Abaminto, inwe nabamo, nase ki mokorwana?

english: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?
ekegusii: Korende oria orenge gokorera oyomwabo bobe, akamosukeria are, agateeba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi ase tore?

english: Wilt thou kill me , as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday ?
ekegusii: Inee! Norigetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria igoro?

english: And said unto him , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and come into the land which I shall shew thee .
ekegusii: akamoteebia: Karue ase ense yao, na ase eamate yao, ogende goika ase ense ndakworokie.

english: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,
ekegusii: Musa agakumia ase okorora koria, na ekero achia goika ang’e gokorora, eriogi ri’Omonene rikamocheera, rigateeba:

english: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .
ekegusii: Ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo. Musa akaiguswa, tarenge na boremu bw’okorigereria.

english: Then said the Lord to him , Put off thy shoes from thy feet : for the place where thou standest is holy ground .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Rusia ebikoroto biao korwa ase amagoro ao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine nase aachenu.

english: I have seen , I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt , and I have heard their groaning , and am come down to deliver them . And now come , I will send thee into Egypt .
ekegusii: Ekeene, narorire ogokorerwa bobe kw’abaanto baane abare Misiri, naigure okorera kwabo, naikire mbasibore. Inchuo bono, ngotome goika Misiri.

english: To whom our fathers would not obey , but thrust him from them , and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt ,
ekegusii: Omonto oyio chisokoro chiaito chikaanga koimoigwera, chikamosukeria are. Na ase ebirengererio biabo bakairana Misiri,

english: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .
ekegusii: Yaya, nigo mwabogoretie Moleki, enyasae yaino, na eng’enang’eni y’enyasae Refani, emegwekano eyio mwakorete, erinde moyesasime. Ase ayio nimbang’anyie goika ng’umbu ya Babiloni.

english: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands ; as saith the prophet ,
ekegusii: Korende Ere Oyore Igoro Mono tari komenya ase chinyomba chiagachire namaboko, buna omobani agoteeba:

english: Hath not my hand made all these things ?
ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?

english: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :
ekegusii: Ning’o ase ababani chisokoro chiaino chitachandete? Na barabwo mbaitete baria babanete amang’ana igoro y’ogocha kw’oria Omonyene Oboronge. Inwe bono mwabeire abamorua na abamoiti.

english: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels , and have not kept it.
ekegusii: Inwe abamwanyorete amachiiko ayarentetwe nabamalaika, korende timwayabwata.” Ogokwa gwa Stefano

english: When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bakagechigwa ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakamoromananeria amaino.

english: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,
ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.

english: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
ekegusii: Agateeba: “Rora, narorire igoro amaanokire, na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.”

english: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,
ekegusii: Korende bagaaka egeturi ase eriogi rinene, bagakuneka amato abo, bakamorindokera bonsi amo,

english: And cast him out of the city , and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet , whose name was Saul .
ekegusii: bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena. Na kirori bakabeeka chianga chiabo ase amagoro ’omomura oyomo, ore korokwa Saulo.

english: And they stoned Stephen , calling upon God , and saying , Lord Jesus , receive my spirit .
ekegusii: Bagaaka Stefano amagena ekero arenge gosaba, Bagaaka Stefano amagena ekero arenge gosaba|alt="They threw stones at Stephen as he prayed" src="Gw-153.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 7:54-61" copy="Graham Wade" ref="7:59" ogoteeba: “Omonene Yeso, ira omoika one.”

english: And he kneeled down , and cried with a loud voice , Lord , lay not this sin to their charge . And when he had said this , he fell asleep .
ekegusii: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

english: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria , except the apostles .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emechando emenene egaacha igoro ase ekanisa ya Yerusalemu; bonsi bagaserebanigwa gochia chinse chia Boyahudi na Samaria, otatiga abatomwa bataserebaanetigwe.

english: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .
ekegusii: Bonsi, abake na abanene, bakamotegerera, bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo are okobua koria kwa Nyasae gokorokwa Okobua Okonene.”

english: And to him they had regard , because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries .
ekegusii: Bakamotegerera, ekiagera ase amatuko amange nigo barenge gokumia ase oborogi bwaye.

english: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .
ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia kwegena Filipo, gakorandia amang’ana amaya igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae na erieta ria Yeso Kristo, bakabatiswa, abasacha na abakungu.

english: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .
ekegusii: Nonya n’Simioni omonyene akeegena, na magega kabatisirwe akagenderera koba amo na Filipo. Ekero aroche ebikone na ogokora okonene gwe chinguru biakoretwe, agakumia. Petero na Yohana ase Samaria

english: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
ekegusii: Na ekero abatomwa ba Yerusalemu bachia koigwa ng’a Abasamaria banchire ring’ana ria Nyasae, bakabatomera Petero na Yohana.

english: Who , when they were come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Ghost :
ekegusii: Barabwo bagatirimboka, bakabasabera, erinde banyore Omoika Omochenu,

english: ( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .)
ekegusii: ekiagera konya torabaikera nonya noyomo obo. Barabwo nigo baabatisetwe rioka ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.

english: Then laid they their hands on them , and they received the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababeekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.

english: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,
ekegusii: Ekero Simioni achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobeekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chitaabu,

english: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: agateeba: “Ing’a nainche okobua oko, ng’a kera omonto ndabeekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”

english: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .
ekegusii: Abanto abeegeni bagatindeka Stefano, bakamoreera okorera okonene.

english: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Chifeta chiao chisire amo naye, ekiagera okagete ng’a nonyore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase chitaabu!

english: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter : for thy heart is not right in the sight of God .
ekegusii: Tori negetari gose nensemo ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera enkoro yao teri boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .
ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka korwa ase obobe bwao obo, osabe Omonene, erinde, keranyarekane, bwaberwe ebirengererio bi’enkoro yao.

english: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .
ekegusii: Naki nakororire ng’a nore nobororo buna endorwe, naende nigo ore ase egesibo ki’ebibe.”

english: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .
ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria: “Insabera inwe ase Omonene, ng’a amang’ana aya mwakwanire tabaisa gocha konyora nonya nerimo riabo.”

english: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .
ekegusii: Erio kabaorokirie oborori na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakorandia amang’ana amaya ase ebichie ebinge bi’Abasamaria. Filipo na Omoetiopia omogomba

english: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Filipo: “Imoka ogende ensemo ya Irianyi goika enchera eria egotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu ekogenda Gasa.” Eye nenchera y’erooro.

english: And he arose and went : and , behold , a man of Ethiopia , an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians , who had the charge of all her treasure , and had come to Jerusalem for to worship ,
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda. Na rora, ekero are inchera, akarora omonto bw’Ethiopia, omokoreri, oyobegetwe igoro y’enibo yonsi ya Kandake, enting’ana ya Ethiopia. Ere nigo agendete Yerusalemu gosasiima.

english: Was returning , and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge koirana na oikaransete ase egari yaye, nigo arenge gosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya.

english: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogateebia Filipo: “Genda ang’e negari eyio, ogende nero.”

english: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?
ekegusii: Filipo akaminyoka gochia asare, akamoigwa ogosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya, akamobooria: “Inee! Kwamanyire buya aya ogosoma?”

english: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Naki ndanyare komanya otatiga omonto antang’ane?” Agateebia Filipo ariine, aikaranse amo nere.

english: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away : and who shall declare his generation ? for his life is taken from the earth .
ekegusii: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekiina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning’o oranyare gototeebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”

english: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?
ekegusii: Omogomba oria akaboria Filipo: “Koranche onteebie igoro ya ng’o omobani oyo agokwana, igoro yaye omonyene gose igoro y’omonto onde?”

english: Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .
ekegusii: Filipo agachaaka gokwana; agachakera korwa ase ririiko eri, akamoranderia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso.

english: And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?
ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete inchera, bagaika aase amaache arenge. Oria omogomba akabora: “Rora amaache aya! Inki kegontanga timbatiswa?” [

english: And Philip said , If thou believest with all thine heart , thou mayest . And he answered and said , I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God .
ekegusii: Filipo akamoteebia: “Koregene nenkoro yao yonsi, nenyarekane.” Akairaneria: “Negenire ng’a Yeso Kristo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”]

english: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch ; and he baptized him .
ekegusii: Agachiika egari eria etenene, na bonsi babere, Filipo na oria omogomba, bagatirimboka gochia ase amaache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa Bagatirimboka gochia ase amaache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa.|alt="The eunuch is baptized." src="Gw-158.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 8:26-40" copy="Graham Wade" ref="8:38" .

english: And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia korwa ase amaache, Omoika bw’Omonene ogataboria Filipo; omogomba oria tamorora naende, korende nigo agendete enchera yaye ore nomogooko.

english: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
ekegusii: Na baria baserebaanetigwe bakagenda chinsemo ne chinsemo, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Cæsarea .
ekegusii: Korende Filipo akarorekana ase Asoto, na ekero arenge goeta, akarandia enchiri ase emechie yonsi, goika agaika Kaisaria.

english: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria , and preached Christ unto them .
ekegusii: Filipo agatirimboka, agasoa omochie o Samaria, akabaranderia Kristo.

english: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .
ekegusii: Emeganda yonsi ase omoyo oyomo bagategerera amang’ana onsi Filipo are gokwana, ekero bamoigwete na korora ebikone ebiarenge gokora.

english: For unclean spirits , crying with loud voice , came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies , and that were lame , were healed .
ekegusii: Ekiagera abange babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na ebirecha ebi bikarwa ase bare, bikarera ase egeturi ekenene; abanto abarenge amagata, na baria barenge ebirema bakagwenigwa.

english: And there was great joy in that city .
ekegusii: Ase igo omogooko omonene okaba ase omochie oria. Simioni omoorogi

english: But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, agwo ritang’ani nigo arenge gokora oborogi ase omochie oria; abanto ba Samaria bakamokumia, ekero are goteeba ng’a ere omonyene nomonto omonene.

english: And Saul , yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord , went unto the high priest ,
ekegusii: Korende ase chingaki echio Saulo akamenta kobagosa na korengereria goita aborokigwa bw’Omonene. Akagenda ase Omokuani omonene,

english: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias ; and to him said the Lord in a vision , Ananias . And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .
ekegusii: Ase Damesiki narengeo omworokigwa ore korokwa Anania. Omonene akamoteebia ase chindoto: “Anania!” Ere akairaneria: “Omonene nao inde aiga.”

english: And the Lord said unto him , Arise , and go into the street which is called Straight , and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul , of Tarsus : for , behold , he prayeth ,
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Imoka ogende enchera eria Endonge, origie ime ase enyomba ya Yudasi omonto okorokwa Saulo o Tariso; rora, nao are agosaba.

english: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .
ekegusii: Na ere ase okorora ororire omonto okorokwa Anania ogosoa, okomobekera amaboko, anyare korora.”

english: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :
ekegusii: Korende Anania akairaneria: “Omonene, naigure korwa ase abanto abange igoro y’omonto oyo, buna akoreire abachenu bao Yerusalemu amabe amange.

english: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .
ekegusii: Aiga nigo are nokobua korwa ase abakuani abanene asibe abanto bonsi baria bakorangeria erieta riao.”

english: But the Lord said unto him , Go thy way : for he is a chosen vessel unto me , to bear my name before the Gentiles , and kings , and the children of Israel :
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Genda aye rioka, ekiagera oyio nomokoreri one omochore, aire erieta riane gochia ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na ase abarwoti, na ase Abaisraeli.

english: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake .
ekegusii: Inche nimworokie onsi ayaramogwenere gochandwa ase engencho y’erieta riane.”

english: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Anania akagenda, agasoa nyomba ime. Akamobekera amaboko aye, akabora: “Oyominto Saulo, Omonene Yeso, ere oyokoorokerete ase enchera kware gochera, ontomire, erinde onyare korora naende, na oichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu.”

english: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales : and he received sight forthwith , and arose , and was baptized .
ekegusii: Erio kegima ebinto buna amasabo bikagwa korwa ase amaiso aye, akanyora okorora, agatenena, akabatiswa,

english: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
ekegusii: akaragera, akanyora chinguru. Akaba agwo amatuko atari make amo naborokigwa abarenge Damesiki.

english: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
ekegusii: akamobooria amoe amarube ariikire ase chisinagogi chia Damesiki, erinde onye okonyora abanto b’Enchera eye, abasacha gose abakungu, abasibe na kobarenta Yerusalemu.

english: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .
ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima akamorandia Yeso ase chisinagogi, okobora: “Ere n’Omwana o Nyasae.”

english: But all that heard him were amazed , and said ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?
ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateeba: “Tari ere oyo orenge Yerusalemu goteema goita abare korangeria erieta eri? Naende aiga, erinde abasibe, abaire ase abakuani abanene?”

english: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .
ekegusii: Korende Saulo akagenderera komenteka koba ne chinguru, agatantania Abayahudi abamenyete Damesiki, ase okoorokia ekeene ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.

english: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .
ekegusii: korende okogamba kwabo gokamanyekana na Saulo. Bakamoboera ase ebiita omobaso na obotuko, erinde banyare komoita.

english: Then the disciples took him by night , and let him down by the wall in a basket .
ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa baye bakamoira botuko na komoikeria ase orwaki, ore egetonga ime. Saulo ore ase Yerusalemu na Tariso

english: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika Yerusalemu agateema kobwatana naborokigwa; na barabwo bonsi bakamoiroka, ekiagera tibanchete ng’a ere nomworokigwa arenge.

english: But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .
ekegusii: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabateebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.

english: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Saulo akaba amo nabarabwo ase Yerusalemu, agasoa na gosoka,

english: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus , and disputed against the Grecians : but they went about to slay him .
ekegusii: akarandia noboremu ase erieta ri’Omonene. Agakwana na koamererania n’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki, korende barabwo bakarigia komoita.

english: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :
ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda, gaikire ang’e na Damesiki, erio mobasokano amasase akarwa igoro, akamomesera korwa chinsemo chionsi.

english: Which when the brethren knew , they brought him down to Cæsarea , and sent him forth to Tarsus .
ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang’ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.

english: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .
ekegusii: Erio ekanisa ekanyora omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi, na Galili, na Samaria. Ekagenderera koagachwa ase okoiroka kw’Omonene, na ase okoremia kw’Omoika Omochenu ekamentekana. Okogwenia gwa Petero ase Lida

english: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .
ekegusii: Ekero Petero are goetanana ase chinsemo chionsi, agatirimboka gochia ase abachenu abamenyete Lida.

english: And there he found a certain man named Æneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .
ekegusii: Akanyora omonto oyomo aroro ore korokwa Ainea. Omonto oyio konya obeire ekeoru + 9:33 ekeoru: engencho yaye omonto omorwaire mono borere ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato, are rigata.

english: And Peter said unto him , Æneas , Jesus Christ maketh thee whole : arise , and make thy bed . And he arose immediately .
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia: “Ainea, Yeso Kristo okogwenirie; imoka bware oborere bwao!” Erio kegima akaimoka.

english: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi abamenyete Lida na Saroni bakamorora, bakaonchokera Omonene. Dorika okoiranerigwa obogima

english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .
ekegusii: Ase Yopa narengeo omworokigwa oyomo ore korokwa Tabitha, engencho yaye Dorika, gose Engabi. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge oichire nogokora okuya na ebiegwa ebi arenge korua.

english: And it came to pass in those days , that she was sick , and died : whom when they had washed , they laid her in an upper chamber .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akarwara, agakwa. Ekero bamosibirie bakamobeka akanyomba ka irongo.

english: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .
ekegusii: Ekiagera Lida nigo orenge ang’e na Yopa, na aborokigwa konya baigure ng’a Petero nao are aria, bagatoma abanto babere asare komosorora na komoteebia: “Koranche, totebana gocha ase tore.”

english: Then Peter arose and went with them . When he was come , they brought him into the upper chamber : and all the widows stood by him weeping , and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made , while she was with them .
ekegusii: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

english: And he fell to the earth , and heard a voice saying unto him , Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
ekegusii: Akagwa inse, akaigwa eriogi rikomoteebia: “Saulo, Saulo, nase ki ogonchanda iga?” Akagwa inse, akaigwa eriogi rikomoteebia: “Saulo, Saulo, nase ki ogonchanda iga?”|alt="He fell down and heard a voice asking him; “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?“" src="Gw-160.tif" size="col" loc="Acts 9:1-8" copy="Graham Wade" ref="9:4"

english: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .
ekegusii: Petero akabasokia bonsi isiko, agatung’ama, agasaba. Akeonchora gochia ase egetondo, agateeba: “Tabitha, imoka!” Na ere akaramokia amaiso aye; ekero arora Petero, akaboka, agaikaransa.

english: And he gave her his hand , and lifted her up , and when he had called the saints and widows , presented her alive .
ekegusii: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta ase bare ore moyo.

english: And it was known throughout all Joppa ; and many believed in the Lord .
ekegusii: Aya akamanyekana ase Yopa, ase omochie omogima, na abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene.

english: And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
ekegusii: Petero akamenya Yopa amatuko atai make ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao.

english: And he said , Who art thou , Lord ? And the Lord said , I am Jesus whom thou persecutest : it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
ekegusii: Akamoboria: “Naye ng’o Omonene?” Akairaneria: “Ninche Yeso, oyo gwachandire aye,

english: And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him , Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .
ekegusii: korende imoka osoe omochie, noteebigwe ayarakogwenere okore.”

english: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless , hearing a voice , but seeing no man .
ekegusii: Abanto abagendete amo nere bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri; bakaigwa eriogi, korende tibarora monto.

english: And Saul arose from the earth ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .
ekegusii: Saulo akaimoka korwa inse, korende ekero achia koramokia amaiso aye tarora gento. Bakamobwata okoboko, bakamoira Damesiki.

english: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .
ekegusii: Akaba omouko amatuko atato, atari koria, nonya nkonywa. Saulo ase omochie o Damesiki

english: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus , which shall devour the palaces thereof.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Turo; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.” Edomu.

english: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase omochie o Temani; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Bosira.” Amoni.

english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle , with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind :
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Raba; nisambe insirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro. Ase rituko erio ebikuuro bi’eseegi mbiigugwe, boigo ndibe rituko ri’omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu.

english: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Omorwoti amo nabagaambi b’oborwoti bwaye mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.

english: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase enyomba ya Hasaeli; oro nosambe osirie kegima chinyomba chinkong’u chia Beni‐Hadadi.

english: I will break also the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven , and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden : and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Nimbune emekorogoto y’ebiita bia Damesiki; ninsirie abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya y’Aveni, + 1:5 Aveni: engencho yaye: obobe na oyio obwate enyimbo y’omogaambi agwo Beti‐Edeni. Abanto ba Siiria mbairwe ase obosomba gochia ase ense ya Kiri.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Filisiti.

english: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof:
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Gasa; oro nosambe insirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.

english: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod , and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon , and I will turn mine hand against Ekron : and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish , saith the Lord GOD .
ekegusii: Ninsirie abanto bamenyete Asidodi, na oyo obwate enyimbo y’obogambi agwo Asikeloni. Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe mamincha ya Ekironi, na abatigari b’Abafilisti mbasirigwe.” Turo.
