ekegusii: Tokaira orogongo rwonsi orwo rwarenge inse y’omorwoti Ogi o Basani: emechie yonsi yarenge ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro na Gileadi yonsi, na Basani yonsi, goikera Saleka na Edirei.”

english: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants ; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron ; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man .
ekegusii: (Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, nere orenge oyobwomoerio ase Abarefai. Esanduki yaye y’ogotindekerwa eyaroiseirie ebioma, nigo yarenge chimita inye ase obotambe boigo n’echimita ibere ase obogare koreng’ana nokorenga kwa boronge. Nao ere agwo Raba, omochie bw’Abaamoni.) Ebisaku biamenyete Moocha ya Yorodani (Omob 32:1-42)

english: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .
ekegusii: “Ekero twairete ense eria ekaba eyaito, ’nkaa abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, orogongo roria rogochaakera ase omochie bw’Aroeri, rore ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni amo n’ekeng’ese gi’ense y’ebitunwa ya Gileadi, na emechie yarengeo.

english: And the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , being the kingdom of Og , gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh ; all the region of Argob , with all Bashan , which was called the land of giants .
ekegusii: Nkaa ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo yatigarete ase ense ya Gileadi, amo na Basani yonsi, eyio yarenge obogaambi bwa Ogi. Orwo narwo orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu.” (Basani yonsi nigo yarenge korokwa ense ya Refaimu.

english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi ; and called them after his own name , Bashan-havoth-jair , unto this day .
ekegusii: Yairi, omonto bw’ororeeria rwa Manase, akaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, narwo Basani, goika orogongo rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka. Akaroka emechie yarengeo ase erieta riaye, Emechie ya Yairi, nabo ekorokwa goika reero iga.)

english: And I gave Gilead unto Machir .
ekegusii: “Nkaa abanto b’eamate ya Makiri, orogongo rwa Gileadi,

english: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon ;
ekegusii: na abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi ’nkabaa orogongo gochakera Gileadi goikera orooche rw’Arinoni. Egati‐gati y’orooche orwo ekaba orobebe rwabo rw’enseemo ya Irianyi, na orooche rwa Yaboki rokaba orobebe rwabo sugusu, orwarenge orobebe rw’Abaamoni.

english: The plain also, and Jordan , and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward .
ekegusii: Bakanyora orogongo rwe rikura ria Yorodani. Orwo rokaba orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo, korwa ase enyancha ya Kinereti, + 3:17 Enyancha ya Kinereti: nero Enyancha ya Kinereti ensemo ya sugusu, goika ase orogongo rwe nyacha y’omoonyo, ensemo ya Irianyi inse y’ebitirimboko bia Pisiga, ensemo ya moocha.

english: But your wives , and your little ones , and your cattle , ( for I know that ye have much cattle ,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
ekegusii: “Korende abakungu baino n’abana, barabwo batigare amo ne’chitugo chiaino ase emechie eyio nabaeire. (Nimanyete ng’a nigo mobwate chitugo chinyinge.)

english: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people , and his land , into thy hand ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene aganteebia: Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi nababeekire ase amaboko ao, boigo nakoeire ense yaye. Nomokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogaamba agwo Hesiboni.

english: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you.
ekegusii: Mokonye Abaisraeli bamino goika banyore ense eri’Omonene, arabae ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika Omonene abae barabwo omorembe buna abaete inwe iga. Nyuma yayio ’namoirane gocha ase ense eye nabaeire inwe.

english: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria ’ngachiika Yoshua, ’nkamoteebia: ’Nkwarooche amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete abarwoti baria babere Sihoni na Ogi; Naboigo arakorere kera oyomo ase ense oraabe kogosoa.

english: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
ekegusii: Timobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nere orabarwanere esegi. Musa ogotangwa gosoa Kaanani

english: O Lord GOD , thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness , and thy mighty hand : for what God is there in heaven or in earth , that can do according to thy works , and according to thy might ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bono kwanyorokirie inche, omosomba oo, omochakano bwoka bw’obonene bwao, n’okoboko kwao gwechinguru. Enyasae ende teri, igoro gose ase ense, eranyaare gokora emeremo emenene na eyechinguru buna ey’ogokora aye.

english: I pray thee, let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .
ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche aye Omonene ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.

english: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter .
ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho yaino inwe Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ase ’nde tanchete koigwa okoboria kwane. Korende aganteebia: Ayio aisanire! Tobaisa gokwana nainche gento kende igoro ye ring’ana erio.

english: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
ekegusii: Tiira gochia igoro ase egentunwa gia Pisiga, otenene ase egechuuria kiaye, oimokie amaiso ao, origererie gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, origererie buya ense eria orarore, ekiagera tokonyaara kwamboka ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

english: But charge Joshua , and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .
ekegusii: Tebereria Yoshua, omoremie na omobeeke chinguru, ekiagera nere oraraae abanto aba, abaambokie ng’umbu, ense eyio orarore.

english: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio tokabeera ase rikura riarochie omochie o Beti‐Peori.”

english: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan , and all his people : and we smote him until none was left to him remaining .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio Omonene akabeeka omorwoti Ogi, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, ase amaboko aito, erio tokabaita bonsi pi, nonya n’oyomo tatigara ore moyo.

english: And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
ekegusii: Boigo tokaira emechie yaye yonsi ase engaki eria. Titwatigete nonya n’omochie oyomo totairete. Emechie yonsi twairete nigo yarenge emerongo etano nomo, tokaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, ase Ogi, Omorwoti o Basani, arenge kogaamba.

english: All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars ; beside unwalled towns a great many .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio yonsi nigo yagiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro, na ebiita biarenge gosiekwa n’emekorogoto; naboigo ebichie ebinge mbiarengeo bitagiteire chindwaki.

english: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon , utterly destroying the men , women , and children , of every city .
ekegusii: Togasaria emechie eyio yonsi, togaita abanto bonsi, abasacha n’abakuungu, na abana, buna twakorete ase emechie ya Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.

english: But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves.
ekegusii: Tokaira chitugo chionsi na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.

english: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan , from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon ;
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria tokaira ense y’abarwoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ense yarenge moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, gochaakera orooche rw’Arinoni goikera egetunwa kia Herimoni.

english: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion ; and the Amorites call it Shenir ;)
ekegusii: (Abanto ba Sidoni nigo bakoroka egetunwa kia Herimoni Sirioni, na Abaamori nigo bagokeroka Seniri.)

english: Now therefore hearken , O Israel , unto the statutes and unto the judgments , which I teach you, for to do them , that ye may live , and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
ekegusii: Naende Musa agakwana, “Inwe Abaisraeli, bono igwera amachiiko na emeroberio ’nkoborokereria, moyakore, erio nario moraabe moyo, erinde mogende moire ense eria, Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa.

english: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb , when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .
ekegusii: erinde bamanye ayakoregete ase rituko riria mwatenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agwo Horebu, ekero Omonene akwanete nainche, aganteebia: Sangereria abanto bonsi amo, na inche mbateebie amang’ana, erinde beorokererie konyiroka ase amatuko onsi barabe bare moyo ase ense, nabarabwo baborokererie abana babo boigo.

english: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire : ye heard the voice of the words , but saw no similitude ; only ye heard a voice .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana nainwe korwa ase omorero oria ime, mokaigwa amang’ana aye, korende timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Nigo mwaigwete eriogi rioka.

english: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves ; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire :
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene akwanete nainwe korwa ase omorero ime agwo Horebu, timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Ase ayio moigwere na kwerenda,

english: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :
ekegusii: gose oyo bw’eng’iti ekwagura ase riroba, gose oyo bw’enswe ende yonsi ere ime ase amaache inse y’ense.

english: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .
ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria gochia igoro, gokorora ebinto bitongire bireo buna risase, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, omoganda oyio bwonsi, tobaisa gotiga Omonene, erinde osasiime na gokorera ebinto ebio, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oo, obirure ase ebisaku bionsi bire inse y’erioba.

english: But I must die in this land , I must not go over Jordan : but ye shall go over , and possess that good land .
ekegusii: Inche goika ’nkwere aiga ase orogongo oro: ting’eiri ribaga kwamboka Yorodani, korende ninwe moramboke, erinde moire ense eria engiya.

english: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God , which he made with you, and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
ekegusii: Moigwere na kwerenda, timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania, okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorete nainwe; timobaisa koroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima. Omonene Nyasae oino, obakanirie ayio.

english: When thou shalt beget children , and children’s children , and ye shall have remained long in the land , and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God , to provoke him to anger :
ekegusii: “Komogochia koibora abana na abaachokoro, naende komenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio; timokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima gose gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino. Moise gokora ayio, rirorio nigo moramogeechie abe n’endamwamu ase more.

english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day , that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed .
ekegusii: Onye timokoigwera, inche ’nkorangeria inde igoro na ense chibe birori ase more reero ng’a, goika mosire kegima ase obwango. Timokomenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio mogochia koira, ekero moramboke Yorodani.

english: And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men’s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .
ekegusii: Agwo ase morasiarerwe gochia, ’namobe mogosasiima chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose koragera, gose konyonka.

english: When thou art in tribulation , and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days , if thou turn to the LORD thy God , and shalt be obedient unto his voice ;
ekegusii: Ekero moraabe n’emechando, na ayio onsi arabanyoore ase amatuko agochia goocha, imomoiranere Omonene Nyasae oino, naende moigwere eriogi riaye.

english: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God ;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere n’oyo bw’amaabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino.

english: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth , and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it?
ekegusii: “Bono booria, momanye korwa ase amatuko a kare, amatuko ayio arengeo ekero konya motaraiborwa, korwa rituko riria Nyasae atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, naende moboorie momanye korwa ase ensemo eyemo y’ense goikera ensemo ende, gose amang’ana agwekaine buna aya ana koba, gose koigugwa.

english: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as thou hast heard , and live ?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto bande bana koigwa Nyasae ogokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero buna inwe mwaiguure, naende mogendererete koba moyo?

english: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation , by temptations , by signs , and by wonders , and by war , and by a mighty hand , and by a stretched out arm , and by great terrors , according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes ?
ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y’ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abakorerete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.

english: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
ekegusii: Akabakora mokaigwa eriogi riaye riarwete igoro, erinde anyare koborokereria; na ase ense akaborokia omorero omonene, nainwe mokaigwa amang’ana aye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero oria.

english: And because he loved thy fathers , therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt ;
ekegusii: Agancha chisokoro chiaino, na ase engencho eyio akabachoora inwe, ororeeria rwabo, mobe ribaga riabo, na ere omonyene akabang’anyia korwa Misiri ase okobua kwaye okonene.

english: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance , as it is this day .
ekegusii: Korwa bosio bwaino akabiseeria ebisaku biarenge ebinene, naende biarenge ne chinguru kobabua; akabarenta ase ense yabo, nainwe mokayeira ekaba omwando oino, naboigo ere nonya ngoika reero iga.

english: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the LORD he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
ekegusii: Ase ayio manya rituko ria reero, morengererie mono ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae o igoro na ense; naende onde tari otatiga ere bweka.

english: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day .
ekegusii: Korende inwe abamwabete abegenwa ase Omonene Nyasae oino, kera oyomo oino moy’are goika reero iga.

english: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
ekegusii: Inwe goika morende emeroberio yaye echiikire n’amachiiko aye, ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria reero, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naboigo nase abana baino, naende amatuko aino nabe amaange ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino kogenderera.” Emechie y’obotamero moocha ya Yorodani

english: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero omoiti aranyare gotamera, ere oy’oraite omonto omwabo mosiabano, gose oyio atabwati obobisa nere. Omonto oria karatamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo aratigwe abe moyo.

english: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , of the Reubenites ; and Ramoth in Gilead , of the Gadites ; and Golan in Bashan , of the Manassites .
ekegusii: Beseri ase erooro, ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro, nigo orenge omochie bw’obotamero ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na Ramoti ase ense ya Gileadi ase abanto ba Gadi, na Golani ase ense ya Basani ase abanto ba Manase. Okoruegwa kw’amachiiko a Nyasae

english: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel :
ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko a Nyasae Musa aruete ase Abaisraeli.

english: These are the testimonies , and the statutes , and the judgments , which Moses spake unto the children of Israel , after they came forth out of Egypt ,
ekegusii: Magega Abaisraeli kobaruure Misiri, Musa akaa Abaisraeli oborori, na emeroberio echiikire, n’amachiiko aya.

english: On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth-peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete agwo moocha ya Yorodani ase rikura riarenge ensemo ekororia Beti‐Peori, ase orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio omenyete agwo Hesiboni. Nere oria Musa na Abaisraeli babuete ekero barwete Misiri,

english: And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising ;
ekegusii: bakaira ense yaye ekaba eyabo, naende bakaira ense ya Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. (Abarwoti abwo babere nigo bamenyete moocha ya Yorodani.)

english: From Aroer , which is by the bank of the river Arnon , even unto mount Sion , which is Hermon ,
ekegusii: Bakaira ense gochaakera Aroeri ase orobebe rwe rigoko ri’Arinoni goikera egetunwa keria Sioni (nakio Herimoni).

english: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .
ekegusii: Bakaira orogongo gochakera rikura moocha ya Yorodani goikera ase Enyancha y’omonyoo inse y’ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.

english: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
ekegusii: “Naama! Inche naborokereirie amachiiko na emeroberio, buna Omonene Nyasae one, anchiigete, erinde inwe moyaigwere ase ense eria mokogeenda koira ebe eyaino.

english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations , which shall hear all these statutes , and say , Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people .
ekegusii: Moyabwate na koyaigwera, ekiagera ayio naro araorokererie abanto b’ebisaku binde ng’a ’more n’obong’aini. Barabwo kobaraigwe amachiiko aya onsi mbateebe: Ekeene, abanto b’egesaku eke ekenene nigo bare abamanyi naende nabang’aini!

english: For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?
ekegusii: “Inee! ’Mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate enyasae ere ang’e nabarabwo buna Omonene Nyasae oito, are ang’e naintwe? Nigo agotoigwa kero kende gionsi tokomorangeria atokoonye.

english: And what nation is there so great , that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law , which I set before you this day ?
ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate amachiiko amaronge na emeroberio emeronge, buna amachiiko aya onsi inche naborokereirie reero?

english: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently , lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen , and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life : but teach them thy sons , and thy sons’ sons ;
ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba ayamwarorire n’amaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abaachokoro baino,

english: And Moses called all Israel , and said unto them, Hear , O Israel , the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day , that ye may learn them, and keep , and do them.
ekegusii: Musa akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi goocha amo, erio akabateebia, Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amachiiko na emeroberio echiikire ’nkobateebia rituko ria reero, moyieorokererie, mobe n’obomaene ng’a ’moyakore.

english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .
ekegusii: Korende nigo ’nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko ane.

english: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou, nor thy son , nor thy daughter , nor thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thine ox , nor thine ass , nor any of thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates ; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatan’akabere, ne’rituko ri’Esabato riatananwe ase Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya n’omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yao, gose etigere yao, gose etugo yao ende yonsi egokora emeremo, gose omomenyi oyomenyete mwao. Omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nabarabwo batimoke buna aye ogotimoka.

english: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a aye omonyene nigo kwarenge omosomba ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agakorusia korwa aroro n’okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire. Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo agochiigete orende rituko ri’Esabato.

english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.

english: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness , (for the mountain did burn with fire ,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders ;
ekegusii: “Ekero egetunwa keria kiagendererete gwoka omorero, mokaigwa eriogi korwa ase egati‐gati y’omosunte oria, nainwe mwensi, abamore abatang’ani na abagaaka ase ebisaku biaino, mogaacha ase ’nde.

english: And ye said , Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .
ekegusii: Mokabora: Naama, Omonene Nyasae oito, otworokirie obonene bwaye na obonguru bwaye, naintwe twaiguure eriogi riaye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero. Rituko ria reero twarorire Nyasae ogokwana na Mwanyabaanto, na Mwanyabaanto oyio ogendererete koba moyo.

english: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more , then we shall die .
ekegusii: Bono nase ki togwenerete gokwa? Omorero oyo omonene nigo ogochia gotosamba na gotosiria, onye naende togochia koigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oito, goika tokwe.

english: For who is there of all flesh , that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as we have , and lived ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nareo obeire okoigwa Nyasae ore moyo kagokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, buna intwe twamoiguure, na omonto oyio ogendererete koba moyo?

english: Go thou near , and hear all that the LORD our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it , and do it .
ekegusii: Naende moganteebia: Aye genda ang’e, oigwe amang’ana onsi Omonene Nyasae oito, agokwana. Erio oche ototeebie onsi ayio Omonene Nyasae oito, aragoteebie, naintwe ’natoyaigwe na koyakora.

english: And the LORD heard the voice of your words , when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people , which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken .
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo aigwete amang’ana aino ekero keria mware gokwana nainche, erio aganteebia: Naiguure amang’ana abanto abwo bakwanire naye. Ayio onsi bagoteebirie, mbuya bakwanire.

english: O that there were such an heart in them , that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever !
ekegusii: Onye ndiria baare koba n’omoyo oyio botambe, na kong’iroka na korenda amachiiko ane onsi, nanga kera egento nigo kiare koba buya ase bare, na ase ororeeria rwabo, kare na kare.

english: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us, who are all of us here alive this day .
ekegusii: Omonene takorete okobwatana okwo ne’chisokoro chiaito, korende nigo akorete okobwatana okwo naintwe abanyene, intwe twensi abatore moyo rituko ria reero.

english: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again .
ekegusii: Genda obateebie bairane ase chiema chiabo.

english: But as for thee, stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
ekegusii: Korende aye tigara aa ase ’nde, na inche ngoteebie amachiiko onsi, na emeroberio echiikire, na onsi aya nachiikire, ayio ogochia koborokia, erio bayarende na koyakora ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa, ebe eyabo.

english: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio morende na gokora ayio Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire. Timoyatiga na koonchoka gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.

english: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live , and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .
ekegusii: Mobwatie chinchera chionsi Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire, erio nario mor’abe moyo, naende nario er’abe buya ase more, na inwe momenye amatuko amaange ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.

english: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,
ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa, korwa ase egati-gati y’omorero, Omonene nigo akwanete nainwe obosio ase obosio.

english: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time , to shew you the word of the LORD : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount ;) saying ,
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche nabeete ’nteneine ase egati y’Omonene nainwe, nareenge gokwana nainwe ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera inwe nigo mwarenge n’obwoba ase engencho y’omorero oria, timwatiirete goocha ase egetunwa. “Omonene agakwana:

english: I am the LORD thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.

english: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
ekegusii: “Toba ne chinyasae chinde otatiga inche.

english: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, Omonene Nyasae oino, anchiigete imborokererie, erinde moyaigwere na koyakora ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.

english: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not, and wells digged , which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full ;
ekegusii: Chinyomba nigo chiraabe chiichire n’ebinto ebiya, ebio inwe motabegeteo, ne chinsooko chi’amaache echio motakuunyete, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, eyio motasimegete.

english: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.

english: Ye shall not go after other gods , of the gods of the people which are round about you;
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosasiima chinyasae chinde chionsi chiria chi’ abanto baabaetanaine.

english: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth .
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, oyomenyete ase egati yaino, nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi; mwerende, erinde endamwamu yaye tebaisa gwoka igoro ase more na kobasiria korwa ase ense.

english: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee.
ekegusii: Mobe abeegenwa ase okobwata amachiiko a Omonene Nyasae oino, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio echiikire, eyio abaeire.

english: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD : that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers ,
ekegusii: Mokore ayaare amaronge na’amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, monyaare gosoa na koira ense eria engiy’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee,

english: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken .
ekegusii: na kobaseeria ababisa baino bonsi korwa ase more, buna Omonene ateebete.

english: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee, thou, and thy son , and thy son’s son , all the days of thy life ; and that thy days may be prolonged .
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaino bwonsi, inwe amo nabana baino, na abaachokoro baino, goika moiroke Omonene Nyasae oino, na kobwata emeroberio yaye yonsi yachiikirwe, n’amachiiko aye onsi ayio inche ’nkobachiika, erio nario amatuko aino arabe amaange.

english: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What mean the testimonies , and the statutes , and the judgments , which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
ekegusii: “Ase chingaki chigochia‐goocha ekero abana baino barababorie: Ninki engencho y’oborori obo, n’amachiiko aya, na emeroberio eye, ebi Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete? Nase ki Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete amachiiko aya na emeroberio eye?

english: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt ; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :
ekegusii: Goika mobairanerie: Intwe nigo twarenge abasomba ba Farao ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene agatorusiao n’okoboko kwaye gwe’chinguru.

english: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders , great and sore , upon Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his household , before our eyes :
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aorogetie ebikone na amakumia amanene, naende ay’okoondokia, aaria ase ense ya Misiri, ase Farao, na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye, naintwe tokayarora.

english: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense eria, erio agatorenta aiga, agatoa ense eye arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a n’abayee.

english: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the LORD our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .
ekegusii: Erio agatochiika ng’a toigwere amachiiko aya onsi, na koimoroka ere Omonene Nyasae oito, erio nario er’abe buya ase tore botambe. Toise gokora bo ere natorende, buna atorendete goika reero iga, naintwe ’natogenderere koba moyo.

english: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God , as he hath commanded us.
ekegusii: Onye tokorenda na koigwera amachiiko aya onsi, ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, buna ere atochiikire, nigo torabarerwe oboronge.”

english: Hear therefore, O Israel , and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily , as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe, monyaare koyarenda; erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naende ’momentekane mono ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira.

english: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
ekegusii: Moyorokererie abana baino mono, mobe mokona‐koyairanerera botambe; moyakwane ekero moikaransete ase chinyomba chiaino, na ekero more ase orogeendo inchera, na ekero mogochia korara, na ekero mokobooka.

english: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .
ekegusii: Moyasiberanie ase amaboko aino, na moyabeeke ase amasio aino igoro, abe amariiko akobainyoria.

english: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house , and on thy gates .
ekegusii: Moyariike ase emetobwa na emeriibo y’ebisieri bi’echinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino. Ogokuurerwa igoro y’ogotaigwera

english: And repayeth them that hate him to their face , to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face .
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akobaakana obobe baria bamogeechete, na kobasiria. Tari goteebana koa omonto oria omogeechete egesusuro.

english: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which I command thee this day , to do them.
ekegusii: Bono morende na koigwera amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, mokore ayio onsi nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero. Ogosesenigwa ase abaigweri (Okoir 28:1-14)

english: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
ekegusii: Ere nabanche na kobasesenia, nabamentekanie. Boigo nasesenie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, na okwama kw’emegondo yaino, na endagera yaino, na edivai yaino, na amaguta aino y’amazeituni; chiombe chiaino ’nchimentekane, amo ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chiaino, ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee.

english: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle .
ekegusii: ’Namosesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde bionsi. Ase egati yaino onde tari omosacha gose omokungu, oraabe omogomba, gose etugo ende yaino tekogombaa.

english: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness , and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which thou knowest , upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
ekegusii: Omonene narusie amarwaire onsi korwa ase more; nonya nobomo bw’amarwaire aria amabe arenge Misiri, aria ase mwamenyete, tagoocha igoro ase more kobachaanda, korende nigo arayarente ase abanto baria bonsi babageechete.

english: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods ; for that will be a snare unto thee.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke ase amaboko aino, mobasirie, timobarorera amaabera. Timobaisa gokorera chinyasae chiabo, ekiagera ase ogokora igo, chirochio ’nachinyaare kobatiga.

english: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
ekegusii: “Moise goteeba ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Ebisaku ebi nigo bire ebinene gotobua, naki toranyaare kobiseeria birueo?

english: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt ;
ekegusii: Timobairoka, korende moinyore buna Omonene Nyasae oino, akorerete Farao na abanto bonsi ba Misiri.

english: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out : so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .
ekegusii: Moinyore amaakwa amanene aria mwarooche, na ebikone, na amakumia, na buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abarusetieo n’okoboko kwaye kore nechinguru, koramboire. Naboigo arakore abanto bonsi baria moirogete.

english: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue, goika mobaite na kobasiria kegima, timobaisa gokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, gose kobarorera amaabera.

english: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left , and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene natome ebiaramba ase egati yabo bibarase, baria abatigari barebise korwa ase more, basire kegima.

english: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible .
ekegusii: Timoondoka ase engencho yabo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo are egati yaino, ere nere Nyasae omonene, naende oyo bw’okoondokia.

english: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, naseerie ebisaku ebio ng’orang’ora, birue ase more. Timobaisa kobiseeria biere kegima ase ekero ekemo gioka. Moise gokora bo, ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chiramentekane chibachaande.

english: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae oino, nabeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino, erio abatantanie, nainwe goika mobasirie kegima.

english: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
ekegusii: Nabeeke abarwoti babo ase amaboko aino, erio mobaite na kobasiria nonya n’amarieta abo tainyorwa ase ense. Omonto onde tari, nonya n’oyomo, oranyaare korwana nainwe na kobabua; goika mobasirie kegima.

english: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire : thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God .
ekegusii: Emegwekano yabo bagosasiima moyesambe n’omorero. Timogania koira chifeta gose chitaabu chire ase emegwekano eyio. Moise gochigania nigo chiraabe chikobatega. Ayio onsi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

english: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house , lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing .
ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta okogeechia buna okwo ase chinyomba chiaino. Komorakore igo, nigo moraragererigwe. Mokogeeche na kogochaaya, ekiagera korokwo nigo koragereirie.”

english: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .
ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana baino abamura ase abaiseke babo,

english: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly .
ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo nigo baraonchore abana baino abamura batige gosasiima Omonene, erio bakorere chinyasae ching’ao. Eri’Omonene abaise koba n’endamwamu ase more, abasirie ara rimo rioka.

english: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people ; for ye were the fewest of all people :
ekegusii: “Omonene tang’usetwe nainwe, gose tabachoorete ekiagera mwarenge abange kobua abanto bande (inwe nigo mwarenge abake mono kobua abanto bonsi),

english: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .
ekegusii: korende ekiagera nigo abanchete, naende akagania goikerania eira eria arierete chisokoro chiaino. Ayio akagera Omonene akabang’anyia n’okoboko kwaye kore nechinguru, na kobabooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba korwa ase okoboko gwa Farao, omorwoti o Misiri.

english: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers .
ekegusii: “Moigwere amachiiko aya onsi nabaeire ase rituko ria reero, moyabwate, erio nario moraabe moyo na komentekana, erinde mogende moire ense eri’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee.

english: When thou hast eaten and art full , then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
ekegusii: ’Namonyoore endagera morie moisaneke. Erio motogie Omonene Nyasae oino, ase engencho y’ense eyio engiya abaeire. Ogokuurerwa ase ogotamweba Omonene

english: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein;
ekegusii: Ekero moraabe mwanyorire endagera ebaisaine na koigota, naende mwaagachire chinyomba chingiya na komenyao,

english: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply , and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied , and all that thou hast is multiplied ;
ekegusii: na ekero amaicho aino ye’chiombe na aye’ching’ondi arabe amentekanire, ne’chifeta, ne’chitaabu chiaino boigo, n’ebinto binde bionsi mobwate biramentekane,

english: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the LORD thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage ;
ekegusii: timobaisa koenena na kweba Omonene Nyasae oino, oy’obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.

english: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness , wherein were fiery serpents , and scorpions , and drought , where there was no water ; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint ;
ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobaetia ase erooro enene eyarenge ey’okoondokia, eyarenge ne’ching’iti chingeenda inse chire n’obosongo, n’ebiuge boigo: ase erooro eria enyomo etabwate amaache ere akababochorera amaache korwa ase egetare keria egekong’u.

english: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna , which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end ;
ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro akabaa mana mokaria, endagera chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, anyare kobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema, erinde ase omoerio oino abakorere amaya.

english: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
ekegusii: Mwerende, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Okobua gwaito ne chinguru chi’amaboko aito nachio chiatonyoreire obotenenku obo.

english: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .
ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, nere okobaa chinguru chi’okonyoora obotenenku, ekiagera aganetie gokong’ia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania okwo akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino buna akorire goika reero iga.

english: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .
ekegusii: Komoramwebe Omonene Nyasae oino, na koonchoka gochia ase chinyasae ching’ao ase ogochikorera, na gochisasiima, nabakuureire ase rituko ria reero ng’a, ekeene, goika mosire kegima.

english: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no.
ekegusii: Moinyore buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abeire okobaraa ase orogeendo rwaino rwonsi ase erooro, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene yaetire, ase okobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema ase okomanya ebirengerio biaino, arore gose ’moganetie korenda amachiiko aye, gose yaya.

english: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face , so shall ye perish ; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God .
ekegusii: Buna ebisaku biria, Omonene arasirie korwa ase amasio aino, naboigo nainwe morasirigwe, ekiagera motaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oino.”

english: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .
ekegusii: Ase emiaka eyio yonsi emerongo ene, chianga chiano tichiabagoterete, gose amagoro aino tabiimbete.

english: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that, as a man chasteneth his son , so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
ekegusii: Momanye ng’a, buna omonto akoa omwana oye egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia, naboigo n’Omonene Nyasae oino, akobaa egesusuro ase okobarongeyia.

english: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio mobwate amachiiko a y’Omonene Nyasae oino, ase ogotaara ase chinchera chiaye na komoiroka.

english: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land , a land of brooks of water , of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills ;
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, ’nkobaira are ase ense engiya ebwate chindooche ne’chinsooko, ne’chintuboka chigosookia amaache gochia ase amagoko na ase ebitunwa.

english: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates ; a land of oil olive , and honey ;
ekegusii: Ense eyio ere n’engano n’esairi, n’emesabibu, n’emeko, n’emekomomanga, n’emezeituni, boigo n’amooke.

english: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio inamorie endagera enyinge etari kobaerera; aroro timokoremerwa gento kende gionsi. Amagena areo nigo are n’ebioma, naende ’namoremere chitaai korwa ase ebitunwa biaye.

english: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Ase rituko ria reero mwabeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodani kogeenda koira ense y’ebisaku bire ebinene mono, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua. Emechie yabo n’emenene, naende nigo egiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro.

english: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God ; and on them was written according to all the words , which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly .
ekegusii: Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio Ere Omonyene ariigete n’ekiara kiaye. Nigo chiariikire amang’ana onsi Omonene konya akwanire nainwe agwo ase egetunwa korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ekero mwasangererekanete aroro.

english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .
ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’amatuko aria emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio chiariikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

english: And the LORD said unto me, Arise , get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image .
ekegusii: “Eri’Omonene aganteebia: Imoka otirimboke bwango korwa aiga ase egetunwa, ekiagera abanto abwo kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri bakorire ebibe. Baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachiigete kobwatia. Beroiseirie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa onyititoire na kobombwa.

english: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying , I have seen this people , and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people :
ekegusii: “Boigo Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia: Narorire abanto aba ng’a n’abanyabigoti bikong’u.

english: Let me alone , that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteema gontanga, ’ntige imbasirie naende intinyie amarieta abo, nimbakore beebwe kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense, erio ’ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere ne chinguru kobabua.

english: So I turned and came down from the mount , and the mount burned with fire : and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands .
ekegusii: “Nkairana, ngatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa imbogoretie ase amaboko ane abere chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena chiariikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Egetunwa keria nigo kiarenge gwoka omorero.

english: And I looked , and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
ekegusii: Erio ’nkarora ng’a mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae oino: konya mweroiseirie omogwekano bw’emori onyititoire na kobombwa, na mwaonchokire bwango, mwatigire enchera eri’Omonene abachiigete mobwatie.

english: And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
ekegusii: ’Nkabwata chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena ase amaboko ane, ’ngachiakera inse, ’ngachiatera agwo ase amasio aino.

english: And I fell down before the LORD , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger .
ekegusii: Erio naende ’nkarara maumama ase obosio bw’Omonene buna agwo ritang’ani, ase engaki y’amatuko emeronge ene, omobaso n’obotuko. Tinabeete ’nkoria kende gose konywa, ase engencho y’ebibe bionsi inwe konya mwakorire, ase ogokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, mokamogeechia goika akaba n’endamwamu.

english: A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
ekegusii: Abanto bakareo n’abanene, naende n’abatambe, abanto b’ororeeria rw’Anaki mwabeire mokoigwa chinkuma chiabo, bagokwanwa: Ning’o oranyaare kobua Abanaki?

english: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abeete n’endamwamu enene ase Aroni boigo, akaba ang’e komoita, korende ase engaki eria eria ’nkamosabera Aroni.

english: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it, and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .
ekegusii: Nkabogoria egento keria ki’ebibe, emori eria konya mwaroisirie, ’nkayesamba n’omorero, n’kayesunyunta, ’nkayesia ekaba orotu. ’Ngatuguta orotu orwo ase akarooche karenge gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa keria.

english: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
ekegusii: Ee, korwa nachagete kobamanya, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.

english: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights , as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
ekegusii: “Ase igo ’nkarara maumama ase obosio bw’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso n’obotuko, ekiagera Omonene nigo ateebete ng’a goika abasirie.

english: I prayed therefore unto the LORD , and said , O Lord GOD , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .
ekegusii: ’Ngasaba Omonene, ’ngakwana, Aye Omonene, tobaisa goita abanto bao aba bare omwando oo, aba gwatooretie ase okobua kwao okonene, aba kwarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri n’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.

english: Remember thy servants , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob ; look not unto the stubbornness of this people , nor to their wickedness , nor to their sin :
ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao, Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo; tobaisa kobarera abanto aba ogotaigwera kwabo gose obonyaka bwabo, gose ebibe biabo.

english: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo barabaise gokwana: Omonene nigo asinyetwe kobaira na kobaikia ase ense eria konya ariire eira ng’a abayee, naende nigo abageechete, nakio kiagerete akabarusia aiga, erinde agachia kobaitera agwo ase erooro.

english: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm .
ekegusii: Aba n’abanto bao, na omwando oo, aba kwang’anyetie ne chinguru chinene, na ase okoboko kwao koramboire.”

english: Understand therefore this day , that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the LORD hath said unto thee.
ekegusii: Ase ayio manya bono ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, oy’orabatang’ane inwe, nigo are buna omorero ogosamba. Ere nasirie abanto baria na kobabeeka inse yaino, erio nario moranyaare kobaseeria na kobaita bwango ara rimo rioka, buna abarierete inwe eira.

english: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying , For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabe oseeririe abanto abwo korwa ase amasio aino, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Oboronge bwaito nabwo bwagera Omonene agatorenta toire ense eye. Taibo! Korende Omonene nigo araseerie abanto abwo barue ase amasio aino, ase engencho y’obobe bwabo.

english: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
ekegusii: Inwe timori gochia koira ense eria yabo ekiagera more abanyene oboronge, gose ab’ekeene ase chinkoro chiaino. Taibo! Korende obobe bw’ebisaku ebio nabwo bwagerire Omonene Nyasae oino, arabaseerie korwa ase amasio aino, erinde anyare goikerania eira ariete na gotiana ase chisokoro chiaino, Aburaamu, na Isaka na Yakobo.

english: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness ; for thou art a stiffnecked people .
ekegusii: Ase ayio mobe n’obomaene ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, tari gochia kobaa ense eria engiya ekiagera more abanyene oboronge. Taibo! Inwe nigo more abanto abanyabigoti bikong’u.”

english: Remember , and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the LORD .
ekegusii: “Moinyore, timobaisa kweba buna mwagerete Omonene, Nyasae oino, akaba n’endamwamu agwo ase erooro. Korwa ase rituko riria mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, goika ekero mwaigete aase aiga, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.

english: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath , so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
ekegusii: Nonya n’ekero mwarenge agwo Horebu, mokagera Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene, ere akebeeka ang’e kegima kobasiria.

english: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
ekegusii: Chingi chikwete nigo chikogundia amaguta akweakwa atioka bobe; naboigo na oboriri obosinini bokobua obong’aini na amasikani.

english: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .
ekegusii: Onye omonto tagotieria ekioma ekero giatuire, rirorio goika abeeke chinguru chinyinge ase ogokora emeremo nakerokio, korende obong’aini nigo bogokonya omonto abue.

english: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment ; and a babbler is no better .
ekegusii: Omoebia + 10:11 Omoebia: Omonto ogochegia ching’iti ching’enda inse ching’iti ching’enda inse aise gotiga eng’iti emorome ritang’ani atarayeebia, rirorio omoebia oyio nigo arabe bosa.

english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious ; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonto omong’aini nigo akogera bwanchwa, korende aya akorua ase ebikoba bi’omoriri nigo akomosiria.

english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .
ekegusii: Oyio omoriri nigo agochaka gokwana amang’ana ’oboriri, naende oyakoora nobobarimo obobe.

english: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo are omonyamang’ana mange. Monto onde tamanyeti aya agochia koba. Ning’o oranyare komoteebia ekegochia koba korwa magega yaye.

english: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
ekegusii: Emeremo y’omoriri nigo ekomoorosia, goika osinywa komanya enchera ekogenda ase omochie.

english: Woe to thee, O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !
ekegusii: Obobe nobwao, aye ense, ekero omorwoti oo are omwana, na abagaambi bao bakobeera ase emeyega y’okwegokia ase chingaki chia mambia.

english: Blessed art thou, O land , when thy king is the son of nobles , and thy princes eat in due season , for strength , and not for drunkenness !
ekegusii: Nosesenirie aye ense, ekero omorwoti oo are omonto omosike na omosibore; na abarai bao bakoragera ase engaki egwenerete, ase okonyora chinguru, korende tari ase ogotinda.

english: By much slothfulness the building decayeth ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto are omworo ekerama ki’enyomba yaye nigo gekogwa, na ase engencho y’obworo obwo embura nigo egotwa imeo.

english: A feast is made for laughter , and wine maketh merry : but money answereth all things .
ekegusii: Emeyega ye chindagera nigo ekorenta omogooko, na edivai nigo egokora omonto bweigwa buya, na ase chitaabu nonyare kogora ebinto bionsi.

english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand ; but a fool’s heart at his left .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomoraa gochia borio + 10:2 Borio: Ensemo yokoboko gwokorio , korende ey’omoriri nigo ekomoraa gochia bomosi + 10:2 Bomosi: Ensemo yokoboko gwokobee .

english: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .
ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omorwoti nonya nase ebirengererio biao, gose tobaisa koragereria omonto omonda ekero ore ase akanyomba kao g’okorara. Oise gokora bo, enyoni nebaise koira amang’ana ao, gose egetongwa kere ne chimbaaba ngetebe amang’ana ayio.

english: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
ekegusii: Nonya nekero omonto omoriri agotaara inchera nigo akoborwa okomanya, na igo omanyia kera omonto ng’a ere nomoriri.

english: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place ; for yielding pacifieth great offences .
ekegusii: Omogambi karabe nendamwamu asore, tobaisa gotiga emeremo yao, ekiagera oboremereria nigo boragere ebibe ebinene biaberwe.

english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :
ekegusii: Aiga inse y’erioba narorire obobe, na obobe obo nigo bokorentwa nabagaambi:

english: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo akoegwa amasikani amanene, ekero abanto abanda bagendererete goikaransa aase a inse.

english: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .
ekegusii: Narorire abasomba bariinete chibarasi, na abagaambi bagotaara namagoro buna abasomba.

english: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
ekegusii: Oyo ogwatia amagena nigo araakwe naro, na oyo ogwatia emete, ande nanyore obokong’u asero.

english: Cast thy bread upon the waters : for thou shalt find it after many days .
ekegusii: Eteria endagera yao igoro ye chinyancha, na magega y’amatuko amange nekoiranere.

english: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart , and put away evil from thy flesh : for childhood and youth are vanity .
ekegusii: Ase ayio tiga aya akogochanda arue ase enkoro yao, na aya akorenta obororo ase omobere oo arue boigo, ekiagera obosae na obuya bw’obogima nigo bore bosa.

english: Give a portion to seven , and also to eight ; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth .
ekegusii: Atanana ebi obwate oe abanto batano na babere, gose batano na batato, ekiagera tomanyeti amabe agochia konyora ense.

english: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
ekegusii: Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya Irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.

english: He that observeth the wind shall not sow ; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap .
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.

english: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
ekegusii: Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga ’omwana ore ase enda ya ng’ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang’ana onsi.

english: In the morning sow thy seed , and in the evening withhold not thine hand : for thou knowest not whether shall prosper , either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good .
ekegusii: Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.

english: Truly the light is sweet , and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun :
ekegusii: Omobaso nigo ore omwansu, na amaiso nigo akogokigwa korora erioba.

english: But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .
ekegusii: Omonto karagenderere koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, tiga agokere engaki eyio yonsi, korende goika ainyore ng’a amatuko ’omosunte nabe amange mono. Onsi aya agochi‐gocha nigo are bosa. Ogosemigwa kw’abasae

english: Rejoice , O young man , in thy youth ; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth , and walk in the ways of thine heart , and in the sight of thine eyes : but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment .
ekegusii: Aye omosae, gokera engaki y’obosae bwao, tiga enkoro yao ekorentere omogooko ase amatuko ’obosae bwao; bwatia chinchera chi’okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aya amaiso ao akorora. Korende oinyore ng’a ase ayio onsi Nyasae nakorangerie ase ekiina.

english: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth , while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh , when thou shalt say , I have no pleasure in them;
ekegusii: Moinyore Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang’e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogooko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”

english: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .
ekegusii: Akarigia konyora amang’ana arenge kogokia, akarika amang’ana ’ekeene ase oboronge.

english: The words of the wise are as goads , and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies , which are given from one shepherd .
ekegusii: Amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana nigo anga buna chimbambo + 12:11 Chimbambo: Ebitugi ebisinini bitieririe bigotongwa ase riboba chiombe chiasibwa aroro chinyoge, na aya basangereirie anga buna emesumari eakeire bokong’u. Ayio onsi nebiegwa korwa ase Omorisia oyomo.

english: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, kobua ase aya onsi, igwera ogokuurerwa oko. Okorika ebitabu ebinge tikori nomoerio; ogosoma okonge nigo gokorosia omobere.

english: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi aigurwe, Omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi noyo: Omoiroke Nyasae na obwate amachiiko aye, ekiagera ayio naro abanto bonsi bagwenerete bakore.

english: For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
ekegusii: Nyasae narente kera ogokora ase ekiina ekero aranachere obobisi bwonsi ekiina, karabe amaya gose amabe.

english: While the sun , or the light , or the moon , or the stars , be not darkened , nor the clouds return after the rain :
ekegusii: Omoinyore ekero erioba, na omobaso, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, bitarabekwa omosunte, gose amare atarairanerana embura koyature.

english: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble , and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few , and those that look out of the windows be darkened ,
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abarendi b’enyomba mbaiguswe, na abasacha bare ne chinguru bekumbe, na abagosia batige gosia ekiagera bare abake ase omobaro, na abwo batengerete korwa ase ebibao, batubwe norotutu tibarora buya.

english: And the doors shall be shut in the streets , when the sound of the grinding is low , and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird , and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low ;
ekegusii: Ebisieri birochie ase chinchera mbisiekwe, na amariogi ay’ogosia nakee; amariogi e chinyoni natabobore omonto korwa ase chitoro, na amariogi ’abaiseke bagotera nakee.

english: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high , and fears shall be in the way , and the almond tree shall flourish , and the grasshopper shall be a burden , and desire shall fail : because man goeth to his long home , and the mourners go about the streets :
ekegusii: Abanto nigo barabe nobwoba ase ebitiiro, na okogoswa kobe ase chinchera. Emelozi + 12:5 Emelozi: Emete egosicha nesiche, na ebisase bibe bikwagura ng’ora ng’ora, na okogania gwonsi ngosire. Eyio nengaki Mwanyabaanto aragende ase obomenyo bwaye bwa kare na kare; abakona‐korera mbabe bakomochiera ekero ase ekero.

english: Or ever the silver cord be loosed , or the golden bowl be broken , or the pitcher be broken at the fountain , or the wheel broken at the cistern .
ekegusii: Engori eroisirie korwa ase efeta nebutorwe, na egetaabo keroisirie korwa ase etaabu ngiatwe, na enyongo yatwe agwo ase ensoko y’amaache, na ekebara‐bara nkebunwe agwo ase egesima ki’amaache.

english: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
ekegusii: Erio orotu ndoirane, ase riroba buna rwarenge, na omoika oirane gochia ase Nyasae oria oyoruete.

english: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher ; all is vanity .
ekegusii: Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteeba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima. Okobeekwa amo kw’amang’ana

english: And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge ; yea, he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
ekegusii: Ekiagera omorandia oria arenge omong’aini, akagenderera kworokereria abanto chisemi na korua ogosemia okuya. Agasangereria na gotuka, naende akaroisia emereng’anio emenge.

english: The words of the Preacher , the son of David , king in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti o Yerusalemu.

english: Is there any thing whereof it may be said , See , this is new ? it hath been already of old time , which was before us.
ekegusii: Inee! Ing’ana rinde ndireo rigokwanwa ng’a neriyia? Yaya. Kera ring’ana nao riarenge korwa kare, intwe konya totarabao.

english: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aetire takoinyorwa, gose ayagochi‐gocha takoinyorwa nabwo bakorwa magega. Aya omorandia eorokereirie

english: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Inche omorandia nigo narenge omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu.

english: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven : this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
ekegusii: Nkerua nenkoro yane korigia na komanya ase obong’aini amang’ana onsi agokoreka inse y’erioba. Nigo ere emeremo etari y’omogooko Nyasae aeire Mwanyabaanto bechande ase okoyekora.

english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun ; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Narigereirie kera egento kegokorwa inse y’erioba, narorire ng’a bionsi nigo bire bosa; nigo enga buna okominyokia embeo.

english: That which is crooked cannot be made straight : and that which is wanting cannot be numbered .
ekegusii: Egento giachiire bogeka tigekorongeigwa, na ekiaremire tigekobareka.

english: And I gave my heart to know wisdom , and to know madness and folly : I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Naende nkerua nenkoro yane komanya goatanana gati y’echisemi, n’oboriri, obong’aini na obobarimo, korende nigo nanyorete ng’a ayio onsi akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.

english: For in much wisdom is much grief : and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini obonge bore, nao omoichano omonge ore, na omonto okomenta chisemi, nigo akomenta obororo.

english: Vanity of vanities , saith the Preacher , vanity of vanities ; all is vanity .
ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteeba: Mbosa na bosa kegima, mbosa, bosa. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.

english: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun ?
ekegusii: Mbitoki ki Mwanyabaanto akonyora ase okwerosia gokora emeremo emekong’u aiga inse y’erioba?

english: One generation passeth away , and another generation cometh : but the earth abideth for ever .
ekegusii: Ekegori ekemo nigo kegoeta, na ekende giacha, korende ense nigo egendererete kobao goika kare na kare.

english: The sun also ariseth , and the sun goeth down , and hasteth to his place where he arose .
ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka naende riarimera, erio riaayerera gochia aase rigosoka korwa.

english: The wind goeth toward the south , and turneth about unto the north ; it whirleth about continually , and the wind returneth again according to his circuits .
ekegusii: Embeo nigo ekogusa gochia Irianyi, naende yaonchoka yagusa gochia sugusu; nigo ekona‐goetanana yagenderera kogusa, naende yagenderera goetanana naende yairana.

english: All the rivers run into the sea ; yet the sea is not full ; unto the place from whence the rivers come , thither they return again .
ekegusii: Chindooche chionsi nigo chikogenda ase enyancha, korende tiyana goichora. Amache ayio nigo akoirana gochia ase chindooche echio chiachakerete, naende agenderera kogenda.

english: All things are full of labour ; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing , nor the ear filled with hearing .
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi agokorwa nigo akorenta omooroso otanyare gokwaneka. Amaiso tari goisaneka naya akorora, na amato tari goisaneka naya akoigwa.

english: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done : and there is no new thing under the sun .
ekegusii: Aya arengeo kare, naro agochia kobao naende. Aya akoregete kare, naro agochia gokoreka naende. Ande tari are amayia inse y’erioba.

english: I said in mine heart , Go to now , I will prove thee with mirth , therefore enjoy pleasure : and, behold, this also is vanity .
ekegusii: Ngakwana nenkoro yane, ngateba, “Bono ninteeme ndore naki omogooko ore, imbe nkwegokia omonyene.” Korende nonya nayio onsi nigo arenge bosa.

english: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy ; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour : and this was my portion of all my labour .
ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi narenge korora na gokegania tinare gwetanga gokenyora, gose tinarinete enkoro yane omogooko onde bwensi, ekiagera enkoro yane nigo yagokerete aya onsi nechanderete, na omogooko oyio noro orenge eng’eria yane y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete.

english: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought , and on the labour that I had laboured to do : and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit , and there was no profit under the sun .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio nkarengereria igoro y’emeremo eyio nakorete namaboko aane, na buna nayiechanderete. Naama! Ayio onsi nigo arenge bosa, na aya naminyokerete konyora nigo are buna embeo bosa, gose bitoki binde tibiri konyorekana inse y’erioba.

english: And I turned myself to behold wisdom , and madness , and folly : for what can the man do that cometh after the king ? even that which hath been already done .
ekegusii: Nkaonchora ebirengererio biane korigereria obong’aini na obobarimo, na oboriri. Omonto oyio okobekwa oborwoti ribaga ri’oyio orengeo, ninki arakore? Tagokora kende otatiga keria oyio omotang’ani akorete.

english: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly , as far as light excelleth darkness .
ekegusii: Erio nkamanya ng’a obong’aini nigo bobuete oboriri, buna oborabu bobuete omosunte.

english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head ; but the fool walketh in darkness : and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo abwate amaiso ase omotwe oye, korende omonto omoriri nigo agotaara ase omosunte; nonya naboigo, nkarora ng’a bonsi nigo bakonyorwa negento ekemo.

english: Then said I in my heart , As it happeneth to the fool , so it happeneth even to me ; and why was I then more wise ? Then I said in my heart , that this also is vanity .
ekegusii: Erio nkebooria, “Ande, amang’ana akomonyoora omoriri naro aranyore nainche, nase ki rende inche nabeire nobong’aini obonge?” Ase ayio ngeteebia ng’a aya boigo mbosa.

english: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever ; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten . And how dieth the wise man ? as the fool .
ekegusii: Buna ere ase omonto omong’aini, naboigo ere nase omoriri, onde takogenderera koinyorwa; bonsi nigo barabe bebirwe kegima ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Inee! Omonto omong’aini tagokwa buna oria omoriri agokwa?

english: Therefore I hated life ; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkagecha obogima, ekiagera emeremo egokorwa inse y’erioba, nigo ekorenta obororo ase ’nde. Ayio onsi mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.

english: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun : because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
ekegusii: Nkagecha emeremo yonsi, eyio nabeete ngwechandera inse y’erioba, ekiagera goika ntigere omonto orambwatie ebinto ebio nakorire.

english: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool ? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured , and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun . This is also vanity .
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omonto oyio nigo arabe omong’aini, gose nigo arabe omoriri? Korende oyio goika aire ebinto ebio bionsi nechandeire inde nobong’aini kobinyora inse y’erioba. Ayio boigo mbosa.

english: I said of laughter , It is mad : and of mirth , What doeth it?
ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a amaseko nigo are obobarimo, na omogooko tori gokora gento kende ekiya.

english: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ngachaka goichana na gokwa omoyo ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete inse y’erioba.

english: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom , and in knowledge , and in equity ; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion . This also is vanity and a great evil .
