ekegusii: Omonto nigo agokora emeremo emekong’u nobong’aini bwaye, ne chisemi, na okomanya kwaye, konyora ebinto, korende magega yaye atigera omonto omoao otabiechanderete okwegokia nabirobio. Ayio boigo mbosa, naende mbobe mono.

english: For what hath man of all his labour , and of the vexation of his heart , wherein he hath laboured under the sun ?
ekegusii: Ngento ki omonto aranyore ekero akorire emeremo emekong’u na kwerosia mono inse y’erioba?

english: For who can eat , or who else can hasten hereunto , more than I?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koria, gose konyora omogooko, onye tari amo n’Omonene?

english: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine , yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom ; and to lay hold on folly , till I might see what was that good for the sons of men , which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life .
ekegusii: Ekero ebirengererio biane biarenge koraagwa nobong’aini, nkagania kogokia omobere one nekenyugwa ki’edivai, nkarigia kobwatia oboriri obwo, erinde ndore ayare amaya agwenerete Mwanyabaanto bakore inse y’erioba, ase amatuko ayio amake bagendererete koba moyo.

english: I made me gardens and orchards , and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits :
ekegusii: Nkeroiseria emegondo na emegondo ende y’amatunda, erio ngasimeka emete y’amatunda ao ao.

english: I made me pools of water , to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees :
ekegusii: Nkeroiseria amatibo ase nare korusia amaache nasiarera emete egokina ase rinani.

english: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :
ekegusii: Kera egento nkere nekero kiaye, na aiga inse y’erioba kera ekegokorekana nkere nengaki yaye.

english: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
ekegusii: Narorire obokong’u obwo Nyasae aeire Mwanyabaanto bechande naborobwo.

english: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
ekegusii: Okorire kera egento kiabeire egeseera ase engaki yaye, naende obekire ime ase chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto engaki etabe nomoerio. Korende nonya naboigo tibakonyara komanya aya Nyasae akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerio.

english: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice , and to do good in his life .
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya kerabagwenere otatiga babe nomogooko, naende bakore ayare amaya ekero bare moyo.

english: And also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy the good of all his labour , it is the gift of God .
ekegusii: Omonto kararie na konywa, naende egokie ase ebio echandeire, ekio nekeegwa kia Nyasae.

english: I know that, whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it , that men should fear before him.
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende gionsi Nyasae agokora nigo gekogenderera kobao kare na kare; gento kende tigekomentwa ase ekio, gose kende tigekorusigwa korwa ase ekio. Nyasae nere okorire igo, erinde Mwanyabaanto bamoiroke.

english: That which hath been is now ; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past .
ekegusii: Amang’ana areo bono, nao arenge korwa kare; na ayio agochia koba, boigo nao arenge korwa kare. Nyasae nigo agokora egento keria keria kiaba naende. Oboronge tibori ase ense

english: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there.
ekegusii: Naende nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a aase ekeene na oboronge bigwenerete koba, nao obobe bore.

english: I said in mine heart , God shall judge the righteous and the wicked : for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work .
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nanachere abanyaboronge ekiina, na abanyabibe boigo, ekiagera obeekire engaki ase kera ring’ana, na ase kera emeremo.

english: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men , that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts .
ekegusii: Naende ngateeba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nigo agoteema Mwanyabaanto kobaenekia ng’a barabwo nigo banga buna ching’iti.

english: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts ; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth , so dieth the other ; yea, they have all one breath ; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast : for all is vanity .
ekegusii: Amang’ana akonyora ching’iti naro ayio akobanyora Mwanyabaanto; buna ching’iti chigokwa, naboigo na Mwanyabaanto bagokwa. Omoika noyomo ore ase ching’iti na ase Mwanyabaanto; Mwanyabaanto tabueti ching’iti kende. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.

english: A time to be born , and a time to die ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted ;
ekegusii: Nere engaki y’okoiborwa, na ey’ogokwa; engaki y’ogosimeka, na ey’ogosimora ekio giasimegetwe;

english: All go unto one place ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda aase ching’iti chikogenda; Mwanyabaanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching’iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.

english: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omoika o Mwanyabaanto niigoro ogochia, na oyo bwe ching’iti ogenda inse y’ense?

english: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkarora ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya, otatiga omonto agokere emeremo yaye; ekio nakio egetari kiaye. Ning’o orachie komoirania ache korora na komanya ayakoregete magega yaye?

english: A time to kill , and a time to heal ; a time to break down , and a time to build up ;
ekegusii: engaki y’ogoita, na ey’okogwenia; engaki y’ogotagora, na ey’okoagacha;

english: A time to weep , and a time to laugh ; a time to mourn , and a time to dance ;
ekegusii: engaki y’okorera, na ey’ogoseka; engaki y’okobokia amagombo, na ey’ogotenga;

english: A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing ;
ekegusii: engaki y’ogosiarera amagena, na ey’okoyasangereria; engaki y’okoboania, na ey’ogotaboania;

english: A time to get , and a time to lose ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away ;
ekegusii: engaki y’okorigia, na ey’ogosiria; engaki y’okogaacha, na ey’ogotuguta;

english: A time to rend , and a time to sew ; a time to keep silence , and a time to speak ;
ekegusii: engaki y’ogotandora, na ey’okobareera; engaki y’ogokira, na ey’ogokwana;

english: A time to love , and a time to hate ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
ekegusii: engaki y’ogwanchana, na ey’okogechana; engaki y’esegi, na ey’omorembe.

english: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth ?
ekegusii: Inee! Mbitoki ki omonto akonyora ase emeremo yonsi agwechandera?

english: So I returned , and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold the tears of such as were oppressed , and they had no comforter ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power ; but they had no comforter .
ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria nkarora ogokora okobe kware gokorwa inse y’erioba. Nkarora abwo bagokorerwa bobe bakorera, na monto onde tarengeo okobaremia, ekiagera abwo barenge kobakorera bobe nigo barenge nokobua, na onde tarengeo okobaremia.

english: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth ; for he hath not another to help him up .
ekegusii: Oyomo karagwe, oyonde namogororokie; korende obobe nobwaye oria ore bweka ekero aragwe, na onde tari oramogororokie.

english: Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?
ekegusii: Abanto babere kobararaare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?

english: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .
ekegusii: Omonto aise korwania oyomo ore bweka, namobue, korende onye bare babere, takobabua. Engori esisire nemegoye etato teri kobutoka bwango.

english: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king , who will no more be admonished .
ekegusii: Omwana omosae omotaka ore nobong’aini niigo’are omuya kobua omorwoti omogotu ore omoriri, otari gwancha gosemigwa;

english: For out of prison he cometh to reign ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
ekegusii: neba ng’a omosae oria nigo aruete echela akabeekwa oborwoti, gose nigo aiboretwe ore omotaka ase obogambi bw’omorwoti oria.

english: I considered all the living which walk under the sun , with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
ekegusii: Nkarora abanto bonsi abamenyete inse y’erioba bakobwatia omosae oria ogochia kobeekwa oborwoti ribaga ri’oria orengeo.

english: There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo arenge koraa tibare kobareka. Nonya naboigo abwo barachiche magega y’abwo tibakomogokera. Ekeene, aya naro mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.

english: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .
ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a nigo ere buya ase abakuure kobua ase abare moyo.

english: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
ekegusii: Korende ase oyo otaraiborwa, oyio otararora ogokora okobe kore aiga inse y’erioba, nigo ere buya asare kobua ase abwo bonsi bare moyo na abakuure.

english: Again, I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Erio nkarora emeremo eye emekong’u egokorwa, na omokia bwonsi bw’ogwechanda ase ogokora emeremo, ayio nigo agokorwa, ekiagera omonto akoba ne ribero + 4:4 Ribero: koba nokogania gokora egento goetania oyonde gose ogotwara okogania ase ebinto bitari ebiao ng’a abue oyonde. Ayio boigo mbosa, nigo are buna okominyokia embeo.

english: The fool foldeth his hands together , and eateth his own flesh .
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agwetumata, na bweria omobere oye orea.

english: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Mbuya koba negento geichire oroe oromo na koba nomorembe, kobua koba n’ebinto biichire chindoe ibere na koba nogwechanda na kominyokera konyora ebire buna embeo bosa.

english: Then I returned , and I saw vanity under the sun .
ekegusii: Naende nkarora obosa kegima bore inse y’erioba:

english: There is one alone , and there is not a second ; yea, he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea, it is a sore travail .
ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogooko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogooko.

english: Two are better than one ; because they have a good reward for their labour .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.

english: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
ekegusii: Orende amagoro ao ekero ogosoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae; mbuya kogenda aroro ase ogotegerera kobua korua ebing’wanso ebio abariri bakorua, ekiagera abwo tibamanyeti ng’a nigo bagokora ebibe.

english: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete chitaabu, tagoisaneka nachirochio; gose oyobwanchete obotenenku, tagoisaneka nebitoki biaye. Ayio boigo mbosa.

english: When goods increase , they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes ?
ekegusii: Ekero obotenenku bokomentekana, boigo nabwo bakoboria nigo bakomentekana; bono mbuya ki oria omonyene akonyora, otatiga akoborora namaiso rioka?

english: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet , whether he eat little or much : but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep .
ekegusii: Chitoro chi’omokori emeremo nigo chire chingiya mono, neba ng’a nigo abwate egento egeke akoria, gose ebinge; korende obotenenku bw’omonto omonda tibokomotiga araare chitoro.

english: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .
ekegusii: Obobe mono narorire inse y’erioba nabwo obo: chinibo chinyinge chikogachwa nigo chiranyare gosiria omonto ochigachete.

english: But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .
ekegusii: Chinibo echio nigo chigosira ase egesio ekebe, na ekero omonto oyio aiboire omwana omomura nigo akonyorekana ore bosa, tabwati kende akomoa.

english: And this also is a sore evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go : and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind ?
ekegusii: Obo boigo nobobe bw’obororo; onye okorua ase ense ogenda buna achete, mbitoki ki abwate ase ogwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u y’okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa?

english: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi nigo abeire okoria endagera ore ase omosunte, obeire ogwechanda ore nobororo na okogechigwa.

english: Behold that which I have seen : it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life , which God giveth him: for it is his portion .
ekegusii: Naama! Aya narorire are amaya na agwenerete nokoria na konywa na koba nomogooko ase ebinto ebio bionsi omonto echandeire aiga inse y’erioba, ase engaki y’amatuko amake Nyasae amoeire; ekio nakio egetari kiaye.

english: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour ; this is the gift of God .
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku ne chinibo, naende omoeire okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio na kobikorera ase obuya bwaye, boigo koba nomogooko ase emeremo yaye, ayio onsi nigo are ebiegwa bia Nyasae.

english: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase ogokwana amang’ana, gose enkoro yao teba enyango gokwana ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ere nigo are igoro, naye nigo ore inse aa ase ense; ase ayio tiga amang’ana ogokwana abe amake.

english: For he shall not much remember the days of his life ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio takogenderera koinyora amatuko aetire ay’obogima bwaye, ekiagera Nyasae nigo akomoa omogooko ase enkoro yaye.

english: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business ; and a fool’s voice is known by multitude of words .
ekegusii: Chindoto nigo chigocha korwa ase ogwechanda okonge, ne chinkwana chinyinge nigo chikorenta amang’ana ’oboriri.

english: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow , than that thou shouldest vow and not pay .
ekegusii: Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.

english: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga amang’ana ’omonwa oo agere okore ebibe, gose tobaisa goteebia omosomba o Nyasae ng’a oko nokomocha gwakora. Nase ki oragere Nyasae agechigwe nogokwana kwao, na asarie emeremo y’amaboko ao?

english: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities : but fear thou God .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae. Obogima nigo bore bosa

english: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth ; and there be higher than they .
ekegusii: Tobaisa goichana ekero orarore agwo ase obogambi abataka bagokorerwa bobe, na ekeene na oboronge biarusigweo ase enchera y’obotindi, omonene oyio okogamba nigo arigereirie noria ore omonene komobua, naende mbare abwo bare abanene kobua abwo bare nokobua.

english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field .
ekegusii: Mbuya ase ense ere nomorwoti okogamba buya na korigereria ng’a abanto nkorema bare emegondo yabo.

english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , and it is common among men :
ekegusii: Mbore obobe narorie aiga inse y’erioba boritoerete Mwanyabaanto:

english: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi kereo nigo kiarogetwe erieta korwa kare, naende nigo yamanyekanete eki omonto are gocha koba. Mwanyabaanto takonyara koamererania noria ore ne chinguru komobua.

english: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity , what is man the better ?
ekegusii: Ogokwana okonge nigo gokorenta amang’ana amange are bosa. Inee! Ayio mbuya ki akorenta ase Mwanyabaanto?

english: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete egento kere ekiya ase omonto, ekero amenyete amatuko amake ase obogima bore bosa, agoeta buna omorengari? Ning’o oranyare goteebia omonto amang’ana arabe korwa magega yaye aiga inse y’erioba?

english: A man to whom God hath given riches , wealth , and honour , so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth , yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity , and it is an evil disease .
ekegusii: Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku, ne chinibo, na ogosikwa, na omonto oyio taremeiri gento kende ase ebio bionsi aganetie, korende Nyasae tamoeti okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio; omonto omoao nigo akobiira bwegokia nabirobio. Ayio naro mbosa, naende nogwechanda okobe.

english: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years , so that the days of his years be many , and his soul be not filled with good , and also that he have no burial ; I say , that an untimely birth is better than he.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oiboire abana rigana erimo, na abe moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, ee, nonya amatuko ’obogima bwaye abeire amange, korende tegogetie ase ebinto ebiya bi’obogima obwo, na tatindekwa ase amasikani, nigo ngoteeba ng’a omwana okwerete enda ya ng’ina nigo are buya kobua omonto oyio.

english: For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
ekegusii: Omwana oyio okwete nigo achete egento bosa, naende nigo akogenda gochia ase omosunte, na omosunte oyio otuba erieta riaye.

english: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
ekegusii: Omwana oria taroche erioba, gose tamanyete gento kende, korende nonya naboigo nigo akonyora omotimoko kobua omonto oria,

english: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
ekegusii: nonya omonto oria ogochia komenya emiaka chilifu ibere, korende tanyora omogooko ase obogima bwaye. Inee! Abwo bonsi babere tibakogenda aase amo?

english: All the labour of man is for his mouth , and yet the appetite is not filled .
ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.

english: For what hath the wise more than the fool ? what hath the poor , that knoweth to walk before the living ?
ekegusii: Mbuya ki omonto omong’aini abwate kobua oyore omoriri? Gose ninki omonto omotaka akonyora, oria omanyete buna akwerenda ase abare moyo?

english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire : this is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
ekegusii: Eki amaiso aroche nigo kere buya kobua eki okogania ng’a okenyore. Ayio boigo mbosa, na okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa.

english: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Nase ki amatuko a kare arenge amaya kobua aya bono?” Okoboria okwo tikori okw’obong’aini.

english: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya buna omwando + 7:11 Omwando: Egento omonto akoegwa buna engeria , na nigo bogokonya abwo baroche erioba.

english: For wisdom is a defence , and money is a defence : but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotokonya buna chitaabu chigotokonya, korende obuya bw’omonyasemi mboria ng’a obong’aini nigo bokorenda obogima bw’oyio ong’ainiire.

english: Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?
ekegusii: Rengereria emeremo ya Nyasae! Ning’o oranyare korongeyia egento Omonene akorire borogochi?

english: In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao are amaya kabe nomogooko, na ekero are amabe rengereria ng’a Nyasae nere okorire ayio onsi abere, erinde omonto tabaisa komanya erirache komobwatia korwa magega yaye.

english: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .
ekegusii: Ase obogima obo bwane obore bosa narorire kera egento; narorire omonto omonyaboronge ogosira ore ase oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe okogenderera koba moyo amatuko amange ore ase ebibe biaye.

english: Be not righteous over much ; neither make thyself over wise : why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omooronge goetania, gose koba omong’aini goetania. Nase ki ogwesiria aye omonyene?

english: Be not over much wicked , neither be thou foolish : why shouldest thou die before thy time ?
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omobe goetania, gose tobaisa koba omoriri. Nase ki oganetie gokwa engaki yao etaraika?

english: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ng’a obwate ring’ana eri erimo, na totiga neria kabere, ekiagera omonto omoirogete Nyasae namanye eki agokora ase kera ring’ana.

english: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogokora abare abang’aini koba ne chinguru chibuete echi’abagaambi ikomi bare ase omochie oyomo.

english: It is better to go to the house of mourning , than to go to the house of feasting : for that is the end of all men ; and the living will lay it to his heart .
ekegusii: Mbuya kogenda ase enyomba y’ebirero kobua kogenda ase enyomba y’omoyega bw’okwegokia, ekiagera oyio noro omoerio o kera omonto, na abare moyo mbabeeke amang’ana aya ase chinkoro chiabo.

english: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not.
ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari aiga ase ense ore omooronge ogokora amaya otari gokora ebibe.

english: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotegerera amang’ana onsi abanto bagokwana, nigo orabaise koigwa omosomba oo ogokoragereria.

english: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others .
ekegusii: Aye omonyene nomanyete ase enkoro yao ng’a ase chingaki chinyinge kwabeire gokoragereria abanto bande.

english: All this have I proved by wisdom : I said , I will be wise ; but it was far from me.
ekegusii: Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateeba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa ase ’nde.

english: That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?
ekegusii: Amang’ana aria nigo akare aare mono, naende akare aatambe gochia inse, aatambe mono, ning’o oranyare koyatuka?

english: I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
ekegusii: Erio ngachaka korengereria imanye, na gotuka, na korigia obong’aini, na komanya buna ebinto bionsi bire; naende nkagania komanya obobe bw’oboriri, na oboriri obore obobarimo.

english: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
ekegusii: Erio nkanyora egento ekeroro kebuete amakweri. Egento ekio nakio omokungu enkoro yaye yarenge omotego, naende amaboko aye are chingataare. Omonto ogogetie Nyasae tari kobwatwa nomokuungu oyio, korende omonyabibe ere nigo akobwatwa.

english: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :
ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteeba iga: Naama! Amang’ana ayio nkayamanya, ekero nabeekeranetie ring’ana erimo ase erinde koyamanya onsi.

english: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
ekegusii: Aya nabeire nkona‐koyairanerera korigia komanya buna are, korende tindayamanya. Ase abanto elifu eyemo nkanyora omosacha oyomo, korende ase abwo bonsi tinanyorete omokungu nonya noyomo.

english: Lo , this only have I found , that God hath made man upright ; but they have sought out many inventions .
ekegusii: Naama! Egento gioka narigirie nanyorire neke: Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto bare abaikeranu, korende barabwo batukire chinchera chinyinge chi’okobaisanekia.

english: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
ekegusii: Omoichano nigo ore omuya kobua amaseko, ekiagera omoichano okororekana ase obosio nigo ogokora enkoro yaba nomogooko.

english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .
ekegusii: Chinkoro chi’abaanto abang’aini nigo chikoba ase enyomba y’ebirero, korende chinkoro chi’abariri nigo chire ase enyomba y’okwegokia.

english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .
ekegusii: Mbuya omonto gotegerera ogotogonyerwa kw’omonto omong’aini kobua gotegerera ogoteera kw’abariri.

english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .
ekegusii: Ogoseka kw’abariri nigo konga amagwa akoyia atoreka inse y’enyongo ere riko. Ayio boigo mbosa.

english: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .
ekegusii: Ekeene, emoko nigo ekoonchora omonto omong’aini oba omoriri, ne riaaki nigo rigosaria ebirengererio.

english: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .
ekegusii: Omoerio bw’egento nigo ore omuya kobua omochakano oye; na omonto omoremereria nigo are omuya kobua omonto omoenenu.

english: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .
ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna omonto omong’aini? Ning’o omanyete engencho y’amang’ana? Obong’aini nigo bogokora obosio bw’omonto bwagirigenta, nigo bokoonchora obokong’u bw’okororekana kwaye. Igwera Omorwoti

english: And so I saw the wicked buried , who had come and gone from the place of the holy , and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done : this is also vanity .
ekegusii: Nkarora abakori amabe batindekirwe batimogete, na ekero abanto bairanete korwa ase achenu nigo bare kobatogia agwo ase omochie. Ayio boigo mbosa.

english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .
ekegusii: Ase engencho obobe botari konacherwa ekiina bwango, chikoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chikwerua gokora ayare amabe.

english: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him:
ekegusii: Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng’a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.

english: But it shall not be well with the wicked , neither shall he prolong his days , which are as a shadow ; because he feareth not before God .
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe tibakonyora amaya ayio, gose obogima bwabo tibokoba obotambe. Nigo banga buna omorengari ogoeta, ekiagera tibamoirogete Nyasae.

english: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth ; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked ; again, there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous : I said that this also is vanity .
ekegusii: Nare amang’ana abosa kegima agokorekana aiga ase ense; mbareo abanto abanyaboronge bakonyorwa negesusuro ki’ogokora kw’abanyabibe, na boigo abanyabibe banyora obuya bw’ogokora kw’abanyaboronge. Ase ayio ngateeba, “Ayio boigo mbosa.”

english: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
ekegusii: Ngatogia omogooko, na nkarora ng’a Mwanyabaanto tabwati gento kende kere ekiya aiga inse y’erioba, otatiga arie na konywa, na kwegokia barabwo abanyene. Ayio naro aranyare kobeera asare ekero agendererete gokora emeremo emekong’u ase obogima obo are moyo, obo Nyasae amoeire aiga inse y’erioba.

english: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom , and to see the business that is done upon the earth : (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes :)
ekegusii: Ekero nabeegete ebirengererio biane komanya obong’aini na korora emeremo emekong’u abanto bagokora aiga ase ense, batari korara chitoro omobaso gose obotuko.

english: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
ekegusii: Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteeba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.

english: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment , and that in regard of the oath of God .
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkogosemia: Oigwere amang’ana omorwoti achiikire, ekiagera nkwarierete Nyasae eira.

english: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
ekegusii: Toayerera gotiga obokoreri ase obosio bwaye, na tobwatana nogokora okobe, ekiagera ere nigo agokora onsi ayanchete.

english: Where the word of a king is, there is power : and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’omorwoti nigo rire nokobua. Ning’o oranyare komobooria, “Aye ngento ki eke ogokora?”

english: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing : and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment .
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera amachiiko takonyorwa namabe, na enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomanya engaki na enchera y’okonacha boronge.

english: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment , therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
ekegusii: Kera ring’ana ndibwate engaki yaye na enchera yaye y’okonacha boronge, na emechando y’omonto nigo ekomoritoera.

english: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
ekegusii: Omonto tamanyeti ayagochia koba, na ning’o oranyare komoteebia buna amang’ana arabe?

english: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari obwate okobua igoro y’embeo, gose igoro ye rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye; ogotooreka tikori ase esegi, gose obobe tibogotooria abwo bakobokora. Ababe na abaronge

english: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo nayaroche ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane kwegera aya onsi agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba, ekero omonto oyomo akogambera omonto onde na komokorera bobe ase okomochanda.

english: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God : no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
ekegusii: Nkarengereria igoro y’amang’ana aya onsi, ngateema komanya buna abanyene oboronge na abare nobong’aini bare ase okoboko kwa Nyasae, amo nogokora kwabo, gokorabe okw’obwanchani gose ogw’okogecha. Monto onde tamanyeti amang’ana are bosio.

english: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do , do it with thy might ; for there is no work , nor device , nor knowledge , nor wisdom , in the grave , whither thou goest .
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi okoboko kwao koranyare gokora, gekore ne chinguru chiao chionsi; ekiagera agwo aase abakuure ase oragende, meremo ende tekaiyo, gose okorengereria, gose chisemi, gose obong’aini.

english: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill ; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
ekegusii: Nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a tari abwo bakominyoka bwango bakobua, gose ababwate chinguru tari barabwo bakobua esegi, gose abare nobong’aini tari barabwo bakonyora endagera, gose abare nokomanya tari barabwo babwate chinibo, gose abanyasemi tari barabwo bakonyora ogwancherwa; korende kera omonto nigo akonyorwa nengaki yaye na egesio kiaye.

english: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Mwanyabaanto onde tamanyeti engaki ya mabe. Buna koreng’ana chinswe chikobwatwa ase ekeonga ase egesio ekebe, ne chinyoni ase obosugunia, naboigo na Mwanyabaanto bakonyorwa nengaki embe, babwatwa mobosokano. Ebirengererio bi’obong’aini na ebi’oboriri

english: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me:
ekegusii: Nainde amang’ana aya naro naroche igoro y’obong’aini aiga inse y’erioba, naro akarorekana ase ’nde ng’a namanene;

english: There was a little city , and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
ekegusii: Norenge omochie omoke omenyire nabaanto abake; omorwoti orenge omonene mono agacha koyorwania esegi; akayonaaria, akaagacha chiburi + 9:14 Chiburi: chinyasi chietaneine omochie echio chikoyokenga korwa ase ababe chinene chi’ogwekengera ase okoyorwania.

english: Now there was found in it a poor wise man , and he by his wisdom delivered the city ; yet no man remembered that same poor man .
ekegusii: Korende ase omochie oyio akanyorekana aroro omonto omotaka orenge omong’aini, na ase obong’aini bwaye agatooria omochie oria. Nonya naboigo, monto onde tari oinyorete omotaka oria.

english: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya mbobuete chinguru, nonya obong’aini bw’omonto oria omotaka bwachayetwe, na amang’ana aye tarenge koigwerwa.”

english: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gotegerera amang’ana omonto omong’aini agokwana ase obotoereru kobua gotegerera amang’ana ’omogambi ogoaka eriogi ase egati y’abanto abariri.

english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war : but one sinner destroyeth much good .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua ebirwanero bi’esegi; korende omonyabibe oyomo nigo agosaria amaya amange.

english: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous , and to the wicked ; to the good and to the clean , and to the unclean ; to him that sacrificeth , and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good , so is the sinner ; and he that sweareth , as he that feareth an oath .
ekegusii: Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing’wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y’ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y’ogotiana.

english: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .
ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na magega y’ayio nigo bakogeenda ase abakuure.

english: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .
ekegusii: Korende omonto ore ase egati y’abare moyo nare nogosemeria, na esese ere moyo nigo ekonyora amaya kobua endo ekwete.

english: For the living know that they shall die : but the dead know not any thing , neither have they any more a reward ; for the memory of them is forgotten .
ekegusii: Ee, abare moyo mbamanyete ng’a mbakwe, korende abakuure tibamanyeti gento kende, na tibagenderereti konyora eng’eria; tibakoinyorwa nonya ndinde.

english: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwabo, na okogecha, ne ribero, bionsi ebio nigo biasirete amo nabarabwo. Tibabwati nonya ng’ake egetari kende ase ayio agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba.

english: Go thy way , eat thy bread with joy , and drink thy wine with a merry heart ; for God now accepteth thy works .
ekegusii: Aye bono genda, orie endagera yao nomogooko, na onywe edivai yao kore nomosasoko ase enkoro yao, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire emeremo yao.

english: Let thy garments be always white ; and let thy head lack no ointment .
ekegusii: Tiga chianga chiao chibe chindabu botambe, na amaguta okweakwa tamocha ase omotwe oo.

english: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity , which he hath given thee under the sun , all the days of thy vanity : for that is thy portion in this life , and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima obo bore bosa, obo Nyasae akoeire omenye aiga inse y’erioba, omenye nomogooko amo nomokuungu oo bwanchete. Okomenya nomogooko, nakio egetari kiao ase obogima obo, ekero ogendererete gwechanda ase emeremo emekong’u inse y’erioba.

english: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him:
ekegusii: ng’a ase ekero ki’ogoikeranigwa kw’engaaki nabeekeranie ebinto bionsi bibe n’obomo ase Kristo, ebinto bire igoro, na ebire ase ense, ase ere oyio.

english: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance , being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will :
ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng’ana buna twachooretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oy’okorete onsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye,

english: That we should be to the praise of his glory , who first trusted in Christ .
ekegusii: erinde intwe abatwatang’anete komosemeria Kristo togere obonene bwaye botogigwe.

english: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
ekegusii: Ase ere oyio, inwe abamwaigure ring’ana ri’ekeene, enchiri y’ogotooreka kwaino, na komwaikire komwegena ere, mokabekwa ekemanyererio n’Omoika Omochenu, oria mwarieretwe eira.

english: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .
ekegusii: Oyo nere ore intenenera ase omwando oito, goika okoboorigwa kw’abare aba Nyasae, ase ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwaye. Ogosaba gwa Paulo

english: Wherefore I also , after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus , and love unto all the saints ,
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero naigwete amang’ana y’okwegena kwaino more nakorokwo ase Omonene Yeso, na obwanchani bwaino ase abachenu bonsi,

english: Cease not to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ;
ekegusii: tintigeti koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, na kobainyora ase ogosaba kw’ane.

english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him :
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a Nyasae Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata Obonene, abae omoika bw’obong’aini na bw’okomaanorerwa, erinde momomanye;

english: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened ; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling , and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints ,
ekegusii: naende ng’a amaiso ye chinkoro chiaino abekwe omobaso, erinde momanye ogosemeria koria abarangereretie monyore, na komanya obonda bw’obonene bw’omwando oye buna bore, obo abachenu baeirwe.

english: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe , according to the working of his mighty power ,
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a momanye obonene bw’okobua kwaye botari nekerengo, obo bwatoikeire intwe abatwegenire koreng’ana nogokora gw’okobua kwaye okonene.

english: Grace be to you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa kw’omoika ase Kristo

english: Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :
ekegusii: igoro mono kobua okogaamba gwonsi, na okobua, ne chinguru, na oborwoti, na igoro ya kera erieta rigwatorwa, tari ase ense eye yoka, korende neria egochia‐gocha boigo.

english: Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .
ekegusii: eyio ere omobere oye, ogoikerania kwaye ere oyogoikerania ebinto bionsi ase bonsi.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :
ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw’omoika aase aaria igoro,

english: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :
ekegusii: buna atochoorete ase ere ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, erinde tobe abachenu, totari na komocha ase obosio bwaye.

english: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his will ,
ekegusii: Ase obwanchani bwaye Nyasae atochorete korwa kare, erinde tokorwe koba abana baye ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, koreng’ana nokogania kw’ogwancha kwaye,

english: To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
ekegusii: erinde obonene bw’obuya bwaye botogigwe, obo atoeire buna ekeegwa ase Omwanchwa oye.

english: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence ;
ekegusii: obo ere akabomenta ase tore ase chiseemi na obong’aini bwonsi.

english: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :
ekegusii: Nyasae agatomanyia obobisi bw’ogwancha kwaye, koreng’ana nokogania kwaye buna aroberetie ase Kristo,

english: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus unto good works , which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them .
ekegusii: Inaki nigo tore emeremo y’amaboko aye, togatongwa ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tokore ogokora okuya okwo Nyasae aroisetie ritang’ani, erio totaare ime ase okwo. Abamo na Kristo

english: Wherefore remember , that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh , who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwareenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingeencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa n’amaboko.

english: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a engaki eria timwareenge na Kristo, nigo mwatananekanete korwa ase obobiare bw’Abaisraeli, abageni b’okobwatana kw’eira, motareenge na gosemeria konde, na motareenge na gosemeria na Nyasae ase ense.

english: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ .
ekegusii: Korende bono, ase Kristo Yeso, inwe abamwareenge are agwo ritang’ani, mwarentirwe ang’e n’amanyinga a Kristo.

english: For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nomorembe oito, otokorete intwe, Abayahudi n’Abagiliki, koba oyomo, goetera ase omobere oye agatagora etoto eria yatwatananete, engencho yaye obobisa.

english: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father .
ekegusii: Inaki goeteera ase Kristo intwe twensi Abayahudi amo n’abanto b’ebisaku twanyorire enchera y’okomoika ang’e na Tata, ase Omoika oyomo.

english: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners , but fellowcitizens with the saints , and of the household of God ;
ekegusii: Gaki korwa bono inwe abanto b’ebisaku timori abamenyi gose abaeti, korende mwabeire ababiare amo n’abachenu, abanto b’enyomba ya Nyasae,

english: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :
ekegusii: Ime ase ebio nigo mwabigendererete kare ase ogotunyana chingeencho chi’ense eye, na gotunyana omogambi bw’okobua kwa igoro gati, oyore omoika oria ogokora emeremo ase abanto bataigwereti Nyasae.

english: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;
ekegusii: mwagaachirwe igoro y’oboroso bw’abatomwa na ababani, na Kristo Yeso omonyene nere rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

english: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :
ekegusii: Ase are ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwataniigwe amo, na gokiina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.

english: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
ekegusii: Asere inwe boigo mw’agaachirwe amo, mobe obomenyo bwa Nyasae, ase Omoika.

english: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe twensi twagendete agwo kare ase okogania gwe chingeencho chiaito chimbe, togaikerania okogania kw’emebere yaito, na ebirengererio biaito, tokaba ase chingeencho chiaito; abanto abaragwe ase endamwamu ya Nyasae buna abwo bande.

english: But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyore n’obonge bw’amaabera, ase obwanchani bwaye obonene atwanchete,

english: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , (by grace ye are saved ;)
ekegusii: nonya n’ekero keria twareenge tokwete ase ogosaria gwaito, agatoa obogima amo na Kristo; inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

english: And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :
ekegusii: Naende agatobookia amo nere, agatoikaransia amo nere aaria igoro ase Kristo Yeso,

english: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: erinde ase ebiro biraache naorokie obonda bw’obuya bwaye, obo boetete ekerengo, ase obwororo ase tore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: For by grace are ye saved through faith ; and that not of yourselves : it is the gift of God :
ekegusii: Inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y’okwegena; ayio tarwete ase more abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae;

english: Not of works , lest any man should boast .
ekegusii: gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde taacha gwetogia.

english: For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
ekegusii: Inaki ase ayio inche Paulo nabeire omosibwa o Kristo Yeso ase engencho yaino, inwe abanto b’Ebisaku.

english: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God ,
ekegusii: erinde bono, ase enchera y’ekanisa, obong’aini bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingeencho chinyinge, bomanyekane n’abagaambi na abare nokobua kwa igoro.

english: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :
ekegusii: Nabo kwareenge okorigia kwaye gwa kare na kare, okwo aikeranetie ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

english: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .
ekegusii: Asere ntore noboremu na ogosemeria kw’ogosoa ase enchera y’okomwegena.

english: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
ekegusii: Gaki nabasabire, timokwa emioyo ase engencho y’ogochaandwa kw’ane inde nakwo ase engencho yaino, okore obonene bwaino. Obwanchani bwa Kristo

english: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio namobekeire amaru aane inse Tata,

english: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named ,
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abakorwa ase Tata, abare igoro na abare ase ense, nigo bakorokwa ase erieta riaye.

english: That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a koreng’ana nobonda bw’obonene bwaye, abanchere momentwe chinguru ase okobua goeteera ase Omoika oye ase omonto o ime;

english: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith ; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love ,
ekegusii: na Kristo amenye ase chinkoro chiaino komwamwegenire. Nasabire ng’a inwe komor’abe n’emeri na oboroso ase obwanchani,

english: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;
ekegusii: monyaare koba ne chinguru ase okomanya amo nabachenu bonsi obogare na obotambe, na gochia igoro, na gochia inse,

english: And to know the love of Christ , which passeth knowledge , that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God .
ekegusii: na komanya obwanchani bwa Kristo oboetete okomanya, erinde monyaare goichorigwa ogoichorwa gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

english: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
ekegusii: Ase ekeene mwaigure amang’ana y’oborendi bw’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo naetwe ase engencho yaino.

english: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,
ekegusii: Gaki, ase are ere oyoranyaare gokora goetania mono kobua aya togosaba gose aya tokorengereria, koreng’ana ne chinguru chigokora emeremo ime ase tore,

english: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages , world without end . Amen .
ekegusii: ase are ere obonene ase ekanisa na ase Kristo Yeso goika ebigori bionsi kare na kare. Amina.

english: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery ; ( as I wrote afore in few words ,
ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa nateebetigwe obobisi boria buna nabariikera reero iga ase amang’ana amake.

english: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;
ekegusii: Obobisi obo Nyasae tamanyetie Mwanyabaanto ase ebigori binde buna bono ase Omoika abaigoreire abatomwa baye abachenu na ababani.

english: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs , and of the same body , and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel :
ekegusii: Obobisi boria nobo, ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku babeire abanyamwando amo naintwe, ebiimo bi’omobere oyomo, na ababwatani amo naintwe ase eira ere ase Kristo Yeso ase enchera y’enchiri.

english: Whereof I was made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power .
ekegusii: Nabo ’ngakorwa koba omosomba bw’enchiri eye koreng’ana nekeegwa ki’obuya bwa Nyasae obo naetwe ase ogokora gw’okobua kwaye.

english: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
ekegusii: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo ’nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.

english: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Nkaegwa kobaorokereria abanto bonsi barore omooroberio bw’obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase Nyasae, oyotongete ebinto bionsi;

english: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche omosibwa ase engencho y’Omonene nabasoroire mogenderere buna egwenerete okorangerigwa kwaino mwarangereretigwe

english: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things .)
ekegusii: Oyoigete nere oyio ogendete boigo igoro ya igoro, erinde ebinto bionsi biichorwe nere.)

english: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;
ekegusii: Ere akarua abande babe abatomwa, na abande ababani, na abande abarandia, na abande abarisia, na abande aboorokia.

english: For the perfecting of the saints , for the work of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :
ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y’obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.

english: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :
ekegusii: Nabo goika intwe twensi tonyaare goikera obomo bw’okwegena, na komanya mono Omwana o Nyasae, na koba omonto omoikeranu, goika ekerengo ki’ogokiina kw’ogoichorwa gwa Kristo;

english: That we henceforth be no more children , tossed to and fro , and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the sleight of men , and cunning craftiness , whereby they lie in wait to deceive ;
ekegusii: erinde titoba naende abana ebing’werere, bagotumatumigwa aaria na aaria, na koirurukigwa ase kera embeo y’okworokereria, ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto, ekero bakobang’aina kobwatia chiinchera chi’okobasiria.

english: But speaking the truth in love , may grow up into him in all things , which is the head , even Christ :
ekegusii: Korende tokwane ekeene ase obwanchani, tokiine goika toikere Kristo ase chiinchera chionsi; nere ore omotwe.

english: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,
ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde ring’ana eri, na koba kirori ase Omonene; korwa bono timogeenda buna abanto b’Ebisaku bakogeenda ase ebirengorerio biabo bitari nengeencho.

english: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :
ekegusii: Obong’aini bwabo bwabekirwe omosunte, barusananiigwe korwa ase obogima bwa Nyasae ekiagera ase ogotamanya koria kore ime ase bare ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo.

english: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo chiabeire n’amagandi, bebeekire ase chingeencho chiimbe chi’omobere, erio ase obwegimeria banyaare gokora kera engencho y’eubi.

english: But ye have not so learned Christ ;
ekegusii: Korende inwe timworokereretigwe komomanya Kristo ase enchera eyio.

english: If so be that ye have heard him , and have been taught by him , as the truth is in Jesus :
ekegusii: Inwe mwamoigwete na kworokererigwa nere, buna ekeene kere ime ase Yeso.

english: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind ;
ekegusii: mokorwe abayia ase emeika na ebirengererio biaino,

english: Neither give place to the devil .
ekegusii: gose timoa Saitani ribaga.

english: Let him that stole steal no more : but rather let him labour , working with his hands the thing which is good , that he may have to give to him that needeth .
ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.

english: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth , but that which is good to the use of edifying , that it may minister grace unto the hearers .
ekegusii: Ogokwana okobe tikorua ase emenwa yaino, korende okore okuya na okoranyaare kobaa obuya abwo bagokoigwa na koagaacha abaganeirie koagaachwa.

english: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .
ekegusii: Mokore omokia konyora obomo bw’Omoika ase egesibo ki’omorembe.

english: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God , whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption .
ekegusii: Gose timoichania Omoika Omochenu o Nyasae, ase are ere oyomwabegetwe ekemanyererio goika rituko ri’okoboorigwa.

english: Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :
ekegusii: Obororo bwonsi, na endamwamu, na okobea, na eriomana, na emerumi birusigwe ase more, amo n’obobe bwonsi.

english: There is one body , and one Spirit , even as ye are called in one hope of your calling ;
ekegusii: Omobere n’oyoomo, na Omoika n’oyoomo, buna mwarangeretigwe ase ogosemeria okomo gw’okorangerigwa kwaino.

english: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,
ekegusii: Omonene oyomo, okwegena okomo, ebatiso eyemo,

english: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .
ekegusii: Nyasae oyomo, ore Tata o bonsi, ere ore igoro ase bonsi, goetera ase bonsi, na ime ase bonsi.

english: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .
ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oito naetwe obuya koreng’ana n’ekerengo gi’ekeegwa gia Kristo.

english: ( Now that he ascended , what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth ?
ekegusii: (Gaki, ring’ana eri, “Ageendete igoro”, engencho yaye inki otatiga naboigo aigete nonya ngoika ensemo yainse y’ense?

english: Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobe abegi ba Nyasae, buna abana abanchwa;

english: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord .
ekegusii: Teema mono komanya ekeragwenere Omonene.

english: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
ekegusii: Timosaanga n’ogokora kw’omosuunte ogotakwama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mokoorokie,

english: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret .
ekegusii: ekiagera nobosooku nonya nogokwana amang’ana ayio agokorwa nabarabwo bobisi.

english: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
ekegusii: Korende onsi ayaorokigwe nomobaso nigo are maiso marore, ekiagera kera egento ekere maiso marore nigo kere omobaso.

english: Wherefore he saith , Awake thou that sleepest , and arise from the dead , and Christ shall give thee light .
ekegusii: Ase ayio oteebire, “Booka aye osundogete, booka korwa ase abakuure, na Kristo nakobarerie.”

english: See then that ye walk circumspectly , not as fools , but as wise ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, rigereria mono buna mogotaara, tari buna abanto batari n’obong’aini, korende buna abare n’obong’aini.

english: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, timoba abariri, korende mobe abanto bakomanya buna ogwancha kw’Omonene kore.

english: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
ekegusii: Naende timotinda ase edivai, ekiagera ase eyio inamoirwe ase obonyaka, korende moichorwe n’Omoika.

english: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
ekegusii: mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono amatuko onsi, ase amang’ana onsi, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

english: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God .
ekegusii: Mosikane inwe ase inwe ase okomoiroka Kristo. Abakungu na abasacha (Abakol 3:18—4:1)

english: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
ekegusii: Inaki omosacha nomotwe bw’omokuungu, buna Kristo are omotwe bw’ekanisa; ere omonyene n’Omotooria bw’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.

english: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ , so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing .
ekegusii: Korende buna ekanisa eigwerete Kristo, naboigo nabakungu baigwere abasacha babo ase kera ring’ana.

english: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word ,
ekegusii: erio anyare koyechena ase okoyesibia ase amaache na ase ring’ana,

english: That he might present it to himself a glorious church , not having spot , or wrinkle , or any such thing ; but that it should be holy and without blemish .
ekegusii: erinde anyare kwenyorera ekanisa y’obonene, etari na kemoa gose omonia, gose rinde rionsi buna aya, korende ebe enchenu etari na kemoa.

english: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .
ekegusii: Naboigo egwenerete abasacha banche abakungu babo buna emebere yabo abanyene. Oyobwanchete mok’aye bweanchire ere omonyene.

english: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :
ekegusii: Inaki omonto taiyo ogeechete omobere oye omonyene, korende nigo akoyorageria na koyorenda, buna Kristo akorageria ekanisa,

english: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
ekegusii: Korende, buna egwenerete abachenu, obotomani na eubi yonsi, gose obwegimeria, tibiatorwa ase egati yaino nonya ng’ake.

english: For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo tore ebiimo bi’omobere oye.

english: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .
ekegusii: Obo nobobisi obonene; korende ngokwana nde amang’ana a Kristo na ekanisa.

english: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself ; and the wife see that she reverence her husband .
ekegusii: Korende kera omonto anche mok’aye buna eanchete ere omonyene; na omokungu tamocha gosika omosacha oye.

english: Neither filthiness , nor foolish talking , nor jesting , which are not convenient : but rather giving of thanks .
ekegusii: Motige kegima amang’ana amabe, gose ay’oboriri, gose obosekereria, aya’atagwenereti; korende mbuya kobua koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

english: For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .
ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasiimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oborwoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae. Taara buna abana b’omobaso

english: Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .
ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase amang’ana atari nengeencho, ekiagera ase aya endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo ekobaachera abanto b’ogotaigwera.

english: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timosaanga nabarabwo.

english: For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :
ekegusii: Inaki kare nigo mwareenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogeenderere buna abana b’omobaso

english: ( For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth ;)
ekegusii: (inaki okwama kw’omobaso nigo gokonyorekana ase obuya bwonsi, na ase oboronge, na ase ekeene).

english: Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .
ekegusii: Omoerio, motenene bokong’u ase Omonene, na ase chinguru chi’okobua kwaye.

english: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
ekegusii: Eboyie ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare gotenena korwania obong’ainereria bwa Saitani.

english: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , agains the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .
ekegusii: Inaki okoamererania gwaito tikori ase abare n’amanyinga ne chinyama, korende igoro y’abagaambi na abare nokobua, igoro y’abanene b’omosuunte bw’ense eye, na igoro y’emegaanda y’ebirecha ebibe bire igoro.

english: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bogoria ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare koamererania ase rituko ri’obobe, na komwaikeranirie onsi, motenene.

english: Above all , taking the shield of faith , wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked .
ekegusii: Kobua onsi bogoria enguba y’okwegena, ase eyio namonyaare korimia emegwe yonsi y’omorero y’oria omobe.

english: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit , and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints ;
ekegusii: Mosabe botambe ase Omoika ase ogosaba gwonsi na ase okoboria kw’ogosorora, na gotagesia ase kera ring’ana. Mogenderere gosabera abachenu bonsi.

english: And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
ekegusii: Monsabere nainche, ng’egwe amang’ana ase ogokwana n’oboremu, erinde ndandie obobisi bw’enchiri.

english: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo inde oyo otometwe nsibire ebinyuri, inyore oboremu bw’ogokwana amang’ana buna ngwenerete gokwana. Amang’ana y’ogokoorera (Abakol 4:7-8)

english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose , that ye might know our affairs , and that he might comfort your hearts .
ekegusii: Namotomire ase more ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde monyaare komanya buna tore; na ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.

english: Peace be to the brethren , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase abaminto, na obwanchani amo nokwegena bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.

english: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity . Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo na bonsi abamwanchete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo n’obwanchani botari gosareka.

english: That it may be well with thee , and thou mayest live long on the earth .
ekegusii: “erinde ebe buya ase ore, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense.”

english: Not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but as the servants of Christ , doing the will of God from the heart ;
ekegusii: gose tari ase obosomba bw’okwegwenia ase amaiso ya Mwanyabaanto, korende buna abasomba ba Kristo, mogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase chinkoro chiaino;

english: With good will doing service , as to the Lord , and not to men :
ekegusii: ase omoyo omuya mogokorera Omonene, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.

english: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth , the same shall he receive of the Lord , whether he be bond or free .
ekegusii: Naende momanye ng’a ring’ana rigiya omonto agokora, naegwe erio erio n’Omonene, k’arabe omosomba, gose omosibore.

english: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Ahaswero akarusia ebango ase abanto b’ense yaye, na ase ebisinka bie chinyancha.

english: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro y’ogokora kwaye gwonsi, na okobua kwaye, amo namang’ana onsi buna aimokereretie Moredekai igoro, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’abarwoti b’Abamedia na ab’Abaayemi.

english: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus , and great among the Jews , and accepted of the multitude of his brethren , seeking the wealth of his people , and speaking peace to all his seed .
ekegusii: Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, nere orenge oyo o kabere ase omorwoti Ahaswero. Nigo arenge omonene ase Abayahudi, osikire nabamwabo bonsi, ekiagera nigo arenge korigia amaya ase abanto baye, na akerua ase okobarentera omorembe.

english: On the seventh day , when the heart of the king was merry with wine , he commanded Mehuman , Biztha , Harbona , Bigtha , and Abagtha , Zethar , and Carcas , the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king ,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omoyega oyio, omorwoti kanyure edivai akaba nomosasoko ase enkoro yaye. Ase ayio akarangeria Mehumani na Bisita, Haribona na Bigita, Abagita na Setari, na Karikasi, abakoreri baye batano na babere abagombaetigwe, abwo barenge komokorera ere ase enyomba yaye,

english: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
ekegusii: akabachika barente Vasti eting’ana achiche ase obosio bwaye obegete egutwa y’oborwoti. Vasti nigo arenge omokungu omonyakieni mono; ase igo omorwoti akagania amoorokie ase abanto bonsi na ase abanene barenge agwo, erinde bamorore.

english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him.
ekegusii: Abasomba baria b’omorwoti bakairera Vasti amang’ana ayio, korende ere akaanga koigwera ogochika kw’omorwoti. Ayio akagera omorwoti akaba nendamwamu enene mono yarenge gwoka ime yaye buna omorero.

english: Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , (for so was the king’s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
ekegusii: Nigo yarenge engencho y’omorwoti arigie ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abang’aini bamanyete amachiiko, naende bamanyete kogamba ebiina. Ase ayio akarangeria abanto abasemia, baria bamanyete ebimanyererio bie chingaki.

english: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king’s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom ;)
ekegusii: Abanto anarete koboria botambe nabwo aba: Karisena na Setari, Adimata na Tarisisi, Meresi na Marisena, na Memukani. Aba batano na babere nigo barenge abagaambi korwa ase ense y’Ayemi, na eya Media, naende nabwo barenge nebirogo ebinene ase obogambi bwaye.

english: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia abanto baria, “Inche omorwoti Ahaswero natoma abasomba baria baane, nabachika barente Vasti eting’ana ase ’nde, korende ere bwanga koigwera ogochika okwo. Inee! Ngento ki agwenerete akorerwe kobwatekana nogochika?”

english: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
ekegusii: Erio Memukani agateebia omorwoti na abanene bonsi, “Vasti eting’ana tari ng’a nomorwoti bweka amocheire, korende omocheire abanene bonsi, na abanto bonsi bare ase chingongo chionsi echio aye omorwoti Ahaswero okogambera.

english: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.
ekegusii: Ogokora oko eting’ana yakorire goise komanyekana ase abakungu bonsi, nigo koragere abakungu bande bachaye abasacha babo, bateebe: Omorwoti Ahaswero nachika abasomba baye barente Vasti eting’ana asare, korende Vasti akaanga, tacha ase omorwoti.

english: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king’s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero ritaraera, abakungu b’abanene bonsi b’Abaayemi na ab’Abamedia mbabe bakoigwa aya eting’ana yakorire, na igo bagochia koyateebia abanene bonsi ase obogambi, na ogochaayana okonene nigo kogochia koba amo nokoengererania okonene.

english: If it please the king , let there go a royal commandment from him , and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes , that it be not altered , That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus ; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti koranche orue ogochika kw’oborwoti ng’a Vasti tabaisa kororekana ogocha ase obosio bwao nonya ndinde rionsi, aye omorwoti Ahaswero. Orike ogochika okwo ase amachiiko ’Abaayemi na ay’Abamedia ariikire, erinde ayio tanyara koonchorwa. Aye omorwoti ochore omokungu omoao obwenerete kobua Vasti, omoe obonene obwo bw’oborwoti.

english: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero Ahaswero omorwoti arenge goikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti aaria ase eburi ya Susa, amang’ana aya naro arenge gokoreka.

english: And when the king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire , (for it is great ,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour , both to great and small .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ’ogochika okwo kw’omorwoti arararigwe ase oborwoti obo obonene, abakungu bonsi, abanene na abake, mbabe bagosika abasacha babo.”

english: And the saying pleased the king and the princes ; and the king did according to the word of Memucan :
ekegusii: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

english: For he sent letters into all the king’s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .
ekegusii: Erio agatoma amarube gochia ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwaye. Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo, goteeba ng’a kera omosacha abe okogamba ase enka yaye, naende abe ogokwana nabaanto baye ase omonwa bw’egesaku kiaye.

english: In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him:
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwaye agakora omoyega omonene ase abanene bonsi amo nabatang’ani abarenge ase obogambi bwaye. Akarangeria abatang’ani b’abasikari b’Abaayemi, na ab’Abamedia, na abanene amo nabagaambi be chingongo chiaye.

english: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .
ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe y’emetienyi etano nomo (6), omorwoti akaba okworokia abanto abwo obonda na obonene bw’oborwoti bwaye, obwo bw’ogosika okonene.

english: And when these days were expired , the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace , both unto great and small , seven days , in the court of the garden of the king’s palace ;
ekegusii: Amatuko ayio kaerire, akaroisia omoyega omonene ase abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, abarenge agwo Susa, omochie omonene. Omoyega oyio okabeera ase eraaro y’egeticha yagiteire, yarenge ase enyomba y’omorwoti, na okagenderera ase amatuko atano na abere.

english: Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .
ekegusii: Aase agwo nigo achabeire nobwari obonge: ebitambaa ebirabu na ebiare buru, bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase egatani. Ebitambaa ebio nigo biasungeire ne chingori chindabu ne chimonyinga, chiaroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya. Chingori echio nigo chiasoirie ase chibonyi chi’echifeta chiarenge ase chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu akomeka‐meka ye rigori rinene. Ebiikaransero biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu ne chifeta nigo biabekire inse aase atichire n’amagena akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene, amarabu na amabariri, na ayare buna obonyansi na amamwamu.

english: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , (the vessels being diverse one from another ,) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .
