ekegusii: Omonene konya oeire abanto abwo ogwancherwa ase Abamisiri, na barabwo bakabaa kende gionsi eki baganetie. Ase enchera eye bagasakora Abamisiri. Abaisraeli bakong’anya korwa Misiri

english: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth , about six hundred thousand on foot that were men , beside children .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamanora kogenda namagoro korwa Ramesesi, bagaika Sukoti. Nigo barenge abasacha koreng’ana chilifu amagana atano na rimo (600,000), abakungu na abana tibaabaretwe.

english: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks , and herds , even very much cattle .
ekegusii: Na omoganda omonene mono bw’abaanto b’ebisaku ao ao bakagenda komo, bakairana ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitugo chinde chinyinge mono.

english: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt , for it was not leavened ; because they were thrust out of Egypt , and could not tarry , neither had they prepared for themselves any victual .
ekegusii: Ase obosie boria konya botarabekwa memera obwo barentanete korwa Misiri bakaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Ememera tiyarengeo, ekiagera nigo baseretigwe korwa Misiri ase obwango, bataranyora ribaga koroisia endagera bagochia koria.

english: And if the household be too little for the lamb , let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls ; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb .
ekegusii: Korende onye abanto b’enyomba eyemo bare abake, batanyare koria emanwa eria bayekoore, rirorio ere na omogisangio oye, oyobasinyaine, basangere emanwa eyemo, koreng’ana buna omobaro bw’abaanto bareo. Ase kera emanwa goika mobare abanto abarache koyeria koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aranyare koria.

english: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years , even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio riomoerio bwe emiaka eyio amagana ane, na emerongo etato, emeganda yonsi y’Omonene ekang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

english: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .
ekegusii: Obotuko obwo nigo bwarenge obotuko bw’okorenda, ekero Omonene arenge ang’e ase okong’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Obwo nobotuko Omonene, bogwenerete korendwa n’Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare. Omoroberio bw’Epasaka

english: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron , This is the ordinance of the passover : There shall no stranger eat thereof:
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Omoroberio bw’Epasaka noro oyo: Omonto omomenyi tabaisa koyeria,

english: But every man’s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
ekegusii: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.

english: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
ekegusii: Omogeni omenyete ase more, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.

english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli goika osange omoyega oyio.

english: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
ekegusii: Onye omomenyi omenyete bwoo bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene, ere na abasacha bonsi abare amo nere goika barokigwe. Erio anyare koria Epasaka, na ere abe buna omobiare oino. Korende onde bwensi otarokiri tayeria.

english: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo ase omobiare bw’Abaisraeli na omomenyi oyomenyete ase egati yaino.”

english: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
ekegusii: Mochore emanwa y’omwaka oyomo etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe eng’ondi gose embori.

english: Thus did all the children of Israel ; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bagakora buna Omonene achigete Musa na Aroni.

english: And it came to pass the selfsame day , that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio eri’Omonene akang’anyia emeganda yonsi y’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

english: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .
ekegusii: Mochigache goika rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyio. Agwo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bachinyenye mogoroba.

english: And they shall take of the blood , and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses , wherein they shall eat it.
ekegusii: Barabwo baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.

english: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo barie chinyama chiria chisambire nomorero, amo nemegati etabekiri memera, ne chinyeni chindoro.

english: Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof.
ekegusii: Timoria chinde imbese gose chiyekire ase amaache, korende chionsi goika chisambwe nomorero amo nomotwe na ebirenge, ne chinyama chianda.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses , saying ,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,

english: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika oko goika korende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echiikire.” Abana abatangi ne ching’iti chintangi

english: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee,
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene arakorae na kogoikia ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio akorierete eira, aye amo ne chisokoro chiao, na akoyee,

english: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb ; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck : and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem .
ekegusii: Korende kera emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria goika oyebune ebigoti. Kera omwana omoisia omotangi o Mwanyabaanto goika omoboorie.

english: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :
ekegusii: Engaki erache omwana oo karakoborie: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki? Goika omoiranerie: Ase okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru Omonene agatong’anyia korwa Misiri agwo ase twarenge abasomba.

english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix , being males ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
ekegusii: Naki ekero Farao akong’etie enkoro yaye akaanga gotoa ribaga kogenda, Omonene agaita kera omwana omotangi ase ense ya Misiri amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi. Nakio gekogera nkoruera Omonene kera eng’iti entangi ye tugo yane, na omwana one omomura omotangi nigo nkomobooria.

english: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya goika abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao na ase obosio bwao, ekiagera Omonene natorusetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.” Riire na omorero

english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :
ekegusii: Ekero Farao aete Abasiraeli ribaga bagende, Nyasae tabaraete baetere ense y’Abafilisti, nonya enchera eyio yarenge omobutokanio. Nyasae nigo arengereretie ng’a aande onye abanto aba bagochia koumera esegi mbaabaisa koirana Misiri.

english: But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabaraa goetanana ase erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri. Na Abaisraeli bakarua ase ense ya Misiri bare nebirwanero bi’esegi.

english: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bakarua Sukoti, bagatoora agwo Etamu aase erooro echakerete.

english: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light ; to go by day and night :
ekegusii: Omonene akaba okobatang’ana, mobaso ase riire riare buna esiiro koborokia enchera, na botuko ase omorero orenge buna esiiro kobaa oborabu, erio barore ase bakogenda, omobaso na obotuko.

english: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .
ekegusii: Riire riria riare kobaraa mobaso nigo riarenge bosio bwabo botambe, na omorero botuko, toruete ase amasio abo.

english: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage ; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abanto, “Mobe mokoinyora rituko eri mwang’anyete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eyio mwarenge abasomba, ekiagera Omonene abang’anyetie korwa agwo nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru. Ase rituko erio omogati obekire ememera toriegwa.

english: This day came ye out in the month Abib .
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero ase omotienyi bw’Abibu nario mokong’anya korwa aa.

english: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey , that thou shalt keep this service in this month .
ekegusii: Omonene nabarierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabae ense y’Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Eyio nense entenenku ere namabeere na obooke. Ekero arabaikie agwo goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke ase omotienyi oyio.

english: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera; ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.

english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .
ekegusii: Emegati etabekiri memera eriegwe ase amatuko atano na abere. Emegati ebekire ememera, gose ememera emenyene, tibirorekana ase ense yaino engima.

english: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ekero mogochaka omoyega, ase rituko erio moteebie abana baino buna nigo mogokora ayio onsi ase okoinyora ay’Omonene abakorerete ekero abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.

english: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand , and for a memorial between thine eyes , that the LORD’s law may be in thy mouth : for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao, na ase obosio bwao abe ekeinyorio kegokoinyoria, erinde ogenderere gokwana amachiiko y’Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nakong’anyetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.

english: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barigereretie magega bakarora Farao na abarwani baye b’esegi bakobabwatia korwa magega, erio agwo barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene, bakarera ase Omonene.

english: And they said unto Moses , Because there were no graves in Egypt , hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness ? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt ?
ekegusii: Erio bagateebia Musa, “Inee! Chimbeera tichiarenge Misiri? Nase ayio ogatorenta toche gokwera aa ase erooro? Igo gwatokorera bobe ekero gwatorusia korwa Misiri!

english: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt , saying , Let us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians , than that we should die in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Titwagotebetie ayio aaria Misiri? Tokagoteebia ng’a: Totige tokorere Abamisiri. Naki anga mbuya tware gokorera Abamisiri kobua gokwera aiga ase erooro.”

english: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not, stand still , and see the salvation of the LORD , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia Abaisraeli, “Timwoboa, motenene bokong’u reero morore buna Omonene arabatoorie; naki Abamisiri abamorooche reero iga, timokobarora naende nonya ng’ake.

english: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace .
ekegusii: Omonene nabarwanere inwe, na inwe mokire‐kiri rioka.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel , that they go forward :
ekegusii: Omonene akaboria Musa, “Inki okorera ase ’nde? Bateebie Abaisraeli bagenderere bosio.

english: But lift thou up thy rod , and stretch out thine hand over the sea , and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea .
ekegusii: Aye imokia enyimbo yao, na orambore okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde yaatananeke, Abaisraeli banyare goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.

english: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they shall follow them : and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
ekegusii: Rora, ninkore chinkoro chi’Abamisiri chibe chinkong’u, barabwo mbaababwatie korwa magega. Nabo inche inyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi chiaye.

english: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
ekegusii: Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”

english: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them:
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika o Nyasae, oyio otang’aine omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akairana magega yabo. Ne riire riria riateneine buna esiiro bosio bwabo rikairana magega yabo,

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth , between Migdol and the sea , over against Baal-zephon : before it shall ye encamp by the sea .
ekegusii: Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bairane gochia Pi‐Hahiroti, batoore agwo ase egati ya Migidoli na enyancha kororia Baali‐Sefoni ase enyancha mbarabare.

english: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel ; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night .
ekegusii: rikabeera gati y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli na oyo bw’Abamisiri. Agwo riire riria rikabao amo nomosunte; korende ase obotuko riire rikarenta oborabu. Na ase obotuko obogima omoganda oyomo toikanete ang’e noyonde.

english: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea ; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night , and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha; n’Omonene agasukia enyancha gochia magega ne chinguru chi’omwaga okorwa moocha okagusa obotuko obogima. Naboigo agakora enyancha koba ense enkamoku. Amache agaatananeka,

english: And the Egyptians pursued , and went in after them to the midst of the sea , even all Pharaoh’s horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .
ekegusii: Na Abamisiri bagasoa na kobabwatia gochia gati y’enyancha amo ne chibarasi chionsi chia Farao, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi.

english: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud , and troubled the host of the Egyptians ,
ekegusii: Bwachia koba mambia, Omonene akaba origereretie omoganda bw’Abamisiri korwa ase esiiro y’omorero na eye riire, akabatantania.

english: And took off their chariot wheels , that they drave them heavily : so that the Egyptians said , Let us flee from the face of Israel ; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Omonene akagokora amagoro e chigari chiabo, goika bagasinywa kogenda bosio. Erio Abamisiri bagateeba, “Tiga totame korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera Omonene nkobarwanera are mamincha yaito intwe Abamisiri.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the sea , that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians , upon their chariots , and upon their horsemen .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amaache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”

english: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea , and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared ; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea .
ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, na ekero bwachia gokiamoka, amaache akairana ase konya are botambe. Abamisiri bagatema gotama korwa ase amaache, korende Omonene akabasiria ase amaache.

english: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
ekegusii: Amache akairanerana, akamera chigari, na abariini chibarasi amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani ba Farao, obatunyanete Abaisraeli, gochia ase enyancha. Monto onde tatigara nonya noyomo.

english: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amaache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi ase bare.

english: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
ekegusii: Farao narengererie ng’a Abaisraeli batantanire enchera bakogenda, na erooro yabatangire tibagenda.

english: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase rituko riri’Omonene atooretie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri; na Abaisraeli bakarora Abamisiri bakwete bacheng’enenete ase engegu y’enyancha.

english: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the LORD , and believed the LORD , and his servant Moses .
ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli baroche buna Omonene aorokirie okobua kwaye okonene igoro y’Abamisiri, bakamoiroka Omonene, bakamwegena Omonene na Musa, omosomba oye.

english: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart , that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host ; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD . And they did so.
ekegusii: Inche ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao, erio ababwatie korwa magega, na inche ninyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi, na Abamisiri bamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Abaisraeli bagakora buna bateebetigwe.

english: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
ekegusii: Ekero Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ateebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”

english: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him:
ekegusii: Erio Farao akabeeka egari yaye y’esegi amo na abarwani baye b’esegi ang’e.

english: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them.
ekegusii: Naende akaira chigari amagana atano na rimo, echi achorete, amo ne chigari chinde chionsi, na abariini chituoni bachiriinete.

english: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued after the children of Israel : and the children of Israel went out with an high hand .
ekegusii: Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, na ere akabwatia Abaisraeli korwa magega, ekero barabwo bang’anyete bare nobomwenu.

english: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi-hahiroth , before Baal-zephon .
ekegusii: Abamisiri bakababwatia korwa magega amo ne chibarasi chionsi, ne chigari chia Farao, na abariini chibarasi chiaye, na abarwani baye bonsi, bakabanyora batoorire enyancha mbarabare, ang’e na Pi‐Hahiroti kororia Baali‐Sefoni.

english: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters .
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aye kwagusete buna omwaga, amaache akabamera; bakamerwa buna embunde ekorimera ase amaache amange ime, yarika inse.

english: Who is like unto thee, O LORD , among the gods ? who is like thee, glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?
ekegusii: Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye ase egati ye chinyasae? Ning’o onga buna aye ore nobonene na obochenu? Naye ogwenerete koirokwa na gotogigwa, aye naye oyogokora amakumia.

english: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them.
ekegusii: Ekero kwaramborete okoboko kwao gw’okorio, ense ekabamera.

english: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .
ekegusii: Ase chiira chiao chi’obwanchani chiria kwabarierete okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

english: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakayaigwa, bagatengechigwa ase omoondoko, omoichano na obororo bikabwata abamenyete Bofilisti.

english: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’Edomu bakaondoka, abanto abanene ba Moabu bakabwatwa nomotengecho, na abanto bonsi ba Kaanani bakerusia moyo.

english: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone ; till thy people pass over , O LORD , till the people pass over , which thou hast purchased .
ekegusii: Omoondoko na obwoba bikababwata; ase engencho y’okobua gw’okoboko kwao bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri buna amagena, goika abanto bao baetire, ee, Omonene, goika abanto bao kwabooretie baetire.

english: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O LORD , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .
ekegusii: Nobasoyie na kobabeeka ase egetunwa kiao aye omonyene, aase aria kweroiseretie, aye Omonene, obomenyo obochenu kwaagachete namaboko ao.

english: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Omonene nagaambe kare na kare.

english: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .
ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chia Farao, amo ne chigari na abariini basoete nyancha ime, Omonene akairania amaache igoro yabo, akabatuba; korende Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku. Ogoteera kwa Miriamu

english: And Miriam the prophetess , the sister of Aaron , took a timbrel in her hand ; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances .
ekegusii: Na Miriamu omobani, omoiseke omwabo Aroni, akaimokia ekebangarara + 15:20 Ekebangarara: Egento kenga buna chindege kiaye, na abakungu bonsi bakamobwatia bakobugia ebibangarara biabo na goteenga.

english: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD , for he hath triumphed gloriously ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
ekegusii: Miriamu akabaterera ogoteera kogoteeba, “Moterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene, chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.” Chinsoko chire namaache amaroro

english: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Bagataara ase engaki y’amatuko atato ase erooro, na tibanyora maache.

english: And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .
ekegusii: Erio bagaika aase are korokwa Mara, + 15:23 Mara: engencho yaye: obororo tibanyara konywa amaache arengeo, ekiagera arenge amaroro mono. Nakio kiagerete aase aria akarokwa Mara.

english: And the people murmured against Moses , saying , What shall we drink ?
ekegusii: Agwo abanto bakemurunganeria Musa, bakamobooria, “Ninki tokonywa?”

english: And he cried unto the LORD ; and the LORD shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them,
ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, n’Omonene akamworokia ekeng’ese kio omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amaache ime, na amaache aria akaba amaansu. Agw’Omonene akabeekera abanto amaachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.

english: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amaachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabeekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”

english: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bagaika Elimu; agwo chinsoko nchiarengeo ikomi na ibere, na emekendo emerongo etan’abere (70). Bagatoora agwo ang’e namaache.

english: The LORD is a man of war : the LORD is his name .
ekegusii: Omonene nomorwani bwe chiseegi, Omonene nario erieta riaye.

english: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .
ekegusii: Orutire chigari chia Farao amo nomoganda oye ase enyancha ime; abarwani baye abachore obarimeirie ase enyancha embariri + 15:4 Enyancha Embariri: erieta rinde enyancha y’emekendo .

english: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone .
ekegusii: Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.

english: Thy right hand , O LORD , is become glorious in power : thy right hand , O LORD , hath dashed in pieces the enemy .
ekegusii: Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkore nokobua okonene, Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngosenyente ababisa.

english: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwao okonene nigo okobaiyeria inse abagokoimokera; endamwamu yao ekobera, nigo ekobasamba buna chimboba chinyomo.

english: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .
ekegusii: Ase omoika korwa ase chimioro chiao amaache akaimoka, agatenena buna orwaki, enyancha egakamoka goika inse kegima.

english: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them.
ekegusii: Omobisa agateeba, “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”

english: And they took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okamanora na koimoka korwa Elimu, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o kabere magega kobarure ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, eyio ere egati y’Elimu na Sinai.

english: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Aroni arenge gokwana nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria gochia ase erooro, bakarora obonene bw’Omonene bokooroka korwa ase riire.

english: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them, saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread ; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God .
ekegusii: “Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabarie omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”

english: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up , and covered the camp : and in the morning the dew lay round about the host .
ekegusii: Mogoroba chinkware chigaacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na mambia yaye aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riimi.

english: And when the dew that lay was gone up , behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing , as small as the hoar frost on the ground .
ekegusii: Na ekero riimi riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.

english: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded , Gather of it every man according to his eating , an omer for every man , according to the number of your persons ; take ye every man for them which are in his tents .
ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”

english: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered , some more , some less .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.

english: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Monto onde tatigaria endagera ende goika mambia.”

english: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro omoganda bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli bakemurunganeria Musa na Aroni,

english: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them.
ekegusii: Korende tibaigwera Musa; abande bagatigaria eyende goika rituko ria kabere, na mambia yaye bakayenyora yagundire na yasoirwe namakonde, na Musa akababea mono.

english: And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .
ekegusii: Ase igo kera emambia bakaba bagosangereria kera oyomo buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana; korende ekero omobaso oyesambire, yanyititoka.

english: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo baba bagosangereria endagera eria ekerengo ara kabere, ase kera omonto ebimunu bine. Abagaaka bonsi b’omoganda bakagenda goteebia Musa amang’ana ayio.

english: And they laid it up till the morning , as Moses bade : and it did not stink , neither was there any worm therein.
ekegusii: Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.

english: And Moses said , Eat that to day ; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD : to day ye shall not find it in the field .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Karie eye reero, ekiagera reero n’Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene, ekiagera reero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.

english: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mobe mokoyesangereria endagera eye, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, endagera eyio tegotoka.”

english: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather , and they found none.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiiko aane?

english: See , for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath , therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days ; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day .
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y’amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”

english: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Nanga mbuya onye twakwerete ase amaboko a ’Omonene aaria ase ense ya Misiri. Agwo tware goikaransa ase chinyongo chie chinyama, tware koria endagera ende enyinge, twaigota. Korende bono mwatorentire aa ase erooro ase ogotoita intwe twensi nenchara.”

english: So the people rested on the seventh day .
ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bakaba bagotimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere.

english: And Moses said , This is the thing which the LORD commandeth , Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations ; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness , when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Omonene otochikiire togache endagera eye inke ya Mana ase engencho ye chinderia chiaito, erinde banyare gocha korora endagera eye Omonene atoete torie ase erooro, ekero atorusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”

english: As the LORD commanded Moses , so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony , to be kept .
ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, naboigo Aroni ayebegete bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ekagachwao.

english: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah .
ekegusii: (Ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere ekio nensemo ya ikomi y’ekerengo gi’efa.)

english: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in ; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily .
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”

english: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bagateebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Mogoroba reero inwe nario moramanye ng’a Omonene nere obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri,

english: And in the morning , then ye shall see the glory of the LORD ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD : and what are we , that ye murmur against us?
ekegusii: na mambia inamorore obonene bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Ee, mwamwemurunganeirie Omonene, tari intwe. Intwe inki toisaine moratuemurunganerie?”

english: And Moses said , This shall be , when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full ; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD .
ekegusii: Naende Musa agateeba, “inwe buna morore obonene bw’Omonene ekero arabae chinyama morie mogoroba, na mambia abae omogati morie, moigote ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Inki mokwemurunganeria ase tore? Intwe titoisaini gento. Tari intwe mwemurunganeirie, korende n’Omonene.”

english: And Moses spake unto Aaron , Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , Come near before the LORD : for he hath heard your murmurings .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Bateebie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli basuke gocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera oigure okwemurungania kwabo.”

english: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .
ekegusii: Yoshua agakora buna Musa amotebetie, akarwania Abaameleki, na Musa, na Aroni, na Huri bagatiira gochia ekegoro igoro.

english: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .
ekegusii: Ekaba Musa kaimokirie amaboko aye igoro, rirorio Abaisraeli babua, na kayairanirie inse, Abaameleki babua.

english: But Moses’ hands were heavy ; and they took a stone , and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .
ekegusii: Ekero amaboko a Musa arosire, Aroni na Huri bakaimokia rigena, bakaritereka inse, na Musa akariikaransera. Erio bakaba bagosiira amaboko a Musa, oyomo okoboko gwo korio, na oyonde ogwokobee. Naboigo bakamosiira goika erioba rikagwa.

english: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .
ekegusii: Na igo Yoshua akabua Abaameleki kegima, akabaita nemioro.

english: And Moses built an altar , and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi :
ekegusii: Musa akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,

english: For he said , Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki’Omonene, na gotiana ng’a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

english: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses , and said , Give us water that we may drink . And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD ?
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakomania Musa, bagoteeba, “Toe amaache tonywe!” Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki mokonyomania? Nase ki mogoteema Omonene?.”

english: And the people thirsted there for water ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?
ekegusii: Agwo bakaba nerang’o enene y’amaache, bakemurunganeria Musa, bakaboora, “Ninki gwatoruseria Misiri gocha aa, amo nabana baito ne chitugo chiaito, togokwa ase erang’o?”

english: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying , What shall I do unto this people ? they be almost ready to stone me.
ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Ninki ngokorera abanto aba? Barabwo nigo bare ang’e kong’aka amagena.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Oete bosio bwa abanto aba, oire abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, oire boigo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.

english: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .
ekegusii: Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amaache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.

english: And he called the name of the place Massah , and Meribah , because of the chiding of the children of Israel , and because they tempted the LORD , saying , Is the LORD among us, or not?
ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria Masa + 17:7 Masa: Masa engencho yaye: ogoteema na Meriba, + 17:7 Meriba: Meriba engencho yaye: okwomana ase engencho y’eriomana ri’Abaisraeli, naende ekiagera abanto bamoteemete Omonene, bakoboora, “Inee! Omonene nare aa ase egati yaito, gose taiyo?” Esegi n’Abaameleki

english: Then came Amalek , and fought with Israel in Rephidim .
ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki bakaoroka na korwania Abaisraeli aaria Refidimu.

english: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ’ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae in’yebwate koboko kwane.”

english: When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses’ father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt ;
ekegusii: Jethiro, Omokuani o Midiani, ise biara Musa, akaigwa amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorerete Musa na Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na buna abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.

english: And Jethro said , Blessed be the LORD , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh , who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, oyo obatooretie abanto baye korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, na korwa ase Farao.

english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nomonene kobua chinyasae chinde chionsi, ekiagera atooririe abanto baye korwa ase Abamisiri abwo baabaenenerete.”

english: And Jethro , Moses’ father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God .
ekegusii: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde bi’okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae. Jethiro Ogosemia Musa igoro yokogamba Ebiina (Okoir 1:9-18)

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agaikaransa kogamba ebiina bi’abaanto; na abanto nigo barengeo bamoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba.

english: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
ekegusii: Ekero ise biara Musa aroche onsi aya Musa are gokorera abanto, akamobooria. “Inki eke ogokorera abanto? Naki oikaransete aye bweka, na abanto bagoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba?”

english: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria ise biara, “Nekiagera abanto bagonchichera, bakorigia oboraai bwa Nyasae.

english: When they have a matter , they come unto me; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .
ekegusii: Ekero bomanire nigo bagocha ase ’nde, na inche nabagambera ebiina biabo na kobamanyia emeroberio ya Nyasae na amachiiko aye.”

english: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good .
ekegusii: Erio Jethiro agateebia Musa, “Enchera eye y’okobagambera ebiina biabo teri engiya.

english: Thou wilt surely wear away , both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
ekegusii: Nigo okorosigwa, aye amo nabaanto aba bonsi bare aa. Naki emeremo eye nemerito mono asore, tokonyara koyekora aye bweka.

english: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :
ekegusii: Bono ntegerera, ngoteebie chisemi chingiya orakore, na Nyasae nabe amo naye. Aye kabe oyo ogotenenera abanto ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na komoirera amang’ana abo.

english: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
ekegusii: Goika oborokererie amachiiko na emeroberio, na obateebererie buna ebagwenerete babe na gokora.

english: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , men of truth , hating covetousness ; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands , and rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens :
ekegusii: Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b’abaanto b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

english: And let them judge the people at all seasons : and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge : so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
ekegusii: Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebiina bia botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.

english: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .
ekegusii: Korakore igo, buna Nyasae aragochiikere, aye nonyore chinguru chi’okogenderera, na abanto aba bonsi ’nabagende chinka chiabo bare nomorembe.”

english: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law , and did all that he had said .
ekegusii: Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.

english: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .
ekegusii: Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.

english: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakogamba ebiina bi’abaanto botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u baba bakobirentera Musa, korende ebire ebike baba bakobigamba abanyene.

english: And Moses let his father in law depart ; and he went his way into his own land .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agakooba ise biara, akamotiga okogenda ase ense yaye.

english: And the name of the other was Eliezer ; for the God of my father , said he, was mine help , and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh :
ekegusii: Boigo akaroka omwana oye okabere Eliezeri agateeba, “Nyasae o tata obeire omokonyi one, agantooria korwa ase ogoita gwa Farao”.

english: And Jethro , Moses’ father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
ekegusii: Nabo Jethiro, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.

english: And he said unto Moses , I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife , and her two sons with her.
ekegusii: Konya otomire amang’ana ase Musa buna ngocha are aretane moka Musa nabana baye babere.

english: And Moses went out to meet his father in law , and did obeisance , and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare ; and they came into the tent .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agasoka komoorotota, agatung’ama na komonyunyunta. Ekero bakwananirie bagasoa ase eema.

english: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the LORD delivered them.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n’Abamisiri ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, na obokong’u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.

english: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Ekero Jethiro aigwete amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri akagoka mono,

english: In the third month , when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt , the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai .
ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatato magega Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Go unto the people , and sanctify them to day and to morrow , and let them wash their clothes ,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene reero na ankio, naende obateebie basibie chianga chiabo,

english: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .
ekegusii: bebeke ang’e goika mambia ende ekiagera ase rituko erio ria gatato, inche Omonene ning’ike ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase abanto bonsi barandore.

english: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned , or shot through ; whether it be beast or man , it shall not live : when the trumpet soundeth long , they shall come up to the mount .
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto onde tigokuna omonto orakore ayio, korende nigo araakwe amagena gose araswe nemegwe. Aya achikirwe ase Mwanyabaanto na ase ching’iti, korende ekero egetureeri kerabugigwe, erio nario abanto baratiire gocha ase egetunwa.”

english: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people , and sanctified the people ; and they washed their clothes .
ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.

english: And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Mwebeke ang’e, na goika rituko ria gatato, timobaisa goika abakungu baino ang’e.”

english: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana abanto korwa ase egetwori bachie koumerana na Nyasae. Barabwo bagatenena ase egetunwa mbarabare.

english: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the LORD descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
ekegusii: Egetunwa gionsi gia Sinai kegatubwa nerioki, ekiagera Omonene aigete aroro ore ase omorero ime; na erioki rigachongororoka gochia igoro buna eri’eriko rinene ri’oboturi, na egetunwa ekegima gekanyegerigwa mono.

english: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’egetureeri rikagenderera kwoga mono kobua. Musa agakwana, na Nyasae akamoiraneria nogoaka gw’enkoba.

english: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness ; and there Israel camped before the mount .
ekegusii: Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.

english: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai , on the top of the mount : and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount ; and Moses went up .
ekegusii: Omonene agaika ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Sinai, akarangeria Musa agende asare, na Musa agatiira gochiao.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze , and many of them perish .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse ase abanto, obakuurere tibatamboka orobebe bache kondora. Baise gokora igo, abange babo mbakwe.

english: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD , sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
ekegusii: Na abakuani barabwo kobagocha ase ’nde, inche Omonene, goika bechene, timbaisa kobaa egesusuro.”

english: And Moses said unto the LORD , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us, saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”

english: And the LORD said unto him, Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD , lest he break forth upon them.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Aroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibaabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa ase ’nde, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”

english: So Moses went down unto the people , and spake unto them.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatirimboka gochia ase abanto, akabateebia amang’ana ayio.

english: And Moses went up unto God , and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain , saying , Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel ;
ekegusii: Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamoteebia, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:

english: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles’ wings , and brought you unto myself.
ekegusii: Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ekeongo ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga ase ’nde.

english: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akagenda akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigeete.

english: And all the people answered together , and said , All that the LORD hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi amo bakairaneria, bakaboora, “Ayio onsi Omonene atebiire, inatoyakore.” Musa nere akairera Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agateebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie. Abanto bagochenwa

english: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Raamses .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamisiri bakabeeka abateneneri abatindi igoro ase Abaisraeli barenge erio baabachande nemeremo emekong’u mono yobosomba. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogaacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.

english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Korende buna Abamisiri bagendererete kobachanda mono, naboigo Abaisraeli bagendererete komenteka na gwesiarera, goika Abamisiri bakabairoka mono.

english: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour :
ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri bakaba abatindi ase Abaisraeli na kobabetereria gokora emeremo emekong’u

english: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage , in morter , and in brick , and in all manner of service in the field : all their service , wherein they made them serve , was with rigour .
ekegusii: bagakora obogima bwabo bokaba obokong’u ase okobakoria emeremo y’ogotiringa esike na koroisia amatabori, na emeremo ende ao ao ase emegondo. Ase emeremo ende yonsi Abaisraeli baare gokora nigo baare gokorigwa ase obotindi.

english: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri agachiika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaiberania, akabateebia,

english: And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
ekegusii: “Ekero mokorigereria abakungu b’Abaiberania kobakoibora, morigererie mwana ki oiborwa; onye nomoisia, momoite, korende karabe omoiseke, momotige abe moyo.”

english: But the midwives feared God , and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive .
ekegusii: Korende abaiboria baria nigo bamoirogete Nyasae, tibakorete buna omorwoti o Misiri abateebeetie, korende barabwo bagatiga abana abamura bakaba moyo.

english: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing , and have saved the men children alive ?
ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?

english: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
ekegusii: Abaiboria baria bakairaneria Farao, “Abakungu b’Abaiberania tibari buna aba Abamisiri; barabwo nabaango ase okoibora, nigo bakoibora ritang’ani omoiboria ataraika.”

english: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,
ekegusii: Rubeni, Simioni, Lawi na Yuda;

english: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives : and the people multiplied , and waxed very mighty .
ekegusii: Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenteka na koba ne chinguru mono.

english: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
ekegusii: Na ekiagera abakungu baria abaiboria bamoirogete Nyasae, ere akabasesenia, na barabwo bakenyorera chinyomba chiabo.

english: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,
ekegusii: Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Benjamini;

english: Dan , and Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .
ekegusii: Dani na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.

english: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls : for Joseph was in Egypt already .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaiboire korwa ase Yakobo nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu momura o Yakobo ere konya nao amenyete Misiri korwa kare.

english: And Joseph died , and all his brethren , and all that generation .
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria bagakwera Misiri.

english: And he said unto his people , Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
ekegusii: Ere agateebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange gotobua, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua,

english: And God spake all these words , saying ,
ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateeba,

english: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou, nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :
ekegusii: korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri’Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore ase omochie oo.

english: And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us, and we will hear : but let not God speak with us, lest we die .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebia Musa, “Kwana naintwe aye omonyene, na intwe inatogotegerere, korende Nyasae takwana naitwe ekiagera ogokwana naintwe, nigo torakwe.”

english: I am the LORD thy God , which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omonene, oyokorusetie ase ense ya Misiri, ase ense y’obosomba.

english: And Moses said unto the people , Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces , that ye sin not.
ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, “Timoondoka! Naki Nyasae nigo achire kobateema inwe, erio egere mogenderere komoiroka, erinde timokora ebibe.”

english: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagatenena aare, korende Musa ere akagenda ang’e ase riire riria rimwamu, ase Nyasae arenge. Amachiiko igoro y’ebisasimero

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.

english: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .
ekegusii: Timwekorera chinyasae chinde chi’echifeta gose echie chitaabu chi’ogosasimwa; monsasime inche bweka.

english: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
ekegusii: Ong’agachere egesasiimero ki’amaroba, onduere ebing’wanso igoro yaye, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, korwa ase ching’ondi chiao, ne chiombe chiao. Kera aase ndatebe onsasimere, ninchiche asore, ngosesenie.

english: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
ekegusii: Naende totiirera ebiriinero igoro, gokogenda ase egesasiimero, egetirianda kiao tikebaisa kooroka.”

english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments .
ekegusii: Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko aane.

english: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko orae Abaisraeli.”

english: If he take him another wife; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio okonyuoma omokungu o kabere, takorina oria omotang’ani endagera yaye, ne chianga chiaye na kende gionsi aganetie buna mokaye.

english: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money .
ekegusii: Atamokorereti amang’ana aya atato, goika aegwe ribaga arue bwoye ataakaneiri embooria.” Amachiiko ase abaiti

english: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .
ekegusii: Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong’ainereria, ere goika aitwe akwe, naisa gotamera egesasiimero kiane.

english: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraake ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.

english: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not, but keepeth his bed :
ekegusii: “Abanto babere kobarabe bakorwana, na oyomo aake oyonde rigena, gose enkundi, amoate chingoma, echio chiramokore omorwaire goika araare borere,

english: If he rise again , and walk abroad upon his staff , then shall he that smote him be quit : only he shall pay for the loss of his time , and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed .
ekegusii: karabe otimokire, naende asoke isiko gotaara ogwesiirera enyimbo, rirorio oria omoagete nigo aratigwe, otatiga amoakane ase engencho y’eng’eria eria asiririe ekero arwarete, na ere amorende goika agwene kegima.

english: And if a man smite his servant , or his maid , with a rod , and he die under his hand ; he shall be surely punished .
ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, nenyimbo, erinde akwere ase amaboko aye, goika aegwe egesusuro.

english: Notwithstanding , if he continue a day or two , he shall not be punished : for he is his money .
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.

english: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine .
ekegusii: “Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokuungu oria araborie magega abagaambi kobanachire ekiina.

english: And if any mischief follow , then thou shalt give life for life ,
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria karakwe, rirorio egesusuro kebe obogima ase obogima,

english: Burning for burning , wound for wound , stripe for stripe .
ekegusii: ogosambwa ase ogosambwa, na eriote ase eriote, naende ogosionorwa ase ogosionorwa.

english: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish ; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na komwata eriso, rirorio goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’eriso riaye.

english: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth , or his maidservant’s tooth ; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
ekegusii: Naende Karamoake omosomba oye omomura gose omoiseke amogookore erino, goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’erino riaye.” Amachiiko ase abanyene chitugo

english: If an ox gore a man or a woman , that they die : then the ox shall be surely stoned , and his flesh shall not be eaten ; but the owner of the ox shall be quit .
ekegusii: “Eeri eise goita omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, ne ching’unchara chiaye, goika eakwe amagena ekwe, ne chinyama chiaye tichiriegwa; korende omonyene eng’ombe eyio taegwa egesusuro.

english: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past , and it hath been testified to his owner , and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman ; the ox shall be stoned , and his owner also shall be put to death .
ekegusii: Korende eeri eyio, onye enarete goita abanto, na omonyene eeri eyio okuureirwe, na ere tayesibeti, ero keraite omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, nigo eraakwe amagena ekwe, na omonyene nere aitwe akwe.

english: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him.
ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokuungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.

english: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
ekegusii: Onye embooria ekoborigwa korwa asare, goika arue chionsi echi chiraganigwe, chibe embooria ase obogima bwaye.

english: Whether he have gored a son , or have gored a daughter , according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
ekegusii: Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne ching’unchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.

english: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .
ekegusii: Onye eeri egoita omosomba, omomura gose omoiseke, omonyene eng’ombe nigo araakane omonyene omosomba oria chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etato, na eeri eria eitwe ase ogoakwa amagena.

english: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
ekegusii: “Omonto karatige engoro yasie, gose onye okunyire engoro na tayekuneka, na eng’ombe gose etigere egwe imeo,

english: The owner of the pit shall make it good , and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
ekegusii: rirorio omonyene engoro goika aakane omonyene etugo chitaabu. Erio eng’iti eria y akuure ebe eyaye.

english: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s , that he die ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide .
ekegusii: Eeri y’omonto keraite ey’omonto onde ekwe, erio barabwo baoonie eeri eyio ere moyo, baatanane chitaabu echio, baatanane ne chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria y akuure boigo.

english: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox ; and the dead shall be his own.
ekegusii: Korende onye emanyekanete ng’a eeri eria nigo enarete goita abanto, na omonyene tayesibeti, goika aakane omonyene eeri eria y akuure ase okomoa eeri eria ere moyo; na eria y akuure ebe eyaye.”

english: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters ; the wife and her children shall be her master’s , and he shall go out by himself .
ekegusii: Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,

english: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children ; I will not go out free :
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karatebe: Nimwanchete omonene one amo na mokane, na abana baane, tinganeti korua ase obosomba bwane,

english: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges ; he shall also bring him to the door , or unto the door post ; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul ; and he shall serve him for ever .
ekegusii: erio omonene oye amorente ase obosio bwa Nyasae, amoikie ase egesieri gose ase emetobwa ya gesieri na amotue + 21:6 Amotue: engencho yaye amobochore ogoto kwaye n’esindake. Erio omonto oria abe omosomba oye ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

english: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .
ekegusii: “Omonto karaoonie omwana oye omoiseke koba omosomba, omoiseke oyio tagosiborwa buna abasomba abamura barasiborwe.

english: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
ekegusii: Onye omoiseke oyio tagwenereti omonene oye, oyorengereretie komokora abe mokaye, rirorio nigo araboorigwe airane. Omonene oye takoba ne ribaga komoonia ase egesaku ekegeni, ekiagera among’ainete.

english: And if he have betrothed her unto his son , he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters .
ekegusii: Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.

english: If a man shall steal an ox , or a sheep , and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox , and four sheep for a sheep .
ekegusii: Omonto karaibe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi na koyenyenya, gose ayeoonie, nigo araakane chiombe isano ribaga ri’eng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi inye ribaga ri’eng’ondi eyemo.

english: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass , or an ox , or a sheep , or any beast , to keep ; and it die , or be hurt , or driven away , no man seeing it:
ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye etigere, gose eeri, gose eng’ondi, gose etugo ende yonsi ebe sagare, na etugo eria eitwe gose eakwe, gose eirwe monto tarora,

english: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both , that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods ; and the owner of it shall accept thereof , and he shall not make it good .
ekegusii: omoiri oria goika atenene bosio bw’ekegambero atiane ase Omonene ng’a takuneti enibo aetwe sagare. Omonyene etugo eria goika anche ng’a ayio atianwa namaene, na tagoakanwa.

english: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
ekegusii: Korende onye nigo yaibwa korwa asare ere goika aakane omonyene oria.

english: If it be torn in pieces , then let him bring it for witness , and he shall not make good that which was torn .
ekegusii: Onye yariegwa nenyang’au, arente chinyama chintigari chibe kirori, taakana ase eye enyang’au yaitete.

english: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour , and it be hurt , or die , the owner thereof being not with it , he shall surely make it good .
ekegusii: “Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.

english: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good : if it be an hired thing , it came for his hire .
ekegusii: Onye omonyene abao ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio yarenge eyogoakanerwa rirerio, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo. Amachiiko y’ogotanga obonyaka na obobe bonde

english: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins .
ekegusii: Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chitaabu chireng’aine rigori ri’omoiseke omwekungi.

english: If a thief be found breaking up , and be smitten that he die , there shall no blood be shed for him.
ekegusii: -4 Igo emogwenerete aakane chionsi. Onye tabwati gento, ere omonyene goika aoonigwe ase engencho y’oboibi bwaye. Onye etugo eyio aiba ekonyorekana ase amaboko aye ere moyo, aakane ara kabere, onye neng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi. Omoibi karanyorekane ogotagora enyomba botuko ase okoiba, nere aitwe akwe: omonto oria omoita takobarerwa oboiti obwo. Korende onye nigo amoita kobwakiire, rirorio nigo arabarerwe oboiti obwo.

english: Ye shall not afflict any widow , or fatherless child .
ekegusii: Tochanda omoboraka onde bwensi, gose omwana entakana oyo abaibori baye bakuure.

english: If thou afflict them in any wise , and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry ;
ekegusii: Oise kobachanda abwo, na barabwo kobaraarere ase ’nde, amaene, inche ninyigwe ekerero kiabo.

english: And my wrath shall wax hot , and I will kill you with the sword ; and your wives shall be widows , and your children fatherless .
ekegusii: Endamwamu yane inayoke, na inche mbaite n’omoro, na abakungu baino nababe ababoraka, na abana baino babe chintakaana batari nabaise.

english: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin : wherein shall he sleep ? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear ; for I am gracious .
ekegusii: ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere karaarere ase ’nde, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamaabera.

english: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits , and of thy liquors : the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
ekegusii: “Totebana kondetera ogotongora kwao kwe rigesa ri’endagera na eri’emesabibu. Ong’e omwana oo omomura omotangi ase abana bao, abe oyone.

english: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen , and with thy sheep : seven days it shall be with his dam ; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
ekegusii: Ong’e boigo chimori chintangi chi’echiombe, ne chimaanwa chintangi chi’eching’ondi. Ochitige chikoore amatuko atano na abere, ko rituko ria gatano na gatato ochindetere.

english: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten , and shall put in his beast , and shall feed in another man’s field ; of the best of his own field , and of the best of his own vineyard , shall he make restitution .
ekegusii: “Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw’endagera, gose oyo bw’emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y’omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.

english: If fire break out , and catch in thorns , so that the stacks of corn , or the standing corn , or the field , be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution .
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.

english: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep , and it be stolen out of the man’s house ; if the thief be found , let him pay double .
ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye chitaabu, gose ebinto binde biaye amogachere, na birobio biibwe korwa nyomba mwaye, omoibi karanyorekane goika aakane ara kabere.

english: If the thief be not found , then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges , to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods .
ekegusii: Korende atanyorekaneti, oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bw’ekegambero, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.

english: For all manner of trespass , whether it be for ox , for ass , for sheep , for raiment , or for any manner of lost thing , which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges ; and whom the judges shall condemn , he shall pay double unto his neighbour .
ekegusii: “Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekiina ekio ki’abaanto abwo babere nigo keraarentwe ase obosio bw’egesasiimero. Na oria Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.

english: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat : and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat . In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard , and with thy oliveyard .
