ekegusii: korende omwaka o gatano na kabere otige omogondo otimoke, toremwa, korende ebirakine na kwama ase omogondo obitigere abataka, na ebi baratigarie bibe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosaana. Okore boigo nomogondo oo bw’emesabibu na oyo bw’emezeituni.

english: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect : and make no mention of the name of other gods , neither let it be heard out of thy mouth .
ekegusii: “Motegerere mono onsi aya nabateebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta ye chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.” Amatuko Amanene (Okong’ 34:18-26; Okoir 16:1-17)

english: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year .
ekegusii: “Kera omwaka nobe kogontwarera Amatuko Amanene ara gatato.

english: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD .
ekegusii: Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae.

english: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso amo nomogati obekire ememera. Ebitinya bie chinyama echi nkoruerwa ekeng’wanso ase rituko riane rinene, tibitigara goika bokie rituko rikobwatia.

english: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil ; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ensemo y’abare abange kobarigetie gokora amabe, gose tobaisa kobakorera abwo bare abange ogwanchereria na gotanga oboronge ase okoba kirori bw’okoonchorana oboronge.

english: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
ekegusii: “Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane na gokorenda ase enchera, agoikie aase aria nakoroiseirie.

english: Beware of him, and obey his voice , provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions : for my name is in him .
ekegusii: Mwerende ase obosio bwaye, na moigwere aya arabateebie. Tobaisa kwanga komoigwera, ere takomoororera amaabera oyoramoche koigwera ekiagera erieta riane nigo rire ime yaye.

english: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .
ekegusii: Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.

english: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .
ekegusii: Naki omomalaika one nagotang’ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y’Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanaani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.

english: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods , nor serve them, nor do after their works : but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images .
ekegusii: Timosasiima chinyasae chiabo, gose gochikorera; na timokora buna abanto abwo bagokora, korende mosirie kegima emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na moyaiyerie inse amagena abo onsi are aase bagosasimera.

english: And ye shall serve the LORD your God , and he shall bless thy bread , and thy water ; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amaache aino, nindusie amarwaire ase more.

english: There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .
ekegusii: Ase ense yaino mokuungu onde tari oborito bwaye boragwe, gose onde takoba omogomba; nimbae obogima obotambe.

english: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
ekegusii: “Nintang’anie okwoboyia kwane bosio bwaino, na goichanie na gotantania abanto bonsi abwo morabe mokoumerana nabarabwo; ninkore ababisa baino bonsi baonchoke batame korwa ase more.

english: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee.
ekegusii: Nintome ebiaramba birase na goseria Abahivi, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, korwa ase Kaanani bosio bwao.

english: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
ekegusii: Tinkobaseria ase omwaka oyomo, ense ebaise koba bosa, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chimenteke chibachande.

english: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased , and inherit the land .
ekegusii: Nigo ndabaserie ng’ora ng’ora goika momenteke moisane komenya ense eyio.

english: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
ekegusii: Inche ninkobekere orobebe rwao gochakera Enyancha Embariri goikera Enyancha y’Abafilisti, naende korwa ase erooro goika orooche rwa Eufarati, ekiagera nimbeke ababiare b’ense eyio ase amaboko aino, na inwe mobaseerie, batame korwa ase more.

english: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana konde gwonsi nabarabwo, gose ne chinyasae chiabo.

english: They shall not dwell in thy land , lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods , it will surely be a snare unto thee.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibaamenya ase ense yao, baabaise kogera onkorere ebibe. Onye kogokorera chinyasae chiabo, chirochio nachinyare kogotega.”

english: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
ekegusii: Korarore etigere y’oyo okogechete yagure negurube ebogoretie, tobaisa koyeetania, korende oyekonye.

english: Keep thee far from a false matter ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked .
ekegusii: Bwetange kegima korwa ase oborimo, na tobaisa kogera omonyaboronge aitwe, ekiagera inche Omonene tingotiga koa omomochi egesusuro.

english: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha oegwe riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria omonto erinde takorora ayare boronge; naende nigo rigosaria ekiina ki’abanyene oboronge.

english: And he said unto Moses , Come up unto the LORD , thou, and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel ; and worship ye afar off .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde, aye amo na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere. Mobeere aare ake, motugame inse monsasiime.

english: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .
ekegusii: bakarora Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Inse y’amagoro aye nigo arenge buna amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, are nobokenonoku buna obore igoro.

english: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .
ekegusii: Omonene tarambora okoboko kwaye kobakorera bobe abagaaka baria b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo kobarorire Nyasae, bakaria na konywa. Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Come up to me into the mount , and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone , and a law , and commandments which I have written ; that thou mayest teach them.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde egetunwa igoro, oganye aa, na inche nkoe chibao chi’amagena chire namachiiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”

english: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .
ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, erio ere agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.

english: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them.
ekegusii: Agateebia abagaaka baria, “Motoganye aiga goika ekero torairane ase more. Rora Aroni na Huri nao bare aiga amo nainwe; onye omonto ore nobokong’u bonde, agende ababorie.”

english: And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.

english: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai , and the cloud covered it six days : and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud .
ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogaacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire gati.

english: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bw’Omonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.

english: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD : but they shall not come nigh ; neither shall the people go up with him.
ekegusii: Naye Musa bweka orachiche ong’ike ang’e, korende abwo bande tibang’ika ang’e. Boigo n’Abaisraeli barabwo tibachicha amo naye nonya ng’ake.”

english: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the LORD hath said will we do .
ekegusii: Musa akagenda agateebia abanto amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene akwanete, na amachiiko aye onsi. Abanto bonsi bakamoiraneria ase eriogi erimo, bakaboora, “Amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene akwanire inatoyakore.”

english: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akariika amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene omoete. Erio akaimoka maambia chuni, akaagacha egesasiimero inse ye getunwa, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere koreng’ana nebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.

english: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, bakanyenyera Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

english: And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basons ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .
ekegusii: Musa akabogoria ekeng’ese ki’amanyinga aya, akayabeeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng’ese kende akanyororokeria egesasiimero.

english: And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the LORD hath said will we do , and be obedient .
ekegusii: Erio akaimokia egetabu gi’okobwatana kw’ogotianania agwo ase amariko a Omonene ariikire agasomera abanto bakaigwa, erio Barabwo bakaboora, “Natoigwere na gokora onsi ay’Omonene akwanire.”

english: Then went up Moses , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel :
ekegusii: Erio Musa, na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere b’Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia egetunwa igoro,

english: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
ekegusii: “Mondoiserie Esanduki ye chibao chi’omokonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .
ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire ime na isiko, oyeetananie omong’orooria bw’etaabu.

english: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera ensemo.

english: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro ebere y’emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.

english: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , that the ark may be borne with them.
ekegusii: Osoyie emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria Esanduki eria.

english: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark : they shall not be taken from it.
ekegusii: Emiaro eyio goika ebe ime ase chibonyi echio, terusigwao.

english: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
ekegusii: Ime y’Esanduki eria obeke chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.” Oboikaranso bwa amaabera

english: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat .
ekegusii: Naende okore emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibere bibwate chimbaba ey’etaabu esunyuntire, oyebeke ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Ekerogo Kiamaabera,

english: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo. Oyekore ebe egento ekemo n’Ekerogo kia Amaabera.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .
ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua ase ’nde.

english: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo barambore chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’ekerogo kiamaabera, babobekere ekiriri, na amasio abo abe achikaine, na barabwo barigererie ekerogo kiamaabera.

english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
ekegusii: Oterekerere ekerogo kia amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria. Erio obeke imeo chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.

english: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Agwo ninchiche ng’umerane naye. Korwa igoro y’ekerogo kia amaabera, gati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba aba babere bare igoro y’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, nimbe ngokwana naye igoro y’amachiiko aya ngochia koa Abaisraeli goetera asore.” Emesa y’emegati erabe ekoruegwa ase Nyasae (Okong’ 37:10-16)

english: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood : two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
ekegusii: “Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , and make thereto a crown of gold round about .
ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
ekegusii: Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu ase emesa eria, ochibeeke ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye,

english: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table .
ekegusii: ang’e norosingo; na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

english: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them.
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeome netaabu, nero emesa erabogorerigwe.

english: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal : of pure gold shalt thou make them.
ekegusii: Oroisie chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa. Obiroisie bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

english: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold , and silver , and brass ,
ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

english: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same.
ekegusii: “Oroisie ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire, okeroisie na enterekerero amo ne ritina na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha, bionsi bibe egento ekemo.

english: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :
ekegusii: Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

english: Three bowls made like unto almonds , with a knop and a flower in one branch ; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch , with a knop and a flower : so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick .
ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.

english: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.

english: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .
ekegusii: Rimumu erimo ribe inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio amamumu abe inse ye chinsagia echio isano nemo, chiroisigwe chibe egento ekemo ne ritina.

english: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
ekegusii: Amamumu ayio amo ne chinsagia biroisigwe bibe egento ekemo ne ritina, bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.

english: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it .
ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.

english: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold .
ekegusii: Ebinachi ne chindogio chiaye biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

english: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels .
ekegusii: Okorere chitaabu chichenire chikiro emerongo etano ase okoroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye.

english: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats’ hair ,
ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;

english: And rams’ skins dyed red , and badgers’ skins , and shittim wood ,
ekegusii: amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;

english: Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,
ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akwaakwa abachore, na ebi’okoroisia ubani ye rimusu rigiya;

english: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .
ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande, akobekwa ase egesibao ki’Omokuani na ase egesembe kiaye.

english: And let them make me a sanctuary ; that I may dwell among them.
ekegusii: Obateebie bandoiserie Obomenyo Obochenu, na inche inyare komenya ase egati yabo.

english: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it .
ekegusii: Mondoiserie Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebirabeo, buna ndakworokie.” Esanduki yamachiiko (Okong’ 37:1-9)

english: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
ekegusii: “Oroisie eema y’Obomenyo nebitambaa ikomi biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Omoroisia omong’aini abiroisie bibe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

english: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling , and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere rigochakera.

english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass , and put the taches into the loops , and couple the tent together, that it may be one .
ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio emerongo etano bi’etai ase ebioro biria, obwatanerie amarondia ayio abere abe eema eyemo engima.

english: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent , the half curtain that remaineth , shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese kie rirondia riria kementire kebekwe gesung’unane, getube magega y’Obomenyo.

english: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
ekegusii: Ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.

english: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers’ skins .
ekegusii: “Oroisie rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ribe rigotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ribe rikobekwa igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.

english: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .
ekegusii: “Oroisie chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, echio chiratenenigwe.

english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: Two tenons shall there be in one board , set in order one against another : thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.

english: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .
ekegusii: Koraroisie chibao echio, oroisie emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

english: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
ekegusii: Oroisie ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere ase kera ebao ase okobwaterania chintamang’o chiaye ibere.

english: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Ebitambaa ebio bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo ekemo.

english: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards :
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo oroisie chibao emerongo ebere,

english: And their forty sockets of silver ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
ekegusii: amo ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.

english: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo eyerochie bosongo, oroisie chibao isano nemo,

english: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .
ekegusii: naende chibao ibere chie chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.

english: And they shall be coupled together beneath , and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring : thus shall it be for them both ; they shall be for the two corners .
ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ebwatanigwe ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere. Ase enchera eyio chibao ibere chibekwe ase chikoona ibere.

english: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

english: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
ekegusii: “Obaache emeriibo ye chibao chi’emekonge, etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,

english: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the two sides westward .
ekegusii: na etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere rinde, na etano y’ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.

english: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end .
ekegusii: Omoriibo o gati‐gati obekwe omogima, oriibe korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

english: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
ekegusii: Oome chibao echio netaabu na okore chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emeriibo erasoigwe, na emeriibo eria oyeoome netaabu.

english: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .
ekegusii: Ebitambaa bitano bibwatanigwe bibe rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.

english: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount .
ekegusii: Otenenie Obomenyo obwo buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.

english: And thou shalt make a vail of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :
ekegusii: “Oroisie etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini ayeroisie ebe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

english: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netaabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitaabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chi’echifeta.

english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place .
ekegusii: Erio obeke oboikaranso bw’amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono.

english: And thou shalt set the table without the vail , and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south : and thou shalt put the table on the north side .
ekegusii: Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya ensemo ya Irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.

english: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework .
ekegusii: Naende ase egesoero ki’eema oroisie egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.

english: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
ekegusii: Naende obaache chisiiro isano chi’emekonge ase ogosunga egetambaa ekio, ochioome netaabu; oture ebigobanio bie chitaai. Okore chinterekerero inye chie chitaai chinyititoire, chibe ase chisiiro echio.”

english: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling ; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
ekegusii: Okore ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, obibeke ase ensinyo y’egetambaa eke kere ensinyo y’ensemo eyemo ya kera rirondia.

english: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second ; that the loops may take hold one of another .
ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bibe bichikaine.

english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold , and couple the curtains together with the taches : and it shall be one tabernacle .
ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, obwateranie amarondia ayio abere amo, ebe eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.

english: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle : eleven curtains shalt thou make .
ekegusii: “Oroisie amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chimbori, abe eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo obwo.

english: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi ikomi na rimo abe ay’ekerengo ekemo.

english: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Obwatanie amarondia atano amo, na amarondia ande atano na rimo oyabwateranie ao. Erio oringe erimo rirondia ria gatano na rimo igoro y’egesoero ki’eema.

english: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood , five cubits long , and five cubits broad ; the altar shall be foursquare : and the height thereof shall be three cubits .
ekegusii: “Oagache egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, nabo chinsemo chionsi inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.

english: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver .
ekegusii: Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chi’echifeta.

english: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long , and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu oroisie ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bisiirwe ne chisiiro emerongo ebere, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio amo ne chinuga chiabo bibe bie chifeta.

english: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits : their pillars ten , and their sockets ten .
ekegusii: Ase obogare bw’eraaro ensemo ya bosongo oroisie ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi, amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi.

english: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits .
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.

english: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits : their pillars three , and their sockets three .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bibe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.

english: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three , and their sockets three .
ekegusii: Naboigo nensemo ende y’egesoero bibekwe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato, amo ne chinterekerero chiaye isato.

english: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework : and their pillars shall be four , and their sockets four .
ekegusii: Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.

english: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver ; their hooks shall be of silver , and their sockets of brass .
ekegusii: Chisiiro chionsi echietanaine eraaro nigo chirabe ne chinuga na ebigobanio bie chifeta, ne chinterekerero chiabo chibe chie chitaai.

english: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits , and the breadth fifty every where , and the height five cubits of fine twined linen , and their sockets of brass .
ekegusii: Obotambe bw’eraaro eyio bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano. Egetambaa keria geetanaine eraaro kebe nobotambe gochia igoro bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na keroisigwe ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Chinterekerero chi’eraaro chibe echie chitaai.

english: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court , shall be of brass .
ekegusii: Ebikorero bi’Obomenyo ebirabe bigokorerwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, amo nebirochi bi’ebitambaa na ebi’eraaro bionsi, nigo birabe ebie chitaai.” Okorendwa gwe chitaaya (Abal 24:1-4)

english: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass .
ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero oroisie emegwekano ye ching’unchara inye. Ching’unchara echio nigo chirabe egento ekemo negesasiimero; oome gionsi netai.

english: And thou shalt command the children of Israel , that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamp to burn always .
ekegusii: “Ochike Abaisraeli barente amaguta amaya, amitire korwa ase amazeituni, akobekwa ase chitaaya kera rituko, chibe chikogenderera gwoka botambe.

english: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail , which is before the testimony , Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD : it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, isiko y’etoto eria ekeng’ete aase chibao chirikire oborori chibekire, Aroni na abamura baye inababe bakorenda chitaaya chiria chigwoka korwa mogoroba goika mambia, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika ase Abaisraeli ebiare ase ebiare.”

english: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes , and his shovels , and his basons , and his fleshhooks , and his firepans : all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass .
ekegusii: Okore chindogio chi’okobuucha ribu korwa ase egesasiimero. Naende okore ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase chitaai.

english: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass ; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
ekegusii: Okore boigo egechungi gi’etai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.

english: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath , that the net may be even to the midst of the altar .
ekegusii: Obeke egechungi eke korwa inse y’orosingo geike gochia gati‐gati y’egesasiimero.

english: And thou shalt make staves for the altar , staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with brass .
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro y’emekonge ase egesasiimero ekio, oyeome netai.

english: And the staves shall be put into the rings , and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar , to bear it.
ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.

english: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount , so shall they make it .
ekegusii: Egesasiimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.” Eraaro y’Obomenyo (Okong’ 38:9-20)

english: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle : for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side :
ekegusii: “Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya Irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.

english: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel , that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office , even Aaron , Nadab and Abihu , Eleazar and Ithamar , Aaron’s sons .
ekegusii: Orangerie Aroni, momura omino, omobeke abe ange naye boigo nabamura baye obatanane korwa ase Abaisraeli, erio obarente ase obosio bwao, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani, ere Aroni amo nabamura baye Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

english: Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
ekegusii: amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.

english: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .
ekegusii: Ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

english: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial .
ekegusii: Oyabeeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Aroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.

english: And thou shalt make ouches of gold ;
ekegusii: Oture ebikonde bibere bi’etaabu,

english: And two chains of pure gold at the ends ; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches .
ekegusii: na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitaabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria. Egesembe ki’obokuani (Okong’ 39:8-21)

english: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it.
ekegusii: Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase Omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

english: Foursquare it shall be being doubled ; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
ekegusii: Egesembe keria kebe keringire rimo. Obotambe bwaye bobe chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo.

english: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .
ekegusii: Obeke emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

english: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;

english: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;

english: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty .
ekegusii: Oroiserie Aroni, momura omino, chianga chinchenu chi’obonene na echi’oboseera.

english: And the fourth row a beryl , and an onyx , and a jasper : they shall be set in gold in their inclosings .
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi abekwe ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

english: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .
ekegusii: Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.

english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .
ekegusii: Okore ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bibekwe ase egesembe keria.

english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold , and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .
ekegusii: Okore boigo chibonyi ibere chi’etaabu, ochibeke ase emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

english: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate .
ekegusii: Osiberanie ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi chi’emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

english: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it .
ekegusii: Chinsinyo chinde chi’ebichanga biria bibere ochisiberanie nebikonde biria bibere, naende obibwateranie bionsi ase ebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio ase egesibao ki’obokuani.

english: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward .
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase egesembe keria ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.

english: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod .
ekegusii: Naende okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibwateranie ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

english: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod .
ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi’egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.

english: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart , when he goeth in unto the holy place , for a memorial before the LORD continually .
ekegusii: Naboigo Aroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Oteebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Aroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue .
ekegusii: Okore eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chire buru chioka.

english: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
ekegusii: Obochore engoro gati gati, ase omotwe ogosoera, oyebeke ekenario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.

english: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about :
ekegusii: Okore emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, oyebeke eetanane omoringero o inse. Ase egati ya kera omogwekano bwe rikomomanga obeke chindege chi’echitaabu.

english: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .
ekegusii: Naboigo ebe emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranie ne chindege chi’echitaabu bietanane omoringero o inse bw’eganchwa.

english: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister : and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD , and when he cometh out, that he die not.
ekegusii: Aroni goika ayebeke eganchwa eyio ekero agokora emeremo y’obokuani, na eriogi rie chindege chiria riigweke ekero agosoa Aase Aachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ekero agosoka, erio tabaisa gokwa.

english: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold , and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE LORD .
ekegusii: Okore ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio omang’ere amang’ana ayio: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.

english: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
ekegusii: Oyesiberanie bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chire buru.

english: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the LORD .
ekegusii: Aroni ayebogorie ase obosio bwaye igoro. Ase igo abogoreranie na korusia amamocho are nebiegwa ebiraatananwe, ebi’Abaisraeli barabe bakoruera Omonene. Aroni nigo arabe okoyebogoria botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .
ekegusii: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.

english: And these are the garments which they shall make ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki’obokuani, na egesibao ki’obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats , and thou shalt make for them girdles , and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty .
ekegusii: “Erio oroiserie abamura ba Aroni chiganchwa, ne chinkini; naende obaroiserie ebigogwa emechoro bi’ogosika na ebi’oboseera:

english: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Obekere Aroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye, chianga echio. Erio obaake amaguta, obaatanane na kobachena, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
ekegusii: Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.

english: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye goika bachibeke botambe ekero bagosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose kobakogenda ase egesasiimero gokora emeremo y’obokuani Aase Aachenu ime, tibaabaisa kwerentera okomocha na gokwa. Oko nogochika koragenderere ase Aroni na ororeria rwaye.

english: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .
ekegusii: Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.

english: And they shall make the ephod of gold , of blue , and of purple , of scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cunning work .
ekegusii: Bakore egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire; keroisigwe nomooroisia omong’aini.

english: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together .
ekegusii: Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.

english: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao ekio amo robe rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao, keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

english: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
ekegusii: Orente amagena abere a oiniki, na ase amagena ayio omang’ere amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli:

english: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,
ekegusii: “Aya naro orakore ase Aroni na abamura baye ase okobaatanana, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani: Orusie eeri ensae ne chimingichi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .
ekegusii: “Orente eeri bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano; Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.

english: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Erio oyenyenyere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock , and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger , and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar .
ekegusii: Oimokie amanyinga make y’eeri, erinde ogindie nekiara kiao emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero. Na amanyinga amatigari oyaumore inse ase egesasiimero.

english: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar .
ekegusii: Orusie ebitinya biria bitubete chinyama chi’enda; naboigo nebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro.

english: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
ekegusii: Korende chinyama chieeri eyio, ne risankwa, enda na eura yonsi obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.

english: Thou shalt also take one ram ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
ekegusii: “Orente emingichi eyemo ase echio ibere, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.

english: And thou shalt slay the ram , and thou shalt take his blood , and sprinkle it round about upon the altar .
ekegusii: Erio oyenyenye na oitorore amanyinga aye ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

english: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces , and wash the inwards of him, and his legs , and put them unto his pieces , and unto his head .
ekegusii: Onache chinyama chi’emingichi eria chibe ebing’ese; osibie chinyama chi’enda eria amo nebirenge, na obibeeke igoro y’ebing’ese biria na omotwe oye.

english: And thou shalt take the other ram ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
ekegusii: “Erio orente emingichi eria ende, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.

english: And unleavened bread , and cakes unleavened tempered with oil , and wafers unleavened anointed with oil : of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
ekegusii: Orusie boigo emegati etabekiri memera na amaandasi atabekiri memera, biroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta. Emegati eyio yonsi eroisigwe korwa ase obosie obonuke bw’engano.

english: Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio oyenyenye, orusie amanyinga make, na ase amanyinga ayio ogindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Aroni amo na mesia y’amato ’abamura baye; ogindie boigo ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Oitorore amanyinga amatigari ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.

english: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons’ garments with him.
ekegusii: Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasiimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Aroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Aroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.

english: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder ; for it is a ram of consecration :
ekegusii: “Orusie ebitinya bi’emingichi eyio, na omokera oye ore omonoru, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ebachwa ya borio, ekiagera emingichi eyio nigo yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu.

english: And one loaf of bread , and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD :
ekegusii: Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron , and in the hands of his sons ; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebi bionsi obibeeke ase amaboko Aroni amo nay’abamura baye, obisungusie bibe okoruegwa ase Omonene.

english: And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the LORD : it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio obirusie ase amaboko abo, obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro y’ekeng’wanso keria kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’omorero.

english: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD : and it shall be thy part .
ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Aroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.

english: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :
ekegusii: “Nabo ekeo Omokuani akobekwa ensemo, naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Aroni amo nabamura baye.

english: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Abakuani kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki’Omonene korwa ase bare, ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’omorembe.

english: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
ekegusii: “Chianga chiria chinchenu chia Aroni nigo chiraegwe ab’ororeria rwaye magega g akuure, bachieboyie ekero bagochia goakwa amaguta na gwatananwa.

english: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
ekegusii: Oyebeke ase egetonga, oyendetere ebe egetonga ime ekero okondetera ekeng’wanso ki’eeri na egie chimingichi chiria ibere.

english: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days , when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place .
ekegusii: Omomura o Aroni, oyorabogorie emeremo y’obokuani ase ribaga ria ise, goika eboyie chianga echi engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ekero agochia gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokora emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu.

english: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration , and seethe his flesh in the holy place .
ekegusii: “Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye Aase Aachenu.

english: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Aroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi’emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.

english: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .
ekegusii: Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri’okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.

english: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations , or of the bread , remain unto the morning , then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire : it shall not be eaten , because it is holy .
ekegusii: Onye chinyama gose emegati bigotigara goika mambia, erio obisambe nomorero; tibibaisa koriegwa, ekiagera nebichenu.

english: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron , and to his sons , according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
ekegusii: “Naboigo orakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye koreng’ana buna nagochikiire. Ogwatananwa kwabo kobe gokogenderera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement : and thou shalt cleanse the altar , when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
ekegusii: Kera rituko orue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa. Ase okorua ekeng’wanso ase okobwatanigwa nigo orabe kogochena egesasiimero. Erio ogeake amaguta na kogiatanana ase emeremo emechenu.

english: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere obe gokogenderera gokora okobwatanigwa ase egesasiimero na kogechena mono; na kera egento kerabe gekogekuna, nigo kerabe egechenu.” Ebing’wanso bia kera rituko (Omob 28:1-8)

english: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
ekegusii: “Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasiimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chi’eching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.

english: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :
ekegusii: Emanwa eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia na eria ende mogoroba.

english: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
ekegusii: “Erio orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

english: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .
ekegusii: Amo nemanwa eria entang’ani orue ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amaya, egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, amitire korwa ase amazeituni. Naende goika orue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.

english: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.

english: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD : where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso eke ki’ogosambwa kebe gekoruegwa ebiaare ase ebiaare botambe agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Agwo ndabe nkoumerana nainwe, naende nkwane naye.

english: And there I will meet with the children of Israel , and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory .
ekegusii: Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.

english: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Ninchene Eema y’Omosangererekano amo negesasiimero; naboigo ninchene Aroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And I will dwell among the children of Israel , and will be their God .
ekegusii: Inche nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli, imbe Nyasae obo.

english: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God .
ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamanye ng’a inche ninche Nyasae obo; ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe imenyete ase egati yabo. Inche ninche Nyasae obo.”

english: And thou shalt take the garments , and put upon Aaron the coat , and the robe of the ephod , and the ephod , and the breastplate , and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod :
ekegusii: Oimokie chianga chiria, obekere Aroni: Eganchwa erobekanirie egoika inse, na eganchwa eria ende, na egesibao ki’obokuani na egesembe keria; omoboerie norokini rw’egesibao.

english: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
ekegusii: Omobekere na ekegogwa omotwe oye, na ase ekegogwa eke osiberanie ekemanyererio keria egechenu gekoorokia ng’a bwatananirwe.

english: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil , and pour it upon his head , and anoint him.
ekegusii: Erio oimokie amaguta akweakwa, omonyoororokerie ase omotwe oye, omoyaake na omobeke ensemo ase emeremo emechenu.

english: And thou shalt bring his sons , and put coats upon them.
ekegusii: “Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga.

english: And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
ekegusii: Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Aroni na abamura baye, na obabeekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Aroni amo nabamura baye obabeeke ensemo babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.

english: And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
ekegusii: Narengeo Omonto oyomo bw’egekasu kia Lawi akamonyuoma omoiseke korwa egesaku kia Lawi.

english: And he looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no man , he slew the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .
ekegusii: Erio akamaga‐maga chinsemo chionsi, na ekero arora ng’a monto onde tari aande, agaita Omomisiri oria agakwa, erio akabisa omobere oye ase omokenye ime.

english: And when he went out the second day , behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?
ekegusii: Naende akagenda rituko ria kabere, akarora Abaiberania babere abasacha bakorwana; akamobooria oria ochegetie oyomwabo, “Nase ki ogoaka oyomino?”

english: And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okobegete koba omoteneneri na omogayani igoro yaito? Inee! Nigo origetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria?” Aya akagera Musa akoboa. Ere agateeba ase omoyo oye ime, “Ndoche ng’a eng’ana eye yamanyekanire!”

english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock .
ekegusii: Narengeo Omokuani o Midiani ore korokwa Jethiro obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amaache; bagaichoria chintuba amaache banyoisie riicho ria ise.

english: And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock .
ekegusii: Erio abarisia b’aroro bagacha bagaseria abaiseke baria ba Jethiro, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.

english: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?
ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke baria bairanete ase ise, ere akababoria, “Nakimwakora reero mwairana bwango iga?”

english: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omomisiri oyomo otokonya korwa ase abarisia baria; amo nayio otobuuchera amaache na gotonyoiseria riicho riaito.”

english: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him, that he may eat bread .
ekegusii: Erio ise akababoria abaiseke baye, “Ng’ai are? Naki mwakora mwatiga omonto oyio? Gachie momorangerie ache koragera.”

english: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .
ekegusii: Musa agancha komenya bw’omonto oria na omonto oria akaa Musa Sipora, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

english: And she bare him a son , and he called his name Gershom : for he said , I have been a stranger in a strange land .
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akamoiborera omwana omoisia, na Musa akamoroka Gerisomu, + 2:22 Gerisomu: Gerisomu, engencho yaye: omomenyi ogoteeba, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni.”

english: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .
ekegusii: Magega y’engaki entambe koyaetire omorwoti o Misiri agakwa. Abaisraeli bakaba bakweumia inse y’obosomba obwo, bakarera bakonywe, na ekerero kiabo korwa ase obosomba kegaika igoro, ase Nyasae obo.

english: And God looked upon the children of Israel , and God had respect unto them .
ekegusii: Nyasae akarigereria ogochandeka kw’Abaisraeli ase obosomba erio akabainyora.

english: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes , and daubed it with slime and with pitch , and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink .
ekegusii: Korende ekero aroche ng’a takonyara komobisa goetania agwo, akaimokia ekebaari ki’amauncho, agakeooma esike, erio agaaka eramu korwa isiko. Erio akaareria omwana oria ase ekebaari ime, agakebeeka ase amauncho ime y’orooche rwa Naeli.

english: And his sister stood afar off , to wit what would be done to him.
ekegusii: Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria agatenena aare ake amanye egekonyora omwana.

english: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river ; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side ; and when she saw the ark among the flags , she sent her maid to fetch it.
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke o Farao agatirimboka gochia Naeli rooche gwesibia, na abasomba baye abaiseke bakaba bakona goonchokanana ase engegu. Ekero aroche ekebaari keria ase amauncho, agatoma omoiseke oyomo akerente;

english: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and, behold, the babe wept . And she had compassion on him, and said , This is one of the Hebrews’ children .
ekegusii: agakemumora, akanyora omwana omoke ore imeo. Omwana oria akarera, na omoiseke o Farao akamororera amabeebe, agakwana, “Oyoiga noyomo bw’abana b’Abaiberania.”

english: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter , Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women , that she may nurse the child for thee?
ekegusii: Agwo agwo Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria akaoroka akaboria omoiseke o Farao, “Inee! Norigetie ngende nkorangererie omokungu okogonkia oyomo bw’Abaiberania ache gokomogonkeria?”

english: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go . And the maid went and called the child’s mother .
ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng’ina omwana oria.

english: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away , and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it.
ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao agateebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.

english: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa. Egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa, Omokuani Omonene okorwa ekeng’wanso |alt="Incense alter and high priest in the Tabernacle" src="HK00260B.TIF" size="col" loc="Exodus 30:1-10" copy="Horace Knowles" ref="30:1"

english: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ara rimo kera omwaka Aroni akore okobwatanigwa ase ching’unchara chiaye. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasiimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasiimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.” Ebango y’Obomenyo Obochenu

english: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD , when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibaabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.

english: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorarikwe, engencho yaye oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, goika arue ekeegwa eke ase Omonene.

english: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls .
ekegusii: Oyore omonda takorua goetania ekeng’ese gi’esekeli, gose oyore omotaka takorua inse y’ekio, ekero morarue ekeegwa ekio ase Omonene. Kerokio kebe embooria ase obogima bwaino.

english: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls .
ekegusii: Koranyore chitaabu echi Abaisraeli bararue chibe embooria, ochikorere ase emeremo y’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase igo Abaisraeli babe bakoinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende chitaabu echio chibe embooria ase obogima bwabo.” Egetuba gi’etai

english: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye babe bagwesibia amaache ayio amaboko na amagoro.

english: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe amaboko abere. Emegwekano yaye ye ching’unchara nigo eraroisigwe ebe egento ekemo negesasiimero.

english: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation , they shall wash with water , that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister , to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD :
ekegusii: Ekero bagosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika besibie ase amaache ayio, tibaabaisa gokwa; naboigo ekero bakogenda ase egesasiimero ase okoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’omorero

english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro abo, tibaabaisa gokwa. Ekio nigo korabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.” Amaguta akweakwa

english: Take thou also unto thee principal spices , of pure myrrh five hundred shekels , and of sweet cinnamon half so much , even two hundred and fifty shekels , and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels ,
ekegusii: “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Amaguta a manemane chikiro ikomi, na omodalasini ore ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano,

english: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
ekegusii: na kasia chikiro ikomi. (Bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo kegokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu). Oimokie na amaguta ’emezeituni ebituba bine.

english: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment , an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary : it shall be an holy anointing oil .
ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio oroisie amaguta akweakwa ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini, abe amaguta amaachenu akweakwa.

english: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony ,
ekegusii: Oake Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori,

english: And the table and all his vessels , and the candlestick and his vessels , and the altar of incense ,
ekegusii: na emesa amo n’ebinto bireo, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye, na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa,

english: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels , and the laver and his foot .
ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo nebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye.

english: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
ekegusii: Naboigo oraatanane ebinto ebi, obikore ebichenu kegima, erio onde bwensi orabikune abe omochenu.

english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .
ekegusii: Oyeoome netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye inye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye; oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye obaake amaguta na kobaatanana babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel , saying , This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations .
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amaachenu ase ’nde egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you.
ekegusii: Tabaisa goakwa ase emebere ya Mwanyabaanto bande bonsi. Timoroisia amaguta ande anga buna ayio. Ayio namaachenu, nabe amaachenu ase more.

english: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger , shall even be cut off from his people .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amaguta buna ayio gose koyaaka omonto omoao, oyotari Omokuani, nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku kiaye.” Amanukato

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Take unto thee sweet spices , stacte , and onycha , and galbanum ; these sweet spices with pure frankincense : of each shall there be a like weight:
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Oborembo bwa nafiti, na amaguta ’amakorogonte na oborembo bwa kalibani, na ebinto binde ebiansu, na ubani engiya; kera egento kebe gi’ekerengo ekemo.

english: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together, pure and holy :
ekegusii: Korwa ase ebinto ebio oroisie amanukato oyaroisie ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini ebekwe omonyoo, abe amarabu achenire.

english: And thou shalt beat some of it very small , and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation , where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy .
