ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amaachenu mono ase more.

english: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make , ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD .
ekegusii: Timweroiseria amanukato ande onsi y’ogosambwa anga buna ayio. Abe ase more amaachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amanukato anga buna ayio ase okwegokeria rimisu riaye nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.”

english: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu ochibeke inse y’omong’ororia chinsemo ibere, na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.

english: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.

english: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee.
ekegusii: Obeke egesasiimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduki egachire, eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori amo n’Ekerogo ki’Amaabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.

english: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it.
ekegusii: Kera emambia ekero Aroni akoroisia chitaaya nabe ogosambera agwo ubani egotioka buya,

english: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even , he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations .
ekegusii: naende ekero arabe ogwokia chitaaya engaki ya mogoroba. Ogosambwa okwo kwa ubani nigo koragenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosamba ubani eye etachikiri, gose ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timobaisa koumora okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa igoro yaye.

english: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest’s office ,
ekegusii: ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Aroni Omokuani, na echi’abamura baye, echi barabeeke ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani,

english: And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
ekegusii: na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikiire kegima.” Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka

english: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations ; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli aye omonyene obateebie “Goika morende Chisabato chiane, ekiagera echio nekemanyererio egati yane nainwe ebiaare ase ebiaare, erinde momanye ng’a ninche Omonene oyokobachena.

english: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death : for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
ekegusii: Ase igo morende rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera ne rituko richenu ase more. Onde bwensi aise korisaria, nigo araitwe akwe. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.

english: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath , to observe the sabbath throughout their generations , for a perpetual covenant .
ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli goika babwate na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ebiaare ase ebiaare, ekiagera oko nokobwatana koragenderere botambe.

english: And he gave unto Moses , when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai , two tables of testimony , tables of stone , written with the finger of God .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.

english: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :
ekegusii: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

english: And I have filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ,
ekegusii: Inche Nyasae namoichoirie omoika one, namoeire obong’aini ne chisemi amanye gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,

english: To devise cunning works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai.

english: And in cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of timber , to work in all manner of workmanship .
ekegusii: Ere abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.

english: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
ekegusii: Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikiire.

english: The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,
ekegusii: Barabwo baroisie Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ebe ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, na ebinto bionsi bi’Eema eyio,

english: And the table and his furniture , and the pure candlestick with all his furniture , and the altar of incense ,
ekegusii: emesa na ebinto birabeo, ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire na ebikorero biaye na egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe,

english: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,
ekegusii: egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe na ebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

english: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation .
ekegusii: Bono tiga endamwamu yane yoke igoro ase bare, erinde mbasirie, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene.”

english: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo origetie Abamisiri bateebe: Igo abarusia aa, oganetie kobaita ase ebitunwa na kobasiria kegima? Ase igo onchoka korwa ase endamwamu yao enene, tokora amabe aya kwarengereirie gokorera abanto bao.

english: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.

english: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides ; on the one side and on the other were they written .
ekegusii: Musa akeonchora, agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, na ase amaboko aye obwate chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori chinsemo chionsi ibere, bosio na magega.

english: And the tables were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , graven upon the tables .
ekegusii: Chibao echio nigo chiaroisetigwe na Nyasae omonyene, na amariko aya nigo ariikire na Nyasae, amang’eire ase chibao chiria.

english: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .
ekegusii: Yoshua akaigwa eriogi ri’abaanto bakwoga, agateebia Musa, “Naigure eriogi ase egetwori, eriogi buna eri’esegi.”

english: And he said , It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery , neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome : but the noise of them that sing do I hear .
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abaanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abaanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abaanto bagotera.”

english: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses’ anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .
ekegusii: Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.

english: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me.
ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitaabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”

english: And he took the calf which they had made , and burnt it in the fire , and ground it to powder , and strawed it upon the water , and made the children of Israel drink of it .
ekegusii: Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenya goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amaache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amaache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.

english: And Moses said unto Aaron , What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
ekegusii: Agwo Musa akaboria Aroni, “Naki abanto aba bagokorete goika okagera bagakora ebibe ebinene buna ebi?”

english: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
ekegusii: Aroni akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, toba nendamwamu entindi, aye nomanyete abanto aba ng’a nababe.

english: For they said unto me, Make us gods , which shall go before us: for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him.
ekegusii: Naki nigo banteebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.

english: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
ekegusii: Inche: nkabateebia: Onde bwensi obwate etaabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”

english: And when Moses saw that the people were naked ; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies :)
ekegusii: Musa akarora abanto bakoonchobana, na buna Aroni abatigete baonchobaane na gosasiima omogwekano oria, ase amasio ’ababisa babo.

english: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
ekegusii: Agwo Musa agatenena geita ki’egetwori, akabora, “Onde bwensi oyore ensemo y’Omonene ache aa ase ’nde.” Abana bonsi ba Lawi bagasangererekana asare.

english: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel , Put every man his sword by his side , and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp , and slay every man his brother , and every man his companion , and every man his neighbour .
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga “Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa egeita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio”.

english: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses : and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men .
ekegusii: Abana ba Lawi bagakora buna Musa abateebeetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.

english: For Moses had said , Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD , even every man upon his son , and upon his brother ; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day .
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia. “Reero inwe mweatananire ase ogokorera Omonene, kera oyomo ase rigori ria mosubati omwabo gose momura omwabo; ase ig’Omonene obasesenirie reero.”

english: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarusia ebigera bie chitaabu biare ase amato abo, bakamobiirera Aroni.

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the LORD ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agateebia abanto, “Mwakorire ebibe ebinene mono. Na bono ngotiira inde gochia ase Omonene, aande nabo ndabanyorere okobwatanigwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe.”

english: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .
ekegusii: Ase igo Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y’etaabu.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book .
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Omonto oria onkoreire ebibe, nere ndatinyie erieta riaye korwa ase egetabu yane.

english: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
ekegusii: Korende bono genda, oraae abanto abwo goika aase aria nagotebetie; omomalaika one nagotang’ane. Korende rituko ndiche ekero ndabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.”

english: And the LORD plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
ekegusii: Omonene akabaa egesusuro, ekiagera bagerete Aroni agakora emori eria, bakayesasiima.

english: And when Aaron saw it , he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation , and said , To morrow is a feast to the LORD .
ekegusii: Ekero Aroni ayeroche, akaagacha egesasiimero bosio bwaye; erio akararia, akabora, “Ankio nigo rirabe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Go , get thee down ; for thy people , which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves:
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,

english: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachigete gotunyana, bekoreire emori eeri y’etaabu. Bayesasimire na koyeruera ekeng’wanso, bagoteeba, Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , I have seen this people , and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people :
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.

english: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi barorire riire riria rigotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema, baba bakoimoka na gotung’ama inse ase ogosasiima, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa obosio ase obosio, buna omonto agokwana nomonto onde. Erio Musa aba okoirana gochia ase egetwori, korende Yoshua, omosomba oye omosae, mosinto o Nuni, tare korua ase Eema eria. Eira y’Omonene y’okoba amo nabaanto baye

english: And Moses said unto the LORD , See , thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people : and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said , I know thee by name , and thou hast also found grace in my sight .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Rora, aye nigo gwantebeetie: Baire abanto aba, korende tigwanteebia ng’a ning’o oratome agende amo nainche. Naende oganteebia: Ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa; naye kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane.

english: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
ekegusii: Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabaanto bao bare.”

english: And he said , My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche omonyene nigo ndagende amo naye, na ninkoe obotoereru.”

english: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence.
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Onye aye omonyene tokogenda amo naintwe, rirorio totige, tobeere aa.

english: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .
ekegusii: Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”

english: And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
ekegusii: Musa akamosaba, “Koranche, onyorokie obonene bwao!”

english: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite , the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite :
ekegusii: Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane, Niserie Abakanaani, na Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi na Abayebusi.

english: And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me, and live .
ekegusii: Naende akamokania, akamoteebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera Mwanyabaanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”

english: And the LORD said , Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock :
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera komoteebia, “Rora, aase aiga are ang’e nainche, aye oranyare gotenena egetare igoro.

english: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
ekegusii: Erio ekero obonene bwane borabe bogoeta, ninkobeke ase omotaro bw’egetare keria, na ngotube nokoboko kwane, goika imbe naetire.

english: And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .
ekegusii: Erio ndusie okoboko kwane, na aye ondore amagega aane, korende obosio bwane tokonyara koborora.”

english: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey : for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people : lest I consume thee in the way .
ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”

english: And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio amakong’u bakarera na onde taba obegete ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera.

english: For the LORD had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa “Bateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”

english: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarusia ebinto biria bechaberete, na tibabibeka korwa ekero baruete egetunwa kia Horebu nakogenderera. Eema y’Omosangererekano

english: And Moses took the tabernacle , and pitched it without the camp , afar off from the camp , and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation . And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation , which was without the camp .
ekegusii: Musa nigo anarete koira eema na koyetenenia are ake korwa ase egetwori akayeroka “Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Na onde bwensi oganetie kobori’Omonene ring’ana, goika are kogende ase Eema eria, isiko y’egetwori.

english: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Engaki ende yonsi Musa arenge kogenda ase Eema eria, abanto bonsi nigo baare koimoka na gotenena, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye, na korigereria Musa goika osoire Eema eria ime.

english: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the LORD talked with Moses .
ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, n’Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, na inche nindiike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria arenge ase chiria chi’eritang’ani, echio gwatete.

english: And he said , Behold, I make a covenant : before all thy people I will do marvels , such as have not been done in all the earth , nor in any nation : and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw’Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang’ana ay’okoondokia.

english: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
ekegusii: Obwate amachiiko ayio ndakoe reero. Norore ase obosio bwao ngoseria Abaamori, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.

english: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest , lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, baabaise kobatega mogwe.

english: For thou shalt worship no other god : for the LORD , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God :
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorokwa Omonyaisemi, nere Nyasae bwe risemi.

english: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods , and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice ;
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria, ekiagera ekero bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo na gochiruera ebing’wanso, mbaabaise kobarangeria inwe morie ebing’wanso biabo.

english: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .
ekegusii: Inamoire abakungu korwa ase abasubati babo abwo bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo, barabwo bakore abamura baino basasime chinyasae chiabo.

english: And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .
ekegusii: Oche bwebeeke ang’e mambia, otiire gocha ase egetunwa gia Sinai maambia, bweorokie aroro ase inde ase egechuria ki’egetunwa.

english: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD , the God of Israel .
ekegusii: “Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao bonsi abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year .
ekegusii: Ninserie abanto b’ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Write thou these words : for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Riika amang’ana aya, ekiagera ase amang’ana ayio nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye amo n’Abaisraeli.”

english: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .
ekegusii: Musa akabeera n’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tare koria kende, gose konywa, akarika ase chibao echi ibere amang’ana ’okobwatana koria, Amachiiko ayio ikomi. Musa ogotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa

english: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount ; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount .
ekegusii: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching’ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang’e negetunwa eke.”

english: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses , behold, the skin of his face shone ; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
ekegusii: Aroni na abanto bonsi, ekero baroche buna risankwa ri’obosio bwa Musa riare komeka‐meka, bakoboa komoika ang’e.

english: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
ekegusii: Korende Musa akabarangeria, erio Aroni amo nabatang’ani bonsi b’omosangererekano bakairana asare, na Musa agakwana nabarabwo.

english: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh : and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

english: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face .
ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana nabarabwo, akabeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye.

english: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .
ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw’Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogoteebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,

english: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses’ face shone : and Moses put the vail upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him.
ekegusii: na barabwo baba bakorora risankwa ri’obosio bwaye rikomeka‐meka. Erio Musa abeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye goika airana naende gokwana n’Omonene.

english: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first ; and Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up unto mount Sinai , as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikiire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.

english: And the LORD descended in the cloud , and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene agaika ore riire ime, agatenena amo nere, akararia erieta NYASAE OMOBUI.

english: Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation .
ekegusii: Nigo agokorera ebiare chilifu obwanchani botari koera; ere nigo akwabera amamocho, na ogosaria, na ebibe, korende tagotiga koa abana na abachokoro egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.”

english: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .
ekegusii: Erio bwango Musa agatung’ama inse agatureka omotwe, agasasiima,

english: And he said , If now I have found grace in thy sight , O Lord , let my Lord , I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people ; and pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for thine inheritance .
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene, onye bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe. Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.” Okobwatana kw’ogotianania kogokorwa naende (Okong’ 23:14-19; Okoir 7:1-5; 16:1-17)

english: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together , and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded , that ye should do them.
ekegusii: Musa akarangeria omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire morakore:

english: And every wise hearted among you shall come , and make all that the LORD hath commanded ;
ekegusii: “Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achiikire,

english: The tabernacle , his tent , and his covering , his taches , and his boards , his bars , his pillars , and his sockets ,
ekegusii: nabio ebi: Obomenyo na eema yaye, na egietubo kiaye, ebigobanio ne chibao chiaye, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo;

english: The ark , and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat , and the vail of the covering ,
ekegusii: Esanduki na emiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’amaabera, na etoto eria erabeekwe ebokenge;

english: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,
ekegusii: emesa na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na emegati eria eraruegwe ase Nyasae;

english: The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,
ekegusii: ekebekerero gie chitaaya na ebikorero biaye, ne chitaaya chiaye amo namaguta e chitaaya,

english: And the incense altar , and his staves , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle ,
ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa amo nemiaro yaye, na amaguta akweakwa, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya, na ebitambaa bigosungwa ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo obwo;

english: The altar of burnt offering , with his brasen grate , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
ekegusii: na egesasiimero aase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo negechungi kiaye gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye;

english: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and their sockets , and the hanging for the door of the court ,
ekegusii: ebitambaa ebirakenge eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiaye, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro,

english: The pins of the tabernacle , and the pins of the court , and their cords ,
ekegusii: na ebirochi bi’Obomenyo na ebi’eraaro amo ne chingori chiabo,

english: The cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chigokorerwa ime y’Ase Achenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni Omokuani, amo nechi’abamura baye, barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokuani.” Abanto bakorenta ebiegwa biabo

english: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses .
ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaruao agwo ase obosio bwa Musa.

english: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .
ekegusii: Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.

english: And they came , both men and women , as many as were willing hearted , and brought bracelets , and earrings , and rings , and tablets , all jewels of gold : and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha, abasacha na abakungu, na ase ogwancha kwabo bakarenta amameka, na ebigera bi’amato abo, ne chibonyi chi’ebiara, ne chisonoi, na ebinto ao ao bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera. Kera omonto akarenta ebinto bie chitaabu, ebi aatananete ase ogokorera Omonene.

english: And every man , with whom was found blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats’ hair , and red skins of rams , and badgers’ skins , brought them .
ekegusii: Naende kera omonto oyo obwate chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na egatani engiya, na amanya e chimbori, na amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, akabirenta.

english: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering : and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service , brought it .
ekegusii: Bonsi abaare konyara korua chifeta ne chitaai bakabirenta bibe ebiegwa ase Omonene, na bonsi abarenge nemekonge eyere emiya ase emeremo ende yonsi, bakayerenta.

english: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .
ekegusii: Na abakungu abaroisia abang’aini bagasisa namaboko abo chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, bagachirenta.

english: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair .
ekegusii: Na abakungu bonsi, abasugetigwe ase emioyo yabo, naende bamanyete emeremo eye, bagasisa amanya e chimbori abe chiusi.

english: And the rulers brought onyx stones , and stones to be set , for the ephod , and for the breastplate ;
ekegusii: Abatang’ani babo bakarenta amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande arabekwe ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani,

english: And spice , and oil for the light , and for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .
ekegusii: naende ebinto bie rimisu rigiya amo namaguta e chitaaya, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya.

english: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD , every man and woman , whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work , which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abarenge nogwancha korenta ebinto bi’emeremo eye Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa, bakarenta ebiegwa biabo ase Omonene. Abaroisia b’Obomenyo (Okong’ 31:1-11)

english: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .
ekegusii: Timobaisa gouta omorero ase rituko ri’Esabato, aande onsi ase momenyete.” Ogosangererigwa kw’ebiegwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu (Okong’ 25:1-9)

english: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah ;
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli, Rora, Omonene ochorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

english: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ;
ekegusii: Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong’aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,

english: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai,

english: And in the cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of wood , to make any manner of cunning work .
ekegusii: abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.

english: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he, and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .
ekegusii: Omonene omoeire ere amo na Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, obong’aini bw’okworokereria abande oboroisia bwabo.

english: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
ekegusii: Obaichoirie obong’aini ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi buna okomang’a, na okoroberia, na koroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, na koroisia ebitambaa binde bionsi. Banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi na bamanye koroberia oboroisia bonde bwonsi.

english: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the LORD commanded , saying ,
ekegusii: Musa agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:

english: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD : whosoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it, an offering of the LORD ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
ekegusii: Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai;

english: And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,
ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;

english: And onyx stones , and stones to be set for the ephod , and for the breastplate .
ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande akobekwa ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani.” Ebinto bi’Obomenyo bwa Nyasae (Okong’ 39:32-43)

english: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the LORD had commanded .
ekegusii: Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achiikire. Abanto bakorenta ebiegwa ebinge

english: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another : and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another .
ekegusii: Akabwatania ebitambaa bitano amo, bikaba rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.

english: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling : likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, bakabibeeka ase ensinyo y’egetambaa kere ensinyo y’ensemo ya kera rirondia.

english: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.

english: And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
ekegusii: Agatura ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, na ase ebio akabwatania amarondia ayio amo, akaba eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.

english: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle : eleven curtains he made them.
ekegusii: Erio akaroisia amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chigoree, akaba eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo boria.

english: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi aya ikomi na rimo nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ekemo.

english: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
ekegusii: Akabwatania amarondia atano amo, akaba rirondia erimo, naende atano na rimo akaba rirondia erimo.

english: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling , and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere ase rigochakera.

english: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together , that it might be one .
ekegusii: Naende agakora ebigobanio emerongo etano bie chitaai ase okobwaterania amarondia ayio abere, abe eema engima.

english: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers’ skins above that .
ekegusii: Agakora rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ase ogotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, erirabeekwe igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.

english: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom , even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abaasugetigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, bache, bachake emeremo eria.

english: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, agachitenenia.

english: The length of a board was ten cubits , and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao nigo bware obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Agakora chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwateranigwe. Naboigo aroisetie chibao echi chionsi chi’Obomenyo.

english: And he made boards for the tabernacle ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
ekegusii: Akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.

english: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
ekegusii: Agakora ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao ase chintamang’o chiaye ibere.

english: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
ekegusii: Nase ensemo ya kabere, nero ya sugusu y’Obomenyo, akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere,

english: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .
ekegusii: Korende ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo, eyerochie bosongo, akaroisia chibao isano nemo.

english: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao ibere chikaba chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.

english: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .
ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.

english: And they received of Moses all the offering , which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary , to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa korwa ase Musa ebiegwa ebi bionsi Abaisraeli konya barentire ase okoroisia Obomenyo boria Obochenu. Na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komorentera ebiegwa biabo kera emambia.

english: And there were eight boards ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .
ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chiabeete isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi, na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.

english: And he made bars of shittim wood ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
ekegusii: Akabaacha emeriibo etano y’emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,

english: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .
ekegusii: na etano ase rikere rinde, na etano ase ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.

english: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .
ekegusii: Akabaacha omoriibo o gati‐gati omogima, ase okoriiba chibao korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

english: And he overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .
ekegusii: Erio akaooma chibao echio netaabu, agakora chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emiaro erasoigwe, naende akaooma emeriibo eria netaabu.

english: And he made a vail of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .
ekegusii: Akaroisia etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini akayeroisia ekaba emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

english: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .
ekegusii: Naende akabaacha chisiiro inye chi’emekonge, agachiooma netaabu, na ebigobanio biaye bie chitaabu. Agakora chinterekerero inye korwa ase efeta enyititoire.

english: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework ;
ekegusii: Na ase egesoero ki’Eema akaroisia egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani, keroisirie nomoroisia omong’aini.

english: And the five pillars of it with their hooks : and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold : but their five sockets were of brass .
ekegusii: Bakabaacha chisiiro isano amo nebigobanio biabo, bakaooma ebisure ne chinuga chiabo netaabu. Chinterekerero chiabo isano nigo chiakorire korwa ase chitaai.

english: And all the wise men , that wrought all the work of the sanctuary , came every man from his work which they made ;
ekegusii: Erio abaroisia baria abang’aini, abarenge gokora emeremo ende yonsi ase Obomenyo boria Obochenu, magega kobatigire emeremo eye baare gokora bagacha ase Musa,

english: And they spake unto Moses , saying , The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work , which the LORD commanded to make .
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Abanto barentire ebiegwa ebinge goetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eri’Omonene achigete ekorwe.”

english: And Moses gave commandment , and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp , saying , Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary . So the people were restrained from bringing .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akarareria abanto bonsi b’egetwori, akabachiika, “Onde tabaisa korenta ebiegwa binde goetania ebi konya biasangererigwe ase Obomenyo Obochenu, abe omosacha gose omokungu.” Ase igo abanto bagatiga korenta ebiegwa binde.

english: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much .
ekegusii: Ebi konya barentire nigo biabeete ebinge, bigaetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria yare gocha gokorwa. Eema y’Obomenyo ekoroisigwa (Okong’ 26:1-37)

english: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
ekegusii: Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini b’abakori emeremo bakaroisia eema y’Obomenyo. Bakayeroisia nebitambaa ikomi, biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chimbariri Omoroisia omong’aini akabiroisia, bire nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.

english: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : the curtains were all of one size .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi’ekerengo ekemo.

english: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
ekegusii: Erio Besaleli akaroisia Esanduki ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo, na ekeng’ese.

english: And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
ekegusii: Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: And he overlaid it with pure gold , and made thereunto a crown of gold round about .
ekegusii: Akayeoma netaabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .
ekegusii: Erio agakora orosingo rore nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na akaroetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
ekegusii: Naende agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase chitaabu, ne chibonyi echio agachibeka ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye ane.

english: Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .
ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

english: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.

english: And he made the vessels which were upon the table , his dishes , and his spoons , and his bowls , and his covers to cover withal , of pure gold .
ekegusii: Agakora ebikorero biare kobekwa ase emesa igoro: chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa; akabiroisia bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire. Ekebekerero gie chitaaya gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 25:31-40)

english: And he made the candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work made he the candlestick ; his shaft , and his branch , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , were of the same:
ekegusii: Akaroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire. Akayeroisia nenterekerero amo ne ritina, na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha; bionsi bikaroisigwa bikaba egento ekemo.

english: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
ekegusii: Nigo kiare ne chinsagia isano nemo, chiasogete korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.

english: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch , a knop and a flower ; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch , a knop and a flower : so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick .
ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.

english: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without , and made a crown of gold to it round about .
ekegusii: Akayeooma netaabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :
ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero gie chitaaya keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.

english: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
ekegusii: Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.

english: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold .
ekegusii: Bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.

english: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chitaaya chiaye isano na ibere, na ebiinachi, ne chindogio chiaye chi’echitaabu chichenire.

english: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
ekegusii: Ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase chitaabu chichenire chi’ekerengo gie chikiro emerongo etano. Egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:1-5)

english: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit ; it was foursquare ; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
ekegusii: Akaroisia egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani erasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko abere. Emegwekano ye ching’unchara ekaroisigwa ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero.

english: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
ekegusii: Agakeooma netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.

english: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, agachibeeka inse y’omong’ororia ase chinsemo ibere. Ase chibonyi echio emiaro egasoigwa, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.

english: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
ekegusii: Na emiaro eria akabaacha korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu. Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato akoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:22-38)

english: And he cast for it four rings of gold , to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etaabu enyititoire, agachibeeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.

english: And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.

english: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .
ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria esanduki eria.

english: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
ekegusii: Akaroisia ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire ebe Oboikaranso bwa’Amaabera. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.

english: And he made two cherubims of gold , beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat ;
ekegusii: Erio agakora emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba babere ey’etaabu esunyuntire, akayebeka ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera,

english: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

english: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high , and covered with their wings over the mercy seat , with their faces one to another ; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakarambora chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachiikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bwa amaabera. Emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene ekoroisigwa (Okong’ 25:23-30)

english: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood : five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare ; and three cubits the height thereof.
ekegusii: Erio akaagacha egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chikaba chireng’aine, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.

english: Their pillars were twenty , and their brasen sockets twenty ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver .
ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

english: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits , their pillars were twenty , and their sockets of brass twenty ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu akaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Chisiiro emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

english: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits , their pillars ten , and their sockets ten ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya bosongo bakaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

english: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits .
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.

english: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.

english: And for the other side of the court gate , on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits ; their pillars three , and their sockets three .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ende bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato. Ase igo chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’egesoero chikaba chireng’aine.

english: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen .
ekegusii: Ebitambaa bionsi ebiaetanaine eraaro eria bikaroisigwa ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire.

english: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass ; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver ; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver ; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver .
ekegusii: Chinterekerero chie chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta, na ebisure biabo bikaoomwa nefeta.

english: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : and twenty cubits was the length , and the height in the breadth was five cubits , answerable to the hangings of the court .
ekegusii: Egetambaa ki’egesoero bakaroisia korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bw’egetambaa keria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano koreng’ana nobogare bwaye buna ebitambaa binde bi’eraaro.

english: And their pillars were four , and their sockets of brass four ; their hooks of silver , and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver .
ekegusii: Chisiiro inye, echiare gokebwata, ne chinterekerero chiabo inye, nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio biabo nigo biarenge bie chifeta, na ebisure bie chisiiro bikaoomwa nefeta, ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.

english: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass .
ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero akaroisia emegwekano ene ye ching’unchara, akayeroisia ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero, akaooma gionsi netai.

english: And all the pins of the tabernacle , and of the court round about , were of brass .
ekegusii: Ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo na ebi’ebitambaa bi’eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai. Omobaro bw’ebinto biare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu

english: This is the sum of the tabernacle , even of the tabernacle of testimony , as it was counted , according to the commandment of Moses , for the service of the Levites , by the hand of Ithamar , son to Aaron the priest .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebiakoreretwe ase okoroisia Obomenyo, engencho yaye Obomenyo bw’Oborori. Omobaro oyo Musa achigete ogakorwa n’Abalawi inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, mosinto o Aroni, Omokuani.

english: And Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah , made all that the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi ay’Omonene achigete Musa.

english: And with him was Aholiab , son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan , an engraver , and a cunning workman , and an embroiderer in blue , and in purple , and in scarlet , and fine linen .
ekegusii: Amo nere nigo arenge Oholiabu, omwana o Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, komokonya. Ere nigo arenge omong’aini bw’okomang’a na kobaacha, na bw’okoroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.

english: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place , even the gold of the offering , was twenty and nine talents , and seven hundred and thirty shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Etaabu yonsi eyakoreretwe ase emeremo y’okoroisia Obomenyo Obochenu, eyaatananetwe ebe ekerugwa, nigo yarenge chikiro elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,465) ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary , and the sockets of the vail ; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents , a talent for a socket .
ekegusii: Chikiro chilifu isano chi’echifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi’Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi’etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.

english: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars , and overlaid their chapiters , and filleted them.
ekegusii: Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.

english: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents , and two thousand and four hundred shekels .
ekegusii: Chitaai chiatananetwe chibe ekerugwa, nigo chiarenge chikiro chilifu isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo ene, na isano (3,545).

english: And he made all the vessels of the altar , the pots , and the shovels , and the basons , and the fleshhooks , and the firepans : all the vessels thereof made he of brass .
ekegusii: Akaroisia ebikorero bionsi bi’egesasiimero nabio ebi: Chindogio chi’okobuucha riibu, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai.

english: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the brasen altar , and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar ,
ekegusii: Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,

english: And the sockets of the court round about , and the sockets of the court gate , and all the pins of the tabernacle , and all the pins of the court round about .
ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chie chisiiro chi’eraaro chibe chinsemo chionsi, na echi’egesoero ki’eraaro, na ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo, na ebi’eraaro chinsemo chionsi.

english: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
ekegusii: Agakora egechungi gi’etai, agakebeeka korwa inse y’orosingo, kegaika gochia igoro gati gati y’egesasiimero.

english: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass , to be places for the staves .
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi’egechungi ekio gi’etai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.

english: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with brass .
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netai.

english: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar , to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards .
ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eria ase chibonyi chire chinsemo chi’egesasiimero, erinde kenyare kobogorerigwa. Agakeagacha ne chibao, akagetiga giasaime. Egetuba gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:18)

english: And he made the court : on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen , an hundred cubits :
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya Irianyi akaroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.

english: And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakaroisia chianga chinseera chi’ogokorera emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu. Bakaroisia chianga chinchenu chia Aroni, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And they set in it four rows of stones : the first row was a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this was the first row .
ekegusii: Bagakebeekera emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani bakabeeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;

english: And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.

english: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet , every one with his name , according to the twelve tribes .
ekegusii: Na amagena ayio nigo arenge ikomi na abere, akaba namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli, amang’ekire buna ekemanyererio gekomang’wa. Kera rigena rikaba nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.

english: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .
ekegusii: Bagakora ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bikabeekwa ase egesembe keria.

english: And they made two ouches of gold , and two gold rings ; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate .
ekegusii: Bagakora na ebikonde bibere bie chitaabu, ne chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, na bakabeeka chibonyi echi ibere ase emego ebere ya igoro y’egesembe keria.

english: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .
ekegusii: Bagasiberania ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi echi ibere ase emego y’egesembe keria.

english: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod , before it .
ekegusii: Naende bakabwaterania chinsinyo chinde ibere chi’ebichanga ase ebikonde biria bibere, na buna biare igo bakabibwaterania nebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio bw’egesibao ki’obokuani.

english: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward .
ekegusii: Bagakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu bagachibeeka ase egesembe keria, ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.

english: And he made the ephod of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
ekegusii: Bagakora egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

english: And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod .
ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chi’echitaabu, bagachibeeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.

english: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Bagachibwaterania chibonyi chi’egesembe amo nechi’egesibao ki’obokuani neusi eburu; erio egesembe gekabeera orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Chianga chinde chi’abakuani chikoroisigwa (Okong’ 28:31-43)

english: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work , all of blue .
ekegusii: Agakora eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chiburu chioka.

english: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .
ekegusii: Ase eganchwa eria bakabochora engoro ase omotwe ogosoera, enga buna engoro y’esati. Engoro eria ekabekwa ekenaario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.

english: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and twined linen .
ekegusii: Bagakora emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakayebeeka ase omoringero o inse.

english: And they made bells of pure gold , and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe , round about between the pomegranates ;
ekegusii: Naende bagakora chindege chi’echitaabu chichenire, bagachibeeka gati y’emegwekano ye rikomomanga chietanane omoringero o inse ase eganchwa.

english: A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Ase igo omong’ororia bw’emegwekano ye rikomomang’a bwateranirie ne chindege orenge ase omoringero o inse ase eganchwa eria ekobekwa ase obokoreri bw’obokuani. Naboigo buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron , and for his sons ,
ekegusii: Bakaroiseria Aroni amo nabamura baye chiganchwa chi’egatani engiya,

english: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,
ekegusii: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,

english: And a girdle of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , of needlework ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: na orokini rwe chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And they did beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in the blue , and in the purple , and in the scarlet , and in the fine linen , with cunning work .
ekegusii: Bagasunyunta etaabu ekaba eng’ao, naende bakayeninta ekaba chiusi chinyerere, bagachisang’ania ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, ase okoroisia egetambaa buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.

english: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE LORD .
ekegusii: Bagatura ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio, bakamang’a amang’ana aya: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.

english: And they tied unto it a lace of blue , to fasten it on high upon the mitre ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Bakayesiberania bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chiburu, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Ogoikeranigwa kw’emeremo (Okong’ 35:10-19)

english: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so did they.
ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarentera Musa Obomenyo boria, na eema amo n’ebinto bionsi ebirabeo: ebigobanio, ne chibao, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,

english: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers’ skins , and the vail of the covering ,
ekegusii: na egietubo ki’amasankwa e chimingichi, aakire etaago, na egietubo ki’amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, na etoto eria ekengete,

english: The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat ,
ekegusii: na Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na ekerogo kia amaabera,

english: The table , and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread ,
ekegusii: na emesa amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na Emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae,

english: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light ,
ekegusii: na ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire, ne chitaaya chiare kobekwa aroro amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na amaguta e chitaaya,

english: And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,
ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etaabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema,

english: The brasen altar , and his grate of brass , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,

english: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .
ekegusii: Bakaroisia ebitwanga bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria, bakabibwatania nakerokio, magega na bosio; chinsinyo chiaye ibere ibere chikabwatanigwa amo.

english: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,
ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’o mosangererekano,

english: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons’ garments , to minister in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chi’abakuani ase obokoreri bwabo ime y’Aase Aachenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni amo nechi’abamura baye barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani.

english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And Moses did look upon all the work , and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded , even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
ekegusii: Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng’a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.

english: And the curious girdle of his ephod , that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao rokaroisigwa rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold , graven , as signets are graven , with the names of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Bakabaacha amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki, bakayabeeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu; na buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare komanya komang’era ebimanyererio, bakamang’era amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli.
