english: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Bakayabeeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Egesembe ki’obokuani gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 28:15-30)

english: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
ekegusii: Egesembe ki’obokuani bagakeroisia, buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia, korwa ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, nakio keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.

english: It was foursquare ; they made the breastplate double : a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled .
ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.

english: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
ekegusii: Musa nigo arenge omorisia bwe riicho, rituko erimo gakorisia riicho ria Jethiro oyio orenge ise biara na Omokuani o Midiani, akariraa gochia bosongo y’erooro, agaika magega ya Horebu, egetunwa egechenu.

english: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ’ngogotoma inde ogende ase Farao orusie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri.”

english: And Moses said unto God , Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?
ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoteebia Nyasae, “Inche ninche ng’o, kogenda ase Farao ’ndusie Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri?”

english: And he said , Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye. Aye noruisie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri erio moche monsasime inche Nyasae ase egetunwa eke, na eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a ninche omonyene nagotoma.”

english: And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The LORD God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamoteebia Musa, “Goika obateebie Abaisraeli: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na boigo Nyasae o Yakobo ontomire ase more; erio nario erieta riane kare na kare; ase erio nigo ’ndabe ekeinyorio ekiare ase ekiare.

english: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me, saying , I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :
ekegusii: Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, aganteebia ng’a mbateebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,

english: And I have said , I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , unto a land flowing with milk and honey .
ekegusii: na igo narire eira ng’a nimbang’anyie korwa Misiri ase mogochandwa, na kobaira ase ense y’Abakaanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, ense entenenku egoiteka amabeere na obooke.

english: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go , we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God .
ekegusii: “Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na abagaaka ba Abaisraeli, ase omorwoti o Misiri, momoteebie: Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, natoorokera; na bono twanchere togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene oito, ekeng’wanso.

english: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go , no, not by a mighty hand .
ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nimanyete ng’a omorwoti o Misiri takobaa ribaga mogende atabeetereirie nokoboko kwane gwe chinguru.

english: And I will stretch out my hand , and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go .
ekegusii: Erio inche nindambore okoboko kwane, ng’ake Abamisiri namaakwa aane yogokumia. Erio magega Omorwoti nabae ribaga mogende.

english: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour , and of her that sojourneth in her house , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment : and ye shall put them upon your sons , and upon your daughters ; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Kera omokungu asabe omogisangio oye, na omokungu onde bwensi omenyete nyomba mwaye, ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu amo ne chianga; mobibekere abana baino, abamura na abaiseke. Ase enchera eyio nero morasakore Abamisiri chinibo chiabo.”

english: And Moses said , I will now turn aside , and see this great sight , why the bush is not burnt .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba, “Nigo ’ngoeta korwa moino ’ndore okorora oko kw’ogokumia, imanye naki egetutu eke getari koyia keere.”

english: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba ogoteeba, “Nao inde aa.”

english: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia, “Tobaisa goika ang’e nonya ng’ake. Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.”

english: Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face ; for he was afraid to look upon God .
ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.” Erio Musa agatuba obosio bwaye, ekiagera nigo airogete komorigereria Nyasae.

english: And the LORD said , I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt , and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters ; for I know their sorrows ;
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando yabaanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakweumia inse yamaboko y’Abamisiri abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.

english: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .
ekegusii: Nainche nigo naikire inse mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ya Abamisiri, mbatiirie korwa ase ense eria ya Misiri, mbaire ase ense engiya engare, ense eichire namabeere nobooke, ense ya Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi bono genda.

english: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
ekegusii: Nainde bono ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire ase ’nde, naende narorire ogochandwa koria Abamisiri bakobachanda,

english: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .
ekegusii: Naende oake amaguta ase egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi. Naboigo ogiatanane, kebe egechenu mono.

english: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it.
ekegusii: Oake egetuba amaguta amo nenterekerero yaye, na kogiatanana.

english: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and wash them with water .
ekegusii: “Orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.

english: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Erio obeekere Aroni chianga chiria chinchenu, omoake amaguta na komwatanana, anyare gonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani,

english: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :
ekegusii: Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga chiabo,

english: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .
ekegusii: obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”

english: Thus did Moses : according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
ekegusii: Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

english: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o kabere magega kobarure Misiri, obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.

english: And Moses reared up the tabernacle , and fastened his sockets , and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars .
ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.

english: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’obomenyo boria, na kobeeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

english: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
ekegusii: “Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, otenenie obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.

english: And he took and put the testimony into the ark , and set the staves on the ark , and put the mercy seat above upon the ark :
ekegusii: Akaimokia chibao chiriikire oborori, agachibeeka ase esanduki ime, agasoyia emiaro ase chibonyi, akamumeka esanduki eria n’ekerogo ki’amaabera.

english: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the vail of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Akabeeka esanduki eria ime y’obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

english: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation , upon the side of the tabernacle northward , without the vail .
ekegusii: Akabeeka emesa ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, isiko y’etoto, ensemo ya sugusu,

english: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD ; as the LORD had commanded Moses .
ekegusii: na akaroberia emegati igoro yaye ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.

english: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .
ekegusii: Akabeeka ekebekerero gie chitaaya ase obomenyo ime, ensemo ya Irianyi, kororia ase emesa.

english: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Naende akabeeka chitaaya igoro y’ekebekerero ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.

english: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail :
ekegusii: Akabeeka na egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, bosio bw’etoto,

english: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: na igoro yaye agasambera ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

english: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’obomenyo.

english: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation , and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe akabeeka ase egesoero ki’eema y’Omosangererekano. Igoro yaye akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.

english: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony , and cover the ark with the vail .
ekegusii: Obeeke esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori imeo, na oyekenge netoto.

english: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and put water there, to wash withal .
ekegusii: Akabeeka egetuba ase egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, akabeeka amaache ogwesibia imeo.

english: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaba bagoisaba amaboko na gosibia amagoro ase amaache ayio.

english: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasiimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar , and set up the hanging of the court gate . So Moses finished the work .
ekegusii: Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasiimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi. Riire igoro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano (Omob 9:15-23)

english: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Musa tanyara gosoa eema y’omosangererekano, ekiagera riire riria riabeete igoro yaye, na obonene bogaichora ime ase obomenyo.

english: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
ekegusii: Na ekero kende gionsi riire riare koimokerera igoro korwa ase obomenyo obwo, Abaisraeli nigo baare koimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo. Naboigo baare gokora ase orogendo rwabo rwonsi.

english: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .
ekegusii: Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.

english: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .
ekegusii: Naki riire ri’Omonene nigo riare kobeera ase bomenyo ekero kia mobaso, na ekero kia botuko omorero oba ase riire ime; na agwo Abaisraeli bonsi baba bakorirora aande onsi ase barenge ase orogendo rwabo.

english: And thou shalt bring in the table , and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick , and light the lamps thereof.
ekegusii: Osoyie emesa, na obeeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na obeeke chitaaya igoro yaye.

english: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Erio obeeke egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase ubani erasamberwe bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na osunge egetambaa kere ase egesoero ki’obomenyo.

english: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
ekegusii: Obeeke egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe bosio bw’egesoero ki’obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.

english: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein.
ekegusii: Obeeke egetuba egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, obeeke na amaache imeo.

english: And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .
ekegusii: Otenenie orosenge rw’egetambaa roetanane eraaro, na osunge egetambaa ase egesoero ki’eraaro.

english: And thou shalt take the anointing oil , and anoint the tabernacle , and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy .
ekegusii: “Oimokie amaguta akweakwa, oake obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo na obwatanane obomenyo amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, erinde bibe ebichenu.

english: And Moses answered and said , But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice : for they will say , The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akamoiraneria Nyasae akamoteebia, “Eraba rende ng’a agwo tibanyegeti, gose koigwa eriogi riaane, barabwo nigo baratebe: Omonene takoorokereti.”

english: And Moses said unto the LORD , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Omonene, “Koranche, Omonene one, inche tindi Omokuani omuya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachaagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Oromeme rwane nororito na nigo ingotutura.”

english: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the LORD ?
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okoa Mwanyabaanto omonwa bw’ogokwana? Ning’o omokorete abe rimama, gose omotino, gose abe okorora, gose koba omouko? Inee! Tari inche Omonene?

english: Now therefore go , and I will be with thy mouth , and teach thee what thou shalt say .
ekegusii: Bono genda! Nainche omonyene nimbe naye naende ninkoe amang’ana ogochia gokwana nomonwa oo na gokworokereria aya ogochia goteeba.”

english: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .
ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Omonene, koranche, toma monto onde bwensi oranche.”

english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekoberoroka ase Musa, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aroni momura omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nasasoke ase enkoro yaye.

english: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .
ekegusii: Aye nokwane nere, omoteebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, boigo nimbaorokererie aya mogochi gokora.

english: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .
ekegusii: Nere orabe ogokwana nabaanto ribaga riao; ere abe Omokuani oo, na aye obe Enyasae asare ere.

english: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .
ekegusii: Aye obogorie enyimbo eyio koboko kwao, nero orakorere ebikone.” Musa okoirana gochia Misiri

english: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law , and said unto him, Let me go , I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt , and see whether they be yet alive . And Jethro said to Moses , Go in peace .
ekegusii: Musa akairana gochia ase Jethiro, ise biara, akamoteebia, “Koranche, tiga ing’irane gochia Misiri korora abaminto gose moyo bare.” Jethiro akamoteebia, “Ee, genda nomorembe.”

english: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .
ekegusii: Ekero Musa konya atararwa aaria Midiani, Omonene akamoteebia, “Irana gochia Misiri, ekiagera baria bonsi barigetie obogima bwao bakuure.”

english: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .
ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria, “Inki ekio obwate koboko kwao?” Musa akairaneria, “Nenyimbo.”

english: And Moses took his wife and his sons , and set them upon an ass , and he returned to the land of Egypt : and Moses took the rod of God in his hand .
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia mokaye na abana baye, akabariinia etigere igoro, na barabwo bakairana gochia ase ense ya Misiri. Ere akabogoria enyimbo ya Nyasae koboko kwaye.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono ekero orabe gokoirana Misiri, origererie buya ng’a nokore ase obosio bwa Farao amakumia onsi aya nakoeire okobua gw’okoyakora. Korende ninkong’ie enkoro yaye, na ere tagotiga abanto bagende.

english: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the LORD , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
ekegusii: Erio omoteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Abaisraeli nomwana one omotangi.

english: And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
ekegusii: Kobare nchera kogenda, Omonene akaumerana na Musa aase baare gotimokera, akarigia komoita.

english: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone , and cut off the foreskin of her son , and cast it at his feet , and said , Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
ekegusii: Erio Sipora akaimokia rigena riare erioge, agasara omwana oye risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha akarikunia amagoro a Musa, akabora, “Amaene, nigo ore omonywomi one bw’amanyinga.”

english: So he let him go : then she said , A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision .
ekegusii: Agw’Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateeba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”

english: And the LORD said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Genda gochia ase erooro orotote Musa.” Erio Aroni akagenda, akaumerana na Musa ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, akamonyunyunta.

english: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie, na igoro y’ebikone bionsi amochigeete akore.

english: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda, bagasangereria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.

english: And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent ; and Moses fled from before it.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.

english: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia amang’ana onsi Omonene atebeetie Musa, na ere agakora ebikone biria maiso marore ase obosio bw’abaanto.

english: And the people believed : and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakwegena; na ekero baigwete ng’a Omonene bwechandeire Abaisraeli, na ororire emechando yabo, barabwo bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Put forth thine hand , and take it by the tail . And he put forth his hand , and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand :
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Erio ere akarambora okoboko kwaye, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.

english: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee.
ekegusii: Na Omonene akamoteebia, “Okore igo, na barabwo inabegene ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nakoorokera.”

english: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga yao ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire okorabu se ase buna okwo omorwaire bwa ukoma.

english: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Irania okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora bo, na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire buya, buna koreng’ana omobere oye onde ore.

english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Onye tibakwegena amang’ana ao, gose tibagwancha ase egekone kie ritang’ani, rirorio mbanche ase egia kabere.

english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs , neither hearken unto thy voice , that thou shalt take of the water of the river , and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land .
ekegusii: Onye tibakwegena nonya nase ebikone ebio bibere, gose gwancha amang’ana ao, rirorio obuuche amaache make korwa ase orooche rwa Naeli, oyaitere ase ense enyomo; amaache ayio orabuuche korwa ase orooche naonchoke abe amanyinga ase ense enyomo.”

english: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the LORD God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Kae abanto baane ribaga basoe ase orogendo gochia gonkorera omoyega bwe Rituko Rinene aaria ase erooro.”

english: And the taskmasters of the people went out , and their officers , and they spake to the people , saying , Thus saith Pharaoh , I will not give you straw .
ekegusii: Abachandi abwo na abateneneri bagasoka bagateebia Abaisraeli, “Farao oteebire iga: Tinkobaa inwe chimboba naende.

english: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .
ekegusii: Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika moroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, kende nkeiyo nonya negeke kegokeigwa korwa ase ekerengo kie emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.”

english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.

english: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying , Fulfil your works , your daily tasks , as when there was straw .
ekegusii: Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteeba, “Goika moroisie kera rituko ekerengo kia amatabori buna konya mokoroisia ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”

english: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?
ekegusii: Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabateebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na reero, oyio konya mokoroisia botambe?”

english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?
ekegusii: Erio abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Farao, bagateeba, “Inki ogotokorera abasomba bao iga?

english: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us, Make brick : and, behold, thy servants are beaten ; but the fault is in thine own people .
ekegusii: Chimboba titori koegwa, korende nigo tokona‐kobetererigwa ng’a toroisie amatabori. Na bono, abasomba bao, nigo bakona‐goakwa; korende okomocha nokw’abaanto bao.”

english: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD .
ekegusii: Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nigo mobarachete nakio gekogera mogoteeba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.

english: Go therefore now, and work ; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .
ekegusii: Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino. Timokorenterwa chimboba, korende goika moroisie ekerengo kia amatabori, keria mochikiire koroisia.”

english: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .
ekegusii: Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokong’u ekiagera bateebetigwe ng’a, “Goika moikeranie kera rituko ekerengo keria kia amatabori.”

english: And Pharaoh said , Who is the LORD , that I should obey his voice to let Israel go ? I know not the LORD , neither will I let Israel go .
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Omonene nere ng’o inyigwe amang’ana aye, na koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende? Inche timomanyeti Omonene, gose tinkoa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.”

english: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
ekegusii: Ekero baare korua ase Farao, bakanyora Musa na Aroni agwo nchera baabaganyete,

english: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.” Ogosaba kwa Musa

english: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me?
ekegusii: Erio Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ogokorera abanto aba amabe buna aya? Inki rende gwantomera inche?

english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name , he hath done evil to this people ; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all .
ekegusii: Naki korwa riria nagendete ase Farao gokwana amang’ana ao omentire gokorera abanto bao bobe mono, na aye torakora kende ase okobatooria.”

english: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go , we pray thee, three days’ journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the LORD our God ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakamoteebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaiberania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde tomoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”

english: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri akabairaneria, “Musa na Aroni, nase ki mogotenenia abanto korwa ase emeremo yabo? Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino y’obosomba.”

english: And Pharaoh said , Behold, the people of the land now are many , and ye make them rest from their burdens .
ekegusii: Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo yobosomba.”

english: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachiika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabateebia,

english: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves.
ekegusii: “Timoa abanto aba naende chimboba ase okoroisia amatabori, buna mware kobaa agwo ritang’ani. Tiga bagende barabwo boka kwerigeria chimboba.

english: And the tale of the bricks , which they did make heretofore , ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle ; therefore they cry , saying , Let us go and sacrifice to our God .
ekegusii: Korende mobabetererie baroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oyo baare gokora ritang’ani, batari koyokeyia. Barabwo tibari nemeremo ebaisaine. Nakio gekogera bakona‐koboria ng’a: Toe ribaga togende koruera Nyasae oito ekeng’wanso.

english: Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words .
ekegusii: Bae abanto abwo emeremo emerito mono, kegima baisaneke nero, na tibanyora ribaga riogotegerera amang’ana ’oborimo.”

english: Then the LORD said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono norore aya ndakorere Farao. Naki ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nimobetererie abae abanto baane ribaga bagende, ee, ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nabetererigwe abaserie korwa ase ense yaye.” Okorangerigwa kwa Musa naende

english: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land .
ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, omoteebie abae Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, barue ase ense yaye.”

english: And Moses spake before the LORD , saying , Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me , who am of uncircumcised lips ?
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene, akamoteebia. “Rora Abaisraeli baangire konyigwera, naki rende Farao ere arakore anyigwere, inche omonto ntamanyeti gokwana.?”

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabachika bagende bateebie Abaisraeli na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ng’a batomirwe barusie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Musa na Aroni

english: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses : The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel ; Hanoch , and Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi : these be the families of Reuben .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chiamate chiabo. Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omomura omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Rubeni.

english: And the sons of Simeon ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman : these are the families of Simeon .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokanani. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Simioni.

english: The sons of Gershon ; Libni , and Shimi , according to their families .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei, ne chiamate chiabo.

english: And the sons of Kohath ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli. Kohati nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etato (133).

english: And the sons of Merari ; Mahali and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.

english: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .
ekegusii: Amuramu akanyuoma Yokebedi, omoiseke omwabo ise; na ere akamoiborera Aroni na Musa. Amuramu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).

english: And the sons of Izhar ; Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isari nabwo aba: Kora, na Nefegi, na Sikiri.

english: And the sons of Uzziel ; Mishael , and Elzaphan , and Zithri .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.

english: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Naashon , to wife ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
ekegusii: Aroni akanyuoma Elisheba, omoiseke bw’Aminadabu, omoiseke omwabo Nashoni. Ere akamoiborera Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

english: And the sons of Korah ; Assir , and Elkanah , and Abiasaph : these are the families of the Korhites .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.

english: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife ; and she bare him Phinehas : these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families .
ekegusii: Eleazari, omwana o Aroni, akanyuoma omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Putieli, na ere akamoiborera Finehasi. Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chinyomba chi’Abalawi, eamate ase eamate.

english: These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the LORD said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .
ekegusii: Aroni amo na Musa nabwo bari’Omonene atebeetie, “Barusie Abaisraeli ase ense ya Misiri, omoganda ase omoganda.”

english: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo baria Musa na Aroni bateebeetie Farao ng’a barusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri. Omonene ogochika Musa na Aroni

english: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,
ekegusii: Rituko riri’Omonene akwanete na Musa ase ense ya Misiri

english: That the LORD spake unto Moses , saying , I am the LORD : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Omonene. Otebie Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, amang’ana onsi nkogoteebia.”

english: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
ekegusii: Naorokerete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete ase bare.

english: And Moses said before the LORD , Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
ekegusii: Korende Musa akairaneri’Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche nomonto ntamanyeti gokwana, naki rende Farao arakore anyigwere?”

english: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their pilgrimage , wherein they were strangers .
ekegusii: Naende ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kaanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.

english: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel , whom the Egyptians keep in bondage ; and I have remembered my covenant .
ekegusii: Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.

english: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel , I am the LORD , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians , and I will rid you out of their bondage , and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm , and with great judgments :
ekegusii: Ase igo oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a, Inche ninche Omonene, ndabarusie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obosomba bwaino. Ase okoboko kwane koramboire, na goetera ase ebisusuro ebinene, nimbaboorie.

english: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Nimbakore mobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino. Inwe namomanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobarusirie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri.

english: And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the LORD .
ekegusii: Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira koa Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”

english: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel : but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit , and for cruel bondage .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio, korende barabwo tibancha gotegerera, ekiagera konya emioyo yabo y akuure, ase engencho y’emeremo y’obosomba obotindi.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora nagokorire obe buna Nyasae ase Farao, na Aroni akwane nere buna omobani oo.

english: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the LORD had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bagakora buna Omonene abachiigete. Aroni akaruta enyimbo yaye bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na ero ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti.

english: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria abanto abanyasemi na abaragori, na abwo abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo bwa bobisi.

english: For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods .
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti; korende enyimbo ya Aroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.

english: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart , that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said .
ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao nigo yarenge enkong’u, na buna Omonene atebeete, taigwera Musa na Aroni. Amaakwa ikomi Ogoakwa kw’eritang’ani: Amache akoonchoka koba amanyinga

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Pharaoh’s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.

english: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning ; lo, he goeth out unto the water ; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .
ekegusii: Ase igo, genda oumerane na Farao ekero aragende rooche mambia, ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.

english: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear .
ekegusii: Omoteebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, ontomire ngoteebie ng’a oe abanto baye ribaga bagende komokorera ase erooro. Naye goika bono toraigwa.

english: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .
ekegusii: Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amaache aria.”

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa moteebie Aroni, aimokie enyimbo yaye, arambore okoboko kwaye igoro ase amaache onsi ay’Abamisiri, ase chindooche chiabo na ase ebirooche, ase amatibo onsi ne chinsoko. Amache ayio onsi aonchoke abe amanyinga. Naboigo amanyinga abe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, nonya nase chintuba na ase chinyongo chionsi.

english: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .
ekegusii: Aye oteebie oyomino Aroni ayio onsi nagochikiire, na ere akwane na Farao, amoteebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.

english: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded ; and he lifted up the rod , and smote the waters that were in the river , in the sight of Pharaoh , and in the sight of his servants ; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Ase obosio bwa Farao na abasomba baye, Aroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche, na amaache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.

english: And the fish that was in the river died ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amaache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

english: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said .
ekegusii: Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebiire, tabaigwa.

english: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house , neither did he set his heart to this also.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akairana akogenda bwoye, amang’ana aria tayabeka ase omoyo oye.

english: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink ; for they could not drink of the water of the river .
ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y’orooche ase okorigia amaache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amaache a rooche.

english: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the LORD had smitten the river .
ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere akaera korwa riri’Omonene aagete orooche rwa Naeli.

english: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt , and bring forth mine armies , and my people the children of Israel , out of the land of Egypt by great judgments .
ekegusii: Korende Farao takobaigwa. Inche nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri na kobaa ebisusuro ebinene, na nindusie emeganda yane, abanto baane Abaisraeli, korwa ase ense ya Misiri.

english: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt , and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, ekero ndarambore okoboko kwane ase barabwo na koruisia Abaisraeli korwa ase bare.”

english: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete.

english: And Moses was fourscore years old , and Aaron fourscore and three years old , when they spake unto Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Aroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83). Enyimbo ya Aroni

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni,

english: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying , Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and cast it before Pharaoh , and it shall become a serpent .
ekegusii: “Ekero Farao arababorie ng’a mokore egekone, erio aye Musa oteebie Aroni abogorie enyimbo yaye, ayerute inse bosio bwa Farao, na ero neonchoke ebe eng’iti.”

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses , Go unto Pharaoh , and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Let my people go , that they may serve me.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.

english: And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God .
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Ng’ankio.” Musa akamoteebia, “Nigo erabe buna gwateba, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari buna Omonene, Nyasae oito.

english: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people ; they shall remain in the river only.
ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

english: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh : and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akabori’Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.

english: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses ; and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the villages , and out of the fields .
ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa amoboretie, na ebioto ebio biare ase chinyomba, na ase chigoora, na aande onsi isiko, bigakwa.

english: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .
ekegusii: Abanto bakabisangereria, bakabibeka ebinge chinyinge, na ense yonsi egatioka bobe.

english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Farao aroche ng’a amang’ana abeire buya, agakong’ia enkoro yaye naende, na buna Omonene ateebete, akanga koigwa Musa na Aroni. Ogoakwa kw’agatato: Chinsona

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch out thy rod , and smite the dust of the land , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni aimokie enyimbo yaye aake orotu rw’eriroba, na rororwo naroonchoke robe chinsona ase ense ya Misiri.”

english: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagakora bo. Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka riroba nenyimbo yaye, na orotu rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona, na chirochio chikaroma Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo. Orotu rwonsi rwe riroba rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona.

english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not: so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .
ekegusii: Abaringoria nabarabwo bagateema korenta chinsona ase oborogi bwabo, korende tibanyara. Chinsona echio chikaba aande onsi, ase Mwanyabaanto na ase chitugo.

english: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
ekegusii: Korende koraange kobaa ribaga bagende, rirorio inche ning’ake ense yao yonsi ase okorenta ebioto.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh ; lo, he cometh forth to the water ; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Let my people go , that they may serve me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni ekero Farao agochia kogenda rooche, otenene ase obosio bwaye, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.

english: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go , behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thy houses : and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .
ekegusii: Onye tokoa abanto baane ribaga, rirorio nintome chingi chinyinge igoro yao na abasomba bao, na igoro y’abanto bao ne chinyomba chiao. Chinyomba chi’Abamisiri inachiichorwe ne chingi, nonya nense eyio yonsi bamenyete.

english: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth .
ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.

english: And I will put a division between my people and thy people : to morrow shall this sign be.
ekegusii: Ninkore ogwatananeka egati y’abanto baane na abao. Ankio egekone eke nagekoreke.”

english: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants’ houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
ekegusii: Omonene agakora ayio. Chingi chigaacha ase obonge mono ase chinyomba chia Farao, na echi’abasomba baye, na ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Na ense eria egasarigwa ne chingi chiria.

english: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land .
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Genda moruere Nyasae oino ekeng’wanso, korende naiga ase ense yaito.”

english: And Moses said , It is not meet so to do ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God : lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us?
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora igo, ekiagera intwe ntoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso ekeragechie Abamisiri. Na onye Abamisiri bagotorora tokorua ekeng’wanso buna ekio, Inee, tibagocha gotoaka amagena?

english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the LORD our God , as he shall command us.
ekegusii: Goika togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso buna atochikiire.”

english: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness ; only ye shall not go very far away : intreat for me .
ekegusii: Farao akabateebia, “Nimbae ribaga mogende moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekeng’wanso ase erooro, korende timogenda aare, naende monsabere inche.”

english: And Moses said , Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people , to morrow : but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD .
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

english: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly , which shall go up and come into thine house , and into thy bedchamber , and upon thy bed , and into the house of thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thine ovens , and into thy kneadingtroughs :
ekegusii: Orooche rwa Naeli naroichorwe nebioto, na birobio nabitiire korwa aroro, nabisoe nyomba mwao, na enyomba yao y’okorara, amo noborere bwao; nabisoe ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao na echi’abaanto bao, ase amariiko ao ase okogeekera emegati, na ase ebituba biao bi’ooboseemiara obosie.

english: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and intreated the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.

english: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses ; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people ; there remained not one .
ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa ateebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.

english: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go .
ekegusii: Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye nonya nengaki eyio, taa abanto ribaga bagende.

english: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people , and upon all thy servants .
ekegusii: Ebioto ebio inabikogenderere omobere oo, na ey’abaanto bao, na ey’abasomba bao.”

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

english: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amaache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.

english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments , and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.

english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Intreat the LORD , that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”

english: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only?
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Farao, “Ase amasikani ao, naye oranteebie ngaki ki ndagosabere aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao, erinde ebioto birue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, bitigare koba ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”

english: Then the LORD said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh , and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.

english: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Na abaringoria tibanyara gotenena ase obosio bwa Musa, ekiagera amagumba konya abariire barabwo buna Abamisiri bande.

english: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh , and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na buna Omonene konya atebirie Musa, Farao akaanga koigwa Musa na Aroni. Ogoakwa gwa gatan’akabere Embura y’amagena

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni, otenene ase obosio bwa Farao, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.

english: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
ekegusii: Engaki eye nindete amaakwa aane onsi igoro yao aye omonyene, na igoro y’abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari, nonya noyomo, ore buna inche, ase ense engima.

english: For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
ekegusii: Naki ase engaki eye nanga narambora okoboko kwane ngoake aye amo nabaanto bao namarwaire amabe abaite, aye nanga ngwasira korwa ase ense eye.

english: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?
ekegusii: Ekiagera aye nigo ogendererete gotanga abanto baane, na tori kobaa ribaga bagende.

english: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
ekegusii: Ase igo ankio, engaki buna eye, nindete embura y’amagena endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa rinde ase Misiri korwa riria ense eye yachaagete goika bono.

english: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die .
ekegusii: Bono, origererie orore ng’a chitugo chiao chiarentirwe inka, naboigo na kende kiao gionsi kere isiko. Onye abanto bonsi abare isiko tibakorentwa ase chinyomba ime, embura y’amagena nebaite bakwe, ne chitugo chionsi boigo.”

english: For if thou refuse to let them go , and wilt hold them still,
ekegusii: Naki onye gokwanga kobaa ribaga, na kogenderera kobatanga,

english: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
ekegusii: Abande b’abasomba ba Farao, abwo bairogete ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakaayerera korenta abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo inka.

english: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field .
ekegusii: Korende abwo basiereretie ring’ana ri’Omonene, bagatiga abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo isiko.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven , that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt , upon man , and upon beast , and upon every herb of the field , throughout the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erio embura y’amagena etwe ase ense ya Misiri, etwere Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo, na ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

english: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the LORD sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground ; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Musa akaimokereria enyimbo yaye gochia igoro, n’Omonene akarenta chinkoba na embura y’amagena, na okomesa gw’enkoba kogaika ase ense. Naboigo Omonene agaitera embura y’amagena igoro ya Misiri.

english: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field , both man and beast ; and the hail smote every herb of the field , and brake every tree of the field .
ekegusii: Embura eria y’amagena egaita Mwanyabaanto bonsi abarenge isiko, amo ne chitugo chionsi ase ense ya Misiri. Egaita na gosaria ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo, ekabuna na emete yonsi y’orosana.

english: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya Goseni yoka, ase Abaisraeli bamenyete, nao embura y’amagena etatwete.

english: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them, I have sinned this time : the LORD is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Ase engaki eye inche nakorire ebibe; Omonene nere omonyene oboronge, inche na abanto baane nabamochi tore.

english: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”

english: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD’s .
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Ekero nkorua ase omochie oo ninyimokie amaboko aane nsabe Omonene. Chinkoba echi nachisire, na embura y’amagena tegotwa goetania. Erio aye onyare komanya ng’a ense ney’Omonene.

english: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field , upon the horses , upon the asses , upon the camels , upon the oxen , and upon the sheep : there shall be a very grievous murrain .
ekegusii: erio nario okoboko kw’Omonene koraake chitugo chiao aase chikorisia, ne chibarasi chiao, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi; chirochio chinyore oborwaire obobe mono borachiite.

english: But as for thee and thy servants , I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God .
ekegusii: Korende nimanyete ng’a, aye na abasomba bao, timomoirogeti Omonene Nyasae nonya mbono.”

english: And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .
ekegusii: Egatani na esairi bigaakwa, bigasarigwa, naki esairi konya yabekire ebigara, na egatani ngosomoria yare.

english: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten : for they were not grown up .
ekegusii: Korende chingano tichiasaretigwe, ekiagera konya tichirakina.

english: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh , and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD : and the thunders and hail ceased , and the rain was not poured upon the earth .
ekegusii: Korende Musa akarua o Farao, agasoka isiko yo omochie, akaimokia amaboko aye, agasaba Omonene. Erio chinkoba chiria na embura y’amagena bigatangwa, na embura tiyagenderera gotwa ase ense.

english: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased , he sinned yet more , and hardened his heart , he and his servants .
ekegusii: Ekero Farao aroche ng’a embura y’amagena ne chinkoba biatangirwe, akagenderera gokora ebibe, bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo ere amo nabasomba baye.

english: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , neither would he let the children of Israel go ; as the LORD had spoken by Moses .
ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, na buna Omonene konya akwanire goetera ase Musa, akaanga gotiga Abaisraeli bagende.

english: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children’s of Israel .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nakore ogwatananeka egati ye chitugo chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abamisiri. Ase echi’Abaisraeli ende tegokwa nonya neyemo.”

english: And the LORD appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land .
ekegusii: Omonene agachora engaki, akabora, “Ankio inche Omonene ninchiche nkore ayio ase ense eye.”

english: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow , and all the cattle of Egypt died : but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Omonene agakora buna ateebete. Chitugo chionsi chi’Abamisiri chigakwa, korende echi’Abaisraeli ende tiyakwa nonya neyemo.

english: And Pharaoh sent , and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .
ekegusii: Farao agatoma abanto barigie egiakoregete, na barabwo bakamorentera amang’ana ng’a ase Abaisraeli tugo yabo ende tekweti. Nonya nabo enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, tabaa abanto ribaga bagende. Ogoakwa kwa gatan’arimo: Amagumba

english: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Genda mobuuche ribu riichire roe korwa riko, na Musa arisiare gochia igoro, ase obosio bwa Farao.

english: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Narirorio rionchoke ribe orotu, roirurukigwe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, rorente amagumba na amaote amabe, ase Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo.”

english: And as for their appearances , they four had one likeness , as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel .
ekegusii: Amagoro aria ane nigo agwekaine, kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.

english: When they went , they went upon their four sides ; they turned not as they went , but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went .
ekegusii: Ekero amagoro ayio arenge kogenda, nigo arenge kogenda ase chinsemo inye chionsi, tarenge koonchoka, akaba akogenda gochia bosio rioka, korende ase okogoro kwa bosio kwarenge kogenda gochia, onsi nigo arenge kobwatia gochiao atari koonchoka ekero akogenda.

english: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .
ekegusii: Nkaigwa amagoro aria akorokwa “Oborundarundia”.

english: And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .
ekegusii: Amakerubi abwo bakaimoka gochia igoro. Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria narooche ang’e norooche rwa Kebari.

english: And when the cherubims went , the wheels went by them : and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria barenge kogenda naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge goeta mbarabare yabo, na ekero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria barenge korambora chimbaaba chiabo ase okoimoka gochia igoro, amagoro aria tarenge gwatananeka korwa ase bare.

english: When they stood , these stood ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
ekegusii: Ekero barenge gotenena, na amagoro aria naro atenena; ekero barenge koimoka gochia igoro, na amagoro aria aimoka amo nabarabwo, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria nigo orenge ime yabo.

english: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokarua ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba y’Omonene, bokagenda bogatenena igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria.

english: And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
ekegusii: Erio ’nkarora ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria bakorambora chimbaaba chiabo na koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba ekero bagendete, na amagoro aria naro akagenda amo nabarabwo. Bagatenena ase egesoero ki’egeita kia moocha kegochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nigo bwarenge igoro yabo.

english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria narooche bire inse ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli ang’e norooche rwa Kebari, na nkamanya ng’a abwo nebitongwa bibwate chimbaba barenge.

english: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
ekegusii: Kera oyomo nigo abwate amasio ane, ne chimbaaba inye, na inse ya kera orobaaba egento nkiarengeo gekororekana buna okoboko kwa Mwanyabaanto.

english: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar , their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward .
ekegusii: Amasio abo nigo agwekaine kegima buna aria narooche agwo ang’e norooche rwa Kebari. Kera oyomo akagenderera gochia bosio atari koonchoka.

english: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in ; and the cloud filled the inner court .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo nigo bateneine ensemo ya Irianyi y’enyomba y’Omonene, ekero omonto oria asoeteo, ne riire rigaichora ase eraaro ya ime.

english: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory .
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro, bokarua ase egetongwa kebwate chimbaba oria, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba eria; enyomba eria egaichorwa ne riire, na eraaro egaichorwa nobomeka‐meku bw’obonene bw’Omonene.

english: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’ogoakania chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria rikaigugwa ase eraaro ya isiko, buna eriogi ria Nyasae Omobui ekero agokwana.

english: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene achiigete omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani agende korusia omorero korwa ase egati‐gati y’amagoro aria anga chinyange, korwa ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, omonto oria agasoa agatenena ang’e nokomo kw’amagoro aria.

english: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims , and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen : who took it , and went out .
ekegusii: Omokerubi oria oyomo akarambora okoboko kwaye ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bande, na agaanchara omorero bw’amakara orenge ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria bande, akayobeka ase amaboko ’omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, na omonto oria akayobogoria, agasoka n’oro isiko.

english: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings .
ekegusii: Nkarora inse ye chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria egento gekororekana buna okoboko kw’omonto.

english: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’s house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene kiarochie moocha. Na rora, agwo ase egesieri ki’egeita mbarengeo abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano, na ase egati yabo nkarora Yasania, mosinto bw’Asuri, na Peletia, mosinto o Benaya, abwo barenge abagaambi b’ abanto.

english: Ye shall fall by the sword ; I will judge you in the border of Israel ; and ye shall know that I am the LORD .
ekegusii: Inwe imoitwe nemioro. Nimbanachere ekiina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

english: This city shall not be your caldron , neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel :
ekegusii: Omochie oyo tori gochia koba buna enyang’eni ase more, na inwe timori koba chinyama ime yaye; inche nimbanachere ekiina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli.

english: And ye shall know that I am the LORD : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
ekegusii: Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Inwe mwangire kobwatia emeroberio y’ane echiikire, gose timori gokora aya nachiikire, korende nigo mogokora koreng’ana namachiiko y’ abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”

english: And it came to pass, when I prophesied , that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then fell I down upon my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , Ah Lord GOD ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel ?
ekegusii: Ekero nagendererete kobana, Pelatia, mosinto o Benaya, agakwa. Erio ’ngatung’ama inse maumama, ’nkarera neriogi rinene, ’nkabora, “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia goita osirie kegima abatigari b’Abaisraeli?” Eira ya Nyasae ase abooswa

english: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying ,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia,

english: Son of man , thy brethren , even thy brethren , the men of thy kindred , and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said , Get you far from the LORD : unto us is this land given in possession .
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo bagokwana igoro y’ abanto bamino b’egesaku kiao, ee, igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi, bagoteeba: Barabwo nigo bare aare korwa ase Omonene, ense eye nintwe twaeirwe ebe eyaito.

english: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nonya nabaseririe gochia aare ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku na kobasiarera gochia ase chinse chionsi, inche omonyene nabeire inde obomenyo bwabo obochenu ase engaki eyio enke, agwo ase chinse echio baseretigwe gochia.

english: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nimbasangererie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, na korwa ase chinse echio ase nabasiarerete gochia, erio mbairanie inwe Abaisraeli, ’mbae ense yaino.

english: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
ekegusii: Ekero barabe bairanire ase ense eyio, mbatugute korwa aroro emegwekano egosasiimwa y’obosooku, na okogechia gwonsi.

english: Then said he unto me, Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto aba nabwo bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe na korua ogoseemia kw’ogokora amabe ase omochie oyo.

english: That they may walk in my statutes , and keep mine ordinances , and do them: and they shall be my people , and I will be their God .
ekegusii: Erio nario barabwatie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, babwatie na amachiiko ane na koyaigwera. Barabwo mbabe abanto bane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.

english: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord GOD .
ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo chinkoro chiabo chikobwatia emegwekano bagosasiima y’obosooku na okogechia, barabwo imbaakane ogokora kwabo kobairanere.” Nabo Omonene agoteeba. Obonene bwa Nyasae bogotiga Yerusalemu

english: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro korwa ase omochie oria, bokagenda bogatenena igoro ase egetunwa kere moocha y’omochie.

english: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
