ekegusii: Omorwoti nabe okweumia, na abagaambi mbatubwe nomoichano; amaboko y’ abanto b’ense eye nabe akoiguswa ase obwoba. Nimbakorere koreng’ana nogokora kwabo; nimbagaambie koreng’ana buna barenge kogaamba. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

english: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .
ekegusii: “Bono omoerio ogocheire, na inche ’nkorenta ’nde endamwamu y’ane ebe igoro ase ore, na ninkonachere ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwao; ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao gwonsi gw’okogechia.

english: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity : but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD .
ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a tinkoroochi, gose tingokororera amaabera, korende ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao, na ogokora kwao gw’okogechia ’ngokoiranere. Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”

english: Thus saith the Lord GOD ; An evil , an only evil , behold, is come .
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, obobe ngoocha bore, obobe borabe bogoetania bonde bwonsi.

english: An end is come , the end is come : it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come .
ekegusii: Omoerio ’ngoocha ore, ee, omoerio ’ngoocha ore okonyore! Naama! Ngoocha ore!

english: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense eye, bono egeku nkobacheera kere. Engaki yao yaikire; rituko ri’omoichano ngocha rire; tirikoba rituko ri’ogoaka amariogi y’omogooko igoro ase ebitunwa.

english: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .
ekegusii: “Bono yatigaire engaki enke, inche ng’umore okogechigwa kwane na goikerania endamwamu y’ane igoro ase more. Nimbanachere ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwaino, nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’okogechia kwaino gwonsi.

english: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth .
ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera, korende nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino, na ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia nkobairanere. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene nabaakire.

english: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o gatano na rimo, ekero narenge ng’ikaransete nyomba mw’ane amo nabagaaka b’Abayuda, okoboko kw’Omonene kogaacha igoro y’ane.

english: So I went in and saw ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , pourtrayed upon the wall round about .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ngasoa ime, nkarigereria enyasi chinsemo chionsi, ’nkarora kera egesaku gie ching’iti chi’okogechia, na emegwekano yonsi Abaisraeli bagosasiima, biamang’eire ase chinyasi.

english: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .
ekegusii: Abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere, amo na Yasania, mosinto o Safania, nigo bateneine ase egati y’emegwekano eyio y’ogosasiimwa. Kera oyomo nigo abwate ase amaboko aye egetaabo ki’ogosambera ubani, na erioki ria ubani richongororogete gochia igoro.

english: Then said he unto me, Son of man , hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark , every man in the chambers of his imagery ? for they say , The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth .
ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwarorire egento abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagokora ase omosunte, kera oyomo ase akanunchi ka’ye k’emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa? Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: Omonene tatorochi. Ere otigire ense eye.”

english: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .
ekegusii: Naende aganteebia, “Norore okogechia okonene kobua okwo barabwo bagokora.”

english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north ; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz .
ekegusii: Erio akang’ira ase egesoero ki’egeita gia sugusu ase enyomba y’Omonene, na aroro ’nkarora abakungu baikaranseteo bakoreera enyasae ekorokwa Tamusi.

english: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwarorire amang’ana aya? Norore okogechia okonene kobuete oko.”

english: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house , and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men , with their backs toward the temple of the LORD , and their faces toward the east ; and they worshipped the sun toward the east .
ekegusii: Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo ase egesieri gie Hekalu y’Omonene egati y’enyomba ya bosio na egesasiimero, nkarora abasacha koreng’ana emerongo ebere, na batano. Barabwo nigo baete Hekalu y’Omonene amagega, barigereretie gochia moocha. Abwo nigo barenge gosasiima erioba barigereretie gochia moocha.

english: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and, lo, they put the branch to their nose .
ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwarorire amang’ana aya? Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu mono ase Abayuda ng’a bakore ebibe bi’okogechia, ebio bagokorera aase aiga? Nigo bagochia goichoria ense yonsi nobobe na bangechie imbe nendamwamu naende? Rora buna babeekire orosagia rw’omosabibu ase chimioro chiabo.

english: Therefore will I also deal in fury : mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice , yet will I not hear them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimbakorere amabe inde nendamwamu. Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera. Nabaisa korera baake eriogi rinene ase ’nde, tinkobaigwa.”

english: And he put forth the form of an hand , and took me by a lock of mine head ; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven , and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem , to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north ; where was the seat of the image of jealousy , which provoketh to jealousy .
ekegusii: Akarambora omogwekano onga buna okoboko, akabwata etukia y’omotwe one. Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro ase egati y’ense na igoro, na ase okorora gokorwa ase Nyasae Omoika okang’ira Yerusalemu. Okang’ira goika ase egesoero ki’eraaro ya ime, goetera ase egeita kiarochie sugusu. Aroro agwo nao omogwekano obekire, oyio obogetie risemi ria Nyasae.

english: Then said he unto me, Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
ekegusii: Erio Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie gochia sugusu.” Ase ayio nkarigereria gochia sugusu, nkarora omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, oria obogetie risemi ria Nyasae oteneine ensemo ya sugusu y’egesoero ki’egeita kegochia ase egesasiimero.

english: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Inee, kwarorire egento Abaisraeli bagokora? Nigo bagokora ebibe ebinge bi’okogechia aase aiga, na bagonseria gochia aare korwa Aase ane Aachenu. Korende norore okogechia okonene kobua okwo.”

english: And he brought me to the door of the court ; and when I looked , behold a hole in the wall .
ekegusii: Erio akandeta ase egesieri ki’eraaro, na ekero narigereretie nkarora ekebao ase enyasi.

english: Then said he unto me, Son of man , dig now in the wall : and when I had digged in the wall , behold a door .
ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bochora enyasi eyio.” Ekero nabochorete gochia ime, ’nkarora egesieri.

english: And he said unto me, Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
ekegusii: Aganteebia, “Soa gochia ime, erinde orore ebibe bi’okogechia okonene bagokorera aase aiga.”

english: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice , saying , Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near , even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand .
ekegusii: Nkaigwa Omonene ogoaka eriogi rinene, ogoteeba, “Teebia abwo bachiikirwe gosaria omochie bache, kera oyomo ache ore nekerwanero kiaye ase okoboko kwaye.”

english: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity , but I will recompense their way upon their head .
ekegusii: Inche tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amaabera, goika mbaakane ogokora kwabo kobairanere.”

english: And, behold, the man clothed with linen , which had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , I have done as thou hast commanded me.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, na bweboeranetie ekaramu akoriikera, akairana akarenta amang’ana, agateeba, “Nakorire buna gwanchiigete.”

english: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer’s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .
ekegusii: Erio abanto batano nomo bagaacha korwa ase egeita kia rogoro kerochie sugusu. Kera oyomo agacha obwate ekerwanero kiaye ki’ogoita koboko kwaye, bare amo nomonto obegete eanga y’egatani, bwebeoranetie ekaramu akoriikera, ere kenema kiaye. Abanto abwo bagasoa ime, bagatenena ang’e negesasiimero kiaroisirie korwa ase etai.

english: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub , whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house . And he called to the man clothed with linen , which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side ;
ekegusii: Obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaiisraeli konya bwaimokereire igoro korwa ase egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, agwo ase bwarenge, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba eria. Erio Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani bweboeranetie ekaramu akoriikera,

english: And to the others he said in mine hearing , Go ye after him through the city , and smite : let not your eye spare , neither have ye pity :
ekegusii: Nkaigwa ogoteebia abanto baria bande, “Mobwatie omonto oyio korwa magega, moetanane ase omochie bwonsi, moite abanto; timoombia ng’a timobarochi, gose timobarorera amaabera.

english: Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .
ekegusii: Moite mosirie kegima abagaaka, na abamura, na abaiseke, na abana, amo nabakaungu, korende timobaisa gokuna omonto obekeire ekemanyererio keria. Mochaakere Aase ane Aachenu.” Ase ayio bagachaaka goita abagaaka bateneine bosio bw’enyomba eria.

english: And he said unto them, Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akabateebia, “Mokore enyomba y’ane ebe eyetachenegeti; moichorie chiraaro chiaye nebitondo bi’abaanto. Nyuma y’ayio mosoe ase omochie” Ase ayio bagasoa ase omochie, bagaita abanto.

english: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left , that I fell upon my face , and cried , and said , Ah Lord GOD ! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem ?
ekegusii: Ekero abwo bagendererete goita abanto, ngatigara inche bweka. Erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarera ase Omonene, nkamoboria, “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia gosiria Abaisraeli bonsi abwo batigaire ase okoumora endamwamu yao ase Yerusalemu?”

english: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great , and the land is full of blood , and the city full of perverseness : for they say , The LORD hath forsaken the earth , and the LORD seeth not.
ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Ebibe bi’Abaisraeli na Abayuda nigo bire ebinene mono. Ense nigo eichire nogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, na omochie nigo oichire nobokorekanu bw’ogosaria amachiiko, ekiagera abanto nigo bagoteeba: Omonene otigire ense eye, ere tari korora kende.

english: Now when Ezra had prayed , and when he had confessed , weeping and casting himself down before the house of God , there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children : for the people wept very sore .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Ezra agendererete gosaba na koorokia amamocho, okorera na oramaime inse bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, omosangererekano omonene mono bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, bagacha asare. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo babete bakorera bare nobororo obonge.

english: And Ezra the priest stood up , and said unto them, Ye have transgressed , and have taken strange wives , to increase the trespass of Israel .
ekegusii: Agwo Ezra Omokuani agatenena, akabateebia, “Inwe timobeti abegenwa, mwanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao; ase igo mwagerire amamocho ’Abaisraeli amentekanire.

english: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers , and do his pleasure : and separate yourselves from the people of the land , and from the strange wives .
ekegusii: Gaki bono oorokia okomocha okwo ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, naende mokore ogwancha kwaye. Mweatanane korwa ase abanto b’ense eye na motige abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao.”

english: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice , As thou hast said , so must we do .
ekegusii: Erio omosangererekano bwonsi okairaneria ase eriogi rinene, ogateba, “Amang’ana ayio nabo are, goika tokore buna gwateebire.

english: But the people are many , and it is a time of much rain , and we are not able to stand without , neither is this a work of one day or two : for we are many that have transgressed in this thing .
ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nabange mono, na engaki eye ney’embura enyinge, titokonyara kogenderera gotenena aa isiko ase eraaro. Emeremo eye teri eye rituko erimo, gose ey’amatuko abere, ekiagera twamochire mono ase ring’ana eri.

english: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand , and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times , and with them the elders of every city , and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
ekegusii: Gaki tiga abatang’ani baito batenenere omoganda bwonsi. Erio abanto bonsi bare ase emechie yaito banyuomire abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao bache ase chingaki barachikwe; bachiche bare amo nabagaaka na abagaambi ebiina ba kera omochie. Ase enchera eyio nabakendie endamwamu ya Nyasae oito igoro ye ring’ana eri, erinde ebe yaonchokire etotige.”

english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
ekegusii: Yonathani, mosinto bw’Asaeli, na Yaseya, mosinto o Tikiwa, barabwo tibanchete amang’ana aria, na Mesulamu na Sabetai Omolawi bakababwatisia.

english: And the children of the captivity did so . And Ezra the priest , with certain chief of the fathers , after the house of their fathers , and all of them by their names , were separated , and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter .
ekegusii: Abanto abairanete korwa ase obosomba bagakora buna bateebetigwe. Ezra Omokuani agachora abanto abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, oyomo oyomo korwa ase kera eamate, na bonsi bakarikwa amarieta abo. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi, barabwo bagachaaka gotuka amang’ana aria,

english: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month .
ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani bagakoora obotuki igoro y’abasaacha bonsi aba konya banyuomire abakungu korwa ase ebisaku ebiao. Abasacha ababwate abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao

english: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives : namely , of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and his brethren ; Maaseiah , and Eliezer , and Jarib , and Gedaliah .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’abakuani konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao nabwo aba: abeamate ya Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, na abamwabo: Maaseya, na Eliezeri, na Yaribu, na Gedalia.

english: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives ; and being guilty , they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass .
ekegusii: Abwo bakaria eira goseria abakungu baria babo na barue kera oyomo emingichi eyemo korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kwabo.

english: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel , one of the sons of Elam , answered and said unto Ezra , We have trespassed against our God , and have taken strange wives of the people of the land : yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
ekegusii: Erio Sekania, mosinto o Yehieli, oyo bw’eamate ya Elamu, agakwana na Ezra, akamoteebia, “Intwe titori abegenwa ase Nyasae oito, ekiagera twanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao bi’abaanto b’ense eye. Nonya nabo, ogosemeria ngotigarete koba ase Abaisraeli.

english: And of the sons of Immer ; Hanani , and Zebadiah .
ekegusii: Abeamate ya Imeri: Hanani na Sebadia;

english: And of the sons of Harim ; Maaseiah , and Elijah , and Shemaiah , and Jehiel , and Uzziah .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Harimu: Maaseya na Elija, Semaya na Yehieli, na Usia;

english: And of the sons of Pashur ; Elioenai , Maaseiah , Ishmael , Nethaneel , Jozabad , and Elasah .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Pasuri: Elioenai na Maaseya, Isumaeli na Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa.

english: Also of the Levites ; Jozabad , and Shimei , and Kelaiah , (the same is Kelita ,) Pethahiah , Judah , and Eliezer .
ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yosabadi na Simei, Kelaya (nere Kelita) na Petahia, Yuda na Eliezeri.

english: Of the singers also; Eliashib : and of the porters ; Shallum , and Telem , and Uri .
ekegusii: Oyo bw’abateri: Eliasibu, Abwo b’abarendi b’ebiita: Salumu, na Telemu, na Uri.

english: Moreover of Israel : of the sons of Parosh ; Ramiah , and Jeziah , and Malchiah , and Miamin , and Eleazar , and Malchijah , and Benaiah .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande: abeamate ya Parosi: Ramia na Isia, Malikia na Miyamini, Eleazari na Malikia na Benaya;

english: And of the sons of Elam ; Mattaniah , Zechariah , and Jehiel , and Abdi , and Jeremoth , and Eliah .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Elamu: Matania na Zakaria, Yehieli na Abidi, Yeremoti na Elija;

english: And of the sons of Zattu ; Elioenai , Eliashib , Mattaniah , and Jeremoth , and Zabad , and Aziza .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Satu: Elioenai na Eliasibu, Matania na Yeremoti, Sabadi na Asisa;

english: Of the sons also of Bebai ; Jehohanan , Hananiah , Zabbai , and Athlai .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Bebai; Yehohanani na Hanania, Sabai na Atilai;

english: And of the sons of Bani ; Meshullam , Malluch , and Adaiah , Jashub , and Sheal , and Ramoth .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Bani: Mesulamu na Maluku, Adaya na Yasubu, Seali na Yeremoti;

english: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives , and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord , and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God ; and let it be done according to the law .
ekegusii: Bono tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Nyasae oito, erinde toserie abakungu abwo bonsi amo nabana babo. Tokore igo ase okobwatia ogosemia kwao, aye omonene one, na okw’abaanto abwo babeire nobwoba na koiguswa ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae oito. Tiga ring’ana erio rikorwe koreng’ana namachiiko.

english: And of the sons of Pahath-moab ; Adna , and Chelal , Benaiah , Maaseiah , Mattaniah , Bezaleel , and Binnui , and Manasseh .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;

english: And of the sons of Harim ; Eliezer , Ishijah , Malchiah , Shemaiah , Shimeon ,
ekegusii: abeamate ya Harimu: Eliezeri na Isia, Malikia na Semaya, Simioni

english: Benjamin , Malluch , and Shemariah .
ekegusii: na Benjamini, Maluku na Semaria;

english: Of the sons of Hashum ; Mattenai , Mattathah , Zabad , Eliphelet , Jeremai , Manasseh , and Shimei .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Hasumu; Matenai na Matata, Sabadi na Elifeleti, Yeremia na Manase, na Simei;

english: Of the sons of Bani ; Maadai , Amram , and Uel ,
ekegusii: abeamate ya Bani: Maadai na Amuramu, Ueli

english: Benaiah , Bedeiah , Chelluh ,
ekegusii: na Benaya, Bedeya na Keluhi,

english: Vaniah , Meremoth , Eliashib ,
ekegusii: Wania na Maremoti, Eliasibu

english: Mattaniah , Mattenai , and Jaasau ,
ekegusii: na Matania, Matenai na Yaasu;

english: And Bani , and Binnui , Shimei ,
ekegusii: abeamate ya Binui: Simei

english: And Shelemiah , and Nathan , and Adaiah ,
ekegusii: na Selemia, Nathani na Adaya,

english: Arise ; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage , and do it .
ekegusii: Imoka, ekiagera emeremo eye naye echigeete, na intwe nigo tore amo naye; kabe omoremu oyekore.”

english: Machnadebai , Shashai , Sharai ,
ekegusii: Makinadebai na Sasai, Sarai

english: Azareel , and Shelemiah , Shemariah ,
ekegusii: na Asareli, Selemia na Semaria,

english: Shallum , Amariah , and Joseph .
ekegusii: Salumu na Amaria, na Yusufu;

english: Of the sons of Nebo ; Jeiel , Mattithiah , Zabad , Zebina , Jadau , and Joel , Benaiah .
ekegusii: abeamate ya Nebo: Yeieli na Matitia, Sabadi na Sebiina, Yadai na Yoel, na Benaya.

english: All these had taken strange wives : and some of them had wives by whom they had children .
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao, na abande b’abwo konya baiboire abana.

english: Then arose Ezra , and made the chief priests , the Levites , and all Israel , to swear that they should do according to this word . And they sware .
ekegusii: Erio Ezra akaimoka, akaboria abakuani abarenge abatang’ani, na Abalawi, na Abaisraeli bonsi, koria eira na gotiana ng’a mbakore buna bateebetigwe. Ase ayio bakaria eira, bagatiana.

english: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God , and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib : and when he came thither, he did eat no bread , nor drink water : for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away .
ekegusii: Ezra akarua agwo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akagenda ase akanyomba ka Yehohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu, akabeera aroro; taria kende gose konywa, korende nigo abeete okorera, ekiagera abanto baria barenge ase obosomba tibabete abegenwa.

english: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity , that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem ;
ekegusii: Erio amang’ana akararigwa ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu, ng’a abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba basangererekane agwo Yerusalemu.

english: And that whosoever would not come within three days , according to the counsel of the princes and the elders , all his substance should be forfeited , and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away .
ekegusii: Naende akararigwa ng’a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga, tacha ase engaki y’amatuko atato, buna abatang’ani na abagaaka bachigete, oyio aurwe ebinto biaye, naende arusananigwe tabaisa koba oyomo bw’omoganda bw’abaanto abwo barwete ase obosomba.

english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days . It was the ninth month , on the twentieth day of the month ; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God , trembling because of this matter , and for the great rain .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio y’amatuko atato Abayuda bonsi na Ababenjamini bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu. Erio nigo riarenge rituko ri’emerongo ebere ri’omotienyi o kianda. Abanto abwo bonsi bagaikaransa ase eraaro isiko, bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, bakaba bakoiguswa ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, naende ekiagera embura yarenge enyinge.

english: Thirty basons of gold , silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten , and other vessels a thousand .
ekegusii: chibakuri chinke chiroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, emerongo etato (30), na echiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, amagana ane, na ikomi (410), naende ebikorero binde, elifu eyemo (1,000).

english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred . All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ebikorero bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu ne chifeta nigo biarenge chilifu isano, na amagana ane (5,400). Ebio bionsi Sesibasari akabiira Yerusalemu; ekero abanto baria barenge ase obosomba baruete Babiloni, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

english: Who is there among you of all his people ? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem , which is in Judah , and build the house of the LORD God of Israel , (he is the God ,) which is in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ore ase egati yaino, ore bw’abaanto baye, tiga atiire gochia Yerusalemu, aaria ase ense y’Abayuda, erinde aagache enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na Nyasae oye abe amo nere. Ere nere Nyasae ogosasimwa Yerusalemu.

english: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth , let the men of his place help him with silver , and with gold , and with goods , and with beasts , beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Onye onde bw’abaanto baye otigarete ase obosomba, nere origetie akonywe airane, abaamate b’aase agwo babakonye chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebinto binde, ne chitugo, amo nebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase enyomba ya Nyasae aaria Yerusalemu.”

english: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin , and the priests , and the Levites , with all them whose spirit God had raised , to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Erio abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abayuda na Ababenjamini amo nabakuani na Abalawi, kera omonto oyo Nyasae akunire omoika oye ng’a atiire, erinde aagache naende enyomba y’Omonene aaria Yerusalemu, bakebeka ang’e.

english: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver , with gold , with goods , and with beasts , and with precious things , beside all that was willingly offered .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete amo nabarabwo bakabakonya ase okobaa ebikorero bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu na ebinto binde, ne chitugo, na ebinto bi’erigori rinene, amo n’ebinto baruete ase ogwancha.

english: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD , which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem , and had put them in the house of his gods ;
ekegusii: Boigo omorwoti Koresi akairania ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie Yerusalemu na akabigacha ase enyomba ye chinyasae chiaye.

english: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer , and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar , the prince of Judah .
ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio Koresi, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi, akabia Mitiredati, omoteneneri bwe chikungo. Mitiredati akabibara, akabirika inse erio akabia Sesibasari, omogambi bw’Abayuda.

english: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold , a thousand chargers of silver , nine and twenty knives ,
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebio: Chibakuri chiroisirie korwa ase chitaabu, emerongo etato (30), ne chibakuri chiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, elifu eyemo (1,000), na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, emerongo ebere na kianda (29);

english: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity , of those which had been carried away , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon , and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah , every one unto his city ;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’orogongo rwa Yuda, baria Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, airete Babiloni ase obosomba, bairanete gocha Yerusalemu na ase ense y’Abayuda.

english: The children of Bani , six hundred forty and two .
ekegusii: aba orwa Bani: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na babere (642);

english: The children of Bebai , six hundred twenty and three .
ekegusii: aba orwa Bebai: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (623);

english: The children of Azgad , a thousand two hundred twenty and two .
ekegusii: aba orwa Asigadi: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na babere (1,222);

english: The children of Adonikam , six hundred sixty and six .
ekegusii: aba orw’Adonikamu: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo (666);

english: The children of Bigvai , two thousand fifty and six .
ekegusii: aba orwa Bigiwai: chilifu ibere, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (2,056);

english: The children of Adin , four hundred fifty and four .
ekegusii: aba orw’Adini: amagana ane, na emerongo etano, na baane (454);

english: The children of Ater of Hezekiah , ninety and eight .
ekegusii: aba orw’Ateri oyio okorokwa Hezekia: emerongo kianda, na batano na batato (98);

english: The children of Bezai , three hundred twenty and three .
ekegusii: aba orwa Besai: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere, na batato (323);

english: The children of Jorah , an hundred and twelve .
ekegusii: aba orwa Yora: rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112);

english: The children of Hashum , two hundred twenty and three .
ekegusii: aba orwa Hasumu: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);

english: Which came with Zerubbabel : Jeshua , Nehemiah , Seraiah , Reelaiah , Mordecai , Bilshan , Mispar , Bigvai , Rehum , Baanah . The number of the men of the people of Israel :
ekegusii: Abarai babo nabwo aba, Serubabeli na Yesua, Nehemia na Seraya, Reelaya na Moredekai, Bilisani na Misipari, Bigiwai na Rehumu, na Baana. Oyo noro omobaro bw’chinderia chia abanto bonsi ba Israeli abwo bairanete korwa obosomba

english: The children of Gibbar , ninety and five .
ekegusii: aba orwa Gibari: emerongo kianda, na batano (95).

english: The children of Beth-lehem , an hundred twenty and three .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Bethlehemu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (123);

english: The men of Netophah , fifty and six .
ekegusii: abanto ba Netofa: emerongo etano, na batano nomo (56);

english: The men of Anathoth , an hundred twenty and eight .
ekegusii: abanto b’Anatoti: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128);

english: The children of Azmaveth , forty and two .
ekegusii: abanto b’Asimaweti: emerongo ene, na babere (42);

english: The children of Kirjath-arim , Chephirah , and Beeroth , seven hundred and forty and three .
ekegusii: abanto ba Kiriati‐Arimu, na Kefira, na Beroti: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene, na batato (743);

english: The children of Ramah and Gaba , six hundred twenty and one .
ekegusii: abanto ba Rama na Geba: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (621);

english: The men of Michmas , an hundred twenty and two .
ekegusii: abanto ba Mikimasi: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na babere (122);

english: The men of Beth-el and Ai , two hundred twenty and three .
ekegusii: abanto ba Beteli na Ai: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);

english: The children of Nebo , fifty and two .
ekegusii: abanto ba Nebo: emerongo etano, na babere (52);

english: The children of Parosh , two thousand an hundred seventy and two .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Parosi: chilifu ibere, ne rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (2,172);

english: The children of Magbish , an hundred fifty and six .
ekegusii: abanto ba Magibisi: rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (156);

english: The children of the other Elam , a thousand two hundred fifty and four .
ekegusii: abanto ba Elamu o kabere: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na baane (1,254);

english: The children of Harim , three hundred and twenty .
ekegusii: abanto ba Harimu: amagana atato, na emerongo ebere (320);

english: The children of Lod , Hadid , and Ono , seven hundred twenty and five .
ekegusii: abanto ba Lodi, na Hadidi, na Ono: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere, na batano (725);

english: The children of Jericho , three hundred forty and five .
ekegusii: abanto ba Yeriko: amagana atato, na emerongo ene, na batano (345);

english: The children of Senaah , three thousand and six hundred and thirty .
ekegusii: abanto ba Senaa: chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etato (3,630).

english: The priests : the children of Jedaiah , of the house of Jeshua , nine hundred seventy and three .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abakuani bairanete korwa obosomba: Abwo b’ororeria rwa Yedaya be chiamate chia Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

english: The children of Immer , a thousand fifty and two .
ekegusii: aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052);

english: The children of Pashur , a thousand two hundred forty and seven .
ekegusii: aba orwa Pasuri: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na batano na babere (1,247);

english: The children of Harim , a thousand and seventeen .
ekegusii: aba orwa Harimu: elifu eyemo, na ikomi na batano na babere (1,017).

english: The children of Shephatiah , three hundred seventy and two .
ekegusii: aba orwa Sefatia: amagana atato, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (372);

english: The Levites : the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel , of the children of Hodaviah , seventy and four .
ekegusii: Abalawi bo’ororeria rwa Yeshua na orwa Kadimieli, oroiboro rwa Hodavia abairanete korwa obosomba nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere, na baane (74).

english: The singers : the children of Asaph , an hundred twenty and eight .
ekegusii: Abateri nabwo abanto b’ororeria rw’Asafu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128).

english: The children of the porters : the children of Shallum , the children of Ater , the children of Talmon , the children of Akkub , the children of Hatita , the children of Shobai , in all an hundred thirty and nine .
ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita nabwo abe chiamate chia Salumu, na Ateri, na Talimoni, na Akubu, na Hatita, na Sobai; bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na kianda (139).

english: The Nethinims : the children of Ziha , the children of Hasupha , the children of Tabbaoth ,
ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;

english: The children of Keros , the children of Siaha , the children of Padon ,
ekegusii: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

english: The children of Lebanah , the children of Hagabah , the children of Akkub ,
ekegusii: Lebana, na Hagaba, na Akubu;

english: The children of Hagab , the children of Shalmai , the children of Hanan ,
ekegusii: Hagabu, na Shamlai na Hanani;

english: The children of Giddel , the children of Gahar , the children of Reaiah ,
ekegusii: Gideli, na Gahari, na Reaya:

english: The children of Rezin , the children of Nekoda , the children of Gazzam ,
ekegusii: Resini, na Nekoda, na Gasamu;

english: The children of Uzza , the children of Paseah , the children of Besai ,
ekegusii: Usa, na Pasea, na Besai;

english: The children of Arah , seven hundred seventy and five .
ekegusii: aba orwa Ara: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano (775);

english: The children of Asnah , the children of Mehunim , the children of Nephusim ,
ekegusii: Asina, na Meunimu, na Nefusimu;

english: The children of Bakbuk , the children of Hakupha , the children of Harhur ,
ekegusii: Bakubuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

english: The children of Bazluth , the children of Mehida , the children of Harsha ,
ekegusii: Basiluti, na Mehida, na Harisa;

english: The children of Barkos , the children of Sisera , the children of Thamah ,
ekegusii: Barikosi, na Sisera, na Tema;

english: The children of Neziah , the children of Hatipha .
ekegusii: Nesia na Hatifa.

english: The children of Solomon’s servants : the children of Sotai , the children of Sophereth , the children of Peruda ,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Hasofereti, na Peruda;

english: The children of Jaalah , the children of Darkon , the children of Giddel ,
ekegusii: Yaala, na Darikoni, na Gideli;

english: The children of Shephatiah , the children of Hattil , the children of Pochereth of Zebaim , the children of Ami .
ekegusii: Sefatia na Hatili, Pokereti‐Hasebaimu na Ami.

english: All the Nethinims , and the children of Solomon’s servants , were three hundred ninety and two .
ekegusii: Abakori emeremo bonsi be Hekalu, amo nabaanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo barenge amagana atato, na emerongo kianda; na babere (392).

english: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah , Tel-harsa , Cherub , Addan , and Immer : but they could not shew their father’s house , and their seed , whether they were of Israel :
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachete korwa Teli‐Mela, na Teli‐Harisa, na Kerubu, na Adani, na Imeri, korende tibanyarete koorokia ase okomanyereria chiamate chiabo, nonya ne chinderia chiabo, gose ekeene ng’a n’Abaisraeli bare:

english: The children of Pahath-moab , of the children of Jeshua and Joab , two thousand eight hundred and twelve .
ekegusii: aba orwa Pahati‐Moabu be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na babere (2,812);

english: The children of Delaiah , the children of Tobiah , the children of Nekoda , six hundred fifty and two .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda, bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano na babere (652).

english: And of the children of the priests : the children of Habaiah , the children of Koz , the children of Barzillai ; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite , and was called after their name :
ekegusii: Boigo nase abakuani: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi, na ere akarokwa Barisilai.

english: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy , but they were not found : therefore were they, as polluted , put from the priesthood .
ekegusii: Abwo bakariga‐rigia korwa ase emeroberio ye chinderia gose mbanyore chisokoro chiabo, korende tichianyoretwe chiriikire aroro. Ase ayio bakaangwa tibaaba abakuani, ekiagera nigo baabaretwe koba abatachenegeti.

english: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore ,
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto bairanete korwa obosomba nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo (42,360),

english: Beside their servants and their maids , of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven : and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women .
ekegusii: amo nabarabwo mbarengeo abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato, na batano na babere (7,337). Boigo mbabwate abateri, abasacha na abakungu, amagana abere (200).

english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six ; their mules , two hundred forty and five ;
ekegusii: Naende mbabwate chibarasi amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etato, na isano nemo (736), ne chibarasi amagana abere, na emerongo ene na isano (245),

english: Their camels , four hundred thirty and five ; their asses , six thousand seven hundred and twenty .
ekegusii: ne chingamia amagana ane, na emerongo etato, na isano (435), ne chitigere chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere (6,720).

english: And some of the chief of the fathers , when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem , offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place :
ekegusii: Ekero abanto be chiamate chiria chianganyete korwa obosomba bachete ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, abande ase abateneneri babo bakarua ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae aase aye.

english: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold , and five thousand pound of silver , and one hundred priests’ garments .
ekegusii: Bakarua buna barenge konyara, bakabeeka ase ekungo y’ogokorerwa emeremo chikiro 5,000 chi’echitaabu, chikiro 2,800 chifeta, ne chianga chi’abakuani, rigana erimo (100).

english: The children of Elam , a thousand two hundred fifty and four .
ekegusii: aba orwa Elamu: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na baane (1,254);

english: The children of Zattu , nine hundred forty and five .
ekegusii: aba orwa Satu: amagana kianda, na emerongo ene, na batano (945);

english: The children of Zaccai , seven hundred and threescore .
ekegusii: aba orwa Sakai: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (760);

english: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, na Abaisraeli bamenyete ase emechie yabo, bonsi bagasangererekana ase obomo agwo Yerusalemu.

english: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice ; and many shouted aloud for joy :
ekegusii: Abange ase abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, baria barenge abagotu, abaroche enyomba eria ye ritang’ani, bono ekero baroche oboroso bw’eyio enyia bwabekirwe, bakarera na koiyeria amariga. Korende abange bagaaka amariogi amanene ay’omogooko.

english: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people : for the people shouted with a loud shout , and the noise was heard afar off .
ekegusii: Abanto tibanyarete gwatanana amariogi ’omogooko are goakwa korwa ase aria ay’okorera. Nigo baagete amariogi amanene mono akaigweka gochia aare mono.

english: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD . But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid .
ekegusii: Abanto bagachaaka korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, korende oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene konya tiborabekwa. Oboagacho bwe Hekalu bogochakwa

english: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .
ekegusii: Abanto bakarua chitaabu, bakaa abaagacheri b’amagena, na abasenia be chibao, naende bakarua chindagera, na ebinyugwa, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ase Abasidoni na Abaturo, erinde barente emecharake korwa Lebanoni goetera ase enyancha goika Yopa, koreng’ana buna Koresi, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi abaete ribaga.

english: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o kabere, omwaka o kabere, magega abanto kobairanire gocha ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, emeremo egachakwa. Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, bagachaaka emeremo amo nabaanto bamwabo, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na bonsi abachete Yerusalemu korwa ase obosomba. Abalawi bonsi abarenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania bagachorwa gotenenera emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.

english: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
ekegusii: Yesua na abamura baye amo nabamwabo, na Kadimieli na abamura baye, abanto b’ororeria rwa Hodawia, bakaba bagotenenera abakori emeremo b’enyomba ya Nyasae. Barabwo bakaba bagokonywa nabaanto b’eamate ya Henadadi na abana babo, abarenge Abalawi.

english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel ;
ekegusii: Bono ekero ababisa b’Abayuda, na ab’Ababenjamini baigwete ng’a abanto baria bairanire korwa ase obosomba naende ng’a nkoagachera bare Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Hekalu,

english: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .
ekegusii: na abanto b’ebisaku binde biria Osinapari, oyorenge omonene naende osikire, arentete, akababeeka komenya ase emechie ya Samaria na ase chinsemo chinde chi’orogongo roria, bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, bakarika riruube.

english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him , even unto Artaxerxes the king ; Thy servants the men on this side the river , and at such a time .
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana e riruube riria riarigetwe: “Ase Aritasasita omorwoti. Intwe abasomba bao aba tomenyete aiga bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, twagokwanirie.

english: Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .
ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti, bono manya ng’a Abayahudi aba barua asore, bagacha ase tore aiga Yerusalemu, bachakire koagacha omochie oria oichire nogosaria na obobe. Nigo bare ang’e gokoora chindwaki chiaye na koroisia amaroso aye.

english: Be it known now unto the king , that, if this city be builded , and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll , tribute , and custom , and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings .
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, manya ng’a onye omochie oyo okoagachwa naende, ne chindwaki chiere koagachwa, rirorio abanto aba tibakorua ebango, gose echogo y’ebinto babwate, gose ebango ye chinchera, na ebitoki bi’omorwoti nigo birakee.

english: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king ;
ekegusii: Na ekiagera intwe tokonyora omonyoo oito korwa ase enyomba yao, aye omorwoti, titogwancha korora aye gokorenterwa ogochaywa buna okwo. Ase ayio twatomire amang’ana ayio asore, aye omorwoti,

english: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers : so shalt thou find in the book of the records , and know that this city is a rebellious city , and hurtful unto kings and provinces , and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time : for which cause was this city destroyed .
ekegusii: erinde obotuki bokorwe ase chibuku aase amang’ana e chisokoro chiao ariikire. Nonyore korwa ase amang’ana arigetwe ase chibuku chiria ng’a omochie oyo noyo bw’obobe na ogotaigwera, obeire okorenta emechando ase abarwoti, na ase chingongo chionsi, naende ng’a eburu‐buru na ogosaria nigo biarengeo korwa kare. Ayio agerete omochie oyio ogasarigwa.

english: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo togokomanyia, aye omorwoti, ng’a omochie oyo oise koagachwa naende, ne chindwaki chiaye chiagachwe chiere, rirorio orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati tirokoba orwao.”

english: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma amairanerio aya. “Ase Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto baria bande babwataine nabarabwo bamenyete Samaria, boigo nase baria barenge ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, nabakwanirie.

english: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
ekegusii: “Riruube mwatoma gocha ase tore riasomirwe buya ase ’nde, nariigure.

english: And I commanded , and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
ekegusii: Nachika, na obotuki bogakorwa na amang’ana akanyorekana ng’a omochie oyio korwa kare obeire okorwania abarwoti, na ogotaigwera, na eburu‐buru amo namariomana mbiarenge imeo.

english: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them.
ekegusii: Abarwoti barenge nokobua babeire bakogambera Yerusalemu na orogongo rwonsi rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na abwo babeire bakorenterwa ebango na echogo y’ebinto na eye chinchera.

english: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .
ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe karue ogochika ng’a abanto abwo batangwe batige gokora emeremo, erinde omochie oyio otigwe, toagachwa naende goika ekero inche ndarue ogochika.

english: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?
ekegusii: Timobaisa goteebana ase amang’ana aya. Nase ki inche omorwoti ndanyore emechando?”

english: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum , and Shimshai the scribe , and their companions , they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews , and made them to cease by force and power .
ekegusii: Obwango obwo riruube ri’omorwoti Aritasasita riasometwe ase Rehumu, na ase Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto abwo babwatanete nabarabwo, barabwo bakagenda Yerusalemu bwango kegima ase Abayahudi, na ase chinguru bakabatenenia tibagenderera koagacha omochie. Emeremo yokoagacha Hekalu egochaka nainde

english: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God ; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
ekegusii: Korende Serubabeli, na Yesua, na abateneneri bande be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabakania, bakabateebia, “Inwe timogwenereti motoagachisie enyomba ya Nyasae oito, korende nintwe tweka toraagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba, buna Koresi, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi atochigeete.”

english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ense eria bagaita Abayuda emioyo, bakaboboyia ng’a tibagenderera koagacha.

english: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose , all the days of Cyrus king of Persia , even until the reign of Darius king of Persia .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakarenta abasemia baare goakanerwa, nabwo bakaba bakorua ogosemia okobe gosaria emeroberio yabo, bakaba bagokora igo korwa amatuko ’okogamba gwa Koresi, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi, goikera ay’okogamba kwa Dario, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi. Ogotangwa gw’okoagacha Yerusalemu naende

english: And in the reign of Ahasuerus , in the beginning of his reign , wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba kw’Ahaswero, ababisa baria bakarika amang’ana ay’ogosoera abanto bamenyete ase orogongo rw’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu.

english: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .
ekegusii: Naende ase amatuko ’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omorwoti bw’Abaayemi, Bisilamu, na Mitiredati, na Tabeeli, na abanto bande babwataine komo, bakarikera Aritasasita riruube ase chinuguta chi’Ekearamaiki na ase omonwa oyio.

english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort :
ekegusii: Boigo Rehumu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, bakarikera Aritasasita riruube bagosoera Yerusalemu.

english: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,
ekegusii: Erio Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na abande babwataine nabarabwo: abagaambi ebiina, na abagabana, na abanene b’oborwoti, na Abaayemi, na Abaereki, na Abaababeli, na Abasusa korwa ase ense y’Abaelamu,

english: We asked their names also , to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
ekegusii: Naende ntwababoria amarieta abo, erinde tokorikere amarieta ’abatang’ani abwo babo.

english: And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .
ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya naro batoteebia: Intwe nigo tore abasomba ba Nyasae o igoro na ense, na nigo tokoagacha naende enyomba eria omorwoti omonene bw’Abaisraeli aagachete na akayekoora ase emiaka emenge yaetire.

english: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem , and brought them into the temple of Babylon , those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor ;
ekegusii: Na ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu ne chifeta, ebio Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yarenge aiga Yerusalemu, akabiira akabibeka ase Hekalu yare Babiloni. Ebikorero ebio omorwoti Koresi akabirusia ase Hekalu ya Babiloni, akabia omonto okorokwa Sesibasari oyo abegete koba omogabana,

english: And said unto him, Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .
ekegusii: akamoteebia ng’a arente ebikorero ebio, abibeke ime ase Hekalu ere aiga Yerusalemu, naende atige enyomba ya Nyasae eagachwe aase yarenge.

english: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .
ekegusii: Bono Sesibasari nere ochagete kobeeka oboroso bw’enyomba ya Nyasae ere aiga Yerusalemu, na korwa engaki eyio goika reero iga, enyomba eye nigo egendererete koagachwa, teraera.

english: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king’s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .
ekegusii: “Gaki bono, aye omorwoti, onye amang’ana aya agokogwenera, ochike obotuki bokorwe ase amagachero e chibuku chi’oborwoti bwa Babiloni, omanye gose Koresi omorwoti naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu eagachwe naende. Aye omorwoti ototomere aya orengereretie igoro y’amang’ana aya.”

english: At the same time came to them Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar-boznai , and their companions , and said thus unto them , Who hath commanded you to build this house , and to make up this wall ?
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Tatenai, omogabana bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abande babwataine nabwo, bagacha, bakababoria, “Ning’o obaa ribaga mokoagacha enyomba eye na gokoora koagacha orwaki orwo?”

english: Then said we unto them after this manner , What are the names of the men that make this building ?
ekegusii: Naende bakabooria iga, “Abaagachi b’oboagacho obo, naki bakorokwa?”

english: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
ekegusii: Korende eriso ria Nyasae obo nigo riarenge ririgereretie abagaaka b’Abayahudi, na abanto baria tibaabatangete goika amang’ana aria amoikere Dario. Magega y’ayio bairanerigwe ase riruube igoro y’amang’ana ayio.

english: The copy of the letter that Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar-boznai , and his companions the Apharsachites , which were on this side the river , sent unto Darius the king :
ekegusii: Ase igo Tatenai, omogabana bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagabana bande baare kogamba amo nabarabwo ase orogongo orwo bagatoma riruube ase Dario omorwoti.

english: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .
ekegusii: Bakamotomera amang’ana ariikire iga. “Ase Dario omorwoti, omorembe bwonsi obe asore!

english: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judea , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands .
ekegusii: “Nigo togokomanyia aye omorwoti ng’a intwe ntwagenda ase orogongo orwo rw’Abayuda, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oyore omonene. Nigo egendererete koagacherwa amagena amanene mono, ne chibao chibekire ase chinyasi. Ekeene, emeremo eye nigo egokorwa ase okwerwa okonene, na nigo esesenirie ase amaboko abo.

english: Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?
ekegusii: “Agwo ntwakwana nabagaaka baria, tokababoria iga: Ning’o obaa ribaga mokoagacha enyomba eye na gokoora koagacha orwaki oro?

english: Then Darius the king made a decree , and search was made in the house of the rolls , where the treasures were laid up in Babylon .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Dario agachiika, na obotuki bogakorwa ase chibuku chiagachire agwo Babiloni ase amagachero ay’oborwoti.

english: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .
ekegusii: Igo mbanyare komoruera Nyasae o igoro ebing’wanso bikomogwenera, na gosabera obogima bwane, inche omorwoti, na obw’abamura baane.

english: Also I have made a decree , that whosoever shall alter this word , let timber be pulled down from his house , and being set up , let him be hanged thereon ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .
ekegusii: Boigo nachiikire ng’a, monto onde bwensi oraonchore ring’ana eri, omwamba osomorwe korwa ase enyomba yaye, na ere omonyene atongwe ase oro, na enyomba yaye ekorwe ebe etui y’eubi.

english: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree ; let it be done with speed .
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae, oyo obekire erieta riaye ribeere aroro, aonchore na koiyeria inse omorwoti onde bwensi, gose abanto, barateeme koonchora ogochika oko, gose gosaria enyomba eye ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu. Inche Dario narure ogochika okwo, tiga koigwerwe kegima.” Hekalu egochenwa

english: Then Tatnai , governor on this side the river , Shethar-boznai , and their companions , according to that which Darius the king had sent , so they did speedily .
ekegusii: Bono Tatenai, omogabana bw’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche roria, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abarenge kogamba komo, bagakora ase okwerwa amang’ana ayio onsi Dario omorwoti konya achiikire.

english: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .
ekegusii: Enyomba eria ekaagachwa ekaera ase rituko ria gatato ri’omotienyi okorokwa Adari, ase omwaka o gatano na rimo bw’okogamba kwa Dario, omorwoti.

english: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli: abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagakora omoyega omonene bw’omogooko ase ogwatanana enyomba eria ya Nyasae na koyechena.

english: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
ekegusii: Na ase ogwatanana enyomba eye na koyechena, bakarua chieri rigana erimo, ne chimingichi amagana abere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chi’eching’ondi amagana ane, chikaba ebing’wanso. Boigo bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli. Echio nigo chiaruetwe koreng’ana nomobaro bw’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.

english: And they set the priests in their divisions , and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God , which is at Jerusalem ; as it is written in the book of Moses .
ekegusii: Boigo bakabeeka abakuani ase ebiombe biabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo, ase okomokorera Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu, koreng’ana buna eriikire ase egetabu ya Musa. Epasaka

english: And there was found at Achmetha , in the palace that is in the province of the Medes , a roll , and therein was a record thus written :
ekegusii: Na agwo Ekibatana, omochie omonene ase orogongo rw’Abamedia, egetabu ekanyorekana eriikire amang’ana aya.

english: For the priests and the Levites were purified together , all of them were pure , and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity , and for their brethren the priests , and for themselves.
ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi konya bechenire; bono bonsi nigo barenge abachenegete. Ase ayio bakanyenya chimanwa chiria chi’eching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase engencho y’abwo bonsi bairanete korwa ase obosomba, na ase abakuani bamwabo, na ase barabwo abanyene.

english: And the children of Israel , which were come again out of captivity , and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land , to seek the LORD God of Israel , did eat ,
ekegusii: Chinyama chie chimanwa chiria nigo chiarietwe n’Abaisraeli baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, boigo na kera omonto bweatananete korwa ase ogosaria kw’abaanto b’ebisaku b’ense eria na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli ase ogosasiima Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the LORD had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere bakaba barendete Rituko riria Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera bare nomogooko. Omonene nigo abarenterete omogooko oyio ase okoonchora enkoro y’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, erinde akabancha akabakonya mono ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae oyore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem , Let the house be builded , the place where they offered sacrifices , and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid ; the height thereof threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof threescore cubits ;
ekegusii: “Ase omwaka bw’eritang’ani bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Koresi, ere akarua ogochika okwo: Enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu, tiga eagachwe naende, na oboroso bwaye bokong’igwe, erinde ebing’wanso bionsi, amo na biria bi’ogosambwa, birentwe aroro na koruegwa. Obotambe bw’enyomba eyio gochia igoro bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo.

english: With three rows of great stones , and a row of new timber : and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house :
ekegusii: Amagena aagachwe ase chindwaro isato, na orwaro oromo roagachwe ne chibao. Chibesa chiraakanerwe chirwe ase ekungo y’oborwoti.

english: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .
ekegusii: Naende ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu ne chifeta, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yare Yerusalemu, akabiira Babiloni, bionsi biiranigwe bibekwe naende ime ase Hekalu ere Yerusalemu; mobibeke ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae, kera ekemo aase aye.” Omorwoti Dario okorua ogochika ng’a emeremo egenderere gokorwa

english: Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar-boznai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :
ekegusii: Ase ayio Dario akarika riruube iga. “Bono aye Tatenai, omogabana bw’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagabana bande abwo mokogamba komo agwo ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche roria, inwe beera aare kegima.

english: Let the work of this house of God alone ; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place .
ekegusii: Inwe tiga emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba eyio ya Nyasae egenderere; tiga omogabana bw’Abayahudi, na abagaaka babo bagenderere koagacha naende enyomba ya Nyasae aase yarenge.

english: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God : that of the king’s goods , even of the tribute beyond the river , forthwith expenses be given unto these men , that they be not hindered .
ekegusii: Amo nayio nachiikire amang’ana morakorere abagaaka abwo b’Abayahudi ase okoagacha enyomba eyio ya Nyasae naende. Emeremo yonsi nigo eraakanerwe korwa ase chitaabu chi’ekungo y’oborwoti, echikorwa ase ebango eria ekorusigwa korwa ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati; mobe mokobaakana motari goteebana.

english: And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :
ekegusii: Na kende gionsi abakuani bare agwo Yerusalemu baraganie baegwe. Kera rituko nigo baraegwe chieri chinsae, ne chimingichi gose ching’ondi, chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Nyasae o igoro. Boigo baegwe engano, na omonyoo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amasabibu. Baegwe ebinto ebio, tibamocha kobiegwa.

english: Now after these things , in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia , Ezra the son of Seraiah , the son of Azariah , the son of Hilkiah ,
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana aria kaerire ase engaki y’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omorwoti bw’ense y’Ayemi, narengeo omonto okorokwa Ezra, mosinto o Seraya, bw’Asaria, o Hilikia,

english: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments .
ekegusii: Ezra konya orure enkoro yaye kweorokereria amachiiko ’Omonene na koyakora, naende nigo arenge kworokereria Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye, na okogamba kwaye kwa boronge. Amang’ana ariikire Aritasasita aete Ezra

english: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD , and of his statutes to Israel .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro ariikire ase riruube riria omorwoti Aritasasita aete Ezra, Omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko, oyo bworokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiiko ’Omonene na emeroberio yaye echiikire ase Abaisraeli.

english: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .
ekegusii: “Inche Aritasasita, omorwoti bw’abarwoti, ngokorikera inde aye Ezra Omokuani, aye kwegerete amachiiko a Nyasae o igoro. Amakwania amo nayakobwatia ayio.

english: I make a decree , that all they of the people of Israel , and of his priests and Levites , in my realm , which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem , go with thee .
ekegusii: “Nachikiire ng’a monto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose oyo bw’abakuani babo, gose oyo bw’Abalawi, oyomenyete ase oborwoti bwane, karanche kogenda Yerusalemu amo naye, tiga agende.

english: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand ;
ekegusii: “Inche omorwoti, amo nabasemia baane batano na babere, twagotomire ogende komanya amang’ana ’ense y’Abayuda, na aya Yerusalemu, kobwatekana namachiiko a Nyasae oo, ayio obwate ase okoboko kwao.

english: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
ekegusii: Naende oire chifeta ne chitaabu chiria inche omorwoti, na abasemia baane, twarure nogwancha ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio obomenyo bwaye bore Yerusalemu.

english: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon , with the freewill offering of the people , and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem :
ekegusii: Boigo oire chifeta ne chitaabu chionsi, echio oranyore korwa ase ense yonsi ya Babiloni, oire nokoruegwa kw’ogwancha okwo abanto na abakuani bararue ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo ere Yerusalemu.

english: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: “Obe omwegenwa, na ase chitaabu echio ogore chieri, ne chimingichi, ne chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa bikoruegwa amo nebing’wanso ebio. Orue ebinto ebio ase egesasiimero ki’enyomba ya Nyasae oo ere agwo Yerusalemu.

english: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .
ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi aye amo nabaanto bamino morarore ere buya, chifeta n’echitaabu chiratigare mochiyekorere, korende mokore igo kobwatekana nogwancha kwa Nyasae oino.

english: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio kwaeirwe gokorera emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, obiire bionsi, obibeke ase obosio bwa Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu.

english: The son of Shallum , the son of Zadok , the son of Ahitub ,
ekegusii: o Salumu, o Zadoki, bw’Ahitubu,

english: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God , which thou shalt have occasion to bestow , bestow it out of the king’s treasure house .
ekegusii: Ebinto binde bionsi biganeirie ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, ebio ogwenerete korenta aroro, obigore ne chitaabu chikorwa ase ekungo y’omorwoti.

english: And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you, it be done speedily ,
ekegusii: “Naende inche omorwoti Aritasasita narure ogochika ase abagachi bonsi be chikungo bare ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati ng’a, gento kende gionsi Ezra Omokuani oyo bwegerete amachiiko a Nyasae o igoro araganie korwa ase more, mogekorere ase oboronge.

english: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .
ekegusii: Momoe goikera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo (100), na engano ebitonga elifu eyemo (1,000), na edivai chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na amaguta ’amazeituni chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na momoe omonyoo otari na kerengo.

english: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven : for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi Nyasae o igoro arachike ng’a gekorwe, ekio gekorwe boronge ase engencho y’enyomba ya Nyasae o igoro, erinde endamwamu ya Nyasae tebaisa koba igoro y’oborwoti bwane, na abamura baane.

english: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them.
ekegusii: Naende nigo tokobamanyia ng’a timobaisa kobeeka ebango gose ogochoga ase onde bwensi bw’abakuani, gose Abalawi, gose abateri, gose abarendi b’ebiita, gose abakori emeremo be Hekalu, gose abakori emeremo bande b’enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God ; and teach ye them that know them not .
ekegusii: “Bono aye Ezra kwaeirwe obong’aini na Nyasae oo. Obokorere emeremo ase ogochora abagaambi ebiina na abamanyi b’amachiiko, erinde babe bakogamba ebiina bi’abaanto bonsi ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, aba bonsi bamanyete amachiiko a Nyasae oo; na abatayamanyeti oborokererie bayamanye.

english: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiiko a Nyasae oo, na ay’omorwoti, oyio anacherwe ekiina kia boronge, kebe eki’ogokwa, gose eki’ogoserigwa, gose kourwa ebinto biaye, gose asibwe.” Ezra okomotogia Nyasae

english: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers , which hath put such a thing as this in the king’s heart , to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem :
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, atogigwe, oria obegete ring’ana eri ime ase enkoro y’omorwoti, oyobwanchire gokora enyomba y’Omonene ere Yerusalemu ebe ensiani mono.

english: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king , and his counsellors , and before all the king’s mighty princes . And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
ekegusii: Ere Omonene oorokirie ase ’nde obwanchani bwaye botari koera ase obosio bw’omorwoti, na ase abasemia baye, na abanene bonsi bare gokonya omorwoti bare nokobua. Inche nkaba noboremu, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae one, kwarenge amo nainche, na igo ngasangereria abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli batiire amo nainche.

english: The son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,
ekegusii: bw’Amaria, bw’Asaria, o Merayoti,

english: The son of Zerahiah , the son of Uzzi , the son of Bukki ,
ekegusii: o Seraya, o Usi, o Buki,

english: The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :
ekegusii: bw’Abisua, o Finehasi, bw’Eleazari, o Aroni, Omokuani omonene.

english: This Ezra went up from Babylon ; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses , which the LORD God of Israel had given : and the king granted him all his request , according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
ekegusii: Ezra oyio akarua Babiloni. Ere nigo arenge omworokia bw’amariko; nigo orokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiiko a Musa, ayio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aruete; na ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae oye, kwarenge amo nere, omorwoti akamoa gento kende gionsi aboretie.

english: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita omorwoti, abande b’Abaisraeli, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, bakagenda Yerusalemu.

english: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month , which was in the seventh year of the king .
ekegusii: Bono ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, omotienyi o gatano, bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti oria, Ezra agaika Yerusalemu.

english: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him.
ekegusii: Nigo achagete orogendo rwaye korwa Babiloni ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, na agaika Yerusalemu rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae oye kwarenge amo nere ase okomokonya.

english: These are now the chief of their fathers , and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon , in the reign of Artaxerxes the king .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babiloni, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:

english: And of the sons of Shelomith ; the son of Josiphiah , and with him an hundred and threescore males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bani, Selomiti, mosinto o Yosifia, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo (160);

english: And of the sons of Bebai ; Zechariah the son of Bebai , and with him twenty and eight males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bebai, Zakaria, mosinto o Bebai, na amo nere abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (28);

english: And of the sons of Azgad ; Johanan the son of Hakkatan , and with him an hundred and ten males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Asigadi, Yohanani, mosinto o Hakatani, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na ikomi (110);

english: And of the last sons of Adonikam , whose names are these, Eliphelet , Jeiel , and Shemaiah , and with them threescore males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Adonikamu, abachete magega y’abande nabwo aba: Elifeleti, na Yeueli, na Semaya, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano nomo (60);

english: Of the sons also of Bigvai ; Uthai , and Zabbud , and with them seventy males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bigiwai, Utai na Sabudi, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70). Ezra okonyora Abalawi bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu
