english: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava ; and there abode we in tents three days : and I viewed the people , and the priests , and found there none of the sons of Levi .
ekegusii: Bono ngasangereria abanto abwo ase orooche rogotirimbokera gochia ase Ahawa, na agwo togatoora, tokabeera aroro ase amatuko atato. Ekero naitaaete abanto amo nabakuani, tinanyorete Abalawi aroro nonya noyomo.

english: Then sent I for Eliezer , for Ariel , for Shemaiah , and for Elnathan , and for Jarib , and for Elnathan , and for Nathan , and for Zechariah , and for Meshullam , chief men ; also for Joiarib , and for Elnathan , men of understanding .
ekegusii: Erio ngatoma abanto korangeria Eliezeri na Arieli, Semaya na Elinatani, Yaribu na Elinatani, Nathani na Zakaria, na Mesualmu, abwo barenge abaraai b’abaanto; boigo nkarangeria Yoyaribu na Elinatani, abarenge abanto abanyasemi.

english: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia , and I told them what they should say unto Iddo , and to his brethren the Nethinims , at the place Casiphia , that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God .
ekegusii: Ngatoma abanto abwo gochia ase Ido, omotang’ani bw’aase akorokwa Kasifa, bamoteebie ere amo nabaanto bamwabo, abarenge abakori emeremo be Hekalu abamenyete aroro ng’a batotomere abanto bache gokorera Nyasae oito ase enyomba yaye.

english: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding , of the sons of Mahli , the son of Levi , the son of Israel ; and Sherebiah , with his sons and his brethren , eighteen ;
ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo atokonyete nokoboko kwaye okuya, bagatotomera Serebia orenge omonto omong’aini bw’ororeria rwa Mali, mosinto o Lawi o Israeli, amo nabamura baye na abamwabo, bonsi abanto ikomi na batano na batato.

english: And Hashabiah , and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari , his brethren and their sons , twenty ;
ekegusii: Boigo bagatoma Hasabia na Yesaia bw’ororeria rwa Merari, na abamwabo, na abana babo, bonsi nabaanto emerongo ebere.

english: Of the sons of Phinehas ; Gershom : of the sons of Ithamar ; Daniel : of the sons of David ; Hattush .
ekegusii: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Finehasi, Gerisomu; korwa ase orwa Itamari, Danieli; korwa ase orwa Daudi, Hatusi

english: Also of the Nethinims , whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites , two hundred and twenty Nethinims : all of them were expressed by name .
ekegusii: Naende bagatoma abakori emeremo be Hekalu amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220), ekeombe kere buna Daudi na abakoonyi baye bachorete gokonya Abalawi ase emeremo yabo. Abwo bonsi nigo batoretwe ase amarieta abo. Ezra ogotang’ana abanto ase okweng’ata na ogosaba

english: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava , that we might afflict ourselves before our God , to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones , and for all our substance .
ekegusii: Erio agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa, nkaraareria abanto, nkabateebia ng’a tweng’ate, naende twekeyie tobe abaitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito na korigia korwa asare oborendi obuya ase orogendo rwaito, intwe na abana baito, na ebinto biaito bionsi.

english: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way : because we had spoken unto the king , saying , The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete nobosooku kobooria omorwoti atoe ekeombe ki’abasikari, na eki’abariini chibarasi ng’a bache gotorenda ase orogendo rwaito, ng’a titokorerwa bobe nababisa baito, ekiagera konya namotebirie ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo gokorenta amaya ase abwo bonsi bakomorigia, naende ng’a endamwamu yaye ere nokobua nigo ekoba igoro y’abwo bonsi bakomotiga.

english: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio tokeng’ata na koboria Nyasae oito, nere akaigwa okoboria gwaito kw’ogosorora. Ebiegwa bie Hekalu

english: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests , Sherebiah , Hashabiah , and ten of their brethren with them,
ekegusii: Erio ngachora abakuani ikomi na babere, abarenge abatang’ani: Serebia na Hasabia, amo nabakuani bande bamwabo ikomi.

english: And weighed unto them the silver , and the gold , and the vessels , even the offering of the house of our God , which the king , and his counsellors , and his lords , and all Israel there present , had offered :
ekegusii: Bono nkabarengera chifeta, ne chitaabu; na ebikorero, ebio omorwoti, na abasemia baye, na abagaambi bare komokonya, na Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge agwo, konya barure ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver , and silver vessels an hundred talents , and of gold an hundred talents ;
ekegusii: Ebi nabio nabaete: Chitalanta chi’echifeta amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano (650), na ebikorero biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta bi’erigori rie chitalanta rigana erimo (100), ne chitaabu chitalanta rigana erimo (100),

english: Also twenty basons of gold , of a thousand drams ; and two vessels of fine copper , precious as gold .
ekegusii: ne chibakuri emerongo ebere chiaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chire chie rigori buna erie chidariki elifu eyemo, na ebikorero bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai chichenire bire bi’erigori buna erie chitaabu.

english: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD ; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers .
ekegusii: Ngateebia abakuani, “Inwe nigo more abachenekire ase Omonene, na ebikorero nabirobio biachenekire. Chifeta ne chitaabu echio nigo chiarurwe chire ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito.

english: Watch ye, and keep them , until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites , and chief of the fathers of Israel , at Jerusalem , in the chambers of the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Chigache na gochirenda goika ekero morachirenge ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene na Abalawi, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bare Yerusalemu ime ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba y’Omonene.”

english: Of the sons of Shechaniah , of the sons of Pharosh ; Zechariah : and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: orwa Sekania; korwa ase orwa Parosi, Zakaria, amo nabwo barigetwe amo nere, abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150);

english: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver , and the gold , and the vessels , to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bakaimokia chifeta ne chitaabu echio barengerete amo nebikorero, erinde baire ebinto ebio Yerusalemu, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito. Okoirana kw’Abayahudi Yerusalemu

english: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month , to go unto Jerusalem : and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy , and of such as lay in wait by the way .
ekegusii: Bono ase rituko ria ikomi na kabere ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani tokarua agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa kogenda Yerusalemu. Okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo kwarenge amo naintwe gototooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, na korwa ase abanto barenge gotoboera inchera.

english: And we came to Jerusalem , and abode there three days .
ekegusii: Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu, tokabeera aroro ase obotoereru amatuko atato.

english: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest ; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas ; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua , and Noadiah the son of Binnui , Levites ;
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane togasoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito; erio chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebikorero biria, bikarengwa bikabekwa ase amaboko a Meremoti Omokuani, mosinto o Uria, oyorenge amo na Eleazari, mosinto o Finehasi, na ase Abalawi aba: Yosabadi, mosinto o Yesua, na Nuhudia, mosinto o Binui.

english: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio bionsi bikabarwa bikarengwa oborito bwabo, na oborito bwa kera egento bokarikwa.

english: Also the children of those that had been carried away , which were come out of the captivity , offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel , twelve bullocks for all Israel , ninety and six rams , seventy and seven lambs , twelve he goats for a sin offering : all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; bakarua chieri ikomi na ibere ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende bakarua chimingichi emerongo kianda na isano nemo (96), ne chimanwa chi’eching’ondi emerongo etano na ebere, na isano na ibere (77). Naende bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe. Ching’iti echio chionsi nigo chiaruetwe chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene.

english: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants , and to the governors on this side the river : and they furthered the people , and the house of God .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakarenta amang’ana arigetwe nomorwoti, bakayaa abagaambi abanene ase oborwoti, na abagabana b’orogongo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, barabwo bonsi bakaba bagokonya abanto, bagakonya nenyomba ya Nyasae.

english: Of the sons of Pahath-moab ; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah , and with him two hundred males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Pahati‐Moabu, Eliehoenai, mosinto o Seraya, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere (200);

english: Of the sons of Shechaniah ; the son of Jahaziel , and with him three hundred males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Satu, Sekania, mosinto o Yahasieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana atato (300);

english: Of the sons also of Adin ; Ebed the son of Jonathan , and with him fifty males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Adini, Ebedi, mosinto o Yonathani, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano (50);

english: And of the sons of Elam ; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah , and with him seventy males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Elamu, Yesaia, mosinto bw’Atalia, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70);

english: And of the sons of Shephatiah ; Zebadiah the son of Michael , and with him fourscore males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Sefatia, Sebadia, mosinto o Mikaeli, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na etato (80);

english: Of the sons of Joab ; Obadiah the son of Jehiel , and with him two hundred and eighteen males .
ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Yoabu, Obadia, mosinto o Yehieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere, na ikomi na batano na batato (218);

english: Now when these things were done , the princes came to me, saying , The people of Israel , and the priests , and the Levites , have not separated themselves from the people of the lands , doing according to their abominations , even of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Perizzites , the Jebusites , the Ammonites , the Moabites , the Egyptians , and the Amorites .
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio onsi kaerire, abatang’ani bagacha ase ’nde, baganteebia, “Abaisraeli, amo n’abakuani, na Abalawi, tibeatananeti korwa ase abanto abamenyete ase chinse echio. Nigo bagokora okogechia okwo Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, na Abamisiri, na Abaamori bagokora.

english: And now, O our God , what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments ,
ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, ninki toranyare gokwana magega y’amang’ana aya onsi? Intwe twatigire kobwata amachiiko ao,

english: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets , saying , The land , unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands , with their abominations , which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness .
ekegusii: ayio gwachigeete goetera ase abasomba bao ababani ogateba: Ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino nigo ere eyetachenegeti, ekiagera abanto b’aroro bayekorire yabeire enyaka ase okoyeichoria nogokora kwabo gw’okogechia korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.

english: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds , and for our great trespass , seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve , and hast given us such deliverance as this;
ekegusii: Na bono nonya amang’ana aya onsi aikire gotonyora ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito okobe, na okomocha gwaito okonene, twarorire ng’a aye, Nyasae oito, totoeti egesusuro buna ebibe biaito bigwenerete, korende gwatotigeire abatigari buna aba iga.

english: Should we again break thy commandments , and join in affinity with the people of these abominations ? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us , so that there should be no remnant nor escaping ?
ekegusii: Inee! Ntosarie naende amachiiko ao na tonyuomerane nabaanto aba bagokora okogechia oko? Inee! Igo aye tokoba nendamwamu ase tore na otosirie kegima, erinde abatigari tibanyorekana, gose monto onde atooreke?

english: O LORD God of Israel , thou art righteous : for we remain yet escaped , as it is this day : behold, we are before thee in our trespasses : for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo ore omonyene oboronge, korende gwatotigairie intwe tore abake boka abatwatoorekire, buna tore aiga reero. Rora, nigo tore aa ase obosio bwao tokoorokia okomocha gwaito, na monto tari oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao ase engencho y’okomocha buna oko.”

english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons : so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands : yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass .
ekegusii: Barabwo banyuomire abaiseke b’abaanto abwo, naende banyuomeirie abamura babo abaiseke b’abaanto abwo. Bono egesaku eke egechenu giochoganire nabaanto b’echinse echi. Abagaambi na abatang’ani b’abaanto nabwo bare ab’eritang’ani ase ogokora okwo kw’ogotegenwa.”

english: And when I heard this thing , I rent my garment and my mantle , and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard , and sat down astonied .
ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, nigo natandorete chianga chiane na eganchwa yane, ngasunyora etukia yane, ne chinderu chiane, erio ngaikaransa ngaichana.

english: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel , because of the transgression of those that had been carried away ; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaigusetwe ase engencho y’amang’ana aria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli akwanete igoro y’ogotegenwa kw’abaanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagasangererekana ase ’nde agwo ase naikaransete ing’ichanete goika engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba.

english: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness ; and having rent my garment and my mantle , I fell upon my knees , and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God ,
ekegusii: Na ekero engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba yaigete, nkaimoka korwa aase aria naikaransete inyekeetie, imbegete chianga na omwambaro one otandogete, erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarambora amaboko aane gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae one,

english: And said , O my God , I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God : for our iniquities are increased over our head , and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens .
ekegusii: ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae one, nabeire nobosooku, na obosio bwane bwabeire nomoichano; tinkonyara gokorigereria aye Nyasae one. Ebibe biaito biabuchire gotoetania goika igoro, na okomocha gwaito gwaikire agwo igoro.

english: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day ; and for our iniquities have we, our kings , and our priests , been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands , to the sword , to captivity , and to a spoil , and to confusion of face , as it is this day .
ekegusii: Korwa amatuko e chisokoro chiaito goika reero iga twabeire tore nokomocha okonene, na ase engencho y’ebibe biaito intwe, na abarwoti baito, n’Abakuani twabeire tokobekwa ase amaboko ’abarwoti b’echinse, na goitwa nemioro, na gwoswa, naende togasakorwa na twabeire tokonyora obosooku, buna ere goika reero iga.

english: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God , to leave us a remnant to escape , and to give us a nail in his holy place , that our God may lighten our eyes , and give us a little reviving in our bondage .
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito ase engaki enke kwaorokirie obuya bw’amaabera ase tore, gwatotigire abatigari abatwatoorekire; gwatonyoreire obotamero ime y’Aase ao Aachenu. Nigo kwamorekeire amaiso aito ase engaki, erinde totimoke na tobe abayia ase obosibwa bwaito.

english: For we were bondmen ; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage , but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia , to give us a reviving , to set up the house of our God , and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abasibwa; nonya naboigo, aye Nyasae oito toratotiga ase obosibwa bwaito. Aye gwatoorokeirie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kwagerire twanyorire ogwancherwa ase abarwoti b’Abaayemi. Barabwo batoeire ribaga koagacha naende enyomba yao, eria yatagoretwe, aye Nyasae oito, na twaeirwe eburi egotokengera aiga ase ense y’Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu.

english: Paul , an apostle , ( not of men , neither by man , but by Jesus Christ , and God the Father , who raised him from the dead ;)
ekegusii: Inche Paulo, ere oyio okorangerigwa koba omotomwa tikwarenge korwa ase Mwanyabaanto gose goetera ase omonto, korende goetera ase Yeso Kristo, na Nyasae Tata oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure.

english: For do I now persuade men , or God ? or do I seek to please men ? for if I yet pleased men , I should not be the servant of Christ .
ekegusii: Bono inee! Nigo eraise koigwekana gose buna inche nigo nkorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto? Tari boigo! Keria indigetie inche nokogwenera korwa ase Nyasae! Gose, inche nigo nkorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto? Onye nabeete nkogwenera Mwanyabaanto goika bono, anga inche tinabeete omosomba o Kristo. Buna Paulo abeete omotomwa

english: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
ekegusii: Naki nimbamanyie inwe abaminto, ng’a enchiri eye nabaranderetie tiyarwete ase Mwanyabaanto.

english: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Naki tinayenyorete korwa ase Mwanyabaanto onde, gose tinorokereretigwe na monto onde bwensi, korende ere Yeso Kristo bweka, ere omonyene akang’a inche okomaanorerwa korwa asaare ere.

english: To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :
ekegusii: agancha koorokia Omwana oye ime ase ’nde erinde, indandie Amang’ana Amaya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku. Erio tinarigia konyota obosemia korwa ase Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi;

english: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
ekegusii: gose tinatiirete kogenda Yerusalemu ase abwo barenge abatomwa b’eritang’ani ase ’nde. Korende erio kegima nkagenda Arabia, naende nkairana goika Damesiki.

english: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord’s brother .
ekegusii: Korende tinaroche motomwa onde otatiga Yakobo, momura omwabo Omonene.

english: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :
ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi abare amo nainche aiga, twabakwanirie inwe abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia:

english: Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .
ekegusii: Ayio nkobariikera, nekeene. Nyasae namanyete buna tindi kongainereria!

english: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia ;
ekegusii: Erio magega nkagenda chinsemo chia Siiria na Kilikia.

english: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :
ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio, inche omonyene tinamanyekanete nonde ase ababwatani be chikanisa chiare Boyahudi.

english: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo bamanyete okaoka aria bare koigwa korwa ase abande ng’a, “Ere oyotochandete ritang’ani, bono nkorandia are okwegena koria aare gosaria agwo ritang’ani.”

english: And they glorified God in me .
ekegusii: Bagatogia Nyasae ase engencho yane.

english: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father , and from our Lord Jesus Christ ,
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo,

english: Who gave himself for our sins , that he might deliver us from this present evil world , according to the will of God and our Father :
ekegusii: Akerua ere omonyene ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, erinde atotoorie korwa ase ekegori eke ekebe kia bono, koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae Tata oito.

english: To whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
ekegusii: Obonene bobe ase Nyasae kare na kare. Amina. Enchiri ende eng’ao teri

english: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
ekegusii: Nakumirie ase more inwe! Ekiagera mokomotiga iga bwango ere oyobarangeretie ase obuya bwa Kristo, na koonchokera enchiri ende eng’ao.

english: Which is not another ; but there be some that trouble you , and would pervert the gospel of Christ .
ekegusii: Ase ekeene “enchiri ende eng’ao” teiyo, korende nigo nkoyakwana aya ase engencho mbareo abanto bande bakobaotorana na korigia koonchorana enchiri ya Kristo.

english: But though we , or an angel from heaven , preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you , let him be accursed .
ekegusii: Korende neisa koba nintwe, gose omomalaika korwa igoro, okobaranderia enchiri ende eng’ao, otatiga eria twabaranderetie, tiga omonto oyio aragererigwe goika obosiru!

english: As we said before , so say I now again , If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received , let him be accursed .
ekegusii: Buna konya twakwanire ritang’ani, bono ninkwane naende: Onye omonto okobaranderia enchiri ende eng’ao, otatiga eria mwaitaberete, oyio tiga aragererigwe goika obosiru!

english: Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
ekegusii: Ring’ana erimo barigetie tokore nario eri, ng’a toinyore abataka, ne ring’ana erio nigo narenge nomokia korikora. Paulo ogotogonyera Petero ase Antiokia

english: But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Kefa achete Antiokia, nkaamererania nere obosio ase obosio, ekiagera konya oikire kogambigwa.

english: For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
ekegusii: Naki konya bataracha abanto baria barwete ase Yakobo, nigo arenge koragera amo nabaanto b’Ebisaku; korende ekero bachete akairana magega, ageatanana, akairoka abaarogete.

english: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .
ekegusii: Agwo amo nere Abayahudi bande bagakora obong’ainereria boria, erinde nonya Barnaba agasirigwa nobong’ainereria bwabo.

english: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel , I said unto Peter before them all , If thou , being a Jew , livest after the manner of Gentiles , and not as do the Jews , why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews ?
ekegusii: Korende ekero nachia korora ng’a ogokora kwabo tikware okwaboronge ase ekeene gi’enchiri, ngateebia Kefa ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi, “Onye aye, oyore Omoyahudi, gokobwatia chingencho chi’abaanto b’Ebisaku, gose tari echi’Abayahudi, naki rende oranyare kobetereria abanto b’Ebisaku babwatie chingencho chi’Abayahudi?” Abayahudi n’Abanto b’ebisaku nigo bagotorigwa ase okwegena

english: We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,
ekegusii: Intwe n’Abayahudi ase okoiborwa gwaito, gose tari abanyene ebibe b’Ebisaku,

english: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .
ekegusii: Korende onye intwe abanyene nigo twarenge korigia konyora oboronge ase Kristo, naende twanyoretwe tore abanyene ebibe, Inee, Kristo nabeire omosomba bw’ebibe? Yaya, taibo!

english: For if I build again the things which I destroyed , I make myself a transgressor .
ekegusii: Korende kondaagache naende aria natagorete, neorokirie inche omonyene ng’a nomomochi inde.

english: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
ekegusii: Naki inche goetera ase amachiiko nakwereire amachiiko, erinde imbe moyo ase Nyasae. Nabambirwe na Kristo ase omosalaba,

english: And I went up by revelation , and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately to them which were of reputation , lest by any means I should run , or had run , in vain .
ekegusii: Na inche ngatiira ekiagera namaanoreretwe na Nyasae buna ngende; ase obobisi nkabateebia abarai enchiri eria nkorandia ase abanto b’Ebisaku. Inche tinarigetie emeremo yane emekoro gose emeyia ebe bosa.

english: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
ekegusii: gose bono tari inche inde moyo, korende Kristo nigo are moyo ime ase ’nde; na obogima inde naborobwo bono ase omobere, nigo inde naborobwo ase okomwegena Omwana o Nyasae, oyonyanchete, naende bweruete omonyene ase engencho yane.

english: I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .
ekegusii: Tinkwanga obuya bwa Nyasae, ekiagera onye oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko, rirorio Kristo nigo akwete bosa.

english: But neither Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised :
ekegusii: Korende Tito oyorenge amo nainche, nonya orenge Omogiriki, tabetereretigwe kwarokigwa.

english: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
ekegusii: Aya nigo aganetigwe nabaminto buna akoreke. Abaminto b’oborimo, abasoetigwe bobisi, banyare kounenkia obosibore bwaito tore nabwo ime ase Kristo Yeso, erinde batobeke ase obosibwa.

english: To whom we gave place by subjection , no, not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .
ekegusii: Korende erinde ekeene gi’enchiri kegenderere amo nainwe titwebegete inse ase bare nonya nensa eyemo.

english: But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;
ekegusii: Korende bakarora ekeene, ng’a inche negenirwe koranderia abatarogeti enchiri, buna Petero egenetwe koyeranderia baria baarogete.

english: ( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles :)
ekegusii: (Naki ere oyoete Petero chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaarogete, nere ong’ete inche chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaanto b’Ebisaku.)

english: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
ekegusii: Naende ekero bachia komanya obuya boria naeirwe, Yakobo na Kefa, na Yohana, abasikire bare buna chisiiro, bagatoa inche na Barnaba okoboko gw’okorio gw’okobwatana, erinde intwe togende ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na barabwo bagende ase abanto b’okwaroka.

english: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?
ekegusii: Inwe Abagalatia abariri! Ning’o obaarogete inwe? Amang’ana igoro y’okobambwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo aorogetigwe ase more maiso marore.

english: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .
ekegusii: Igo ogosesenigwa okwo Aburaamu anyorete goikera abanto b’Ebisaku goetera ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyare konyora Omoika ase enchera y’okwegena, buna twarieretwe eira. Ogochika n’echiira

english: Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man’s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .
ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokwana ’nde ase omobwekano bw’amang’ana a kera rituko. Ekero okoriera kw’omwando bw’omonto kogoikerana, onde tari oranyaare gokoonchora gose komenta ring’ana.

english: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .
ekegusii: Chiira chiria chiarieretwe Aburaamu na omoiborwa oye. Biblia teri gokwana amang’ana aya, “Ase oroiboro” buna nase abange; korende eira iga erengete ase oyomo, “Ase omoiborwa oo”, nere Kristo.

english: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .
ekegusii: Amachiiko rende, inki agwenerete? Akamentwa ase engencho y’amamocho, goika omoiborwa oria orieretwe eira anyare gocha. Amachiiko aria nigo aruetwe goetera ase abamalaika ase okoboko kw’omobwatania.

english: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
ekegusii: Tiga mbaborie ring’ana eri rioka: Igo mwanyorete Omoika ase ogokora kw’amachiiko, gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?

english: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .
ekegusii: Oyore omobwatania tari omobwatania ase oyomo, korende Nyasae noyomo. Engencho y’amachiiko

english: Is the law then against the promises of God ? God forbid : for if there had been a law given which could have given life , verily righteousness should have been by the law .
ekegusii: Inee! Amachiiko nigo are mamincha yechiira chia Nyasae? Yaya, taibo! Naki onye amachiiko aruetwe ayaranyare koa abanto obogima, anga oboronge nigo bwanyorekanete ase amachiiko.

english: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .
ekegusii: Korende amariiko asiekeire bonsi inse y’okobua kw’ebibe, erinde abegenire baegwe ayio ariereretwe eira ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso o Kristo.

english: But before faith came , we were kept under the law , shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed .
ekegusii: Korende ekero okwegena gotaracha, nigo twabwatire inse y’amachiiko, twasibire goika okwegena goche koorokigwa.

english: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ , that we might be justified by faith .
ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko abeire omotebereria oito agotoira goika ase Kristo, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okwegena.

english: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .
ekegusii: Korende bono okwegena kogwachire, titori naende inse y’omotebereria.

english: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Naki ime ase Kristo Yeso inwe mwensi mwabeire abana ba Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena.

english: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe mwensi, abamwabatisetwe ase Kristo, mwamweboire Kristo.

english: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Aiga tari Omoyahudi gose Omogiriki, tari omosomba gose omosibore, tari omosacha gose omokungu, ekiagera inwe mwensi nigo more oyomo ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Are ye so foolish ? having begun in the Spirit , are ye now made perfect by the flesh ?
ekegusii: Nabo more abariri buna iga? Mogachaaka ase Omoika, na bono morigetie goikeranigwa ase chingencho chiaino abanyene?

english: Have ye suffered so many things in vain ? if it be yet in vain .
ekegusii: Inee! Igo mwanarete emechando emenge enga buna eye bosa? Aande gose tiyarenge bosa.

english: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
ekegusii: Ere oyokobaa inwe Omoika na gokora ebikone bie chinguru egati yaino, Inee, igo agokora ayio ase ogokora kw’amachiiko gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?

english: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham .
ekegusii: Naboigo abwo bare nokwegena mbasesenirie amo na Aburaamu oyorenge omwegeni.

english: Now I say , That the heir , as long as he is a child , differeth nothing from a servant , though he be lord of all ;
ekegusii: Korende nigo ngokwana ng’a omonyamwando, ekero are omwana, tari nogwatananeka nomosomba, nonya ore omonyene enibo yonsi.

english: Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .
ekegusii: Nigo mokorenda mono amatuko, na emetienyi, na ebiro, na emiaka.

english: I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .
ekegusii: Noboire ng’a nigo nerosirie bosa ase engencho yaino.

english: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all.
ekegusii: Abaminto, nabasoroire, mobe buna inche inde, ekiagera inche nigo nabeire buna inwe. Timwankorerete bobe bonde.

english: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .
ekegusii: Inwe mwamanyire ng’a inabaranderetie enchiri ritang’ani ase engencho y’oboreu bw’omobere one.

english: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Nonya oboreu boria bwarenge ogoteemwa ase more timwanchayete gose timwanyangete, korende mokandoisia buna omomalaika o Nyasae ee, buna Kristo Yeso omonyene.

english: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .
ekegusii: Ng’ai rende omogooko oino ore? Naki nababereire kirori, ng’a onye yanyarekana, anga mwanduseria amaiso aino mong’e.

english: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire omobisa oino, ekiagera nabateebirie ayare ay’ekeene?

english: They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .
ekegusii: Baria bande mbare nomokia ase more, korende tari ase enchera ere engiya; mbarigetie kobasiekera isiko, erinde monyare gokora omokia kobakorera.

english: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .
ekegusii: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring’ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.

english: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw’okobina gw’okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.

english: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .
ekegusii: Ere nigo are inse y’abareri na abarendi goika engaki eria yachigetwe na ise eike.

english: I desire to be present with you now , and to change my voice ; for I stand in doubt of you .
ekegusii: Ee, anga nancha koba amo nainwe bono, na koonchora eriogi riane, ekiagera timanyeti inki ngokora ase more. Abana babere abamura

english: Tell me , ye that desire to be under the law , do ye not hear the law ?
ekegusii: Nteebie, inwe abamorigetie koba inse y’amachiiko, Inee, timori koigwera amachiiko?

english: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .
ekegusii: Korende omwana oria bw’omokuungu omosomba akaiborwa buna monto onde bwensi; na oria bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba, akaiborwa ase eira.

english: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo agokwanwa buna omoreng’anio. Abakungu aba nabwo amabwatano abere. Okomo nigo gokorwa egetunwa Sinai, gokoibora abana ase obosomba; nere Hagari.

english: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia , and answereth to Jerusalem which now is , and is in bondage with her children .
ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.

english: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .
ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu ya igoro nomochie omosibore, noro baba oito.

english: Now we , brethren , as Isaac was , are the children of promise .
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe nigo more abana b’eira buna Isaka.

english: Even so we , when we were children , were in bondage under the elements of the world :
ekegusii: Nabo naintwe, ekero twarenge abana, nigo twarenge abasomba inse y’amorokererio aye ritang’ani y’ense.

english: So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, intwe titori abana b’omokuungu omosomba, korende nabana b’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.

english: But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Nyasae agatoma Omwana oye; ere akaiborwa nomokuungu, akaiborerwa inse y’amachiiko,

english: And because ye are sons , God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts , crying , Abba , Father .
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe more abana baye, Nyasae agatoma Omoika bw’Omwana oye ase chinkoro chiaito, okorera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”

english: Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .
ekegusii: Ase igo, aye tori omosomba naende, korende Nyasae ogokorire koba omwana oye; na onye kwabeire omwana, naboigo kwabeire omonyamwando. Paulo ogosorora baria baonchogete tibairana magega

english: Howbeit then , when ye knew not God , ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods .
ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani, ekero motamomanyete Nyasae, inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase chinyasae chitare chinyasae bori.

english: But now , after that ye have known God , or rather are known of God , how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements , whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage ?
ekegusii: Korende bono, komwaikire komomanya Nyasae, gose kobua, mwamanyekanire na Nyasae, nase ki rende mokoiranera amorokererio aye ritang’ani, ayare amoro na amataka? Nase ki morigetie koyakorera naende?

english: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .
ekegusii: Kristo agatosibora, erinde tomenye ase obosibore; gaki tenena bokong’u, timobwatwa naende ase obosibwa bw’obosomba.

english: I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .
ekegusii: Ase Omonene ninde nogosemeria ase more ng’a timokoba nebirengererio binde ebiao, korende ere oyokobachanda nabogorie okogambigwa kwaye, naba onde bwensi.

english: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
ekegusii: Korende baminto, onye inche ngendererete nonya mbono koraria amang’ana y’okwaroka, nase ki rende nkona‐gochandwa? Igo ekegocha ki’omosalaba kiarusigwe.

english: I would they were even cut off which trouble you .
ekegusii: Anga nancha ng’a abwo bakobachanda begombayie abanyene. Obosibore goika bogamberwe nobwanchani

english: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
ekegusii: Inwe abaminto, nigo mwarangeretigwe monyore obosibore; korende ogosiborwa kwaino tikoba ogw’okobwatia chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe, mbuya mokorerane inwe ase inwe ase obwanchani.

english: But if ye bite and devour one another , take heed that ye be not consumed one of another .
ekegusii: Korende kerabe mokoromana na koriana, rigereria timocha gosirania inwe ase inwe. Okwama kw’Omoika na ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe

english: This I say then , Walk in the Spirit , and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh .
ekegusii: Gaki nigo nkobateebia, mogenderere ase Omoika na timogoikerania okogania gwe chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe.

english: But if ye be led of the Spirit , ye are not under the law .
ekegusii: Korende komokoraagwa n’Omoika, rirorio timori inse y’amachiiko.

english: Now the works of the flesh are manifest , which are these ; Adultery , fornication , uncleanness , lasciviousness ,
ekegusii: Ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo kore maiso marore na korokwo nobotomani, eubi, obonyaka,

english: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
ekegusii: Igwa, inche Paulo nkobateebia nde inwe, ng’a moise kwarokigwa, rirorio Kristo takoba nengencho ende ase more.

english: Idolatry , witchcraft , hatred , variance , emulations , wrath , strife , seditions , heresies ,
ekegusii: ogosasiima emegwekano, oborogi, obobisa, eriomana, ribero, endamwamu, obong’iti, okwerusanania, ogweatanana,

english: Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: emoko, oboiti, ogotinda, chigosori chimbe, na amang’ana ande buna ayio. Nabakuureire buna narenge kobakuurera ritang’ani, ng’a abwo bagokora amang’ana anga buna ayio, tibakonyora omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , longsuffering , gentleness , goodness , faith ,
ekegusii: Korende okwama kw’Omoika nobwanchani, omogooko, omorembe, oboremereria, obwororo, obuya, obwegenwa,

english: Meekness , temperance : against such there is no law .
ekegusii: oboitongo, okwerita ase onsi; machiko ande tari arange amang’ana buna ayio.

english: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts .
ekegusii: Abwo bare abakristo Yeso baabambire chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.

english: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .
ekegusii: Onye intwe twabeire moyo ase Omoika, togenderere boigo ase Omoika.

english: Let us not be desirous of vain glory , provoking one another , envying one another .
ekegusii: Titoba nokogania kw’ogwetogia abanyene, titochegania, gose koba nemoko intwe ase intwe.

english: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .
ekegusii: Naende ngoteebia nde kera omonto oyokwarokigwa, ng’a rirorio osibirwe ase ogoikerania amachiiko onsi.

english: Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .
ekegusii: Mwatananirwe korwa ase Kristo, inwe abamorigetie konyora oboronge korwa ase amachiiko, mwagure korwa ase obuya.

english: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith .
ekegusii: Naki intwe ase Omoika ntoganyete oboronge boria tosemeretie ase enchera y’okwegena.

english: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .
ekegusii: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.

english: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?
ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?

english: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .
ekegusii: Okoebereria okwo tikwarwete asare ere oyobarangeretie inwe.

english: Brethren , if a man be overtaken in a fault , ye which are spiritual , restore such an one in the spirit of meekness ; considering thyself , lest thou also be tempted .
ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto obuirwe nokomocha konde, inwe abamore ab’Omoika nebagwenerete koirania omonto oyio ase omoika bw’obwororo. Erigererie aye omonyene, tobaisa goteemwa.

english: As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .
ekegusii: Nabo gatorabe ne ribaga tokorere abanto bonsi amaya, korende kobua mono abwo bare ab’okwegena. Ogokuurera na ogosesenigwa

english: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .
ekegusii: Rigereria, buna chinuguta chire chinene echi nabariikeire nokoboko kwane omonyene.

english: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .
ekegusii: Bonsi abwo barigetie kororekana buya ase emebere yabo, abwo nabwo bakobabetereria ng’a mwarokigwe, erinde tibachandwa ase engencho y’omosalaba o Kristo.

english: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law ; but desire to have you circumcised , that they may glory in your flesh .
ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abaarogete tibabwateti amachiiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.

english: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
ekegusii: Ogwetogia kobe are nainche, otatiga inyetogerie omosalaba Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ase oro ense yabambirwe ase ’nde, na inche ase ense.

english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
ekegusii: Naki okwaroka tai gento, gose ogotaroka tai gento, korende negento koba egetongwa ekeyia.

english: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .
ekegusii: Omorembe na amaabera bibe amo na bonsi abaragenderere ase ogochika oko, na amo n’Abaisraeli ba Nyasae.

english: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .
ekegusii: Korwa bono monto onde tanchanda; naki nabogoirie ekemanyererio kia Yeso ase omobere one.

english: Brethren , the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen . Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
ekegusii: Abaminto, obuya bw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino. Amina.

english: Bear ye one another’s burdens , and so fulfil the law of Christ .
ekegusii: Bogorerania chigurube inwe ase inwe, nario moraikeranie amachiiko a Kristo.

english: For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .
ekegusii: Naki omonto karekage ng’a ere naisaine, ere taisaini kende; igo akweng’aina ere omonyene.

english: But let every man prove his own work , and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone , and not in another .
ekegusii: Korende kera omonto arenge emeremo yaye omonyene. Onye ore nengencho y’ogwetogia, tiga ayietogerie bweka omonyene, na tereng’ania nomogisangio oye.

english: For every man shall bear his own burden .
ekegusii: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.

english: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things .
ekegusii: Korende ere oyokworokererigwa ring’ana, abwatane nere oyokomworokereria ase ebinto ebiya bionsi.

english: Be not deceived ; God is not mocked : for whatsoever a man soweth , that shall he also reap .
ekegusii: Timong’aineka; Nyasae tagokorerwa echeche. Naki kende gionsi omonto agosimeka, nakio arache kogesa.

english: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he tha soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .
ekegusii: Naki ere oyogosimeka ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe nache kogesa ogosareka korwa ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe, korende ere oyogosimeka ase Omoika nache kogesa obogima bwa kare na kare korwa ase Omoika.

english: And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
ekegusii: Titorosa gokora amaya, ekiagera natogese ekero engaki eraike, totakweti emioyo.

english: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rw’abana ba Nuhu: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Na aba batato bakaibora abana abamura magega y’etoigo eria.

english: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
ekegusii: Omochakano bw’obogaambi bwaye nigo bware Babiloni, na Ereku, na Akadi, (na Kaline); eyio yonsi nigo yaare ase ense ya Sinari.

english: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,
ekegusii: Akarwa ase ense eria, akagenda goika Asuri, akaagacha Ninawi, na Rehoboti‐Iri, na Kala,

english: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .
ekegusii: na Reseni, omochie omonene oyorenge egati ya Ninawi na Kala.

english: And Pathrusim , and Casluhim , (out of whom came Philistim ,) and Caphtorim .
ekegusii: na Abapaturusi, Abakasiluhi, (korwa ase bare nao Abafirisiti barwete), na Abakafitori.

english: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,
ekegusii: Kaanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,

english: And the Jebusite , and the Amorite , and the Girgasite ,
ekegusii: na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi,

english: And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite : and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad .
ekegusii: na Abaarivadi, na Abaseremari, na Abahamati. Erio magega y’ayio eamate ya Kaanani egesiarera.

english: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboim , even unto Lasha .
ekegusii: Orobebe rw’Abakaanani rogachaka korwa ase Sidoni, rokagenda enchera ya Gerari, rogaika Gasa, naende ase enchera ya Sodomu, na Gomora, na Adima, na Seboimu, rogaika Lasa.

english: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Hamu, buna bareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.

english: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .
ekegusii: Shemu, oyorenge sokoro y’abana b’Eberi, naende oyio neere orenge omomura omonene omwabo Yafeti, akaiborerwa abana.

english: The children of Shem ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .
ekegusii: Abana ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu, na Asuri, na Arifakisadi, na Ludi, na Aramu.

english: And the children of Aram ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .
ekegusii: Na abana ba Aramu nabwo aba: Usi, na Huli, na Geteri, na Masi.

english: And unto Eber were born two sons : the name of one was Peleg ; for in his days was the earth divided ; and his brother’s name was Joktan .
ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Omomura omotangi nigo aare korokwa Pelegi + 10:25 Pelegi: engencho yaye: ogwatananekana (1 Amg 1:24-27) , ekiagera ase amatuko aye nario ense yaatananegete, na oyomwabo nigo aare korokwa Yokitani.

english: And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,
ekegusii: na Hadoramu, na Usali, na Dikila,

english: And Obal , and Abimael , and Sheba ,
ekegusii: na Obali, na Abimaeli, na Seba,

english: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .
ekegusii: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nabwo abana ba Yokitani.

english: And the sons of Gomer ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .
ekegusii: Na abana ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi, na Rifati, na Togama.

english: And their dwelling was from Mesha , as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east .
ekegusii: Ensemo eria bamenyete nigo yachakerete Mesa gochia Sefari, ase ebitunwa bia moocha.

english: These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Shemu, buna baareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.

english: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .
ekegusii: Echio nachio chiamate chi’abana ba Nuhu, koreng’ana na ororeeria rwabo ase ebisaku biabo; na korwa ase bare ebisaku bigesiarera ase ense yonsi magega y’etoigo.

english: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands ; every one after his tongue , after their families , in their nations .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo chisokoro chi’abaanto abwo bamenyete mbarabare ye nyancha na as’ebisinka. Barabwo nororeeria rwa Yebita abwo bamenyete kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye, ne chingongo chiabo na kera oyomo ase omonwa oye areenge gokwana.

english: And the sons of Ham ; Cush , and Mizraim , and Phut , and Canaan .
ekegusii: Na abana ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi, na Misiri, na Putu, na Kaanani.

english: And the sons of Cush ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabtah , and Raamah , and Sabtecha : and the sons of Raamah ; Sheba , and Dedan .
ekegusii: Na abana ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba, na Havila, na Sabuta, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana ba Raama nabwo aba: Seba na Dedani.

english: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .
ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw’eritang’ani oyorenge nokobua ase ense.

english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD : wherefore it is said , Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD .
ekegusii: Ere nigo areenge omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene. Ase ayio, igo abanto banarete goteeba igoro y’omonto: “Igo anga buna Nimurodi, omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene.”

english: And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense engima nigo baarenge nomonwa oyomo na amang’ana abwekaine.

english: These are the generations of Shem : Shem was an hundred years old , and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood :
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Shemu. Ekero konya Shemu aikire emiaka rigana erimo (100), akaibora Arifakisadi; ekaba emiaka ebere magega y’etoigo eria.

english: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Arifakisadi, Shemu naende akamenya emiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years , and begat Salah :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Arifakisadi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na etano (35) akaibora Sela.

english: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Sela, Arifakisadi nigo kakoorete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akamanya akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Sela akoorire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Eberi.

english: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Eberi, Sela agaika emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), erio akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Eber lived four and thirty years , and begat Peleg :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Eberi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ene (34), akaibora Pelegi.

english: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Pelegi, Eberi agakoora emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Pelegi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Reu.

english: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Reu, Pelegi gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na kianda (209), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east , that they found a plain in the land of Shinar ; and they dwelt there.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimoka kogenda orogendo gochia ensemo ya moocha, bakanyora ense omweya ase ense ya Shinari, bagachaaka komenya aroro.

english: And Reu lived two and thirty years , and begat Serug :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Reu aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ebere (32), akaibora Serugi,

english: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Serug lived thirty years , and begat Nahor :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Serugi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.

english: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nahori, Serugi agaika emiaka amagana abere (200), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :
ekegusii: Ekero konya Nahori aikire emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda (29), akaibora Tera.

english: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Tera, Nahori gaikire emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi na kianda (119), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .
ekegusii: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Ororeeria rwa Tera

english: Now these are the generations of Terah : Terah begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran ; and Haran begat Lot .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Tera. Tera akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Harani akaibora Loti.

english: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity , in Ur of the Chaldees .
ekegusii: Harani agatanga gokwa, agatiga Tera ise ore moyo, ase ense eria aiboreretwe, ase Uru y’Abakalidayo.

english: And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai ; and the name of Nahor’s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .
ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abarugi. Moka Aburamu nigo areenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere orenge ise Milka na Isika.

english: And they said one to another , Go to , let us make brick , and burn them throughly . And they had brick for stone , and slime had they for morter .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Inchuo, toroisie amatobori na toyasambe nomorero.” Igo bakanyora amatabori ribaga ri’amagena, na bakore esike gete ase okoyabwaterania.

english: But Sarai was barren ; she had no child .
ekegusii: Korende Sarai igo areenge omogomba, tabwate mwana.

english: And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram’s wife ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees , to go into the land of Canaan ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there.
ekegusii: Tera akaira Aburamu omwana oye, na Loti omochokoro oye, omwana o Harani, amo na Sarai, moka momura oye Aburamu; bakagenda komo gochia Uru y’Abakalidayo, bakagenda goika ense ya Kaanani. Korende ekero baigete omochie o Harani, bakamenya aroro.

english: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years : and Terah died in Haran .
ekegusii: Tera agaika emiaka amagana abere, na etano (205); erio agakwera aaria Harani.

english: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .
ekegusii: Erio bagateeba: “Inchuo tweagachere omochie na omoorobiri, na obotambe bwaye boike erioba igoro, tweekorere erieta rinene, titobaisa gocha goserebanigwa ase ense yonsi.” Omochie na Omorobiri o Babeli|alt="Tower of Babel" src="HK-016E.TIF" size="col" loc="Genesis 11:4-9" copy="Horace Knowles" ref="11:4-9"

english: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower , which the children of men builded .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agaika goocha inse, erinde arore omochie na omoorobiri oyio abana ba Mwanyabaanto konya baagachire.

english: And the LORD said , Behold, the people is one , and they have all one language ; and this they begin to do : and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do .
ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Rora, abanto aba negesaku ekemo, na bagokwana omonwa oyomo bonsi na amang’ana abwekaine. Na bono rora, aya naro bachakire gokora, eyio ekworokia ng’a magega y’ayio tibagosinywa gento kende gionsi baraarengererie gokora.

english: Go to , let us go down , and there confound their language , that they may not understand one another’s speech .
ekegusii: Eta togende toike inse ase bare, tobatantanie ase omonbwa obo tibaigwana ase chinkwana chiao barabwo ase barabwo.”

english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth : and they left off to build the city .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Omonene akabaserebania korwa agwo, bagesiarera ase ense yonsi, na abamenyeo. Erio bagatiga koagacha omochie oria.

english: Therefore is the name of it called Babel ; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth : and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth .
ekegusii: Aase ayio baare koagacha akarokwa Babiloni + 11:9 Babiloni: engencho yaye: obotantanu , ekiagera Omonene atantanetie omonwa bw’abaanto b’ense yonsi, na korwa agwo Omonene akabaserebania erio bagende ense yonsi, bayemenye. Ororeeria rwa Shemu

english: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land .
ekegusii: Bono enchara egasoa ase ense eria, na ase engencho enchara eria yareenge enene mono, ekagera Aburamu agatirimboka gochia Misiri achi kobeera aroro

english: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt , that he said unto Sarai his wife , Behold now , I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon :
ekegusii: Kobaikire aang’e gosoa Misiri, agateebia Sarai mokaye iga: “Nimanyete ng’a nigo ore omokungu omonyakieni ase okororekana;

english: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive .
ekegusii: aande gose Abamisiri, ekero barakorore, nigo barateebe: Oyo mokaye; erio bang’ite inche, korende aye bagotige moyo.

english: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu asoete Misiri, Abamisiri bakarora omokungu oyio ng’a nigo areenge omonyakieni mono.

english: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house .
ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baaria abaarenge inse ya Farao bachia korora omokungu oria, bakamotogia mono ase obosio bwa Farao. Na omokungu oria akairwa komenya mwa Farao.

english: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .
ekegusii: Farao agakorera Aburamu buya ase engencho ya Sarai, na Aburamu nigo anyorete ching’ondi, ne chieeri chi’okorema, ne chitigere, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, ne chitigere chiaberi, ne chingamia.

english: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akarenta amaakwa amanene ase Farao amo na abanto baye ase engencho ya Sarai, moka Aburamu.

english: And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Aburamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwankoreire iga, otaare gonteebia ng’a oyo Sarai mokao?

english: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
ekegusii: Naki gwakorete iga, ogateeba ng’a oyo mosubati omino, erio ekagera na inche nkamoira akaba mokane? Bono mokao oyio moire, ogende nere.”

english: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee, and make thy name great ; and thou shalt be a blessing :
ekegusii: Ningokore obe egesaku ekenene, ningosesenie, ninkore erieta riao ribe rinene, na aye nobe omosesenigwa.

english: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away , and his wife , and all that he had.
ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto bakoobe Aburamu amo na mokaye na kende gionsi abwate.

english: So Abram departed , as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akaimoka, akagenda buna Omonene amoteebetie, na Loti akagenda amo nere. Aburamu nigo areenge omomura bw’ekegori kiemiaka emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (75), ekero are kong’anya korwa Harani.

english: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother’s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
ekegusii: Aburamu akaira Sarai mokaye, na Loti, omwana omomura omwabo, na ebinto bionsi ebi babwate, ebio konya benyoreire abanyene, na abasomba babo bonsi babwate agwo Harani, bakaimoka, bakagenda ense ya Kaanani.

english: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
ekegusii: Ekero baigeteo, Aburamu agaeta gati y’ense eria goika Shekemu, aase aachenu, aase omote okorokwa omwaloni orenge, agwo More. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani nabwo bamenyete ase ense eyio.

english: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el , and pitched his tent , having Beth-el on the west , and Hai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the LORD , and called upon the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio akarwa agwo, akagenda goika ebitunwa bire ensemo ya moocha ya Beteli, agatenenia eema yaye aroro. Korwa aase agwo Beteli nigo orenge ensemo ya bosongo, na Ai ensemo ya moocha. Na agwo akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, erio akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene.

english: And Abram journeyed , going on still toward the south .
ekegusii: Na Aburamu akabwatia orogendo akagenderera bosio gochia ensemo ya Negebu. Aburamu okogenda Misri

english: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he, and his wife , and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south .
ekegusii: Aburamu akarwa Misiri, akagenda gochia Negebu, ere amo na mokaye na ebi bionsi abwate, na Loti akageenda amo nere.

english: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan ; and Lot journeyed east : and they separated themselves the one from the other .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Loti agechorera bweka ense omweya yonsi ya Yorodani. Barabwo bagatananekana. Igo Loti akamanora kogenda gochia moocha.

english: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .
ekegusii: Aburamu akamenya ase ense ya Kaanani, na Loti nere akamenya egati y’emechie agwo ase ense eria y’omweya, akang’anyia eema yaye gochia Sodomu.

english: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sodomu nigo barenge ababe, barenge gokora ebibe ebinge ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aburamu okong’anya gochia ase Heburoni

english: And the LORD said unto Abram , after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes , and look from the place where thou art northward , and southward , and eastward , and westward :
ekegusii: Magega Loti na Aburamu kobaatananekire, Omonene agateebia Aburamu: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie korwa agwo aase ore, origererie ensemo ya sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, na bosongo;

english: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .
ekegusii: Ningokore aye n’ororeeria rwao robe buna orotu rw’ense rotanyare kobareka; onye omonto okonyara kobara orotu rw’ense, rirorio nanyare boigo kobara ororeeria rwao narororwo.

english: Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
ekegusii: Bono imoka, otaare ense eye, orore obotambe na oboagare bwaye, ekiagera ninkoe aye ense eyio.”

english: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang’anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya ebitutu bw’emete ekorokwa emialoni agwo Mamure, ang’e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro.

english: And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
ekegusii: Nabo Aburamu areenge omotenenku mono, nigo abwate etugo enyinge, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu.

english: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el , unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Beth-el and Hai ;
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akageenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani kegima, gati ya Beteli na Ai,

english: Unto the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first : and there Abram called on the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: agwo nao aase Aburamu aagachete egesasiimero kie ritang’ani kegima na korirangeria erieta ri’Omonene. Aburamu na Loti bagwatananeka

english: And Lot also, which went with Abram , had flocks , and herds , and tents .
ekegusii: Na Loti, oyogendete amo n’Aburamu, nigo abwate ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chiema.

english: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .
ekegusii: Ase igo, ense eria tiyabaisana banyare komenya amo bonsi babere, ekiagera chinibo chiabo nechinyinge chiarenge, goika tibanyara komenya amo.

english: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle : and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land .
ekegusii: Agwo eriomana rigatuboka egati y’abarisia b’Aburamu, na abarisia ba Loti. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani na Abaperisi nabwo bamenyete ase ense eria.

english: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen ; for we be brethren .
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agateebia Loti, “Tari buya twomane inche naye, gose abarisia baane na abao, ekiagera intwe nabaanto abamo tore.

english: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .
ekegusii: Inee! Ense eye yonsi teri ase obosio bwao? Tigango twatananeke. Koragende ensemo ya bomosi, inche ningende eya borio; koragende ensemo ya borio, inche ningende eya bomosi.”

english: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar , Arioch king of Ellasar , Chedorlaomer king of Elam , and Tidal king of nations ;
ekegusii: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,

english: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits ; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled , and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain .
ekegusii: Na ense omweya ya Sidimu nigo yaichire amabwago y’esike gete, na abarwoti abwo ba Sodomu na Gomora ekero baarenge gotama, bakagwa ase amabwago ayio ime, na baria batigarete bagatama gochia ebitunwa igoro.

english: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .
ekegusii: Erio ababisa bagasakora chinibo chionsi chia Sodomu na Gomora, na endagera yabo yonsi bakaira chinsobo.

english: And they took Lot , Abram’s brother’s son , who dwelt in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .
ekegusii: Naboigo bagoosa Loti, omwana omomura omwabo Aburamu, oyomenyete agwo Sodomu, bakamoira amo nenibo yaye.

english: And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, oyotamete korwa ase abooswa, akagenda agateebia Aburamu Omoiberania, oyomenyete ase akaanani k’emete enga buna Emealuni ka Mamure, oria Omoamori, momura omwabo Esikoli na Aneri. Abwo konya bakorire okobwatana na Aburamu.

english: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .
ekegusii: Aburamu agachia koigwa ng’a oyomwabo osakoirwe na gwoswa, agatoma abamura baye abakong’u, abaiboire bwoye, abamanyire korwana esegi, babwatie ababisa goika Dani. Abarwani aba nigo baarenge amagana atato, na ikomi na batano na batato.

english: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants , by night , and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .
ekegusii: Bwachia koba botuko, Aburamu agaatanana abanto baye, erinde barwanie ababisa babo, akababua akabaseria goika Hoba, sugusu ya Damesiki.

english: And he brought back all the goods , and also brought again his brother Lot , and his goods , and the women also, and the people .
ekegusii: Erio akairania enibo yonsi, na akairania boigo Loti omwabo amo nenibo yaye, na abakungu, na abanto bande abasakoretwe. Melkizedeki ogosesenia Aburamu

english: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king’s dale .
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu are koirana korwa ogoita Kedorilaoma amo n’abarwoti baria baarenge amo nere, omorwoti o Sodomu agasooka akamoorototera Aburamu ase ense omweya ya Shawe, eyio n’Ense omweya y’Omorwoti.

english: And he blessed him, and said , Blessed be Abram of the most high God , possessor of heaven and earth :
ekegusii: Akamosesenia, akabora, “Aburamu asesenigwe na Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense;

english: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom , and with Birsha king of Gomorrah , Shinab king of Admah , and Shemeber king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela , which is Zoar .
ekegusii: abarwoti aba bagakora esegi na Bera, omorwoti o Sodomu, na Birisa, omorwoti o Gomora, na Shinabu, omorwoti o Adima na Shemeberi, omorwoti o Seboimu, na omorwoti o Bela noro Soari.

english: And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all.
ekegusii: Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono atogigwe, oyo obekire ababisa bao inse y’amaboko ao!” Aburamu akamoa ensemo ya ikomi ya kera egento ekiabwate.

english: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram , Give me the persons , and take the goods to thyself.
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Sodomu agateebia Aburamu: “Ing’a abanto baane, korende enibo ero oire aye.”

english: And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,
ekegusii: Korende Aburamu agateebia omorwoti o Sodomu: “Naimokirie okoboko kwane na gotiana ase Omonene Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense,

english: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
ekegusii: ng’a tinkoira nonya ng’ake eusi, gose enuga y’egekoroto kiao, gose kende gionsi kiao, obaise gocha goteeba: Ninche natenenkirie Aburamu.

english: Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre ; let them take their portion .
ekegusii: Tinkoira gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera eyio abamura abwo bariete, na ensemo y’abwo bagendete amo nainche; tiga Aneri, na Esikoli, na Mamure, barabwo baire ebiabo.”

english: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .
ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bagasangererekana ase ense omweya ya Sidimu, agwo nao Enyancha y’omonyo ere. + 14:3 Enyancha y’omonyo: engencho yaye ne nyancha ase kende gionsi kere moyo getamenye

english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .
ekegusii: Konya bamokoreire Kedorilaoma emeremo ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, korende omwaka o ikomi na gatato bakaenena, tibamokorera naende.

english: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,
ekegusii: Na omwaka o ikomi na kane Kedorilaoma na abarwoti baria babwataine nere bagacha, bakarwania na kobua Abarefai ase Asteroti‐Karinaimu, na Abasusi ase Hamu, na Abaemi ase Shawe‐Kiriataimu,

english: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El-paran , which is by the wilderness .
ekegusii: n’Abahori ase egetunwa Edomu goika Eli-Parani ore ang’e nerooro.

english: And they returned , and came to En-mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar .
ekegusii: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.

english: And there went out the king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrah , and the king of Admah , and the king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar ;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim ;
ekegusii: Agwo omorwoti o Sodomu, na oyo o Gomora, na oyo bw’Adima, na oyo o Seboimu, na oyo o Bela, noro Soari, bakageenda, bakabwatarena korwana esegi ase ense omweya ya Sidimu,

english: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar ; four kings with five .
ekegusii: barwane na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goimu, na Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eliesari. Abarwoti abwo baane bakarwania baria batano.

english: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision , saying , Fear not, Abram : I am thy shield , and thy exceeding great reward .
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio, naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachiera Aburamu ase endooto, rigoteeba: “Aburamu, toiroka, Inche nenguba yao, na eng’eria yao nebe enene mono.”

english: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not.
