ekegusii: Akamorentera echio chionsi, agatandora kera eyemo chimbaara ibere, akabeeka kera orobaara rogachikana norwamwabo, korende chinyoni chirochio tachitandora.

english: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases , Abram drove them away .
ekegusii: Na ekero chinsoti chiachia kogwa ase amabego aria, Aburamu agachiseria.

english: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace ; thou shalt be buried in a good old age .
ekegusii: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.

english: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagoika ase ekiaare gia kane inabairane gocha aa, ekiagera obobe bw’Abaamori tiboraikerana goika bono.”

english: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .
ekegusii: Ekero erioba riagure, na omosunte osoire, eriko rigosokia erioki amo nekieri kere nomorero ekebemberi, bigaeta gati-gati ye chinyama chiria.

english: The Kenites , and the Kenizzites , and the Kadmonites ,
ekegusii: ase ense y’Abakeni, na Abakenisi, na Abakadimoni,

english: And Abram said , Lord GOD , what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?
ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Omonene, ninki gose orang’e, egekogera nigo nde aang’e gokwa ntari na mwana, na oyorache koira omwando one n’Eliezeri, oyo Omodamesiki?”

english: And the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Rephaims ,
ekegusii: na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abarefai,

english: And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .
ekegusii: na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abagirigasi, na Abayebusi.”

english: And Abram said , Behold, to me thou hast given no seed : and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir .
ekegusii: Aburamu akabora naende: “Rora, tong’eti abana, na omosomba oyoiboirwe aa bwone, nere oraire omwando one!”

english: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying , This shall not be thine heir ; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir .
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikamochiera Aburamu naende, rigateeba: “Omonto oyio, tari ere oraire omwando oo, otatiga omwana oo bori, orarwe ase enda yao, nere oraire omwando oo.”

english: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees , to give thee this land to inherit it.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorusetie korwa ase Uru y’Abakalidayo, ninkoe ense eye ebe omwando oo bori.”

english: And he said , Lord GOD , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?
ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Aye Omonene, naki ndakore imanye ng’a nebe omwando one bori?”

english: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria: “Ndetera emori ritororo y’emiaka etato, na embori esubeni y’emiaka etato, na emingichi y’emiaka etato, ne riruma ne riige rie riruma.”

english: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children : and she had an handmaid , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .
ekegusii: Bono Sarai, moka Aburamu, tamoiborerete bana. Sarai nareenge nomoiseke omosomba Omomisiri, ore korokwa Hagari.

english: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .
ekegusii: Naende omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Nimentekanie ororeeria rwao, na omobaro obo tokonyara kobareka, ekiagera nigo barabe abange mono.”

english: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael ; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction .
ekegusii: Naende Omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia, “Rora, morito ore, noibore omwana omoisia; nomooroke Isumaeli, + 16:11 Isumaeli: engencho yaye: Nyasae okoigwa ekiagera Omonene oigure ekerero ki’emechando yao.

english: And he will be a wild man ; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe buna etigere y’orosana ase egati y’abanto, na okoboko kwaye nigo korabe igoro y’abanto bonsi, na amaboko ’abaanto bonsi nigo arabe igoro yaye; ere nigo aramenye bosio bw’abamwabo bonsi.”

english: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?
ekegusii: Ase ayio Hagari Akaroka Omonene oyo okwanete nere Eli‐Roi, engencho yaye “Aye naye Nyasae bw’okorora”; naki akebooria: “Inee! Amaene, narorire Nyasae, na ere ontiga inde moyo magega konamororire?”

english: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi ; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ensoko eria ekarokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi + 16:14 Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi: engencho yaye; Nyasae okorora ; ero nigo ere egati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.

english: And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .
ekegusii: Aburamu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano nomo (86), ekero Hagari amoiborerete Isumaeli.

english: And Sarai said unto Abram , Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing : I pray thee, go in unto my maid ; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai .
ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Norooche bono ng’a Omonene ontangire tinyora abana, menyana nomoiseke oyo one omosomba; aande nabo ndanyore abana korwa asare.” Aburamu akaigwera ogokwana gwa Sarai.

english: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian , after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan , and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife .
ekegusii: Ase igo, magega Aburamu kamenyire ense ya Kaanani ase emiaka ikomi, Sarai akaimokia Hagari, omosomba oye Omomisiri, akamomoa Aburamu, omosacha oye, ng’a abe buna mokaye.

english: And he went in unto Hagar , and she conceived : and when she saw that she had conceived , her mistress was despised in her eyes .
ekegusii: Erio bakamenyana na Hagari, na ere akaba morito. Ekero Hagari achia korora ng’a obeire morito, agachaaka gochaaya Sarai moibori omwabo.

english: And Sarai said unto Abram , My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom ; and when she saw that she had conceived , I was despised in her eyes : the LORD judge between me and thee.
ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Obobe obo bwanyorete, tiga naye bokonyore! Inakoa omoiseke one omosomba koboko kwao; ere, ekero achia korora ng’a obeire morito, onchayire. Tiga Omonene atwatanane inche naye!”

english: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold, thy maid is in thy hand ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face .
ekegusii: Aburamu nere agateebia Sarai: “Rora, omosomba oo oyio nase amaboko ao are; moonchie buna oranche.” Erio Sarai akamochanda bobe, na ere agatama korwa asare.

english: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness , by the fountain in the way to Shur .
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarora Hagari ase erooro ase ensoko y’amaache yareenge ase enchera ekogenda Suri.

english: And he said , Hagar , Sarai’s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Aye omosomba o Sarai, ng’ai okorwa, naende ng’ai okogenda?” Akamoiraneria: “Nigo ngotama korwa ase moibori ominto Sarai.”

english: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase moibori omino, na bwekeyie asare.”

english: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the LORD appeared to Abram , and said unto him, I am the Almighty God ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99). Omonene akamoorokera, akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omobui; genderera ase obosio bwane, na obe omoikeranu.

english: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin ; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
ekegusii: Goika mwarokigwe risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaino ki’obosacha, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana egati yane nainwe.

english: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations , he that is born in the house , or bought with money of any stranger , which is not of thy seed .
ekegusii: Ekiaare ase ekiaare kera omwana omoisia ore ase egati yaino goika arokigwe ekero akoorire amatuko atano na atato, omobiare o inka amo nomogorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, otari bw’ororeeria rwao.

english: He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .
ekegusii: Omobiare o inka na omogorwa chitaabu, bonsi goika barokigwe. Ase igo, ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane inakebe ase emebere yaino goika kare na kare.

english: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised , that soul shall be cut off from his people ; he hath broken my covenant .
ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”

english: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Sarai mokao, tobaisa komooroka naende Sarai, korende erieta riaye nigo rirabe Sara. + 17:15 Sara: engencho yaye: Omoiseke bw’omorwoti

english: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations ; kings of people shall be of her.
ekegusii: Nimosesenie, nkonyorere omwana omomura korwa asare, nimosesenie, abe ng’ina bw’ebisaku; na abarwoti b’abaanto inabaiborwe korwa asare.”

english: Then Abraham fell upon his face , and laughed , and said in his heart , Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old ? and shall Sarah , that is ninety years old , bear ?
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse, agaseka, akabora ase omoyo oye ime: “Inee! Omonto ore nemiaka rigana nanyare koibora omwana?” Sara nere oyo ore nemiaka emerongo kianda aibore omwana?

english: And Abraham said unto God , O that Ishmael might live before thee !
ekegusii: Aburaamu agateebia Nyasae: “Koranche, Isumaeli abe moyo ase obosio bwao!”

english: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .
ekegusii: Nyasae akamokania, akamoteebia: “Taibo, Sara mokao nakoiborere omwana omomura, na aye nomooroke Isaka + 17:19 Isaka: engencho yaye ase omonwa bwe ’keiberania amaseko . Inche ning’ikeranie nere okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare ase ororeeria rwaye rorache korwa magega yaye.

english: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly .
ekegusii: Inche ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, ninkomentekanie mono.”

english: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana igoro ya Isumaeli nakoigure, rora, nimosesenie nimomentekanie mono, naibore abagaambi ikomi na babere; ninkore egesaku ekenene kerwe asare.

english: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac , which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year .
ekegusii: Korende ning’ikeranie okobwatana kwane na Isaka, oyo Sara araibore ase engaki buna eye iga, ase omwaka ogocha.”

english: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham .
ekegusii: Nyasae ekero akoorire gokwana na Aburaamu, akairana korwa asare, akagenda.

english: And Abraham took Ishmael his son , and all that were born in his house , and all that were bought with his money , every male among the men of Abraham’s house ; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day , as God had said unto him.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akabwata Isumaeli omwana oye, na abasomba aba baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu, kera omonto omosacha ore ase abanto b’enka ya Aburaamu, akabarokia risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiabo ki’obosacha, ase rituko riria riria, buna Nyasae amotebetie.

english: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
ekegusii: Aburaamu konya oikire nemiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99), ekero arogetigwe.

english: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
ekegusii: Na Isumaeli, omwana oye, nigo konya aikire emiaka ikomi, na etato, ekero arogetigwe.

english: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Aburaamu akarokigwa amo na omwana oye Isumaeli.

english: And all the men of his house , born in the house , and bought with money of the stranger , were circumcised with him.
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, bakarokigwa amo nere.

english: And Abram fell on his face : and God talked with him, saying ,
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agatugama inse akaumama, na Nyasae akamoteebia,

english: As for me , behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations .
ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.

english: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
ekegusii: Ninkomente obe na ororeeria oronge mono, ninkore ebisaku ebinge birue asore, na abarwoti nabarue asore boigo.

english: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations .
ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Aye goika obwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ekiaare ase ekiaare.

english: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day ;
ekegusii: Omonene akaorokera Aburaamu ase emete enga buna Emealuni agwo Mamure, ekero Aburaamu aikaransete gesieri ki’eema yaye, engaki y’omobaso omoororo.

english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .
ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu na Sara konya bagotire mono, baetanirie emiaka y’obosae, na Sara konya oeteire emiaka y’okonyora abana.

english: And the LORD said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old ?
ekegusii: Omonene akabooria Aburaamu: “Ninki Sara agosekera, ogoteeba: Inche amaene ninyibore omwana buna nagotire iga?

english: Then Sarah denied , saying , I laughed not; for she was afraid . And he said , Nay ; but thou didst laugh .
ekegusii: Sara agakana, agateeba: “Inche tinsegeti,” naki nigo noboete. Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo; korende aye ngwaseka.” Aburaamu ogosabera abanto ba Sodomu

english: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom : and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way .
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakagenda, bakaba barigereretie gochia Sodomu, na Aburaamu akagenda amo nabarabwo, akabakooba.

english: And the LORD said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do ;
ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Inee! Imobise Aburaamu ring’ana ngochia gokora,

english: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
ekegusii: ekero ndoche ng’a ngochia are koba egesaku ekenene gie chinguru, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe goetera asare?

english: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him , and they shall keep the way of the LORD , to do justice and judgment ; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
ekegusii: Naki namochorire + 18:19 namochorire: Ase Ekeiberania erieta ritumegete namomanyire , ng’a ere arue ogochika gochia ase abana baye na bonsi abagotoka enka yaye, na baria abarache koiborwa korwa magega yaye, babwatie enchera y’Omonene, bakore oboronge na ekeene, erinde Omonene aikeranerie Aburaamu, onsi aya amorierete eira.”

english: And the LORD said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous ;
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateeba: “Ekiagera ekerero gia Sodomu na Gomora nekenene, na ebibe biabo biamentekire mono,

english: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know .
ekegusii: nigo ndaike gochia inse, indore onye bakorire amabe amange buna ekerero eke kiang’ikeire kegoteeba; onye taibo, nimanye ayio.”

english: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom : but Abraham stood yet before the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio abanto baria bakarwa agwo, bakagenda gochia Sodomu, korende Aburaamu agatigara oteneine agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?
ekegusii: Aburaamu agasuka gochia ase Omonene, akamobooria: “Inee! Amaene, nigo orasirie abanyene oboronge amo nabakori amabe?

english: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
ekegusii: Aande ase omochie oria abanyene oboronge emerongo etano mbakareo, nigo orayosirie, gose noyororere amaabera ase engencho y’abwo abanyene oboronge emerongo etano?

english: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
ekegusii: Yaya gaki teeba boigo, ekeene, nosirie abanyene oboronge nabakori amabe amo? Omonyene oboronge tagokorerwa buna abakori amabe! Inee! Aye Omogambi omonene bw’ense engima notige gokora ayare y’oboronge!”

english: And the LORD said , If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city , then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Inse konyora abanyene oboronge emerongo etano ase omochie oria o Sodomu, rirorio nigo ndatige gosiria omochie aria ase engencho y’abwo, abaronge.”

english: And Abraham answered and said , Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord , which am but dust and ashes :
ekegusii: Aburaamu akairaneria: “Rigereria, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene, nonya inche inde orotu rw’amaroba, na eriibu bosa.

english: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .
ekegusii: Aande ase baria emerongo etano baise koba batano tibaiyo, abanyene oboronge, Inee, nosarie omochie ekiagera batano tibaiyo?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, kondarore agwo emerongo ene, na batano.”

english: And he spake unto him yet again , and said , Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said , I will not do it for forty’s sake.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akagenderera naende gokwana nere: “Aande baraisa kororekana rende emerongo ene?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ene, tingosaria omochie.”

english: And said , My Lord , if now I have found favour in thy sight , pass not away , I pray thee, from thy servant :
ekegusii: akabora: “Omonene one, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, tong’etaania inche, omosomba oo.

english: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Omonene, koranche, tobaisa kombea nainche, ningendererete gokwana naye. Aande barabaisa konyorekana rende emerongo etato?” Omonene akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie oria, inse konyora mbare emerongo etato aroro.”

english: And he said , Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord : Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said , I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Rora, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene. Baise konyorekana rende emerongo ebere?” Omonene akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ebere, tingosaria omochie.”

english: And he said , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak yet but this once : Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said , I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamobooria naende: “Omonene, tobaisa kombea, bono ndimo rioka ngokoboria, barachia konyorekana rende ikomi boka?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, inse konyora agwo ikomi boka.”

english: And the LORD went his way , as soon as he had left communing with Abraham : and Abraham returned unto his place .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorete gokwana na Aburaamu, akagenda; na Aburaamu akairana bwoye.

english: Let a little water , I pray you , be fetched , and wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree :
ekegusii: Tiga morenterwe amaache make, mwesibie amagoro, na motimokere aa ase ekiriiri ki’omote oyo.

english: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .
ekegusii: Inche imbarentere endagera inke morie, erio monyore chinguru; erio momanye kogenderera gochia ase mware kogenda, naki aase aiga mwaeta mbwone, inche omosomba oino.” Bakamoteebia: “Gaki, kora buna gwateeba.”

english: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah , and said , Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal , knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Aburaamu akaayerera, agasoa eema ime agwo ase Sara arenge, akamoteebia: “Renta bwango obosie, ebirengo bitato, obokonye, oroisie emegati.”

english: And Abraham ran unto the herd , and fetcht a calf tender and good , and gave it unto a young man ; and he hasted to dress it.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaminyoka getii ase riicho riaye, akarenta emori engiya, enoru, enterere, akayea omosomba oye, akamoteebia: “Yeroisie bwango, orente.”

english: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
ekegusii: Akabogoria amaguta, na amabeere, ne chinyama chi’emori eria aroisetie, agaterekera abageni baria. Ere agatenena ase bare ensemo ase ekiriiri ki’omote, ekero baare koragera.

english: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold, in the tent .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria: “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria: “Neema ime are.”

english: And there came two angels to Sodom at even ; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom : and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground ;
ekegusii: Abamalaika baria babere bakagenda, bagaika Sodomu mogoroba, na Loti nigo areenge oikaransete geita gia Sodomu. Ekero Loti abarooche, akaimoka kobarotota, agatugama inse, akaumama,

english: But the men put forth their hand , and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door .
ekegusii: Korende abanto baria baarenge ime bakarambora amaboko abo, bakang’usa Loti gochia nyomba ime, na erio kegima bagasieka egesieri.

english: And the men said unto Lot , Hast thou here any besides? son in law , and thy sons , and thy daughters , and whatsoever thou hast in the city , bring them out of this place :
ekegusii: Erio abasacha baria babere bakabooria Loti: “Nore nonde omino aa? Nobwate abana bao banyuomete abaiseke bao, gose abamura na abaiseke bao, gose kobwate bande bamino ase omochie oyo, barusie korwa aase aa.

english: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD ; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo twachire gosaria aase aa, ekiagera ekerero kiaye kiamentekire ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene ototoomire tosarie aase aa.”

english: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place ; for the LORD will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .
ekegusii: Erio Loti agasooka, agateebia abamura aba konya bariereire abaiseke baye boko: “Imoka bwango, morue aase aa, ekiagera Omonene ngocha are gosaria omochie oyo,” Korende barabwo bagakaga ng’a negosori akobakorera. Loti ogotoorigwa amo nabaiseke baye, korende mokaye akoomera inchera

english: And when the morning arose , then the angels hastened Lot , saying , Arise , take thy wife , and thy two daughters , which are here ; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city .
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abamalaika baria bakaayereria Loti, bakamoteebia: “Imoka bwango, ira mokao na abaiseke bao babere abare aa amo naye, tobaisa gosirigwa ase egesusuro keria omochie oyo ogochia konyora.”

english: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad , that he said , Escape for thy life ; look not behind thee , neither stay thou in all the plain ; escape to the mountain , lest thou be consumed .
ekegusii: Ekero baabasookirie isiko, oyomo obo akabateebia: “Tama, motoorie obogima bwaino; timorigereria magega, gose timotenena aande onsi ase ense eraire. Motame gochia ase ebitunwa, timobaisa gosira.”

english: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord :
ekegusii: Loti akabakania, akabateebia: “Taibo, Omonene one;

english: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me, and I die :
ekegusii: rora omosomba oo onyorire ogwancherwa ase amaiso ao, kwamentire amaabera ao ase ’nde ase ogotooria obogima bwane; korende inche tinkonyara gotama ng’ikeere ebitunwa; amabe abaise konyora, ang’ite.

english: And he said , Behold now, my lords , turn in , I pray you, into your servant’s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay; but we will abide in the street all night .
ekegusii: akabora: “Abaanene baane, gobera gocha aa, mosoe mw’omosomba oino, monyore amaache mwesibie amagoro aino, moraare goika mambia bokie; erio moche moimoke mambia, mogende.” Barabwo bagakana, bagateeba: “Yaya, nigo tokoba aa inchera obotuko obo bwonsi.”

english: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one : Oh, let me escape thither, ( is it not a little one ?) and my soul shall live .
ekegusii: Rora omochie oyo ore ang’e aiga, omochie omoke, noro ndaike bwango. Tiga ntame gochia ase omochie oria, ore omoke iga, ntoorie obogima bwane.”

english: And he said unto him, See , I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city , for the which thou hast spoken .
ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia: “Rora, nagwancheire ase ring’ana erio boigo. Tingosaria omochie oyio gwateeba.

english: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .
ekegusii: Ayerera, bwetoorie, ekiagera tingokora ing’ana rinde rionsi goika gwasoire omochie oria ime.” Ase ayio, omochie oyio okarokwa Soari. Sodomu na Gomora egosambwa na gosarigwa

english: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .
ekegusii: Erioba konya riaorokire ekero Loti asoete Soari.

english: And he overthrew those cities , and all the plain , and all the inhabitants of the cities , and that which grew upon the ground .
ekegusii: agasamba emechie eyio, amo nense eyio yonsi eraire, na agasiria bonsi abamenyete imeo, na ebinto bionsi biare gokina ase ense eria.

english: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD :
ekegusii: Mambia kobwakia, Aburaamu akagenda aase aria atenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah , and toward all the land of the plain , and beheld , and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace .
ekegusii: Ere akarigereria maate gochia ensemo ya Sodomu na Gomora, na ense yonsi eraire, na agwo akarora erioki rigotiira korwa inse, buna erioki rikorwa ase eriko rinene.

english: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Nyasae asaretie emechie eyio y’ense eraire, akaba okoinyora Aburaamu, akarusia Loti ase ogosarigwa koria, ekero asambete emechie eyio ase Loti amenyete. Omochaki bwe chinderia chi’Abamoabu na Abaamoni

english: And he pressed upon them greatly ; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house ; and he made them a feast , and did bake unleavened bread , and they did eat .
ekegusii: Korende akabasorora mono, na barabwo bakagobera, erio bagasoa nyomba mwaye. Erio akabaroiseria endagera, na emegati etabekiri memera, na barabwo bakaria.

english: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .
ekegusii: Loti agatiira korwa Soari, agacha akamenya ase ebitunwa amo nabaiseke baye babere, ekiagera nigo oboete komenya Soari; akamenya ase rikuruma amo nabaiseke baye babere.

english: And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :
ekegusii: Omoiseke oye omotangi agateebia oyomwabo omoke: “Tata ogotire, gose monto onde tari ase ense oyorache gotonyuoma buna engencho y’ense yonsi ere.

english: Come , let us make our father drink wine , and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father .
ekegusii: Bono, tiga toe tata edivai anywe, atinde, toraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”

english: And they made their father drink wine that night : and the firstborn went in , and lay with her father ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
ekegusii: Bakanyoinsia ise edivai ase obotuko boria; omoiseke oria omotangi agachia, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the firstborn said unto the younger , Behold, I lay yesternight with my father : let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in , and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia omoiseke oria omotangi agateebia oria omoke omwabo: “Rora, obotuko bwa igoro nigo naraire na Tata; tomonyooinsie naende edivai ase obotuko obo, erio naye ochie, oraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”

english: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose , and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
ekegusii: Bakamonyoinsia naende edivai ase obotuko obwo. Omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.

english: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father .
ekegusii: Naboigo abaiseke abwo babere ba Loti bakorete iga, ekagera bakaba barito korwa ase ise.

english: And the firstborn bare a son , and called his name Moab : the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day .
ekegusii: Ase igo omoiseke oria omotangi akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Moabu; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abamoabu goika reero iga.

english: And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben-ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
ekegusii: Na moiseke oria omwabo omoke, nere akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Ben‐Ami; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abaamoni goika reero iga.

english: But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :
ekegusii: Ritang’ani batarachia korara, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria o Sodomu, abamura na abagaaka, bagacha bagaetanana enyomba,

english: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him ,
ekegusii: Loti agasoka isiko ase abanto baria, agasieka egesieri korwa magega yaye,

english: And said , I pray you, brethren , do not so wickedly .
ekegusii: akabateebia: “Baminto, nabasoroire, timokora obosooku buna obo.

english: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man ; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .
ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing’ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y’oborendi bwane.”

english: And they said , Stand back . And they said again , This one fellow came in to sojourn , and he will needs be a judge : now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man , even Lot , and came near to break the door .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoteebia: “Torwereo!” Naende bagateebania: “Omonto oyo nomomenyi are aa seito, na bono nigo arigetie gototeebereria! Bono nigo toragokorere bobe mono kobua buna nanga tware gokorera abanto abwo.” Erio bagatwoma‐twoma Loti mono, bakarigia kobuna egesieri.

english: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth .
ekegusii: Agwo omochakano Nyasae agatonga igoro na ense,

english: And God called the dry land Earth ; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas : and God saw that it was good .
ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria aomo ense, na amaache aria asangererekanete amo akayaroka chinyancha. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.

english: And God said , Let the earth bring forth grass , the herb yielding seed , and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind , whose seed is in itself, upon the earth : and it was so.
ekegusii: Erio agachiika agateeba: “Tiga ense emere ebimeri bigokina, buna ebimeri bikorua na emete ekwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo, kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye ekenyene” ayio akaba boigo.

english: And the earth brought forth grass , and herb yielding seed after his kind , and the tree yielding fruit , whose seed was in itself, after his kind : and God saw that it was good .
ekegusii: Na ense ekamera ebimeri bionsi, na Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

english: And the evening and the morning were the third day .
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatato.

english: And God said , Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night ; and let them be for signs , and for seasons , and for days , and years :
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika “Tiga emebaso ebe ase oboiko bw’aaria igoro, bwatanane omobaso korwa ase obotuko; erio ebe ebimanyererio bikworokia ebiro bi’amatuko, ne chingaki, n’emiaka,

english: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth : and it was so.
ekegusii: ebe emebaso ase oboiko aaria igoro, boyee ense omobaso na oborabu,” ayio onsi akaba boigo.

english: And God made two great lights ; the greater light to rule the day , and the lesser light to rule the night : he made the stars also.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agakora emebaso ebere emenene, Risase rigaambere ekero kia mobaso n’omotienyi ogaambere ekero kia botuko; agakora ne ching’enang’eni boigo.

english: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth ,
ekegusii: Akayebeka ase eanga aaria igoro, eyee ense oborabu,

english: And to rule over the day and over the night , and to divide the light from the darkness : and God saw that it was good .
ekegusii: egaambere omobaso na obotuko, na gwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.

english: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day .
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kane.

english: And the earth was without form , and void ; and darkness was upon the face of the deep . And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters .
ekegusii: Bono ense tiyarenge na kieni kende, gose kende gionsi tikiareengeo, n’omosunte ekerima nigo oyetubete, na Omoika o Nyasae ogatoeerera igoro y’amaache.

english: And God said , Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life , and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven .
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache atware obonge bw’ebitongwa bire moyo, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro ase ense, chigoetanana inse y’eaanga ya igoro.”

english: And God created great whales , and every living creature that moveth , which the waters brought forth abundantly , after their kind , and every winged fowl after his kind : and God saw that it was good .
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatonga ebitongwa ebinene bire ase amaache ime, amo n’ebitongwa binde bionsi bimenyete ase amache ime, boigo agatoonga chinyoni. Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

english: And God blessed them, saying , Be fruitful , and multiply , and fill the waters in the seas , and let fowl multiply in the earth .
ekegusii: Erio akabisesenia bionsi, agateeba ebitoongwa biria bimenyete amaache ime bisaraare biichore ime ase chinyancha, naende agateebia chinyoni chisaraare ase ense.

english: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day .
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano.

english: And God said , Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind , cattle , and creeping thing , and beast of the earth after his kind : and it was so.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga ense etware ebitongwa bire moyo, kera egesaku n’engencho yaye. Ching’iti chigotugwa, n’echikwagura, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, kera egesaku nengencho yaye” ayio akaba boigo.

english: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind , and cattle after their kind , and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind : and God saw that it was good .
ekegusii: Ase igo Nyasae agakora ching’iti chi’orosana, Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.

english: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful , and multiply , and replenish the earth , and subdue it : and have dominion over the fish of the sea , and over the fowl of the air , and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth .
ekegusii: akabasesenia, akabateebia: “Moibore, mosarare, moichore ase ense, na moyegaambere. Ngokobeeka inde ogaambere chinswe, ne chinyoni, n’echingiti chionsi chi’orosana.

english: And God said , Behold , I have given you every herb bearing seed , which is upon the face of all the earth , and every tree , in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed ; to you it shall be for meat .
ekegusii: Nabaeire kera ekemeri gekwama chimbusuro, na kera omote okwama amatunda ebio nabio biraabe endagera yaino.

english: And to every beast of the earth , and to every fowl of the air , and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth , wherein there is life , I have given every green herb for meat : and it was so.
ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chi’orosana ne chinyoni chionsi nachieire ebimeri ebibese bionsi bibe endagera yabo.” Ayio onsi akaba boigo.

english: And God saw every thing that he had made , and, behold, it was very good . And the evening and the morning were the sixth day .
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ebinto ebio bionsi akorete, na birobio nigo biareenge ebiya mono. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano na rimo.

english: And God saw the light , that it was good : and God divided the light from the darkness .
ekegusii: Nyasae akagokigwa na keria aroche. Erio agaatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte,

english: And God called the light Day , and the darkness he called Night . And the evening and the morning were the first day .
ekegusii: akaroka oborabu boria omobaso, na omosunte akayoroka obotuko. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba maambia, rituko rie ritang’ani.

english: And God made the firmament , and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament : and it was so .
ekegusii: Igo Nyasae agakora oboiko boria, bogaatanana amaache ayare inse y’eaanga korwa ase amaache ayare igoro y’oboiko; ayio akaba boigo.

english: And God called the firmament Heaven . And the evening and the morning were the second day .
ekegusii: Akaroka oboiko boria igoro. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kabere.

english: And God said , Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place , and let the dry land appear : and it was so.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache ayare inse y’erioba asangererekane aase aamo, egere ense enyomo erorekane;” ayio akaba boigo.

english: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka korwa agwo mamure, akagenda gochia ensemo y’ense ya Negebu, akaroisia obomenyo bwaye, egati ya Kadeshi na Suri agwo Gerari.

english: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What sawest thou , that thou hast done this thing ?
ekegusii: Naende Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inki kwareengereretie goika ogakora ring’ana eri?”

english: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place ; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Nabo nakorete igo, ekiagera narooche ng’a abamoirogete Nyasae tibari aase aa, na barabwo nigo barang’ite ase engencho ya mokane.

english: And yet indeed she is my sister ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother ; and she became my wife .
ekegusii: Ere amaene nomoiseke ominto, tata noyomo, korende ng’ina nomoao, na inche nkamonyuoma.

english: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house , that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come , say of me, He is my brother .
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae andusetie korwa ase omochie o tata kogenda gochia aaria na aaria ngateebia mokane: Obwo nabwo obwanchani orankorere: kera aase toragende oteebe igoro yane ng’a inche momura omino.”

english: And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Aburaamu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.

english: And Abimelech said , Behold, my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee.
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Rora, ense yane nigo ere ase obosio bwao; menya aande onsi ase oranche komenya.”

english: And unto Sarah he said , Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver : behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes , unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved .
ekegusii: Ere agateebia Sara: “Rora naeire momura omino chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, chibe entorobi yao ase amaiso ’abaanto bonsi abare amo naye, erio omanyekane ng’a nomonto omooronge ore.”

english: So Abraham prayed unto God : and God healed Abimelech , and his wife , and his maidservants ; and they bare children .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agasaba Nyasae; na Nyasae akagwenia Abimeleki amo na mokaye, na abasomba baye abakungu, na barabwo bakaibora abana.

english: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham’s wife .
ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya okorire abakungu b’enka y’Abimeleki koba abagomba, erio tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Aburaamu.

english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken ; for she is a man’s wife .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaorokera Abimeleki botuko ase okorota, akamoteebia: “Aye goika okwe, ekiagera omokungu oyo kwarentire nomokuungu bw’omonto onde.”

english: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said , Lord , wilt thou slay also a righteous nation ?
ekegusii: Abimeleki konya ataraba nere, akabora: “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo oraite nonya nabanyaboronge?

english: Said he not unto me, She is my sister ? and she , even she herself said , He is my brother : in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyio tantebeetie ere omonyene ng’a oyo mosubati omwabo? Na omokungu nere aganteebia ng’a oyo momura omwabo? Ase enkoro etari na komocha konde, na ase amaboko amarabu nakorire ayio.”

english: And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akamoteebia ase okoroota: “Inche namanyire ng’a ase enkoro etari na komocha gwakorire aya, na inche nkagotanga tigwankorera ebibe. Ase ayio, tinakoa ribaga omokune.

english: Now therefore restore the man his wife ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou, and all that are thine.
ekegusii: Bono moiranerie omonto oria mokaye, ekiagera ere n’omobani, nagosabere onyare koba moyo. Korende otamoiranereti, manya amaene, goika okwe, aye amo na abanto bao bonsi ore nabarabwo.”

english: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
ekegusii: Abimeleki akaimoka mambia chuni akarangeria abasomba baye bonsi, akabateebia amang’ana aya onsi, na abanto abwo bakaondoka mono.

english: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Aburaamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Inki nakomocheire goika kwarentire igoro yane na igoro y’oborwoti bwane ebibe ebinene buna ebi? Gwankoreire amang’ana atagwenereti gokorwa.”

english: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said , and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken .
ekegusii: Omonene akamotaarera Sara, akamokorera buna konya amoriereire eira.

english: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son .
ekegusii: Ring’ana erio tiriamogwenera Aburaamu nonya ng’ake, ase engencho y’omwana oye.

english: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .
ekegusii: Naboigo, omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba nimokore abe egesaku ekenene, ekiagera nere oyio nomwana oo.”

english: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akaimokia omogati na ebirandi biroiseirie amasankwa, bire n’amaache, akabiaa Hagari, akamobibekera mareko. Akamorentera na omwana, akamoteebia agende amo nere. Akagenda, akana‐koong’anya ase erooro ya Beeri‐Seba.

english: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .
ekegusii: Ekero amaache aria areenge ebirandi ime aerire, akaareria omwana inse y’egetutu.

english: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .
ekegusii: Erio akagenda, agaikaransa are ake, ase oboare bw’okoruta ensara, ekiagera nigo atebeete: “Tinkonyara korigereria omwana one ekero ogokwa.” Ekero aikaransete omorigereretie, agaaka eriogi riaye, akareera.

english: And God heard the voice of the lad ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar ? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .
ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa okoreera kw’omwana, na omomalaika o Nyasae akarangeria Hagari korwa igoro, akamoteebia: “Hagari, inki okoreera? Tibwoboa, ekiagera Nyasae oigure okoreera kw’omwana agwo ase araire.

english: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand ; for I will make him a great nation .
ekegusii: Tenena, oimokie omwana, omobwate koboko kwao; naki nimokore abe egesaku ekenene.”

english: And God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water ; and she went , and filled the bottle with water , and gave the lad drink .
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaramokia Hagari amaiso, na ere akarora ensoko y’amaache, akagenda, akabuucha, agaichoria ekerandi amaache, akaa omwana oria erio akanywa.

english: And God was with the lad ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .
ekegusii: Nyasae akaba amo nomwana oria. Ere akamenya ase erooro, akaba omomanyi bw’okorasa nemegwe.

english: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Akamenya ase erooro ya Parani, na ng’ina akamonyuomeria omokungu korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Aburaamu na Abimeleki bagokora okobwatana

english: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son , nor with my son’s son : but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono karie eira na gotiana ase Nyasae ng’a togonkorera obong’ainereria inche, na abana baane, na abachokoro baane, korende koreng’ana buna inche nagokorerete aye, obwanchani obo naye onkorere nainche boigo, amo nense eye aye omenyete ime.”

english: And Abraham said , I will swear .
ekegusii: Aburaamu agateeba: “Ee, ninkoriere eira.”

english: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamwemurunganeria Abimeleki ase engencho y’ensoko eria abasomba b’Abimeleki bamourete.

english: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it , but to day .
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Inche timanyeti ning’o okorete ring’ana erio, gose tikwana gonteebia; nonya nokoigwa, tinana koyaigwa otatiga reero rioka.”

english: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech ; and both of them made a covenant .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimokia etugo yaye, ching’ondi ne chiombe, akaa Abimeleki, na barabwo babere bagakora okobwatana gati yabo.

english: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
ekegusii: Aburaamu agaatanana chimanwa chisigiti isano na ibere, agachibeeka ensemo.

english: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
ekegusii: Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inee, chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere gwatanana, engencho yaye inki?”

english: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac .
ekegusii: Omwana oyio Sara aiborete, Aburaamu ise akamoroka Isaka.

english: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere nigo nagochieire korwa ase okoboko kwane, erinde chibe kirori ase ’nde, ng’a ensoko eye ninche nayeremete.”

english: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba ; because there they sware both of them .
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaaroka ase agwo Beeri‐Seba + 21:31 Beeri‐Seba: engencho yaye: chinsoko isano na ibere, gose: ensoko y’emuma , ekiagera barabwo babere mbariereranete emuma aroro.

english: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
ekegusii: Ekero bakorire okobwatana aria Beeri‐Seba, Abimeleki na Pikoli, oria omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti.

english: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba , and called there on the name of the LORD , the everlasting God .
ekegusii: Aburaamu agasimeka omote onga buna ekerachuoki aria Beeri‐Seba, na agwo akarangeria erieta ria Nyasae Omonene o kare na kare ase okomosasiima.

english: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamenya buna omomenyi ase ense y’Abafilisti amatuko amange.

english: And Abraham was an hundred years old , when his son Isaac was born unto him.
ekegusii: Aburaamu nigo areenge nemiaka rigana erimo ekero Isaka, omwana oye, aiboretwe.

english: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me.
ekegusii: Sara akabora: “Nyasae onkoreire amaseko, na onde bwensi orayaigwe nansegisie.”

english: And she said , Who would have said unto Abraham , that Sarah should have given children suck ? for I have born him a son in his old age .
ekegusii: Naende agateeba: “Ning’o nanga ore komoteebia Aburaamu ng’a Sara nagonkie abana? Na bono namoiboreire omwana ase obogotu bwaye.”

english: And the child grew , and was weaned : and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned .
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakina, agatiga okogonka. Ase rituko riria Isaka atigete kogonka, Aburaamu agakora omoyega omonene. Ogoserigwa gwa Isumaeli na Hagari

english: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
ekegusii: Korende Sara akarora omwana oria o Hagari Omomisiri, oyio aiborerete Aburaamu, ogochecheria Isaka, omwana oye.

english: And Abraham stretched forth his hand , and took the knife to slay his son .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabogoria omoyio anyenye omwana oye.

english: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven , and said , Abraham , Abraham : and he said , Here am I.
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika Omonene akamorangeria korwa igoro, akabora: “Aburaamu, Aburaamu!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

english: And he said , Lay not thine hand upon the lad , neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God , seeing thou hast not withheld thy son , thine only son from me.
ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamoteebia: “Torambora okoboko kwao igoro ase omwana oo, gose tomokorera ing’ana rinde rionsi riibe. Bono namanyire ng’a nomoirogete Nyasae, naende narorire ng’a tondineti omwana oo omomoima.”

english: And Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns : and Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokerereria amaiso aye igoro, akaonchora ebigoti gochia aa anaaria, akarora eng’ondi emingichi ebwatire ching’unchara ase orosana nemerande. Aburaamu akagenda, akarusia eng’ondi eyio, akayerua, ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase ribaga ri’omwana oye.

english: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen .
ekegusii: Aburaamu Akaaroka aase aria “Omonene nayaroke” (Yahwe‐Yire); + 22:14 Yahwe‐Yire: engencho yaye: Omonene okororwa gose okoa (1 Amg 1:32-33) (1 Amg 1:28-31) buna abanto bagokwana goika reero iga: “Ase egetunwa ki’ Omonene, nao ekonyorekana.”

english: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarangeria Aburaamu korwa igoro eria kabere, akamoteebia:

english: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akairana gochia ase abamura baria baarenge komo; bonsi bakaimoka, bakagenda amo gochia Beeri‐Seba; na Aburaamu akaba okomenya agwo Beeri‐Seba. Ororeeria rwa Nahori

english: And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold, Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor ;
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio kaerire Aburaamu agateebigwa ng’a, “Milka oiboreire momura omino Nahori abana.

english: Huz his firstborn , and Buz his brother , and Kemuel the father of Aram ,
ekegusii: Abana abwo nabwo aba: Usi, omwana oye omotangi, na Busi omwabo, na Kemueli, ise Aramu,

english: And Chesed , and Hazo , and Pildash , and Jidlaph , and Bethuel .
ekegusii: na Kesedi, na Haso, na Pilidasi, na Yidilafu, na Betueli.”

english: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham’s brother .
ekegusii: Betueli nere omoiborete omoiseke ore korokwa Rebeka. Abwo batano na batato nabwo Milka aiborerete Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.

english: And his concubine , whose name was Reumah , she bare also Tebah , and Gaham , and Thahash , and Maachah .
ekegusii: Naende omokungu oye o sere‐sere, ore korokwa Reuma, akamoiborera Teba, na Gahamu, na Tahasi, na Maaka.

english: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and saddled his ass , and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son , and clave the wood for the burnt offering , and rose up , and went unto the place of which God had told him.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae.

english: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Aburaamu akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora aase aria korwa aare.

english: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agateebia abamura baria abaarenge komo: “Ikaransa inwe aiga amo netigere eye! Inche amo nomwana oyo one nkogenda tore gochia aria, tosasime, erio toirane ase more naende.”

english: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering , and laid it upon Isaac his son ; and he took the fire in his hand , and a knife ; and they went both of them together .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokia chinko echi areenge gochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, agatweka Isaka omwana oye, na ere omonyene akaimokia omorero na omoyio. Bakagenda amo bonsi babere.

english: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I, my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?
ekegusii: Isaka agakwana na Aburaamu ise, agateeba: “Tata!” Ise agoitaba ogoteeba: “Nao inde aa, omwana one.” Isaka akamobooria: “Rora, omorero ne chinko ntobwate, korende ng’ai emaanwa y’eng’ondi ere togochia gokorera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa?”

english: And Abraham said , My son , God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering : so they went both of them together .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Omwana one, Nyasae nenyorere emaanwa y’eng’ondi ase ekeng’wanso eke.” Erio bakagenderera amo bonsi babere.

english: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old : these were the years of the life of Sarah .
ekegusii: Sara nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere (127); eye nero emiaka y’obogima bwa Sara.

english: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth : and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth , even of all that went in at the gate of his city , saying ,
ekegusii: Bono Efuroni nigo areenge oikaransete agwo ase egati y’Abahiti. Ere Efuroni, Omohiti, akairaneria Aburaamu ekero Abahiti bonsi, abaare goetera egeita ki’omochie oye, bamotegererete,

english: Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead .
ekegusii: agateeba: “Yaya, omonene one, ntegerera. Oboremo boria nakoeire amo ne rikuruma riria rire imeo, ase amaiso ’abaanto baminto nakobieire; otindeke mokao aroro.”

english: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse ase amasio ’abaanto b’ense eria.

english: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land , saying , But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee , hear me: I will give thee money for the field ; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
ekegusii: Agateebia Efuroni ekero abanto b’ense eria bamotegererete: “Koranche, ntegerera! Inche nindue rigori ri’oboremo; naye obogorie chifeta korwa ase ’nde, na inche nintindeke mokane aroro.”

english: And Ephron answered Abraham , saying unto him,
ekegusii: Efuroni akairaneria Aburaamu,

english: My lord , hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver ; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead .
ekegusii: akamoteebia: “Omonene one, ntegerera! Oboremo obwo bw’erigori rie chisekeli chi’efeta amagana ane, ngento ki toengereranie inche naye? Tindeka mokao agwo.”

english: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron ; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver , which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth , four hundred shekels of silver , current money with the merchant .
ekegusii: Aburaamu bagaancherana na Efuroni; na Aburaamu akarengera Efuroni chifeta chiria ateebete Abahiti kobaigwete, chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana ane, koreng’ana nekerengo giancheranire nabaonchoreria.

english: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
ekegusii: Oboremo bw’Efuroni obwo bware agwo Makipela moocha ya Mamure, oboremo amo ne rikuruma riria riare imeo na emete yonsi yareengeo, ensemo eria yonsi Aburaamu akayeegwa.

english: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth , before all that went in at the gate of his city .
ekegusii: Igo ayeetwe ase amasio ’Abahiti, abwo bonsi baare gosoera egeita kiaye.

english: And after this , Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre : the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Aburaamu agatindeka Sara mokaye ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani.

english: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba ; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan : and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her.
ekegusii: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani. Aburaamu akagenda komoreera Sara na okweumia okonene, na akaroberia omoyega bw’ogotindekwa kwaye.

english: And the field , and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .
ekegusii: Nabo oboremo boria, ne rikuruma riria riare imeo, Aburaamu akabinyora korwa ase Abahiti bibe aase kwaye agwo ase agotindeka abakuure.

english: And Abraham stood up from before his dead , and spake unto the sons of Heth , saying ,
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka korwa ase egetondo kiaye, agateebia Abahiti,

english: And the children of Heth answered Abraham , saying unto him,
ekegusii: Abahiti bakairaneria Aburaamu, bakamoteebia,

english: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .
ekegusii: “Omonene, totegerere! Aye nigo ore omonto omonene o Nyasae ase egati yaito. Tindeka omokungu oo ase embeera ende yonsi engiya orachoore. Onde tari ase egati yaito orakorine embeera yaye gose agotange totindeka omokungu oo.”

english: And Abraham stood up , and bowed himself to the people of the land , even to the children of Heth .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka, agatugama inse ase amasio ’Abahiti, abanto b’ense eria.

english: And he communed with them, saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight ; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
ekegusii: Ere agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Komoranche mong’e ribaga ntindeke omokungu one, imorusie ase obosio bwane, monyigwe na monsabere ase Efuroni, omwana o Sohari,

english: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath, which is in the end of his field ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .
ekegusii: ang’e rikuruma riaye, erio rire agwo Makipela, ase ensinyo y’oboremo bwaye. Ase rigori riikeranu tiga ang’ere ase amasio aino, togoranereo, ribe aase aane ndabe ngotindeka abakuure.”

english: And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu konya obeire omogotu, akoorire emiaka emenge; n’Omonene konya omosesenirie ase amang’ana onsi.

english: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia chingamia ikomi chi’omonene oye, akaimokia na ebiegwa ebinge ebiya; akaimoka, akagenda gochia Mesopotamia, agaika omochie oria Nahori amenyete.

english: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .
ekegusii: Agwo agatimokeria chingamia isiko y’omochie ang’e nensoko y’amaache engaki ya mogoroba, ekero abakungu bagocha kobuucha amaache.

english: And he said , O LORD God of my master Abraham , I pray thee, send me good speed this day , and shew kindness unto my master Abraham .
ekegusii: Ere agasaba, agateeba: “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, nagosabire, onsesenie ase amang’ana aane a reero, okorere omonene one Aburaamu obwanchani.

english: Behold, I stand here by the well of water ; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water :
ekegusii: Rora, ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amaache, na abaiseke b’omochie oyo ngocha bare kobuucha amaache.

english: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say , Let down thy pitcher , I pray thee, that I may drink ; and she shall say , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac ; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master .
ekegusii: Tiga ebe iga; Kondaborie oyomo obo: Koranche obeke enyongo yao inse, inche inywe amaache, na ere karang’iranerie: Ee, kanywe aye, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere gwachoreire omosomba oo Isaka, na inche erio nimanye ng’a aye Omonene one gwankoreire amaya ase obwanchani.”

english: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking , that, behold, Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham’s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .
ekegusii: Ritang’ani atarakoora ogosaba kwaye, akarora Rebeka ogocha obogoretie enyongo yaye mareko. Ere nomoiseke o Betueli, na Betueli nomwana o Milka, moka Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.

english: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .
ekegusii: Na omoiseke oria nigo areenge omonyakieni, naende nomwekuungi, otaraba na mosacha onde. Agatirimboka gochia ase ensoko, agaichoria enyongo yaye amaache, agatiira.

english: And the servant ran to meet her , and said , Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher .
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akaminyoka bwango gochia komoorotota, akamosaba: “Koranche, ong’e amaache inywe.”

english: And she said , Drink , my lord : and she hasted , and let down her pitcher upon her hand , and gave him drink .
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria akamoteebia: “Kanywe, omonene one!” Agatoora enyongo yaye bwango, akayebeeka koboko kwaye, akamoa, na ere akanywa.

english: And when she had done giving him drink , she said , I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking .
ekegusii: Gakoorire komoa amaache, akabora: “Ne chingamia chiao boigo ninchibuuchere, na chirochio chinywe.”

english: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had, Put , I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh :
ekegusii: Aburaamu akarangeria omosomba oye oyo konya omokoreire ase emiaka emenge mono, na omorenderete enibo yaye yonsi, akamoteebia: “Beka okoboko kwao inse y’ebinama biane,

english: And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .
ekegusii: Akaayerera, akaumora amaache aria areenge ase enyongo ase orotuba ime, akaminyoka bwango ase ensoko naende, agachibuuchera chingamia chiaye chionsi.

english: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akamobeta amaiso, akaba okirete kiri, erinde amanye gose Omonene osesesenirie orogendo rwaye, gose taibo.

english: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold ;
ekegusii: Ekero chingamia chiakoorire konywa amaache, omonto oria akamoruseria ekegera gi’etaabu, kiare noborito bwe chigiramu isano na isato, na ebitange bibere bie chitaabu ase amaboko aye, ebiare noborito bwe chigiramu rigana erimo, na emerongo etano.

english: And said , Whose daughter art thou ? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in ?
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore? Naende onteebie gose ribaga ndire mwa iso toranyare koraara botuko.”

english: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah , which she bare unto Nahor .
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli, oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.”

english: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough , and room to lodge in .
ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia: “Seito obonyansi mboreo, na aase tokorisia aisaine, na enyomba y’abageni bakorara nereo.”

english: And the man bowed down his head , and worshipped the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatugama inse, agasasiima Omonene,

english: And he said , Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren .
ekegusii: agateeba: “Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, atogigwe! Ere tatigeti koorokia omonene one obuya na obwegenwa. Omonene ondaaire enchera, naikire enka y’abamwabo omonene one.”

english: And the damsel ran , and told them of her mother’s house these things .
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria akaminyoka, agaika inka sobo, agateebia abanto ba nyomba mwa ng’ina amang’ana ayio.

english: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .
ekegusii: -30 Rebeka nabwate momura omwabo ore korokwa Labani. Ekero Labani arooche ekegera na ebitange ase amaboko ’omoiseke omwabo, na kaigure amang’ana omonto oria ateebetie Rebeka, agasoka, akaminyoka gochia ase ensoko ase omonto oria areenge, akamorora oteneine ase chingamia chiaye,

english: And I will make thee swear by the LORD , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
ekegusii: na inche ninkoboorie otiane ase Omonene Nyasae o igoro na ense, ng’a tokorigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase egati yabo.

english: And he said , Come in , thou blessed of the LORD ; wherefore standest thou without ? for I have prepared the house , and room for the camels .
ekegusii: akamoteebia: “Inchuo, aye osesenirie n’Omonene! Naki oteneine isiko aa? Inche nakoroiseirie enyomba ase ogochia koraara, na aase e chingamia chiao.”

english: And the man came into the house : and he ungirded his camels , and gave straw and provender for the camels , and water to wash his feet , and the men’s feet that were with him.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agasoa nyomba, na Labani agasibora chingamia chigurube chiabo, agachia obonyansi, na chirochio chikaria. Naende akarentera omonto oria amaache, akarentera na abwo baarenge komo, bagesibia amagoro.

english: And there was set meat before him to eat : but he said , I will not eat , until I have told mine errand . And he said , Speak on .
ekegusii: Erio akaariganigwa ase endagera, korende agateeba: “Tinkoria endagera, goika ndateeba amang’ana ane.” Erio Labani akairaneria: “Gaki, yakwane!”

english: And he said , I am Abraham’s servant .
ekegusii: Erio agateeba: “Inche nomosomba o Aburaamu.

english: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
ekegusii: Omonene osesenirie omonene one mono, na ere obeire omotenenku. Omoeire amaicho e ching’ondi, na aye chiombe, chifeta ne chitaabu, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, chingamia ne chitigere.”

english: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old : and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
ekegusii: Na Sara, moka omonene one, akamoiborera omwana omomura ekero amenyire omogotu; na omonene one oeire omwana oyio bionsi ebi abwate.

english: And my master made me swear , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , in whose land I dwell :
ekegusii: Omonene one akamboria ntiane, aganteabia: “Torigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase ense yabo;

english: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .
ekegusii: Korende ogende ase omochie o tata, ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.

english: And I said unto my master , Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
ekegusii: Na inche ngateebia omonene one: Aande omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche.

english: But thou shalt go unto my country , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son Isaac .
ekegusii: Korende ogende ase ense yane na ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one Isaka omokungu korwa aroro abe mokaye.”

english: And he said unto me, The LORD , before whom I walk , will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way ; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred , and of my father’s house :
ekegusii: Korende aganteebia: Omonene oyo ngendererete ase obosio bwaye, natome omomalaika oye amo naye, asesenie orogendo rwao. Naye orentere omwana one omokungu korwa ase eamate yane, korwa ase omochie o tata;

english: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath , when thou comest to my kindred ; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath .
ekegusii: erio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eyio nakoboririe otiane. Ekero oraike ase eamate yane, onye tibagokoa omoiseke oyio, aye rirorio nobe gwasiboirwe korwa ase ogotiana kwao.”

english: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O LORD God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :
ekegusii: “Inche igo nacha reero ase ensoko, nasaba iga: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, koranche onsesenie bono ase orogendo rwane nkogenda.

english: Behold, I stand by the well of water ; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her, Give me , I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink ;
ekegusii: Rora ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amaache. Tiga ebe iga: Omoiseke onde omo orache kobuucha amaache, na inche imosabe oyio: Koranche ong’e amaache make korwa ase enyongo yao inywe.

english: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son .
ekegusii: Onye ere okong’iraneria: Ee, kanywe, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere omokungu Omonene achoreire omwana bw’omonene one.”

english: And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink , I pray thee.
ekegusii: “Ritang’ani ntarakoora ogosaba ase omoyo one, narora Rebeka ogocha obegete enyongo yaye mareko, ogotirimboka gochia ase ensoko kobuucha amaache.” Na inche namosaba: “Koranche, ong’e amaache inywe.”

english: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank , and she made the camels drink also.
ekegusii: Ere orusia enyongo yaye bwango korwa ase amareko aye, oyebeeka inse, onteebia: Kanywe, ne chingamia chiao ninchibuchere boigo. Erio ong’a, nanywa, oa ne chingamia, nachirochio chianywa.

english: And I asked her, and said , Whose daughter art thou? And she said , The daughter of Bethuel , Nahor’s son , whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face , and the bracelets upon her hands .
ekegusii: Erio namobooria: “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore?” Ere ong’iraneria: “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.” Agwo namobekera ekegera chimioro chiaye, na ebitange ase amaboko aye.

english: And I bowed down my head , and worshipped the LORD , and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham , which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son .
ekegusii: Erio natugama inse nasasiima Omonene. Naende namotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, oyontang’anete ase enchera endonge, erinde imorentere omwana bw’omonene one omokungu korwa ase eamate yaye.

english: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master , tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand , or to the left .
ekegusii: Bono rende, onye morigetie gokorera Omonene one amaya, na ayare boronge, monteebie; onye taibo, monteebie, ngende ensemo ende eng’ao korigia.

english: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Aande, omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche goika ase ense eye; Inee, nigo ndaire omwana oo goika ase ense eria kwarwete?”

english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the LORD : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .
ekegusii: Erio Labani na Betueli bakamoiraneria, bakamoteebia: “Amang’ana aya nigo arure ase Omonene; intwe titokonyara gokwana ande, amabe gose amaya.

english: Behold, Rebekah is before thee , take her , and go , and let her be thy master’s son’s wife , as the LORD hath spoken .
ekegusii: Rora, Rebeka oyio ore ase obosio bwao, moire, mogende komo, achie koba omokungu bw’omwana bw’omonene oo, buna Omonene konya ateebire.”

english: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words , he worshipped the LORD , bowing himself to the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero omosomba o Aburaamu aigwete amang’ana abo, agatugama inse ase obosio bw’Omonene.
