english: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia ebinto bi’ogwechabera bie chitaabu, na ebie chifeta, amo ne chianga, akaa Rebeka. Naende akaa momura omwabo amo na ng’ina ebiegwa bi’erigori rinene.

english: And they did eat and drink , he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night ; and they rose up in the morning , and he said , Send me away unto my master .
ekegusii: Ere na abanto baria baarenge komo bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakaraara aroro. Mambia kobwachia gokia akabateebia: “Ing’a ribaga ng’irane ase omonene one.”

english: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten ; after that she shall go .
ekegusii: Momura omwabo Rebeka na ng’ina bakamoteebia: “Tiga omoiseke oyo arabeere aiga koreng’ana amatuko ikomi; magega y’ayio mogende komo.”

english: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way ; send me away that I may go to my master .
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia: “Timobaisa goteebania, ekiagera Omonene onsesenirie ase orogendo rwane; ing’a ribaga ngende ase omonene one.”

english: And they said , We will call the damsel , and enquire at her mouth .
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Tiga torangerie omoiseke, tomoboorie, toigwe buna agoteeba.”

english: And they called Rebekah , and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man ? And she said , I will go .
ekegusii: Bakarangeria Rebeka, bakamobooria: “Inee! Inabwanche ogende nomonto oyo?” Akairaneria: “Ee, nanchire, ngende nere.”

english: And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham’s servant , and his men .
ekegusii: Erio bakaa Rebeka ribaga amo nomoreri oye bagende nomosomba o Aburaamu na abanto baye.

english: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Bwerende, tobaisa koira omwana one aroro.

english: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her, Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
ekegusii: Bagasesenia Rebeka, bakamoteebia, “Oyominto, obe ng’ina abanto chilifu ne chilifu; ororeeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa bao, royegambere!”

english: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akaimoka amo nabaiseke baye abasomba, bakariina chingamia, bagatunyana omonto oria. Naboigo omosomba oria akaira Rebeka, akagenda nere sobo.

english: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi ; for he dwelt in the south country .
ekegusii: Bono Isaka konya orure ase ensoko ya Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi, ekiagera nigo amenyete ase ense ya Negebu.

english: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and, behold, the camels were coming .
ekegusii: Isaka nigo achiete mogondo ekero kia mogoroba, akaba ore nebirengererio. Agwo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora chingamia chigocha.

english: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .
ekegusii: Rebeka nere akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora Isaka; erio agaika bwango korwa ase engamia igoro,

english: For she had said unto the servant , What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us ? And the servant had said , It is my master : therefore she took a vail , and covered herself .
ekegusii: akabooria omosomba oria: “Monto ki oria ogotaara ase omogondo, ogocha koumerana naintwe?” Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Oria nere omonene one.” Erio omoiseke oria akabwata egietubo kiaye, agetuba.

english: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done .
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agateebia Isaka amang’ana onsi, buna akorete.

english: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife ; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death .
ekegusii: Isaka agasoyia Rebeka ase eema ya ng’ina ime, akaba omonywomire, naende akaba omwanchete. Ase ogi, Isaka akaremigwa korwa ase omoichano bw’ogokwa kwa ng’ina.

english: The LORD God of heaven , which took me from my father’s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro na ense, oyondusetie o tata korwa ase ense eria naiboreretwe, ere nigo akwanete nainche na gotiana, ogoteeba: Ning’ee ororeeria rwao ense eye, ere natome omomalaika oye agotang’ane; aye norentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.

english: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee , then thou shalt be clear from this my oath : only bring not my son thither again .
ekegusii: Na omokungu oria atancheti moche komo, rirorio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eye okoria ase ’nde, korende tobaisa koira omwana one gochia aroro.”

english: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria ababeeka okoboko kwaye inse y’ekebono kia Aburaamu, omonene oye, akerama ase ring’ana erio.

english: Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akanyuoma omokungu onde, ore korokwa Ketura.

english: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi .
ekegusii: Magega y’ogokwa kwa Aburaamu, Nyasae agasesenia Isaka, omwana oye. Na Isaka akamenya ang’e nensoko yaare korokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi. Ororeeria rwa Isumaeli

english: Now these are the generations of Ishmael , Abraham’s son , whom Hagar the Egyptian , Sarah’s handmaid , bare unto Abraham :
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rwa Isumaeli, omwana o Aburaamu, oyo Hagari, omosomba o Sara, amoiborerete.

english: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael , by their names , according to their generations : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebajoth ; and Kedar , and Adbeel , and Mibsam ,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana ba Isumaeli, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo: Nebayoti, nere omwana oye omotangi, na Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu,

english: And Mishma , and Dumah , and Massa ,
ekegusii: na Misima, na Duma, na Masa,

english: Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :
ekegusii: na Hadadi, na Tema, na Yeturi, na Nafisi, na Kedema.

english: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles ; twelve princes according to their nations .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Isumaeli, na aya naro amarieta abo ase emechie yabo na ebitwori biabo, na barabwo nigo baarenge abagaambi ikomi na babere, ase ebisaku biabo.

english: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died ; and was gathered unto his people .
ekegusii: Isumaeli nigo aigetie emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137), erio erio agakwa; agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.

english: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .
ekegusii: Abana ba Isumaeli nigo baamenyete bagachaakera Havila, bagaika Suri moocha ya Misiri, ase enchera ekogenda Asuri; bakamenya babebekaine n’abamwabo bonsi. Okoiborwa gwa Esau na Yakobo

english: And these are the generations of Isaac , Abraham’s son : Abraham begat Isaac :
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rwa Isaka, mosinto o Aburaamu. Aburaamu nere oiborete Isaka.

english: And she bare him Zimran , and Jokshan , and Medan , and Midian , and Ishbak , and Shuah .
ekegusii: Nere akamoiborera Simurani, na Yokisani, na Medani, na Midiani, na Isibaki, na Sua.

english: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife , the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram , the sister to Laban the Syrian .
ekegusii: Isaka nigo areenge nemiaka emerongo ene ekero anyuomete Rebeka, omoiseke o Betueli, Omoaramu o Padan‐Aramu, omoiseke omwabo Labani, Omoaramu.

english: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife , because she was barren : and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived .
ekegusii: Isaka agasabera mokaye ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo areenge omogomba. Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na Rebeka mokaye akaba morito.

english: And the children struggled together within her ; and she said , If it be so, why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abana bakaba bakomigana enda yaye ime. Ere akabora: “Onye nabo iga, okoba moyo kwane ninki korangwenere?” Akagenda koboori’Omonene.

english: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold, there were twins in her womb .
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye ay’okoibora achia goikerana, bakanyora ne chibarongo chiare enda yaye ime.

english: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment ; and they called his name Esau .
ekegusii: Oyo bw’eritang’ani agasooka, ere nigo areenge omobariri, omobere bwonsi nigo orenge namarionya; bakamoroka Esau. + 25:25 Esau: engencho yaye: ore namarionya. Erieta riaye rinde Edomu. Engencho yaye: omobariri (ekebungu 30)

english: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
ekegusii: Magega yaye oyomwabo agasooka, okoboko kwaye kobwatete egetingiro gia Esau na ere bakamoroka Yakobo. + 25:26 Yakobo: engencho yaye: okobwata egetingiro, gose: omong’ainereria Isaka nigo areenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo (60), ekero mokaye abaiborete. Esau okoonia omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi

english: And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .
ekegusii: Ekero abana abwo bakinire, Esau akaba omotwari bwe ching’iti, korende Yakobo nigo areenge omonto omotoereru, ore kobeera ase chiema.

english: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
ekegusii: Isaka nigo amwanchete Esau, ekiagera areenge komorentera chinyama chi’obotwari bwaye; korende Rebeka nigo amwanchete Yakobo.

english: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yakobo naiyegete omosori gete. Esau agacha korwa orosana, konya orosire mono, ogoyire ase engencho y’enchara.

english: And Jokshan begat Sheba , and Dedan . And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim , and Letushim , and Leummim .
ekegusii: Yokisani akaibora Seba na Dedani. Na basinto ba Dedani nabwo aba: Ashurimu, na Letusi, na Leumi.

english: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .
ekegusii: Na Esau agasaba Yakobo: “Koranche, ong’e omosori oyio omobariri inywe, ekiagera n akuure enchara.” Ase ayio bakamoroka Edomu (engencho yaye, omobariri).

english: And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Ritang’ani ng’oonerie omwando oo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.”

english: And Esau said , Behold, I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
ekegusii: Esau agateeba: “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokwa, omwando oyo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi inki orankonye?”

english: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles ; and he did eat and drink , and rose up , and went his way : thus Esau despised his birthright .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaa Esau omogati na omosori bwe ching’ende, na ere akaria na konywa; erio akaimoka akagenda. Naboigo Esau achayete omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.

english: And the sons of Midian ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abidah , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .
ekegusii: Basinto ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa, na Eferi, na Hanoki, na Abida, na Elidaa. Abwo bonsi nabwo baarenge abana ba Ketura.

english: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaa Isaka ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.

english: But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .
ekegusii: Korende abana b’abakuungu baria ba sere‐sere Aburaamu akabaa ebiegwa. Ekero are moyo, konya atarakwa, akabateebia barue ase omwana oye Isaka, bagende gochia moocha, ase ense ya Moocha. Ogokwa kwa Aburaamu

english: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived , an hundred threescore and fifteen years .
ekegusii: Aburaamu nigo amenyete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (175), ase obogima bwaye.

english: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years; and was gathered to his people .
ekegusii: Nigo asogetie omoyo ase obogotu n’obuya, ore omogaka, oisanekire nemiaka emenge; agasangerekana amo nabaanto baye.

english: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre ;
ekegusii: Isaka na Isumaeli bakamotindeka ase rikuruma agwo Makipela ase oboremo bwa Efuroni, omwana o Sohari, Omohiti, moocha ya Mamure,

english: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .
ekegusii: Bono enchara yachete ase ense eria, nenchara y’ogokumia, tari eria yachete ritang’ani ase engaki ya Aburaamu. Erio Isaka agachiera Abimeleki, omorwoti bw’Abafilisti, aria Gerari.

english: And Abimelech said , What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife , and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Aande monto onde oito areenge gochia araare na mokao, na aye anga nigo gwatobeka ase okomocha.”

english: And Abimelech charged all his people , saying , He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abimeleki agatianera abanto bonsi, akabateebia: “Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna omonto oyo ore aa, gose mokaye, goika aitwe.”

english: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the LORD blessed him.
ekegusii: Isaka agasimeka endagera ase ense eria, akagesa ase omwaka oyio ara rigana, n’Omonene akamosesenia.

english: And the man waxed great , and went forward , and grew until he became very great :
ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaba ne chinguru, akagenderera komenteka gokina, goika akaba nokobua okonene.

english: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him.
ekegusii: Nigo abeete nenibo y’amaicho e ching’ondi ne chiombe, na abasomba abange. Ase igo, Abafirisiti bakamororera ribero.

english: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth .
ekegusii: (Ne chinsoko chiria chionsi abasomba ba Aburaamu ise Isaka baremete, Abafirisiti konya bachitichire namaroba.)

english: And Abimelech said unto Isaac , Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki agateebia Isaka: “Karue ase tore, ekiagera aye kwamenyire ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua.”

english: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar , and dwelt there .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Isaka akang’anya korwa aroro, agatoora ase ense eraire ya Gerari, akamenya aroro.

english: And Isaac digged again the wells of water , which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father ; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham : and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
ekegusii: Isaka akarubora chinsoko chiria naende, echio chiaremetwe ase engaki ya Aburaamu ise, ekiagera Abafirisiti konya bachitichire magega Aburaamu g akuure. Isaka agachiroka buna ise achirogete ritang’ani.

english: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .
ekegusii: Abasomba ba Isaka bakarema agwo ase ense eraire, bakanyora entuboka y’amaache.

english: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said , Go not down into Egypt ; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
ekegusii: Na Omonene akaorokera Isaka, akamoteebia: “Totirimboka gochia Misiri, korende omenye ase ense eye ndakworokererie.

english: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen , saying , The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek ; because they strove with him.
ekegusii: Abarisia b’ensemo ya Gerari bakaba bakwomana nabarisia ba Isaka, bagoteeba: “Amache aya nayaito.” Ase igo, Isaka Akayeroka entuboka eria Eseki, ekiagera bamwomaneretie aroro.

english: And they digged another well , and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah .
ekegusii: Naende bakarema, bakanyora entuboka ende, nero bakayiomanera. Ase igo, akayeroka Sitina + 26:21 Sitina: engencho yaye: eriomana .

english: And he removed from thence, and digged another well ; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth ; and he said , For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land .
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda akarema akanyora entuboka ende; eyio ero tibayiomanera. Ase ayio akayeroka Rehoboti + 26:22 Rehoboti: engencho yaye: aase aagare , akabora: “Naki Omonene otoeire ense engare, na toragenderere komenteka ase ense eye.”

english: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba .
ekegusii: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

english: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obw’Omonene akamoorokera, akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae o Aburaamu iso, tibwoboa, ekiagera nigo inde amo naye, ningosesenie aye amo na ororeeria rwao, ase engencho y’omosomba one Aburaamu.”

english: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD , and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well .
ekegusii: Na Isaka akaagacha egesasiimero aroro, akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, agatenenia chiema chiaye aroro. Na agwo abasomba baye bakarema, bakanyora entuboka. Isaka na Abimeleki bagokora okobwatana

english: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
ekegusii: Na Isaka akababooria: “Inki mwacha korigia aa bwone, na ekero nare nainwe nigo mongechete, naende mwanseretie korwa seino?”

english: And they said , We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Amaene, twarorire maiso marore ng’a Omonene nigo are amo naye. Na nigo torengereretie ng’a totiananie na tokore okobwatana naye ng’a,

english: That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the LORD .
ekegusii: bono togotokorera bobe bonde, buna intwe totagokunete, gose totagokorerete bobe, otatiga amaya oka; tokagotiga okagenda bwoo nomorembe. Naye bono nomosesenigwa Omonene.”

english: And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .
ekegusii: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

english: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .
ekegusii: Bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatianania barabwo ase barabwo; na Isaka akabakooba, na barabwo bakarua asare, bakagenda nomorembe.

english: And it came to pass the same day , that Isaac’s servants came , and told him concerning the well which they had digged , and said unto him, We have found water .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria abasomba ba Isaka bagaacha, bakamorentera amang’ana igoro y’entuboka eria banyorete, bakamoteebia: “Twanyorire amaache.”

english: And he called it Shebah : therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day .
ekegusii: Ere akayeroka Seba; na ase engencho eyio omochie oyio nigo okorokwa Beeri‐Seba goika reero iga. Esau okonyuoma abakungu babere

english: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :
ekegusii: Ekero Esau gaika nemiaka emerongo ene akanyuoma Yuditi, omoiseke o Beeri, Omohiti, na Basemati, omoiseke o Eloni, nere n’Omohiti.

english: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah .
ekegusii: Barabwo babere bagakora obogima bwa Isaka na Rebeka koba nobororo obonge.

english: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven , and will give unto thy seed all these countries ; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed ;
ekegusii: Nimente ororeeria rwao robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro; ne chinse echi chionsi ninchiee ororeeria rwao; na ase ororeeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe,

english: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice , and kept my charge , my commandments , my statutes , and my laws .
ekegusii: ekiagera Aburaamu naigwerete amang’ana aane, akabwata aya namochiigete, na amachiiko aane, na aya narigete, amo nogoteebereria kwane.”

english: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar :
ekegusii: Ase igo, Isaka akamenya Gerari.

english: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
ekegusii: Ekero konya bamenyire aria engaki entambe, Abimeleki, omorwoti bw’Abafilisti, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Isaka bakogosoria na Rebeka mokaye.

english: And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold, of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou, She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said , Lest I die for her.
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Isaka, akamobooria: “Amaene, oyo ’mokao? Naki gwakora ogateeba ng’a oyo mosubati omino?” Isaka akamoiraneria: “Nigo nareengereretie ng’a, aande nimbaise goitwa ase engencho yaye.”

english: And it came to pass , that when Isaac was old , and his eyes were dim , so that he could not see , he called Esau his eldest son , and said unto him, My son : and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
ekegusii: Ekero Isaka konya abeire omogotu, nonya na amaiso aye konya amerire orotutu, atari korora buya, akarangeria Esau, omwana oye omotangi, akamoteebia: “Omwana one!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa Tata.”

english: And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .
ekegusii: Erio omoirere iso arie, erinde anyare kogosesenia ritang’ani atarakwa.”

english: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man :
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo agateebia Rebeka ng’ina; “Norooche Esau ominto nomonto omerete amarionya ase omobere oye, korende inche omobere one nigo ore omoterere.

english: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver ; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing .
ekegusii: Aande, Tata nigo arantaba‐tabe, na inche imbe ase amaiso aye buna omong’ainereria, inyerentere okoragererigwa ribaga ri’ogosesenigwa.”

english: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .
ekegusii: Ng’ina akamoteebia: “Okoragererigwa kwao tiga kobe igoro yane; igwa aya nkogoteebia rimo rioka, genda ondetere chimanwa echio chie chimbori.”

english: And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
ekegusii: Erio agwo akagenda, akarentera ng’ina chimanwa echio, na ere akaroisia endagera engiya, eria ise anchete.

english: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau , which were with her in the house , and put them upon Jacob her younger son :
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akabogoria eanga eria engiya mono ya Esau, omwana oye omotangi; eye nigo yagachire nyomba mwaye, akayebekera Yakobo, omwana oye omoke.

english: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands , and upon the smooth of his neck :
ekegusii: Na amasankwa aria e chimanwa chie chimbori akamoboyia ase amaboko aye ne rigoti.

english: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread , which she had prepared , into the hand of her son Jacob .
ekegusii: Erio ababeeka ase amaboko ’omwana oye Yakobo endagera eria engiya aroisetie, amo nomogati.

english: And he came unto his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I; who art thou, my son ?
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda agasoa nyomba mwaise, akamoteebia: “Tata!” Nere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa. Naye ng’o, mwana one?”

english: And Jacob said unto his father , I am Esau thy firstborn ; I have done according as thou badest me: arise , I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison , that thy soul may bless me.
ekegusii: Yakobo akairaneria ise iga: “Ninche Esau, omwana oo omotangi. Nakorire buna gwantebeetie; booka, oikaranse egere orie enyama y’obotwari bwane, erio onsesenie.”

english: And he said , Behold now, I am old , I know not the day of my death :
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: “Rora bono inche nagotire, gose timanyeti engaki y’ogokwa kwane.

english: And Isaac said unto his son , How is it that thou hast found it so quickly , my son ? And he said , Because the LORD thy God brought it to me .
ekegusii: Isaka akamobooria: “Omwana one, naki gwakora kwanyora ching’iti bwango iga?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “mboora Omonene, Nyasae oo, ochindetera.”

english: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka agateebia Yakobo: “Inchuo aiga ang’e ase ’nde, ngotabatabe, erinde imanye gose naye omwana one Esau, gose tari ere.”

english: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father ; and he felt him, and said , The voice is Jacob’s voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau .
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda agaika ise ang’e, na ere akamotaba‐taba, akabora: “Eriogi rirorio neria Yakobo, korende amaboko naya Esau.”

english: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau’s hands : so he blessed him.
ekegusii: Na ise tamomanya, ekiagera amaboko aye nigo areenge namarionya buna aya Esau omwabo. Ase igo, akamosesenia.

english: And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Amaene, naye omwana one Esau?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Ee, Tata ninche.”

english: And he said , Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison , that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat : and he brought him wine , and he drank .
ekegusii: Naende Isaka akamoteebia: “Ng’ererie endagera eyio gocha ang’e aiga, omwana one, indie enyama y’obotwari bwao, erio ngosesenie.” Ase igo, akamoyeirera endagera eria na ere akaria, akamoa na edivai, akanywa.

english: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son .
ekegusii: Isaka ise akamoteebia: “Omwana one, inchwo aiga ang’e ase ’nde, erio onyunyunte.”

english: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven , and the fatness of the earth , and plenty of corn and wine :
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae agoitororere riime rikorwa igoro na obonoru bwe riroba, ne rigesa riao ribe rinyinge, na edivai boigo.

english: Now therefore take , I pray thee, thy weapons , thy quiver and thy bow , and go out to the field , and take me some venison ;
ekegusii: Bono bogoria obota n’echinsara chiao, ogende borabu otware ching’iti, ondetere chinyama.

english: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob , and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , that Esau his brother came in from his hunting .
ekegusii: Ekero Isaka konya aikire gosesenia Yakobo, na Yakobo karure ase obosio bwa Isaka ise, Esau omwabo akairana korwa ase obotwaari bwaye.

english: And he also had made savoury meat , and brought it unto his father , and said unto his father , Let my father arise , and eat of his son’s venison , that thy soul may bless me.
ekegusii: Nere boigo akaroisia endagera engiya, akarentera ise, akamoteebia: “Tata, inchwo orie endagera y’obotwari bwane, inche omwana oo, erinde onsesenie.”

english: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said , I am thy son , thy firstborn Esau .
ekegusii: Isaka ise akamobooria: “Aye naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria: “Ninche Esau omwana oo, okoira kwao ogotang’ani.”

english: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly , and said , Who? where is he that hath taken venison , and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest , and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed .
ekegusii: Erio Isaka agakumia mono na koiguswa, akabora: “Kai! Kai! Ning’o oria ocha ondetera endagera engiya, na inche naria yonsi ekero otaracha, namosesenia? Ee! Ee!, Nere bono oikire gosesenigwa!”

english: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me, even me also, O my father .
ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koigwa amang’ana aya korwa ase ise, agakuura na korera ekerero ekenene mono ki’obororo, akamoteebia: “Nsesenie nainche boigo, Tata!”

english: And he said , Thy brother came with subtilty , and hath taken away thy blessing .
ekegusii: Korende Isaka akamoiraneria: “Oyomino nigo achicha nobong’ainereria, na ere bono oirire ogosesenigwa kwao.”

english: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold, I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son ?
ekegusii: Isaka akamoiraneria: “Rora, bono naikire komokora obeire omonene oo, na abamwabo bonsi babe abasomba baye, naende namoeire endagera y’omogondo na edivai. Inki rende bono nkogokorera aye, omwana one?”

english: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me, that I may eat ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
ekegusii: Erio ondoiserie endagera engiya, eria nyanchete, oyendetere indie, erinde ngosesenie konde moyo, ntarakwa.”

english: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .
ekegusii: Esau akagecha Yakobo ase engencho y’ogosesenigwa okwo ise amosesenetie, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Amatuko ay’okomoreera Tata ng’ang’e are; erio nario ndaite Yakobo.”

english: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah : and she sent and called Jacob her younger son , and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau , as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Rebeka ateebigwa aya Esau, omwana oye omonene, agoteeba, agatoma omonto korangeria Yakobo, omwana oye omoke, akamoteebia: “Rora, momura omino Esau ogotianeire ng’a nkogoitare.

english: Now therefore, my son , obey my voice ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran ;
ekegusii: Na bono, omwana one, igwa amang’ana aane, imoka otame gochia o Labani, momura ominto aaria Harani.

english: And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother’s fury turn away ;
ekegusii: Omenye aroro ase engaki enke, goika ekeririanda kia momura omino gekende.

english: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send , and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?
ekegusii: Ekero endamwamu yaye erakee, na ere ebire aya kwamokorerete, erio nintome abanto bache gokorangeria oirane korwa aroro. Nase ki ndakwerwe nainwe mwensi babere ase rituko erimo.” Isaka Ogotoma Yakobo ase Labani

english: And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me?
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka agakwana na Isaka, akamoteebia: “Nigo ngechirie mono ase obogima bwane ase engencho y’abaiseke b’Abahiti. Onye Yakobo ogochia konyuoma oyomo bw’abaiseke b’Abahiti, koreng’ana buna aba bamenyete ase ensemo eye, rirorio obogima bwane inki borangwenere?”

english: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son . And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison , and to bring it .
ekegusii: Ko bono, ekero Isaka are gokwana nomwana oye Esau, Rebeka nigo ategererete bobisi. Ase igo, ekero Esau agendete borabu gotwara ching’iti amorentere ise,

english: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son , saying , Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother , saying ,
ekegusii: Rebeka agateebia Yakobo, omwana oye: “Naigure iso ogoteebia momura omino Esau:

english: Bring me venison , and make me savoury meat , that I may eat , and bless thee before the LORD before my death .
ekegusii: Ndetere chinyama chia borabu, ondoiserie endagera engiya indie, erio inyare kogosesenia ase obosio bw’Omonene, konde moyo, ntarakwa.

english: Now therefore, my son , obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
ekegusii: Ase igo, omwana one, ntegerera bono aya nkogoteebia.

english: Go now to the flock , and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats ; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father , such as he loveth :
ekegusii: Genda getii ase riicho, ondetere chimanwa chie chimbori ibere chingiya, na inche nimoroiserie iso endagera engiya, eria anchete.

english: And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .
ekegusii: Erio Isaka akarangeria Yakobo, akamosesenia, akamoteebia: “Tobaisa konyuoma omoiseke bw’Abakaanani.

english: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba , and went toward Haran .
ekegusii: Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba kogenda Harani.

english: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .
ekegusii: Agaika aase gete, akaraara agwo botuko, ekiagera erioba konya riagure. Akabogoria rigena erimo ri’aase aria, agatoorera omotwe oye ase rigena riria, karaaire.

english: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land ; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nimbe amo naye, ninkorende aande onsi ase orabe gokogenda, naende ninkoiranie gocha ase ense eye; naki tinkogotiga goika nagokoreire ayio nagoteebirie.”

english: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the LORD is in this place ; and I knew it not.
ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akabora: “Amaene, Omonene nao are aase aa, na inche tinamanyete.”

english: And he was afraid , and said , How dreadful is this place ! this is none other but the house of God , and this is the gate of heaven .
ekegusii: Ere akoboa, akabora: “Aa nase okoirokia! Aa takomocha koba enyomba ya Nyasae, aa nao egeita kia igoro.”

english: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .
ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka mambia chuni, akaimokia rigena riria atoorerete omotwe rogoro, akaritenenia buna esiiro koba ekeinyorio, akaumora amaguta igoro yaye.

english: And he called the name of that place Beth-el : but the name of that city was called Luz at the first .
ekegusii: Aase aria akaaroka Beteli. + 28:19 Beteli: engencho yaye; enyomba ya Nyasae Korende ritang’ani omochie oria nigo ore korokwa Lusu.

english: Arise , go to Padan-aram , to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father ; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother .
ekegusii: Imoka, ogende Padan‐Aramu ase omochie o Betueli, sokoro yao, onyuome omokungu oyomo korwa ase abaiseke ba Labani, nyoko-rome.

english: And Jacob vowed a vow , saying , If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and raiment to put on ,
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaria eira, okobora: “Nyasae karabe amo nainche, andende ase orogendo rwane na kong’a endagera nkoria, ne chianga nkobeeka,

english: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace ; then shall the LORD be my God :
ekegusii: na inche kondairane ase omochie o Tata nomorembe, eri’Omonene nabe Nyasae one;

english: And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God’s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
ekegusii: ne rigena eri natenenia aa buna esiiro nigo rirabe enyomba yao, Nyasae. Na kende gionsi orang’e inche, amaene tinkomocha gokoa ensemo ya ikomi.”

english: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful , and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people ;
ekegusii: Na Nyasae Omobui nagosesenie, agokinie, na oroiboro rwao naromente robe omoganda omonene bw’ebisaku.

english: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob’s and Esau’s mother .
ekegusii: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau. Esau okonyuoma omokungu onde

english: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Padan-aram , to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan ;
ekegusii: Bono Esau akarora buna Isaka asesenirie Yakobo na komotoma agende Padan‐Aramu anyuome omokungu korwa aroro, ekiagera ekero amosesenetie, akamokania tabaisa konyuoma moiseke onde bwensi bw’Abakaanani!

english: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Padan-aram ;
ekegusii: Naende akarora ng’a Yakobo oigwereire ise na ng’ina ochiire Padan‐Aramu.

english: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father ;
ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero Esau arooche ng’a Isaka ise tancheti abaiseke abwo b’Abakaanani,

english: Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son , the sister of Nebajoth , to be his wife .
ekegusii: nonya obwate abakungu bande, akagenda o Isumaeli, akanyuoma Mahalati, omoiseke o Isumaeli mosinto o Aburaamu, mosubati omwabo Nebayoti, abe omokungu oye amo nabakungu baria bande abwate ritang’ani. Okoroota kwa Yakobo agwo Beteli

english: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, agaika ense y’abanto ba moocha.

english: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother , and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother , that Jacob went near , and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth , and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yakobo achia korora Raeli, omoiseke o Labani, ng’ina rome, okorenta riicho ria Labani, akaimoka, agatigeria rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko, akanyoinsia ching’ondi chia Labani, ng’ina rome.

english: And Jacob kissed Rachel , and lifted up his voice , and wept .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaagata Raeli, akarera na koiyeria amariga.

english: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother , and that he was Rebekah’s son : and she ran and told her father .
ekegusii: Agateebia Raeli, “Inche nomoigwa o iso, omwana o Rebeka.” Raeli akaminyoka, agateebia ise amang’ana ayio.

english: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son , that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .
ekegusii: Ekero Labani achia koigwa amang’ana a Yakobo, omoigwa oye, akaminyoka gochia komoorotota, akamoagata n’amaiga amanene, akamoira gochia nka bwoye. Yakobo agateebia Labani amang’ana onsi.

english: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh . And he abode with him the space of a month .
ekegusii: Erio Labani akamoteebia: “Amaene, aye namanyinga omobere one.” Ere akamenya bwoye ase engaki y’omotienyi oyomo. Yakobo ogokorera Labani ase okonyora Raeli na Lea

english: And Laban said unto Jacob , Because thou art my brother , shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought ? tell me, what shall thy wages be ?
ekegusii: Labani agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Nonya kore omoigwa one, tegwenereti onkorere emeremo bosa. Nteebia eng’eria yao ninki ndakoe!”

english: And Laban had two daughters : the name of the elder was Leah , and the name of the younger was Rachel .
ekegusii: Bono Labani nigo abwate abaiseke babere; omoiseke oria omonene nigo are korokwa Lea, na oria omoke Raeli.

english: Leah was tender eyed ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .
ekegusii: Lea amaiso aye nigo areenge amatu, korende Raeli nigo areenge omonyakieni, naende omwasioku.

english: And Jacob loved Rachel ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .
ekegusii: Yakobo konya omwanchire Raeli, na ase ayio agateebia Labani, “Ningokorere emiaka etano na ebere, erinde ong’e Raeli, omoiseke oo omoke.”

english: And Laban said , It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man : abide with me.
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya. Tiga nkomoe aye kobua ’nkomoa omonto onde; menya aa bwone.”

english: And he looked , and behold a well in the field , and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks : and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth .
ekegusii: Agwo akarigereria akarora ensoko yaare ase egetii, na amaicho atato e ching’ondi araire ensoko eyio ensemo, ekiagera ase ensoko eyio nao amaicho are konywera amaache. Na ndiareenge aroro rigena rinene igoro y’omonwa bw’ensoko.

english: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel ; and they seemed unto him but a few days , for the love he had to her.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akamokorera emiaka etano na ebere aegwe Raeli. Emiaka eyio ekarorekana asare buna namatuko makeigo, ekiagera nigo amwanchete Raeli mono.

english: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Bono naikeranirie engaki yane, ing’a mokane, tobe nere.”

english: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Labani akarangeria abanto bonsi b’ensemo eria, agakorera omoyega.

english: And it came to pass in the evening , that he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba Labani akaimokia Lea, omoiseke oye omonene, akamorentera Yakobo, erio Yakobo akaba nere.

english: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .
ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Labani akarua omosomba oye omoiseke okorokwa Silpa, abe omokoreri o Lea, omwana oye.

english: And it came to pass, that in the morning , behold, it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, Yakobo akanyora ng’a ’Lea aetwe. Erio akabooria Labani: “Inki eke gwankorerete? Tinagokorerete, erinde ong’e Raeli? Naki gwakorete okang’aina?”

english: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Aiga seito intwe titori gokora bo, gosokia omoiseke omoke, na gotiga omonene.

english: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
ekegusii: Tiga omoyega oyo bw’amatuko aya atano na abere oraera bw’oyio omonene, erio noegwe na oria omoke, naende aye onkorere emeremo emiaka ende etano na ebere.”

english: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week : and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
ekegusii: Yakobo agancha ebe boigo, erio agaikerania amatuko ayio atano na abere. Erio Labani akamomoa Raeli, omoiseke oye omoke, abe mok’aye.

english: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid .
ekegusii: Labani akamoa Raeli, omwana oye, omokoreri, nere Bilia, omosomba oye omoiseke.

english: And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place .
ekegusii: Agwo nao amaicho onsi areenge gosangererekana, na abarisia nigo baare korusia rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko banyoinsia ching’ondi, naende bariirania ase omonwa bw’ensoko.

english: And he went in also unto Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him yet seven other years .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba na Raeli; na agancha Raeli mono kegima kobua Lea. Erio Yakobo naende agakorera Labani emiaka ende etano na ebere. Abana ba Yakobo

english: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Lea tanchiri, akamosesenia ase oroiboro rwa abana, korende Raeli ere nigo areenge omogomba.

english: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction ; now therefore my husband will love me.
ekegusii: Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Rubeni, + 29:32 Rubeni: engencho yaye: rora omomura naki nigo atebeete: “Omonene ororire buna ’nchayire. Korende ase engencho y’okoibora, bono omosacha one nanyanche.”

english: And she conceived again, and bare a son ; and said , Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon .
ekegusii: Naende Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Omonene ororire ng’a tinyanchiri, naende ong’eire omwana onde omoisia boigo,” akamoroka Simioni. + 29:33 Simioni: engencho yaye aande: okoigwa

english: And she conceived again , and bare a son ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .
ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Bono engaki eye omosacha one nabwatane amo nainche, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batato.” Ase ayio akamoroka Lawi. + 29:34 Lawi: engencho yaye aande: obwateranirie

english: And she conceived again, and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the LORD : therefore she called his name Judah ; and left bearing .
ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Engaki eye nintogie Omonene.” Ase ayio akamoroka Yuda. + 29:35 Yuda: engencho yaye aande: ogotogigwa Erio Lea agatenena koibora.

english: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren , whence be ye? And they said , Of Haran are we.
ekegusii: Yakobo akababooria: “Baminto, ng’ai seino?” Abarisia baria bakamoiraneria: “Seito naiga Harani.”

english: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .
ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Inee! Momanyete Labani, mochokoro o Nahori?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Ee, ntomomanyete.”

english: And he said unto them, Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .
ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Mbuya are?” Abarisia bakamoiraneria: “Ee, mbuya are; na rigereria, Raeli, omoiseke oye oyio ogocha ne ching’ondi!”

english: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .
ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Rigereria, bono mobaso, chinsa chi’ogosangereria amaicho tichiraika, nyoinsia ching’ondi, naende mochiire korisia.”

english: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth ; then we water the sheep .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Titokonyara gokora bo goika ekero amaicho onsi arache asangererekane amo, erinde abarisia bamanye gotigeria rigena korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko; erio tomanye konyoinsia ching’ondi.”

english: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep : for she kept them .
ekegusii: Ekero areenge ogendererete gokwana nabarabwo, Raeli agacha obwate ching’ondi chia ise, naki nere orenge gochirisia.

english: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished , and all the host of them .
ekegusii: Naboigo igoro na ense bigaikeranigwa.

english: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden ; and from thence it was parted , and became into four heads .
ekegusii: Orooche rogatuboka korwa ase omogondo o Edeni na rokayobekera amaache. Korwa agwo rokagabekana, rokaba chindooche inye.

english: The name of the first is Pison : that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah , where there is gold ;
ekegusii: Orooche rwe ritang’ani rokarokwa Pisoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Havila.

english: And the gold of that land is good : there is bdellium and the onyx stone .
ekegusii: Aa noo Etaabu engiya kegima egotoka boigo namagena ande ye rigori rinene.

english: And the name of the second river is Gihon : the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia .
ekegusii: Na orooche rwa kabere rokarokwa Gihoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Kusi.

english: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel : that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria . And the fourth river is Euphrates .
ekegusii: Na orooche rwa gatato rokarokwa Tigirisi, orwo rogoeta moocha y’Asuri. Na orooche rwa kane narororwo rokarokwa Eufarati.

english: And the LORD God took the man , and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaira omonto oria, akamobeka ase omogondo o Edeni, ayoroiserie na koyorenda.

english: And the LORD God commanded the man , saying , Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat :
ekegusii: Akamoteebia omonto oria, “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo oyo nonyare koyaria,

english: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil , thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die .
ekegusii: gotatiga amatunda y’omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe toyaria, ekiagera rituko riria orayarie goika okwe.”

english: And the LORD God said , It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Tai buya omonto oyo abe bweka, nimokorere omokonyi oramokoonye.”

english: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field , and every fowl of the air ; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature , that was the name thereof .
ekegusii: Erio akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akaroisia kera eng’iti, ne chinyoni chionsi. Erio agachirenta ase omonto oria, arore buna agochiroka; naboigo kera egetongwa kianyorete erieta riaye.

english: And Adam gave names to all cattle , and to the fowl of the air , and to every beast of the field ; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
ekegusii: Ase igo omonto oyio akaroka chinyoni chionsi n’echingiti chionsi; korende ase ebio bionsi ebiatongetwe, tarorekana mokonyi onde oye.

english: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam , and he slept : and he took one of his ribs , and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akabeekera omonto oria chitoro chindito mono kegima, ekero araire akamorusia orobaru rwaye oromo, na akairaneria chinyama aase aria.

english: And the rib , which the LORD God had taken from man , made he a woman , and brought her unto the man .
ekegusii: Akaroisia omokungu korwa ase orobaru akamoirera omonto oria.

english: And Adam said , This is now bone of my bones , and flesh of my flesh : she shall be called Woman , because she was taken out of Man .
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agateeba, “Omoerio oyombwekaine oyo aa Oyo neriuga korwa ase amauga aane, ne chinyama korwa ase chinyama chiane. Oyo nigo ararokwe omokungu, ekiagera oyo nigo arusigwe ase omosacha.”

english: And they were both naked , the man and his wife , and were not ashamed .
ekegusii: Omosacha na omokungu nigo baarenge getirianda, na tibaare kororerana obosooku.

english: And God blessed the seventh day , and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made .
ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia rituko ria gatano na kabere, akariatanana, akarikora richenu, ekiagera erio nario rituko atimogete korwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi y’obotongi, eyio konya akorire.

english: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created , in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens ,
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano igoro y’ense, na bionsi ebire imeo buna biatongetwe. Omogondo o Eden

english: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth , and every herb of the field before it grew : for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth , and there was not a man to till the ground .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria’Omonene atongete igoro na ense, kemeri kende tikiarenge komera korwa ase riroba, gose nyeni chinde, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae konya taratoma embura etwe ase ense, nonya ’monto onde tarengeo ore korema riroba.

english: But there went up a mist from the earth , and watered the whole face of the ground .
ekegusii: Korende obotooru nigo bware gotiira korwa inse na konyiyia riroba ri’ense yonsi.

english: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden ; and there he put the man whom he had formed .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agasimeka ebimeri ase omogondo aaria Edeni, ensemo ya moocha, erio akabeeka omonto aroro, oria abombete na koroisia.

english: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
ekegusii: Ekero Raeli arooche ng’a tari koiborera Yakobo abana, akarorera mosubati omwabo ribero, agateebia Yakobo: “Ing’a abana! Otabang’eti, rirorio nigo ndakwe!”

english: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son .
ekegusii: Erio Silpa, omosomba omoiseke o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.

english: And Leah said , A troop cometh : and she called his name Gad .
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Ninde negesio.” Akamoroka Gadi. + 30:11 Gadi: engencho yaye aande: egesio ekiya

english: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son .
ekegusii: Silpa, omosomba o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.

english: And Leah said , Happy am I , for the daughters will call me blessed : and she called his name Asher .
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Inche ninde nomogooko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore n’omogooko.” Ase igo, akamoroka Aseri. + 30:13 Aseri: engencho yaye: omogooko

english: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes .
ekegusii: Ase engaki ye rigesa ri’engano Rubeni akagenda akanyora amasooni ng’ombe + 30:14 Amasooni ng’ombe: amatunda amarabu ko nigo anga buna chinyanya getii, akayatwa, akayarentera Lea ng’ina.

english: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes .
ekegusii: Erio Raeli agasaba Lea amwatanere amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oye, korende Lea akamoiraneria: “Inee! Nering’ana rike kwang’urire omosacha one, na bono korigetie koira amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one boigo?” Raeli akamoiraneria: “Reero nache araare naye, korang’e amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oo.”

english: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening , and Leah went out to meet him, and said , Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes . And he lay with her that night .
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo areenge koirana korwa mogondo mogoroba, Lea akagenda komoorotota, akamoteebia: “Reero goika oraare mwane, nakogorire namasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one.” Ase obotuko Yakobo akaba nere.

english: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa Lea, na ere akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano.

english: And Leah said , God hath given me my hire , because I have given my maiden to my husband : and she called his name Issachar .
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire eng’eria yane, ekiagera naete omosacha one omosomba one omoiseke.” Ase igo, Akaaroka omwana oria Isakaru + 30:18 Isakaru: engencho yaye aande: eng’eria .

english: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son .
ekegusii: Lea akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano na rimo.

english: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?
ekegusii: Yakobo akabea Raeli mono, akamobooria: “Inee! Ninche inde ribaga ria Nyasae, oyogotangete tikwaegwa abana?”

english: And Leah said , God hath endued me with a good dowry ; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons : and she called his name Zebulun .
ekegusii: Erio Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire ekeegwa ekiya; bono omosacha one nansike, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batano nomo.” Ase igo, akamoroka Sabuloni. + 30:20 Sabuloni: engencho yaye aande: okomanya, gose: amasikani

english: And afterwards she bare a daughter , and called her name Dinah .
ekegusii: Magega yaye akaibora omwana omoiseke, akamoroka Dina.

english: And God remembered Rachel , and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoinyora Raeli, akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na akaigora enda yaye;

english: And she conceived , and bare a son ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
ekegusii: ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nyasae onduseirie ogochaywa kwane.”

english: And she called his name Joseph ; and said , The LORD shall add to me another son .
ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria Yusufu + 30:24 Yusufu: engencho yaye: amente oyonde , akabora: “Tiga Omonene karanche amentere omwana onde omoisia.” Yakobo Okogomba na Labani

english: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .
ekegusii: Ekero Raeli aiboire Yusufu, Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Ing’a ribaga ngende seito, ase ense yane.

english: Give me my wives and my children , for whom I have served thee, and let me go : for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
ekegusii: Ing’a abakungu baane na abana baane, aba namenyire nkogokorera, ontige ’ngende seito; naki nomanyete emeremo nabeire nkogokorera.”

english: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake .
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Oise kong’anchera nkwane iga, rigereria namanyire boronge ng’a Omonene onsesenirie mono ase engencho yao.

english: And he said , Appoint me thy wages , and I will give it .
ekegusii: Bono nteebia eng’eria yao ey’oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”

english: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aye omonyene nomanyete buna nabeire omokoreri oo, na amaicho ao buna abeire ase oborendi bwane.

english: And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her.
ekegusii: Erio akamoiraneria: “Nimbwate omosomba one omoiseke, Bilia. Motware, erinde inyore abana korwa asare, barokwe abana baane, na goetera asare na inche inyore oroiboro.”

english: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude ; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
ekegusii: Naki enibo yao nigo yareenge enke ritang’ani ekero ntaracha aa, korende bono yamentekanire mono kegima. Omonene ogosesenirie aye, aande onsi ase nabeire nkogenda kogokorera emeremo. Ko bono, inche indi ndabe nkoroisia amang’ana abwone inche omonyene?”

english: And he said , What shall I give thee ? And Jacob said , Thou shalt not give me any thing : if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock :
ekegusii: Labani akamobooria: “Ninki ndakoe rende?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Tinganeti ong’e kende. Oise gonkorera ring’ana eri ndagoteebie rioka, rirorio naende ningenderere korisia amaicho ao, na koyarenda.

english: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
ekegusii: Tiga ng’ete reero ase amaicho ao onsi, ndusie korwao kera eng’ondi emechege na egesembe, na emaanwa y’eng’ondi emwamu, na kera embori nyankororo na nyankanga. Erinde echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yane.

english: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me.
ekegusii: Ase igo, amatuko agochia bosio, ekero orache korora eng’eria yane, oboronge bwane nabombeere kirori. Kera embori etari nyankanga gose nyankororo, na kera emaanwa y’eng’ondi etari emwamu, onye ekonyorekana ase ’nde, oyebare ng’a eyio nigo eibire.”

english: And Laban said , Behold, I would it might be according to thy word .
ekegusii: Labani agancha amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Tiga abe buna gwateebire.”

english: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted , and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted , and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep , and gave them into the hand of his sons .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Labani akarusia chigoree chiimarera ne chinkororo, ne chimbori chiaberi, echiare nyankanga ne chire nyankororo, na kera eyare nebimoa ebirabu ase omobere oye, na kera eng’ondi eyare emwamu. Echio chionsi agachia abana baye abamura bachirende.

english: And he set three days’ journey betwixt himself and Jacob : and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks .
ekegusii: Erio ageatanana korwa ase Yakobo oboare bw’orogendo rw’amatuko atato; na Yakobo agatigara okorisia riicho ria Labani eriatigarete.

english: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree ; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods .
ekegusii: Yakobo agatwa ebite ebibese biomopopla + 30:37 Omopopla: Ebite bi’emete gete enga buna omosobeti, na omwalozi, na omouru. akabisata chinsemo, erinde emeng’ororia emerabu ekarorekana ase ebite biria.

english: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka ebite biria ase chintuba chi’amaache ase amaicho are gocha konywera. Na ekiagera ching’iti chiria chiare koa chiaberi amarieme, ekero chigocha konywa amaache,

english: And the flocks conceived before the rods , and brought forth cattle ringstraked , speckled , and spotted .
ekegusii: chirochio chikanyora amarieme bosio bw’ebite ebio, chikabiara chimanwa chire chimarera, ne chinkanga, ne chire nyankororo.

english: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife : and Jacob went in unto her.
ekegusii: Naboigo Yakobo akaegwa Bilia, omosomba omoiseke o Raeli, abe mokaye, na Yakobo akaba nere.

english: And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban ; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle .
ekegusii: Na Yakobo agaatanana ching’ondi chimingichi, ne ching’ondi chiaberi agachisang’anania ne chimingichi chie riicho ria Labani echiareenge namagwari, na echiare chimwamu. Naboigo akenyorera amaicho aye ere omonyene, ayio atabegete amo naya Labani.

english: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .
ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi chimbori gose ching’ondi echiare ne chinguru gochiaganirie amarieme, Yakobo nigo are kobeeka ebite biria bosio bwe ching’iti ase chintuba chiria chinyare konyora amarieme gochikorigereria ebite ebio.

english: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban’s , and the stronger Jacob’s .
ekegusii: Korende echiare chinyoro tare gochibekera ebite ebio. Ase igo, echiare chinyoro nigo chiare koba echia Labani, na echiare ne chinguru chiba echia Yakobo.

english: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba okomenteka koba omotenenku, akaba namaicho amange, na abasomba, abaiseke na abamura, ne chingamia, ne chitigere.

english: And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .
ekegusii: Bilia akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.

english: And Rachel said , God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice , and hath given me a son : therefore called she his name Dan .
ekegusii: Erio Raeli akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire oboronge bwane, amaene, oigure ekerero kiane, ong’eire omwana omoisia.” Ase ayio akamoroka Dani. + 30:6 Dani: engencho yaye: ong’eire oboronge bwane

english: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son .
ekegusii: Bilia, omosomba o Raeli, akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.

english: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .
ekegusii: Raeli akabora: “Ase okoamererania okonene namenyire nkoamererania na mosubati ominto, nabuire.” Ase igo, akamoroka Nafutali. + 30:8 Nafutali: engencho yane: okoamere rania

english: When Leah saw that she had left bearing , she took Zilpah her maid , and gave her Jacob to wife .
ekegusii: Ekero Lea achia korora ng’a Bilia okoorire koibora abana, akaimokia Silpa, omosomba oye omoiseke, akamomoa Yakobo, abe mokaye.

english: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s ; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory .
ekegusii: Bono basinto ba Labani bakaigwekana kwemurungania bagoteeba ng’a: “Yakobo oirire enibo yonsi ya tata; na ase enibo eyio bwenyoreire obotenenku obwo bwonsi abwate.”

english: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria amaicho gachiire rieme nkarigereria, nkarora ase chindoto ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari na ebisembe, ne chimechege.

english: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I.
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika o Nyasae akandangeria ase chindoto: Yakobo! Nainche ngaitaba: ‘Nao inde aa!’”

english: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
ekegusii: Aganteebia: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie orore, ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari, na ebisembe, ne chimechege, naki narorire onsi aya Labani abeire okogokorera.

english: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house ?
ekegusii: Erio Raeli na Lea bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Ntwe ntori na egetari gose omwando ase omochie o tata?

english: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money .
ekegusii: Tatokorete buna abamenyi? Naki nigo atoonetie, naende akaria enibo eria yonsi.

english: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours, and our children’s : now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do .
ekegusii: Naki enibo eyio yonsi Nyasae arusirie korwa ase tata nigo etotungetie intwe na abana baito. Ase igo, ayio onsi Nyasae agoteebirie, yakore.”

english: Then Jacob rose up , and set his sons and his wives upon camels ;
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaimoka, akariinia abana baye na abakungu baye ase chingamia igoro;

english: And he carried away all his cattle , and all his goods which he had gotten , the cattle of his getting , which he had gotten in Padan-aram , for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: akaira amaicho aye onsi, na enibo yaye yonsi eyio anyorete ase Padan-Aramu, erio akagenda ase ense ya Kaanani o Isaka ise.

english: And Laban went to shear his sheep : and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s .
ekegusii: Ekero Labani konya achiire konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, Raeli akaiba ebinyasae biaye bi’ogosasiimwa, ebiareenge nyomba mwaye.

english: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and, behold, it was not toward him as before .
ekegusii: Yakobo akanyora ng’a Labani oonchokire, tamorigereretie buya buna botambe.

english: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian , in that he told him not that he fled .
ekegusii: Yakobo nigo agendete bobisi korwa o Labani Omoaramu, tamoteebetie ng’a nkogenda are sobo.

english: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up , and passed over the river , and set his face toward the mount Gilead .
ekegusii: Agatama amo nenibo yaye yonsi eye abwate, akaamboka orooche roria rware korokwa Eufarati, akagenda gochia ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani okobwatia Yakobo

english: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Labani agateebigwa ng’a Yakobo otamire.

english: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey ; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead .
ekegusii: Erio Labani akaira abamwabo, bakamobwatia ase orogendo rw’amatuko atano na abere, akamoikeera ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi.

english: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night , and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaachera Labani Omoaramu ase chindoto botuko, akamoteebia: “Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.”

english: Then Laban overtook Jacob . Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount : and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead .
ekegusii: Ekero Labani aikeereire Yakobo, Yakobo nere konya otenenirie eema yaye agwo ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani nere amo nabamwabo bagatenenia chiema chiabo agwo.

english: And Laban said to Jacob , What hast thou done , that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters , as captives taken with the sword ?
ekegusii: Labani akabooria Yakobo: “Inki eke gwakorire iga? Ninki okong’ainera, na koira abana baane abasubati buna abasakorwa korwa ase esegi?

english: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly , and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth , and with songs , with tabret , and with harp ?
ekegusii: Nase ki gwatamete okeiberia, tigwanteebia? Inche anga nagokoobete nomochengo na amatera, na kobugia chikonu na amakano.

english: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing .
ekegusii: Naki otantigerete ribaga inyunyunte abachokoro baane na abana baane abasubati, mbaganerie amaya ase orogendo rwabo? Amaene, aye nigo gwankorerete egento ki’oboriri.

english: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt : but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight , saying , Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad .
ekegusii: Ninde nokobua gw’okogokorera amabe, korende Nyasae o iso nakwanete nainche ase obotuko bwaetete, agankurera aganteebia: Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.

english: And the LORD said unto Jacob , Return unto the land of thy fathers , and to thy kindred ; and I will be with thee.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiao, ase eamate yao, na inche nimbe amo naye.”

english: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?
ekegusii: Na bono gwachiire, ekiagera ore namaiga amange ay’abaanto banka seino, korende naki gwakorete okaiba emegwekano y’enyasae yane?”

english: And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria, akamoteebia: “Nigo noboete, nkarengereria ng’a nobaise kong’ura abana bao abasubati.

english: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyore obwate ebinyasae biao goika aitwe akwe. Tiga abaminto aba bare aa babe kirori. Rigia! Koranyore kende kiao kere ase ’nde, okeire.” Yakobo tamanyete ng’a Raeli obiibire.

english: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent , and into Leah’s tent , and into the two maidservants’ tents ; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent , and entered into Rachel’s tent .
ekegusii: Erio Labani agasoa eema ya Yakobo, na eya Lea, na ey’abakungu baria babere abasomba, tanyora kende. Agasoka korwa ase eema ya Lea, agasoa eya Raeli.

english: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel’s furniture , and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not.
ekegusii: Korende Raeli konya obisire ebinyasae ebio ase egeikaransero kiaye igoro y’engamia, akaba obiikaranserete. Labani akariga‐rigia eema ime, tabinyora.

english: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee ; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched , but found not the images .
ekegusii: Raeli agateebia ise: “Tata, onyabere, tobaisa kombea, naki tinkonyara koimoka ase obosio bwao, ekiagera nimbwate engencho yaito intwe abakungu.” Nabo akariga‐rigia, korende tanyora chinyasae chiaye.

english: And Jacob was wroth , and chode with Laban : and Jacob answered and said to Laban , What is my trespass ? what is my sin , that thou hast so hotly pursued after me ?
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akabea mono, akomania Labani ase okomotogonyera na goteeba: “Nkomocha ki nakorire? Nebibe biane nakorire mbiribi, goika kwagerire nabeire nobororo engencho enga eye?

english: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff , what hast thou found of all thy household stuff ? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren , that they may judge betwixt us both .
ekegusii: Kwariga‐rigirie ase ebinto bionsi. Ngento ki kiao kwanyorao narentanire? Kebeke aiga ase obosio bw’abaminto na obw’abamino, batwatanane inche naye.

english: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young , and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten .
ekegusii: Bono inche namenyire bwoo emiaka emerongo ebere. Ching’ondi chiao gose chimbori, ekero chianga amarieme, ende terekereti; gose inche tinyenyeti chimingichi chinde chie riicho riao, na gochiria.

english: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .
ekegusii: Echiaitetwe ne chinyang’au tingochirentereti, ninche omonyene nachiakanete. Echiaibetwe mobaso gose botuko ogachinsaba korwa ase amaboko aane.

english: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock ,
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akagania Raeli na Lea barangerigwe, erio Raeli na Lea bakagenda getii ase Yakobo areenge korisia amaicho aye.

english: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .
ekegusii: Eye nero yareenge engencho yane: Riberera ri’omobaso boira rikaba rigonsamba, na obokendu boganchanda botuko, ne chitoro chikaera korwa ase amaiso aane.

english: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .
ekegusii: Emiaka eye emerongo ebere imenyete bwoo, nabeire nkogokorera emiaka ikomi na ene ase okonyora abaiseke bao babere, na emiaka etano nomo ase okonyora amaicho ao, na aye kwabeire gokoonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi.

english: Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae o tata, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae oyio Isaka airogete ataarenge amo nainche, amaene, nanga nigo gwanseria bono inde namaboko amasa. Emechando na emeremo yane Nyasae oyerorire, Ase igo ere nagotogonyerete obotuko bwaetete.” Yakobo na Labani bagokora okobwatana

english: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob , These daughters are my daughters , and these children are my children , and these cattle are my cattle , and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters , or unto their children which they have born ?
ekegusii: Labani akairaneria Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Abasubati aba nabana baane, na abana babo nabarabwo nabana baane, na amaicho aya, naro nayaane, na bionsi ebio orooche nebiane. Bono ninki ndanyare gokorera abana baane na abana babo baiboire?

english: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
ekegusii: Inchuo bono, tokore okobwatana, aye nainche, na korokwo inakobe kirori egati yao nainche.”

english: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia ribe esiiro y’ekeinyorio.

english: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
ekegusii: Yakobo agateebia abamwabo: “Sangereria amagena”, na barabwo bakayasangereria, bakayakora etui, bakariera endagera ase etui eyio.

english: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha : but Jacob called it Galeed .
ekegusii: Labani akayeroka Yegari‐Sahaduta + 31:47 Yegari‐Sahaduta engencho yaye: etui y’oborori. , korende Yakobo akayeroka Galeedi + 31:47 Galeedi (Ekearamaiki): engencho yaye: etui y’oborori .

english: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed ;
ekegusii: Labani akabora: “Etui eye nero kirori egati yane naye reero iga.” Ase ayio akayeroka Galeedi.

english: And Mizpah ; for he said , The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another .
ekegusii: Naende ekarokwa Misipa + 31:49 Misipa: engencho yaye: omoorobiri bw’okorenda , naki nigo ateebete: “Omonene nere orabe ogotorigereria aye nainche, ekero torabe totarochaini.
