english: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance , that it is not toward me as before ; but the God of my father hath been with me.
ekegusii: Agwo Yakobo akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso tari kondigereria buya reero buna botambe. Korende Nyasae o tata nigo are amo nainche.

english: If thou shalt afflict my daughters , or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters , no man is with us; see , God is witness betwixt me and thee.
ekegusii: Korabe gokobachanda abana baane abasubati, gose gokonyuoma abakungu bande abaao goetania barabwo, manya ng’a nonya monto onde taiyo oyarooche, rora, Nyasae nere kirori egati yao nainche.”

english: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
ekegusii: Erio Labani agateebia Yakobo: “Rigereria etui eye na esiiro eye, natenenirie egati yao nainche.

english: This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm .
ekegusii: Etui eye ebe kirori, na esiiro eye ebe kirori boigo, ng’a tingotamboka etui eye inchiche bwoo, gose aye togoetania etui eye na esiiro eye ochiche bwone, tokorerane amabe.

english: The God of Abraham , and the God of Nahor , the God of their father , judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac .
ekegusii: Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Nahori, oyorenge Nyasae o ise obo, agambe ase egati yaito.” Ase igo, Yakobo agatiana ase Oyio Isaka ise airogete.

english: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount , and called his brethren to eat bread : and they did eat bread , and tarried all night in the mount .
ekegusii: Yakobo akarua ekeng’wanso agwo ase egetunwa, akarangeria abanto baye bache koragera amo nere, bakaba aroro ase egetunwa obotuko obwo bwonsi.

english: And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them: and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .
ekegusii: Mambia chuni Labani akaimoka, akaagata abachokoro baye na abana baye abasubati, akabasesenia; erio akairana gocha bwoye.

english: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .
ekegusii: Inwe ’momanyete ng’a nabeire ngokorera iso ne chinguru chiane chionsi;

english: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times ; but God suffered him not to hurt me .
ekegusii: nonya nabo, iso obeire okong’ainereria, na koonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi, korende Nyasae tamoete ribaga gonkorera bobe.

english: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .
ekegusii: Onye otebeete: ‘Echire nebisembe echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire nebisembe, na ekero atebeete.’ Echire namagwari nachio echio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire namagwari.

english: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father , and given them to me.
ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae akarusia etugo ya iso, akayeng’a.”

english: And Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him.
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, bakaumerana nabamalaika ba Nyasae.

english: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan ; and now I am become two bands .
ekegusii: Inche tingwenereti nonya ng’ake obuya na obwegenwa bwonsi gwankorerete inche, omosomba oo, naki engaki naambogeete orooche rwa Yorodani nigo nabwate enyimbo yoka koboko kwane, na bono nabeire ebiombe bibere.

english: Deliver me , I pray thee, from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
ekegusii: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.

english: And he lodged there that same night ; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother ;
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaraara aroro ase obotuko obwo; agachora korwa ase etugo eria abwate, echio aranyare koa Esau omwabo ebiegwa.

english: Two hundred she goats , and twenty he goats , two hundred ewes , and twenty rams ,
ekegusii: Agachoora chimbori chiaberi amagana abere, ne chigoree emerongo ebere, ne ching’ondi chiaberi amagana abere, ne chimingichi emerongo ebere,

english: Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .
ekegusii: ne chingamia chiare gokamwa emerongo etato, amo ne chimori chiabo, ne chiombe chiaberi emerongo ene, ne chieeri ikomi, ne chitigere chiaberi emerongo ebere, ne chitigere chinsacha ikomi.

english: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants , every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants , Pass over before me , and put a space betwixt drove and drove .
ekegusii: Akabeeka ching’iti echio ase amaboko ’abasomba baye, kera riicho akaribeeka ao, agateebia abasomba baye: “Eta motang’ane, na egati ya kera riicho motige ribaga.”

english: And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
ekegusii: Agachiika omosomba oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: “Esau ominto, ekero araumerane naye, na gokoboria: Noyo ng’o ore? Ng’ai ogochia? Etugo eye otang’anetie, neya ng’o?.

english: Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob’s ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and, behold, also he is behind us .
ekegusii: Erio omoiranerie, omoteebie: Ney’omosomba oo Yakobo, nekeegwa akorenteire aye omonene one Esau; ere omonyene ngotobwatia are korwa magega,”

english: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him.
ekegusii: Agachiika naende oyo o kabere, na oyo o gatato, na abande bonsi abaare gotunyana amaicho, akabateebia: “Moteebie Esau amang’ana ayio ayio ekero mokoumerana nere.

english: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God’s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .
ekegusii: Na ekero Yakobo abarooche akabora: “Oyo nomoganda o Nyasae!” Ase igo, Akaaroka aase aria Mahanaimu + 32:2 Mahanaimu: engencho yaye: ebitwori bibere .

english: And say ye moreover , Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face ; peradventure he will accept of me .
ekegusii: Naende momoteebie: Omosomba oo Yakobo ngotobwatia are korwa magega.” Ere nigo arengereretie ng’a: “Nimwororobie nebiegwa ebi namotang’aneirie; magega yaye nindore obosio bwaye, aande nanyanchere.”

english: So went the present over before him : and himself lodged that night in the company .
ekegusii: Naboigo ebiegwa biria bigatang’anigwa gochia bosio bwaye, ere omonyene akaraara obotuko obwo aase aria atenenetie eema yaye. Yakobo ogokinana na Nyasae, naende okorokwa Israeli

english: And he rose up that night , and took his two wives , and his two womenservants , and his eleven sons , and passed over the ford Jabbok .
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Yakobo akaimoka, akaira abakungu baye babere, na abasomba baye babere abakungu, na abana baye ikomi nomo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yaboki.

english: And he took them , and sent them over the brook , and sent over that he had.
ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaambokia orooche, akaambokia na bionsi ebi areenge nabio.

english: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh ; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him.
ekegusii: Nere omonto oria, ekero arora ng’a tari kobua Yakobo, akamokuna enengo y’ebachwa, akamoteng’eria, kobagendererete gokinana.

english: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me.
ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Ntige ngende, ekiagera bwakiire.” Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Tingokoa ribaga ogende, otaransesenia.”

english: And he said unto him, What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Naki okorokwa?” Akamoiraneria: “Yakobo.”

english: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .
ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma abatomwa batang’ane kogenda ase Esau momura omwabo, baike ensemo ya Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.

english: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel : for I have seen God face to face , and my life is preserved .
ekegusii: Yakobo Akaaroka aase aria Penieli + 32:30 Penieli: engencho yaye: obosio bwa Nyasae , naki nigo ateebete: “Naroranire na Nyasae obosio ase obosio, na obogima bwane bwatoorigwe.”

english: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh .
ekegusii: Erioba rikaorokera Yakobo kagoeta Penueli, akaba ogosegora, ekiagera ateng’eretigwe enengo y’ebachwa.

english: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank , which is upon the hollow of the thigh , unto this day : because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli tibari koria omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa goika reero iga, ekiagera omonto oria namoteng’eretie Yakobo omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa yaye.

english: And he commanded them, saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now:
ekegusii: Akabachiika bateebie Esau omonene oye iga: “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y’obogeni, ense ya Labani goika reero iga;

english: And I have oxen , and asses , flocks , and menservants , and womenservants : and I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find grace in thy sight .
ekegusii: nanyorire chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke. Na bono, omonene one, nigo natomire abanto nkomanyie amang’ana ayio, inyoore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.”

english: And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying , We came to thy brother Esau , and also he cometh to meet thee , and four hundred men with him.
ekegusii: Abatomwa baria, ekero bairanete ase Yakobo bakamoteebia: “Ntwaika o momura omino Esau, ere ngocha are gokorotota ore nabaanto amagana ane (400).”

english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed : and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks , and herds , and the camels , into two bands ;
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaondoka mono na koumata, agaatanana abanto baria baarenge amo nere, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chingamia, bikaba ebiombe bibere,

english: And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
ekegusii: akarengereria ng’a: “Esau karache aumokere ekeombe kie ritang’ani na kogesiria, keria kende nagetooreke.”

english: And Jacob said , O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country , and to thy kindred , and I will deal well with thee:
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agasaba, akabora: “Aye Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka tata, aye Omonene, gwanteebetie ng’a: Oirane gochia seino, na eamate yao, na inche ningokorere amaya.

english: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and, behold, Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .
ekegusii: Yakobo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarigereria, akarora Esau ogocha amo nabaanto amagana ane. Erio agaatanana abana, akaa kera omokungu abaye, Lea, na Raeli, na abakungu baria babere abasomba.

english: And Jacob said , Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Taibo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche obwate ekeegwa eke korwa ase okoboko kwane; naki okorora obosio bwao nigo enga buna okorora obosio bwa Nyasae, ase ogwanchera kwanyancheire inche.

english: Take , I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . And he urged him, and he took it .
ekegusii: Koranche oire ebiegwa ebi nakorenteire, ekiagera Nyasae onkoreire obuya obonge, na inche nimbwate ebing’isaine.” Naboigo ere akaebereria Esau na ere agancha, akabiira.

english: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee.
ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Eta, togende seito, na inche ningotang’ane.”

english: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a abana nebing’werere mbwate, naende chimbori ne ching’ondi nigo chibwate chimanwa chikogonka, ne chiombe boigo. Ching’iti echio chiise koayererigwa ase rituko erimo, nigo chirakwe chionsi.

english: Let my lord , I pray thee, pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .
ekegusii: Koranche, omonene one, oete otang’ane bosio bwane, inche omosomba oo; na inche nindaae ching’iti echio ng’ora ng’ora, buna orogendo rwabo rong’ana, na abana buna chinguru chiabo ching’ana, goika ng’ike bwoo, omonene one, aaria Edomu.”

english: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said , What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Ningotigere abanto bande ase aba inde nabwo.” Korende Yakobo akairaneria: “Bakore ki? Otatiga ndore ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene one.”

english: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Esau akabwatia enchera, akairana gochia Edomu.

english: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth , and built him an house , and made booths for his cattle : therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akagenderera, agaika Sukoti, akeagachera enyomba, akaagachera na amaicho aye ebigutu. Ase igo, aase aria akarokwa Sukoti.

english: And Jacob came to Shalem , a city of Shechem , which is in the land of Canaan , when he came from Padan-aram ; and pitched his tent before the city .
ekegusii: Yakobo kairanire korwa Padan‐Aramu, agaika buya ase omorembe ase Sekemu, omochie omonene bw’ense ya Kaanani, agatenenia eema yaye isiko y’omochie oyio.

english: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
ekegusii: Akabeeka abakungu baria abasomba amo nabana babo batang’ane, na Lea amo nabana baye korwa magega yabo, na Raeli na Yusufu akababeeka magega kegima.

english: And he erected there an altar , and called it El-elohe-Israel .
ekegusii: Akaagacha agwo egesasiimero, agakeroka Eli‐Elohe‐Israeli.

english: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
ekegusii: Ere omonyene agatang’ana bosio bwabo, akaba okona‐gotung’ama inse chintunda isano na ibere goika agaika ase oyomwabo.

english: And Esau ran to meet him , and embraced him, and fell on his neck , and kissed him : and they wept .
ekegusii: Esau akaminyoka gochia komorotota, akamoboania rigoti riaye, na komoagata, barabwo bakareererana.

english: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children ; and said , Who are those with thee? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .
ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora abakungu na abana, akamobooria: “Aba nabang’o more komo?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana Nyasae ang’eire inche, omosomba oo, ase obuya bwaye.”

english: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .
ekegusii: Erio abakungu baria abasomba bagasuka gochia ang’e, kera oyomo nabana baye, bagatung’ama inse.

english: And Leah also with her children came near , and bowed themselves : and after came Joseph near and Rachel , and they bowed themselves.
ekegusii: Lea nere boigo agasuka gochia ang’e amo n’abana baye, nabarabwo bagatung’ama inse. Magega kegima Yusufu na Raeli bagasuka gochia ang’e, nabarabwo boigo bagatung’ama inse.

english: And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .
ekegusii: Naende Esau akamobooria: “Emeganda eye yonsi twaumerana gochia aa, neya ki?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Engencho yaye inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omonene one.”

english: And Esau said , I have enough , my brother ; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria: “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”

english: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .
ekegusii: Bono Dina, omoiseke o Lea, oyio Lea aiborerete Yakobo, akagenda kororana nabaiseke b’ense eria.

english: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you ; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
ekegusii: Inwe nabo moramenye egati yaito, aiga ase ense yaito ribaga ndireo ase more, moramenye na koonchoreria, mwenyorere enibo.”

english: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .
ekegusii: Sekemu agateebia ise Dina na bamura bamwabo: “Nyanchere aya naboria aase more, kende gionsi moramboorie nimbae.

english: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife .
ekegusii: Mboorie enibo ende yonsi na ebiegwa boigo, nimbae buna moraganie, kogicha mong’e omoiseke oyo abe mokane.”

english: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :
ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Yakobo bakairaneria Sekemu na Hamori ise ase okong’ainereria, ekiagera konya osaririe Dina, omoiseke omwabo.

english: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised ; for that were a reproach unto us:
ekegusii: Bakairaneria: “Titokonyara gokora ring’ana eri, komoa omonto otaarogeti, omoiseke ominto, ekiagera ayio nigo arabe aya obosooku ase tore.

english: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised ;
ekegusii: Natonyare gwancha okoboria kwaino ase ring’ana erimo rioka, naende nario eri: Komoranche mobe buna intwe, kera omonto omosacha ore asemore aarokigwe.

english: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people .
ekegusii: Erio ’natobae abaiseke baito, na intwe toire abaino, tomenye amo, tobe abanto abamo.

english: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised ; then will we take our daughter , and we will be gone .
ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke oito aa, togende nere.”

english: And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor’s son .
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akagwenera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu.

english: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
ekegusii: Omomura oyio tatebana gokora ring’ana riria, ekiagera omoiseke oria o Yakobo konya omogweneire. Bono Sekemu nigo asikire kobua abande bonsi ase eamate yabo.

english: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , prince of the country , saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her .
ekegusii: Ekero Sekemu, omwana o Hamori Omohivi, omonene bw’ense eria, amorooche, akamobwata, akaba nere, akamosareria obwekungi bwaye.

english: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase igo, Hamori na Sekemu, omomura oye, bakagenda ase egeita ki’omochie obo, bagakwana nabaanto babo, bakabateebia,

english: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein; for the land , behold, it is large enough for them ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .
ekegusii: “Abanto aba babeire abasani baito, tiga bamenye ase ense yaito, babe abaonchoreria, ekiagera ense eye nenene, netoisane twensi, intwe amo na barabwo. Intwe ntonyuomerane na barabwo.

english: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .
ekegusii: Barabwo banchire komenya seito babe obomo naintwe, korende mbaganetie tokore ring’ana erimo, nario eri, ng’a kera omosacha ore ase tore aarokigwe buna barabwo baarogete.

english: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
ekegusii: Amaicho abo, na enibo yabo, na etugo yabo yonsi, inee, tibikoba ebiaito? Tiga twancherane nabarabwo rioka, bamenye aa seito.”

english: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oria, bakaigwera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu, na kera omosacha oyomenyeteo akaarokigwa. Abamura ba Yakobo bagoakana abanto ba Sekemu egesiomba

english: And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah’s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero abwo baarogete baarenge koromwa mono, abamura babere ba Yakobo, Simioni na Lawi, bamura ba ng’ina omo na Dina, bakaimoka nemeyio ya birende, bagasoa ase omochie ime mobosokano, bagaita abasacha bonsi abaarengeo.

english: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house , and went out .
ekegusii: Bagaita Hamori amo na Sekemu momura oye nemeyio ya birende, bakarusia Dina omwabo mwa Sekemu, bakagenda nere.

english: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .
ekegusii: Erio abamura bande ba Yakobo bagachiera abwo baitetwe na bagasakora omochie, ekiagera konya basaririe omoiseke omwabo;

english: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,
ekegusii: bakaira ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, na bionsi ebiareenge ase omochie ime, na bionsi ebiareenge ase emegondo boigo.

english: And all their wealth , and all their little ones , and their wives took they captive , and spoiled even all that was in the house .
ekegusii: Bagasakora enibo yabo yonsi, na abana babo, na abakungu babo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase chinyomba bakabiira.

english: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .
ekegusii: Korende magega y’ayio agakorera Dina, omoiseke oyio o Yakobo, buya, akamwancha na gokwana nere amang’ana amaya.

english: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Simioni na Lawi: “Inwe mwambekire ase emechando, mwankorire ogotioka okobe egati-gati y’abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense eye, Abakaanani na Abaperisi. Inche na abanto baane nabake tore; barabwo baise gosangererekana na kong’umokera nigo barang’ite na gonsiria amo nabaanto baane.”

english: And they said , Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot ?
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Nabo barabwo bagwenerete bakorere omoiseke ominto buna omokungu omotayayi?”

english: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor , saying , Get me this damsel to wife .
ekegusii: Sekemu agakwana na Hamori ise, akamoteebia: “Mborerie omoiseke oyo abe mokane!”

english: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo achia koigwa ng’a Sekemu osaririe Dina, omoiseke oye, abamura baye ngetii baarenge korisia, Ase igo Yakobo agakira‐kiri goika bakairana inka.

english: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
ekegusii: Hamori, ise Sekemu, akaimoka akagenda o Yakobo gokwana nere.

english: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved , and they were very wroth , because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter ; which thing ought not to be done .
ekegusii: Abamura ba Yakobo, ekero bachia koigwa ayio, bagacha korwa getii, bare nobororo na ekeririanda ekenene mono, ekiagera Sekemu akorete obokayayu ase Abaisraeli ase okomotachera inse omoiseke o Yakobo, ring’ana ritagwenerete gokoreka.

english: And Hamor communed with them, saying , The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter : I pray you give her him to wife .
ekegusii: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, bono komoranche, momomoe amonyuome.

english: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
ekegusii: Tonyuomerane intwe nainwe, motoe abaiseke baino, naintwe tobae abaito.

english: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .
ekegusii: Na ense eye naete Aburaamu na Isaka, ninkoyee aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao.”

english: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaimoka akagenda igoro, akarwa asare, agwo ase areenge gokwana nere.

english: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el .
ekegusii: Igo Yakobo akaaroka aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere Beteli. Ogokwa kwa Raeli

english: And they journeyed from Beth-el ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .
ekegusii: Erio bagachaaka orogendo rwabo korwa Beteli, ekero batigairie orogendo oroke baike Efarati, Raeli agachaaka kobina ase okoibora, akaba nobokong’u bw’okoibora.

english: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
ekegusii: Ekero areenge koromwa mono, omoiboria akamoteebia: “Toondoka, ekiagera naende nomwana omoisia oraibore.”

english: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing , (for she died ) that she called his name Ben-oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
ekegusii: Agwo akaba okogireka ase ogokwa; na ekero areenge ang’e ase ogokwa, Akamoroka omwana oyio Ben‐Oni + 35:18 Ben‐Oni: engencho yaye: omwana omomura bw’emechando yane , korende ise akamoroka Benjamini. + 35:18 Benjamini: engencho yaye: omwana omomura bw’okoboko kwane gw’okorio (1 Amg 1:38-42) (1 Amg 1:43-54)

english: And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth-lehem .
ekegusii: Erio Raeli agakwa, agatindekwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.

english: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia abanto baye amo naabwo bonsi baarenge komo: “Rusia emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni b’ebisaku, ebi mobwate ase egati yaino, mwesibie inwe abanyene, moonchorerie chianga chiaino.

english: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day .
ekegusii: Na Yakobo agatenenia rigena ri’ekeinyorio ase embeera ya Raeli, nao rire goika reero iga.

english: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
ekegusii: Erio Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, agatenenia eema yaye ng’umbu y’omoorobiri o Ederi. Abamura ba Yakobo

english: The sons of Leah ; Reuben , Jacob’s firstborn , and Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Zebulun :
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lea nabwo aba: Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Yakobo, na Simioni, na Lawi, na Yuda, na Isakaru, na Sabuloni.

english: The sons of Rachel ; Joseph , and Benjamin :
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.

english: And the sons of Bilhah , Rachel’s handmaid ; Dan , and Naphtali :
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bilia, omoiseke omosomba o Raeli, nabwo Dani na Nafutali.

english: And the sons of Zilpah , Leah’s handmaid ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Padan-aram .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Silpa, omoiseke omosomba o Lea, nabwo Gadi na Aseri. Aba nabwo abana abamura Yakobo aiboreretwe agwo Padan‐Aramu. Ogokwa kwa Isaka

english: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years .
ekegusii: Isaka nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato (180).

english: And Isaac gave up the ghost , and died , and was gathered unto his people , being old and full of days : and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka ero agakwa, agasangerereka amo nabaanto baye, ore omogotu kegima, omonto bw’emiaka emenge, na abamura baye, Esau na Yakobo, bakamotindeka.

english: And let us arise , and go up to Beth-el ; and I will make there an altar unto God , who answered me in the day of my distress , and was with me in the way which I went .
ekegusii: Toimoke totiire gochia Beteli, erinde ing’agachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae oyonyigwete ekero keria nareenge nobokong’u, akaba amo nainche ase orogendo rwane rwonsi.”

english: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaa Yakobo emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni bionsi ebio babwate, na ebigera babeegete ase amato abo, na Yakobo akabitindeka inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni, + 35:4 Omwaloni: oyo nomote (omwaloni — Kiswahili) gose onga buna onde okorokwa Omoaluni (ase ekegusii). oyorenge ang’e na Sekemu.

english: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
ekegusii: Ekero baimogete kogenda orogendo rwabo, okoondokia gokarua ase Nyasae, gokabwata abanto b’emechie eria yabaetanaine; Ase igo tibanyara komonyookia basinto ba Yakobo.

english: So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth-el , he and all the people that were with him.
ekegusii: Yakobo amo nabwo bonsi baarenge nere bagaika omochie o Lusu, Omochie oyio naende noro okorokwa Beteli, oyio ore ime y’ense ya Kaanani

english: And he built there an altar , and called the place El-beth-el : because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother .
ekegusii: Agwo akaagacha egesasiimero, Akaaroka aase aria Eli‐Beteli + 35:7 Eli‐Beteli: engencho yaye: Nyasae o Beteli (1 Amg 2:1-2) (1 Amg 1:34-37) , ekiagera agwo nao Nyasae aorokerete Yakobo, ekero areenge gotama korwa ase oyomwabo.

english: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died , and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak : and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth .
ekegusii: Agwo Debora, omoreri o Rebeka, agakwa, agatindekwa inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni. Aase agwo akarokwa Aloni‐Bakuti.

english: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram , and blessed him.
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae akaorokera Yakobo, ekero Yakobo areenge korwa Padan‐Aramu, Nyasae akamosesenia.

english: Now these are the generations of Esau , who is Edom .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau, nere Edomu.

english: These are the names of Esau’s sons ; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau , Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau .
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta a basinto b’Esau: Elifasi, omomura o Ada moga Esau, na Reueli, omomura o Basemati moga Esau.

english: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman , Omar , Zepho , and Gatam , and Kenaz .
ekegusii: Na basinto b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, na Sefo, na Gatamu, na Kenasi.

english: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son ; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek : these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife .
ekegusii: Timuna nigo areenge omokungu o sere‐sere o Elifasi, mosinto bw’Esau. Ere akaiborera Elifasi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baareenge abachokoro abamura b’Ada moga Esau.

english: And these are the sons of Reuel ; Nahath , and Zerah , Shammah , and Mizzah : these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Reueli: Nahati, na Zera, na Sama, na Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

english: And these were the sons of Aholibamah , the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon , Esau’s wife : and she bare to Esau Jeush , and Jaalam , and Korah .
ekegusii: Na abana aba nabwo abamura ba Oholibama, moga Esau mosubati o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni: Ere akaiborera Esau Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora.

english: These were dukes of the sons of Esau : the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau ; duke Teman , duke Omar , duke Zepho , duke Kenaz ,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Esau. Basinto b’Elifasi, omomura omotangi bw’Esau, nabwo aba: Omogambi Temani, na omogambi Omari, na omogambi Sefo, na omogambi Kenasi,

english: Duke Korah , duke Gatam , and duke Amalek : these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom ; these were the sons of Adah .
ekegusii: na omogambi Kora, na omogambi Gatamu, na omogambi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Elifasi, ase ense y’Edomu. Barabwo nabachokoro abamura b’Ada.

english: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son ; duke Nahath , duke Zerah , duke Shammah , duke Mizzah : these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom ; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

english: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife ; duke Jeush , duke Jaalam , duke Korah : these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah , Esau’s wife .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo abamura b’Oholibama, moga Esau: Omogambi Yeusi, na omogambi Yalamu, na omogambi Kora. Aba nabwo abagaambi baiboretwe na Oholibama, mosubati o Ana moga Esau.

english: These are the sons of Esau , who is Edom , and these are their dukes .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto b’Esau, nere Edomu; naba nabwo abagaambi babo. Ororeeria rwa Edomu

english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite , who inhabited the land ; Lotan , and Shobal , and Zibeon , and Anah ,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Edomu Omohori, ababiare b’ense eria: Lotani, na Sobali, na Sibeoni, na Ana,

english: And Dishon , and Ezer , and Dishan : these are the dukes of the Horites , the children of Seir in the land of Edom .
ekegusii: na Dishoni, na Eseri, na Disani. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi b’Abahori, basinto ba Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.

english: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam ; and Lotan’s sister was Timna .
ekegusii: Na basinto ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Hemamu, na mosubati omwabo Lotani nigo areenge korokwa Timuna.

english: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan , and Manahath , and Ebal , Shepho , and Onam .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sobali: Alivani, na Manahati, na Sefo, na Onamu.

english: And these are the children of Zibeon ; both Ajah , and Anah : this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness , as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sibeoni: Aya na Ana. Ana oyo nere onyorete chinsoko chi’amaache are morero, ase erooro, ekero areenge korisia chitigere chia Sibeoni ise.

english: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon , and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah .
ekegusii: Na mosinto o Ana nere Dishoni, na omoiseke o Ana nere Oholibama.

english: And these are the children of Dishon ; Hemdan , and Eshban , and Ithran , and Cheran .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Dishoni: Hemudani, na Esibani, na Itirani, na Kerani.

english: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan , and Zaavan , and Akan .
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto b’Eseri: Bilihani, na Sawani, na Akani.

english: The children of Dishan are these; Uz , and Aran .
ekegusii: Na basinto ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.

english: These are the dukes that came of the Horites ; duke Lotan , duke Shobal , duke Zibeon , duke Anah ,
ekegusii: Na abagaambi barwete ase Abahori nabwo aba: Omogambi Lotani, na omogambi Sobali, na omogambi Sibeoni, na omogambi Ana,

english: Duke Dishon , duke Ezer , duke Dishan : these are the dukes that came of Hori , among their dukes in the land of Seir .
ekegusii: na omogambi Dishoni, na omogambi Eseri, na omogambi Disani. Aba nabwo abagaambi b’Abahori, koreng’ana nebisaku biabo, ase ense ya Edomu. Abarwoti b’Edomu

english: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom , before there reigned any king over the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Na abarwoti abagamberete ense y’Edomu ritang’ani konya morwoti onde bwensi ataragaambera Abaisraeli nabwo aba:

english: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom : and the name of his city was Dinhabah .
ekegusii: Bela, mosinto o Beori, akaba okogaamba ase ense y’Edomu, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Dinihaba.

english: And Bela died , and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Bela agakwa, na Yobabu mosinto o Zera, oyo orwete Bosira, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And Jobab died , and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Yobabu nere agakwa, na Husamu bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And Husham died , and Hadad the son of Bedad , who smote Midian in the field of Moab , reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith .
ekegusii: Husamu nere agakwa, na Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye; oyo nere obuete Abamidiani, ase ense ya Moabu na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Aviti.

english: And Hadad died , and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Hadadi nere agakwa, na Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And Samlah died , and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Samula nere agakwa, na Saulo, oyo orwete Rehoboti, omochie orenge orooche ensemo, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And Saul died , and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
ekegusii: Saulo nere agakwa, na Baali‐Hanani mosinto o Akibori akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

english: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died , and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau ; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel , the daughter of Matred , the daughter of Mezahab .
ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani, mosinto o Akibori, nere agakwa, na Hadari akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Pau, na mokaye nigo areenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi, mosubati o Mesahabu.

english: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz ; and Bashemath bare Reuel ;
ekegusii: Ada akamoiborera Esau omwana okorokwa Elifasi, na Basemati akaibora Reueli,

english: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau , according to their families , after their places , by their names ; duke Timnah , duke Alvah , duke Jetheth ,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rwa Esau, gotunyana chiamate chiabo, na aase bamenyete nigo are namarieta abo: Omogambi Timuna, na omogambi Aliva, na omogambi Yeteti,

english: Duke Magdiel , duke Iram : these be the dukes of Edom , according to their habitations in the land of their possession : he is Esau the father of the Edomites .
ekegusii: na omogambi Magadieli, na omogambi Iramu. Aba nabwo abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rw’Edomu, koreng’ana buna bamenyete chinsemo chiabo ase ense eria bairete ekaba eyabo. (Esau nere sokoro bw’Abaedomu).

english: And Aholibamah bare Jeush , and Jaalam , and Korah : these are the sons of Esau , which were born unto him in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: na Oholibama akaibora Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora. Aba nabwo abana abamura Esau aiboreretwe ase ense ya Kaanani.

english: And Esau took his wives , and his sons , and his daughters , and all the persons of his house , and his cattle , and all his beasts , and all his substance , which he had got in the land of Canaan ; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob .
ekegusii: Erio Esau akaimokia abakungu baye, na abana baye abamura na abaiseke, na abanto bonsi ababwate abwo bwoye, ne chiombe chiaye, ne ching’iti chiaye chionsi echi atugete, na enibo yaye yonsi eyaniberete ase ense ya Kaanani; akagenda agaika ase ense yareenge aare korwa ase Yakobo omwabo.

english: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together ; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle .
ekegusii: Ekiagera babwate enibo enyinge tibare konyara komenya amo; na ense eria tiyare kobaisana bamenye babere bonsi ne chitugo chiabo.

english: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir : Esau is Edom .
ekegusii: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.

english: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir :
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau ise Edomu, ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.

english: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Yakobo akaba okomenya ase ense y’Abakaanani, eyio ase ise nere areenge omenyete buna omomenyi.

english: And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?
ekegusii: Korende ekero ateebetie ise na bamura bamwabo amang’ana ayio, ise akamotogonyera, akamobooria: “nkoroota ki okwo okoroota? Inee! Inche na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amaene, nigo torache togotugamere togosasime aye?”

english: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem .
ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bakagenda korisia amaicho a ise ang’e na Sekemu.

english: And Israel said unto Joseph , Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem ? come , and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I .
ekegusii: Na Israeli akarangeria Yusufu, akamoteebia: “Inee! Abamino tibakari korisia amaicho aaria Sekemu? Inchuo bono ngotome gochia ase bakare.” Yusufu agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

english: And he said to him, Go , I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren , and well with the flocks ; and bring me word again . So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron , and he came to Shechem .
ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: “Genda bono orore gose abamino mbuya bare amo namaicho, erinde ondetere amang’ana.” Ase igo, akamotoma korwa ase omweya o Heburoni, akageenda agaika Sekemu;

english: And a certain man found him , and, behold, he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou?
ekegusii: omonto oyomo akamonyora, ekero areenge kona‐goetanana ase erooro, na omonto oyio akamobooria: “Inki okorigia?”

english: And he said , I seek my brethren : tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks .
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Nabaminto nkorigia; koranche nteebie aase bakorisia amaicho.”

english: And the man said , They are departed hence ; for I heard them say , Let us go to Dothan . And Joseph went after his brethren , and found them in Dothan .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akabateebia: “Barure aa, bachiire, naki nigo nabaigwa bagoteebania: Tiga togende Dotani.” Erio Yusufu akababwatia korwa magega, akabanyora Dotani.

english: And when they saw him afar off , even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamorora ere okare egeka, ritang’ani konya ataraika ang’e asebare, bakagaamba buna bamoite.

english: And they said one to another , Behold, this dreamer cometh .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Omonyandooto oyio ogocha.

english: These are the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brethren ; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah , and with the sons of Zilpah , his father’s wives : and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano bw’ororeeria rwa Yakobo. Yusufu, ekero aikire emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, nigo areenge korisia amaicho amo na bamura bamwabo. Omosae oyio akaba ore amo nabamura bamwabo, abana ba Bilia na Silpa, abakungu ba ise. Yusufu akaba okorentera ise amang’ana igoro y’ogokora kwabo okobe.

english: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit , and we will say , Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams .
ekegusii: Bono ntore ne ribaga; tiga tomoite, tomorute ase engoro eyemo ye chingoro chire aa, erio toteebe ng’a neng’iti y’orosana yamoriete, na torore chindoto echio chiaye buna chirabe.”

english: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands ; and said , Let us not kill him.
ekegusii: Rubeni ekero ayaigwete, akarigia komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, akabakania: “Yaya! Titomoita akwe.”

english: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia: “Timoitera amanyinga aye; morute ase engoro eyemo y’echi chire aa ase erooro, korende timorambora amaboko aino gochia asare ase okomoita.” Ere nigo abateebetie igo, erinde anyare komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, amoiranie ase ise.

english: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him;
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yusufu achia goika ase abamwabo, barabwo bakamorusia eanga eria engiya entambe abeegete,

english: And they took him, and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it.
ekegusii: bakamobwata, bakamoruta engoro ime. Engoro eyio nigo yareenge bosa, mache tareengeo.

english: And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .
ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa inse koragera; bagachia koimokia amaiso abo korigereria, bakarora omoganda bw’Abaisumaeli ogocha korwa Gileadi. Barabwo nigo baare ne chingamia chiabo, chibogoretie ubani, na amaguta akogwenia, na manemane, ase orogendo rwabo baare kogenda Misiri.

english: And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?
ekegusii: Agwo Yuda agateebia abamwabo: “Inki eratogwenere toite oyominto na kobisa ogokwa kwaye?

english: Come , and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites , and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh . And his brethren were content .
ekegusii: Tiga tomoonie ase Abaisumaeli aba, erinde titobaisa komoita namaboko aito, ekiagera noyominto, toiboire komo.” Na abamwabo bagancherana nere.

english: And Reuben returned unto the pit ; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit ; and he rent his clothes .
ekegusii: Rubeni agachia koirana korigereria ase engoro eria, akanyora Yusufu taiyo ase engoro, ere agatandora chianga chiaye,

english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children , because he was the son of his old age : and he made him a coat of many colours .
ekegusii: Bono Israeli nigo anchete Yusufu kobua abana baye bande bonsi, ekiagera nigo areenge omwana oye bw’obogotu. Akamoroiseria eanga engiya entambe.

english: And he returned unto his brethren , and said , The child is not; and I, whither shall I go ?
ekegusii: akeonchora gochia ase abamwabo, akabateebia: “Omwana timonyoreti ase engoro. Ng’ai rende nkogenda?”

english: And they took Joseph’s coat , and killed a kid of the goats , and dipped the coat in the blood ;
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia eanga ya Yusufu, na bakanyenya embori, bakaimokia eanga eria, bakayetobeka ase amanyinga;

english: And they sent the coat of many colours , and they brought it to their father ; and said , This have we found : know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.
ekegusii: bakagenda n’eanga eria entambe bakayeirera ise, bakamobateebia: “Yemanye eanga eye gose ney’omwana oo gose tari ero.”

english: And he knew it , and said , It is my son’s coat ; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces .
ekegusii: Yakobo akayemanya, akabora: “Neanga y’omwana one, amaene neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitire; Yusufu orirwe!”

english: And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia kenema kiaye, akaba okomoreera omwana oye engaki entambe.

english: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him.
ekegusii: Abana baye, abamura na abaiseke bonsi, bakaimoka gochia komoremia, korende akaanga, taremigwa, agateeba: “Yaya, goika inkwe, ngende inse ase oboina nkona‐komoreera omwana one.” Ise akaba okona‐kweumia.

english: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh’s , and captain of the guard .
ekegusii: Na Abamidiani baria bakamoonia aaria Misiri ase Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande.

english: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
ekegusii: Abamwabo ekero barooche ng’a ise nigo amwanchete ere kobua abamwabo bonsi, barabwo bakamogecha, tibare gokwana amang’ana y’omorembe amo nere.

english: And Joseph dreamed a dream , and he told it his brethren : and they hated him yet the more .
ekegusii: Yusufu akaroota chindoto, na ekero ateebetie abamwabo chindoto echio, barabwo bakamenta mono komogecha.

english: And he said unto them, Hear , I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed :
ekegusii: Yusufu akabateebia: “Montegerere, moigwe okoroota oko narootete.

english: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field , and, lo, my sheaf arose , and also stood upright ; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .
ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a intwe nigo twareenge mogondo tokoboa emesaima y’endagera, na omosaima one okaimoka ogatenena boronge, na emesaima yaino ekaba ekoyoetanana, egotugama inse ase omosaima one.”

english: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobooria: “Inee! Aye nigo orengereretie ng’a nigo orabe omogambi oito, otogambere?” Ase igo, barabwo bakamenta komogecha mono ase engencho y’okoroota kwaye, na ase engencho y’amang’ana aye.

english: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
ekegusii: Naende akaroota konde, na okwo agateebia abamwabo, akabora: “Moigwe! Inche nigo narootete okoroota konde. Nkarora erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni ikomi nemo bigotugama inse ase obosio bwane.”

english: And it came to pass at that time , that Judah went down from his brethren , and turned in to a certain Adullamite , whose name was Hirah .
ekegusii: Ekaba ase engaki eria Yuda agatigana n’abamwabo, agatirimboka, agaika ase omonto gete Omoadulamu ore korokwa Hira, bakabwatana nere.

english: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD : wherefore he slew him also.
ekegusii: Ayio akorete akaba amabe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Omobui, nere Omonene akamoita.

english: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father’s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house .
ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Tamari, moka momura oye: “Genda omenye buna omoboraka ase omochie o iso goika Sela omwana one akine”; naki nigo oboete ng’a nere nabaise gocha gokwa, buna abamwabo bakwete. Ase igo, Tamari akagenda akamenya o ise. Okomocha kwa Yuda

english: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .
ekegusii: Magega ya amatuko make, moiseke o Sua, moka Yuda, agakwa; Yuda gakoorire okomoreera, agatiira gochia Timuna ase abanachi amarionya be ching’ondi chiaye, amo nomosani oye Hira Omoadulamu.

english: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep .
ekegusii: Ekero Tamari ateebetigwe ng’a ise biara ’nkogenda akare Timuna konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya,

english: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnath ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .
ekegusii: akarusia chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania, akeboyia chianga na gwetuba obosio bwaye, agaikaransa geita ki’Enaimu, ang’e nenchera ekogenda Timuna; naki nigo arooche ng’a Sela obeire omonto omonene, na tamoeiri amotware.

english: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot ; because she had covered her face .
ekegusii: Ekero Yuda amorooche, agakaga ng’a nomokuungu omotayayi, ekiagera nigo atubete obosio bwaye.

english: And he turned unto her by the way , and said , Go to , I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law .) And she said , What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
ekegusii: Yuda akagobera gochia asare enchera ensemo, akamoteebia: “Inyanchere ’mbe naye,” naki tamanyete gose moka momura oye orenge. Tamari akamobooria: “Inki orang’e, erinde osoe ase ’nde?”

english: And he said , I will send thee a kid from the flock . And she said , Wilt thou give me a pledge , till thou send it ?
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Ninche ngotomera emaanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Inee! Inki orang’e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”

english: And he said , What pledge shall I give thee? And she said , Thy signet , and thy bracelets , and thy staff that is in thine hand . And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Ngento ki origetie nkoe kebe intenenera?” Akamoiraneria: “Ebonyi yao ere nekemanyererio, na orokini rwao, na enyimbo yao obwate koboko.” Erio akamobia, akaraara nere, na ere akaba morito.

english: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood .
ekegusii: Erio akaimoka akagenda, akarusia egietubo, akabeeka chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania.

english: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shuah ; and he took her , and went in unto her.
ekegusii: Aroro Yuda akarora moiseke o Sua, omoiseke bw’Omokaanani gete, akamonyuoma. Bakaba bakorara amo,

english: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite , to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand : but he found her not.
ekegusii: Yuda akaa omosani oye Omoadulamu emaanwa egoree airere omokungu oria, erinde ere airanie ebinto biria amoete bibe intenenera, korende tamonyora.

english: Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .
ekegusii: Omoadulamu oria akabooria abanto b’aase aria: “Ng’ai are omokungu oria omotayayi, oyorenge aa Enaimu enchera ensemo?” Bakamokania: “Omokungu omotayayi tana koba aa.”

english: And he returned to Judah , and said , I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said , that there was no harlot in this place .
ekegusii: Ase igo, akairana gochia ase Yuda, akabateebia: “Timonyoreti; naboigo nonya nabaanto b’aase aria nigo bankania ng’a mokuungu motayayi tana kobao.”

english: And Judah said , Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed : behold, I sent this kid , and thou hast not found her.
ekegusii: Yuda akabora: “Tiga atware ebinto ebio namoete bibe intenenera, titobaisa gocha kororekana nobosooku. Rora, namotomerete emaanwa egoree, na aye tikwamonyorete.”

english: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah , saying , Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot ; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom . And Judah said , Bring her forth , and let her be burnt .
ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’emetienyi etato Yuda ateebetigwe ng’a Tamari, moka momura oye, okorire obotomani bw’obotayayi; amo nayio morito are ase obotayayi. Erio Yuda akabora: “Mosokie isiko, asambwe nomorero.”

english: When she was brought forth , she sent to her father in law , saying , By the man , whose these are, am I with child : and she said , Discern , I pray thee, whose are these, the signet , and bracelets , and staff .
ekegusii: Gasokiigwe isiko agatoma abanto ase ise biara, bamoteebie: “Omonto omonyene ebinto ebi, nere ong’ete oborito obo.” Naende akabora: “Manya ebonyi eyio ere nekemanyererio, na orokini oro, na enyimbo eye, gose nebiang’o.”

english: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more.
ekegusii: Erio Yuda akabimanya, akabora: “Ere nomooronge kombua, nigo akora ayio, ekiagera ntamoete Sela, omwana one, amotware.” Erio Yuda tarara nere naende.

english: And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that, behold, twins were in her womb .
ekegusii: Ekero engaki yaye y’okoibora yachia goika, akarorekana ore ne chibarongo enda yaye ime.

english: And it came to pass, when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
ekegusii: Ekero areenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang’ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateeba: “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”

english: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand , that, behold, his brother came out : and she said , How hast thou broken forth ? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez .
ekegusii: Kairanirie okoboko kwaye, rora, oyomwabo akaromeng’ana, agasoka isiko. Erio omoiboria agateeba: “Naki okoromeng’ana ne chinguru iga?” Ase ayio bakamoroka Peresi + 38:29 Peresi: engencho yaye: okoromeng’ana .

english: And she conceived , and bare a son ; and he called his name Er .
ekegusii: na moiseke o Sua akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Eri.

english: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zarah .
ekegusii: Magega yaye oyomwabo agasoka ore neusi embariri koboko kwaye. Nere akarokwa Zera. + 38:30 Zera: engencho yaye aande, ekieni kemonyinga

english: And she conceived again, and bare a son ; and she called his name Onan .
ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Onani.

english: And she yet again conceived , and bare a son ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him.
ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao areenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborerete abana.

english: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .
ekegusii: Na Yuda akanyuomeria Eri, omwana oye omotangi, omokungu ore korokwa Tamari.

english: And Er , Judah’s firstborn , was wicked in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD slew him.
ekegusii: Nere Eri, omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo areenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene akamoita.

english: And Judah said unto Onan , Go in unto thy brother’s wife , and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother .
ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Onani: “Motware moka momura omino, erinde omotenenerie egesaku.”

english: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .
ekegusii: Korende Onani akamanya ng’a abana abwo agochia koibora tibari gochia korokwa abaye. Kera engaki, arekoba na moka momura omwabo, ekero embego y’oroiboro ere nchera gocha, asomora aitera inse, ng’a erio tabaisa goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku.

english: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt ; and Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh , captain of the guard , an Egyptian , bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites , which had brought him down thither.
ekegusii: Bono Yusufu agatirimbokigwa gochia Misiri; na Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande, omonto o Misiri, akamogora korwa ase Abaisumaeli, abwo bamotirimbogetie gochia aroro.

english: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her , or to be with her.
ekegusii: Akaba okonagokwana na Yusufu rituko ase rituko, korende Yusufu tamwanchera baraare komo, gose koba amo.

english: And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business ; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
ekegusii: Ekaba rituko erimo, ekero Yusufu asoete nyomba gokora emeremo yaye, gose monto onde bw’abaanto b’enyomba eria tareengeo,

english: And she caught him by his garment , saying , Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand , and fled , and got him out .
ekegusii: omokungu oria akamobwata eanga yaye eyare kwambara, akabateebia: “Rara nainche.” Korende Yusufu agatigera omokungu oria eanga yaye eyare kwambara, agatama gochia isiko.

english: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and was fled forth ,
ekegusii: Omokungu oria, ekero arooche ng’a Yusufu omotigeire eanga yaye koboko kwaye, na gotama gochia isiko,

english: That she called unto the men of her house , and spake unto them, saying , See , he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice :
ekegusii: akarangeria abanto ba nyomba mwaye, akabateebia: “Rigereria, omosacha one otorenteire omonto oyo Omoiberania ase egati yaito atokorere echeche; nigo acha ase ’nde ng’a araare nainche, na inche nakuura neriogi rinene.

english: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
ekegusii: Na ekero aigwa ng’a nakuurire neriogi rinene, ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”

english: And she laid up his garment by her , until his lord came home .
ekegusii: Akagacha eanga eria goika omosacha oye agacha inka,

english: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
ekegusii: akamoteebia amang’ana ayio ayio, agateeba: “Omoiberania oyo omosomba kwarenta aa nabo asoa ase ’nde gonkorera echeche.

english: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .
ekegusii: Korende ekero nachaka gokuura na goaka eriogi ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.” Yusufu okobekwa echela

english: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him, saying , After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled .
ekegusii: Ekero omonene o Yusufu achia koigwa aya mokaye amoteebirie ng’a: “Aya naro omosomba oo ankorera”, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.

english: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison , a place where the king’s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
ekegusii: Omonene oyio akabwata Yusufu, akamobeka echela ime, aase abasomba b’omorwoti basibire, na ere akaba agwo echela ime.

english: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison ; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it .
ekegusii: Omonene oria akabeeka abasibwa bonsi abwo baarenge echela ime ase amaboko a Yusufu; na onsi ayare gokoreka ase echela, ere akaba okoyakora.

english: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand ; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did , the LORD made it to prosper .
ekegusii: Na omonene oria bw’echela tachia goitaa kende gionsi kiare ase amaboko a Yusufu, ekiagera Omonene nigo areenge amo nere, na ande onsi are gokora, Omonene nigo are koyasesenia.

english: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arooche ng’a Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, ogerire ebinto bionsi biasesenigwe ase amaboko aye.

english: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .
ekegusii: Ase igo,, Yusufu aganchwa mono ase obosio bw’omonene oye Potifari na akamobeka koba omokoreri oye; na ere akamobeka abe omoteneneri bw’enka yaye yonsi, na omorigereria bw’ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.

english: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake ; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio amobegete abe omoteneneri igoro y’enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate. Omonene agasesenia Omomisiri oria ase engencho ya Yusufu, na ogosesenia kw’Omonene gokaba ase ebinto bionsi abwate ase enyomba na emegondo.

english: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand ; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .
ekegusii: Ase igo, agatiga bionsi ebiareenge nabio ase amaboko a Yusufu; gose taba ogwechandera gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera yoka eria areenge koria. Yusufu na moka Potifari Yusufu nigo areenge omonto omerete buya, naende omonyakieni.

english: And it came to pass after these things , that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph ; and she said , Lie with me.
ekegusii: Magega y’engaki gete moka omonene oye akarigereria Yusufu ase okomogania, akamoteebia: “Inchuo oraare nainche!”

english: But he refused , and said unto his master’s wife , Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house , and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand ;
ekegusii: Korende ere akaanga, agateebia moka omonene oye: “Rora, omonene one techandereti gento kende gionsi ase enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate obibekire ase amaboko aane.

english: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?
ekegusii: Onde tari ase enyomba yaye oeire okobua otatiga inche, gose tantangeti gento kende gionsi otatiga aye bweka, ekiagera aye mokaye ore. Naki rende ndanyare gokora ebibe ebinene buna ebi, imomochere Nyasae?”

english: And he said , I heard thy voice in the garden , and I was afraid , because I was naked ; and I hid myself .
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: “Nigo naigwa eriogi riao ase omogondo, noboa ase ayio nebisa ekiagera igo nde getirianda.”

english: And he said , Who told thee that thou wast naked ? Hast thou eaten of the tree , whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat ?
ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria: “Ing’o ogoteebia ng’a ngetirianda ore? Inee! Nkwarire amatunda y’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria?”

english: And the man said , The woman whom thou gavest to be with me , she gave me of the tree , and I did eat .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria: “Omokungu oyo kwang’ete ng’a abe amo nainche, nere ong’ete amatunda y’omote oyio, na inche nkaria.”

english: And the LORD God said unto the serpent , Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle , and above every beast of the field ; upon thy belly shalt thou go , and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life :
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae agateebia eng’iti eria, “Ekiagera gwakorire aya, aye bweka kwaragererigwe kobua ching’iti chionsi; aye nenda oragendere, na orotu orarie buna endagera ase obogima bwao bwonsi.

english: Unto the woman he said , I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception ; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children ; and thy desire shall be to thy husband , and he shall rule over thee.
ekegusii: Akaonchokera omokungu, akamoteebia, “Ninkomentere emechando emeenge ekero okoba morito, na ekero okoibora abana nonyore obororo; nonya nabo okogania kwao nigo korabe ase omosacha oo, na ere nakogaambere.”

english: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field ;
ekegusii: Riroba narikwamere amagwa na amageri, na aye norie okwama kw’ebimeri bi’orosana.

english: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread , till thou return unto the ground ; for out of it wast thou taken : for dust thou art , and unto dust shalt thou return .
ekegusii: Goika okore omokia na goitera ebigeri gokora riroba riame kende gionsi omanye konyora endagera orie; goika oirane ase riroba, ekiagera agwo nao kwarwete. Naki aye norotu, naende noirane ase orotu.”

english: And the woman said unto the serpent , We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden :
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akairaneria eng’iti eria: “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo ’natonyare koyaria

english: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve ; because she was the mother of all living .
ekegusii: Adamu akaaroka mokaye Hawa + 3:20 Hawa: engencho yaye: okoba moyo , ekiagera ere nere ng’ina bw’abare moyo bonsi.

english: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins , and clothed them .
ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaroiseria Adamu na mokaye chingobo chi’amasankwa, erio agwo akababoyia. Adamu na Hawa bagoserigwa korwa ase omogondo o Edeni

english: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden , to till the ground from whence he was taken .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae akamoseeria korwa ase omogondo o Edeni, akamobeka areme riroba agwo ase arwete.

english: So he drove out the man ; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims , and a flaming sword which turned every way , to keep the way of the tree of life .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya moocha y’omogondo o Edeni akabeeka ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, n’omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi. Erio korenda onde bwensi tacha ase omote bw’obogima.

english: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden , God hath said , Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die .
ekegusii: otatiga amatunda y’omote ore mogondo gati-gati. Nyasae nigo atokanetie titoria amatunda korwa ase omote oria gose koyakuna, toise gokora bo nigo torakwe.”

english: And the serpent said unto the woman , Ye shall not surely die :
ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekairaneria omokungu oria “Ayio tari bo ogokwa, timogokwa.

english: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened , and ye shall be as gods , knowing good and evil .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akwanete bo akiagera amanyete ng’a ekero moraarie amatunda y’omote oyio nigo morabwekane Nyasae mobe mokomanya amaya na amabe.”

english: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food , and that it was pleasant to the eyes , and a tree to be desired to make one wise , she took of the fruit thereof , and did eat , and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria agachia korora omote oria buna ore omuya okoriegwa na okogwenera amaiso, na omote oria noyo bw’okoganigwa, ekiagera okobaa okomanya, agatwa amatunda aye, akaria. Erio agwo akairera omosacha oye amatunda ande nere akaria.

english: And the eyes of them both were opened , and they knew that they were naked ; and they sewed fig leaves together , and made themselves aprons .
ekegusii: Erio agwo nyuma ko barire, bakaegwa okomanya bakamanya ng’a ngetirianda bare; erio bagatabora amato y’omoko, bakayasonerania, erio bakeboyia.

english: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day : and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden .
ekegusii: Emogoroba eria bakaigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae ogotaara ase omogondo, erio barabwo bakebisa mogondo gati y’emete.

english: And the LORD God called unto Adam , and said unto him, Where art thou ?
ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria, akamobooria: “Ng’ai ore?”

english: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase engaki gete, magega y’amang’ana ayio, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa bia Farao na omoteneneri oye bw’abaroisia emegati bakamoochera omonene obo, omorwoti o Misiri.

english: And in the vine were three branches : and it was as though it budded , and her blossoms shot forth ; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes :
ekegusii: na omosabibu oyio nigo orenge ne chinsagia isato; bwango ogasomoria, ogasokia ebisicha, na okaama ebisago bi’amasabibu amatobu.

english: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand .
ekegusii: Na egekombe kia Farao nigo nakebwate ase okoboko kwane; nkabogoria amasabibu aria, nkayamitera ase egekombe kia Farao, nkaa Farao egekombe eke koboko kwaye.”

english: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days :
ekegusii: Yusufu akamoteebia: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinsagia echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head , and restore thee unto thy place : and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand , after the former manner when thou wast his butler .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakorusie aiga, akoe ogosika, akoiranie ase emeremo yao, na aye nobe gokomoa egekombe koboko kwaye, buna kware komoa agwo ritang’ani, ekero kwareenge omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa biaye.

english: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness , I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :
ekegusii: Korende ekero oranyore amaya, ong’inyore nainche, ondorere amaabera. Koranche nagosabire onyatore ase Farao, ondusie ase enyomba eye,

english: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews : and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo naibetwe korwa ase ense y’Abaiberania, nonya naa tinkoreti ing’ana rinde riibe riagwenerete kombeeka ase echela.”

english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head :
ekegusii: Ekero omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati arooche ng’a okoonchora okwo nigo kwabeete okuya, agateebia Yusufu: “Nainche boigo nigo narootete. Nkarora ng’a inyetwegete chinteru isato chire nemegati emerabu ase omotwe one.

english: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh ; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head .
ekegusii: Ase oroteru rwa igoro kegima yarengeo emegati y’ebisaku ao ao yaroiseretigwe Farao, korende chinyoni chigaacha chikayeria korwa ase oroteru igoro, oro netwegete ase omotwe one.”

english: And Joseph answered and said , This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days :
ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.

english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakoimokie, agosunge ase omote igoro ne chinyoni nachirie chinyama chi’omobere oo.”

english: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers , against the chief of the butlers , and against the chief of the bakers .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Farao akabeigwa n’abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati.

english: And it came to pass the third day , which was Pharaoh’s birthday , that he made a feast unto all his servants : and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants .
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato, erio riaare ri’okoinyora okoiborwa gwa Farao, ere agakorera abasomba baye bonsi omoyega, akabarusia echela baria babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase egati y’abasomba baye.

english: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand :
ekegusii: Akairania omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa ase emeremo yaye y’obonyoisia, na ere akaba okomoa Farao egekombe ase okoboko kwaye;

english: But he hanged the chief baker : as Joseph had interpreted to them.
ekegusii: korende omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati ere akamosunga ase omote igoro, buna Yusufu abanorete chingencho chie chindoto chiabo.

english: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph , but forgat him.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo oyio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa taba okoinyora Yusufu, korende akamweba.

english: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
ekegusii: Akababeeka barendwe ase enyomba yomotang’ani bw’abarendi, ase echela eyio Yusufu nere asibetwe.

english: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarendi akamobeka Yusufu abe okobarigereria na kobakorera, na barabwo bakabeera ase egesibo ase engaki enke.

english: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obomo bonsi babere, omoteneneri oria bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati b’omorwoti o Misiri, abwo basibetwe echela, bakaba bakoroota chindoto. Kera oyomo akaroota okoroota kwaye okware nengencho eng’ao korwa ase okw’oyonde.

english: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad .
ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu agendete mambia kobarigereria akabanyora nigo baichanete.

english: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house , saying , Wherefore look ye so sadly to day ?
ekegusii: Ase igo, akabooria abateneneri abwo ba Farao, abaarenge amo nere ase egesibo ase enyomba y’omonene oye, akabora: “Naki moichaanete iga reero?”
