english: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarootete chindoto, na onde tari oranyare kogoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiaito.” Yusufu akabateebia: “Nigoro ya Nyasae kobateebia engencho yaye. Komoranche, mochinteebie.”

english: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him, In my dream , behold, a vine was before me ;
ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Yusufu okoroota kwaye, akabora: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche omosabibu ore ase obosio bwane,

english: And it came to pass at the end of two full years , that Pharaoh dreamed : and, behold, he stood by the river .
ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka ebere koyaetire Farao akaroota chindoto ng’a oteneine engegu y’orooche rwa Naeli.

english: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants , and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house , both me and the chief baker :
ekegusii: Ekero aye Farao gwatobeete intwe abasomba bao, na gotosiekera, inche na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase echela eyere ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’abarendi,

english: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .
ekegusii: intwe ase obotuko obomo tokaroota chindoto twensi, kera oyomo okoroota kwaye kore nengencho yaye eng’ao.

english: And there was there with us a young man , an Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard ; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams ; to each man according to his dream he did interpret .
ekegusii: Agwo amo naintwe narengeo omomura oyomo Omoiberania, omosomba bw’omotang’ani bw’abarendi. Tokamoteebia chindoto chiaito, na ere agatoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiria, agatobanorera kera oyomo engencho y’okoroota kwaye.

english: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .
ekegusii: Na buna ere atoteebetie engencho ye chindoto chiaito, naboigo abeete; inche nkairanigwa ase emeremo yane, na oria onde agasungwa ase omote igoro.”

english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Erio Farao agatoma abanto korangeria Yusufu. Bakamorenta bwango korwa ase echela, na ere akagingirwa, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye, akagenda ase obosio bwa Farao.

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Nigo narota okoroota, gose onde tari oranyare gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ng’a gokwaigure chindoto, nabo okomanya engencho ye chindoto echio.”

english: And Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , It is not in me : God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace .
ekegusii: Yusufu akairaneria Farao, akabora: “Tari inche, korende Nyasae orakoe aye Farao okoiraneria kw’omorembe.”

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold, I stood upon the bank of the river :
ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche ng’a nteneine ase engegu y’orooche.

english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured ; and they fed in a meadow :
ekegusii: Nkarora chiombe isano na ibere, chinoru chingiya mono, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka;

english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :
ekegusii: naende nkarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega. Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri tinana korora chiombe chimbe buna echio.

english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed ; and they fed in a meadow .
ekegusii: Akarora chiombe isano na ibere, chingiya mono chinoru, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka.

english: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :
ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiombe chiria isano na ibere chi’eritang’ani, chiare chingiya chinoru,

english: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .
ekegusii: korende ekero chiachirire tichiarorekana ng’a nchiachiria, nkarora nabo chire buna chiare ritang’ani. Erio nkaboka.

english: And I saw in my dream , and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk , full and good :
ekegusii: Naende konararire nkarora ase okoroota kwane ebigara ebinene ebinoru bitano na bibere, bikinete ase oroboba oromo;

english: And, behold, seven ears , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them :
ekegusii: na ebigara ebiomo ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka korwa magega yabo,

english: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears : and I told this unto the magicians ; but there was none that could declare it to me.
ekegusii: na ebigara biria ebireu bikaria biria ebinoru bitano na bibere. Inche ngateebia abaringoria, korende onde tari onyarete gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane.”

english: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia Farao: “Chindoto chiao, aye Farao, nigo chire echimo. Nyasae okworokirie, aye Farao, aya agochia gokora iga bwango.

english: The seven good kine are seven years ; and the seven good ears are seven years : the dream is one .
ekegusii: Chiombe chiria chingiya isano na ibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria ebiya bitano na bibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere; chindoto echio nechimo.

english: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years ; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine .
ekegusii: Ne chiombe chiria isano na ibere chimbe chindeu, chiachitunyanete chiria chinoru, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria bitano na bibere bitaamete, biasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere y’enchara.

english: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Aya naro buna nagoteebia aye Farao, ng’a Nyasae okworokirie aya agochia gokora iga bwango.

english: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :
ekegusii: Rora, ngochi-gocha ere emiaka etano na ebere y’omoigoto ase ense yonsi ya Misiri,

english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river , ill favoured and leanfleshed ; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river .
ekegusii: Naende akarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega, chigatenena ase engegu y’orooche ang’e nase chiombe chiria chinde.

english: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine ; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt ; and the famine shall consume the land ;
ekegusii: korende magega y’ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y’enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.

english: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following ; for it shall be very grievous .
ekegusii: Omoigoto oria tokoinyorwa ase ense eye, ase engencho y’enchara eye erache gocha korwa magega yaye, ekiagera nigo erabe endito mono.

english: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
ekegusii: Na bono Farao, okoroota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikiire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.

english: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.

english: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .
ekegusii: Na bono Farao, aya naro ogwenerete okore: Obeke abateneneri igoro y’ense eye bachoge ensemo ya isano y’endagera ase ense ya Misiri ase emiaka eye etano na ebere y’omoigoto.

english: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .
ekegusii: Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.

english: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt ; that the land perish not through the famine .
ekegusii: Na endagera eye egachwe eche koegwa abanto emiaka eye etano na ebere y’enchara, erache gocha ase ense ya Misiri, abanto tibaabaisa gocha gosira ase enchara eyio.” Yusufu okoimokigwa konyora obonene ase Misiri

english: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.

english: And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?
ekegusii: Farao akabooria abasomba baye: “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang’ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na obong’aini buna aye.

english: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine . So Pharaoh awoke .
ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Rora nakobekire aye igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

english: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Akamoriinia ase egari yaye ya kabere y’oborwoti. Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bakobora: “Tung’ama inse!” Naboigo akamobeka abe omogambi bw’ense yonsi ya Misiri.

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Naende Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”

english: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah ; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On . And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Farao Akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.

english: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu, ekero asoete gokorera Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato. Na Yusufu akarua ase obosio bwa Farao, agaetanana ase ense yonsi ya Misri.

english: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,

english: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years , which were in the land of Egypt , and laid up the food in the cities : the food of the field , which was round about every city , laid he up in the same .
ekegusii: na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.

english: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering ; for it was without number .
ekegusii: Yusufu akagacha endagera ase obonge mono, ekaba enyinge buna omokenye bw’Enyancha, goika agatiga koyerenga, ekiagera tiyare konyara korengeka. Enchara egosoa Misiri

english: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .
ekegusii: Akaraara naende, akaroota eria kabere, akarora ebigara bitano na bibere ebinene ebinoru, bikinete ase oroboba oromo.

english: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani konya emiaka eria y’enchara etaracha, Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akaiborera Yusufu abana abaisia babere.

english: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh : For God , said he , hath made me forget all my toil , and all my father’s house .
ekegusii: Yusufu Akaaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, + 41:51 Manase: engencho yaye aande: okogera okweba agateeba: “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata”

english: And the name of the second called he Ephraim : For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction .
ekegusii: Na omwana o kabere akamoroka Efraimu, + 41:52 Efraimu: engencho yaye: okoibora ara kabere agateeba: “Nyasae ong’eire oroiboro ase ense y’emechando yane.”

english: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .
ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto ekaera ase ense ya Misiri,

english: And the famine was over all the face of the earth : and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabeete endito ase ense ya Misiri.

english: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands .
ekegusii: Abanto b’echinse chionsi bagacha Misiri kogora endagera korwa ase Yusufu, ekiagera enchara nigo yareenge endito ase ense engima.

english: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .
ekegusii: Magega yabo ebigara binde ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka.

english: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and, behold, it was a dream .
ekegusii: Agwo ebigara ebio ebireu bitano na bibere bikaria biria binde ebinene ebinoru. Farao akaboka, akanyora ng’a nigo are koroota.

english: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :
ekegusii: Erio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Farao: “Bono nainyoire okomocha kwane.

english: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another?
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo aigwete ng’a endagera nekare ase ense ya Misiri, akabooria abamura baye: “Inaki morigereranetie iga?”

english: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord , but to buy food are thy servants come .
ekegusii: Bakamokania: “Tari bo, Omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.

english: We are all one man’s sons ; we are true men , thy servants are no spies .
ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”

english: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
ekegusii: Akabakania: “Yaya, nigo mwachire koroota ense, na korora ense ase ere bosa etari na getango.”

english: And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan ; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kaanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”

english: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying , Ye are spies :
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobateebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.

english: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya nimbateeme: Amaene, buna Farao are moyo, timokorua aa mogende, oria omino omoke ataracha aa.

english: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother , and ye shall be kept in prison , that your words may be proved , whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies .
ekegusii: Toma oyomo oino agende korenta oyio omino, na inwe abande motigare echela. Nabo morateemwe gose namaene mogoteeba. Onye taibo, amaene buna Farao are moyo, inwe nechirooti more.”

english: And he put them all together into ward three days .
ekegusii: Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.

english: And Joseph said unto them the third day , This do , and live ; for I fear God :
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Yusufu akabateebia: “Mokore iga buna ndabateebie, nario morabe moyo; naki inche nomonto imoirogete Nyasae.

english: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses :
ekegusii: Onye inwe more abanto abaronge, tiga oyomo oino atigare aa ase echela, na inwe abande moirere abwo mwatigete inka endagera, ase engencho y’enchara;

english: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so.
ekegusii: erio morente oria omino omoke ase ’nde. Igo amang’ana aino aenekigwe ng’a namaene are, na inwe timobaisa gokwa. Barabwo bagakora bo.”

english: And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us, and we would not hear ; therefore is this distress come upon us.
ekegusii: Erio bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twarooche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”

english: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibamanya ng’a Yusufu nayaigwete, ekiagera omonogi nareengeo ore komoonchorera.

english: And he turned himself about from them, and wept ; and returned to them again , and communed with them, and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .
ekegusii: Erio akarua ase bare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simioni korwa ase bare, akamosiba korwa ase amasio abo.

english: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man’s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them.
ekegusii: Yusufu agachiika abanto baichorie chigunia chiabo endagera, na kera oyomo airanerigwe chitaabu chiaye, chibekwe egunia yaye ime, na aegwe endagera agochia koria inchera. Naboigo baabakorerete. Abamwabo Yusufu bakoirana gochia Kaanani

english: And they laded their asses with the corn , and departed thence.
ekegusii: Erio bakaberekia chitigere chiabo endagera, bakagenda.

english: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money ; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth .
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase bakorara botuko, oyomo obo agasansora egunia yaye arusie endagera ae etigere yaye, akarora chitaabu chiaye igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime,

english: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored ; and, lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us?
ekegusii: agateebia abamwabo: “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateeba: “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”

english: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them; saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase Yakobo ise, ase ense ya Kaanani, bakabateebia ayio onsi abanyorete, bakaboora,

english: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase igo, bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.

english: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country .
ekegusii: “Omonto oria omonene bw’ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang’ana amakong’u agatoroka ng’a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.

english: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies :
ekegusii: Korende tokamoteebia: Intwe nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.

english: We be twelve brethren , sons of our father ; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, tata noyomo. Oyomo oito takaiyo, na omoke kegima nere okare ase tata inka, ase ense ya Kaanani.

english: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :
ekegusii: Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatoteebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabaanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga ase ’nde, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.

english: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .
ekegusii: Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabaanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”

english: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks , that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack : and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money , they were afraid .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chitaabu chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise barooche chisaro chi’echitaabu chiabo, bakaondoka.

english: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
ekegusii: Yakobo ise akabateebia: “Mwang’urire abana baane, Yusufu taiyo, na Simioni taiyo, na bono morigetie koira Benjamini nere. Amang’ana aya onsi anyorire inche.”

english: And Reuben spake unto his father , saying , Slay my two sons , if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand , and I will bring him to thee again .
ekegusii: Erio Rubeni agateebia ise “Oite abana baane babere abamura onye tinkomoirania gocha asore. Mobeke ase amaboko aane na inche nimoiranie.”

english: And he said , My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
ekegusii: Akamokania: “Omwana one tagotirimboka amo nainwe, ekiagera oyomwabo okuure na oyo nere otigarete bweka. Amabe aise gochia komonyoora agwo inchera, nigo moragere ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane inde nomoichano.”

english: But Benjamin , Joseph’s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo tamwancherete Benjamini, omwabo Yusufu, kogende amo nabarabwo, ekiagera nigo aoboete ng’a aande nabaise gochia konyorwa n’amabe.

english: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Nabo basinto ba Israeli bakagenda amo nabaanto bande abachiete kogora endagera, ekiagera enchara yarenge ase ense ya Kaanani.

english: And Joseph was the governor over the land , and he it was that sold to all the people of the land : and Joseph’s brethren came , and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth .
ekegusii: Yusufu nere orenge gabana igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, naende nere orenge kooneria abanto bonsi b’ense eria endagera. Na abamwabo Yusufu, ekero baigete asare, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.

english: And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .
ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero abarora, akabamanya, korende agekora buna tabamanyeti, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amakong’u. Akababooria: “Abanto aba, ng’ai mwarure?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarure ase ense ya Kaanani, twachire kogora endagera.”

english: And Joseph knew his brethren , but they knew not him.
ekegusii: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.

english: And the famine was sore in the land .
ekegusii: Enchara ekaba enene ase ense.

english: For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .
ekegusii: Onye totatebanire nanga twairanire chintunda ibere.”

english: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now , do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
ekegusii: Israeli ise akabateebia: “Onye naboigo are, bono mokore iga: Mobeke ebinto ebiya bi’ense eye yaito ase chigunia chiaino, moirere omonto oyio buna ebiegwa. Momoirere amaguta okogwenia make, na obooke boke, na ubani, na manemane, na amajozi. + 43:11 amajozi: chinchugu gete chikwama ase emete igoro

english: And take double money in your hand ; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks , carry it again in your hand ; peradventure it was an oversight :
ekegusii: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

english: Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :
ekegusii: Moire na oyomino, mogende komo, mogende ase omonto oria naende.

english: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may send away your other brother , and Benjamin . If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved .
ekegusii: Nyasae Omobui abae ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyio, erio abasiborere oria omino onde, erinde moirane nere amo na Benjamini. Onye inche ekongwenera nsirerwe nabana baane, tiga abe bo.”

english: And the men took that present , and they took double money in their hand , and Benjamin ; and rose up , and went down to Egypt , and stood before Joseph .
ekegusii: Ase igo, abanto abwo bakaimokia ebiegwa, bakaimokia ne chitaabu ara kabere; amo na Benjamini bakagenda, bagatirimboka gochia Misiri, bagachia bagatenena ase obosio bwa Yusufu.

english: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house , Bring these men home , and slay , and make ready ; for these men shall dine with me at noon .
ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu arooche Benjamini ore amo nabarabwo agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Barente abanto abwo nyomba, na onyenye emori, oyeroisie, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo bagocha koragera amo nainche endagera ya mobaso.”

english: And the man did as Joseph bade ; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house .
ekegusii: Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.

english: And the men were afraid , because they were brought into Joseph’s house ; and they said , Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in ; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen , and our asses .
ekegusii: Korende abanto aba bakaondoka, ekiagera bairetwe nyomba mwa Yusufu, bakaboora: “Nigo twarentirwe nyomba ime ase engencho ye chitaabu chiria chiabegetwe ase chigunia chiaito engaki eria entang’ani. Na bono nigo ararigie gotosoera, na atoimokere, atobwate, atokore tobe abasomba baye, aire ne chitigere chiaito.”

english: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house , and they communed with him at the door of the house ,
ekegusii: Ase igo, bakamoika ang’e omoteneneri oria bw’enka ya Yusufu, bakaba bagokwana nere gesieri ki’enyomba,

english: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said unto them, Go again , buy us a little food .
ekegusii: Na ekero bakoorire endagera eria bagorete korwa Misiri, ise akabateebia: “Irana naende motogorere endagera nke toche koria.”

english: And said , O sir , we came indeed down at the first time to buy food :
ekegusii: bakabateebia: “Koranche Omonene, otoigwe! Engaki eria entang’ani twachete aiga kogora endagera,

english: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .
ekegusii: ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twaraarete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chitaabu chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chitaabu chionsi pi. Bono chitaabu echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.

english: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food : we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks .
ekegusii: Naende ntwarentana chitaabu chinde, echi togocha kogora endagera. Titomanyeti gose ning’o ochibegete ase chigunia chiaito ime.”

english: And he said , Peace be to you, fear not: your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria “Timoka, motoerere, timoondoka; Nyasae oino, oyore Nyasae o iso, nere obaete enibo eye ase chigunia chiaino; chitaabu chiaino inachinyorete.” Erio akarenta Simioni ase bare.

english: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house , and gave them water , and they washed their feet ; and he gave their asses provender .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akaira abanto baria nyomba mwa Yusufu, akabaa amaache bagesibia amagoro abo, akaa ne chitigere chiabo endagera.

english: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakabeeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.

english: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
ekegusii: Na ekero Yusufu achete nyomba ime bakamoirera ebiegwa biria barentete, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.

english: And he asked them of their welfare , and said , Is your father well , the old man of whom ye spake ? Is he yet alive ?
ekegusii: Akabakwania, akababooria: “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaka oria mwanteebia? Moyo are?”

english: And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.

english: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother’s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me? And he said , God be gracious unto thee, my son .
ekegusii: Yusufu agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora Benjamini omwabo, omwana omwabo baruete enda eyemo nere, akababooria: “Oyo nere oria omoke omino, oria mwanteebia?” Akaonchokera Benjamini, akamoteebia: “Nyasae akoe obuya, omwana one!”

english: And Judah spake unto him, saying , The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you.
ekegusii: Korende Yuda akabateebia: Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatoteebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.

english: And Joseph made haste ; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother : and he sought where to weep ; and he entered into his chamber , and wept there.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba ende, ekiagera enkoro yaye nigo yaare namaiga ase omwana omwabo, aroro ase enyomba eyio akarera amariga.

english: And he washed his face , and went out , and refrained himself, and said , Set on bread .
ekegusii: Erio agesibia obosio, agasoka oremereretie. Naende akabora: “Renta endagera!”

english: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Bakamobekera endagera bweka ao, na abamwabo boka ao, na Abamisiri baria konya bakoragera komo boka ao, ekiagera Abamisiri nigo bagechete Abaiberania, tibaare koria amo nabarabwo.

english: And they sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth : and the men marvelled one at another .
ekegusii: Abamwabo Yusufu bagaikaransigwa ase obosio bwaye, bakaroberigwa gochakera ase oria omonene kogenderera goika ase oria omoke. Bonsi kobaikaransire, bakarigererania, bagakumia.

english: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank , and were merry with him.
ekegusii: Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamini ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.

english: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food :
ekegusii: Koratoe oyominto agende amo naintwe, rirorio inatotirimboke tokogorere endagera.

english: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you.
ekegusii: Korende onye togotomoa togende komo, rirorio titokogenda, ekiagera omonto oria nigo atoteebetie, “Timokondora obosio bwane motacheti noyio omino.”

english: And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?
ekegusii: Israeli akababooria: “Ninki mwankorera igo na gonchanda, goika mogateebia omonto oria ng’a mokare noyomino onde inka?”

english: And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Omonto oria nigo atounetie mono amanye amang’ana aito na ay’eamate yaito, agatoboria: Iso moyo are? Mokare nonde omino? Na intwe tokamoiraneria buna atoboretie. Inee! Ntwamanyete aya agochia gokwana ng’a: Gachie morente oyomino?”

english: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go ; that we may live , and not die , both we, and thou, and also our little ones .
ekegusii: Yuda agateebia Israeli ise: “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.

english: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee , then let me bear the blame for ever :
ekegusii: Nerure imbe intenenera asare: korwa ase okoboko kwane oche komonsaba. Onye tinkomoirania gocha asore, rirorio ontige mbogorie okomocha okwo amatuko onsi ase obosio bwao.

english: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men’s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agachiika omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Ichoria chigunia chi’abaanto aba endagera, koreng’ana buna baranyare kobogoria, obeke ne chitaabu chia kera omonto igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime.

english: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant ; and ye shall be blameless .
ekegusii: Akabora: “Tiga abe buna mwateeba, omonto oranyorekane okebwate nigo arabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande inamobe motari na komocha.”

english: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
ekegusii: Erio bagakora bwango, bagaikia kera omonto egunia yaye inse, na koyesansora.

english: And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack .
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agachaaka koriga‐rigia, agachakera ase omomura omonene, agachia gokoorera ase omoke, na egekombe gekanyorekana ase egunia ya Benjamini.

english: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabeekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.

english: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house ; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground .
ekegusii: Yuda na abamwabo, ekero bairanete ase omochie, bakanyora Yusufu nao are nyomba, barabwo bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, ase obosio bwaye.

english: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done ? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine ?
ekegusii: Yusufu akababooria: “Ing’ana ki eri mwakorire? Timomanyeti ng’a omonto buna inche nigo ndanyare gokora oboringoria imanye?”

english: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold, we are my lord’s servants , both we, and he also with whom the cup is found .
ekegusii: Yuda akairaneria: “Ninki togoteeba asore, Omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”

english: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant ; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father .
ekegusii: Yusufu akabora: “Yaya, tari bo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.” Yuda ogosabera Benjamini

english: Then Judah came near unto him, and said , Oh my lord , let thy servant , I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears , and let not thine anger burn against thy servant : for thou art even as Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Erio Yuda akamoika ang’e, akamoteebia: “Koranche, omonene one, ong’e inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana erimo. Tobaisa kombea inche, omosomba oo, naki aye nigo ore buna Farao.

english: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?
ekegusii: Aye omonene one, nigo gwatoboretie intwe abasomba bao: Inee! Mokare na iso gose onde omino?

english: And put my cup , the silver cup , in the sack’s mouth of the youngest , and his corn money . And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken .
ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chitaabu chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.

english: And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him.
ekegusii: Intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one: Ee, ntokare na tata, ere ogotire, nakabwate omwana omomura bw’obogotu bwaye, korende momura omwabo nakwete, oyo nere otigarete bweka ase ng’ina, na ise nigo amwanchete mono.

english: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
ekegusii: Erio ogatoteebia intwe, abasomba bao: Gachie momondetere, ache aa imorore.

english: And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .
ekegusii: Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng’a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.

english: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more .
ekegusii: Naye ogatoteebia intwe abasomba bao: Momura omino omoke atatirimbogeti amo nainwe, timogocha ase obosio bwane naende.

english: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
ekegusii: “Ekero twairanete ase tata, omosomba oo, tokamoteebia amang’ana ao, omonene one.

english: And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .
ekegusii: Na ekero tata atoteebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,

english: And we said , We cannot go down : if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down : for we may not see the man’s face , except our youngest brother be with us.
ekegusii: tokamoiraneria: Titokonyara gotirimboka gochia ase obosio bw’omonto oria, oyominto omoke atari amo naintwe, korende onye oyominto ogotirimboka amo naintwe, rirorio natogende.

english: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oo tata agatoteebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.

english: And the one went out from me, and I said , Surely he is torn in pieces ; and I saw him not since :
ekegusii: Oyomo nigo ansirerete, na inche ngateeba: Tekomocha koba ng’a neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitete, tinana komoorora goika reero iga.

english: And if ye take this also from me , and mischief befall him , ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
ekegusii: Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa ase ’nde, na amabe achie komonyoora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.

english: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their asses .
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia abanto baria bakaegwa ribaga baimokie chitigere chiabo, bagende sobo.

english: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father , and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life ;
ekegusii: “Na bono kondagende inka ase tata, omosomba oo, ntaireti omosae oyo amo naintwe, oyo tata nigo amwanchete mono, takorora buya.

english: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die : and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave .
ekegusii: Ekero ararore ng’a omosae oyo taiyo, nigo arakwe, na intwe, abasomba bao, nigo toragere agende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiaye, ore nomoichano.

english: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .
ekegusii: Naki inche, omosomba oo, nigo nebegete nkaba intenenera ase omosae oyo ase tata, nkamoteebia: Ntamoiraneti asore, nigo ndabe omomochi asore ase obogima bwane bwonsi.

english: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one, nagosoroire, ntige imbe omosomba oo ribaga ri’ omosae oyo; ere omotige agende amo nabamwabo inka.

english: For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .
ekegusii: Naki ndakore ing’irane ase tata, omosae oyo atari amo nainche? Tinkoremereria korora emechando enga buna eyio ekomonyoora tata.”

english: And when they were gone out of the city , and not yet far off , Joseph said unto his steward , Up , follow after the men ; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good ?
ekegusii: Ekero bagendire egeka geke korwa ase omochie, Yusufu agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye. “Imoka, obwatie abanto baria! Ekero orabanyore obaborie: Nase ki mogoakana amabe ase amaya?

english: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .
ekegusii: Inee! Egekombe eke mwaibete, tai kerokio omonene one akonywera? Naende nakio agokorera oboringoria. Mwakorire bobe ase ogokora iga.”

english: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words .
ekegusii: Ekero abaikerete agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana aria aria.

english: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Naki aye, Omonene oito, ogokwana amang’ana buna ayio?

english: Behold, the money , which we found in our sacks’ mouths , we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan : how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold ?
ekegusii: Tari bo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kaanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etaabu korwa ase enyomba y’omonene oo?

english: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord’s bondmen .
ekegusii: Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, Omonene oito.”

english: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen , and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children , and thy children’s children , and thy flocks , and thy herds , and all that thou hast:
ekegusii: Aye nigo oramenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, nigo oramenye ang’e nainche, aye amo nabana bao, na abachokoro bao.

english: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine ; lest thou, and thy household , and all that thou hast, come to poverty .
ekegusii: Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremeerwa, aye amo nabaanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.

english: And, behold, your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
ekegusii: “Na bono imorooche namaiso aino, na Benjamini boigo narooche namaiso aye, ng’a ninche omonyene ngokwana nainwe.

english: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
ekegusii: Moteebie tata obonene bwonsi mbwate aiga Misiri, na binde bionsi mwarorire. Mokore bwango, momorente gocha aa.”

english: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck , and wept ; and Benjamin wept upon his neck .
ekegusii: Erio akaboania Benjamini rigoti, akarera; Benjamini nere akarera kamoboanetie rigoti riaye.

english: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
ekegusii: Yusufu akanyunyunta abamwabo bonsi, akarera ase bare. Na magega y’ayio abamwabo bakagosoria nere.

english: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house , saying , Joseph’s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
ekegusii: Ekero chinkuma chiaigwekanete ase enka ya Farao ng’a abamwabo Yusufu bachire, amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.

english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Say unto thy brethren , This do ye; lade your beasts , and go , get you unto the land of Canaan ;
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Bateebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kaanani,

english: And take your father and your households , and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .
ekegusii: Morente iso na abanto b’enka yaye bache ase ’nde. Inche nimbae ebire ebiya bi’ense ya Misiri, na inwe namorie obonoru bw’ense eye.

english: Now thou art commanded , this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
ekegusii: Naende goika obateebie iga, Ira chigari korwa aa Misiri, ase okobogoreria abana baino abake, na abakungu baino, mobogorerie na iso, moche nabarabwo.

english: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .
ekegusii: korende ekero aagete eriogi ase okorera, Abamisiri amo nabaanto b’enka ya Farao bakamoigwa.

english: Also regard not your stuff ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
ekegusii: Timochandekera ebinto biaino, ebi moratige magega, ekiagera bionsi ebire ebiya mono ase ense ya Misiri nebiaino.”

english: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .
ekegusii: Erio basinto ba Israeli bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na Yusufu akabaa chigari buna Farao achiigete, amo nendagera bagochia koria inchera.

english: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment ; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver , and five changes of raiment .
ekegusii: Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamini ere akamoa chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.

english: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .
ekegusii: Agatomera na ise chitigere ikomi chiabogoretie ebinto ebiya mono bia Misiri, ne chitigere chiaberi chiabogoretie endagera, na emegati, na endagera ende agochia koria inchera.

english: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way .
ekegusii: Erio agatigana nabamwabo bagende sobo, akabateebia: “Timobaisa kwomana inchera!”

english: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua Misiri, bagaika ense ya Kaanani ase Yakobo ise.

english: And told him, saying , Joseph is yet alive , and he is governor over all the land of Egypt . And Jacob’s heart fainted , for he believed them not.
ekegusii: Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.

english: And they told him all the words of Joseph , which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived :
ekegusii: Korende bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abateebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.

english: And Israel said , It is enough ; Joseph my son is yet alive : I will go and see him before I die .
ekegusii: Israeli akabora: “Ayio aisanire. Yusufu, omwana one, moyo are. Nigo ndagende komoorora ritang’ani ntarakwa.”

english: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence .
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.

english: And Joseph said unto his brethren , Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near . And he said , I am Joseph your brother , whom ye sold into Egypt .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Inchuo ase ’nde ang’e!” Barabwo bakamoika ang’e. Naende akabateebia: “Ninche Yusufu omiino, oyo mwaoonetie gocha aa Misiri.

english: Now therefore be not grieved , nor angry with yourselves , that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life .
ekegusii: Korende timoichana, gose timwechanda ase emioyo yaino, ekiagera mwang’oonetie gocha aa. Naki Nyasae nere ontomete mbatang’anere gocha aa, erinde ntoorie obogima bw’abaanto.

english: For these two years hath the famine been in the land : and yet there are five years , in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest .
ekegusii: Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.

english: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo antomete mbatang’anere inwe, erinde motigare ase ense, na koba moyo ase ogotooreka kw’abange.

english: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: Ase igo,, tari inwe mwantomete gocha aa, korende Nyasae omonyene. Nere ombegete imbe ise Farao, n’Omonene ase enka yaye yonsi, na omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

english: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .
ekegusii: Ase igo, Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, akaira ebinto bionsi ebi abwate, agaika Beeri‐Seba, akaruera Nyasae o Isaka ise ekeng’wanso.

english: And the sons of Simeon ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokaanani.

english: And the sons of Levi ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

english: And the sons of Judah ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri, na Onani, na Sela, na Peresu, na Zera; korende Eri na Onani bagakwera ase ense ya Kaanani. Na abana ba Peresu nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.

english: And the sons of Issachar ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yobu, na Simuroni.

english: And the sons of Zebulun ; Sered , and Elon , and Jahleel .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.

english: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura Lea aiborerete Yakobo agwo Padan‐Aramu. Na omoiseke oyomo aiborete, nere Dina. Abana baye bonsi amo nabachokoro, abamura na abaiseke, nigo baareenge emerongo etato na batato.

english: And the sons of Gad ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gadi nabwo aba: Sifioni, na Hagi, na Suni, na Esiboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.

english: And the sons of Asher ; Jimnah , and Ishuah , and Isui , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah ; Heber , and Malchiel .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.

english: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro ba Silpa, oyio Labani aete Lea, omwana oye omosubati. Abwo Silpa aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na batano nomo.

english: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife ; Joseph , and Benjamin .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli, moka Yakobo, nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.

english: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarangeria Israeli ase okorora ekero kia botuko, akabora: “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”

english: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah , and Becher , and Ashbel , Gera , and Naaman , Ehi , and Rosh , Muppim , and Huppim , and Ard .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Asibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Eki, na Roshi, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aridi.

english: These are the sons of Rachel , which were born to Jacob : all the souls were fourteen .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na baane.

english: And the sons of Dan ; Hushim .
ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Dani nere Husimu.

english: And the sons of Naphtali ; Jahzeel , and Guni , and Jezer , and Shillem .
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yaseri, na Silemu.

english: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro abamura Bilia aiborerete Yakobo, abanto batano na babere.

english: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob’s sons’ wives , all the souls were threescore and six ;
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagendete amo na Yakobo ase ense ya Misiri, abwo baiboretwe korwa asare, nigo baareenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo. Abakungu b’abana abamura ba Yakobo, barabwo tibaabariri.

english: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph , to direct his face unto Goshen ; and they came into the land of Goshen .
ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma Yuda amotang’anere kogenda ase Yusufu, erinde aoroke ase obosio bwaye agwo Goseni, Naboigo bagaika ase ensemo ya Goseni.

english: And Joseph made ready his chariot , and went up to meet Israel his father , to Goshen , and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck , and wept on his neck a good while .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabeeka egari yaye ang’e, akayeriina, akagenda korotota Israeli aria Goseni. Ekero achia goika asare akamoboania rigoti riaye engaki etari nke.

english: And he said , I am God , the God of thy father : fear not to go down into Egypt ; for I will there make of thee a great nation :
ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.

english: And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
ekegusii: Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Bono tiga inkwe, ekiagera nakororire obosio bwao, naende narorire ng’a moyo ore.”

english: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father’s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him, My brethren , and my father’s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me;
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo na abanto b’enka ya ise: “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imoteebie: Abaminto na abanto b’enka ya tata, aba baarenge ase ense ya Kaanani, bachire ase ’nde.

english: And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have.
ekegusii: Na abanto abwo nabatugi be chitugo, na bono barentire chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio.

english: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say , What is your occupation ?
ekegusii: Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,

english: That ye shall say , Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers : that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen ; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
ekegusii: nigo moramoiranerie: Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abatugi be chitugo korwa obwana bwaito goika reero; buna tore igo, nabo ne chisokoro chiaito chiareenge. Na igo namonyore ribaga komenya ase ensemo ya Goseni, ekiagera kera omorisia bwe chitugo nigo are okogechia ase Abamisiri.”

english: I will go down with thee into Egypt ; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .
ekegusii: Inche nintirimboke amo naye goika Misiri, naende tinkomocha gokoirania; na Yusufu nabe okoirania amaiso ao kogw akuure.”

english: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.

english: His sons , and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters , and his sons’ daughters , and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt .
ekegusii: abana baye abamura na abamura babo; na abana baye abaiseke, na abaiseke b’abamura babo. Naboigo akaira oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, akagenda nabarabwo goika Misiri. Ororeeria rwa Israeli

english: And these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt , Jacob and his sons : Reuben , Jacob’s firstborn .
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta Abaisraeli abwo bagendete Misiri: Yakobo na abana baye, nabwo aba: Rubeni, nere omotangi o Yakobo.

english: And the sons of Reuben ; Hanoch , and Phallu , and Hezron , and Carmi .
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.

english: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan ; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagenda agateebia Farao: “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kaanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”

english: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from before Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Yakobo agasesenia Farao naende, akarua ase obosio bwaye.

english: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
ekegusii: Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y’ense eria, buna Farao achiigete.

english: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father’s household , with bread , according to their families .
ekegusii: Nere Yusufu akaba okorenda ise amo nabamwabo bonsi, akabaa endagera buna kera omonto abwate abanto baye bang’ana. Enchara ekomentekana, n’Abamisiri koonigwa ase Farao

english: And there was no bread in all the land ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .
ekegusii: Bono ase ense yonsi endagera tiyareengeo; na enchara nigo yareenge endito mono, konya yanyarire abanto ba Misiri na Abakaanani.

english: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the corn which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house .
ekegusii: Yusufu agasangereria chitaabu chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kaanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeeka ase ekungo ya Farao.

english: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth .
ekegusii: Ekero chitaabu chionsi chiaerire ase ense ya Misiri na ase ense ya Kaanani, Abamisiri bagachiera Yusufu, bakamosaba, “Toe endagera, titobaisa gokwera ase obosio bwao, ekiagera chitaabu chiaito chiaerire.”

english: And Joseph said , Give your cattle ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .
ekegusii: Yusufu akabairaneria, “Onye chitaabu chiaino chiaerire, ndetera chitugo chiaino, na inche mbae endagera morie.”

english: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph : and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses , and for the flocks , and for the cattle of the herds , and for the asses : and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year .
ekegusii: Erio bakarentera Yusufu chitugo chiabo, na Yusufu akabaa endagera. Bakarentera Yusufu chibarasi chiabo, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere. Igo akaba okobarenda na kobaa endagera ase omwaka oyio oyomo, na barabwo bakamoa chitugo chiabo.

english: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :
ekegusii: Omwaka oria oyomo okaera. Naende omwaka o kabere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia: “Titokonyara gokobisa, Omonene oito, ng’a chitaabu chiaito chiaerire, ne chitugo chiaito chiabeire echiao. Titotigareti gento kende togokoa, omonene oito, otatiga emebere yaito na amaremo aito.

english: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes , both we and our land ? buy us and our land for bread , and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh : and give us seed , that we may live , and not die , that the land be not desolate .
ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”

english: And he took some of his brethren , even five men , and presented them unto Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Agachora abamwabo batano, akabaira ase obosio bwa Farao.

english: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagorera Farao amaremo onsi areenge Misiri, naki Abamisiri nigo baoonetie kera omonto oboremo bwaye, ekiagera enchara yareenge endito mono. Naboigo ense ekaba eya Farao.

english: And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
ekegusii: Farao akang’anyia abanto abwo bamenye ase emechie, babe abasomba baye, bakore emeremo korwa ensemo eyemo ya Misiri goika eyende.

english: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands .
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo, tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.

english: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land .
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abanto: “Igwa! Reero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.

english: And it shall come to pass in the increase , that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh , and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field , and for your food , and for them of your households , and for food for your little ones .
ekegusii: Engaki ye rigesa moruserie Farao ensemo ya isano. Chinsemo inye chintigari inachibe echiaino ase chimbusuro na endagera yaino inwe abanyene, na ey’abare ase chinka chiaino, na ey’abana baino.”

english: And they said , Thou hast saved our lives : let us find grace in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh’s servants .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Gwatooririe obogima bwaito. Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, Omonene oito, tiga tobe abasomba ba Farao.”

english: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s .
ekegusii: Yusufu akabeeka ogochika ase ense ya Misiri, ng’a ensemo ya isano ebe eya Farao; na ogochika okwo ngokora kore emeremo nonya ngoika bono. Korende amaremo ’abakuani oka naro atabeete aya Farao. Okogania kw’omoerio kwa Yakobo

english: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt , in the country of Goshen ; and they had possessions therein, and grew , and multiplied exceedingly .
ekegusii: Israeli na abana baye bakaba bakomenya ase ense ya Misiri, ensemo ya Goseni, bakayeira ekaba eyabo, bakamenteka na kobucha mono.

english: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .
ekegusii: Yakobo akamenya ase ense ya Misiri emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere. Ase igo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na etano na ebere (147) ase obogima bwaye.

english: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren , What is your occupation ? And they said unto Pharaoh , Thy servants are shepherds , both we, and also our fathers .
ekegusii: Farao akababooria: “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokooro chiaito chiareenge.”

english: But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .
ekegusii: korende ekero ndakwe, tiga ndare ne chisokoro chiane. Ombogorie korwa aa Misiri, ontindeke aase barabwo batindegetwe.” Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Ninkore buna gwantebirie.”

english: And he said , Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head .
ekegusii: Korende Israeli akamoteebia “Tiana ng’a nonkorere bo.” Ere agatiana. Erio Israeli agetureka ase ogotoorera omotwe borere bwaye.

english: They said moreover unto Pharaoh , For to sojourn in the land are we come ; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks ; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan : now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen .
ekegusii: Naende bakabateebia: “Nigo twachire tobe abamenyi b’ense eye, ekiagera intwe, abasomba bao, titori nase tokorisia amaicho aito, ekiagera enchara nenene mono ase ense ya Kaanani. Ase igo, koranche otoe intwe, abasomba bao, ribaga tomenye ase ensemo ya Goseni.”

english: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
ekegusii: Erio Farao agakwana na Yusufu, akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso na abamino bagocheire.

english: The land of Egypt is before thee ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle .
ekegusii: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.” Yakobo ase obosio bwa Farao

english: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akarenta Yakobo ise, akamoira ase obosio bwa Farao; na Yakobo agasesenia Farao.

english: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob , How old art thou?
ekegusii: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

english: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh , The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years : few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage .
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Emiaka yane nakoorire ase ense eye nerigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130). Ase obogima bwane nigo nabeire nobokong’u, naende emiaka yane nemeke, teikereti eye chisokoro chiane chiakorete ase obogima bwabo.”

english: And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold, thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
ekegusii: Ekaba engaki magega y’ayio Yusufu ateebetigwe ng’a, “Iso nomorwaire.” Erio akaimokia abana baye babere abamura, Manase na Efraimu, bakagenda komoorora.

english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he could not see . And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabaagata na kobaboania.

english: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed .
ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Tinasemeretie ng’a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”

english: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .
ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatugama inse.

english: And Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand , and brought them near unto him.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabwata bonsi babere, Efraimu ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, akamobeka ensemo y’okobee ya Israeli, na Manase akamobwata ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, akamobeka ensemo y’okorio ya Israeli.

english: And Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it upon Ephraim’s head , who was the younger , and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head , guiding his hands wittingly ; for Manasseh was the firstborn .
ekegusii: Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, agakobeeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeeka okoboko kwaye gw’okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.

english: And he blessed Joseph , and said , God , before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk , the God which fed me all my life long unto this day ,
ekegusii: Erio agasesenia Yusufu, akabora, “Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu na o Isaka tata, oyio baare gotaara ase obosio bwaye; Nyasae oyo nere ondisirie ase obogima bwane bwonsi goika reero,

english: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads ; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac ; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth .
ekegusii: omomalaika oria ontooretie korwa ase amabe onsi, asesenie abamura aba. Abana aba babe bagwatorwa ase erieta riane, na ase erieta ria sokoro yane Aburaamu, na eria Isaka tata; tiga bakine babe abanto abange ase ense.”

english: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim , it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand , to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head .
ekegusii: Yusufu agachia korora ng’a ise obekire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, ayio tayancha. Akabwata okoboko gwa ise akorusie korwa ase omotwe o Efraimu, erio akobeke ase oyo o Manase.

english: And Joseph said unto his father , Not so, my father : for this is the firstborn ; put thy right hand upon his head .
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia ise: “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beeka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”

english: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it: he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .
ekegusii: Korende ise akaanga, akabora: “Nimanyete, omwana one, nimanyete. Nere boigo nabe egesaku; ere boigo nabe omonene, korende oyomwabo omoke nabe omonene komobua, na oroiboro rwaye narobe egesaku kiabo ao boka.”

english: And one told Jacob , and said , Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed .
ekegusii: Yakobo nere ateebetigwe ng’a “Yusufu, omwana oo, ngocha are gokorora.” Erio Israeli agekomereria, akaboka, agaikaransa borere igoro.

english: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold, I die : but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .
ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Rora ng’ang’e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.

english: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
ekegusii: Inche nakomentire ensemo y’ekenyoro ekeao kobua abamino. Eyio naurete Abaamori n’omoro one, na obota bwane.”

english: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .
ekegusii: aganteebia: Inche ninkomente, na oroiboro rwao robuche goika robe emeganda y’ebisaku. Ning’ee ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao ense eye ebe omwando obo kare na kare.

english: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine.
ekegusii: “Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Rubeni na Simioni bare abaane.

english: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
ekegusii: Abana bao bande baiboire magega y’aba, barabwo nabao barabe; korende nigo baratorwe ase amarieta ’abamwabo, na komenya ase omwando obo.

english: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons , and said , Who are these?
ekegusii: Israeli, ekero arooche abana ba Yusufu, akamobooria: “Aba mbarabi?”

english: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
ekegusii: Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana baane Nyasae ang’erete aiga.” Erio Israeli akamoteebia, “Bandetere aiga ase ’nde, mbasesenie.”

english: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akarangeria abamura baye, akabateebia: “Sangererekana aa ase ’nde, mbateebie amang’ana arabanyore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.

english: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah , nor a lawgiver from between his feet , until Shiloh come ; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be .
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi tekorua o Yuda, gose omobeeki amachiiko ase ororeeria rwaye, goika achiche oyo orabogorie obogaambi, oyo abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baraigwere.

english: Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :
ekegusii: Nigo arasibe etigere yaye ase omote bw’omosabibu, na emori y’etigere yaye ase chinsagia chi’omosabibu omuya. Nigo arasibie egetambaa kiaye akwambara nedivai, ne chianga chiaye n’amaache amonyinga y’amasabibu

english: His eyes shall be red with wine , and his teeth white with milk .
ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo arabe amabariri ase okonywa edivai, na amaino aye abe amarabu ase okonywa amabeere. + 49:12 okonywa amabeere: engencho yaye, nigo babwate obotenenku bw’endagera

english: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea ; and he shall be for an haven of ships ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .
ekegusii: “Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.

english: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens :
ekegusii: “Isakaru netigere ere ne chinguru, ekorara obweri bwe chitugo.
