english: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .
ekegusii: Akarora ng’a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo, agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong’u.

english: Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .
ekegusii: “Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.

english: Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .
ekegusii: Dani nabe eng’iti ekweriba inchera, ring’ere ase oboeto, rikoroma egetingiro ki’ebarasi, goika oyoyeriinete agwe masogota.

english: I have waited for thy salvation , O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!

english: Gad , a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last .
ekegusii: “Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’abauri, korende nere nabamige korwa magega.

english: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob ; and hearken unto Israel your father .
ekegusii: “Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.

english: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
ekegusii: “Aseri natware endagera y’obonoru, narue endagera engiya eragwenere abarwoti.

english: Naphtali is a hind let loose : he giveth goodly words .
ekegusii: “Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo ekobiara chimanwa chingiya.

english: Joseph is a fruitful bough , even a fruitful bough by a well ; whose branches run over the wall :
ekegusii: “Yusufu nomote omorere okwama ang’e nensoko; chinsagia chiaye nigo chikoranda enyasi igoro.

english: The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :
ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomogwera n’bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komoorosia,

english: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob ; (from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel :)
ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko ’Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.

english: Even by the God of thy father , who shall help thee; and by the Almighty , who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts , and of the womb :
ekegusii: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

english: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills : they shall be on the head of Joseph , and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren .
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa gwa iso nkore ne chinguru ngoetanetie okw’ebitunwa bia kare, na obonene bw’ebigoro bia kare na kare. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe egutwa ase omotwe o Yusufu, igoro y’egiototeri ki’oyore omogambi ase egati y’abamwabo.

english: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf : in the morning he shall devour the prey , and at night he shall divide the spoil .
ekegusii: “Benjamini n’eseese y’orosana ekoria mono, engaki ya mambia yaria ebi’obotwari bwaye, na engaki ya mogoroba bwatanana ebiasakoire.”

english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel : and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebisaku bia Israeli ikomi na bibere; naya naro ise abateebetie ekero are kobasesenia na koa kera oyomo ogosesenigwa kwaye. Ogokwa kwa Yakobo

english: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people : bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite ,
ekegusii: Erio Israeli akabachiika, akabora: “Inche nkoirwa inde gosangererekana amo nabaanto baane. Montindeke ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware bw’Efuroni Omohiti,

english: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
ekegusii: “Rubeni, aye nomwana one omotangi, aye nokobua kwane, na ogotongora gwe chinguru chiane. Noetanetie abamino ase okobua, nobaetanetie ase chinguru.

english: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
ekegusii: Oboremo obwo amo ne rikuruma riria nigo biagoretwe korwa ase Abahiti.”

english: Unstable as water , thou shalt not excel ; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed ; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch .
ekegusii: Aye nkwaberete buna amaache; korende togoetania abande, ekiagera nkwarinete borere bwa iso, okabosaria, ase igo okarenta obosooku.

english: Simeon and Levi are brethren ; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations .
ekegusii: “Simioni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.

english: O my soul , come not thou into their secret ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .
ekegusii: Omoyo one tosoa ase obobisi bwabo, gose enkoro yane tesanga ase omosangererekano obo; naki ase endamwamu yabo mbaitete abanto, na ase obomwenu bwabo bakanacha chinteng’e chie chintang’ana.

english: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .
ekegusii: Endamwamu yabo eragererigwe, ekiagera nigo yareenge entindi, na ekeririanda kiabo, ekiagera tikiareenge namaabera. Nimbaatanane ase abana ba Yakobo, nimbasiarere ase abana ba Israeli.

english: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies ; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.
ekegusii: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti biababisa bao; abamura ba iso ng’a batugame bosio bwao na amasikani.

english: And Adam knew Eve his wife ; and she conceived , and bare Cain , and said , I have gotten a man from the LORD .
ekegusii: Bono Adamu akaba na mokaye Hawa, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nanyorire omwana omomura ase ogokonywa kw’Omonene.” Ase igo akamoroka Kaini + 4:1 Kaini: engencho yaye: okonyora (1 Amg 1:1-4) .

english: And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand ;
ekegusii: Bono aye kwaragererigwe na tokogenderera korema korwa ase riroba. Rirorio nigo riaasamirie omonwa oye na konywa amanyinga y’omwana omino korwa ase okoboko kwao.

english: When thou tillest the ground , it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength ; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero orabe gokorema riroba tirigokwamera endagera nonya ng’ake. Igo orabe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense.”

english: And Cain said unto the LORD , My punishment is greater than I can bear .
ekegusii: Erio Kaini agateebia Omonene: “Egesusuro kiane nekerito, tinkonyara gokebogoria.

english: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth ; and from thy face shall I be hid ; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth ; and it shall come to pass , that every one that findeth me shall slay me .
ekegusii: Rora, reero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang’umere nigo arang’ite.”

english: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain , vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold . And the LORD set a mark upon Cain , lest any finding him should kill him.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo! Onde bwensi oraite Kaini nigo araakanigwe egesiomba ara gatano na kabere.” Na Omonene akabeekera Kaini ekemanyererio ng’a onde bwensi oramoumere tabaisa komoita.

english: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD , and dwelt in the land of Nod , on the east of Eden .
ekegusii: Erio Kaini akarwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, akageenda, akamenya ase ense ekorokwa okoombogana ere moocha ya Edeni. Ororeeria rwa Kaini

english: And Cain knew his wife ; and she conceived , and bare Enoch : and he builded a city , and called the name of the city , after the name of his son , Enoch .
ekegusii: Kaini akaba na mokaye, na ere akaba morito, akaibora Enoku; na Kaini akaagacha omochie, akayoroka Enoku, erieta ri’omwana oye.

english: And unto Enoch was born Irad : and Irad begat Mehujael : and Mehujael begat Methusael : and Methusael begat Lamech .
ekegusii: Enoku akaibora Iradi, Iradi akaibora Metusaeli, Metusaeli akaibora Lameki.

english: And Lamech took unto him two wives : the name of the one was Adah , and the name of the other Zillah .
ekegusii: Lameki akanyuoma abakungu babere. Omokungu oyomo nigo are korokwa Ada, n’oyonde Zila.

english: And she again bare his brother Abel . And Abel was a keeper of sheep , but Cain was a tiller of the ground .
ekegusii: Naende akaibora omwana onde Abeli. Abeli akaba omorisia bwe ching’ondi, na Kaini akaba omoremi bw’omogondo.

english: And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
ekegusii: Ada akaibora Yabeli; oyo nere sokoro y’abare komenya ase ebigutu na babwate ching’iti chigotugwa.

english: And his brother’s name was Jubal : he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ .
ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro y’abanto baria baare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.

english: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal-cain , an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah .
ekegusii: Zila akaibora Tubali‐Kaini. Ere nigo areenge omoturi bw’ebinto bi’ebioma na ebie chitaai. Na omosubati omwabo nere Naama.

english: And Lamech said unto his wives , Adah and Zillah , Hear my voice ; ye wives of Lamech , hearken unto my speech : for I have slain a man to my wounding , and a young man to my hurt .
ekegusii: Lameki agateebia abakungu baye, inwe “Ada na Zila, igwa eriogi riane, inwe abakungu ba Lameki, tegerera buya moigwe buna ngoteeba, naitire omomura omoke ekiagera ong’akire na kombeeka rioote.

english: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .
ekegusii: Onye Kaini ogoakanerwa egesiomba ara gatano na kabere, amaene, Lameki ere naakanerwe ara emerongo etano na ebere, na gatano na kabere.” Seti na Enosu

english: And Adam knew his wife again ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .
ekegusii: Adamu na mokaye bakaibora omwana onde omomura, erio Hawa akamoroka Seti, agateeba: “Bono Nyasae ong’eire omwana onde omomura ribaga ri’Abeli, oria Kaini aitete”. Erio akamoroka Seti.

english: And to Seth , to him also there was born a son ; and he called his name Enos : then began men to call upon the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Seti nere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Enosu. Erio agwo abanto bagachaaka korangeria erieta ri’Omonene ase okomosasiima.

english: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Engaki egaika Kaini akarenta okwama kw’omogondo oye erio kobe ekengwanso ase Omonene.

english: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect . And Cain was very wroth , and his countenance fell .
ekegusii: korende tagogetigwe nekengwanso gia Kaini. Ase igo, ayio akagera Kaini akagechigwa mono kegima, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka, bokairura.

english: And the LORD said unto Cain , Why art thou wroth ? and why is thy countenance fallen ?
ekegusii: Na Omonene akamobooria: “Kaini, nase ki okobeera nendamwamu na obosio bwao bwairurire?

english: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him.
ekegusii: “Onye ndiria gwakora buya anga nigo agogete; korende bono aye gwakorire ebibe, ebibe nigo bikoganyererete gesieri; na birobio nigo bikoganetie. Korende nekogwenerete obibue kegima.”

english: And the LORD said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper ?
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabooria Kaini: “Ng’ai Abeli momura omino are?” Kaini akamoiraneria: “Inche tinkomanya. Inee! Ninche nkorenda oyominto?”

english: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face , and wept upon him, and kissed him.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagwera ise ase obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.

english: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gi’Atadi ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani, bakaba bakorera ebirero ebinene mono. Agwo Yusufu akagenderera komoreera ise ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .
ekegusii: Na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense eria, ekero bachia korora ebirero agwo Atadi ase ekeooreri, bakaboora: “Ebirero ebi bi’Abamisiri nebinene mono.” Ase ayio, aase aria ng’umbu ya Yorodani akarokwa Abeli‐Misiri. + 50:11 Abeli‐Misiri: engencho yaye: Ekerero ki’Abamisiri

english: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
ekegusii: Naboigo basinto ba Yakobo bakorete buna ise abachiigete.

english: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he, and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero akoorire gotindeka ise, akairana Misiri amo nabamwabo na bonsi abatiirete amo nere. Yusufu okoremia abamwabo

english: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo Yusufu barooche ng’a ise okuure bagateebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”

english: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph , saying , Thy father did command before he died , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma abanto ase Yusufu komoteebia ng’a: “Iso nigo ateebete iga ritang’ani atarakwa.

english: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin ; for they did unto thee evil : and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
ekegusii: Moteebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo, bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.

english: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face ; and they said , Behold, we be thy servants .
ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bagacha, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye, bakaboora: “Intwe iga nabasomba bao tore.”

english: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God ?
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia: “Timoiroka! Inee! Inche inde ribaga ria Nyasae?

english: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .
ekegusii: Agachiika abarwaria abaare komokorera, ng’a baake Israeli ise amafuta, tabaisa kogunda; naboigo abarwaria bamokorerete,

english: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .
ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe nabo mwarengereretie gonkorera amabe, korende Nyasae akayaonchora akaba amaya, na buna mwarorire reero iga, otooririe obogima bw’abaanto abange.

english: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones . And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
ekegusii: Gaki, bono timoiroka! Nimbaragerie inwe amo nabana baino.” Naboigo akaba okobaremia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amaya. Ogokwa kwa Yusufu

english: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he, and his father’s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
ekegusii: Yusufu akamenya Misiri, ere amo nabaanto bamwabo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi (110).

english: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees .
ekegusii: Agwo akarora abana b’Efraimu na abachokoro baye goika ekiaare kia gatato, akarora na abana ba Makiri, omwana o Manase, baiboreretwe ase Yusufu.

english: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo: “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”

english: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu erio agakwa ore n’emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amafuta, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeeka ase esanduki ime aaria Misiri.

english: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .
ekegusii: goika amatuko emerongo ene agaikerana. Ase amatuko ang’ana buna ayio naro egetondo kiare goakwa amariogo. Abamisiri bakamoreera Israeli amatuko emerongo etano na ebere.

english: And when the days of his mourning were past , Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh , saying , If now I have found grace in your eyes , speak , I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko okomoreera Israeli aerete, Yusufu agakwana nabaanto b’enka ya Farao, akabora: “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase amaiso aino, komoranche monteeberie Farao

english: And Pharaoh said , Go up , and bury thy father , according as he made thee swear .
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria: “Tiira ochie gotindeka iso, buna akorierete omwando.”

english: And Joseph went up to bury his father : and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh , the elders of his house , and all the elders of the land of Egypt ,
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatiira gochia gotindeka ise. Abasomba bonsi ba Farao bakagenda amo nere, na abagaaka bonsi b’enka yaye, na abagaaka bonsi ba Misiri,

english: And all the house of Joseph , and his brethren , and his father’s house : only their little ones , and their flocks , and their herds , they left in the land of Goshen .
ekegusii: na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.

english: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .
ekegusii: Naende Yusufu akaira amo nere chigari na abariini chibarasi; bakaba omoganda omonene mono.

english: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Kainani, Enosu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na etano (815), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Enosu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na etano (905), erio agakwa.

english: And Cainan lived seventy years , and begat Mahalaleel :
ekegusii: Ekero Kainani konya emenyire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, (70), akaibora Mahalaleli.

english: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Mahalaleli, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ene (840), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi (910), erio agakwa.

english: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years , and begat Jared :
ekegusii: Ekero Mahalaleli emenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Yaredi.

english: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Yaredi, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato (830), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo kianda, na etano (895), erio agakwa.

english: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years , and he begat Enoch :
ekegusii: Ekero Yaredi amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (162), akaibora Enoku.

english: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enoku, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato (800), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (962), erio agakwa.

english: And Enoch lived sixty and five years , and begat Methuselah :
ekegusii: Ekero Enoku amenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Metusela.

english: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Metusela, Enoku akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae ase emiaka amagana atato (300), erio akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years :
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Enoku akamenya nemiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, ne etano (365),

english: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :
ekegusii: Ekero Metusela amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato, na etano na ebere (187), akaibora Lameki.

english: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Lameki, Metusela nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere, (782), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Metusela nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na kianda (969), erio agakwa.

english: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years , and begat a son :
ekegusii: Ekero Lameki amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere (182), akaba ise omwana omomura,

english: And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed .
ekegusii: akamoroka Nuhu + 5:29 Nuhu: engencho yaye: okoremigwa (1 Amg 1:5-23) agateeba: “Oyo nere oratoremie intwe ase emeremo yaito, na obokong’u bwaito, ase riroba eri Omonene aragereretie.”

english: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image ; and called his name Seth :
ekegusii: Ekero Adamu konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etato (130), akaba ise bw’omwana omomura omobwekaine, ore ekieni kiaye ere omonyene, akamoroka Seti.

english: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nuhu, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano, na emerongo kianda, na etano (595), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano na ebere (777), erio agakwa.

english: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu amenyire emiaka amagana atano (500), akaba ise bw’abana abamura, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

english: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years : and he begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Seti, Adamu akagenderera komenya goika emiaka ende amagana atano na atato (800), erio akaba ise bw’abana baabande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo Adamu nigo amenyete, emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (930), erio agakwa.

english: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :
ekegusii: Ekero Seti konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na etano (105), akaibora Enosu.

english: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters :
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti akamenya naende emiaka ende amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.

english: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years : and he died .
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.

english: And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :
ekegusii: Ekero Enosu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda (90), akaba ise Kainani.

english: And Noah begat three sons , Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batato, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

english: The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .
ekegusii: Ense ekaba yasarekire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, egaichorwa nobotindi na okoregana kwegeitano.

english: And God looked upon the earth , and, behold, it was corrupt ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ng’a ense yatutukanire, ekiagera kera omonto obwatirie chinchera chi’obotutukanu ase ense. Nuhu okoagacha obwato

english: And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me ; for the earth is filled with violence through them ; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth .
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Narorire ng’a ninsirie Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera baichoirie obotindi na oboregani ense, ase igo nimbasirie amo nense yonsi.

english: Make thee an ark of gopher wood ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .
ekegusii: Eroiserie obwato obonene bw’emete y’ebirobo; obonachane nechitoto ime ebinyomba, na oboome eramu ime na isiko.

english: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
ekegusii: Obwato obwo nigo oraboroisie iga: Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obw’ebirengo bi’amaboko amagana atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.

english: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it.
ekegusii: Inse y’ekerama otige ribaga ri’okorenta oborabu ase obwato obwo, orikore obotambe gochia igoro obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, obeke egesieri rikere ensemo. Onachane obwato obwo ase amarongo atato.

english: And, behold , I , even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .
ekegusii: Naki rora, nindete etoigo igoro y’ense, ninsirie Mwanyabaanto na binde bionsi bire moyo; kera egento kere moyo ase ense goika gekwe.

english: But with thee will I establish my covenant ; and thou shalt come into the ark , thou , and thy sons , and thy wife , and thy sons’ wives with thee.
ekegusii: Korende ninkore egeteebanio kiogotianania naye; aye nosoe ase obwato ime amo nabamura bao, na mokao, na baka bamura bao.

english: And of every living thing of all flesh , two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark , to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female .
ekegusii: Na orente ching’iti ase obwato ime, na chinde chionsi chire moyo, korwa ase kera egesaku, ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, chibe moyo amo naye.

english: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .
ekegusii: Abamura ba Nyasae bakarora abaiseke ba Mwanyabaanto ng’a nigo baare nebieni ebiya, bakanyuoma ase ogwechorera abakungu korwa ase abaiseke baria koreng’ana buna baabagogetie.

english: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive .
ekegusii: Ase kera egesaku gie chinyoni, ne ching’iti chionsi, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, ochirente ibere ibere amo naye, erinde chibe moyo.

english: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten , and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
ekegusii: Oire endagera egochia koriegwa, oyegache erio eyio nebe endagera yaino na ey’echingi’ti ne chinyoni.”

english: And the LORD said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Omoika one tokonyara komenya ime ase Mwanyabaanto kare na kare, ekiagera ere nomobere ogokwa. Ase ayio emiaka yaye nigo erabe rigana erimo na emerongo ebere yoka.”

english: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .
ekegusii: Ase ayi’Omonene akairianyeka + 6:6 Akairianyeka: engencho yaye ogochandeka ase nkoro ase engencho yering’ana ribe riakorekire , ekiagera atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, agaichana ase omoyo oye.

english: And the LORD said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air ; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Ninsirie Mwanyabaanto abwo natongete mbarusie ase ense, gose tari Mwanyabaanto boka, korende ne ching’iti, na ebitongwa bikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro. Neitirie ekiagera natongete abanto abwo na ching’iti echio.”

english: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende Nuhu akanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nuhu

english: And the LORD said unto Noah , Come thou and all thy house into the ark ; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Nuhu: “Soa ase obwato ime amo nabaanto bao, ekiagera buna nakorigereirie, narorire ng’a ase ekegori eke naye bweka ore omonyaboronge ase obosio bwaane.

english: And it came to pass after seven days , that the waters of the flood were upon the earth .
ekegusii: Erio magega y’amatuko atano na abere, etoigo egacha ase ense.

english: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights .
ekegusii: na embura egatwa igoro ase ense, rioka rioka ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.

english: In the selfsame day entered Noah , and Shem , and Ham , and Japheth , the sons of Noah , and Noah’s wife , and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark ;
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo na Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti, bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye batato.

english: They , and every beast after his kind , and all the cattle after their kind , and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind , and every fowl after his kind , every bird of every sort .
ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo, chigasoa ching’iti chi’orosana echia kera egesaku, ne ching’iti chigotugwa echia kera egesaku, na echikwagura echia kera egesaku, na kera enyoni y’egesaku kende gionsi.

english: And they went in unto Noah into the ark , two and two of all flesh , wherein is the breath of life .
ekegusii: Na chirochio chionsi echiare moyo chigasoa ibere ibere ase obwato amo na Nuhu.

english: And they that went in , went in male and female of all flesh , as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in .
ekegusii: Ching’iti ne chinyoni chionsi chiasoete, chinsacha ne chinkuungu chire moyo chia kera egesaku, chigasoa buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu, eri’Omonene akamosiekera egesieri.

english: And the flood was forty days upon the earth ; and the waters increased , and bare up the ark , and it was lift up above the earth .
ekegusii: Etoigo eria ekagenderera igoro y’ense ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, ekagera amaache akamentekana mono, erio agacheng’enenia obwato na koboimokereria igoro mono kegima korwa ase ense.

english: And the waters prevailed , and were increased greatly upon the earth ; and the ark went upon the face of the waters .
ekegusii: Amache aria akaba nechinguru, na akamenteka mono igoro y’ense, na obwato boria bogacheng’enena ase amaache ayio igoro.

english: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth ; and all the high hills , that were under the whole heaven , were covered .
ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera komenteka mono na akaba nechinguru chinene, erio agoichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe mono kegima, biareenge kera ase inse y’erioba, bikarimera amaache ime.

english: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens , the male and his female : and of beasts that are not clean by two , the male and his female .
ekegusii: Ekero ogosoa, oirane amo naye ching’iti chichenegete, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu; na ase kera eng’iti etachenegeti, ibere ibere, ensacha na enkuungu.

english: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail ; and the mountains were covered .
ekegusii: Amache ayio akamenteka rioka rioka agoichora, agatiira goika ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na atano igoro y’ebitunwa bionsi.

english: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of beast , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth , and every man :
ekegusii: Ne ching’iti chiria ne chinyoni chionsi echiare moyo, chiare gotaara ase ense, chigakwa; chinyoni, ne ching’iti chiatugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, amo na Mwanyabaanto bonsi bagakwa.

english: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life , of all that was in the dry land , died .
ekegusii: Ebitongire bionsi biare koeyanera chimioro na bire moyo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase ense enyomo bigakwa.

english: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground , both man , and cattle , and the creeping things , and the fowl of the heaven ; and they were destroyed from the earth : and Noah only remained alive , and they that were with him in the ark .
ekegusii: Nyasae agasiria ebinto bionsi biare moyo, ebiareenge igoro ase ense, Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti chigotaara na amoogoro, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro; na bionsi bigasirigwa korwa ase ense engima; Korende Nuhu bweka agatoorigwa amo nabwo baareenge amo nere ase obwato ime.

english: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days .
ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera koyaaba igoro ase ense, ase engaki y’amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150).

english: Of fowls also of the air by sevens , the male and the female ; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth .
ekegusii: Naende oirane ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu. Okore ayio ase engencho y’okorenda kera egesaku erio kegenderere koba moyo ase ense.

english: For yet seven days , and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights ; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na abere nindete embura ase ense etwe amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, na kende gionsi nakorete kere moyo ase ense ningesirie kegima.”

english: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
ekegusii: Na Nuhu agakora ayio onsi buna Omonene amochiigete.

english: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth .
ekegusii: Nuhu konya okorire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600) engaki eyio etoigo yachete ase ense.

english: Of clean beasts , and of beasts that are not clean , and of fowls , and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth ,
ekegusii: Na ase ching’iti chichenegete, ne ching’iti chitachenegeti, ne chinyoni na ebitongwa bionsi ebikwagura igoro ase ense,

english: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark , the male and the female , as God had commanded Noah .
ekegusii: chigasoa ase obwato amo na Nuhu ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu.

english: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters asswaged ;
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoinyora Nuhu ne ching’iti chionsi, echi’orosana, na echiatugire, echiareenge amo nere ase obwato ime. Erio agwo Nyasae akagusia omwaga ase ense, na amaache aria agakea.

english: And he stayed yet other seven days ; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark ;
ekegusii: Erio akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, naende ase egeka giakabere, agatoma riruma riria korwa ase obwato.

english: And the dove came in to him in the evening ; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .
ekegusii: Riruma riria rikairana chinsa chia mogoroba, ribogoretie rito ribese ri’omozeituni ase omonwa oye. Ase ayio Nuhu akamanya ng’a amaache akeanire korwa ase ense.

english: And he stayed yet other seven days ; and sent forth the dove ; which returned not again unto him any more .
ekegusii: Naende akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, agatoma riruma riria, korende rirorio tirichieti koirana asare naende.

english: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year , in the first month , the first day of the month , the waters were dried up from off the earth : and Noah removed the covering of the ark , and looked , and, behold, the face of the ground was dry .
ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana atano na rimo, na oyomo (601), rituko rie ritangani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, amaache agakama kegima korwa ase ense. Nuhu akarusia ekerama ki’obwato, akarigereria, akarora ng’a ense yakamokire.

english: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .
ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo ebere, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ense ekaba yakamokire kegima.

english: And God spake unto Noah , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu,

english: Go forth of the ark , thou, and thy wife , and thy sons , and thy sons’ wives with thee.
ekegusii: “Soka korwa ase obwato, aye na mokao, na abana bao abamura, na abakungu babo.

english: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .
ekegusii: Osooke amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo naye: chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigotaara, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, erinde chibiare chimenteke, chiichore ase ense.”

english: And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons’ wives with him:
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agasoka amo na bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye.

english: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .
ekegusii: Na kera eng’iti, na kera eyekwagura, na kera enyoni, na ebitongwa binde bionsi bigotaara ase ense bigasoka amo noroiboro rwabo, korwa ase obwato. Nuhu okorua ekeng’wanso

english: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained ;
ekegusii: Chinsoko chia amaache chiare kobera korwa inse amo na ebibao bia igoro bigasiekwa, na embura yaare gotwa egasira,

english: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, akarusia eyemo ase kera eng’iti, na ase kera enyoni echenegete, agachirua buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa igoro ase egesasiimero keria.

english: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour ; and the LORD said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake ; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .
ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene aigwete rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Tinkoragereria ense naende nonya ng’ake ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, naki ebirengererio bie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nebibe korwa obwana bwabo; nonya nebitongwa bionsi bire moyo tingocha kobisiria naende buna nakorete.

english: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
ekegusii: Engaki ense egendererete kobao, nebe engaki y’ogosimeka na ey’okogesa, engaki y’obokendu na ey’omobaso omoororo, engaki y’etoigo na ey’egurugura, omobaso na obotuko, tichikoera nonya ng’ake.”

english: And the waters returned from off the earth continually : and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated .
ekegusii: na amaache akana gokeea ng’ora ng’ora korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amaache aria agakea.

english: And the ark rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , upon the mountains of Ararat .
ekegusii: Ase igo, rituko ria ikomi na gatano na kabere, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, obwato bogeeterekerera igoro ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Ararati.

english: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .
ekegusii: Na amaache akagenderera gokea goika omotienyi o ikomi. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bikarorekana.

english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days , that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made :
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko emerongo ene kaerire Nuhu akaigora ekebao keria akorete ase obwato,

english: And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .
ekegusii: agatoma ekegonkoru, na kerokio gekairuruka gochia aaria na aaria goika amaache agakama korwa ase ense.

english: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground ;
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agatoma riruma, egere arore gose amaache akamire korwa ase ense,

english: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .
ekegusii: korende riruma riria tirianyora aase rikogwa, ase igo rikairana ase obwato, ekiagera amaache nao areenge igoro y’ense engima. Ase igo, Nuhu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwata riruma riria akarisoyia obwato ime ase areenge.

english: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl , of the cattle , and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark , to every beast of the earth .
ekegusii: naende na kera egetongwa kere moyo kere amo nainwe, chinyoni chionsi ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana echio chire amo nainwe, chionsi echiasokire korwa ase obwato ime.

english: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .
ekegusii: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, ng’a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n’amaache y’etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y’ayio.”

english: And God said , This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations :
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateeba: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochiagocha.”

english: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateeba: “Inche nabekire omokubinyongo one ase amare, noro nobe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana oko egati yane na ense.

english: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :
ekegusii: Ekero nkwara amare igoro y’ense, na omokubinyongo nobe okororekana ase amare.

english: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
ekegusii: Erio nimbe nkoinyora okobwatana kwane, okwo nakorire egati yane nainwe, amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo. Amache takoba naende etoigo egoita ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo.

english: And the bow shall be in the cloud ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero omokubinyongo okoba ase amare, na inche nkoyorigereria, ning’inyore okobwatana kwane gwa kare na kare, okwo nakorire egati yane, buna inche Nyasae na kera egetongwa kere moyo ase ense.”

english: And God said unto Noah , This is the token of the covenant , which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth .
ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana okwo nakorire egati yane na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase ense.” Abana ba Nuhu

english: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .
ekegusii: Abana ba Nuhu abarwete ase obwato nabwo aba: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Hamu nere ise Kaanani.

english: These are the three sons of Noah : and of them was the whole earth overspread .
ekegusii: Aba batato nabwo baareenge abana ba Nuhu, na korwa ase abwo Mwanyabaanto bakaranda ase ense engima.

english: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth , and upon every fowl of the air , upon all that moveth upon the earth , and upon all the fishes of the sea ; into your hand are they delivered .
ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense chibooboe na kobairoka inwe; chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chikwagura igoro ase ense, ne chinswe chionsi chi’enyancha; echio chionsi chiabekirwe ase amaboko aino.”

english: And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
ekegusii: Nuhu akaba omoremi, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani gosimeka emesabibu, nero ekoroisigwa edivai.

english: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken ; and he was uncovered within his tent .
ekegusii: Ere akanywa edivai; erio agatinda, akaraara ore getirianda ase eema yaye ime.

english: And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .
ekegusii: Hamu, ise Kaanani, akamorora ore getirianda, agateebia bamura bamwabo babere baareenge isiko amang’ana aya arooche.

english: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father’s nakedness .
ekegusii: Erio Shemu na Yafeti bakabogoria engobo, bakayebeeka amareko abo igoro, bakagenda kemagega‐magega, bakabisia ise obogetirianda bwaye. Amaiso abo nigo arigereretie aase bakorwa, na tibarora obogetirianda bwa ise.

english: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu atindokire korwa ase okonywa kwaye kw’edivai, akamanya eke omwana oye omoke amokoreire,

english: And he said , Cursed be Canaan ; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Kaanani aragererigwe; nigo arabe omosomba bw’abasomba ase abamwabo.”

english: And he said , Blessed be the LORD God of Shem ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonene, Nyasae o Shemu, nasesenigwe, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.

english: God shall enlarge Japheth , and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
ekegusii: Nyasae amentere Yafeti obomenyo, tiga amenye ase chiema chia Shemu, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.”

english: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years .
ekegusii: Magega y’etoigo eria Nuhu akamenya naende emiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano (350).

english: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .
ekegusii: Nuhu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano (950), erio agakwa.

english: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kere moyo na gekwagura inakebe endagera yaino; buna nabaete chinyeni na ebimeri binde bigokina, naboigo nabaeire nebio bionsi.

english: And surely your blood of your lives will I require ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man ; at the hand of every man’s brother will I require the life of man .
ekegusii: Amaene, amanyinga y’obogima bwaino ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe; korwa ase kera eng’iti ninyaganie, na korwa ase kera omonto oyogoita oyomwabo ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe obogima bw’omonto oyio.

english: And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him, saying ,
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateebia Nuhu amo nabamura baye,

english: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you ;
ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo na ororeeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa magega yaino;

english: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u omobani Habakuki aroche ase okorora. Habakuki okorera, ekiagera oboronge tiboiyo

english: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold ; for they shall heap dust , and take it.
ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abarwoti, na gosekerera abagaambi. Nigo bagochaaya kera eburi enkong’u, baagacha chiburi chiabo, babua bachiira.

english: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .
ekegusii: Erio baeta bwango buna omwaga, bagenderera gochia bosio; abanto abwo bare abamochi, ne chinguru chiabo nachio enyasae yabo.” Habakuki okorera ase Omonene naende

english: Art thou not from everlasting , O LORD my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O LORD , thou hast ordained them for judgment ; and, O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki’ogotorongeyia.

english: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
ekegusii: Aye ore namaiso amaachenu mono atari korigereria amabe na aya atari ay’oboronge, naki orakore oremererie korora abanto batari abegenwa, na okire‐kiri ekero abakori amabe bagosiria abare abanyaboronge kobabua?

english: And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them?
ekegusii: Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi’enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.

english: They take up all of them with the angle , they catch them in their net , and gather them in their drag : therefore they rejoice and are glad .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobabwata nebigobanio biabo baabakurura nekeonga kiabo na kobasangereria ase ekeonga kiabo bakorubera; erio bagoka na gochenga.

english: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net , and burn incense unto their drag ; because by them their portion is fat , and their meat plenteous .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bakorua ebing’wanso ase ekeonga kiabo na kogesambera ubani, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio bikobanyorera ebinoru na endagera enyinge.

english: Shall they therefore empty their net , and not spare continually to slay the nations ?
ekegusii: Inee! Abwo nigo bagochia konakorusia abanto b’ebisaku ase ekeonga kiabo baabasirie batari namaabera?

english: O LORD , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri ndabe nkorera ng’a onkonye, naye tori konyigwa? Gose ngoika ririri ndabe ngokorangeria ase engencho y’obotindi, naye tori gontooria?

english: Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention .
ekegusii: Naki gwantigire narorire amabe buna aya? Naki ondigereretie ing’etananire nemechando? Ogosirigwa na ogokorerwa bobe nigo bire ase obosio bwane; amariomana na ogotaigwana nigo bireo.

english: Therefore the law is slacked , and judgment doth never go forth : for the wicked doth compass about the righteous ; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio amachiiko tari ne chinguru, na oboronge tibori gokorwa. Abakori amabe nigo baetanaine abanyaboronge, na ebiina nigo bikonachwa bobe. Omonene okoiraneria Habakuki

english: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabaanto bakoondokia na kwoboyia; oboronge bwabo na okobua kwabo nigo bikorwa ase barabwo abanyene.

english: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
ekegusii: “Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.

english: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagocha gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakorigereria gochia bosio bare nomokia buna omwaga okorwa moocha; nigo bagosangereria abasibwa abange buna omokenye.

english: I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved .
ekegusii: Inche nintenene korenda, ee, nintenene igoro ase omoorobiri bw’ogotengera, ndore ay’Omonene aranteebie, na buna ndairanerie igoro y’okorera kwane.

english: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people , and hast sinned against thy soul .
ekegusii: Aye kwarenteire enyomba yao obosooku ase ogoita abanto abange, na igo gwakorire ebibe bi’ogosiria obogima bwao aye omonyene.

english: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
ekegusii: Amagena ’enyasi naake eriogi na emiamba ye rirongo neyairanerie.

english: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha omochie ase ogoitera amanyinga na kobeeka oboroso bw’omochie ase ogokora ebibe.

english: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire , and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity ?
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo eyio erasambwe nomorero, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo ere bosa. Rora, ayio nigo arure ase Nyasae bw’Emeganda.

english: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink , that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness !
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.

english: Thou art filled with shame for glory : drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered : the cup of the LORD’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri’ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki’egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.

english: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts , which made them afraid , because of men’s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein.
ekegusii: Obobe bwakoretwe ase Lebanoni mbogotube, na ogosirigwa gwe ching’iti koria gwachiondogetie; aye noegwe egesusuro, ekiagera gwaiterete amanyinga ’abaanto, na ogakora amabe ase ense, na ase emechie, na ase abanto bamenyeteo.

english: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols ?
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, mbitoki ki okorentera oyio okoyobomba? Oyio nomogwekano obombire ore omworokia omong’ainereria? Oyio oyoroisetie nigo asemeretie emeremo y’amaboko aye ere chinyasae chitari gokwana.

english: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria ogoteebia egento kebaachire korwa ase omote: Boka! Na oteebia rigena ritanyare gokwana: Imoka! Inee! Ebinto ebio mbinyare gokworokereria enchera? Rora, ebio nigo bioomire ne chitaabu ne chifeta, korende omoika tori ime yabo.

english: And the LORD answered me, and said , Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables , that he may run that readeth it.
ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Riika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.

english: But the LORD is in his holy temple : let all the earth keep silence before him.
ekegusii: “Korende Omonene nao are ase Hekalu yaye Enchenu; tiga ense yonsi ekire‐kiri ase obosio bwaye.”

english: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine , he is a proud man , neither keepeth at home , who enlargeth his desire as hell , and is as death , and cannot be satisfied , but gathereth unto him all nations , and heapeth unto him all people :
ekegusii: “Edivai nigo ere buna omoonchoreria omong’ainereria; omonto omwerori tari kogenderera koba n’obotoereru. Okogania kwaye nigo gokogarea kwaba buna aase abakuure; nigo konga buna amakweri atari goisaneka. Nigo agosangereria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi gocha asare na gokora abanto b’echinse chionsi koba abaye.”

english: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi nigo baramokorere echeche baroisie engero y’okomochecheria bateebe, “Obobe nobwaye oyo‐gosangereria amo ebinto bitari ebiaye, na bwetweka ebinto airete bibe ntenenera. Ngoika ririri aragenderere gokora igo?”

english: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto baria kwairete ebinto biabo tibakogochera mobosokano, na bagochande, bakobwate bakoire ase obosomba.

english: Because thou hast spoiled many nations , all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein.
ekegusii: Ekiagera aye gwasakoire ebisaku ebinge, abanto b’ebisaku ebitigari mbagosakore aye; gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto abange, na ogakora ayare amabe ase ense na ase emechie, na ase bonsi abamenyeteo.

english: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria okonyora ebitoki bi’obobe na kobirenta ase enyomba yaye, erinde bweagachera egeswa kiaye aase aimokererete igoro ng’a abe noborendi korwa ase okobua kw’amabe.

english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .
ekegusii: Oko nogosaba kw’omobani Habakuki. + 3:1 Habakuki: Oko nogosaba kw’omobani Habakuki, ase Siginoti

english: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled : the overflowing of the water passed by : the deep uttered his voice , and lifted up his hands on high .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo biakorooche, bikanyegerigwa, amaache e chiooro agaeta; chindiba chigaaka amariogi, chikaimokia amaboko abo gochia igoro.

english: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation : at the light of thine arrows they went , and at the shining of thy glittering spear .
ekegusii: Ekero emegwe yao yarenge korunda na komesa, ne ritimo riao riarenge komekameka, na erioba na omotienyi bigatenena aase abo.

english: Thou didst march through the land in indignation , thou didst thresh the heathen in anger .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.

english: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people , even for salvation with thine anointed ; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked , by discovering the foundation unto the neck . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasogete ase ogotooria abanto bao, ee, okarentera omoakwa amaguta oo ogotooreka. Nigo gwasenyentete ekerama ki’enyomba y’omokori amabe, okayetagora korwa ase oboroso goika ase egechuria.

english: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwabeetete emetwe y’abasikari babo namatimo abo abanyene, ekero batocherete buna ekembugumbugu kegocha gotoserebania bare nomochengo gotosiria buna abataka bagosirigwa bobisi.

english: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .
ekegusii: Nigo gwaetete ase enyancha ne chibarasi chiao, ogaetera ase emerindo yarenge koeera ne chinguru.

english: When I heard , my belly trembled ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .
ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, enda yane egatengechigwa, ebikoba biane bikaiguswa ekero naigwete okoeera okwo, amauga ’omobere one akarwara na kogunda, ngatengechigwa aase nateneine. Nimbe ndemereretie ase rituko riria ri’emechando, ekero omobisa arache korwania egesaku giaito.

english: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :
ekegusii: Emeko tegosicha, na emesabibu tekwama; emezeituni nigo erabe bosa tiyama, na emegondo tekwama chindagera. Amaicho e ching’ondi nasirigwe korwa ase ameri, na amaicho e chiombe takobao.

english: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD , I will joy in the God of my salvation .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ningokere Omonene, ninchengere Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane.

english: O LORD , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O LORD , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known ; in wrath remember mercy .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naigure chinkuma chiao, nairokire. Omonene, ogokora kwao tiga kobe okoyia ase emiaka eye, tiga komanyekane ase emiaka eye. Ekero ore nendamwamu oinyore amaabera.

english: God came from Teman , and the Holy One from mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and the earth was full of his praise .
ekegusii: Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.

english: And his brightness was as the light ; he had horns coming out of his hand : and there was the hiding of his power .
ekegusii: Okobara kwaye nigo konga buna okw’erioba, gokomoreka korwa ase okoboko kwaye, aroro agwo obobui bwaye nao bobisire.

english: Before him went the pestilence , and burning coals went forth at his feet .
ekegusii: Amarwaire agoita nigo atang’aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.

english: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
ekegusii: Ekero agotenena, ense nigo agotengechigwa, na ekero akorigereria, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakonyegerigwa. Ebitunwa biarengeo korwa kare nigo bikorimera gochia inse. Ere nigo agotaara ase chinchera chiaye chia kare.

english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction : and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble .
ekegusii: Nkarora chinyomba chire Kusani chichandegete, ne chieema chi’ense ya Midiani chikanyegerigwa.

english: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye Omonene nigo ogechirie ne chindooche, gose endamwamu yao nigo ere igoro ase chirochio? Inee! Nigo ore nekeririanda ase chinyancha, ekiagera nigo gwachete ne chibarasi chiao koriinete chigari chiao chi’obobui?

english: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
ekegusii: Obota bwao bwaorokigwe maiso marore amo nemegwe ye ring’ana riao kwarierete ebisaku eira. Nigo gwatandorete ense ne chindooche.

english: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew , and the earth is stayed from her fruit .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, riime rikorwa igoro riatangirwe na ense tekwama endagera.

english: And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .
ekegusii: Narentire eguru‐gura ase ense, na ase ebitunwa, na ase endagera, na ase emesabibu, na ase emezeituni, na ase kende gionsi kegokina ase riroba. Boigo nayerentire ase abanto, na ase emeremo yonsi abanto bagokora.” Abanto bakoigwera ay’Omonene achigete

english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Joshua the son of Josedech , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the voice of the LORD their God , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, amo nabatigari bonsi b’abaanto bakaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, na amang’ana ’omobani Hagai, oyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, atomete; abanto bakaba bakomoiroka Omonene.

english: Then spake Haggai the LORD’s messenger in the LORD’s message unto the people , saying , I am with you, saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’ Omonene, agakwana nabaanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabateebia, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”

english: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people ; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts , their God ,
ekegusii: Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogabana bw’Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw’abatigari bonsi b’abaanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.

english: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month , in the second year of Darius the king .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario.

english: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , saying , This people say , The time is not come , the time that the LORD’s house should be built .
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng’a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y’Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”

english: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:

english: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses , and this house lie waste ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Eye nero engaki inwe mogwenerete komenya ase chinyomba chinyasi chiabo chitubire ne chibao chingiya, ekero enyomba eye egendererete koba ritombe?”

english: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts ; Consider your ways .
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Inwe rengereria buna chinchera chiaino chiabeire.

english: Ye have sown much , and bring in little ; ye eat , but ye have not enough ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink ; ye clothe you, but there is none warm ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .
ekegusii: Nigo mokobusura chimbusuro chinyinge, korende mwagesa chinke; nigo mokoragera, korende timori koigota; nkonywa more, korende timori goisaneka; nigo mokobeeka chianga, korende timori koigwa riberera; oyo okonyora eng’eria, nigo akoyenyora erinde oyebeka ase omobuko obochogete.

english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ; Consider your ways .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Rengereria buna amang’ana aino abeire.

english: Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house ; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, morente emete moagachere enyomba eye, erio nario ndagokigwe nero, naende inyeorokie ng’a inche ninde nobonene.” Nabo Omonene atebiire.

english: Ye looked for much , and, lo, it came to little ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .
ekegusii: “Nigo mwasemeretie monyore ebinge, korende mokanyora ebike; na ekero mwabirentete inka, nkabirurukia bikagenda. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo nkobaboria: Nase ki yabeete bo? Nekiagera enyomba yane yatigirwe egendererete koba ritombe, na kera oyomo oino nigo echanderete enyomba yaye omonyene.

english: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo, omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigateba:

english: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o kabere, bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai omobani, rikamoteebia:

english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ; Ask now the priests concerning the law , saying ,
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Boria abakuani naki amachiiko agoteeba.

english: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No.
ekegusii: Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”

english: Then answered Haggai , and said , So is this people , and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD ; and so is every work of their hands ; and that which they offer there is unclean .
ekegusii: Erio Hagai akairaneria, agateeba, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Naboigo nabaanto aba, na egesaku eke, bare ase obosio bwane, na kera omoremo bagokora namaboko abo nabo ore, na kende gionsi eke bakorua aroro nigo kere egetachenegeti. Omonene okoria eira y’okobasesenia

english: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward , from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD :
ekegusii: “Ase ayio nigo nkobaboria ng’a korwa rituko ria reero mobe mokorengereria buna yarenge ekero keria rigena konya ritarabekwa igoro ase rigena rinde, ase okoagacha Hekalu y’Omonene.

english: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures , there were but ten : when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press , there were but twenty .
ekegusii: Ninki kiabeete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.

english: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands ; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Nigo nabaagete ase okobarentera oborwaire enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia, na embura y’amagena ase chindagera chiaino mwakorerete emeremo. Nonya naboigo timwang’iranerete. Nabo Omonene atebiire.

english: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it .
ekegusii: Korwa rituko ria reero, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, ekero oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene bwabegetwe, na kogenderera, morengererie buna arabe!

english: Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea, as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .
ekegusii: Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria reero nimbasesenie.” Eira y’Omonene ase Serubabeli

english: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Josedech , the high priest , and to the residue of the people , saying ,
ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na abatigari bonsi b’abaanto, obaborie:

english: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month , saying ,
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi oria o kianda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai naende, rikamoteebia,

english: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth ;
ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, omoteebie ng’a inche nintengechie igoro chionsi amo nense.

english: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .
ekegusii: Ning’onchorane ebirogo bi’obonene bw’abarwoti, ninsirie chinguru chi’amarwoti ’abaanto b’ebisaku. Ning’onchorane chigari na abachiriini; chibarasi nchigwe amo nabachiriinete, kera omonto naite oyomwabo n’omoro.

english: In that day , saith the LORD of hosts , will I take thee, O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the LORD , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko riria ninkoire aye Serubabeli omosomba one, mosinto o Sealitieli. Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningokore obe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane, ekiagera nagochorire. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.”

english: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the LORD ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Josedech , the high priest ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the LORD , and work : for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts :
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Aye Serubabeli, obe omokong’u na aye Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, obe omokong’u, nainwe abanto bonsi abamore ase ense eye, mobe abakong’u ase ogokora emeremo, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo inde amo nainwe.

english: And I will shake all nations , and the desire of all nations shall come : and I will fill this house with glory , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing’ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.

english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Chifeta nechiane, ne chitaabu nechiane. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.

english: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former , saith the LORD of hosts : and in this place will I give peace , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.” Ogosemia korwa ase abakuani

english: For the law having a shadow of good things to come , and not the very image of the things , can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect .
ekegusii: Naki ayare ime y’amachiiko nekiriri gioka ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, gose tari ekieni ekenyene. Ase ayio, ebing’wanso biria biria biare koruegwa kera omwaka botambe tibiarenge konyara kobaikerania abwo baare kobirua.

english: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .
ekegusii: Ase ogwancha okwo twanyorire ogochenwa ase okoruegwa kw’omobere o Yeso Kristo ara rimo rioka.

english: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .
ekegusii: Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.

english: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
ekegusii: Naki ase okoruegwa okomo obaikeranirie ase amatuko onsi abwo bachenirwe.

english: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us : for after that he had said before ,
ekegusii: Naki Omoika Omochenu noro otobereire kirori. Naki ritang’ani nigo agoteeba iga:

english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin .
ekegusii: Gaki, okorusigwa kw’ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y’ebibe tigekobao naende. Tiga toike ang’e na kobwata okoorokia gwaito
