english: Having therefore , brethren , boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, ntore noboremu bw’ogosoa Aase Aachenu goetera ase amanyinga a Yeso,

english: For then would they not have ceased to be offered ? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins .
ekegusii: Onye mbianyarete, Inee, anga tibiatigetwe, tibikoruegwa? Naki onye abwo baare kobirua bakoorire gochenwa ara rimo, anga tibare kwerora ng’a mbare nebibe naende.

english: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh ;
ekegusii: ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.

english: And having an high priest over the house of God ;
ekegusii: Naende ntore n’Omokuani Omonene igoro y’enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering ; ( for he is faithful that promised ;)
ekegusii: Tiga tobwate mono okoorokia kw’ogosemeria gwaito, totari konyegerigwa; ekiagera ere oyoriete eira nomwegenwa.

english: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :
ekegusii: Naende twechanderane intwe ase intwe, na kobeekana chinguru ase obwanchani, na ase ogokora okuya.

english: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together , as the manner of some is ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more , as ye see the day approaching .
ekegusii: Titotiga gosangererekana amo, buna engencho y’abande ere, korende toremanie intwe ase intwe, kobua mono ekiagera morooche ng’a Rituko riria riaikire ang’e.

english: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,
ekegusii: Naki onye togokora ebibe moeneno magega gotwaikire komanya ekeene, keng’wanso kende tikeri ase engencho y’ebibe.

english: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .
ekegusii: Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.

english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God .
ekegusii: Okogwa ase amaboko a Nyasae ore moyo, eri nering’ana ri’okoondokia.

english: But call to remembrance the former days , in which , after ye were illuminated , ye endured a great fight of afflictions ;
ekegusii: Korende moinyore amatuko e ritang’ani, magega komwabarerigwe omobaso igo mwaremereretie okoamererania okonene kw’ogochandwa.

english: Partly , whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions ; and partly , whilst ye became companions of them that were so used .
ekegusii: Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.

english: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .
ekegusii: Naki mwabarorerete amaabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogooko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.

english: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.

english: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
ekegusii: Naki iigo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.

english: Now the just shall live by faith : but if any man draw back , my soul shall have no pleasure in him .
ekegusii: korende omonyene oboronge one nabe moyo ase okwegena, na, karasukwane, omoyo one tokogokigwa nere.”

english: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition ; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul .
ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.

english: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .
ekegusii: Naki amanyinga e chieeri na aye chimbori takonyara korusia ebibe.

english: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .
ekegusii: Ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, tikwagogetigwe nabirobio.

english: Then said I , Lo , I come ( in the volume of the book it is written of me ,) to do thy will , O God .
ekegusii: Erio ngakwana: Nachire gokora ogwancha kwao, Nyasae, buna eriikire igoro yane ase egetabu.”

english: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein ; which are offered by the law ;
ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani nigo agoteeba, “Ebing’wanso, na ebirugwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe tikwabiganetie, gose tikwagogetigwe nabirobio”, nonya birobio biare korentwa buna amachiiko are goteeba.

english: Then said he , Lo , I come to do thy will , O God . He taketh away the first , that he may establish the second .
ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Rora, nachire gokora ogwancha kwao.” Igo akarusia ebie ritang’ani, erinde abeeke egia kabere.

english: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for , the evidence of things not seen .
ekegusii: Gaki, okwegena nakwo okoba nobomaene ase amang’ana ayio asemeirie, nonya nekeene ki’ayio atari kororekana.

english: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .
ekegusii: Naki igo aganyete omochie ore namaroso, oyo Nyasae aroseti na koagacha.

english: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
ekegusii: Naki abagokwana amang’ana buna ayio nkoorokia bare maiso marore, ng’a nkorigia bare ense yabo abanyene.

english: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
ekegusii: Onye barabwo mbainyorete ense eria ase baruete, anga mbanyorete ribaga koirana aroro.

english: But now they desire a better country , that is , an heavenly : wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God : for he hath prepared for them a city .
ekegusii: Korende bono mbaganetie ense ere engiya kobua, engencho yaye ense ya igoro. Ase ayio Nyasae takorora obosooku korokwa Nyasae obo, ekiagera obaroiseirie omochie.

english: Accounting that God was able to raise him up , even from the dead ; from whence also he received him in a figure .
ekegusii: Akarengereria ng’a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakuure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.

english: For by it the elders obtained a good report .
ekegusii: Naki ase okwo abagaaka abakoro mbaberetwe kirori.

english: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season ;
ekegusii: agachoora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabaanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.

english: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .
ekegusii: Ere nigo abarete ogochaaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng’a nobonda kobua chiniibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng’eria ere bosio.

english: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
ekegusii: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y’omorwoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.

english: (Of whom the world was not worthy :) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .
ekegusii: abanto ense etagwenere koba nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo barenge goetanana ase chirooro na ase ebitunwa, ase amabwago na amakuruma.

english: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi babereirwe kirori goetera ase okwegena kwabo, korende tibanyora ayabarieretwe eira,

english: God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae natang’anete gotogachera intwe egento kere ekiya kobua, naki barabwo tibaikeranetigwe intwe totaiyo.

english: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .
ekegusii: Korende omonto atari nokwegena takonyara komogwenera Nyasae. Naki oyogocha asare nagwenerete gwancha ng’a nareo, naende nigo akobaa eng’eria baria bakomorigia.

english: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,

english: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure ; but he for our profit , that we might be partakers of his holiness .
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.

english: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised there by .
ekegusii: Kera okorongeigwa ase engaki yaye gokororekana ng’a tikori egento ki’omogooko, korende neki’omoichano. Korende magega yaye abakonarire banyore okwama kw’omorembe na okw’oboronge.

english: Follow peace with all men , and holiness , without which no man shall see the Lord :
ekegusii: Kora omokia koba nomorembe nabaanto bonsi, na rigia obochenu, ekiagera onde tari orarore Omonene, atari naborobwo.

english: For ye know how that afterward , when he would have inherited the blessing , he was rejected : for he found no place of repentance , though he sought it carefully with tears .
ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buya ng’a ekero achiete korigia omwando bw’ogosesenigwa korwa magega, agakanigwa, naki tanyora ribaga ri’okoonchoka nonya oririgetie mono namariga.

english: And the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words ; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
ekegusii: na egeturi ki’egetureeri, na eriogi ri’amang’ana. Abwo bayaigwete bagasorora tibateebigwa ing’ana rinde naende.

english: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .
ekegusii: na korigereria Yeso, omochaki na omoikerania bw’okwegena gwaito. Ribaga ri’omogooko oyobegetwe bosio bwaye, akaremereria omosalaba na gochaaya obosooku, ere nigo aikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae.

english: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwaikire egetunwa gekorokwa Sayoni, na omochie o Nyasae ore moyo, Yerusalemu ya igoro, na abamalaika abange batari kobareka,

english: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn , which are written in heaven , and to God the Judge of all , and to the spirits of just men made perfect ,
ekegusii: na omosangererekano bw’omoyega, na omosangererekano bw’abaiborwa b’eritang’ani, abwo amarieta abo ariikire igoro, na Nyasae oyore omogambi bw’abaanto bonsi, na emeika y’abanto abanyene oboronge abaikeraniigwe,

english: And this word , Yet once more , signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that are made , that those things which cannot be shaken may remain .
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri, “Ara rimo naende”, nigo rikoorokia, ng’a ebinto biria bigotengechigwa nigo birang’anyigwe ekiagera biatongetwe, erinde ebitanyare gotengechigwa bibeo.

english: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved , let us have grace , whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear :
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera twanyorire oborwoti obotanyare gotengechigwa, tiga toiranerie ng’a mbuya mono na komokorera Nyasae ase okomogokia amo namasikani na okoiroka.

english: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
ekegusii: Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.

english: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood , striving against sin .
ekegusii: Timorarwana esegi goika mwaiteire amanyinga aino ase okoamererania nebibe,

english: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .
ekegusii: Naki ere oyo Omonene anchete nigo akomoorongeyia, na kong’wania bororo omwana oyo obeire oyoye.”

english: If ye endure chastening , God dealeth with you as with sons ; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not ?
ekegusii: Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?

english: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .
ekegusii: Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.

english: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence : shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits , and live ?
ekegusii: Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?

english: Let brotherly love continue .
ekegusii: Mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.

english: We have an altar , where of they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Ntore negesasiimero aase baria bagokorera Eema batari ne ribaga koria ebinto bikoruegwa aroro.

english: Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Yeso nere agachanderwa isiko y’egeita, erinde achene abanto namanyinga aye ere omonyene.

english: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, togende asare isiko y’omochie, tobwatane nere ase okoramwa kwaye,

english: For here have we no continuing city , but we seek one to come .
ekegusii: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.

english: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .
ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.

english: But to do good and to communicate forget not : for with such sacrifices God is well pleased .
ekegusii: Timweba gokora amaya, na gosanga nabande, naki ebing’wanso binga buna ebi nabio bikomogwenera Nyasae.

english: Obey them that have the rule over you , and submit yourselves : for they watch for your souls , as they that must give account , that they may do it with joy , and not with grief : for that is unprofitable for you .
ekegusii: Moigwere abwo bakobatang’ana, na mobasike, ekiagera barabwo nigo barendete emioyo yaino buna abanto barache korua omobaro, erinde banyare gokora ayio ase omogooko. Onye bagocha koyakora ase okweumia anga taba na gokonywa konde ase more.

english: Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .
ekegusii: Tosabere, naki ntore nobomaene ng’a chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, ntorigetie koba norogendo oruya ase amang’ana onsi.

english: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .
ekegusii: Na inche nabasoroire mono kobua gokora ayio, erinde ng’iranigwe ase more bwango. Ogosesenigwa na ogokwania kw’ogokoorera

english: Now the God of peace , that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus , that great shepherd of the sheep , through the blood of the everlasting covenant ,
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae bw’omorembe oyomorentete naende korwa ase amakweri Omonene oito Yeso, oyore omorisia omonene bwe ching’ondi goetera ase amanyinga y’okobwatana gwa kare na kare,

english: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
ekegusii: ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.

english: And I beseech you , brethren , suffer the word of exhortation : for I have written a letter unto you in few words .
ekegusii: Abaminto, nababoririe, moremererie ring’ana eri ri’ogosorora, ekiagera nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake.

english: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty ; with whom , if he come shortly , I will see you .
ekegusii: Manya ng’a oyominto Timotheo oikire gosiborwa. Amo nere ntoche kobarora karache bwango.

english: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie abwo bonsi bakobatang’ana, na abachenu bonsi. Abwo baruete Italia baabakwanirie.

english: Grace be with you all . Amen . Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

english: Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .
ekegusii: Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.

english: Marriage is honourable in all , and the bed undefiled : but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge .
ekegusii: Okonyuomana gosikwe nabaanto bonsi, na ebiraarero bibe bitari nobosooku, naki abanyaka na abatomani Nyasae nabagaambie ekiina.

english: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
ekegusii: Inyora abwo baare kobatang’ana, abaabateebetie ring’ana ria Nyasae. Naende morengererie mono omoerio bw’obogima bwabo, mobe abegi b’okwegena kwabo.

english: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .
ekegusii: Yeso Kristo buna arenge igoro, na buna are reero, nabo arabe goika kare na kare.

english: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines . For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace ; not with meats , which have not profited them that have been occupied therein .
ekegusii: Timoirwa bogeka namorokererio ao ao, ayare ay’ekegeni, ekiagera mbuya chinkoro chibekwe chinguru ase obuya, gose tari ase emeroberio y’okoria endagera ase eyio barabwo bagendererete neyio tibanyora gokonywa konde.

english: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets ,
ekegusii: Agwo kare, Nyasae nigo are gokwana n’echisokoro chiaito ebiro ebinge ne chinchera chinyinge goetera ase ababani,

english: They shall perish ; but thou remainest ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment ;
ekegusii: Ebio inabisire, korende aye nigo oragenderere kobao, birobio inabigote buna chianga,

english: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up , and they shall be changed : but thou art the same , and thy years shall not fail .
ekegusii: nobiringe buna egetambaa gi’okwambara, na birobio nabionchoke buna chianga. Korende aye naye oria oria ore buna kwarenge, na obogima bwao tibokoba nomoerio.”

english: Are they not all ministering spirits , sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation ?
ekegusii: Abamalaika ngento ki gotatiga emeika y’ogokorera Nyasae, batomire gokorera baria barache konyora omwando bw’ogotooreka?

english: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds ;
ekegusii: korende ase amatuko aya y’omoerio okwanire naintwe goetera ase Omwana oye. Ere oyo Nyasae aragete koba omonyamwando bw’ebinto bionsi, na goetera asare agatonga ense.

english: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high ;
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotobareria obonene bwa Nyasae, na buna Nyasae are, nere naboigo are, naende nigo akobogoria ebinto bionsi ne ring’ana riaye ri’okobua. Gaikire gokora ogosibigwa kw’ebibe, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Obonene igoro. Obonene bw’Omwana o Nyasae

english: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .
ekegusii: Omwana agakorwa koba omonene kobua abamalaika, buna erieta eri anyorete ri’omwando rire rinene kobua ayabo.

english: Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete oboronge, na kogechete ogosaria; ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo, ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.”

english: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard , lest at any time we should let them slip .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, netogwenerete gotegerera mono kobua na kobwata ayatwaigure, titocha gosira.

english: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho ya Nyasae, na ase okobua kwaye, ebinto bionsi mbireo. Ase ayio yamogwenerete ere goikerania Omochaki bw’ogotooreka gwaito goetera ase emechando, erio aire abana abange ase obonene. Ekiagera Yeso nere okoraa gochia ogotoreka

english: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one : for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren ,
ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.

english: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera abana buna akobaroka babwataine ase amanyinga ne chinyama, Yeso naboigo abwataine nayio ayio, erio ase enchera y’amakweri asirie ere oyore nokobua igoro y’amakweri, engencho yaye Saitani,

english: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .
ekegusii: naende ase enchera eyio asibore abwo bonsi barenge abasomba ase obogima bwabo bwonsi, ekiagera bairogete amakweri.

english: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, yamogwenerete abe buna abamwabo ase amang’ana onsi, erinde anyare koba Omokuani omonene, Omonyene amaabera, na omwegenwa ase ogokorera Nyasae, na koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe bia Mwanyabaanto.

english: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ere omonyene achandetwe na goteemwa, nanyare gokonya abwo bagoteemwa.

english: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward ;
ekegusii: Ring’ana riria riakwanetwe gochia ase Chisokoro chiaito nabamalaika nigo riarenge eri’ekeene, na kera oyotaribwatetie gose korigwera nigo anyorete egesusuro keria kiamobwenerete.

english: How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him ;
ekegusii: Inee, naki intwe toranyare gwetooria onye twangire ogotooreka okonene buna oko? Ritang’ani Omonene naraaretie ogotooreka oko, naende baria bamoigwete batoenekeirie buna n’eriekeene.

english: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamenta oborori bwaye nebimanyererio, na amakumia, na ebikone bie chinguru ao ao amo na kogabera abanto ebiegwa bi’Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye. Oria ogotoraa gochia ase ogotooreka

english: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come , whereof we speak .
ekegusii: Naki tari inse y’abamalaika Nyasae abegete Ense eria egochi‐gocha, eyio togokwana.

english: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels ; thou crownedst him with glory and honour , and didst set him over the works of thy hands :
ekegusii: Kwamokorire omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, kwamobekeire egutwa y’obonene na amasikani.

english: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .
ekegusii: Okabakora koba abateneneri igoro ase ebinto bionsi.” Naki ase okobeeka ebinto bionsi inse yaye tatigete gento kende atabegete inse yaye. Korende goika bono titorarora ere okogambera ebinto bionsi bibekire inse yaye.

english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .
ekegusii: Korende twarorire Yeso oyio ase ekero egeke okoretwe koba omoke kobua abamalaika, erio goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae akwe ase engencho ya kera omonto. Bono nigo tokomorora obekeirwe egutwa y’obonene na amasikani ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwaye kw’amakweri.

english: Wherefore , holy brethren , partakers of the heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession , Christ Jesus ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto abachenu, ababwatani b’okorangerigwa gokorwa igoro, morengererie mono Yeso omotomwa na Omokuani Omonene bw’okoorokia gwaito.

english: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart ; and they have not known my ways .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nkagechigwa nekegori keria, ngateba: Botambe abanto aba nigo basirete ase chinkoro chiabo, ne chinchera chiane tibachimanyeti,

english: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest .)
ekegusii: buna natianire ase endamwamu yane: Tibagosoa ense eria ase nare gocha kobaa ogotimoka.”

english: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
ekegusii: Rigereria baminto, taba onde omo oino oyore nenkoro embe y’ogotegena, abaise kweatanana korwa ase Nyasae ore moyo.

english: But exhort one another daily , while it is called To day ; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin .
ekegusii: Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Reero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong’u ase obong’ainereria bw’ebibe.

english: For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end ;
ekegusii: Naki twabeire ababwatani na Kristo, gatorabwate bokong’u ogosemeria gwaito kw’eritang’ani goika omoerio.

english: But with whom was he grieved forty years ? was it not with them that had sinned , whose carcases fell in the wilderness ?
ekegusii: Naende mbarabi abwo ere agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?

english: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest , but to them that believed not ?
ekegusii: Naende nase barabi atianete ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye? Tari ase baria bangete koigwera?

english: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief .
ekegusii: Na igo twarorire ng’a tibanyarete gosoa ase ense eria ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo.

english: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses , in as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house .
ekegusii: Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng’a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.

english: For every house is builded by some man ; but he that built all things is God .
ekegusii: (Kera enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nomonto, korende Nyasae nere omoagachi bw’ebinto bionsi.)

english: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after ;
ekegusii: Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,

english: But Christ as a son over his own house ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .
ekegusii: korende Kristo nigo are omwegenwa buna Omwana igoro ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Intwe nenyomba yaye gatorabwate bokong’u oboremu na ogwetogia kw’ogosemeria goika omoerio. Ogotimoka kore ase Abanto ba Nyasae

english: Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
ekegusii: timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna ekero keria gi’okogechia, ase rituko riria ri’ogoteemwa agwo ase erooro.

english: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .
ekegusii: Agwo chisokoro chiaino nchianteemete ase okondenga, naende nchiaroche ogokora kwane ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.

english: Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .
ekegusii: Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.

english: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest , lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief .
ekegusii: Gaki, tokore omokia gosoa ase ogotimoka koria, erinde onde tacha kogwa ase ogotaigwera kogwekaine koria koria.

english: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rire moyo, naende ndire ne chinguru, nigo rire nobwoge kobua omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere. Nigo rikobeta ime na gwatanana omoyo na omoika, chinengo na emeseto, naende ndinyare komanya ebirengererio na okogania bire ime ase enkoro.

english: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
ekegusii: Naki getongwa kende tikeri getari maiso marore asare, korende ebinto bionsi nigo bire aarabu naende bimaanoire ase amaiso aye, ere oyo torache koa omobaro. Yeso nere Omokuani Omonene Mono

english: Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore n’Omokuani Omonene mono, oyosoete igoro, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae, tobwate mono okoorokia gwaito.

english: For we have not an high priest which can not be touched with the feeling of our infirmities ; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin .
ekegusii: Naki titori n’Omokuani Omonene oyotanyare gotobogoreria oboreu bwaito, korende oyoteemetwe koreng’ana buna intwe ase amang’ana onsi, atakoreti ebibe.

english: Let us therefore come bold ly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .
ekegusii: Gaki, toike ang’e ase ekerogo ki’obonene aase obuya bore, erinde tonyore amaabera na obuya bw’ogotokonya ase engaki y’okoremerwa.

english: For unto us was the gospel preached , as well as unto them : but the word preached did not profit them , not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, intwe twaranderigwe amang’ana amaya buna barabwo. Korende ring’ana riria baigwete tiriabakonyete, ekiagera ekero baare koriigwa tiriasang’ananete nabarabwo ase okwegena.

english: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter there in , and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief :
ekegusii: Gaki, ase ayio ring’ana ndireo, ng’a mbare abanto barache gosoa. Abwo baranderetigwe amang’ana amaya ritang’ani bakamocha gosoa ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo.

english: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .
ekegusii: Ase igo, ogotimoka gw’esabato gwatigaire ase abanto ba Nyasae.

english: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani Omonene ore gochorwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto nigo are kobekwa ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, kobatenenera ase ogokorera Nyasae, arue ebiegwa na ebing’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.

english: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec .
ekegusii: bwatoirwe na Nyasae ng’a n’Omokuani Omonene, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki. Ogokuurera kw’ogoteatanana korwa ase Okwegena

english: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .
ekegusii: Igoro yaye ntore namang’ana amange tware gokwana korende naakong’u koyorokereria, ekiagera mwabeire aboro ase okoigwa.

english: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .
ekegusii: Naki oyokonyora amabeere oka tamanyeti mono ring’ana ri’oboronge, ekiagera nomwana omoke.

english: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age , even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil .
ekegusii: Korende endagera enkong’u ney’abaanto abanene, ekiagera barabwo mbanaretie ebirengererio biabo, na igo mbamanye ogwatanana amaya na amabe.

english: Who can have compassion on the ignorant , and on them that are out of the way ; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity .
ekegusii: Na ere oranyare kobabogoreria ase obwororo abwo batamanyeti gento na batantanire, ekiagera nere omonyene nigo abuire noboreu.

english: Though he were a Son , yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered ;
ekegusii: Nonya orenge Omwana akeorokereria okoigwera ase emechando eyio yamonyorete,

english: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him ;
ekegusii: na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,

english: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ , let us go on unto perfection ; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works , and of faith toward God ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, totige okworokereria kw’eritang’ani gwa Kristo, togenderere toikere oboikeranu. Titobeka naende oboroso bw’okoonchoka korwa ase ogokora gotari nobogima, na obw’okomwegena Nyasae,

english: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari buna oyotari omooronge, goika ebe emeremo yaino, na obwachani boria mwaorogetie ase engencho y’erieta riaye ekero mwakorerete abachenu, na nonya mbono nkobakorera more.

english: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
ekegusii: Na intwe ntoganetie mono kera oyomo oino aorokie omokia oria goika omoerio, na igo amanye obomaene oboikeranu bw’ogosemeria kwaino.

english: That ye be not slothful , but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises .
ekegusii: Timoba aboro, korende mobe abegi b’abaraire ayabarieretwe chiira, buna omwando, goetera ase okwegena na oboremereria. Eira ya Nyasae ney’obomaene

english: For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,
ekegusii: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Aburaamu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,

english: And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase okoremereria Aburaamu akanyora ayarieretwe eira.

english: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
ekegusii: Naki abanto nigo bagotiana ase oyore omonene kobabua, na omoerio bw’okoamererania nemuma egokoora.

english: Where in God , willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel , confirmed it by an oath :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Nyasae arigetie koborokia mono kegima abaraire omwando oria abarierete eira buna atanyare koonchora ayaroberetie, akabeeka emuma gati.

english: That by two immutable things , in which it was impossible for God to lie , we might have a strong consolation , who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us :
ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

english: Of the doctrine of baptisms , and of laying on of hands , and of resurrection of the dead , and of eternal judgment .
ekegusii: na okworokereria gwe chibatiso, na okobekerwa kw’amaboko, na okobokigwa kw’abakuure, na okogambigwa gwa kare na kare.

english: And this will we do , if God permit .
ekegusii: Natokore ayio, Nyasae karatwanchere.

english: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened , and have tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,
ekegusii: Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,

english: And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,
ekegusii: na koigwa obuya bw’ering’ana ria Nyasae amo nogokora gwe chinguru gw’ekero kegochi‐gocha,

english: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
ekegusii: na magega y’ayio kobeatananire, tekonyarekana abwo bakorwe abayia naende ase okoonchorwa, ekiagera bamobambire naende Omwana o Nyasae barabwo abanyene, na komosookia maiso marore.

english: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :
ekegusii: Naki omogondo oyokonywa embura egotwa engaki ase engaki, na gokinia chinyeni, chigokonya abwo bakoyorema, nigo okonyora ogosesenigwa gokorwa ase Nyasae.

english: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .
ekegusii: Korende abanchani, nonya togokwana ayio, ntore nobomaene igoro yaino, ng’a mwanyorire amang’ana amaya kobua, ayakorenta ogotooreka.

english: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .
ekegusii: ekiagera arenge ase ekebono gia sokororia yaye, ekero Melkizedeki aumeranete na Aburaamu.

english: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law ,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
ekegusii: Gaki, onye oboikeranu bware konyorekana ase obokuani bwa Lawi, naki ase obwo abanto banyorete amachiiko, inki kiagerete Omokuani onde abekwe, oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki, na tatoretwe koreng’ana buna Aroni?

english: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .
ekegusii: Naki obokuani koboraonchorwe, goika okoonchorwa kw’amachiiko boigo kobeo.

english: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .
ekegusii: Naki omonene oito, amang’ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw’ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasiimero.

english: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .
ekegusii: Naki igo are maiso marore ng’a ere nigo arwete ase ororeria rwa Yuda. Na ekero Musa akwanete igoro y’ororeria orwo takwanete ing’ana rinde igoro y’abakuani.

english: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,
ekegusii: Kerabe Omokuani onde oorokire oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki amang’ana ayio nigo are maiso marore mono kobua.

english: Who is made , not after the law of a carnal commandment , but after the power of an endless life .
ekegusii: Ere igo obeire Omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omooroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.

english: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .
ekegusii: Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kw’eritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.

english: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .
ekegusii: Naki rinde tiriri riaikeranetigwe namachiiko. Ribaga ri’ayio ogosemeria okore okuya mono kobua gokarentwa, na ase okwo twamoikire Nyasae ang’e.

english: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all ; first being by interpretation King of righteousness , and after that also King of Salem , which is , King of peace ;
ekegusii: Na Aburaamu akamwatanera ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto bionsi. Ritang’ani engencho y’erieta ria Melkizedeki nigo ere iga: “Omorwoti bw’oboronge”, naende nigo are omorwoti o Salemu, engencho yaye: “Omorwoti bw’omorembe”.

english: And in as not without an oath he was made priest :
ekegusii: Kobua mono obokuani obo tibwarenge gokoreka botari nemuma.

english: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament .
ekegusii: Gaki, ase ekerengo eke Yeso obeire oyo bw’obomaene bw’okobwatana kore okuya kobua.

english: And they truly were many priests , because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death :
ekegusii: Baria barenge abakuani b’eritang’ani barenge abange, ekiagera batangetwe namakweri, tibagendererete,

english: But this man , because he continueth ever , hath an unchangeable priesthood .
ekegusii: korende ere, ekiagera agendererete kare na kare, nare nobokuani botari koonchoka.

english: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.

english: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens ;
ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.

english: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity ; but the word of the oath , which was since the law , maketh the Son , who is consecrated for evermore .
ekegusii: Naki amachiiko nigo are kobeeka abanto abare noboreu babe abakuani abanene, korende ring’ana ri’emuma, eriachete magega y’amachiiko, riabekire Omwana, oyoikeranetigwe kare na kare.

english: Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life ; but made like unto the Son of God ; abideth a priest continually .
ekegusii: Ere tarenge na ise, gose na ng’ina, gose ne chisokoro chiaye; tarenge nomochakano bw’amatuko aye, gose nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, korende ogwekanigwe n’Omwana o Nyasae. Igo agendererete koba Omokuani o kare na kare.

english: Now consider how great this man was , unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils .
ekegusii: Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Aburaamu, omogaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto asakorete korwa ase esegi.

english: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
ekegusii: Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Aburaamu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.

english: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better .
ekegusii: Okoamererania tikoiyo nonya ng’ake ng’a oria omoke osesenigwa noria omonene.

english: And here men that die receive tithes ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
ekegusii: Na ase ororeria rwa Lawi Mwanyabaanto, abakonyorekana namakweri, nkonyora bare ensemo ya ikomi, korende aiga ere oyogwatorwa ng’a moyo are nkoyenyora are.

english: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .
ekegusii: Igo nenyare gotebwa, ng’a goetera ase Aburaamu nonya Lawi, oyore konyora ensemo ya ikomi, nere naruete ensemo ya ikomi,

english: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :
ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli magega y’amatuko aria: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ase ebirengererio biabo, ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo ime; inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.

english: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibakworokererania kera omonto nomogisangio oye, gose kera omonto noyomwabo, ogoteeba: Momanye omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi mbamanye inche, korwa omoke mono goika omonene mono.

english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .
ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”

english: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
ekegusii: Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kw’eritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.

english: A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .
ekegusii: omokoreri bw’aase aachenu na obw’Eema y’ekeene, eye Omonene aagachete, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.

english: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .
ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani omonene nigo are kobekwa ase okorua ebiegwa na ebing’wanso. Ase ayio yamogwenerete Omokuani oyo boigo abe negento akorua.

english: For if he were on earth , he should not be a priest , seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law :
ekegusii: Onye nabeete ase ense, anga tabeti Omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiiko achigete.

english: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .
ekegusii: Korende bono Kristo onyorire obokuani bore obuya kobua, koreng’ana buna ere are omobwatania bw’okobwatana okuya kobua, okwo kwagachetwe ase chiira chingiya kobua.

english: For if that first covenant had been faultless , then should no place have been sought for the second .
ekegusii: Naki onye okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani kwarenge tikori na komocha, anga ribaga tiriarigetigwe ase koria gwa kabere.

english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .
ekegusii: Okobwatana oko tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ase rituko riria nababwatete amaboko abo ase okobarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ekiagera tibagendererete ase okobwatana kwane, inche tinabechanderete, Omonene oteebire.

english: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service , and a worldly sanctuary .
ekegusii: Gaki, nonya okobwatana kw’eritang’ani kwarenge nemeroberio ase okomosasiima Nyasae, naende kwarenge nase aachenu ase ense eye.

english: Which stood only in meats and drinks , and divers washings , and carnal ordinances , imposed on them until the time of reformation .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebi nigo biare ase okoria na okonywa, na ogosibigwa ao ao, amachiiko ase omobere ayabekire goika engaki y’okoroisigwa okoyia eike.

english: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come , by a greater and more perfect tabernacle , not made with hands , that is to say , not of this building ;
ekegusii: Korende Kristo oikire gocha, oyore Omokuani Omonene bw’amang’ana amaya agochi‐gocha. Agaeta ase eema ere enene na eng’ikeranu kobua, etakoretwe namaboko, engencho yaye etari egetongwa gi’ense eye.

english: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .
ekegusii: Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.

english: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
ekegusii: tari mono kobua amanyinga a Kristo, ere ase Omoika o kare na kare akerua ere omonyene ase Nyasae koba ekeng’wanso getari na komocha, anyare gochena okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaito ime korwa ase emeremo ekwete, erinde tokorere Nyasae ore moyo?

english: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament , that by means of death , for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament , they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eye ere nomobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, erinde abwo barangerigwe banyore omwando oria o kare na kare, oyo barieretwe eira, ekiagera amakweri aikire gokoreka ase okobabooria barabwo korwa ase ogosaria koria bakorete ase okobwatana kw’eritang’ani.

english: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .
ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw’omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.

english: For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
ekegusii: Naki okoriera kw’omwando nigo kogoikeranigwa ekero ki’amakweri, ekiagera onye oria oyoriete ore moyo, rirorio tikori na nguru.

english: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani tigwachagete gotare namanyinga,

english: Saying , This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you .
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana oko Nyasae abachikerete inwe.”

english: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these ; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these .
ekegusii: Gaki, yagwenerete emegwekano y’ebinto bire igoro bichenwe ase ebing’wanso buna ebio, korende ebinto bia igoro ebinyene bichenwe nebing’wanso bire ebiya kobua ebi.

english: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands , which are the figures of the true ; but into heaven itself , now to appear in the presence of God for us :
ekegusii: Naki Kristo tasoete Aase Aachenu akoretwe namaboko, naro omogwekano bw’Aachenu a ekeene, korende agasoa igoro aanyene, na bono nao akororekana ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase engencho yaito intwe.

english: Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others ;
ekegusii: Ere terua omonyene ekero ase ekero, buna Omokuani omonene are gosoa Aase Aachenu kera omwaka amo namanyinga atari ayaye.

english: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .
ekegusii: Onye nabo, anga yamogwenerete achandwe ekero ase ekero korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe. Korende bono, ase amatuko ’omoerio bw’ense akaoroka ara rimo rioka ase okorusia ebibe ase okong’wanswa kwaye ere omonyene.

english: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :
ekegusii: Buna abanto bagacheirwe ogokwa ara rimo, na magega y’ogokwa ekiina,

english: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.

english: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience ;
ekegusii: Eyio nekiorokererio ase engaki eye ya bono, ekero ebiegwa na ebing’wanso bikorugwa, ebitanyare komoikerania oyokobirua erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.

english: Israel is an empty vine , he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars ; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo banga buna omosabibu okororekana ore omuya mono okwama amasabibu. Buna koreng’ana okwama kwabo kwamentekanete, naboigo bagendererete koagacha ebisasimero ebinge; na buna bagendererete gotenenka, naboigo bagendererete gotenenia chisiiro bagosasiima.

english: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .
ekegusii: Ekero ndaganie, nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia, erio abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbasangererekane amo, baabachere amo baabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bibere.

english: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught , and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck : I will make Ephraim to ride ; Judah shall plow , and Jacob shall break his clods .
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo baarenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbeekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na Abayakobo goika babe bakobosa.

english: Ye have plowed wickedness , ye have reaped iniquity ; ye have eaten the fruit of lies : because thou didst trust in thy way , in the multitude of thy mighty men .
ekegusii: Mwasimekire ayare amabe, mwagesire aya atari ay’oboronge, mwarire ayare okwama kw’oborimo. Nigo mwasemeretie ogokora kwaino, na obonge bw’abasikari baino chituoni.

english: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
ekegusii: Ase ayio eriomana rie chiseegi ndibe ase egati y’abanto baino, ne chiburi chiaino chisarigwe, buna omorwoti Salimani asaretie Beti‐Aribeli ase rituko riria ri’esegi, abang’ina amo nabana babo banachanetwe bakaba ebing’ese.

english: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
ekegusii: Naboigo na abanto ba Beteli barabakore ase engencho y’obobe bwaino obonene. Kobogokiamoka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli naitwe akwe.

english: Their heart is divided ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima.

english: For now they shall say , We have no king , because we feared not the LORD ; what then should a king do to us?
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo mbateebe, “Titobwati omorwoti, ekiagera titomoirogeti Omonene. Inee! Toraba nomorwoti, ngento ki aratokorere?”

english: They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .
ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, naende betiania ase oborimo ekero bagokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania; ase igo ekiina nigo gekobacheera buna ekemeri kere nobosongo ase emetaro ya mogondo.

english: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y’omogwekano bw’emori bagosasiima agwo Beti‐Aveni. + 10:5 Beti‐Aveni: engencho yaye, rora 4:15 Abwo bakoyosasiima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng’ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.

english: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb : Ephraim shall receive shame , and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel .
ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio noirwe Asuri, oegwe omorwoti Yarebu buna ekeegwa. Abaefraimu mbabe nobosooku, na Abaisraeli mbasookigwe boigo ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.

english: As for Samaria , her king is cut off as the foam upon the water .
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amaache igoro.

english: They shall walk after the LORD : he shall roar like a lion : when he shall roar , then the children shall tremble from the west .
ekegusii: “Abanto abwo mbabwatie Omonene; ere narume buna endo, ee, narume, na abanto baye mbache korwa bosongo bakoiguswa.

english: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt , and as a dove out of the land of Assyria : and I will place them in their houses , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Abaisraeli amo Abayuda bakogaambigwa

english: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bang’etananire n’amang’ana ’oborimo, na Abaisraeli boigo n’amang’ana ’obong’ainereria; n’Abayuda nigo bagendererete gosaria ase Nyasae, oria ore Omochenu na Omwegenwa.

english: As they called them, so they went from them : they sacrificed unto Baalim , and burned incense to graven images .
ekegusii: Buna bagendererete korangerigwa, nabo bagendererete kona‐kwerusanania. Nigo babete bakorua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae Baali, na bagasamba ubani ase emegwekano baarenge gosasiima.

english: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms ; but they knew not that I healed them.
ekegusii: Ninche norokereretie Abaefraimu gotaara, nkababogoria namaboko aane, korende abanto abwo tibamanyete ng’a nigo naganetie kobagwenia.

english: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them.
ekegusii: Nigo nabang’usete ne chingori chinyororo, ee, ne chingori chi’obwanchani. Nigo nororobetie rikorogoto igoro ye chinsea chiabo, ngekumba gochia inse nkabarageria.

english: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .
ekegusii: “Barabwo mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na Abaasuri mbaabagambere, ekiagera bangire koirana gocha ase ’nde.

english: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .
ekegusii: Omoro nogwere emechie yabo nobotindi, nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biabo na gosaria kende gionsi ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.

english: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo banchete gontiga, nonya bakorangerigwa gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, onde tari okomotogia, nonya noyomo.

english: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man ; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city .
ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde Nyasae, tindi Mwanyabaanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha ase more inde nekeririanda.

english: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, nigo bakobwatia embeo ya moocha omobaso bwonsi. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.

english: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge gokwana nababani, nkaba nkobaorokeria amaroro amange ao ao, na goetera ase ababani nkaba ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio.

english: Is there iniquity in Gilead ? surely they are vanity : they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal ; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields .
ekegusii: Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna obonge bwa amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”

english: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly : therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu abwo bagechetie Omonene goika ere akaba nendamwamu enene mono; ase ayio Omonene obo nabeeke okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kobe igoro yabo; nabairanerie okogechia kwabo.

english: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah , and will punish Jacob according to his ways ; according to his doings will he recompense him.
ekegusii: Omonene nabwate amang’ana akwomania Abayuda, nae abanto ba Yakobo egesusuro koreng’ana ne chinchera chiabo, nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.

english: Even the LORD God of hosts ; the LORD is his memorial .
ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.

english: Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye irana ase Nyasae oo. Obwatie obwanchani na oboronge bwaye, erio obe komosemeretie Nyasae oo botambe. Okogaambigwa kogendererete

english: He is a merchant , the balances of deceit are in his hand : he loveth to oppress .
ekegusii: Omoonchoreria nigo abwate ebirengero bi’obong’ainereria ase amaboko aye, nigo anchete gokora oborianania.

english: And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bagoteeba: “Amaene twabeire abanda, twenyoreire obotenenku; ase emeremo yaito yonsi monto onde tari oranyare gotosoera ng’a nigo twanyorire obonda obo ase enchera y’ebibe bi’oborianania.”

english: When Ephraim spake trembling , he exalted himself in Israel ; but when he offended in Baal , he died .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaefraimu baarenge gokwana, abanto nigo baarenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y’Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasiima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.

english: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up ; his sin is hid .
ekegusii: “Obobe bw’Abaefraimu nigo bosibire amo, na ebibe biabo nigo birikire bigachire.

english: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son ; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children .
ekegusii: Obororo bonga buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore mbobachere, nigo bonga buna omwana otari nokomanya osinyirwe gosoka korwa ase enda ya ng’ina ekero engaki yaye yaikire.

english: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nabaisa koibora babuche ase egati y’abamwabo, omwaga korwa moocha noche, ee, omwaga o Omonene noche korwa ase erooro. Erio ebisima biabo bi’amaache biome, ne chinsoko chiabo chikame. Omwaga oyio nosirie kegima chinibo chiabo banchete.

english: Samaria shall become desolate ; for she hath rebelled against her God : they shall fall by the sword : their infants shall be dashed in pieces , and their women with child shall be ripped up .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria mbaegwe egesusuro, ekiagera basaririe ase Nyasae obo, mbaitwe nemioro, na abana babo banachanwe ebing’ese. Abakungu babo bare barito mbatandorwe chinda.”

english: And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
ekegusii: Nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe goetania, bakaroisia emegwekano ye chifeta bagosasiima, eyio babombete nobong’aini. Eyio yonsi nemeremo yaroisirie nabaroisia b’ebinto. Nigo bagoteeba igoro y’abwo: “Abwo bakorua abanto baba ebing’wanso, nigo bakonyunyunta emegwekano eyio ye chimori.”

english: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud , and as the early dew that passeth away , as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor , and as the smoke out of the chimney .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo nabasire buna ritaturi ria mambia, gose buna riime rigosira bwango, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga korwa ase ekeooreri, gose buna erioki rigoetera ase ekebao riasira.

english: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt , and thou shalt know no god but me : for there is no saviour beside me .
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero mwarenge ase ense ya Misiri. Timwabeete momanyete enyasae ende yonsi otatiga inche; omotooria onde tari otatiga inche.

english: According to their pasture , so were they filled ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted ; therefore have they forgotten me.
ekegusii: Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.

english: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo ase bare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.

english: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps , and will rend the caul of their heart , and there will I devour them like a lion : the wild beast shall tear them.
ekegusii: Nimbaumokere buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, mbatandore ebikuba biabo, erinde mbaite mbarie buna endo ekoria, ee, nimbe buna eng’iti y’orosana mbatandorane.

english: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help .
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli mwesiririe inwe abanyene ase okoba mamincha yane, inche oyo narenge ooboseemiaka kwaino.

english: O Israel , return unto the LORD thy God ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.

english: Take with you words , and turn to the LORD : say unto him, Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .
ekegusii: Irana ase Omonene, momoteebie amang’ana aya: Toruserie obobe bwaito bwonsi obwo twakorire, bwanchere ayare amaya, naintwe torue asore ogotogia kw’ebikoba biaito konga buna okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bie chieri.

english: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
ekegusii: Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amaabera ase oyore entakana. Omonene okoriera Abaisraeli eira y’okobanyorera obogima oboyia

english: I will heal their backsliding , I will love them freely : for mine anger is turned away from him.
ekegusii: “Ningwenie abwo batigire obwegenwa bwabo. Nimbanche nenkoro yane yonsi, ekiagera endamwamu yane yabatigire.

english: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
ekegusii: Niimbe buna riime ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo mbasiche buna ebisicha ebiya, mbakinie emeri buna emete ya Lebanoni.

english: His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .
ekegusii: Ebisabo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw’emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri’emete ya Lebanoni.

english: They that dwell under his shadow shall return ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
ekegusii: Abwo baramenye inse ase ekiriri kiabo bairane, bagenderere koreereta buna ebimeri bia mogondo mbasiche, na obonene bwabo bobe buna obw’emesabibu ya Lebanoni.

english: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him: I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .
ekegusii: Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ngokora nemegwekano yaino mogosasiima? Ninche omonyene naigure ogosaba kwaino inwe Abaefraimu, nimbairanerie, naende ninche mbarendete. Inche nigo inde buna omotarakwa omobese; na okwama kwaino nigo gokonyorekana ime yane.” Amang’ana ay’ogokoorera

english: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right , and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
ekegusii: Oyore omong’aini, nere oramanye amang’ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi’Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.

english: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
ekegusii: Abayuda amo n’Abaisraeli mbasangererekane, erinde bechorere oyomo korwa ase egati yabo erio abe omotwe obo okobaraa, barue ase ense eye. Ee, rituko erio ria Yesireeli nigo rirabe rinene.

english: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea . And the LORD said to Hosea , Go , take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms : for the land hath committed great whoredom , departing from the LORD .
ekegusii: Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamoteebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”

english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim ; which conceived , and bare him a son .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Hosea akagenda, akanyuoma Gomeri, omoiseke o Dibulaimu, na omokungu oyio akaba morito, akamoiborera omwana omoisa.

english: And it shall come to pass at that day , that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio nimbune amata ’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.”

english: And she conceived again , and bare a daughter . And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah : for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel ; but I will utterly take them away .
ekegusii: Naende Gomeri akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoiseke. Erio Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ruhama, + 1:6 Lo‐Ruhama: engencho yaye: tanchiri ekiagera tinkonyara kogenderera koba namaabera ase Abaisraeli, gose tinkobaabera nonya ng’ake.

english: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the LORD their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .
ekegusii: Korende nindorere Abayuda amaabera. Inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nimbatoorie ne chinguru chiane, gose tari ase okorwana namata, gose nemioro, gose ne chibarasi chi’esegi, gose nabariini be chibarasi.”

english: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah , she conceived , and bare a son .
ekegusii: Ekero Gomeri atachire Lo‐Ruhama, + 1:8 Lo‐Ruhama: engencho yaye, oyotaroreiri amaabera akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana onde omoisia.

english: Then said God , Call his name Lo-ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ami, + 1:9 Lo‐Ami: engencho yaye: tibari abanto baane ekiagera inwe timori abana baane, na inche tinkoba Nyasae oino.” Abaisraeli bakoiranerigwa amaya abo

english: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi ; and to your sisters , Ru-hamah .
ekegusii: Mobaroke abamino abamura Ami, na abamino abasubati Ruhama. Gomeri otari omwegenwa okworokia ng’a Abaisraeli tibari abegenwa

english: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers , and none shall deliver her out of mine hand .
ekegusii: Bono nimochabore chianga chiaye ase amasio ’abanchi baye, imotige ore getirianda, gose monto onde tari oranyare komotooria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

english: I will also cause all her mirth to cease , her feast days , her new moons , and her sabbaths , and all her solemn feasts .
ekegusii: Ninsirie kegima omogooko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echiikire.

english: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
ekegusii: Ninsirie emesabibu yaye, na emeko yaye, ebio akwanete igoro yabo, agateeba ng’a eyio nero eng’eria yaye abanchi baye bamoete. Inche ninsirie emete eyio ebe orosana, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiyerie.

english: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me, saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Ning’ee omokungu oyio egesusuro ase engencho y’amatuko ayio akorerete chinyasae chiria chia Baali emeyega, agachisambera ubani, naende agechabera ebigera bi’amato na ebinto binde bi’ogwechabera, ekero arenge gotunyana abanchi baye, korende akaanyeba.” Nabo Omonene agoteeba. Obwanchani Omonene ase abanto baye

english: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana y’obwanchani.

english: And it shall be at that day , saith the LORD , that thou shalt call me Ishi ; and shalt call me no more Baali .
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio nondoke omosacha oo, gose tokogenderera kondoka Baali yao.

english: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
ekegusii: Nindusie amarieta e chinyasae Baali korwa ase omonwa bw’omokuungu oyio, tichiatorwa nonya ng’ake ase amarieta abo.”

english: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven , and with the creeping things of the ground : and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth , and will make them to lie down safely .
ekegusii: “Ase rituko riria, ninkore okobwatana ne ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura inse, ase engencho y’abanto baane. Ninsirie korwa ase ense eye amata, na emioro, na esegi, ntige batimoke bare n’obotoereru.

english: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever ; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness , and in judgment , and in lovingkindness , and in mercies .
ekegusii: “Ninkoriere boko nkonyuome obe oyone goika kare na kare; ee, ninkoriere boko ase oboronge n’ekeene, na ase obwanchani botari koera, na ase amaabera.

english: Plead with your mother , plead : for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband : let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight , and her adulteries from between her breasts ;
ekegusii: Mosorore nyoko, ee, momosorore, ekiagera ere tari omokungu one, na inche tindi omosacha oye. Tiga atige obonyaka borue ase obosio bwaye, na obotomani borue ase egekuba kiaye.

english: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the LORD .
ekegusii: Ee, ninkoriere boko ase obwegenwa, naye omanye ng’a ninche Omonene.

english: And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the LORD , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth ;
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio nebe ng’a ninyigwe ogosaba kwa igoro, na igoro nchiigwe ogosaba gw’ense.

english: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil ; and they shall hear Jezreel .
ekegusii: Erio ense eiranerie erue endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ebinto ebio mbiisanekie okogania kwa Yesireeli.

english: Lest I strip her naked , and set her as in the day that she was born , and make her as a wilderness , and set her like a dry land , and slay her with thirst .
ekegusii: Atakoreti bo, nimochabore chianga chiaye, imotige getirianda abe bosa buna ase rituko riria aiboretwe. Nimokore abe buna erooro, na buna ense enyomo, nimotige akwe ase engencho y’erang’o.

english: And I will not have mercy upon her children ; for they be the children of whoredoms .
ekegusii: Tinkororera abana baye amaabera, ekiagera nigo bare abana b’omokuungu omotayayi.

english: For their mother hath played the harlot : she that conceived them hath done shamefully : for she said , I will go after my lovers , that give me my bread and my water , my wool and my flax , mine oil and my drink .
ekegusii: Ng’ina nigo arenge omotayayi, ee, oyo obaiborete nigo arenge gokora amang’ana y’obosoku. Nigo ateebete iga: niimbe ngotunyana abanchi baane, abwo bakong’a endagera nkoria, na amaache, na amarionya e ching’ondi, na egatani, na amaguta, na edivai.

english: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns , and make a wall , that she shall not find her paths .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nintiiche enchera yaye namagwa, ning’agache orwaki roramotange ase agoetera.

english: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband ; for then was it better with me than now .
ekegusii: Nabe okobwatia abanchi baye, korende takobaikeera; nabarigie, korende takobanyora. Erio nateebe: “Bono nkoirana inde, ngende ase omosacha one bw’eritang’ani, ekiagera engaki eria narenge asare nigo narenge buya kobua bono.

english: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
