ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akabateebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okuure.

english: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there , to the intent ye may believe ; nevertheless let us go unto him .
ekegusii: Na inche nagokire ase engencho yaino, ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare kwegena. Korende bono togende asare.”

english: Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .
ekegusii: Nabo Thomas, ore korokwa Barongo, agateebia aborokigwa bamwabo, “Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere.”

english: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia goika aroro akanyora Lazaro ng’a oikire koba ase embeera amatuko ane.

english: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem , about fifteen furlongs off :
ekegusii: Bethania nigo orenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, koreng’ana chimaeli ibere.

english: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .
ekegusii: Na abanto abange ase Abayahudi bagacha ase Martha na Mariamu, erinde baabaremie ase engencho y’ogokwa kw’oyomwabo.

english: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .
ekegusii: Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komoorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.

english: Then said Martha unto Jesus , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
ekegusii: Erio Martha agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.

english: But I know , that even now , whatsoever thou wilt ask of God , God will give it thee .
ekegusii: Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Thy brother shall rise again .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Momura omino naboke.”

english: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .
ekegusii: Martha akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a nache kobokigwa ase okobokigwa rituko ri’omoerio.”

english: Jesus said unto her , I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.

english: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die . Believest thou this ?
ekegusii: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”

english: She saith unto him , Yea , Lord : I believe that thou art the Christ , the Son of God , which should come into the world .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene; inche negenire ng’a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae, oria ogocha ase ense.” Okobokigwa kwa Lazaro

english: And when she had so said , she went her way , and called Mary her sister secretly , saying , The Master is come , and calleth for thee .
ekegusii: Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”

english: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly , and came unto him .
ekegusii: Mariamu agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera.

english: Therefore his sisters sent unto him , saying , Lord , behold , he whom thou lovest is sick .
ekegusii: Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma amang’ana asare, bakaboora, “Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire.”

english: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town , but was in that place where Martha met him .
ekegusii: Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.

english: The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi baria barenge amo nere nyomba ime bakomoremia, bagachia korora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango na gosoka, bakamotunyana, bakagete ng’a nigo akogenda embeera erinde arere aroro.

english: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was , and saw him , she fell down at his feet , saying unto him , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
ekegusii: Erio Mariamu agachia goika aase aria Yeso arenge, akamorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.” Akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.” |alt="She fell on her feet and told him “Lord, if you were here, my brother would not have died“" src="GW-129.TIF" size="col" loc="John 11:29-39" copy="Graham Wade" ref="11:32"

english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komoorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.

english: And said , Where have ye laid him ? They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ng’ai mwamobeka?” Bakamoteebia, “Omonene, inchwo orore!”

english: Jesus wept .
ekegusii: Yeso akaiyeria amariga.

english: Then said the Jews , Behold how he loved him !
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaboora, “Rora buna amwanchete.”

english: And some of them said , Could not this man , which opened the eyes of the blind , have caused that even this man should not have died ?
ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo oramogetie amaiso ’omouko oria, tare konyara kogwenia oyo takwa?”

english: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso oichanete naende ase omoyo oye, agaika ase embeera. Ero nigo yarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye.

english: Jesus said , Take ye away the stone . Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamoteebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”

english: When Jesus heard that , he said , This sickness is not unto death , but for the glory of God , that the Son of God might be glorified thereby .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw’amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tinagoteebia ng’a koregene norore obonene bwa Nyasae?”

english: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said , Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
ekegusii: Nabo bakarusia rigena riria. Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, “Tata, nakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okonyigwa.

english: And I knew that thou hearest me always : but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me .
ekegusii: Na inche nimanyete ng’a nigo okonyigwa amatuko onsi; korende ase engencho y’omoganda oyo ong’etanaine konya nakwanire aya, banyare gwancha ng’a naye gwantomete.”

english: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice , Lazarus , come forth .
ekegusii: Ekero akwanire igo, agaaka eriogi rinene, “Lazaro, soka isiko!”

english: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them , Loose him , and let him go .
ekegusii: Oria okwete agasoka, oboyirie egetambaa amagoro na amaboko; obosio bwaye boboyirie egetambaa. Yeso akabateebia, “Mosansore, momotige agende.” Abakuani abanene bakomoboera Yeso bamoite (Mat 26:1-5; Mar 14:1-2; Luk 22:1-2)

english: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
ekegusii: Nabo abange ase Abayahudi abachete amo na Mariamu na korora aya Yeso akorete, bakamwegena.

english: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .
ekegusii: Korende abande babo bakagenda ase Abafarisai, bakabateebia aya Yeso akorete.

english: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakaboora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.

english: If we let him thus alone , all men will believe on him : and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation .
ekegusii: Toise komotiga iga, abanto bonsi mbamwegene; na Abarumi mbache, batoure Aase aito Aachenu na egesaku giaito.”

english: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase bare, Kayafa, oyorenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabateebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.

english: Now Jesus loved Martha , and her sister , and Lazarus .
ekegusii: Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.

english: Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .
ekegusii: Gose timorengerereti ng’a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”

english: And this spake he not of himself : but being high priest that year , he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation ;
ekegusii: Naende eri takwanete ase omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabana ng’a Yeso nakwe ase engencho y’egesaku keria;

english: And not for that nation only , but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad .
ekegusii: gose tari ase engencho y’egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.

english: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death .
ekegusii: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.

english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .
ekegusii: Yeso tataarete naende maiso marore ase egati y’Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang’e nerooro, goika omochie okorokwa Efraimu; akamenya aroro amo naborokigwa baye.

english: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand : and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover , to purify themselves .
ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang’anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.

english: Then sought they for Jesus , and spake among themselves , as they stood in the temple , What think ye , that he will not come to the feast ?
ekegusii: Nabo bakarigia Yeso, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase Hekalu, “Naki morooche? Tagocha‐gocha ase rituko rinene nonya ng’ake?”

english: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment , that , if any man knew where he were , he should shew it , that they might take him .
ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.

english: When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .
ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ng’a nomorwaire, agateebana amatuko abere aria aase arenge.

english: Then after that saith he to his disciples , Let us go into Judæa again .
ekegusii: Erio magega ase aya agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”

english: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee ; and goest thou thither again ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi nigo barenge gokorigia gokoaka amagena, na aye gokogenda aroro naende?”

english: Jesus answered , Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.

english: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .
ekegusii: Nabo amatuko atano na rimo ritang’ani ri’Epasaka Yeso agaika Bethania, agwo aase Lazaro arenge, oria okwete, akabokigwa na Yeso.

english: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death ;
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina baite Lazaro boigo,

english: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away , and believed on Jesus .
ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho yaye abange b’Abayahudi bakagenda bakamwegena Yeso. Yeso ogochengerwa kagosoa Yerusalemu (Mat 21:1-11; Mar 11:1-11; Luk 19:28-40)

english: On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia abanto abange abachete ase Rituko Rinene, kobachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are Yerusalemu,

english: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon ; as it is written ,
ekegusii: Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,

english: These things understood not his disciples at the first : but when Jesus was glorified , then remembered they that these things were written of him , and that they had done these things unto him .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende magega Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorere aya.

english: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave , and raised him from the dead , bare record .
ekegusii: Nabo omoganda bw’abaanto abwo barenge amo nere ekero arangeretie Lazaro korwa ase embeera ime, na komobokia, bakaba bakomoorokia.

english: For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .
ekegusii: Ekio nakio kiagerete omoganda okagenda komoorotota, ekiagera baigwete ng’a okorire egekone eke.

english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing ? behold , the world is gone after him .
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng’a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.” Okorigia kw’Abagiriki

english: There they made him a supper ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .
ekegusii: Bakamoroiseria endagera aria. Martha ere agakora emeremo eyio, korende Lazaro nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria baikaransete ase endagera amo nere.

english: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast :
ekegusii: Naende mbarenge Abagiriki bande ase abanto abwo batiirete kogenda gosasiima ase ekero kie Rituko Rinene.

english: The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachiera Filipo o Bethisaida bw’ensemo ya Galili, bakamosaba, bakobora, “Omosike, ntorigetie korora Yeso.”

english: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
ekegusii: Filipo akagenda, agateebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagateebia Yeso.

english: And Jesus answered them , saying , The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabora, “Ensa yaikire, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abakwe.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie; Enyeke y’engano etagweti esoe inse ase riroba ekwe, nigo ekobao yoka; korende kerakwe, nigo ekwama okwama okonge.

english: If any man serve me , let him follow me ; and where I am , there shall also my servant be : if any man serve me , him will my Father honour .
ekegusii: Omonto karankorere, antunyane; na aase inde inche, nomosomba one nao arabe; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike.

english: Now is my soul troubled ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
ekegusii: “Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, ontoorie korwa ase ense eye! Yaya, korende ase engencho y’ayio naikeire ensa eye.

english: Father , glorify thy name . Then came there a voice from heaven , saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again .
ekegusii: Tata, obake erieta riao!” Erio eriogi rigacha korwa igoro, rigateba, “Naribakire, na inche nindibake naende.”

english: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
ekegusii: Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakaboora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakaboora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”

english: Jesus answered and said , This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.

english: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .
ekegusii: Bono ekiina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.

english: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
ekegusii: Na inche kondaimokererigwe igoro korwa ase ense, nimbang’use bonsi ase ’nde.”

english: This he said , signifying what death he should die .
ekegusii: Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

english: Then Jesus said unto them , Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Omobaso nigo ore amo nainwe egeka egeke bosio. Genda ekero more nomobaso oria, omosunte tocha kobabua; ere oyokogenda ase omosunte ime tamanyeti aase akogenda.

english: While ye have light , believe in the light , that ye may be the children of light . These things spake Jesus , and departed , and did hide himself from them .
ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b’omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa ase bare. Ogotegena kw’abaanto ba Boyahudi, korende mbareo aborokigwa ba bobisi

english: But though he had done so many miracles before them , yet they believed not on him :
ekegusii: Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge ase amasio abo, tibamwegenete,

english: Therefore they could not believe , because that Esaias said again ,
ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete tibanyara kwegena. Naki Isaya nigo ateebete naende,

english: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon’s son , which should betray him ,
ekegusii: Korende Yudasi Iskariota mosinto o Simioni, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,

english: These things said Esaias , when he saw his glory , and spake of him .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang’ana aye.

english: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him ; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue :
ekegusii: Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y’Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,

english: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .
ekegusii: ekiagera mbanchete ogotogia kw’abaanto kobua ogotogia kwa Nyasae. Okworokereria kwa Yeso maiso marore

english: Jesus cried and said , He that believeth on me , believeth not on me , but on him that sent me .
ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi akabora, “Oyonyegenire inche, tanyegeneti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete.

english: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me .
ekegusii: Na ere oyondoche inche nigo aroche ere oyontomete.

english: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
ekegusii: Inche nachire imbe omobaso ase ense, erinde kera oyonyegenire, tamenya ase omosunte ime.

english: And if any man hear my words , and believe not , I judge him not : for I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .
ekegusii: Naende omonto karaigwe amang’ana aane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia, ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyetoorie.

english: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .
ekegusii: Oyo oranyange na otancheti amang’ana aane, nare noyo oramogambie. Ring’ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia ase rituko ri’omoerio.

english: For I have not spoken of myself ; but the Father which sent me , he gave me a commandment , what I should say , and what I should speak .
ekegusii: Naki tinakwanete ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende Tata oyontomete onchikiire aya ngokwana.

english: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence , and given to the poor ?
ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”

english: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .
ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio nigo ngokwana buna Tata antebetie.”

english: This he said , not that he cared for the poor ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .
ekegusii: Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amaabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduki ye chibesa, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.

english: Then said Jesus , Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateeba, “Motige, agache aya goika rituko ri’ogotindekwa kwane.

english: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus’ sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
ekegusii: Nabo omoganda omonene bw’Abayahudi bakamanya ng’a ere nao are aria; bagacha, tari ase engencho ya Yeso yoka, korende barore Lazaro, oyio Yeso abogetie korwa ase abakuure.

english: Now before the feast of the passover , when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father , having loved his own which were in the world , he loved them unto the end .
ekegusii: Ekero rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ritaraba, Yeso akamanya ng’a ensa yaye yaikire akorua ase ense eye na kogenda ase Ise, akaba nanchete abanto baye abarenge ase ense, naboigo akabancha goika omoerio. Yeso ogosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro|alt="Jesus washes his disciples’ feet" src="Gw-132.tif" size="col" loc="John 13:1-15" copy="Graham Wade" ref="13:1"

english: Jesus saith to him , He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oyoikire gwesibia tagwenereti gwesibia naende, otatiga amagoro oka, korende obeire omochenu omobere bwonsi; na inwe mwabeire abachenu, korende tai mwensi.”

english: For he knew who should betray him ; therefore said he , Ye are not all clean .
ekegusii: Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua; ase ayio agateeba, “Timori abachenu mwensi.”

english: Ye call me Master and Lord : and ye say well ; for so I am .
ekegusii: Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene; na igo mbuya mokobora, naki naboigo inde.

english: If I then , your Lord and Master , have washed your feet ; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet .
ekegusii: Nabo onye inche, inde Omonene naende Omworokia, nabasibirie amagoro aino, nebagwenerete gosibania amagoro inwe ase inwe.

english: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
ekegusii: Naki nabaeire ekiorokererio ekiya, erinde ayio nabakorera inwe, nainwe moyakore.

english: If ye know these things , happy are ye if ye do them .
ekegusii: Komoramanye ayio, mosesenirie komorayakore.

english: Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .
ekegusii: Nabatebirie aya korwa bono ritang’ani ataraba, erio ekero arache koba monyare kwegena ng’a ninche ere.

english: And supper being ended , the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon’s son , to betray him ;
ekegusii: Ekero ki’endagera ya mogoroba, Saitani gaikire kobeeka Yudasi omwana o Simioni Iskariota enkoro y’okomorua,

english: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said , Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”

english: Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakarigererania, bagasinywa komanya gose ning’o atora.

english: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
ekegusii: Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.

english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .
ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero akamoraga, akamobooria, “Moborie ning’o atora?”

english: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him , Lord , who is it ?
ekegusii: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamobooria, “Omonene, ning’o?”

english: Jesus answered , He it is , to whom I shall give a sop , when I have dipped it . And when he had dipped the sop , he gave it to Judas Iscariot , the son of Simon .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akairaneria, “Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye ki’omogati na komoa.” Agatongereria Yudasi, mosinto o Simioni Iskariota, egesamunye, agakemoa.

english: And after the sop Satan entered into him . Then said Jesus unto him , That thou doest , do quickly .
ekegusii: Naende magega kanyorire egesamunye keria, Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Aya ogokora, yakore bwango.”

english: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.

english: For some of them thought , because Judas had the bag , that Jesus had said unto him , Buy those things that we have need of against the feast ; or , that he should give something to the poor .
ekegusii: Ekiagera Yudasi arenge kobogoria esanduki ye chitaabu, baria bande bagakaga ng’a Yeso nigo are komoteebia, “Gora ebitorigetie ase Rituko Rinene”, gose ng’a abae abataka egento.

english: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God ;
ekegusii: Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.

english: He then having received the sop went immediately out : and it was night .
ekegusii: Nabo oyo, kanyorire egesamunye keria agasoka bwango; na igo bwarenge botuko. Ogochika okoyia kw’obwanchani

english: Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said , Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .
ekegusii: Erio oyio gasokire, Yeso akabora, “Bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto obakirwe, na Nyasae obakirwe ime yaye.

english: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.

english: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .
ekegusii: Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.” Ogokana gwa Petero gokobanwa (Mat 26:31-35; Mar 14:27-31; Luk 22:31-34)

english: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him , Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane magega.”

english: Peter said unto him , Lord , why cannot I follow thee now ? I will lay down my life for thy sake .
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ntanyare kogotunyana bono? Nindue obogima bwane ase engencho yao.”

english: Jesus answered him , Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake ? Verily , verily , I say unto thee , The cock shall not crow , till thou hast denied me thrice .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Obogima bwao noborue ase engencho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Etuoni tekobuga goika gwankanire ara gatato.

english: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.

english: After that he poureth water into a bason , and began to wash the disciples’ feet , and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded .
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka amaache ase esani, agachaaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.

english: Then cometh he to Simon Peter : and Peter saith unto him , Lord , dost thou wash my feet ?
ekegusii: Nabo agaika ase Simioni Petero, Oyo akamoteebia, “Omonene! Aye ngosibia ore amagoro aane?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto him , What I do thou knowest not now ; but thou shalt know hereafter .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye magega.”

english: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him , If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .
ekegusii: Petero akamokania, “Togonsibia amagoro aane nonya ng’ake.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntagosibeti, tori nobomo amo nainche.”

english: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”

english: Let not your heart be troubled : ye believe in God , believe also in me .
ekegusii: “Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.

english: Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .
ekegusii: Tibwegeneti ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang’ana aya inche nkobateebia, tindi gokwana ase okobua kwane, korende n’Tata ore ime yane nigo agokora emeremo yaye.

english: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works’ sake .
ekegusii: Inyegene ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane; gose inyegene ase engencho y’emeremo emenyene.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also ; and greater works than these shall he do ; because I go unto my Father .
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.

english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name , that will I do , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .
ekegusii: Kende gionsi morasabe ase erieta riane, ekio nangekore, erinde Tata abakwe ime ase Omwana.

english: If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it.
ekegusii: Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore. Yeso okoriera aborokigwa baye eira ng’a nabatomere Omoika Omochenu

english: If ye love me , keep my commandments .
ekegusii: “Komoranyanche namobwate amachiiko aane.

english: And I will pray the Father , and he shall give you another Comforter , that he may abide with you for ever ;
ekegusii: Naende inche ninsambe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,

english: Even the Spirit of truth ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .
ekegusii: Omoika bw’ekeene. Ense etanyare komwancha, ekiagera temorochi, nonya nkomomanya. Korende inwe mwamomanyire, ekiagera namenyete amo nainwe, naende nabe ime yaino.

english: I will not leave you comfortless : I will come to you .
ekegusii: “Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche ase more.

english: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
ekegusii: Nkere ekero egeke, ense etandore naende; korende inwe namondore, ekiagera inche moyo inde, na inwe namobe moyo.

english: In my Father’s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .
ekegusii: Ase enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabateebia. Nkogenda nde kobaroiseria aase.

english: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father , and ye in me , and I in you .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ime ase Tata, na inwe ime yane, na inche ime yaino.

english: He that hath my commandments , and keepeth them , he it is that loveth me : and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father , and I will love him , and will manifest myself to him .
ekegusii: Oyore namachiiko aane, na koyabwata, oyio nere onyanchete; ere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, na inche nimwanche na kweorokia asare.”

english: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
ekegusii: Yudasi (tari oria o Iskariota) akamobooria, “Omonene, naki yaba ng’a norigetie kweorokia ase tore, gose tari ase ense?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto him , If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.

english: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings : and the word which ye hear is not mine , but the Father’s which sent me .
ekegusii: Oyotanyancheti, tabwateti amang’ana aane; naende ring’ana mwaigure tari eriane, korende neria Tata oyontomete.

english: These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .
ekegusii: “Aya nabateebirie ekero inde ase more.

english: But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .
ekegusii: Korende Omokonyi, Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome ase erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, na kobainyoria onsi aya nabateebirie.

english: Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
ekegusii: Omorembe nabatigeire; omorembe one nabaeire; tinkoyobaa buna ense ekoyobaa. Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino, gose timoba nobwoba.

english: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
ekegusii: Mwaigwete inche nkobateebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende ase more. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.

english: And now I have told you before it come to pass , that , when it is come to pass , ye might believe .
ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie ritang’ani ataraba, erinde ekero akoba, mwegene.

english: And if I go and prepare a place for you , I will come again , and receive you unto myself ; that where I am , there ye may be also .
ekegusii: Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie ase ’nde, erinde ase ’nde inche, nainwe mobeo.

english: Hereafter I will not talk much with you : for the prince of this world cometh , and hath nothing in me .
ekegusii: Tingokwana nainwe amang’ana amange naende, ekiagera omonene bw’ense ngocha are. Tari nokobua ase ’nde;

english: But that the world may know that I love the Father ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .
ekegusii: korende nigo ngokora buna Tata achigeete, erinde ense emanye ng’a nimwanchete Tata. Imoka, torue aa!

english: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
ekegusii: Nase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”

english: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest ; and how can we know the way ?
ekegusii: Thomas akamobooria, “Omonene, titomanyeti aase ogochia, naki toramanye enchera?”

english: Jesus saith unto him , I am the way , the truth , and the life : no man cometh unto the Father , but by me .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera ase ’nde.

english: If ye had known me , ye should have known my Father also : and from henceforth ye know him , and have seen him .
ekegusii: Onye imwamanyete inche, anga imwamomanyete Tata boigo; korwa bono mwamomanyire, naende mwamororire.”

english: Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
ekegusii: Filipo akamoteebia, “Omonene, tworokie Tata, toisaneke.”

english: Jesus saith unto him , Have I been so long time with you , and yet hast thou not known me , Philip ? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father ; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteeba: Tworokie Tata?

english: I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .
ekegusii: “Inche ninche omosabibu bw’ekeene, na Tata one nomooroiseria.

english: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love ; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments , and abide in his love .
ekegusii: Komorabwate amachiiko aane, namomenye ase obwanchani bwane, buna inche nabwatete amachiiko a Tata one na komenya ase obwanchani bwaye.

english: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .
ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde omogooko one obe ime yaino, naende ng’a omogooko oino oikeranigwe.

english: Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
ekegusii: Onde tari ore nobwanchani obonene kobua obo, obw’omonto akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho y’abasani baye.

english: Ye are my friends , if ye do whatsoever I command you .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachiikire.

english: Henceforth I call you not servants ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .
ekegusii: Tinkobaroka naende abasomba, ekiagera omosomba tamanyeti eki omonene oye agokora; korende inwe nabarokire abasani, ekiagera onsi aya naigwete korwa ase Tata nabaorokeirie.

english: Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae. Ense na Omoika bw’ekeene

english: These things I command you , that ye love one another .
ekegusii: “Aya nabachiikire naro aya: mwanchane.

english: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .
ekegusii: Ense kerabageche, momanyete ng’a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe.

english: If ye were of the world , the world would love his own : but because ye are not of the world , but I have chosen you out of the world , therefore the world hateth you .
ekegusii: Onye nab’ense mware, anga ense ’yancha abare abaye, korende ekiagera inwe timori ab’ense, otatiga inche nabachorire korwa ase ense, ase ayio ense yabagechire.

english: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .
ekegusii: Kera orosagia ime ase ’nde orotameti, nigo akoronacha, na kera orokwama nigo akorososa, erinde romente kwama.

english: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake , because they know not him that sent me .
ekegusii: Korende aya onsi nabaabakorere ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete.

english: If I had not come and spoken unto them , they had not had sin : but now they have no cloke for their sin .
ekegusii: Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.

english: He that hateth me hateth my Father also .
ekegusii: Oyongechete inche, nigo amogechete na Tata one.

english: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .
ekegusii: Onye ntakorete emeremo ase bare eye monto onde atakoreti, anga tibabete nebibe, korende bono barorire, naende batogechire inche na Tata.

english: But when the Comforter is come , whom I will send unto you from the Father , even the Spirit of truth , which proceedeth from the Father , he shall testify of me :
ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.

english: And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .
ekegusii: Na inwe boigo mwambereire birori, ekiagera korwa omochakano mwarenge amo nainche.

english: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you .
ekegusii: Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring’ana nabateebirie.

english: Abide in me , and I in you . As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself , except it abide in the vine ; no more can ye , except ye abide in me .
ekegusii: Menya ime yane, na inche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotabeti ime ase omosabibu, naboigo nainwe motamenyeti ime yane.

english: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .
ekegusii: Inche nomosabibu, na inwe nechinsagia. Oyo omenyete ime yane, na inche ime yaye, oyio name mono, ekiagera ntaiyo inche, timokonyara gokora kende gionsi.

english: If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .
ekegusii: Omonto otamenyeti ime yane, nigo aratugutwe isiko buna orosagia rwomete. Chinsagia chiomete nigo chigosangererigwa, na korutwa ase omorero, na koyia.

english: If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .
ekegusii: Komoramenye ime yane, na amang’ana aane karabe ime yaino, saba kera ekemoganetie na inwe namokorerwe.

english: Herein is my Father glorified , that ye bear much fruit ; so shall ye be my disciples .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata abakwe ekero mwamire mono; na inwe namobe aborokigwa baane.

english: As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .
ekegusii: Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.

english: These things have I spoken unto you , that ye should not be offended .
ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nabateebirie timocha kogochwa.

english: Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more ;
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’oboronge, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, gose timokondora naende;

english: Of judgment , because the prince of this world is judged .
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ekina, ekiagera omonene bw’ense eye okoorire kogambigwa.

english: I have yet many things to say unto you , but ye cannot bear them now .
ekegusii: “Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobateebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono.

english: Howbeit when he , the Spirit of truth , is come , he will guide you into all truth : for he shall not speak of himself ; but whatsoever he shall hear , that shall he speak : and he will shew you things to come .
ekegusii: Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw’Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang’ana agochi‐gocha nabateebie engencho yaye.

english: He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
ekegusii: Ere nambake inche, ekiagera nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.

english: All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
ekegusii: Onsi ayare aya Tata nayane; ase ayio ngateba ng’a nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie. Yeso ogoakera aborokigwa baye ng’a batigare buya

english: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .
ekegusii: “Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.”

english: Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
ekegusii: Nabo abande baborokigwa baye bagateebania, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore; na: Nkogenda nde ase Tata?”

english: They said therefore , What is this that he saith , A little while ? we cannot tell what he saith .
ekegusii: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba, ng’a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”

english: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them , Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ng’a mbarigetie komoboria, akabateebia, “Inee! Nigo mokoborania inwe ase inwe ase erio natebiire: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore, naende nkere ekero egeke morandore?

english: They shall put you out of the synagogues : yea , the time cometh , that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service .
ekegusii: Nabaabaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng’a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , That ye shall weep and lament , but the world shall rejoice : and ye shall be sorrowful , but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Inwe namorere na kweng’ereria, korende ense negoke; inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nakoonchoke koba omogooko.

english: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .
ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogooko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.

english: And ye now therefore have sorrow : but I will see you again , and your heart shall rejoice , and your joy no man taketh from you .
ekegusii: Nabo nainwe bono nigo more nomoichano; korende nimbarore naende, ne chinkoro chiaino nachigoke, na omogooko oino onde tari orabaure.

english: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring’ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Komorasabe Tata kende gionsi ase erieta riane nabae.

english: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .
ekegusii: Goika reero timorasaba gento ase erieta riane; saba, namonyore, erinde omogooko oino obe omoikeranu.

english: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs : but the time cometh , when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs , but I shall shew you plainly of the Father .
ekegusii: “Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.

english: At that day ye shall ask in my name : and I say not unto you , that I will pray the Father for you :
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobateebia ng’a nimbasabere ase Tata,

english: For the Father himself loveth you , because ye have loved me , and have believed that I came out from God .
ekegusii: ekiagera Tata omonyene nigo abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, na mwegenire ng’a inche nigo narwete ase Tata.

english: I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
ekegusii: Narwete ase Tata, ngacha ase ense; naende ngotiga nde ense na nkoirana nde ase Tata.”

english: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omobayeeno onde bwonsi.

english: And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .
ekegusii: Naende ayio nabaabakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.

english: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things , and needest not that any man should ask thee : by this we believe that thou camest forth from God .
ekegusii: Bono twamanyire ng’a kwamanyire onsi, torigeti omonto akoborie. Ase ayio twegenire ng’a nigo kwarwete ase Nyasae.”

english: Jesus answered them , Do ye now believe ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Igo bono mwegenire?

english: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .
ekegusii: Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.

english: These things I have spoken unto you , that in me ye might have peace . In the world ye shall have tribulation : but be of good cheer ; I have overcome the world .
ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”

english: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie aya, erio engaki eria egocha, moyainyore ng’a inche nabateebeetie. “Tinabateebeetie aya korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe.

english: But now I go my way to him that sent me ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?
ekegusii: Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari ase more okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?

english: But because I have said these things unto you , sorrow hath filled your heart .
ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabateebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.

english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie erire ri’ekeene: Nebe buya ase more inche ngende, ekiagera ntagendeti, Omokonyi oria tagocha ase more; korende kondagende, nimotome ase more.

english: And when he is come , he will reprove the world of sin , and of righteousness , and of judgment :
ekegusii: Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang’ana ’ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekiina;

english: Of sin , because they believe not on me ;
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ebibe, ekiagera tibanyegeneti inche;

english: These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said , Father , the hour is come ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,

english: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine ; and I am glorified in them .
ekegusii: Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.

english: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
ekegusii: Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde ase ore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.

english: And now come I to thee ; and these things I speak in the world , that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves .
ekegusii: Na bono ngocha nde ase ore, na aya nkoyakwana, inde ase ense ime, erinde omogooko one obe oikeranigwe ime yabo.

english: I have given them thy word ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
ekegusii: Inche nabaeire ring’ana riao; ense yabagechire, ekiagera barabwo tibari abanto b’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.

english: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .
ekegusii: Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.

english: They are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari ab’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.

english: Sanctify them through thy truth : thy word is truth .
ekegusii: Obachene ase ekeene; ring’ana riao nario ekeene.

english: As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .
ekegusii: Buna gwantomete inche ime ase ense, na inche naboigo nabatomire barabwo ase ense ime.

english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .
ekegusii: Na ase engencho yabo nechenire, erinde nabarabwo bachenwe ase ekeene.

english: As thou hast given him power over all flesh , that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him .
ekegusii: buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi, erinde bonsi aba kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare na kare.

english: Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word ;
ekegusii: “Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,

english: That they all may be one ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .
ekegusii: bonsi babe abamo, buna aye Tata ore ime ase ’nde, na inche ime yao, erinde na aba babe abamo ime yaito; ense enyare kwengena ng’a naye gwantomete.

english: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
ekegusii: Na obonene boria kwang’ete nabaeire, babe abamo, buna intwe tore oyomo;

english: I in them , and thou in me , that they may be made perfect in one ; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me , and hast loved them , as thou hast loved me .
ekegusii: inche ime yabo, na aye ime yane, banyare goikerana babe abamo. Igo ense emanye ng’a naye gwantomete, okabancha barabwo, buna kwanyanchete inche.

english: Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .
ekegusii: Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.

english: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
ekegusii: Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.

english: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
ekegusii: Nabamanyetie erieta riao, naende nimbarimanyie, erinde obwanchani boria kwanyanchete inche bobe ime yabo, na inche imbe ime yabo.”

english: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
ekegusii: Na obogima bwa kare na kare nabwo obo: bakomanye aye Nyasae bw’ekeene bweka, naende Yeso Kristo gwatomete.

english: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .
ekegusii: Inche nakobakire ase ense, emeremo eria kwang’ete gokora nayekoorire.

english: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
ekegusii: Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang’ani ense etaratongwa.

english: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me ; and they have kept thy word .
ekegusii: “Erieta riao nariorokeirie abanto baria kwang’ete korwa ase ense. Barabwo nigo barenge abao, okabang’a inche, ne ring’ana riao baribwatire.

english: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee .
ekegusii: Bono bamanyire ng’a onsi aya kwang’ete nigo akorwa ase ore.

english: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .
ekegusii: Naki amang’ana kwang’ete nabayaeire, na barabwo bayabwatire, mbamanyete ekeene ng’a nigo narure ase ore, bakeegena ng’a naye gwantomete.

english: I pray for them : I pray not for the world , but for them which thou hast given me ; for they are thine .
ekegusii: Inche nabasabeire barabwo; tindi gosabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang’eire ekiagera barabwo nabao.

english: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .
ekegusii: Yeso gakwanire amang’ana aya, akaimoka amo naborokigwa baye kogenda ng’umbu y’akarooche Kedron, aase omogondo orenge. Ere na aborokigwa baye bagasoa aroro.

english: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest’s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant’s name was Malchus .
ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero narenge nomoyio o birende, akayong’usa, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto kwaye gw’okorio. Na omosomba oria erieta riaye nigo are korokwa Maliko.

english: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi amo nomotang’ani obo, na abarendi baria b’Abayahudi bakabwata Yeso, bakamosiba.

english: And led him away to Annas first ; for he was father in law to Caiaphas , which was the high priest that same year .
ekegusii: Erio bakamoira ritang’ani ase Anasi oyorenge ise biara Kayafa, oria orenge Omokuani omonene omwaka oria.

english: And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .
ekegusii: Simioni Petero na omworokigwa onde bagatunyana Yeso. Omworokigwa oria onde nigo amanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yeso ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene,

english: But Peter stood at the door without . Then went out that other disciple , which was known unto the high priest , and spake unto her that kept the door , and brought in Peter .
ekegusii: korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo omworokigwa oria onde, oyomanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene agasoka agakwana nomoiseke orenge korenda gesieri, akarenta Petero ime.

english: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples ? He saith , I am not .
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria orenge korenda gesieri akaboria Petero, “Aye tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye omonto oyo?” Ere agakana, “Tari inche.”

english: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .
ekegusii: Abasomba baria na abarwani nigo barenge bateneine, bautete omorero bw’amakara, ekiagera obokendu mbwarenge, bakaba ngwota bare omorero. Petero nere nigo arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero.

english: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang’ana igoro yaborokigwa baye, na amang’ana ’okworokereria kwaye.

english: And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
ekegusii: Na Yudasi, oria omoruete naamanyete aase aria, ekiagera Yeso are kogenda aroro ekero ase ekero amo naborokigwa baye.

english: Jesus answered him , I spake openly to the world ; I ever taught in the synagogue , and in the temple , whither the Jews always resort ; and in secret have I said nothing .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore. Amatuko onsi nigo narenge kworokereria ase chisinagogi na ase Hekalu, aase Abayahudi bonsi baare gosangererekana, gose tintebeti ing’ana bobisi.

english: Why askest thou me ? ask them which heard me , what I have said unto them : behold , they know what I said .
ekegusii: Nase ki okomboria? Boria baria baigwete aya nakwanete nabarabwo; barabwo mbamanyete aya nabateebeetie.”

english: And when he had thus spoken , one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand , saying , Answerest thou the high priest so ?
ekegusii: Gachia gokwana amang’ana aya, oyomo bw’abarendi baria oteneine ang’e, agaaka Yeso oroe, akabora, “Naboigo okoiraneria Omokuani omonene?”

english: Jesus answered him , If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nakwana bobe, orokia obobe boria, korende onye nakwana buya, ninki okong’akera?”

english: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .
ekegusii: Nabo Anasi akamoira osibire ase Kayafa, Omokuani omonene.

english: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .
ekegusii: Na Simioni Petero nigo arenge oteneine ogwota omorero. Bakamoteebia, “Aye boigo tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye?” Ere agakana, akabora, “Tari inche.”

english: One of the servants of the high priest , being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off , saith , Did not I see thee in the garden with him ?
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba b’Omokuani Omonene, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakorooche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”

english: Peter then denied again : and immediately the cock crew .
ekegusii: Petero agakana naende. Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga. Yeso ase obosio bwa Pilato gabana o Rumi (Mat 27:1-2; 11—14; Mar 15:1-5; Luk 23:1-5)

english: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled ; but that they might eat the passover .
ekegusii: Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibaabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.

english: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabachiera isiko, akababoria, “Ngosoera ki mobwate ase omonto oyo?”

english: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .
ekegusii: Nabo Yudasi gaikire konyora omoganda bw’abarwani, na abarendi baruete ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, akagenda aroro ne chitaaya na ebieri, na ebinto bi’esegi.

english: They answered and said unto him , If he were not a malefactor , we would not have delivered him up unto thee .
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta ase ore.”

english: Then said Pilate unto them , Take ye him , and judge him according to your law . The Jews therefore said unto him , It is not lawful for us to put any man to death :
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”

english: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again , and called Jesus , and said unto him , Art thou the King of the Jews ?
ekegusii: Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende, akarangeria Yeso, akamobooria, “Inee! Naye omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

english: Jesus answered him , Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naye gwateebire ayio aye omonyene, gose nabaanto bande bagotebirie amang’ana aya igoro yane?”

english: Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Inee! Inche n’Omoyahudi nde? Abanto b’egesaku kiao na abakuani abanene bakorentire ase ’nde. Inki gwakorete?”

english: Jesus answered , My kingdom is not of this world : if my kingdom were of this world , then would my servants fight , that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now is my kingdom not from hence .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oborwoti bwane tibori obw’ense eye. Onye oborwoti bwane mbwarenge obw’ense eye, abasomba baane anga mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’Abayahudi, korende bono oborwoti bwane tibori obw’aa.”

english: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered , Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Aye nomorwoti rende?” Yeso akairaneria, “Aye gwateebete ng’a inche nomorwoti. Inche nigo naiboretwe ase engencho y’aya, na ase engencho y’aya, ngacha ase ense, erinde imbe kirori ase ekeene. Kera oyore oyo bw’ekeene nigo akoigwa eriogi riane.”

english: Pilate saith unto him , What is truth ? And when he had said this , he went out again unto the Jews , and saith unto them , I find in him no fault at all .
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Ekeene ngento ki?” Gakwanire ring’ana eri agachiera Abayahudi isiko eria kabere, akabateebia, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare.

english: But ye have a custom , that I should release unto you one at the passover : will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
ekegusii: Korende inwe more nengencho ng’a nabasiborera omonto oyomo ase ekero ki’Epasaka; nabo morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

english: Jesus therefore , knowing all things that should come upon him , went forth , and said unto them , Whom seek ye ?
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso, kamanyete onsi ayagochia komonyoora, akaoroka, akababoria, “Ning’o mokorigia?”

english: Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .
ekegusii: Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakaboora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.

english: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them , I am he . And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudasi nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.

english: As soon then as he had said unto them , I am he , they went backward , and fell to the ground .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero Yeso achia kobateebia, “Ninche ere,” bakairana magega, bagaaka inse.

english: Then asked he them again , Whom seek ye ? And they said , Jesus of Nazareth .
ekegusii: Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakaboora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”

english: Jesus answered , I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia ng’a ninche ere; nabo onye mokondigia inche, batige aba bagende.”

english: That the saying might be fulfilled , which he spake , Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none .
ekegusii: Erio riikeranigwe ring’ana riria akwanete, “Aba kwang’ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo.”

english: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus , and scourged him .
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akaira Yeso, akamoaka emecharichi.

english: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng’a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”

english: Jesus answered , Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”

english: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him : but the Jews cried out , saying , If thou let this man go , thou art not Cæsar’s friend : whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omorwoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”

english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he brought Jesus forth , and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement , but in the Hebrew , Gabbatha .
ekegusii: Erio ekero Pilato achia koigwa amang’ana aya, akarenta Yeso isiko, agaikaransa igoro ase ekerogo gi’ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire n’Amagena, naende ase Ekeiberania, Gabata.

english: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
ekegusii: Nigo yarenge Okwearigania gw’Epasaka; naende nigo yarenge koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo. Agateebia Abayahudi, “Rora omorwoti oino!”

english: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Cæsar .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, “Morusie, morusie, mobambe!” Pilato akababoria, “Imobambe omorwoti oino?” Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, “Titori nomorwoti otatiga Kaisari.”

english: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .
ekegusii: Erio agwo akamobeka ase amaboko abo abambwe. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Mar 15:21-32; Luk 23:26-43) Barabwo bakabwata Yeso.

english: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull , which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha :
ekegusii: Ere agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika aase akorokwa Ekeore; ase Ekeiberania akorokwa Gologotha.

english: Where they crucified him , and two other with him , on either side one , and Jesus in the midst .
ekegusii: Bakamobamba aroro amo nabaanto bande babere, oyonde ensemo, na oyonde ensemo, na Yeso gati‐gati.

english: And Pilate wrote a title , and put it on the cross . And the writing was , JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS .
ekegusii: Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro ase omosalaba. Igo kiarigetwe, “YESO OMONAZARETI, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

english: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns , and put it on his head , and they put on him a purple robe ,
ekegusii: Abarwani bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera ase omotwe, bakamobekera na eanga embariri,

english: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .
ekegusii: Nabo amariiko ayio abange b’Abayahudi mbayasomete, ekiagera aase aria Yeso abamberetwe nigo arenge ang’e nomochie; naro nigo arigetwe ase Ekeiberania, na Ekerumi, na Ekegiriki.

english: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”

english: Pilate answered , What I have written I have written .
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Aya nariikire, nariikire.” Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Mar 15:33-41; Luk 23:44-49)

english: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .
ekegusii: Erio abarwani kobaabambire Yeso, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagachiatanana chinsemo inye, kera omorwani anyore ensemo yaye. Bakabogoria eganchwa nero. Korende eganchwa eyio tiyasonire; igo yabwatanirie korwa igoro goika inse.

english: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother’s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .
ekegusii: Naboigo abarwani bakorete. Korende ase omosalaba o Yeso ng’ina, na ng’ina moke, Mariamu moga Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidalena bagatenenao.

english: When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother , Woman , behold thy son !
ekegusii: Erio ekero Yeso achia korora ng’ina na omworokigwa oria anchete bateneine ang’e agateebia ng’ina, “Omong’ina, rora omwana oo!”

english: Then saith he to the disciple , Behold thy mother ! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.

english: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar : and they filled a spunge with vinegar , and put it upon hyssop , and put it to his mouth .
ekegusii: Nkiarenge aroro egetaabo giaichire chinkama, erio bakabeeka esifunchi eichire chinkama igoro ase egetonto, bakamobekera monwa.

english: And said , Hail , King of the Jews ! and they smote him with their hands .
ekegusii: bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!” Bakamoaka chindoe.

english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar , he said , It is finished : and he bowed his head , and gave up the ghost .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo. Yeso okobetwa ritimo na koirwa gotindekwa

english: The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day ,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .
ekegusii: Igo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Abayahudi tibarigetie emebere ebe ase emesalaba igoro ase rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera Esabato eria nigo yarenge enene. Ase ayio bagasaba Pilato ng’a amagoro y’abaanto abwo baabambetwe abunwe, na emebere yabo erusigweo.

english: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .
ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakagenda, bakabuna amagoro abo, oyo bw’eritang’ani, na oyo o kabere, abwo baabambetwe amo na Yeso.

english: But when they came to Jesus , and saw that he was dead already , they brake not his legs :
ekegusii: Bagachia gochiera Yeso, bakarora ng’a oikire gokwa, tibamobuna amagoro aye.

english: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side , and forthwith came there out blood and water .
ekegusii: Korende oyomo bw’abarwani akamobeta ritimo rikere riaye, akaruao bwango amanyinga na amaache.

english: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .
ekegusii: Nere oyoyaroche akaba kirori, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene, nere omanyire ng’a igo agokwana ekeene, erinde inwe monyare kwegena.

english: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yusufu bw’Arimathaya agasaba Pilato ribaga arusie omobere o Yeso. Ere nigo arenge omworokigwa o Yeso, korende bobisi, ekiagera airogete Abayahudi. Pilato akamoa ribaga. Igo agacha, akarusia omobere oye.

english: Pilate therefore went forth again , and saith unto them , Behold , I bring him forth to you , that ye may know that I find no fault in him .
ekegusii: Pilato akaoroka naende isiko, akabateebia, “Rora, inche namorentire ase more, monyare komanya ng’a tindochi komocha konde asare.”

english: Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .
ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria omobere o Yeso, bakayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, bakayoaka amaguta aria amanukato, buna yarenge engencho y’Abayahudi ase ogotindeka.

english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .
ekegusii: Naende aase aria abamberetwe norengeo omogondo, na ime ase omogondo oboina oboyia, aase monto onde konya atarabekwa.

english: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
ekegusii: Na ase engencho y’Okwearigania kw’Abayahudi bakabeeka Yeso aroro, ekiagera oboina boria bwarenge ang’e.

english: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoka isiko, obekeire egutwa eria y’amagwa na eanga eria y’oborwoti embariri. Pilato akabateebia, “Rora omonto oyo!”

english: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komoorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”

english: The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”

english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he was the more afraid ;
ekegusii: Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua.

english: And went again into the judgment hall , and saith unto Jesus , Whence art thou ? But Jesus gave him no answer .
ekegusii: Agasoa ase ekegambero, akaboria Yeso naende, “Ing’ai kwarure aye?” Korende Yeso tamoiraneria.

english: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .
ekegusii: Agwo omochakano ndiarengeo Ring’ana, ne Ring’ana nigo riarenge amo na Nyasae, na rirorio Ring’ana nigo riarenge Nyasae.

english: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .
ekegusii: Nao arenge ase ense ime, ense egatongwa goetera asere, na abanto b’ense tibamomanya.

english: He came unto his own , and his own received him not .
ekegusii: Agaacha ase abaye, na barabwo abaare abaye tibamwancha.
