english: But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
ekegusii: Korende bonsi abamoitabete na kwegena erieta riaye, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae.

english: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .
ekegusii: Abwo baiboirwe, tari korwa ase amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omobere, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omonto, korende nigo baiboirwe na Nyasae.

english: And the Word was made flesh , and dwelt among us , ( and we beheld his glory , the glory as of the only begotten of the Father ,) full of grace and truth .
ekegusii: Na rirorio Ring’ana rigakoreka koba omobere, akamenya ase egati yaito. Tokarora obonene bwaye, obonene buna obw’Omwana omomoima oruure ase Tata, oichire nobuya na ekeene.

english: John bare witness of him , and cried , saying , This was he of whom I spake , He that cometh after me is preferred before me : for he was before me .
ekegusii: Yohana agakwana igoro yaye, agaaka egeturi, akabora, “Oyo nere nateebete igoro yaye ng’a: Oyorache magega yane nigo are omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.”

english: And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .
ekegusii: Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.

english: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Naki amachiiko arwerete ase amaboko a Musa, obuya na ekeene nigo biachete goetera ase Yeso Kristo.

english: No man hath seen God at any time ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie. Oborori bwa Yohana Omobatisi igoro ya Yeso (Mat 3:1-12; Mar 1:7-8; Luk 3:15-17)

english: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
ekegusii: Naende obo nabwo oborori bwa Yohana, ekero Abayahudi batomete abakuani na Abalawi korwa Yerusalemu bamoboorie, “Aye naye ng’o?”

english: The same was in the beginning with God .
ekegusii: Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.

english: And he confessed , and denied not ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .
ekegusii: Ere akaorokia, takaana, agateeba, “Inche tari Kristo.”

english: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o rende? Toe abatotomete okoiraneria. Naki ogweteeba?”

english: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees .
ekegusii: Na barabwo abatometwe nigo barwete ase Abafarisai.

english: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
ekegusii: Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani?”

english: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not ;
ekegusii: Yohana akabairaneria, “Inche nigo nkobatisa ase amaache, korende egati yaino nateneineo oyomotamanyeti inwe.

english: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
ekegusii: Nere oyoraache magega yane, inche tinyisaini nyesibore enuga y’egekoroto kiaye.”

english: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .
ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete Bethania ng’umbu ya Yorodani, aase Yohana arenge kobatisera. Emanwa y’eng’ondi ya Nyasae

english: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asaare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!

english: All things were made by him ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .
ekegusii: Goetera ase are ebinto bionsi bigakoreka; gento kende gionsi tigiakoregete otatiga goetera ase are.

english: This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .
ekegusii: Oyo nere naare goteeba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto magega yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.

english: And I knew him not : but that he should be made manifest to Israel , therefore am I come baptizing with water .
ekegusii: Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amaache.”

english: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .
ekegusii: Naende Yohana akaorokia, “Narorire Omoika ogoika korwa igoro buna riruma, okobeera igoro asare.

english: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Na inche tinamomanya, korende ere oyontomete kobatisa ase amaache, oyio nere ontebetie: Ere oyo oranyare korora Omoika ogoika na goikaransa igoro yaye, oyio nere okobatisa n’Omoika Omochenu.

english: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .
ekegusii: Na inche narorire, naende naorokirie ng’a oyo nere Omwana o Nyasae.” Aborokigwa b’eritang’ani ba Yeso

english: Again the next day after John stood , and two of his disciples ;
ekegusii: Naende rituko riare kobwatia Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere baborokigwa baye.

english: And looking upon Jesus as he walked , he saith , Behold the Lamb of God !
ekegusii: Akarigereria Yeso ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”

english: And the two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baria babere bakamoigwa ogoteeba aya, bagatunyana Yeso.

english: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them , What seek ye ? They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master ,) where dwellest thou ?
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamoteebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”

english: He saith unto them , Come and see . They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagaacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa ikomi.

english: In him was life ; and the life was the light of men .
ekegusii: Ime yaye nao bwarenge obogima; na obogima obwo nigo bwarenge oborabu ase mwanyabaanto.

english: One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him , was Andrew , Simon Peter’s brother .
ekegusii: Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria babere baigwete Yohana, na gotunyana Yeso.

english: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .
ekegusii: Oyo akanyora ritang’ani Simioni momura omwabo omonyene, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire Masihi” (okoonchorwa kwaye Kristo).

english: And he brought him to Jesus . And when Jesus beheld him , he said , Thou art Simon the son of Jona : thou shalt be called Cephas , which is by interpretation , A stone .
ekegusii: Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simioni, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose rigena). Yeso Okorangeria Filipo na Natanaeli

english: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee , and findeth Philip , and saith unto him , Follow me .
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Yeso akarigia koimoka kogenda Galili. Akanyoora Filipo, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana.”

english: Now Philip was of Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .
ekegusii: Nere Filipo nigo arenge omonto o Bethisaida, omochie bw’Anderea na Petero.

english: Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him, of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .
ekegusii: Filipo akanyoora Natanaeli, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire ere oyo amang’ana aye arigetwe na Musa ase amachiiko, naende nababani, Yeso omwana o Yusufu, omonto o Nazareti.”

english: And Nathanael said unto him , Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth ? Philip saith unto him , Come and see .
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Egento ekiya nakenyare korwa Nazareti?” Filipo akamoteebia, “Inchuo orore.”

english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him , Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !
ekegusii: Yeso akarora Natanaeli ogocha asare, agakwana igoro yaye, “Rora oyo n’Omoisraeli ekeene, otari nobong’ainereria ime yaye!”

english: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him , Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Ing’ai kwamanyera?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani Filipo atarakorangeria, ekero kwarenge inse ase omoko, konya nakororire.”

english: Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God ; thou art the King of Israel .
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”

english: And the light shineth in darkness ; and the darkness comprehended it not .
ekegusii: Noro omobaso obarire ase omosunte, erio omosunte toyorimia.

english: Jesus answered and said unto him , Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Kwegenire ekiagera nagoteebia ng’a nakorooche inse ase omoko? Norore amang’ana amanene kobua aya.”

english: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .
ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete abe kirori, erinde aorokie omobaso, bonsi banyare kwegena goetera asere.

english: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
ekegusii: Oyio tarenge omobaso oria, korende nigo achete aorokie omobaso.

english: That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .
ekegusii: Omobaso bw’ekeene, oria okobarera kera omonto, ngocha orenge ase ense.

english: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Bono ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma Mariamu; Magidalena akagenda ase oboina kobogokiamoka, ekero botarakiamoka buya, akarora ng’a rigena riarusigwe korwa ase oboina.

english: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baria bakagenda chinsobo. Yeso okoorokera Mariamu Magidalena (Mar 16:9-11)

english: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping : and as she wept , she stooped down , and looked into the sepulchre ,
ekegusii: Korende Mariamu nigo ateneine isiko ang’e noboina, okorera; nabo gakorera, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime ase oboina.

english: And seeth two angels in white sitting , the one at the head , and the other at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .
ekegusii: Erio akarora abamalaika babere, barenge ne chianga chindabu, baikaransete, oyomo ase omotwe, naende oyomo ase amagoro, agwo aase omobere o Yeso obegetwe.

english: And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria, “Omokungu, inki okorera?” Akabairaneria, “Nekiagera barusirie Omonene one, na timanyeti aase bamobeka.”

english: And when she had thus said , she turned herself back , and saw Jesus standing , and knew not that it was Jesus .
ekegusii: Kagokwana aya akeonchora gochia magega, akarora Yeso oteneine, tamanya ng’a n’Yeso.

english: Jesus saith unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? whom seekest thou ? She , supposing him to be the gardener , saith unto him , Sir , if thou have borne him hence , tell me where thou hast laid him , and I will take him away .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, ninki okorera? Ning’o okorigia?” Ere agakaga ng’a nomorendi bw’omogondo, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naye kwamoira, nteebia aase kwamobeka, na inche nimorusie.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Mary . She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni ; which is to say , Master .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mariamu.” Ere akeonchora, akamoteebia ase Ekeiberania, “Raboni!” (Okoonchorwa kwaye, Omworokia).

english: Jesus saith unto her , Touch me not ; for I am not yet ascended to my Father : but go to my brethren , and say unto them , I ascend unto my Father , and your Father ; and to my God , and your God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tonkuna, ekiagera tindagenda ase Tata one, korende genda ase abaminto, obateebie, ng’a nkogenda nde ase Tata one oyore Iso oino, ase Nyasae one oyore Nyasae oino.”

english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .
ekegusii: Mariamu Magidalena akagenda, agateebia aborokigwa amang’ana ng’a, “Narorire Omonene”, naende ng’a omotebirie aya. Yeso okoorokera abatomwa (Mat 28:16-20; Mar 16:14-18; Luk 24:36-49)

english: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them , Peace be unto you .
ekegusii: Ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, na ebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera bairogete Abayahudi, Yeso agacha, agatenena gati‐gati akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

english: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
ekegusii: Erio akagenda bwango goika ase Simioni Petero, na ase omworokigwa oria onde, oria Yeso anchete, akabateebia, “Barusirie Omonene korwa ase oboina, korende titomanyeti aase bamobeka.”

english: And when he had so said , he shewed unto them his hands and his side . Then were the disciples glad , when they saw the Lord .
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akaborokia amaboko aye ne rikere riaye. Erio aborokigwa bakagoka kobachia korora Omonene.

english: Then said Jesus to them again , Peace be unto you : as my Father hath sent me , even so send I you .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia eria kabere, “Omorembe obe ase more! Buna Tata antomete, naboigo nainche nabatomire inwe.”

english: And when he had said this , he breathed on them , and saith unto them , Receive ye the Holy Ghost :
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika, akabateebia, “Nyora Omoika Omochenu.

english: But Thomas , one of the twelve , called Didymus , was not with them when Jesus came .
ekegusii: Ko Thomas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, oyokorokwa Barongo, tarenge amo nabarabwo ekero Yeso achete. Yeso okoorokera Thomas|alt="Jesus appears to Thomas" src="Gw-134.jpg" size="col" loc="John 20:24-29" copy="Graham Wade" ref="20:23"

english: The other disciples therefore said unto him , We have seen the Lord . But he said unto them , Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails , and put my finger into the print of the nails , and thrust my hand into his side , I will not believe .
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bande bakamoteebia, “Twarorire Omonene.” Korende ere akabateebia, “Ntarochi amaboko aye na ebimanyererio bi’emesumari, na kobeeka ekiara kiane aase emesumari yamobetete, na kobeeka okoboko kwane rikere riaye ime, tinkwegena nonya ng’ake.”

english: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said , Peace be unto you .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na atato aborokigwa baye nao barenge naende ase enyomba eria ime, na Thomas amo nabarabwo. Yeso agacha ekero ebisieri bisiekire, agatenena gati‐gati, akabora, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

english: Then saith he to Thomas , Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Thomas, “Renta aiga ekiara kiao. Orore amaboko aane. Renta okoboko kwao, okobeke ase rikere riane; toba oyotegeneti, korende oyo bwegenete.”

english: And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
ekegusii: Thomas akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, na Nyasae one!”

english: Jesus saith unto him , Thomas , because thou hast seen me , thou hast believed : blessed are they that have not seen , and yet have believed .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Iga kwegena ekiagera kwandora; mbare nomogooko abatarochi ko begenire.” Engencho yagerete enchiri eye ekarikwa

english: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Petero agasoka, akagenda amo nomworokigwa oria onde, bakabwatia enchera kogenda oboina.

english: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :
ekegusii: Nabo mbire ebikone binde ebinge Yeso akorete ase amasio y’aborokigwa baye bitarikiri ase egetabu eke,

english: But these are written , that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ , the Son of God ; and that believing ye might have life through his name .
ekegusii: korende ebi biarikirwe, erinde monyare kwegena ng’a Yeso nere Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae; naende ase okwegena mobe nobogima ase erieta riaye.

english: So they ran both together : and the other disciple did outrun Peter , and came first to the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Bakaminyoka chimbero bonsi babere amo. Omworokigwa oria onde akaminyoka bwango kobua Petero, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina,

english: And he stooping down , and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying ; yet went he not in .
ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.

english: Then cometh Simon Peter following him , and went into the sepulchre , and seeth the linen clothes lie ,
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero agacha, akamotunyana, agasoa oboina ime, akarora ebitambaa bireo,

english: And the napkin , that was about his head , not lying with the linen clothes , but wrapped together in a place by itself .
ekegusii: na egetambaa keria ki’omotwe oye tikiabekire amo nebitambaa binde, korende nigo kiaringire, kebekire ao gioka.

english: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .
ekegusii: Erio agwo omworokigwa oria onde orenge bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina agasoa, akarora, akeegena.

english: For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .
ekegusii: Naki konya tibaramanya ririiko, ng’a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakuure.

english: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias ; and on this wise shewed he himself .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:

english: Jesus saith unto them , Bring of the fish which ye have now caught .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Renta aiga echinde chie chinswe echi mwarubire bono.”

english: Simon Peter went up , and drew the net to land full of great fishes , an hundred and fifty and three : and for all there were so many , yet was not the net broken .
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akariina obwato ime, akang’usa ekeonga gochia engegu geichire chinswe chinene, rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na isato; nonya chiarenge chinyinge buna iga, ekeonga tigiatandogete.

english: Jesus saith unto them , Come and dine . And none of the disciples durst ask him , Who art thou ? knowing that it was the Lord .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo morie!” Gose onde tarenge ase aborokigwa baria orenge na boremu komoboria, “Aye naye ng’o?” Ekiagera mbamanyete ng’a n’Omonene.

english: Jesus then cometh , and taketh bread , and giveth them , and fish likewise .
ekegusii: Yeso akagenda akabogoria omogati, akabaa, ne chinswe boigo.

english: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples , after that he was risen from the dead .
ekegusii: Eke nekero kia gatato Yeso arorekanete ase aborokigwa baye magega y’okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure. Amang’ana y’omoerio a Yeso ase Petero

english: So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter , Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ? He saith unto him , Yea , Lord ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him , Feed my lambs .
ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire koragera, Yeso akaboria Simioni Petero, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete kobua aba?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chiane.”

english: He saith to him again the second time , Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ? He saith unto him , Yea , Lord ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him , Feed my sheep .
ekegusii: Akamoboria eria kabere, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.”

english: He saith unto him the third time , Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time , Lovest thou me ? And he said unto him , Lord , thou knowest all things ; thou knowest that I love thee . Jesus saith unto him , Feed my sheep .
ekegusii: Akamoboria eria gatato, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete inche?” Petero agaichana ekiagera amoboretie eria gatato, “Nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, aye nomanyete onsi, nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , When thou wast young , thou girdedst thyself , and walkedst whither thou wouldest : but when thou shalt be old , thou shalt stretch forth thy hands , and another shall gird thee , and carry thee whither thou wouldest not .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Ekero kwarenge omosae, nigo kwarenge kweboyia, kwagenda aase origetie, korende ekero orache koba omogaka, norambore amaboko ao, na oyonde nagosibe, akoire aase otancheti.”

english: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him , Follow me .
ekegusii: (Agakwana eri ase okworokia imakweri ki aramotogie Nyasae). Erio gakoorire gokwana aya, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana?”

english: There were together Simon Peter , and Thomas called Didymus , and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two other of his disciples .
ekegusii: Simioni Petero, na Thomas oyokorokwa Barongo, na Natanaeli o Kana ya Galili, na abamura ba Zebedi, na babere bande baborokigwa baye barenge amo.

english: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?
ekegusii: Petero agachia komoorora oyio, akaboria Yeso, “Omonene, noyo rende?”

english: Jesus saith unto him , If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Kondarigie oyo abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio? Aye ntunyane inche.”

english: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren , that that disciple should not die : yet Jesus said not unto him , He shall not die ; but , If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ?
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana eri rigasarera ase abamwabo ng’a omworokigwa oria tagokwa, korende Yeso tamotebetie ng’a tagokwa, otatiga, “Kondarigie abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio?” Amang’ana ’ogokoorera

english: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .
ekegusii: Oyo nomworokigwa oria orooche aya, na koyarika, naende twamanyire ng’a oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.

english: And there are also many other things which Jesus did , the which , if they should be written every one , I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written . Amen .
ekegusii: Nare naende ayande amange aya Yeso akorete; naro kararikwe erimo erimo, nigo ngokaga ng’a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa chibekwe.

english: But when the morning was now come , Jesus stood on the shore : but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus .
ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng’a n’Yeso.

english: Then Jesus saith unto them , Children , have ye any meat ? They answered him , No .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akababoria, “Abana, more neki mokoria?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya.”

english: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher’s coat unto him , ( for he was naked ,) and did cast himself into the sea .
ekegusii: Omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete agateebia Petero, “Nere Omonene.” Erio Simioni Petero, agachia koigwa ng’a n’Omonene, akeboyia eanga yaye (ekiagera arenge getirianda), akeruta enyancha ime.

english: And the other disciples came in a little ship ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits ,) dragging the net with fishes .
ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa bande bagacha ase obwato, bagakurura ekeonga geichire chinswe, ekiagera tibarenge are ase ense enyomo, ang’e chifuti amagana atato.

english: As soon then as they were come to land , they saw a fire of coals there , and fish laid thereon , and bread .
ekegusii: Erio kobachia goika engegu, bakarora omorero bw’amakara aroro, na enswe ebekire igoro yaye, na omogati.

english: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee ; and the mother of Jesus was there :
ekegusii: Naende rituko ria gatato ’yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng’ina Yeso nao arenge.

english: And saith unto him , Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine ; and when men have well drunk , then that which is worse : but thou hast kept the good wine until now .
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyuure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”

english: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory ; and his disciples believed on him .
ekegusii: Oyio noro omochakano bw’ebikone Yeso akorete, agwo Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwegena.

english: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :
ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.

english: And when he had made a scourge of small cords , he drove them all out of the temple , and the sheep , and the oxen ; and poured out the changers’ money , and overthrew the tables ;
ekegusii: Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, akabasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chitaabu chiabo abaare koonchora chitaabu, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo. Agaitera chitaabu chiabo abaare koonchora chitaabu, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.|alt="He spread their money and overturned their tables" src="GW-122.TIF" size="col" loc="John2:11-21" copy="Graham Wade" ref="2:15"

english: And said unto them that sold doves , Take these things hence ; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise .
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia baria barenge koonia amaruma, “Rusia ebinto ebi aa timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y’okoonchoreria.”

english: Then answered the Jews and said unto him , What sign shewest thou unto us , seeing that thou doest these things ?
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamobooria, “Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ng’a nore noboronge bw’ogokora aya?”

english: And both Jesus was called , and his disciples , to the marriage .
ekegusii: Yeso nere konya orangeriigwe amo naborokigwa baye ase enyangi.

english: Then said the Jews , Forty and six years was this temple in building , and wilt thou rear it up in three days ?
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Hekalu eye yaagachetwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene na etano nomo, na aye oyetenenie ase amatuko atato?”

english: But he spake of the temple of his body .
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akwanete igoro ye Hekalu y’omobere oye.

english: When therefore he was risen from the dead , his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them ; and they believed the scripture , and the word which Jesus had said .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero abogetigwe korwa ase abakuure aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nigo ateebete ring’ana eri, bakegena ririiko riria, ne ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete. Yeso namanyete chinkoro chi’abanto bonsi

english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .
ekegusii: Goika agachia kobao Yerusalemu ekero ki’Epasaka ase Rituko Rinene, abanto abange bakariegena erieta riaye, kobarorire ebikone arenge gokora.

english: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tegenete ase bare, ekiagera nabamanyete bonsi,

english: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .
ekegusii: naende ekiagera tarigetie onde amobere kirori igoro ya Mwanyabaanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime ya Mwanyabaanto.

english: And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .
ekegusii: Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamoteebia, “Tibari nedivai.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, inki inche nde naye? Ensa yane teraika.”

english: His mother saith unto the servants , Whatsoever he saith unto you , do it .
ekegusii: Ng’ina agateebia abasomba, “Rinde rionsi arabateebie, morikore.”

english: And there were set there six waterpots of stone , after the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three firkins apiece .
ekegusii: Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi’amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y’ogwesiberia kw’Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.

english: Jesus saith unto them , Fill the waterpots with water . And they filled them up to the brim .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ichoria chinsiongo echi amaache.” Bagachiichoria goika igoro.

english: And he saith unto them , Draw out now , and bear unto the governor of the feast . And they bare it .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, Bono taoria, “moirere omonene bw’omoyega.” Bakamoirera.

english: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine , and knew not whence it was : ( but the servants which drew the water knew ;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom ,
ekegusii: Omonene bw’omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw’omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

english: There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :
ekegusii: Narengeo omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw’Abayahudi.

english: Jesus answered and said unto him , Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aye nomworokia bw’Abaisraeli, na aya toyamanyeti?

english: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen ; and ye receive not our witness .
ekegusii: Ekeene, nagotebirie: Eri tomanyete nario togokwana, na eri torooche twariorokia; na oborori bwaito timori kobwancha.

english: If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
ekegusii: Onye nkobateebia amang’ana ense, na inwe timokoyeegena, naki moreegene kondabateebie amang’ana a igoro?

english: And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .
ekegusii: Naende monto onde tari ogendete igoro, otatiga ere oyoigete korwa igoro, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

english: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .
ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.”

english: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .
ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.

english: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world ; but that the world through him might be saved .
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatomete Omwana oye ase ense agambie ense, korende ense etoorigwe nere.

english: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .
ekegusii: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.

english: And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .
ekegusii: Na eke nakio ekiina ng’a omobaso ochire ase ense, korende abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso, ekiagera ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe.

english: The same came to Jesus by night , and said unto him , Rabbi , we know that thou art a teacher come from God : for no man can do these miracles that thou doest , except God be with him .
ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamoteebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”

english: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .
ekegusii: Naki kera oyogokora amabe nigo agechete omobaso, gose tagocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa koorokigwa.

english: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .
ekegusii: Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.” Yohana Omobatisi na Yeso

english: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa ; and there he tarried with them , and baptized .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.

english: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim , because there was much water there : and they came , and were baptized .
ekegusii: Yohana nere nigo arenge kobatisera aria Ainoni, ang’e na Salimu, ekiagera amaache amange narengeo. Abanto bakamochiera bakabatiswa.

english: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying .
ekegusii: Nabo okoamererania gokaoroka ase egati yaborokigwa ba Yohana na Omoyahudi oyomo ase amang’ana ogwesibia.

english: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .
ekegusii: Bagachiera Yohana, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ere oyorenge amo naye ng’umbu ya Yorodani, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nao are akobatisa, na abanto bonsi nkomochiera bare.”

english: John answered and said , A man can receive nothing , except it be given him from heaven .
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.

english: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom : but the friend of the bridegroom , which standeth and heareth him , rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice : this my joy therefore is fulfilled .
ekegusii: Oyore nomoriakari nere omonywomi, korende omong’wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogookera eriogi ri’omonywomi; naboigo omogooko one oikeranire bono.”

english: Jesus answered and said unto him , Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he can not see the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara korora oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: He must increase , but I must decrease .
ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee. Oyochire korwa igoro

english: He that cometh from above is above all : he that is of the earth is earthly , and speaketh of the earth : he that cometh from heaven is above all .
ekegusii: “Oyochire korwa igoro, oyio nigo are igoro ase onsi; oyore bw’ense noyo bw’ense, nigo agokwana amang’ana ’ense; ere oyochire korwa igoro nigo are igoro ase onsi.

english: And what he hath seen and heard , that he testifieth ; and no man receiveth his testimony .
ekegusii: Nigo akoba kirori ase aya arorire na koyaigwa; gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye.

english: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .
ekegusii: Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye oorokirie Nyasae maiso marore, ng’a noyo bw’ekeene.

english: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God : for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .
ekegusii: Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasae nigo agokwana amang’ana a Nyasae; naki Nyasae tari komoa Omoika ase ekerengo.

english: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life : and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life ; but the wrath of God abideth on him .
ekegusii: Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”

english: Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb , and be born ?
ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki omonto aranyare koiborwa kabeire omogaka? Nanyaare gosoa enda ya ng’ina eria kabere aiborwe?”

english: Jesus answered , Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he can not enter into the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amaache na Omoika, takonyaara gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh ; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .
ekegusii: Ekeiboire ase omobere n’omobere; na ekeiboire ase Omoika n’Omoika.

english: Marvel not that I said unto thee , Ye must be born again .
ekegusii: Tokumia ekiagera nagoteebia: Goika oiborwe naende.

english: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .
ekegusii: Embeo nigo ekogusa aase erigetie, na egeturi kiaye nigo ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti aase ekorwa gose aase ekogenda; naboigo na kera omonto oiboirwe ase Omoika.”

english: Nicodemus answered and said unto him , How can these things be ?
ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”

english: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John ,
ekegusii: Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng’a Abafarisai baigure ng’a Yeso okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, na kobatisa,

english: Jesus answered and said unto her , If thou knewest the gift of God , and who it is that saith to thee , Give me to drink ; thou wouldest have asked of him , and he would have given thee living water .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasae, naende nere ng’o oyo okogosaba amaache anywe, anga nkwamosaba ere, na ere anga nakoa amaache are moyo.”

english: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tori negento gi’okobuuchera, na ensoko yachiire inse mono; ng’ai kwanyorire amaache aya are moyo?

english: Art thou greater than our father Jacob , which gave us the well , and drank thereof himself , and his children , and his cattle ?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonene ore kobua sokoro yaito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amaache aya, na abana baye bonsi, na etugo yaye?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto her , Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again :
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kera oyokonywa amaache aya naigwe erang’o naende;

english: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .
ekegusii: korende onde bwensi oyoranywe amaache aria ndamoe inche, takorang’a nonya ng’ake; korende amaache aria ndanyaare komoa, nabe ime yaye ensoko y’amaache agosoka na komoa obogima bwa kare na kare.”

english: The woman saith unto him , Sir , give me this water , that I thirst not , neither come hither to draw .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, ing’a amaache ayio tindang’a, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobuucha.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Go , call thy husband , and come hither .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, orangerie omosacha oo, oche nere aiga.”

english: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her , Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Tindi nomosaacha.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Gwakwanire boronge ng’a tori nomosaacha,

english: For thou hast had five husbands ; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband : in that saidst thou truly .
ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nabasaacha batano, na ere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo, ase ayio gwakwanire ekeene.”

english: The woman saith unto him , Sir , I perceive that thou art a prophet .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, narorire ng’a nomobani ore.

english: ( Though Jesus himself baptized not , but his disciples ,)
ekegusii: (nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),

english: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasiima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasiimera.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, inyegene, ensa neche, motamosasiime Tata ase egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu.

english: Ye worship ye know not what : we know what we worship : for salvation is of the Jews .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogosasiima eki motamanyeti; intwe nigo togosasiima eki tomanyete, ekiagera ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Abayahudi.

english: But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .
ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasiimi b’ekeene barasasiime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.

english: God is a Spirit : and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth .
ekegusii: Nyasae n’Omoika, na abwo bakomosasiima nebagwenerete komosasiima ase omoika na ekeene.”

english: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a ngocha are Masihi (oyokorokwa Kristo); karache ere, natoorokerie onsi.”

english: Jesus saith unto her , I that speak unto thee am he.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”

english: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
ekegusii: Erio kegima aborokigwa baye bagaacha. Bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokuungu; korende onde tamoboretie, “Inki okorigia?” Gose, “Naki ogokwana nere?”

english: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,
ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agateebia abanto,

english: Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
ekegusii: “Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire! Inee! Oyio tari ere Kristo?”

english: He left Judæa , and departed again into Galilee .
ekegusii: akarua Boyahudi, akagenda Galili naende.

english: Then they went out of the city , and came unto him .
ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa omochie, bakamochiera.

english: In the mean while his disciples prayed him , saying , Master , eat .
ekegusii: Agwo ekero bataracha, aborokigwa bakamosorora bakaboora, “Rabii, ragera?”

english: But he said unto them , I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”

english: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboorania, “Inee! Nomonto omorentera endagera?”

english: Jesus saith unto them , My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Endagera yaane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.

english: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields ; for they are white already to harvest .
ekegusii: Inwe timori goteeba: Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio rigesa riiche? Rora nabateebirie: Imokia amaiso aino, morigererie emegondo, ng’a yaikire koba emerabu ang’e ase rigesa.

english: And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .
ekegusii: Oyo okogesa nkonyora are eng’eria na gosangereria amatunda ase obogima bwa kare na kare, erinde oyo okobusura na ere oyokogesa bagoke amo.

english: And herein is that saying true , One soweth , and another reapeth .
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria: Oyomo obusura, na oyonde okogesa, nigo rire ekeene.

english: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour : other men laboured , and ye are entered into their labours .
ekegusii: Inche nabatomete mogese aya motakorerete emeremo; abande bakorire emeremo, na inwe mwasoire ase emeremo yabo.”

english: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman , which testified , He told me all that ever I did .
ekegusii: Naende ase omochie oria Abasamaria abange bakamwegena ase engencho y’oborori bw’omokuungu oria ekero abateebetie ng’a, “Onteebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire.”

english: And he must needs go through Samaria .
ekegusii: Naende yamogwenerete goika aete Samaria.

english: So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero Abasamaria baria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo; akabeera aroro amatuko abere.

english: And many more believed because of his own word ;
ekegusii: Abanto abange kobua bakeegena ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye;

english: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .
ekegusii: bagateebia omokungu oria, “Bono twegenire, tari ase engencho y’amang’ana ao, korende ekiagera tweigwereire intwe abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng’a oyo n’Omotooria bw’ense.” Yeso okogwenia omwana omomura bw’omosomba bw’omorwoti

english: Now after two days he departed thence , and went into Galilee .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko abere akaimoka akagenda Galili.

english: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .
ekegusii: Oyio agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche agwenie omwana oye, ekiagera konya oisire gokwa.

english: Then said Jesus unto him , Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamoteebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”

english: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .
ekegusii: Omosike oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tirimboka ritang’ani omwana one atarakwa.”

english: Jesus saith unto him , Go thy way ; thy son liveth . And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring’ana riria ateebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.

english: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gotirimboka abasomba baaye bagaacha komorootota, bakamoteebia, “Omwana oo moyo are.”

english: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .
ekegusii: Erio akababoria amang’ana ensa achaagete koba buya. Bakamoteebia, “Niigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”

english: So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him , Thy son liveth : and himself believed , and his whole house .
ekegusii: Erio ise akamanya ng’a nensa eria eria ateebetigwe na Yeso, “Omwana oo nabe moyo!” Akeegena ere, na enyomba yaye yonsi.

english: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did , when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee .
ekegusii: Eke nakio egekone gia kabere Yeso akorete korwa ekero arwete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.

english: Now Jacob’s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .
ekegusii: agwo yarengeo ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yeso, konya orosire ase orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga ase ensoko. Konya chiabeire ang’e chinsa isano nemo.

english: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her , Give me to drink .
ekegusii: Omokungu o Samaria agacha kobuucha amaache. Yeso akamoteebia, “Ing’a amaache inywe.” Omokungu o Samaria agaacha kobuucha amaache. Yeso akamoteebia, Ing’a amaache inywe.|alt="A Samaritan woman came to draw water. Jesus told her, give me water so I can drink" src="Gw-124.tif" size="col" loc="John 4:5-15" copy="Graham Wade" ref="4:7"

english: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat .)
ekegusii: Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachiire omochie kogora endagera.

english: After this there was a feast of the Jews ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’Abayahudi; Yeso agatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

english: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me , Take up thy bed , and walk .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere onteebia: Etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

english: Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee , Take up thy bed , and walk ?
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Oria ogoteebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”

english: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .
ekegusii: Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning’o. Yeso nigo erusananetie, ekiagera abanto abange barenge aase aria.

english: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him , Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akamonyora ore Hekalu ime, akamoteebia. “Rora, kwabeire omogima; tokora ebibe naende, ring’ana rire riibe kobua tiricha gokonyoora.”

english: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akagenda, agateebia Abayahudi amang’ana, ng’a Yeso nere omokorete koba omogima.

english: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abayahudi bagachaaka gochanda Yeso, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya ase rituko ri’Esabato.

english: But Jesus answered them , My Father worketh hitherto , and I work .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”

english: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .
ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera ase aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera tasaretie Esabato yoka, korende amo naya narogete Nyasae ng’a n’Ise, ogwekora koreng’ana buna Nyasae. Buna Ise agokora na Omwana naboigo agokora

english: Then answered Jesus and said unto them , Verily , verily , I say unto you , The Son can do nothing of himself , but what he seeth the Father do : for what things soever he doeth , these also doeth the Son likewise .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.

english: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .
ekegusii: Naende aaria Yerusalemu ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi ndiarengeo ritibo rikorokwa ase Ekeiberania Betiseda, na rirorio ndiabwate ebisoero bitano.

english: For the Father loveth the Son , and sheweth him all things that himself doeth : and he will shew him greater works than these , that ye may marvel .
ekegusii: Tata nigo amwanchete Omwana, na komworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene; na emeremo emenene kobua eye iga namworokie, erinde inwe monyaare gokumia.

english: For as the Father raiseth up the dead , and quickeneth them ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will .
ekegusii: Na buna Tata akobokia ebitondo obia obogima, naboigo n’Omwana akobaa obogima aba arigetie.

english: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
ekegusii: Naki Tata tari kogambia monto onde bwensi, korende oeire Omwana obogambi bwonsi,

english: That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .
ekegusii: erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that heareth my word , and believeth on him that sent me , hath everlasting life , and shall not come into condemnation ; but is passed from death unto life .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekiina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ensa ngocha ere, na bono nereo, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri’Omwana o Nyasae, na baria barariigwe nababe moyo.

english: For as the Father hath life in himself ; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself ;
ekegusii: Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo oeire na Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene.

english: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
ekegusii: Omoeire okobua kw’ogokora ekiina, ekiagera ere n’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.

english: Marvel not at this : for the hour is coming , in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice ,
ekegusii: Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,

english: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk , of blind , halt , withered , waiting for the moving of the water .
ekegusii: Ime ase ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire baare koraara, emeuko, ebirema, na amagata, [baganyete amaache aturubanigwe.

english: I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .
ekegusii: “Inche omonyene tinkonyaara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekiina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.

english: If I bear witness of myself , my witness is not true .
ekegusii: Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.

english: There is another that beareth witness of me ; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true .
ekegusii: Nare oyonde oy’okombera kirori; na inche namanyire ng’a oborori bwaye agonteeba nobw’ekeene.

english: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
ekegusii: Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.

english: He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge etaaya egwoka na komoreka, na inwe mwanchire gosasokera omobaso oye ase ekero egeke.

english: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
ekegusii: Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng’a Tata nere ontomete.

english: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .
ekegusii: naende ring’ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino, ekiagera timomwegeneti ere oyotomirwe nere.

english: Search the scriptures ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .
ekegusii: Igo mokorigarigia mono amariiko, ekiagera mokagete ng’a nigo more nobogima bwa kare na kare ime y’aro; na ayio naro are kirori ase ’nde,

english: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .
ekegusii: Naki ekero gete omomalaika ngoika arenge osoa ase ritibo riria, oturubania amaache. Nabo ere oyorenge gosoa ritang’ani magega ase amaache gaturubaniigwe, nigo arenge kogwena oborwaire bonde bwonsi obwamonyorete.]

english: And ye will not come to me , that ye might have life .
ekegusii: ko mwangire gocha ase ’nde monyare koba nobogima.

english: I receive not honour from men .
ekegusii: Tindi konyora obonene korwa ase abanto.

english: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .
ekegusii: Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.

english: I am come in my Father’s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .
ekegusii: Inche nachire ase erieta ria Tata one, na inwe timori konyancha; oyonde karaache ase erieta riaye omonyene, oyio namomwanche.

english: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
ekegusii: Naki moranyare kwegena, inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe ase inwe, na obonene boria bokorwa ase Nyasae ore bweka, timori koborigia?

english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father : there is one that accuseth you , even Moses , in whom ye trust .
ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a inche nimbasoere ase Tata; nare oyo okobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe.

english: For had ye believed Moses , ye would have believed me : for he wrote of me .
ekegusii: Naki onye mwamwegenete Musa anga mwanyegena nainche, ekiagera nere origete amang’ana igoro yane.

english: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?
ekegusii: Korende onye timwegeneti amariiko aye, naki moregene amang’ana aane?”

english: And a certain man was there , which had an infirmity thirty and eight years .
ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw’emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato.

english: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him , Wilt thou be made whole ?
ekegusii: Yeso agachia komorora oraire, konya omanyire ng’a obeire engencho eye amatuko amange, akamobooria, “Norigetie koba omogima?”

english: The impotent man answered him , Sir , I have no man , when the water is troubled , to put me into the pool : but while I am coming , another steppeth down before me .
ekegusii: Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amaache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani ase ’nde.”

english: Jesus saith unto him , Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

english: And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .
ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge Esabato rituko riria.

english: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee , which is the sea of Tiberias .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.

english: And Jesus said , Make the men sit down . Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ikaransia abanto.” Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Igo abasacha bagaikaransa, barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isaano.

english: And Jesus took the loaves ; and when he had given thanks , he distributed to the disciples , and the disciples to them that were set down ; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would .
ekegusii: Yeso akabogoria emegati; kayesesenirie, akagabera abaikaransete; naboigo ne chinswe chiria, koreng’ana buna barigetie.

english: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples , Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
ekegusii: Kobachia koigota, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, gento tigesira.”

english: Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .
ekegusii: Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere ase ebisamunye bi’emegati etano y’esairi, ebiatigaretigwe na baria bariete.

english: Then those men , when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did , said , This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria bachia korora egekone keria Yeso akorete, bakaboora, “Oyo ekeene nomobani oria orenge gocha ase ense!” Yeso ogweatanana na gotaara ase enyancha igoro (Mat 14:22-27; Mar 6:45-52)

english: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force , to make him a king , he departed again into a mountain himself alone .
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso namanyete ng’a mbarigetie gocha komoira, erinde bamobeeke abe omorwoti. Ase ayio akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa ere bweka.

english: And when even was now come , his disciples went down unto the sea ,
ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia nyancha,

english: And entered into a ship , and went over the sea toward Capernaum . And it was now dark , and Jesus was not come to them .
ekegusii: bakariina obwato ime, bagachaaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kapernaumu. Naende omosunte konya obeire, na Yeso konya taracha ase bare.

english: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
ekegusii: Enyancha egachaaka koimoka ase engencho y’omwaga omonge orenge kogusa.

english: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
ekegusii: Nabo kabang’usire obwato chimaeli isato gose inye bakarora Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, ogoika ang’e ase obwato. Erio bakairoka,

english: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .
ekegusii: Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire.

english: But he saith unto them , It is I ; be not afraid .
ekegusii: korende Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche. Timoiroka!”

english: Then they willingly received him into the ship : and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went .
ekegusii: Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime, erio kegima obwato bogaika ase barenge kogenda. Abanto bakorigia Yeso

english: The day following , when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there , save that one whereinto his disciples were entered , and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat , but that his disciples were gone away alone ;
ekegusii: Ankio yaye omoganda oteneine ng’umbu y’enyancha bakarora ng’a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, otatiga boria obomo bwoka, naende ng’a Yeso tasoete ase obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye, korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka.

english: ( Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread , after that the Lord had given thanks :)
ekegusii: Korende amaato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang’e nase aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene ayesesenetie.

english: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there , neither his disciples , they also took shipping , and came to Capernaum , seeking for Jesus .
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia korora ng’a Yeso tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amaato ime, bakagenda Kapernaumu, bakorigia Yeso. Yeso nomogati bw’obogima

english: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea , they said unto him , Rabbi , when camest thou hither ?
ekegusii: Goika bagachia komoorora ng’umbu y’enyancha bakamobooria, “Omworokia, indi gwachete aa?”

english: Jesus answered them and said , Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.

english: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .
ekegusii: Timokorera endagera egosareka korende, endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare na kare, eye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aranyare kobaa, ekiagera Nyasae Tata obekire ekemanyererio kiaye asare.”

english: Then said they unto him , What shall we do , that we might work the works of God ?
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Ninki togokora tonyare gokora emeremo ya Nyasae?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto them , This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasae, ng’a momwegene ere oyotomirwe nere.”

english: And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .
ekegusii: Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa, agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye.

english: They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?

english: Then Jesus said unto them , Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.

english: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
ekegusii: Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”

english: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .
ekegusii: Nabo bakamoteebia, “Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio.”

english: And Jesus said unto them , I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha ase ’nde takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.

english: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.

english: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me ; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out .
ekegusii: Bonsi aba Tata akong’a nabache ase ’nde, na ere oyogocha ase ’nde tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng’ake.

english: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
ekegusii: Naki naikire korwa igoro, tari ase ogokora ogwancha kwane omonyene, korende ogwancha kwaye oyontomete.

english: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me , that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing , but should raise it up again at the last day .
ekegusii: Naende ogwancha kwaye Tata oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a ase bonsi ang’eire tinsiria nonya noyomo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.

english: And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .
ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.

english: And this is the will of him that sent me , that every one which seeth the Son , and believeth on him , may have everlasting life : and I will raise him up at the last day .
ekegusii: Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”

english: The Jews then murmured at him , because he said , I am the bread which came down from heaven .
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, ekiagera ateebete, “Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro.”

english: And they said , Is not this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? how is it then that he saith , I came down from heaven ?
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Oyo tari Yeso, omwana o Yusufu? Ntomanyete ise na ng’ina. Naki rende akobora: Naikire korwa igoro?”

english: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them , Murmur not among yourselves .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.

english: No man can come to me , except the Father which hath sent me draw him : and I will raise him up at the last day .
ekegusii: Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, atang’usiri na Tata oyontomete, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.

english: Not that any man hath seen the Father , save he which is of God , he hath seen the Father .
ekegusii: Tari ng’a monto ororire Tata, otatiga ere oyorure ase Nyasae, oyio nere ororire Tata.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.

english: I am that bread of life .
ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima.

english: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness , and are dead .
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino nchiariete mana ase erooro, na barabwo bagakwa.

english: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip , Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akaboria Filipo, “Ng’ai togochia kogora emegati, aba banyare koria?”

english: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.

english: I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima oyoigete korwa igoro; omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare na kare; na omogati ndarue inche, ase engencho y’obogima bw’ense, nomobere one.”

english: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa omobere oye toyorie?”

english: Then Jesus said unto them , Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene nabateebirie: Motarieti omobere oye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto na konywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino.

english: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life ; and I will raise him up at the last day .
ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio,

english: For my flesh is meat indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .
ekegusii: ekiagera omobere one nendagera y’ekeene, na amanyinga aane nekenyugwa gi’ekeene.

english: He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.

english: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
ekegusii: Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.

english: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .
ekegusii: Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”

english: These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo ayakwanete ase esinagogi, kaare kworokereria aria Kapernaumu. Abande ase aborokigwa bakaba ne chitang’u‐tang’u

english: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .
ekegusii: Igo amoboretie aya, erinde amoteeme, ekiagera namanyete ere omonyene eki arakore.

english: Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying ; who can hear it ?
ekegusii: Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakaboora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”

english: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them , Doth this offend you ?
ekegusii: Ko Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a aborokigwa baye bemurunganeirie ring’ana eri, akababoria, “Ring’ana eri ndiabagochire?

english: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before ?
ekegusii: Naki erabe rende, komorarore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto okogenda aaria aase arenge ritang’ani?

english: It is the spirit that quickeneth ; the flesh profiteth nothing : the words that I speak unto you , they are spirit , and they are life .
ekegusii: Omoika noro okobeeka obogima, omobere togwenereti gento; amang’ana nabateebirie n’Omoika, naende nobogima.

english: But there are some of you that believe not . For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not , and who should betray him .
ekegusii: Korende mbare abande ase egati yaino bategeneti.” Naki Yeso amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abategeneti, naende ning’o orache komorua.

english: And he said , Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabateebia, ng’a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”

english: From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abange ase aborokigwa baye bakairana magega, tibamotunyana naende. Okoorokia gwa Petero igoro ya Yeso

english: Then said Jesus unto the twelve , Will ye also go away ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaboria baria ikomi na babere, “Nainwe boigo morigetie kogenda?”

english: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ , the Son of the living God .
ekegusii: Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng’a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”

english: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .
ekegusii: Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”

english: Jesus answered them , Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabachorete inwe ikomi na babere, na oyomo oino Saitani?”

english: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon : for he it was that should betray him , being one of the twelve .
ekegusii: Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudasi, omwana o Simioni Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.

english: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter’s brother , saith unto him ,
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, akamoteebia,

english: There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?
ekegusii: “Nare aa omosae, obwate emegati etano y’esairi ne chinswe ibere, korende ebi inki biraisane ase abanto abange buna aba?”

english: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akaba ogotaara ase Galili; naki tarigetie gotaara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi nigo barenge korigia komoita.

english: But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .
ekegusii: Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.

english: Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakobora, “Ng’ai are oyio?”

english: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay ; but he deceiveth the people .
ekegusii: Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakaboora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakaboora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”

english: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews .
ekegusii: Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ase engencho y’okoiroka Abayahudi. Yeso okworokereria agwo Yerusalemu ng’a ere nigo arwete ase Nyasae

english: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .
ekegusii: Goika egachia koba gati‐gati ye Rituko Rinene Yeso agatiira, agasoa Hekalu ime akorokereria.

english: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
ekegusii: Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakaboora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”

english: Jesus answered them , and said , My doctrine is not mine , but his that sent me .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.

english: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .
ekegusii: Omonto karanche gokora ogwancha kwaye, namanye gose okworokereria oko nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose nigo ngokwana ase okobua kwane omonyene.

english: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .
