ekegusii: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw’oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw’ekeene, na asare obong’ainereria tiboiyo.

english: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?
ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”

english: The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
ekegusii: Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto them , I have done one work , and ye all marvel .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nakorete ogokora okomo, na inwe mwensi nigo mogokumetie.

english: Judge not according to the appearance , but judge righteous judgment .
ekegusii: Timogamba ekiina ase engencho y’ekieni, korende nacha ekiina ase oboronge.”

english: Then said some of them of Jerusalem , Is not this he , whom they seek to kill ?
ekegusii: Abande ase abanto ba Yerusalemu bakaboora, “Oyo tari ere omonto oria bakorigia goita?

english: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
ekegusii: Nao are aa gokwana maiso marore gose tibari komoteebia ing’ana? Aande gose abanene bamanyire bori ng’a nere Kristo?

english: Howbeit we know this man whence he is : but when Christ cometh , no man knoweth whence he is .
ekegusii: Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”

english: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying , Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agaaka eriogi riaye ase Hekalu ime, okworokereria, okobora, “Inche momanyete, na aase narure mwaamanyire, naende tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene, oyio motamanyeti inwe.

english: But I know him : for I am from him , and he hath sent me .
ekegusii: Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”

english: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judæa , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.

english: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
ekegusii: Igo bakarigia komobwata, korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye, erinde amobwate, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.

english: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?
ekegusii: Abanto abange ase omoganda bakamwegena, bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo ekero arachiche nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebi iga oyo akorire?”

english: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaigwa omoganda okwemurungania igoro yaye. Erio abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate.

english: Then said Jesus unto them , Yet a little while am I with you , and then I go unto him that sent me .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete.

english: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .
ekegusii: Namondigie, korende timokonyoora; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”

english: Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Oyo ng’ai aragende goika intwe titomonyoora? Nigo aragende ase Abagiriki abwo abaatananekire na kworokereria Abagiriki abwo?

english: What manner of saying is this that he said , Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
ekegusii: Ing’ana ki erio akwana: Namondigie, korende timokoonyora, na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao?” Amache are moyo

english: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified .)
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y’Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore magega, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.

english: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret , and he himself seeketh to be known openly . If thou do these things , shew thyself to the world .
ekegusii: Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”

english: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
ekegusii: Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakaboora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”

english: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?
ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Oyo nere Kristo.” Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo nigo ararwe Galili?

english: So there was a division among the people because of him .
ekegusii: Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.

english: And some of them would have taken him ; but no man laid hands on him .
ekegusii: Abande ase barabwo bakarigia komobwata; korende monto onde taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate.

english: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?
ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairana ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, na barabwo bakababoria, “Naki motamorenta?”

english: The officers answered , Never man spake like this man .
ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”

english: Then answered them the Pharisees , Are ye also deceived ?
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?

english: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?

english: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .
ekegusii: Korende omoganda oyio, otamanyeti amachiiko, oragererigwe.

english: For neither did his brethren believe in him .
ekegusii: Naki nonya mbamura bamwabo tibamwegenete.

english: Doth our law judge any man , before it hear him , and know what he doeth ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekiina ritang’ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”

english: They answered and said unto him , Art thou also of Galilee ? Search , and look : for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet .
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.” [

english: And every man went unto his own house .
ekegusii: Bakagenda kera omonto bwoye.

english: Then Jesus said unto them , My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.

english: The world cannot hate you ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .
ekegusii: Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng’a emeremo yaye nemebe.

english: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast ; for my time is not yet full come .
ekegusii: Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”

english: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora kobateebia aya, agatigara Galili.

english: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.

english: When Jesus had lifted up himself , and saw none but the woman , he said unto her , Woman , where are those thine accusers ? hath no man condemned thee ?
ekegusii: Yeso akagororoka tarora monto onde otatiga omokungu oria, akamobooria, “Omokungu, ng’ai abasoeri bao bare? Onde tari ogokogambia?”

english: She said , No man , Lord . And Jesus said unto her , Neither do I condemn thee : go , and sin no more .
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”] Omobaso bw’ense

english: Jesus answered and said unto them , Though I bear record of myself , yet my record is true : for I know whence I came , and whither I go ; but ye cannot tell whence I come , and whither I go .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw’ekeene, ekiagera namanyire aase narure, na aase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti aase narure, gose aase ngochia.

english: Ye judge after the flesh ; I judge no man .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a Mwanyabaanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.

english: And yet if I judge , my judgment is true : for I am not alone , but I and the Father that sent me .
ekegusii: Naende ninsa kogamba, okogamba kwane nogw’ekeene, ekiagera tari inche bweka nkogamba, korende ninche na Tata oyontomete.

english: I am one that bear witness of myself , and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me .
ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”

english: Then said they unto him , Where is thy Father ? Jesus answered , Ye neither know me , nor my Father : if ye had known me , ye should have known my Father also .
ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Iso are?” Yeso akairaneria, “Timokomanya inche, nonya n’Tata timokomomanya, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one.”

english: And early in the morning he came again into the temple , and all the people came unto him ; and he sat down , and taught them .
ekegusii: Mambia chuni agasoa naende Hekalu ime. Abanto bonsi bakamochiera, na ere agaikaransa, akaborokereria.

english: These words spake Jesus in the treasury , as he taught in the temple : and no man laid hands on him ; for his hour was not yet come .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya Yeso nigo ayakwanete, gakworokereria ase Hekalu, ase enyomba y’ekebekerero gi’esadaka; omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. Ekiina kegochia komonyoora Yeso

english: Then said Jesus again unto them , I go my way , and ye shall seek me , and shall die in your sins : whither I go , ye cannot come .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”

english: Then said the Jews , Will he kill himself ? because he saith , Whither I go , ye cannot come .
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Inee! Nigo areite, ekiagera akobora: Aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao?”

english: And he said unto them , Ye are from beneath ; I am from above : ye are of this world ; I am not of this world .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe naba inse; inche noyo o igoro; inwe nab’ense eye; inche tindi oyo bw’ense eye.

english: I said therefore unto you , that ye shall die in your sins : for if ye believe not that I am he , ye shall die in your sins .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebia ng’a namokwe ase ebibe biaino. Onye timokwegena ng’a inche nere, namokwe ase ebibe biaino.”

english: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? And Jesus saith unto them , Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning .
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o?” Yeso akabairaneria, “Nonya nayio nabateebirie inwe korwa omochakano.

english: I have many things to say and to judge of you : but he that sent me is true ; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him .
ekegusii: Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”

english: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father .
ekegusii: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana ase bare aya Ise.

english: Then said Jesus unto them , When ye have lifted up the Son of man , then shall ye know that I am he , and that I do nothing of myself ; but as my Father hath taught me , I speak these things .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero mwakoorire koimokereria igoro Omwana‐o‐mwanya banto, erio namomanye ng’a ninche ere, naende tindi gokora kende ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana.

english: And he that sent me is with me : the Father hath not left me alone ; for I do always those things that please him .
ekegusii: Ere oyontomete nigo are amo nainche, tantigeti inche bweka, ekiagera botambe nigo ngokora ayakomogwenera.”

english: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery ; and when they had set her in the midst ,
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakarenta omokungu obwatetwe ase obotomani. Kabamobekire gati‐gati,

english: As he spake these words , many believed on him .
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, abange bakamwegena. Okoengererania n’Abayahudi

english: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him , If ye continue in my word , then are ye my disciples indeed ;
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agateebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,

english: And ye shall know the truth , and the truth shall make you free .
ekegusii: naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”

english: Jesus answered them , Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, oyio nomosomba bw’ebibe,

english: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever : but the Son abideth ever .
ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.

english: If the Son therefore shall make you free , ye shall be free indeed .
ekegusii: Gaki Omwana karabasibore, namobe abasibore kegima.

english: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed ; but ye seek to kill me , because my word hath no place in you .
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a nigo more oroiboro rwa Aburaamu; korende nigo mokorigia kong’ita, ekiagera ring’ana riane tirinyoreti ibaga ime yaino.

english: I speak that which I have seen with my Father : and ye do that which ye have seen with your father .
ekegusii: Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana; nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire ase iso oino, naro mogokora.”

english: They answered and said unto him , Abraham is our father . Jesus saith unto them , If ye were Abraham’s children , ye would do the works of Abraham .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Tata oito nere Aburaamu.” Yeso akabateebia, “Onye nabana ba Aburaamu mware, anga mwakora emeremo ya Aburaamu.

english: They say unto him , Master , this woman was taken in adultery , in the very act .
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.

english: But now ye seek to kill me , a man that hath told you the truth , which I have heard of God : this did not Abraham .
ekegusii: Korende bono morigetie kong’ita, ninche oyo nabateebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Aburaamu takorete igo.

english: Ye do the deeds of your father . Then said they to him , We be not born of fornication ; we have one Father , even God .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogokora emeremo ya iso oino.” Bakamoteebia, “Intwe titoiboiri ase obonyaka; nigo tore na Tata oyomo, nere Nyasae.”

english: Jesus said unto them , If God were your Father , ye would love me : for I proceeded forth and came from God ; neither came I of myself , but he sent me .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Onye Nyasae n’Iso oino are, anga imonyanchete inche; naki narure ase Nyasae, na igo nachire; gose tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende nere ontomire.

english: Why do ye not understand my speech ? even because ye cannot hear my word .
ekegusii: Naki motamanyeti amang’ana aane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motancheti koigwa ring’ana riane.

english: Ye are of your father the devil , and the lusts of your father ye will do . He was a murderer from the beginning , and abode not in the truth , because there is no truth in him . When he speaketh a lie , he speaketh of his own : for he is a liar , and the father of it .
ekegusii: Inwe n’aba iso oino Saitani, na ogwancha kwaino nogokora okogania gwa iso. Ere nigo arenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete ase ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, nigo agokwana ayare ayaye omonyene, ekiagera nomonyaborimo, na ise bw’oborimo.

english: And because I tell you the truth , ye believe me not .
ekegusii: Ekiagera inche ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena.

english: Which of you convinceth me of sin ? And if I say the truth , why do ye not believe me ?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati yaino okong’orokia ng’a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?

english: He that is of God heareth God’s words : ye therefore hear them not , because ye are not of God .
ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang’ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”

english: Then answered the Jews , and said unto him , Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan , and hast a devil ?
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”

english: Jesus answered , I have not a devil ; but I honour my Father , and ye do dishonour me .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inche timbwatiri nekerecha, korende nigo nsigete Tata one, na inwe timonsigeti.

english: And I seek not mine own glory : there is one that seeketh and judgeth .
ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.

english: Verily , verily , I say unto you , If a man keep my saying , he shall never see death .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng’ake.”

english: Then said the Jews unto him , Now we know that thou hast a devil . Abraham is dead , and the prophets ; and thou sayest , If a man keep my saying , he shall never taste of death .
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Bono twamanyire ng’a nigo obwatire nekerecha, Aburaamu okuure, na ababani, na aye nigo ogoteeba: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng’ake.

english: Art thou greater than our father Abraham , which is dead ? and the prophets are dead : whom makest thou thyself ?
ekegusii: Aye nomonene kobua sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oyo okuure? Naende nababani bakuure. Naye kogwekora obe ng’o?”

english: Jesus answered , If I honour myself , my honour is nothing : it is my Father that honoureth me ; of whom ye say , that he is your God :
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Kondetogie inche omonyene, obonene bwane tibori gento; oyogontogia n’Tata one, oyo mogoteeba ng’a nere Nyasae oino.

english: Yet ye have not known him ; but I know him : and if I should say , I know him not , I shall be a liar like unto you : but I know him , and keep his saying .
ekegusii: Na inwe timomanyeti, korende inche nimomanyete. Kondatebe ng’a timomanyeti nimbe omonyaborimo buna inwe, korende nimomanyete, naende ring’ana riaye nindibwatete.

english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day : and he saw it , and was glad .
ekegusii: Aburaamu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”

english: Then said the Jews unto him , Thou art not yet fifty years old , and hast thou seen Abraham ?
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Torakoora emiaka emerongo etano, na Aburaamu kwamororire?”

english: Jesus said unto them , Verily , verily , I say unto you , Before Abraham was , I am .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ritang’ani Aburaamu atarabao, inche nao naare.”

english: Then took they up stones to cast at him : but Jesus hid himself , and went out of the temple , going through the midst of them , and so passed by .
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia amagena bamorute, korende Yeso akebisa, agasoka korwa ase Hekalu.

english: This they said , tempting him , that they might have to accuse him . But Jesus stooped down , and with his finger wrote on the ground , as though he heard them not .
ekegusii: Bagateeba ring’ana eri ase okomoteema, banyore enchera bakomosoera. Korende Yeso agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.

english: So when they continued asking him , he lifted up himself , and said unto them , He that is without sin among you , let him first cast a stone at her .
ekegusii: Barabwo kobamentire komoboria, akagororoka, akabateebia, “Ere oyotari nebibe ase egati yaino abe oyo bw’eritang’ani komoruta rigena.”

english: And again he stooped down , and wrote on the ground .
ekegusii: Agekumba naende, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.

english: And they which heard it , being convicted by their own conscience , went out one by one , beginning at the eldest , even unto the last : and Jesus was left alone , and the woman standing in the midst .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia koyaigwa, bagasoka oyomo ase oyomo, abagaaka nabwo bachaagete. Yeso bweka agatigara, na omokungu oria oteneine gati‐gati.

english: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.

english: Therefore said they unto him , How were thine eyes opened ?
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Amaiso ao naki rende aramogetigwe?”

english: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me , Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash : and I went and washed , and I received sight .
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, aganteebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamuu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”

english: Then said they unto him , Where is he ? He said , I know not .
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”

english: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind .
ekegusii: Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.

english: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay , and opened his eyes .
ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.

english: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamobooria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabateebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”

english: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .
ekegusii: Erio abande b’Abafarisai bakaboora, “Omonto oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, ekiagera tabwateti Esabato.” Abande bakaboora, “Naki omonto omonyene ebibe aranyare gokora ebikone buna ebi?” Ogwatananekana gokaba ase egati yabo.

english: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .
ekegusii: Bakaboria omouko oria eria kabere, “Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera akoramokia amaiso?” Akabora, “Nigo are omobani.”

english: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,

english: And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteeba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”

english: And his disciples asked him , saying , Master , who did sin , this man , or his parents , that he was born blind ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Rabii, ning’o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabaibori baye, goika akaiborwa ore omouko?”

english: His parents answered them and said , We know that this is our son , and that he was born blind :
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bakairaneria, “Twamanyire ng’a oyo nomwana oito, naende ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko;

english: But by what means he now seeth , we know not ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .
ekegusii: korende buna anyara korora bono, titomanyeti, gose ning’o omoramokia amaiso, titomanyeti. Ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere.”

english: These words spake his parents , because they feared the Jews : for the Jews had agreed already , that if any man did confess that he was Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .
ekegusii: Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.

english: Therefore said his parents , He is of age ; ask him .
ekegusii: Nero engencho yagerete abaibori baye bakaboora, “Ere nomonto omogima, moborie.”

english: Then again called they the man that was blind , and said unto him , Give God the praise : we know that this man is a sinner .
ekegusii: Erio eria kabere bakarangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamoteebia, “Moe Nyasae ogotogia; intwe twamanyire ng’a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe.”

english: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akairaneria, “Onye ere nomonyene ebibe, timanyeti; ring’ana erimo namanyire, inche nigo narenge omouko, korende bono nkorora nde.”

english: Then said they to him again , What did he to thee ? how opened he thine eyes ?
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”

english: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”

english: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple ; but we are Moses’ disciples .
ekegusii: Erio bakamorama, bakaboora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.

english: We know that God spake unto Moses : as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is .
ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo arenge gokwana na Musa, korende oyo titomanyeti aase arure.”

english: Jesus answered , Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oyo takorete ebibe, nonya nabaibori baye, korende aya akorekire, erinde emeremo ya Nyasae eorokigwe asare.

english: The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .
ekegusii: Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ring’ana eri neri’ogokumia, ng’a inwe timomanyeti aase arure, na ere ondamokirie amaiso.

english: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Nyasae tari koigwa abanyene ebibe; korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasae, na gokora ogwancha kwaye, oyio nere Nyasae akoigwa.

english: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind .
ekegusii: Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng’a omonto oramokirie amaiso ’omouko oiboretwe engencho eye.

english: If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .
ekegusii: Onye oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, anga takonyara gokora gento.”

english: They answered and said unto him , Thou wast altogether born in sins , and dost thou teach us ? And they cast him out .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwaiboretwe ase ebibe ebinene, na intwe ngotworokereria ore?” Bakamosokia isiko.

english: Jesus heard that they had cast him out ; and when he had found him , he said unto him , Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
ekegusii: Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamobooria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto?”

english: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, inyare komwegena?”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwamororire, naende nere oyogokwana naye nere oyio.”

english: And he said , Lord , I believe . And he worshipped him .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasiima.

english: And Jesus said , For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see ; and that they which see might be made blind .
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekiina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”

english: I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .
ekegusii: Netogwenerete tokore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero rire mobaso; obotuko ngocha bore, omonto atanyare gokora emeremo.

english: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words , and said unto him , Are we blind also ?
ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamobooria, “Inee! Naintwe nigo tore emeuko?”

english: Jesus said unto them , If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see ; therefore your sin remaineth .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe; korende bono nigo mogoteeba: Nkorora tore; gaki ebibe biaino biagendereire kobao.

english: When he had thus spoken , he spat on the ground , and made clay of the spittle , and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay ,
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, agatwera amate inse, agakora etintira ase amate aria, agaaka omouko oria amaiso netintira eria,

english: And said unto him , Go , wash in the pool of Siloam , ( which is by interpretation , Sent .) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamuu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.

english: The neighbours therefore , and they which before had seen him that he was blind , said , Is not this he that sat and begged ?
ekegusii: Nabo abagisangio baye, na baria bamorooche ekero arenge omosabereri bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo tari ere oria orenge oikaransete gosaberera?”

english: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .
ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Nere”; abande bakaboora, “Yaya, nigo agwekaine nere.” Ere omonyene akabora, “Ninche ere.”

english: My soul is weary of my life ; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .
ekegusii: “Omoyo one ogechire obogima bwane; nimbe nobosibore gokwana na kwemurungania, ninkwane nobororo bore ase omoyo one.

english: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?
ekegusii: Inee! Tari aye kwang’umorete buna amabeere, na okambomba buna ekerimu kiabwatanire?

english: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .
ekegusii: Aye okaboyia omobere one risankwa okayobekera chinyama, okayobwatania namauga na emekia.

english: Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .
ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.

english: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart : I know that this is with thee.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo nigo obisete amang’ana ayio ase enkoro yao, nimanyete ng’a oko nakwo kwarenge okogania kwao.

english: If I sin , then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity .
ekegusii: Inse gokora ebibe, aye nigo ondigereretie, na totiga kong’a egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biane.

english: If I be wicked , woe unto me; and if I be righteous , yet will I not lift up my head . I am full of confusion ; therefore see thou mine affliction ;
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.

english: For it increaseth . Thou huntest me as a fierce lion : and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
ekegusii: Kondaimokererie omotwe one igoro, aye nigo okondigia buna endo egotwara orotwari, erinde ogenderere koorokia amakumia ao igoro yane.

english: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me ; changes and war are against me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.

english: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me!
ekegusii: “Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,

english: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
ekegusii: imbe buna tinarengeo, anga nigo narusetigwe ase enda ya baba ntindekwe.

english: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
ekegusii: Ninkwane, nteebie Nyasae: Tobaisa kongambia; imanyie egekogera aye okondwania iga.

english: Are not my days few ? cease then, and let me alone , that I may take comfort a little ,
ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko y’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe n’obotoereru ase engaki eye enke,

english: Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death ;
ekegusii: ekero ntaragenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao rinde, ense eria y’omosunte ekerima na ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri,

english: A land of darkness , as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death , without any order , and where the light is as darkness .
ekegusii: ense emwamu ti buna omosunte ekerima; naende ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri na obotantanu, agwo oborabu bwaye bore obomwamu ti buna obw’obotuko gati.”

english: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogokirie ase ogonchanda na gochaaya emeremo y’amaboko ao, na gwanchera ogosemania kw’abakori amabe?

english: Hast thou eyes of flesh ? or seest thou as man seeth ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amaiso ao naya Mwanyabaanto are? Gose nigo okorora buna Mwanyabaanto akorora?

english: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man’s days ,
ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko ao nabo ang’ana buna aya Mwanyabaanto, gose emiaka yao buna ey’omonto,

english: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
ekegusii: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?

english: Thou knowest that I am not wicked ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
ekegusii: Nonya nabo nomanyete ng’a inche tindi nokomocha, na onde tari orantoorie korwa ase okoboko kwao?

english: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about ; yet thou dost destroy me.
ekegusii: “Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang’onchokeire na gonsiria.

english: Remember , I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a naye kwambombete buna esike. Inee! Nigo okong’irania imbe orotu naende?

english: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite , and said ,
ekegusii: Erio Sofari Omonaama agakwana, akabora:

english: If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him?
ekegusii: Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?

english: For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it ?
ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete abanto batagwenereti. Ekero akorora amabe agokorwa, Inee, takorengereria igoro y’ayio?

english: For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass’s colt .
ekegusii: Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.

english: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him;
ekegusii: “Oise kwebeeka ang’e ase enkoro yao gokora amaronge, na orambore amaboko ao gochia ase Nyasae;

english: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .
ekegusii: onye kogotuguta ebibe bire ase amaboko ao, na togotiga obobe bomenye ase eema yao,

english: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot ; yea, thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :
ekegusii: amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.

english: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :
ekegusii: Nigo orebe emechando yao, buna amaache aetire, takoinyorwa naende.

english: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .
ekegusii: Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.

english: And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope ; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
ekegusii: Aye nomenye kore noboremu, ekiagera ogosemeria nkoreo; norendwe na gotimoka ase obotoereru.

english: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid ; yea, many shall make suit unto thee .
ekegusii: Ekero okorara, monto onde tagokwoboyia; abanto abange mbache asore bagosorore ng’a banyore ogwancherwa.

english: Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?

english: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una + 11:20 bakouna‐una: korigia egento otari n’obomanyi ase kere ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng’ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”

english: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao atari nengencho nagere abanto bakire‐kiri? Na ekero ogokwana amang’ana ay’ogochecheria, monto onde takogosookia?

english: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba ng’a amang’ana ogokwana nay’ekeene, naende ng’a nigo ochenegete ase amaiso a Nyasae.

english: But oh that God would speak , and open his lips against thee;
ekegusii: Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,

english: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom , that they are double to that which is ! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth .
ekegusii: erinde akomaanorere orore obobisi bw’obong’aini! Ere nigo abwate obomanyi botari korengeka. Ase ayio manya ng’a nigo akoeire egesusuro egeke, tari buna okomocha kwao kogwenerete.

english: Canst thou by searching find out God ? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare komanya ebinto bia Nyasae bibisekanete? Nonyare komanya oboikeranu bw’Omonguru?

english: It is as high as heaven ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell ; what canst thou know ?
ekegusii: Onye bore obonene gochia igoro, inki oranyare gokora? Onye bore obotambe inse gochia aase abakuure, inki oranyare komanya?

english: The measure thereof is longer than the earth , and broader than the sea .
ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.

english: And Job answered and said ,
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

english: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .
ekegusii: Obogima bwa kera egetongwa kere moyo na omoika o Mwanyabaanto, nigo bire ase okoboko kwaye.

english: Doth not the ear try words ? and the mouth taste his meat ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?

english: With the ancient is wisdom ; and in length of days understanding .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.

english: With him is wisdom and strength , he hath counsel and understanding .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo are nobong’aini na okobua, boigo nare nogosemia na obomanyi.

english: Behold, he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .
ekegusii: Ere aise gotagora, onde tari oraagache naende; aise gosiekera omonto, onde tari oramoigorere.

english: Behold, he withholdeth the waters , and they dry up : also he sendeth them out , and they overturn the earth .
ekegusii: Aise gotanga amaache, ense igo erome pa, na ekero akoyarenta nigo akoonchorana ense.

english: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his.
ekegusii: Chinguru na obong’aini nigo bikorwa asare. Abwo bakong’aineka na abakong’ainereria nigo bare ase okoboko kwaye.

english: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled , and maketh the judges fools .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoombogania abare abasemia obatiga getirianda, nigo agokora abagaambi ebiina baba abariri.

english: He looseth the bond of kings , and girdeth their loins with a girdle .
ekegusii: Nigo agosibora chinkini chi’abarwoti, erio obaboyia ebibarachi.

english: He leadeth princes away spoiled , and overthroweth the mighty .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoombogania abakuani, obatiga getirianda, na oonchorana abanto bare nokobua.

english: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you.
ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, obong’aini nigo borasire.

english: He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeirie nigo akobaura amang’ana bagokwana, na oura abanto abagotu ogosemia.

english: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorentera abagaambi ogochaywa, na abanto bare nokobua nigo akobaura chinguru.

english: He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.

english: He increaseth the nations , and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations , and straiteneth them again .
ekegusii: Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing’anyia.

english: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth , and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorusia obong’aini ase abatang’ani b’abaanto bare ase ense, erio obatiga bakoombogana erooro bosa.

english: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotaba‐taba ase omosunte borabu botaiyo, na ogera baong’anya buna omonto otindire.

english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
ekegusii: Korende nainche nabo inde nokomanya buna inwe, gose timombueti. Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana buna ayio?

english: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn .
ekegusii: Abasani baane nigo bagonchecheria, inche oyo narenge korangeria Nyasae, na ere akaba okong’iraneria, inche omonyaboronge ntari na komocha, bono nigo ngochecherigwa.

english: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease .
ekegusii: Omonto otari na mechando ende, nigo agochaaya emechando, nigo are ang’e gotindachera inse abwo batererigwe.

english: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .
ekegusii: Chinka chi’abauri nigo chigendererete koba nomorembe, na abwo bagechete Nyasae nigo barendire buya, na enyasae yabo nigo ere ase amaboko abo.

english: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee:
ekegusii: Bono boria ching’iti, nchikworokererie; boria chinyoni chia igoro chigoteebie amang’ana;

english: Or speak to the earth , and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
ekegusii: gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikoraarerie.

english: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
ekegusii: Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana aya onsi ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nakwo gwakorire aya?

english: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this , mine ear hath heard and understood it.
ekegusii: Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.

english: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons .
ekegusii: Ekeene ere nabatogonyere Onye mogokora ogwanchereria bobisi.

english: Shall not his excellency make you afraid ? and his dread fall upon you?
ekegusii: Inee! Obonene bwaye tibokobaboyia, na okogosa kwaye kobaondokie?

english: Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .
ekegusii: Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.

english: Hold your peace , let me alone, that I may speak , and let come on me what will .
ekegusii: Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.

english: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?
ekegusii: Nase ki ndabeeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egerereti obogima bwane.

english: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
ekegusii: Omonene naisa kong’ita, ningenderere komosemeria, nonya nabo goika ndete amang’ana aane ase obosio bwaye.

english: He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
ekegusii: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng’a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.

english: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .
ekegusii: Tegerera onyigwe, tiga ogotebereria kwane gosoe ase amato aino.

english: Behold now, I have ordered my cause ; I know that I shall be justified .
ekegusii: Rora, naroisirie amang’ana aane, namanyire ng’a nimbarerwe oboronge.

english: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .
ekegusii: Ning’o oreo ogochia koamererania nainche? Onye oreo, rirorio inche nigo ndakire‐kiri inkwe.

english: What ye know , the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
ekegusii: Aya momanyete, nainche ninyamanyete; inwe timombueti kende.

english: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee .
ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:

english: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid .
ekegusii: Rusia okoboko kwao korwa ase ’nde, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.

english: Then call thou, and I will answer : or let me speak , and answer thou me.
ekegusii: Erio aye ondangerie, na inche ng’itabe, gose ing’a ribaga nkwane, naye ong’iranerie.

english: How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
ekegusii: Amamocho aane, na ebibe biane, mbirenga bire? Imanyie ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane.

english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face , and holdest me for thine enemy ?
ekegusii: Nase ki okobisa obosio bwao na kombara ng’a nomobisa oo inde?

english: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro ? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo orasegenyie + 13:25 Orasegenyie: engencho yaye n’ogosaria rito eriomo rikona‐koirwa nembeo? Gose aye nigo ogochia gotunya omoiriro korwa magega?

english: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .
ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang’ana ’obororo, naende kwang’akanire amabe ’obosae bwane.

english: And he, as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agosira oruao buna egento ekegundo, na buna eanga yarirwe nebigwankwa.

english: Surely I would speak to the Almighty , and I desire to reason with God .
ekegusii: Korende nigo nganetie nkwane n’Omonguru; mbeke amang’ana aane ase Nyasae, erinde ng’amereranie nere,

english: But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .
ekegusii: Korende inwe nabatongi oborimo, inwe mwensi nabarwaria bare bosa, motari kogwenia.

english: O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .
ekegusii: Onye ndiria mware gokira‐kiri! Okwo nanga nigo kwaba obong’aini bwaino.

english: Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .
ekegusii: Bono tegerera moigwe amang’ana ngwekwanera, naende tegerera moigwe ogosorora gokorwa ase omonwa one.

english: Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him?
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana oborimo? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong’ainereria?

english: Will ye accept his person ? will ye contend for God ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae ase ekegambero?

english: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana nabe amaya ase more Omonene karabarenge abamanye buna more? Gose mokagete ng’a nigo moramong’aine buna abanto bakong’ainana?

english: Man that is born of a woman is of few days , and full of trouble .
ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto okoiborwa nomokuungu, amatuko aye namake; ayio aichire nemechando.

english: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea, man giveth up the ghost , and where is he?
ekegusii: Korende omonto nigo agokwa, bwarerigwa riroba inse; omonto nigo agotiga koeyana, ng’ai agochia?

english: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana amaache e chinyancha agosira pi, naboigo naye chindooche agokama chioma pa,

english: So man lieth down , and riseth not: till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .
ekegusii: naboigo na Mwanyabaanto kararire, tagotenena naende; tagoturwa goika ekero igoro na ense bitabeo; tagotaboborwa korwa ase chitoro chiaye.

english: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave , that thou wouldest keep me secret , until thy wrath be past , that thou wouldest appoint me a set time , and remember me!
ekegusii: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakuure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong’inyora!

english: If a man die , shall he live again ? all the days of my appointed time will I wait , till my change come .
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto gakuure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.

english: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .
ekegusii: Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y’amaboko ao.

english: For now thou numberest my steps : dost thou not watch over my sin ?
ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.

english: My transgression is sealed up in a bag , and thou sewest up mine iniquity .
ekegusii: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.

english: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .
ekegusii: “Buna egetunwa gekogwa na giasamunyokana, na egetare giasukigwa korwa aase aye;

english: The waters wear the stones : thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth ; and thou destroyest the hope of man .
ekegusii: buna amaache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa Mwanyabaanto.

english: He cometh forth like a flower , and is cut down : he fleeth also as a shadow , and continueth not.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.

english: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogendererete kobua omonto, na ere nigo agoeta osira, nigo okoonchora ekieni kiaye kwamosiria.

english: His sons come to honour , and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low , but he perceiveth it not of them.
ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoegwa ogosikwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio; nigo bakourwa ogosikwa kwabo na gokoigwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio.

english: But his flesh upon him shall have pain , and his soul within him shall mourn .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”

english: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo okorigereria omonto buna oyio? Nigo okondeta ase obosio bwao na kongambia ekiina?

english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare korenta egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti? Onde taiyo, nonya noyomo.

english: Seeing his days are determined , the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass ;
ekegusii: Omonto nigo abareire amatuko aye, na omobaro bw’emetienyi yaye naye kwayochikire, naende kwamobeekeire chimbebe atanyare goetania.

english: Turn from him, that he may rest , till he shall accomplish , as an hireling , his day .
ekegusii: Tiga komorigereria, motige anyore obotoereru, erinde agokere amatuko aye buna omonto orikire emeremo.

english: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
ekegusii: “Ogosemeria nkoreo ase omote, ekero ogechirwe noseboke naende, na emeseboko eyio tegosira.

english: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth , and the stock thereof die in the ground ;
ekegusii: Emeri y’omote oyio neisa kogota ime ase riroba, na egetugi kiaye nkegote gesire ime ase riroba,

english: Yet through the scent of water it will bud , and bring forth boughs like a plant .
ekegusii: nonya naboigo, ekero embura eratwe, nigo keraseboke na gosokia ebisabo buna ekemeri ekeyia.

english: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite , and said ,
ekegusii: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

english: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father .
ekegusii: Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.

english: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
ekegusii: “Inee! Okoremia koria Nyasae akoeire tikogoisaini? Gose ring’ana ri’oboitongo agokwana naye nigo rire bosa asore?

english: Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,
ekegusii: Nase ki enkoro yao ere morero, na amaiso ao akomogora,

english: That thou turnest thy spirit against God , and lettest such words go out of thy mouth ?
ekegusii: goika omoyo oo obeire mamincha ya Nyasae, na bono aye ngosokia ore amang’ana aya korwa ase omonwa oo?

english: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints ; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight .
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabachenu baye, na igoro chionsi tichichenegeti ase obosio bwaye.

english: How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio ogokora ay’okogechia na gosaria, oyio okonywa ebibe buna amaache?

english: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare ;
ekegusii: “Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.

english: Which wise men have told from their fathers , and have not hid it:
ekegusii: Ayio abanto abang’aini bateebeetigwe ne chisokoro chiabo, nabarabwo tibayabisete.

english: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa ense eria, na abanto b’ense engeni tibaetete aroro.

english: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?

english: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days , and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor .
ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.

english: A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okwoboyia nigo agosoa ase amato aye; na ekero are n’obotoereru, oyo ogosiria nigo akomocheera.

english: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness , and he is waited for of the sword .
ekegusii: Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng’a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.

english: He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akoba okoombogana korigia endagera, oboria: Ng’ai ere? Nigo amanyete ng’a rituko ri’omosunte riamoikeire ang’e.

english: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid ; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle .
ekegusii: Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omorwoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.

english: For he stretcheth out his hand against God , and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty .
ekegusii: “Ere oramboire okoboko kwaye mamincha ya Nyasae, naende oba nomokia gokora ay’oboenenu ase obosio bw’Omonguru.

english: He runneth upon him, even on his neck , upon the thick bosses of his bucklers :
ekegusii: Oyio nigo akobogoria ching’aya chiaye chikumbire, ominyoka ore nebigoti ebikong’u ochia korwania Omonene.

english: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
ekegusii: Nigo atubire obosio bwaye namaguta ’obonoru, naende onorire ase ebibono biaye.

english: And he dwelleth in desolate cities , and in houses which no man inhabiteth , which are ready to become heaps .
ekegusii: “Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.

english: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.

english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nemogwenerete koamererania ne chinkwana chitari nengencho, gose amang’ana atari korenta buya bonde?

english: He shall not depart out of darkness ; the flame shall dry up his branches , and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away .
ekegusii: Tagotooreka korwa ase omosunte; omorero mbwomie emeseboka egoseboka, ere omonyene nasire ase omoika bw’Omonene.

english: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .
ekegusii: Tabaisa kweng’aina ase ogosemeria amang’ana abosa, ekiagera obosa obwo nabwo borabe eng’eria yaye.

english: It shall be accomplished before his time , and his branch shall not be green .
ekegusii: Naakanwe obosa obwo ritang’ani engaki yaye etaraika, na nigo arabe buna orosagia rwaye rotarasicha.

english: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .
ekegusii: Oyio nigo arabe buna omosabibu okoarora amasabibu ataratoba, na buna omozeituni okoarora ebisicha biaye.

english: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .
ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo biragombae, na omorero nosambe emechie y’abanchete amaaki.

english: They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe, barenta ogosaria; okwama kwabo bakorenta nokw’obong’ainereria.”

english: Yea, thou castest off fear , and restrainest prayer before God .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.

english: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .
ekegusii: Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

english: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
ekegusii: Tari inche ngokonachera ekiina, korende amang’ana aya ogokwana, ee, aya ogokwana nomonwa oo akobereire kirori.

english: Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Naye ore omonto bw’eritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?

english: Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana koigwa emeroberio y’obobisi bwa Nyasae? Aye nigo kwenyoreire obong’aini aye bweka?

english: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye ninki omanyete intwe totamanyeti? Mbong’aini ki omanyete intwe totamanyeti?

english: They have gaped upon me with their mouth ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully ; they have gathered themselves together against me.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo banyansameretie emenwa yabo, bang’akire chindoe ase chinsea. Bakondama; nigo bagosangererekana amo ng’a bankore bobe.

english: God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .
ekegusii: Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko abakori amabe.

english: I was at ease , but he hath broken me asunder : he hath also taken me by my neck , and shaken me to pieces , and set me up for his mark .
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge inde n’obotoereru, korende ere agansenyenta, ee, Nyasae akambwata ebigoti, akambutorana ebing’ese, bono onkorire nabeire ekerenga kiaye gekoraswa.

english: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .
ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe baye bang’etananire aande onsi, ombetire chinyigo chiane, tandorereti amaabera; oumoire amaache endorwe yane igoro ase riroba.

english: He breaketh me with breach upon breach , he runneth upon me like a giant .
ekegusii: Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.

english: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .
ekegusii: Bono natubire omobere one negunia, ne chinguru chiane nachitugutire ime ase orotu.

english: My face is foul with weeping , and on my eyelids is the shadow of death ;
ekegusii: Amaiso aane abariirire ase obosio bwane, na ekiriri kiarorekanire ase obosio bwane,

english: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .
ekegusii: nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.

english: O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .
ekegusii: Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.

english: I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all.
ekegusii: Inche naigure amang’ana amange buna ayio, inwe mwensi nigo more abaremia mogonchanda.

english: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God .
ekegusii: Nonya nabasani baane nigo bagonsekerera, inche nigo nkoiyeria amariga ndigereretie Nyasae.

english: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
ekegusii: Kirori one nansororere ase Nyasae, buna omonto agosororera omonto onde.

english: When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .
ekegusii: Emiaka emeke netigarete, inche mbwatie enchera ekogenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao naende.

english: Shall vain words have an end ? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ayio anga buna omwaga okogusa aerire? Gose nkere egekogoseegeta oiranerie ayande?

english: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri’obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang’ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one.

english: But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief .
ekegusii: Amang’ana nare ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one, nigo are kobabeeka chinguru; ee, amabeebe ay’ebikoba igoro nigo are kobaremia.

english: Though I speak , my grief is not asswaged : and though I forbear , what am I eased ?
ekegusii: Ninsa koba ngokwana, obororo bwane tibogokea; na ninsa koremereria nkire, emechando yane tegokea nonya ng’ake.

english: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.

english: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
ekegusii: Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.

english: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu ase ’nde, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye ase ’nde; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.

english: My breath is corrupt , my days are extinct , the graves are ready for me.
ekegusii: “Omoika ong’ereire, amatuko aane aikeire omoerio; oboina mbonganyete.

english: But as for you all, do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you.
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwensi, moirane gocha; tinkonyara konyora nonya nomonto oyomo ase egati yaino ore omong’aini.

english: My days are past , my purposes are broken off , even the thoughts of my heart .
ekegusii: Amatuko aane aetire, emeroberio yane yasarekire, nonya nokogania gw’enkoro yane.

english: They change the night into day : the light is short because of darkness .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baonchoire obotuko bwabeire omobaso; nigo bagoteeba ng’a omobaso nigo ore ang’e, korende omosunte noreo.

english: If I wait , the grave is mine house : I have made my bed in the darkness .
ekegusii: Nonya inde nogosemeria, aase abakuure nao obomenyo bwane, nindambore oborere bwane ase omosunte ime.

english: I have said to corruption , Thou art my father : to the worm , Thou art my mother , and my sister .
ekegusii: Ninteebie oboina: Naye tata Ninteebie amakonde: Ninwe baba na abaiseke baminto.

english: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it?
ekegusii: Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?

english: They shall go down to the bars of the pit , when our rest together is in the dust .
ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakuure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”

english: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?
ekegusii: Ekeene, abachecheria bang’etananire, na amaiso aane nigo agendererete korora okogechia kwabo.

english: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
ekegusii: Aye omonyene obe ntenenera ase ’nde, imbe asore. Inee! Ning’o rende oranyare kwerua abe ntenenera ase ’nde?

english: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .
ekegusii: Aye gwasiekire ebirengererio biabo tibiba nokomanya, ase ayio tokobaimokereria igoro na kobaa okobua.

english: He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
ekegusii: Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, amaiso abana babo nigo araukore.

english: He hath made me also a byword of the people ; and aforetime I was as a tabret .
ekegusii: Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaaya ase ogotwa amate.

english: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow , and all my members are as a shadow .
ekegusii: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.

english: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .
ekegusii: Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.

english: The righteous also shall hold on his way , and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger .
ekegusii: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.

english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite , and said ,
ekegusii: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

english: The snare is laid for him in the ground , and a trap for him in the way .
ekegusii: Engori y’ogotegerwa nebiswe ase riroba ase agotacha, na omotego otegwe ase enchera agoeta.

english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side , and shall drive him to his feet .
ekegusii: Nabe okogoswa na kwoboigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, nkomoseria atame namagoro.

english: His strength shall be hungerbitten , and destruction shall be ready at his side .
ekegusii: Enchara nemorie goika chinguru chiaye chiere, na emechando nemobeere ang’e komoiyeria.

english: It shall devour the strength of his skin : even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength .
ekegusii: Oborwaire mbokoore risankwa ri’omobere oye, oborwaire obotang’ani bw’amakweri mbogundie ebiimo biaye.

english: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .
ekegusii: Nataboranwe ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omorwoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.

english: It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
ekegusii: Enka yaye nebe bosa abanto abaao mbabe bakomenya aroro; amagena omorero nasiarerwe ase enka yaye.

english: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off .
ekegusii: Emeri yaye ’nyome inse ye riroba, ne chinsagia chiaye nachisusane.

english: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
ekegusii: Oyio takoinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake, gose nonya nerieta riaye tirikogenderera koinyorwa agwo ase enchera.

english: He shall be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .
ekegusii: Ere narusigwe korwa ase oborabu arutwe gochia ase omosunte; naende aserigwe korwa ase ense.

english: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .
ekegusii: Takoba nomwana gose abanto b’ororeria rwaye ase egati y’abanto bamwabo, gose monto onde oye tagotigara ore moyo agwo ase amenyete.

english: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words ? mark , and afterwards we will speak .
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri ogochia korigia amang’ana agokwanwa? Yarengererie, magega yaye naintwe tokwane.

english: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete bosongo mbakumie igoro ye rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye, na abamenyete moocha mbaondokigwe namang’ana ayio.

english: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .
ekegusii: Ekeene, obomenyo bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nabo bore igo, na aase ay’abataganeti komomanya Nyasae nabo are igo.”

english: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
ekegusii: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching’iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?

english: He teareth himself in his anger : shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place ?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo ogwetandora ase engencho y’endamwamu yao, ense nigo egochia gotigwa bosa ase engencho yao? Gose egetare ngetigerigwe korwa aase aye?

english: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him.
ekegusii: Oborabu bore ase obomenyo bwaye nigo borabe omosunte, na etaya yaye ere asare nerimigwe.

english: The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
ekegusii: Amatambokero aye are ne chinguru nakeeigwe, na emeroberio yaye emoiyerie inse.

english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nabwatwe nomotego, abe ogotaara ase egati ye chiirima.

english: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him.
ekegusii: Omotego nomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.

english: He hath destroyed me on every side , and I am gone : and mine hope hath he removed like a tree .
ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi ong’iyeirie, bono inche nasirigwe; osimoire ogosemeria kwane buna omote ogosimorwa.

english: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .
ekegusii: Obeire nekeririanda ekenene ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.

english: His troops come together , and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle .
ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abarwani baye b’esegi nigo bigocha bire amo, biabekire eburi ase ngoetera; biatoorire biang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi chi’Obomenyo bwane.

english: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
ekegusii: “Nyasae ogerire abaminto bantigire, bambeereire aare, na abanto twamanyaine bantigire, babeire buna tibamanyeti.

english: My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
ekegusii: Abanto baminto bantigire, na abasani twanchaine mono banyebire.

english: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .
ekegusii: Abageni bamenyete mwane banyebire; na abasomba baane abaiseke bambarire buna omoeti; nabeire omomenyi ase amaiso abo.

english: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer ; I intreated him with my mouth .
ekegusii: Ekero nkorangeria omosomba one, ere tari kong’itabera, otatiga ekero namosoroire, nario rioka agocha.

english: My breath is strange to my wife , though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body .
ekegusii: Omoika okorwa ase omonwa one nigo ogotiokera omokungu one bobe; nigo inde okogechia ase abamura baminto torwete enda eyemo.

english: Yea, young children despised me; I arose , and they spake against me.
ekegusii: Nonya n’abana abake banchayire; ekero ngotenena nigo bagonkwana bobe.

english: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
ekegusii: Abasani abagisangio banyinyerire na kogechigwa nainche; nabwo nanchete bang’onchokeire na gonkora bobe.

english: How long will ye vex my soul , and break me in pieces with words ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri morabe mokogechia omoyo one na mogonsenyenta namang’ana aino?

english: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .
ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongononire ase risankwa ne chinyama, natigeirwe egesabo getubete amaino gioka.

english: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends ; for the hand of God hath touched me.
ekegusii: Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!

english: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?
ekegusii: Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?

english: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !
ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase egetabu,

english: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever !
ekegusii: ee, arikwe nekaramu eroisirie korwa ase risasi, ekioma egekong’u, amang’erwe ase egetare abeo kare na kare.

english: For I know that my redeemer liveth , and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth :
ekegusii: “Korende nimanyete ng’a Omobooria one moyo are, omoerio nigo aratenene igoro ye riroba.

english: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
ekegusii: Nyuma risankwa ri’omobere one korirabe riasarekire, erio nindore Nyasae ’nde ase omobere one.

english: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold , and not another ; though my reins be consumed within me.
ekegusii: Nimwerorere inche omonyene; amaiso aane namorigererie, ayane, tari ay’omonto omoao. “Nimoganetie mono ase enkoro yane ime.

english: But ye should say , Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
ekegusii: Moise goteeba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?

english: Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .
ekegusii: Inwe iroka ogoitwa n’omoro, ekiagera oyore nekeririanda nigo akoegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa nemioro; erio monyare komanya ng’a okogambigwa nkoreo.”

english: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
ekegusii: Mwabeire mogonchecheria ara ikomi. Inee! Timori korora obosooku gonkorera bobe iga?

english: And be it indeed that I have erred , mine error remaineth with myself.
ekegusii: Ee, nonya ekeene nakorire okomocha, okomocha okwo nokwane inche omonyene.

english: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach :
ekegusii: Inwe onye mogwetogia ng’a nabaya more kombua na kong’enekeria igo kobwatekana nogochaywa kwane,

english: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net .
ekegusii: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya ase ’nde, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.

english: Behold, I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .
ekegusii: Rora, nigo nkorera mono ngoteeba: Nakoreirwe bobe, korende tindi koiranerigwa; nigo nkorangeria neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, korende ekeene, oboronge tibori gokorwa.

english: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .
ekegusii: Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obeekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.

english: He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .
ekegusii: Ong’urire obonene bwane. Orusirie egutwa korwa ase omotwe one.

english: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
ekegusii: Ase ense ya Usi narengeo omonto ore korokwa Ayubu. Omonto oyio nigo arenge omwegenwa, na nigo abwate enkoro endonge; nigo amoirogete Nyasae, agetanga korwa ase ogokora amabe.

english: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house , and about all that he hath on every side ? thou hast blessed the work of his hands , and his substance is increased in the land .
