ekegusii: Aye nigo omorendete na komokengera ase chinsemo chionsi, ere amo nabaanto b’enyomba yaye yonsi, na gento kende gionsi abwate. Ee, nigo osesenetie emeremo yaye yonsi agokora, naende gwakorire enibo yaye yamentekanire mono ase ense.

english: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face .
ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune ebinto bionsi abwate obisirie, ekeene, ere goika akoragererie agwo ase obosio bwao.”

english: And the LORD said unto Satan , Behold, all that he hath is in thy power ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD .
ekegusii: Agwo Omonene agateebia Saitani, igo mbuya, “Rora, ebinto bionsi Ayubu abwate bono nigo bire inse y’okobua kwao, korende ere omonyene tobaisa komokuna.” Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, akagenda. Abana b’Ayubu bagosirigwa amo nenibo yaye

english: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house :
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero abana b’Ayubu, abamura na abaiseke, babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene,

english: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them:
ekegusii: omonto obwate amang’ana akaminyoka gochia ase Ayubu, akamoteebia, “Chiombe nigo chiarenge korema, ne chitigere nigo chiarenge korisia ang’e ase chiombe chiria.

english: And the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away ; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Seba bacha mobasokano, baira chitugo chionsi, naende baita abasomba nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

english: While he was yet speaking , there came also another, and said , The fire of God is fallen from heaven , and hath burned up the sheep , and the servants , and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
ekegusii: Ekero oyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateeba, “Omorero o Nyasae nigo ogwa korwa igoro, osamba ching’ondi chiayia chiaera, naende boigo osamba abasomba bayia baera; ninche bweka natigara, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

english: While he was yet speaking , there came also another, and said , The Chaldeans made out three bands , and fell upon the camels , and have carried them away , yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
ekegusii: Na ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abakalidayo nigo bachicha bare ebiombe bitato, baumokera chingamia, bachiira, naende baita abasomba bande nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

english: While he was yet speaking , there came also another, and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house :
ekegusii: Ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, nigo babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene;

english: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
ekegusii: bono omwaga bw’echinguru ocha korwa ase erooro, onyegeria chikoona inye chi’enyomba eria, erinde yagwera abana abwo abasae, bakuure bonsi; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”

english: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters .
ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.

english: Then Job arose , and rent his mantle , and shaved his head , and fell down upon the ground , and worshipped ,
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akaimoka, agatandora eanga yaye, agakigita + 1:20 Agakigita: engencho yaye nokogongira etukia yo’motwe. etukia yaye, erio agatung’ama inse, agasasiima,

english: And said , Naked came I out of my mother’s womb , and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave , and the LORD hath taken away ; blessed be the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Nigo narwete ase enda ya baba inde getirianda, naende nigo ndairane korwa ase ense inde getirianda. Omonene nere oruete, naende oirire. Erieta riaye ritogigwe.”

english: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe, gose tabeekerete Nyasae obobe.

english: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .
ekegusii: Naende nabwate ching’ondi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), ne chingamia chilifu isato (3,000), ne chiombe elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chitigere chiaberi amagana atano (500); naende nabwate abasomba abange mono. Ase ayio omonto oyio nigo arenge omonda mono kobua abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Moocha.

english: And his sons went and feasted in their houses , every one his day ; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Ayubu nigo banarete gokora emeyega ase chibisi, kera oyomo ase rituko riaye ase enyomba yaye. Nigo barenge korangeria abaiseke bamwabo baria batato bacha koragera na konywa amo nabarabwo kera engaki.

english: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .
ekegusii: Nyuma ya kera omoyega koerire, mambia chuni Ayubu nigo arenge korangeria abana baye nakobaruera ekeng’wanso ase kera oyomo ase okobachena. Nigo arenge gokora igo, ekiagera arenge korengereria, oteeba, “Ande nebe ng’a onde bw’abana baane okorire ebibe, oramire Nyasae ase enkoro yaye ime.” Naboigo Ayubu arenge gokora botambe.

english: And the LORD said unto Satan , Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”

english: And the LORD said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
ekegusii: Agw’Omonene akabooria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa, na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe.”

english: His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .
ekegusii: Abana baye mbabe bagosaberera korwa ase abataka, na amaboko aye nairanie obotenenku bwaye bwonsi.

english: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo aichire ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, korende chinguru echio nigo chiraraare nere ase riroba.

english: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth , though he hide it under his tongue ;
ekegusii: “Nonya obobe bore obwansu ase omonwa oye ime, nabobise inse y’oromeme rwaye,

english: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth :
ekegusii: nonya obwatererete obobe obwo bokong’u, takobotiga, korende nabogache ase omonwa oye ime,

english: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him.
ekegusii: endagera eyio nigo erarore se ase enda yaye, ebe buna obosongo bw’eng’iti engenda inse ime yaye.

english: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomera chinibo, naende ochiroka; Nyasae nigo agochiseria korwao.

english: He shall suck the poison of asps : the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nanyunyunte obosongo bw’eng’iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw’eng’iti eria mbomoite.

english: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .
ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chinsoko chiichire namooke na amabeere.

english: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .
ekegusii: Ebinto akoreire emeremo emekong’u nabiiranie, takobimera, gose takonyara kwegokeria ebitoki biria anyorire.

english: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
ekegusii: Ekiagera obeire ogokorera abataka bobe na kobatiga bare bosa, naende obeire okoira ne chinguru enyomba ende yonsi ere ataagachete.

english: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
ekegusii: “Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.

english: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly , he shall not save of that which he desired .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ribero ri’omonto oyio riagerire taba n’obotoereru, takonyara kogaacha gento kende gekomogokia.

english: There shall none of his meat be left ; therefore shall no man look for his goods .
ekegusii: Ekero arageire tari gotigaria kende, ase ayio obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera.

english: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
ekegusii: Nebe ekero agendererete gotenenka mono nachandwe, na obokong’u obonge mbomochere.

english: When he is about to fill his belly , God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating .
ekegusii: Nebe ng’a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.

english: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .
ekegusii: Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etai.

english: It is drawn , and cometh out of the body ; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall : terrors are upon him.
ekegusii: Ensara eyio eng’uswe korwa ase omobere oye, ee, ensonga ekomesa nesokere ase endorwe yaye, erio ekeondoko ki’amakweri nakemosoe.

english: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo ogacheire chinibo chiaye; omorero otautiri nonde nomosirie, na ebitigarete ase obomenyo bwaye mbisambwe biere.

english: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity ; and the earth shall rise up against him.
ekegusii: Igoro neorokie ebibe biaye maiso marore, na ense nemoimokere komorwania.

english: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .
ekegusii: Ebinto asangereretie ase enyomba yaye mbiirwe; bionsi nigo birairwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu ya Nyasae.

english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God , and the heritage appointed unto him by God .
ekegusii: “Eke nakio egetari ki’omokori amabe gekorwa ase Nyasae, naende oyio noro omwando oye Nyasae amochikerete.”

english: I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .
ekegusii: Naigure ogokuurerwa gw’okonyomania ng’a inche nomomochi, korende omoika bw’okomanya ore ime yane ogerire ing’iranerie.

english: Knowest thou not this of old , since man was placed upon earth ,
ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwana komanya ng’a korwa kare, ekero Mwanyabaanto babeegetwe ase ense,

english: That the triumphing of the wicked is short , and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment ?
ekegusii: omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogooko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?

english: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds ;
ekegusii: Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,

english: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he?
ekegusii: goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamorooche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?

english: He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .
ekegusii: Nigo arasire buna chindoto, takonyorekana, ee, nigo aragikerigwe buna amaroro a botuko.

english: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more ; neither shall his place any more behold him.
ekegusii: Eriso riarenge komoorora, tirikomoorora naende, gose aase aye takomorigereria naende.

english: But Job answered and said ,
ekegusii: Bono Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

english: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
ekegusii: Chiombe chiabo nigo chikonyora amarieme buya, naende chiabiara chitari korekera.

english: They send forth their little ones like a flock , and their children dance .
ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga.

english: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .
ekegusii: Nigo bagotera bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano, naende bagokera amariogi ’ebiroria.

english: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .
ekegusii: Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakuure bare nomorembe.

english: Therefore they say unto God , Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways .
ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bagoteebia Nyasae: totige intwe! Titoganeti komanya chinchera chiao.

english: What is the Almighty , that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
ekegusii: Oria Omobui ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?

english: Lo, their good is not in their hand : the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
ekegusii: Rora, ogosesenigwa kwabo tikori ase amaboko abo; ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore aare nainche.

english: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out ! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger .
ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobacheera? Inee! Ara karenga Nyasae akobaa emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?

english: They are as stubble before the wind , and as chaff that the storm carrieth away .
ekegusii: Gose barabwo nkoirurukigwa bare buna chimboba, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga?

english: God layeth up his iniquity for his children : he rewardeth him, and he shall know it .
ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Nyasae nigo akogachera abana ebibe bi’abaise. Tiga Omonene aakane abanto abanyene ebibe biabo, erio nario baranyare kobimanya.

english: Hear diligently my speech , and let this be your consolations .
ekegusii: Tegerera mono moigwe amang’ana aane, ayio naro arabe okoremia kwaino ase ’nde.

english: His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .
ekegusii: Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.

english: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
ekegusii: Ekero emetienyi yabo yaerire na bakuure, Inee, mbabe bagwechandera chinka chiabo?

english: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
ekegusii: Onde nare oranyare kworokereria Nyasae obong’aini, ere oria okogambia abwo bare igoro mono?

english: One dieth in his full strength , being wholly at ease and quiet .
ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo nigo agokwa ore nobotenenku obonge, ore n’obotoereru bwonsi na orendire buya,

english: His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .
ekegusii: ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga ’omobere oye aichire nemeseto.

english: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul , and never eateth with pleasure .
ekegusii: Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw’omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng’ake.

english: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bakobeekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.

english: Behold, I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
ekegusii: “Rora, nimanyete ebirengererio biaino, na emeroberio yaino y’ogonkora bobe.

english: For ye say , Where is the house of the prince ? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked ?
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ng’ai enyomba y’omochandi oria ere? Naende: Ng’ai obomenyo bw’abakori amabe bore?

english: Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,

english: Suffer me that I may speak ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
ekegusii: Remereria, erinde nkwane; na ngokoora gokwana, mogenderere gonchecheria.

english: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .
ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?

english: Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koorokeria omokori amabe chinchera chiaye? Ning’o oramoakane amabe ayio akorire?

english: Yet shall he be brought to the grave , and shall remain in the tomb .
ekegusii: Ekero arabeekwe ase oboina, oboina boria nigo boraarendwe.

english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
ekegusii: Amaroba erigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa magega, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.

english: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?
ekegusii: “Nase ki rende mokondemia namang’ana abosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”

english: As for me, is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche Mwanyabaanto nkwemurunganeria? Nase ki rende ndaremererie tinyemurungania?

english: Mark me, and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .
ekegusii: Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.

english: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aya, obwoba nigo bogonsoa, na omobere one oiguswa.

english: Wherefore do the wicked live , become old , yea, are mighty in power ?
ekegusii: Nase ki abakori amabe bakogenderera koba moyo na kwegotera bare ne chinguru na okobua?

english: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes .
ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.

english: Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them.
ekegusii: Chinka chiabo nigo chire buya, bwoba tiboiyo, gose Nyasae tari kobaa egesusuro.

english: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
ekegusii: Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.

english: Or darkness , that thou canst not see ; and abundance of waters cover thee.
ekegusii: Oborabu bwao bwabekirwe omosunte, goika tori korora, na amaache amange agotubire.

english: Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are!
ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!

english: And thou sayest , How doth God know ? can he judge through the dark cloud ?
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio aye nigo ogoteeba: Inki Nyasae amanyete? Nanyare konacha ekiina goetera ase omosunte ekerima?

english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven .
ekegusii: Amare amarito nigo amotubete, takonyara korora, naende nigo agotaara ase obokumbe bwa igoro.

english: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nenchera enkoro ogochia kobwatia, eria abakori amabe babwatetie?

english: Which were cut down out of time , whose foundation was overflown with a flood :
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogooko okoira.

english: Which said unto God , Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateebeetie Nyasae: Karue ase tore! Naende bakaboora: Inee! Ngento ki Omobui oyio aratokorere?

english: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae konya oichoirie chinyomba chiabo n’ebinto ebiya. Ogosemia kw’abakori amabe tiga kobe aare nainche.

english: The righteous see it , and are glad : and the innocent laugh them to scorn .
ekegusii: Ekero abanyaboronge bakorora ayio, nigo bakogoka; ee, abwo batari na komocha nigo bagosekerera abakori amabe na kobachecheria,

english: Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nenyarekane ng’a omonto abe nengencho ase Nyasae? Ekeene, omonto oria ore nobong’aini nigo akwegwenera ere bweka omonyene.

english: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.

english: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee.
ekegusii: “Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.

english: Receive , I pray thee, the law from his mouth , and lay up his words in thine heart .
ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio akorwa ase omonwa oye; gacha amang’ana aye ime ase enkoro yao.

english: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
ekegusii: Korairanere Omobui, noiranerigwe amaya ao; korende oserie obobe korwa ase obomenyo bwao.

english: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust , and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks .
ekegusii: Otugute chitaabu chiao ime ase amaroba, ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri ochibeke ase egati y’amagena ’ebirooche,

english: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence , and thou shalt have plenty of silver .
ekegusii: erinde Omobui bweka abe etaabu yao, na efeta yao ere nengencho enene.

english: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
ekegusii: Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omobui oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.

english: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows .
ekegusii: Na ekero orabe gokomosaba, nakoigwe; naye nonyare goakana chiira chiao chi’ogotiana.

english: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways .
ekegusii: Erio ekero orabe gokoroberia gokora gento kende gionsi, ekio nkebe bo, na oborabu mbomoreke chinchera chiao.

english: When men are cast down , then thou shalt say , There is lifting up ; and he shall save the humble person .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokeyia abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo obatooria.

english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty , that thou art righteous ? or is it gain to him , that thou makest thy ways perfect ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omogoko onde nore ase Omonguru ng’a nomonyaboronge ore? Gose inki aranyore onye aye kogokora chinchera chiao chibe ching’ikeranu?

english: He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria omonto ore nokomocha, omonto buna oyio nigo aratoorigwe goetera ase amaboko ao achenegete.”

english: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a nekiagera omoirogete, nakio gekogera agokoa egesusuro na gokorenta ase ekiina?

english: Is not thy wickedness great ? and thine iniquities infinite ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.

english: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought , and stripped the naked of their clothing .
ekegusii: Aye kwairire bosa ebinto abamino baruete bibe ntenenera, naende kwabachaboire chianga, kwabatigire gesobono.

english: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink , and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .
ekegusii: Oyo konya orosire tomoeti amaache anywe, na oyo orenge nenchara okamorina endagera.

english: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth ; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.

english: Thou hast sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire kogoseria ababoraka bare namaboko amasa na kobuna amaboko e chintakana.

english: But he knoweth the way that I take : when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold .
ekegusii: Korende ere namanyete chinchera chiane ngoetera. Ekero arakoore gonteema, nimbioke buna etaabu ekobioka korwa riko.

english: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .
ekegusii: Inche natachire bokong’u ase amabarato aye, nabeire ndendete chinchera chiaye, gose tindi koonchoka nchitige.

english: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .
ekegusii: Tinana gotiga kobwata amachiiko akwanete; nimbwatetie amang’ana ere akwanete, gose tari aya naroberetie inche omonyene.

english: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .
ekegusii: Korende ere tari koonchoka, ning’o oranyare komoonchorana? Egento aganirie gokora, nigo akogekora.

english: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
ekegusii: Aya achiikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.

english: Therefore am I troubled at his presence : when I consider , I am afraid of him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabeire nobwoba koba ase obosio bwaye, na ekero nkoyarengereria nigo nkomwoboa.

english: For God maketh my heart soft , and the Almighty troubleth me:
ekegusii: Nyasae ogoyirie omoyo one, ee, Omobui ongosire,

english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.

english: Even to day is my complaint bitter : my stroke is heavier than my groaning .
ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.

english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat !
ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare komanya aase ndamonyore, rirorio nigo nare kogenda goika ase obomenyo bwaye bore.

english: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge komoteebia amang’ana aane, ing’ichorie omonwa one namang’ana nkoamererania nere.

english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
ekegusii: Igo nigo nare komanya eki akong’iraneria, na komanya ayarenge gonteebia.

english: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No; but he would put strength in me.
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nkoamererania arenge nainche ase okobua kwaye kore okonene? Yaya, nigo arenge gontegerera.

english: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
ekegusii: Agwo omonto omonyaboronge nigo are konyara koamererania nere, rirorio nigo nare gotigwa kegima noyokongambia.

english: Behold, I go forward , but he is not there; and backward , but I cannot perceive him:
ekegusii: Rora, nabeire nkogenda gochia bosio, korende ere taiyo; naende nabeire nkoirana gochia magega, korende tindi komoorora.

english: On the left hand , where he doth work , but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand , that I cannot see him:
ekegusii: Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende ere nigo akwebisa; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komoorora.

english: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty , do they that know him not see his days ?
ekegusii: Nase ki Omonguru atabegeti chingaki chi’ekina? Naende nase ki baria bamwanchete batararora rituko riria riaye?

english: They cause him to go naked without clothing , and they take away the sheaf from the hungry ;
ekegusii: Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.

english: Which make oil within their walls , and tread their winepresses , and suffer thirst .
ekegusii: Nigo bakomita amaguta ’amazeituni, boigo edivai korende nonya naboigo nigo bare nerang’o.

english: Men groan from out of the city , and the soul of the wounded crieth out : yet God layeth not folly to them .
ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete ase omochie nigo bakweumia, abanto baakire chingoma nigo bakorera, nonya naboigo Nyasae tari gotegerera ogosaba kwabo.

english: They are of those that rebel against the light ; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
ekegusii: Abanto bande bangire oborabu, nonya ne chinchera chi’oborabu tibachimanyeti, gose tibari kobwatia chinchera chi’oborabu obwo.

english: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .
ekegusii: Omoiti nigo akoboka mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko emeremo yaye neyoboibi.

english: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face .
ekegusii: Eriso ri’omotomani nigo rikoganya kobwairire, ere oteeba: Onde tari ondoche, erio otuba obosio bwaye bwekona.

english: In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .
ekegusii: Omosunte gosoire, abaibi nigo bakobochora chinyomba basoa ime. Barabwo mobaso nigo bagwesiekerera bebisa; tibamanyeti oborabu.

english: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death : if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death .
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo onga buna emambia ase bare; barabwo nigo bare abasani b’okwoboyia kw’omosunte.

english: He is swift as the waters ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Omokori amabe nigo akoirwa bwango ne chiooro, na egetari kiaye ase ense eye nigo keragereirie, ere takonyara koirana ase emegondo yaye y’emesabibu.

english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana egurugura ne riberera bigokoora amaache ’amagena ’embura, naboigo nabaanto bakorire ebibe barairwe gochia aase abakuure.

english: Some remove the landmarks ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotigeria chimbebe, baira amaicho e chitugo nechinguru, bachia koyarisia aba ayabo.

english: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .
ekegusii: Chinda chi’abaiborete nchibange pi; amakonde nabarie baere, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake; igo oyogokora amabe nabunwe buna omote.

english: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.

english: He draweth also the mighty with his power : he riseth up , and no man is sure of life .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae ase okobua kwaye nigo akoa omokori amabe chinguru; ekero erusirie moyo, nigo agotenena naende.

english: Though it be given him to be in safety , whereon he resteth ; yet his eyes are upon their ways .
ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.

english: They are exalted for a little while , but are gone and brought low ; they are taken out of the way as all other , and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn .
ekegusii: Ase engaki enke nabo abakori amabe bagokinigwa, erio bwango basirigwa; nigo bakogwa inse, bakwa buna abande, babutorwa buna ebigara bikobutorwa ekero bikogeswa.

english: And if it be not so now , who will make me a liar , and make my speech nothing worth ?
ekegusii: Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa.

english: They drive away the ass of the fatherless , they take the widow’s ox for a pledge .
ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bakoira chitigere chie chintakana, baira chiombe chi’ababoraka koba intenenera.

english: They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .
ekegusii: Nigo bagotwoma abaremeire korwa inchera, bagera abataka bonsi b’ense eyio bachia kwebisa amo.

english: Behold, as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .
ekegusii: Rora, abataka abwo babeire buna chitigere chi’orosana chire ase erooro; nigo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora ebi bakoria. Ase ekerubo ekiomo nao bakorigeria abana babo endagera.

english: They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .
ekegusii: Nigo bakogesera omonto onde chindagera chi’echitugo chiaye, naende basangereria amasabibu agotigwa ase omogondo bw’omokori amabe.

english: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .
ekegusii: Nigo bakorara gesobono ase obotuko bwonsi, batabwati eki bakwebisia, gose tibabwati eki bakobeeka ekero ki’embeo.

english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .
ekegusii: Emebere yabo nigo enyiete nembura egotwa ase ebitunwa, erio bamigererania ase chingako chi’ebitare koigama aroro.

english: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
ekegusii: Abande nigo bagotaboria chintakana korwa ase chimbeere chi’abang’ina, na baira abana ebing’werere b’abataka babe intenenera.

english: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places .
ekegusii: “Obonene na okoirokia nigo bire ase Nyasae, nigo agokora omorembe aaria igoro mono.

english: Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o oranyare kobara emeganda yaye? Ning’o omobaso oye otari kobarera?

english: How then can man be justified with God ? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman ?
ekegusii: Naki rende omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae? Naki omonto oiboire nomokuungu aranyare koba oyochenegete?

english: Behold even to the moon , and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight .
ekegusii: Rora, nonya nomotienyi tori noborabu asare, gose ching’enang’eni tichiikeraneti ase amaiso aye.

english: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?
ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na Mwanyabaanto oyio onga buna enyongore.”

english: He hath compassed the waters with bounds , until the day and night come to an end .
ekegusii: Ong’ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw’amaache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.

english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof .
ekegusii: Chisiiro chia igoro nigo chigotengecha, chiakumia ase ogotogonyera kwaye.

english: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .
ekegusii: Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, + 26:12 Rahabu: rora 9:13 eng’iti enene y’enyancha.

english: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens ; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omechiera igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.

english: Lo, these are parts of his ways : but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand ?
ekegusii: Naama! Echi nechinsinyo chie chinchera chiaye, aya tokoigugwa nokomonyerera ogosinini. Korende ning’o oranyare komanya okobua kwaye konga buna enkoba egoaka.”

english: How hast thou helped him that is without power ? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength ?
ekegusii: “Naki ere buya aye gwakonyire omonto otari nokobua! Ee, aye gwatooririe omonto omoreu otari ne chinguru.

english: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom ? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is ?
ekegusii: Naki ere buya gwasemirie omonto otari nobong’aini, na gwakwanire amang’ana aichire ne chisemi chingiya!

english: To whom hast thou uttered words ? and whose spirit came from thee?
ekegusii: Nase chinguru chia ng’o gwakwanire amang’ana buna aya? Na ngoetera ase omoika o ng’o kwayakwanire?

english: Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof.
ekegusii: “Emeika y’abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namaache na ebimenyete imeo.

english: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering .
ekegusii: Aase abakuure nigo aasie ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ee, aase agwo ogosiria tabwati kemumeko.

english: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place , and hangeth the earth upon nothing .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.

english: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds ; and the cloud is not rent under them.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aochoganetie amaache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.

english: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
ekegusii: Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.

english: Moreover Job continued his parable , and said ,
ekegusii: Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye akabora:

english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagokigwe ase Omobui? Nabe okorangeria Nyasae ase chingaki chionsi?

english: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
ekegusii: Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.

english: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?
ekegusii: Rora, inwe mwensi mweroreire ayio; bono, nase ki rende mogokwana amang’ana abosa?

english: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .
ekegusii: Ekio nakio egetari Nyasae akoa omokori amabe, na omwando Omobui akoa abwo bagochanda abanto.

english: If his children be multiplied , it is for the sword : and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread .
ekegusii: Abana b’omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa n’omoro, abanto b’ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.

english: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .
ekegusii: Abatigari baye nigo oborwaire borabaite, na abakungu baratigwe bare ababoraka, tibakonyara kobareera.

english: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay ;
ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa gosangereria chifeta chinyinge buna orotu + 27:16 orotu: engencho yaye ebuse naende atumbe chianga chibe chinyinge mono;

english: He may prepare it , but the just shall put it on , and the innocent shall divide the silver .
ekegusii: nonya ochitumbire igo, nomonto omooronge orachibeeke, na abatari na komocha baatanane chifeta chiaye.

english: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .
ekegusii: Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.

english: The rich man shall lie down , but he shall not be gathered : he openeth his eyes , and he is not.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rinde; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.

english: As God liveth , who hath taken away my judgment ; and the Almighty , who hath vexed my soul ;
ekegusii: Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,

english: Terrors take hold on him as waters , a tempest stealeth him away in the night .
ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bonga buna eooro nigo bokomocheera; erio ekembugu‐mbugu kiamocheera botuko kiamoira.

english: The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .
ekegusii: Omwaga okorwa moocha nigo okomoirurukia; omorusia aase aye, omosiria kegima.

english: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare : he would fain flee out of his hand .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akomoruta emegwe atari namaabera, nere otama bokong’u korua ase okoboko kwaye.

english: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagoaka chinkobi igoro yaye, bamoseria neriogi ri’okomwogerera, orua aase aye.

english: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils ;
ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,

english: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .
ekegusii: omonwa one togokwana aya atari a boronge, gose oromeme rwane ay’obong’ainereria.

english: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
ekegusii: Abe aare korwa ase ’nde kobabara ng’a nabanyaboronge more; goika ogokwa kwane ningenderere goteeba ng’a tindi nokomocha.

english: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .
ekegusii: Nimbwaterere bokong’u oboronge bwane, tinkobotiga, enkoro yane tekongambia ase amatuko ande inde moyo.

english: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .
ekegusii: Tiga omobisa one abarwe buna omokori amabe, na oyore mamincha yane buna oyotari omonyaboronge.

english: For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?
ekegusii: Ngosemeria ki omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae abwate, ekero arakwe, ekero Nyasae aramoure obogima bwaye?.

english: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
ekegusii: Inee, ekero emechando eramochere Nyasae, namoigwe gose?

english: Surely there is a vein for the silver , and a place for gold where they fine it .
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ribwago ase chifeta chigokunywa korwa ndire, na aase abanto bagosiberia chitaabu nare.

english: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .
ekegusii: Nigo akorema emetaro ime ase ebitare, na amaiso aye arora kera egento kie rigori rinene.

english: He bindeth the floods from overflowing ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
ekegusii: Nigo akogita chindooche, otanga amaache tagoeta, erio egento kebisekanete ime, okerenta aase aarabu.

english: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?
ekegusii: Korende ng’ai obong’aini boranyorekane? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?

english: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living .
ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto tamanyeti rigori ri’obong’aini; borobwo tibori konyorekana ase ense emenyire nabare moyo.

english: The depth saith , It is not in me: and the sea saith , It is not with me.
ekegusii: Chindiba nigo chigokana chiateeba: Tibori ase ’nde aa, na enyancha nigo egoteeba: Tibori aiga ase ’nde.

english: It cannot be gotten for gold , neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.

english: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir , with the precious onyx , or the sapphire .
ekegusii: Tibokoreng’anigwa ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri, gose namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki na safiro.

english: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .
ekegusii: Chitaabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa n’ebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.

english: No mention shall be made of coral , or of pearls : for the price of wisdom is above rubies .
ekegusii: Amakorongote na ebirore bichenire tibigwatorwa. Rigori ri’obong’aini nigo rire rinene kobua eri’amagena erigori rinene akomeka‐meka.

english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold .
ekegusii: Topasio, rigena rie rigori rinene rikorwa Ethiopia, tirikoboreng’anigwa, gose tibokoreng’anigwa netaabu echenire.

english: Iron is taken out of the earth , and brass is molten out of the stone .
ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.

english: Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?
ekegusii: “Bono rende, obong’aini ng’ai bokorwa? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?

english: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
ekegusii: Nigo bobisire korwa ase amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo; ee, nigo botubire chinyoni tichiborora.

english: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
ekegusii: Aase ay’obosareku na amakweri nigo bigoteeba: Intwe twaigure chinkuma chiaye.

english: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
ekegusii: “Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.

english: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven ;
ekegusii: Ere nigo arigereretie goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, aroche kera egento kere inse y’erioba.

english: To make the weight for the winds ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amaache,

english: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :
ekegusii: ekero abegete ogochika ase embura, na akaroisia enchera y’okomesa gw’enkoba,

english: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out .
ekegusii: nario aroche obong’aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.

english: He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotongia chitaaya ime aaria, basiria omosunte; erio baba bakoriga‐rigia amagena ase ebinunchi bire ase omosunte ekerima.

english: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokunya chingoro chintambe gochia inse. Abwo nigo bakoba bebirwe nabaanto bagotaara igoro ye riroba, nigo bagotirimbokigwa basung’unaine bairwa aare korwa ase abanto.

english: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
ekegusii: Ase riroba igoro nao endagera ekwama ime y’ense inse aroro aonchoranwa aba buna omorero ogosamba oonchorana.

english: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nao are amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, amo namagena e chitaabu.

english: There is a path which no fowl knoweth , and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen :
ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda aase agwo enyoni ende yonsi egotwara orotwari teyemanyeti, gose ekebaki tikiana koyerora.

english: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
ekegusii: Eng’iti y’orosana eng’enenu tiyana koyetacha, gose endo tiyana goetera aroro.

english: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto nigo agokunya egetare ekiomo pa, erio osensema ebitunwa korwa inse obionchorana.

english: The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .
ekegusii: Amariogi ’abagaambi nigo arenge gokea, chimeme chiabo chiabwatana namang’ang’ura abo.

english: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me:
ekegusii: Ekero abanto barenge konyigwa, nigo barenge kondoka oyosesenirie, ekero baare kondora, baba birori ase ’nde,

english: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ngotooria abataka abwo barenge korera, ne chintakana chitabwate onde ogochikonya.

english: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy .
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagateera nechinkoro chire nomogooko.

english: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
ekegusii: Nigo neboyetie oboronge, naborobwo bogantuba; ekeene kiane nigo kiarenge buna omwambaro na ekegogwa.

english: I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .
ekegusii: Ninche narenge eriso ase emeuko, na okogoro ase ebirema.

english: I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .
ekegusii: Ninche narenge ise bw’abataka: na omonto ochandegete ntamanyete, nigo namwechanderete.

english: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .
ekegusii: Nigo nabunete chinsea chi’abatari abanyaboronge, ngatooria korwa ase emenwa yabo abwo konya babwatirwe.

english: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
ekegusii: Erio nkaba nkorengereria ng’a amatuko aane nigo arabe amange buna omokenye, erio ngokwa imbe ase egeswa kiane.

english: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge buna omote emeri yaye ekoranda yaika ase chindooche; chinsagia chiane chikagenderera gotoora riime ase obotuko bwonsi;

english: Oh that I were as in months past , as in the days when God preserved me;
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwane bware koba buna bwarenge ase amatuko a kare, amatuko aria Nyasae andendete!

english: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .
ekegusii: obonene bwane nigo bwarenge kona‐koba oboyia ase ’nde, na obota bwane bokona‐konyora chinguru chinyia ase amaboko aane.

english: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .
ekegusii: Ekero narenge korua ogosemia, abanto nigo barenge gontegerera, bakira‐kiri.

english: After my words they spake not again ; and my speech dropped upon them.
ekegusii: Ekero nakoorire gokwana, monto onde tarenge komenta ing’ana rinde, ekiagera amang’ana aane nigo arenge kobagwera buna amatoima ’embura.

english: And they waited for me as for the rain ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .
ekegusii: Nigo barenge koba baganyete buna embura ekoganywa; bakaba bagwasamia emenwa yabo buna embura y’okwamia endagera egwasamerwa.

english: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down .
ekegusii: Ekero konya berusirie moyo nigo narenge kobasekera; obwasioku bw’obosio bwane tibabosieereretie.

english: I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .
ekegusii: Inche nigo nachorete enchera bagwenerete kobwatia, naende nkabeera egati yabo buna omogambi; nigo namenyete ase bare buna omorwoti akomenya nabarwani baye b’esegi, naende buna omonto okoremia baria bakorera.

english: When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness ;
ekegusii: Engaki eria etaya yaye yarenge komorekera omotwe one, na ase oborabu bwaye nkaba ngotaara ase omosunte.

english: As I was in the days of my youth , when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle ;
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.

english: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
ekegusii: Engaki eria Omonguru nigo arenge amo nainche, na abana baane nigo bang’etanaine;

english: When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil ;
ekegusii: nigo narenge gwesibia amagoro aane namabeere, emezeituni ekamera ase egetare, nkanyora chindooche chi’amaguta ’amazeituni.

english: When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
ekegusii: Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,

english: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose , and stood up .
ekegusii: abasae abaare kondora nigo barenge kogobera, na abanto abagotu batenena konyorokia amasikani.

english: The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto nigo baare gokira tibagokwana, batuba emenwa yabo namaboko.

english: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD .
ekegusii: Naende ekaba ng’a rituko erimo, ekero abamura ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase barenge kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh . What ? shall we receive good at the hand of God , and shall we not receive evil ? In all this did not Job sin with his lips .
ekegusii: Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamoteebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu onde bwensi omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye. Abasani b’Ayubu bagocha

english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
ekegusii: Ayubu nabwate abasani batato: Elifasi korwa Temani, na Bilidadi korwa Sua, na Sofari korwa Naama. Ekero barabwo baigwete igoro y’emechando eria Ayubu anyorete, bagachikana ng’a kera oyomo arue bwoye, baumerane amo, bagende komwechandera na komoremia.

english: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not, they lifted up their voice , and wept ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .
ekegusii: Bagachia komoorora korwa aare, tibanyara komomanya gose nere. Bagachaaka goaka amariogi bakorera; bagatandora chianga chiabo, bagesiarera ebuse gochia igoro na ase emetwe yabo.

english: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagaikaransa inse agwo amo nere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, omobaso na obotuko; agwo onde tabeete ogokwana ing’ana rinde rionsi ase Ayubu, ekiagera baroche ng’a emechando yaye nigo yarenge emenene mono.

english: And the LORD said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause .
ekegusii: Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe. Nonya kwang’ebereretie komochanda ngencho ende etaiyo, ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa.”

english: And Satan answered the LORD , and said , Skin for skin , yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life .
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneri’Omonene, akamoteebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.

english: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will curse thee to thy face .
ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune amauga ’omobere oye, amo ne chinyama, omokore bobe, ekeene, ere nigo arakoragereria agwo ase obosio bwao.”

english: And the LORD said unto Satan , Behold, he is in thine hand ; but save his life .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Saitani ayio namaya, “Rora, Ayubu nigo are inse y’okobua kwao, korende omotige abe moyo.”

english: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase Omonene, akageenda, akarentera Ayubu amagumba, gochakera chimbaratero goikera ase omotwe igoro.

english: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes .
ekegusii: Ayubu akaba ogoikaransa ase ribu, akaimokia orogio, akana‐kweageria amaote aye.

english: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity ? curse God , and die .
ekegusii: Erio mokaye akamobooria, “Inee, nonya ngoika bono nigo ogendererete koba omwegenwa ase Omonene? Ragereria Nyasae, erio okwe!”

english: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .
ekegusii: Korende bono abanto bare abake ase ’nde, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.

english: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bangechete, bantamire; tibetangeti gontwera amate obosio bwane.

english: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
ekegusii: Nyasae ong’urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.

english: Upon my right hand rise the youth ; they push away my feet , and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction .
ekegusii: Ekeombe ki’abanto abasaria nigo bagontubokera korwa ensemo yane ya borio, erio baminyokia gonseria; nigo bagokora emeroberio emenge y’ogonsiria.

english: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .
ekegusii: Basaririe enchera yane ngoetera; abwo batabwate ogosemia konde abanyene, nigo bagokonya abande ase ogonsiria.

english: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .
ekegusii: Nigo bagoeta aase omogwa omogare banchichera ne chinguru, erio bang’umokera goetera ase omogwa oyio baabagoire.

english: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind : and my welfare passeth away as a cloud .
ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bwanchicheire; ogosikwa kwane gwasirigwe buna omwaga ogosiria, na obotenenku bwane bwasirire pi buna amare agosira.

english: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
ekegusii: Na bono omoyo one oberire ime yane; amatuko ’emechando ambwatereire bokong’u.

english: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .
ekegusii: Amauga omobere one nigo akonyatia botuko bokia, na obororo bokondia tibori gokenda.

english: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed : it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat .
ekegusii: Oborwaire bwane bwabeire ne chinguru bwaonchoire risankwa ri’omobere one, bono nigo ring’usererete buna rigoti ri’eanga yane.

english: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
ekegusii: Nyasae ontugutire ase etintira ime, nabeire buna orotu ne ribu.

english: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished ?
ekegusii: Abanto abwo chinguru chiabo chiaerire ase obogotu, ngokonywa ki ndanyore korwa ase amaboko abo?

english: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up , and thou regardest me not .
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera asore, korende aye tori kong’iraneria; nigo nteneine asore, korende aye nigo onsonchete rioka.

english: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire omotindi ase ’nde; nigo okondwania nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.

english: Thou liftest me up to the wind ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
ekegusii: Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konduchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.

english: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .
ekegusii: Ee, namanyire ng’a nong’ire aase abakuure, ase enyomba eria echikeire abare moyo bonsi.

english: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto karagwe takorambora okoboko kwaye, na ase emechando yaye arere akonywe?

english: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble ? was not my soul grieved for the poor ?
ekegusii: Inee! Tinarerete ase engencho y’abwo barenge ase emechando? Omoyo one tochandekerete abataka?

english: When I looked for good , then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light , there came darkness .
ekegusii: Korende ekero nasemeretie konyora amaya, amabe agacha, na ekero nabeete nsemeretie konyora oborabu, omosunte ogaacha.

english: My bowels boiled , and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nemechando mono, teri n’obotoereru, amatuko ’emechando anchicheire.

english: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
ekegusii: Nigo nkona‐koong’anya inde nemechando ntarochi omobaso; nigo ngotenena ase omosangererekano, narera ng’a nkonywe.

english: I am a brother to dragons , and a companion to owls .
ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyomwabo chisese chi’orosana, na omogisangio bwe chisagero.

english: For want and famine they were solitary ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.

english: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat .
ekegusii: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.

english: My harp also is turned to mourning , and my organ into the voice of them that weep .
ekegusii: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoirwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.

english: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .
ekegusii: Nigo bakona‐gosangereria ebimeri bie chinsana, na baremora emeri y’emete enga buna ebisanka.

english: They were driven forth from among men , (they cried after them as after a thief ;)
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa magega na kwogererwa buna abaibi.

english: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.

english: Among the bushes they brayed ; under the nettles they were gathered together .
ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amase akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.

english: They were children of fools , yea, children of base men : they were viler than the earth .
ekegusii: Barabwo nabana b’abaanto abariri na ab’abakayayu; nigo baseretigwe nemecharichi barue ase ense.

english: And now am I their song , yea, I am their byword .
ekegusii: Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa ase bare, ee, nabeire ase bare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.

english: I made a covenant with mine eyes ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
ekegusii: Inche nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namaiso aane ng’a tinkorigereria omoiseke omwekungi ase okomogania.

english: Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her.
ekegusii: rirorio tiga omokungu one abe ogoseera omonto omoao obosie, naende abasacha bande babe bakoba nere.

english: For this is an heinous crime ; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .
ekegusii: Okwo nigo kware koba ogosaria okobe mono goetania, na kware koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina bonsi.

english: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .
ekegusii: Boigo nigo kware koba omorero ogosamba gochia aase ay’ogosiria na koria ebinto biane bionsi kobikoora.

english: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me;
ekegusii: Inse kwanga koroisia amang’ana omosomba one, omosacha gose omokungu, ekero baremurunganie igoro yane,

english: What then shall I do when God riseth up ? and when he visiteth , what shall I answer him?
ekegusii: ninki ndakore ekero Nyasae aranyimokere? Ninki ndamoiranerie ekero arabe okorua egesusuro ki’ebibe biane?

english: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?
ekegusii: Inee! Oyio ontongete ase enda ya baba, tari ere otongete oyio boigo? Tari ere oyomo otobombete ase enda ime?

english: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail ;
ekegusii: Inche tinarinete omotaka egento aganetie, gose tinatigete omoboraka kwerusia moyo;

english: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
ekegusii: tinarenge koria endagera yane inche bweka, nigo naete nentakana nero, ekayeria.

english: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother’s womb ;)
ekegusii: Oyio inche nabeete ise korwa obosae bwaye, na korwa okoiborwa kwaye nkaba nkomorera na komoraa.

english: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering ;
ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nare ochandegete ase okoborwa chianga, gose omotaka otabwati ekiebisio, ntakonyete?

english: For what portion of God is there from above ? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high ?
ekegusii: Naki rende egetari kiane gekorwa ase Nyasae o igoro kerabe? Na omwando one okorwa ase Omobui ore igoro, naki orabe?

english: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep ;
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.

english: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
ekegusii: Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng’a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,

english: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade , and mine arm be broken from the bone .
ekegusii: rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi’amaboko aane chisomoke.

english: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
ekegusii: Nigo nare gocha kwoboigwa nemechando korwa ase Nyasae; na tinare konyara gotenena bosio bw’obonene bwaye.

english: If I have made gold my hope , or have said to the fine gold , Thou art my confidence ;
ekegusii: Tinasemeretie etaabu, nonya netaabu echenire;

english: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much ;
ekegusii: tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.

english: If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness ;
ekegusii: Tinarigereretie erioba ekero riabarete, gose omotienyi ekero omesete,

english: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :
ekegusii: goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasiima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.

english: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge : for I should have denied the God that is above .
ekegusii: Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.

english: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
ekegusii: Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw’omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?

english: Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?
ekegusii: Inee! Emechando teri konyora abatari abanyaboronge, na ogosirigwa gwachera abagokora ebibe?

english: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
ekegusii: Yaya, tinatigete omonwa one okore ebibe ase okomoragereria na komoganeria amakweri.

english: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh ! we cannot be satisfied .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete aa bwone babeire birori ng’a kera omonto obeire oisanegete nendagera nkomoa.

english: The stranger did not lodge in the street : but I opened my doors to the traveller .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.

english: If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :
ekegusii: Tinatubete ogosaria kwane buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere, gose ebibe biane ase egekuba kiane ime.

english: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?
ekegusii: Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abaanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.

english: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book .
ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye nanyora omonto okonyigwa. Inche nakoorire amang’ana aane! Oria Omonguru nang’iranerie! Ninganetie ndore amang’ana omobisa one andikerete ase okonyomania.

english: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me.
ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo nare koyabogoria igoro ase amareko aane; nanga nigo nayesiberania abe buna egutwa ase ’nde.

english: I would declare unto him the number of my steps ; as a prince would I go near unto him.
ekegusii: Nanga namoteebia igoro y’orogendo rwane rwonsi; nigo nare komochiera inde buna omogambi.

english: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain ;
ekegusii: “Inee! Oboremo bwane bwanakondeera? Gose emeng’ororia ye chintinde yana‐korererana?

english: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :
ekegusii: Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,

english: Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae tarochi chinchera chiane chionsi na kobara amatambokero aane onsi?

english: Let thistles grow instead of wheat , and cockle instead of barley . The words of Job are ended .
ekegusii: rirorio tiga amagwa amereo ribaga ri’engano, na amabanchore ribaga ri’esairi.” Amang’ana ’Ayubu aereire aa.

english: If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit ;
ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi’obong’ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay’oborimo?

english: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .
ekegusii: Tiga ndengwe ase ekerengo ekeronge, na Nyasae amanye oboikeranu bwane.

english: If my step hath turned out of the way , and mine heart walked after mine eyes , and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands ;
ekegusii: Onye nagobeire korwa ase enchera, na enkoro yane yabeire ekobwatia okogania kw’amaiso aane, na onye komocha konde kwabwatereire amaboko aane,

english: Then let me sow , and let another eat ; yea, let my offspring be rooted out .
ekegusii: rirorio inche nsimeke endagera, na omonto omoao ayeire, na kende gionsi kiane keramere gesimorwe.

english: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door ;
ekegusii: Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,

english: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .
ekegusii: Bono ekiagera Ayubu arenge omonyaboronge ase amaiso aye ere omonyene, abanto baria batato bagatiga komoiraneria.

english: Therefore I said , Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion .
ekegusii: Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.

english: Behold, I waited for your words ; I gave ear to your reasons , whilst ye searched out what to say .
ekegusii: Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.

english: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :
ekegusii: Ee, nigo nabategererete mono, korende onde tarenge ase more obuete Ayubu, gose onde tanyarete koiraneria amang’ana aye.

english: Lest ye should say , We have found out wisdom : God thrusteth him down , not man .
ekegusii: Inwe erende mono, timobaisa goteeba: Intwe twanyorire obong’aini. Nyasae nere orabue Ayubu na amoiyerie, tari Mwanyabaanto.

english: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches .
ekegusii: Ayubu takwanete nainche amang’ana ande ay’okweegerera, na inche tinkomoiraneria buna inwe.

english: They were amazed , they answered no more: they left off speaking .
ekegusii: Bono batang’ang’ire, tibakonyara kong’iraneria nonya ng’ake; tibabwati ring’ana bagokwana.

english: When I had waited , (for they spake not, but stood still , and answered no more;)
ekegusii: Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?

english: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .
ekegusii: Inche ngokwana inde ayane, erinde ng’orokie ayare ase ebirengererio biane.

english: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me.
ekegusii: Inche nimbwate amang’ana amange nganetie gokwana, ekiagera omoika ore ime yane onsukirie.

english: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent ; it is ready to burst like new bottles .
ekegusii: Rora, enda yane nigo enga buna edivai ekunekire mono, buna ebirandi biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa amayia bire ang’e kworeka.

english: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .
ekegusii: Erio Elihu akaba nendamwamu ase Ayubu, ekiagera ekorete omonyakeene kobua Nyasae. Elihu oyio nigo arenge mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, na oyo bw’eamate ya Ramu.

english: I will speak , that I may be refreshed : I will open my lips and answer .
ekegusii: Goika nkwane, erio nario ndanyore obotoereru; goika imaanore omonwa nkwane, ing’iranerie.

english: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person , neither let me give flattering titles unto man .
ekegusii: Inche tinkonyara gwanchereria monto onde bwensi, gose gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.’

english: For I know not to give flattering titles ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .
ekegusii: Inche timanyeti gokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, inse gokora bo, Omotongi one nigo aransirie bwango.

english: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .
ekegusii: Boigo akaba nendamwamu ase abasani baria batato b’Ayubu, ekiagera batanyorete amang’ana bakoiraneria, nonya bateebeete ng’a Ayubu nomomochi.

english: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken , because they were elder than he.
ekegusii: Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.

english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men , then his wrath was kindled .
ekegusii: Na ekero aroche ng’a baria batato tibabwate ing’ana baare koiraneria, akaba nendamwamu. Elihu

english: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said , I am young , and ye are very old ; wherefore I was afraid , and durst not shew you mine opinion .
ekegusii: Elihu mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, agateeba: Inche nigo inde omoke ase emiaka, korende inwe nabakoro more; ayio naro agerete nkaba nobwoba, ngakira‐kiri, na tinakwana ay’ebirengererio biane ase more.

english: I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .
ekegusii: Korende ngateeba: Tiga abanto b’amatuko amange bakwane, abanyamiaka menge borokererie obong’aini.

english: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .
ekegusii: Korende omoika nore ime ase Mwanyabaanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.

english: Great men are not always wise : neither do the aged understand judgment .
ekegusii: Bono tari ng’a nabaanto b’emiaka emenge bare abang’aini, gose tari ng’a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.

english: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee, hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, bono inyigwe, ntegerera ase onsi aya ngokwana.

english: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy ,
ekegusii: Naama! Nyasae onyorire amasoero ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.

english: Behold, in this thou art not just : I will answer thee, that God is greater than man .
ekegusii: “Naama! Nigo ngokoiraneria ng’a ase amang’ana aya tokwaneti ekeene; Nyasae nigo are omonene goetania Mwanyabaanto.

english: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters .
ekegusii: Nase ki okoamererania nere kogoteeba ng’a ere takoiraneria amang’ana aya nonya nerimo?

english: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo agokwana ase enchera eyemo, gose ibere; nonya nabo monto onde tari okomotegerera.

english: Then he openeth the ears of men , and sealeth their instruction ,
ekegusii: Erio agwo otinora amato abanto, na obarentera ogokuurera gw’okoondokia

english: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .
ekegusii: ng’a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw’omonto.

english: He keepeth back his soul from the pit , and his life from perishing by the sword .
ekegusii: Nigo agotanga omonto tagenda ase oboina, naende orenda obogima bwaye tibosirigwa n’omoro.

english: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
ekegusii: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi’okomoorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.

english: Behold, now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .
ekegusii: Rora, bono namumoire omonwa one, na oromeme rwane rwachakire gokwana.

english: So that his life abhorreth bread , and his soul dainty meat .
ekegusii: Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.

english: His flesh is consumed away , that it cannot be seen ; and his bones that were not seen stick out .
ekegusii: Chinyama chi’omobere oye nigo chikoera, tichikororekana, na amauga aye atongonona.

english: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo agosuka gochia ang’e noboina, na obogima bwaye gochia ase abagosiria obogima.
