english: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter , one among a thousand , to shew unto man his uprightness :
ekegusii: “Onye omomalaika nkoba arenge asare, oyomo bwa baria chilifu bagokora okobwatania asare, erinde amworokie ayare ay’oboronge,

english: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith , Deliver him from going down to the pit : I have found a ransom .
ekegusii: erio amororere amaabera, ateebe: Tooria omonto oyo tabaisa gotirimboka gochia ase oboina, ekiagera inche namonyoreire embooria.

english: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
ekegusii: Omobere oye oiranigwe obe buna oyo bw’obosae bwaye, naende aonchorwe abe buna ekero arenge ne chinguru.

english: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .
ekegusii: Ekero arabe ogosaba Nyasae, nere namororere amaabera; omonto oyio nachiche ase obosio bwaye ore nomogooko, na Nyasae nairanie oboronge bw’omonto oyio.

english: He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not;
ekegusii: Omonto oyio natere ase amasio ’abaanto, ateebe: Nigo nakorete ebibe, nkaonchorana aya arenge amaronge, gose tinanyorete egesusuro buna nagwenerete.

english: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .
ekegusii: Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.

english: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man ,
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,

english: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart : and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aane nigo akoorokia oboronge bore ime ase enkoro yane, na ase omonwa one nigo ngokwana aya imanyete.

english: To bring back his soul from the pit , to be enlightened with the light of the living .
ekegusii: erinde amoiranie korwa ase oboina, ng’a oyio anyare komorekerwa noborabu bw’obogima.

english: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me: hold thy peace , and I will speak .
ekegusii: “Aye Ayubu, ntegerera, okire‐kiri, inche nkwane.

english: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me: speak , for I desire to justify thee.
ekegusii: Onye kobwate ing’ana rinde okong’iraneria, kwana, ekiagera nigo nganetie gokoa oboronge bwao.

english: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .
ekegusii: Onye tobwati kende, kira‐kiri ontegerere, na inche ninkworokererie obong’aini.”

english: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .
ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae noro ontongete, na omoika bw’obomoyo bw’Omonguru noro okong’a obogima.

english: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up .
ekegusii: Bono ing’iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang’ana ao ang’e, otenene bokong’u!

english: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay .
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.

english: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
ekegusii: Rora, inche tindi kende ogwenerete konyoboa; gose tindi gochia koba buna egurube endito asore.

english: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,
ekegusii: “Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang’ana ao.

english: I am clean without transgression , I am innocent ; neither is there iniquity in me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.

english: Furthermore Elihu answered and said ,
ekegusii: Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

english: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng’a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?

english: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tagokora ayare amabe; ee, ere Omonguru tari gosaria ayare ay’ekeene.

english: Who hath given him a charge over the earth ? or who hath disposed the whole world ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oete Nyasae okobua gw’okogambera ense? Ning’o obeegete ense yonsi koba eyaye?

english: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath ;
ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,

english: All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bonsi pi goika bakwe, bairane ase amaroba.

english: If now thou hast understanding , hear this: hearken to the voice of my words .
ekegusii: “Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteeba:

english: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekiina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?

english: Is it fit to say to a king , Thou art wicked ? and to princes , Ye are ungodly ?
ekegusii: Nonyare goteebia omorwoti: Aye nigo ore omonto bosa, gose noteebie abanene basikire: Inwe nabakori amabe?

english: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .
ekegusii: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagaambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.

english: Hear my words , O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge .
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!

english: In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokwa ara rimo; nigo bakonyegerigwa botuko gati, basira kegima, baria bare nokobua nigo bagosirigwa ko tari namaboko a Mwanyabaanto.

english: For his eyes are upon the ways of man , and he seeth all his goings .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie chinchera chi’omonto; ere nigo aroche amatambokero aye onsi.

english: There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
ekegusii: Aase aamwamu tari, gose omosunte ekerima, ase omokori amabe aranyare kwebisa.

english: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God .
ekegusii: Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeeke omonto ase ekiina.

english: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeeke abande aase abo.

english: Therefore he knoweth their works , and he overturneth them in the night , so that they are destroyed .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ere namanyete emeremo yabo, nigo akobaonchorana botuko baitwa kegima.

english: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaita maiso marore, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo,

english: Because they turned back from him , and would not consider any of his ways :
ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.

english: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .
ekegusii: Abwo bagerire ekerero ki’abataka giaikire asare, nere oigure ekerero ki’abagokorerwa bobe.

english: When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :
ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae karakire‐kiri ning’o oramonachere ekiina? Karabise obosio bwaye, ning’o oranyare komorigereria, gokerabe egesaku gete gose omonto gete,

english: For the ear trieth words , as the mouth tasteth meat .
ekegusii: Amang’ana amato akoigwa, nigo akoyateema, buna oromeme rokomena endagera.

english: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared .
ekegusii: ekero ararusie okogamba korwa ase abatamoirogeti na abatange tibaaba emeribo ase abanto?

english: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more:
ekegusii: “Inee! Monto onde nare oteebirie Nyasae: Inche naremereirie egesusuro gi’okondongeyia, nonya tinkorereti monto onde bobe.

english: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity , I will do no more.
ekegusii: Bono inyorokererie aya ntamanyeti, na onye nakorire ebibe, tingwancha kobikora naende.

english: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse , or whether thou choose ; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest .
ekegusii: Nigo okagete ng’a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.

english: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
ekegusii: “Abanto abare nokomanya, na kera omonto omong’aini orabe okonyigwa, nigo baranteebie:

english: Job hath spoken without knowledge , and his words were without wisdom .
ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agokwana atari na semi; na amang’ana aye tari ay’obong’aini.

english: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men .
ekegusii: Nigo yagwenerete Ayubu ateemwe goika omoerio, ekiagera nigo akoiraneria buna abakori amabe bakoiraneria.

english: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin , he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomenta ogosaria ase ebibe biaye, naende nigo agotoakera chinkobi ase ogotochaya na gokwana amang’ana amange are mamincha ya Nyasae.”

english: Let us choose to us judgment : let us know among ourselves what is good .
ekegusii: Tochore ayare amaronge; intwe amo toteeme komanya ayare amaronge.

english: For Job hath said , I am righteous : and God hath taken away my judgment .
ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agoteeba: Inche nomonyene oboronge, korende Nyasae ong’urire oboronge bwane.

english: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .
ekegusii: Nonya inde omonyene oboronge, nabarirwe ng’a nomonyaborimo inde; amaote aane takonyara kogwena, nonya gosaria konde tikori ime ase ’nde.

english: What man is like Job , who drinketh up scorning like water ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Monto ki onga buna Ayubu, oyio okonywa ogochaywa, ogokomera buna amaache?

english: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .
ekegusii: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.

english: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .
ekegusii: Naende ere oteebire ng’a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.

english: Elihu spake moreover, and said ,
ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

english: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night ;
ekegusii: Korende monto onde tari okobooria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?

english: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth , and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven ?
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotworokereria kobua ching’iti chi’ense, na otokora twaba nobong’aini kobua chinyoni.

english: There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera, korende Nyasae tari koiraneria, ase engencho y’ogokora okobe kw’oboenenu kwa’ banyabibe.

english: Surely God will not hear vanity , neither will the Almighty regard it.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tari koigwa okorera gotari ogw’ekeene, gose ere Omonguru takogwechandera.

english: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
ekegusii: “Nonya kogoteeba ng’a tori komoorora, ere tagokoigwa; ekiina kiao nigo kere ase obosio bwaye, bono nigo omoganyete nogosemeria.

english: But now, because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
ekegusii: Korende bono nigo okorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari korua egesusuro ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye, naende ng’a ere tari gwechandera ogosaria.

english: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera aye Ayubu ogokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, nigo okomenta gokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini.”

english: Thinkest thou this to be right , that thou saidst , My righteousness is more than God’s ?
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, nigo okorengereria ng’a ayio nekeene? Gose nigo ogoteeba ng’a nomonyaboronge ore ase obosio bwa Nyasae?

english: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee? and , What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin ?
ekegusii: Naende nigo okoboria ng’a mbuya ki oboronge bokogokorera kobua ogokora ebibe?

english: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
ekegusii: Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.

english: Look unto the heavens , and see ; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
ekegusii: Rigereria gochia igoro, orore; rora amare buna are igoro mono kogoetania.

english: If thou be righteous , what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand ?
ekegusii: Onye kore omonyene oboronge, ngento ki okoa Nyasae, gose ninki akonyora korwa ase okoboko kwao?

english: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .
ekegusii: Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.

english: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ogokorerwa bobe kwabuchire, abanto nigo bakorera mono ng’a bakonywe; nigo bakorangeria bakonywe korwa ase amaboko ay’abare nokobua.

english: Elihu also proceeded , and said ,
ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora,

english: He openeth also their ear to discipline , and commandeth that they return from iniquity .
ekegusii: Nigo agotinora amato abo baigwa ogokuurerwa, na obachika baonchoke, batige gokora amabe.

english: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .
ekegusii: Kobaraigwere na komokorera, rirorio mbabe bagoseseneka ase amatuko abo onsi, naende babe bakwegokia ase obogima bwabo.

english: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword , and they shall die without knowledge .
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakoigwera, nigo baraitwe nemioro, erio bakwe batamanyeti kende.

english: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath : they cry not when he bindeth them.
ekegusii: Abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo bagachete endamwamu ime ase chinkoro chiabo; barabwo tibari korera barigie bakonywe, ekero Nyasae akobaa egesusuro.

english: They die in youth , and their life is among the unclean .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagokwa ekero bare abake, obogima bwabo nigo bogosirigwa buna obw’abanyaka.

english: He delivereth the poor in his affliction , and openeth their ears in oppression .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka goetera ase emechando yabo, otinora amato abo goetera ase ogokorerwa bobe kwabo.

english: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
ekegusii: Ee, nigo akoebereretie, agakorusia korwa ase chimbanderana, agakorenta aase aagare, ase komigwa gotaiyo; boigo chindagera kwabeekeretwe emesa nigo chiarenge chinoru.

english: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .
ekegusii: Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekiina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekiina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.

english: Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.

english: Will he esteem thy riches ? no , not gold , nor all the forces of strength .
ekegusii: Inee! Obotenenku bwao mbonyare kogotanga korwa ase emechando? Gose okobua kwao ne chinguru chiao mbinyare?

english: Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
ekegusii: Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana ribaga ria Nyasae.

english: Desire not the night , when people are cut off in their place.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogania ng’a obotuko boria boche, obwo abanto baraitwe basirigwe.

english: Take heed , regard not iniquity : for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction .
ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa koirana gokora amabe, ekiagera nigo gwanchire gokora ayio kobua konyora emechando.

english: Behold, God exalteth by his power : who teacheth like him?
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning’o okworokereria buna ere?

english: Who hath enjoined him his way ? or who can say , Thou hast wrought iniquity ?
ekegusii: Ning’o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning’o oranyare komoteebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?

english: Remember that thou magnify his work , which men behold .
ekegusii: Inyora gotogia emeremo yaye, eyio abanto babeire bagoteera na koyetogia.

english: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, Mwanyabaanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.

english: Behold, God is great , and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out .
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are omonene mono, na intwe titomomanyeti; omobaro bw’emiaka yaye temanyekaneti.

english: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
ekegusii: Ere nigo akong’usa chintonyi chi’amaache gochia igoro, na chirochio chiatwa buna embura chiaba riime.

english: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly .
ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo egotwa gocha ase ense, yatwera Mwanyabaanto ase obonge.

english: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds , or the noise of his tabernacle ?
ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?

english: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
ekegusii: Inche nindusie chisemi chiane korwa aare, ing’orokie ng’a Omotongi one nere omonyene oboronge.

english: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea .
ekegusii: Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.

english: For by them judgeth he the people ; he giveth meat in abundance .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo akonachera abanto ekiina; naende nigo akobaa chindagera ase obonge.

english: With clouds he covereth the light ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .
ekegusii: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.

english: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour .
ekegusii: Ekerundo gi’okomesa nigo gekoraria igoro ya Nyasae, nonya ne ching’iti nigo chikomanya ng’a ekerundo ngocha kere.

english: For truly my words shall not be false : he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aane tari ay’oborimo; inche oyo nteneine aiga amo naye nomoikeranu inde ase okomanya.

english: Behold, God is mighty , and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom .
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong’aini.

english: He preserveth not the life of the wicked : but giveth right to the poor .
ekegusii: Ere tagotiga omokori amabe agenderere koba moyo, korende nigo akoa abachandire oboronge bwabo.

english: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous : but with kings are they on the throne ; yea, he doth establish them for ever , and they are exalted .
ekegusii: Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeeka amo nabarwoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,

english: And if they be bound in fetters , and be holden in cords of affliction ;
ekegusii: na onye bagosibwa chingataare na baba bare ase emechando, gose kobwatwa ase emeeto y’emechando,

english: Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaorokeria ayabakorire, na ogosaria kwabo, boigo obaorokeria buna bakororekana abaenenu.

english: At this also my heart trembleth , and is moved out of his place .
ekegusii: “Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.

english: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akorua omoika bw’obokeng’entu obwatania amaache, na amaache oyarenta abwatana oma pa.

english: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
ekegusii: Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namaache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.

english: And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
ekegusii: Amare nigo agoetanana gochia aaria na aaria, akoraagwa nere, goikerania aya onsi ere achiikire akore ase ense.

english: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora ayio aba bo, ase okorua ebisusuro bi’okorongeyia, gose ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye.

english: Hearken unto this, O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, igwa aya; karategerera, orengererie igoro y’emeremo y’ogokumia ya Nyasae.

english: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna Nyasae agokora ochika ayio, naende buna agokora okomesa kwamoreka goetera ase amare,

english: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna areng’anetie amare, eyio ere emeremo y’ogokumia y’oria ore nobong’aini oboikeranu?

english: How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa Irianyi?

english: Hast thou with him spread out the sky , which is strong , and as a molten looking glass ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare korambora igoro buna ere ayeramborete, igoro eria ere enkong’u buna ekerore gi’ekioma?

english: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .
ekegusii: Tworokererie aya togochia gokwana asare; titokonyara konyora amang’ana togochia gokwana, ekiagera tore ase omosunte.

english: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe okogukura kw’eriogi riaye, na okoruma gokorwa ase omonwa oye.

english: Shall it be told him that I speak ? if a man speak , surely he shall be swallowed up .
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nigo agochia goteebigwa ng’a inche ninganetie gokwana? Onde nare oganetie ere amosirie?

english: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them.
ekegusii: “Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase ’erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abisirwe nomwaga.

english: Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
ekegusii: Oborabu bokomeka‐meka nigo bokorwa sugusu; ee, Nyasae nigo eboetie nobonene bw’ogosikwa gw’okoondokia.

english: Touching the Almighty , we cannot find him out : he is excellent in power , and in judgment , and in plenty of justice : he will not afflict .
ekegusii: Oyio Omobui, intwe titokonyara komoorora buna are; nigo abwate okobua okonene, naende nigo are omonyene ekeene, ere nigo are omonyene oboronge mono, takorega onde.

english: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Mwanyabaanto nigo bamoirogete; ere tari gosika oyokwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are.”

english: He directeth it under the whole heaven , and his lightning unto the ends of the earth .
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi’ense.

english: After it a voice roareth : he thundereth with the voice of his excellency ; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard .
ekegusii: Erio eriogi riaye rikoruma, ere nigo akogukura neriogi ri’obonene, gose tari gotanga okomesa ekero eriogi riaye ri’okogukura riaigurwe.

english: God thundereth marvellously with his voice ; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.

english: For he saith to the snow , Be thou on the earth ; likewise to the small rain , and to the great rain of his strength .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agoteebia amagena ’embura: Kagwe igoro ase ense; na otoma omonyirira na embura enene ere ne chinguru.

english: He sealeth up the hand of every man ; that all men may know his work .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotanga emeremo y’amaboko a kera omonto, erinde abanto bonsi banyare komanya emeremo yaye.

english: Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .
ekegusii: Erio ching’iti chi’orosana chiagenda kwebisa, chiagenderera kobeera ase amakuruma abo.

english: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind : and cold out of the north .
ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo Irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.

english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamoteebia:

english: And brake up for it my decreed place , and set bars and doors ,
ekegusii: naende nkabeekera enyancha chimbebe chiaye, boigo nkayebekera emekorogoto na ebisieri,

english: And said , Hitherto shalt thou come , but no further : and here shall thy proud waves be stayed ?
ekegusii: ngateba: Aa nao oraikere, korende togoetania, naiga nao emerindo yao eimokererete igoro eratangerwe.

english: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days ; and caused the dayspring to know his place ;
ekegusii: Inee! Ase obogima bwao bwonsi kwana gochika emambia ebeo? Kwana kworokia amasase a mambia aase akomoreka,

english: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth , that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
ekegusii: erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?

english: It is turned as clay to the seal ; and they stand as a garment .
ekegusii: Ense nigo ekoonchorwa yarorekana buna amaroba abeire inse y’ebonyi + 38:14 Ebonyi: engencho yaye n’ekemanyererio ere nekemanyererio, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikororekana buna chianga chire n’ebieni ao ao.

english: And from the wicked their light is withholden , and the high arm shall be broken .
ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bogotangwa korwa ase abakori amabe, ne chinguru chiabo chi’okweenenia nigo chikobunwa chiasirigwa.

english: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?

english: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?
ekegusii: Kwana kworokigwa ebiita bi’amakweri, gose korora ebisieri bi’ekiriri ki’amakweri?

english: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all.
ekegusii: Kwana korengereria igoro y’obogare bw’ense? Onye komanyete ayio onsi, yararie!

english: Where is the way where light dwelleth ? and as for darkness , where is the place thereof,
ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda ase oborabu bore, ng’ai ere? Nomanyete ase omosunte omenyete,

english: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge ?
ekegusii: Aye naye ng’o okorenta omosunte ase ogosemia ase ogokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini?

english: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
ekegusii: erinde ogende oyoire ase ribebe riaye? Naende nomanyete ebinchera bigochia ase enyomba yaye?

english: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?
ekegusii: Ee, aye nomanyete, ekiagera nigo kwaiboretwe kare, na emiaka yao nemenge.

english: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow ? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail ,
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase ebigachero bi’obokeng’entu, gose ebigachero bi’amagena ’embura?

english: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble , against the day of battle and war ?
ekegusii: Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.

english: By what way is the light parted , which scattereth the east wind upon the earth ?
ekegusii: Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?

english: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder ;
ekegusii: Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,

english: To cause it to rain on the earth , where no man is; on the wilderness , wherein there is no man ;
ekegusii: echio chikogera embura yatwa aase monto atamenyeti, ase erooro monto ataiyo?

english: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?
ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.

english: Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?
ekegusii: Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning’o okoibora amatoima e riime?

english: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it?
ekegusii: Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?

english: Gird up now thy loins like a man ; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
ekegusii: Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ninkoborie, naye ong’iranerie.

english: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .
ekegusii: Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.

english: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?
ekegusii: Nonyare koraa ching’enang’eni chioroke ase chingaki chiabo? Gose nonyare koraa egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu ne chimanwa chiaye?

english: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
ekegusii: Nomanyete emeroberio ya igoro echiikire? Nonyare koroberia okogamba kwabo igoro ase ense?

english: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee?
ekegusii: Nonyare goaka eriogi riao riike ase amare ogere embura enyinge egotwere?

english: Canst thou send lightnings , that they may go , and say unto thee, Here we are ?
ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigoteebie: Ee, nao tore aa?

english: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
ekegusii: Ning’o okobeeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?

english: Who can number the clouds in wisdom ? or who can stay the bottles of heaven ,
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koba nobong’aini abare amare? Gose ning’o oranyare koberereka chinyongo chi’amaache chia igoro,

english: When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
ekegusii: ekero riroba riabwatanire riomire pa, na amagakara abwatanire amo.

english: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,

english: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth ? declare , if thou hast understanding .
ekegusii: Ng’ai kwarenge ekero nabegete oboroso bw’ense? Ntebie onye aye kore omong’aini.

english: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?
ekegusii: ekero chire ase amakuruma abo chieringanetie ase okoboera, gose gochiramaime agwo ase chiebisete?

english: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
ekegusii: Ning’o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?

english: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
ekegusii: Ning’o obegete ebirengo biaye? Ntebie onye komanyete. Gose ning’o oramborete engori y’okoyerenga?

english: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
ekegusii: Ng’ai amaroso aye aterekereretwe? Gose ning’o obegete rigena riaye ri’ekoona,

english: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
ekegusii: ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogooko?

english: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
ekegusii: Ekero keria naroisetie amare abe chianga chiaye, na nkayeboyia omosunte ekerima,

english: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi’orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?

english: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow ? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare koyesiba ne chingori eete ase emeng’ororia ye chintinde? Gose ebutorane chintinde ase rikura riao?

english: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
ekegusii: Inee! Noyesemerie ekiagera ere ne chinguru chinyinge? Nonyare gotiga emeremo yao, ng’a ero ekoyekorere?

english: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed , and gather it into thy barn ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo oyiegenete ng’a neirane na ekorentere endagera ase ekeoreri kiao?

english: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
ekegusii: “Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?

english: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth , and warmeth them in dust ,
ekegusii: Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.

english: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
ekegusii: Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.

english: She is hardened against her young ones , as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear ;
ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

english: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong’aini, gose tayeete okomanya.

english: What time she lifteth up herself on high , she scorneth the horse and his rider .
ekegusii: Ekero ekoimokerera igoro, egwesamunsa eminyoke, nigo egosekerera ebarasi na oyo oyerinete.

english: Hast thou given the horse strength ? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Naye okoa ebarasi chinguru? Naye oboetie ebigoti biaye namanya?

english: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil ? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth ?
ekegusii: Nonyare komanya omobaro bw’emetienyi chigokoora, naende nomanyete chingaki chikobiara?

english: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .
ekegusii: Naye oyeete chinguru egocharokera buna engige? Eriogi egochuria nigo rire ri’okoirokia.

english: He paweth in the valley , and rejoiceth in his strength : he goeth on to meet the armed men .
ekegusii: Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi’esegi.

english: He mocketh at fear , and is not affrighted ; neither turneth he back from the sword .
ekegusii: Ero nigo egosekerera obwoba, teri koondokigwa na kende; gose teri koonchoka etame korwa ase emioro.

english: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield .
ekegusii: Chinsara nigo chikorutwa chiaba chikwoga goeta igoro yaye, na amatimo akomesa, ne chisimisi boigo.

english: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage : neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet .
ekegusii: Nigo egotitiria riroba ere nobotindi na ekeririanda, gose teri gotegerera ekire, ekero egetureri gekobugigwa.

english: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .
ekegusii: Ekero egetureeri gekobugigwa, nigo ekwana eriogi riaye ri’okoega‐ega. Nigo ekoigwa omonyonko bw’esegi korwa aare, na buna abachiki b’esegi bagochika, na okwoga gw’esegi.

english: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nobong’aini bwao bokogera ekebaki kiairuruka igoro, naende kiarambora chimbaaba chiaye koiruruka gochia Irianyi?

english: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?
ekegusii: Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?

english: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock , upon the crag of the rock , and the strong place .
ekegusii: Ekeongo nigo gekomenya ase egetare; ase omwenya bw’egetare, aase gekonyora oborendi obuya.

english: From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .
ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro nigo kegotengera ebi kegotwara, amaiso aye nigo akobirora korwa aare.

english: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones , they cast out their sorrows .
ekegusii: Nigo chigwekumba chiabiara chimanwa chiabo, na ekero chiabiarire, obororo bw’okobina bwasira.

english: Their young ones are in good liking , they grow up with corn ; they go forth , and return not unto them.
ekegusii: Chimanwa chiabo nigo chikoba ne chinguru chiakinera ase orosana. Nigo chikogenda kegima, tichiri koirana.

english: Who hath sent out the wild ass free ? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass ?
ekegusii: “Ning’o otigire etigere y’orosana esiboire? Gose ning’o bwororobirie ebisibo bi’etigere ere enyango?

english: Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .
ekegusii: Inche nayeeire ekerubo ekiomo kebe enka yaye, na ense ere nomonyo, emenyeo.

english: He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .
ekegusii: Ero nigo egochaaya eriogi rire ase omochie, teri koigwa okwoga kw’omotemi onde bwensi.

english: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
ekegusii: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.

english: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Eng’era nayanche egokorere emeremo? Nenyare korara ase obweri bwao botuko?

english: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb , nor hid sorrow from mine eyes .
ekegusii: ekiagera borobwo tibwatangete baba tanyibora, gose tibwatangete emechando korwa ase amaiso aane.

english: Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?
ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete tinakwera inda ya baba? Ninki kiagerete tinakwa ekero keria nasogete korwao?

english: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck ?
ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete baba akaang’agata? Ninki kiagerete akangonkia amabeere aye?

english: For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,
ekegusii: Onye nakwete, anga nindaire ntoererete, anga nindaire chitoro ntimogete,

english: With kings and counsellors of the earth , which built desolate places for themselves;
ekegusii: buna abarwoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.

english: Or with princes that had gold , who filled their houses with silver :
ekegusii: Inche anga nigo inde buna abanene batenengete ne chitaabu, baichoretie chinyomba chiabo ne chifeta.

english: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light .
ekegusii: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.

english: There the wicked cease from troubling ; and there the weary be at rest .
ekegusii: Aroro agwo abakori amabe tibari gochanda abande, boigo abarosire kobaikire aroro, nigo bagotimoka.

english: There the prisoners rest together ; they hear not the voice of the oppressor .
ekegusii: Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi y’abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.

english: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master .
ekegusii: Abanto batasikiri na abasikire nigo bareng’anetie aroro; omosomba nigo are omosibore korwa ase oyorenge omonene oye.

english: And Job spake , and said ,
ekegusii: Ayubu agateeba,

english: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery , and life unto the bitter in soul ;
ekegusii: “Nase ki oyochandegete akoegwa korora omobaso? Nase ki oria obwate obororo ase enkoro akoegwa obogima?

english: Which rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogoka mono na gochenga, ee, nabo bakogoka kobabeire ang’e kogenda ase chimbeera na gotubererwa.

english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?
ekegusii: Nase ki omobaso oorokire ase omonto chinchera chiaye chibisire, oyio Nyasae agiteire chinsemo chionsi?

english: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .
ekegusii: Obororo bw’emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amaache.

english: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria inyoboete rianchicheire, na riria rikoondokia rianyorire.

english: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet ; yet trouble came .
ekegusii: Inche timbwati omorembe gose botoereru bonde; timbwati ogotimoka, korende emechando nigo egendererete konagocha.”

english: Let the day perish wherein I was born , and the night in which it was said , There is a man child conceived .
ekegusii: Rituko riria naiboretwe, tiga risire riebwe kegima, boigo obotuko boria amang’ana aya akwanetwe: Omwana omoisia otongirwe enda ime.

english: Let that day be darkness ; let not God regard it from above , neither let the light shine upon it.
ekegusii: Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.

english: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
ekegusii: Tiga omosunte na ekiriri ekemwamu biritube. Tiga amare aritube, na kende gionsi egekorenta obomwamu ase rituko kerioboyie.

english: As for that night , let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year , let it not come into the number of the months .
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’emetienyi.

english: Lo, let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein.
ekegusii: Ee, obotuko boria tiga bogombae; eriogi ri’omogooko tiribaisa koigugwa ase borobwo.

english: Let them curse it that curse the day , who are ready to raise up their mourning .
ekegusii: Boragererigwe nabwo bamanyete koragereria amatuko, abwo baganyete korenta Leviatani eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia.

english: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark ; let it look for light , but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day :
ekegusii: Ching’enang’eni chiaye chia ituko ria mambia chibe omosunte; obotuko tiga bochie koganya ng’a bokie, korende tibokia rinde, gose tibobaisa korora ogokiamoka kwa mambia,

english: Moreover the LORD answered Job , and said ,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera gokwana, agateebia Ayubu,

english: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .
ekegusii: Aye echabere nobonene na obwari, eboyie ogosikwa na okobua.

english: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath : and behold every one that is proud , and abase him.
ekegusii: Siara ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.

english: Look on every one that is proud , and bring him low ; and tread down the wicked in their place.
ekegusii: Ee, rigereria oyio ore omoenenu, omokeyie, na abakori amabe obatindachere inse agwo ase bateneine.

english: Hide them in the dust together ; and bind their faces in secret .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong’u amasio abo ime y’ense inse.

english: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
ekegusii: Igo inche ninyancherane naye, ng’a okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokoe okobua.

english: Behold now behemoth , which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox .
ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.

english: Lo now, his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
ekegusii: Rora, chinguru chiaye nigo chire ase ekeneema + 40:16 Ekeneema: engencho yaye ase omonto akueboeria orokini kiaye, na okobua kwaye nigo kore ase chinyama chi’enda yaye.

english: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye nigo kere egekong’u pa buna omocharake, na emekia y’amariagati aye nigo esisekaine amo.

english: His bones are as strong pieces of brass ; his bones are like bars of iron .
ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.

english: He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .
ekegusii: “Ero negetongwa ki’ogokumia inche Nyasae natongete; inche nayetongete, nayeete amaino anga buna emioro.

english: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it.
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n’Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende.” Ayubu

english: Surely the mountains bring him forth food , where all the beasts of the field play .
ekegusii: Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.

english: He lieth under the shady trees , in the covert of the reed , and fens .
ekegusii: Nigo ekorara ase ekiriri ki’omote okorokwa lotusi, yebisa na gokenderera ime ase ebitonto bire ase etente.

english: The shady trees cover him with their shadow ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
ekegusii: Omote oyio noro ore ekiriri kiaye; ee, emete enga buna emesobeti nigo eyeetanaine.

english: Behold, he drinketh up a river , and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth .
ekegusii: Rora, nonya orooche rore nemerindo, ero teri kwoboa; nonya orooche rwa Yorodani rokominyoka gocha ase omonwa oye, nigo ere noboremu.

english: He taketh it with his eyes : his nose pierceth through snares .
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”

english: Then Job answered the LORD , and said ,
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneri’Omonene, agateeba:

english: Behold, I am vile ; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .
ekegusii: “Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.

english: Once have I spoken ; but I will not answer : yea, twice ; but I will proceed no further .
ekegusii: Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.” Omonene

english: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime Omonene akairaneria Ayubu, akamoteebia:

english: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
ekegusii: “Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ngokoboria nde, naye ong’iranerie.

english: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment ? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare kombara ng’a nomomochi inde? Norigetie kongambia inche, erinde obarerwe oboronge?

english: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
ekegusii: Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?

english: None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me?
ekegusii: Onde tari ore omotindi oraremererie ayechegie. Ning’o rende oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwane?

english: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
ekegusii: Ning’o ong’eire egento ritang’ani ng’a nainche imogeakane? Gento kende gionsi kere inse y’erioba nekiane.

english: I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
ekegusii: “Inche tingotiga ting’orokia buna ebiimo biaye bire, naende buna okobua ne chinguru chiaye bire, na buna amauga ’omobere oye aagachegete buya.

english: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koyiaboria risankwa riaye? Ning’o oranyare gosoyia okoboko kwaye gati‐gati y’amaino aye?

english: Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .
ekegusii: Ning’o oraasamie omonwa oye? Amaino aye nigo are ay’okwoboyia mono.

english: His scales are his pride , shut up together as with a close seal .
ekegusii: Obonene bwaye namagonko aye anga buna chinguba, achokaine chindwaro; nigo abwataine amo, buna ayanantirie.

english: One is so near to another , that no air can come between them.
ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.

english: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .
ekegusii: Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.

english: By his neesings a light doth shine , and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning .
ekegusii: Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.

english: Out of his mouth go burning lamps , and sparks of fire leap out .
ekegusii: Chinsase chi’omorero nigo chikorwa ase omonwa oye; ee, chinsase nigo chigotaroka korwa asere.

english: Canst thou put an hook into his nose ? or bore his jaw through with a thorn ?
ekegusii: Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?

english: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke , as out of a seething pot or caldron .
ekegusii: Erioki nigo rigosoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, buna enyongo ekobera egosokia omwoki bw’amaache.

english: His breath kindleth coals , and a flame goeth out of his mouth .
ekegusii: Omoika bw’omonwa oye nigo ogosoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na omorero nigo ogosoka korwa ase omonwa oye,

english: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.

english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together : they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved .
ekegusii: Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.

english: His heart is as firm as a stone ; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .
ekegusii: Enkoro yaye nenkong’u buna rigena, ee, nenkong’u buna orogena rogosia.

english: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid : by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
ekegusii: Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.

english: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .
ekegusii: Nerutwa omoro oyegwere, tori koyekorera kende, nonya ne ritimo, gose ensara, gose esimisi.

english: He esteemeth iron as straw , and brass as rotten wood .
ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kenga risakwe asere, na etai nigo enga omote ogundire.

english: The arrow cannot make him flee : slingstones are turned with him into stubble .
ekegusii: Ensara tekoyioboyia etame; amagena ’enduruche akorutwa nigo anga buna amasakwe.

english: Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .
ekegusii: Chinungu nigo chinga buna amasakwe asere; ekero amatimo akwoga gocha nigo egoseka.

english: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
ekegusii: Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?

english: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .
ekegusii: Ase enda yaye nigo ebwate ebigionkorio ebioge; nigo egotiga ebimanyerererio buna ebi’egari y’okoorera egokurura ase etintira.

english: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot : he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment .
ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amaache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amaache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.

english: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary .
ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.

english: Upon earth there is not his like , who is made without fear .
ekegusii: Getongwa kende tikeri igoro ase ense kenga ero, ekio giatongetwe getari kwoboa.

english: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride .
ekegusii: Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omorwoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”

english: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever ?
ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogenderera botambe?

english: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird ? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?

english: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants ?
ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeonerania?

english: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?
ekegusii: Nonyare kobochora riiyo riaye ne ritimo rikobeta chinswe? Gose ritimo erio ndibete omotwe oye riyobochore?

english: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle , do no more .
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.

english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agoteema igo, nigo ogosemeria kwaye kogosira kegima; nonya nase okoyerora rioka, omonto nigo akwerusia moyo.

english: Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .
ekegusii: Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabebe na komoremia ase engencho y’amabe aria onsi Omonene amorenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chitaabu na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu.

english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .
ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia amatuko a magega ay’Ayubu kobua aye ritang’ani. Boigo Ayubu akanyora ching’ondi chilifu ikomi na inye, ne chingamia chilifu isano nemo, ne chiombe chilifu ibere, ne chitigere chiaberi elifu eyemo.

english: He had also seven sons and three daughters .
ekegusii: Boigo akaegwa abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.

english: And he called the name of the first , Jemima ; and the name of the second , Kezia ; and the name of the third , Keren-happuch .
ekegusii: Akaroka omoiseke omotang’ani Yemima, na oyo o kabere Kesia, na oyo o gatato Kereni‐Hapuki.

english: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job : and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren .
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio yonsi bakungu bande tibarengeo baare abanyabieni buna abaiseke b’Ayubu, na ise akabaa omwando amo nabamura bamwabo.

english: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons’ sons , even four generations .
ekegusii: Na magega y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.

english: So Job died , being old and full of days .
ekegusii: Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.

english: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
ekegusii: “Nimanyete ng’a aye nonyare gokora ebinto bionsi, naende ng’a aya kwaganirie gokora takonyara gotangwa taba.

english: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkoigwa igoro yao ase okoigwa namato rioka, korende bono amaiso aane akororire.

english: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nechayire inche omonyene, naende neakire orotu ne ribu ase ogweitia na goonchoka.” Omoerio

english: And it was so , that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job , the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .
ekegusii: Omonene gakwanire amang’ana ayio n’Ayubu, agakwana n’Elifasi Omotemani, akamoteebia, “Nabeire nendamwamu asore na ase abasani bao baria babere, ekiagera inwe timokwaneti ayare ay’oboronge igoro yane buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.

english: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering ; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .
ekegusii: Ase igo bono ira ase Ayubu, omosomba one, chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere; mochirue chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaino inwe abanyene. Ayubu, omosomba one, nabasabere, ekiagera inche nigo ndanchere ogosaba kwaye ase engencho yaino, timbaisa kobakorera buna oboriri bwaino bore. Inwe timokwaneti igoro yane amang’ana are ay’oboronge buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.”

english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job .
ekegusii: Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, n’Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said ,
ekegusii: Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

english: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .
ekegusii: Nonya bakoruma buna endo ere entindi, bakirigwe, na amaino e chindo chinsae nigo akobunwa.

english: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad .
ekegusii: Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi’endo eaberi nigo chigosererebekana.

english: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
ekegusii: Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.

english: Fear came upon me, and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .
ekegusii: obwoba bokambwata amo nokoiguswa, na amauga onsi ay’omobere one agachaaka gotengechigwa.

english: Then a spirit passed before my face ; the hair of my flesh stood up :
ekegusii: Embeo egaeta ase obosio bwane, na amarionya ’omobere one agatenena.

english: It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’egento gete ogatenena ase obosio bwane, korende tinanyarete komanya ng’a ngento ki gose nkieni ki; erio nkaigwa eriogi eriororo rigoteeba:

english: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto nanyare koba omooronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?

english: Behold, he put no trust in his servants ; and his angels he charged with folly :
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabasomba baye; ere nigo akobabeekeera abamalaika baye obobe.

english: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay , whose foundation is in the dust , which are crushed before the moth ?
ekegusii: Onye naboigo, naki rende arasemerie abwo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’amaroba, abwo amaroso abo abekire ase riroba? Barabwo nigo bagoakwa na komionogorwa buna ebigwankwa.

english: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved ? but who can withhold himself from speaking ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?

english: They are destroyed from morning to evening : they perish for ever without any regarding it .
ekegusii: Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.

english: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .
ekegusii: Bionsi ebi’abaanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong’aini bonde bwonsi.

english: Behold, thou hast instructed many , and thou hast strengthened the weak hands .
ekegusii: Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong’irie.

english: Thy words have upholden him that was falling , and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong’irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.

english: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest ; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled .
ekegusii: Bono naye emechando yacheire, na tori noboremu bonde bwonsi, yagokunire na aye kwegosire.

english: Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?
ekegusii: Aye buna omoirogete Nyasae, tori noboremu? Naende buna chinchera chiao chire chindonge, tori nogosemeria?

english: Remember , I pray thee, who ever perished , being innocent ? or where were the righteous cut off ?
ekegusii: Bono rengereria, indi yabeete ng’a omonto omoikeranu nasiretigwe? Naende indi yabeete ng’a abanto abaronge mbatugutetwe?

english: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same.
ekegusii: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.

english: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.

english: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn ?
ekegusii: Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?

english: Who giveth rain upon the earth , and sendeth waters upon the fields :
ekegusii: Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amaache.

english: To set up on high those that be low ; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.

english: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness : and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo, emeroberio yabo y’ogotega nigo egosirigwa bwango.

english: They meet with darkness in the daytime , and grope in the noonday as in the night .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobwatwa nomosunte mobaso gati, bataba‐taba mobaso gati buna nobotuko bore.

english: But he saveth the poor from the sword , from their mouth , and from the hand of the mighty .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka korwa ase emenwa egoita, na abaremeire korwa ase abwo bare ne chinguru.

english: So the poor hath hope , and iniquity stoppeth her mouth .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.

english: He shall deliver thee in six troubles : yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase emechando etano nomo, ee, nonya nkorwa ase etano na ebere, na amabe tagokonyora.

english: For wrath killeth the foolish man , and envy slayeth the silly one .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ogwechanda nigo kogoita omoriri, na emoko nigo egoita oyo otari omong’aini.

english: In famine he shall redeem thee from death : and in war from the power of the sword .
ekegusii: Ekero ki’enchara nagotoorie korwa ase amakweri, na ekero gi’esegi korwa ase abwo bagoita nemioro.

english: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue : neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bakogokwana bobe nobiswe, na ekero amabe agoita arache, toyoboa.

english: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh : neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching’iti chintindi chire ase ense.

english: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field : and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
ekegusii: Nonya namagena are mogondo, nobwatane naro, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nobe nomorembe nachirochio.

english: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace ; and thou shalt visit thy habitation , and shalt not sin .
ekegusii: Erio nonyare korora ng’a obomenyo bwao mborendire buya, na ekero orabe gokorata ase ameri e chitugo chiao, nonyore ng’a ende tesireti korwao.

english: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great , and thine offspring as the grass of the earth .
ekegusii: Norore buna abana bao babeire abange, na ororeria rwao ndobuche robe oronge buna obonyansi bore ase ense.

english: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age , like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season .
ekegusii: Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y’endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.

english: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio; naro nay’ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang’ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”

english: I have seen the foolish taking root : but suddenly I cursed his habitation .
ekegusii: Nabeire nkorora omonto omoriri okogenderera bokong’u, korende mobosokano nkaragereria enka yaye.

english: His children are far from safety , and they are crushed in the gate , neither is there any to deliver them .
ekegusii: Abana baye tibakonyora ogokonywa, nigo bakomionogorerwa geita, gose monto onde tari okobatooria.

english: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up , and taketh it even out of the thorns , and the robber swalloweth up their substance .
ekegusii: Abanto bare nenchara nabwo bakoria endagera eye omonto oria akogesa, abwo nigo bakoyerusia nonya egiteire namagwa; abasaneri nigo bagosanera obotenenku bwaye.

english: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust , neither doth trouble spring out of the ground ;
ekegusii: Obobe tibori korwa ase riroba, gose emechando teri komera korwa inse ase riroba,

english: Yet man is born unto trouble , as the sparks fly upward .
ekegusii: korende Mwanyabaanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.

english: I would seek unto God , and unto God would I commit my cause :
ekegusii: Yare koba ng’a ninche nanga nigo narigia Nyasae, nere bweka nare goteebia amang’ana aane.

english: Which doeth great things and unsearchable ; marvellous things without number :
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana amanene atari komanyekana buna are, boigo namakumia atanyare kobareka.

english: Then should I yet have comfort ; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo are kogera ndemigwe; nigo narenge kogoka ntari koigwa obororo bw’okoromwa oko okonene. Ekiagera tinkaneti amang’ana a Nyasae ore Omochenu.

english: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane inki chiisaine imbe nokoganya kore nogosemeria? Na omoerio one naki ogochia koba, ngenderere koremereria?

english: Is my strength the strength of stones ? or is my flesh of brass ?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinguru chiane nigo chire chinkong’u buna echi’amagena? Gose omobere one nigo ore omokong’u buna etai?

english: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
ekegusii: Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.

english: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .
ekegusii: Oyotakororera omosani oye amaabera oyio, rirorio otigire koiroka Omobui.

english: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away ;
ekegusii: Abaminto bakorire obong’ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi’amaache, na buna chiooro chi’emegoko chigoeta chiaera.

english: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna chindooche chiamerire amaache ’obokendu abwataine, na amagena ’embura are imeo.

english: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .
ekegusii: Ekero ki’omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.

english: The paths of their way are turned aside ; they go to nothing , and perish .
ekegusii: Abagendi babwate chitugo chiabo nigo bakogobera korigia amaache, tibakoyanyora; ase igo bakwera ase erooro.

english: The troops of Tema looked , the companies of Sheba waited for them.
ekegusii: Abagendi ba Tema nigo bakoriga‐rigia amaache, naboigo abaonchoreria ba Seba basemeria koyanyora.

english: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed , and my calamity laid in the balances together !
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obororo bwane bwarenge korengwa, na emechando yane yonsi ebeekwe ase ekerengo erengwe!

english: They were confounded because they had hoped ; they came thither, and were ashamed .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoichana, ekiagera tibanyorete eki basemeretie; ekero bachete aase agwo, bakanyora ng’a nigo bang’ainetwe.

english: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down , and are afraid .
ekegusii: Nabogio nainwe mwabeire ase ’nde buna chintuboka chiria; mwarorire emechando yane, mwakumirie na kwoboa.

english: Did I say , Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche nateebirie onde ng’a andetere ekeegwa? Gose naboririe onde ng’a arue embooria korwa ase chinibo chiaye?

english: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand ? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?
ekegusii: Gose nateebirie onde ng’a antoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omobisa one? Gose nateebirie onde ng’a amboorie korwa ase amaboko ’abachandi baane?

english: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
ekegusii: Inyorokererie, na inche ninkire‐kiri imanyie amamocho nakorire.

english: How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
ekegusii: Naki amang’ana ’ekeene agwansa! Korende amang’ana ayio aino ay’obong’ainereria, inki agokonya?

english: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a amang’ana ’omonto bwerusirie moyo nigo anga buna omwaga?

english: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
ekegusii: Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.

english: Now therefore be content , look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie .
ekegusii: Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo ase more.

english: Return , I pray you, let it not be iniquity ; yea, return again , my righteousness is in it.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire, irana, timobaisa gokora ing’ana rinde riibe. Bono irana naende, ekiagera ring’ana riane neri’oboronge.

english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea : therefore my words are swallowed up .
ekegusii: Ebio nigo biare ebirito kobua omokenye ore ase enyancha; ase ayio nabeire omwango ase ogokwana ayio.

english: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana aane ngokwana nay’oborimo? Inee! Tinkonyara gokwana inyatanane ayare amabe?

english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
ekegusii: Nyasae Omonguru ombetire chinsara chiaye, na omoika one ong’usire obosongo bwabo; okogosa kwa Nyasae kwarobeire kondwania.

english: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass ? or loweth the ox over his fodder ?
ekegusii: Inee! Etigere y’orosana nkwana ere, ekero egotakuna obonyansi? Gose eng’ombe nkwana ere, ekero egendererete korisia?

english: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt ? or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?
ekegusii: Onye endagera tebekiri omonyoo okoyiansia, neriegwe? Inee! Omochununu bwe rigena ri’engoko nobwate obwansu?

english: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat .
ekegusii: Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.

english: Oh that I might have my request ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !
ekegusii: Naki nanga yaba buya onye nanyora aya nkobooria, onye Nyasae nanchera aya nganetie!

english: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie Nyasae anche ang’ake ansegenye, arambore okoboko kwaye ang’ite nkwe!

english: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?
ekegusii: “Ekero omonto are ase ense, nigo abwate obogima buna obw’oyokorwana esegi. Amatuko y’obogima bwaye nigo anga buna ay’omorikwa emeremo.

english: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more.
ekegusii: Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyoora naende.

english: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y’omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.

english: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me?
ekegusii: “Nase ki obegete oborendi igoro yane? Inche nenyancha inde, gose neng’iti enene mono ya nyancha?

english: When I say , My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint ;
ekegusii: Ekero nkorengereria ng’a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,

english: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :
ekegusii: erio aye nigo okongosa ase ogontomera chindoto na kong’a obwoba goetera ase amaroro.

english: So that my soul chooseth strangling , and death rather than my life .
ekegusii: Ase igo nachorire ng’a ng’entwe inkwe, ekiagera amakweri namaya kobua obororo bore ase omobere one.

english: I loathe it; I would not live alway : let me alone ; for my days are vanity .
ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.

english: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?
ekegusii: Nigo okomorigereria kera emambia, naende nigo okomorenga kera engaki.

english: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?

english: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow , and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work :
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omosomba akogania anyore aase agokenderera, na buna koreng’ana omonto orikire emeremo akogania aegwe eng’eria yaye,

english: I have sinned ; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
ekegusii: Aye omorigereria bw’abaanto, onye ngokora ebibe, ninki nagokoreire? Nase ki gwankorire nabeire ekerenga kiao? Nase ki nabeire buna egurube endito asore?

english: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression , and take away mine iniquity ? for now shall I sleep in the dust ; and thou shalt seek me in the morning , but I shall not be .
ekegusii: Nase ki otakonyabera ogosaria kwane, erinde otige ebibe biane kegima? Bono inche nkogenda inde korara ime ye riroba; aye nigo orabe gokondigia, korende tokonyora aande.”

english: So am I made to possess months of vanity , and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
ekegusii: naboigo nainche ngendererete koba nobobe omotienyi ase omotienyi, na obotuko ase obotuko nigo inde ase emechando.

english: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .
ekegusii: Ekero nararire nigo nkobooria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.

english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust ; my skin is broken , and become loathsome .
ekegusii: Amakonde ne riko biatubire omobere one; omobere one nigo okona‐gosaboka amasabo, erio otandoka, na obogundo bwaruao.

english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle , and are spent without hope .
ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango kobua egekorero gi’okoroisia egetambaa, nigo akoera ntabwati gosemeria konde.

english: O remember that my life is wind : mine eye shall no more see good .
ekegusii: “Manya ng’a obogima bwane nigo bore buna embeo bosa; amaiso aane takorora amaya naende.

english: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
ekegusii: Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng’ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.
