english: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away : so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakuure atakoirana korwao.

english: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ’obong’aini chisokoro chiria chiakwanete, takonyara gokworokereria, erinde bwegere?

english: Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
ekegusii: “Inee! Amauncho nanyare komera ase entente etari? Gose ebitonto nabimere ase amaache atari?

english: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .
ekegusii: Ekero bigendererete gosicha, engaki y’okobitema etaraika, nigo birasusane bitige ebimeri binde.

english: So are the paths of all that forget God ; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish :
ekegusii: Naboigo nabaanto bonsi abebire Nyasae bakoba, ogosemeria kw’omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae nagosire.

english: Whose hope shall be cut off , and whose trust shall be a spider’s web .
ekegusii: Aya asemeretie nasirigwe kegima, na aya egenete nigo are buna enyomba y’oronyambobe.

english: He shall lean upon his house , but it shall not stand : he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agwesiirera ase enyomba yaye, korende tekogenderera gotenena, nigo ayesemeretie, korende tekogenderera kobao.

english: He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .
ekegusii: “Nabo akoreereta buna ekemeri kere ase omobaso, ekio gekoranda ase omogondo bwonsi;

english: His roots are wrapped about the heap , and seeth the place of stones .
ekegusii: emeri yaye nigo egwesiserania ase etui y’amagena; buna eyekwemigereria ase egati y’amagena y’egetare.

english: If he destroy him from his place , then it shall deny him, saying , I have not seen thee.
ekegusii: Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.

english: Behold, this is the joy of his way , and out of the earth shall others grow .
ekegusii: Ee, oyio noro omogooko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.

english: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?
ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri orabe kogokwana amang’ana aya, na amang’ana ’omonwa oo abe buna omwaga omonene?

english: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :
ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae takonyara kwanga na gotiga omonto omoikeranu; gose tagokonya abakori amabe.

english: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing , and thy lips with rejoicing .
ekegusii: Ekeene, nagoichorie namaseko, na omonwa oo otere nomochengo.

english: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
ekegusii: Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw’abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”

english: Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nanyare koonchorana ekeene? Gose Omonguru naonchorane ayare ay’oboronge?

english: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression ;
ekegusii: Onye abana bao bakorete ebibe asare, ere obaeire egesusuro ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo.

english: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty ;
ekegusii: Korende aye korarigie Nyasae na gosaba ase oboitongo ase ere Omonyanguru,

english: If thou wert pure and upright ; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .
ekegusii: korabe oyochenegete na ore nenkoro endonge, ekeene, rirorio ere nagochandekere, nakoroiserie obomenyo, na oboronge bogenderere kobao.

english: Though thy beginning was small , yet thy latter end should greatly increase .
ekegusii: Eki kwabwate ritang’ani kerorekane kere egeke, koreng’anigwa neki oramenterwe magega.

english: For enquire , I pray thee, of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
ekegusii: “Korende boria omanye ay’ebigori bia kare, bweigwere aya chisokoro chiao chianyorete.

english: (For we are but of yesterday , and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow :)
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.

english: Which doeth great things past finding out ; yea, and wonders without number .
ekegusii: Nigo agokora amang’ana amanene aetanetie obomanyi bwonsi, na amakumia amange atari kobareka.

english: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
ekegusii: Rora! Ere nigo akong’ika ang’e oeta, tinkomoorora; nigo akong’etania, tinkomomanyereria.

english: Behold, he taketh away , who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoira eki aganetie. Ning’o oranyare komotanga? Ning’o oranyare komobooria ng’a ninki ekio agokora?

english: If God will not withdraw his anger , the proud helpers do stoop under him.
ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, + 9:13 Rahabu: eng’iti enene y’enyancha etenenerete chinguru chi’obotantanu na obobe nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.

english: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
ekegusii: Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.

english: Whom, though I were righteous , yet would I not answer , but I would make supplication to my judge .
ekegusii: Nonya inche nare koba tindi nokomocha, tinarenge komoiraneria; nigo narenge gosaba amaabera korwa ase omonsoeri.

english: If I had called , and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice .
ekegusii: Onye narenge komorangeria, na ere ang’itabere, rirorio tinarenge kwegena ng’a nategererete eriogi riane.

english: For he breaketh me with a tempest , and multiplieth my wounds without cause .
ekegusii: Ere ong’akire nomwaga ore nomoubera, na omentire amaote aane ngencho ende etaiyo.

english: He will not suffer me to take my breath , but filleth me with bitterness .
ekegusii: Tang’eti ribaga nkoeyanera, korende omenteire obororo obonge mono.

english: If I speak of strength , lo, he is strong : and if of judgment , who shall set me a time to plead ?
ekegusii: Onye namang’ana e chinguru, rora ere nigo are ne chinguru. Onye igoro y’oboronge, monto ki oranyare koamererania nere?

english: I know it is so of a truth : but how should man be just with God ?
ekegusii: Ekeene, namanyire ng’a ayio nabo are, korende naki omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae?

english: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .
ekegusii: Nonya nare koba omonyaboronge, amang’ana ngokwana nigo are kongambia; nonya nare koba ng’a tindi na komocha, aya nigo are kombera kirori ng’a nomokori amabe inde.

english: Though I were perfect , yet would I not know my soul : I would despise my life .
ekegusii: Inche tindi na komocha. Tinyemanyeti; tinkobara obogima bwane ng’a negento.

english: This is one thing , therefore I said it , He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked .
ekegusii: Mang’ana taiyo. Ase ayio nigo ngoteeba: Ere nigo agosiria omonyaboronge na omokori amabe amo.

english: If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .
ekegusii: Ekero ebiku bikorenta amakweri a mobosokano, na abanto batari na komocha banyorwe namaakwa, ere nigo akobachecheria.

english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where , and who is he?
ekegusii: Ense nigo ebeekire inse y’amaboko ’abakori amabe, Nyasae otubire amasio ’abagaambi ebiina. Onye tari ere, ning’o rende okorire ayio?

english: Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .
ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta bwango kobua omominyoki okominyoka; nigo akoera bwango, tari korora maya ande.

english: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
ekegusii: Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.

english: If I say , I will forget my complaint , I will leave off my heaviness , and comfort myself:
ekegusii: Inse goteeba ng’a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,

english: I am afraid of all my sorrows , I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent .
ekegusii: nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.

english: If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?
ekegusii: Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?

english: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand .
ekegusii: Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.

english: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean ;
ekegusii: Ninsa gwesibia namaache arabete buna amagena ’embura, na goisaba nesabuni,

english: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.

english: For he is not a man , as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment .
ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto buna inche, erinde imoiranerie, na ngende nere ase ekegambero.

english: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both .
ekegusii: Monto onde tari orabe omogayani oito, oyio oratogambie inche nere.

english: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
ekegusii: Tiga ere arusie enyimbo yaye korwa ase ’nde; okogosa kwaye tikobaisa kong’ondokia.

english: Then would I speak , and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
ekegusii: Erio inyare gokwana ntari nobwoba ase engencho yaye, nimanyete ng’a tindi nokomocha.

english: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered ?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobong’aini ase enkoro yaye, na omonyene chinguru, monto ki oratoorigwe onye takomoigwera?

english: Which removeth the mountains , and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoba nendamwamu nigo akoonchorana ebitunwa, obitigeria korwa aase abo, na abanto tibari komanya ayio.

english: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
ekegusii: Nigo agotengechia ense yarwa aase aye, erio chintenenero chiaye chianyegerigwa.

english: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars .
ekegusii: Nigo agochika erioba tirigosoka; ne ching’enang’eni ochibeeka ekemanyererio.

english: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
ekegusii: Nere bweka oramborete igoro chionsi, agachiaara, nere ogotaara igoro ase emerindo y’enyancha.

english: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel .
ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Yoel, mosinto o Petueli. Abanto bakoreera ogosirigwa kw’ebimeri

english: The field is wasted , the land mourneth ; for the corn is wasted : the new wine is dried up , the oil languisheth .
ekegusii: Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai tekobao na amaguta ’emezeituni akeeire kegima.

english: Be ye ashamed , O ye husbandmen ; howl , O ye vinedressers , for the wheat and for the barley ; because the harvest of the field is perished .
ekegusii: Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.

english: The vine is dried up , and the fig tree languisheth ; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree , even all the trees of the field , are withered : because joy is withered away from the sons of men .
ekegusii: Emesabibu yomire, na emeko boigo. Emekomomanga, na emekendo, na emete y’amapera, ee, emete ende yonsi y’emegondo yomire. Ogochenga kwaerire ase egati y’abanto.

english: Gird yourselves, and lament , ye priests : howl , ye ministers of the altar : come , lie all night in sackcloth , ye ministers of my God : for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God .
ekegusii: Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasiimero, bokia amagombo! Eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biaborire, ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: Sanctify ye a fast , call a solemn assembly , gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God , and cry unto the LORD ,
ekegusii: Raria engaki y’okweng’ata; rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima! Sangereria abagaaka na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, bache ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde morere ase Omonene.

english: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes , yea , joy and gladness from the house of our God ?
ekegusii: Endagera yasiriigwe torigereretie na amaiso aito. Omogooko na amaseko arusiigwe korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: The seed is rotten under their clods , the garners are laid desolate , the barns are broken down ; for the corn is withered .
ekegusii: Chimbusuro chagundeire riroba ime; ebiage biatigaire bosa na ebigancha biasarekire, ekiagera endagera ekogachwa yaborire.

english: How do the beasts groan ! the herds of cattle are perplexed , because they have no pasture ; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate .
ekegusii: Rigereria chitugo buna chikwana chichandegete, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.

english: O LORD , to thee will I cry : for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness , and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera omorero bwomirie obonyansi ase ebitii, n’echimeme chi’omorero chiasiririe emete y’orosana.

english: Hear this, ye old men , and give ear , all ye inhabitants of the land . Hath this been in your days , or even in the days of your fathers ?
ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ya Yuda, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?

english: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up , and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness .
ekegusii: Nonya ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikorera asore, ekiagera chindooche chiakamire, amaache taiyo, ee, omorero oria osambire amarisio ’erooro.

english: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children , and their children another generation .
ekegusii: Yateebie abana baino amang’ana aya, na abana baino bayateebie abana babo, na abana babo bayateebie ekegori kende.

english: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten ; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten ; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten .
ekegusii: Ogosongerera ase obonge gw’echingige, chiagwereire ebimeri, biria chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.

english: Awake , ye drunkards , and weep ; and howl , all ye drinkers of wine , because of the new wine ; for it is cut off from your mouth .
ekegusii: Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho amasabibu onsi y’okoroisia edivai enyia, asarigwe.

english: He hath laid my vine waste , and barked my fig tree : he hath made it clean bare , and cast it away ; the branches thereof are made white .
ekegusii: Giasaririe emesabibu yaito, kiabunire emeko yaito; kiayesaboire, na gotuguta amasabo inse, ne chinsagia chi’emete eyio chiarabire se.

english: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth .
ekegusii: Rera na kobokia amagombo buna omoiseke omwekungi obegete chianga chi’echigunia, okwereirwe nomosaacha bw’oboke bwaye.

english: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD ; the priests , the LORD’s ministers , mourn .
ekegusii: Okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b’Omonene nigo bakorera.

english: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the LORD cometh , for it is nigh at hand ;
ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni, ee, bugia egetureeri ki’ogotabobora ase egetunwa egechenu. Tiga abanto bonsi ba Yuda baiguswe, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ang’e.

english: Therefore also now, saith the LORD , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :
ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Nonya mbono ng’iranere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, ase okweng’ata, na okorera, na okweng’ereria.

english: And rend your heart , and not your garments , and turn unto the LORD your God : for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repenteth him of the evil .
ekegusii: Tandora chinkoro chiaino ase ogweitia, gose tari ogotandora chianga chiaino.” Irana gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera ere nomuya na omonyamaabera; ere tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu; obwanchani bwaye nobwa botambe, nigo akoonchoka otiga kobarentera amabe.

english: Who knoweth if he will return and repent , and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God ?
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete, ande gose Omonene naonchoke atige kobarentera amabe, korende abatigere ogosesenigwa, erinde moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa?

english: Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :
ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima!

english: Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
ekegusii: Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga nonya mbaria banyuomanire bwango iga basoke korwa mwabo,

english: Let the priests , the ministers of the LORD , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , Spare thy people , O LORD , and give not thine heritage to reproach , that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people , Where is their God ?
ekegusii: Abakuani abwo bakomokorera Omonene tiga barere ase egati y’egesona na egesasiimero, bakwane iga, “Aye Omonene, rorera abanto bao amaabera; totiga abanto abwo bare omwando oo bachecherigwe, bakwanwe bobe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nase ki abanto baraborie: Ng’ai Nyasae obo are”? Nyasae okoirania obotobu ase ense

english: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land , and pity his people .
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba ne risemi ase engencho y’ense yaye, akarorera abanto baye amabeebe.

english: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people , Behold, I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria abanto baye, akabateebia, Rora, nkobatomera nde endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na inwe namoisaneke; tinkobatiga mogenderere gochaywa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.

english: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong ; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations .
ekegusii: Nigo rirabe rituko ri’omosunte na eri’amataturi, rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima. Omoganda omonene bw’echingige nochiche, nigo orarande buna omosunte igoro ase ebitunwa. Omogwekano bw’amang’ana ayio tana koba korwa kare, gose takoba nonya ng’ake ase ebigori bigochi‐gocha.

english: But I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate , with his face toward the east sea , and his hinder part toward the utmost sea , and his stink shall come up , and his ill savour shall come up , because he hath done great things .
ekegusii: Ninserie omoganda bw’echingige okorwa sugusu orue ase more, obeere are korwa ase more, ninyoserie ogende ase ense enyomo ere bosa, ensemo etang’aine egende gochia ase Enyancha y’omonyo, na ensemo ekorwa magega egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Mediterania. Ogotioka kw’ebitondo biabo nkoimokerere igoro, ekiagera okorire ayare amanene mono.

english: Fear not, O land ; be glad and rejoice : for the LORD will do great things .
ekegusii: Aye ense, toiroka! Korende goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.

english: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti chi’orosana, timoiroka, ekiagera amarisio are ase erooro amerire obonyansi; emete yamire amatunda, emeko na emesabibu yamire okwama kwabo okonene.

english: Be glad then, ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the LORD your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka, mochenge ase ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abakoreire, ekiagera obaeire embura entang’ani ebaisaine; nere okobatweria embura botambe, eye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.

english: And the floors shall be full of wheat , and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil .
ekegusii: Ebiooreri bikoorerwa mbiichorwe ne chindagera; na ebimitero mbiichore nedivai na amaguta goika biiteke.

english: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten , the cankerworm , and the caterpiller , and the palmerworm , my great army which I sent among you.
ekegusii: Nimbairanerie ebi’emiaka eria biasaretigwe, ne chingige, na ebisase, ne chingeeti, omoganda oyio omonene natomete gocha ase egati yaino.

english: And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the LORD your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed .
ekegusii: Bono monyore endagera enyinge mokoria moigote, erio motogie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obakoreire amakumia. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.

english: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the LORD your God , and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed .
ekegusii: Erio namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ase egati yaino inwe Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, naende Nyasae onde omoao tari. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende. Rituko ri’Omonene

english: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one; abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabaabaane, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto, na abamura baino nabarore amaroro.

english: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one.

english: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth : the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness ; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omorero ogosamba noboigo omoganda oyio ogosaria kera egento kere bosio bwaye, na magega gotiga kera egento gekoyia; ekero chitaraeta, ense eyio nigo enga buna omogondo o Eden, korende ekero chiaetire yatigara erooro bosa ase echio kende tikeri kerachitamboke.

english: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .
ekegusii: Ning’orokie ebikone igoro na ase ense; amanyinga, na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.

english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .
ekegusii: Ekero chigoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, ebititiro biabo nigo binga buna ebie chigari, naende nigo binga buna ogotoreka kw’omorero ogosamba amasakwe; chirochio nigo chire buna abasikari bare ne chinguru baroberigwe.

english: Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
ekegusii: Ekero chigocha abanto nigo bagoichorwa nobwoba, amaiso ’abaanto bonsi nigo akoonchoka arachoka.

english: They shall run like mighty men ; they shall climb the wall like men of war ; and they shall march every one on his ways , and they shall not break their ranks :
ekegusii: Nigo chikominyoka gochia korwana esegi buna abasikari chituoni; nigo chikoriina chindwaki igoro buna abasikari. Kera eyemo nigo eragenderere gochia bosio, ende teri eragobere esire enchera ebwatetie.

english: Neither shall one thrust another ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .
ekegusii: Tichikomigererania, kera eyemo nigo egoeta omong’ororia oye; nigo chigoeta gati‐gati y’ebirwanero, tichigotangeka.

english: They shall run to and fro in the city ; they shall run upon the wall , they shall climb up upon the houses ; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief .
ekegusii: Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.

english: For, behold, in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,
ekegusii: “Rora, ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, inche Omonene ning’iranerie Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, bare ase obosomba, amaya abo.

english: Assemble yourselves, and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O LORD .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku momenyete ase chinsemo chionsi, ayerera bwango mooche, sangererekana amo agwo ase rikura. Aye Omonene, renta abarwani bao b’esegi babaumokere!

english: Let the heathen be wakened , and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat : for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku baseegetane, bache ase Rikura ri’ekiina ria Yehosafati. Aroro agwo nao ndanachere abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baabaetanaine ekiina.

english: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision .
ekegusii: Emeganda na emeganda nigo ere ase Rikura ri’ekiina, ekiagera agwo ase Rikura ri’ekiina nao rituko ri’Omonene rirache bwango.

english: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .
ekegusii: Erioba na omotienyi mbibekwe omosunte, ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara. Nyasae nasesenie abanto baye

english: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion , my holy mountain : then shall Jerusalem be holy , and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
ekegusii: “Erio namomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, imenyete Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu. Yerusalemu nobe omochie omochenu, na abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni tibagosoa aroro nonya ng’ake.

english: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the mountains shall drop down new wine , and the hills shall flow with milk , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters , and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD , and shall water the valley of Shittim .
ekegusii: “Ase rituko erio ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore amabeere, ne chindooche chionsi chi’Abayuda nachiichorwe namaache. Ensoko netuboke korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, enyiyie ense omweya ya Sitimu.

english: Egypt shall be a desolation , and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness , for the violence against the children of Judah , because they have shed innocent blood in their land .
ekegusii: “Ense ya Misiri nesarigwe ebe bosa, na Edomu nero nebe erooro ere bosa, ekiagera abanto b’aroro mbakorerete Abayuda amabe; nigo baiterete ase ense yabo amanyinga ’abaanto batarenge na komocha.

english: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ri’ekegambero ria Jehoshaphat; + 3:2 Jehoshaphat: engencho yaye: Omonene okonacha ekiina aroro agwo nimbanachere ekiina, ase onsi eria bakorerete abanto bane. Ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane Israeli.

english: But Judah shall dwell for ever , and Jerusalem from generation to generation .
ekegusii: Korende ense y’Abayuda nemenywe kare na kare, na Yerusalemu boigo, ekiaare ase ekiaare.

english: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the LORD dwelleth in Zion .
ekegusii: Nimbae egesusuro baria baiterete amanyinga y’abanto ba Yuda gose tinkobatigera abamochi. Inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngendererete komenya Sayoni.”

english: And they have cast lots for my people ; and have given a boy for an harlot , and sold a girl for wine , that they might drink .
ekegusii: Baakeire abanto baane obomera, erio korigia ning’o okoira abooswa baoonirie abana abamura, erinde banyore abakungu abatayayi, na baoonirie abana abaiseke, erinde banyore edivai bakonywa.

english: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold , and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things :
ekegusii: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitaabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chikalu chiaino.

english: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians , that ye might remove them far from their border .
ekegusii: Mwarusirie Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase chingongo chiabo, mwabaoonirie ase Abagiriki.

english: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head :
ekegusii: Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.

english: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the LORD hath spoken it .
ekegusii: Inche Omonene, ning’oonie abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ase Abayuda, na barabwo baabaoonie ase abanto ba Seba, abwo bamenyete aare mono. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”

english: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near ; let them come up :
ekegusii: Raria amang’ana aya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku: Ebeke ang’e ase esegi! Seegeta abarwani chituoni! Tiga abarwani bonsi bachiche bebeke ang’e basuke motwe.

english: Then were the men exceedingly afraid , and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD , because he had told them.
ekegusii: Erio Jona akabateebia ng’a nigo are gotama korwa ase Omonene Nyasae. Ekero baigwete ayio, abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamobooria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?”.

english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .
ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio chionsi enyancha nigo yagendererete gosareka mono. Erio abanto baria bakabooria Jona, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?”

english: And he said unto them, Take me up , and cast me forth into the sea ; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere ase more, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”

english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land ; but they could not: for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous against them.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto baria bagateema ne chinguru gosukia emeeri eria gochia ase engegu, korende tibanyarete, ekiagera ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete koburukania enyancha mono goetania.

english: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD , and said , We beseech thee , O LORD , we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man’s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou, O LORD , hast done as it pleased thee.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateeba, “Aye Omonene, totoa egesusuro ki’ogokwa ase engencho y’ogosiria obogima bw’omonto oyo. Ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”

english: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia Yona, bakamoruta ase enyancha ime; na agwo kegima enyancha egatoerera.

english: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD , and made vows .
ekegusii: Eke gekagera abanto baria bakairoka Omonene mono, bakamoruera ekeng’wanso na koria chiira chi’okomokorera.

english: Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
ekegusii: “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, oake eriogi ri’okoyokuurera, ekiagera ogokora kwaye okobe gwaikire ase obosio bwane.”

english: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD , and went down to Joppa ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chitaabu chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabaanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene.

english: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea , and there was a mighty tempest in the sea , so that the ship was like to be broken .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akagusia omwaga omonene mono igoro ase enyancha, na ekembugu‐mbugu gie chinguru kegacha ase enyancha, na emeeri ekaba ang’e kobuneka.

english: Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .
ekegusii: Erio abagendia b’emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng’a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng’a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.

english: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper ? arise , call upon thy God , if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
ekegusii: Omochiki bw’emeeri akagenda asare akamobooria, “Naki oraire chitoro iga okirete‐kiri? Imoka orangerie Nyasae oo! Ande Nyasae oyio nabo arabaise gotorengereria atokonye titosira.”

english: And they said every one to his fellow , Come , and let us cast lots , that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots , and the lot fell upon Jonah .
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagateebania, “Tiga toake obomera tomanye gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atocheire.” Erio bagaaka obomera, na obomera obwo bokagwera Yona.

english: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou?
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakamobooria, “Toteebie gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng’ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”

english: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew ; and I fear the LORD , the God of heaven , which hath made the sea and the dry land .
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inche n’Omoiberania inde, na nigo inyirogete Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, oyo otongete enyancha na ense enyomo.”

english: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly ,
ekegusii: Ekero Yona arenge ime ase enda y’enswe eria, akaba ogosa Omonene, Nyasae oye,

english: And the LORD spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akayechiika enswe eria emoroke Yona, igoro ase engegu, nero egakora boigo.

english: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD , and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Ekero narenge ase emechando, aye Omonene, ngakorangeria naye okangiraneria inche. Korwa ase endiba y’ense y’abakuure ’nkarera onkoye naye okanyigwa inche.

english: For thou hadst cast me into the deep , in the midst of the seas ; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananete inche. Na emerindo yao yonsi emetindi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.

english: Then I said , I am cast out of thy sight ; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple .
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng’a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, naende ng’a tikonyara koyerora Hekalu yao Enchenu.

english: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .
ekegusii: Amache agacha agantuba naende agantokeria inche; enyancha egantuba inche kegima enderema ya nyancha ekarandererwa omotwe one.

english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains ; the earth with her bars was about me for ever : yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption , O LORD my God .
ekegusii: Nigo nagendete inse kegima goika ase emeri y’ebitunwa agwo ase ense eyio ebisiekero bi’ebiita biaye bigosieka kare na kare. Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo kwangiranetie korwa ase chindiba inde moyo.

english: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD : and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple .
ekegusii: Ekero obomoyo bwane bwachagete gosoka gochia aria are erio aye Omonene ngasaba gocha ase ore na korwa ime y’Hekalu yao enchenu okanyigwa inche.

english: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagosasiima emegwekano eyio ere bosa barabwo batigire oboigweri gocha ase ore.

english: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende inche ningoterere ’ngokobaka aye; nikoruere aye ekengwanso na goikerania aria nakoriereire chiira. Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Omonene!”

english: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying ,
ekegusii: Nainde, Omonene agakwana na Yona.

english: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora aria bakorete; akarora nga batigire chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe. Erio ere agaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye naende agatiga kobaa egesusuro keria ere atebeete nga nabae.

english: Arise , go unto Nineveh , that great city , and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, erio obararerie abanto amang’ana ayio nakoeire.”

english: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the LORD . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Yona akamoigwera Omonene akagenda Ninawi omochie omogare kegima, akaira amatuko atato koyotara bwonsi.

english: So the people of Nineveh believed God , and proclaimed a fast , and put on sackcloth , from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi bakegena amang’ana a Nyasae, bagaetia buna kera oyomo eng’ate, na abanto bonsi pi, korwa omonene kegima goika omoke, bakeboyia chigunia koorokia buna beitirie.

english: For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ayio aigete ase omorwoti, ere akaimoka korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akarusia engobo yaye y’obonene, akeboyia chigunia, agaikaransa inse ase ribu igoro.

english: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles , saying , Let neither man nor beast , herd nor flock , taste any thing : let them not feed , nor drink water :
ekegusii: Erio agatoma okoraria gochia ase abanto ba Ninawi: “Oko n’ogochika korwa ase omorwoti n’abanene baye: onde tabaisa koria kende; abanto bonsi, chiombe, amo n’echingondi tibiancheiri koria gose konywa.

english: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea, let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi pi amo n’echingiti babeke chianga chi’echigunia. Kera oyomo goika amosabe Nyasae ase ekeene naende boigo goika atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe namakora aye y’ebibe.

english: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not?
ekegusii: Kero kende Nyasae nabo abaise koonchoreria ebirengererio biaye; kero kende nabaise gotiga koba n’ekeririanda, naitwe titogokwa!”

english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly , and he was very angry .
ekegusii: Yona akagechigwa namang’ana ayio, akaba nendamwamu.

english: Then said the LORD , Thou hast had pity on the gourd , for the which thou hast not laboured , neither madest it grow ; which came up in a night , and perished in a night :
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye kwaroreire omobono oyo amaabera, nonya tikwaywechanderete ase ogokora emeremo asoro, gose ase okoyokinia; nigo omerete ase obotuko obomo, naende ogasira ase obotuko obomo.

english: And should not I spare Nineveh , that great city , wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand ; and also much cattle ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche tingwenereti koba namabeebe ase Ninawi, omochie oyio omonene, agwo ase abanto goetania chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000) bamenyeteo? Abanto abwo tibamanyete gwatanana ayare ensemo ya borio na ayare ase eya bomosi. Boigo omochie oyio nobwate ching’iti chinyinge mono chitugireo.”

english: Then said the LORD , Doest thou well to be angry ?
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamobooria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”

english: So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .
ekegusii: Bono Yona agasoka korwa ase omochie oria, agaikaransa ase ensemo ya moocha y’omochie. Agwo akeagachera ekegutu, agaikaransa imeo gokenderera koganya arore ayare gochia gokorekana ase omochie oria.

english: And the LORD God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.

english: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachiika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.

english: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .
ekegusii: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omoororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateeba, “Nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”

english: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaboria Yona, “Inee! Mboronge igo aye okogechigwa ase engencho y’omobono oyio?” Yona akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Ee, nigo inde noboronge kogechigwa, nonya ngoika ogokwa.”

english: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them;
ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omorwoti o Yerusalemu, akaigwa ng’a Yoshua obuire omochie o Ai na oyosiririe kegima, oitire na omorwoti bw’aroro, buna akorete Yeriko na omorwoti bw’aroro. Naboigo akaigwa buna Abagibeoni bakorire omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a banyorire ribaga komenya ase egati yabo.

english: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .
ekegusii: Omonene akabatantania na kobaondokia ase amasio ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaita ogoita okonene agwo Gibeoni, akababwatia gochia egetirimboko kia Beti‐Horoni, naende akababwatia na kobaita goika omochie bw’Aseka na oyo o Makeda.

english: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth-horon , that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaamori barenge gotama Abaisraeli, na kobaikire egetirimboko gekorua Beti‐Horoni, Nyasae akabaiyereria amagena ’embura amanene mono korwa igoro ase enchera yabo goika omochie bw’Aseka, nabarabwo bagakwa. Abwo baitetwe namagena ’embura nigo barenge abange kobua abwo baitetwe n’Abaisraeli.

english: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon ; and thou, Moon , in the valley of Ajalon .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riri’Omonene abegeete Abaamori ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, Yoshua agakwana n’Omonene. Ekero Abaisraeli bategererete, akabora, “Aye erioba, tenena, okire‐kiri igoro ya Gibeoni, naye omotienyi boigo, igoro ye Rikura ri’Ayaloni!”

english: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the LORD fought for Israel .
ekegusii: Ituko rinde tiriana koba buna erio nonya ng’ake, ritang’ani ri’ayio, gose magega y’ayio, ekero Omonene aigwerete Mwanyabaanto. Nyasae nigo arwanererete Abaisraeli.

english: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Giligali ase batoorete.

english: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
ekegusii: Abarwoti baria batano bagatama, bakebisa ase rikuruma ria Makeda.

english: And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
ekegusii: Ekero Yoshua atebetigwe ng’a abarwoti baria barorekanire bebisete agwo ase rikuruma riria,

english: And Joshua said , Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave , and set men by it for to keep them:
ekegusii: agachiika, agateeba, “Turunkania amagena amanene, mosieke egesoero kie rikuruma, naende mobeeke abanto barende aroro.

english: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand .
ekegusii: Korende inwe abande, timobaisa kobeera aroro, mobwatie ababisa baino, mobaumokere korwa magega, na kobaita. Timobatiga basoe emechie yabo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, obabekire ase amaboko aino.”

english: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .
ekegusii: Bono omorwoti oria amo nabaanto baye bakaondoka mono; ekiagera Gibeoni nigo orenge omochie omonene buna omochie onde bwonsi obwate omorwoti; nomonene orenge kobua Ai, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nigo barenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana.

english: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabaita ogoita okonene, goika bakabasiria bonsi otatiga abanto bake boka, abwo batamerete emechie yagiteire chindwaki.

english: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakairana buya ase Yoshua agwo Makeda erio batoorete. Onde tarenge noboremu gokwana mamincha y’Abaisraeli naende.

english: Then said Joshua , Open the mouth of the cave , and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave .
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agateeba, “Igora egesoero kie rikuruma na mondetere abarwoti baria batano korwa aroro.”

english: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , and the king of Eglon .
ekegusii: Aya agakoreka. Bakarusia abarwoti baria batano korwa ase rikuruma: omorwoti o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yerimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bakabarenta ase Yoshua.

english: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua , that Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near , put your feet upon the necks of these kings . And they came near , and put their feet upon the necks of them.
ekegusii: Ekero abarwoti baria barentetwe ase Yoshua, ere akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, agateebia abatang’ani b’abarwani, abwo bagendete amo nere ase esegi, “Inchuo aiga ang’e, motache abarwoti aba ebigoti biabo.” Erio barabwo bagaika ang’e, bakabatacha.

english: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
ekegusii: Naende Yoshua agateebia abatang’ani baria b’abarwani, “Timoiroka, timokwa emioyo; mobe noboremu na gotenena bokong’u, ekiagera naboigo Omonene arakore ababisa bonsi morarwanie.”

english: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees : and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua agaita abarwoti baria, akabatonga ase emete etano; agwo bagasung’unana goika mogoroba.

english: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth , which remain until this very day .
ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachiika ng’a ebitondo bi’abaanto baria bisungorwe, bitugutwe ase rikuruma riria bebisete, na abanto bagakora bo. Naende bakabeeka amagena amanene ase egesoero kie rikuruma, nao are goika reero iga.

english: And that day Joshua took Makkedah , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof he utterly destroyed , them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain : and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua akaumokera na kobwata omochie o Makeda, agaita na gosiria nemioro abanto bonsi pi abarenge imeo, amo nomorwoti obo. Onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Agakora omorwoti o Makeda buna akorete omorwoti o Yeriko.

english: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him, unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Makeda, bakagenda korwania Libuna.

english: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omurwoti o Yerusalemu, agatoma abanto gochia ase Hohamu, omorwoti o Heburoni, na Piramu, omorwoti o Yarimuti, na Yafia, omorwoti o Lakisi, na Debiri, omorwoti bw’Egiloni, akabateebia,

english: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .
ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka omochie oyio amo nomorwoti oye ase amakobo ’Abaisraeli. Bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi pi b’omochie oyio; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Naende agakora omorwoti bw’aroro buna akorete omorwoti o Yeriko.

english: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him, unto Lachish , and encamped against it, and fought against it:
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaimoka amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Libuna, bakagenda Lakisi, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.

english: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel , which took it on the second day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah .
ekegusii: Na Omonene akabeeka Lakisi ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, erio bakayobwata rituko ria kabere, bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi b’omochie, buna bakorete agwo Libuna.

english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish ; and Joshua smote him and his people , until he had left him none remaining .
ekegusii: Erio Horamu, omorwoti o Geseri, agatiira gokonya Lakisi, korende Yoshua akamoita ere amo nabarwani baye; onde tatigarete ore moyo.

english: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Lakisi, bakagenda Egiloni, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.

english: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .
ekegusii: Rituko erio erio bakayobwata, bagaita nemioro abanto b’aroro, buna bakorete omochie o Lakisi.

english: And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him, unto Hebron ; and they fought against it:
ekegusii: Korwa Egiloni Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira, bagaika Heburoni bayorwanie.

english: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword , and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining , according to all that he had done to Eglon ; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
ekegusii: Bakayobwata na bagaita nemioro omorwoti oye na kera omonto bw’omochie oyio amo nabwo b’emechie ende yarenge ang’e Yoshua agasiria omochie oyio kegima, buna akorete omochie bw’Egiloni; tatigete nonya noyomo abe moyo.

english: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him, to Debir ; and fought against it:
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Debiri, akaumokera omochie oyio.

english: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .
ekegusii: Akayobwata amo nomorwoti oye na emechie yonsi yarenge ang’e. Bagaita nemioro abanto abarenge imeo, tibatigaretie nonya noyomo abe moyo. Agakora omochie o Debiri na omorwoti bw’aroro buna akorete omochie o Heburoni, na omochie o Libuna, na abarwoti b’emechie eyio.

english: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .
ekegusii: “Tiira gocha aa, monkonye, torwanie Abagibeoni, ekiagera barabwo bakorire omorembe na kobwatana na Yoshua na Abaisraeli.”

english: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills , and of the south , and of the vale , and of the springs , and all their kings : he left none remaining , but utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the LORD God of Israel commanded .
ekegusii: Naboigo Yoshua akaira ense eria engima. Akabua na goita abarwoti bonsi b’ense y’ebitunwa, na eye Negebu, na ey’omwenya, na ey’ebitirimboko. Agaita abanto bonsi pi, tatigaretie nonya noyomo, buna achigetwe n’Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .
ekegusii: Yoshua akabua abanto bonsi korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea goika Gasa, na akaira ense yonsi ya Goseni goika Gibeoni.

english: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time , because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel .
ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akabua abarwoti abwo bonsi, ne chinse chiabo, ase engaki eyemo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo arwanerete Abaisraeli.

english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites , the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jarmuth , the king of Lachish , the king of Eglon , gathered themselves together , and went up , they and all their hosts , and encamped before Gibeon , and made war against it.
ekegusii: Erio abarwoti abwo batano b’Abaamori: oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bagasangererekana amo, bagatiira amo nabarwani babo bonsi, bagaetanana Gibeoni na koyoumokera.

english: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants ; come up to us quickly , and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
ekegusii: Erio Abagibeoni bagatoma abanto ase Yoshua agwo Giligali ase atoorete komoteebia, “Tototiga intwe abasomba bao! Ayerera, otiire gocha aa, otokonye na gototooria, ekiagera abarwoti bonsi b’Abaamori, abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, basangererekanire gotorwania.”

english: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal , he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour .
ekegusii: Ase igo Yoshua na abarwani baye bonsi amo ne chituoni chi’esegi bagatiira korwa Giligali.

english: And the LORD said unto Joshua , Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Tobairoka, nabekire abanto aba ase okoboko kwao, onde tari oranyare gokobua.”

english: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
ekegusii: Obotuko obogima Yoshua agataara korwa Giligali, akaumokera Abaamori mobosokano.

english: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,
ekegusii: Yabini, omorwoti o Hasori, akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Yobabu, omorwoti o Madoni, na ase abarwoti ba Simuroni na ase Akisafu,

english: And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua akairana gochia Hasori, akayobwata, agaita omorwoti bw’aroro n’omoro. (Engaki eria Hasori nigo orenge omochie omonene bw’amarwoti aria onsi).

english: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword , utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe : and he burnt Hazor with fire .
ekegusii: Bagaita bonsi abarenge ase omochie oyio ime, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.

english: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them, did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded .
ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akaira emechie yonsi y’abarwoti baria, na abarwoti abanyene amo na bonsi abarengeo akabaita nemioro, akabasiria kegima, buna Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya achiikire.

english: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength , Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibasambete emechie eyio yaagachetwe ase ebigoro igoro, otatiga Hazori bwoka, noro Yoshua asambete.

english: And all the spoil of these cities , and the cattle , the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword , until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagasakora ebinto bionsi bi’emechie eyio, ne chitugo chionsi bakaira chikaba echiabo. Korende bagaita abanto bonsi nemioro, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo.

english: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua ; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achigete Musa, omosomba oye, naboigo Musa achigete Yoshua. Na Yoshua agakora ayio onsi, tatigete kende gionsi ase ayio onsi Omonene achigete Musa. Yoshua okoira ense eria

english: So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country , and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain , and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same;
ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima: Ense y’ebitunwa, na Negebu engima, na ense yonsi ya Goseni, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, amo nebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli na ense omweya y’aroro.

english: Even from the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir , even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon : and all their kings he took , and smote them, and slew them.
ekegusii: Akaira ense eria yonsi gochakeera egetunwa kia Halaki agwo Irianyi, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu na goikera Baali‐Gadi agwo sugusu ase ebate ya Lebanoni, inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni. Agoosa abarwoti bonsi b’agwo, akabaaka na kobaita.

english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .
ekegusii: Yoshua konya obeire okorwania abarwoti abwo ase engaki entambe.

english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
ekegusii: Omochie onde tori, nonya noyomo, okorete omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, otatiga Gibeoni ase Abahivi bamenyete. Emechie ende yonsi nigo yabuetwe ase esegi eria.

english: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains , and of the plains south of Chinneroth , and in the valley , and in the borders of Dor on the west ,
ekegusii: na ase abarwoti bamenyete sugusu, ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, Irianyi ya Galili, na ase ense omweya amo nabwo b’engegu, ang’e na Dori, ensemo ya bosongo.

english: And at that time came Joshua , and cut off the Anakims from the mountains , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel : Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yoshua akagenda gosiria Abanaki, abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Heburoni, na Debiri, na Anabu, na ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bi ’Abayuda na ebi’Abaisraeli, Yoshua akabasiria kegima amo nemechie yabo.

english: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
ekegusii: Abanaki bande tibatigarete ase ense y’Abaisraeli nonya noyomo. Ase Gati, na Asidodi nao bake batigarete.

english: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the LORD said unto Moses ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Akayea Abaisraeli ebe omwando obo, akayiatananera kera egesaku ensemo yaye. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe etari nesegi.

english: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west , and to the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Jebusite in the mountains , and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh .
ekegusii: Naboigo agatoma amang’ana ase Abakanaani ba moocha na bosongo, ase Abaamori na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi ase ense y’ebitunwa, amo n’Abahivi abamenyete ang’e na Herimoni, egetunwa gi’ense ya Misipa.

english: And they went out , they and all their hosts with them, much people , even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude , with horses and chariots very many .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha nabarwani babo bonsi, omoganda bw’abaanto abange buna omokenye bw’engegu y’enyancha. Nigo barenge ne chibarasi ne chigari chinyinge mono.

english: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .
ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bakagenda bagatoora amo, ang’e ne chinsoko chia Meromu, ase okorwania Abaisraeli.

english: And the LORD said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Toiroka abanto aba, ekiagera ankio, engaki buna eye, nimbarue bonsi bakwe ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli. Nainwe monache chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e na mosambe chigari chiabo nomorero.”

english: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly ; and they fell upon them.
ekegusii: Yoshua amo nabarwani baye bonsi bakabachiera mobosokano, bakabarwania agwo Meromu, ase chinsoko chiarenge.

english: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth-maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward ; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining .
ekegusii: Na Omonene akababeeka ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaumokera na kobaseria gochia Sidoni, omochie omonene, na Misirefoti‐Maimu, na goika ebate ya Misipa, ensemo ya moocha. Bakabaita; monto tatigara nonya noyomo.

english: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses , and burnt their chariots with fire .
ekegusii: Yoshua akabakora buna Omonene amochigeete; akanacha chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e agasamba chigari chiabo nomorero.

english: The king of Jerusalem , one ; the king of Hebron , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni,

english: The king of Jarmuth , one ; the king of Lachish , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi,

english: The king of Eglon , one ; the king of Gezer , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo bw’Egiloni, na oyo o Geseri,

english: The king of Debir , one ; the king of Geder , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Debiri, na oyo o Gederi,

english: The king of Hormah , one ; the king of Arad , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Horima, na oyo bw’Aradi,

english: The king of Libnah , one ; the king of Adullam , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Libuna, na oyo bw’Adulamu,

english: The king of Makkedah , one ; the king of Beth-el , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Makeda, na oyo o Beteli,

english: The king of Tappuah , one ; the king of Hepher , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Tapua, na oyo o Heferi,

english: The king of Aphek , one ; the king of Lasharon , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo bw’Afeki, na oyo o Lasaroni,

english: The king of Madon , one ; the king of Hazor , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Madoni, na oyo o Hasori,

english: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon ;
ekegusii: Oyomo obo nere Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori. Ere nigo amenyete Hesiboni, akagamba korwa Aroeri ore ensinyo ye rigoko ri’Arinoni, na korwa gati‐gati ye rigoko riria goika orooche rwa Yaboki, orore ribebe ri’Abaamoni. Ense eyio nekeng’ese kia Gileadi.

english: The king of Shimron-meron , one ; the king of Achshaph , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Simuroni‐Meroni, na oyo bw’Akisafu,

english: The king of Taanach , one ; the king of Megiddo , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Taanaki, na oyo o Megido

english: The king of Kedesh , one ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Kedesi, na oyo o Yokinamu, ang’e na Karimeli,

english: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor , one ; the king of the nations of Gilgal , one ;
ekegusii: na oyo o Dori, ase orogongo rwa Dori, na oyo o Goimu ase Giligali,

english: The king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty and one .
ekegusii: na oyo o Tirisa. Abarwoti abwo bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato nomo (31).

english: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth-jeshimoth ; and from the south , under Ashdoth-pisgah :
ekegusii: Naende akaba okogamba ase rikura ria Yorodani, moocha y’enyancha ya Galili goika Beti‐Yesimoti, ensemo ya moocha y’Enyancha y’omonyoo + 12:3 Enyancha y’omonyo: Enyancha ekwete , eyere ase orogongo rwa Araba + 12:3 Araba: Ense ya Mediterania: , gochia Irianyi goika ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.

english: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,
ekegusii: Naende bakabua Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, oyorenge oyomo bw’Abarefai abwo batigarete. Ere nigo amenyete ase Asitaroti na Edirei,

english: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salcah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .
ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase egetunwa kia Herimoni, na ase Saleka, na ase Basani engima goika orobebe rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka, amo nekeng’ese kende kia Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.

english: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions ;
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabua na goita abarwoti bonsi abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodani, gochakera Baali‐Gadi ase ebate ya Lebanoni goikera egetunwa kia Halaki, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu. Yoshua agaatananera kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli ense eria ekaba eyabo.

english: In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :
ekegusii: Ense eria ekabwaterania ense y’ebitunwa, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, na ebitirimboko bi’ebitunwa, amo nerooro, na Negebu, na ense y’Abahiti, na ey’Abaamori, na ey’Abakanaani, na ey’Abaperisi, na ey’Abahivi, na ey’Abayebusi. Abarwoti abwo babuetwe nabwo aba:

english: The king of Jericho , one ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth-el , one ;
ekegusii: Omoruoto o Yeriko, na oyo bwa Ai, ang’e na Beteli,

english: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years ; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years , and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed .
ekegusii: Bono Yoshua konya ogotire mono. Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye bono kwagotire mono, korende ensemo enene y’ense netigarete etarairwa.

english: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , unto the border of the children of Ammon ;
ekegusii: amo nemechie yonsi ya Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogambera Hesiboni, goikera orogongo rw’Abaamoni.

english: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salcah ;
ekegusii: Naende ekabwaterania Gileadi na orogongo rw’Abagesuri na orw’Abamaaka, amo negetunwa gionsi kia Herimoni, na Basani yonsi goika Saleka,

english: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan , which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei , who remained of the remnant of the giants : for these did Moses smite , and cast them out .
ekegusii: na ime ase Basani oborwoti bwonsi bwa Ogi, oyo orenge kogambera Asitaroti na Edirei. (Ogi nere oyo otigarete korwa ase Abarefai.) Abwo Musa konya abuire na kobaseria.

english: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaseretie Abagesuri na Abamaaka: barabwo nigo bamenyete ase egati y’Abaisraeli goika reero iga.

english: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families .
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni ensemo y’ense kobwatekana n’enyomba yabo.

english: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba ;
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie omochie bw’Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, amo nomochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko, na ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, yaetanaine Medeba,

english: Heshbon , and all her cities that are in the plain ; Dibon , and Bamoth-baal , and Beth-baal-meon ,
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na emechie yonsi ase ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu; Diboni, na Bamoti‐Baali, na Beti‐Baali‐Meoni;

english: And Jahazah , and Kedemoth , and Mephaath ,
ekegusii: Yahasi na Kedemoti, na Mefaati;

english: And Kirjathaim , and Sibmah , and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley ,
ekegusii: Kiriataimu, na Sibuma, na Sereti‐Sahari, oyore ase ekegoro kie rigoko;

english: This is the land that yet remaineth : all the borders of the Philistines , and all Geshuri ,
ekegusii: Chinsemo chiatigaire nachio echi: Chinsemo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, na ense yonsi y’Abagesuri.

english: And Beth-peor , and Ashdoth-pisgah , and Beth-jeshimoth ,
ekegusii: Beti‐Peori amo nebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga, na Beti‐Yesimoti;

english: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .
ekegusii: emechie yonsi y’ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, na oborwoti bwonsi bwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio konya ogambeire Hesiboni. Musa konya omobuire ere amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamidiani: Evi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Abwo bonsi barenge kogamba inse ya Sihoni bamenyete ase ense eria.

english: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
ekegusii: Baalamu, omoringoria, mosinto o Beori, nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo Abaisraeli baitete nemioro.

english: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof.
ekegusii: Orooche rwa Yorodani nigo rwarenge orobebe rwa bosongo rw’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Rubeni. Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni, ekaba omwando obo.

english: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad , even unto the children of Gad according to their families .
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ensemo y’ense eria ebe omwando obo.

english: And their coast was Jazer , and all the cities of Gilead , and half the land of the children of Ammon , unto Aroer that is before Rabbah ;
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Yaeseri na emechie yonsi ya Gileadi, na ekeng’ese gi’ense y’Abaamoni goika Aroeri, oyore moocha ya Raba,

english: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh , and Betonim ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir ;
ekegusii: na ense korwa Hesiboni goika Ramati‐Misipa na Betonimu, na korwa Mahanaimu goika orobebe rwa Debiri.

english: And in the valley , Beth-aram , and Beth-nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .
ekegusii: Ase riranya + 13:27 Riranya: Engencho yaye Rikura ria Yorodani orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Beti‐Haramu na Beti‐Nimura, na Sukoti, na Safoni, na ensemo eye yatigarete ey’oborwoti bwa Sihoni o Hesiboni. Orooche rwa Yorodani narwo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo gochia sugusu goika enyancha ya Galili.

english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ebe omwando obo. Orogongo rw’ Egesaku kia Manase

english: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo y’ense eyio, koreng’ana ne’nka yabo.

english: From Sihor , which is before Egypt , even unto the borders of Ekron northward , which is counted to the Canaanite : five lords of the Philistines ; the Gazathites , and the Ashdothites , the Eshkalonites , the Gittites , and the Ekronites ; also the Avites :
ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakeera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw’Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng’a ney’Abakanaani. Abagaambi batano b’Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y’Abaavi,

english: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwachakerete Mahanaimu, na nigo rwabwateranetie Basani engima oborwoti bwonsi bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo nemechie yonsi emerongo etano nomo ya Yairi agwo Basani.

english: And half Gilead , and Ashtaroth , and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie naende ekeng’ese kia Gileadi amo n’Asitaroti, na Edirei, emechie emenene y’oborwoti bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Eyio nigo yarwetwe ase kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ekaba omwando obo.

english: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
