ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Musa aatananete agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

english: From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :
ekegusii: na gochia Irianyi ense yonsi y’Abakanaani, korwa Meara eyare kogamberwa n’Abasidoni, goika Afeki na goika orobebe rw’Abaamori;

english: And the land of the Giblites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrising , from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath .
ekegusii: ense y’Abagebali amo na Lebanoni yonsi gochia moocha, na korwa Baali‐Gadi inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni goika enchera ekogenda Hamati.

english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,
ekegusii: Ase igo bono atanana ense eye ase egati y’ebisaku kianda amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ebe omwando obo.” Chingongo chia Rubeni, na Gadi, na Manase, moocha ya Yorodani

english: From Aroer , that is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon ;
ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

english: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance to them.
ekegusii: Echi nachio chingongo Abaisraeli baatananeretwe ase ense ya Kaanani, chibe emiando yabo. Eleazari, Omokuani, amo na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli bakabaatananera ense ase ogoaka obomera.

english: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years , even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses , while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness : and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old .
ekegusii: Bono rora, emiaka emerongo ene, na etano, yaetire korwa rituko riri’Omonene atebeetie Musa amang’ana ayio, ase engaki eria Abaisraeli baetete ase erooro, n’Omonene ondendire ngendererete koba moyo. Na bono, rora, nabeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano,

english: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war , both to go out , and to come in .
ekegusii: na inche nigo inde ne chinguru ching’ana buna chiria nabwate rituko riria Musa antomete. Nonya ndero nabo inde ne chinguru chi’okogenda korwana esegi na echi’okoirana.

english: Now therefore give me this mountain , whereof the LORD spake in that day ; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced : if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out , as the LORD said .
ekegusii: Ase igo, bono ing’a ense eye y’ebitunwa, eye Omonene andierete eira ase rituko riria ng’a nang’e. Nkwaigwete aye omonyene ng’a Abanaki nigo bamenyeteo, na buna emechie yabo yarenge emenene, naende yagiteire chindwaki. Aande nab’Omonene arabe amo nainche, erinde imbaserie, buna Omonene ateebete.”

english: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agasesenia Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akamoa omochie o Heburoni okaba omwando oye.

english: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day , because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel .
ekegusii: Naboigo Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akaegwa Heburoni, okaba omwando oye. Nonya ndero iga ororeria rwaye narwo royobwate, ekiagera ere aigwerete Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.

english: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .
ekegusii: Kare Heburoni nigo orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Ariba. Ariba nigo arenge omonto omonene ase Abanaki. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe, etari nesegi.

english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yusufu nigo rwarenge ebisaku bibere: Manase na Efraimu. Abalawi tibaetwe orogongo, otatiga baetwe emechie bakomenya, amo nebitii ase chitugo chiabo chiare korisia na ase baare kobeeka ebinto biabo.

english: As the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .
ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baatananete ense ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene achigete Musa. Kalebu okoegwa Heburoni

english: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt : but I wholly followed the LORD my God .
ekegusii: Abanto baria twagendete komo bakagera abanto bakerusia moyo, korende inche nkaba omwegenwa ase okoigwera Omonene, Nyasae one.

english: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .
ekegusii: Chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiaetwe orogongo rwabo ase ensemo ya Irianyi, ang’e norobebe rwa Edomu, ase erooro ya Sini ere Irianyi kegima.

english: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir , and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim , which is Chesalon , on the north side , and went down to Beth-shemesh , and passed on to Timnah :
ekegusii: rogaetanana bosongo ya Baala gochia egetunwa gia Edomu, naende sugusu y’egetunwa kia Yearimu (nakio Kesaloni), na maate gochia Beti‐Semesi na rokabwatia Timuna.

english: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .
ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera gochia sugusu ase egetunwa gi’Ekironi, rokaonchoka gochia Sikironi, rokabwatia egetunwa kia Baala, naende rogaika Yabuneli, na omoerio rogaika Enyancha Enene,

english: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .
ekegusii: eyarenge orobebe rwa bosongo. Abanto be chiamate chia Yuda nabwo bamenyete ase orogongo orwo. Kalebu okobua Heburoni na Debiri

english: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .
ekegusii: Kalebu agaseria abanto batato b’ororeria rw’Anaki korwa ase omochie oyio. Abanaki abwo nabwo aba: Sesai, na Ahimani, na Talimai.

english: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo agatiira kogenda korwania abanto ba Debiri. (Kare omochie oyio nigo ore korokwa Kiriati‐Seferi).

english: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
ekegusii: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, momura omwabo Kalebu, akaira omochie oyio, na Kalebu akamoa omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

english: And it came to pass, as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass ; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
ekegusii: Ekero Asika achete bw’Otinieli, akamobooria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Asika akaayerera goika korwa ase etigere igoro. Erio Kalebu akamobooria, “Inki otagete?”

english: Who answered , Give me a blessing ; for thou hast given me a south land ; give me also springs of water . And he gave her the upper springs , and the nether springs .
ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa ntagete, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ong’e chinsoko chi’amaache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate. Emechie y’Abayuda

english: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea , from the bay that looketh southward :
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ensemo ya Irianyi,

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda.

english: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,
ekegusii: Emechie yabo eyarenge ensinyo kegima ya Irianyi ang’e norobebe rw’Edomu, nigo yarenge: Kabuseli, na Ederi, na Yaguri,

english: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,
ekegusii: Na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,

english: And Kedesh , and Hazor , and Ithnan ,
ekegusii: na Kedesi, na Hazori, na Itinani,

english: Ziph , and Telem , and Bealoth ,
ekegusii: na Sifu, na Telemu, na Bealoti,

english: And Hazor , Hadattah , and Kerioth , and Hezron , which is Hazor ,
ekegusii: na Hasori‐Hadata, na Kerioti‐Hezironi (noro Hasari),

english: Amam , and Shema , and Moladah ,
ekegusii: na Amamu, na Sema, na Molada,

english: And Hazar-gaddah , and Heshmon , and Beth-palet ,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Gada, na Hesimoni, na Beti‐Peleti,

english: And Hazar-shual , and Beer-sheba , and Bizjothjah ,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Saulo, na Beeri‐Seba, na Bisiotia,

english: Baalah , and Iim , and Azem ,
ekegusii: na Baala, na Iyimu, na Esemu,

english: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim , and passed along to Zin , and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea , and passed along to Hezron , and went up to Adar , and fetched a compass to Karkaa :
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge, na goetera Sini gochia Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea, naende rogaeta Hezironi, rogatiira gochia Adari, rokaonchoka rogaika Karika,

english: And Eltolad , and Chesil , and Hormah ,
ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Kesili, na Horima,

english: And Ziklag , and Madmannah , and Sansannah ,
ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Madimana, na Sanisana,

english: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :
ekegusii: na Lebaoti, na Silihimu, na Aini, na Rimoni, emechie emerongo ebere na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

english: And in the valley , Eshtaol , and Zoreah , and Ashnah ,
ekegusii: Ase ense omweya nero Esitaoli, na Sora, na Asina,

english: And Zanoah , and En-gannim , Tappuah , and Enam ,
ekegusii: na Sanoa, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Tapua, na Enamu,

english: Jarmuth , and Adullam , Socoh , and Azekah ,
ekegusii: na Yarimuti, na Adulamu, na Soko, na Aseka,

english: And Sharaim , and Adithaim , and Gederah , and Gederothaim ; fourteen cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Saaraimu, na Aditaimu, na Gedera, na Gederotaimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Zenan , and Hadashah , and Migdal-gad ,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Senani, na Hadasa, na Migidali‐Gadi,

english: And Dilean , and Mizpeh , and Joktheel ,
ekegusii: na Diliani, na Misipe, na Yokiteli,

english: Lachish , and Bozkath , and Eglon ,
ekegusii: na Lakisi, na Bosikati, na Egiloni,

english: From thence it passed toward Azmon , and went out unto the river of Egypt ; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea : this shall be your south coast .
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Asimoni rokabwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri goika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orobebe rw’Abayuda, ensemo ya Irianyi.

english: And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,
ekegusii: na Kaboni, na Lamasi, na Kitilisi,

english: And Gederoth , Beth-dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah ; sixteen cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Gederoti, na Beti‐Dagoni, na Naama, na Makeda, emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Libnah , and Ether , and Ashan ,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Libuna, na Eteri, na Asani,

english: And Jiphtah , and Ashnah , and Nezib ,
ekegusii: na Yifuta, na Asina, na Nesibu,

english: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah ; nine cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Keila, na Akisibu, na Maresa, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Ekron , with her towns and her villages :
ekegusii: Norengeo Ekironi, amo nemechie na ebichie biaye;

english: From Ekron even unto the sea , all that lay near Ashdod , with their villages :
ekegusii: na korwa Ekironi gochia Enyancha Enene emechie yonsi yarengeo ensemo y’Asidodi, amo nebichie biaye.

english: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof:
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Asidoli na Gasa amo nemechie na ebichie biabo, goika orooche orore orobebe rwa Misiri, naende goika engegu y’Enyancha Enene.

english: And in the mountains , Shamir , and Jattir , and Socoh ,
ekegusii: Na ase ense y’ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,

english: And Dannah , and Kirjath-sannah , which is Debir ,
ekegusii: na Dana, na Kiriati‐Sana (noro Debiri),

english: And the east border was the salt sea , even unto the end of Jordan . And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan :
ekegusii: Orobebe rwa moocha nigo rwabwatetie Enyancha y’omonyoo goika ensemo yaye ya sugusu ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Orobebe rwa sugusu nigo rwachakerete aroro,

english: And Anab , and Eshtemoh , and Anim ,
ekegusii: na Anabu, na Esitemoa, na Animu,

english: And Goshen , and Holon , and Giloh ; eleven cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Goseni, na Holoni, na Gilo, emechie ikomi nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Arabu, na Duma, na Esani,

english: And Janum , and Beth-tappuah , and Aphekah ,
ekegusii: na Yanumu, na Beti‐Tapua, na Afeka,

english: And Humtah , and Kirjath-arba , which is Hebron , and Zior ; nine cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Humuta, na Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), na Sihori, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Maon , Carmel , and Ziph , and Juttah ,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Maoni, na Karimeli, na Sifu, na Yuta,

english: And Jezreel , and Jokdeam , and Zanoah ,
ekegusii: na Yesireeli, na Yokidamu, na Sanoa,

english: Cain , Gibeah , and Timnah ; ten cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Kaini, na Gibea, na Timuna, emechie ikomi, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Halhul , Beth-zur , and Gedor ,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Halihuli, na Beti‐Suri, na Gedori,

english: And Maarath , and Beth-anoth , and Eltekon ; six cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Maarati, na Beti‐Anoti, na Elitekoni, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

english: And the border went up to Beth-hogla , and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Beti‐Hogila, rogaeta sugusu ya Beti‐Araba. Erio rogaika Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,

english: Kirjath-baal , which is Kirjath-jearim , and Rabbah ; two cities with their villages :
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), na Raba, emechie ebere, amo nebichie biabo. Kiriati Yearimu|alt="Kiriath Jearim" src="HK-020C.TIF" size="col" loc="Joshua 15:21-62" copy="Horace Knowles" ref="15:60"

english: In the wilderness , Beth-arabah , Middin , and Secacah ,
ekegusii: Na aria ase erooro nigo yarengeo: Beti‐Araba, na Midini, na Sekaka,

english: And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En-gedi ; six cities with their villages .
ekegusii: na Nibusani, na Omochie bw’Omonyoo, na Eni‐Gedi, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

english: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that is before the going up to Adummim , which is on the south side of the river : and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh , and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel :
ekegusii: na rokagenda korwa ebate eria y’Akori goika Debiri, naende rokaonchoka sugusu gochia Giligali kororia Adumini, Irianyi y’ebate eria. Naende rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi rogaika ase ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli. Erio rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi, na goika ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli.

english: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite ; the same is Jerusalem : and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward :
ekegusii: Erio rokagenderera gochia rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, Irianyi y’egetunwa kia Yebusi, nao Yerusalemu. Magega y’ayio rogatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ekio kerochie Rikura ria Hinomu, ensemo ya bosongo, sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu.

english: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath-jearim :
ekegusii: Korwa egetunwa igoro orobebe rogatirimboka gochia ensoko ya Nefitoa, na korwa agwo rogaikera emechie ang’e negetunwa gia Efuroni. Agwo rokaonchoka gochia Baala, (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu),

english: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho , unto the water of Jericho on the east , to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el ,
ekegusii: Orobebe rw’orogongo roria obomera bwagwerete ororeria rwa Yusufu rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, ang’e na Yeriko, moocha ye chinsoko chi’aroro goika erooro, rogatiira korwa Yeriko goetera ase erooro gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli.

english: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz , and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth ,
ekegusii: Korwa Beteli rokagenda Lusu, rogatiira gochia Ataroti ase Abaariki bamenyete.

english: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
ekegusii: Erio rogatirimboka gochia ase ense y’Abayafeleti goika Beti‐Horoni ya maate, na goika Geseri, naende rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.

english: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .
ekegusii: Orogongo orwo narwo omwando bw’ebisaku bia Manase na Efraimu, ebi’ororeria rwa Yusufu.

english: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar , unto Beth-horon the upper ;
ekegusii: Oro narwo orogongo rwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Efraimu: Orobebe rwabo rwa moocha rogaachakeera Ataroti‐Adari, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro,

english: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side ; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh , and passed by it on the east to Janohah ;
ekegusii: na korwa aroro goika Enyancha Enene + 16:6 Enyancha enene: Enyancha ya Mediterania . Mikimetati noro orenge orobebe rw’ensemo ya sugusu. Korwa Mikimetati orobebe rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rogaika Taanati‐Silo, rogaeta ase omochie oyio, rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Yanoa.

english: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth , and to Naarath , and came to Jericho , and went out at Jordan .
ekegusii: Korwa Yanoa rogatirimboka gochia Ataroti na Naara, erio rogatwomera Yeriko, na korwa aroro rogaika Yorodani.

english: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah ; and the goings out thereof were at the sea . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families .
ekegusii: Korwa Tapua rokagenderera gochia bosongo, rogaika akarooche ga Kana, naende rogaika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orogongo chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Efraimu chianyorete, rokaba omwando obo,

english: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
ekegusii: amo nemechie na ebichie barabwo baatananeretwe, ebiarenge ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.

english: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .
ekegusii: Orogongo oro narwo rwaetwe egesaku kia Manase, omwana omomura omotangi o Yusufu ase ogoakerwa obomera, Makiri, ise Gileadi, nigo arenge omwana omomura omotangi o Manase. Ororeria rwaye rokaegwa Gileadi na Basani, ekiagera Makiri nigo arenge omonto etuoni y’esegi.

english: Southward it was Ephraim’s , and northward it was Manasseh’s , and the sea is his border ; and they met together in Asher on the north , and in Issachar on the east .
ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi nense y’Efraimu, na ensemo ya sugusu neya Manase yarenge. Enyancha Enene nero yarenge orobebe rwabo ensemo ya bosongo. Ensemo ya sugusu bagasinyana nabaanto b’Aseri, na ensemo ya moocha naba Isakaru.

english: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns , and Ibleam and her towns , and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns , and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns , and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns , even three countries .
ekegusii: Ase orogongo rwa Isakaru na orw’Aseri Manase akaegwa Beti‐Sehani, na Ibileamu, amo nebichie biabo. Naende akaegwa abanto ba Dori, na Eni‐Dori, na Taanaki, na Megido, amo nebichie b’emechie eyio, na Nafati, ensemo ya gatato.

english: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute ; but did not utterly drive them out .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babete ne chinguru kobua bakaa Abakaanani baria emeremo emekong’u, korende tibaabaseretie kegima.

english: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua , saying , Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit , seeing I am a great people , forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto ?
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu bagakwana na Yoshua, bakamoteebia, “Nase ki gwatoeire ensemo eyemo yoka ebe omwando oito? Intwe nigo tore abanto abange, ekiagera Omonene otosesenirie.”

english: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
ekegusii: Yoshua akabairaneria, “Onye more abange igo, na ensemo y’ebitunwa bi’Efraimu tebaisaini, tiira gochia rinani, morirabie, na momenye aroro ase ense y’Abaperisi na ey’Abarefai.”

english: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria, “Ense eria y’ebitunwa tegotoisana, na Abakanaani abamenyete ase ense omweya nigo babwate chigari chi’ebioma, abwo bamenyete Beti‐Sehani na ebichie bire inse yabo, amo nabwo bamenyete ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli boigo.”

english: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only:
ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto b’ebisaku bi’Efraimu na Manase (abw’ororeria rwa Yusufu), “Amaene, inwe nabaanto abange more, naende nigo more ne chinguru. Ase ayio, ensemo eyemo yoka tekobaisana ase okomenya.

english: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood , and thou shalt cut it down : and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites , though they have iron chariots , and though they be strong .
ekegusii: Ense y’ebitunwa nabo erabe eyaino. Nonya ere ne rinani, genda moyerabie, moyeire engima ebe eyaino, korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende. Goika moserie Abakanaani korwa aroro nonya babwate chigari chi’ebioma, naende bare ne chinguru.”

english: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa chingongo chiabo. Aba nabwo barenge b’ororeria rw’Abieseri na Heleki, na Asirieli, na Sekemu, na Heferei, na Shemida. Aba nabwo abamura b’ororeria rwa Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, naende barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.

english: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
ekegusii: Korende Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase, taiborete abana abamura, otatiga abaiseke boka. Amarieta ’abaiseke aba naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

english: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan ;
ekegusii: Ase igo abanto ba Manase bakaegwa chinsemo ikomi, amo nense eria ya Gileadi, na Basani, ng’umbu ya Yorodani,

english: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead .
ekegusii: ekiagera abaiseke abwo b’ororeria rwa Manase nigo baetwe omwando ase egati y’abamura b’orororeria rwaye. Abana bande b’ororeria rwa Manase konya baeirwe ense ya Gileadi.

english: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah , that lieth before Shechem ; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah .
ekegusii: Orogongo rwa Manase rogaachakera Aseri, rogaika Mikemetati, moocha ya Sekemu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi ase abanto b’Eni‐Tapua.

english: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim ;
ekegusii: (Ense ya Tapua neya Manase yarenge, korende omochie o Tapua, ase orobebe rwa Manase, okaegwa Efraimu.)

english: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah , southward of the river : these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh : the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river , and the outgoings of it were at the sea :
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rogatirimboka gochia akarooche ga Kana. Emechie yarenge Irianyi y’akarooche aka neya Efraimu, nonya yarenge ase orogongo rwa Manase. Orobebe rwa Manase rokagenderera goika sugusu y’akarooche, rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.

english: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babuete ense eria, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, na agwo bagatenenia Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
ekegusii: Yoshua akabaakera obomera ase okobori’Omonene aria Silo, agaatananera Abaisraeli ense eyio, kera egesaku ensemo yaye. Orogongo rw’egesaku kia Benjamini

english: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families : and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph .
ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini. Orogongo rwabo rokaba egati y’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Yuda na orw’ekia Yusufu.

english: And their border on the north side was from Jordan ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven .
ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rwabo rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, rogatiira gochia egetirimboko sugusu ya Yeriko, naende gochia bosongo goetera ense y’ebitunwa, rogaika erooro ya Beti‐Aveni.

english: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth-el , southward ; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon .
ekegusii: Na korwa aroro rokagenderera goika ebitirimboko bia Lusu (noro Beteli), rogatirimboka goika Ataroti Adari ase egetunwa kere, Irianyi ya Beti‐Horoni maate.

english: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward , from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward ; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal , which is Kirjath-jearim , a city of the children of Judah : this was the west quarter .
ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia Irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.

english: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim , and the border went out on the west , and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah :
ekegusii: Orobebe rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ensinyo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, rokagenderera gochia ensemo ya bosongo, rogaika ase chinsoko chia Nefitoa.

english: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom , and which is in the valley of the giants on the north , and descended to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of Jebusi on the south , and descended to En-rogel ,
ekegusii: Korwa agwo rogatirimboka rogaika ensinyo y’egetunwa kerochie Rikura ria Beni‐Hinomu, rire ensemo ya sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi goetera Rikura ria Hinomu, Irianyi y’esagamo y’Abayebusi gochia Eni‐Rogeli.

english: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En-shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,
ekegusii: Naende rokagenderera gochia sugusu rogaika Eni‐Semesi, naende goika Geliloti kororia egetirimboko ki’Adumimi. Erio rogatirimboka gochia Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,

english: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward , and went down unto Arabah :
ekegusii: rogaeta sugusu y’esagamo ere igoro y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, naende rogatirimboka goika Ekerubo keria Ekiomo.

english: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa Irianyi.

english: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes , which had not yet received their inheritance .
ekegusii: Korende ebisaku bitano na bibere mbiatigarete bitatananeretwe ensemo y’ense ebe omwando obo.

english: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the coasts thereof round about , according to their families .
ekegusii: Yorodani narwo orobebe rwa moocha. Echio nachio chimbebe chiaetanaine orogongo orwo chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini chianyorete rokaba omwando obo.

english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth-hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,
ekegusii: Emechie ye chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini nigo yarenge: Yeriko, na Beti‐Hogila, na Emeki‐Kesisi,

english: And Beth-arabah , and Zemaraim , and Beth-el ,
ekegusii: na Beti‐Araba, na Semaraimu, na Beteli,

english: And Avim , and Parah , and Ophrah ,
ekegusii: na Avimu, na Para, na Ofura,

english: And Chephar-haammonai , and Ophni , and Gaba ; twelve cities with their villages :
ekegusii: na Kefari‐Amoni, na Ofuni, na Geba, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Gibeon , and Ramah , and Beeroth ,
ekegusii: Naende yarenge Gibeoni, na Rama, na Beroti,

english: And Mizpeh , and Chephirah , and Mozah ,
ekegusii: na Misipa, na Kefira, na Mosa,

english: And Rekem , and Irpeel , and Taralah ,
ekegusii: na Rekemu, na Iripeli, na Tarala,

english: And Zelah , Eleph , and Jebusi , which is Jerusalem , Gibeath , and Kirjath ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .
ekegusii: na Zela, na Elefu, na Yebusi (noro Yerusalemu), na Gibea, na Kiriati‐Yearimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo. Oyo noro orenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini.

english: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , How long are ye slack to go to possess the land , which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
ekegusii: Ase igo Yoshua agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inee! Ngoika ririri moratebaane kogenda koira ense eye Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abaeire?

english: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them, and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
ekegusii: Nchorere abanto batato korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbatome bataare ase ense engima, bayiate na kworokia ase okorika chinsemo chigwenerete koba omwando bwa kera egesaku. Erio bandetere amang’ana.

english: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .
ekegusii: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya Irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.

english: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God .
ekegusii: Morike mworokie omooroberio oyio bw’ogwaterana ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere, moyorente ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

english: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibakoegwa egetari gi’ense amo nainwe, ekiagera egetari kiabo nokomokorera Omonene ase emeremo y’obokuani. Egesaku kia Gadi, na ekia Rubeni na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase barabwo konya baeirwe omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, omwando oria Musa, omosomba Omonene, abaatananerete.”

english: And the men arose , and went away : and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land , saying , Go and walk through the land , and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh .
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda gwata ense buna Yoshua abachiigete na kobateebereria, “Genda motaare ase ense engima, mworokie ase okorika buna ense eyio ere. Erio moirane ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene aiga Silo.”

english: And the men went and passed through the land , and described it by cities into seven parts in a book , and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh .
ekegusii: Bono abanto abwo bakagenda, bagaetanana ense eria engima, bakarika ase okworokia buna bayiatete ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere kobwatekana nemechie yonsi. Erio bakairana ase Yoshua ase egetwori agwo Silo

english: And the second lot came forth to Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families : and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah .
ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y’omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

english: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families : and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid :
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatato bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rwabeete omwando obo rogaikera Saridi.

english: And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam ;
ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rwabo rogatiira gochia bosongo, rogaika Marala, rogatwomera Dabeseti ne rigoko rire moocha ya Yokinamu.

english: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,
ekegusii: Korwa Saridi rokagenderera goika Kisiloti‐Tabori, naende goika Daberati, erio rogatiira goika Yafia.

english: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher , to Ittah-kazin , and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah ;
ekegusii: Korwa agwo rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Gati‐Heferi na Eta‐Kasini, rokagenda gochia Rimoni, rokaonchoka gochia Nea.

english: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el :
ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.

english: And Kattath , and Nahallal , and Shimron , and Idalah , and Beth-lehem : twelve cities with their villages .
ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nigo biarenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Isakaru

english: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar , for the children of Issachar according to their families .
ekegusii: Obomera bwa kane bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru.

english: And their border was toward Jezreel , and Chesulloth , and Shunem ,
ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Yesireeli, na Kesuloti, na Sunemu,

english: And Hapharaim , and Shion , and Anaharath ,
ekegusii: na Hafaraimu, na Sihoni, na Anaharati,

english: And Rabbith , and Kishion , and Abez ,
ekegusii: na Rabiti, na Kisioni, na Ebesi,

english: And Remeth , and En-gannim , and En-haddah , and Beth-pazzez ;
ekegusii: na Remeti, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Eni‐Hada, na Beti‐Pasesi.

english: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth-shemesh ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogatwomera boigo Tabori na Sahasuma, na Beti‐Semesi, rokanacha Yorodani. Orogongo oro rokabwaterania emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities and their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate ch’egesaku gia Isakaru. Orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Aseri

english: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families .
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.

english: And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Helikati, na Hali, na Beteni, na Akisafu,

english: And Alammelech , and Amad , and Misheal ; and reacheth to Carmel westward , and to Shihor-libnath ;
ekegusii: na Alameleki, na Amadi, na Misali. Ensemo ya bosongo orobebe rwabo rogatwomera Karimeli na Sihori‐Libinati.

english: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,
ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense yo’mweremo o Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,

english: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon ;
ekegusii: na Eburoni, na Rehobu, na Hamoni, na Kana, rogaika Sidoni, Omochie omonene.

english: And then the coast turneth to Ramah , and to the strong city Tyre ; and the coast turneth to Hosah ; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib :
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia Rama, rogaika omochie omonene o Turo, oyogiteire chindwaki, rokaonchoka gochia Hosa, na rokanucha Enyancha Enene. Naende orogongo orwo rokabwaterania engegu y’ensemo y’Akisibu,

english: And Hazar-shual , and Balah , and Azem ,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,

english: Ummah also, and Aphek , and Rehob : twenty and two cities with their villages .
ekegusii: na Uma, na Afeki, na Rehobu, emechie emerongo ebere, na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Orogongo rw’egesaku kia Nafutali

english: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na rimo bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali.

english: And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami , Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogaachaka korwa Helefu ase Omoaluni orenge, agwo Sananimu, na korwa Adami‐Nekebu, na Yabuneli, rogaika Lakumu, rogatwomera Yorodani.

english: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia bosongo goika Asinoti‐Tabori, na korwa agwo rokagenderera goika Hukoki, rogatwomera orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni ensemo ya Irianyi, na orw’egia Aseri ensemo ya bosongo, na orw’ekia Yuda ensemo ya moocha ase Yorodani.

english: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,
ekegusii: Emechie yabo yagiteire chindwaki nero: Sidimu, na Seri, na Hamati, na Rakati, na Galili,

english: And Adamah , and Ramah , and Hazor ,
ekegusii: na Adama, na Rama, na Hasori,

english: And Kedesh , and Edrei , and En-hazor ,
ekegusii: na Kedesi na Edirei, na Eni‐Hasori,

english: And Iron , and Migdal-el , Horem , and Beth-anath , and Beth-shemesh ; nineteen cities with their villages .
ekegusii: na Yironi, na Migidali‐Eli, na Horemu, na Beti‐Anati, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie ikomi na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Dani

english: And Eltolad , and Bethul , and Hormah ,
ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Betuli, na Horima,

english: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families .
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani.

english: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah , and Eshtaol , and Ir-shemesh ,
ekegusii: Omwando obo okabwaterania Sora, na Esitaoli, na Iri‐Semesi,

english: And Shaalabbin , and Ajalon , and Jethlah ,
ekegusii: na Saalabini, na Ayaloni, na Itila,

english: And Elon , and Thimnathah , and Ekron ,
ekegusii: na Eloni, na Timuna, na Ekironi,

english: And Eltekeh , and Gibbethon , and Baalath ,
ekegusii: na Eliteke, na Gibetoni, na Baalati,

english: And Jehud , and Bene-berak , and Gath-rimmon ,
ekegusii: na Yehudi, na Bene‐Beraki, na Gati‐Rimoni,

english: And Me-jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border before Japho .
ekegusii: na Me‐Yarikoni, na Rakoni, amo nense erochie Yafo.

english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani. Omwando o Yoshua

english: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts , the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
ekegusii: Abaisraeli kobakoorire gwatanana ense eria ase chinsemo ao ao, bakaa Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, ensemo ase egati yabo, ebe omwando oye.

english: And Ziklag , and Beth-marcaboth , and Hazar-susah ,
ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susa,

english: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked , even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim : and he built the city , and dwelt therein.
ekegusii: Na buna Omonene achigete bakamoa omochie oria aboretie, noro Timunati‐Sera ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Erio Yoshua akaagacha omochie oria okaba omoyia, akamenya aroro.

english: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okobori’Omonene, ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y’ogwatanana ense eria.

english: And Beth-lebaoth , and Sharuhen ; thirteen cities and their villages :
ekegusii: na Beti‐Lebaoti, na Saruheni, emechie ikomi na etato, amo nebichie biabo.

english: Ain , Remmon , and Ether , and Ashan ; four cities and their villages :
ekegusii: Naende yarenge Aini, na Rimoni, na Eteri, na Asani, emechie ene, amo nebichie biabo.

english: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .
ekegusii: Amo neyio bakanyora ebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio goika Baalati‐Beeri (noro Rama‐Negebu). Oyio noro orenge bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni.

english: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon : for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
ekegusii: Omwando bw’egesaku gia Simioni nigo orenge ensemo y’oyio bw’egesaku kia Yuda, ekiagera ensemo y’egesaku kia Yuda nigo yarenge enene mono ase bare. Ayio naro agerete egesaku gia Simioni gekaegwa omwando obo korwa ase omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni

english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses’ minister , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya akuure, Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, oyio orenge omokonyi o Musa,

english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agachiika abatang’ani b’abaanto

english: Pass through the host , and command the people , saying , Prepare you victuals ; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan , to go in to possess the land , which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
ekegusii: ng’a baete egati y’ebitwori bachiike abanto ng’a beroiserie endagera, ekiagera ritang’ani amatuko atato ataraera inabamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, baire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae obo, abaeire ebe eyabo.

english: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying , The LORD your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .
ekegusii: “Inyora ring’ana riria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete ekero abateebeetie ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabae obotoereru ase ense eyio arabae momenye.

english: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them;
ekegusii: Abakungu baino na abana baino nabatigare, amo namaicho aino, ase ense eye Musa abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Inwe abanyene abamore chituoni chi’esegi goika mwamboke mobogoretie ebirwanero biaino, motang’ane abamino.

english: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .
ekegusii: Mobakoonye goika Omonene abae barabwo obotoereru, buna abaete inwe, nabarabwo mbaire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae. Erio momanye koirana ase ense yaino, eye Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani.”

english: And they answered Joshua , saying , All that thou commandest us we will do , and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Onsi ayagwatochikiire natoyakore, na aase aande onsi oratotome natogende.

english: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses .
ekegusii: Buna tware koigwera Musa, naye natokoigwere. Omonene, Nyasae oo, abe amo naye buna abeete na Musa.

english: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiiko ao na taigwa amang’ana ande onsi orachiike, goika aitwe akwe. Aye otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu!”

english: Moses my servant is dead ; now therefore arise , go over this Jordan , thou, and all this people , unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel .
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Musa, omosomba one, okuure. Imoka, bwamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, aye na Abaisraeli aba bonsi, mosoe ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.

english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river , the river Euphrates , all the land of the Hittites , and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun , shall be your coast .
ekegusii: Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachaakere erooro ya Irianyi, roikere Lebanoni ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochakeere orooche oronene rw’Eufarati, robwateranie ense yonsi y’Abahiti roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.

english: Only be thou strong and very courageous , that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law , which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left , that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest .
ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u rioka, na obe omoremu! Orende na obwate boronge amachiiko onsi aya omosomba one Musa agochigete. Tobaisa koyatiga, na koonchoka gochia aande onsi ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee; erio nario orasesenigwe aande onsi ase ogochia.

english: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth ; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night , that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous , and then thou shalt have good success .
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’egetabu eke ki’amachiiko oyakwane botambe nomonwa oo, oyairanerere omobaso na obotuko, obwate na okore onsi ayarikireo. Erio nario orasesenigwe mono ase chinchera chiao chionsi na kogenderera.

english: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
ekegusii: Inee! Tari inche nagochikiire ng’a otenene bokung’u, obe omoremu? Ase ayio, toondoka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo inde amo naye aande onsi orabe gokogenda.” Yoshua ogochika abanto

english: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bachore emechie y’obotamero, buna nabateebetie goetera ase Musa.

english: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
ekegusii: Omonto karaite omonto onde mosiabano atancheti, anyare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogwetooria korwa ase oyomwabo oria oitetwe oganetie korusia egesiomba.

english: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place , that he may dwell among them.
ekegusii: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.

english: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .
ekegusii: Onye omonto oria oganetie korusia egesiomba okomobwatia gochiao, abanto b’omochie oyio tibakorua omoiti oria ase amaboko aye, ekiagera aitete omoamate oye mosiabano, atamogechete.

english: And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment , and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days : then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .
ekegusii: Omonto oria namenye ase omochie oria goika ere arentwe bosio bw’omosangererekano agambigwe na goika Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eria akwe. Magega y’ayio arue ase omochie oria atamerete, airane nka ase omochie oye.”

english: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath-arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
ekegusii: Ase igo bagaatanana Kedesi o Galili, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Nafutali, na Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Kiriati‐Ariba (nao Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda.

english: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .
ekegusii: Ngumbu ya moocha ya Yorodani ase erooro moocha ya Yeriko, bagachora Beseri ase orogongo rwa Rubeni, na Ramoti o Gileadi, ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Gadi, na Golani o Basani ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.

english: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood , until he stood before the congregation .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero yachoretwe ebe obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abamenyi abaare ase egati yabo. Onde bwensi orenge goita omonto mosiabano atame gochia aroro, erinde taitwa noria oganetie korusia egesiomba, ataratenena ase omosangererekano amang’ana aye agambwe.

english: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest , and unto Joshua the son of Nun , and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel ;
ekegusii: Abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi bagaacha ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli,

english: Which the children of Aaron , being of the families of the Kohathites , who were of the children of Levi , had: for theirs was the first lot .
ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, eamate eyemo y’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi.

english: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda, amo namarisio aetanaineo. (Ariba nigo arenge sokoro y’Anaki.)

english: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .
ekegusii: Korende emegondo amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio konya baeire Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, bikaba omwando oye.

english: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Eye nero emechie abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni Omokuani baetwe: Heburoni, omochie oyio abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Libuna,

english: And Jattir with her suburbs , and Eshtemoa with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: na Yatiri, na Esitemoa,

english: And Holon with her suburbs , and Debir with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: na Holoni, na Debiri,

english: And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs ; nine cities out of those two tribes .
ekegusii: na Aini, na Yuta, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie kianda, amo namarisio arengeo, korwa ase ebisaku ebio bibere.

english: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Gibeoni, na Geba,

english: Anathoth with her suburbs , and Almon with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Anatoti, na Alamoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: All the cities of the children of Aaron , the priests , were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi abanto b’ororeria rwa Abakuani baetwe nigo yarenge ikomi na etato; bakayeegwa, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And the families of the children of Kohath , the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath , even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi, bakaegwa emechie korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

english: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim , to be a city of refuge for the slayer ; and Gezer with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie oyomo abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Geseri,

english: And Kibzaim with her suburbs , and Beth-horon with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Kibusaimu, na Beti‐Horoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the tribe of Dan , Eltekeh with her suburbs , Gibbethon with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Dani bakaegwa Eliteke, na Gibetoni,

english: Aijalon with her suburbs , Gath-rimmon with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Ayaloni, na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Tanach with her suburbs , and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs ; two cities .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa Taanaki na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate echio chi’Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer ; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs ; two cities .
ekegusii: Abagerisoni, chiamate chinde chi’Abalawi, bakaegwa korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Golani o Basani, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Besitera, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishon with her suburbs , Dabareh with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kisioni, na Daberati,

english: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En-gannim with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Yarimuti na Eni‐Ganimu, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the LORD , these cities and their suburbs .
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakaa Abalawi emechie gete amo namarisio arengeo korwa ase emiando yabo, koreng’ana buna Omonene achigete.

english: And out of the tribe of Asher , Mishal with her suburbs , Abdon with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Misali, na Abidoni,

english: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Helikati, na Rehobo, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer ; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs ; three cities .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi o Galili, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Hamoti‐Dori, na Karitani, emechie etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
ekegusii: Nabo abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’Abagerisoni baetwe emechie ikomi na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Abalawi abatigarete, chiamate chia Merari, bakaegwa emechie ya Yokinamu, na Karita,

english: Dimnah with her suburbs , Nahalal with her suburbs ; four cities .
ekegusii: na Dimuna, na Nahalali, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the tribe of Reuben , Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni bakaegwa Beseri, na Yahasi,

english: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities .
ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefaati, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer ; and Mahanaim with her suburbs ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti o Gileadi, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Mahanaimu,

english: Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs ; four cities in all.
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites : and the children of Aaron the priest , which were of the Levites , had by lot out of the tribe of Judah , and out of the tribe of Simeon , and out of the tribe of Benjamin , thirteen cities .
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera chiamate chi’Abakohati buna iga: Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rwa Aroni, Omokuani, bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni, na ekia Benjamini, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

english: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .
ekegusii: Nabo abanto b’eamate ya Merari, abatigarete ase chiamate chi’Abalawi, baetwe emechie ikomi na ebere, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

english: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs .
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi y’Abalawi eyarenge ase egati y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emerongo ene, na etano na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.

english: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities .
ekegusii: Kera omochie bw’eyio nigo orenge namarisio aetanaineo, Nabo arenge ase emechie eyio yonsi. Abaisraeli bakoira ense eria

english: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers ; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene akaa Abaisraeli ense eyio yonsi arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nabayee; barabwo kobayeeirwe bakamenya aroro.

english: And the LORD gave them rest round about , according to all that he sware unto their fathers : and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand .
ekegusii: Omonene akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi, buna arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana. Onde tarenge ase ababisa babo obabuete, ekiagera Omonene abegete ababisa babo bonsi ase amaboko abo.

english: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel ; all came to pass .
ekegusii: Nab’Omonene aikeranetie chiira chionsi chingiya echi abarierete Abaisraeli. Ende teri etaikeranetigwe.

english: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , and out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh , ten cities .
ekegusii: Na Abakohati abatigarete bakanyora emechie ikomi korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Efraimu na ekia Dani, na ekeng’ese kia Manase, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

english: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .
ekegusii: Abagerisoni bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru, na egi’Aseri, na ekia Nafutali, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase agwo Basani, buna obomera bwabagwerete.

english: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
ekegusii: Abamerari bakanyora emechie ikomi na ebere ase chiamate chiabo korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na egia Sabuloni.

english: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs , as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie eyio amo namarisio arengeo, ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.

english: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.

english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,

english: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan , that are in the land of Canaan , the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan , a great altar to see to .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese gi’ekia Manase baigete Yorodani mbarabare ase ensemo ya Kaanani bakaagacha aroro egesasiimero ekenene kiare kororekana korwa are.

english: And the children of Israel heard say , Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan , in the borders of Jordan , at the passage of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande bakaigwa amang’ana aya agokwanwa, “Naama! Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase baagachire egesasiimero aria Geliloti, ensemo ya bosio bw’ense ya Kaanani, ang’e na Yorodani, erochie ensemo y’Abaisraeli.”

english: And when the children of Israel heard of it , the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh , to go up to war against them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baigwete amang’ana ayio, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, erinde ogende kobarwania esegi.

english: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the half tribe of Manasseh , into the land of Gilead , Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest ,
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, gochia ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase ense ya Gileadi.

english: And with him ten princes , of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel ; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel .
ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.

english: And they came unto the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the half tribe of Manasseh , unto the land of Gilead , and they spake with them, saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo baigete ase ense ya Gileadi, ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, bagakwana nabarabwo, bakabateebia,

english: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD ? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD , that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel .
ekegusii: Inee! Na bono inwe motagete gotiga Omonene? Onye mokwanga reero koigwera Omonene, ekeene, ankio nigo arabe nekeririanda ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli.

english: Notwithstanding , if the land of your possession be unclean , then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD , wherein the LORD’s tabernacle dwelleth , and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD , nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God .
ekegusii: Onye morooche ng’a ense eye mwaeirwe ebe eyaino tegwenereti mogosasimerao, imoka mwamboke gochia ase ense y’Omonene, ase obomenyo bwaye boteneine, moegwe chingongo chiaino agwo ase egati yaito. Timobaisa kwanga koigwera Omonene, gose kwanga gotoigwera intwe ase okweagachera egesasiimero kiaino ekeao goetania eki’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered , and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel ,
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakairaneria abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabateebia,

english: The LORD God of gods , the LORD God of gods , he knoweth , and Israel he shall know ; if it be in rebellion , or if in transgression against the LORD , ( save us not this day ,)
ekegusii: “Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene! Omobui nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene. Ere namanyete aya twakorire, nainwe Abaisraeli boigo moyamanye. Onye aya twakorire akorirwe mamincha y’Omonene, gose onye titwarenge nobwegenwa asare, rirorio timogototooria reero.

english: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD , or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering , or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
ekegusii: Onye tweagacheire egesasiimero giaito intwe abanyene ase ogotiga Omonene, na onye tokoruerao ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose ogw’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, tiga Omonene omonyene atoe egesusuro.

english: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing , saying , In time to come your children might speak unto our children , saying , What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel ?
ekegusii: Taibo! Nigo twakorire aya, ekiagera twoboire ng’a gose ase engaki erache abana b’ororeria rwaino baise gocha koboria ab’orwaito: Inee! Nainwe more negetari ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?

english: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad ; ye have no part in the LORD : so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD .
ekegusii: Naki Omonene nigo akorete orooche rwa Yorodani rokaba orobebe egati yaito nainwe, inwe Abareubeni na Abagadi. Ase ayio timori negetari kende gionsi ase Omonene. Na igo abana b’ororeria rwaino mbaabaise kogera ab’orwaito tibamoiroka Omonene.

english: Therefore we said , Let us now prepare to build us an altar , not for burnt offering , nor for sacrifice :
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo twateebete: Tiga toagache egesasiimero, tari ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,

english: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings , and with our sacrifices , and with our peace offerings ; that your children may not say to our children in time to come , Ye have no part in the LORD .
ekegusii: otatiga ase okoba kirori egati yaito nainwe, na egati y’ororeria rwaito na orwaino, ng’a nigo tokomokorera Omonene ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ekeng’wanso kende amo neki’omorembe ase obosio bwaye. Aya nigo twakorire ase ogotanga abana b’ororeria rwaino tibaabaisa gocha goteebia ab’orwaito ng’a: Timori negetari ase Omonene.

english: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come , that we may say again , Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD , which our fathers made , not for burnt offerings , nor for sacrifices ; but it is a witness between us and you.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo twarengerererie ng’a: Kerabe babe bagokwana igo ase tore, gose ase abana b’ororeria rwaito, nabanyare kobairaneria: Rora, chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagachete egesasiimero keng’ana buna eki’Omonene. Eke tikeri ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende, otatiga kere kirori egati yaito nainwe.

english: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn this day from following the LORD , to build an altar for burnt offerings , for meat offerings , or for sacrifices , beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle .
ekegusii: Taibo! Ayio abe aare naintwe ng’a ntorigetie kwanga koigwera Omonene Nyasae, gose komotiga bono, ase okoagacha egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ekeng’wanso, gose korua okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, egesasiimero kere ao na keria kere bosio bw’Obomenyo bwaye.”

english: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day , but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika reero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.

english: And when Phinehas the priest , and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake , it pleased them.
ekegusii: Ekero Finehasi, Omokuani, na abatang’ani b’omoganda abwo baare abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, abaare amo nere, baigwete aya abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, amo nab’ekia Manase bakwanete, barabwo bagaisaneka.

english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the children of Manasseh , This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD : now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD .
ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, agateebia Abareubeni na Abagadi amo n’Abamanase, “Bono twamanyire ng’a Omonene nigo are ase egati yaito, ekiagera timwangete koba abegenwa ase Omonene. Igo mwatooririe Abaisraeli korwa ase egesusuro ki’Omonene.”

english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , and the princes , returned from the children of Reuben , and from the children of Gad , out of the land of Gilead , unto the land of Canaan , to the children of Israel , and brought them word again .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, na abatang’ani baria, bagatiga Abareubeni na Abagadi agwo Gileadi, bakairana gochia ase ense ya Kaanani, ase Abaisraeli, bakabairera amang’ana onsi.

english: And the thing pleased the children of Israel ; and the children of Israel blessed God , and did not intend to go up against them in battle , to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagwenera Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bagatogia Nyasae, na tibaaba bakoroberia korwania Abareubeni na Abagadi, gose gosaria ense eria bamenyete.

english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God .
ekegusii: Abareubeni na Abagadi bagateeba, “Egesasiimero eke nkirori egati yaito nainwe ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae”, na igo bagakeroka “Kirori”.

english: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren , as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents , and unto the land of your possession , which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan .
ekegusii: Bono Omonene, Nyasae oino, oeire abamino obotoereru, buna abarierete eira. Ase igo, bono irana ase chinka chiaino, ase ense eria mwanyorire ebe omwando oino, eria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

english: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law , which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God , and to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul .
ekegusii: Morende mono na koigwera amachiiko aya Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete; mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na motaare ase chinchera chiaye chionsi. Moigwere amachiiko aye, mobe abegenwa asare, na momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.”

english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away : and they went unto their tents .
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akabasesenia, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda chinka chiabo.

english: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan : but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward . And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents , then he blessed them,
ekegusii: (Musa konya oeire ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase orogongo agwo Basani, na ekeng’ese kende Yoshua agakea orogongo ang’e nabamwabo, bosongo ya Yorodani.) Na ekero Yoshua abaete ribaga bagende chinka chiabo akabasesenia,

english: And he spake unto them, saying , Return with much riches unto your tents , and with very much cattle , with silver , and with gold , and with brass , and with iron , and with very much raiment : divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren .
ekegusii: akabateebia “Irana chinka chiaino amo nobotenenku obo obonge mwanyorire, chitugo chinyinge amo ne chifeta ne chitaabu ne chitaai, na ebioma, amo ne chianga chinyinge. Ase ayio mwatananere abamino ebisakorwa ebio mwasakorete ababisa baino.”

english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned , and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan , to go unto the country of Gilead , to the land of their possession , whereof they were possessed , according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese kiegesaku kia Manase bagatiga Abaisraeli bande agwo Silo ase ense ya Kaanani, bakairana ase ense ya Gileadi, ense eria banyorete ase okomenya, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.

english: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about , that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age .
