english: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
ekegusii: Korende motoorie abande ase okobataboria korwa ase omorero. Abande mobarorere amaabera mobe nokoiroka, mogeche nonya neanga eria ebekire riko ri’okogania okobe kw’omobere. Ogosaba kw’ogotogia

english: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling , and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy ,
ekegusii: Bono asare ere oyoranyare kobarenda inwe timotererigwa, na kobatenenia ase obonene bwaye, motari na komocha, ase omogooko omonene,

english: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .
ekegusii: ere oyore Nyasae bweka, Omotooria oito goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito, asare ere ogotogigwa, na obonene, n’echinguru, na okobua, korwa kare na kare, na bono, na goika kare na kare. Amina.

english: Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .
ekegusii: Abanchani, ekero narenge gokora omokia mono kobarikera inwe amang’ana ogotooreka gwaito, okwo tosangete nainwe, nkarora ng’a negwenerete mbarikere na kobasorora morwanerere okwegena okwo abachenu baetwe ara rimo.

english: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Naki mbare abanto besoirie bobisi, abwo barikeretwe kare okogambigwa oko, abanto batari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae. Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana obuya bwa Nyasae oito ase okobiserera ogokora kwabo kw’obonyaka, naende bagokana Omonene oito ore bweka, oyore Omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Korwa agwo kare amariiko nabanete okoragererigwa konya banyorire.

english: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .
ekegusii: Na abamalaika baria batarendete okobua kwabo abanyene, korende bagatiga obomenyo bwabo, barendire nere ase ebisibo bia kare na kare inse y’omosunte omonene goika ekiina geche koba ase rituko riria rinene.

english: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh , despise dominion , and speak evil of dignities .
ekegusii: Naboigo nabwo abanyandoto bakobeeka emebere yabo riko bagochaaya okobua, na korama abwo b’obonene.

english: How doth the city sit solitary , that was full of people ! how is she become as a widow ! she that was great among the nations , and princess among the provinces , how is she become tributary !
ekegusii: Naki omochie oyo otigaire bosa, oyio orenge oichire n’abanto! Naki otigaire buna omokungu omotakanwa oyio orenge omonene ase egati y’ebisaku! Oyio orenge buna eting’ana ase egati-gati y’emechie, bono obeire omosomba ase emechie ende.

english: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things : for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary , whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation .
ekegusii: Omobisa oyio oramboire amaboko aye gochia gosakora ebinto bionsi bi’erigori rinene bire ase omochie ime; ee, omochie oyio ororire abanto b’ebisaku bagosoa Aase aye Aachenu, agwo aye Omonene gwakanete ng’a tibasoa ase omosangererekano oo.

english: All her people sigh , they seek bread ; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul : see , O LORD , and consider ; for I am become vile .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omochie nigo baumatete, ekero barigereretie endagera; barabwo baoonirie chinibo chiabo bagore endagera barie, erinde banyore chinguru. “Aye Omonene, koranche ondigererie, ekiagera nachayirwe.”

english: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by ? behold , and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow , which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger .
ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe mwensi aba mogoeta inchera aa, aya nigo are amang’ana abosa ase more? Rigereria morore gose emechando ende ere buna eyane, eyio yarentetwe ase ’nde, eyi’Omonene andeterete, ekero arenge n’endamwamu ekobera.

english: From above hath he sent fire into my bones , and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet , he hath turned me back : he hath made me desolate and faint all the day .
ekegusii: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba + 1:13 oboreba: engencho yaye omotego ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n’obororo omobaso boira.

english: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand : they are wreathed , and come up upon my neck : he hath made my strength to fall , the Lord hath delivered me into their hands , from whom I am not able to rise up .
ekegusii: “Nigo abarete amamocho aane onsi akayasangereria amo akayasiba ase ebigoti biane buna rikorogoto, na ase enchera eyio akang’uura chinguru ase oborito bwaye. Omonene nigo ambegete ase amaboko ay’abwo ntanyare kobua.

english: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men : the Lord hath trodden the virgin , the daughter of Judah , as in a winepress .
ekegusii: “Omonene bwangire abanto bonsi chituoni, abamenyete ime yane, orangeirie omosangererekano bw’abaanto, erinde osenyente abamura bane. Abayuda abwo banga buna omoiseke omwekuungi, Omonene obatiringeire inse, babeire buna amasabibu agotiringwa ase ekemitero.

english: For these things I weep ; mine eye , mine eye runneth down with water , because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate , because the enemy prevailed .
ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo nkorera, amaiso aane nigo akoiyeria amariga, oyio okondemia nigo are aare korwa ase ’nde, oyio okong’a chinguru chinyia; abana bane batigaire bare boka, ekiagera ababisa bane bambuire.”

english: Zion spreadeth forth her hands , and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob , that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni basamunsire amaboko abo, korende onde tari okobaremia. Omonene ochikiire igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo ng’a abanto abwo baabaetananire babe ababisa babo; Yerusalemu obeire okogechia ase bare.

english: The LORD is righteous ; for I have rebelled against his commandment : hear , I pray you, all people , and behold my sorrow : my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity .
ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nonya naboigo inche tinyigwereti amachiiko aye. Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera moigwe, morigererie emechando yane, abaiseke bane abekungi, na abamura bane, boosirwe na koirwa ase obosomba.

english: I called for my lovers , but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city , while they sought their meat to relieve their souls .
ekegusii: “Inche nkarangeria abanchi bane ng’a bankonye, korende bakang’aina; abakuani bane na abagaaka bagakwera ase omochie ime, ekero baarenge korigia endagera barie banyore chinguru chinyia.

english: She weepeth sore in the night , and her tears are on her cheeks : among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies .
ekegusii: Nigo okorera nobororo botuko bokia, na amariga nigo agoiteka ase chimboto chiaye; ase abanchi baye bonsi onde tari okomoremia; abasani baye bamong’ainire, babeire ababisa baye.

english: Behold , O LORD ; for I am in distress : my bowels are troubled ; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled : abroad the sword bereaveth , at home there is as death .
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, rigereria buna inde ase emechando, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yaonchoranirwe, ekiagera nabeire oyo otari omoigweri. Abana bane baitirwe nemioro ase chinchera, na amakweri abeire ase enka yane.

english: They have heard that I sigh : there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble ; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called , and they shall be like unto me.
ekegusii: “Abanto baigure buna ng’umatete, na onde tari nonya noyomo okondemia. Ababisa bane bonsi baigure igoro y’emechando yane, bagokire ng’a naye gwakorire aya. Renta rituko riria gwateebete ng’a orarente, na barabwo babe buna inche.

english: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions : for my sighs are many , and my heart is faint .
ekegusii: “Tiga obobe bwabo bwonsi bororekane ase obosio bwao, obae egesusuro; buna kwang’ete inche ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nigo ng’umatete mono, na enkoro yane yanyarekire.”

english: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction , and because of great servitude : she dwelleth among the heathen , she findeth no rest : all her persecutors overtook her between the straits .
ekegusii: Abayuda bairirwe ase obosomba, babeire nemechando na obokong’u batari gotimoka. Nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku; abakobabwatia baabaikereire kobare nemechando.

english: The ways of Zion do mourn , because none come to the solemn feasts : all her gates are desolate : her priests sigh , her virgins are afflicted , and she is in bitterness .
ekegusii: Chinchera chikogenda Sayoni nigo chiichanete, ekiagera onde tari ogocha ase Amatuko Amanene achiikire; ebiita biaye bionsi nigo bitigarete bosa, na abakuani baye bonsi nigo baichanete. Abaiseke baye abekungi nigo baumatete, na omochie omonyene nigo ore nobororo obonge.

english: Her adversaries are the chief , her enemies prosper ; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions : her children are gone into captivity before the enemy .
ekegusii: Ababisa baye babeire abanene baye, ee, ababisa baye nigo bagendererete goseseneka. Omonene oyotomeire emechando ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaye okonge, na ababisa baye bairire abana baye ase obosomba.

english: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed : her princes are become like harts that find no pasture , and they are gone without strength before the pursuer .
ekegusii: Ogosikwa gwonsi kwarure ase abanto ba Sayoni; abagaambi baye babeire buna chingabi chitabwati ase chikorisia; batamire korwa ase abakobabwatia, tibari ne chinguru.

english: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old , when her people fell into the hand of the enemy , and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu baarenge nemechando na obokong’u, bakaba bakoinyora ebinto ebiya mono baarenge nabio ase amatuko a kare. Agwo ekero bagwete ase amaboko y’abachandi, onde tarenge ore kobakonya, abachandi babo bakobachecheria ase engencho y’okogwa kwabo.

english: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned ; therefore she is removed : all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness : yea, she sigheth , and turneth backward .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.

english: Her filthiness is in her skirts ; she remembereth not her last end ; therefore she came down wonderfully : she had no comforter . O LORD , behold my affliction : for the enemy hath magnified himself .
ekegusii: Riko riaye nigo riarenge ase chianga chiaye, tarengereretie igoro y’omoerio oye. Ase ayio okogwa kwaye gokaba ogw’okoondokia, tarenge nonde okomoremia. “Aye Omonene, rigereria emechando yane, ekiagera omobisa one ngwetogia are!”

english: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
ekegusii: Naki Omonene atubire omochie o Sayoni nomosunte, ekero arenge n’endamwamu! Otugutire obonene bokomeka‐meka bw’Abaisraeli korwa igoro gocha inse aa. Ere tainyoreti egeteni ki’amagoro aye, ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.

english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .
ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omochie o Sayoni nigo baikaransete inse bakirete‐kiri, besiarerete ebuse ase emetwe yabo na kweboyia chigunia, abaiseke abekungi ba Yerusalemu nigo baturegete emetwe yabo gochia inse.

english: Mine eyes do fail with tears , my bowels are troubled , my liver is poured upon the earth , for the destruction of the daughter of my people ; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city .
ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoiyeria amariga, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yachandekire ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane, ekiagera abana, nonya nabakogonka, nigo bakona‐kogireka ase chinchera chi’omochie.

english: They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoboria abang’ina: “Ng’ai endagera ere, na edivai?” Nigo bakona‐kogireka na korara ase chinchera chi’omochie buna abaakirwe chingoma, batweka mo ase amaboko ’abang’ina.

english: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee?
ekegusii: Aye omochie o Yerusalemu, ninki ndagoteebie? Ninki ndakoreng’anie? Mang’ana ki anga buna ayao ndagoteebie, erinde nkoremie, aye Sayoni ore buna omoiseke omwekuungi? Ogosarigwa kwao nokonene buna enyancha ere enene, ning’o oranyare gokogwenia?

english: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity , to turn away thy captivity ; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment .
ekegusii: Abaabani bao nigo bakobarorera amaroro ’obong’ainereria are bosa, tibakoorokeretie obobe bwao, erinde nario orairanerigwe amaya ao; korende aya amaroro abo ayakworogetie, nigo arenge ay’oborimo, agerete ogatantanigwa.

english: All that pass by clap their hands at thee ; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem , saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty , The joy of the whole earth ?
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagoeta inchera nigo bagoaka chinkobi ase okogochaaya, nigo bakobugia emeroria na gosingiseria omochie o Yerusalemu emetwe, bakobora: “Inee! Omochie oyio noro orenge korokwa omoikeranu bw’obosiani, na omogooko bw’ense yonsi?”

english: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for ; we have found , we have seen it .
ekegusii: Ababisa bao bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gokobugeria emeroria na gokoriananeria amaino, bakobora: “Twayosaririe! Ee, rituko eri nario twaganetie, bono twariikeire, twarirorire!”

english: The LORD hath done that which he had devised ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .
ekegusii: Omonene okorire aya achiigete ng’a ayakore, oikeranirie ring’ana riaye aroberetie agwo kare, otagoire atari namaabera, otigire ababisa bao bagochenga igoro yao, ere okinirie ching’unchara chi’ababisa bao.

english: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chikorera ase Omonene. Ee, aye orwaki rw’omochie o Sayoni, tiga amariga ao aiteke buna orooche, omobaso na obotuko! Tobaisa korosa, gose gotimokia amaiso ao.

english: Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .
ekegusii: Imoka, orere botuko bokie! Ekero oborendi bw’obotuko bogochaka, oumore ayare ase enkoro yao ime ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna okoumora amaache! Rambora amaboko ao asare osabere obogima bw’abana bao, abwo bagoyire nenchara ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

english: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
ekegusii: Omonene oiyeirie inse obomenyo bwonsi bw’abaanto ba Yakobo atari namaabera, otagoire chiburi chi’ense y’Abayuda, ekero arenge nendamwamu; osiririe oborwoti, na ourire abanene baye amasikani.

english: Behold , O LORD , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Ning’o gwakorerete buna ayio? Inee! Abakungu mbarie oroiboro rwabo, abana abwo barerete ase amaboko abo? Inee! Abakuani na ababani mbaiterwe agwo Aase Aachenu a Omonene?

english: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .
ekegusii: Abamura na abagaaka nigo baraire ase chinchera inse, abaiseke bane, na abamura bane, baitirwe nemioro; ase rituko ri’endamwamu yao kwabaitire otari namaabera.

english: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about , so that in the day of the LORD’s anger none escaped nor remained : those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed .
ekegusii: Buna ase rituko ri’omoyega omonene okarangeria ababisa bane bakanyoboyia korwa chinsemo chionsi; ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene onde tatooregete, gose gotigara, ase abwo nabogoretie na kobareera. Ababisa bane baabasiririe.

english: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel : he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy , and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire , which devoureth round about .
ekegusii: Obutoire ching’unchara chionsi chi’Abaisraeli ore nendamwamu yaye entindi, orusirie okoboko kwaye gw’okorio korwa ase bare ase amasio ’ababisa babo: ere osambire abanto ba Yakobo buna omorero ekebemberi ogosamba ase chinsemo chionsi.

english: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .
ekegusii: Ere otingire obota bwaye buna omobisa agotinga, otenenire na kobong’usa nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna omochandi; agaita bonsi aba twetogeretie. Igoro y’obomenyo bw’abaanto ba Sayoni, oumoire ekeririanda kiaye kere buna omorero.

english: The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .
ekegusii: Omonene obeire buna omobisa, osiririe Abaisraeli; osiririe chinyomba chiaye chionsi chi’oborwoti, otagoire chiburi chiaye chinkong’u; naende omenteire abanto ba Yuda okorera na okweumia.

english: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
ekegusii: Ere oiyeirie inse orobago rwaye rore buna orw’omogondo, ee, osaririe aase emesangererekano y’ogosasiima ekobeera. Omonene otigire abanto bebire Amatuko Amanene ne Chisabato agwo Sayoni, na ase okogechigwa kwaye okonene bwangire omorwoti na Omokuani.

english: The Lord hath cast off his altar , he hath abhorred his sanctuary , he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces ; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD , as in the day of a solemn feast .
ekegusii: Omonene bwangire egesasiimero kiaye, otigire Aase aye Aachenu asarigwe; otigire chindwaki chiaye ase amaboko ’ababisa. Abanto bakuurire ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, buna nase rituko ri’omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima.

english: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament ; they languished together .
ekegusii: Omonene onachire ase ebirengererio biaye gosaria chindwaki chi’omochie o Sayoni, oramboire engori y’okorengera. Tagotanga okoboko kwaye tayosaria; otigire chiburi ne chindwaki chikweumia, chionsi amo nigo chiumatete.

english: Her gates are sunk into the ground ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebiita biaye biarimeire ase riroba, emekorogoto yaye yabunirwe na gosarigwa. Omorwoti oye, na abagaambi baye, nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bitabwati amachiiko, na ababani baye tibari konyora amaroro korwa ase Omonene.

english: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
ekegusii: Inche nomonto narorire emechando inse y’endamwamu y’Omonene ere buna enyimbo.

english: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
ekegusii: Nigo amboerete buna edubu, enyang’au entindi, ekoboera, na buna endo eboerete eite.

english: He hath turned aside my ways , and pulled me in pieces : he hath made me desolate .
ekegusii: Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese, ontigire ntang’ang’ete bosa.

english: He hath bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .
ekegusii: Otingire obota bwaye, na ombekire imbe ekerenga akoruta chinsara.

english: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins .
ekegusii: Ere ondasire ne chinsara chi’egochi + 3:13 chinsara chi’egochi: engencho yaye esaro yaye, chiasoire ase chinyigo chiane.

english: I was a derision to all my people ; and their song all the day .
ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyo ogosekererwa nabaanto bane bonsi, na engeero y’ogochaaya kwabo omobaso boira.

english: He hath filled me with bitterness , he hath made me drunken with wormwood .
ekegusii: Ong’ichoirie nobororo, ong’eire ekenyugwa ekeroro nanyure.

english: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
ekegusii: Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi’amagena, ontubire neribu.

english: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .
ekegusii: Aye kwarusirie omorembe ase omoyo one, na inche nebire ayare ay’omogooko.

english: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD :
ekegusii: Ngateeba, “Chinguru chiane chiaerire, na ogosemeria kwane ase Omonene boigo.”

english: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .
ekegusii: Inyora emechando yane, na obokong’u bwane, buna nanyure ay’obororo na obosongo.

english: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness , but not into light .
ekegusii: Ontang’anire na kong’etia ase omosunte, gose tari ase omobaso

english: My soul hath them still in remembrance , and is humbled in me.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogendererete koyainyora, na bwekeeirie ime yane.

english: This I recall to my mind , therefore have I hope .
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya nigo nkoyainyora ase omoyo one, ase ayio ninde nogosemeria.

english: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not.
ekegusii: Nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera ng’a titosiriri, ekiagera amaabera aye tari koera;

english: They are new every morning : great is thy faithfulness .
ekegusii: nigo bire ebiyia ase kera emambia, ee, obwegenwa bwao nigo bore obonene.

english: The LORD is my portion , saith my soul ; therefore will I hope in him.
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetari kiane, ayio naro omoyo one ontebirie, ase ayio nimosemeretie.

english: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete, ee, nomuya ase oyo okomorigia.

english: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okoba n’obotoereru na koganya ogotooreka gokorwa ase Omonene.

english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okobogoria rikorogoto ekero are omoke.

english: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him.
ekegusii: Tiga aikaranse ao bweka akire‐kiri, ekiagera Omonene nere omotwekire egurube eyio.

english: He putteth his mouth in the dust ; if so be there may be hope .
ekegusii: Tiga abeete omonwa oye ase riroba akire‐kiri, aande nabo ogosemeria korabeo.

english: Surely against me is he turned ; he turneth his hand against me all the day .
ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane, ekero ase ekero omobaso boira.

english: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach .
ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.

english: For the Lord will not cast off for ever :
ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta omonto goika kare na kare.

english: But though he cause grief , yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies .
ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amaabera naende, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.

english: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men .
ekegusii: Ere tari gwancha gochanda Mwanyabaanto, gose kobaichania.

english: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth ,
ekegusii: Omonto ogotiringera inse abasibwa bonsi bare ase ense,

english: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,
ekegusii: gose koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ase obosio bw’Oyore Igoro Mono,

english: To subvert a man in his cause , the Lord approveth not.
ekegusii: gose gokorekania ekiina ki’omonto onde bwensi. Inee! Ayi’Omonene nkoyaanchera are?

english: Who is he that saith , and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
ekegusii: Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka, onye Omonene tarichiigete rikorwe?

english: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amabe na amaya, tari korwa ase omonwa bw’Oyore Igoro Mono?

english: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?
ekegusii: Nase ki rende Mwanyabaanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria? Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.

english: My flesh and my skin hath he made old ; he hath broken my bones .
ekegusii: Otigire chinyama chi’omobere one, ne risankwa, bigosareka; obunire amauga aane.

english: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the LORD .
ekegusii: Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito, erio tomoiranere Omonene!

english: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens .
ekegusii: Tiga toimokererie chinkoro chiaito igoro, na amaboko aito, gochia ase Nyasae ore igoro, totebe:

english: We have transgressed and have rebelled : thou hast not pardoned .
ekegusii: “Intwe twasaririe asore, twabeire abatari abaigweri, naye togotwabera.

english: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us: thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
ekegusii: “Aye gwetubire endamwamu na gwatochandire, gwaitire, gose tobeti namaabera.

english: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .
ekegusii: Aye omonyene gwetubire riire, ng’a ogosaba gwaito tikogoika ang’e.

english: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .
ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire eubi na abaangire, ase egati y’ebisaku bi’ense.

english: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
ekegusii: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.

english: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction .
ekegusii: Obwoba ne chiirima biatocheire amo nogosaria na ogosirigwa.

english: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people .
ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amaache a rooche, ase engencho y’ogosirigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane.

english: Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not, without any intermission ,
ekegusii: “Amaiso aane abeire agoitera amariga atari gokama, gose korosa,

english: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail .
ekegusii: Onsibire ase eburi ime na ong’etananeirie obororo na obokong’u.

english: Till the LORD look down , and behold from heaven .
ekegusii: goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.

english: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.

english: Mine enemies chased me sore , like a bird , without cause .
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge korigigwa buna enyoni nabwo baarenge ababisa bane engencho ende etaiyo.

english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me.
ekegusii: Bakanduta ase engoro ime inde moyo, na konduta amagena.

english: Waters flowed over mine head ; then I said , I am cut off .
ekegusii: Amaache agaichora agaeta ase omotwe one igoro, ngateeba: Omoerio one oikire.

english: I called upon thy name , O LORD , out of the low dungeon .
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nigo narangeretie erieta riao korwa ase engoro entambe,

english: Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .
ekegusii: na aye okaigwa okorera kwane; toticha amato ao ase ogwechanda kwane ekero nkorera.

english: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst , Fear not.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwang’igete ang’e ase rituko riria narerete asore, oganteebia: Toondoka!

english: O Lord , thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul ; thou hast redeemed my life .
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, kwarwanereire omoyo one na gwatooririe obogima bwane.

english: O LORD , thou hast seen my wrong : judge thou my cause .
ekegusii: Kwarorire obobe obo nakoreirwe, onache ekiina kiane ase oboronge.

english: He hath set me in dark places , as they that be dead of old .
ekegusii: Ombekire imenye ase omosunte, buna abanto baria bakwete kare.

english: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
ekegusii: Aye kwarorire buna ababisa bane baganetie korusia egesiomba, na buna bakorire emeroberio emebe ase ’nde.

english: Thou hast heard their reproach , O LORD , and all their imaginations against me;
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, noigwete okorama kwabo, na emeroberio yabo yonsi igoro yane.

english: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day .
ekegusii: Aya abwo bakondwania bagokwana na korengereria, nigo bare mamincha yane omobaso boira.

english: Behold their sitting down , and their rising up ; I am their musick .
ekegusii: Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka, ninche engeero yabo bagochaaya.

english: Render unto them a recompence , O LORD , according to the work of their hands .
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nobaakane koreng’ana nogokora kw’amaboko abo.

english: Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them.
ekegusii: Otube chinkoro chiabo nomosunte; okoragereria kwao kobe igoro yabo.

english: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie, basire korwa inse y’erioba!”

english: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out : he hath made my chain heavy .
ekegusii: Onsiekeire ase chinsemo chionsi, tinkonyara gosoka; onsibeire ebinyuri ebirito.

english: Also when I cry and shout , he shutteth out my prayer .
ekegusii: Nonya nkorera neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, ere bwangire koigwa ogosaba kwane.

english: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone , he hath made my paths crooked .
ekegusii: Oribirie chinchera chiane namagena abaachire, oonchoranire oboeto bwane.

english: How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
ekegusii: Naki etaabu yasiririe obomeka‐meku bwaye! Naki etaabu echenire yaonchokire! Amagena aya Aase Aachenu asiareirwe ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.

english: The LORD hath accomplished his fury ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
ekegusii: Omonene oumoire okogechigwa kwaye, ee, oumoire endamwamu yaye entindi; na ase Sayoni otongirie omorero, osambire amaroso aye.

english: The kings of the earth , and all the inhabitants of the world , would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense, na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, tibegenete ng’a omochandi, gose omobisa onde bwensi, nkonyara arenge gosoa ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu.

english: For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bi’ababani baye, na ebi’abakuani baye, abwo baiterete amanyinga ’abanyene oboronge, agwo ase omochie ime.

english: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakoong’anya ase chinchera bare buna emeuko bakaba bakwegindia amanyinga, na onde tarenge gokuna chianga chiabo.

english: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean ; depart , depart , touch not: when they fled away and wandered , they said among the heathen , They shall no more sojourn there .
ekegusii: Abanto bakagobera, bakaboora: “Karue aa! Inwe timochenegeti! Karue aa! Karue aa! Timokuna abanto!” Ase ayio barabwo bagatama na koombogana. Abanto b’ebisaku bakabakwana bakaboora, “Tibakogenderera komenya ase tore.”

english: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .
ekegusii: Okobea kw’Omonene kwabasiareire, takobechandera naende; abakuani tibasigetwe, na abagaaka tibaroreretwe amaabera.

english: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
ekegusii: Amaiso aito arosire ase okorigereria, na okoganya bosa ng’a natokonywe; korwa ase ebitengero biaito, nigo twaganyete egesaku getanyare gototooria.

english: They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled ; for our end is come .
ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo batoboerete, titwarenge konyara gotaara ase chinchera chiaito. Engaki yaito nigo ere ang’e koera; amatuko aito abarirwe; ee, omoerio oito oikire.

english: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo baare abaango kobua ebiongo bikoiruruka, nigo batoseretie gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, bagatoboera ase erooro.

english: The precious sons of Zion , comparable to fine gold , how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers , the work of the hands of the potter !
ekegusii: Abamura ba Sayoni abare nengencho enene, abwo bareng’anirie ne chitaabu chingiya, naki yabeire ng’a bareng’anigwe ne chinyongo chi’amaroba, echire emeremo y’amaboko ’abakori chinyongo?

english: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the LORD , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
ekegusii: Omoakwa amaguta Omonene, oyio orenge omoika bw’obogima bwaito, akabwatwa ne chiirima chiabo, oyio nere twateebete ng’a ase ekiriri kiaye nao toramenye ase egati y’ebisaku.

english: Rejoice and be glad , O daughter of Edom , that dwellest in the land of Uz ; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken , and shalt make thyself naked .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Edomu, inwe abamomenyete ase ense ya Usi, goka na gochenga! Nonya nasemore egekombe nkebaikere, monywe motinde goika motigare getirianda.

english: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom ; he will discover thy sins .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, egesusuro ki’ebibe biaino giaikeranigwe. Omonene takogenderera gokoira ase obosomba; korende inwe abanto ba Edomu, Omonene nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino, ee, naorokie ebibe biaino maiso marore.

english: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast , they give suck to their young ones : the daughter of my people is become cruel , like the ostriches in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Nonya ne chisese chi’orosana nkogonkia chire chimanwa chiabo, korende abakungu b’omochie bw’abaanto bane babeire abatindi, buna chisagero chire ase erooro.

english: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them.
ekegusii: Chimeme chi’abana bakogonka chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura ase engencho y’erang’o; abana abake nigo bagosaba endagera, korende monto onde tari okobaa.

english: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets : they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baarenge koria endagera engiya mono bakwereire ase chinchera; na abwo barenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga, nigo baraire ase ebinge bi’eribu.

english: Her Nazarites were purer than snow , they were whiter than milk , they were more ruddy in body than rubies , their polishing was of sapphire :
ekegusii: Abagaambi baye nigo baarenge komeka-meka kobua amagena ’embura, nigo baarenge abarabu se kobua amabeere, emebere yabo nigo yarenge emebariri kobua amagena amabariri, na okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge buna safiro, rigena rie rigori rinene.

english: Their visage is blacker than a coal ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
ekegusii: Bono amaiso abo abeire amamwamuti kobua embiro, tibari komanywa agwo ase chinchera; amasankwa ’emebere yabo abwatanire namauga abo, omire pa buna amasabo amomo.

english: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .
ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.

english: Remember , O LORD , what is come upon us: consider , and behold our reproach .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora aya atonyorire, origererie orore ogochaywa gwaito.

english: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .
ekegusii: Amasankwa ’emebere yaito nigo are ne riberera buna erie riko, ekiagera enchara nigo egotosamba buna omorero.

english: They ravished the women in Zion , and the maids in the cities of Judah .
ekegusii: Abakungu baito bare Sayoni bakoreirwe amabe, boigo nabaiseke abekungi abare ase emechi y’Abayuda.

english: Princes are hanged up by their hand : the faces of elders were not honoured .
ekegusii: Abagaambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.

english: They took the young men to grind , and the children fell under the wood .
ekegusii: Abamura baito nabwo bakobogoria chingena chigoserwa, na abana abake nigo bakoritoerwa ase okobogoria chinko, bagwa.

english: The elders have ceased from the gate , the young men from their musick .
ekegusii: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki’omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.

english: The joy of our heart is ceased ; our dance is turned into mourning .
ekegusii: Omogoko bwe chinkoro chiaito osirire; ogotenga gwaito kwaonchokire kwabeire ebirero.

english: The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us, that we have sinned !
ekegusii: Chigutwa chiarenge ase emetwe yaito chiagure inse. Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe!

english: For this our heart is faint ; for these things our eyes are dim .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio chinkoro chiaito chiarwarire, na ase engencho y’ayio amaiso aito abeire orotutu.

english: Because of the mountain of Zion , which is desolate , the foxes walk upon it.
ekegusii: Ekiagera egetunwa gia Sayoni giatigaire kere bosa, chisese chi’orosana nao chigotaara.

english: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever ; thy throne from generation to generation .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo oragaambe kare na kare, ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi nigo kerabeo ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: Our inheritance is turned to strangers , our houses to aliens .
ekegusii: Omwando oito oeirwe abanto abaao, chinyomba chiaito chiaeirwe abamenyi.

english: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?
ekegusii: Naki gwatwebire kogenderera botambe? Naki gwatotigire ase engaki entambe iga?

english: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD , and we shall be turned ; renew our days as of old .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranie gocha asore, erinde toiranigwe, onchora amatuko aito oyakore abe amayia, abe buna aria a kare!

english: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
ekegusii: Gose ngwatotangire kegima? Nigo ogendererete kogechigwa mono naintwe?

english: We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .
ekegusii: Twabeire buna chintakana, chitari nabaise, abaababa nigo banga buna ababoraka.

english: We have drunken our water for money ; our wood is sold unto us.
ekegusii: Amaache tokonywa goika toakane chitaabu, ne chinko togwota nigo tokogora.

english: Our necks are under persecution : we labour , and have no rest .
ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo batobwatete amogoti, nigo tokorosa mono, titori konyora ogotimoka.

english: We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .
ekegusii: Twaramboreire Abamisiri na Abaasuri amaboko batoe endagera egotoisana.

english: Our fathers have sinned , and are not ; and we have borne their iniquities .
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiakorete ebibe, bono tichiyo; goika tobogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.

english: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand .
ekegusii: Abasomba nabwo bagotogaambera, na onde tari ogototooria korwa ase amaboko abo.

english: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness .
ekegusii: Nigo tokonyora endagera yaito ase okobeeka obogima bwaito ase emechando, ekiagera emioro nere ase erooro.

english: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD , which he commanded them not.
ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu, abamura ba Aroni, kera oyomo akaimokia orogio rwaye, akabeeka omorero ase orogio orwo, na akabeeka ekoroso igoro ase omorero oyio, bakarentera Omonene omorero orenge bw’engencho eng’ao, oyi’Omonene atabachiigete.

english: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean ;
ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwaatanana egento egechenu kere ekia Omonene korwa ase ekio getaatananiri koba egechenu, na egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti.

english: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Mworokererie Abaisraeli amachiiko onsi aya inche Omonene nabachiikire goetera ase Musa.”

english: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons’ due , of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire : for so I am commanded .
ekegusii: Mokoriere agwo Aase gete are aachenu. Ekio negetari kiao, na eki’abamura bao, gekorusigwa korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene. Ayio nar’Omonene anchiigete.

english: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD ; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever ; as the LORD hath commanded .
ekegusii: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing’wanso bigosaambwa n’omorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki’abamura bao kogenderera botaambe, buna Omonene achiigete.”

english: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering , and, behold, it was burnt : and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar , the sons of Aaron which were left alive , saying ,
ekegusii: Musa agatuka mono komanya inaki embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe yabeete, akamanya ng’a embori eria nigo yasaambetwe. Ase ayio akaba nendamwamu enene ase Eliezeri na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, baria batigarete, akabateebia.

english: Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
ekegusii: Rora, amanyinga aye tairetwe agwo Aase Aachenu; nigo yabagwenerete mokeriere agwo aase achenire.”

english: And Aaron said unto Moses , Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD ; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day , should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD ?
ekegusii: Aroni akairaneria Musa, “Rora, rituko ria reero abanto barure ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosaambwa, ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo nomanyete emechando eye nanyorire. Onye inaria ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe rituko ria reero, Inee, nanga nancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene?”

english: And there went out fire from the LORD , and devoured them, and they died before the LORD .
ekegusii: Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And when Moses heard that , he was content .
ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agaisaneka.

english: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the LORD spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Aya nar’Omonene atebiire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso b’abaanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Aroni agakira‐kiri.

english: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan , the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron , and said unto them, Come near , carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Mishaeli na Elisafani, basinto ba Usieli, ise moke Aroni, akabateebia, “Inchuo mobogorie emebere y’abamino, abana ba iso moke, moyerusie korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, moyeire isiko y’egetwori.”

english: So they went near , and carried them in their coats out of the camp ; as Moses had said .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abateebeetie.

english: And Moses said unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons , Uncover not your heads , neither rend your clothes ; lest ye die , and lest wrath come upon all the people : but let your brethren , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amo n’Eleazari na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, “Timobaisa gotiga chitukia chiaino chitachanuiri, gose timobaisa gotandora chianga chiaino ase okobaichanera. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene echiche igoro y’omoganda bwonsi. Korende Abaisraeli bamino bonsi barabwo mbabe bakorera ase engencho y’ogosamba ogotindi Omonene arentire.

english: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses .
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, ekiagera mwatananirwe ase ogoakwa amaguta ’Omonene.” Barabwo bagakora buna Musa abateebetie. Amachiiko ase abakuani

english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron , saying ,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aroni, akamoteebia,

english: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :
ekegusii: “Aye amo nabamura bao timobaisa konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kegotindia, ekero mogosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron , saying unto them,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

english: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas , and in the rivers , of all that move in the waters , and of any living thing which is in the waters , they shall be an abomination unto you:
ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo ime ase chinyancha, gose ase chindooche, bigotaara bire amaicho bitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, timobiria; ebio nokogechia ase more.

english: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh , but ye shall have their carcases in abomination .
ekegusii: Ebio nabigenderere koba okogechia ase more, chinyama chiabo timochiria, na echikwete ase echio timochiria, ekiagera echio nokogechia ase more.

english: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters , that shall be an abomination unto you.
ekegusii: Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia ase more.

english: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls ; they shall not be eaten , they are an abomination : the eagle , and the ossifrage , and the ospray ,
ekegusii: Nase chinyoni chiraabe okogechia ase more motarie nachio echi: Ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;

english: And the little owl , and the cormorant , and the great owl ,
ekegusii: enyakweumia, na endubi, na ebaraara;

english: And the swan , and the pelican , and the gier eagle ,
ekegusii: etibibi, na egetekere, na ensoti;

english: And the stork , the heron after her kind , and the lapwing , and the bat .
ekegusii: riagonga, na omoneke, na ebisaku biamwabo; enteema bobe na egetabora mato.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth .
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobateebie: Ase ching’iti chire ase ense, echi nachio moraarie chinyama chiabo:

english: All fowls that creep , going upon all four , shall be an abomination unto you.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebisinini bionsi bire moyo bire ne chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.

english: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four , which have legs above their feet , to leap withal upon the earth ;
ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane inamorie ebio bigotaroka nebirenge.

english: Even these of them ye may eat ; the locust after his kind , and the bald locust after his kind , and the beetle after his kind , and the grasshopper after his kind .
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio moraarie.

english: But all other flying creeping things , which have four feet , shall be an abomination unto you.
ekegusii: Korende ebinde bionsi ase ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.

english: And for these ye shall be unclean : whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Ase ebitongwa ebio nigo moresoyie ase ogotacheneka. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebikwete ase ebio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio,

english: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: na onde bwensi oraimokie egekwete korwa ase ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof , and is not clovenfooted , nor cheweth the cud , are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean .
ekegusii: Kera eng’iti ebwate ebitaago, korende tibiatananegeti kegima, naende teri koria eng’ang’ura, eyio nebe eyetachenegeti ase more. Moonto onde bwensi orakune ching’iti echio nabe oyotachenegeti.

english: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws , among all manner of beasts that go on all four , those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Ching’iti chiria chikogendera ebisonsogoro ase echio chibwate amagoro ane tichichenegeti ase more. Monto onde bwensi orakune echikwete ase echio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : they are unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi oraimokie eyekwete ase echio nasibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Ching’iti echio nachibe chitachenegeti ase more.

english: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth ; the weasel , and the mouse , and the tortoise after his kind ,
ekegusii: Ase ching’iti chinke chigoetanana ase ense, echio nchibe chitachenegeti ase more; Ekenyamunyonge, na embeba, na ekiigo ekenene, amo nebisaku biamwabo;

english: Whatsoever parteth the hoof , and is clovenfooted , and cheweth the cud , among the beasts , that shall ye eat .
ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero moraarie.

english: And the ferret , and the chameleon , and the lizard , and the snail , and the mole .
ekegusii: ekiigo egeke, na eng’oina, na ensagara, enke na enene, amo n’enyambu.

english: These are unclean to you among all that creep : whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead , shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chinke echio nchibe chitachenegeti ase more. Monto onde bwensi orachikune ekero chi akuure nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead , doth fall , it shall be unclean ; whether it be any vessel of wood , or raiment , or skin , or sack , whatsoever vessel it be , wherein any work is done , it must be put into water , and it shall be unclean until the even ; so it shall be cleansed .
ekegusii: Ching’iti echio chiise kogwera egento kende gionsi ekero chi akuure, egento ekio nakebe egetachenegeti, onye negento keroisirie korwa ase emete, gose gokeraabe eanga, gose risankwa, gose esaro, gose egento kende gionsi kegokorerwa emeremo. Egento ekio kebekwe ime ase amaache, naende kebe getachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; erio nakebe giachenekire.

english: And every earthen vessel , whereinto any of them falleth , whatsoever is in it shall be unclean ; and ye shall break it.
ekegusii: Onye eyemo ye ching’iti echio ekogwera enyongo, gose gento kende keroisirie korwa ase amaroba, ekere ime yaye nakebe egetachenegeti, na egento ekio goika giatwe.

english: Of all meat which may be eaten , that on which such water cometh shall be unclean : and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean .
ekegusii: Endagera ende yonsi ekoriegwa nebe eyetachenegeti onye amaache akoumorwa korwa ase enyongo buna eyio akoyekuna, na ekenyugwa kende gionsi kere ime y’enyongo buna eyio nkebe getachenegeti.

english: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean ; whether it be oven , or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down : for they are unclean , and shall be unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi keragwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete inakebe getachenegeti; onye ne riko rikoroisia emegati, gose neri’ endagera, erio riatwe, riabeire eritachenegeti ase more.

english: Nevertheless a fountain or pit , wherein there is plenty of water , shall be clean : but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean .
ekegusii: Ensoko gose aase amaache akogachwa nabigenderere koba ebichenegete, korende ebinto binde bionsi ebiaao biise gokuna ching’iti echio chikwete mbibe ebitachenegeti.

english: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown , it shall be clean .
ekegusii: Onye eng’iti eyemo y’echio ekwete keragwere embusuro egosimekwa, embusuro eyio negenderere koba echenegete.

english: But if any water be put upon the seed , and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Korende onye embusuro eyio yainekirwe ase amaache ime, na egwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete, rirorio nebe etachenegeti.

english: And if any beast , of which ye may eat , die ; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi yancheire koriegwa kerakwe, na omonto orayekune, rirorio omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud , or of them that divide the hoof : as the camel , because he cheweth the cud , but divideth not the hoof ; he is unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Korende ase ching’iti chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete timoria engamia, ekiagera nigo ekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio techenegeti.

english: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Moonto onde bwensi oraarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination ; it shall not be eaten .
ekegusii: “Ebitongwa ebike bionsi bigoetanana ase ense nigo bire okogechia, tibiriegwa.

english: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly , and whatsoever goeth upon all four , or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth , them ye shall not eat ; for they are an abomination .
ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.

english: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth , neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gwekora okogechia ase engencho y’ebitongwa ebio bigoetanana, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho ya birobio. Moise gokora igo, namobe abatachenegeti.

english: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : ye shall therefore be holy , for I am holy .
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”

english: This is the law of the beasts , and of the fowl , and of every living creature that moveth in the waters , and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth :
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching’iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amaache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,

english: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean , and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten .
ekegusii: na igo momanye gwaatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.

english: And the coney , because he cheweth the cud , but divideth not the hoof ; he is unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Timoria egesengi, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

english: And the hare , because he cheweth the cud , but divideth not the hoof ; he is unclean unto you.
ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.

english: And the swine , though he divide the hoof , and be clovenfooted , yet he cheweth not the cud ; he is unclean to you.
ekegusii: Naende timoria embeche, ekiagera nigo ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, korende teri koria eng’ang’ura; eyio techenegeti.

english: Of their flesh shall ye not eat , and their carcase shall ye not touch ; they are unclean to you.
ekegusii: Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.

english: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters : whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters , in the seas , and in the rivers , them shall ye eat .
ekegusii: Monyare koria chinswe chire ase chinyancha ne chindooche ime, echibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
ekegusii: “oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a omokungu karabe morito na aibore omwana omoisia nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, amatuko ang’ana buna ekero abwate omotienyi abe oyotachenegeti.

english: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days ; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato na atato, goika amanyinga akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete. Tabaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi gechenegete, gose gosoa Aase Aachenu, goika amatuko aye ay’ogochenwa aere.

english: But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .
ekegusii: Korende karaibore omwana egesagane, nabe oyotachenegeti ase chichuma ibere, buna ekero abwate omotienyi, naende aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etano nomo, na atano na rimo, goika amanyinga aye akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete.

english: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :
ekegusii: “Ekero amatuko ’omokuungu oyio ay’ogochenwa aerire, karabe nomwana omoisia aiboire, gose egesagane, omokungu oyio arente eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, ne riige rie riruma, gose riruma, ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abirente ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: Who shall offer it before the LORD , and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .
ekegusii: Omokuani oria arue eng’ondi eyio, gose riruma erio ase obosio bw’Omonene, na akore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oyio, na igo nabe ochenekire korwa ase ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye. Oko nakwo ogochika ase omokungu oiborete omwana, omoisia gose egesagane.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron , saying ,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia:

english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin , and it have turned the hair white , and there be quick raw flesh in the rising ;
ekegusii: na ere amorenge buya. Kararore egesambo ekerabu ase risankwa, na amarionya aonchokire abeire amarabu, naende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo,

english: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean .
ekegusii: obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma obokoro bogendererete ase engaki entambe ase risankwa ri’omobere bw’omonto oria. Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti; bono tamobeeka ase egesomo, ekiagera tachenegeti.

english: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh ;
ekegusii: Onye oborwaire obwo bwa ukoma bwasokire ase risankwa isiko, na Omokuani ororire ng’a bwesiareire ase omobere bwonsi korwa omotwe goika amagoro,

english: Then the priest shall consider : and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .
ekegusii: erio Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria bwatubire omobere bwonsi bw’omonto oria, rirorio ateebe ng’a ochenekire. Onye omobere bwonsi obeire omorabu, omonto oria obeire oyochenegete.

english: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean .
ekegusii: Korende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.

english: And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
ekegusii: Ekero Omokuani ararore ng’a enyama eria embariri yasokire, rirorio ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Enyama eria embariri nigo ere eyetachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

english: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest ;
ekegusii: Korende onye enyama eria embariri ekoonchoka ebe endabu, erio omonto oyio agende ase Omokuani,

english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .
ekegusii: na ere amorenge buya, na onye egesambo kiaonchokire na koraba, erio Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire.

english: The flesh also, in which , even in the skin thereof, was a boil , and is healed ,
ekegusii: “Omonto onye orenge ne rigumba ase risankwa riaye, ne rigumba erio koriagwenire,

english: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest ;
ekegusii: na aase agwo, ase risankwa riareenge obobimbu oborabu bororekane, gose egesambo gekororekana kere nobobariri na oborabu, omonto oria goika agende ase Omokuani.

english: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :
ekegusii: “Ekero omonto abeire negesambo, gose abimbire risankwa ri’omobere oye, gose risankwa riatorekire na koonchoka ribe buna oborwaire bwa ukoma, omonto oyio arentwe ase Aroni Omokuani, gose ase oyomo bw’abamura baye ore Omokuani.

english: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .
ekegusii: Ere amorenge buya, na kararore ng’a egesambo keria giakorire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, na amarionya areo aonchokire na koraba, Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oria tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwaorokeire ase rigumba riria.

english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
ekegusii: Korende Omokuani karamorenge na arore ng’a amarionya ’egesambo keria tari amarabu, na tigekoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende giachakire gosira, Omokuani abeeke omonto oria ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .
ekegusii: Onye oborwaire obwo bwesiareire ase risankwa, erio Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti, risankwa rianyorire oborwaire.

english: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil ; and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
ekegusii: Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti na gwesiarera, eyio engoro ase rigumba riariete, na Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire.

english: Or if there be any flesh , in the skin whereof there is a hot burning , and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot , somewhat reddish , or white ;
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ore ne risambo ri’omorero ayiete ase risankwa ri’omobere oye, na enyama embariri ekineteo ebe egesambo ki’obobariri na oborabu, gose kebe ekerabu,

english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
ekegusii: Omokuani areenge egesambo ekio. Onye amarionya egesambo ekio aonchokire na koraba, naende egesambo kiabeire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa ri’omobere oye, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokire ase risambo ri’omorero riareenge. Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot , and it be no lower than the other skin , but be somewhat dark ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
ekegusii: Korende Omokuani karaarenge egesambo keria, na arore ng’a amarionya aria areo taonchogeti abe amarabu, naende egesambo tikerakora engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, korende giachakire gosira, erio Omokuani amobeeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day : and if it be spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende. Kararore ng’a egesambo keria giesiareire ase risankwa, erio ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.

english: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .
ekegusii: Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti gose giesiarere ase risankwa, korende giachakire gosira, okwo nokobimba kwe risambo, na Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire. Eyio engoro ye risankwa ri’omobere.

english: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard ;
ekegusii: “Onye omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, obwate egesambo ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu,

english: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean .
ekegusii: Omokuani oyio areenge oborwaire obwo buya. Kararore ng’a amarionya are ase egesambo keria aonchokire abeire amarabu, na oborwaire bwakorire engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, rirorio oborwaire obwo nobwa ukoma. Ekero Omokuani arengire omonto oria buya, ateebe ng’a oyio onyorekanire ng’a tachenegeti.

english: Then the priest shall see the plague : and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .
ekegusii: Omokuani areenge egesambo ekio. Onye gekorete engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende onye amarionya areo are monuri na konyererea, erio Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Erio nerichoncho ri’oborwaire bwa ukoma ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu.

english: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall , and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin , and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days :
ekegusii: Omokuani karaarenge richoncho riria na arore ng’a tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende amarionya amamwamu tari aroro, erio Omokuani amobeeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague : and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair , and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin ;
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani areenge naende oborwaire boria, na onye tibwesiarereti, naende amarionya amonuri tario, naende richoncho tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa,

english: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :
ekegusii: omonto oyio akigite etukia, korende takigita ase richoncho rire, na Omokuani amwatanane, amobeeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende, na onye richoncho riria tiriesiarereti ase risankwa, na tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire, ase igo asibie chianga chiaye, abe oyochenegete kegima.

english: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing ;
ekegusii: Korende onye richoncho riria riesiareire ase risankwa magega gachenekire,

english: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin , the priest shall not seek for yellow hair ; he is unclean .
ekegusii: Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a richoncho riria riesiareire, takorigia korora gose amarionya are monuri nareo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.

english: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay , and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed , he is clean : and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
ekegusii: Omokuani kararore ng’a richoncho riria tirionchogeti, na amarionya amamwamu amerire imeo, richoncho riria riagwenire, na omonto oria ochenekire kegima. Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire.

english: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots , even white bright spots ;
ekegusii: “Onye omosacha gose omokungu obwate ebisambo ebirabu ase risankwa ri’omobere,

english: Then the priest shall look : and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin ; he is clean .
ekegusii: Omokuani amorenge. Nere kararore ng’a ebisambo bie risankwa ri’omobere nigo bire ebirabu ake, ebisambo ebio tibiri bobe; omonto oyio ochenekire.

english: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :
ekegusii: Onye egesambo keria kere ekerabu, korende tigekoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, na amarionya egesambo keria tabeti amarabu, rirorio Omokuani abeeke omonto oria ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

english: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head , he is bald ; yet is he clean .
ekegusii: “Onye omonto osunyokire etukia, risio riachiire magega, nigo are nyaisio, ere ochenekire,

english: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face , he is forehead bald : yet is he clean .
ekegusii: na onye osunyokire etukia y’omotwe bosio, boigo ere ochenekire.

english: And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .
ekegusii: Korende onye ase risio ri’omotwe oye, magega gose bosio, obwate egesambo kere nobobariri na oborabu, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokeire ase risio.

english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omokuani karamorenge arore ng’a egesambo kebimbete ase risio riria, magega gose bosio, kere nobobariri na oborabu, na nigo gekororekana buna oborwaire bwa ukoma mbore ase risankwa ri’omobere,

english: He is a leprous man , he is unclean : the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean ; his plague is in his head .
ekegusii: omonto oyio nabwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, ere tachenegeti. Omokuani ateebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti; oborwaire nigo bore ase omotwe oye.

english: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .
ekegusii: “Omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma abeeke chianga amachanchabe, tabaisa gochanua etukia yaye, atube omonwa oye ase egekoba kia igoro, erio aake eriogi na gokuura: Inche tinchenegeti! Tinchenegeti!

english: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone ; without the camp shall his habitation be .
ekegusii: Ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti ekero are noborwaire boria, aatananwe amenye isiko y’egetwori, ao korwa ase abanto bande. Ukoma ase chianga

english: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment ;
ekegusii: “Onye ukoma bore ase eanga eroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani,

english: Whether it be in the warp , or woof ; of linen , or of woollen ; whether in a skin , or in any thing made of skin ;
ekegusii: gose bore ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao korwa ase egatani, gose ase amarionya, gose ase rirondia rie risankwa, gose ase egento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa,

english: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
ekegusii: na onye ekemoa gekororekana kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, ase eanga, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase egento kende keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, obwo noukoma bogwesiarera, na ebinto ebi biorokigwe ase Omokuani.

english: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa, erio amobeeke naende ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.
