english: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light ; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops .
ekegusii: Nabo onsi aya mogokwana ase omosunte, naigugwe ase omobaso; naro aya mokomonyererana ase ebinyomba ime nararigwe igoro ase ebirama. Oyogwenerete koirokwa (Mat 10:28-33)

english: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after : and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things .
ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense nigo bakorigia ebinto ebio bionsi, korende Iso oino omanyire ng’a moganetie ebio bionsi,

english: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
ekegusii: Korende rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.

english: Fear not , little flock ; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .
ekegusii: “Timoiroka inwe abamore omoganda omoke, ekiagera Iso oino ororire buya kobaa oborwoti.

english: Sell that ye have , and give alms ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
ekegusii: Oonia ebio more nabio, morue ebiegwa; mwekorere ebimoya bitari kogota amo nenibo etari gokea igoro, aase omoibi atagoika, gose ebigwankwa gosaria.

english: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
ekegusii: Ekiagera aase chinibo chiaino chire nao chinkoro chiaino chikoba. Okogania gw’okorenda, na omoreng’anio bw’abasomba abegenwa na abatari abegenwa

english: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabateebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.

english: And if he shall come in the second watch , or come in the third watch , and find them so , blessed are those servants .
ekegusii: Naende karache ase oborendi bwa kabere gose oborendi bwa gatato, abanyore barendete, mbare nomogooko abasomba baria.

english: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .
ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe abasani baane, timoiroka abwo bagoita omobere, na magega ase ayio tibari negento baranyare gokora kobua.

english: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .
ekegusii: Nainwe nabo, mobe ang’e, ekiagera ensa motakagereti, nero Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache.”

english: Then Peter said unto him , Lord , speakest thou this parable unto us , or even to all ?
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, nintwe ogoteebia omoreng’anio oyo, gose nase abanto bonsi?”

english: And the Lord said , Who then is that faithful and wise steward , whom his lord shall make ruler over his household , to give them their portion of meat in due season ?
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?

english: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.

english: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.

english: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken ;
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,

english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .
ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nachiche rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti, nigo aramonachane abe ebing’ese, namoe ensemo yaye amo nabategeneti.

english: And that servant , which knew his lord’s will , and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will , shall be beaten with many stripes .
ekegusii: Naende omosomba oria omanyete ogwancha kw’omonene oye, na tebeka ang’e, gose gokora ogwancha kwaye, naakwe ebiranya ebiroro,

english: But he that knew not , and did commit things worthy of stripes , shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given , of him shall be much required : and to whom men have committed much , of him they will ask the more .
ekegusii: korende oria otamanyeti, ko ere okorire ayagwenerete ogoakwa, naakwe ebiranya ebiororo. Kera oyoeirwe ebinge, korwa asare ere nabiganigwe ebinge; na ere oyoeirwe ebinge kobua, korwa asare nabiganigwe ebinge kobua. Ebimanyererio bi’ebiro (Mat 10:34-36; 16:1-4; Mar 8:11-13)

english: I am come to send fire on the earth ; and what will I , if it be already kindled ?
ekegusii: “Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?

english: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .
ekegusii: Korende nimbakuurere oyo morairoke: Moiroke oria ore nokobua, magega ase ogoita omonto omoruta ase omorero o kare na kare. Ee, nabateebirie, moiroke oria!

english: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay ; but rather division :
ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.

english: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .
ekegusii: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.

english: And he said also to the people , When ye see a cloud rise out of the west , straightway ye say , There cometh a shower ; and so it is .
ekegusii: Naende agateebia emeganda, “Ekero mokorora riire rikoimoka bosongo, erio mwateeba bwango: Embura netwe; yaba bo.

english: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat ; and it cometh to pass .
ekegusii: Naende ekero mokorora embeo ekorwa Irianyi mwabora. Nebe eguru‐gura; yaba bo.

english: Ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth ; but how is it that ye do not discern this time ?
ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Imomanyete ense na igoro, buna bikororekana, korende naki rende, motamanyeti ekero eke?

english: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right ?
ekegusii: “Naende naki ase emioyo yaino motari gwatanana ayare boronge?

english: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero okogenda nomogosoeri oo ase omogambi, kora omokia kobwatana nere komore ’nchera, tachicha kogokurura ase omogambi, na omogambi oria akobeke ase amaboko ’omorendi bw’echela, na omorendi oria akorute echela.

english: I tell thee , thou shalt not depart thence , till thou hast paid the very last mite .
ekegusii: Nagotebirie, tokorwa agwo nonya ng’ake goika oakane kegima ebesa y’omoerio.”

english: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chitaabu ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered . Fear not therefore : ye are of more value than many sparrows .
ekegusii: Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.

english: Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobateebia, kera oyomo oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere namwatore ase abamalaika ba Nyasae;

english: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
ekegusii: korende oyorankaane ase Mwanyabaanto, nere nakaanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.

english: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans , whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices .
ekegusii: Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.

english: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath .
ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri’Esabato.

english: And , behold , there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years , and was bowed together , and could in no wise lift up herself .
ekegusii: Naende rora, narengeo omokungu obwatire nekerecha ki’oboreu ase emiaka ikomi na etano na etato, na ere konya okogotaire, taare konyara kwerambora nonya ng’ake.

english: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her , Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komoorora, akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”

english: And he laid his hands on her : and immediately she was made straight , and glorified God .
ekegusii: Akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, na ere akaramboka erio kegima, akamotogia Nyasae.

english: The Lord then answered him , and said , Thou hypocrite , doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall , and lead him away to watering ?
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang’ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng’ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri’Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?

english: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
ekegusii: Oyo nenyaroka ya Aburaamu; ekiagera Saitani omosibire emiaka eye ikomi na etano na etato, temogwenereti asiborwe korwa ase egesibo eke ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

english: And when he had said these things , all his adversaries were ashamed : and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him .
ekegusii: Naende ekero are gokwana aya, abanto bonsi abare koamererania nere bagasookigwa. Abanto bonsi bakagoka ase engencho y’amang’ana onsi amanene akorire. Omoreng’anio bw’entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi na oyo bw’ememera (Mat 13:31-33; Mar 4:30-32)

english: Then said he , Unto what is the kingdom of God like ? and whereunto shall I resemble it ?
ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?

english: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and cast into his garden ; and it grew , and waxed a great tree ; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it .
ekegusii: Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”

english: And Jesus answering said unto them , Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans , because they suffered such things ?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Mokagete ng’a Abagalili abwo nigo barenge abanyene ebibe kobua Abagalili bande bonsi, ekiagera banyorete emechando buna eyio?

english: And again he said , Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?
ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oborwoti bwa Nyasae?

english: It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
ekegusii: Igo boreng’anirie nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.” Egesieri ekegote gochia ase obogima (Mat 7:13-14,21-23)

english: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda Yerusalemu, agaeta ase emechie na ebichie okworokereria.

english: Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamobooria, “Omonene, barabwo abaratoorigwe nabake?” Akabateebia,

english: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
ekegusii: “Teema mono gosoa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera nabateebirie: Abanto abange nabarigie gosoa, na barabwo tibakonyara.

english: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
ekegusii: Ekero omonyene enyomba araimoke na gosieka egesieri, inwe namochake gotenena isiko na gotura gesieri, mokobora, Omonene, toigorere, na ere nabairanerie: Timbamanyeti aase mokorwa.

english: Then shall ye begin to say , We have eaten and drunk in thy presence , and thou hast taught in our streets .
ekegusii: Erio namochake goteeba: Nigo tware koria na konywa ase obosio bwao, naye nkworokereria kwarenge ase chinchera chiaito.

english: And they shall come from the east , and from the west , and from the north , and from the south , and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Naende mbache abanto korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi, na barabwo mbaikaranse ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi namosire boigo.

english: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees , saying unto him , Get thee out , and depart hence : for Herod will kill thee .
ekegusii: Ekero keria abande b’Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, ogende, ekiagera Herode narigetie kogoita.”

english: And he said unto them , Go ye , and tell that fox , Behold , I cast out devils , and I do cures to day and to morrow , and the third day I shall be perfected .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda moteebie ekebwe ekio: Rora ngoseria nde ebirecha, ngokora nde emeremo y’okogwenia abanto reero na ankio, ne rituko ria gatato ninkoore emeremo yane.

english: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane reero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu. Ogoichanerwa kwa Yerusalemu (Mat 23:37-39)

english: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , which killest the prophets , and stonest them that are sent unto thee ; how often would I have gathered thy children together , as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings , and ye would not !
ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!

english: Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
ekegusii: Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloamu, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?

english: He spake also this parable ; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard ; and he came and sought fruit thereon , and found none .
ekegusii: Agakwana omoreng’anio oyo, “Omonto oyomo narenge nomoko osimekire ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu; akagenda korigia amatunda ase omoko oria, korende tanyora gento.

english: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down ; why cumbereth it the ground ?
ekegusii: Agateebia omooroiseria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu: Rora, emiaka eye etato nachire korigia amatunda ase omoko oyo, na tindanyora gento. Yonache! Nase ki ogosaria riroba?

english: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.

english: And if it bear fruit , well : and if not , then after that thou shalt cut it down .
ekegusii: Noro korame amatunda, mbuya; onye taibo, erio oyonache.” Omokungu ogwenetigwe rituko ri’Esabato

english: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’Esabato, ekero asoete ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, omonene bw’Abafarisai, arie endagera, nigo barenge bamorigereretie.

english: But when thou art bidden , go and sit down in the lowest room ; that when he that bade thee cometh , he may say unto thee , Friend , go up higher : then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee .
ekegusii: Korende gokorangerigwa, genda oikaranse magega, erinde kagocha oyokorangeretie, agoteebie: Mosani, tigera gocha aa aase e ritang’ani. Erio nobe nogosikwa ase amasio abo bonsi abaikaransete amo naye.

english: Then said he also to him that bade him , When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .
ekegusii: Agateebia oria omorangeretie, “Kogokora endagera ya mambia gose eya mogoroba, torangeria abasani bao, gose abamino, gose eamate yao, gose abagisangio bao abanda; baabaise gokorangeria banyare gokoakana.

english: But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
ekegusii: Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;

english: And thou shalt be blessed ; for they cannot recompense thee : for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just .
ekegusii: aye nosesenigwe, ekiagera tibari na gento bagokoakana. Naki aye noche goakanwa ase okobokigwa kw’abanyene oboronge.” Omoreng’anio bw’omoyega omonene

english: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things , he said unto him , Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamoteebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!”

english: Then said he unto him , A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.

english: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come ; for all things are now ready .
ekegusii: Ekero ki’omoyega agatoma omosomba oye kogenda goteebia baria konya barangerigwe: Inchuo, ekiagera ebinto bionsi biabeire ang’e.

english: And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .
ekegusii: Bagachaaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akamoteebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.

english: And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nagorire chintang’ana amachoki atano, nkogenda nde gochiteema; nagosabire, onyabere.

english: And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.

english: And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .
ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nanyuomire omokungu, na ase engencho eye tinkonyara gocha.

english: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .
ekegusii: Omosomba oria agacha, akorokia omonene oye amang’ana aya. Erio oria omonyene enyomba akabea, agateebia omosomba oye: Soka bwango, ogende ase chinchera na ebinchera bi’emechie, orente abataka, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amagata.

english: And the servant said , Lord , it is done as thou hast commanded , and yet there is room .
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria akabora: Omonene, ayio gwachika aikire gokoreka, ko nonya mbono ribaga ndireo.

english: And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .
ekegusii: Omonene oria agateebia omosomba oye: Genda ase chinchera ne chimbebe, obabetererie basoe, erinde enyomba yane enyare goichora.

english: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .
ekegusii: Ekiagera nagotebirie ng’a ase abanto baria barangeretigwe onde tari nonya noyomo oranyare koigwa omoyega one.” Rigori ri’okoba omworokigwa

english: And there went great multitudes with him : and he turned , and said unto them ,
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge nigo yarenge amo na Yeso; ere akeonchora, akabateebia,

english: For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?
ekegusii: Naki ning’o ase more, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?

english: Lest haply , after he hath laid the foundation , and is not able to finish it , all that behold it begin to mock him ,
ekegusii: Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,

english: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abanto b’amachiiko na Abafarisai, akababoria, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose taibo?”

english: Saying , This man began to build , and was not able to finish .
ekegusii: bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.

english: Or what king , going to make war against another king , sitteth not down first , and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand ?
ekegusii: Gose morwoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomorwoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabaanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomocheera nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere?

english: Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sendeth an ambassage , and desireth conditions of peace .
ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo agotoma abanto korigia enchera y’omorembe, omonto oria gakare aare.

english: So likewise , whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath , he cannot be my disciple .
ekegusii: Nabo kera oyomo oino otatigeti ebinto bionsi are nabio, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.

english: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?
ekegusii: “Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?

english: It is neither fit for the land , nor yet for the dunghill ; but men cast it out . He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Togwenereti riroba gose etui; abanto nigo bakoyotuguta isiko. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

english: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go ;
ekegusii: Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.

english: And they could not answer him again to these things .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria. Oboitongo na okoroisia abageni

english: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden , when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms ; saying unto them ,
ekegusii: Agateebia baria barangeretigwe omoreng’anio, gachia korora buna bachorire ebirogo bi’eritang’ani, akabateebia,

english: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .
ekegusii: oria obarangeretie inwe babere nache kogoteebia aye: Motigerere oyo ekerogo eke; erio nochake koba nobosooku gokoiranigwa goikaransa magega.

english: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .
ekegusii: Naboigo, nabateebirie, nore omogooko ase abamalaika ba Nyasae ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire.” Omwana omomura omoria bobe

english: And he said , A certain man had two sons :
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonto oyomo narenge nabamura babere.

english: And the younger of them said to his father , Father , give me the portion of goods that falleth to me . And he divided unto them his living .
ekegusii: Oria omoke agateebia ise: Tata, ing’a ensemo y’enibo entungetie. Ise akabaatanera ebinto biaye.

english: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atai mange oria omoke agasangereria ebinto biaye bionsi, akaimoka akagenda orogendo gochia ense y’aare; agasiarera agwo enibo yaye ase ogokora kw’obokayayu.

english: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land ; and he began to be in want .
ekegusii: Gakoorire bionsi, enchara enene egasoa ase ense eria, ere akaremerwa.

english: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country ; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine .
ekegusii: Akagenda akabwatana nomonto oyomo bw’abanyene ense eria; ere akamoira ebitii biaye korageria chimbeche.

english: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .
ekegusii: Akaba nkogania are koigotia enda yaye ase amasabo aria chimbeche chiarenge koria; monto onde tarenge komoa gento.

english: And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !
ekegusii: Goika agachia kweiranerera kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!

english: I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,
ekegusii: Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imoteebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,

english: And am no more worthy to be called thy son : make me as one of thy hired servants .
ekegusii: tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw’abasomba bao b’eng’eria.

english: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .
ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakemurungania, bakaboora, “Oyo nigo akoroisia abanyene ebibe, na koria amo nabarabwo.”

english: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda ase ise. Agachia koba okare are, ise akamorora, akamororera amaabera, akaminyoka, akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono. Akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono.|alt="His father embraced the lost son" src="Gw-104.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 15:11-32" copy="Graham Wade" ref="15:20"

english: And the son said unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and in thy sight , and am no more worthy to be called thy son .
ekegusii: Omwana oria akamoteebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.

english: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
ekegusii: Korende ise agateebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.

english: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it ; and let us eat , and be merry :
ekegusii: Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,

english: For this my son was dead , and is alive again ; he was lost , and is found . And they began to be merry .
ekegusii: ekiagera oyo omwana one konya okuure, naende moyo are; konya osirire, korende bono ororekanire. Bagachaaka gochenga.

english: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .
ekegusii: “Nabo oria omomura oye omonene nigo arenge mogondo; agachia goika ang’e nenyomba, akaigwa egeturi ki’ogoteera na ogotenga.

english: And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .
ekegusii: Akarangeria oyomo bw’abasomba, akamobooria amang’ana ayio, engencho yaye inki.

english: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: Momura omino ochire, na iso omonyenyeire emori enoru, ekiagera amonyora ore omogima.

english: And he was angry , and would not go in : therefore came his father out , and intreated him .
ekegusii: Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,

english: And he answering said to his father , Lo , these many years do I serve thee , neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment : and yet thou never gavest me a kid , that I might make merry with my friends :
ekegusii: korende ere akamoiraneria: Rora, inche nagokoreire emiaka eye emenge, tinsareti ogochika kwao kero kende gionsi; korende tikwana kong’a emanwa y’embori, erinde ingoke amo nabasani baane.

english: And he spake this parable unto them , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo:

english: But as soon as this thy son was come , which hath devoured thy living with harlots , thou hast killed for him the fatted calf .
ekegusii: Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, oriire ebinto biao nabakuungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.

english: And he said unto him , Son , thou art ever with me , and all that I have is thine .
ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.

english: It was meet that we should make merry , and be glad : for this thy brother was dead , and is alive again ; and was lost , and is found .
ekegusii: Mboronge gokora omogooko na gochenga, ekiagera oyo momura omino konya okuure, na bono moyo are; konya osirire, na bono ororekanire.”

english: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?
ekegusii: “Monto ki oino oyore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo esire, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase erooro, na gochia korigia eria yasirire, goika ayenyore?

english: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .
ekegusii: Nabo kayenyorire ayebeka amareko aye nomogooko.

english: And when he cometh home , he calleth together his friends and neighbours , saying unto them , Rejoice with me ; for I have found my sheep which was lost .
ekegusii: Na ekero akoirana inka, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire eng’ondi yane eria yasirete.

english: I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .
ekegusii: Naboigo nabateebirie, nobe omogooko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka. Ebesa ensiru

english: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?
ekegusii: “Gose mokuungu ki ore ne chisiringi ikomi chi’echifeta, na eyemo esire, tagotongia etaya na kwabusa enyomba, arigie nomokia goika ayenyore?

english: And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together , saying , Rejoice with me ; for I have found the piece which I had lost .
ekegusii: Kayenyorire, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire esiringi eria nasiria.

english: And he said also unto his disciples , There was a certain rich man , which had a steward ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
ekegusii: Naende agateebia aborokigwa baye, Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng’a osiareire enibo yaye.

english: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much : and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much .
ekegusii: Oyore omwegenwa ase ekere egeke, nabo are omwegenwa ase ekere ekenene; na oyotari omooronge ase ekere egeke, naboigo tari omooronge ase ekere ekenene.

english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ?
ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase enibo y’ense eye etari boronge, ning’o oranyare kobegena koba nenibo y’ekeene?

english: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s , who shall give you that which is your own ?
ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase ekio ki’omonto onde, ning’o oranyare kobaa ekio ekere kiaino abanyene?

english: And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .
ekegusii: Abafarisai abarenge abanchi enibo bakaigwa amang’ana aya onsi, bakamosekereria.

english: And he said unto them , Ye are they which justify yourselves before men ; but God knoweth your hearts : for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe nabaanto mogwetogia ng’a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.

english: There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :
ekegusii: “Narenge omonto gete omonda, orenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga na echi’egatani engiya, na kwegokia kera rituko ase okoria.

english: And he called him , and said unto him , How is it that I hear this of thee ? give an account of thy stewardship ; for thou mayest be no longer steward .
ekegusii: Akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Ninki eke naigure ase ore? Orokia amang’ana y’oborendi bwao, ekiagera tokonyara kogenderera koba omorendi.

english: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus , which was laid at his gate , full of sores ,
ekegusii: Na ase egesieri kiaye narengeo omonto oyomo omotaka, erieta riaye Lazaro, orenge namaote amange.

english: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table : moreover the dogs came and licked his sores .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge kogania kweigotia namatori are kogwa korwa ase emesa y’omonda oria, ne chisese nachirochio chicha chiamomena amaote aye.

english: And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried ;
ekegusii: Omotaka oria agakwa, akabogorigwa nabamalaika, akabeekwa ase egekuba kia Aburaamu. Na oria omonda agakwa boigo, agatindekwa,

english: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
ekegusii: na ekero aare agwo aase Eora y’amakweri akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Aburaamu okare aare, na Lazaro ore ase egekuba kiaye.

english: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue ; for I am tormented in this flame .
ekegusii: Akarera, akabora: Tata Aburaamu, indorera amaabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amaache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.

english: But Abraham said , Son , remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things , and likewise Lazarus evil things : but now he is comforted , and thou art tormented .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremiigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.

english: And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .
ekegusii: Na kobua aya onsi, egati yaito na inwe eoromomo nereo yabeekirwe, erinde abanto abarigetie korua aiga bamboke gocha ase ore tibanyara, gose baria bare agwo tibanyara kwamboka gocha ase tore.

english: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house :
ekegusii: Akabora: Nagosabire tata, omotome ase enyomba ya tata,

english: For I have five brethren ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .
ekegusii: ekiagera ninkare nabamura baminto batano; tiga agende abakuurere, erinde barabwo tibacha aa ase emechando.

english: Abraham saith unto him , They have Moses and the prophets ; let them hear them .
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Mbare na Musa na ababani; tiga baigwere barabwo.

english: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig ; to beg I am ashamed .
ekegusii: Omorendi oria akabora ase omoyo oye: Ninki ndakore, ekiagera omonene one ondusirie ase oborendi bwane? Tindi ne chinguru chi’okorema; ogosaba nobosooku ase ’nde.

english: And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .
ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.

english: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Bataigwereti Musa na ababani, naisa koboka omonto korwa ase abakuure, tibakoebererigwa banche.”

english: I am resolved what to do , that , when I am put out of the stewardship , they may receive me into their houses .
ekegusii: Namanyire eke ndakore, erinde abanto bandoisie ase chinyomba chiabo, ekero nkorusigwa ase oborendi.

english: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him , and said unto the first , How much owest thou unto my lord ?
ekegusii: Erio akarangeria abasiira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bw’eritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?

english: And he said , An hundred measures of oil . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and sit down quickly , and write fifty .
ekegusii: Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’amaguta. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, ikaransa bwango, oriike emerongo etano.

english: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .
ekegusii: Naende akaboria oyonde: Naye ninki oriete? Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’engano. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, orike emerongo etano na etato.

english: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .
ekegusii: Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omooronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene. Enchera engiya y’ogokorera enibo emeremo

english: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .
ekegusii: Nkobateebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, baabaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.

english: Then said he unto the disciples , It is impossible but that offences will come : but woe unto him , through whom they come !
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amang’ana ’okogocha takomocha kooroka, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okoyarenta!

english: So likewise ye , when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you , say , We are unprofitable servants : we have done that which was our duty to do .
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorakore onsi aya mwachiikirwe, teba: ‘Intwe nabasomba bataisaneti; twakorire aya atogwenerete gokora.’” Yeso okogwenia abanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma

english: And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
ekegusii: Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.

english: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
ekegusii: Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabaanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;

english: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .
ekegusii: na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amaabera!”

english: And one of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , and with a loud voice glorified God ,
ekegusii: Oyomo obo agachia korora ng’a osibekire, akairana okomobaaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene,

english: And fell down on his face at his feet , giving him thanks : and he was a Samaritan .
ekegusii: akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, okomoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na ere n’Omosamaria orenge.

english: And Jesus answering said , Were there not ten cleansed ? but where are the nine ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tari bonsi ikomi basibeka? Baria kianda, ng’ai bare?

english: There are not found that returned to give glory to God , save this stranger .
ekegusii: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”

english: And he said unto him , Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tenena, ogende; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Ogocha kw’oborwoti (Mat 24:26-28,37-41)

english: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he cast into the sea , than that he should offend one of these little ones .
ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.

english: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said , The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,

english: Neither shall they say , Lo here ! or , lo there ! for , behold , the kingdom of God is within you .
ekegusii: gose tibakobora: Rora naiga bore, gose: Naaria! Rora, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bore ime ase more.”

english: And he said unto the disciples , The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .
ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, korende timokorirora.

english: And they shall say to you , See here ; or , see there : go not after them , nor follow them .
ekegusii: Naende nabaabateebie: Rora aaria, gose: Rora aiga! Timogenda, gose timobatunyana.

english: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .
ekegusii: Naki buna okomesa gokomesa korwa igoro ensemo eyemo goika ensemo ende, nabo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araache koba ase rituko riaye.

english: But first must he suffer many things , and be rejected of this generation .
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.

english: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .
ekegusii: Korende ase rituko riria Loti aruete Sodomu omorero na ekebiriti bigatwa korwa igoro, bigasiria bonsi.

english: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
ekegusii: Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araoroke.

english: I tell you , in that night there shall be two men in one bed ; the one shall be taken , and the other shall be left .
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, obotuko boria abanto babere nababe ase oborere obomo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.

english: Two women shall be grinding together ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
ekegusii: Abakungu babere nababe bagoseera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe. [

english: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
ekegusii: Abanto babere inababe mogondo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.]”

english: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them , Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Omonene?” Akabairaneria, “Ase ribego rire nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.”

english: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent ; thou shalt forgive him .
ekegusii: Naende karakore ebibe ase ore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteeba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”

english: And the apostles said unto the Lord , Increase our faith .
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakamoteebia, “Omonene, tomentere okwegena gwaito.”

english: And the Lord said , If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye might say unto this sycamine tree , Be thou plucked up by the root , and be thou planted in the sea ; and it should obey you .
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Onye mwarenge nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, anga mwateebia omokenene oyo: Simoka, bwesimeke nyancha, noro anga nobaigwera.

english: But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?
ekegusii: “Korende ning’o ase more oyore nomosomba okorema, gose okorisia ching’ondi, oramoteebie ekero akorwa mogondo agosoa nyomba: Inchuo bwango oikaranse, orie endagera?

english: And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?
ekegusii: Inee! Takomoteebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na magega yaye, naye orie na konywa?

english: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him ? I trow not .
ekegusii: Gose nkomoteebia are omosomba oria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera akora eki achikwa?

english: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint ;
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia omoreng’anio ng’a nebagwenerete komosaba Nyasae botambe, tibakwa emioyo,

english: Two men went up into the temple to pray ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
ekegusii: “Abanto babere bagatiira gochia Hekalu gosaba; oyomo n’Omofarisai na oyonde omorusia ebango.

english: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself , God , I thank thee , that I am not as other men are , extortioners , unjust , adulterers , or even as this publican .
ekegusii: Oria Omofarisai agatenena, agasaba iga ase omoyo oye: Nyasae, nakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inche tindi buna abanto bande, abauri, abatari boronge, abatomani, gose buna oyo omorusia ebango.

english: I fast twice in the week , I give tithes of all that I possess .
ekegusii: Igo nkweng’ata ara kabere ase echuma; ’ndua ensemo ya ikomi y’okonyora kwane gwonsi.

english: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .
ekegusii: Na oria omorusia ebango agatenena are, tarigia nonya nkoimokia amaiso aye igoro, korende ageaka‐aka egekuba kiaye, okobora: Nyasae, indorera amaabera inche omonyene ebibe!

english: And they brought unto him also infants , that he would touch them : but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them .
ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.

english: But Jesus called them unto him , and said , Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, ogoteeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwotinbwa Nyasae nobwabo.

english: Verily I say unto you , Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein .
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oborwoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.” Obogima bwa kare na kare, na obobe bw’obotenenku (Mat 19:16-30; Mar 10:17-31)

english: And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
ekegusii: Na omogambi gete akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, ninki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.

english: Saying , There was in a city a judge , which feared not God , neither regarded man :
ekegusii: akabora, “Narenge omogambi ase omochie gete, otasigete Nyasae, gose taare koyiera monto.

english: And he said , All these have I kept from my youth up .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”

english: Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him , Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”

english: And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .
ekegusii: Korende ekero achia koigwa aya akaba nomoichano, ekiagera arenge omonda mono.

english: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said , How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!

english: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Naki naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esiindani, kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: And they that heard it said , Who then can be saved ?
ekegusii: Na abwo abayaigwete bakaboora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

english: And he said , The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”

english: Then Peter said , Lo , we have left all , and followed thee .
ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Rora, intwe twatigire chinka chiaito, twagotunyanire aye.”

english: And he said unto them , Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God’s sake ,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae,

english: And there was a widow in that city ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteeba: Ngambera boronge ase omosiira one.

english: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time , and in the world to come life everlasting .
ekegusii: otanyore kobua ara aange bono, naende ase ense egochi‐gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.” Obobani bwa gatato bwa Yeso igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 20:17-19; Mar 10:32-34)

english: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them , Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaira baria ikomi na babere, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, naende amang’ana onsi ayariikeretwe Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nababani naikeranigwe.

english: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :
ekegusii: Naki nabekwe ase amaboko y’abanto b’Ebisaku, nakorerwe echeche, na gokorerwa bobe, na gotwerwa amate;

english: And they shall scourge him , and put him to death : and the third day he shall rise again .
ekegusii: naende inabamoake emecharichi na komoita, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”

english: And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya nonya nering’ana erimo ase aya. Ring’ana eri rikabiseka ase bare, na tibamanya ayateebetwe. Yeso okogwenia omonto omouko (Mat 20:29-34; Mar 10:46-52)

english: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.

english: And hearing the multitude pass by , he asked what it meant .
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa omoganda ogoeta, akaboria, “Inki ekio?”

english: And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”

english: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
ekegusii: Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

english: And they which went before rebuked him , that he should hold his peace : but he cried so much the more , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
ekegusii: Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamoteebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

english: And he would not for a while : but afterward he said within himself , Though I fear not God , nor regard man ;
ekegusii: Omogambi oria ase ekero egeke tancha; magega agateeba ase omoyo oye: Nonya inche tinsigeti Nyasae, gose tindi koyiera monto,

english: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, agachiika arentwe asare. Agachia komoika ang’e, akamobooria,

english: Saying , What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee ? And he said , Lord , that I may receive my sight .
ekegusii: “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oegwe okorora; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”

english: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .
ekegusii: Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, akamotunyana, okomotogia Nyasae; na abanto bonsi bagachia korora aya, bakamotogia Nyasae.

english: Yet because this widow troubleth me , I will avenge her , lest by her continual coming she weary me .
ekegusii: korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”

english: And the Lord said , Hear what the unjust judge saith .
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omooronge agoteeba.

english: And shall not God avenge his own elect , which cry day and night unto him , though he bear long with them ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae takobanyorera oboronge abachore baye, abakomoreera omobaso na obotuko? Na ere takoba omoremereria ase bare?

english: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?
ekegusii: Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?” Omoreng’anio bw’Omofarisai na omorusia ebango

english: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo ase abanto baare gwekaga ng’a nabanyene oboronge, bagochaaya abande bonsi:

english: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho .
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yeriko, akaba ngoeta are egati‐gati yaye.

english: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagachia koigwa aya, Yeso akamenta kobateebia omoreng’anio, ekiagera konya oikire ang’e na Yerusalemu, na barabwo bagakaga ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo borarorekane ekero ekio kegima.

english: He said therefore , A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom , and to return .
ekegusii: Nabo akabora, “Omonto oyomo omosike akagenda ense y’aare, erinde anyare kwenyorera oborwoti, naende airane.

english: And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .
ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabateebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.

english: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yaye bakamogecha, bagatoma abatomwa komotunyana na komoteebia, Titorigeti omonto oyo atogambere.

english: And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .
ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oborwoti, agachiika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.

english: Then came the first , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained ten pounds .
ekegusii: Oyo bw’eritang’ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.

english: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya, aye omosomba omuya! Ekiagera kwabeire omwegenwa ase egento kere egeke, nabo nobe nokobua igoro ase emechie ikomi.

english: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere agacha, akabora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo bitano.

english: And he said likewise to him , Be thou also over five cities .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia nere boigo: Aye nobe igoro ase emechie etano.

english: And , behold , there was a man named Zacchæus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto oyomo ore korokwa Zakayo, omonene bw’abarusia ebango; ere nomonda orenge.

english: And another came , saying , Lord , behold , here is thy pound , which I have kept laid up in a napkin :
ekegusii: Naende oyonde agacha, akabora: Omonene, eke nakio ekerengo kiao nagachete ase egetambaa;

english: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .
ekegusii: nigo nakoirogete, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonto omokong’u. Nigo okobogoria eki otagachete, na kogesa eki otasimegete.

english: And he saith unto him , Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee , thou wicked servant . Thou knewest that I was an austere man , taking up that I laid not down , and reaping that I did not sow :
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Ase enkwana y’omonwa oo ninkogambie, aye omosomba omobe. Nkwamanyete ng’a inche nomonto omokong’u, nkobogoria eki ntagachete, na kogesa eki ntasimegete.

english: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?
ekegusii: Naki rende otabeegete chitaabu chiane ase aba bakorua ebitoki, ninche ngocha anga nachinyora amo nebitoki?

english: And he said unto them that stood by , Take from him the pound , and give it to him that hath ten pounds .
ekegusii: Agateebia abarengeo: Moure ekerengo kiaye, moe oria oyore nebirengo ikomi.

english: ( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds .)
ekegusii: (Bakamoteebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).

english: And when he had thus spoken , he went before , ascending up to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, agatang’ana gotiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

english: And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
ekegusii: Agachia goika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,

english: And he sought to see Jesus who he was ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .
ekegusii: Akarigia korora Yeso, gose ’monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.

english: Saying , Go ye into the village over against you ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .
ekegusii: akabateebia, Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.

english: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
ekegusii: Naende omonto karababorie: Naki, mokoyesibora? Momoteebie iga, “Omonene nayeganetie.”

english: And they that were sent went their way , and found even as he had said unto them .
ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bakagenda, bakayenyora buna abateebeetie.

english: And as they were loosing the colt , the owners thereof said unto them , Why loose ye the colt ?
ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”

english: And they said , The Lord hath need of him .
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”

english: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .
ekegusii: Bakayerenta ase Yeso; bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ase emori eria, bakariinia Yeso igoro aseero.

english: And as he went , they spread their clothes in the way .
ekegusii: Ere gakogenda, bakaara chianga chiabo inchera.

english: And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen ;
ekegusii: Agachia goika egetirimboko ki’egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, omoganda bwonsi bw’aborokigwa baye bagachaaka kogooka na komobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene ase ebikone bie chinguru bionsi barorire,

english: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .
ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge ase omosangererekano bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, togonyera aborokigwa bao!”

english: And he ran before , and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him : for he was to pass that way .
ekegusii: Agatang’ana bwango, akariina igoro ase omoko anyare komorora, ekiagera ngoetera arenge ase enchera eria.

english: And he answered and said unto them , I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.” Yeso ogwechandera Yerusalemu

english: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
ekegusii: Ere agachia goika ang’e akarora omochie, akayoiyereria amariga,

english: Saying , If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
ekegusii: okobora, “Onye nkwamanya reero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!

english: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,
ekegusii: Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotangerane ase chinsemo chionsi,

english: And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .
ekegusii: na bakoiyerie inse, na abana bao ime ase ore. Tibagotiga ime ase ore riigena erimo igoro ase erinde, ekiagera otamanyeti engaki y’ogocherwa kwao.” Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mat 21:12-17; Mar 11:15-19)

english: And he went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold therein , and them that bought ;
ekegusii: Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,

english: And could not find what they might do : for all the people were very attentive to hear him .
ekegusii: na barabwo tibanyora eki bagokora, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamotegererete.

english: And when Jesus came to the place , he looked up , and saw him , and said unto him , Zacchæus , make haste , and come down ; for to day I must abide at thy house .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamoteebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera reero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.” Akamoteebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera reero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.” |alt="He told him, get down quickly for I will be a visitor in your house today" src="Gw-109.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 19:1-9" copy="Graham Wade" ref="19:5"

english: And he made haste , and came down , and received him joyfully .
ekegusii: Agaika bwango, akamoroisia nomogooko.

english: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw’omonyene ebibe.”

english: And Zacchæus stood , and said unto the Lord ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
ekegusii: Zakayo agatenena, agateebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng’ese ki’enibo yane ning’ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.

english: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,
ekegusii: Abanto abange beruete koriika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.

english: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense .
ekegusii: Na omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki’ogosamba ubani.

english: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani.

english: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled , and fear fell upon him .
ekegusii: Ere agaichana gachia komorora, na omoondoko okamobwata.

english: But the angel said unto him , Fear not , Zacharias : for thy prayer is heard ; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son , and thou shalt call his name John .
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika oria akamoteebia, Toiroka, Zakaria, ekiagera ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na mokao Elisabeti nakoiborere omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye nomoroke Yohana.

english: And thou shalt have joy and gladness ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .
ekegusii: Aye nobe nomogooko na ogosasooka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,

english: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .
ekegusii: Naonchore abange b’Abaisraeli gocha ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.

english: And Zacharias said unto the angel , Whereby shall I know this ? for I am an old man , and my wife well stricken in years .
ekegusii: Zakaria agateebia omomalaika, “Naki ndakore imanye ayio? Ekiagera inche nomogotu, na mokane nagendererete kogota.”

english: Even as they delivered them unto us , which from the beginning were eyewitnesses , and ministers of the word ;
ekegusii: Nigo barigete buna intwe twatebetigwe nabwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring’ana batorenteire.

english: And , behold , thou shalt be dumb , and not able to speak , until the day that these things shall be performed , because thou believest not my words , which shall be fulfilled in their season .
ekegusii: Korende bono aye ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane ayio agochia kooroka chingaki chiaye rora aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka.”

english: And the people waited for Zacharias , and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple .
ekegusii: Chingaki echio abanto baria baganyete Zakaria, bagakumia ase ogotebana kwaye ime ase Hekalu.

english: And when he came out , he could not speak unto them : and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple : for he beckoned unto them , and remained speechless .
ekegusii: Ekero asogete isiko, tanyarete gokwana nabarabwo; erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a nigo arora okorora aria Hekalu ime. Ere nigo arenge kobateeberia nokoboko, akagenderera koba rimama.

english: And it came to pass , that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished , he departed to his own house .
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye y’ogokora emeremo aerete, ere akagenda bwoye.

english: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived , and hid herself five months , saying ,
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteeba,

english: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .
ekegusii: “Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio y’abanto.” Obobani bw’okoiborwa kwa Yeso

english: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,
ekegusii: Omotienyi bw’etano nomo omomalaika Gabirieli agatomwa na Nyasae kogenda omochie o Galili, okorokwa Nazareti,

english: And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .
ekegusii: Agacha asare, akabora, “Mbuya ore aye, oyobwanchererie + 1:28 oyobwanchererie: engencho yaye oyo osesenirie goetania bonsi . Omonene nigo are amo naye.”

english: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
ekegusii: Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring’ana eri, erio ere akebooria, “Ngokwania ki oko?”

english: It seemed good to me also , having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first , to write unto thee in order , most excellent Theophilus ,
ekegusii: Naboigo nainche narorire buya, magega konatukire amang’ana onsi boronge korwa ritang’ani, gokoriikera aye Theofilo bw’amasikani,

english: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, Toiroka Mariamu, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase Nyasae.

english: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
ekegusii: nagaambere enyomba ya Yakobo goika kare na kare; nonya noborwoti bwaye tibokoba nomoerio.

english: Then said Mary unto the angel , How shall this be , seeing I know not a man ?
ekegusii: Mariamu akabooria omomalaika oria, “Naki rirabe ring’ana eri, ekiagera tindaba nomosaacha?”

english: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, “Omoika Omochenu nogochere, ne chinguru chiaye Oyore Igoro Mono nachikobekere ekiriri. Ase ayio, oyoraiborwe narokwe Omochenu, Omwana o Nyasae.

english: And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .
ekegusii: Rora, Elisabeti omoamate oo, nere boigo nare noborito bw’omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye; na omotienyi oyo noyo bw’etano nomo asare ere oyorogetwe omogomba.

english: And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .
ekegusii: Mariamu akabora, “Rora, inche nomosomba bw’Omonene; abe ase ’nde buna ring’ana riao.” Omomalaika akaimoka akarua asare. Mariamu ogochia gokwania Elisabeti, naende ogotogia Nyasae

english: And Mary arose in those days , and went into the hill country with haste , into a city of Juda ;
ekegusii: Mariamu akaimoka ase amatuko ayio, akagenda bwango ase ebitunwa goika omochie oyomo o Yuda,

english: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
ekegusii: erinde onyare komanya oboene bw’amang’ana aria kwegeretigwe. Obobani igoro yokoiborwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi

english: And entered into the house of Zacharias , and saluted Elisabeth .
ekegusii: agasoa nyomba mwa Zakaria, agakwania Elisabeti.

english: And it came to pass , that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the babe leaped in her womb ; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost :
ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,

english: And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .
ekegusii: agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, agakwana, “Gwaseseniigwe aye ase abakungu, na oroiboro rw’enda yao rwasesenigwe.

english: And whence is this to me , that the mother of my Lord should come to me ?
ekegusii: Ng’ai ring’ana eri riarure, ng’ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?

english: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .
ekegusii: Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.

english: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyobwegenete ng’a amang’ana ayio ateebigwe n’Omonene naikeranigwe.”

english: And Mary said , My soul doth magnify the Lord ,
ekegusii: Mariamu agateeba, “Omoyo one otogirie Omonene,

english: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour .
ekegusii: omoika one ogokeire Nyasae, Omotoria one,

english: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things ; and holy is his name .
ekegusii: ekiagera ere oyore ne chinguru onkoreire amanene, na erieta riaye nerichenu.

english: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .
ekegusii: Amaabera aye nigo are ase abwo bamoirogete korwa ebigori goika ebigori.

english: He hath shewed strength with his arm ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
ekegusii: Okorire ogokora gwe chinguru, oserebanirie abaenenu ase ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo.

english: He hath filled the hungry with good things ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .
ekegusii: Abare nenchara obaigotirie amaya; abanyene enibo obaseririe bare namaboko amasa.

english: He hath holpen his servant Israel , in remembrance of his mercy ;
ekegusii: Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amaabera aye,

english: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .
ekegusii: Mariamu akamenya nere emetienyi etato, akairana sobo. Okoiborwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi

english: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered ; and she brought forth a son .
ekegusii: Engaki yokoibora kwa Elisabeti egaika, ere akaibora omwana omoisia.

english: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her ; and they rejoiced with her .
ekegusii: Abairi na eamate yaye bakaigwa ng’a Omonene omororeire amaabera amange, bakagoka amo nere.

english: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .
ekegusii: Na bonsi babere nigo barenge abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae; nigo babwatetie amachiiko ne chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene batari na komocha.

english: And his mother answered and said , Not so ; but he shall be called John .
ekegusii: korende ng’ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”

english: And they said unto her , There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name .
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Tari nonya noyomo ase eamate yao okorokwa erieta erio.”

english: And they made signs to his father , how he would have him called .
ekegusii: Bakorokia ise ase ogokwana kw’ebimanyererio bi’amaboko, komoboria buna arigetie arokwe.

english: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .
ekegusii: Agasaba ebao y’okorika, akarika “Yohana, nario erieta riaye.” Bagakumia bonsi.

english: And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .
ekegusii: Erio kegima agasiborwa omonwa na oromeme rwaye, agakwana, ogotogia Nyasae.

english: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa .
ekegusii: Obwoba bogasoa ase abairi babo bonsi. Amang’ana aya onsi agasaarera ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bia Boyahudi.

english: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts , saying , What manner of child shall this be ! And the hand of the Lord was with him .
ekegusii: Na bonsi abayaigwete bakayabeeka ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakaboora, “Mwana ki rende arabe oyo?” Naki okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere.

english: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost , and prophesied , saying ,
ekegusii: Zakaria ise agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akabana, okobora,

english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,
ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, atogigwe, ekiagera obacheire abanto baye na kobabooria.

english: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David ;
ekegusii: Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.

english: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.

english: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :
ekegusii: Buna ateebete korwa omochakano goetera ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu,

english: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us ;
ekegusii: ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,

english: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant ;
ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.
