english: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham ,
ekegusii: Emuma eria arierete sokoro yaito Aburaamu,

english: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,
ekegusii: ng’a natoe ribaga ri’okomosasiima totari nobwoba, gatoratoorigwe korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baito,

english: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.

english: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins ,
ekegusii: omanyie abanto baye ogotooreka ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.

english: Through the tender mercy of our God ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,
ekegusii: Ase amaabera aye Nyasae oito, ekero amasase a igoro aratochere,

english: And it came to pass , that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course ,
ekegusii: Na ekero riika ria Zakaria ri’ogokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwa Nyasae riarenge,

english: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel .
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru ase omoika, akaba ase erooro goika rituko riria aorogete ase Abaisraeli.

english: According to the custom of the priest’s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .
ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.

english: And it came to pass , that on one of those days , as he taught the people in the temple , and preached the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders ,
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchiri, abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,

english: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen , that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard : but the husbandmen beat him , and sent him away empty .
ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda y’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

english: And again he sent another servant : and they beat him also , and entreated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .
ekegusii: Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.

english: And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .
ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.

english: Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .
ekegusii: Oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu akabora: Inki ndakore? Nintome omwana one, omwanchwa one, aande ere inabamosike.

english: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .
ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria bagachia komoorora, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando, tomoite gaki, omwando onyare koba oyoito.

english: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?
ekegusii: Bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita. Naki rende oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu arabakore?

english: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others . And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .
ekegusii: Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.” Bagachia koigwa aya, bakaboora, “Taba bo.”

english: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken ; but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
ekegusii: Kera omonto oragwe igoro ase rigena erio nabunanekane, na ere oyo riragwere narimosenyente.

english: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo akobayeena, korende bakairoka abanto. Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mat 22:15-22; Mar 12:13-17)

english: And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Toteebie nase okobua ki ogokora aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”

english: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .
ekegusii: Erio bakamoboera Yeso, bagatoma chirooti, na barabwo bagekora buna nabanyene oboronge, erinde bamobwate ase ogokwana kwaye, bamobeke ase okobua kwa gabana na obogambi bwaye.

english: And they asked him , saying , Master , we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly , neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly :
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.

english: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar , or no ?
ekegusii: Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?”

english: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them , Why tempt ye me ?
ekegusii: Korende akamanya obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia,

english: Shew me a penny . Whose image and superscription hath it ? They answered and said , Cæsar’s .
ekegusii: “Inyorokie ebesa! Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakaboora, “Nebia Kaisari.”

english: And he said unto them , Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar’s , and unto God the things which be God’s .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nabo, ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

english: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .
ekegusii: Tibanyaara komobwata ase ring’ana riaye ase obosio bw’abaanto; bagakumia ase okoiraneria kwaye, bagakira. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Mar 12:18-27)

english: There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana;

english: And he answered and said unto them , I will also ask you one thing ; and answer me :
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nainche nkobaboria nde inwe ring’ana erimo, monteebie:

english: And the second took her to wife , and he died childless .
ekegusii: na oyio o kabere akamotwara, na ere agakwa, tatiga bana;

english: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .
ekegusii: nonya noyo o gatato akamotwara. Naboigo bonsi batano na babere bagakwa, tibatiga abana.

english: Last of all the woman died also .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio omokungu oria nere agakwa.

english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she ? for seven had her to wife .
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”

english: And Jesus answering said unto them , The children of this world marry , and are given in marriage :
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;

english: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :
ekegusii: korende barabwo abaabarirwe bagwenerete konyora ense eria, na kobokigwa korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, gose tibakonyuomwa.

english: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .
ekegusii: Naende tibagokwa, ekiagera nigo barabe koreng’ana buna abamalaika, na abana ba Nyasae bare, ekiagera nabana b’okobokigwa.

english: For he is not a God of the dead , but of the living : for all live unto him .
ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”

english: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .
ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakairaneria, “Omworokia, gwakwanire buya.”

english: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ?
ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?”

english: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
ekegusii: Naki monto onde taaba okomoboria ring’ana magega ase aya. Riborio igoro ya Kristo (Mat 22:41-46; Mar 12:35-37)

english: And he said unto them , How say they that Christ is David’s son ?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, Naki abanto bagoteeba ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?

english: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool .
ekegusii: goika mbeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.

english: David therefore calleth him Lord , how is he then his son ?
ekegusii: Daudi nigo akomoroka Omonene, naki rende aba omwana oye? Ogokuurerwa igoro yaborokia b’amariiko (Mat 23:1-36; Mar 12:38-40; Luk 11:37-54)

english: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bamotegererete agateebia aborokigwa baye,

english: Beware of the scribes , which desire to walk in long robes , and love greetings in the markets , and the highest seats in the synagogues , and the chief rooms at feasts ;
ekegusii: “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,

english: Which devour widows’ houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
ekegusii: abakourereria chinyomba chiababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe. Abwo nabanyore ekiina kere ekenene kobua.”

english: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki motamwegenete rende?

english: But and if we say , Of men ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .
ekegusii: Korende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, abanto bonsi nabatoake amagena; ekiagera banchire ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”

english: And they answered , that they could not tell whence it was .
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Titomanyeti aase yarwete.”

english: And Jesus said unto them , Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.” Omoreng’anio bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu (Mat 21:33-46; Mar 12:1-12)

english: And he looked up , and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury .
ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto abanda bakobeeka ebiegwa biabo ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka.

english: Then said he unto them , Nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom :
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti naborwane noborwoti bonde;

english: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .
ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana y’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.

english: But before all these , they shall lay their hands on you , and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues , and into prisons , being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake .
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani ase aya onsi nabababwaate na kobachanda, nabaabaire ase chisinagogi, na ase chichela, namoirwe ase abarwoti na ase abagabana ase engencho y’erieta riane.

english: And it shall turn to you for a testimony .
ekegusii: Eke nekero kiaino koba kirori.

english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom , which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist .
ekegusii: ekiagera inche nimbae chinkwana na obong’aini, abachandi baino batanyare gokana gose koamererania nabio.

english: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents , and brethren , and kinsfolks , and friends ; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death .
ekegusii: Na inwe namoruegwe nabaibori baino, na bamura bamino, na eamate yaino, na abasani baino, na barabwo nababeeke abande baino ase ogoitwa.

english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake .
ekegusii: Inamogechwe nabaanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.

english: But there shall not an hair of your head perish .
ekegusii: Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.

english: In your patience possess ye your souls .
ekegusii: Na ase okoremereria kwaino namonyoore obogima bwaino.

english: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites .
ekegusii: Akarora omoboraka oyomo omotaka, okobeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai.

english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
ekegusii: “Korende, komorarore Yerusalemu oetananirwe nemeganda y’abarwani b’esegi, erio momanye ng’a ogosareka kwaye gwaikire ang’e.

english: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains ; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out ; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto .
ekegusii: Erio abare Boyahudi tiga batame gochia ase ebitunwa, na abare ime ase omochie basoke isiko, na abare isiko tibasoa aroro,

english: But woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck , in those days ! for there shall be great distress in the land , and wrath upon this people .
ekegusii: Nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria, ekiagera nebe emechando emenene igoro ase ense, na endamwamu ase egesaku eke.

english: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword , and shall be led away captive into all nations : and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles , until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled .
ekegusii: Barabwo nabagwe ase chinsonga chi’emioro, nabooswe bairwe ase ebisaku bionsi, na Yerusalemu notachwe nabaanto b’Ebisaku, goika ebiro biabo biikeranigwe. Omoerio bw’ense (Mat 24:29-31; Mar 13:24-27)

english: Men’s hearts failing them for fear , and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth : for the powers of heaven shall be shaken .
ekegusii: Abanto mbakwe ekeondoko na okoiroka kobaganyete ayagoochera ense, ekiagera chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.

english: And when these things begin to come to pass , then look up , and lift up your heads ; for your redemption draweth nigh .
ekegusii: Nabo karachake koba ayio, rigereria igoro, ekiagera okoboorigwa kwaino gwaikire ang’e.” Amorokererio korwa ase Omoko (Mat 24:32-35; Mar 13:28-31)

english: And he spake to them a parable ; Behold the fig tree , and all the trees ;
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Rigereria omoko na emete ende yonsi;

english: And he said , Of a truth I say unto you , that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all :
ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie, Omoboraka oyo omotaka obekire ebinge kobua bonsi,

english: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
ekegusii: ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

english: So likewise ye , when ye see these things come to pass , know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand .
ekegusii: Nainwe boigo komorarore ayio agokoreka, momanye ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae ng’ang’e bore.

english: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass away , till all be fulfilled .
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.

english: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.

english: And take heed to yourselves , lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting , and drunkenness , and cares of this life , and so that day come upon you unawares .
ekegusii: “Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.

english: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth .
ekegusii: Naki naboigo eranyaare goochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.

english: Watch ye therefore , and pray always , that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass , and to stand before the Son of man .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyoore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi araache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”

english: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamochiera mambia chuni aria Hekalu ime, erinde banyaare komoigwa.

english: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .
ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi babeekire korwa ase obonge bwe chinibo chiabo, korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obeekire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio.” Yeso okobana ogotagorwa gwe Hekalu (Mat 24:1-2; Mar 13:1-2)

english: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bande barenge gokwana amang’ana igoro ye Hekalu, buna echabeire namagena amaya na ebiegwa, agateeba.

english: As for these things which ye behold , the days will come , in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
ekegusii: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mat 24:3-25; Mar 13:3-23)

english: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?
ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Omworokia, aya indi arabe rende? Naende ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi araabe ang’e goikerana?”

english: And he said , Take heed that ye be not deceived : for many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ ; and the time draweth near : go ye not therefore after them .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabaache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.

english: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass ; but the end is not by and by .
ekegusii: Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana y’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”

english: And he said unto them , Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,

english: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house , The Master saith unto thee , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
ekegusii: moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia nkoboria are: Ng’ai enyomba y’abageni ere, inyare koriera Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

english: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished : there make ready .
ekegusii: Omonto oria naboorokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo karoisirie; agwo moariganie.”

english: And they went , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakanyora buna abateebetie, bakaarigania Epasaka.

english: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .
ekegusii: Erio ensa egachia goika ang’e, agaikaransa amo nabatomwa.

english: And he said unto them , With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer :
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ninganetie mono koria Epasaka eye amo nainwe ritang’ani ntarachaandwa,

english: For I say unto you , I will not any more eat thereof , until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: ekiagera nabateebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Endagera y’omoerio (Mat 26:20-30; Mar 14:22-26; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)

english: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said , Take this , and divide it among yourselves :
ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabora, “Bogoria eke, mosaange inwe ase inwe;

english: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
ekegusii: naki nabateebirie, korwa bono tinkonywa okwama kw’omosabibu goika oborwoti bwa Nyasae boche.”

english: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying , This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
ekegusii: Akabogoria omogati, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Oyo nomobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino. [Kora iga ase okong’inyora.”

english: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him ; for they feared the people .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.

english: And truly the Son of man goeth , as it was determined : but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed !
ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna yachiigetwe; korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okomorua!”

english: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o ase bare orakore ring’ana eri. Obonene bw’ekeene

english: And he said unto them , The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abarwoti b’abaanto b’ebisaku nigo bakogambera abanto; naende abare nokobua igoro ase bare barokwa Abakori Abaya.

english: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .
ekegusii: “Inwe ninwe mwabeire mogendererete amo nainche ase ogoteemwa kwane,

english: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me ;
ekegusii: na inche nabaeire inwe oborwoti buna Tata ang’ete,

english: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .
ekegusii: Saitani agasoa Yudasi okorokwa Iskariota. Yudasi nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.

english: And the Lord said , Simon , Simon , behold , Satan hath desired to have you , that he may sift you as wheat :
ekegusii: Akabora, “Simioni, Simioni, rora Saitani nabarigetie abaire anyaare kobasoonga buna engano,

english: But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .
ekegusii: korende nagosabeire, erinde okwegena kwao tikoera, na aye gokwaonchokire, obeeke abamiino chinguru.”

english: And he said unto him , Lord , I am ready to go with thee , both into prison , and to death .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”

english: And he said , I tell thee , Peter , the cock shall not crow this day , before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Nagotebirie Petero, reero etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato ng’a tomanyeti.”

english: Then said he unto them , But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Korende bono oyore nekemoya akebogorie, na esaro boigo, na ere oyotari nomoyio o birende aoonie eganchwa yaye, agore oyomo.

english: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them , It is enough .
ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.” Yeso ore Gethisemane (Mat 26:36-46; Mar 14:32-42)

english: And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives ; and his disciples also followed him .
ekegusii: Agasooka, akagenda goika egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, buna engencho yaye yarenge, na aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

english: And he went his way , and communed with the chief priests and captains , how he might betray him unto them .
ekegusii: Akagenda agakwana nabakuani abanene na abatang’ani b’abarendi buna aranyare komobeeka ase amaboko abo.

english: And when he was at the place , he said unto them , Pray that ye enter not into temptation .
ekegusii: Agachia goika aase aria akabateebia, “Saba, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”

english: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast , and kneeled down , and prayed ,
ekegusii: Ageatanana korwa ase bare, ekerengo gi’okoruta rigena, akabeeka amaru inse, agasaba,

english: Saying , Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Tata, koranche, onduserie egekombe eke, + 22:42 Rora Mat 26–42 korende tari buna ndigetie inche, korende buna origetie aye, bikoreke.”

english: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoorokera korwa, igoro, akamobeka chinguru.

english: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .
ekegusii: Na ere ekiagera arenge nomoichano mono, akamenta ogosaba nomokia; ebigeri biaye bikaba buna amatoima y’amanyinga agoiteka inse.

english: And when he rose up from prayer , and was come to his disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow ,
ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.

english: And said unto them , Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mat 26:47-56; Mar 14:43-50; Yoh 18:2-11)

english: And while he yet spake , behold a multitude , and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve , went before them , and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, omoganda ogaacha, na oria okorokwa Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, obatang’aine. Ere akamoika Yeso ang’e komonyunyunta.

english: But Jesus said unto him , Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Yudasi, nkomorua ore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ase okomonyunyunta?”

english: When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?
ekegusii: Na abwo barenge amo nere bagachia korora ayakorigia koba, bakaboora, “Omonene, inatorwane nomoyio o birende?”

english: And they were glad , and covenanted to give him money .
ekegusii: Bakagoka bakabwatana nere komoa chiropia.

english: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .
ekegusii: Oyomo obo agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto gw’okorio.

english: And Jesus answered and said , Suffer ye thus far . And he touched his ear , and healed him .
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.

english: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him , Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abakuani abanene, na abanene b’abarendi be Hekalu, na abagaaka, baria bamoocherete, “Iga mwachire nemeyio ya birende ne chinungu buna mogochiera omouri.

english: Then took they him , and led him , and brought him into the high priest’s house . And Peter followed afar off .
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira, bakagenda nere nyomba ime ase Omokuani omonene. Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka.

english: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .
ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.

english: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire , and earnestly looked upon him , and said , This man was also with him .
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oyomo akamorora oikaransete ang’e nomorero, akamobeta amaiso akabora, “Oyo nere igo arenge amo nere.”

english: And he denied him , saying , Woman , I know him not .
ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Omokungu, timomanyeti.”

english: And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
ekegusii: Naende ake omonto onde akamorora, akabora, “Aye noyomo obo ore.” Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, tai inche.”

english: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed , saying , Of a truth this fellow also was with him : for he is a Galilæan .
ekegusii: Na magega y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”

english: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .
ekegusii: Agancha, akarigia ribaga akomoruera ase bare emeganda etaiyo. Okwearigania kw’Endagera y’omoerio (Mat 26:17-19; Mar 14:12-16)

english: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .
ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, timanyeti eri ogokwana.” Erio kegima kagokwana, etuoni ekabuga.

english: And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him , Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
ekegusii: Omonene akeonchora, akarigereria Petero. Petero akainyora ring’ana ri’Omonene, buna amoteebetie, “Reero, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga nonkaane ara gatato.”

english: And Peter went out , and wept bitterly .
ekegusii: Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo. Yeso ogosekererigwa na goakwa (Mat 26:67-68; Mar 14:65)

english: And the men that held Jesus mocked him , and smote him .
ekegusii: Abanto baria babwatete Yeso, bakamosekereria, na komoaka.

english: And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?
ekegusii: Bakamotuba amaiso, bakamobooria, “Bana! Ning’o ogoaka?”

english: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .
ekegusii: Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama. Yeso ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene (Mat 26:59-66; Mar 14:55-64; Yoh 18:19-24)

english: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abaanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakoboora,

english: Art thou the Christ ? tell us . And he said unto them , If I tell you , ye will not believe :
ekegusii: “Onye aye naye Kristo, toteebie.” Korende akabateebia, “Ninsa kobateebia, timokonyaara gwancha;

english: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me , nor let me go .
ekegusii: naende nimbaboria, timokong’iraneria.

english: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .
ekegusii: Korende korwa bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto naikaranse ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.”

english: Then came the day of unleavened bread , when the passover must be killed .
ekegusii: Rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera rigaika, eri’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka egwenerete konyenywa.

english: Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them , Ye say that I am .
ekegusii: Bakaboora bonsi, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabateebia, “Inwe mwateebire ng’a ninche ere.”

english: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”

english: And he sent Peter and John , saying , Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”

english: And they said unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare ?
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie toyeroiserie?”

english: And the whole multitude of them arose , and led him unto Pilate .
ekegusii: Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.

english: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bagatenena, bakomosoera ne chinguru.

english: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .
ekegusii: Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.

english: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .
ekegusii: Erio Herode na Pilato abwo barenge ababisa agwo ritang’ani bakabwatana korwa rituko riria bakaba abasani. Pilato, na Baraba, na Yeso (Mat 27:15-26; Mar 15:6-15; Yoh 18:39—19:16)

english: And Pilate , when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people ,
ekegusii: Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagaambi, na abanto,

english: Said unto them , Ye have brought this man unto me , as one that perverteth the people : and , behold , I , having examined him before you , have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him :
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Mwandeterete omonto oyo, buna oyo baonchoire abanto; naunirie amang’ana aye ase amasio aino, na tindochi bobe ase omonto oyo ase aria mwamosoerete,

english: No , nor yet Herod : for I sent you to him ; and , lo , nothing worthy of death is done unto him .
ekegusii: nonya n’Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha ase tore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.

english: I will therefore chastise him , and release him .
ekegusii: Erio konamoakire, nimosibore.”

english: ( For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast .)
ekegusii: Bono igo yamogwenerete kobasiborera omonto oyomo ekero kie rituko rinene.

english: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :
ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi bonsi amo, bakaboora, “Morusie oyo, tosiborere Baraba!”

english: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison .)
ekegusii: (Ere nomonto obegetwe ase echela ase engencho y’eriomana riakoregete ase omochie ime, na ase oboiti.)

english: And they began to accuse him , saying , We found this fellow perverting the nation , and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar , saying that he himself is Christ a King .
ekegusii: Bagachaaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire ense yaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omorwoti.”

english: Pilate therefore , willing to release Jesus , spake again to them .
ekegusii: Nabo eria kabere Pilato agakwana nabarabwo, akarigia gosibora Yeso.

english: But they cried , saying , Crucify him , crucify him .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Mobambe, mobambe!”

english: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”

english: And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .
ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera kobora ase eriogi rinene ng’a goika abambwe. Eriogi riabo rikabua.

english: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .
ekegusii: Pilato akanacha amang’ana akoreke buna barigetie.

english: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .
ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso ase bare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Mar 15:21-32; Yoh 19:17-27)

english: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .
ekegusii: Bagachia komoira, bakabwata Simioni Omokurene, oyorenge korwa borabu, bakamotweka omosalaba, ayobogorie magega ya Yeso.

english: And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .
ekegusii: Omoganda bw’abaanto okamotunyana, na abakungu baare kweaka‐aka, na komweng’erereria.

english: But Jesus turning unto them said , Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .
ekegusii: Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.

english: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .
ekegusii: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!

english: And Pilate asked him , saying , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answered him and said , Thou sayest it .
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akaimoiraneria, “Naye gwateebire.”

english: For if they do these things in a green tree , what shall be done in the dry ?
ekegusii: Onye bagokora aya ekero omote ore omobese, naki eraabe ekero bwomire?”

english: And there were also two other , malefactors , led with him to be put to death .
ekegusii: Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.

english: And when they were come to the place , which is called Calvary , there they crucified him , and the malefactors , one on the right hand , and the other on the left .
ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro, Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro|alt="When they came to a place known as the skull, there they crucified him" src="Gw-118.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 33:32-38" copy="Graham Wade" ref="23:33" na baria abasaria, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko gw’okobee.

english: And saying , If thou be the king of the Jews , save thyself .
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Onye aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, etoorie.”

english: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek , and Latin , and Hebrew , THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
ekegusii: Igoro asare nkiarengeo ekemanyererio keriikire ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki, na Ekerumi, na Ekeiberania “OYO NERE OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

english: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
ekegusii: Oyomo bwa baria abasaria baabambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”

english: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people , I find no fault in this man .
ekegusii: Pilato agateebia abakuani abanene na emeganda, “Inche tindochi komocha konde ase omonto oyo.”

english: But the other answering rebuked him , saying , Dost not thou fear God , seeing thou art in the same condemnation ?
ekegusii: Oyo o kabere akamokania, akabora, “Aye tori komoiroka nonya Nyasae, aye kore ase ekiina keria keria?

english: And we indeed justly ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .
ekegusii: Intwe ekeene mboronge; ekiagera twaeirwe eng’eria ya boronge y’ogokora gwaito, korende oyo takoreti gento kende kebe.”

english: And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oborwoti bwao!”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Verily I say unto thee , To day shalt thou be with me in paradise .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.” Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Mar 15:33-41; Yoh 19:28-30)

english: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
ekegusii: ekero omobaso orimire. Na egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka gati‐gati.

english: Now when the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man .
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana agachia korora aya, agatogia Nyasae, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge omonyene oboronge.”

english: And all the people that came together to that sight , beholding the things which were done , smote their breasts , and returned .
ekegusii: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.

english: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Jewry , beginning from Galilee to this place .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobetereria, bakaboora, “Oburukanirie abanto, goetera ase amorokererio aye ase Boyahudi yonsi, korwa Galili ase achaakerete na goika bono oikire aiga.” Yeso ase obosio bwa Herode

english: And , behold , there was a man named Joseph , a counsellor ; and he was a good man , and a just :
ekegusii: Rora, narengeo omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yusufu, omonto bw’Arimathaya, omochie o Boyahudi, ere nomonto bw’ekegambero kiabo, omonto omuya, naende omooronge.

english: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them ;) he was of Arimathæa , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Ere tanchete amang’ana abo, nonya nogokora kwabo, nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: This man went unto Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus .
ekegusii: Omonto oyo agachiera Pilato, akamosaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.

english: And he took it down , and wrapped it in linen , and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone , wherein never man before was laid .
ekegusii: Akayoikia, akayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, akayobeeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare, aase monto onde atana kobekwa.

english: And that day was the preparation , and the sabbath drew on .
ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Esabato egachaaka gosoa.

english: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .
ekegusii: Abakungu abaachete amo nere korwa Galili, nigo batunyanete korwa magega, bakarigereria oboina na buna omobere oye bwareretigwe.

english: When Pilate heard of Galilee , he asked whether the man were a Galilæan .
ekegusii: Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”

english: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .
ekegusii: Agachia komanya ng’a nigo are inse ase obogambi bwa Herode, akamotoma gochia ase Herode. Na Herode omonyene nigo arenge Yerusalemu ase amatuko aria.

english: And when Herod saw Jesus , he was exceeding glad : for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him ; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him .
ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora Yeso akagokigwa mono, ekiagera korwa kare nigo arigetie komoorora, ekiagera aigwete chinkuma chiaye, naende nigo asemeretie korora egekone kegokorwa nere.

english: Then he questioned with him in many words ; but he answered him nothing .
ekegusii: Akamoboria amaborio ase engaki entambe, korende Yeso tamoiraneria ing’ana rinde rionsi.

english: Now upon the first day of the week , very early in the morning , they came unto the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared , and certain others with them .
ekegusii: Korende rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kobogokiamoka, abakungu baria bakagenda ase oboina, bakaira amanukato aria, ayababegete ang’e.

english: It was Mary Magdalene , and Joanna , and Mary the mother of James , and other women that were with them , which told these things unto the apostles .
ekegusii: Na baria bateebetie abatomwa amang’ana aya nabwo aba: Mariamu Magidalena, na Yoana, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na abakungu bande abarenge amo nabarabwo.

english: And their words seemed to them as idle tales , and they believed them not .
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akarorekana koba ng’a naya bosa ase bare, gose tibayancha. [

english: Then arose Peter , and ran unto the sepulchre ; and stooping down , he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves , and departed , wondering in himself at that which was come to pass .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.] Yeso okororekana ase enchera ekogenda Emau (Mar 16:12-13)

english: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
ekegusii: Rituko riria babere ase bare nkogenda baare ase omochie okorokwa Emau, orenge oboare korwa Yerusalemu ang’e chimaeli isano na isato.

english: And they talked together of all these things which had happened .
ekegusii: Na barabwo ngokwana baare barabwo ase barabwo igoro ase aya onsi akorekire.

english: And it came to pass , that, while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
ekegusii: Kabagokwana na koborania, Yeso omonyene agaika ang’e, akagenda amo nabarabwo.

english: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him .
ekegusii: Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.

english: And he said unto them , What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki aya mokoborania ase orogendo rwaino?” Bagatenena, baichanete.

english: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?
ekegusii: Oyomo obo, erieta riaye Kiliopa, akamoiraneria, “Inee! Naye bweka ore omogeni ase Yerusalemu, otamanyeti ayare ime yaye amatuko aya?”

english: And he said unto them , What things ? And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki?” Bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana a Yeso Omonazareti, oyorenge omobani, omonyene chinguru ase ogokora na ase ring’ana, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase abanto bonsi;

english: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Bakanyoora rigena riria riatigerigwe korwa ase oboina,

english: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death , and have crucified him .
ekegusii: na buna abakuani abanene na abanene baito bamoruete ase ekiina ki’ogokwa, bakamobaamba.

english: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .
ekegusii: Korende intwe nigo twasemeretie ng’a nere oraboorie Abaisraeli. Kobua aya onsi, reero nerituko ria gatato korwa ekero ayio akorekanete.

english: Yea , and certain women also of our company made us astonished , which were early at the sepulchre ;
ekegusii: Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,

english: And when they found not his body , they came , saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .
ekegusii: na ekero batanyorete omobere oye, bakairana, bakaboora ng’a baorokeirwe nabamalaika ababatebetie ng’a moyo are.

english: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre , and found it even so as the women had said : but him they saw not .
ekegusii: Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu bateebete, korende ere tibamorora.”

english: Then he said unto them , O fools , and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken :
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Inwe abanto abariri, nabanyene chinkoro chinyoro ase okwegena onsi aya ababani bateebete.

english: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things , and to enter into his glory ?
ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”

english: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself .
ekegusii: Agachaakera korwa Musa na ababani bonsi akabateebereria korwa ase amariiko onsi amang’ana ariikire igoro yaye.

english: And they drew nigh unto the village , whither they went : and he made as though he would have gone further .
ekegusii: Bagaika omochie oria ase baare kogenda, na ere agekora buna nigo arigetie kobaetania.

english: But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .
ekegusii: Bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.

english: And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
ekegusii: korende ekero basoa, tibanyoora omobere Omonene Yeso.

english: And it came to pass , as he sat at meat with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .
ekegusii: Ekero aikaransire amo nabarabwo koragera, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa.

english: And their eyes were opened , and they knew him ; and he vanished out of their sight .
ekegusii: Erio amaiso abo akaramokigwa, bakamomanya; na agwo kegima agasira, tarorekana ase bare.

english: And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?
ekegusii: Bakaboorania, “Inee! Emioyo yaito tiyarenge gwoka ekero aba ngokwana are naintwe inchera na gotworokereria amariiko?”

english: And they rose up the same hour , and returned to Jerusalem , and found the eleven gathered together , and them that were with them ,
ekegusii: Bakaimoka ensa eria eria, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakanyoora baria ikomi nomo basangererekanete, na baria abarenge amo nabarabwo,

english: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Ekeene, Omonene obokire, oorokeire Simioni.”

english: And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakabateebia aya akoreka inchera, buna emanyekania ase bare ase ogosamunyora omogati. Yeso okoorokera abatomwa (Mat 28:16-20; Mar 16:14-18; Yoh 20:19-23)

english: And as they thus spake , Jesus himself stood in the midst of them , and saith unto them , Peace be unto you .
ekegusii: Ekero baare gokwana iga, Yeso omonyene agatenena egati yabo, akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”

english: But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .
ekegusii: Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.

english: And he said unto them , Why are ye troubled ? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts ?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?

english: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
ekegusii: Rora amaboko aane na amagoro aane, ng’a ninche omonyene; mbwata‐bwate, morore, ekiagera rirengari tiriri nomobere na amauga buna mondoche inche inde nabio.”

english: And it came to pass , as they were much perplexed thereabout , behold , two men stood by them in shining garments :
ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e ase bare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.

english: And when he had thus spoken , he shewed them his hands and his feet .
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya akaborokia amaboko aye na amagoro aye.

english: And while they yet believed not for joy , and wondered , he said unto them , Have ye here any meat ?
ekegusii: Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogooko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”

english: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish , and of an honeycomb .
ekegusii: Bakamoa egesamunye gi’enswe gesambire na obooke boke.

english: And he took it , and did eat before them .
ekegusii: Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.

english: And he said unto them , These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Aya naro amang’ana aane nare kona‐kobateebia ekero narenge amo nainwe, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa, ayarigetwe igoro yane ase amachiiko a Musa, na ase ababani, na ase Zaburi.”

english: Then opened he their understanding , that they might understand the scriptures ,
ekegusii: Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariiko.

english: And said unto them , Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakuure ase rituko ria gatato;

english: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations , beginning at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: na ebisaku bionsi mbiranderigwe ase erieta riaye okoonchoka na okorusigwa kw’ebibe, gochaakera Yerusalemu.

english: And ye are witnesses of these things .
ekegusii: Inwe mbirori b’amang’ana aya.

english: And as they were afraid , and bowed down their faces to the earth , they said unto them , Why seek ye the living among the dead ?
ekegusii: Abakungu baria bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatung’ama inse. Abanto baria bakabateebia, “Nase ki mokorigia oyore moyo ase ebitondo? [Tari aa, korende obokire.]

english: And it came to pass , while he blessed them , he was parted from them , and carried up into heaven .
ekegusii: Kabasesenirie ageatanana korwa ase bare akabogorigwa gochia igoro.

english: And they worshipped him , and returned to Jerusalem with great joy :
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamosasiima, bakairana Yerusalemu nomogooko omonene;

english: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
ekegusii: bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.

english: Saying , The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men , and be crucified , and the third day rise again .
ekegusii: ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abekwe ase amaboko y’abanto abanyene ebibe, na kobambwa, na ase rituko ria gatato nabooke.”

english: And they remembered his words ,
ekegusii: Bakainyora amang’ana aye.

english: And returned from the sepulchre , and told all these things unto the eleven , and to all the rest .
ekegusii: Bakairana korwa ase oboina, bagateebia baria ikomi nomo na baria abande bonsi amang’ana ayio onsi.

english: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abaanto oriikwe ase ense yonsi.

english: And the angel said unto them , Fear not : for , behold , I bring you good tidings of great joy , which shall be to all people .
ekegusii: Omomalaika akabateebia, “Timoiroka, ekiagera nabarenteire amang’ana amaya ay’omogooko omonene, oraabe ase abanto bonsi,

english: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour , which is Christ the Lord .
ekegusii: naki reero ase Omochie o Daudi oiboirwe Omotooria ase engencho yaino, nere Kristo Omonene.

english: And this shall be a sign unto you ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .
ekegusii: Na eke nekemanyererio ase more: Namonyore omwana ekeng’werere obekeire chianga chi’obwana, bwareirie ase orotuba.”

english: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,
ekegusii: Bwango igo mbarengeo amo nomomalaika oria omoganda o igoro, bagotogia Nyasae, bakoboora,

english: Glory to God in the highest , and on earth peace , good will toward men .
ekegusii: “Obonene ase Nyasae ore Igoro Mono, na ase ense omorembe, ase abanto abwo bancheirwe nere.”

english: And it came to pass , as the angels were gone away from them into heaven , the shepherds said one to another , Let us now go even unto Bethlehem , and see this thing which is come to pass , which the Lord hath made known unto us .
ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagateebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”

english: And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .
ekegusii: Bakagenda nomoayerero, bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba. Bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba.|alt="They found Mary and Joseph with the new-born baby laid in a manger" src="Gw-065.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 2:15-17" copy="Graham Wade" ref="2:16"

english: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
ekegusii: Bagachia komorora, bakaorokia ring’ana bateebetigwe igoro y’omwana oyio.

english: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds .
ekegusii: Bonsi abaigwete bagakumia ase aria bateebetigwe nabarisia.

english: But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .
ekegusii: Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.

english: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria .)
ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omobaro bw’eritang’ani oriigetwe ekero Kurenio arenge gabana o Siiria.

english: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
ekegusii: Abarisia bakairana, bagotogia Nyasae na komobaka ase amang’ana onsi baigwete, na ayabaroche, buna bateebetigwe. Yeso Okorokwa Erieta

english: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished , they brought him to Jerusalem , to present him to the Lord ;
ekegusii: Na ekero amatuko ogwesibia kwabo achia goika, ayachikiire ase amachiiko a Musa, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bamobeke ase Omonene

english: And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .
ekegusii: Rora narengeo omonto Yerusalemu, erieta riaye Simioni + 2:25 Simioni: engencho yaye omoika omochenu ore igoro asare . Oyio nigo arenge omonto omooronge, na nigo asigete Nyasae, ere nigo aganyete ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli; na Omoika Omochenu nigo orenge igoro asare.

english: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost , that he should not see death , before he had seen the Lord’s Christ .
ekegusii: Ere nigo aorokereretigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a takorora amakweri atararora Kristo Omonene.

english: And he came by the Spirit into the temple : and when the parents brought in the child Jesus , to do for him after the custom of the law ,
ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiiko,

english: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,
ekegusii: Simioni akamonyora, akamoagata ase amaboko aye, agatogia Nyasae, akabora,

english: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :
ekegusii: “Omonene, bono otige omosomba oo agende nomorembe, koreng’ana nering’ana riao.

english: And all went to be taxed , every one into his own city .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakagenda koriikwa, kera omonto ase omochie oye.

english: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,
ekegusii: Ekiagera amaiso aane arorire ogotooreka kwao,

english: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people ;
ekegusii: oko kwabekire ase amaiso y’abanto bonsi,

english: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .
ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

english: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against ;
ekegusii: Simioni akabasesenia, agateebia Mariamu ng’ina, “Rora, Omwana oyo otenenigwe ase ogosira na ogotoreka ase abange b’Abaisraeli, abe ekiorokererio kerabe kegokwanwa mamincha,

english: ( Yea , a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also ,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed .
ekegusii: erinde ebirengererio bie chinkoro chinyinge biorokigwe. Boigo omoro nokobete omoyo oo.”

english: And there was one Anna , a prophetess , the daughter of Phanuel , of the tribe of Aser : she was of a great age , and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity ;
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu omobani, Anna, omoiseke o Fanueli, bw’egesaku ki’Asheri. Ere nomong’ina bw’amatuko amange, obete nomosaacha oye emiaka etano na ebere magega y’okoera kw’oboiseke bwaye.

english: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .
ekegusii: Ere agatigara ore omoboraka goika emiaka emerongo etano etato na ene (84), atana korua ase Hekalu ime, korende akaba okweng’ata, na ogosaba, na ogosasiima obotuko na omobaso.

english: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord , and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agateebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria. Koirana gochia Nazareti

english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judæa , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David :)
ekegusii: Na Yusufu nere akaimoka korwa Galili korwa ase omochie o Nazareti, agatiira kogenda Boyahudi, goika Omochie o Daudi, okorokwa Bethlehemu, ekiagera nigo arenge oyo bw’enyomba na eamate ya Daudi,

english: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , filled with wisdom : and the grace of God was upon him .
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru, agaichorwa nobong’aini ne chisemi; na akanyora ogwancherwa ase Nyasae. Omwana Yeso ase Hekalu

english: And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .
ekegusii: Goika agachia koba nemiaka ikomi na ebere, bagatiira kogenda aroro, buna yarenge engencho ye Rituko Rinene.

english: And when they had fulfilled the days , as they returned , the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem ; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .
ekegusii: Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara magega agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.

english: But they, supposing him to have been in the company , went a day’s journey ; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw’omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase abairi babo boigo nabasani.

english: And when they found him not , they turned back again to Jerusalem , seeking him .
ekegusii: Ekero batamonyorete, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakamorigia.

english: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riagatato bakamonyora Hekalu ime, oikaransete gati ase aborokia, obategererete na kobaboria amaborio.

english: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .
ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia ase okomanya kwaye na okoiraneria kwaye.

english: And when they saw him , they were amazed : and his mother said unto him , Son , why hast thou thus dealt with us ? behold , thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing .
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagachia komoorora bagaichana mono. Ng’ina akamoteebia, “Omwana one, naki gwatokorire iga? Rora, iso na inche twarenge gokorigia nomoichano.”

english: And he said unto them , How is it that ye sought me ? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business ?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naki mokondigia? Timomanyeti ng’a nengwenerete koba ase enyomba ya Tata one + 2:49 Ase enyomba ya tata: Ase emeremo ya tata ?”

english: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife , being great with child .
ekegusii: erinde ariikwe amo na Mariamu, ekiagera konya omoriereire boko, na Mariamu nigo arenge morito.

english: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .
ekegusii: Tibamanya ring’ana riria abateebia.

english: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .
ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agaika Nazareti, akaba nkobaigwera are. Ng’ina akagacha amang’ana aya onsi ase enkoro yaye ime.

english: And so it was , that, while they were there , the days were accomplished that she should be delivered .
ekegusii: Ekero barenge aroro engaki yaye y’okoibora egaika.

english: And she brought forth her firstborn son , and wrapped him in swaddling clothes , and laid him in a manger ; because there was no room for them in the inn .
ekegusii: Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni. Abarisia na Abamalaika

english: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio mbarengeo abarisia baikaransete ase ebitii, bakorenda amaicho abo botuko.

english: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .
ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akabaorokera, na obonene bw’Omonene bokabaabarera; bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge.

english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato orenge gabana o Boyahudi, na Herode omorwoti o Galili, na Filipo momura omwabo arenge omorwoti o Iturea na ense ya Tarakoniti, na Lusania omorwoti o Abileni,

english: And the people asked him , saying , What shall we do then ?
ekegusii: Emeganda eria ekamoboria, “Ninki rende torakore?”

english: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”

english: And he said unto them , Exact no more than that which is appointed you .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timorusia kobua ebi mwachigetwe.”

english: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him , saying , And what shall we do ? And he said unto them , Do violence to no man , neither accuse any falsely ; and be content with your wages .
ekegusii: Abasikari nabarabwo bakamobooria, “Naintwe inki torakore?” Akabairaneria, “Timourereria monto onde ase chinguru gose ase obosoeri bw’oborimo; naende moisaneke neng’eria yaino.”

english: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not ;
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baganyete na konakorengereria, bonsi bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo ime gose Yohana nere Kristo.

english: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria abwo bonsi, “Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amaache, korende oyore ne chinguru kombua ngocha are, ting’isaini gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye; oyio nere orabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.

english: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will throughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .
ekegusii: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”

english: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people .
ekegusii: Nabo ase ogokuurera okonge Yohana akaranderia abanto amang’ana amaya.

english: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests , the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness .
ekegusii: ekero ki’obokuani obonene bw’Anasi na Kayafa, ring’ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.

english: Added yet this above all , that he shut up John in prison .
ekegusii: Korende Herode agakora rinene kobua, ase okoruta ase Yohana echela. Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mat 3:13-17; Mar 1:9-11)

english: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,
ekegusii: Egachia koba abanto bonsi kobaabatisirwe, na Yeso boigo kabatisirwe, na ekero agosaba, igoro akamaanoka.

english: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age , being ( as was supposed ) the son of Joseph , which was the son of Heli ,
ekegusii: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye igo yarenge ang’e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng’a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,

english: Which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi , which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Janna , which was the son of Joseph ,
ekegusii: o Mathati, o Lawi, o Meliki, o Yana, o Yusufu,

english: Which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Amos , which was the son of Naum , which was the son of Esli , which was the son of Nagge ,
ekegusii: o Matathia, o Amos, o Nahum, o Esili, o Nagai,

english: Which was the son of Maath , which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Semei , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Juda ,
ekegusii: o Maathi, o Matathia, o Semei, o Yoseki, o Yoda,

english: Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
ekegusii: o Yohana, o Resa, o Serubabeli, o Salatieli, o Neri,

english: Which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Addi , which was the son of Cosam , which was the son of Elmodam , which was the son of Er ,
ekegusii: o Meliki, o Adi, o Kosamu, o Elimadamu, o Eri,

english: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
ekegusii: o Yoshua, o Eliezeri, o Yorimu, o Mathati, o Lawi,

english: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins ;
ekegusii: Akagenda chinse chionsi chi’ensemo ya Yorodani, okorandia ebatiso y’okoonchoka ekorenta okwaberwa kw’ebibe.

english: Which was the son of Simeon , which was the son of Juda , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Jonan , which was the son of Eliakim ,
ekegusii: o Simioni, o Yuda, o Yusufu, o Yonam, o Eliakimu,

english: Which was the son of Melea , which was the son of Menan , which was the son of Mattatha , which was the son of Nathan , which was the son of David ,
ekegusii: o Melea, o Mainani, o Mattatha, o Nathani, o Daudi,

english: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,
ekegusii: o Yese, o Obedi, o Boazi, o Salimoni, o Nashoni,

english: Which was the son of Aminadab , which was the son of Aram , which was the son of Esrom , which was the son of Phares , which was the son of Juda ,
ekegusii: o Aminadabu, o Admin, o Aramu, o Hezironi, o Peresu, o Yuda,

english: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
ekegusii: o Yakobo, o Isaka, o Aburaamu, o Tera, o Nahori,

english: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
ekegusii: o Serugi, o Reu, o Pelegi, o Eberi, o Sala,

english: Which was the son of Cainan , which was the son of Arphaxad , which was the son of Sem , which was the son of Noe , which was the son of Lamech ,
ekegusii: o Kainani, o Arifakisadi, o Shemu, o Nuhu, o Lameki,

english: Which was the son of Mathusala , which was the son of Enoch , which was the son of Jared , which was the son of Maleleel , which was the son of Cainan ,
ekegusii: o Metusela, o Enoku, o Yaredi, o Malaleeli, o Kainani,

english: Which was the son of Enos , which was the son of Seth , which was the son of Adam , which was the son of God .
ekegusii: o Enosu, o Seti, o Adamu, o Nyasae.

english: Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth ;
ekegusii: Kera rigooko nariichorigwe, na kera ekegoro na egetunwa nabikeeigwe; aare bogeka inarongeigwe, na enchera ere ebitunwa‐tunwa nereng’anigwe;

english: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God .
ekegusii: na abanto bonsi nabarore ogotooreka gokorwa ase Nyasae.”

english: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,
ekegusii: Na Yeso oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akairana korwa Yorodani, agatang’anwa n’Omoika kogenda ase erooro,

english: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
ekegusii: naende: Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.

english: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .
ekegusii: Saitani agachia gokoora ogoteema kwaye gwonsi, akaimoka korwa asare, akamotiga ase egeka. Yeso ogochaka emeremo Galili (Mat 4:12-17; Mar 1:14-15)

english: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee : and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about .
ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi’Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.

english: And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .
ekegusii: Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabaanto bonsi. Yeso okwangwa Nazareti (Mat 13:53-58; Mar 6:1-6)

english: And he came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up : and , as his custom was , he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and stood up for to read .
ekegusii: Akagenda Nazareti, aria ase arereretwe; na ase rituko ri’Esabato agasoa ase esinagogi yabo, buna engencho yaye yarenge, agatenena gosoma.

english: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias . And when he had opened the book , he found the place where it was written ,
ekegusii: Akaegwa egetabu y’omobani Isaya. Nabo akaigora egetabu eyio, akanyora aase ariikire,

english: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord .
ekegusii: Na korandia omwakabwo Omonene bwancheretwe.

english: Being forty days tempted of the devil . And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended , he afterward hungered .
ekegusii: agateemwa na Saitani ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene. Na amatuko aria tariete gento. Goika agachia koera, akaigwa enchara.

english: And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .
ekegusii: Akamumekeria egetabu eria akayea omokori emeremo bw’esinagogi, agaikaransa. Abanto bonsi abarenge ase esinagogi bakamobeta amaiso.

english: And he began to say unto them , This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .
ekegusii: Agachaaka kobateebia, “Reero ririiko eri riaikeranigwe ase more buna mwarigwa rigosomwa.”

english: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph’s son ?
ekegusii: Bonsi bakamokwana buya bagakumia amang’ana obuya aruete ase omonwa oye, bagateebania, “Oyo tari ere omwana o Yusufu?”

english: And he said unto them , Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene, namonteebie omoreng’anio oyo: Omogwenia, egwenie aye omonyene; amang’ana onsi twaigure akorekire Kapernaumu, yakore aiga ase ense yao.”

english: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,
ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.

english: And rose up , and thrust him out of the city , and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built , that they might cast him down headlong .
ekegusii: Bakaimoka bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoira goika igoro y’egetunwa keria omochie obo oagachire erio, banyare komoturunkania.

english: And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .
ekegusii: Saitani akamoteebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”

english: But he passing through the midst of them went his way ,
ekegusii: Korende ere agaeta egati‐gati yabo, akagenda. Okogwenigwa kw’omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi (Mar 1:21-28)

english: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .
ekegusii: Agatirimboka goika Kapernaumu, omochie o Galili. Akaba nkoborokereria are rituko ri’Esabato.

english: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,
ekegusii: Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire n’Omoika bw’ekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,

english: Saying , Let us alone ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art ; the Holy One of God .
ekegusii: “Ah! Totige intwe Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Ngwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”

english: And Jesus rebuked him , saying , Hold thy peace , and come out of him . And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!” Ekerecha keria gekamoiyeria agwo gati‐gati, gekamorwa, tikiamokorera gento.

english: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .
