ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ing’ana ki eri? Naki ase chinguru na okobua kiagochika ebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio biasoka.”

english: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria. Yeso okogwenia aaria mwa Simioni (Mat 8:14-17; Mar 1:29-39)

english: And he arose out of the synagogue , and entered into Simon’s house . And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever ; and they besought him for her .
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase esinagogi, agasoa ase enyomba ya Simioni. Nabo ng’ina biara Simioni konya orwarire esosera; bakamosaba ase engencho yaye.

english: And he stood over her , and rebuked the fever ; and it left her : and immediately she arose and ministered unto them .
ekegusii: Agatenena ang’e nere, agatogonyera esosera eria; ekamotiga. Bwango ere akaimoka akabakorera.

english: Now when the sun was setting , all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him ; and he laid his hands on every one of them , and healed them .
ekegusii: Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.

english: And devils also came out of many , crying out , and saying , Thou art Christ the Son of God . And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak : for they knew that he was Christ .
ekegusii: Ebirecha bigasoka korwa ase abange, bigaaka eriogi, bikabora, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabitogonyera, tabitiga bikwane, ekiagera biamanyete ng’a nere Kristo. Yeso okorandia ase esinagogi

english: And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .
ekegusii: Goika ekaba mobaso, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto. Na abanto bakamoriga‐rigia, bakamoikera, bakarigia komotanga taimoka korwa ase bare.

english: And he said unto them , I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also : for therefore am I sent .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nengwenerete korandia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase emechie ende boigo, ekiagera natometwe ase engencho eyio.”

english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee .
ekegusii: Akaba nkorandia are ase chisinagogi chia Boyahudi.

english: And the devil , taking him up into an high mountain , shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .
ekegusii: Saitani akamoira aase aimokererete igoro, akamworokia amarwoti onsi ay’ense ase egeka ekemo,

english: And the devil said unto him , All this power will I give thee , and the glory of them : for that is delivered unto me ; and to whomsoever I will I give it .
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe okobua oko gwonsi, na obonene bwaye, ekiagera nabieirwe, na inche iga nkoa oyo ngwancha.

english: If thou therefore wilt worship me , all shall be thine .
ekegusii: Nabo koransasiime, bionsi nabibe ebiao.”

english: And he brought him to Jerusalem , and set him on a pinnacle of the temple , and said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down from hence :
ekegusii: Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu, akamotenenia igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono, akamoteebia, Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse korwa aa,

english: And so was also James , and John , the sons of Zebedee , which were partners with Simon . And Jesus said unto Simon , Fear not ; from henceforth thou shalt catch men .
ekegusii: naboigo Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, abarenge ababwatani ba Simioni. Yeso agateebia Simioni, “Toiroka; korwa bono nobe omorubi bw’abaanto.”

english: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .
ekegusii: Naende kobarentire amaato abo gochia engegu, bagatiga bionsi, bakamotunyana. Yeso Okogwenia omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma (Mat 8:1-4; Mar 1:40-45)

english: And it came to pass , when he was in a certain city , behold a man full of leprosy : who seeing Jesus fell on his face , and besought him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomoteebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

english: And he put forth his hand , and touched him , saying , I will : be thou clean . And immediately the leprosy departed from him .
ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.

english: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .
ekegusii: Korende chinkuma chiaye chikamenteka gokuma. Emeganda emenge egasangererekana gocha komoigwa, na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.

english: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .
ekegusii: Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasaba. Yeso okogwenia omonto orenge rigata (Mat 9:1-8; Mar 2:1-12)

english: And it came to pass on a certain day , as he was teaching , that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by , which were come out of every town of Galilee , and Judæa , and Jerusalem : and the power of the Lord was present to heal them .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’amatuko aria ekero arenge kworokereria, Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiiko barenge aroro baikaransete. Abwo baruete ase kera omochie o Galili na Boyahudi, na korwa Yerusalemu. Na okobua kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere anyare kogwenia.

english: And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .
ekegusii: Na rigereria, abanto mbabogoretie noborere omonto orenge rigata, bakarigia komoira nyomba ime na komobeka ase obosio bwaye.

english: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude , they went upon the housetop , and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus .
ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ri’okomoira ime ase engencho y’omoganda oria bw’abaanto, bakariina kerama igoro, bakamoikia korwa kerama noborere bwaye goika gati‐gati ase obosio bwa Yeso.

english: And saw two ships standing by the lake : but the fishermen were gone out of them , and were washing their nets .
ekegusii: Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y’enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.

english: And when he saw their faith , he said unto him , Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
ekegusii: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamoteebia, “Mosani, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

english: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?
ekegusii: Aborokia baria b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka korengereria, bakobora, “Ning’o oyo ogokwana okorama? Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”

english: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts , he answering said unto them , What reason ye in your hearts ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ebirengererio biabo, akairaneria, “Naki mokorengereria ase chinkoro chiaino?

english: Whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee ; or to say , Rise up and walk ?
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, ogende?

english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins , (he said unto the sick of the palsy ,) I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria rigata, “Nagoteebirie: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”

english: And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .
ekegusii: Erio kegima agatenena ase obosio bwabo, akabogoria ekeraarero kiaye arenge koraarera, akagenda bwoye, ogotogia Nyasae.

english: And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .
ekegusii: Ogokumia gokabwata bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae; bagaichorwa nokoiroka, bakaboora, “Twarorire amakumia reero.” Yeso okorangeria Lawi (Mat 9:9-13; Mar 2:13-17)

english: And after these things he went forth , and saw a publican , named Levi , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he said unto him , Follow me .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaimoka, akarora omorusia ebango, erieta riaye Lawi, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!”

english: And he left all , rose up , and followed him .
ekegusii: Agatiga bionsi, akaimoka, akamotunyana.

english: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house : and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them .
ekegusii: Nere Lawi akamokorera omoyega omonene nyomba mwaye, naende mbarengeo omoganda bw’abarusia ebango na abanto bande baikaransete amo nabarabwo ase endagera.

english: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon’s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .
ekegusii: Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simioni akamobooria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.

english: And Jesus answering said unto them , They that are whole need not a physician ; but they that are sick .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

english: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
ekegusii: Tincheti korangeria ababoronge korende abanyene ebibe baonchoke.” Riborio igoro y’okweng’ata (Mat 9:14-17; Mar 2:18-22)

english: And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees ; but thine eat and drink ?
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Aborokigwa ba Yohana nigo bakweng’ata ebiro ebinge na gosaba, na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai nabo bagokora, korende abao nigo bakoria na konywa.”

english: And he said unto them , Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abachire ase enyangi beng’ate ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo?

english: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
ekegusii: Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase amatuko aria.”

english: And he spake also a parable unto them ; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio: “Onde tari ogotandora ekeraka ki’eanga enyia na gokebeeka ase eanga engotu; aise gokora bo, natandore eria enyia, na ekeraka keria ki’eanga enyia tigekobwatana neanga eria engotu.

english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.

english: But new wine must be put into new bottles ; and both are preserved .
ekegusii: Korende edivai enyia negwenerete ebeekwe ase ebirandi ebiya.

english: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
ekegusii: Gose omonto tari onyure edivai yaroisetigwe kare, naende arigie edivai enyia, ekiagera nigo agoteeba: Eria ya kare nengiya kobua.”

english: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon , Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
ekegusii: Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agateebia Simioni, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”

english: And they beckoned unto their partners , which were in the other ship , that they should come and help them . And they came , and filled both the ships , so that they began to sink .
ekegusii: bagasuma abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere Ekero ebionga biabo biachaaka gotandoka, bagasuma abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere.|alt="They called their colleagues from another boat when their nets began to break" src="Gw-072.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 5:5-11" copy="Graham Wade" ref="5:7" , bache kobakonya. Bagacha, bagaichoria amaato onsi abere, goika agachaaka korimera.

english: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus’ knees , saying , Depart from me ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .
ekegusii: Korende Simioni Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”

english: For he was astonished , and all that were with him , at the draught of the fishes which they had taken :
ekegusii: Naki igo akumetie, ere na bonsi abarenge amo nere, ase oborubi bwe chinswe barubete;

english: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man , Stretch forth thy hand . And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
ekegusii: Akabarigereria bonsi, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakora bo; okoboko kwaye gokagwenigwa.

english: And they were filled with madness ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagaichorwa nokobea, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, buna baramokore Yeso. Yeso ogochora abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:1-4; Mar 3:13-19)

english: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akaimoka akagenda ase egetunwa gosaba; akabao obotuko bwonsi ase ogosaba Nyasae.

english: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles ;
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia akarangeria aborokigw baye, agachora korwa ase bare ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa.

english: Simon , ( whom he also named Peter ,) and Andrew his brother , James and John , Philip and Bartholomew ,
ekegusii: Simioni nere arogete Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo na Yohana, Filipo na Baritholomayo,

english: Matthew and Thomas , James the son of Alphæus , and Simon called Zelotes ,
ekegusii: na Matayo na Thomas, Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Simioni oyomo bw’Abazelote,

english: And Judas the brother of James , and Judas Iscariot , which also was the traitor .
ekegusii: na Yuda o Yakobo, na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

english: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases ;
ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase ateremu, amo nomoganda bw’aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw’abaanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.

english: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .
ekegusii: Bagacha koigwa amang’ana aye boigo nakogwenigwa amarwaire abo, na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.

english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi okarigia komokuna, ekiagera chinguru chiare korua asare, chikabagwenia bonsi. Ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa (Mat 5:1-12)

english: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them , Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days ?
ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai bakababoria, “Naki mogokora aya’atagwenereti gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

english: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said , Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, Imosesenirie inwe abamore abataka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwaino.

english: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe abamore nenchara bono, ekiagera namoigotigwe. “Imosesenirie inwe abamokorera bono, ekiagera namoseke.

english: But woe unto you that are rich ! for ye have received your consolation .
ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino inwe abanda, ekiagera mwanyorire omogooko oino.

english: Woe unto you that are full ! for ye shall hunger . Woe unto you that laugh now ! for ye shall mourn and weep .
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.

english: Woe unto you , when all men shall speak well of you ! for so did their fathers to the false prophets .
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe, ekero abanto bakobatogia, ekiagera chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani b’oborimo engencho eyio eyio. Obwanchani ase ababisa (Mat 5:38-48)

english: But I say unto you which hear , Love your enemies , do good to them which hate you ,
ekegusii: “Korende nabateebirie inwe abamokoigwa: Ancha ababisa baino, bakorere amaya abwo baabagechete,

english: Bless them that curse you , and pray for them which despitefully use you .
ekegusii: basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.

english: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other ; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also .
ekegusii: Oyo okogoaka orosea oromo, moonchorere noronde, na ere oyogokoura eanga ya isiko, tomorina neya ime.

english: And Jesus answering them said , Have ye not read so much as this , what David did , when himself was an hungred , and they which were with him ;
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,

english: Give to every man that asketh of thee ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
ekegusii: Moe kera oyokogosaba; na oyogokoura ebinto biao tomoboria naende.

english: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .
ekegusii: “Komoranche abaabanchete inwe, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo banchete abwo baabanchete.

english: And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .
ekegusii: Komorabakorere amaya abwo abakobakorera inwe amaya, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nabo bagokora.

english: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive , what thank have ye ? for sinners also lend to sinners , to receive as much again .
ekegusii: Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa ase bare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.

english: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .
ekegusii: Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.

english: Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .
ekegusii: Mobe namaabera, buna Iso oino are namaabera. Igoro y’okogambia abande (Mat 7:1-5)

english: Judge not , and ye shall not be judged : condemn not , and ye shall not be condemned : forgive , and ye shall be forgiven :
ekegusii: “Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa; timonachera, nainwe timokonacherwa; abera, nainwe namwaberwe;

english: Give , and it shall be given unto you ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .
ekegusii: karue, nainwe namoegwe. Ekerengo ekiya keigateire, keinyageire, geichire, nakio abanto barabae inwe ase amaboko aino, ekiagera ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa nainwe.”

english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino, na omoribo ore ase eriso riao ime toyorochi?

english: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye .
ekegusii: Gose naki orateebie oyomino: Oyominto, ntige nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriso riao ime, na aye omonyene torochi omoriibo ore ase eriso riao? Aye omong’ainereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino.

english: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
ekegusii: “Naki tori omote omuya okwama amatunda amabe, gose omote omobe okwama amatunda amaya.

english: And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?
ekegusii: “Nase ki mokondoka Omonene Nyasae, na inwe timori gokora aya ngoteeba?

english: Whosoever cometh to me , and heareth my sayings , and doeth them , I will shew you to whom he is like :
ekegusii: Kera omonto ogocha ase ’nde, na koigwa amang’ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:

english: He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .
ekegusii: Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.

english: But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell ; and the ruin of that house was great .
ekegusii: Nere oyokoigwa otari gokora iga, nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba igoro ase amaroba, etabegetwe oboroso. Nabo eooro ekayeaka ne chinguru, ekagwa bwango, na okogwa kw’enyomba eria gokaba okonene.”

english: And he said unto them , That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw’Esabato.”

english: And it came to pass also on another sabbath , that he entered into the synagogue and taught : and there was a man whose right hand was withered .
ekegusii: Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akaorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw’okorio kwagataete.

english: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day ; that they might find an accusation against him .
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakamotega korora gose namogwenie ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.

english: But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand , Rise up , and stand forth in the midst . And he arose and stood forth .
ekegusii: Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.

english: Then said Jesus unto them , I will ask you one thing ; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good , or to do evil ? to save life , or to destroy it ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”

english: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
ekegusii: Magega Yeso gakorire gokwana amang’ana onsi aria arigetie abanto baigwe, agasoa Kapernaumu.

english: And they that were sent , returning to the house , found the servant whole that had been sick .
ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bagachia koirana nyomba mwaye, bakanyora omosomba oria otimokire. Yeso okobokia omwana omomura bw’omoboraka

english: And it came to pass the day after , that he went into a city called Nain ; and many of his disciples went with him , and much people .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.

english: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .
ekegusii: Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.

english: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her , Weep not .
ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene achia komoorora akamororera amaabera, akamoteebia, “Torera!”

english: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said , Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .
ekegusii: Akagenda ang’e, agakuna esanduki; baria babogoretie esanduki bagatenena. Erio agakwana, “Omomura, nagotebirie, imoka!”

english: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
ekegusii: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.

english: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us ; and , That God hath visited his people .
ekegusii: Omoondoko okabwata bonsi, bagatogia, Nyasae, bakaboora, “Omobani omonene oorokire ase egati yaito!” Na “Nyasae ocheire abanto baye!”

english: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa , and throughout all the region round about .
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine. Abatomwa korwa ase Yohana omobatisi (Mat 11:2-19)

english: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamoteebia aya onsi,

english: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
ekegusii: erio Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

english: And a certain centurion’s servant , who was dear unto him , was sick , and ready to die .
ekegusii: Omosomba oyomo bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana konya onyarekire nigo arenge ang’e nogokwa; ere nomonto anchete mono.

english: When the men were come unto him , they said , John Baptist hath sent us unto thee , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo baikire asare, bakamoteebia, “Yohana Omobatisi ototomire ase ore, okobora: Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

english: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yeso akagwenia abanto abange abarenge namarwaire, na emechando, na babwatire n’Omoika omobe; na abange abarenge emeuko akabaramokia amaiso abo, bakarora.

english: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie onde bwensi otagochiri nainche.”

english: And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John , What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaaka goteebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?

english: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings’ courts .
ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Nomonto oboyirie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chingiya mono, na koria obwansu bw’omogooko, nigo bare ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.

english: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .
ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabateebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,

english: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .
ekegusii: Nigo nkobateebia: Ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana, korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae nomonene komobua.”

english: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agatoma asare abagaaka b’Abayahudi komoboria ache agwenie omosomba oye.

english: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .
ekegusii: korende Abafarisai na abanto b’amachiiko bagakana omooroberio o Nyasae ase bare abanyene, ekiagera tibaabatisetwe na Yohana.)

english: And the Lord said , Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera gokwana akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?

english: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
ekegusii: Nigo bagwekaine nabana baikaransete ase echiiro, bakorangerania, bakobora, “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.

english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
ekegusii: Naki Yohana Omobatisi nigo achete, tare koria omogati, gose tare konywa edivai; na inwe mogoteeba: Nabwatire nekerecha.

english: The Son of man is come eating and drinking ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !
ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteeba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe!

english: But wisdom is justified of all her children .
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.” Yeso okwabera omokungu omonyabibe

english: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him . And he went into the Pharisee’s house , and sat down to meat .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai akamoarigania ache koria endagera amo nere. Agasoa ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, agaikaransa ase endagera.

english: And stood at his feet behind him weeping , and began to wash his feet with tears , and did wipe them with the hairs of her head , and kissed his feet , and anointed them with the ointment .
ekegusii: agatenena korwa magega, ang’e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.

english: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself , saying , This man , if he were a prophet , would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him : for she is a sinner .
ekegusii: Omofarisai, oria omoariganetie, agachia koyarora akeboria ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba, “Omonto oyo, onye nomobani orenge, anga namomanya oyo ng’a nere ng’o, gose mokuungu ki oyo okomokuna, ng’a nomonyene ebibe.”

english: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia goika ase Yeso, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Nagwenerete omokorere ring’ana eri,

english: And Jesus answering said unto him , Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And he saith , Master , say on .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Simioni, ninde ne ring’ana nkogoteebia.” Akabora, “Omworokia, kwana.”

english: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors : the one owed five hundred pence , and the other fifty .
ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo omorua singo + 7:41 omorua singo: engencho yaye n’omonto okoa abanto rikobesa orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano (500), na oyo o kabere emerongo etano (50).

english: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge na gento bagoakana. Akabaabera bonsi babere. Gaki, ase abwo, ning’o oramwanche kobua?”

english: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him , Thou hast rightly judged .
ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria, “Igo ndabore ng’a, noria bwaberetwe ebinge.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwanachire boronge.”

english: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon , Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tear , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
ekegusii: Akaonchoka gochia ase omokungu oria, agateebia Simioni, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amaache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.

english: Thou gavest me no kiss : but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet .
ekegusii: Tonyunyunteti, korende ere korwa ekero nasoete aa tatigeti konyunyunta amagoro aane.

english: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .
ekegusii: Tong’ageti omotwe one amaguta, korende ere ong’akire amagoro aane amaguta agotioka buya.

english: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nagotebirie, obwanchani bwaye bworokirie ng’a ebibe biaye ebinge biabeirwe; ere oyokwaberwa ebike nigo anchete ake.”

english: And he said unto her , Thy sins are forgiven .
ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Kwabeirwe ebibe biao.”

english: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves , Who is this that forgiveth sins also ?
ekegusii: Na baria baikaransete amo nere bagachaaka goteeba ase emioyo yabo ime, “Nere ng’o oyo oranyare kwabera ebibe?”

english: For he loveth our nation , and he hath built us a synagogue .
ekegusii: ekiagera nanchete abanto baito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”

english: And he said to the woman , Thy faith hath saved thee ; go in peace .
ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Okwegena kwao kwagotooririe; genda nomorembe.”

english: Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :
ekegusii: Yeso akagenda amo nabarabwo. Goika agachia koba tari are ase enyomba yaye, oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani agatoma abasani asare, okomoteebia, “Omonene, tibwerosia, ekiagera inche ting’isaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane.

english: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee : but say in a word , and my servant shall be healed .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo neroche ng’a ting’isaini gocha ase ore; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

english: For I also am a man set under authority , having under me soldiers , and I say unto one , Go , and he goeth ; and to another , Come , and he cometh ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
ekegusii: Naki inche nomonto mbekire inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabasikari inse yane. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda, na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”

english: When Jesus heard these things , he marvelled at him , and turned him about , and said unto the people that followed him , I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no, not in Israel .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”

english: And it came to pass afterward , that he went throughout every city and village , preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God : and the twelve were with him ,
ekegusii: Magega ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobateebia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,

english: Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering’ana ria Nyasae.

english: Those by the way side are they that hear ; then cometh the devil , and taketh away the word out of their hearts , lest they should believe and be saved .
ekegusii: Baria b’enchera ensemo, nabwo baikire koriigwa; erio Saitani ochicha, na korusia ring’ana riria ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde tibacha kwegena batooreke.

english: They on the rock are they , which , when they hear , receive the word with joy ; and these have no root , which for a while believe , and in time of temptation fall away .
ekegusii: Na baria bare ase egetare nabwo baria bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata nomogooko, korende barabwo tibari nemeri, begena ase ekero egeke, na ekero ki’ogoteemwa beatanana.

english: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .
ekegusii: Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw’enibo, na omogooko bw’ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.

english: But that on the good ground are they , which in an honest and good heart , having heard the word , keep it , and bring forth fruit with patience .
ekegusii: Na echinde chire ase amaroba amaya; aba nabwo bare ne chinkoro chingiya naende echi’ekeene, bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata, bama okwama noboremereria. Okworokereria korwa ase etaya (Mat 4:21-25)

english: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .
ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda.

english: And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .
ekegusii: Akairerwa amang’ana agateebigwa, “Nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, baganetie kororana naye.”

english: And he answered and said unto them , My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .
ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.” Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mat 8:23-27; Mar 4:35-41)

english: Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them , Let us go over unto the other side of the lake . And they launched forth .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo akariina obwato, ere na aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha.” Bakamanora.

english: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .
ekegusii: Kobachia kogenda, akarara chitoro; omwaga ogaacha, na emerindo ase enyancha, obwato bogaachaka goichorwa namaache, bakaba ase emechando.

english: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .
ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakaboora, “Omonene Nyasae, ngosira tore!” Erio ere akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amaache, Omonene Nyasae, ngosira tore! Erio ere akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amaache.|alt="Lord, Lord, we are perishing! he woke up and commanded the water and storms into calmness" src="Gw-080.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 8:22-25" copy="Graham Wade" ref="8:24" na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.

english: And he said unto them , Where is your faith ? And they being afrai wondered , saying one to another , What manner of man is this ! for he commandeth even the winds and water , and they obey him .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Okwegena kwaino, ng’ai kore?” Bakairoka, bagakumia bagateebania, “Oyo nere ng’o, ogochika nonya nomwaga na enyancha, bikomoigwera?” Yeso okogwenia Omogeraseni obwatire nebirecha (Mat 8:28-34; Mar 5:1-20)

english: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is over against Galilee .
ekegusii: Bagaika engegu y’ense y’Abageraseni, erigereretie Galili.

english: And when he went forth to land , there met him out of the city a certain man , which had devils long time , and ware no clothes , neither abode in any house , but in the tombs .
ekegusii: Agachia goika engegu, akaumerana nomonto oyomo bw’omochie oria, obwatire nebirecha; na ase amatuko amange tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge komenya nyomba, otatiga ase chimbeera.

english: When he saw Jesus , he cried out , and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God most high ? I beseech thee , torment me not .
ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso, agaaka egeturi, akagwa ase obosio bwaye, agakwana neriogi rinene, okobora, “Inaki inde naye, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagosabire, tonchanda.”

english: ( For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man . For oftentimes it had caught him : and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters ; and he brake the bands , and was driven of the devil into the wilderness .)
ekegusii: Naki konya ochikiire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)

english: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .
ekegusii: na Yoana moka Kusa, omorendi bwe Herode, na Susana, na abande abange. Abwo nigo barenge kobakorera ne chinibo chiabo. Omoreng’anio bw’omobusuri (Mat 13:1-9; Mar 4:1-9)

english: And Jesus asked him , saying , What is thy name ? And he said , Legion : because many devils were entered into him .
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Elegioni”, ekiagera ebirecha ebinge biamosoete.

english: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .
ekegusii: Bikamosorora tabichika bigende goika ase eora entambe.

english: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .
ekegusii: Ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche, chiare korisia ase egetunwa, bikamosorora abie ribaga bichisoe. Akabia ribaga.

english: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .
ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.

english: When they that fed them saw what was done , they fled , and went and told it in the city and in the country .
ekegusii: Abarisia bagachia korora ayio, bagatama, bakararia amang’ana ase omochie na ebichie.

english: Then they went out to see what was done ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
ekegusii: Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire; bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha biria oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso obegete chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge, bakairoka.

english: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .
ekegusii: Na baria bayaroche bakabateebia buna oria obwatire nebirecha agwenetigwe.

english: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .
ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ense y’Abageraseni bakamobooria arue ase bare, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiroka okonene. Erio akariina obwato, akairana.

english: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
ekegusii: Na omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha akamosorora abe amo nere, korende Yeso akamokania, akabora,

english: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee . And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .
ekegusii: “Irana nka bwoo orarie amang’ana amanene aya Nyasae agokoreire.” Akagenda bwoye, akararia ase omochie omogima amang’ana amanene aya Yeso amokoreire. Omoiseke o Yairo okobokigwa, na omokungu oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga okogwenigwa (Mat 9:18-26; Mar 5:21-43)

english: And when much people were gathered together , and were come to him out of every city , he spake by a parable :
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio: Omoreng’anio bw’omobusuri |alt="The parable of the sower" src="GW-079.TIF" size="col" loc="Luke 8:4-8" copy="Graham Wade" ref="8:4"

english: And it came to pass, that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koirana, omosangererekano okamogokera, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamoganyete.

english: And , behold , there came a man named Jairus , and he was a ruler of the synagogue : and he fell down at Jesus’ feet , and besought him that he would come into his house :
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,

english: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
ekegusii: ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e ogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.

english: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,
ekegusii: Naende omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, konya oonirie ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase abarwaria, tanyara kogwenigwa nonde.

english: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .
ekegusii: Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.

english: And Jesus said , Who touched me ? When all denied , Peter and they that were with him said , Master , the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou , Who touched me ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabooria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamoteebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”

english: And Jesus said , Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Omonto onkunire, ekiagera naigure ng’a chinguru chiandure.”

english: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abaanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.

english: And he said unto her , Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole ; go in peace .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie; genda nomorembe.”

english: While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead ; trouble not the Master .
ekegusii: Erio kagokwana, omonto agacha korwa ase enyomba y’oria omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamoteebia, “Enyaroka yao yakuure, torosia omworokia naende.”

english: A sower went out to sow his seed : and as he sowed , some fell by the way side ; and it was trodden down , and the fowls of the air devoured it .
ekegusii: “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura embusuro yaye: Ekero akobusura, echinde chikagwa enchera ensemo, chigatiringwa namagoro, chinyoni chia igoro chigachiria.

english: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying , Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, erio akamoiraneria, “Toiroka; egene rioka, ere nagwenigwe.”

english: And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .
ekegusii: Agachia goika nyomba, tancha monto onde asoe amo nere otatiga Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na ise na ng’ina b’omwana oria.

english: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said , Weep not ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi nigo barenge komoreera, bakweng’ereria, korende Yeso akabora, “Timorera, ekiagera takweti, korende nigo araire.”

english: And they laughed him to scorn , knowing that she was dead .
ekegusii: Bakamosekerera, bamanyete ng’a okuure.

english: And he put them all out , and took her by the hand , and called , saying , Maid , arise .
ekegusii: Korende ere akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateeba, “Omwana, imoka!”

english: And her spirit came again , and she arose straightway : and he commanded to give her meat .
ekegusii: Omoika oye okairana, agatenena erio kegima Yeso akabachiika bamoe endagera arie.

english: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagakumia, mono, korende akabachiika tibateebia monto ayakoreka.

english: And some fell upon a rock ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.

english: And some fell among thorns ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina amo na chirochio, agachimiga.

english: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold . And when he had said these things , he cried , He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikamera, chikama rigana.” Ekero are kobateebia aya, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.” Ogotebereria kw’omoreng’anio oria (Mat 13:10-23; Mar 4:10-20)

english: And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Omoreng’anio oyio ninki ogoteeba?”

english: Then he called his twelve disciples together , and gave them power and authority over all devils , and to cure diseases .
ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere akabaa chinguru na okobua igoro ase ebirecha bionsi na ase okogwenia amarwaire.

english: And the apostles , when they were returned , told him all that they had done . And he took them , and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida .
ekegusii: Abatomwa baria ekero bachia koirana bagateebia Yeso amang’ana onsi ayabakorire. Erio akagenda amo nabarabwo bobisi akabaira, gochia ase omochie okorokwa Bethisaida. Okoragerigwa kw’abaanto chilifu isano|alt="Feeding of the 5,000 people" src="Gw-084.tif" size="col" loc="Luke 9:10-17" copy="Graham Wade" ref="9:9"

english: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .
ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw’okogwenigwa.

english: And when the day began to wear away , then came the twelve , and said unto him , Send the multitude away , that they may go into the towns and country round about , and lodge , and get victuals : for we are here in a desert place .
ekegusii: Rigachaaka kogoroba + 9:12 Rigachaaka kogoroba: engencho yaye boachaka koira , na baria ikomi na babere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Tiga omoganda ogende goika ase ebichie ne chinsemo chietanaine, banyore aase bakorara amo nendagera, ekiagera aiga nigo tore aase erooro.”

english: But he said unto them , Give ye them to eat . And they said , We have no more but five loaves and two fishes ; except we should go and buy meat for all this people .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakaboora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”

english: For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples , Make them sit down by fifties in a company .
ekegusii: Naki mbarengeo abasacha chilifu isano iga. Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Baikaransie abanto aba ase ebiombe, na kera ekeombe koreng’ana emerongo etano.”

english: And they did so , and made them all sit down .
ekegusii: Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.

english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .
ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa babiterekere abanto.

english: And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .
ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota. Na ebisamunye biria biatigarete bigasangererigwa, bigaichora ebitonga ikomi na bibere. Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mat 16:13-19; Mar 8:27-29)

english: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying , Whom say the people that I am ?
ekegusii: Engaki eyemo ekero Yeso are gosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge ange nere, akababooria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”

english: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God , and to heal the sick .
ekegusii: Akabatoma korandia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.

english: And he straitly charged them , and commanded them to tell no man that thing ;
ekegusii: Akabachiika na kobakania tibateebia monto ring’ana eri,

english: Saying , The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Negwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, naende aitwe, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mat 16:24-28; Mar 8:34—9:1)

english: For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?
ekegusii: Ekiagera inki eragwenere omonto karanyore ense yonsi, ko esirie gose gwesaria ere omonyene?

english: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words , of him shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he shall come in his own glory , and in his Father’s , and of the holy angels .
ekegusii: Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.

english: But I tell you of a truth , there be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ekeene, mbare abanto ase aba bateneine aa, abataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake, goika barore oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Okoonchoka ekieni kwa Yeso (Mat 17:1-8; Mar 9:2-8)

english: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .
ekegusii: Agachia koba amatuko ang’e atano na atato magega ase amang’ana aya, akaira Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro gosaba.

english: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .
ekegusii: Na ekero arenge gosaba, ekieni ki’obosio bwaye gekaonchoka, ne chianga chiaye chikaba chindabu, chikameka‐meka.

english: And he said unto them , Take nothing for your journey , neither staves , nor scrip , neither bread , neither money ; neither have two coats apiece .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Timobogoria gento ase orogendo rwaino, nonya nenyimbo, gose esaro, gose omogati, gose chitaabu; naende timoba ne chianga ibere.

english: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :
ekegusii: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.

english: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang’ana ay’ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.

english: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
ekegusii: Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo bategesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.

english: And it came to pass , as they departed from him , Peter said unto Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias : not knowing what he said .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto aba baare korua asare, Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, imbuya intwe koba aiga; tokore ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, na ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija”; tamanyete aya agokwana.

english: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.

english: And when the voice was past , Jesus was found alone . And they kept it close , and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen .
ekegusii: Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibateebia monto ase amatuko aria ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio baroche. Yeso okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mat 17:14-18; Mar 9:14-27)

english: And it came to pass, that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero baare gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, omoganda omonene okaumerana nere.

english: And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .
ekegusii: Naende rora, omonto oyomo ase omoganda oria agaaka egeturi, okobora, “Omworokia, nagosabire, origererie omomura one, ekiagera ere nomwana one omomoima.

english: And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .
ekegusii: Na rora ekerecha nigo gekomobwata, na ere bwango nigo akorera, naende kemogaragaria, erinde asokia amasombogoku, korende tikeri komorua otatiga ase okomosionora mono.

english: And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .
ekegusii: Naende enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, mobeere aroro goika moruo.

english: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out ; and they could not .
ekegusii: Nasaba aborokigwa bao bageserie, korende tibanyara.”

english: And Jesus answering said , O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you , and suffer you ? Bring thy son hither .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri, na koremereria nainwe? Renta omomura oo aiga.”

english: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .
ekegusii: Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omomura oria, akamoirania ase ise.

english: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God . But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did , he said unto his disciples ,
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Obobani bwa kabere bwa Yeso igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 17:22-23; Mar 9:30-32) Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agateebia aborokigwa baye,

english: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
ekegusii: “Tiga amang’ana aya asoe ase amato aino, ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abaanto.”

english: But they understood not this saying , and it was hid from them , that they perceived it not : and they feared to ask him of that saying .
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, rikaba ndiabiseka ase bare, erinde tibarimanya. Bakaba nobwoba komoboria engencho ye ring’ana riria. Okworokereria igoro y’oboitongo (Mat 18:1-5; Mar 9:33-37)

english: And Jesus , perceiving the thought of their heart , took a child , and set him by him ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,

english: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Forbid him not : for he that is not against us is for us .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.” Yeso okomanora kogenda Yerusalemu. Abasamaria abatakoroisia abageni

english: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye aika ang’e kogenda igoro, akamanora kogenda Yerusalemu.

english: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .
ekegusii: Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.

english: And they did not receive him , because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.

english: But he turned , and rebuked them , and said , Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of .
ekegusii: Akeonchora, akabakania.

english: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives , but to save them . And they went to another village .
ekegusii: Erio Bakagenda ase agachie kande. Amateemwa ase abwo barigetie koba aborokigwa (Mat 8:19-22)

english: And it came to pass, that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
ekegusii: Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto tari nase akobeeka omotwe oye.”

english: And he said unto another , Follow me . But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
ekegusii: Agateebia oyonde, “Ntunyana!” Ere akabora, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”.

english: And they departed , and went through the towns , preaching the gospel , and healing every where .
ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchiri, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi. Ogoichana kwa Herode (Mat 14:1-2; Mar 6:14-16)

english: Jesus said unto him , Let the dead bury their dead : but go thou and preach the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo, korende aye genda orandie oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto tari orabeeke okoboko kwaye ase obokombe bwe chieri, naende arigererie magega, oragwenere ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: And of some , that Elias had appeared ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .
ekegusii: na abande ng’a n’Elija oorokire, na abande ng’a noyomo bw’ababani abakoro obokire.

english: And Herod said , John have I beheaded : but who is this , of whom I hear such things ? And he desired to see him .
ekegusii: Herode agateeba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora. Okoragerigwa kw’abaanto chilifu isano (Mat 14:13-21; Mar 6:30-44; Yoh 6:1-13)

english: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi .
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’an’Omonene atomerete Abaisraeli goetera ase Malaki. Obwanchani bw’Omonene ase Abaisraeli

english: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought . I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts , neither will I accept an offering at your hand .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Onye ndiria arenge gotoka omonto nonya noyomo korwa ase more asieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, erinde timobaisa kogenderera gouta omorero ase egesasiimero kiane bosa, ekiagera tingokiri nainwe, gose tingwancha ebing’wanso korwa ase amaboko aino.

english: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles ; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name , and a pure offering : for my name shall be great among the heathen , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Korwa ekero erioba rigosoka goika ekero rikorimera, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku, na ase kera aase ubani egosambwa ase erieta riane, na okoruegwa gochenegete gokorentwa. Ee, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

english: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say , The table of the LORD is polluted ; and the fruit thereof, even his meat , is contemptible .
ekegusii: “Korende inwe nigo mokorikora ribe eritachenegeti ekero mogoteeba ng’a emesa y’ane yakorirwe koba eyetachenegeti na gochaaya okoruegwa gokorentwa aroro.

english: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts ; and ye brought that which was torn , and the lame , and the sick ; thus ye brought an offering : should I accept this of your hand ? saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Amang’ana aya atorosirie, naende mwagenderera gonchaaya inche Omonene bw’Emeganda. Nigo mokondetera eng’iti eurereirie, gose eye eremarete, gose erwarete, ebe ekeng’wanso. Inee! Ninyare gwanchera ebinto buna ebio korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene akoboria.

english: But cursed be the deceiver , which hath in his flock a male , and voweth , and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing : for I am a great King , saith the LORD of hosts , and my name is dreadful among the heathen .
ekegusii: “Oragereriigwe omonto oria omong’ainereria obwate emingichi ase riicho riaye, eyio ariete eira ng’a ayerue, korende orenta ase ’nde inche Omonene eng’iti eng’ao ere n’ekemocho ase omobere oye. Inche nigo inde omorwoti omonene, na erieta riane nigo rire eri’okoirokwa ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

english: And I hated Esau , and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness .
ekegusii: na nkaba ’ngechete Esau na ’ngasaria ense yaye y’ebitunwa ekaba erooro, na omwando oye ’nkaa chisese chi’orosana chikamenyao.”

english: Whereas Edom saith , We are impoverished , but we will return and build the desolate places ; thus saith the LORD of hosts , They shall build , but I will throw down ; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness , and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever .
ekegusii: Abaedomu kobarateebe: “Nonya twaakirwe, ngochia tore koagaacha naende aase aria asaretigwe agatigara bosa.” Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Nabo baranyare koagaacha naende, korende inche goika ’ntagore amaagacho ayio, erinde ense eyio erokwe ey’abakori amabe, abwo inche Omonene inde nendamwamu ase bare kogenderera botambe.”

english: And your eyes shall see , and ye shall say , The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel .
ekegusii: Namwerorere amang’ana ayio namaiso aino; erio moteebe: “Omonene nigo are omonene nonya nisiko y’ense y’Abaisraeli.” Omonene ogotogonyera abakuani

english: A son honoureth his father , and a servant his master : if then I be a father , where is mine honour ? and if I be a master , where is my fear ? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests , that despise my name . And ye say , Wherein have we despised thy name ?
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Omwana nigo asigete ise, na omosomba nairogete omonene oye. Onye inche inde iso oino, amasikani aino ase ’nde, ng’ai are? Na onye inde omonene, okonyiroka kwaino, ng’ai kore? Inwe abakuani nigo mochaayete erieta riane, naende nigo mokoboria: Nase enchera ki tochaayete erieta riao?

english: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar ; and ye say , Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say , The table of the LORD is contemptible .
ekegusii: Nimbatebie: Nigo mokorenta ase egesasiimero kiane okoruegwa kw’endagera gotari ogochenu. Erio mwaboria: Nase inchera ki twagokorire oyotachenegeti. Nimbairanerie: Nase okorengereria ng’a emesa y’ane inche Omonene ney’ogochaaywa.

english: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means : will he regard your persons ? saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: “Inwe abakuani, sorora Nyasae, erinde atororere amaabera. Inee! Naroreire onde bwensi oino amaabera, ekero mokorua okoruegwa konga buna okwo korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.

english: And now, O ye priests , this commandment is for you.
ekegusii: “Bono inwe abakuani, amang’ana aya nigo achiikirwe ase more.

english: Have we not all one father ? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother , by profaning the covenant of our fathers ?
ekegusii: Inee! Intwe twensi titobwati Tata oyomo? Tari ere Nyasae oyomo ototongete? Nase ki rende totari abegenwa intwe ase intwe? Nase ki togosaria okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaito?

english: Judah hath dealt treacherously , and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem ; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved , and hath married the daughter of a strange god .
ekegusii: Abayuda bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa, na ay’okogechia akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli, na ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera Abayuda baturutumbire + 2:11 Baturutumbire: engencho yaye basaririe esiko Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, banyuomire abaiseke b’ abanto bagosasiima enyasae engeni.

english: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar , out of the tabernacles of Jacob , and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Omonene nasirie korwa ase chinyomba chia Yakobo onde bwensi ogokora amang’ana ayio karabe Omwarimu gose omworokigwa, nonya noyokorenta ekeng’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda.

english: And this have ye done again , covering the altar of the LORD with tears , with weeping , and with crying out , insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ande mogokora naya: Nigo mogotuba egesasiimero kia Omonene n’amariga aino, mwaba mokorera na kweumia, na ase ayio Omonene tagwanchera ebing’wanso bikorwa ase amaboko aino nonya ng’ake, gose takogokigwa nabirobio.

english: Yet ye say , Wherefore ? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth , against whom thou hast dealt treacherously : yet is she thy companion , and the wife of thy covenant .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: “Nase ki atari kobianchera?” Nekiagera Omonene arenge kirori ase egati yao na omokungu bw’obosae bwao, oyio aye otari omwegenwa ase are, nonya ore omokiare oo, na omokungu oo ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania.

english: And did not he make one ? Yet had he the residue of the spirit . And wherefore one ? That he might seek a godly seed . Therefore take heed to your spirit , and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo takorete bo, oria omoika ogendererete gotigara ime yaye. Ninki oria oyomo aganetie? Nigo aganetie ororeria rwatananwe robe orwa Nyasae. Ase engencho eyio, mwerende mono, erinde onde tabaisa koba oyo otari omwegenwa ase omokungu bw’obosae bwaye.

english: For the LORD , the God of Israel , saith that he hateth putting away : for one covereth violence with his garment , saith the LORD of hosts : therefore take heed to your spirit , that ye deal not treacherously .
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche nigo ngechete ogotigana, naende nigo ngechete ng’a omonto nigo agwetuba obotindi buna agwetuba eyanga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba. Ase engencho eyio mwerende timobasa koba abatari abegenwa. Rituko ri’ekiina nigo rire ang’e

english: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words . Yet ye say , Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say , Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD , and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment ?
ekegusii: Inwe mwarosirie Omonene n’amang’ana aino. Nigo mokoboria: “Inaki twamorosirie?” Nekiagera mogoteeba ng’a kera omonto ogokora ebibe nigo are omuya ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende ng’a Omonene nigo akogokigwa nere. Naende mwaboria; “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio okonacha ebiina are?”

english: If ye will not hear , and if ye will not lay it to heart , to give glory unto my name , saith the LORD of hosts , I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings : yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Onye timogotegerera amang’ana ayio na koyabeka ase chinkoro chiaino ime, erinde mosike erieta riane, rirorio nindete okoragererigwa ase more, ndagererie ogosesenigwa kwaino. Ee, naikire koragereria ogosesenigwa okwo, ekiagera timori kobeeka amang’ana ayio ase chinkoro chiaino.

english: Behold, I will corrupt your seed , and spread dung upon your faces , even the dung of your solemn feasts ; and one shall take you away with it.
ekegusii: Nintogonyere ororeria rwaino, nintube amaiso aino n’esike ye ching’iti echio mokorua chibe ebing’wanso. Abanto mbaabarente baababeeke ase esike eyio.

english: The law of truth was in his mouth , and iniquity was not found in his lips : he walked with me in peace and equity , and did turn many away from iniquity .
ekegusii: Amorokererio amaronge nigo arenge ase omonwa oye, na obobe tibwanyorekanete ase ebikoba biaye. Nigo abeete ogotaara nainche ase omorembe na oboronge, na akaonchora abanto abange korwa ase ebibe.

english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge , and they should seek the law at his mouth : for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’Omokuani goika birende chisemi, na abanto barigie okworokererigwa korwa ase omonwa oye, ekiagera nigo are omotomwa one inche Omonene bw’Emeganda.

english: But ye are departed out of the way ; ye have caused many to stumble at the law ; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y’amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

english: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people , according as ye have not kept my ways , but have been partial in the law .
ekegusii: Inwe mwangire kobwatia chinchera chiane; nigo mogwanchereria abanto ekero mokworokereria amachiiko. Ase ayio nimbatige mochaaywe na gokeeigwa ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi.” Abanto batari abegenwa ase Nyasae

english: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Nintogonyere ebigosaria okwama kwe riroba riaino, tibigosaria, gose amasabibu aino takoaroroka kaare amarere. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.

english: And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inabaabaroke abasesenirie, ekiagera ense yaino n’ebe y’okogokia. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.” Eira ya Nyasae y’amaabera

english: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang’ana amakong’u igoro y’ane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang’ana ki amakong’u twakwanire igoro yao?

english: Ye have said , It is vain to serve God : and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance , and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts ?
ekegusii: Inwe mwateebire: Okomokorera Nyasae, ayio namang’ana abosa. Mbuya ki twanyorire ase okobwata amachiiko aye, gose ase ogotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda tore nomoichano?

english: And now we call the proud happy ; yea, they that work wickedness are set up ; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered .
ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”

english: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another : and the LORD hearkened , and heard it , and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD , and that thought upon his name .
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bamoirogete Omonene bakaba bagokwana barabwo ase barabwo; Omonene agategerera, akaigwa amang’ana abo, na egetabu y’ekeinyorio ekarikwa ase obosio bwaye ase okoinyora abwo bamoirogete na barengereretie igoro y’erieta riaye.

english: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts , in that day when I make up my jewels ; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Abanto aba mbabe abanto bane bori ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana, nimbarorere amaabera buna omonto akorora amaabera ase omwana oye okomokorera.
