english: Then shall ye return , and discern between the righteous and the wicked , between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
ekegusii: Erio imorore ogwatananeka ase egati y’omonyaboronge na omokori amabe, na ase egati y’oyogonkorera inche Nyasae na oria otari gonkorera.”

english: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver : and he shall purify the sons of Levi , and purge them as gold and silver , that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness .
ekegusii: Ere naikaranse buna oyo ogosamba na gosibia chifeta. Ere nachene Abalawi, abasibie buna chitaabu ne chifeta chigosibigwa, erinde banyare korua ebing’wanso bi’oboronge ase Omonene.

english: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD , as in the days of old , and as in former years .
ekegusii: Erio ebing’wanso bi’Abayuda, na ebi’ abanto ba Yerusalemu, bigokie Omonene, buna ase amatuko aria a kare, na ase emiaka ya kare.

english: And I will come near to you to judgment ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Nimbaike ang’e ase okonacha ekiina. Nimbe kirori omwango igoro y’abarogi na abatomani, na abagotiana oborimo, na abagokorera abarikwa emeremo bobe ase okobarina ching’eria chiabo, na abagokorera ababoraka ne chintakana bobe, na abakoonchorana oboronge bw’abamenyi, korende tibanyirogeti. Ogoakana ensemo ya ikomi

english: For I am the LORD , I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .
ekegusii: “Inche Omonene tindi koonchoka, na ase engencho eyio, inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo timwasiretigwe.

english: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances , and have not kept them . Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts . But ye said , Wherein shall we return ?
ekegusii: Korwa ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino inwe mwagoberete mogatiga emeroberio y’ane echiikire, timwayebwatete. Bono inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteeba iga: Ing’iranera, nainche nimbairanere. Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: Tokoiranere ase inchera ki?

english: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings .
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare konyibera inche Nyasae ebiane? Korende inwe mwanyibeire ebiane. Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki twakoibeire? Mwanyibeire ensemo ya ikomi na okoruegwa konde.

english: Ye are cursed with a curse : for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation .
ekegusii: Mwaragererigwe nokoragererigwa, ekiagera inwe egesaku eke gionsi mwanyibeire ebiane.

english: For, behold, the day cometh , that shall burn as an oven ; and all the proud , yea, and all that do wickedly , shall be stubble : and the day that cometh shall burn them up , saith the LORD of hosts , that it shall leave them neither root nor branch .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora, rituko ngocha rire rigosamba buna omorero o riko. Erio abanto abaenenu bonsi, na abakori amabe bonsi, ’mbabe buna obonyansi obwomo, n’erituko erio rigocha nigo rirabasambe kegima, tirigotiga omori gose orosagia.

english: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .
ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ’ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaaba chiaye. Inwe inamosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.

english: And ye shall tread down the wicked ; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this , saith the LORD of hosts .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ’ndakore ring’ana erio, inwe imotiringe abakori amabe n’amagoro aino, na barabwo ’mbabe buna ribu.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.

english: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .
ekegusii: “Inwe inyora amachiiko a Musa, omosomba one, na emeroberio yonsi namochiigete agwo ase egetunwa kia Horebu, oborokererie Abaisraeli bonsi.

english: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children , and the heart of the children to their fathers , lest I come and smite the earth with a curse .
ekegusii: Ere nairanie chinkoro chi’abaise gochia ase abana babo, na echi’abana gochia ase abaise, erinde ekero ’ndache timbaisa goaka ense eye nokoragererigwa.”

english: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .
ekegusii: Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere bache asare, akabaa okobua ase ebirecha ebibe na kobiseria, na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.

english: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter , enquire who in it is worthy ; and there abide till ye go thence .
ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na ase ekenyoro gionsi, morigie ning’o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.

english: And when ye come into an house , salute it .
ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa enyomba eria, yekwanie.

english: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria egwenerete, tiga omorembe oino oyeikere; ko onye tegwenereti, omorembe oino nobairanere inwe.

english: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
ekegusii: Na inwe namoirwe ase abagabana na ase abarwoti ase engencho y’ane, koba kirori ase bare na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.

english: But when they deliver you up , take no thought how or what ye shall speak : for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak .
ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira, timoichana buna mogochia koiraneria, gose eki mogochia gokwana, ekiagera ase ekero keria inamoegwe aya morakwane;

english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these ; The first , Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother ; James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother ;
ekegusii: Na amarieta abotomwa baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bw’eritang’ani, Simioni, oyio ore korokwa naende Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;

english: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .
ekegusii: inaki tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika o Iso oino orakwane goetera ase more.

english: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo barabachande ase omochie oyomo, motame gochia ase oyonde; nekeene nabateebirie: Timogokoora emechie y’Abaisraeli Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ataracha.

english: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
ekegusii: Eri nkobateebia ase omosunte ime, ritebe ase omobaso; na eri mokoigwa rikomonywa, rirarie igoro ase ebirama.

english: And fear not them which kill the body , but are not able to kill the soul : but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell .
ekegusii: Timoiroka abagoita omobere, abatanyare goita omoyo; kobua moiroke oyo oranyare goita omobere na omoyo ase omorero o kare na kare.

english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing ? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father .
ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro + 10:29 Chinchiro: enyoni ibere tichiri koonigwa ase ebesa eyemo? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tigakogwa inse, Iso oino atancheti.

english: Philip , and Bartholomew ; Thomas , and Matthew the publican ; James the son of Alphaeus , and Lebbaeus , whose surname was Thaddaeus ;
ekegusii: Filipo na Batholomayo; Thomas na Matayo, omorusia ebango; Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Tadayo;

english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered .
ekegusii: Korende nonya nechitukia chionsi chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe.

english: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.

english: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
ekegusii: Inaki kera omonto oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, nainche boigo nimwatore ase Tata one ore igoro,

english: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth : I came not to send peace , but a sword .
ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo naachire korenta omorembe ase ense; tincheti korenta omorembe, korende omoro bw’eseegi.

english: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household .
ekegusii: Na abanto b’enyomba y’omonto inababe ababisa baye.

english: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me : and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me .
ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete ise gose ng’ina kombua, oyio tangwenereti, na oyo bwanchete omwana oye omomura gose omoiseke kombua, oyio tangwenereti.

english: Simon the Canaanite , and Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him .
ekegusii: Simioni omoKaanani, na Yudasi Iskariota, ere oria omoruete. Emeremo ya baria ikomi na babere (Mar 6:7-13; Luk 9:1-6)

english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward ; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward .
ekegusii: Oyobwanchire omobani ekiagera ere nomobani, nanyore eng’eria y’omobani; na oyo bwanchire omonto omooronge ekiagera ere nomonto omooronge, nanyore eng’eria y’omonto omooronge.

english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi oramoe oyomo obo bw’aba abake egekombe kiamaache amakendu ekiagera are omworokigwa one, nekeene nabatebirie: Takoyesiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.”

english: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying , Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :
ekegusii: Aba ikomi na babere Yeso akabatoma, akabachiika, “Timogenda enchera ende yonsi y’ abanto b’Ebisaku, timosoa nonya nomochie onde bwonsi bw’Abasamaria,

english: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
ekegusii: korende mbuya mochiere ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli.

english: And as ye go , preach , saying , The kingdom of heaven is at hand .
ekegusii: Na inwe ase okogenda kwaino, randia, moteebe: Oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.

english: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .
ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakuure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.

english: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
ekegusii: Timobogoria chitaabu, gose chifeta, gose chitaai ase ebimoya biaino,

english: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gochiika aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere, akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda kworokereria na korandia ase emechie yabo. Abatomwa korwa ase Yohana Omobatisi (Luk 7:18-35)

english: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie inwe ng’a ase baria baiboire nomokuungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana Omobatisi; korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa igoro nomonene komobua.

english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .
ekegusii: Inaki ababani bonsi mbaabanete, na amachiiko boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana.

english: He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.

english: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,
ekegusii: Korende inaki ndakegwekanie ekegori eke? Nigo kegwekaine abana baikaransete ase chichiiro, bakorangeria abagisangio babo, bagoteeba;

english: And saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced ; we have mourned unto you , and ye have not lamented .
ekegusii: “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti”.

english: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .
ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete, tare koria gose tare konywa: bagateeba; Nare nekerecha.

english: The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nigo achete okoria na konywa, na barabwo bateebire: Rora, rinyandambe na omotindu bw’edivai, omosani bw’abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe! Na obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi. Obobe bw’emechie eria etegeneti (Luk 10:13-15)

english: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ , he sent two of his disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekero Yohana achia koigwa aaria ase echela ebitage bia Kristo, agatoma aborokigwa baye komoboria,

english: Then began he to upbraid the cities where in most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka gotogonyera emechie eria, aase ebikone biaye ebinge bie chinguru biakorekire, ekiagera etaonchogete:

english: But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe, n’ebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase more.

english: At that time Jesus answered and said , I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agakwana, “Nakobaakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwababisire abare nobong’aini ne chisemi amang’ana aya, na kwayamaanoire ase abana abake.

english: Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .
ekegusii: Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya. Obotomwa bwa Yeso omonyene (Luk 10:22)

english: Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .
ekegusii: Inchuo ase ’nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.

english: And said unto him , Art thou he that should come , or do we look for another ?
ekegusii: “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

english: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .
ekegusii: ekiagera rikorogoto riane neriororo, na egurube y’ane nengusu.”

english: Jesus answered and said unto them , Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Genda moteebie Yohana aya mwaigwa na korora:

english: And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John , What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda, Yeso agachaaka gokwana nemeganda igoro ya Yohana, Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Negetonto gekonyegerigwa nomwaga?

english: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses .
ekegusii: Gose inki mwachiete korora isiko? Omonto bweboyetie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chinterere nigo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.

english: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwasogete isiko? Korora omobani? Ee, nabateebirie, oyore omonene kobua omobani.

english: And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .
ekegusii: Na rora, narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete. Bakaboria Yeso, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato?” Nigo bamoboretie igo erio banyare komosoera.

english: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto tabueti rigori ri’eng’ondi? Ase igo mboronge gokora amaya ase rituko ri’Esabato.”

english: Then saith he to the man , Stretch forth thine hand . And he stretched it forth ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao.” Agakorambora; gokagwena, gokaba okogima buna okonde.

english: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagasoka isiko, bakagaamba igoro ya Yeso buna barakore bamoite. Omosomba omochore

english: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all ;
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komanya aya, akarua aroro. Abanto abange bakamotunyana, akabagwenia bonsi.

english: And charged them that they should not make him known :
ekegusii: Akabachika tibatebia abande igoro yaye.

english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Eri nigo riabeete, erinde rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,

english: He shall not strive , nor cry ; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets .
ekegusii: Takwomana, gose tagoaka eriogi; nonya nomonto takoigwa eriogi riaye ase chinchera chinene.

english: But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him , Behold , thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakamoteebia, “Rigereria, aborokigwa bao buna bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato.”

english: A bruised reed shall he not break , and smoking flax shall he not quench , till he send forth judgment unto victory .
ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki, takororimia, goika arete oboronge ase okobua;

english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust .
ekegusii: na ase erieta riaye abanto b’Ebisaku mbasemerie.” Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mar 3:20-30; Luk 11:14-23; 12:10)

english: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .
ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.

english: And all the people were amazed , and said , Is not this the son of David ?
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia, bakaboorania, “Inee! Oyo nanyare koba omwana o Daudi?”

english: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them , Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
ekegusii: Yeso Konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabateebia, “Kera oborwoti kobwatananekire borobwo obonyene tibogotenena; na kera omochie na enyomba kobiatananekanire, birobio ebinyene tibigotenena;

english: And if Satan cast out Satan , he is divided against himself ; how shall then his kingdom stand ?
ekegusii: na Saitani karaserie Saitani, igo bweatananire ere omonyene, Inee, oborwoti bwaye, naki boratenene?

english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .
ekegusii: Na inche, onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseeria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo inababe abagaambi baino.

english: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .
ekegusii: Korende onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Omoika o Nyasae, igo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.

english: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .
ekegusii: Gose inaki omonto aranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani omonto oria omonyene chinguru? Erio magega anyare gosakora enyomba yaye.

english: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nabateebirie, kera ebibe na okorama Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, korende onye bagochecheria Omoika tibakwaberwa.

english: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
ekegusii: Omonto omuya, ase emonga + 12:35 Emonga: engencho yaye okogacha gose okobekerania biria biraganerigwe ae ebiro bia motwe yaye engiya nigo akorua amaya, na omonto omobe, ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua amabe.

english: But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie, ng’a ase kera ring’ana ritari nengencho Mwanyabaanto barakwane, ase rituko ri’ekiina ’nabache korua omobaro.

english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .
ekegusii: Inaki ase amang’ana ao noegwe oboronge, na ase amang’ana ao nogaambigwe.” Yeso okwanga koorokia egekone (Mar 8:11-12; Luk 11:29-32)

english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest , and findeth none .
ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namaache, kiarigia aase kegotimokera, korende tigekonyora.

english: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
ekegusii: Erio kiabora: ‘Ning’irane ase enyomba y’ane aase narwete.’ Gakegocha kiayenyora nenchwa, yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.

english: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .
ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha binde bitano na bibere (7), ebire ebibe kobua kerokio ekenyene. Nabirobio biasoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani. Naboigo erache koba ase ekegori eke ekebe.” Abamwabo Yeso b’ekeene (Mar 3:31-35; Luk 8:19-21)

english: While he yet talked to the people , behold , his mother and his brethren stood without , desiring to speak with him .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana n’abanto, rora, ng’ina na bamura bamwabo nigo bateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana nere.

english: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Rora, nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana naye.”

english: But he answered and said unto him that told him , Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?
ekegusii: Korende akairaneria oria omotebetie, akabora, “Baba nere ng’o? Na bamura baminto mbarabi?”

english: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said , Behold my mother and my brethren !
ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!

english: For who soever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven , the same is my brother , and sister , and mother .
ekegusii: Ekiagera oyorakore ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”

english: But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .
ekegusii: Inche nabateebirie, nkere aiga egento ekenene kobua Hekalu.

english: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .
ekegusii: ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.” Okogwenigwa kw’omonto ogataete okoboko (Mar 3:1-6; Luk 6:6-11)

english: And when he was departed thence , he went into their synagogue :
ekegusii: Akarua aroro, agasoa ase esinagogi yabo.

english: The same day went Jesus out of the house , and sat by the sea side .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria Yeso akarua nyomba agaikaransa ase enyancha mbarabare.

english: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki kware gokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno?”

english: He answered and said unto them , Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, korende barabwo tibaeiri.

english: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .
ekegusii: Eke nakio gekogera ngokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno, ekiagera okorigereria ’nabarigererie, korende tibakorora, na ogotegerera nabategerere, korende tibakoigwa, nonya nokomanya, tibakomanya.

english: For this people’s heart is waxed gross , and their ears are dull of hearing , and their eyes they have closed ; lest at any time they should see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and should understand with their heart , and should be converted , and I should heal them .
ekegusii: Inaki chinkoro chi’ abanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo gose koigwa namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie - 13:15 Isaya 6:9-10; Ogok 28:26-27 .

english: For verily I say unto you , That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them.
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abaabani abange na abanyene oboronge mbaganetie korora aya morooche inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mokoigwa inwe, tibayaigwa. Ogotebereria kw’omobayeeno bw’omobusuri (Mar 4:13-20; Luk 8:11-15)

english: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower .
ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.

english: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoigwa ring’ana ri’oborwoti, na ere takorimanya, nigo agocha oria omobe, otaboria riria riasimekirwe ase enkoro yaye, oyo nere obusuirwe ase enchera ensemo.

english: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it ;
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase egetare nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, erio kegima oribwata nomogooko,

english: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .
ekegusii: korende tari nemeri ime yaye, ogenderera ekero egeke; na ekero emechando egochi‐gocha, gose okorosigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana, erio bwango ogwa korwa ase okwegena kwaye.

english: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word ; and the care of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , choke the word , and he becometh unfruitful .
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amagwa, oyo nere okoigwa ring’ana; okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo biaba nkomiga bire ring’ana, riaba tirikwama.

english: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word , and understandeth it ; which also beareth fruit , and bringeth forth , some an hundredfold , some sixty , some thirty .
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, orimanya; nere ekeene bwama okwama. Oyomo bwama rigana, na oyonde emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde emerongo etato.” Omobayeeno bw’amabanchore

english: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying , The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field :
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oye;

english: But while men slept , his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat , and went his way .
ekegusii: korende ekero abanto bararire, omobisa oye agacha akabusura amabanchore ime ase engano, akagenda.

english: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .
ekegusii: Egachia komera ekama chinyeke, erio amabanchore naro akarorekana.

english: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him , Sir , didst not thou sow good seed in thy field ? from whence then hath it tares ?
ekegusii: Erio abasomba b’omonyene enyomba bagaacha, bakamobooria: Omonene, tikwabusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oo? Inaki rende ororekanire namabanchore?

english: He said unto them , An enemy hath done this . The servants said unto him , Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up ?
ekegusii: Akabateebia: Nomobisa okorete ayio. Abasomba bakamobooria: Inee! Norigetie tochie toyasimore?

english: But he said , Nay ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .
ekegusii: Akabakania: Yaya; moise koyasimora amabanchore namoiye engano amo naro.

english: And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying , Behold , a sower went forth to sow ;
ekegusii: Akabateebia amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, okobora, “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.

english: Let both grow together until the harvest : and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers , Gather ye together first the tares , and bind them in bundles to burn them : but gather the wheat into my barn .
ekegusii: Bitige bikiine bionsi bibere goika rigesa, na ekero kie rigesa ninteebie abakogesa: Ritang’ani sangereria amabanchore, moyaboe emesaima monyare koyasamba; korende engano moyesangererie gochia kiage kiane.” Omobayeeno bw’entetere y’Omosirapi na oyo bw’ememera (Mar 4:30-34; Luk 13:18-21)

english: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying , The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nentetere y’omosirapi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye;

english: Which indeed is the least of all seeds : but when it is grown , it is the greatest among herbs , and becometh a tree , so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof .
ekegusii: ero nenke mono kobua chimbusuro chionsi, korende koyakiinire yaba enene kobua ebimeri bionsi, eba omote, goika chinyoni chia igoro chichia koroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”

english: Another parable spake he unto them ; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”

english: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :
ekegusii: Aya onsi Yeso nigo ayakwanete ase emeganda eria ase emereng’anio; na tabateebeetie ring’ana otatiga ase emebayeeno,

english: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw’amabanchore a mogondo.”

english: He answered and said unto them , He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man ;
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyogosimeka embusuro engiya n’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto;

english: The field is the world ; the good seed are the children of the kingdom ; but the tares are the children of the wicked one ;
ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b’oborwoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana boria omobe.

english: The enemy that sowed them is the devil ; the harvest is the end of the world ; and the reapers are the angels .
ekegusii: Omobisa oria oyasimegete nere Saitani; rigesa nomoerio bw’ense, na abaraache kogesa nabamalaika.

english: And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :
ekegusii: Ekero are kobusura, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha, chigachiria,

english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
ekegusii: Buna amabanchore agosangererigwa asambwa nomorero, naboigo nomoerio bw’ense orache koba.

english: The Son of man shall send forth his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend , and them which do iniquity ;
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto natome abamalaika baye, na barabwo nabasangererie na kobarusia korwa ase oborwoti bwaye abakogera abande bagochwe, na abagokora ebibe bonsi,

english: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
ekegusii: nababatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

english: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabagirigente buna erioba + 13:43 Erioba: nario “risase” ase oborwoti bwa Ise obo. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe - 13:43 11:15; 13:9 . Emereng’anio y’eniibo, eruru, na ekeonga

english: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .
ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine neniibo yabisire ase omogondo, eye omonto anyorete, akayebisa; erio ase omogooko oye akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akagora omogondo oria.

english: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :
ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro mbogwekanirie nomonto omoonchoreria, okorigia chiruru chingiya.

english: Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .
ekegusii: Ere agachia korora eruru eyemo ye rigori rinene, akaimoka akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akayegora.

english: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net , that was cast into the sea , and gathered of every kind :
ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bonga buna ekeonga ekiarutetwe ase enyancha ime, kegasangereria chinswe chia kera egesaku.

english: Which , when it was full , they drew to shore , and sat down , and gathered the good into vessels , but cast the bad away .
ekegusii: Ekero giaichoire, abanto bagakeng’usa gocha engegu; bagaikaransa, bagasangereria chiria chingiya ase amakuru + 13:48 Amakuru: nebibekerero binga ebitonga , na chiria chimbe bagachituguta.

english: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,
ekegusii: Naboigo eraache koba ase omoerio bw’ense. Abamalaika nabaoroke bache gwatanana baria ababe korwa ase abanyene oboronge,

english: Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
ekegusii: na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, aase amaroba arenge amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.

english: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
ekegusii: babatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino - 13:50 13:42; 22:12; 24:51; 25:30 .”

english: Jesus saith unto them , Have ye understood all these things ? They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Mwamanyire aya onsi?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee.”

english: Then said he unto them , Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ase engencho eyio kera Omwarimu bw’amariiko oyokorirwe koba omworokigwa bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, obeire omogwekano bw’omonyene enyomba, oyokorua ase emonga yaye ebinto ebiyia na ebikoro.” Yeso okwangwa Nazareti (Mar 6:1-6; Luk 4:16-30)

english: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emebayeeno eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.

english: And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?
ekegusii: Agachia goika ense yaye omonyene + 13:54 Agachia goika ense yaye omonyene: nao Yeso akiinerete na ekaba buna sobo nonya oiboreretwe Bethlehemu na gotamigwa gochia Misiri ekero kiobwana bwaye , akaborokereria ase esinagogi yabo, goika bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire obong’aini obo na ogokora oko gwe chinguru?

english: Is not this the carpenter’s son ? is not his mother called Mary ? and his brethren , James , and Joses , and Simon , and Judas ?
ekegusii: Oyo tari omwana bw’omobaachi? Ngi’na tari oria okorokwa Mariamu? Na bamura bamwabo tibari Yakobo, na Yusufu na Simioni, na Yuda?

english: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?
ekegusii: Na basubati bamwabo bonsi tibari aa seito? Gaki oyo ng’ai ayanyorire aya onsi?”

english: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief .
ekegusii: Ere takorete amakumia amange agwo, ekiagera batarenge nokwegena.

english: And when the sun was up , they were scorched ; and because they had no root , they withered away .
ekegusii: Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikooma.

english: And some fell among thorns ; and the thorns sprung up , and choked them :
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga.

english: But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama echinde rigana, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, na echinde emerongo etato.

english: Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe!” Ekerenga ki’ogokwana ase emebayeeno (Mar 4:10-12; Luk 8:9-10)

english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus ,
ekegusii: Ekero keria Herode omorwoti o Galili akaigwa chinkuma igoro ya Yeso;

english: And he sent , and beheaded John in the prison .
ekegusii: Agatoma omonto ase echela ime anache Yohana omotwe.

english: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
ekegusii: Omotwe oye okarentwa ase esani, okaegwa omoiseke oria, na ere akayoira ase ng’ina.

english: And his disciples came , and took up the body , and buried it , and went and told Jesus .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachia bakabogoria omobere, bakayotindeka, bakagenda, bagateebia Yeso amang’ana ayio. Okoragerigwa kw’ abanto chilifu isano (Mar 6:30-44; Luk 9:10-17; Yoh 6:1-13)

english: When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart : and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akarua agwo nobwato, akagenda ere bweka aase abanto batari. Korende ekero emeganda yachia koigwa aya, bakamotunyana namagoro korwa ase emechie.

english: And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikire engegu, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, akagwenia abarwaire babo.

english: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .
ekegusii: Ekero riachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, ngochia koira bore, batige abanto bagende ebinyoro begorere endagera.”

english: But Jesus said unto them , They need not depart ; give ye them to eat .
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tibagwenereti kogenda; inwe bae endagera barie.”

english: And they say unto him , We have here but five loaves , and two fishes .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoteebia, “Titobwati gento aiga, otatiga emegati etano ne chinswe ibere.”

english: He said , Bring them hither to me .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Bindetere aiga.”

english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass , and took the five loaves , and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed , and brake , and gave the loaves to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
ekegusii: Agachiika emeganda eikaranse inse ase obonyansi; akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati, akaa aborokigwa emegati eria, na aborokigwa bakayea emeganda.

english: And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist ; he is risen from the dead ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
ekegusii: agateebia abasomba baye, “Oyo nere Yohana Omobatisi, obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure, eke nakio gekogera chinguru echio chigokora emeremo asare.”

english: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .
ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota. Bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga ikomi na bibere biichire.

english: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men , beside women and children .
ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha ange chilifu isano (5,000), otatiga abakungu na abana. Yeso ogotaara enyancha igoro (Mar 6:45-52; Yoh 6:16-21)

english: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
ekegusii: Erio agachiika aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu ende, goika akaa emeganda ribaga egende.

english: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .
ekegusii: Na nyuma kaeire emeganda ribaga kogenda, akariina ebitunwa igoro ere bweka gochia gosaba. Riachia koba mogoroba akaba agwo bweka.

english: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .
ekegusii: Korende obwato konya bwaikire enyancha gati bokorunda‐rundigwa nemerindo, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete.

english: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .
ekegusii: Na ekero kiabotuko ange gokiamoka, Yeso agacha ase bare, ogotaara ase enyancha igoro.

english: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit ; and they cried out for fear .
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bakaondoka, bakaboora, “Eri nerirengari!” Bagaaka eriogi ase okoiroka.

english: But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying , Be of good cheer ; it is I ; be not afraid .
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”

english: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .
ekegusii: Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene, onye naye, ’nchiike nchiche agwo ase ore igoro ase amaache.”

english: And he said , Come . And when Peter was come down out of the ship , he walked on the water , to go to Jesus .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Inchuo!” Petero agaika korwa ase obwato, agataara igoro ase amaache, gochia ase Yeso.

english: But when he saw the wind boisterous , he was afraid ; and beginning to sink , he cried , saying , Lord , save me .
ekegusii: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bw’echinguru, akairoka, agachaaka korimera amaache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateeba, “Omonene ntooria!”

english: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand , and caught him , and said unto him , O thou of little faith , wherefore didst thou doubt ?
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamobwata akamoteebia, “Aye omonto bw’okwegena ogoke, nase ki okwoboa?”

english: And when they were come into the ship , the wind ceased .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koriina obwato ime, omwaga ogakira.

english: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
ekegusii: N’abwo abarenge ase obwato ime bakamosasiima, bagateeba, “Ekeene, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae.” Abanto ba Genesareti bakogwenigwa (Mar 6:53-56)

english: And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .
ekegusii: Ekero bambokire, bagaika ense ya Genesareti.

english: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased ;
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’orogongo roria bachia komomanya, bagatoma amang’ana ase chinsemo chionsi, bamorentere bonsi abarenge abarwaire;

english: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment : and as many as touched were made perfectly whole .
ekegusii: bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eyanga yaye - 14:36 9:20 ; na bonsi abayokunete bakagwenigwa.

english: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .
ekegusii: Goika akarigia komoita, korende akairoka abanto, ekiagera konya banchire ng’a Yohana n’omobani orenge.

english: But when Herod’s birthday was kept , the daughter of Herodias danced before them , and pleased Herod .
ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye Herode, omoiseke bwe Herodia agatenga gati‐gati y’ abanto, akagokia Herode.

english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask .
ekegusii: Erio Herode agatiana ase okomoriera eira ng’a namoe kende gionsi araborie.

english: And she, being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger .
ekegusii: Kobwatekana n’obosemia bwa ng’ina omoiseke oria agateeba, “Ing’a omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi aiga ase esani.”

english: And the king was sorry : nevertheless for the oath’s sake , and them which sat with him at meat , he commanded it to be given her .
ekegusii: Omorwoti agaichana, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye na abageni baye ase omoyega, agachiika ayoegwe.

english: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero ekio Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakarwa Yerusalemu, bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria,

english: And he called the multitude , and said unto them , Hear , and understand :
ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto bache asare, akabateebia, “Igwa na manya:

english: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .
ekegusii: Tari ekio kegosoa omonwa gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka, korende egekorwa ase omonwa nakio ekio gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”

english: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?
ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire ng’a Abafarisai, ekero baigwete ring’ana riria, mbagechetigwe?”

english: But he answered and said , Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Kera ekemeri getasimekiri na Tata one ore igoro ngesimorwe.

english: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Declare unto us this parable .
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia, “Totebererie omobayeeno oyio.”

english: And Jesus said , Are ye also yet without understanding ?
ekegusii: Akabora, “Inee! Nonya mbono nainwe timori nobong’aini?

english: Do not ye yet understand , that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly , and is cast out into the draught ?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a kende gionsi kegosoa ase omonwa nigo kegoeta enda, kiagwa kebara + 15:17 Kebara: engencho yaye echoo ase abanto bagwekoonyera ?

english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :
ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana y’oborimo, na okorama.

english: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders ? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread .
ekegusii: “Nase ki aborokigwa bao bagosaria chingencho chi’abagaaka? Inaki kobakoragera tibari goisaaba amaboko abo buna egwenerete.”

english: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .
ekegusii: Ayio naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka korende okoria namaboko ataisaabiri tikori kobekera omonto ogotacheneka.” Okwegena kw’omokuungu bw’Ebisaku (Mar 7:24-30)

english: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro, akagenda chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni.

english: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .
ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu o Kaanani korwa ase ensemo eria akaoroka, agakaa eriogi, akabora, “Omonene, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera; enyaroka y’ane yachandirwe mono nekerecha.”

english: But he answered her not a word . And his disciples came and besought him , saying , Send her away ; for she crieth after us .
ekegusii: Korende tamoiraneria ing’ana. Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Mokanie, agende, ekiagera akona‐gototunyana ogotoakera eriogi.”

english: But he answered and said , I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”

english: Then came she and worshipped him , saying , Lord , help me .
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamochiera agatugama inse ase are, akabora, “Omonene, nkonya.”

english: But he answered and said , It is not meet to take the children’s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana na koyerutera chisese.”

english: And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabora, “Ee, Omonene, korende nonya ne chisese nkoria chire amatori ayakogwa korwa ase chimesa chi’abanene babo.”

english: Then Jesus answered and said unto her , O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt . And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aye omong’ina, okwegena kwao nokonene! Tiga abe buna oganetie.” Na ekero ekio enyaroka yaye ekagwenigwa - 15:28 Luk 18:1-8 . Abange bakogwenigwa (Mar 7:31-37)

english: And Jesus departed from thence , and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee ; and went up into a mountain , and sat down there .
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro akagenderera, agacha ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akariina ebitunwa igoro, agaikaransa aroro.

english: But he answered and said unto them , Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Nase ki inwe mogosaria ogochika kwa Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino?

english: And great multitudes came unto him , having with them those that were lame , blind , dumb , maimed , and many others , and cast them down at Jesus’ feet ; and he healed them :
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamochiera, ekarenta amagata, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amamama, na abande abange, bakababeeka ase amagoro a Yeso, na ere akabagwenia.

english: Insomuch that the multitude wondered , when they saw the dumb to speak , the maimed to be whole , the lame to walk , and the blind to see : and they glorified the God of Israel .
ekegusii: Goika emeganda egakumia ekero bachia korora abarenge amamama bagokwana, abarenge ebirema babeire buya, abarenge amagata bakogenda, na abarenge emeuko bakorora; bakamotogia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Okoragerigwa kw’ abanto chilifu inye (Mar 8:1-10)

english: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said , I have compassion on the multitude , because they continue with me now three days , and have nothing to eat : and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye bache asare, akabora, “Inche naroreire emeganda amaabera, ekiagera babeire amo nainche amatuko atato, batari nendagera; na tindigeti kobatiga bagende nenchara, baabaise kogoya inchera.”

english: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Aa nerooro, ng’ai toranyore emegati emenge eraisane abanto abange buna aba baigote?”

english: And Jesus saith unto them , How many loaves have ye ? And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere, ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo.”

english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .
ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse.

english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano n’ebere, ne chinswe chiria. Ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, na barabwo bakayea emeganda eria.

english: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .
ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere biichire.

english: And they that did eat were four thousand men , beside women and children .
ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha chilifu inye, otatiga abakungu na abana.

english: And he sent away the multitude , and took ship , and came into the coasts of Magdala .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso gatigire emeganda egende, akariina obwato ime, akagenda chinsemo chia Magadani.

english: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me ;
ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.

english: And honour not his father or his mother , he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition .
ekegusii: Ase chingencho chiaino chia kare nigo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: Ye hypocrites , well did Esaias prophesy of you , saying ,
ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Mbuya Isaya abanete igoro ase more, ekero ateebete:

english: But in vain they do worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

english: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
ekegusii: Inaki inwe motari komanya ng’a tindi gokwana igoro y’emegati? Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

english: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
ekegusii: Erio bakamanya ng’a tare kobateebia okwerenda nememera y’emegati, korende nokworokereria kw’Abafarisai na Abasadukai. Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mar 8:27-30; Luk 9:18-21)

english: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi , he asked his disciples , saying , Whom do men say that I the Son of man am ?
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso acha ensemo ya Kaisaria Filipi, akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Inee! Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”

english: He saith unto them , But whom say ye that I am ?
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Nainwe mokobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”

english: And Jesus answered and said unto him , Blessed art thou , Simon Bar-jona : for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee , but my Father which is in heaven .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nosesenirie aye Simioni, mosinto o Yona, ekiagera eri tomaanoreiri nomobere na amanyinga, korende na Tata one ore igoro.

english: And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .
ekegusii: Na inche nagotebirie, ng’a aye naye Petero, na igoro ase egetare eke ning’agache ekanisa y’ane, ne chinguru chi’amakweri tichikoyebua.

english: He answered and said unto them , When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Rikoba mogoroba, mwaboora: Reero nerakeere, ekiagera igoro abariirire.

english: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .
ekegusii: Erio akabatianera bokong’u aborokigwa baye ng’a tibateebia onde nere Kristo. Yeso okobana ogokwa na okoboka kwaye (Mar 8:31-33; Luk 9:22)

english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples , how that he must go unto Jerusalem , and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be killed , and be raised again the third day .
ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria aborokigwa baye ng’a nemogwenerete kogenda Yerusalemu, agwo ase aranyare gochandwa mono ase amaboko y’abagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa; ase rituko ria gatato naboke.

english: Then Peter took him , and began to rebuke him , saying , Be it far from thee , Lord : this shall not be unto thee .
ekegusii: Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania, akabora, “Omonene, ayio tabaisa gokonyora! Takoba ase ore buna ayio.”

english: But he turned , and said unto Peter , Get thee behind me , Satan : thou art an offence unto me : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but those that be of men .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akeonchora, agateebia Petero, “Irana magega y’ane, Saitani! Aye nigo origetie koba egetango ase inde, ekiagera ebirengererio biao tibiri ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mar 8:34; 9:1; Luk 9:23-27)

english: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye? Gose omonto inki ararue ase ribaga ri’omoyo oye - 16:26 Mar 8:36 ?

english: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abanto mbare aiga ase aba bateneine, barabwo bataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake goika barore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase oborwoti bwaye.”

english: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?
ekegusii: Na mambia mwaboora: Reero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera igoro yababariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete korora obosio bwa igoro, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.

english: And when his disciples were come to the other side , they had forgotten to take bread .
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa baika ng’umbu, konya beebire koirana emegati.

english: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .
ekegusii: Bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Titwarentete emegati.”

english: Which when Jesus perceived , he said unto them , O ye of little faith , why reason ye among yourselves , because ye have brought no bread ?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabora, “Inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke, inki gekogera mokona‐koborania ng’a timori nemegati?

english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,
ekegusii: Na nyuma y’amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene, n’Elija ogochia gocha ritang’ani, na ere naroisie onsi.

english: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist .
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baye bakamanya ng’a ere nigo are kobateebia igoro ya Yohana Omobatisi. Yeso okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mar 9:14-29; Luk 9:37-43)

english: And when they were come to the multitude , there came to him a certain man , kneeling down to him , and saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ase omoganda, omonto oyomo akamochiera agwo, akamotung’amera, akabora,

english: Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatick , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .
ekegusii: “Omonene, ororere omomura one amaabera, ekiagera nare nendurume, nigo achandegete mono. Inaki ere, kero kende nigo akogwa ase omorero ime, na kero kende ase amaache ime.

english: And I brought him to thy disciples , and they could not cure him .
ekegusii: Namorenta ase aborokigwa bao, tibanyara komogwenia.”

english: Then Jesus answered and said , O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him hither to me .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aiga.”

english: And Jesus rebuked the devil ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
ekegusii: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.

english: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart , and said , Why could not we cast him out ?
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso bobisi, bakaboora, “Ninki kiagera intwe titwanyara korusia ekerecha keria?”

english: And was transfigured before them : and his face did shine as the sun , and his raiment was white as the light .
ekegusii: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.

english: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .
ekegusii: Korende ekerecha kenga buna eke tikegosoka otatiga ase ogosaba na okweng’ata.”] Yeso ogokwana naende igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mar 9:30-32; Luk 9:43-45)

english: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them , The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
ekegusii: Ekero basangererekanete Galili, Yeso akabateebia, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto.

english: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again . And they were exceeding sorry .
ekegusii: Barabwo inabamoite, ne rituko ria gatato nabooke.” Bagaichana mono. Yeso ogoakana ebango ye Hekalu

english: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying , What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ee, nkorua are.” Goika agasoa nyomba, Yeso agatang’ana gokwana na Petero, akamobooria, “Inki okorengereria Simioni? Nase ng’o abarwoti b’ense bakorusia ebango n’echoogo? Nkorwa ase abana babo, gose nase abanto bande?”

english: Peter saith unto him , Of strangers . Jesus saith unto him , Then are the children free .
ekegusii: Na ekero Petero amoiraneria, “Nkorwa ase abande,” Yeso akamoteebia, “Rirorio abana babo barabwo nabasibore.

english: Notwithstanding , lest we should offend them , go thou to the sea , and cast an hook , and take up the fish that first cometh up ; and when thou hast opened his mouth , thou shalt find a piece of money : that take , and give unto them for me and thee .
ekegusii: Korende titobaisa kobagechia, genda nyancha orute endobio na enswe eraache ritang’ani oyebwate; na ekero okoyiasamia omonwa oye norore egesamunye kiebesa kereo, okerusie, obae abwo ase engencho y’ane amo naye.”

english: And , behold , there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him .
ekegusii: Na rora, Musa na Elija bakabaorokera, bagakwana nere.

english: Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, mbuya intwe koba aiga; onye ngwancha, ninkore aiga ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”

english: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face , and were sore afraid .
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.

english: And Jesus came and touched them , and said , Arise , and be not afraid .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agacha akabakuna, akabora, “Imoka, timobaisa kwoboa.”

english: And when they had lifted up their eyes , they saw no man , save Jesus only .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koimokia amaiso abo, tibarora monto otatiga Yeso bweka.

english: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying , Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .
ekegusii: Kobagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, Yeso akabatianera, akabora, “Timoteebia monto onde okorora oko goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto aboke korwa ase abakuure.”

english: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost .
ekegusii: Inaki Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nigo achete gotooria egiasirete.] Omobayeeno bw’eng’ondi ensiru (Luk 15:3-7)

english: How think ye ? if a man have an hundred sheep , and one of them be gone astray , doth he not leave the ninety and nine , and goeth into the mountains , and seeketh that which is gone astray ?
ekegusii: “Inki mokorengereria? Omonto obwate ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo kerasire; Inee, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase ebitunwa, achie korigia eria yasirire?

english: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .
ekegusii: Kayenyorire, nekeene nabateebirie: Nagoke ase eria kobua ase chiria emerongo kianda na kianda chitasirete.

english: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven , that one of these little ones should perish .
ekegusii: Naboigo, tari ogwancha gwa iso oino ore igoro ng’a oyomo bw’aba abake asire. Buna orakore ase oyomino okorire bobe (Luk 17:3)

english: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
ekegusii: Ere atabategerereti abwo, teebia ekanisa; naende ataigwereti ekanisa nero, ase ore aye tiga abe buna omonto bw’ense + 18:17 bw’ense: engencho yaye oy’otegeneti gose omosiru , na buna omorusia ebango.

english: Again I say unto you , That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask , it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven .
ekegusii: “Naende nabateebirie: Onye babere ase more bagwancherana ase ense igoro yering’ana rinde rionsi barasabe, inabakorerwe rirorio na Tata one ore igoro.

english: And Jesus called a little child unto him , and set him in the midst of them ,
ekegusii: Akarangeria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yaabo,

english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .
ekegusii: Inaki ase bare babere gose batato basangererekanire ase erieta riane, nainche nao inde agwo gati‐gati yabo.” Omobayeeno bw’omosomba otari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono (Luk 17:4)

english: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king , which would take account of his servants .
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti origetie gokora omobaro bw’abasomba baye.

english: And when he had begun to reckon , one was brought unto him , which owed him ten thousand talents .
ekegusii: Ekero achaakire gokora omobaro akarenterwa omosomba oyomo omoriete chitalanta chilifu ikomi.

english: But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .
ekegusii: Ekero asinyetwe goakana, omonene oye agachiika aoonigwe, ere na mokaye, na abana baye, na ebi abwate bionsi, na esiira eria eakanwe.

english: The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
ekegusii: Omosomba oria akagwa inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Omonene one, ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane bionsi.

english: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’omosomba oria agasogwa namaabera, akamosibora, akamwabera ase esiira yaye.

english: But the same servant went out , and found one of his fellowservants , which owed him an hundred pence : and he laid hands on him , and took him by the throat , saying , Pay me that thou owest .
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio, ekero achia korua aroro, akarora ase abasomba bande oyomo omoriete chidinari rigana erimo, akamobwata ebigoti, akabora: Ng’akane ebi kwariete.

english: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet , and besought him , saying , Have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
ekegusii: Omosomba oria agatung’ama inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane.

english: And he would not : but went and cast him into prison , till he should pay the debt .
ekegusii: Akanga, agachia akamoruta echela ime goika aakane esira eria.

english: So when his fellowservants saw what was done , they were very sorry , and came and told unto their lord all that was done .
ekegusii: Ekero abasomba bande bachia korora aya akoreka, bagaichana mono, bakagenda, bagateebia omonene obo onsi ayakorekire.

english: Then his lord , after that he had called him , said unto him , O thou wicked servant , I forgave thee all that debt , because thou desiredst me :
ekegusii: Erio omonene oye akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Aye omosomba omobe! Inche ngakwabera esira yonsi, ekiagera gwansororete.

english: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwagwenerete kwabera omosomba oria onde, buna nainche nakwaberete?

english: And his lord was wroth , and delivered him to the tormentors , till he should pay all that was due unto him .
ekegusii: Omonene oye akabea mono, akamobeka ase abarendi b’echela, goika aakane ebi ariete bionsi.

english: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .
ekegusii: Naboigo na Tata one ore igoro arabakorere nainwe, onye timokwabera abamino ase chinkoro chiaino ime.”

english: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: Gaki, onde bwensi oyo orekeyie omonyene koba buna omwana oyo, oyio nere ore omonene kobua abande ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

english: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraariganie omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyariganirie inche. Ogotemwa gokora ebibe (Mar 9:42-48; Luk 17:1-2)

english: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me , it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea .
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramochere oyomo bw’aba abake, abanyegenete, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe ase endiba y’enyancha.

english: Woe unto the world because of offences ! for it must needs be that offences come ; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh !
ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’ense ase engencho y’amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Inaki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!

english: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan ;
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodani;

english: His disciples say unto him , If the case of the man be so with his wife , it is not good to marry .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana igoro y’omonto na mok’aye k’arabe engencho eye, tegwenereti konywoma.”

english: But he said unto them , All men cannot receive this saying , save they to whom it is given .
ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Tari bonsi baranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, otatiga abwo baeirwe.

english: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother’s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it.
ekegusii: Inaki mbare abagomba abaiboretwe bo, naende mbare abagomba aba abanto bagombaetie, naende mbare abagomba abekorete abanyene koba abagomba ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa igoro. Oyoranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, tiga arianche.” Yeso ogosesenia abana abake (Mar 10:13-16; Luk 18:15-17)

english: Then were there brought unto him little children , that he should put his hands on them , and pray : and the disciples rebuked them .
ekegusii: Erio abana abake bakarentwa ase Yeso, erinde ababeekere amaboko aye na kobasabera. Aborokigwa baye bagatanga abanto,

english: But Jesus said , Suffer little children , and forbid them not , to come unto me : for of such is the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: korende Yeso agateeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa igoro n’obwabo.”

english: And he laid his hands on them , and departed thence .
ekegusii: Akababeekera amaboko aye, akaimoka korwa aroro, akagenda. Omomura omonda (Mar 10:17-22; Luk 18:18-23)

english: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?
ekegusii: Na rora, omonto oyomo akamochiera, akamobooria, “Omworokia ’mboseera ki ndakore ’nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”

english: And he said unto him , Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Nase ki okomboria ninki kere ekiya? Nareo oyomo bweka oyore omuya. Onye korigetie gosoa ase obogima, bwata amachiiko.”

english: And great multitudes followed him ; and he healed them there .
ekegusii: na emeganda emenene ekamotunyana, akabagwenia aroro.

english: The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?
ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoteebia, “Ayio onsi nayabwatire; ing’ana ki rimochete?”

english: Jesus said unto him , If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Onye korigetie koba omoikeranu, gachie, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe neniibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”

english: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .
ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ring’ana riria, omomura oria akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge neniibo enyinge.

english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples , Verily I say unto you , That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nabe aakong’u ase omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

english: And again I say unto you , It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Naende nabateebirie inwe, naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bagakumia mono, bagateeba, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

english: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them , With men this is impossible ; but with God all things are possible .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarigereria, akabateebia, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, korende ase Nyasae onsi nigo akonyarekana.”

english: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Behold , we have forsaken all , and followed thee ; what shall we have therefore ?
ekegusii: Erio Petero akamoiraneria, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire, inki rende toranyore?”

english: And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name’s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .
ekegusii: Na onde bwensi otigete chinyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ise, gose ng’ina, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’erieta riane, namenteranigwe ara rigana, na obogima bwa kare na kare nabonyore.

english: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mok’aye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi?”

english: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
ekegusii: Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo. Naboigo, ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”

english: He saith unto them , Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives : but from the beginning it was not so .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino Musa abaete ribaga gotiga abakungu baino, korende ayio tarenge bo korwa omochakano.

english: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ , the son of David , the son of Abraham .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’echisokoro chia Yeso Kristo korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, oyio orenge korwa ase ororeria rwa Aburaamu.

english: And Ezekias begat Manasses ; and Manasses begat Amon ; and Amon begat Josias ;
ekegusii: na Hezekia akaibora Manase, na Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia,

english: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren , about the time they were carried away to Babylon :
ekegusii: na Yosia akaibora Yekonia na abamwabo ase chingaki chiria Abaisraeli basakoretwe na kong’anyigwa gochia Babiloni.

english: And after they were brought to Babylon , Jechonias begat Salathiel ; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel ;
ekegusii: Na magega ko Abaisraeli basakoirwe na kong’anyigwa gochia Babiloni Yekonia akaibora Salatieli, na Salatieli akaibora Serubabeli,

english: And Zorobabel begat Abiud ; and Abiud begat Eliakim ; and Eliakim begat Azor ;
ekegusii: na Serubabeli akaibora Abihudi, na Abihudi akaibora Eliakimu, na Eliakimu akaibora Azoro,
