english: And Azor begat Sadoc ; and Sadoc begat Achim ; and Achim begat Eliud ;
ekegusii: na Azoro akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Akimu, na Akimu akaibora Eliudi,

english: And Eliud begat Eleazar ; and Eleazar begat Matthan ; and Matthan begat Jacob ;
ekegusii: na Eliudi akaibora Eleazari, na Eleazari akaibora Matani, na Matani akaibora Yakobo,

english: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary , of whom was born Jesus , who is called Christ .
ekegusii: na Yakobo akaibora Yusufu, omosacha o Mariamu oyo oiborete Yeso, oyio okorokwa Kristo.

english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations ; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations ; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations .
ekegusii: Na ebigori bionsi korwa Aburaamu goika Daudi nigo biarenge ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa Daudi goika ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa kwa Abaisraeli gochia Babiloni, n’ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa kwa Abaisraeli gochia Babiloni goika Kristo, nebigori ikomi na bine. Okoiborwa kwa Yeso (Luk 2:1-7)

english: Then Joseph her husband , being a just man , and not willing to make her a publick example , was minded to put her away privily .
ekegusii: Yusufu nigo arenge omonto omooronge, na tarigetie komoa obosooku, maiso marore, ase igo akaroberia amotige bobisi.

english: Abraham begat Isaac ; and Isaac begat Jacob ; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren ;
ekegusii: Korwa ase Aburaamu goika omorwoti Daudi akaibora Isaka, na Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora Yuda na abamwabo,

english: But while he thought on these things , behold , the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream , saying , Joseph , thou son of David , fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife : for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Korende ekero arenge orengereretie aya, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamochiera ase chindoto akamoteebia. “Aye Yusufu, korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, toiroka koira Mariamu abe mokao, ekiagera nigo abeire morito ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu.

english: Now all this was done , that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Aya onsi nigo abeire, erinde riikerane ring’ana riria riakwanetwe n’Omonene goetera ase omonwa bw’omobani:

english: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him , and took unto him his wife :
ekegusii: Na Yusufu agachia kobooka korwa ase chitoro, akanywoma Mariam buna omomalaika bw’Omonene konya amoteebirie akore.

english: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar ; and Phares begat Esrom ; and Esrom begat Aram ;
ekegusii: na Yuda akaibora Peresu na Zera ase Tamari, na Peresu akaibora Hezironi, na Hezironi akaibora Aramu,

english: And Aram begat Aminadab ; and Aminadab begat Naasson ; and Naasson begat Salmon ;
ekegusii: na Aramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nashoni, na Nashoni akaibora Salimoni,

english: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab ; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth ; and Obed begat Jesse ;
ekegusii: na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,

english: And Solomon begat Roboam ; and Roboam begat Abia ; and Abia begat Asa ;
ekegusii: na Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya, na Abiya akaibora Asa,

english: And Asa begat Josaphat ; and Josaphat begat Joram ; and Joram begat Ozias ;
ekegusii: na Asa akaibora Yehosafati, na Yehosafati akaibora Yoramu, na Yoramu akaibora Usia,

english: And Ozias begat Joatham ; and Joatham begat Achaz ; and Achaz begat Ezekias ;
ekegusii: na Usia akaibora Yotamu na Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia,

english: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard .
ekegusii: “Inaki oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine - 20:1 13:24,31,44; 18:23; 22:2 n’omonto omonyene enyomba oyosoogete mambia chuni kogenda koriika abaremi ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.

english: But when the first came , they supposed that they should have received more ; and they likewise received every man a penny .
ekegusii: Bono ekero ab’eritang’ani bacha, bagakaga ng’a barabwo nabaegwe kobua abande, bakanyora nabarabwo kera oyomo edinari eyemo.

english: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,
ekegusii: Erio kabaeirwe, bakaba nkwemurungania bare ase omonyene enyomba,

english: Saying , These last have wrought but one hour , and thou hast made them equal unto us , which have borne the burden and heat of the day .
ekegusii: bakaboora: Abwo ba magega nigo bakora emeremo y’ensa eyemo yoka, na aye kwabatoreng’aneria naintwe abatwaremereretie emechando ne riberera ri’omobaso bwonsi?

english: But he answered one of them , and said , Friend , I do thee no wrong : didst not thou agree with me for a penny ?
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria oyomo obo: Omosani, tingokorereti bobe. Titwancheranete naye ase edinari eyemo?

english: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
ekegusii: Bwata ekere ekiao, ogende; nindigetie koa oyo o magega koreng’ana naye.

english: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?
ekegusii: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?

english: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way , and said unto them ,
ekegusii: Nabo, ekero Yeso arenge gotiira gochia Yerusalemu, akabaira aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere ensemo.

english: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,
ekegusii: Kobare inchera, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore gochia Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruugwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko, na barabwo ’nabamonachere ekiina ki’ogokwa,

english: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .
ekegusii: naende nabamorue ase amaboko y’ abanto b’Ebisaku; nakorerwe echeche, naende naakwe emecharichi na kobambwa; na ase rituko ria gatato nabokigwe.” Okoboria koegwa ogosika gw’ense eye (Mar 10:35-40)

english: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .
ekegusii: Agancherana nabaremi kobaakana edinari eyemo ase rituko, erio akabaira ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.

english: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons , worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him .
ekegusii: Erio ng’ina abana ba Zebedi akamochiera Yeso amo nabana baye, akamotung’amera na komosaba ring’ana.

english: And he said unto her , What wilt thou ? She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Inki origetie?” Akamoiraneria, “Chiika ng’a abana bane babere baikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, n’oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee ase oborwoti bwao.”

english: But Jesus answered and said , Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ? They say unto him , We are able .
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe timomanyeti eri mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe ’ndache konywera inche?” Bakamoteebia, “Natonyare.”

english: And he saith unto them , Ye shall drink indeed of my cup , and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with : but to sit on my right hand , and on my left , is not mine to give , but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Egekombe ’nkonywera inche, namokenywere, korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio ney’okobee, tindi nokobua gw’okobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire na Tata one nabwo barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mar 10:41-45)

english: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .
ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakababea abamura baria babere.

english: And whosoever will be chief among you , let him be your servant :
ekegusii: na oyorarigie koba omotang’ani ase more, goika abe omosomba oino,

english: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
ekegusii: buna Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto atachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.” Yeso okogwenia abanto babere emeuko (Mar 10:46-52; Luk 18:35-43)

english: And as they departed from Jericho , a great multitude followed him .
ekegusii: Ekero baare korua Yeriko, omoganda omonene okamotunyana.

english: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,
ekegusii: Agasoka chinsa isato, akarora abande bateneine echiiro, batari nemeremo,

english: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
ekegusii: Rora, abanto babere emeuko baikaransete ase enchera ensemo, na ekero bachia koigwa Yeso ogoeta, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Omonene omwana o Daudi! Tororere amaabera.”

english: And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
ekegusii: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga mono, bakaboora, “Omonene, tororere amaabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”

english: And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said , What will ye that I shall do unto you ?
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabarangeria, akababoria, “Ninki morigetie mbakorere?”

english: They say unto him , Lord , that our eyes may be opened .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omonene, otoramokie amaiso aito.”

english: So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes : and immediately their eyes received sight , and they followed him .
ekegusii: Yeso agasogwa namaabera, agakuna amaiso abo. Erio kegima bakarora, bakamotunyana.

english: And said unto them ; Go ye also into the vineyard , and whatsoever is right I will give you . And they went their way .
ekegusii: akabateebia nabarabwo: Genda nainwe ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu na inche nimbae ekebagwenerete. Bakagenda.

english: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
ekegusii: Agasoka naende chinsa isano nemo, ne chinsa kianda, agakora boigo.

english: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?
ekegusii: Goika chinsa ikomi nemo agasoka, akarora abande bateneine, akababoria nabarabwo: Ninki mwatenenera aa bwaira, motari nameremo?

english: They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: Ekiagera monto onde tatoriigeti. Akabateebia: Genda nainwe boigo ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu.

english: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour , they received every man a penny .
ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo baachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.

english: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem , and were come to Bethphage , unto the mount of Olives , then sent Jesus two disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Erio Yeso agatoma aborokigwa baye babere,

english: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Yerusalemu, omochie omogima ogasega‐sega, abanto bakabooria, “Ning’o oyio?”

english: And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .
ekegusii: Emeganda ekairaneria, “Oyio nere Yeso, omobani o Nazareti ya Galili.” Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mar 11:15-19; Luk 19:45-48; Yoh 2:13-22)

english: And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, akabasokia isiko bonsi abarenge koonia na kogora ime ase Hekalu, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma.

english: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple ; and he healed them .
ekegusii: Emeuko na amagata bakamochiera aria ase Hekalu, na ere akabagwenia.

english: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David ; they were sore displeased ,
ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakabea, ekero bachia korora ebirage bi’ogokumia akorete, na abana bagoaka eriogi ase Hekalu ime, bakobora, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi!”

english: And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany ; and he lodged there .
ekegusii: Akabatiga, agasoka korwa ase omochie, akagenda Bethania, akarara aroro. Omoko omogomba (Mar 11:12-14,20-26)

english: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
ekegusii: Mambia gakoirana omochie, akaigwa enchara.

english: And when he saw a fig tree in the way , he came to it , and found nothing thereon , but leaves only , and said unto it , Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever . And presently the fig tree withered away .
ekegusii: Akarora omoko oyomo ase enchera ensemo, akayochiera, tarora gento asoro otatiga amato oka. Akayoteebia, “Korwa bono tokwama amatunda nonya ndinde.” Erio kegima omoko oyio okoma.

english: Saying unto them , Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria kere bosio bwaino, erio kegima namorore etigere esibire, na emori yaye amo nero; mochisibore mochindetere.

english: And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled , saying , How soon is the fig tree withered away !
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia korora ogokora oko, bagakumia, bakabooria, “Inaki bono omoko oyo bwoma bwango iga?”

english: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .
ekegusii: Kende gionsi moraborie ase ogosaba, komoregeene namokenyore.” Riborio igoro y’okobua kwa Yeso (Mar 11:27-33; Luk 20:1-8)

english: And when he was come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching , and said , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority ?
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na etureti + 21:23 Etureti: etureti n’abagaaka bakogamba ebiina ase ebinyoro ase erieta rinde nabwo abatureti y’abanto, bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang’ana aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nainche boigo nimbaboorie ring’ana erimo, komorang’iranerie, nainche boigo nimbateebie nase okobua ki ngokora aya.

english: The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ? And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?
ekegusii: Inee! Ebatiso ya Yohana, ng’ai yarwete? Igoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?” Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, igo aratoborie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?

english: But if we shall say , Of men ; we fear the people ; for all hold John as a prophet .
ekegusii: Naende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, nkoiroka tore omoganda, ekiagera abanto bonsi banchete ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”

english: And they answered Jesus , and said , We cannot tell . And he said unto them , Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Titomanyeti.” Ere akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase kobua ki ngokora aya. Omobayeeno bw’abana babere abamura

english: But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .
ekegusii: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

english: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Tindigeti kogenda, korende magega yaye akaonchoka, akagenda.

english: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them ; and straightway he will send them .
ekegusii: Na omonto karabateebie ring’ana, momoteebie: Omonene nachiganetie; erio kegima nachitome.”

english: And he came to the second , and said likewise . And he answered and said , I go , sir : and went not .
ekegusii: Akamochiera oy’okabere, akamoteebia boigo. Nere akamoiraneria: Nkogenda inde, omonene; ko tagenda.

english: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ? They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them , Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
ekegusii: Inee! Norori ase baria babere okorete ogwancha gwa ise?” Bakaboora, “Noria bw’eritang’ani.” Yeso akabateebia, “Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi nkobatang’anera bare gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.

english: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’amatunda yachia goika ang’e, agatoma abasomba baye ase abaremi, banyore amatunda aye.

english: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .
ekegusii: Abaremi bakabwata abasomba baye, oyomo bakamoaka, oyonde bakamoita, na oyonde bakamoaka amagena.

english: Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani; bakabakorera boigo.

english: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
ekegusii: Omoerio oye agatoma omwana oye ase bare, ogoteeba: Inabasike omwana one.

english: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria, ekero bachia korora omwana oria, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye toyoire.

english: And they caught him , and cast him out of the vineyard , and slew him .
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita.

english: All this was done , that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Aya onsi agakoreka, erinde anyare goikeranigwa ayatebetwe nomobani, ogoteeba,

english: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh , what will he do unto those husbandmen ?
ekegusii: Inee! Karache omonyene omogondo, naki arakore abaremi baria?”

english: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Igo araite abamwamu baria ogoita okobe, na aatananere abaremi bande omogondo oria bw’emesabibu, abarache komoa amatunda ekero amire.”

english: Therefore say I unto you , The kingdom of God shall be taken from you , and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nabateebirie, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae naborusigwe ase more, boegwe egesaku egekwama amatunda aye. [

english: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken : but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
ekegusii: Oyoragwe igoro ase rigena eri nabunekane, na ere oyo rigena riria riragwere inarimosenyente.]

english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
ekegusii: Ekero abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bachia koigwa emebayeeno yaye, bakamanya ng’a nabwo agoteeba.

english: But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia korigia komobwata, bakairoka emeganda, ekiagera abanto konya banchire ng’a ere nomobani.

english: And the disciples went , and did as Jesus commanded them ,
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachiigete.

english: And brought the ass , and the colt , and put on them their clothes , and they set him thereon .
ekegusii: Bakamorentera etigere amo nemori yaye, bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ya chirochio, na Yeso akayeriina.

english: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .
ekegusii: Na abange b’emeganda bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete bagachiaara nchera.

english: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables , and said ,
ekegusii: Naende Yeso agakwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno akabora,

english: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
ekegusii: Abasomba baria bagasoka, bagaika ase chinchera, bagasangereria abanyorete bonsi, ababe na abaya; igo enyomba y’enyangi egaichorwa nabageni.

english: And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :
ekegusii: “Korende ekero omorwoti achia gosoa korigereria abageni, akarora omonto oyomo aroro otabegete eyanga y’enyangi.

english: And he saith unto him , Friend , how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment ? And he was speechless .
ekegusii: Akamoboria: Mosani, naki gwakorete ogasoa aiga, na aye otari neyanga y’enyangi? Agakira‐kiri.

english: For many are called , but few are chosen .
ekegusii: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.” Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mar 12:13-17; Luk 20:20-26)

english: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakagenda, bakaroberia buna bagochia gotega Yeso ase amang’ana aye.

english: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
ekegusii: Bagatoma aborokigwa babo ase are, amo n’Abaherode, bakaboora, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, na enchera ya Nyasae nigo okoyiorokereria ase ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto - 22:16 Mar 12:14; Luk 18:2,4; 20:21 ; ekiagera torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto.

english: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?
ekegusii: Gaki toteebie naki orooche aye? Mboronge komoa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo.”

english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said , Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabora, “Inaki mogonteema, inwe abang’ainereria?

english: Shew me the tribute money . And they brought unto him a penny .
ekegusii: Inyorokie ebesa y’ebango.” Bakamorentera ebesa.

english: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king , which made a marriage for his son ,
ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti okorete omoyega bw’enyangi y’omwana oye.

english: And he saith unto them , Whose is this image and superscription ?
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?”

english: They say unto him , Cæsar’s . Then saith he unto them , Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s ; and unto God the things that are God’s .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.” Erio akabateebia, “Nabo, ebire ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

english: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa ring’ana riria, bagakumia; bakamotiga, bakagenda. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mar 12:18-27; Luk 20:27-40)

english: Now there were with us seven brethren : and the first , when he had married a wife , deceased , and , having no issue , left his wife unto his brother :
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise oyomo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mok’aye.

english: Likewise the second also , and the third , unto the seventh .
ekegusii: Naboigo noyo o kabere akamotwara, na oyo o gatato, goika bonsi batano na babere bakaera.

english: And last of all the woman died also .
ekegusii: Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.

english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa, mokang’o arabe ase baria batano na babere; naki bonsi mbameny’anete nere?”

english: Jesus answered and said unto them , Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwasirire inwe, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae.

english: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .
ekegusii: Agatoma abasomba baye batuunye baria konya barangerigwe ase enyangi, korende barabwo bakaanga gocha.

english: For in the resurrection they neither marry , nor are given in marriage , but are as the angels of God in heaven .
ekegusii: Inaki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.

english: But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
ekegusii: Na ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure timwana gosoma eri mwatebetigwe na Nyasae:

english: And when the multitude heard this , they were astonished at his doctrine .
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia koigwa aya, ogakumia ase okworokereria kwaye. Ogochika kore okonene kobua ayande (Mar 12:28-34)

english: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.

english: Then one of them , which was a lawyer , asked him a question , tempting him , and saying ,
ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw’amachiiko, akamobooria ase okomoteema,

english: Master , which is the great commandment in the law ?
ekegusii: “Omworokia, ngochiika ki kore okonene ase amachiiko onsi?”

english: This is the first and great commandment .
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika okonene, naende nakwo kw’eritang’ani.

english: Again , he sent forth other servants , saying , Tell them which are bidden , Behold , I have prepared my dinner : my oxen and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready : come unto the marriage .
ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, agateeba: Bateebie abarangerigwe: Rigereria, naroisirie endagera y’ane, chieri amo n’echimori chiane chianyenyirwe, na bionsi biabeire ang’e; inchwo ase omoyega bw’enyangi.

english: While the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them ,
ekegusii: Abafarisai kobasangererekanire amo, Yeso akababoria,

english: Saying , What think ye of Christ ? whose son is he ? They say unto him , The Son of David .
ekegusii: “Inaki inwe mokorengereria ase Kristo? Nomwana o ng’o are?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nomwana o Daudi.”

english: He saith unto them , How then doth David in spirit call him Lord , saying ,
ekegusii: Akababoria, Inki rende gekogera Daudi, akoraagwa n’Omoika, akamoroka Omonene, okobora:

english: If David then call him Lord , how is he his son ?
ekegusii: Gaki, onye Daudi okomooroka Kristo, naki rende arabe omwana oye?

english: And no man was able to answer him a word , neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
ekegusii: Onde tarenge ore konyara komoiraneria ing’ana; nonya nkorwa rituko riria monto onde tarenge na boremu komoboria maborio ande.

english: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
ekegusii: Korende bagachaaya amang’ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;

english: And the remnant took his servants , and entreated them spitefully , and slew them .
ekegusii: na abatigarete bakabwata abasomba baye, bakabakorera bobe bakabaita.

english: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
ekegusii: Omorwoti oria akaba nendamwamu, agatoma emeganda y’abarwani, egasiria abaiti baria, na koyosamba omochie obo nomorero.

english: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia abasomba baye: Ekeene enyangi yabeire ang’e, korende abaariganetigwe tibagwenereti.

english: Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .
ekegusii: Gaki, genda ase chinchera chinene, aba moranyore bonsi mobarangerie gocha ase omoyega bw’enyangi.

english: Then spake Jesus to the multitude , and to his disciples ,
ekegusii: Naende Yeso agateebia emeganda na aborokigwa baye,

english: Neither be ye called masters : for one is your Master , even Christ .
ekegusii: Gose timobaisa korokwa abanene, ekiagera Omonene oino noyomo, nere Kristo.

english: But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .
ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mwasiekeire abanto oborwoti bwa igoro; naki inwe abanyene timori gosoa, na baria barigeti gosoa, timori kobaa ribaga basoe. [

english: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows’ houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mokounereria chinyomba chi’abatakaanwa, na ase obong’ainereria mwasaba ogosaba ogotambe. Ase ayio, inamonyore ekiina ekere ekenene kobua.]

english: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosiongorokana enyancha na ense enyomo korigia omotunyani oyomo, na ekero abeire omotunyani, mwagera oba omwana bw’omorero o kare na kare ara kabere kobua inwe abanyene.

english: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, abaraai emeuko, inwe abamogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase Hekalu, tari gento, korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase etaabu ye Hekalu, bwesibire n’emuma yaye.

english: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gold , or the temple that sanctifieth the gold ?
ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?

english: And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase egesasiimero tari gento; korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase ekeng’wanso kere igoro ase egesasiimero bwesibire nemuma yaye.

english: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gift , or the altar that sanctifieth the gift ?
ekegusii: Inwe emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: nesadaka, gose negesasiimero kegokora esadaka ebe enchenu?

english: Saying , The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat :
ekegusii: “Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai baikaransire ase ekerogo kia Musa.

english: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .
ekegusii: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasiimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.

english: And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .
ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase Hekalu, nigo ararie ase eyio na ase oyo omenyete imeo.

english: Ye blind guides , which strain at a gnat , and swallow a camel .
ekegusii: Inwe abaraai emeuko, mwakenonora egechuni, mwamera engamia!

english: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.

english: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
ekegusii: Aye Omofarisai omouko! Sibia ritang’ani egekombe na esani ime, erio nonya nisiko binyare koba ebirabu.

english: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
ekegusii: Nainwe nabo more, isiko mwarorekana ase abanto ng’a nabaronge more, korende ime yaino mwaichoirwe nobong’ainereria na ebibe ebinge.

english: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokoagaacha chimbeera chi’ababani, na kobaria chimbeera chi’abaronge,

english: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .
ekegusii: Gaki, amang’ana onsi bakobateebia, moyanare na koyabwata; korende, timokora buna barabwo bagokora.

english: And say , If we had been in the days of our fathers , we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets .
ekegusii: mogoteeba: Onye ntwarengeo kare ase amatuko ye chisokoro chiaito, anga titwabwatanete nabarabwo ase ogoitera amanyinga y’ababani.

english: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .
ekegusii: Igo mwetebire inwe abanyene, ng’a inwe nabana babo more, baria baitete ababani.

english: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .
ekegusii: Gaki bono, ichoria ekerengo gie chisokoro chiaino.

english: Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire ababani ase more, na abanto abang’aini, na aborokia b’amariiko; abande babo inamobaite na kobaabamba, na abande babo inamobang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiaino, na kobachanda omochie ase omochie.

english: Verily I say unto you , All these things shall come upon this generation .
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi naache igoro ase ekegori eke. Yeso ogwechandera omochie o Yerusalemu (Luk 13:34-35)

english: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, omochie ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao, buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye ase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!

english: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne , and lay them on men’s shoulders ; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers .
ekegusii: Inaki nigo bakoboa chigurube chindito, bachitweka ase amareko y’abanto, korende barabwo abanyene tibari gwancha gochitigeria nekiara kiabo.

english: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts , and the chief seats in the synagogues ,
ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete aase amasikani ase emeyega, na goikaransa aase ebirogo bi’amasikani ase chisinagogi,

english: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .
ekegusii: na gokwanigwa n’amasikani ase chichiiro, na korokwa Omwarimu n’abanto.

english: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ ; and all ye are brethren .
ekegusii: Korende inwe timobaisa korokwa Omworokia, ekiagera Omwarimu oino noyomo, na inwe mwensi nabamo.

english: And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .
ekegusii: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.

english: And Jesus went out , and departed from the temple : and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple .
ekegusii: Yeso agatiga Hekalu, akaba nkogenda are, na aborokigwa baye bakamochiera komworokia amaagacho ye Hekalu.

english: And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobeekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,

english: And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .
ekegusii: na ababani b’oborimo abange mbaimoke, baraae abange na kobasiria.

english: And because iniquity shall abound , the love of many shall wax cold .
ekegusii: Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange ’nabokende.

english: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations ; and then shall the end come .
ekegusii: Naende, amang’ana aya amaya y’oborwoti narandigwe ase ense yonsi koba kirori ase ebisaku bionsi; erio omoerio ochiche. Okogechia kw’ogosaria

english: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains :
ekegusii: erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa.

english: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eyanga yaye.

english: And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
ekegusii: Korende nebe aakong’u ase abare morito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.

english: And Jesus said unto them , See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabateebirie: Tirigotigara rigena erimo aiga igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mar 13:3-23; Luk 21:7-24)

english: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :
ekegusii: Korende saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo, gose ase rituko ri’Esabato,

english: And except those days should be shortened , there should no flesh be saved : but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened .
ekegusii: Naende onye amatuko ayio atanachetwe, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete; korende ase engencho y’abachore amatuko ayio nanachwe.

english: Then if any man shall say unto you , Lo , here is Christ , or there ; believe it not .
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.

english: For there shall arise false Christs , and false prophets , and shall shew great signs and wonders ; insomuch that , if it were possible , they shall deceive the very elect .
ekegusii: Inaki nabaoroke abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo, nabaorokie ebikone ebinene na amakumia, goika keranyarekane, nabang’aine nonya nabachore.

english: Behold , I have told you before .
ekegusii: Rora, nabateebirie aya ritang’ani.

english: For as the lightning cometh out of the east , and shineth even unto the west ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
ekegusii: Inaki buna okomesa gokorwa moocha kwabara gochia bosongo, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto korache koba.

english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives , the disciples came unto him privately , saying , Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign of thy coming , and of the end of the world ?
ekegusii: Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”

english: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .
ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki’egetuureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachoore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mar 13:28-37; Luk 21:29-36; 17:26-30)

english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :
ekegusii: Eorokererie omobayeeno oyo korwa ase omoko: Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

english: So likewise ye , when ye shall see all these things , know that it is near , even at the doors .
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe komokorora aya aorokire, momanye ng’a omoerio obeire ang’e na gesieri.

english: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass , till all these things be fulfilled .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

english: Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .
ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake. Onde taiyo omanyete rituko nonya n’ensa

english: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no, not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ye rituko riria, na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika ba igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata bweka.

english: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noe entered into the ark ,
ekegusii: Inaki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , Take heed that no man deceive you .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina.

english: Then shall two be in the field ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto babere inababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.

english: Two women shall be grinding at the mill ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
ekegusii: Abakungu babere inababe bagoseera orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.

english: Watch therefore : for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda, ekiagera timomanyeti ituko ki Omonene oino agocha.

english: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe, kabe ang’e; naki ase ensa eria motakagereti nario Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto araache. Abasomba abegenwa na abatari abegenwa (Luk 12:42-46)

english: Who then is a faithful and wise servant , whom his lord hath made ruler over his household , to give them meat in due season ?
ekegusii: Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero kegwenerete?

english: Verily I say unto you , That he shall make him ruler over all his goods .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.

english: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming ;
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria omobe, karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire goocha,

english: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants , and to eat and drink with the drunken ;
ekegusii: achaake goaka abasomba b’omonene oye, na koria na konywa amo nabagotinda,

english: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ ; and shall deceive many .
ekegusii: Inaki abange inabaache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche Kristo; baraae abange na kobasiria.

english: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,
ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nigo araache rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti;

english: And shall cut him asunder , and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
ekegusii: ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto ’mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.

english: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars : see that ye be not troubled : for all these things must come to pass , but the end is not yet .
ekegusii: Na inwe inamoigwe esegi, ne chinkuma, chi’esegi; rigereria timoichanigwa, ekiagera ekeene, aya onsi nabe; korende omoerio toracha.

english: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be famines , and pestilences , and earthquakes , in divers places .
ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti inaborwane noborwoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y’ense inabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.

english: All these are the beginning of sorrows .
ekegusii: Ayio onsi naro omochakano bw’obororo. Yeso ogokwana igoro y’ogochandwa

english: And while they went to buy , the bridegroom came ; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage : and the door was shut .
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonywomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.

english: But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .
ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria: Nekeene nabateebirie: Timbamanyeti inwe.

english: Watch therefore , for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh .
ekegusii: Yeso agakoora ogoteeba “Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa. Omobayeeno bwe chitalanta

english: And unto one he gave five talents , to another two , and to another one ; to every man according to his several ability ; and straightway took his journey .
ekegusii: Akaa oyomo chitalanta isano, na oyonde ibere, na oyonde eyemo, kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye. Erio akagenda. Akabaa chitalanta kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye.|alt="He gave them talents each according to his ability" src="Gw-032.jpg" size="col" loc="Matthew 25:14-30" copy="Graham Wade" ref="25:15"

english: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same , and made them other five talents .
ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano akagenda erio kegima, agachionchoreria, akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.

english: And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
ekegusii: Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

english: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth , and hid his lord’s money .
ekegusii: Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyeemo akagenda, agakuunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.

english: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh , and reckoneth with them .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amange omonene bw’abasomba baria agacha, akarigia gokora omobaro nabarabwo.

english: And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .
ekegusii: Batano ase barabwo nigo barenge abariri, na batano abang’aini.

english: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .
ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano agacha ne chitalanta chinde isano, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta isano, rora nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.

english: His lord said unto him , Well done , thou good and faithful servant : thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
ekegusii: Omonene oye akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.

english: He also that had received two talents came and said , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me two talents : behold , I have gained two other talents beside them .
ekegusii: Naende oria oetwe chitalanta ibere agacha, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta ibere, rora, nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

english: His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.

english: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :
ekegusii: Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng’a nigo ore omonto omokong’u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;

english: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .
ekegusii: erio nkoboa, nkagenda nkabisa etalanta yao inse. Nero eye.

english: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
ekegusii: Korende omonene oye akamoiraneria: Aye omosomba omobe naende omworo! Nkwamanyete ng’a nigo nkogesa aase ntasimegete, naende nigo ngosangereria aase ntabusureti?

english: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers , and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury .
ekegusii: Gaki nkwagwenerete kobeeka chitaabu chiane ase abakorua efaida, na inche ngocha, anga nanyora echiane amo nefaida y’ane.

english: Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .
ekegusii: Bono moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.

english: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :
ekegusii: Na ekero baria abariri baimogetie chitaaya chiabo, korende tibaimokia y’ogochi komenta;

english: And before him shall be gathered all nations : and he shall separate them one from another , as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats :
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abanto buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.

english: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand , but the goats on the left .
ekegusii: Ching’ondi nachibeeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

english: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come, ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :
ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio: Inchuo inwe abamwasesenetigwe na Tata one, soa ase omwando bw’oborwoti mwaroiseretigwe korwa ogotongwa gw’ense,

english: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me drink : I was a stranger , and ye took me in :
ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

english: Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .
ekegusii: inarenge getirianda, mokamboyia; inarwarete, mogaacha kondora; inasibetwe echela, moganchichera.

english: Then shall the righteous answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , and fed thee ? or thirsty , and gave thee drink ?
ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabamoiranerie: A! Omonene, indi twakorooche kore nenchara, togakorageria? Gose indi twakorooche kore nerang’o, togakoa okanywa?

english: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?
ekegusii: Indi twakorooche kore omogeni, togakoroisia, gose getirianda, togakoboyia?

english: Or when saw we thee sick , or in prison , and came unto thee ?
ekegusii: Naende indi twakorooche kore omorwaire, gose gosibire echela, togaacha gokorora?

english: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .
ekegusii: korende baria abang’aini bakaimokia amaguta ase ebinto biabo amo ne chitaaya chiabo.

english: And the King shall answer and say unto them , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren , ye have done it unto me .
ekegusii: Na Omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna mware gokorera oyomo bw’aba abaminto abare abake, ninche mwakorerete.

english: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
ekegusii: Erio nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue ase ’nde inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,

english: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :
ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, timwang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, timwang’a inywe.

english: I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .
ekegusii: Inarenge omogeni, timwandoisia; inarenge getirianda, timwamboyia; inarwarete, naende inarenge echela ime, timwacha kondora.

english: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?
ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakorooche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang’o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?

english: Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna motare gokorera oyomo bw’aba abare abake, timwankorerete inche.

english: While the bridegroom tarried , they all slumbered and slept .
ekegusii: Ekero omonywomi atebana gocha, bagasundoka bonsi, bakarara.

english: And at mid night there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh ; go ye out to meet him .
ekegusii: Korende botuko gati gekaba egeturi: Rigereria, omonywomi oyo! Soka momorotote!

english: Then all those virgins arose , and trimmed their lamps .
ekegusii: Erio abaiseke baria bonsi bakaimoka koroisia chitaaya chiabo.

english: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil ; for our lamps are gone out .
ekegusii: Baria abariri bagateebia baria abang’aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaaya chiaito chiarimire.

english: But the wise answered , saying , Not so ; lest there be not enough for us and you : but go ye rather to them that sell , and buy for yourselves .
ekegusii: Korende baria abang’aini bakabairaneria: Taibo. Takonyara gotoisana intwe amo nainwe, mbuya mogende mwegorere ase abaonia.

english: And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye,

english: When Jesus understood it , he said unto them , Why trouble ye the woman ? for she hath wrought a good work upon me .
ekegusii: Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabateebia, “Nase ki mokorosia omokungu oyo? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya,

english: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body , she did it for my burial .
ekegusii: Buna anyororokeria amaguta aya ase omobere one, onkoreire aya ase okombeeka ang’e ase ogotindekwa kwane.

english: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this, that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri eye erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.” Yudasi ogwancherana korwa Yeso (Mar 14:10-11; Luk 22:3-6)

english: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,

english: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him .
ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio akaba nkorigia are ribaga ri’okomorua. Yeso okoria Endagera y’omoerio y’Epasaka amo n’aborokigwa baye (Mar 14:12-26; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)

english: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie tokoroisie oriere Epasaka?”

english: And he said , Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momoteebie: Omworokia oteebire: Engaki y’ane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa bane.”

english: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them ; and they made ready the passover .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagakora buna bachiigetwe na Yeso, bakaarigania Epasaka.

english: Now when the even was come , he sat down with the twelve .
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, agaikaransa ase endagera, amo naborokigwa baria ikomi na babere.

english: And as they did eat , he said , Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
ekegusii: Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabateebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”

english: And they were exceeding sorrowful , and began every one of them to say unto him , Lord , is it I ?
ekegusii: Bagaichana mono, bagachaaka kera oyomo komoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche?”

english: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him : but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! it had been good for that man if he had not been born .
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna amariiko agoteeba, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto arurwe nere! Nigo ere buya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”

english: Then Judas , which betrayed him , answered and said , Master , is it I ? He said unto him , Thou hast said .
ekegusii: Yudasi, nere oyokomorua, akamobooria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwateebire.”

english: And as they were eating , Jesus took bread , and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples , and said , Take , eat ; this is my body .
ekegusii: Kobakoragera, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, akabora, “Bogoria, morie; oyo noro omobere one.”

english: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying , Drink ye all of it ;
ekegusii: Akabogoria na egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa, akabora, “Kanywe aya inwe mwensi,

english: But I say unto you , I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine , until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom .
ekegusii: Nabateebirie, tinkonywa naende okwama oko kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa oboyia amo nainwe ase oborwoti bwa Tata.”

english: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;

english: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
ekegusii: Kobakoorire goteera Ogoteera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Yeso okobana buna Petero agocha komokana (Mar 14:27-31; Luk 22:31-34; Yoh 13:36-38)

english: Peter answered and said unto him , Though all men shall be offended because of thee , yet will I never be offended .
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi ase engencho yao na bagotige, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.” “Neba inabagochwe bonsi ase engencho yao na bagotige, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.”|alt="Even if they all stumble and desert you,I won't desert you at all" src="Gw-035.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 26:31-35" copy="Graham Wade" ref="26:33"

english: Jesus said unto him , Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagoteebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”

english: Peter said unto him , Though I should die with thee , yet will I not deny thee . Likewise also said all the disciples .
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateeba boigo. Yeso ogosaba Gethisemane (Mar 14:32-42; Luk 22:39-46)

english: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane , and saith unto the disciples , Sit ye here , while I go and pray yonder .
ekegusii: Naende Yeso akagenda nabarabwo goika aase akorokwa Gethisemane, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa ekero nkogenda aria gosaba.”

english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
ekegusii: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

english: Then saith he unto them , My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, nonya ngoika ogokwa; ikaransa aa, morende amo nainche.”

english: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying , O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
ekegusii: Akagenderera ake, akagwa maumama, agasaba, “Tata one, onye ekonyarekana, tiga egekombe eke + 26:39 Egekombe eke: engencho yaye emechando eye kerusigwe ase ’nde; korende taba buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”

english: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty , and kill him .
ekegusii: erio bakaigwana bagakora omoroberio banyare komobwata Yeso bobisi, na komoita.

english: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter , What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?
ekegusii: Agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabanyora bararire, agateebia Petero, “Inee! Iga timokonyara korenda amo nainche nonya nensa eyemo?

english: Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .
ekegusii: Renda, mosabe, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika oro nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”

english: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying , O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
ekegusii: Naende akagenda eria kabere, agasaba, “Tata one, onye tekonyarekana egekombe eke + 26:42 Egekombe eke: engencho yaye emechando eye keng’etere ntakenywereti, abe buna bwanchete aye.”

english: And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .
ekegusii: Agacha naende, akabanyora bararire; ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito.

english: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatiga naende, akagenda, agasaba eria gatato agakwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.

english: Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them , Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
ekegusii: Erio agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono nigo moraire na gotimoka? Rora ensa yaikire, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.

english: Rise , let us be going : behold , he is at hand that doth betray me .
ekegusii: Imoka, togende, rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mar 14:43-50; Luk 22:47-53; Yoh 18:2-11)

english: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agacha, na omoganda omonene amo nere bare nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto.

english: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .
ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua, konya obaeire ekemanyererio, agateeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate.”

english: And forthwith he came to Jesus , and said , Hail , master ; and kissed him .
ekegusii: Erio kegima agachiera Yeso, agateeba, “omorembe obe naye, Omonene!” Akamonyunyunta.

english: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people .
ekegusii: Korende bakaboora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa goocha koba rirorooche ase abanto.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mar 14:3-9; Yoh 12:1-8)

english: And Jesus said unto him , Friend , wherefore art thou come ? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mosani, kora bwango eki giakoreta aa?” Erio bagaacha, bakamobwata Yeso, bakamoira.

english: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest’s , and smote off his ear .
ekegusii: Na rora, oyomo obo bw’abarenge amo na Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.

english: Then said Jesus unto him , Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.

english: Thinkest thou that I can not now pray to my Father , and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels ?
ekegusii: Gose tomanyeti ng’a ninyare gosaba Tata, na ere nantomere abamalaika kobua emeganda ikomi na ebere?

english: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?
ekegusii: Korende naki rende nanga amariiko aikeranigwa, ng’a nabo egwenerete koba?”

english: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled . Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .
ekegusii: Korende aya onsi abeire, erinde amariiko y’ababani aikeranigwe.” Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama. Yeso bosio bw’etureti (Mar 14:53-65; Luk 22:54-55,63-71; Yoh 18:12-14,19-24)

english: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .
ekegusii: Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase enyomba ya Kayafa Omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka basangererekanete.

english: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .
ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agasoa ime, agaikaransa amo nabarendi, erinde arore eki gekoba omoerio.

english: Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death ;
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na ab’ekegaambero bonsi bakarigia amang’ana y’oborimo y’ogosoera Yeso, banyare komoita;

english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,
ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni, oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma,

english: But found none : yea, though many false witnesses came , yet found they none . At the last came two false witnesses ,
ekegusii: korende nonya abarori abange b’oborimo bachete, tibayanyora. Omoerio abarori babere bagaacha,

english: And the high priest arose , and said unto him , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene agatenena akamobooria Yeso, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”

english: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agakira. Na Omokuani omonene akamoteebia, “Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ore moyo, ototeebie gose naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae.”

english: What think ye ? They answered and said , He is guilty of death .
ekegusii: Inaki morooche?” Bakairaneria, “Omonto oyo nigo agwenerete akwe.”

english: Saying , Prophesy unto us , thou Christ , Who is he that smote thee ?
ekegusii: bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?” Petero okomokana Yeso (Mar 14:66-72; Luk 22:56-62; Yoh 18:15-18,25-27)

english: Now Peter sat without in the palace : and a damsel came unto him , saying , Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee .
ekegusii: Bono Petero nigo aikaransete egoora isiko. Omoiseke oyomo omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene akamochiera, akabora, “Aye naye kwarenge amo na Yeso Omogalili.”

english: But he denied before them all , saying , I know not what thou sayest .
ekegusii: Korende ere agakaana ase amasio abo bonsi, akabora “Timanyeti ayio ogokwana.”

english: And when he was gone out into the porch , another maid saw him , and said unto them that were there , This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth .
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoka gesieri, omoiseke onde akamorora, agateebia abarengeo, “Omonto oyo nigo arenge amo na Yeso, Omonazareti.”

english: And again he denied with an oath , I do not know the man .
ekegusii: Agakaana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”

english: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .
ekegusii: Magega ase egeka egeke abateneine aroro bagaacha, bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera ogokwana kwao gwakoorokirie.”

english: Then began he to curse and to swear , saying , I know not the man . And immediately the cock crew .
ekegusii: Erio agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, okobora, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.” Agwo kegima etuoni ekabuga.

english: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him , Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice . And he went out , and wept bitterly .
ekegusii: Erio Petero akainyora ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.” Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.

english: But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa baye bachia korora aya, bakagechigwa, bakaboora, “Nobwa ki obosiru obo:

english: For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga taonigwa ase chisiringi chinyinge na chiegwe abataka?”

english: When the morning was come , all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death :
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bonsi na abatureti bagakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Yeso.

english: And gave them for the potter’s field , as the Lord appointed me .
ekegusii: bagachiira ase okogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene achigeete.” Pilato okoboria Yeso amaborio (Mar 15:2-15; Luk 23:3-5,13-25; Yoh 18:33—19:16)

english: And Jesus stood before the governor : and the governor asked him , saying , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And Jesus said unto him , Thou sayest .
ekegusii: Nere Yeso agatenena ase gabana bw’Abarumi; oyio omobooretie, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”

english: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abakuani abanene na abagaaka bamosoerete, tairaneria ing’ana rinde.

english: Then said Pilate unto him , Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee ?
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoteebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteeba igoro yao?”

english: And he answered him to never a word ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .
ekegusii: Korende ere tairaneria rinde, nonya nase ring’ana erimo, na gabana agakumia mono.

english: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner , whom they would .
ekegusii: Bono ekero kie rituko rinene nigo yarenge engencho ya gabana gosiborera Abayahudi omosibwa oyomo oyo barigetie.

english: And they had then a notable prisoner , called Barabbas .
ekegusii: Mbabwate omosibwa oyomo omanyekanete, okorokwa Baraba.

english: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
ekegusii: Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere ase abasibwa aba babere Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”

english: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him .
ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

english: When he was set down on the judgment seat , his wife sent unto him , saying , Have thou nothing to do with that just man : for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him .
ekegusii: Ekero Pilato aikaransire ase ekerogo gi’ekiina, akarenterwa amang’ana na mok’aye, ogoteeba, “Oyio nomonto omonyene oboronge, tobaisa kwebwatia asare, ekiagera reero inachandetwe namange ase okorota ase engencho yaye.”

english: And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .
ekegusii: Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gabana o Rumi. Ogokwa kwa Yudasi

english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na abagaaka bakagenka emeganda ng’a baborie baegwe Baraba, na Yeso bamoite.

english: The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .
ekegusii: Korende Pilato akaboria omoganda oria naende, “Ase abanto aba babere, norori morigetie mbasiborere?” Bakamoteebia, “Baraba.”

english: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Imokore naki Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?” Bakamoteebia bonsi, “Tiga abambwe!”

english: And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Barabwo bakamenta goaka egeturi, bakobora, “Tiga abambwe!”

english: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro ase tore, na ase abana baito!”

english: Then released he Barabbas unto them : and when he had scourged Jesus , he delivered him to be crucified .
ekegusii: Erio akabasiborera Baraba, na magega gaakire Yeso emecharichi, akabamotigera anyare kobambwa. Abasikari bagochecheria Yeso (Mar 15:16-32; Luk 23:26-43; Yoh 19:17-27)

english: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall , and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers .
ekegusii: Erio abarwani ba Pilato bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’egabana, bakamosangererekanera omoganda omogima bw’abarwani.

english: And they stripped him , and put on him a scarlet robe .
ekegusii: Bakamorusia chianga chiaye, bakamobeekera eyanga embariri.

english: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
ekegusii: Bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobeekera motwe, na egetonto bakamobekera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio; bagatung’ama asare, bakamochecheria na kobora, “Ochie kare, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”

english: And they spit upon him , and took the reed , and smote him on the head .
ekegusii: Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.

english: And after that they had mocked him , they took the robe off from him , and put his own raiment on him , and led him away to crucify him .
ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eyanga eria embariri, bakamobeekera chianga chiaye omonyene, bakamoira isiko abambwe.

english: And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .
ekegusii: Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simioni; erio abasikari bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.

english: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,
ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),

english: And sitting down they watched him there ;
ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa komorigereria aria.

english: And set up over his head his accusation written , THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
ekegusii: Igoro ase omotwe oye bakabeeka ogosoerwa kwaye, koriikire, “OYO NERE YESO, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI”.

english: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
ekegusii: Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

english: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .
ekegusii: okobora, “Namochire ase okorua omonto otari na bobe bonde aitwe.” Barabwo bakaboora, “Ninki aya are ase tore? Echio n’echigurube chiao!”

english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders , said ,
ekegusii: Na baria abakuani abanene bagakora boigo, bakamokorera echeche amo naborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka, bakobora,

english: He saved others ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .
ekegusii: “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.

english: The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .
ekegusii: Na baria abauri, abaabambetwe amo nere, bakamorama boigo. Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mar 15:33-41; Luk 23:44-49; Yoh 19:28-30)

english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour .
ekegusii: Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.

english: Some of them that stood there , when they heard that , said , This man calleth for Elias .
ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine aroro, bakayaigwa, bakaboora, “Omonto oyo n’Elija akorangeria.”
