english: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
ekegusii: Korende baria abande bakaboora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komotooria.”

english: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple , and departed , and went and hanged himself .
ekegusii: Yudasi agatuguta chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta ase Hekalu ime, akaimoka, akagenda akeng’enta.

english: Jesus , when he had cried again with a loud voice , yielded up the ghost .
ekegusii: Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.

english: And the graves were opened ; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose ,
ekegusii: Chimbeera chikamaanoka chigaasama, na abanto abange abachenu konya bakuure bakabokigwa.

english: And came out of the graves after his resurrection , and went into the holy city , and appeared unto many .
ekegusii: Kabaruure ase chimbeera, magega y’okoboka kwa Yeso bagasoa ase omochie omochenu + 27:53 Omochie omochenu: Noro Yerusalemu agwo ase abanto abange babaroche.

english: Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .
ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, na abwo barenge amo nere korenda Yeso, bachia korora omotengecho bw’ense na ebiakorekire, bakairoka mono, bakaboora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae!”

english: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee’s children .
ekegusii: Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magadalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na Yusufu, na ng’ina ’abana ba Zebedi. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mar 15:42-47; Luk 23:50-56; Yoh 19:38-42)

english: When the even was come , there came a rich man of Arimathæa , named Joseph , who also himself was Jesus’ disciple :
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.

english: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
ekegusii: Oyio akagenda ase Pilato, akarigia omobere o Yeso. Erio Pilato agachiika ayoegwe.

english: And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,
ekegusii: Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani, Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani, akayobeka ase oboina |alt="Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a linen cloth and buried it in his tomb" src="Gw-043.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 27:57-61" copy="Graham Wade" ref="27:59"

english: And the chief priests took the silver pieces , and said , It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury , because it is the price of blood .
ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta bakaboora, “Tari boronge gochibeeka ase ekungo y’esadaka ya Nyasae, ekiagera chirochio nechie rigori ri’amanyinga.”

english: And laid it in his own new tomb , which he had hewn out in the rock : and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre , and departed .
ekegusii: akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.

english: And there was Mary Magdalene , and the other Mary , sitting over against the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Mbarengeo Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina. Mbarengeo Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina.|alt="There were Mary Magdalene and the other Mary, they all sat on the tomb" src="Gw-045.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 27:57-66" ref="27:61" Oboina bokorendwa

english: Now the next day , that followed the day of the preparation , the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate ,
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, erio riare rituko ri’Esabato, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase Pilato,

english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
ekegusii: Gaki, chiika oboina borendwe buya goika rituko ria gatato, aborokigwa baye tibaabaisa gocha komoiba, bateebie abanto ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; oborimo bw’omoerio inabobue boria bw’eritang’ani.”

english: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .
ekegusii: Pilato akabateebia, “More nabarendi; genda morende mono oboina buna moranyaare.”

english: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
ekegusii: Ase igo bakagenda bakarenda oboina mono ase okobeeka rigena riria ekemanyererio, naende bakabeeka abarendi.

english: And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter’s field , to bury strangers in .
ekegusii: Bakanacha ekiina giokogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, obe aase bagotindeka abageni.

english: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .
ekegusii: Ase ayio omogondo oyo nigo okorokwa Omogondo bw’Amanyinga goika reero.

english: In the end of the sabbath , as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week , came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Esabato egachia koera, kobogokiamoka rituko ria Jumapili, Mariamu Magadalena na oria Mariamu onde bakagenda korora oboina.

english: Then said Jesus unto them , Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timoiroka! Genda moteebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.” Amang’ana y’abarendi boboina

english: Now when they were going , behold , some of the watch came into the city , and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done .
ekegusii: Ekero abakungu baria bachire, rora abande b’abarendi baria boboina bagasoa ase omochie, bagateebia abakuani abanene amang’ana onsi ayakoregete.

english: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakaumerana amo n’abagaaka, bakaroisia omoroberio erio bakaa abarendi baria chitaabu chinyinge,

english: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Moteebie abanto: Aborokigwa baye mbachete botuko, bakamoiba ekero twararire.

english: And if this come to the governor’s ears , we will persuade him , and secure you .
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri koriraigweke ase gabana, intwe natoche tokwane nere, tomoebererie, na kobarusia inwe ase emechando.”

english: So they took the money , and did as they were taught : and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day .
ekegusii: Bakabogoria chitaabu chiria, bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na omogano oyo okumire ase Abayahudi goika reero iga. Yeso okoorokera aborokigwa baye

english: And when they saw him , they worshipped him : but some doubted .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia komorora, bakamosasiima; korende abande mbabete n’echitang’utang’u.

english: And Jesus came and spake unto them , saying , All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth .
ekegusii: Yeso agacha ange nabarabwo akabateebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.

english: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
ekegusii: Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.

english: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .
ekegusii: mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachiikire; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw’ense.”

english: His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :
ekegusii: Ekieni kiaye nigo kiarenge buna okomesa kw’embura, na eyanga yaye nendabu buna amagena y’embura.

english: And for fear of him the keepers did shake , and became as dead men .
ekegusii: Ase okomoiroka ere abarendi bakaiguswa, bakaba buna abanto bakuure.

english: And the angel answered and said unto the women , Fear not ye : for I know that ye seek Jesus , which was crucified .
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika agateebia abakungu baria, “Timoiroka inwe, ekiagera namanyire ng’a Yeso mokorigia, oria obambetwe.

english: He is not here : for he is risen , as he said . Come , see the place where the Lord lay .
ekegusii: Tari aiga, ekiagera obokire, buna ateebete. Inchuo, morigererie aase Omonene araire.

english: And go quickly , and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead ; and , behold , he goeth before you into Galilee ; there shall ye see him : lo , I have told you .
ekegusii: Na genda bwango, moteebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”

english: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy ; and did run to bring his disciples word .
ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogooko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang’ana.

english: And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying , All hail . And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .
ekegusii: Na rora, Yeso akaumerana na barabwo, akabakwania, “Omorembe obe nainwe!” Na barabwo bagaacha, bakamobwata amagoro, bakamosasiima.

english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king , behold , there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem ,
ekegusii: Yeso nigo aiboretwe ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ase amatuko aria Herode arenge omorwoti. Matuko make igo nyuma kaiboirwe, abaringoria b’eching’enang’eni bagacha korwa moocha goika Yerusalemu. Abaringoria b’eching’enang’eni bagacha korwa moocha goika Yerusalemu.|alt="The wise men came from the East to Jerusalem" src="Gw-002.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 2:1-10" copy="Graham Wade" ref="2:1"

english: And when they were come into the house , they saw the young child with Mary his mother , and fell down , and worshipped him : and when they had opened their treasures , they presented unto him gifts ; gold , and frankincense , and myrrh .
ekegusii: Bakagenda bagasoa nyomba, bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima. Erio bagakuunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etaabu, na ubani, na manemane.

english: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod , they departed into their own country another way .
ekegusii: Erio bakairana gochia soobo bakabwatia enchera eng’ao ekiagera Nyasae konya obakuureire ase chindoto nga tibairanera ase Herode. Ogotamigwa kw’Omwana gochia Misiri

english: And when they were departed , behold , the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream , saying , Arise , and take the young child and his mother , and flee into Egypt , and be thou there until I bring thee word : for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him .
ekegusii: Magega k’abageni baria bachiire, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu ase chindoto, akamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, oire omwana na ng’ina, otame gochia Misiri, omenye aroro goika ngoteebie, ekiagera Herode narigie omwana oyo anyare komoita.”

english: When he arose , he took the young child and his mother by night , and departed into Egypt :
ekegusii: Ere akaimoka botuko, akaira omwana oria na ng’ina, akagenda Misiri,

english: Then Herod , when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men , was exceeding wroth , and sent forth , and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem , and in all the coasts thereof , from two years old and under , according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men .
ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochaayirwe n’ abaringoria baria b’eching’enang’eni, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abwo barenge inse y’emiaka ebere, koreng’ana n’ekero keria atebetigwe n’abanto baria abang’aini.

english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero ekio rigaikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia,

english: But when Herod was dead , behold , an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt ,
ekegusii: Magega Herode gakuure, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamoteebia,

english: Saying , Where is he that is born King of the Jews ? for we have seen his star in the east , and are come to worship him .
ekegusii: Erio bakaboria “Ng’ai are omwana oiborwe oyio orabe omorwoti bw’Abayahudi? Nigo twaroche eng’enang’eni yaye ekero yachete agwo igoro ime ya moocha, naende intwe nigo twachire komosasiima.”

english: Saying , Arise , and take the young child and his mother , and go into the land of Israel : for they are dead which sought the young child’s life .
ekegusii: “Imoka, oire omwana na ng’ina, mogende ase ense ya Israeli, ekiagera baria barenge korigia obogima bw’omwana bakuure.”

english: And he arose , and took the young child and his mother , and came into the land of Israel .
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.

english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod , he was afraid to go thither : notwithstanding , being warned of God in a dream , he turned aside into the parts of Galilee :
ekegusii: Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oborwoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akairoka kogenda aroro, korende erio gakuureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.

english: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth : that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets , He shall be called a Nazarene .
ekegusii: Akagenda, akamenya omochie oyomo okorokwa Nazareti, rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nababani, “Igo ararokwe Omonazareti.”

english: When Herod the king had heard these things , he was troubled , and all Jerusalem with him .
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Herode achia koigwa aya ere agaichana mono, nabo igo kera omonto ime ya Yerusalemu.

english: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together , he demanded of them where Christ should be born .
ekegusii: Ere akabarangeria amo abakuani abanene bonsi amo n’aborokia b’amachiiko akababoria, “Narai gose Kristo araiborerwe?”

english: And they said unto him , In Bethlehem of Judaea : for thus it is written by the prophet ,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria. Ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ekiagera aya naro omobani ariigete:

english: Then Herod , when he had privily called the wise men , enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared .
ekegusii: Erio Herode akarangeria abageni baria barwete moocha agatwara okoumerana kwa bobisi nabarabwo, erio akamanya korwa ase bare kegima chingaki eng’enang’eni eria yarorekanete.

english: And he sent them to Bethlehem , and said , Go and search diligently for the young child ; and when ye have found him , bring me word again , that I may come and worship him also .
ekegusii: Akabatoma goika Bethlehemu, n’amang’ana akobwatia: “Genda morigie buya omwana oyio, ekero moramonyore ere, nainche momanyie, erio nainche boigo ingende komosasiima ere.”

english: When they had heard the king , they departed ; and , lo , the star , which they saw in the east , went before them , till it came and stood over where the young child was .
ekegusii: -10 Ase igo barabwo bakarwa aroro, kobare nchera kogenda bakarora naende eng’enang’eni eria eria baroche ase ensemo ya moocha. Ekero barabwo bayeroche omogoko obo okabucha, inaki omogoko obo obete omonge! Ekabatang’ana, goika egatenena igoro aase omwana oria arenge.

english: In those days came John the Baptist , preaching in the wilderness of Judaea ,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro ya Boyahudi agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba,

english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :
ekegusii: “Inche n’amaache nkobabatisera ase okoonchoka, korende ere, oyoraache magega y’ane, nare ne chinguru kombua. Ting’isaini koimokia ebikoroto biaye. N’ere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.

english: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will throughly purge his floor , and gather his wheat into the garner ; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire .
ekegusii: Oroteru rw’aye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kia’ye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiruro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.” Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mar 1:9-11; Luk 3:21-22)

english: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .
ekegusii: Ekero ekio Yeso akarua Galili, akagenda ase Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani abatiswe nere.

english: But John forbad him , saying , I have need to be baptized of thee , and comest thou to me ?
ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateeba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha ase ’nde?”

english: And Jesus answering said unto him , Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness . Then he suffered him .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ancha ebe iga bono, ekiagera naboigo etogwenerete goikerania oboronge bwonsi.” Erio agwo Yohana akamwanchera.

english: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :
ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero abatisirwe, agendererete gotiira korwa ase amaache ime; igoro ekamaanoka, na ere akarora Omoika o Nyasae ogoika buna riruma, ogocha igoro ase are.

english: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi yonsi, ne chinsemo chionsi chia Yorodani bakamochiera.

english: And were baptized of him in Jordan , confessing their sins .
ekegusii: Bakangama ebibe biabo erio bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani.

english: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance :
ekegusii: Gaki, orokia ase ebikorwa buna ekeene mwaonchokire;

english: Then the devil leaveth him , and , behold , angels came and ministered unto him .
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagaacha, bakamokorera - 4:11 Zab 91:11-12 . Yeso ogochaaka emeremo yaye Galili (Mar 1:14-15; Luk 4:14-15)

english: The people which sat in darkness saw great light ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
ekegusii: abanto abamenyete omosunte ime, barorire omobaso omonene, na abamenyete ensemo y’ekiriri ki’amakweri, omobaso obabareire.” - 4:16 Isaya 8:22

english: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge gotaara ase engegu y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora abamura babere bamwabo abwo barenge abarubi, Simioni (oyokorokwa Petero), na Anderea omwabo, bakoruta ekeonga + 4:18 Ekeonga: nakio naende gekorokwa eneti ase enkwana y’ekegori kia bono enyancha ime, erio barube chinswe.

english: And he saith unto them , Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montuny’ane na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abaanto.”

english: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights , he was afterward an hungred .
ekegusii: Akeng’ata ase egeka ki’amatuko emerongo ene, obotuko n’omobaso. Magega ase aya, enchara ekamoria.

english: And they straightway left their nets , and followed him .
ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.

english: And going on from thence , he saw other two brethren , James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , in a ship with Zebedee their father , mending their nets ; and he called them .
ekegusii: Erio akagenda gochia motwe korwa aroro, akarora abamura babere bande bamwabo, Yakobo omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana omwabo, barenge obwato ime amo na Zebedi ise bakoroisia + 4:21 Koroisia: ase amariiko ande “gosona” gose “kobareera” ebionga biabo, na barabwo akabarangeria.

english: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .
ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga obwato boria, bagatiga na ise, bakamotunyana. Yeso Okoranderia omoganda bw’abaanto (Luk 6:17-19)

english: And his fame went throughout all Syria : and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments , and those which were possessed with devils , and those which were lunatick , and those that had the palsy ; and he healed them .
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, y’obosareru, na ababwatire n’ebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.

english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli + 4:25 Dekapoli: engencho yaye ’emechie ikomi’ ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki , na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani.

english: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .
ekegusii: Omoteemi agacha, akamoteebia, “Onye aye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia amagena aya abe omogati.”

english: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city , and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple ,
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu omochie omochenu, akamobeka igoro ase egechuuria egetambe mono gie Hekalu.

english: Again , the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain , and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world , and the glory of them ;
ekegusii: Naende Saitani akamoira ase ekegoro egetambe mono, akamworokia amarwoti onsi y’ense, na obonene bwabo,

english: And saith unto him , All these things will I give thee , if thou wilt fall down and worship me .
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ebi bionsi ninkoe, koratung’amere onsasiime.”

english: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora emeganda eria y’abanto, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro; na ekero aikaransire, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera. Ekero aikaransire, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera agachaaka koborokereria.|alt="He sat down and began to teach them" src="Gw-003.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 5:1-11" copy="Graham Wade" ref="5:1"

english: Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .
ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a nigo nachire gosaria amachiiko, gose amang’ana y’ababani; tincheti kobisaria, korende ase okobiikerania.

english: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: Ase igo monto onde bwensi orasarie richiiko erimo erire rike ase amachiiko aya, na kworokereria abanto kogosaria okwo, oyio narokwe omoke mono ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende oyorayakore na koyorokereria, oyio nere orarokwe omonene ase oborwoti bwa igoro.

english: And he opened his mouth , and taught them , saying ,
ekegusii: Agachaaka koborokereria, ogoteeba.

english: For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, onye oboronge bwaino tibokobua obw’aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, timogosoa nonya ng’ake ase oborwoti bwa igoro. Amorokererio igoro y’obororo (Luk 12:57-59)

english: But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie ng’a onde bwensi orageeche oyomwabo, nabe omonto okonacherwa ekiina, na oyoramogorere oyomwabo nabe omonto okoirwa ase ekegaambero, na oyoramoroke oyonde Omoriri! Nagwenere omorero o kare na kare.

english: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee ;
ekegusii: Nabo gokorenta okorua kwao ase egesasiimero, korainyore ng’a oyomino nare ne ring’ana ase ore,

english: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
ekegusii: otige okorwa kwao agwo ase egesasiimero, ogende ritang’ani mwanchane noyomino, erio oirane ase okorua kwao.

english: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .
ekegusii: Bwatana nomosoeri oo bwango, ekero more nere inchera gochia ase ekegaambero, erinde omosoeri oo tabaisa gokobeeka ase okoboko kw’omogaambi, na omogambi akobeke ase omorendi bw’echela, naye norutwe ime yechela.

english: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
ekegusii: Nekeene nagoteebirie: Tokorwa aroro nonya ng’ake goika oakane ebesa y’omoerio. Obotomani (Mat 18:8-9; Mar 9:43-48; Mat 19:9; Mar 10:11-12; Luk 16:18)

english: But I say unto you , That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart .
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, ng’a onde bwensi orarigererie omokungu na korengereria gotomana nere otomanire nere ime ase enkoro yaye.

english: Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abataka ase omoika, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro nobwabo.

english: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
ekegusii: Na totiana ase omotwe oo, ekiagera tokonyara gokora agatukia akamo kabe akarabu gose akamwamu.

english: But let your communication be , Yea , yea ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aino abe: Ee, gose: Yaaya; naki ayakomenteka ase aya, nigo akorwa ase oria omobe. Amorokererio igoro yokorusia egesiomba (Luk 6:29-30)

english: But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Timobaisa koamererania noyore omobe. Korende omonto karagoake orosea rwa borio, omoonchorere norw’okobee.

english: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloke also .
ekegusii: Na omonto karigetie gokoira ase ekegambero kogosoera na koira eyanga yao ya ime, omotigere neya isiko boigo.

english: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile , go with him twain .
ekegusii: Na onye omonto ogokobetereria kogenda nere emaeli eyemo, genda nere goika chimaeli ibere.

english: Give to him that asketh thee , and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away .
ekegusii: Oyokogosaba, moe; na oyorigetie singo, tomorina. Obwanchani ase Ababisa (Luk 6:27-28,32-36)

english: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .
ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: “Ancha omogisangio oo, na ogeche omobisa oo.”

english: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you ;
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Ancha ababisa baino, mobasabere abakobachanda,

english: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .
ekegusii: nario moranyare koba abana ba Iso oino ore igoro, ekiagera ere nigo akobabareria omobaso oye ababe na abaya, obatweria embura abakori oboronge, na abatari gokora oboronge.

english: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?
ekegusii: Inaki komoranche abaabanchete inwe, ing’eria ki more nero? Inee! Nonya mbaria bakorusia ebango tibari gokora bo?

english: And if ye salute your brethren only , what do ye more than others ? do not even the publicans so ?
ekegusii: Na inwe komorakwanie abamino boka, mbuya ki mwakora kobua abande? Nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku tibari gokora boigo?

english: Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abakororera abande amaabera, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarorerwe amaabera.

english: Blessed are the peacemakers : for they shall be called the children of God .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagokora omorembe, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarokwe abana ba Nyasae.

english: Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done in earth , as it is in heaven .
ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao boche, Ogwancha kwao gokoreke ense, Buna kogokoreka igoro.

english: Give us this day our daily bread .
ekegusii: Otoe intwe reero endagera yaito ya kera rituko.

english: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .
ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, Buna intwe tokobaabera abagotokorera bobe.

english: And lead us not into temptation , but deliver us from evil : For thine is the kingdom , and the power , and the glory , for ever . Amen .
ekegusii: Totoira ase ogoteemwa, Korende ototoorie korwa ase oria omobe.

english: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .
ekegusii: Korende motaabereti abanto okomocha kwabo, na Iso oino takobaabera okomocha kwaino. Okweng’ata

english: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
ekegusii: “Ekero mokweng’ata timokonyiria amasio aino buna abang’ainereria, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakonyiria amasio abo, erinde banyare kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbeng’atete. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.

english: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face ;
ekegusii: Korende aye, gokweng’ata, eake amaguta omotwe oo, bwesibie obosio bwao,

english: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .
ekegusii: erio tobaisa kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbweng’atete, korende ororekane ase Iso oo ore bobisi, na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane. Obotenenku bw’ekeene (Luk 12:33-34)

english: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
ekegusii: Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang’ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi’emechie, erinde batogigwe n’abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a barabwo banyorire eng’eria yabo.

english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
ekegusii: korende mogache chinibo chiaino igoro, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bitagosoa, na abaibi batagotaagora na koiba.

english: The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .
ekegusii: “Etaya y’omobere n’eriiso. Nabo onye eriiso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe noborabu;

english: But if thine eye be evil , thy whole body shall be full of darkness . If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness , how great is that darkness !
ekegusii: korende onye eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe nomosunte. Onye oborabu boria bore ime yao bwabeire omosunte, omosunte oyio nomonene mono. Gokorera Abanene babere (Luk 16:13; 12:22-31)

english: No man can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .
ekegusii: “Onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.

english: Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink ; nor yet for your body , what ye shall put on . Is not the life more than meat , and the body than raiment ?
ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabateebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?

english: Behold the fowls of the air : for they sow not , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns ; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them . Are ye not much better than they ?
ekegusii: Morigererie chinyoni chia igoro! Chirochio tichiri gosimeka, tichiri kogesa, tichiri gosangereria gochia biage, na Iso oino ore igoro nigo agochirageria. Inee! Inwe timobueti rigori riabo?

english: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature ?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase more goetera ase ogwechanda kwaye oranyare komenta chingaki ase obogima bwaye?

english: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
ekegusii: Ne chianga, nase ki mogochiechandera? Morigererie ebisicha bi’orosana buna bigokiina; tibiri gokora emeremo, gose tibiri gwesisa;

english: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :
ekegusii: Korende aye, gokorua obokonyi gochia ase omotaka, kora ayio korende, nonya n’omosani oo oime tamanya ayio gwakora,

english: Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
ekegusii: Korende onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe, abamore nokwegena ogoke?

english: Therefore take no thought , saying , What shall we eat ? or , What shall we drink ? or , Wherewithal shall we be clothed ?
ekegusii: Gaki, timona gwechanda mogoteeba: Ninki torarie? Gose: Ninki toranywe? Gose: Ninki torabeeke?

english: ( For after all these things do the Gentiles seek :) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things .
ekegusii: Inaki abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakorigia ebio bionsi; korende Iso oino ore igoro namanyete ng’a ’moganetie ebinto ebio bionsi.

english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na oboronge bwaye, na ebinto ebio bionsi ’namobiegwe.

english: Take therefore no thought for the morrow : for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself . Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof .
ekegusii: “Gaki, timwechandera ay’ankio, ekiagera ankio inariechande rinyene. Kera rituko ndiisaine nogwechanda kwaye.

english: That thine alms may be in secret : and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly .
ekegusii: Obokonyi bwao bonyare koba bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane. Amegerio igoro y’ogosaba

english: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .
ekegusii: Korende aye ekero ogosaba, soa nyomba mwao ime, osieke egesieri, omosabe Iso oo ore bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.

english: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .
ekegusii: Ase ogosaba kwaino timokwana amang’ana amange abosa buna abanto b’Ebisaku; naki barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a Nyasae nabaigwe ase obonge bw’amang’ana abo.

english: Be not ye therefore like unto them : for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of , before ye ask him .
ekegusii: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba. Ogosaba kw’Omonene (Luk 11:2-4)

english: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .
ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mogwenerete gosaba iga: Tata oito ore igoro, Erieta riao risikwe.

english: Judge not , that ye be not judged .
ekegusii: “Timogaambia, nainwe timokogaambigwa.

english: Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?
ekegusii: Gose karamosabe enswe, namoe eng’iti?

english: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?
ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa amaya abwo bakomosaba? Ogochika okore okuya mono (Luk 6:31)

english: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :
ekegusii: “Soa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera egesieri gekogenda ase obosiru nekegare, na enchera ekogendao nengare, na abagosoa gochiao nabange.

english: Because strait is the gate , and narrow is the way , which leadeth unto life , and few there be that find it .
ekegusii: Korende egesieri gekogenda ase obogima nekegote, na enchera ekogendao nenyerere, na abakoyenyora nabake. Omote n’amatunda aye (Luk 6:43-44)

english: Beware of false prophets , which come to you in sheep’s clothing , but inwardly they are ravening wolves .
ekegusii: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha ase more beboyetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chintindi mono.

english: Ye shall know them by their fruits . Do men gather grapes of thorns , or figs of thistles ?
ekegusii: Ase amaamo abo ’namobamanye. Inee! Abanto nigo bagotwa amasabibu korwa ase emetobo, gose amako korwa ase amageri?

english: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
ekegusii: Naboigo kera omote omuya nigo okwama amatunda amaya, na omote omobe nigo okwama amatunda amabe.

english: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
ekegusii: Omote omuya tokonyara kwama amatunda amabe, na omote omobe tokonyara kwama amatunda amaya.

english: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
ekegusii: “Tari kera omonto ogonteebia: Omonene Nyasae, orasoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende n’oyogokora ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro.

english: Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nabange baranteebie: Omonene Nyasae, titware kobana ase erieta riao, na ase erieta riao goseria ebirecha, na ase erieta riao togakora ebikone ebinge bie chinguru? - 7:22 Isaya 2:11,17; Ezek 14:6

english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :
ekegusii: “Kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, na koyakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto orenge omong’aini, oagachete mwaye igoro ase egetare;

english: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house ; and it fell not : for it was founded upon a rock .
ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, egatwoma enyomba eria, korende tiyagwa, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare. Onomwaga, na eooro egacha, egatwoma enyomba eria, korende tiyagwa, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.|alt="Storms and floods would'nt fell it because it was build on a rock" src="Gw-008.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 7:24-27" copy="Graham Wade" ref="7:25"

english: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
ekegusii: Na kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, ko tayakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto omoriri, oagachete mwaye ase amaroba;

english: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house ; and it fell : and great was the fall of it .
ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, bigatwoma enyomba eria, ekagwa; okogwa kwaye gokaba okonene.” Okobua kwa Yeso

english: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire amang’ana aya, emeganda egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye,

english: For he taught them as one having authority , and not as the scribes .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, na tari buna aborokia babo b’amariiko.

english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriiso ri’oyomino, na omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao ime toyorochi?

english: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?
ekegusii: Gose ’naki orateebie oyomino: ’Ntige ’nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriiso riao, na rora omoriibo nore ase eriiso riao?

english: Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye .
ekegusii: Aye omonga’inereria, rusia ritang’ani omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriiso ri’oyomino.

english: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
ekegusii: “Timoa chisese ekere egechenu, gose timoitera chiruru chiaino ase chimbeche, tichicha gochitacha namagoro abo, naende chibaonchokere inwe, chibarie. Saba, Rigia, Tura (Luk 11:9-13)

english: Ask , and it shall be given you ; seek , and ye shall find ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :
ekegusii: “Saba, ’namoegwe; rigia, ’namonyore; tura, ’namoigorerwe egesieri.

english: Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?
ekegusii: Gose monto onde n’are ase more, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena?

english: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, emeganda emenge ekamotunyana.

english: When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed , Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no, not in Israel .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso amoigwa agakumia, agateebia abamotunyanete, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.

english: And Jesus said unto the centurion , Go thy way ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee . And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, “Genda bwoo, nabe ase ore koreng’ana nokwegena kwao.” Omosomba oria akagwenigwa ase ekero keria. Yeso okogwenia Abanto abange (Mar 1:29-34; Luk 4:38-41)

english: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house , he saw his wife’s mother laid , and sick of a fever .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso asoete nyomba mwa Petero, akarora ng’ina biara Petero oraire, orwarete esosera.

english: And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .
ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.

english: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, bakamoirera abanto abange ababwatire nebirecha, na ere akarusia ebirecha ase ring’ana, na bonsi abarenge abarwaire akabagwenia;

english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him , he gave commandment to depart unto the other side .
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia korora emeganda emenge yamoetananire, agachiika ng’a baimoke korwa aroro bagende ng’umbu.

english: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
ekegusii: Omworokia oyomo bw’amariiko akamochiera, akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”

english: And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
ekegusii: Rora, omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma akamochiera, akamotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Omonene, oise gwancha nabo ogonsibia.”

english: And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
ekegusii: Na oyonde ase aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”

english: But Jesus said unto him , Follow me ; and let the dead bury their dead .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntunyana, tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo.” Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mar 4:35-41; Luk 8:22-25)

english: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato, aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

english: And , behold , there arose a great tempest in the sea , insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves : but he was asleep .
ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya oraarire.

english: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omonene, totoorie, ngosira tore!”

english: And he saith unto them , Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ? Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea ; and there was a great calm .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inaki mokwoboa, inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?” Erio akaimoka, agatogonyera omwaga na enyancha; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

english: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?” Yeso okogwenia Abageraseni abwo Ebirecha biabwatete (Mar 5:1-20; Luk 8:26-39)

english: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes , there met him two possessed with devils , coming out of the tombs , exceeding fierce , so that no man might pass by that way .
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ng’umbu y’ense y’Abageraseni, abanto babere ababwatire nebirecha bakaumerana nere, na barabwo nigo baare korwa ase chimbeera, nigo barenge abatindi mono, goika monto onde tarenge konyara goeta enchera eria.

english: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?
ekegusii: Na rora, barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Inki obwate naintwe, Omwana o Nyasae? Inee! Ngwachire aiga gotoita ekero engaki etaraika?”

english: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying , I will ; be thou clean . And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bogasibigwa.

english: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .
ekegusii: Ang’e nagwo ndiarengeo riicho rie chimbeche chinyinge, riare korisia.

english: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .
ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bikamosorora, bikabora, “Onye kogotorusia aa, rirorio toe ribaga tosoe ase riicho rie chimbeche.”

english: And he said unto them , Go . And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
ekegusii: Yeso akabiteebia, “Genda!” Bigasooka, bigasoa ase chimbeche. Na rora, riicho rionsi rigatirimboka, rigasoa enyancha ime, rigasirera aroro. Bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche.|alt="The spirits got out and entered into the pigs" src="Gw-016.tif" size="col" loc="Matthew 8:28-33" copy="Graham Wade" ref="8:32"

english: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .
ekegusii: Na abarisia b’echimbeche chiria bagatama, bakagenda omochie bakararia amang’ana onsi ayakoregete ase baria babwatire nebirecha.

english: And , behold , the whole city came out to meet Jesus : and when they saw him , they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts .
ekegusii: Na rora, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria bakagenda koumerana na Yeso; bagachia komoorora, bakamosorora arue orogongo rwabo.

english: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gosoa Kapernaumu, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamochiera, akamosorora,

english: And saying , Lord , my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy , grievously tormented .
ekegusii: agateeba, “Omonene, omosomba one nyomba araire, oborwaire bomogataetie, akoromwa mono.”

english: And Jesus saith unto him , I will come and heal him .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ninchiche komogwenia.”

english: The centurion answered and said , Lord , I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof : but speak the word only , and my servant shall be healed .
ekegusii: Oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.

english: For I am a man under authority , having soldiers under me : and I say to this man , Go , and he goeth ; and to another , Come , and he cometh ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
ekegusii: Inaki inche nomonto inde inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse ase ’nde. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda; na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”

english: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .
ekegusii: Agasoa obwato, akaamboka, agaika omochie oye + 9:1 Omochie oye: Omochie oyio noro Kapernaumu ase Yeso amenyete magega y’ogokwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi. Rora Mat. 4:13 .

english: And when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto his disciples , Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners ?
ekegusii: Ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakabooria aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki Omworokia oino akoria amo nabarusia ebango n’a banyabibe?”

english: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them , They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .
ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.

english: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?
ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamochiera, bakamoboria, Nase ki intwe na Abafarisai tokweng’ata ekero ase ekero, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata

english: And Jesus said unto them , Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare korera ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi; erio nario barache kweng’ata.

english: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .
ekegusii: Onde tari okobeka ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eyanga engotu, ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eyanga eria, na ase yatandogete ake nigo ekona‐gochiererera.

english: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa + 9:17 Amasankwa: naro akorokwa ase erieta rinde “amao” . Eise kobekwa bo, ebirandi biria nigo biratandoke, na edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bisareke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia, bionsi bibere biasirana.” Omoiseke o Yairo na omokungu ore noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga bakogwenigwa (Mar 5:21-43; Luk 8:40-56)

english: While he spake these things unto them , behold , there came a certain ruler , and worshipped him , saying , My daughter is even now dead : but come and lay thy hand upon her , and she shall live .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gokwana aya, omonene oyomo agacha, akabeeka amaru inse asare, okobora, “Omwana one omoiseke okuure bono iga, korende inchwo aye, omobekere okoboko, na ere nabe moyo.”

english: And Jesus arose, and followed him , and so did his disciples .
ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka agatunyana omonto oria, ere na aborokigwa baye.

english: And , behold , they brought to him a man sick of the palsy , lying on a bed : and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy ; Son , be of good cheer ; thy sins be forgiven thee .
ekegusii: Na rigereria, bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata, oraire borere; na, ekero Yeso achia korora okwegena kwabo, agateebia oria rigata, “Remia enkoro, omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

english: And , behold , a woman , which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years , came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment :
ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, akamochiera korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eyanga yaye.

english: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
ekegusii: Igo arengereretie ase omoyo oye ime, “Inse gokuna eyanga yaye, ningwene.”

english: But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said , Daughter , be of good comfort ; thy faith hath made thee whole . And the woman was made whole from that hour .
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akamorora, akamoteebia, “Moiseke one, remia enkoro; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Omokungu oria akagwena erio kegima.

english: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house , and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise ,
ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa enyomba y’omonto oria omonene, akarora ababugia ebiroria, na abanto basangererekaneteo bakorera.

english: He said unto them , Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth . And they laughed him to scorn .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Karuo aa! Omoiseke oyo takweti, okorara araire gwoka.” Bakamosekerera.

english: But when the people were put forth , he went in, and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .
ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka - 9:25 1 Abar 17:17-24; 2 Abar 4; Luk 7:11-16; Yoh 11; Ogok 9:36-43 .

english: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya agasarera ase ense eria yonsi. Yeso okogwenia abanto babere emeuko

english: And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge goeta korwa aase aria, abanto babere barenge emeuko bakamotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Tororere amaabera, aye omwana o Daudi!”

english: And when he was come into the house , the blind men came to him : and Jesus saith unto them , Believe ye that I am able to do this ? They said unto him , Yea , Lord .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa nyomba, emeuko eria ekamochiera. Yeso akababoria, “Inee! Mwegenire ng’a inche ninyare gokora ring’ana eri?” Bakamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene.”

english: Then touched he their eyes , saying , According to your faith be it unto you .
ekegusii: Erio agwo agakuna amaiso abo, akabateebia, “Abe ase more koreng’ana nokwegena kwaino.”

english: And , behold , certain of the scribes said within themselves , This man blasphemeth .
ekegusii: Na rora, abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakaboora ase emioyo yabo, “Omonto oyo ’nkorama are Nyasae.”

english: And their eyes were opened ; and Jesus straitly charged them , saying , See that no man know it .
ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabatianera bokong’u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang’ana aya.”

english: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagasoka isiko, bagasareria amang’ana aye ase ense eria yonsi. Yeso okogwenia omonto orenge rimama, naende obwatire nekerecha

english: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoka isiko, rora, abanto bakamorentera omonto orenge rimama, naende nigo ere abwatire nekerecha.

english: And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .
ekegusii: Ekero ekerecha giachia goserigwa, omonto oria rimama agakwana. Emeganda egakumia, ekabora, “Amang’ana anga buna aya tana kororekana nonya ng’ake ase Abaisraeli.”

english: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he will send forth labourers into his harvest .
ekegusii: gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.”

english: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said , Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts ?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akababoria, “Nase ki inwe mokorengereria ebirengererio ebibe ase chinkoro chiaino?

english: For whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee ; or to say , Arise , and walk ?
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire riango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka ogende?

english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins , ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy ,) Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Imoka, bwetweke egeseero + 9:6 Egeseero: nakio kiarenge ekerarero kiomonto arenge kobogoria boigo gotaara nakio ase orogendo ki’ao, ogende bwoo.”

english: And he arose , and departed to his house .
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda bwoye.

english: But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled , and glorified God , which had given such power unto men .
ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora aya, bakooboa, bakamotogia Nyasae, oy’oete Mwanyabaanto okobua konga buna oko. Okorangerigwa kwa Matayo (Mar 2:13-17; Luk 5:27-32)

english: And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him , Follow me . And he arose, and followed him .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goeta korwa aroro akarora omonto oyomo okorokwa Matayo, oikaransete aase enyomba ekoruserigwa ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.

english: Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .
ekegusii: Tiga goteebia ababisa baito ime ya Gati igoro y’okobugwa gwaito; timobaisa gotiga barore mokorera. Abanto ba Beti‐Le‐Afura orokia okorusia moyo kwaiko ase okwegaragaria igoro ase ebuse!

english: Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel ; he shall receive of you his standing .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Safiri genda ase obooswa, getirianda more n’obosoku. Baria momenyete Saanani timweba mosoke korwa ase omochie obo omonene. Ekero moraigwe abanto ba Beti‐Hasaeli bakorera, agwo momanye ng’a botamero tibori aroro agwo.

english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Maroti ganyerera obokonyi n’obwoba ase engencho Omonene oretire amaakwa ange na Yerusalemu.

english: O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
ekegusii: Inwe baria momenyete ime ya Lakisi agia chibarasi chiaino chi’esegi ebisibero. Inwe nigo mweegetie ebibe bi’Abaisraeli mokagera Yerusalemu egakora ebibe.

english: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath : the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel .
ekegusii: Na bono, abanto ba Yuda batebie batigare buya omochie o Mosereti‐Gati. Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli tibakonyora gokonywa konde korwa ase omochie o Akisibuse.

english: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Maresa Omonene nabaererie omobisa, oyio orachie koira omochie oino. Abarai b’Abaisraeli mbagende bebise ime ase rikuruma rire Adulamu.

english: Make thee bald , and poll thee for thy delicate children ; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle ; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey’echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

english: Hear , all ye people ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple .
ekegusii: Igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tegerera moigwe Inwe mwensi abwo momenyete ase ense, Omonene nabe kirori mamincha yaino. Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya! Nigo agokwana korwa ase Hekalu yaye ya igoro.

english: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .
ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye achenu; ere ngoika are gocha aa, atare ebitunwa bi’ense.

english: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebio mbinyititoke inse yaye, binyititoke buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero, na bibe buna amaache akoba ekero aumoirwe ase egetirimboko.

english: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho abanto ba Israeli bakorete ebibe bakaba mamincha ya Nyasae. Inee! Niing’o orabogorie ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Israeli? ’Samaria omochie omonene omonyene! Na ase ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasiima emegwekano ase Abayuda? ’Yerusalemu enyene!

english: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field , and as plantings of a vineyard : and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley , and I will discover the foundations thereof.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otebire “nintagore Samaria obe obonge bw’amagena, obe omogondo ase emesabibu erasimekwe. Ninturunkanie amagena ’omochie oyio gochia ase rigoko, nintubore amaroso aye atigwe maiso marore.

english: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces , and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire , and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate : for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot , and they shall return to the hire of an harlot .
ekegusii: Emegwekano yaye yonsi yerigori rinene egosasimwa nesamunyoranwe ebe ebisamunye, kera egento keria gekoegwa abatayayi be Hekalu ng’esarigwen’omorero, na emegwekano yaye yonsi nebe amatombe atigire. Samaria nigo yanyorete ebinto ebio bionsi ase emeyega y’okomenta oroiboro, bono ababisa baye mbababogorie korwa aroro gochia ase abatayayi b’echikalu b’echinsemo chinde.”

english: Therefore I will wail and howl , I will go stripped and naked : I will make a wailing like the dragons , and mourning as the owls .
ekegusii: Erio Mika agateeba, “ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo ndarere na kweumia. Ase o koorokia amagombo ane nigo ndatare ’ntabegeti bikoroto naende ’inde getirianda. Nigo ndaorie buna ekebwe naende ’mbuge buna esagero.

english: For her wound is incurable ; for it is come unto Judah ; he is come unto the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Amaote a Samaria takonyara kobwenigwa nabo igo Yuda yabereiri ange gochandeka enchera eyio eyio; ogotagorwa gwaikire ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu enyene agwo ase abanto bane bamenyete.” Ababisa bagocha Yerusalemu

english: Woe to them that devise iniquity , and work evil upon their beds ! when the morning is light , they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand .
ekegusii: Naki erabe akong’u ase baria bakogeesa ase okoroberia amabe! Ekero bogokiamoka buna bakonyora ribaga rike baikerania obebe boria baroberetie.

english: Arise ye, and depart ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .
ekegusii: Imoka mogende; borendi tiboiyo aiga naende. Ebibe biano biaragereirie aase aa gochia ase obosareku.

english: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie , saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink ; he shall even be the prophet of this people .
ekegusii: “Abanto aba nigo batagete omobani ogoetanana n’oborimo amo n’obong’ainereria boigo ogoteeba, ’nababaneire buna Edivai n’amarwa naumoke ase more.

english: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .
ekegusii: “Korende nimbasangererie mbabeke amo inwe abanto bonsi ba Israeli abwo batigarete. Nimbarete amo buna ching’ondi chikoirana gocha ase riicho. Buna oboriisia boichire ching’ondi, ense yaino neichorwe naende n’abanto abange.”

english: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up , and have passed through the gate , and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
ekegusii: Omonene naigore chinchera ase bare naende abarae korwa ase obooswa. Mbasoke korwa ase ebiita bi’omochie omonene bagende bare n’obosibore. Omorwoti obo, Omonene obo bweka nere orabarae gochia isiko.

english: And they covet fields , and take them by violence ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo batagete emegondo baurereria; ekero batagete chinyomba bachiira rioka. Eamate teiyo gose enibo bire n’oborendi.

english: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil , from which ye shall not remove your necks ; neither shall ye go haughtily : for this time is evil .
ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene nigo agoteeba, nigo ndoberetie koreta amaakwa ase more, nainwe timokonyaara koyatamboka. Ngochia more kwenyora ase obokong’u, naende timogochia konyara gotara n’obwerori naende.

english: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields .
ekegusii: Ekero chingaki chirache, abanto mbabogorie omogano oino koba ekiorokererio k’iobobe, na nigo baratere ogoteera gw’okwerusia moyo igoro ase ayio mwaeteire: “Twatagokire kegima! Omonene otourire ense yaito naende oyeire abanto baria batoosete.”

english: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD .
ekegusii: Na bono ekero engaki eraike ense ekoiranigwa gochia ase abanto b’Omonene, onde oino taiyo oranyore egatari aroro.

english: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakondanderia bateeba, Tobaisa gotorandia. Tobaisa korandia ayio onsi Omonene tari gochia gotoa obosoku.

english: O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the LORD straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?
ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria buna Abaisraeli nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa? Nigo Omoika bw’Omonene asirie okoremereria kwaye? Ekeene ere nakore ebinto ebio? Tari gokwana ase obwororo ase baria bagokora ay’ekeene?

english: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .
ekegusii: Omonene airaneria, “Nigo mokoboera abanto bane buna ababisa. Abasacha nigo bakoirana korwa ase esegi, bakagerete ng’a mbare n’oborendi ase enka, korende nao more agwo moganyererete kobaboria chigoti chiabo korwa mareko.

english: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses ; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever .
ekegusii: Mwaseria abakungu b’abanto bane korwa ase chinka chiabo banchete, naende mwaunereirie abana babo ogosesenigwa kwane.

english: And I said , Hear , I pray you, O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
ekegusii: Tegerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli! Eganga yaino nigo egwenerete koba okorigereria oboronge,

english: They build up Zion with blood , and Jerusalem with iniquity .
ekegusii: Nigo mogendererete koagacha Yerusalemu omochie omonene o Nyasae, ase oboroso bw’ogoita n’borimo.

english: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the LORD , and say , Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
ekegusii: Abarai b’omochie omonene nigo bakogamba goetera ase amaaki, abakuani b’abana richiiko ase ogoakanwa, ababani barwa amaroro abo ase chitaabu boigo abwo bonsi bataamera buna Omonene nigo are amo na barabwo. Nigo bagoteeba, “bobe bonde tiboiyo boratochere.” Nainde bateeba “Omonene nigo are amo naitwe.”

english: Who hate the good , and love the evil ; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones ;
ekegusii: Korende nwe nigo mwangete aria are amaya naende nigo mwanhete ayare amabe. Nigo bogosabora abanto risankwa bare moyo naende mwarusia chinyama korwa amauga abo.

english: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoria abanto baane. Mwabachobora risankwa, mwabuna amauga abo, mwababutorana buna chinyama chikobekwa enyongo.

english: Then shall they cry unto the LORD , but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time , as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings .
ekegusii: Engaki neike ekero morarere gochia ase Omonene korende takobairaneria inwe. Ere tagotegerera amasabo aino, ekiagera mwakorire amabe.

english: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him.
ekegusii: Abanto bane nigo bakong’ainwa n’ababani abwo bakobariera chiira chi’omorembe baria bakobaakana, korende bagosereria baria batari kobaakana egesi. Ase ababani abwo Omonene nigo agoteeba,

english: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision ; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them.
ekegusii: “Inwe ababani, amatuko aino igo are ange koera; risase riabarimereire gochia inse. Ase engencho inwe mogosiria abanto bane, inwe timokonyora naende amaroro y’obobani, naende timokonyara kobana kende gionsi.”

english: Then shall the seers be ashamed , and the diviners confounded : yea, they shall all cover their lips ; for there is no answer of God .
ekegusii: Baria bakobana aria agochia gocha mbasokigwe ase ogotaikerana kw’ayio. Abwo bonsi mbasookigwe ekiagera Nyasae takobairaneria barabwo kende.

english: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .
ekegusii: Korende ase inde inche, Omonene nigo akongichoria n’Omoika oye n’echinguru, naende ong’a inche eki’orokererio ki’oboronge nabo igo oboremu bw’ogotebia abanto ba Israeli keria kere ebibe biabo.

english: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob , and princes of the house of Israel , that abhor judgment , and pervert all equity .
ekegusii: Integerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli, inwe baria mwangete oboronge naende mogonchorana ekeene koba egetari boronge.

english: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills ; and people shall flow unto it.
ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.

english: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon ; there shalt thou be delivered ; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babiloni, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.

english: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .
ekegusii: Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo baabarwanie esegi, bagoteeba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”

english: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .
ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omooroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.

english: Arise and thresh , O daughter of Zion : for I will make thine horn iron , and I will make thy hoofs brass : and thou shalt beat in pieces many people : and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth .
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, imoka moore, ekiagera ninkore ching’unchara chiaino chibe echi’ebioma, na ebitaago biaino bibe ebi’etai, erinde moake abanto abange, mobasamunyore.” Ebinto biabo morasakore mobiatanane bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, ne chinibo chiabo chibe echi’Omonene bw’ense engima.

english: And many nations shall come , and say , Come , and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD , and to the house of the God of Jacob ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for the law shall go forth of Zion , and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabe bakogendao bagoteeba: “Inchuo totiire gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tochibwatie.” Amachiiko narue Sayoni, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiiche korwa Yerusalemu.

english: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Kera egesaku nigo kerabwatie erieta ri’enyasae yaye, korende intwe nigo torabwatie erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae oito goika kare na kare. Abaisraeli mbairane korwa ase obosomba

english: In that day , saith the LORD , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted ;
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsangererie ebirema, naende ninsangererie abwo naseretie, na bonsi abwo naete amaakwa.

english: And I will make her that halted a remnant , and her that was cast far off a strong nation : and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever .
ekegusii: Nintige abare ebirema babe abatigari, na abwo baseretigwe babe egesaku kere ne chinguru. Omonene nabagambere agwo ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

english: And thou, O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: “Naye Omorobiri bw’oborendi, aye ekegoro ki’omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.”

english: Now why dost thou cry out aloud ? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished ? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail .
ekegusii: Bono, ninki okorera neriogi rinene? Inee! Omorwoti tari ime yao? Abasemia bao mbasirigwe goika kwabeire nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore?

english: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
ekegusii: Aye Omochie bw’emeganda, sangereria emeganda yao y’esegi. Ababisa banaaririe omochie oito bayorwanie esegi. Barabwo mbaake omogambi bw’Abaisraeli orosea rwaye nenyimbo. Eira ya Nyasae igoro y’Omogambi orarwe Bethlehemu

english: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the LORD , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots :
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue ase more kegima.

english: And I will cut off the cities of thy land , and throw down all thy strong holds :
ekegusii: Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.

english: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :
ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana ase more nonya ng’ake.

english: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
ekegusii: Ninsirie emegwekano yaino yonsi amo, ne chisiiro chiaino, ebinto ebio mogosasiima, na inwe timokogenderera gosasiima emeremo y’amaboko aino.

english: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities .
ekegusii: Ninsimore emete y’Asera eyio mogosasiima, ninyerusie korwa ase more, ninkore emechie yaino ebe bosa.

english: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .
ekegusii: Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”

english: Therefore will he give them up , until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth : then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.
