english: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD , in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero oyio oraiborwe arache, narisie riicho riaye ore ne chinguru chi’Omonene, ee, narisie nobonene bw’erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye. Riicho riaye ndibe rirendire buya, ekiagera bono ere nabe omonene goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.

english: And this man shall be the peace , when the Assyrian shall come into our land : and when he shall tread in our palaces , then shall we raise against him seven shepherds , and eight principal men .
ekegusii: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ogotooreka na egesusuro Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.

english: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .
ekegusii: Erio abatigari ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, buna riime rigotonya korwa ase Omonene, na buna embura engiya egotwera obonyansi, embura eria tegoteebana koganya monto gete, gose Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi.

english: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who, if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .
ekegusii: Ee, abatigari abwo ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, babe buna endo ere ase egati ye ching’iti chire ase rinani, na buna endo ensae ere ase egati ye riicho rie ching’ondi, eyio ekero yasoire ase riicho nigo egotachera inse na gotandorana eyaitire, na onde tari oranyare koyetooria.

english: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries , and all thine enemies shall be cut off .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio amaboko aino naimokererigwe igoro y’abachandi baino, na inwe mosirie kegima ababisa baino bonsi.

english: Hear ye now what the LORD saith ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .
ekegusii: Bono inwe tegerera moigwe ay’Omonene agoteeba: Imoka, mwekwanere agwo bosio bw’ebitunwa, na motige ebigoro biigwe amariogi aino.

english: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?

english: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?
ekegusii: Ninyare gwanchera ebirengero bi’obourereria, gose amagena ’obong’ainereria ay’okorengera abeere ase chisaro ime?

english: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .
ekegusii: Abanto abanda bare ase egati yaino baichire nobourereria, na abwo bamenyete agwo nigo bagokwana oborimo, ne chimeme chiabo nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.

english: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.

english: Thou shalt eat , but not be satisfied ; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold , but shalt not deliver ; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword .
ekegusii: Ekero morabe mokoragera, timokoigota; nigo moragenderere koba nenchara. Mosangererie na kwegachera ebinto, korende ebio mwegacheire nimbirue bisirigwe nemioro.

english: Thou shalt sow , but thou shalt not reap ; thou shalt tread the olives , but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil ; and sweet wine , but shalt not drink wine .
ekegusii: Imosimeke chindagera, korende timogochigesa. Imomite amazeituni, korende timokweaka amaguta korwao; imomite amasabibu, korende timokonywa edivai ekorwao.

english: Hear ye, O mountains , the LORD’s controversy , and ye strong foundations of the earth : for the LORD hath a controversy with his people , and he will plead with Israel .
ekegusii: “Inwe ebitunwa, nainwe ebitare, ninwe more oboroso bw’ense, tegerera moigwe ogosoera kw’Omonene! Ere nabwate amang’ana nabaanto baye, nare nekina n’Abaisraeli.

english: O my people , what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, ngento ki nabakoreire? Nase amang’ana ki nabarosirie? Ng’iranerie!

english: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?
ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?

english: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”

english: He hath shewed thee, O man , what is good ; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?
ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, Omonene okworokirie ayare amaya. Ninki Omonene aganetie korwa asore otatiga okore ayare ay’oboronge, na bwanche gokora ayare ay’obwanchani, naende otaare ase oboitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo.

english: The LORD’s voice crieth unto the city , and the man of wisdom shall see thy name : hear ye the rod , and who hath appointed it.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorangeria abare ase omochie, na omonto oirogete erieta riaye nere omong’aini. Eriogi riaye nigo rigoteeba: “Igwa igoro y’egesusuro na ning’o ogechikiire.

english: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nabeire nkororekana buna ekero amatunda ’omorakera agosangererigwa, na ayatigaire ase emesabibu achorirwe. Ebisago bi’amasabibu bikoriegwa tibiyo, na amako amatang’ani, aya nganetie, taiyo.

english: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it , and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God ? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets .
ekegusii: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.

english: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .
ekegusii: Rituko ndiche ekero chindwaki chiao chiraagachwe. Ase rituko erio chimbebe chiao nchigareeigwe.

english: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbagochere korwa Asuri na korwa ase emechie ya Misiri, ee, korwa Misiri goika orooche rwa Eufarati, na korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika ase eyende, na korwa ase egetunwa ekemo goika ase ekende.

english: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings .
ekegusii: Korende ense netigwe ebe bosa ase engencho y’abanto bamenyeteo; okwo korabe okwama kw’ogokora kwabo okobe. Omonene okororera Abaisraeli amaabera

english: Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .
ekegusii: Risia abanto bao nenyimbo yao abanto abwo bare riicho ri’omwando oo, rimenyete ao rioka ase rinani ime agwo Karimeli. Oritige rikorisia agwo Basani na Gileadi, buna yarenge ase amatuko a kare.

english: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .
ekegusii: “Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”

english: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’ebisaku bararore ayio mbasooke, ekiagera chinguru chiabo chiabuirwe. Mbatube emenwa yabo namaboko abo, na amato abo natine.

english: They shall lick the dust like a serpent , they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth : they shall be afraid of the LORD our God , and shall fear because of thee.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbamene orotu rwe riroba buna ching’iti ching’enda inse. Mbarue ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u bakoiguswa bekurure inse buna amakonde; mbakoonchokere aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, bare nobwoba obonene, ee, mbakoiroke aye.

english: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity , and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage ? he retaineth not his anger for ever , because he delighteth in mercy .
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae onde nare onga buna aye? Aye nigo okwabera abatigari abare omwando oo ebibe biabo, na kweba obobe bwabo. Aye tori kogenderera koba nendamwamu yao goika kare na kare, ekiagera bwanchete koorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera.

english: He will turn again , he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities ; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea .
ekegusii: Aye notoiranere, otororere amaabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.

english: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .
ekegusii: Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.

english: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .
ekegusii: Aye noorokerie ororeria rwa Yakobo obwegenwa bwao, na orwa Aburaamu obwanchani bwao botari koera, buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira korwa ase amatuko a kare, ogatiana.

english: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare nomokia gokora ayare amabe namaboko abo. Omogambi nigo anchete aegwe riaaki, na omogambi ebiina boigo; omonto ore nokobua nigo agosaba aegwe ebi aganetie ase okogania kwaye okobe, na nigo babwateranete amo.

english: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh ; now shall be their perplexity .
ekegusii: Oyore omuya goetania abande ase egati yabo nigo anga buna egetutu kere namagwa, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are nobobe kobua orobago rogiteire amagwa. Ekero rituko ri’abarendi bao, riria ri’egesusuro kiao riraike, abanto mbabe nomoichano.

english: Trust ye not in a friend , put ye not confidence in a guide : keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.

english: Therefore I will look unto the LORD ; I will wait for the God of my salvation : my God will hear me.
ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nindigererie Omonene; ninganye inde nogosemeria ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane; Nyasae one nanyigwe. Omonene okorenta ogotooreka

english: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy : when I fall , I shall arise ; when I sit in darkness , the LORD shall be a light unto me.
ekegusii: Aye omobisa one, togokera okogwa kwane; ekero ndagwe, nintenene naende; ekero ndabe inde ase omosunte, Omonene nabe etaya yane.

english: I will bear the indignation of the LORD , because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .
ekegusii: Ekiagera nakorire ebibe ase Omonene, nindemererie endamwamu yaye, goika ere agambe amang’ana aane na ang’e oboronge bwane. Ere nandete ase omobaso, na inche ningokere oboronge bwaye.

english: And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judæa by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .
ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa agwo, agaika chimbebe chia Boyahudi, ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Abanto abange bakamosangererekanera naende; akaborokereria aroro, buna anarete botambe.

english: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
ekegusii: Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakabooria Yeso engencho ye ring’ana erio.

english: And if a woman shall put away her husband , and be married to another , she committeth adultery .
ekegusii: na omokungu karatige omosacha oye, na konyuomwa nomonto onde, nere otomanire.” Yeso ogosesenia abana abake (Mat 19:13-15; Luk 18:15-17)

english: And they brought young children to him , that he should touch them : and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .
ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.

english: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them , Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agachia korora, akabea mono, akabateebia, “Batige abana abake bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwabo

english: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeeka amaboko aye igoro ase bare. Yeso ogosesenia abana abake |alt="Jesus blesses little children" src="Gw-054.tif" size="col" loc="Mark 10:13-16" copy="Graham Wade" ref="10:13" Omomura omonda (Mat 19:16-22; Luk 18:18-23)

english: And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achaaka orogendo rwaye kogenda enchera, omonto oyomo agacha bwango, akamotung’amera, akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, inki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inaki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.

english: And the Pharisees came to him , and asked him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife ? tempting him .
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamobooria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto gotiga mok’aye?” Bakamoteema.

english: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”

english: Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him , One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .
ekegusii: Yeso akamobeta amaiso, akamwancha, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; genda, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”

english: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .
ekegusii: Korende ere akanyiria obosio ase ring’ana riria, akagenda n’obororo, ekiagera arenge n’eniibo enyinge. Obobe bw’obotenenku (Mat 19:23-30; Luk 18:24-30)

english: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples , How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
ekegusii: Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them , Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagaichana ase amang’ana aya. Yeso akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Abana, nabe aakong’u ase abasemeretie enibo gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!

english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”

english: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaichana mono, bakaboorania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

english: And Jesus looking upon them saith , With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .
ekegusii: Yeso akabarigereria, akabora, “Ase Mwanyabaanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae taibo, ekiagera onsi nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”

english: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .
ekegusii: Petero agachaaka komoteebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”

english: And Jesus answered and said , Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel’s ,
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde otigire enyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ng’ina, gose ise, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’ane, gose ase engencho y’enchiri, chinyomba, na bamura bamwabo, na basubati bamwabo, na abang’ina, na abana, na emegondo, ase emechando,

english: And he answered and said unto them , What did Moses command you ?
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inki Musa abachiigete?”

english: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions ; and in the world to come eternal life .
ekegusii: ere naegwe ebinge ase chingaki echi chia bono, na ase ense egochi-gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.

english: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem ; and Jesus went before them : and they were amazed ; and as they followed , they were afraid . And he took again the twelve , and began to tell them what things should happen unto him ,
ekegusii: Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Naende akaira baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobateebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyoora,

english: Saying , Behold , we go up to Jerusalem ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :
ekegusii: akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nabekwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko. Abwo nabamogambie, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b’Ebisaku,

english: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .
ekegusii: na barabwo nabamochecherie, na komoaka chinkini, na komotwera amate, na komoita akwe; magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.” Okoboria kwa Yakobo na Yohana (Mat 20:20-23)

english: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .
ekegusii: Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie otokorere rinde rionsi toragosabe.”

english: And he said unto them , What would ye that I should do for you ?
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Inki morigetie mbakorere?”

english: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Otwanchere intwe toikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee, ase obonene bwao.”

english: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them , Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Ntonyare.” Yeso akabateebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche imokenywere, na ebatiso ’mbatisire inche imobatiswe,

english: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
ekegusii: korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kw’ane gw’okorio na okoboko nogw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mat 20:24-28; Luk 22:24-27)

english: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .
ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bagachaaka kobea Yakobo na Yohana.

english: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
ekegusii: Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, nabe omosomba o bonsi.

english: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.” Baritimayo oria orenge omouko okogwenigwa (Mat 20:29-34; Luk 18:35-43)

english: And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimæus , the son of Timæus , sat by the highway side begging .
ekegusii: Bagaika Yeriko. Goika Yeso agachia koba okobwatia enchera korwa Yeriko amo naborokigwa baye na omoganda omonene, omwana o Timayo, Baritimayo, oyio orenge omouko, nigo arenge oikaransete enchera ensemo, ogosaba ebiegwa.

english: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth , he began to cry out , and say , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso Omonazareti ogoeta, agachaaka goaka eriogi, ogoteeba, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera!”

english: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
ekegusii: Abanto abange bakamotogonyera, bakamoteebia ng’a anyare gokira, korende akamenta goaka eriogi kobua, ogoteeba “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”

english: And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise ; he calleth thee .
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamoteebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abariikerete ogochika oko.

english: And he, casting away his garment , rose , and came to Jesus .
ekegusii: Ere agatuguta eanga yaye, agacharoka, agachiera Yeso.

english: And Jesus answered and said unto him , What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ? The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Omonto oria orenge omouko akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, inyare korora.”

english: And Jesus said unto him , Go thy way ; thy faith hath made thee whole . And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda! Okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, agatunyana Yeso kwagachia.

english: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .
ekegusii: na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo. Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo.

english: What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
ekegusii: Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”

english: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,

english: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David , that cometh in the name of the Lord : Hosanna in the highest .
ekegusii: Mbosesenirie oborwoti bogocha, oborwoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”

english: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem , and into the temple : and when he had looked round about upon all things , and now the eventide was come , he went out unto Bethany with the twelve .
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; akarigereria buya chinsemo chionsi kera egento. Korende ase engencho nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere. Yeso okoragereria Omoko (Mat 21:18-19)

english: And on the morrow , when they were come from Bethany , he was hungry :
ekegusii: Rituko riare kobwatia kobakorwa Bethania Yeso akaigwa enchara.

english: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves ; for the time of figs was not yet .
ekegusii: Akarora korwa are omoko ore namato, akagenda arore gose amako nareo. Agachia goika aroro tarora gento otatiga amato, ekiagera tikiarenge ekero ki’amako.

english: And Jesus answered and said unto it , No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever . And his disciples heard it.
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omoko oria, “Korwa bono monto taria amatunda ao nonya ndinde.” Aborokigwa baye bakaigwa aya. Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mat 21:12-17; Luk 19:45-48; Yoh 2:13-22)

english: And they come to Jerusalem : and Jesus went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ;
ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, agaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare goonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;

english: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple .
ekegusii: tatiga monto abogorie gento ase egati ye Hekalu.

english: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakanyora amang’ana, bakarigia enchera y’okomosiria, ekiagera bamoirogete; naki emeganda yonsi egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.

english: And when even was come , he went out of the city .
ekegusii: Koriaba mogoroba akarua ase omochie. Amegerio korwa ase omoko omwomo (Mat 21:20-22)

english: And saith unto them , Go your way into the village over against you : and as soon as ye be entered into it , ye shall find a colt tied , whereon never man sat ; loose him , and bring him .
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.

english: And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .
ekegusii: Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.

english: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him , Master , behold , the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away .
ekegusii: Petero akainyora amang’ana aria, agateebia Yeso, “Rabii, rora, omoko oria kwaragereretie bwomire.”

english: And Jesus answering saith unto them , Have faith in God .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.

english: Therefore I say unto you , What things soever ye desire , when ye pray , believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebirie, ebinto bionsi morasabe, egene ng’a mwabinyorire, nabirobio inabibe ebiaino.

english: But if ye do not forgive , neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses .
ekegusii: Onye inwe timokwabera, nonya n’Iso oino ore igoro takobaabera inwe amamocho aino.]” Riborio igoro y’okobua kwa Yeso (Mat 21:23-27; Luk 20:1-8)

english: And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,
ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu naende. Ekero Yeso are gotaara Hekalu ime, abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka bakamochiera,

english: And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?
ekegusii: bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokorera aya?”

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbateebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.

english: And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him ; and straightway he will send him hither .
ekegusii: Na omonto karababorie: Inaki mogokora iga? Momoteebie: Omonene nayeganetie, na bwango nayeiranie naende aa.”

english: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ? answer me .
ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete igoro, gose nase Mwanyabaanto? Ng’iranerie.”

english: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven ; he will say , Why then did ye not believe him ?
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoboorie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?

english: But if we shall say , Of men ; they feared the people : for all men counted John , that he was a prophet indeed .
ekegusii: Gose toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete?” — Bakairoka abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi mbaroche ng’a Yohana nomobani bw’ekeene.

english: And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them , Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabateebia “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”

english: And they went their way , and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met ; and they loose him .
ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakarora emori y’etigere esibire geita isiko ase enchera enene; bakayesibora.

english: And certain of them that stood there said unto them , What do ye , loosing the colt ?
ekegusii: Abanto bande bateneine aroro, bakababoria, “Inki ekio mogokora, mogosibora emori y’etigere?”

english: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded : and they let them go .
ekegusii: Bakabateebia buna Yeso abachiigete; na abwo bakabatiga bagende.

english: And they brought the colt to Jesus , and cast their garments on him ; and he sat upon him .
ekegusii: Bakarentera Yeso emori eria y’etigere, bakaara chianga igoro asero, na Yeso akayeriina.

english: And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
ekegusii: Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiara inchera.

english: This was the Lord’s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”

english: And they sought to lay hold on him , but feared the people : for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them : and they left him , and went their way .
ekegusii: Erio Abakuani abanene, aborokia b’amariiko n’abagaaka bakarigia kobwata Yeso ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omobayeeno oria nabwo ogoteeba; korende bakairoka omoganda, bakamotiga, bakagenda. Riborio igoro y’okorwa ebango (Mat 22:15-22; Luk 20:20-26)

english: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians , to catch him in his words .
ekegusii: Bagatoma asare abande b’Abafarisai na Abaherodia, erinde bamotege ase amang’ana.

english: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar , or not ?
ekegusii: Bagachia goika bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a aye nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto, naki torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae. Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?

english: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them , Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .
ekegusii: Tomoe, gose titomoa?” Korende Yeso ere konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia: Nase ki mogonteema? Yendetere ebesa inyerore!

english: And they brought it . And he saith unto them , Whose is this image and superscription ? And they said unto him , Cæsar’s .
ekegusii: Bakayerenta. Ere akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.”

english: And Jesus answering said unto them , Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar’s , and to God the things that are God’s . And they marvelled at him .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Luk 20:27-40)

english: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .
ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde anyore korwa ase abaremi ensemo y’amatunda y’emesabibu.

english: Now there were seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and dying left no seed .
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana.

english: And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere akamotwara, agakwa; nonya nere tatiga abana; nonya noyo o gatato boigo.

english: And the seven had her , and left no seed : last of all the woman died also .
ekegusii: Bonsi batano na babere bakamotwara, tibatiga abana. Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.

english: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa ’mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”

english: And Jesus answering said unto them , Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Timori gosira ase aya, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae?

english: For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .
ekegusii: Inaki kobaraboke korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika bare igoro.

english: He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .
ekegusii: Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.” Ogochika okonene (Mat 22:34-40)

english: And one of the scribes came , and having heard them reasoning together , and perceiving that he had answered them well , asked him , Which is the first commandment of all ?
ekegusii: Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariiko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”

english: And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .
ekegusii: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind , and with all thy strength : this is the first commandment .
ekegusii: naye mwanche Omonene oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.

english: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple , How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabora gakworokereria ime ase Hekalu, “Inaki aborokia b’amariiko bakobora ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?

english: David therefore himself calleth him Lord ; and whence is he then his son ? And the common people heard him gladly .
ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo akomoroka Omonene; inaki rende Masihi aba omwana oye? Na omoganda oria omonene nigo orenge komoigwa ase omogooko. Yeso ogokuurera igoro yaborokia b’amariiko (Mat 23:1-36; Luk 11:37-54; 20:45-47)

english: And he said unto them in his doctrine , Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,
ekegusii: Akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye, “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abwo banchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro,

english: And the chief seats in the synagogues , and the uppermost rooms at feasts :
ekegusii: na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.

english: And again he sent unto them another servant ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatoma naende ase bare omosomba onde, na oyio bakamoaka chingoma ase omotwe, bakamosokia bakamokora bobe.

english: Which devour widows’ houses , and for a pretence make long prayers : these shall receive greater damnation .
ekegusii: Abwo bakounereria chinyomba ch’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe; aba nabanyore ekiina ekere ekenene kobua.” Esadaka y’omoboraka (Luk 21:1-4)

english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury , and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury : and many that were rich cast in much .
ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa korigereria ekebekerero gi’esadaka, akarigereria buna omoganda okobeeka chitaabu ase ekebekerero. Abande abarenge abanda bakabeeka chinyinge.

english: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .
ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.

english: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them , Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :
ekegusii: Akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Oyo omoboraka omotaka obekire chinyinge kobua bonsi ababeeka ase ekebeekerero gi’esadaka,

english: For all they did cast in of their abundance ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .
ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi nigo babeeka korwa ase ogoiteka kw’obonda bwabo; korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire bionsi ebiarenge nabio, nonya n’enibo y’obogima bwaye bwonsi.” Esadaka y’omoboraka|alt="Widow's offering" src="Gw-057.tif" size="col" loc="Mark 12:41-44" copy="Graham Wade" ref="12:40"

english: And again he sent another ; and him they killed , and many others ; beating some , and killing some .
ekegusii: Omonto oria naende agatoma omosomba onde naende, na oyio bakamoita agakwa. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita bagakwa.

english: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .
ekegusii: Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma ase bare magega, okobora: Inabasike omwana one.

english: But those husbandmen said among themselves , This is the heir ; come , let us kill him , and the inheritance shall be ours .
ekegusii: Abaremi baria bagateebania: Oyo nomonyamwando; inchwo tomoite, omwando oye obe oyoito.

english: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoita agakwa, bakaimokia omobere oye bakayotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

english: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do ? he will come and destroy the husbandmen , and will give the vineyard unto others .
ekegusii: Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.

english: And as he went out of the temple , one of his disciples saith unto him , Master , see what manner of stones and what buildings are here !
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gosoka korwa Hekalu, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omworokia, rora buna amagena na amaagacho aya are amaya!”

english: And the gospel must first be published among all nations .
ekegusii: Naende negwenerete enchiri erandigwe ritang’ani ase ebisaku bionsi.

english: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira ase ekiina, na kobabeeka ase amaboko y’ abanto, timochaaka gwechanda korengereria ayamorigetie gokwana; korende rinde rionsi moraegwe ase ensa eria, morikwane, ekiagera tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika Omochenu.

english: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.

english: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment .
ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.

english: But woe to them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
ekegusii: N’abe aakong’u ase abare morito na barabwo abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.

english: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .
ekegusii: Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo,

english: And Jesus answering said unto him , Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Norooche amaagacho aya amanene? Aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritanyaare gotaagorwa.” Amabe n’ogochandwa (Mat 24:3-25; Luk 21:7-24)

english: And except that the Lord had shortened those days , no flesh should be saved : but for the elect’s sake , whom he hath chosen , he hath shortened the days .
ekegusii: Naende onye Omonene atanachete amatuko aria, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete, korende ase engencho y’abachore, abachorete, onachire amatuko aria.

english: And then if any man shall say to you , Lo , here is Christ ; or , lo , he is there ; believe him not :
ekegusii: Ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, oyo nere Kristo, gose: Oria aaria, timwegena,

english: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
ekegusii: ekiagera abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo nabaorokie ebikone na amakumia, banyare gosiria nonya nabachore ko eranyarekane.

english: But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwerende! Rora, nakoorire koborokia onsi ritang’ani. Ogocha kw’Omwana Omwanyabaanto (Mat 24:29-31; Luk 21:25-28)

english: And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mat 24:32-36,42; Luk 21:29-33)

english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :
ekegusii: “Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omobayeeno oyo. Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.

english: So ye in like manner , when ye shall see these things come to pass , know that it is nigh , even at the doors .
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorarore aya aorokire, momanye ng’a obeire ang’e na gesieri.

english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately ,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni korigereria Hekalu, Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, na Anderea, bakamobooria bobisi,

english: Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .
ekegusii: Rigereria, renda, saba, ekiagera timomanyeti engaki eria indi eranyare koba.

english: Watch ye therefore : for ye know not when the master of the house cometh , at even , or at midnight , or at the cockcrowing , or in the morning :
ekegusii: Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw’enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,

english: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
ekegusii: tacha ababasokanie, abanyore mwararire.

english: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .
ekegusii: Na erio nabateebirie inwe, nabateebirie bonsi: Renda!”

english: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
ekegusii: “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”

english: And Jesus answering them began to say , Take heed lest any man deceive you :
ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka kobateebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina,

english: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be ; but the end shall not be yet .
ekegusii: Naende komoraigwe esegi, na ebirage bi’esegi, timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe, ko moerio toracha.

english: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be earthquakes in divers places , and there shall be famines and troubles : these are the beginnings of sorrows .
ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nkeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti mborwane noborwoti bonde. Emetengecho y’ense n’ebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe buna obororo bw’eritang’ani bw’okoibora.

english: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .
ekegusii: Yudasi Iskariota, ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, akagenda ase abakuani abanene, anyare komorua ase bare.

english: And when they heard it , they were glad , and promised to give him money . And he sought how he might conveniently betray him .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chitaabu. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya. Yeso okoria Epasaka y’omoerio n’aborokigwa baye (Mat 26:17-30; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)

english: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
ekegusii: Goika rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi’okonyenya emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”

english: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples , and saith unto them , Go ye into the city , and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water : follow him .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye akabateebia, “Genda ase omochie na moumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotuny’ane,

english: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
ekegusii: na aande onsi arasoe moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia oteebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

english: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
ekegusii: Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”

english: And his disciples went forth , and came into the city , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagasoka, bakagenda omochie, bakarora buna abateebetie, bakaroisia Epasaka.

english: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve .
ekegusii: Ekero riaba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.

english: And they began to be sorrowful , and to say unto him one by one , Is it I ? and another said, Is it I ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachaaka goichana, bakamobooria oyomo ase oyomo “Inee! Ninche?”

english: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
ekegusii: korende barabwo bagateeba, “Titomobwata ekero kie rituko rinene, ekiagera abanto nigo bararente rirorooche.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mat 26:6-13; Yoh 12:1-8)

english: And he answered and said unto them , It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Noyomo bw’aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche omogati ase esani.

english: The Son of man indeed goeth , as it is written of him : but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! good were it for that man if he had never been born .
ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna ariikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto. Nanga mbuya ase are omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.” Emesa y’Omonene

english: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said , Take , eat : this is my body .
ekegusii: Ekero barenge koria, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Bogoria! Oyo noro omobere one.”

english: And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa. Bagakenywera bonsi.

english: Verily I say unto you , I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine , until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God .
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Tinkonywa naende nonya ng’ake okwama kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Emesa y’Omonene|alt="Holy Communion" src="Gw-057.tif" size="col" loc="Mark 14:22-26" copy="Graham Wade" ref="14:21"

english: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba imbagochwe bonsi na kogotiga, korende tari inche.”

english: And Jesus saith unto him , Verily I say unto thee , That this day , even in this night , before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”

english: But he spake the more vehemently , If I should die with thee , I will not deny thee in any wise . Likewise also said they all .
ekegusii: Korende Petero ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na bonsi bagateeba boigo. Yeso ogosaba Gethisemane (Mat 26:36-46; Luk 22:39-46)

english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane : and he saith to his disciples , Sit ye here , while I shall pray .
ekegusii: Naende bagaika aase akorokwa Gethisemane: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa, ekero ngosaba.”

english: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy ;
ekegusii: Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

english: And saith unto them , My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”

english: And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .
ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akagwa maumama, ogosaba ng’a onye ekonyarekana, ensa eye emoetere.

english: And he said , Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .
ekegusii: Agateeba, Abba! Engencho yaye “Tata”, onsi nigo akonyarekana ase ore, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.

english: And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter , Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?
ekegusii: Erio akairana gocha ase aborokigwa baria baye batato akabanyora bararire. Agateebia Petero, “Simioni, nkwararire? Tokonyara korenda nonya nensa eyemo?

english: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .
ekegusii: Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”

english: And again he went away , and prayed , and spake the same words .
ekegusii: Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.

english: And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?
ekegusii: Abanto bake ase abwo barenge oo bakagechigwa ase emioyo yabo, bakaboora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?

english: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy ,) neither wist they what to answer him .
ekegusii: Erio naende akairana gocha ase aborokigwa akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.

english: And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them , Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
ekegusii: Agacha eria gatato, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono moraire, na gotimoka? Aisanire. Engaki yaikire. Rora, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.

english: Rise up , let us go ; lo , he that betrayeth me is at hand .
ekegusii: Imoka, togende; rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mat 26:47-56; Luk 22:47-53; Yoh 18:2-11)

english: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso kagokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka.

english: And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he ; take him , and lead him away safely .
ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua konya obaeire ekemanyererio, ogoteeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate, momoire momorendete.”

english: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master ; and kissed him .
ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi aigete akagenda bwango, goika ase Yeso, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.

english: And they laid their hands on him , and took him .
ekegusii: Erio bakabwata Yeso, bakamoira.

english: And one of them that stood by drew a sword , and smote a servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .
ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.

english: And Jesus answered and said unto them , Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?

english: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence , and have been given to the poor . And they murmured against her .
ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.

english: And they all forsook him , and fled .
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama. Omomura oyotamete

english: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body ; and the young men laid hold on him :
ekegusii: Omomura oyomo akamotunyana, bweboyetie egetambaa ki’egatani gioka. Bagatema kamobwata,

english: And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .
ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda. Yeso bosio bw’abakuani (Mat 26:57-68; Luk 22:54-55,63-71; Yoh 18:12-14,19-24)

english: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .
ekegusii: Bakaira Yeso ase Omokuani omonene; bakamosangererekanera bonsi, abakuani abanene na abagaaka, na aborokia b’amariiko.

english: And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .
ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.

english: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death ; and found none .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na ab’ekegambero bonsi bakarigia oborori igoro ase Yeso banyare komoita, korende tibabonyora,

english: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .
ekegusii: ekiagera abange bakomoteebera oborimo, na oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.

english: And there arose certain , and bare false witness against him , saying ,
ekegusii: Na abande bagatenena bakamoteebera oborimo, bakaboora,

english: But neither so did their witness agree together .
ekegusii: Nonya nabo oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.

english: And Jesus said , Let her alone ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Motige! Nase ki mokomorosia? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya.

english: And the high priest stood up in the midst , and asked Jesus , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatenena gati‐gati, akaboria Yeso okobora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”

english: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
ekegusii: Korende agakira, tairaneria ing’ana. Omokuani omonene akamobooria naende, akamoteebia, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana bw’Omosesenigwa?”

english: Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Ninki tokorigeria abarori bande?

english: And some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to buffet him , and to say unto him , Prophesy : and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands .
ekegusii: Abande bagachaaka komotwera amate, na komotuba obosio, na komoaka chinkundi, na komoteebia, “Bana!” Abarendi nabarabwo bakamoaka chindoe. Petero ogokana Yeso (Mat 26:69-75; Luk 22:56-62; Yoh 18:15-18,25-27)

english: And as Peter was beneath in the palace , there cometh one of the maids of the high priest :
ekegusii: Na Petero nigo arenge egoora inse, na oyomo bw’abaiseke abasomba b’Omokuani omonene agacha,

english: And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .
ekegusii: akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateeba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”

english: But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch ; and the cock crew .
ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.

english: And a maid saw him again , and began to say to them that stood by , This is one of them .
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaaka goteebia abateneine ang’e, “Oyo n’oyomo obo.”

english: And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .
ekegusii: Agakaana naende. Magega y’egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang’e bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye n’oyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”

english: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .
ekegusii: Agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, “Timanyeti omonto oyio mogoteeba.”

english: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him , Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice . And when he thought thereon , he wept .
ekegusii: Erio etuoni ekabuga eria kabere. Petero akainyora ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkaane ara gatato.” Agachia agetugutana, akarera.

english: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
ekegusii: Okorire eki abuete, goaka omobere one ase ogotindekwa kwane.

english: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.” Yudasi ogwancherana korwa Yeso (Mat 26:14-16; Luk 22:3-6)

english: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council , and bound Jesus , and carried him away , and delivered him to Pilate .
ekegusii: Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.

english: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy .
ekegusii: Ekiagera amanyete ng’a abakuani abanene nigo bamorure ase obogechi.

english: But the chief priests moved the people , that he should rather release Barabbas unto them .
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakagenka abanto b’omoganda, erinde anche kobasiborera Baraba.

english: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Imokore naki oyo mogoteeba ng’a n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

english: And they cried out again , Crucify him .
ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”

english: Then Pilate said unto them , Why , what evil hath he done ? And they cried out the more exceedingly , Crucify him .
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Bakamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Mobambe!”

english: And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .
ekegusii: Pilato agancha gokora ayaragwenere omoganda, akabasiborera Baraba, na ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe. Ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe.|alt="After Pilate whipped him with cords, he gave him over to be crucified" src="Gw-062 tif" size="col" loc="Mark 15:1-15" copy="Graham wade" ref="15:15" Abarwani bagochecheria Yeso (Mat 27:27-31; Yoh 19:2-3)

english: And the soldiers led him away into the hall , called Prætorium ; and they call together the whole band .
ekegusii: Abarwani bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero (nero Praitorio), bagasangererekana amo ekeombe ekegima.

english: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,
ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,

english: And began to salute him , Hail , King of the Jews !
ekegusii: bagachaaka komokwania, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”

english: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .
ekegusii: Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasiima.

english: And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him , Thou sayest it .
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akamoiraneria, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”

english: And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .
ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria emonyinga, bakamoboyia chianga chiaye omonyene. Bakamoira isiko komobamba. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Luk 23:26-43; Yoh 19:17-27)

english: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha , which is , being interpreted , The place of a skull .
ekegusii: Bakamoira aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore).

english: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .
ekegusii: Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.

english: And it was the third hour , and they crucified him .
ekegusii: Nigo chiare chinsa isato ekero bamobambete.

english: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .
ekegusii: Na amariiko y’ogosoerwa kwaye nigo ariikire igoro, “OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”

english: And the scripture was fulfilled , which saith , And he was numbered with the transgressors .
ekegusii: Nabo ririiko rigaikerana, erigoteeba, “Obareraniigwe amo nabasaria.”]

english: And the chief priests accused him of many things : but he answered nothing.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakamosoera ase amang’ana amange.

english: Save thyself , and come down from the cross .
ekegusii: etoorie, ika korwa ase omosalaba!”

english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes , He saved others ; himself he cannot save .
ekegusii: Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b’amariiko, bagateeba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.

english: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him reviled him .
ekegusii: Tiga Kristo, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, tonyare korora na kwegena!” Na barabwo abaabambetwe amo nere bakamoraama. Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Luk 23:44-49; Yoh 19:28-30)

english: And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
ekegusii: Ekero chinsa isano nemo chiaika omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.

english: And some of them that stood by , when they heard it , said , Behold , he calleth Elias .
ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine ang’e koyaigwa bakaboora, “Rora, nkorangeria are Elija.”

english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice , and gave up the ghost .
ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi rinene, agatweka mo.

english: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng’a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”

english: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoereire.”

english: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him ;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo bamotuny’anete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:57-61; Luk 23:50-56; Yoh 19:38-42)

english: And now when the even was come , because it was the preparation , that is , the day before the sabbath ,
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, ekiagera nerituko ri’okwebeka ang’e, nario rituko ri’ogotang’anera Esabato,

english: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
ekegusii: Yusufu omonto bw’Arimathaya agacha, oyorenge omosike, omonto bw’ekegambero. Ere omonyene nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae; agasoa noboremu ase obosio bwa Pilato, agasaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.

english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
ekegusii: Pilato agakumia, ekiagera aikire gokwa, akarangeria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, akamobooria gose nkare akwete.

english: And when he knew it of the centurion , he gave the body to Joseph .
ekegusii: Goika agachia konyora ekeene ng’a okuure, akaa Yusufu omobere.

english: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .
ekegusii: Yusufu akagora egetambaa ki’egatani, akamoikia, akamoboyia egetambaa keria, akamobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare. Naende agaturunkania rigena gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina.

english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .
ekegusii: Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yose bakarigereria aase abegetwe.

english: But Jesus yet answered nothing ; so that Pilate marvelled .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.

english: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .
ekegusii: Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.

english: And there was one named Barabbas , which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him , who had committed murder in the insurrection .
ekegusii: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.

english: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them .
ekegusii: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.

english: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”

english: And when the sabbath was past , Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James , and Salome , had bought sweet spices , that they might come and anoint him .
ekegusii: Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta yamanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.

english: And she went and told them that had been with him , as they mourned and wept .
ekegusii: Oyo akagenda agateebia baria barenge amo nere korwa kare, baare kweumia na korera.

english: And they , when they had heard that he was alive , and had been seen of her , believed not .
ekegusii: Na barabwo, bagachia koigwa ng’a moyo are, na ororirwe nere, tibegena.

english: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them , as they walked , and went into the country .
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.

english: And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakagenda bagateebia abande amang’ana aria, korende abwo tibabegena.

english: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
ekegusii: Naende akaorokera baria ikomi nomo, ekero barenge koragera; akabatogonyera ase ogotegena kwabo na obokong’u bw’emioyo yabo, ekiagera bategenete abamorooche kabokire.

english: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .
ekegusii: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.

english: And these signs shall follow them that believe ; In my name shall they cast out devils ; they shall speak with new tongues ;
ekegusii: Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,

english: They shall take up serpents ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .
ekegusii: nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.” Yeso okogenda igoro (Luk 24:50-53)

english: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .
ekegusii: Goika mambia chuni, rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, bakagenda ase oboina, erioba korikooroka.

english: And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiabatuny’anete. Amina.

english: And they said among themselves , Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre ?
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki’oboina?”

english: And when they looked , they saw that the stone was rolled away : for it was very great .
ekegusii: Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng’a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.

english: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side , clothed in a long white garment ; and they were affrighted .
ekegusii: Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y’okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bakegosa.

english: And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Timoichana; Yeso Omonazareti mokorigia, oria obambetwe. Ere obookire, tari aiga. Rigereria aase bamobegete!

english: And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man ; for they were afraid .
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nekeondoko na ogokumia. Tibateebetie monto ing’ana, ekiagera bairogete. Yeso okororekana kabookire (Yoh 20:11-18; Luk 24:13-35; Mat 28:16-20; Luk 24:36-49; Yoh 20:19-23)

english: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .
ekegusii: Yeso ekero abookire, mambia rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma akaorokera ritang’ani Mariamu Magidalena, ere oria arusetie ebirecha bitano na bibere.

english: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ , the Son of God ;
ekegusii: Eye nero enchiri igoro ya Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae,

english: And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
ekegusii: Erio kegima, Yeso kagotiira korwa ase amaache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare, Erio kegima, Yeso kagotiira korwa ase amaache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare|alt="holy spirit in a form of a dove descended on him" src="Gw-049.tif" size="col" loc="Mark 1:9-11" copy="Graham Wade" ref="1:10"

english: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .
ekegusii: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.

english: And he was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted of Satan ; and was with the wild beasts ; and the angels ministered unto him .
ekegusii: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare. Yeso okorangeria Abarubi bane (Mat 4:17; Luk 4:14-15)

english: Now after that John was put in prison , Jesus came into Galilee , preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God ,
ekegusii: Magega Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchiri ya Nyasae,

english: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simioni na Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.

english: And Jesus said unto them , Come ye after me , and I will make you to become fishers of men .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’ abanto.”

english: And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .
ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.

english: And when he had gone a little further thence , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who also were in the ship mending their nets .
ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akarora Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana momura omwabo; barabwo nigo barenge obwato ime bakobareera ebionga biabo.

english: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .
ekegusii: Erio kegima akabarangeria; barabwo bagatiga Zebedi ise amo n’abanto b’eng’eria ime ase obwato, bakamotunyana. Yeso okogwenia Omonto obwatire n’ekerecha agwo Kapernaumu (Luk 4:31-37)

english: And they went into Capernaum ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.

english: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit ; and he cried out ,
ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi agacha ase esinagogi, ere agaaka eriogi,

english: Saying , Let us alone ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .
ekegusii: akabora, “Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Inee! Nigo gwachire gotosiria? Namanyire aye ning’o, aye n’Omochenu o Nyasae.”

english: And Jesus rebuked him , saying , Hold thy peace , and come out of him .
ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Karwe ase omonto oyo!”

english: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
ekegusii: Ekerecha keria ki’eubi gekamogaragaria, gekarera ase eriogi rinene, gekamorwa.

english: And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .
ekegusii: Bagaichana bonsi, goika bakaborania, bakobora, “Inki eke? Nokworokereria okoyia! Omonto oyo nigo abwate okobua kw’ogochika nonya nebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio bikomoigwera.”

english: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .
ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense ya Galili. Yeso okogwenia abanto abange (Mat 8:14-17; Luk 4:38-41)
