english: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
ekegusii: Erio agwo kobasokire korwa ase esinagogi, bakagenda goika nyomba mwa Simioni na Anderea: Yakobo na Yohana bakagenda nere.

english: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever , and anon they tell him of her .
ekegusii: Ng’ina biara Simioni nigo araire, arwarete esosera. Erio kegima Yeso gaikire bakamoteebia amang’ana igoro yaye.

english: And he came and took her by the hand , and lifted her up ; and immediately the fever left her , and she ministered unto them .
ekegusii: Yeso agaika omong’ina oria ang’e, akamoimokia ase okomobwata okoboko. Erio esosera ekamotiga na ere akabakorera.

english: And at even , when the sun did set , they brought unto him all that were diseased , and them that were possessed with devils .
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, erioba korikogwa, abanto bakarentera Yeso abarwaire bonsi, na ababwatire nebirecha.

english: And all the city was gathered together at the door .
ekegusii: Na omochie bwonsi okaba ngosangererekana ore gesieri.

english: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases , and cast out many devils ; and suffered not the devils to speak , because they knew him .
ekegusii: Yeso akagwenia abange abarenge namarwaire ao ao, na agaseria ebirecha ebinge; tatiga ebirecha bikwane, ekiagera biamomanyete. Yeso okorandia Galili (Luk 4:42-44)

english: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .
ekegusii: Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasooka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasabera aroro.

english: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him .
ekegusii: Simioni na abarenge amo nere bakamotunyana,

english: And when they had found him , they said unto him , All men seek for thee .
ekegusii: ekero bamonyorete, bakamoteebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”

english: And he said unto them , Let us go into the next towns , that I may preach there also : for therefore came I forth .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebinyoro bire ang’e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”

english: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
ekegusii: Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobateebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”

english: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma agacha asare, akamosorora na komotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”

english: And Jesus , moved with compassion , put forth his hand , and touched him , and saith unto him , I will ; be thou clean .
ekegusii: Yeso akamororera amaabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”

english: And as soon as he had spoken , immediately the leprosy departed from him , and he was cleansed .
ekegusii: Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamotiga, agasibeka.

english: And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away ;
ekegusii: Akamotianera bokong’u, kamosokirie agende,

english: But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .
ekegusii: Korende agasoka, agachaaka koraria amang’ana aya na gosareria ring’ana riria, goika Yeso tanyara naende gosoa ase omochie ime maiso marore, korende akabeera isiko aase atari nabaanto; na abanto bakamochiera korwa kera aase.

english: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa , and they of Jerusalem , and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan , confessing their sins .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na bonsi aba Yerusalemu bakamochiera, bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.

english: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
ekegusii: Akarandia, okobora, “Nache korwa magega y’ane oyore ne chinguru kombua, oyio inche ntaisaini gotung’ama na gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye.

english: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaabatisa ase amaache, korende ere nabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu.” Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mat 3:13-17; Luk 3:21-22)

english: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yeso agacha korwa Nazareti ya Galili, akabatiswa na Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani.

english: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days ; and it was noised that he was in the house .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Yeso akairana gochia Kapernaumu, abanto bakanyora amang’ana ng’a nao are nyomba.

english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins , (he saith to the sick of the palsy ,)
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata,

english: I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .
ekegusii: “Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”

english: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .
ekegusii: Erio kegima akaimoka, agetweka oborere bwaye, akarua ase amasio abo bonsi; goika bagakumia bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae, bakoboora, “Ayare buna aya, titwana koyarora rinde nonya ng’ake!” Yeso okorangeria Lawi (Mat 9:9-13; Luk 5:27-32)

english: And he went forth again by the sea side ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .
ekegusii: Yeso naende akairana gochia ensemo y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi okamochiera, ere agachaaka koborokereria.

english: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him , Follow me . And he arose and followed him .
ekegusii: Ekero achia goeta, akarora Lawi, omwana bw’Alufayo, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.

english: And it came to pass , that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yeso aikaransete nyomba mw’omonto oria, okoria endagera, abarusia ebango abange na abanyene ebibe bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye; inaki barenge abange bamotuny’anete.

english: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners , they said unto his disciples , How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners ?
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachia komoorora okoria amo n’abanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”

english: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them , They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete; tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyene ebibe.” Riborio igoro y’okweng’ata (Mat 9:14-17; Luk 5:33-39)

english: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana na Abafarisai nigo barenge kweng’ata. Abanto bande bagaacha, bakamobooria, “Nase ki aborokigwa ba Yohana na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai bakweng’ata, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata?”

english: And Jesus said unto them , Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they can not fast .
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abatuunyire enyangi inabanyare kweng’ata ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Ekero omonywomi are amo na barabwo, tibakonyara kweng’ata.

english: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no, not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .
ekegusii: Erio abanto abange bagasangererekana amo, tiriatigara ribaga ase bare, nonya ngoika gesieri; na Yeso akaba ogokwana ring’ana ase bare.

english: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .
ekegusii: Gose tari monto onde okobareera ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, keria ekeyia kiagendereria eanga eria engotu etandoke kobua.

english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.” Riborio igoro y’okorenda Esabato (Mat 12:1-8; Luk 6:1-5)

english: And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamoboria, “Rora, naki bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”

english: And he said unto them , Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete ekero aremeretwe endagera, akaba nenchara, ere na abwo barenge amo nere,

english: And he said unto them , The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Esabato nigo yakoretwe ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, tari Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’Esabato;

english: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
ekegusii: naki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”

english: And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .
ekegusii: Abanto bagaacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabaanto bane.

english: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .
ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyarete komoikia ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda, bakabochora ekerama aase aaria Yeso arenge. Kobakoorire kogetagora, bagaikia oborere boria oria orenge rigata araire.

english: When Jesus saw their faith , he said unto the sick of the palsy , Son , thy sins be forgiven thee .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

english: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there , and reasoning in their hearts ,
ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko baikaransete aroro, bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo,

english: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?
ekegusii: “Inaki oyo agoteeba iga? Nkorama are! Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”

english: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them , Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabateebia, “Inaki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?

english: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy , Thy sins be forgiven thee ; or to say , Arise , and take up thy bed , and walk ?
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?

english: And he entered again into the synagogue ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa naende ase esinagogi. Agwo narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete.

english: For he had healed many ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .
ekegusii: Ekiagera agwenetie abanto, bonsi abarenge nemechando bakamosongerera, banyare komokuna.

english: And unclean spirits , when they saw him , fell down before him , and cried , saying , Thou art the Son of God .
ekegusii: Na abanto barenge n’ebirecha bi’eubi bagachia komoorora, bakagwa ase obosio bwaye, bakarera bagateeba, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.”

english: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .
ekegusii: Akabitianera mono tibimoorokia. Yeso ogochora abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:1-4; Luk 6:12-16)

english: And he goeth up into a mountain , and calleth unto him whom he would : and they came unto him .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.

english: And he ordained twelve , that they should be with him , and that he might send them forth to preach ,
ekegusii: Agachoora ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa erio banyare koba amo nere, erinde abatome bagende korandia,

english: And to have power to heal sicknesses , and to cast out devils :
ekegusii: na babe nokobua kw’ogoseria ebirecha.

english: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere achoorete nabwo aba: Simioni nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,

english: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :
ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;

english: And Andrew , and Philip , and Bartholomew , and Matthew , and Thomas , and James the son of Alphaeus , and Thaddaeus , and Simon the Canaanite ,
ekegusii: Anderea na Filipo, na Baritholomayo, na Matayo, na Thomas, na Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Tadayo, na Simioni, oyomo bw’Abazelote,

english: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .
ekegusii: na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyomoruete. Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mat 12:22-37; Luk 11:14-23; 12:10) Erio agasoa nyomba.

english: And they watched him , whether he would heal him on the sabbath day ; that they might accuse him .
ekegusii: Agwo mbarenge oo abanto gete abwo baganetie gotega Yeso barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.

english: And the multitude cometh together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .
ekegusii: Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.

english: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .
ekegusii: Abaamate baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasoka kogenda komobwata, ekiagera bateebete, “Obakirwe n’eosi.”

english: And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables , How can Satan cast out Satan ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabateebia ase emebayeeno, “Inaki Saitani aranyare goseria Saitani?

english: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .
ekegusii: Na oborwoti kaboraatananeke ase borobwo obonyene, oborwoti boria tibokonyara gotenena.

english: And if a house be divided against itself , that house cannot stand .
ekegusii: Na enyomba keraatananeke enyene, enyomba eria tekonyara gotenena.

english: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .
ekegusii: Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.

english: No man can enter into a strong man’s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man ; and then he will spoil his house .
ekegusii: Omonto takonyara gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani oria omonyene chinguru; nario aranyare gosakora enyomba yaye.

english: Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
ekegusii: “Ekeene nabateebirie: Ebibe bionsi Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, na okorama gwonsi bararame,

english: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand , Stand forth .
ekegusii: Agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”

english: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .
ekegusii: Nigo abateebetie ayio ekiagera bateebete, “Nabwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.” Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso (Mat 12:46-50; Luk 8:19-21)

english: There came then his brethren and his mother , and , standing without , sent unto him , calling him .
ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso bagaacha, bagatenena isiko, bagatoma omonto komorangeria.

english: And the multitude sat about him , and they said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee .
ekegusii: Na omoganda nigo orenge oikaransete omoetanaine, okamoteebia, “Rora nyoko na bamura bamino isiko bare, mbagotagete.”

english: And he answered them , saying , Who is my mother , or my brethren ?
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Baba na bamura baminto mbarabi?”

english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said , Behold my mother and my brethren !
ekegusii: Akabarigereria abwo baikaransete bamoetanaine, akabora, “Rora aba nabwo baba na bamura baminto!

english: For whosoever shall do the will of God , the same is my brother , and my sister , and mother .
ekegusii: Inaki oyorakore ogwancha kwa Nyasae, oyio nere baba na momura ominto, na mosubati ominto.”

english: And he saith unto them , Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days , or to do evil ? to save life , or to kill ? But they held their peace .
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mboronge ase rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya, gose gokora amabe; gotooria obogima, gose koboita?” Bagakira.

english: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man , Stretch forth thine hand . And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
ekegusii: Akabamogoreria amaiso chinsemo chionsi ase okobea, akaigwa obororo ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakorambora, na okoboko kwaye gokagwena.

english: And the Pharisees went forth , and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him , how they might destroy him .
ekegusii: Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n’Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso. Omoganda bw’abaanto engegu y’enyancha

english: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea : and a great multitude from Galilee followed him , and from Judæa ,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarwa agwo amo n’Aborokigwa baye, bakagenda goika engegu ye’nyancha ya Galili, na omoganda omonene korwa Galili, naboigo korwa ase Boyahudi,

english: And from Jerusalem , and from Idumaea , and from beyond Jordan ; and they about Tyre and Sidon , a great multitude , when they had heard what great things he did , came unto him .
ekegusii: na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni okabatunyana. Ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, omoganda oyio omonene, okamochiera.

english: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
ekegusii: Ekero arenge bweka, abanto baria bamoetanaine amo nabaria ikomi na babere bakamobooria amang’ana y’emebayeeno eria.

english: And he said unto them , Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but unto them that are without , all these things are done in parables :
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, korende ase abanto bare isiko, amang’ana onsi nigo are emebayeeno ase bare,

english: And he said unto them , Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timomanyeti omobayeeno oyo? Gaki emebayeeno yonsi naki morayemanye?

english: The sower soweth the word .
ekegusii: Omobusuri nering’ana akobusura.

english: And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo bare buna embusuro eyio ekogwa enchera ensemo; na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa ring’ana, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.

english: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness ;
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo banga buna chimbusuro chiria chiaguete ase egetare, ekiagera kobaigure ring’ana riria, erio kegima baribwata nomogooko;

english: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake , immediately they are offended .
ekegusii: na abwo tibari nemeri ime yabo abanyene, korende bagenderera ekero egeke, na ekero emechando gose okorosigwa bikooroka ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, bwango bagwa.

english: And these are they which are sown among thorns ; such as hear the word ,
ekegusii: Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,

english: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .
ekegusii: naende okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo, na okogania kw’amang’ana ande kogosoa, biamiga ring’ana riria, riaba tirikwama.

english: And he taught them many things by parables , and said unto them in his doctrine ,
ekegusii: Akaborokereria amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye,

english: And these are they which are sown on good ground ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .
ekegusii: Naende aba nabwo babusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, abwo n’abanto baria bakoigwa ring’ana riria, na koribwata, na kwama okwama, oyomo emerongo etato, oyomo emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde rigana.” Okworokereria korwa ase etaya na korwa ase embusuro (Mat 13:31-35; Luk 8:16-18; 13:18-19)

english: If any man have ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Onye omonto ore n’amato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”

english: And he said , So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground ;
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro ase riroba.

english: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .
ekegusii: Akaba okoraara botuko na koboka, mobaso, na embusuro eyio ekamera na gokiina, ere atamanyeti buna egokoreka.

english: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
ekegusii: Inaki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang’ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.

english: Hearken ; Behold , there went out a sower to sow :
ekegusii: “Tegerera! Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.

english: And he said , Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God ? or with what comparison shall we compare it ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akagenderera koboora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase mobayeeno ki?

english: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , is less than all the seeds that be in the earth :
ekegusii: Nigo bonga entetere y’omoaruni, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,

english: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
ekegusii: korende koyasimekirwe, yakiina, yaba enene kobua emete yonsi y’amato, yaba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”

english: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .
ekegusii: Yeso akaranderia abanto ring’ana riaye ase emebayeeno emenge ere buna eye; nigo arenge gokwana ring’ana ase bare, koreng’ana buna baare konyara koigwa,

english: But without a parable spake he not unto them : and when they were alone , he expounded all things to his disciples .
ekegusii: gose taare kobateebia ring’ana otatiga ase omobayeeno, korende ekero arenge ensemo n’Aborokigwa baye nigo arenge kobateebia obobisi bwonsi. Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mat 8:23-27; Luk 8:22-25)

english: And the same day , when the even was come , he saith unto them , Let us pass over unto the other side .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu.”

english: And when they had sent away the multitude , they took him even as he was in the ship . And there were also with him other little ships .
ekegusii: Bagatiga omoganda, bakamoira amo nabarabwo, buna arenge, ase obwato boria. Na amaato ande narenge amo nere

english: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .
ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu ekenene ki’omwaga gekaoroka, emerindo egaaka‐aka obwato goika amaache agachaaka goichora obwato ime.

english: And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?
ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo arenge ase obwato ime magega oraire igoro ase omoito. Bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, tari gento ase ore gatogosira?”

english: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea , Peace , be still . And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .
ekegusii: Yeso akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga, agateebia enyancha, “Kira, otoerere!” Omwaga okaera; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

english: And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .
ekegusii: Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha chigachiria.

english: And he said unto them , Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Inaki mokwoboa inwe? Timori nokwegena?”

english: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
ekegusii: Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagateebania, “Oyo ning’o rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

english: And some fell on stony ground , where it had not much earth ; and immediately it sprang up , because it had no depth of earth :
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.

english: And some fell among thorns , and the thorns grew up , and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga, tichiama amatunda.

english: And other fell on good ground , and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased ; and brought forth , some thirty , and some sixty , and some an hundred .
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”

english: And he said unto them , He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
ekegusii: Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.” Ekerenga ki’ogokwana ase emebayeeno (Mat 13:10-17; Luk 8:9-10)

english: And they came over unto the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .
ekegusii: Bagaika ng’umbu y’enyancha, goika ense y’Abageraseni.

english: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country .
ekegusii: Erio ere agasorora Yeso mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.

english: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding .
ekegusii: Aria ase egetunwa ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche riare korisia.

english: And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .
ekegusii: Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikaboora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa ase chirochio.”

english: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave . And the unclean spirits went out , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea , (they were about two thousand ;) and were choked in the sea .
ekegusii: Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi’eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng’ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.

english: And they that fed the swine fled , and told it in the city , and in the country . And they went out to see what it was that was done .
ekegusii: Abarisia bagatama, bakararia amang’ana aya ase omochie na ebinyoro. Abanto bagasooka barore amang’ana aorokire.

english: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
ekegusii: Bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria obwatire nomoganda bw’ebirecha oikaransete, bweboyetie chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge bakairoka.

english: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
ekegusii: Na baria abayaroche bakaorokia amang’ana amonyorire oria obwatire nebirecha, na amang’ana ye chimbeche.

english: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts .
ekegusii: Bagachaaka gosorora Yeso arue ase ense yabo.

english: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato ime, oria obwatire nebirecha akamosorora ng’a abe amo nere.

english: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not , but saith unto him , Go home to thy friends , and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee , and hath had compassion on thee .
ekegusii: Yeso tamwanchera, korende akamoteebia, “Genda nka bwoo ase abamino, obateebie amang’ana amanene ay’Omonene agokoreire, naende buna akororeire amaabera.”

english: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa obwato; agwo akaumerana nomonto okorwa ase chimbeera obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.

english: And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .
ekegusii: Akagenda bwoye, agachaaka koraria ase Dekapoli amang’ana aya Yeso amokoreire. Abanto bonsi bagakumia. Omoiseke o Yairo na omokungu ore noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga bakogwenigwa (Mat 9:18-26; Luk 8:40-56)

english: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side , much people gathered unto him : and he was nigh unto the sea .
ekegusii: Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.

english: And , behold , there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue , Jairus by name ; and when he saw him , he fell at his feet ,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’abanene b’esinagogi agacha, erieta riaye Yairo. Agachia komoorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye,

english: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed ; and she shall live .
ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”

english: And Jesus went with him ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
ekegusii: Bono Yeso akaimoka akagenda amo nere. Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, okamomiga‐miga korwa ase chinsemo chionsi.

english: And a certain woman , which had an issue of blood twelve years ,
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.

english: And had suffered many things of many physicians , and had spent all that she had , and was nothing bettered , but rather grew worse ,
ekegusii: Ere nigo achandegete mono ase amaboko y’abarwaria abange. Ere konya osiareire ebinto bionsi arenge nabio, tagwenigwa nonya ng’ake, korende obogima bwaye bokamentekana koba obobe kobua.

english: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .
ekegusii: Konya oigure amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agaeta ase omoganda korwa magega, agakuna eanga yaye,

english: For she said , If I may touch but his clothes , I shall be whole .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ateebete, “Kondakune chianga chiaye chioka, ningwene.”

english: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .
ekegusii: Erio kegima ensoko y’amanyinga aye egakama: akaigwa omobere oye ng’a ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.

english: Who had his dwelling among the tombs ; and no man could bind him , no, not with chains :
ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,

english: And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said , Who touched my clothes ?
ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a chinguru chiarure asare, akeonchora gati ase omoganda, akabora, “Ning’o okuna chianga chiane?”

english: And his disciples said unto him , Thou seest the multitude thronging thee , and sayest thou , Who touched me ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Norooche omoganda oyo buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”

english: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.

english: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .
ekegusii: Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.

english: And he said unto her , Daughter , thy faith hath made thee whole ; go in peace , and be whole of thy plague .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie, genda nomorembe, ogwene korwa ase oborwaire bwao.”

english: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso agendererete gokwana, abanto korwa ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’esinagogi bagaacha, bakaboora, “Enyaroka yao yakuure. Inki okona‐koroseria Omworokia rende?”

english: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue , Be not afraid , only believe .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tancha gotegerera ring’ana riria rigotebwa, agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’esinagogi, “Toiroka, egene rioka.”

english: And he suffered no man to follow him , save Peter , and James , and John the brother of James .
ekegusii: Gose tanchete monto onde amotuny’ane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.

english: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .
ekegusii: Bagaika enyomba y’omonene oria bw’esinagogi; akarora rirorooche, na abanto bakorera nokweumia okonge.

english: And when he was come in , he saith unto them , Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .
ekegusii: Agachia gosoa, akabateebia, “Inaki mogokora rirorooche na korera? Omwana takweti, korende nigo araire.”

english: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains , and the chains had been plucked asunder by him , and the fetters broken in pieces : neither could any man tame him .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge konya osibirwe ara aange ne chingataare na ebinyuri, abibutora ebinyuri biria, na kobuna‐buna chingataare chiria, na onde tarenge ore ne chinguru chi’okomobua.

english: And they laughed him to scorn . But when he had put them all out , he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel , and them that were with him , and entereth in where the damsel was lying .
ekegusii: Bakamosekerera. Korende gaikire kobasokia isiko bonsi, akaira ise omwana, na ng’ina, na aborokigwa baye batato abwo barenge amo nere, agasoa ime ase omwana oria arenge.

english: And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her , Talitha cumi ; which is , being interpreted , Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .
ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko omoiseke oria omoke, akamoteebia, “Talitha kumi”, okoonchorwa kwaye, “Tenena aye enyaroka.”

english: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .
ekegusii: Erio agwo omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka akagenda, ere konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere. Erio bagakumia ogokumia okonene.

english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .
ekegusii: Yeso akabakuurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachiika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.

english: And always , night and day , he was in the mountains , and in the tombs , crying , and cutting himself with stones .
ekegusii: Na botambe, botuko na mobaso, nao arenge ase chimbeera na ebitunwa, okona‐korera na gwekeba‐keba namagena.

english: But when he saw Jesus afar off , he ran and worshipped him ,
ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso korwa are, akaminyoka chimbero, akamosasiima;

english: And cried with a loud voice , and said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of the most high God ? I adjure thee by God , that thou torment me not .
ekegusii: agaaka eriogi, okobora, “Inaki inde naye aye Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ng’a tonchanda”,

english: For he said unto him , Come out of the man , thou unclean spirit .
ekegusii: ekiagera Yeso konya ogetebirie, “Aye ekerecha ki’eubi, karwe ase omonto oyo!”

english: And he asked him , What is thy name ? And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni abasigari chilifu isano nemo na goetani erombe y’ abanto, ekiagera nabange tore.”

english: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country ; and his disciples follow him .
ekegusii: Yeso akarua agwo, agaika ase ense yaye omonyene; aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.

english: And he said unto them , In what place soever ye enter into an house , there abide till ye depart from that place .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Enyomba ende yonsi ase moraroisigwe, mobeere aroro goika ekero moraimoke korwa aase aria.

english: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .
ekegusii: Bagasoka, bakarandia ng’a abanto baonchoke.

english: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .
ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “N’Elija.” Na abande bakaboora, “Oyo nomobani, gose nigo anga buna oyomo bw’ababani.”

english: But when Herod heard thereof , he said , It is John , whom I beheaded : he is risen from the dead .
ekegusii: Korende Herode agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oyio Yohana oria nanachete omotwe, obokire.”

english: For John had said unto Herod , It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife .
ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge ase ore komenyana na moka momura omino.”

english: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him , and would have killed him ; but she could not :
ekegusii: Nabo oria Herodia akaba nokogecha asare, akarigia komoita, korende tanyara,

english: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?
ekegusii: Na ekero gi’Esabato agachaaka kworokereria ase esinagogi; abange abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire aya? Mbong’aini ki obo aeirwe oyo? Ogokora gwe chinguru ki oko okonene kogokoreka ase amaboko aye?

english: For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .
ekegusii: ekiagera Herode nairogete Yohana, konya omanyire ng’a nomonto omooronge, omochenu, akamorenda. Nigo anchete komoigwa, nonya orenge goichana mono kamoigure.

english: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee ;
ekegusii: Rituko rigwenerete rigaika Herodia akanyora ribaga ekero Herode ase rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye ekero akora omoyega ase abatang’ani bare inse yaye, na abatang’ani b’esegi, na abanto abanene ba Galili.

english: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke bwe Herodia gasoa gotenga, akagokia Herode amo nabwo baikaransete nere ase omoyega. Omorwoti agateebia omoiseke oria, “Nsabe kende gionsi ekio origetie, na inche ninkoe.”

english: And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .
ekegusii: Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekio orarigie korwa ase ’nde ninkoe, nonya nekeng’ese ki’oborwoti bwane.”

english: And she went forth , and said unto her mother , What shall I ask ? And she said , The head of John the Baptist .
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ’ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”

english: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .
ekegusii: Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”

english: And the king was exceeding sorry ; yet for his oath’s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaba nomoichano mono, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye, na ase engencho y’abwo baikaransete ase omoyega, tarigetie kwanga.

english: And immediately the king sent an executioner , and commanded his head to be brought : and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,
ekegusii: Erio kegima omorwoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachiika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,

english: And brought his head in a charger , and gave it to the damsel : and the damsel gave it to her mother .
ekegusii: akayorenta ore ase esani, akayoa omoiseke oria, na omoiseke oria akayoa ng’ina.

english: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa ba Yohana baigwete amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka. Yeso okorageria abanto chilifu isano (Mat 14:13-14; Luk 9:10; Mat 14:15-21; Luk 9:11-17; Yoh 6:1-13)

english: Is not this the carpenter , the son of Mary , the brother of James , and Joses , and of Juda , and Simon ? and are not his sisters here with us ? And they were offended at him .
ekegusii: Oyo tari oria omobaachi, omwana o Mariamu, momura omwabo Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simioni, na basubati bamwabo tibari aiga seito?” Bakagechigwa nere.

english: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakairana ase Yeso, bakamoteebia onsi ayabakorete, na amang’ana onsi aya aborokereretie.

english: And he said unto them , Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while : for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Inaki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; goika Yeso n’aborokigwa baye tibanyora ribaga ri’okoria.

english: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately .
ekegusii: Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabaanto.

english: And the people saw them departing , and many knew him , and ran afoot thither out of all cities , and outwent them , and came together unto him .
ekegusii: Abanto bakabarora bakogenda, abange ase abwo bakabamanya, bakaminyoka bwango korwa ase emechie yonsi, batang’ane goika asare.

english: And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :
ekegusii: Goika chinsa chinyinge chi’omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.

english: Send them away , that they may go into the country round about , and into the villages , and buy themselves bread : for they have nothing to eat .
ekegusii: Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebinyoro, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”

english: He answered and said unto them , Give ye them to eat . And they say unto him , Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread , and give them to eat ?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe bae endagera.” Bakamobooria “Inee! Togende togore emegati ye chidinari amagana abere, tobae barie?”

english: He saith unto them , How many loaves have ye ? go and see . And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakaboora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”

english: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .
ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika aborokigwa baye baabaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.

english: And they sat down in ranks , by hundreds , and by fifties .
ekegusii: Bagaikaransa ase chindwaro, echinde rigana erimo na echinde emerongo etano.

english: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.

english: And they did all eat , and were filled .
ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota.

english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments , and of the fishes .
ekegusii: Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.

english: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men .
ekegusii: Na abasacha abariete emegati eria nigo barenge chilifu isano. Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro (Mat 14:22-27; Yoh 6:16-21)

english: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabetereria aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu goika Bethisaida ekero are koa omoganda ribaga ogende.

english: And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .
ekegusii: Magega gakorire gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.

english: And when even was come , the ship was in the midst of the sea , and he alone on the land .
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, obwato bokaba enyancha gati, na ere bweka ase ense enyomo.

english: And he saw them toiling in rowing ; for the wind was contrary unto them : and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them , walking upon the sea , and would have passed by them .
ekegusii: Akabarora bagwechanda bagwata amaache nemegango, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete. Koreng’ana ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko agacha ase bare, ogotaara igoro ase enyancha, akarigia kobaetania.

english: But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari, bagaaka eriogi,

english: And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .
ekegusii: Gose tanyara gokora ogokora gwe chinguru aroro, otatiga abegete amaboko aye igoro ase abarwaire bake, akabagwenia.

english: For they all saw him , and were troubled . And immediately he talked with them , and saith unto them , Be of good cheer : it is I ; be not afraid .
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abamorooche mbaondogete. Bwango Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabateebia, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”

english: And he went up unto them into the ship ; and the wind ceased : and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure , and wondered .
ekegusii: Akariina ime ase obwato ase bare; omwaga ogakira. Aborokigwa bagaichana mono,

english: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
ekegusii: ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana y’emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong’u. Yeso okogwenia abanto ba Genesareti (Mat 14:34-36)

english: And when they had passed over , they came into the land of Gennesaret , and drew to the shore .
ekegusii: Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeeka ekeroochi.

english: And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,
ekegusii: Bagachia gosoka korwa ase obwato, abanto bakamanya Yeso bwango,

english: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
ekegusii: bakaminyoka, bagaetanana ense eria yonsi, bagachaaka kobogoria abarwaire bare ase amarere abo, bakagenda kera aase baigwete ng’a nao are.

english: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
ekegusii: Kera aase are kogenda ase ebinyoro, gose emechie, gose emegondo, bakabeeka abarwaire ase chichiiro, bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eanga yaye; na abwo bonsi abamokunete bakagwena.

english: And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .
ekegusii: Agakumia ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo. Yeso Ogotoma Abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:5-15; Luk 9:1-6) Agaetanana ase ebinyoro biaetanaineo okworokereria.

english: And he called unto him the twelve , and began to send them forth by two and two ; and gave them power over unclean spirits ;
ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobatoma babere babere, akabaa okobua igoro ase ebirecha bi’eubi;

english: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey , save a staff only ; no scrip , no bread , no money in their purse :
ekegusii: akabakaania tibaira gento ase orogendo rwabo, otatiga enyimbo yoka. Tibaira nonya nomogati, nonya nesaro, nonya nechitaabu ase ebimoya biabo.

english: But be shod with sandals ; and not put on two coats .
ekegusii: Korende babeeke ebikoroto, ko tibeboyia chianga ibere.

english: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai na abande ase aborokia b’amariiko barwete Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.

english: But ye say , If a man shall say to his father or mother , It is Corban , that is to say , a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me ; he shall be free .
ekegusii: Korende inwe moteeba: Omonto karateebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde nakio Korbani (engencho yaye: Ebiarurwe ase Nyasae) —

english: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother ;
ekegusii: timori komotiga naende amokorere ise gose ng’ina ring’ana rinde.

english: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye.
ekegusii: Igo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino chia kare. Naende amange mwakorire mware koenana omogwekano bw’ayio.”

english: And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them , Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand :
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria omoganda naende, akayoteebia, “Nyigwe mwensi, naende manya:

english: There is nothing from without a man , that entering into him can defile him : but the things which come out of him , those are they that defile the man .
ekegusii: Tari egento kere isiko y’omonto, na gekomosoa, keranyare komobekera ogotacheneka, korende ebikorwa ase omonto nabio bikomobekera ogotacheneka. [

english: And when he was entered into the house from the people , his disciples asked him concerning the parable .
ekegusii: Goika agachia gosoa nyomba, gatigire omoganda, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria amang’ana y’omobayeeno oria.

english: And he saith unto them , Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it can not defile him ;
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nonya ninwe timori nobong’aini? Timomanyeti ng’a kera egento kere isiko y’omonto gokeramosoe, tigekonyara komobekera ogotacheneka,

english: Because it entereth not into his heart , but into the belly , and goeth out into the draught , purging all meats ?
ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebara?” (Ase ogoteeba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)

english: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .
ekegusii: Bakarora abande baborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.

english: And he said , That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.

english: For from within , out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , fornications , murders ,
ekegusii: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’ abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,

english: Thefts , covetousness , wickedness , deceit , lasciviousness , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , foolishness :
ekegusii: okogania okobe, obobe, obong’ainereria, oboenenu, ribero, oborami, obwerori, oboriri.

english: All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .
ekegusii: Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.” Okwegena kw’omokuungu oyomo (Mat 15:21-28)

english: And from thence he arose , and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and entered into an house , and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid .
ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda goika omochie o Turo. Agasoa ase enyomba, akarigia tamanyekana na monto, korende tanyara kobiseka.

english: For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
ekegusii: Erio agwo omokungu oyomo, omwana oye enyaroka obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi, akaigwa amang’ana aye, agacha akamogwera ase amagoro aye.

english: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria n’Omogiriki orenge, egesaku kiaye n’Omosurofenisia. Akamosaba amosererie ekerecha korwa ase enyaroka yaye.

english: But Jesus said unto her , Let the children first be filled : for it is not meet to take the children’s bread , and to cast it unto the dogs .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana, gotugutera chisese.”

english: And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs .
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nab’Omonene, nonya nechisese nyaro ye chimesa nigo chikoria amatori y’abana.”

english: And he said unto her , For this saying go thy way ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ase engencho ye ring’ana eri, genda bwoo, ekerecha kiarure ase enyaroka yao.”

english: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
ekegusii: (Inaki Abafarisai na Abayahudi bonsi tibakoragera ritang’ani bataraisaba amaboko. Igo babwatetie engencho y’abagaaka babo.

english: And when she was come to her house , she found the devil gone out , and her daughter laid upon the bed .
ekegusii: Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure. Yeso Okogwenia omonto orenge omotiino naende rimama (Mat 15:29-31)

english: And again , departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon , he came unto the sea of Galilee , through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarua agwo ase ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.

english: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .
ekegusii: Bakamorentera omonto ore omotiino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.

english: And he took him aside from the multitude , and put his fingers into his ears , and he spit , and touched his tongue ;
ekegusii: Yeso akamwatanana korwa ase omoganda bobisi, akabeeka ebiara biaye ase amato aye, agatwa amate, akamokuna oromeme.

english: And looking up to heaven , he sighed , and saith unto him , Ephphatha , that is , Be opened .
ekegusii: Erio akarigereria gochia igoro, agaita egekoe, akamoteebia, “Efatha,” engencho yaye, “Igoreka.”

english: And straightway his ears were opened , and the string of his tongue was loosed , and he spake plain .
ekegusii: Bwango amato aye agatiinoka, egesibo ki’oromeme rwaye gekororoba, agakwana buya.

english: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it ;
ekegusii: Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.

english: And were beyond measure astonished , saying , He hath done all things well : he maketh both the deaf to hear , and the dumb to speak .
ekegusii: Abanto bagakumia mono kobua, bakaboora, “Okorire onsi buya. Abarenge emetiino obatiinoire, na abarenge amamama bakwane.”

english: And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .
ekegusii: Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibetie. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)

english: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?
ekegusii: Bono Abafarisai baria na aborokia b’amariiko bakabooria Yeso, “Nase ki aborokigwa bao batari kobwata chingencho chi’abagaaka, korende bakoragera namaboko are neriko?”

english: Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa, bakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.

english: For laying aside the commandment of God , ye hold the tradition of men , as the washing of pots and cups : and many other such like things ye do .
ekegusii: Igo mogotiga richiiko ria Nyasae, mwabwata chingencho chia Mwanyabaanto.

english: And he said unto them , Full well ye reject the commandment of God , that ye may keep your own tradition .
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Mwangire richiiko ria Nyasae ng’a monyare kobwata chingencho chiaino.

english: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia,

english: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples , and came into the parts of Dalmanutha .
ekegusii: Akabaa ribaga bagende, na erio bwango akariina obwato amo naborokigwa baye, akagenda chinsemo chia Dalumanuta. Abafarisai bakoboria baorokigwe egekone (Mat 16:1-4; Luk 12:54-56)

english: And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .
ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu. Yeso ogotogonyera obouko bw’aborokigwa (Mat 16:5-12)

english: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread , neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf .
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.

english: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
ekegusii: Bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Nigo agokwana igo ase engencho totari n’emegati.”

english: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them , Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabateebia, “Inaki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timokomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?

english: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ? They say unto him , Twelve .
ekegusii: Ekero nasamunyorete emegati eria etano nkaa baria chilifu isano, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangererete biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Ikomi na bibere.”

english: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :
ekegusii: “Naroreire abanto aba amaabera, ekiagera barabwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;

english: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ? And they said , Seven .
ekegusii: “Na eria etano na ebere nkaa baria chilifu inye, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Mbitano na bibere.”

english: And he said unto them , How is it that ye do not understand ?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki motaramanya?” Yeso okogwenia omonto omouko agwo Bethisaida

english: And he cometh to Bethsaida ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .
ekegusii: Bagaika Bethisaida. Bakarentera Yeso omonto omouko, bakamosorora amokune.

english: And he took the blind man by the hand , and led him out of the town ; and when he had spit on his eyes , and put his hands upon him , he asked him if he saw ought .
ekegusii: Yeso akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’ekenyoro, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamobooria, “Kwarorire gento?”

english: And he looked up , and said , I see men as trees , walking .
ekegusii: Omouko oria akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Narorire abanto, ko nigo banga buna emete bakogenda.”

english: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes , and made him look up : and he was restored , and saw every man clearly .
ekegusii: Erio naende Yeso akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase amaiso aye. Omouko oria akarigereria mono, akagwena, akarora ebinto bionsi buya.

english: And he sent him away to his house , saying , Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda bwoo, tosoa nonya nekenyoro!” Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mat 16:13-20; Luk 9:18-21)

english: And Jesus went out , and his disciples , into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi : and by the way he asked his disciples , saying unto them , Whom do men say that I am ?
ekegusii: Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebinyoro bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”

english: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .
ekegusii: ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo n’enchara, nabagoye ’nchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”

english: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto amanya amang’ana aye. Yeso okobana ogokwa na okobokigwa kwaye (Mat 16:21-23; Luk 9:22)

english: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka koborokereria, ng’a negwenerete Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa, na magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.

english: And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
ekegusii: Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania.

english: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying , Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akarigereria aborokigwa baye, agatogonyera Petero, akabora, “Irana magega y’ane Saitani, ekiagera tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mat 16:24-28; Luk 9:23-27)

english: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?
ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye?

english: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
ekegusii: Gose inki omonto ararue ribaga ri’omoyo oye?

english: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation ; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels .
ekegusii: Inaki oyio oranyare kondorera obosooku inche, na amang’ana aane, ase ekegori eke ki’obotomani na ebibe, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto namororere obosooku ere, ekero agocha n’obonene bwa Ise amo nabamalaika abachenu.”

english: And his disciples answered him , From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness ?
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Inaki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”

english: And he asked them , How many loaves have ye ? And they said , Seven .
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”

english: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them ; and they did set them before the people .
ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayebagere abanto, na barabwo bakayegagera omoganda.

english: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .
ekegusii: Igo barenge ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo. Gachisesenirie, akabora, “Nechi bagagere”!

english: So they did eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets .
ekegusii: Bakaria, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere.

english: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .
ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo barenge ang’e chilifu inye (4,000).

english: And he said unto them , Verily I say unto you , That there be some of them that stand here , which shall not taste of death , till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power .
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Mbare abanto bande ase aba bateneine aiga, abataetere amakweri goika barorire oborwoti bwa Nyasae bogocha ne chinguru.” Okoonchoka ekieni kwa Yeso (Mat 17:1-13; Luk 9:28-36)

english: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .
ekegusii: Bakabwata ring’ana riria, bakaboorania barabwo ase barabwo, ng’a okoboka korwa ase abakuure, engencho yaye ninki.

english: And he answered and told them , Elias verily cometh first , and restoreth all things ; and how it is written of the Son of man , that he must suffer many things , and be set at nought .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nekeene Elija ogocha ritang’ani, na koroisia onsi; korende amo naya, ekiagera ariikire ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachandwe namange na gochaaywa?

english: But I say unto you , That Elias is indeed come , and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed , as it is written of him .
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie: Elija oikire gocha, na barabwo bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie, buna ariikeretwe.” Yeso Okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mat 17:14-21; Luk 9:37-43)

english: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
ekegusii: Kobaikire ase aborokigwa bande, bakarora omoganda omonene obaetanaine; aborokia b’amariiko bakaengererania nabarabwo.

english: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi, ogachia korora Yeso, ogakumia mono; abwo bakamochiera bwango, bakamokwania.

english: And he asked the scribes , What question ye with them ?
ekegusii: Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”

english: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit ;
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, namorenta omomura one ase ore, obwatire nekerecha kemokorete rimama;

english: And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out ; and they could not .
ekegusii: ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”

english: He answereth him , and saith , O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, nimbe nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aa!”

english: And they brought him unto him : and when he saw him , straightway the spirit tare him ; and he fell on the ground , and wallowed foaming .
ekegusii: Bakamorenta asare. Ekero kiarora Yeso, bwango ekerecha keria gekaigusia omomura oria, na ere akagwa inse akegaragaria, agasokia risombogoku.

english: And he asked his father , How long is it ago since this came unto him ? And he said , Of a child .
ekegusii: Yeso akaboria ise, “Nkorwa kero ki anyoretwe naya?” Agateeba, “Nkorwa obwana bwaye.

english: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .
ekegusii: Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amaache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amaabera, otokonye.”

english: Jesus said unto him , If thou canst believe , all things are possible to him that believeth .
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Koranyare! Onsi nigo akonyarekana asare ere oyobwegenire.”

english: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe ; help thou mine unbelief .
ekegusii: Bwango ise omwana oria agaaka eriogi, akarera, akabora, “Negenire, korende okwegena kwane n’ogoke nkoonye!”

english: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him , Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a omoganda ngosangererekana ore bwango, agakania ekerecha keria ki’eubi, akageteebia, “Aye ekerecha rimama na egetiino, inche nagochiikire, morwe, tomoiranera naende!”

english: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him: and he was as one dead ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
ekegusii: Erio gekarera, gekamogaragaria mono gekamorwa. Omwana oria akaba buna oyokuure, goika abange bakaboora, “Okuure.”

english: But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up ; and he arose .
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamobwata okoboko, akamoimokia, na ere agatenena.

english: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
ekegusii: Gasoire ase enyomba, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria bobisi, “Inaki intwe totanyara kogeseria?”

english: And he said unto them , This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekerecha kenga buna eke tigekonyara korwa ase ring’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ase ogosaba.” Yeso ogokwana naende eriakabere igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 17:22-23; Luk 9:43-45)

english: And his raiment became shining , exceeding white as snow ; so as no fuller on earth can white them .
ekegusii: Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omosibia onde ase ense atanyare gochisibia chibe chindabu.

english: And they departed thence , and passed through Galilee ; and he would not that any man should know it .
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aria, na’borokigwa baye bagaeta gati‐gati ya Galili; Yeso tancha omonto amanye ase are,

english: For he taught his disciples , and said unto them , The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
ekegusii: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia ng’a, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke magega y’amatuko atato.”

english: But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria. Ning’o ore omonene? (Mat 18:1-5; Luk 9:46-48)

english: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them , What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?
ekegusii: Bagaika Kapernaumu. Ekero arenge nyomba ime, Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mware koamererania inchera?”

english: And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,
ekegusii: Akabogoria omwana, akamotenenia gati‐gati yaabo, akamoagata, akabateebia,

english: And John answered him , saying , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name , and he followeth not us : and we forbad him , because he followeth not us .
ekegusii: Yohana akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao; tokamokania, ekiagera tare gototunyana intwe.”

english: But Jesus said , Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Timomokania, ekiagera monto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ase erieta riane, anyare erio bwango gonteeba bobe,

english: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
ekegusii: Bakaorokerwa na Elija amo na Musa; na barabwo nigo barenge gokwana na Yeso.

english: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me , it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he were cast into the sea .
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oragere oyomo bw’aba abake abanyegenete akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, na gotugutwa ime y’enyancha.

english: Where their worm dieth not , and the fire is not quenched .
ekegusii: naboigo amakonde abo tagokwa].

english: And if thy foot offend thee , cut it off : it is better for thee to enter halt into life , than having two feet to be cast into hell , into the fire that never shall be quenched :
ekegusii: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n’amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu [ase omorero o kare na kare

english: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .
ekegusii: “Inaki kera omonto nabekwe omoonyo ase omorero.

english: And Peter answered and said to Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omwarimu, mbuya intwe koba aiga, tiga tokore ebigutu bitato: ekemo ekiao, ekemo kia Musa, na ekemo ki’Elija.”

english: For he wist not what to say ; for they were sore afraid .
ekegusii: Inaki tamanyete eki agokwana, ekiagera babete nomoondoko omonene.

english: And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .
ekegusii: Erio bwango kobarigereirie aria na aaria, tibarora monto onde, otatiga Yeso bweka amo nabarabwo.

english: And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .
ekegusii: Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatorera monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kabokire korwa ase abakuure.

english: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .
ekegusii: Buna korengana amagwa asisikaine na obonyansi obwomo inwe abatindu mosambwe mosire!

english: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD , a wicked counsellor .
ekegusii: Korwa ase ore, aye Ninawi, nachete korwa aroro omonto gete oichire n’emeroberio y’obobe, ere akaroberia mamincha y’Omonene. Ase Abayuda

english: Thus saith the LORD ; Though they be quiet , and likewise many , yet thus shall they be cut down , when he shall pass through . Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba ase abanto baye Abaisraeli: “Nonya Abasiria bare abakong’u naende abange ina baitwe nagosirigwa. Abanto bane ’nabakorete mogachandeka, korende inche tinkoirorera gokora ayio naende.

english: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder .
ekegusii: Bono ninkoore chinguru chi’Abaasiria korwa igoro ase more naende nimbutore chinyororo chiria chibasibete inwe.” Ase Ninawi

english: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave ; for thou art vile .
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene achiikire igoro y’Abaasiria: “Tibagotwara ororeria roragendererie erieta riabo. Inche ninsarie emegwekano ere ase chi’Hekalu chi’ebinyasae biabo. Ningendererete koroisia oboina ase Abaasiria-barabwo tibagwenereti koba moyo!” Ase Abayuda
