ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari nonya noyomo, oranyare korora ense eria narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Onde tari ase abwo banchaayete oranyare koyerora.

english: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley .) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
ekegusii: Na bono ekiagera Abaameleki na Abakaanani bamenyete ime ase amakura, inwe ankio moonchoke, mochake koirana gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri.” Omonene akaa abanto abwo bamwemurunganeretie egesusuro

english: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me.
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri omoganda oyo omobe oremurunganie ase ’nde? Naigure Abaisraeli banyemurunganeirie.

english: Say unto them, As truly as I live , saith the LORD , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you:
ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Buna inche inde moyo, naigure amang’ana ayio mwakwanire, ayio naro ndabakorere.

english: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land , to fall by the sword , that our wives and our children should be a prey ? were it not better for us to return into Egypt ?
ekegusii: Ninki gekogera Omonene agotoira ase ense eria tochie goitwa ase esegi? Abakungu baito, na abana baito, nigo bagochia gwoswa n’ababisa baito. Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwairana gochia Misiri.”

english: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .
ekegusii: Ase ense eria nabarierete eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee, onde tari ase more orachie komenyao, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

english: But your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , them will I bring in , and they shall know the land which ye have despised .
ekegusii: Korende abana baino, abwo mwateebete ng’a nabooswe, aba nabwo ndaire aroro, na barabwo mbamenye ase ense eria inwe mwangire.

english: But as for you, your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .
ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo morakwere aiga ase erooro, na emebere yaino esirere aiga.

english: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land , even forty days , each day for a year , shall ye bear your iniquities , even forty years , and ye shall know my breach of promise .
ekegusii: Inwe nigo morachandeke ase emiaka emerongo ene, omwaka oyomo ase kera rituko mwarenge koroota ense eria, nainwe namonyare komanya ng’a inki gekoba ekero nkoba mamincha yaino.

english: I the LORD have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nakwanire. Ekeene ninkore egento eke ase omoganda oyo omobe osangererekanire amo, na obeire mamincha y’ane. Aiga ase erooro ninsirie abanto aba, aa ase erooro nao barakwere.”

english: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land ,
ekegusii: Abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria barentete amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria, bakagera omoganda bwonsi okemurungania ase Omonene.

english: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land , died by the plague before the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabaaka noborwaire bogoita, na barabwo bagakwera agwo ase obosio bwaye.

english: But Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of the men that went to search the land , lived still .
ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, barabwo boka bagatigwa bare moyo korwa ase abanto baria bagendete koroota ense eria. Abaisraeli bagoteema gosoa Kaanani engaki entang’ani (Okoir 1:41-46)

english: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi Omonene akwanete, na abanto bakarera mono nobororo.

english: And they said one to another , Let us make a captain , and let us return into Egypt .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania, “Tochore omonto oyomo abe omoraai oito, toirane Misiri.”

english: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised : for we have sinned .
ekegusii: Ase emambia ye rituko ria kabere bakaimoka, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagakwana, “Rora twachire, nao tore aa, bono twanchire kogeenda ase ense eri’Omonene atoteebetie. Intwe twakorire ebibe.”

english: And Moses said , Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD ? but it shall not prosper .
ekegusii: Korende Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki bono mogosaria ogochika kw’Omonene. Timokonyara konyora ogosesenigwa ase okogeendao.

english: Go not up , for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies .
ekegusii: Timobaisa kogeenda; moise gokora igo, rirorio nigo mogochia goitwa n’ababisa baino, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nainwe.

english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the LORD , therefore the LORD will not be with you.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo bosio bwaino Abaameleki na Abakaanani mbareo. Nigo bagochia kobarwania baababue na kobakenya, ekiagera inwe mwaonchokire, mwangire komoigwera Omonene; nere takonyara koba amo nainwe.”

english: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .
ekegusii: Korende bagekora abaremu, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, nonya Esanduki eria yare ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene yatigarete ase egetwori, na Musa nao atigarete.

english: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah .
ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagatirimboka bakarwania Abaisraeli abwo, bakababua na kobaseria, bakababwatia goika Horima.

english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama ase obosio bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli osangererekanete.

english: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, abwo barenge amo ne chirooti + 14:6 chirooti: engencho yaye omotuki ase okomanya amang’ana bobisi chiria chiarootete ense eria, bagatandora chianga chiabo,

english: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel , saying , The land , which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land .
ekegusii: bagateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Ense eria twataarete ase okoyeroota nigo ere ense engiya mono.

english: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land , and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
ekegusii: Onye Omonene okogokigwa naintwe, na gotoyea toyeire, ense eria n’entenenku ere namabeere naamooke.

english: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD .
ekegusii: na orue edivai ebituba bibere ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa. Okwo n’okoruegwa kogosambwa n’omorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

english: Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
ekegusii: “Ebinto ebi nabio biraruegwe amo na kera eeri, gose emingichi, gose kera emanwa y’eng’ondi gose ey’embori.

english: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaro bwe ching’iti echio chiraruegwe chibe ebing’wanso oraabe, n’okoruegwa kw’endagera naboigo koraabe.

english: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi ababiare nabwo barabwatie omooroberio oyio, ekero bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kobe risimu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

english: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; as ye do , so he shall do .
ekegusii: Onye omogeni ore amo nainwe, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, nere oganetie korenta okoruegwa kwaye kogosambwa n’omorero, kobe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene, nigo arabwatie omooroberio oria oria obekirwe ase more.

english: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano oyio ogochika nokomo koraabe ase more na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino. Okwo nakobe ogochika koragenderere botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Buna inwe more, naboigo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino arabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria ase ’ngochia kobaira,

english: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land , ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: na mokoria endagera y’ense eria, morente okoruegwa kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations , which I give unto you,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie buna barachie gokora ekero baraike ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa.

english: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering : as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor , so shall ye heave it.
ekegusii: Ekero moraroisie omogati korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kw’endagera, namoyorente ase Omonene obe okoruegwa kw’ogotongora buna mokomoruera endagera korwa ase ekeooreri kiaino.

english: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations .
ekegusii: Ase ebiaare biaino bionsi morentere Omonene okoruegwa korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kwaino.

english: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses ,
ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng’a mwamochire kobwatia amachiiko ande onsi Omonene achiikire Musa,

english: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses , from the day that the LORD commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations ;
ekegusii: gose abanto baino tibarakora onsi ay’Omonene achiikire goetera ase Musa, gochaakera rituko riri’Omonene aruete amachiiko, na kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation , that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour unto the LORD , with his meat offering , and his drink offering , according to the manner , and one kid of the goats for a sin offering .
ekegusii: Onye okomocha okwo gwakorirwe ase ogotancha, na ase ogotamanya kw’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, rirorio barue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Amo nekio barente okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire, amo negoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

english: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance : and they shall bring their offering , a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD , and their sin offering before the LORD , for their ignorance :
ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, na barabwo ’mbaaberwe, ekiagera okomocha okwo nigo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha. Barabwo barentire okoruegwa kwabo, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, naboigo barentire ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe ase Omonene ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.

english: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel , and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance .
ekegusii: Naboigo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, bonsi ’nabaaberwe, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo baabareretwe okomocha koria gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.

english: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD , to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase omonto oria okorire ebibe atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.

english: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance , both for him that is born among the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
ekegusii: Nigo moraabe n’ogochika okomo ase oyio okorire ebibe mosiabano, atancheti, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino.

english: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering , or a sacrifice in performing a vow , or in a freewill offering , or in your solemn feasts , to make a sweet savour unto the LORD , of the herd , or of the flock :
ekegusii: Bateebie: ’Monyare komoruera Omonene eng’iti korwa ase chiombe, gose korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, chibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi ase ogoikerania eira mwariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaino, gose ase chingaki chichiikire ase Amatuko aino Amanene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

english: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
ekegusii: “Korende omonto orakore gento kende gionsi moeneno, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oyio igo oramire Omonene, ere oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.

english: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD , and hath broken his commandment , that soul shall utterly be cut off ; his iniquity shall be upon him.
ekegusii: Oyio ochaayire ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende osaririe ogochika kwaye, takororerwa amaabera. Goika aatananwe kegima, nere abarerwe ebibe biaye.” Omonto Okobwatwa Ase Ogosaria Esabato

english: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.

english: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .
ekegusii: Abanto baria bamonyorete bakamoira ase Musa na Aroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi.

english: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him.
ekegusii: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , The man shall be surely put to death : all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”

english: And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omoganda bakamosokia isiko y’egetwori, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa, buna Omonene achiigete Musa. Amachiiko Igoro Y’amasugunia

english: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD , and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
ekegusii: Ekiagera amasugunia ayio nabe ekeinyorio ase more. Ekero mokoyarigereria monyare koinyora amachiiko ane onsi na koyabwata. Naboigo moranyare gokonywa, erinde mobe abegenwa ase ’nde na gwetanga korwa ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiaino na amaiso aino.

english: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil .
ekegusii: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo,

english: That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .
ekegusii: Ase igo moinyore na kobwata amachiiko ane onsi, nainwe ’namobe abachenu ase ’nde inche Nyasae oino.

english: I am the LORD your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the LORD your God .
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.”

english: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .
ekegusii: n’edivai egetuba ekemo kebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, amo na kera emanwa y’eng’ondi; onye nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi.

english: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .
ekegusii: Ekero okorua emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso, orente amo nero obosie obonuke ebimunu bine, bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa morue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.

english: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the LORD :
ekegusii: Ekero okorua eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi, onye nase ogoikerania eira kwariete, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene,

english: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .
ekegusii: orue amo n’eeri eria obosie obonuke ebimunu bitan’omo, bwochoganirie n’amaguta ebituba bibere,

english: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoete aye amo n’Abalawi bamino ribaga mobeere ang’e nere. Inee! Igo mokorigia obokuani boigo?

english: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD : and what is Aaron , that ye murmur against him?
ekegusii: Aroni ninki aisaine inwe mwamwemurunganirie mamincha yaye? Ase ayio, mwerende, aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia. Igo mwasangererekanire mamincha y’Omonene.”

english: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Datani na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu. Barabwo bakairaneria, “Intwe titogocha.

english: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
ekegusii: Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu ase ore ng’a gwatorusetie korwa ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, na ogatorenta aa, erinde otoite tokwere aa ase erooro eye? Na bono aye nigo ogwekora koba omonene igoro ase tore?

english: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .
ekegusii: Naende nonya naboigo, aye totorenteti ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, gose totoeti emiando y’amaremo na emegondo y’emesabibu. Inee! Nigo otagete kobaukoria abanto aba bonsi? Intwe titogocha.”

english: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the LORD , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa mono, agateebia Omonene, “Tobaisa gwanchera ebing’wanso biabo. Inche tindaira nonya netigere yabo eyemo, gose tindakorera nonya noyomo obo bobe.”

english: And Moses said unto Korah , Be thou and all thy company before the LORD , thou, and they, and Aaron , to morrow :
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Kora, Ankio aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia mochiche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aroni nere nache boigo.

english: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers ; thou also, and Aaron , each of you his censer .
ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino aimokie orogio rw’aye rw’omorero, na arobekere ubani na kororenta ase obosio bw’Omonene. Chindogio chionsi nigo chirabe amagana abere, na merongo etano; naye orente orwao, na Aroni nere arente orwaye.’

english: And they took every man his censer , and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron .
ekegusii: Ase ayio kera omonto akaimokia orogio rw’aye, akarobeka omorero, na igoro yaye ubani, bagaacha bagatenena ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Musa na Aroni bagatenenenao boigo.

english: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation .
ekegusii: Erio Kora agasangereria omoganda bwonsi, na barabwo bagatenena bosio bwa Musa na Aroni agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera omoganda bwonsi.

english: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :
ekegusii: bakabwatana, bakaanga koigwera Musa. Amo nabwo ’mbarengeo abanto bande b’Abaisraeli, amagana abere, namerongo etano. Abwo barenge abaraai bachorire korwa ase omosangererekano, bamanyekanete, naende basikire.

english: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .
ekegusii: “Tigera, morue ase abanto b’omoganda oyo, erinde mbasirie ara rimo.”

english: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateeba, “Aye ’Nyasae, Nyasae okorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, Inee, omonto oyomo gakorire ebibe, naye igo okogechigwa n’omoganda oyo bwonsi?”

english: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .
ekegusii: “Kwana n’omoganda bw’ abanto oyoteebie: Tigera morue aase aetanaine chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu.”

english: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram ; and the elders of Israel followed him .
ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, bakageenda ase Datani na Abiiramu.

english: And he spake unto the congregation , saying , Depart , I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men , and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, “Eatanane, nabasoroire, morue ase chiema chi’ abanto aba abakori amabe. Timobaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi kiabo; moise kogekuna nigo mogochia gosirigwa ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi.”

english: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram , on every side : and Dathan and Abiram came out , and stood in the door of their tents , and their wives , and their sons , and their little children .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bageatanana bakarua ase chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu. Datani na Abiiramu bagasoka isiko, amo nabakungu babo na abana babo, abanene na abake, bagatenena ase ebisoero bie chiema chiabo.

english: And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Ase aya namomanye ’ng’a Omonene ontomire gokora aya onsi, naende ng’a tari inche omonyene nebegete gokora buna inyanchete.

english: If these men die the common death of all men , or if they be visited after the visitation of all men ; then the LORD hath not sent me.
ekegusii: Onye abanto aba bagochia gokwa buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi agokwa, gose bakonyora egesusuro buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi akonyora, rirori’Omonene tantometi.

english: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy , every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD ?
ekegusii: Barabwo bakabwatana, bakaba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, bakabateebia, “Bono ayio aisanire. Abanto bonsi b’omoganda oyo nigo bare abachenu; Omonene nigo are amo na kera oyomo. Nase ki rende inwe mweimokereirie igoro na mogwekora abanene igoro y’omosangererekano Omonene?”

english: But if the LORD make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende onye Omonene ogochia gokora egento ekeyia, erinde riroba ritandoke, rimere abanto abwo amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi, na barabwo barimere riroba ime bare moyo, bagende gochia aase abakuure, erio ’namomanye ng’a abanto aba bachaayire Omonene.”

english: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, riroba rigatandoka inse yabo.

english: And the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their houses , and all the men that appertained unto Korah , and all their goods .
ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka, rikabamera, amo ne chiamate chiabo, na abanto bonsi ababwatetie Kora, amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi.

english: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation .
ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bonsi bakamerwa bare moyo, bakageenda gochia aase abakuure, boigo n’ebinto biabo, erio riroba rikairanerana, rikabatindeka, na barabwo bagasirigwa bakarua ase omosangererekano oria.

english: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ang’e nabarabwo bagatama, bakarera, bakobora, “Boigo naintwe riroba ndibaise gotomera.”

english: And there came out a fire from the LORD , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
ekegusii: Erio omorero okarua ase Omonene, ogasamba abanto baria amagana abere, na merongo etano, abwo konya barentire ubani. Chindogio chi’omorero

english: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder ; for they are hallowed .
ekegusii: “Teebia Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, ng’a arusie chindogio chiria chi’omorero korwa ase omorero oyio ogwoka, na omorero oyio ayosiare gochia aare. Chindogio chiria chi’omorero konya chiabeire chinchenu.

english: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the LORD , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Chindogio echio chi’ abanto baria basirete ekiagera bakorete ebibe, tiga chisunyuntwe chiroisigwe, chibe ekemumeko gekomumeka egesasiimero, ekiagera abanto baria nigo bachiruete ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio chindogio echio konya chiabeire chinchenu. Echio nachio ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera.”

english: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers , wherewith they that were burnt had offered ; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar :
ekegusii: Nabo Eleazari Omokuani akaimokia chindogio chiria chi’etai, echio abanto baria omorero osambete konya barentire ase obosio bw’Omonene. Echio chikaroisigwa, chikaba ekemumeko ki’egesasiimero.

english: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :
ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio akagwa inse maumama.

english: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the LORD ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Ekio gekaba ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera Abaisraeli, ng’a nonya noyomo otari Omokuani, otari bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, tabaisa goika ang’e gosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aise gokora bo, nasire buna Kora amo n’abanto baria bamobwatetie basirete. Aya onsi nigo akoretwe buna Omonene konya achiikire Eleazari goetera ase Musa. Aroni Ogotooria Abanto

english: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron , saying , Ye have killed the people of the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere, omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okemurunganeria Musa na Aroni, okabora. “Ninwe mwaitire abanto ba Omonene.”

english: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron , that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation : and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared .
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda oria konya osangererekanire amo ase okoba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria Eema y’Omosangererekano bakarora riire riayetubire, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka.

english: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagaacha bosio bw’Eema eria.

english: Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .
ekegusii: “Karue ase omoganda oyo, otigere gochia aare, erio inche ’mbasirie ara rimo.” Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.

english: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD ; the plague is begun .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia orogio rwao rw’ogosambera ubani rusia omorero ase egesasiimero oyobeke igoro yaye, erio obeeke ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, oroimokie ogende bwango ase omoganda bw’ abanto, erinde okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, ekiagera Omonene obeire nendamwamu: amaakwa achakire goita abanto.”

english: And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation ; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
ekegusii: Aroni akaimokia orogio rwa ubani buna Musa amoteebetie, akaminyoka gochia ase egati y’omoganda oria. Amaakwa konya achakire ase egati y’ abanto, korende Aroni akabeeka ubani ase orogio roria, agakora okobwatanigwa ase bare.

english: And he stood between the dead and the living ; and the plague was stayed .
ekegusii: Ekero Aroni atenenete gati gati ya baria bakwete na baria barenge moyo, amaakwa aria agatiga goita abanto.

english: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .
ekegusii: Abanto konya bakuure nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na inye, na magana atano abere (14,700). Baria bakwete ase ogosaria gwa Kora tibarenge ase omobaro oyo.

english: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company , saying , Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy ; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabateebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyio achorire amoike ang’e.

english: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the plague was stayed .
ekegusii: Ekero amaakwa atigete goita abanto, Aroni akairana ase Musa agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: This do ; Take you censers , Korah , and all his company ;
ekegusii: Ankio mambia moche mokore iga: Aye Kora amo na bonsi abagokobwatia, moimokie chindogio,

english: And put fire therein , and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow : and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose , he shall be holy : ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi .
ekegusii: mwanchare omorero mobekeo, na igoro y’omorero oyio mobeke ubani, naende mochirente ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omonto ori’Omonene arachore, nere oyio oraabe oria omochenu. Inwe Abalawi, bono ayio abaisanire.”

english: And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you, ye sons of Levi :
ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateeba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!

english: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo morooche ng’a negento egesinini ase more ng’a Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli obaatananire inwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, na kobarenta mobe ang’e nere, na komokorera Omonene ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, na gotenenera omoganda bw’ abanto, na kobakorera?

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony , to be kept for a token against the rebels ; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, Irania enyimbo ya Aroni ebeere agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere noborori, erinde egachwe ebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera abanto batari koigwera. Nabo okirie okwemurungania kwabo ase ’nde, timbaisa koigwa amang’ana buna ayio, mbaise kobaita bakwe.

english: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
ekegusii: Naboigo Musa akorete buna Omonene amochiigete.

english: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses , saying , Behold, we die , we perish , we all perish .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagateebia Musa, “Rora, intwe twaikeire omoerio oito, tw akuure, twasirire intwe twensi.

english: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die : shall we be consumed with dying ?
ekegusii: Kera omonto ogoika ang’e ase Obomenyo bw’Omonene, goika akwe. Inee! Ntwensi pi torakwe?”

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers , of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods : write thou every man’s name upon his rod .
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bakoe chinyimbo chiabo, eyemo ase kera omotang’ani o kera egesaku kiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, Oriike erieta ria kera oyomo ase enyimbo yaye.

english: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi : for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Oriike erieta ria Aroni ase enyimbo y’egesaku kia Lawi. Kera omotang’ani bwe chiamate chia kera egesaku abe n’enyimbo eyemo.

english: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you.
ekegusii: Erio obeke chinyimbo echio ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano bosio bw’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, agwo ase inche ndaumerane nainwe.

english: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you.
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’omonto oria inche ’ndachoore neseboke. Ase enchera eyio ninkore Abaisraeli batige kwemurungania mamincha y’ane, naende ningere batige kwemurungania mamincha yaino.”

english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one , according to their fathers’ houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabateebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Aroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.

english: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness .
ekegusii: Musa akaira chinyimbo chiria ime ase Eema y’Oborori, agachibekao ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agachisokia isiko chinyimbo chiria chionsi korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, agachirenta ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Abwo bagachirigereria, na kera omonto akabogoria enyimbo yaye.

english: And the LORD said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye na abamura bao amo n’abanto b’eamate yaino nigo morabarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorerwa ase obokoreri ime y’Aase Aachenu, naende aye na abamura bao inamobarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorwa ase obokuani bwaino.

english: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore ase more nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio n’ebinto ebichenu ase ore.

english: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift , with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel : I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever : every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
ekegusii: “Boigo nakoeire okoruegwa Abaisraeli barabe bakorenta ase ’nde buna ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusia. Nakoeire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, ’nabibe ebiaino kogenderera botambe. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.

english: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD , them have I given thee.
ekegusii: “Nakoeire kera ekere ekiya mono ki’ogotongora oko Abaisraeli bakondetera: Amaguta y’amazeituni, na edivai, n’endagera.

english: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the LORD , shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
ekegusii: Okwama gwonsi kw’eritang’ani ase ebinto bionsi bigokina ase ense yabo, okwo bakondetera, ’nakobe okwao. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.

english: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the LORD , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .
ekegusii: “Kera omwana omotangi bakorua ase ’nde ’nabe oyoo, na kera eng’iti entangi boigo, korende nonya naboigo bwanche embooria ase omwana omotangi o Mwanyabaanto, na ase chintangi chie ching’iti chiria chitachenegeti.

english: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem , according to thine estimation , for the money of five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , which is twenty gerahs .
ekegusii: Abana baboorigwe ekero bakoorire omotienyi oyomo, ne ching’iti boigo. Aye nobeke rigori ri’okobooria, ribe chisekeli isano chi’echifeta, koreng’ana nesekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera ibere.)

english: But the firstling of a cow , or the firstling of a sheep , or the firstling of a goat , thou shalt not redeem ; they are holy : thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar , and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a sweet savour unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chintangi chi’echiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, tichikoboorigwa. Echio nchiatananwe ase ’nde. Amanyinga abo oyanyororokererie igoro ase egesasiimero, na ebitinya biabo obisambe bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rikongwenera.

english: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
ekegusii: Korende chinyama chiabo amo ne ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama kia borio, echio nachio echiao.

english: All the heave offerings of the holy things , which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD , have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever : it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
ekegusii: “Ebiegwa bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli barandetere inche Omonene nakobieire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, bibe ebitari biaino kera ekero. Okwo nokobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’omonyoo gwa kare na kare ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, okwo nakorire naye na ororeria rwao.”

english: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
ekegusii: Renta Abalawi bamino, egesaku gia iso, barabwo bakore emeremo aroro amo naye. Abwo bagokorere aye amo nabamura bao, ekero mogokora emeremo agwo bosio bw’Eema eria ere noborori.

english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye tokonyora omwando bw’orogongo ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande. Tokoegwa ensemo ende yonsi ase egati yabo. Inche ninche ensemo yao, naende omwando oo, ase egati y’Abaisraeli. Egetari Ki’Abalawi

english: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .
ekegusii: Korwa bono na kogenderera Abaisraeli bande tibaabaisa goika ang’e n’Eema eria. Baise gokora bo, nigo barabe nebibe, erio bakwe.

english: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .
ekegusii: Korende Abalawi barabwo nigo barakore emeremo ase Eema y’omosangererekano, okomocha kw’ebibe gokoraabeo nakobarwe igoro ase bare. Okwo nakwo koraabe ogochika ase bare kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare. Barabwo tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

english: But the tithes of the children of Israel , which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD , I have given to the Levites to inherit : therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance .
ekegusii: Ensemo ya ikomi eye Abaisraeli bakondetera buna okoruegwa kwabo nayeire Abalawi ebe eyabo. Ase ayio, nabateebirie ng’a tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande.” Ensemo ya ikomi y’Abalawi

english: Thus speak unto the Levites , and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance , then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD , even a tenth part of the tithe .
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abalawi, obateebie: Ekero mokonyora ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Abaisraeli, eri’Omonene abaeire ebe eyaino, erio morusie ensemo ya ikomi y’okoruegwa okwo, moyerentere Omonene.

english: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .
ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo inwe morarue, nigo korabarwe ase more buna n’okoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase ebiooreri biaino, na ogw’edivai na amaguta korwa ase ekemitero, okwo abande bakorua.

english: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes , which ye receive of the children of Israel ; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eye nainwe morentere Omonene okoruegwa kwaino, okwo mokorusia korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria mokonyora korwa ase Abaisraeli. Na okoruegwa okwo gw’enseemo ya ikomi okore kw’Omonene, moe Aroni Omokuani.

english: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD , of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ebiegwa ebio bionsi moranyore korwa ase Abaisraeli, mwatananere Omonene biria bire ebiya mono.

english: And they shall keep thy charge , and the charge of all the tabernacle : only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar , that neither they, nor ye also, die .
ekegusii: Barabwo ’nabagokorere, naende bakore emeremo yonsi ase Eema eria, korende tibaabaisa goika ang’e ase ebikorero ebichenu bi’Aase Aachenu, gose tibaika ang’e ase egesasiimero. Baise gokora igo, aye amo nabarabwo igo morakwe.

english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .
ekegusii: Ase ayio otebie Abalawi: Ekero moraabe mwarure ebinto ebiya mono korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria, erio ebinto ebio nigo birabarwe ase more, inwe Abalawi, buna okoruegwa kwaino kw’endagera, na okomitwa gw’edivai, na okw’amaguta.

english: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Inwe amo n’abanto b’echinka chiaino namoriere ebinto ebio aase aande onsi, ekiagera eyio neng’eria yaino moraakanwe ase emeremo mogokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .
ekegusii: Ekero mwarure ensemo engiya kobua korwa ase okoruegwa okwo, timokoba nokomocha ase okoria eria entigari. Timobaisa gokora ebinto ebichenu bi’Abaisraeli bibe ebitachenegeti, erinde timokwa.”

english: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , for all the service of the tabernacle : and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
ekegusii: Nigo barabwatane naye na gokora emeremo yabo yonsi y’obokoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Omonto onde omoao otachiikiri tabaisa goika ang’e akore emeremo amo nainwe.

english: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu na ase egesasiimero, erio nario endamwamu yane etabaise koba igoro y’Abaisraeli naende.

english: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the LORD , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Ninche nachorire Abalawi bamino korwa ase Abaisraeli, babe ekeegwa ase more. Barabwo baatananirwe ase ’nde inche Omonene, bakore emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar , and within the vail ; and ye shall serve : I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift : and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo yonsi y’obokuani, na emeremo yonsi ase egesasiimero, na eria ere moino y’etoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu. Nabaeire obokuani buna ekeegwa kebe ekiaino. Onye omonto onde omoao otachiikiri ogocha ang’e ase obokoreri obwo, goika aitwe akwe.” Ebitari bi’abakuani

english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron , Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel ; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing , and to thy sons , by an ordinance for ever .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Rora, nakoeire okoruegwa konde gwonsi gokoruegwa ase ’nde, obe gokorenda. Ebinto bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli bakorua, ebio nakobieire bibe egetari kiao amo neki’ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.

english: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .
ekegusii: Ase ebinto bire ebichenu mono, ebiratigare, bitari gosambwa nomorero, ebiraabe ebiao, nabio ebi: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera, na kera ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakorua ase ’nde, nabibe ebichenu mono ase ore, na ase abamura bao.

english: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever .
ekegusii: Omonto oria orabuuche riibu riria, asibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Oko nakwo ogochika koragenderere botambe ase Abaisraeli na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo. Ogokuna Egetondo

english: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .
ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase amatuko atan’abere.

english: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto oria goika esibie n’amaache, nabe ochenekire; korende onye tagwesibia ase amatuko aya abere takoba oyochenekire.

english: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead , and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel : because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean ; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, korende tesibia, igo agokora Obomenyo bw’Omonene bobe obotachenegeti. Omonto oyio aatananwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera amaache aria ay’okomochena taumoiri ase are; ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti.

english: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .
ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika: Omonto onde bwensi orasoe eema eria ase egetondo kere, na omonto onde bwensi ore imeo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.

english: And every open vessel , which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean .
ekegusii: Egekorero kende gionsi kere ase eema eria ime, getabwati egekuneko, korende kere giasie, kiabeire egetachenegeti.

english: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields , or a dead body , or a bone of a man , or a grave , shall be unclean seven days .
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oranyore omonto okenyirwe orosana ime, gose okwete ogokwa konde gwonsi, na amokune, gose akune riuga ri’egetondo, gose oboina, omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.

english: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :
ekegusii: “Ekiagera babeire abatachenegeti, nabaimokie riibu ike ri’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, keria giasambirwe, na kobeeka amaache amaya a rooche igoro ye riibu riria.

english: And a clean person shall take hyssop , and dip it in the water , and sprinkle it upon the tent , and upon all the vessels , and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone , or one slain , or one dead , or a grave :
ekegusii: Erio omonto ochenegete aimokie orosagia rwa hisopo, arotobeke ase amaache ayio ime, erio anyororokerie eema n’ebinto bionsi bireo, amo n’abanto barenge imeo. Naende anyororokerie omonto oria okunete riuga, gose okunete omonto oitetwe, gose oyokwete bweka, gose oboina.

english: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, na ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto ochenegete anyororokie amaache ase oria otachenegeti. Ase igo ase rituko ria gatan’akabere namochene; ere oria ogochia gochenwa nasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, na ase engaki ya mogoroba nabe ochenekire.

english: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded , saying , Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring thee a red heifer without spot , wherein is no blemish , and upon which never came yoke :
ekegusii: “Oyo n’oro omooroberio inche Omonene nachiikire: Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a barente eng’ombe eaberi embariri etari na kemoa ase omobere oye, naende etana kobekerwa rikorogoto ase ogokorigwa emeremo.

english: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean .
ekegusii: “Omonto obeire oyotachenegeti, nere tancheti gwesibia, arusigwe ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto. Ere okorire Aase Aachenu a Omonene abeire atachenegeti, ekiagera amaache aria y’okomochena tanyororokeretigwe ase are; ere nigo are oyotachenegeti.

english: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika kwa botambe ase bare. Omonto oria okonyororokeria amaache aria y’ogochena asibie chianga chiaye, na omonto onde omoao karakune amaache aria, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean ; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even .
ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi omonto oria otachenegeti arakune nakerokio ’nakebe egetachenegeti. Omonto onde bwensi orakune egento keria nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”

english: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face:
ekegusii: Orente eng’ombe eria, oyee Eleazari Omokuani; na eng’ombe eria eirwe isiko y’egetwori, erio enyenyerweo ase obosio bwaye.

english: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
ekegusii: Eleazari atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga y’eng’ombe eria, ayanyororokerie ara gatano nakabere bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight ; her skin , and her flesh , and her blood , with her dung , shall he burn :
ekegusii: Erio chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria, chisamberwe ase obosio bwaye amo ne riiyo na amanyinga, n’esike.

english: And the priest shall take cedar wood , and hyssop , and scarlet , and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer .
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abogorie oroko rw’emecharake na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi embariri, erio abirute as’omorero oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria.

english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani asibie chianga chiaye, esibie omobere boigo namaache. Ekero akoorire gokora bo achiche ase egetwori, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .
ekegusii: Na omonto oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

english: Of the children of Joseph : of Ephraim ; Elishama the son of Ammihud : of Manasseh ; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur .
ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu: ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, na ase egesaku kia Manase, Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.

english: Of Benjamin ; Abidan the son of Gideoni .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.

english: Of Dan ; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.

english: Of Asher ; Pagiel the son of Ocran .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.

english: Of Gad ; Eliasaph the son of Deuel .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.

english: Of Naphtali ; Ahira the son of Enan .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Ahira, mosinto o Enani.”

english: These were the renowned of the congregation , princes of the tribes of their fathers , heads of thousands in Israel .
ekegusii: Abaaanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang’ani be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.

english: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names :
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaira abanto abwo baatoretwe ase amarieta abo,

english: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month , and they declared their pedigrees after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , by their polls .
ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto amo. Bakariika amarieta y’ abanto abwo konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba, na omonto ase omonto.

english: As the LORD commanded Moses , so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai .
ekegusii: Musa akabara abanto abwo na kobarika, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

english: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel , after their families , by the house of their fathers , with the number of their names , every male by their polls ;
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba. Oriike amarieta y’ abanto abasacha bonsi, oyomo ase oyomo.

english: And the children of Reuben , Israel’s eldest son , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , by their polls , every male from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Rubeni, omotangi o Israeli, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abaaanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben , were forty and six thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano nemo, n’amagana atano (46,500).

english: Of the children of Simeon , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names , by their polls , every male from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Simioni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon , were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na kianda, n’amagana atato (59,300).

english: Of the children of Gad , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad , were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n’amagana atano nomo, namerongo etano (45,650).

english: Of the children of Judah , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah , were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nebere na inye, n’amagana atano nomo (74,600).

english: Of the children of Issachar , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Isakaru bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar , were fifty and four thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nainye, n’amagana ane (54,400).

english: From twenty years old and upward , all that are able to go forth to war in Israel : thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies .
ekegusii: Aye amo na Aroni mobare abanto abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, baria baranyare korwana esegi, mobaroberie ase esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe.

english: Of the children of Zebulun , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun , were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isano ibere, n’amagana ane (57,400).

english: Of the children of Joseph , namely , of the children of Ephraim , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, narwo orw’Efraimu, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim , were forty thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).

english: Of the children of Manasseh , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Manase bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh , were thirty and two thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naibere, n’amagana abere (32,200).

english: Of the children of Benjamin , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin , were thirty and five thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naisano, n’amagana ane (35,400).

english: Of the children of Dan , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Dani bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan , were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo naibere, n’amagana atano n’abere (62,700).

english: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe ; every one head of the house of his fathers .
ekegusii: Naende mochore korwa ase kera egesaku omonto oyomo ore omoteneneri obo. Barabwo babe amo nainwe ase okobakonya.

english: Of the children of Asher , by their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher , were forty and one thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene nomo, n’amagana atano (41,500).

english: Of the children of Naphtali , throughout their generations , after their families , by the house of their fathers , according to the number of the names , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Nafutali bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali , were fifty and three thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano naisato, n’amagana ane (53,400).

english: These are those that were numbered , which Moses and Aaron numbered , and the princes of Israel , being twelve men : each one was for the house of his fathers .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barigetwe na Musa, na Aroni, na abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ikomi na babere, abatenenerete kera oyomo egesaku kiaye.

english: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel , by the house of their fathers , from twenty years old and upward , all that were able to go forth to war in Israel ;
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarigetwe, enyomba ase enyomba, baria konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, naende baare konyara korwana esegi,

english: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, n’amagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).

english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ororeria rwa Lawi, barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’abanto abwo bande,

english: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses , saying ,
ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene nigo atebeetie Musa,

english: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi , neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel :
ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi tobaabara amo n’Abaisraeli bande.

english: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben ; Elizur the son of Shedeur .
ekegusii: Amarieta y’ abanto abwo naro aya: Korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni, Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.

english: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony , and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle , and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Obeeke Abalawi babe bakorenda Obomenyo Obochenu obwo bore noborori, naende babe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo boria ime, na ebikorero biaye. ’Nababe bakobobogoria amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, na gokora emeremo imeo. Barabwo nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chi’okomenya chietanane Obomenyo obwo.

english: And when the tabernacle setteth forward , the Levites shall take it down : and when the tabernacle is to be pitched , the Levites shall set it up : and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo obwo boraabe bokong’anyigwa, Abalawi nabwo barabosimore, na ekero boraabe bogotenenigwa naende, nabwo barabotenenie aase agwo. Omonto onde bwensi otachikiri aise goika ang’e n’Obomenyo obwo goika aitwe akwe.

english: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents , every man by his own camp , and every man by his own standard , throughout their hosts .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande nabatenenie chiema chiabo, kera egesaku ase egetwori kiaye, na kera omonto abeere inse y’ebendera yaye, ase ekeombe kiaye.

english: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony , that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel : and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony .
ekegusii: Korende Abalawi nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chietanane Obomenyo obwo bore noborori, na komenyao, erinde endamwamu yane etangwe tebaisa kogwera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli. Abalawi barende Obomenyo obwo bore noborori.”

english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so did they.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene abachiigete goetera ase Musa.

english: Of Simeon ; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

english: Of Judah ; Nahshon the son of Amminadab .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.

english: Of Issachar ; Nethaneel the son of Zuar .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

english: Of Zebulun ; Eliab the son of Helon .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.

english: Then came the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , into the desert of Zin in the first month : and the people abode in Kadesh ; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ogaika ase erooro ya Sini na gotoora agwo Kadeshi. Miriamu agakwana agatindekwa aroro.

english: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bosio bw’egetare keria, akabateebia, “Igwa inwe abasaria aba! Inee! ’Nkobasokeria tore amaache korwa ase egetare eke?”

english: And Moses lifted up his hand , and with his rod he smote the rock twice : and the water came out abundantly , and the congregation drank , and their beasts also .
ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka egetare keria nenyimbo yaye ara kabere. Amaache agasoka amaange mono, na omoganda oria okanywa ne chitugo chiabo chikayanywa boigo.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Ekiagera inwe motanyegenete na koorokia ase amasio y’Abaisraeli ng’a inche nomochenu inde, timokoraa na goikia omosangererekano oyio ase ense eria ebe eyabo.

english: This is the water of Meribah ; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD , and he was sanctified in them.
ekegusii: Aya naro amaache a Meriba + 20:13 Meriba: rora Okong’ 17:7 aase Abaisraeli baamereranetie n’Omonene, na ere akeorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase egati yabo.” Omorwoti o Edomu okwanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yaye

english: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom , Thus saith thy brother Israel , Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa Kadeshi gochia ase omorwoti o Edomu bamoteebie, “Amang’ana aya naro intwe Abaisraeli bamino togoteeba: Nomanyete emechando yonsi yatonyorire,

english: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time ; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers :
ekegusii: buna chisokoro chiaito chiagendete ase ense ya Misiri, chikamenyao emiaka emenge. Abamisiri bagachichanda ase obotindi obobe, bagatochanda naintwe.

english: And when we cried unto the LORD , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and, behold, we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :
ekegusii: Ekero twarerete ase Omonene, ere akaigwa ebirero biaito, agatoma omomalaika agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bono nao tore aiga Kadeshi, omochie ore ase orobebe kegima rw’orogongo rwao.

english: Let us pass , I pray thee, through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king’s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .
ekegusii: Koranche otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titokogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino. Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, titokogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi, goika tobe twaetanirie orogongo rwao.”

english: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword .
ekegusii: Korende omorwoti o Edomu akamoiraneria, “Timobaisa goeta ase egati y’ense y’ane; moise goeta, nigo ndabarwanie esegi imbaite nemioro.”

english: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoteebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amaache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio ’natoakane amaache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”

english: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .
ekegusii: Abaedomu bakairaneria naende, “Timori ne ribaga goeta ase ense yaito.” Bagacha nabarwani barenge ne chinguru gocha korwania Abaisraeli.

english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Abaedomu barinete Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yabo, Abaisraeli bakarua ase bare, bagaeta ensemo eng’ao. Aroni Ogokwa

english: And the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , journeyed from Kadesh , and came unto mount Hor .
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okarua Kadeshi, okageenda ogaika egetunwa kia Hori.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,
ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, ase orobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,

english: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people : for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel , because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah .
ekegusii: “Aroni nakwe, asangererekane amo n’abanto baye. Ere tagosoa ase ense eria naeire Abaisraeli, ekiagera inwe babere mwasaretie, timwanyigwera buna nabachiigete agwo ase amaache a Meriba.

english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
ekegusii: Ira Aroni na Eleazari, momura oye, igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori.

english: And strip Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son : and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there.
ekegusii: Orusie Aroni chianga chiaye chi’obokuani, ochibekere Eleazari, momura oye. Aroni ere ’nakwe, na asangererekane amo n’abanto baye, ekero more aaria.”

english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .
ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete. Barabwo bagatiira gochia igoro as egetunwa keria kia Hori, ekero omoganda bwonsi origereretie.

english: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead , they mourned for Aaron thirty days , even all the house of Israel .
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda bw’Abaisraeli orooche ng’a Aroni okuure bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.

english: And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD !
ekegusii: Abanto baria bakaamerererania na Musa, bagakwana, “Nanga nigo yabeete buya kobua onye naintwe ’ntwakwete ekero abaminto baitetwe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there?
ekegusii: Ninki mwatwegegeretie + 20:4 mwatwegegeretie: engencho yaye nokobogoria omosigo gose egurube ere enene kobua okwenyara kwao intwe omoganda Omonene gocha ase erooro eye, erio toche gokwera aiga, amo ne chitugo chiaito?

english: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates ; neither is there any water to drink .
ekegusii: Ninki mwatorusetie Misiri gocha ense eye yamakweri? Aase aa ataka atari kwama endagera, gose amako, gose amasabibu, gose amakomomanga. Nonya namaache tokonywa tari aa.”

english: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
