ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakageenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.

english: Take the rod , and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother , and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes ; and it shall give forth his water , and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock : so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink .
ekegusii: “Imokia enyimbo eria, erio aye na Aroni mosangererie omoganda bwonsi, na agwo ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi mokwane negetare keria, na amaache ’nasoke korwa aroro. Ase enchera eyio ’mosokerie abanto amaache yokonywa, ne chitugo chiabo ’nchiyanywe.”

english: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD , as he commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia enyimbo eria korwa aase yarenge, agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

english: And the children of Israel set forward , and pitched in Oboth .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka kogeenda orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Ije-abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
ekegusii: Naende bakarua agwo Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, agwo ase erooro ere moocha ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro.

english: From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zared .
ekegusii: Na korwa aroro bakageenda bagaika ase Rikura ria Seredi, bagatoora aroro.

english: From thence they removed , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites : for Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakageenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.

english: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD , What he did in the Red sea , and in the brooks of Arnon ,
ekegusii: Aya naro akogera “Egetabu gi’echisegi chi’Omonene” yakwana igoro ya “Omochie bw’Abahebu ase orogongo rwa Sufa, na amakura ase orooche rw’Arinoni rogoeta,

english: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .
ekegusii: na egetirimboko ki’amakura, aase omochie bw’Ari ore, na gochia orobebe rwa Moabu.”

english: And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .
ekegusii: Na korwa ase Arinoni bakagenderera n’orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Beeri. Eyio nensoko eria aase Omonene atebeetie Musa, “Sangereria abanto, na inche nimbae amaache banywe.”

english: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well ; sing ye unto it:
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatera ogoteera oko: “Chinsoko, sokia amaache acharaare gocha, naintwe togoke na goteera ase amaache ayio.

english: The princes digged the well , the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver , with their staves . And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah :
ekegusii: Chinsoko abanene baremete, echio chiaremetwe nenyimbo y’omogaambi, ne chinyimbo chiabo chi’ogotaarera.” Korwa agwo ase erooro bakageenda bagaika Matana,

english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel : and from Nahaliel to Bamoth :
ekegusii: na korwa Matana bakageenda bagaika Nahalieli, na korwa agwo bakageenda bagaika Bamoti.

english: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said , If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand , then I will utterly destroy their cities .
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakariera Omonene eira, bakaboora, “Aye koraabeeke abanto aba ase amaboko aito, intwe natosirie emechie yabo kegima.”

english: And from Bamoth in the valley , that is in the country of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looketh toward Jeshimon .
ekegusii: Bakarua Bamoti, bakageenda gochia ase rikura riarenge ase ense y’Abaamori, ase egetirimboko ki’egetunwa gia Pisiga, ekio kerochie maate ase erooro. Okobugwa Kw’abarwoti Sihoni na Ogi (Okoir 2:26; 3:11)

english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,
ekegusii: Korwa aroro agwo Abasiraeli bagatoma abanto ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori bakwane nere, bamoborie,

english: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king’s high way , until we be past thy borders .
ekegusii: “Koranche, otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titogotiga enchera na kogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino, korende nigo toraete ase enchera enene goika tobe twaetanirie ense yaino.”

english: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and went out against Israel into the wilderness : and he came to Jahaz , and fought against Israel .
ekegusii: Korende Sihoni akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi, akageenda agaika Yahasi ase erooro, na agwo akarwania Abaisraeli.

english: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .
ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagakenya abanto abange, bakaira ense ya Sihoni, korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orooche rwa Yaboki ase ense y’Abaamoni. Ribebe ri’Abaamoni nigo riarendire ne chinguru.

english: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira emechie yonsi y’Abaamori, bakaira na Hesiboni, erio bakamenya ase emechie amo nebichie bi’emechie eyio.

english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites , who had fought against the former king of Moab , and taken all his land out of his hand , even unto Arnon .
ekegusii: Hesiboni n’oro orenge omochie omonene o Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria konya orwanirie omorwoti orenge kogambera Abaamori agwo ritang’ani. Sihoni konya oirire ense yonsi y’omorwoti oyio goikera Arinoni.

english: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :
ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abateri be chingero bakobora: “Inchuo ase Hesiboni, tiga omochie oyo oagachwe, tiga omochie o Sihoni oagachwe na kogitwa.

english: Woe to thee, Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe Abamoabu! Mwasirigwe, inwe abamogosasiima Kemosi! Nere otigire abana baino abamura bagotama, bakorigia aase bakwebisa, na abana baino abaiseke boosirwe, barabwo bairirwe ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori.

english: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel , and delivered up the Canaanites ; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities : and he called the name of the place Hormah .
ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y’Abakaanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria emechie yabo. Ase ogokora oko, aase aria akarokwa Horima. + 21:3 Horima: engencho yaye n’ogosarigwa Eng’iti y’etai

english: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire chinsara; Abahesiboni basiriigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”

english: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites .
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase ense y’Abaamori.

english: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
ekegusii: Musa agatoma chirooti gochia koroota omochie o Yaeseri. Abaisraeli bakayorwania, bakayoira amo nebichie biaye, bakabang’anyia Abaamori bamenyeteo.

english: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people , to the battle at Edrei .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairana, bagaetera ase enchera yarenge kogeenda Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, agacha amo nabarwani baye korwania Abaisraeli agwo Edirei.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera namobekire ase okoboko kwao, ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi, na ense yaye. Aye goika omokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria omenyete agwo Hesiboni.”

english: So they smote him, and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagaita Ogi, bagaita nabana baye abamura, na abanto baye, goika tibatigaria nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo. Erio bakayeira ense yaye ekaba eyabo.

english: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people ; and much people of Israel died .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agatoma ching’iti chingeenda inse chire nobosongo chigaacha ase egati y’Abaisraeli, chikabaroma, na abanto abange bagakwa.

english: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the LORD , and against thee; pray unto the LORD , that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people .
ekegusii: Abanto bakageenda ase Musa, bakamoteebia, “Twakorire ebibe, ekiagera twakwanire mamincha y’Omonene na ase ore. Koranche osabe Omonene arusie ching’iti echi ase tore.” Ase ayio Musa akabasabera.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Make thee a fiery serpent , and set it upon a pole : and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten , when he looketh upon it, shall live .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Roisia omogwekano bw’eng’iti korwa ase etai, erio oyebeke igoro ase omote, erinde kera omonto oromirwe neng’iti kararigererie eng’iti eria nabe moyo.”

english: And the children of Israel set forward , and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera norogeendo rwabo gochia ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.

english: And Balaam said unto God , Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , hath sent unto me, saying ,
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omorwoti o Moabu, nere otomire abanto aba ase ’nde, ogoteeba ng’a

english: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out .
ekegusii: abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na barabwo nigo bare abange, batubete orogongo rwonsi. Ere nigo aganetie imbaragererie, erinde abarwanie, ababue na kobaseria.”

english: And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogeenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”

english: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, agateebia abanene baria batometwe na Balaki, “Bono inwe irana mogende ase ense yaino, ekiagera Omonene bwangire kong’a ribaga ngende amo nainwe.”

english: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanene baria ba Moabu bakaimoka bakageenda ase Balaki bakamoteebia, “Baalamu nigo aanga, tacheti amo naintwe.”

english: And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they.
ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatoma abanene bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani, naende ababwate amasikani amanene kobua abwo.

english: And they came to Balaam , and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor , Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bagaacha ase Baalamu, bakamoteebia, “Aya naro Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, agoteeba: Koranche totiga kende gionsi kegotange tochicha.

english: For I will promote thee unto very great honour , and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people .
ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo ’ngochia kogokorera aya arakorentere amasikani amanene, naende kende gionsi oramborie, ekio ningokorere; aye inchwo ondagererie abanto aba.”

english: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak , If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God , to do less or more .
ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akairaneria abasomba baria ba Balaki, akabateebia, “Nonya Balaki arenge kong’a enyomba yaye eichire chifeta ne chitaabu, tintageti gosaria na kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene Nyasae anchiikire, na gokora amang’ana ande ase ogwancha kwane, abe amake gose amanene.

english: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more .
ekegusii: Nababoririe komoranche, mobeere aa ase obotuko bwa reero, erio imborie Omonene, imanye gose nabwate amang’ana ande aranteebie.”

english: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, akaigwa amang’ana onsi Abaisraeli konya bakoreire Abaamori.

english: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up , and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do .
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu ase obotuko boria, akamoteebia, “Onye abanto aba bachire gokorangeria, imoka ogende amo nabarabwo, korende egento ndagochiike nakio gioka orakore.”

english: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and saddled his ass , and went with the princes of Moab .
ekegusii: Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, akaberekia etigere yaye egeikaransero, akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Moabu. Baalamu Na Etigere Yaye

english: And God’s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him.
ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.

english: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye, ekagobera gochia enchera ensemo, ekageenda ase omogondo. Baalamu agaaka etigere eria koyeirania ase enchera.

english: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
ekegusii: Naende omomalaika oria Omonene akageenda ase enchera yarenge engote gati y’emegondo y’emesabibu, ne chimbago nchiarenge ase chinsemo chionsi ibere.

english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she thrust herself unto the wall , and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall : and he smote her again .
ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria Omonene, ekemigereria gochia orobago ang’e, ekabwaterania okogoro kwa Baalamu ase orobago, na Baalamu akayeaka naende.

english: And the angel of the LORD went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
ekegusii: Erio naende omomalaika Omonene akageenda bosio, agatenena aase aagote mono, ase ribaga ritarenge ri’okogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi.

english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she fell down under Balaam : and Balaam’s anger was kindled , and he smote the ass with a staff .
ekegusii: Ekero etigere yarooche omomalaika oria, ekarara inse, na Baalamu oyeriinete mogongo igoro. Baalamu akaba nendamwamu enene mono, agaaka etigere eria nenyimbo yaye.

english: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass , and she said unto Balaam , What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times ?
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakunora omonwa bw’etigere eria goika egakwana, ekaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki nagokoreire goika kwang’akire chintunda echi isato?”

english: And Balaam said unto the ass , Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand , for now would I kill thee.
ekegusii: Baalamu akayeiraneria, “Nekiagera gwankoreire echeche. Onye nabwate omoro ase okoboko kwane, nanga nigo narenge kogoita.”

english: And Moab was sore afraid of the people , because they were many : and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Abamoabu bakoboa abanto abwo mono, ekiagera nigo barenge abange; ee Abamoabu bakabegosera Abaisraeli.

english: And the ass said unto Balaam , Am not I thine ass , upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day ? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said , Nay.
ekegusii: Naende etigere ekaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Inche tindi etigere yao, kwabeire gokondiina ase amatuko y’obogima bwao bwonsi goika rituko eri ria reero? Inee! Inche nana‐gokora egento buna eke ase ore?” Baalamu akairaneria, “Yaya.”

english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam , and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaramokia Baalamu amaiso, na ere akarora omomalaika Omonene oteneine ase enchera gati, obwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye. Baalamu agekumba, agatung’ama inse, akaumama.

english: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akaboria Baalamu, “Nase ki gwaakire etigere yao chintunda echi isato? Rora, inche nigo nacha kogotanga, ekiagera orogeendo oro okogeenda norw’ogosaria rore mamincha yane.

english: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times : unless she had turned from me , surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive .
ekegusii: Korende etigire ero yandora, nero yeonchora gochia enchera ensemo chintunda isato. Ekeene, onye etigere eye eteonchora gochia ensemo korwa asende, nanga nigo nagoita okwe, ntige etigere ere moyo.”

english: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD , I have sinned ; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee , I will get me back again .
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agateebia omomalaika Omonene, “Inche nakorire ebibe, tinamanyete ng’a naye gwateneine gati y’enchera gontanga. Korende bono onye orogeendo rokororekana ng’a norobe ase ore, tiga ing’irane.”

english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Baalamu, “Genda amo n’abanto abwo, korende amang’ana aria ndagochike, naro oka ogochia gokwana.” Bono Baalamu akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Balaki. Balaki Okomoorotota Baalamu

english: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come , he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab , which is in the border of Arnon , which is in the utmost coast .
ekegusii: Ekero Balaki aigwete ng’a Baalamu inchera are gocha, akageenda komoorototera agwo Ari, omochie orenge ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni, ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

english: And Balak said unto Balaam , Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour ?
ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Naki otachete ekero natomete abanto gokorangeria? Nase ki otachete? Nigo gwakagete ng’a tingocha gokoa ogosika kogoisaine?”

english: And Balaam said unto Balak , Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing ? the word that God putteth in my mouth , that shall I speak .
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Rora, bono nachire ase ore, nigo okagete ng’a inche nimbwate okobua nonya nogoke gokwana ring’ana ase ore? Ring’ana riria Nyasae aranteebie nario ndakwane.”

english: And Balaam went with Balak , and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth .
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akageenda amo na Balaki, bagaika Kiriati‐Husoti.

english: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .
ekegusii: Abamoabu bagateebia abagaaka ba Midiani, “Omoganda oyo omonene nigo ogochia komena okoore kera egento getoetanaine aiga, buna chintang’ana chikomena obonyansi ase egetii chiabokoora.” Ase engaki eria Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, nere orenge omorwoti bw’Abamoabu.

english: And Balak offered oxen and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him.
ekegusii: Balaki akanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, akaa Baalamu amo nabanene barenge amo nere. Obobani Bw’eritang’ani Bwa Baalamu

english: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Balak took Balaam , and brought him up into the high places of Baal , that thence he might see the utmost part of the people .
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia Balaki akaira Baalamu igoro ase Bamoti‐Baali, na korwa igoro agwo Baalamu akarora ensemo eyemo y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli.

english: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people ; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
ekegusii: Bono inchwo obandagererie, ekiagera barabwo nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua. Gokobaragereria, ande nabo ndabaise kobarwania mbabue na kobaseria, barabwo barue ase ense y’ane. Nimanyete ng’a oyo aye ogosesenia, nigo agoseseneka, na oyo aye okoragereria, nigo akoragerereka.”

english: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand ; and they came unto Balaam , and spake unto him the words of Balak .
ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Moabu na ab’Abamidiani bakabogoria eng’eria y’okoringoreria ase amaboko abo, bakayeirera Baalamu, bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi a Balaki.

english: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night , and I will bring you word again , as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam .
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia abanto baria, “Rara aa ase obotuko obo, nainche nimbarentere amairanerio korwa ase Omonene ankio mambia.” Ase ayio abanene baria ba Moabu bakabeera aroro amo na Baalamu.

english: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee?
ekegusii: Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu, akamobooria, “Abanto abamore komo mbarabi?”

english: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia Balaki, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”

english: Who can count the dust of Jacob , and the number of the fourth part of Israel ? Let me die the death of the righteous , and let my last end be like his!
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobara ororeria rwa Yakobo, abwo bare abange buna orotu rw’amaroba? Gose ning’o oranyare kobara nonya nenseemo ya inye y’Abaisraeli? Tiga inkwe buna oyomo bw’abanyene oboronge, na omoerio bw’amatuko ane obe buna oyoobo.”

english: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether .
ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki eke aye gwankoreire? Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oche obaragererie ababisa bane, na rora, ribaga ri’ayio kwabasesenirie.”

english: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth ?
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Inee! Tiyangwenerete inyigwere na gokwana amang’ana ari’Omonene agonteebia nkwane?” Obobani Bwa Kabere Bwa Baalamu

english: And Balak said unto him, Come , I pray thee, with me unto another place , from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
ekegusii: Balaki akamoteebia, “Inchuo, togende amo naye goika aase ande aao. Korwa aroro nonyare korora abare ang’e. Tokorora bonsi. Korwa aase agwo nobandagererie.”

english: And he brought him into the field of Zophim , to the top of Pisgah , and built seven altars , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
ekegusii: Akamoira goika ase omogondo o Sofimu agwo ase egechuria gia Pisiga. Agwo Balaki akaagacha ebisasimero bitano na bibere, akarua eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo igoro ase kera egesasiimero.

english: And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the Lord yonder .
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene ensemo y’ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa inche ’ngende aaria ng’umbu, toumerane n’Omonene.”

english: And the LORD met Balaam , and put a word in his mouth , and said , Go again unto Balak , and say thus.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera Baalamu, akamoteebia amang’ana arenge gochia gokwana, naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.

english: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken ?
ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na abanene b’Abamoabu bateneine agwo amo nere. Balaki akamobooria, “Mang’ana ki Omonene akwanire?”

english: And he took up his parable , and said , Rise up , Balak , and hear ; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor :
ekegusii: Baalamu agachaaka gokwana obobani bwaye, agateeba, “Inchuo aye Balaki, omwana o Sipori, ontegerere oigwe aya ’ngokwana!

english: God is not a man , that he should lie ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?
ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto, erinde akwane oborimo, gose tari Mwanyabaanto, erinde anyare koonchoka. Inee! Aya akwanire, takonyara koyakora? Gose, aya ateebire, takonyara koyaikerania?

english: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken ; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram .
ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna Baalamu amoteebetie, na abwo babere bakarua ekeng’wanso igoro ase kera egesasiimero, eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.

english: Behold, I have received commandment to bless : and he hath blessed ; and I cannot reverse it.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo nachigetwe ng’a ’nsesenie; na ekero Nyasae asesenirie, inche tinkonyara koirania ogosesenigwa okwo.

english: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob , neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel : the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
ekegusii: Ere tarochi obobe ase Yakobo, tarochi bokong’u bonde ase Abaisraeli. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo are amo nabarabwo, igo bakoraria nomochengo ng’a omorwoti nareo.

english: God brought them out of Egypt ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn .
ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri; barabwo nigo babwate chinguru buna echi’eng’era.

english: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !
ekegusii: Oborogi tibogokora gento ase abanto ba Yakobo, gose oboriori ase Abaisraeli. Nakwanwe igoro y’ abanto ba Yakobo, nabwo Abaisraeli: Rora aya Nyasae akorire!

english: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion , and lift up himself as a young lion : he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey , and drink the blood of the slain .
ekegusii: Rigereria abanto abwo nigo banga buna endo eaberi ekoboka, na buna endo ekoimokerera igoro, teri korara goika eraria echi yatwarire, goika eranywa amanyinga ay’echi yaitire.”

english: And Balak said unto Balaam , Neither curse them at all , nor bless them at all .
ekegusii: Naende Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono tobaisa kobaragereria, gose tobaisa kobasesenia nonya ng’ake.”

english: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak , Told not I thee, saying , All that the LORD speaketh , that I must do ?
ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Tinagoteebia ng’a amang’ana onsi Omonene agonteebia, ayio naro ’ndakore?” Obobani Bwa Gatato Bwa Baalamu

english: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
ekegusii: Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono inchwo ’nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”

english: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor , that looketh toward Jeshimon .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Balaki akaira Baalamu gochia ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Peori, bakarigereria erooro inse.

english: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams .
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, na ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”

english: And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place .
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa; inche ’ngende korora gose ande Omonene nang’orokere. Kende gionsi aranteebie, ekio nakio ndagoteebie.” Baalamu agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro aarabu.

english: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna atebetigwe, akarua eeri eyemo amo n’emingichi eyemo ase kera egesasiimero.

english: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .
ekegusii: Nyasae agaika korwa igoro, akaumerana na Baalamu. Baalamu akamoteebia, “Naagachire ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende narure igoro ase kera ekemo eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.”

english: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth , and said , Return unto Balak , and thus thou shalt speak .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Baalamu ring’ana agochia gokwana. Naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.

english: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice , he, and all the princes of Moab .
ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamoabu.

english: And he took up his parable , and said , Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram , out of the mountains of the east , saying , Come , curse me Jacob , and come , defy Israel .
ekegusii: Baalamu agakwana obobani bwaye, agateeba: “Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, ondetire korwa Siiria, korwa ase ebitunwa bia Moocha, oteebire: Inchuo, ondagererie abanto ba Yakobo, inchwo ogambie Abaisraeli.

english: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the LORD hath not defied ?
ekegusii: Naki ’ndakore ndagererie oyo Nyasae ataragerereti? Naki ’ndakore ’ngambie oy’Omonene atagambeti?

english: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone , and shall not be reckoned among the nations .
ekegusii: Korwa aiga ase ebitare igoro nimbarooche, na korwa aiga ase ebitunwa nimbarigereretie. Abwo n’abanto bamenyete boka, beatananire korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku.

english: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel , he went not, as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .
ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu arooche ng’a Omonene nigo amoganetie asesenie Abaisraeli tagendete naende ase okorigia oboringoria buna chingaki chiria chi’eritang’ani, korende akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase erooro.

english: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam , and he smote his hands together : and Balak said unto Balaam , I called thee to curse mine enemies , and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times .
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio Balaki akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Baalamu, agaaka chinkobi, akamoteebia, “Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oragererie ababisa bane, na rora, bono aye kwabasesenirie chintunda echi isato.

english: Therefore now flee thou to thy place : I thought to promote thee unto great honour ; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour .
ekegusii: Bono irana gochia bwoo. Inche igo narengereretie gokoa ogosika okonene, korende Omonene okorinire, tonyora ogosikwa okwo.”

english: And Balaam said unto Balak , Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying ,
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Inee! Tinateebetie abanto baria gwatomete ase inde ng’a

english: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD , to do either good or bad of mine own mind ; but what the LORD saith , that will I speak ?
ekegusii: Balaki naisa kong’a enyomba yaye eichire ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, tinkonyara kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene anchikiire, na tingokora gento kende ase ogwancha kwane, abe amabe, gose amaya. Ay’Omonene agoteeba, ayio naro ngwenerete ’nkore. Obobani Bw’omoerio Bwa Baalamu

english: And now, behold, I go unto my people : come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .
ekegusii: “Bono ’nkoirana inde gochia ase abanto bane. Inchuo ’nkomanyie egento Abaisraeli barakore ase abanto bao ase amatuko agochia goocha.”

english: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ’ngokwana, amang’ana aya nay’ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.

english: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, naende onyorire okomanya korwa ase oria ore Igoro Mono. Na okorora amaroro akorwa ase oria Omobui, oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso.

english: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
ekegusii: Namororire, korende tari bono; namorigereirie, korende tari ang’e. Eng’enang’eni neoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo, na enyimbo y’obogambi neoroke korwa ase Abaisraeli. Nesenyente chintakunero chi’emetwe y’Abamoabu, neiyerie abanto b’ororeeria rwa Seti.

english: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
ekegusii: Ense ya Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Edomu nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y’ababisa babo. Abaisraeli ’mbagenderere koba n’okobua.

english: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion , and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city .
ekegusii: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”

english: And Balaam lifted up his eyes , and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes ; and the spirit of God came upon him.
ekegusii: Agachia koimokia amaiso, aye, akarora Abaisraeli batoorete egesaku ase egesaku. Erio Omoika o Nyasae ogaacha igoro ase are.

english: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akarigereria Abaameleki, agakwana obobani obo: “Abaameleki nabwo barenge ab’eritang’ani ase ebisaku, korende ase omoerio nabasirigwe kegima.”

english: And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .
ekegusii: Naende akarigereria Abakeni, agakwana obobani obo: “Obomenyo bwabo nabogenderere kobao, buna egeswa keagachire ase engako y’egetare.

english: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abakeni nabasirigwe, ekero Abaasuri barabaire babe abasibwa.”

english: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this!
ekegusii: Baalamu akagenderera gokwana obobani bwaye: “Obee! Ning’o oranyare koba moyo ekero Nyasae arakore aya?

english: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbachiche ne chimeeri korwa ase engegu ya Kitimu, nabarabwo ’mbachaande Abaasuri na Abaeberi, korende barabwo abanyene ’mbasirigwe boigo.”

english: And Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place : and Balak also went his way .
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akaimoka, akairana bwoye, na Balaki nere akabwatia enchera, akageenda bwoye.

english: He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, oyo okorora amaroro akorwa ase ere oria Omonguru + 24:4 Omonguru: engencho yaye ere oria ore nechinguru gose okobua ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania El-Shaddai , oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso aye.

english: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, chiema chiaino naki chire chingiya! Inwe Abaisraeli aase momenyete, naki are aagiya mono!

english: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river’s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .
ekegusii: Igo mogwekaine omweya orambogete gochia aare, gose emegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche, nigo more buna emegaka Omonene asimegete. Gose emecharake ere ase amaache mbarabare.

english: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .
ekegusii: Amache amaange naiteke korwa ase chinyongo chiabo na oroiboro rwabo nigo roraabe oronge mono. Omorwoti obo nabe omonene goetania Agagi, na oborwoti bwaye inabotogigwe mono.

english: God brought him forth out of Egypt ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .
ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y’emebere y’ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

english: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete agwo Sitimu, abanto bagachaaka gokora obotomani n’abakuungu b’Abamoabu.

english: Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy .
ekegusii: “Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, nere ogera endamwamu yane yatigire Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere aba ne risemi buna inche inde ne risemi ase egati y’ abanto aba. Ase ayio tinasiretie bonsi ase risemi riane.

english: Wherefore say , Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, moteebie ng’a, ’ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe.

english: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood ; because he was zealous for his God , and made an atonement for the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw’omorembe ’nkobe ase are ere, na ase ororeria rw’aye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw’obokuani, ekiagera abeete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”

english: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianitish woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
ekegusii: Omoisraeli oria oitetwe amo nomokuungu Omomidiani nigo arenge korokwa Simuri, mosinto o Salu, omotang’ani bw’eamate yaye ase egesaku gia Simioni.

english: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .
ekegusii: Omokungu oria bw’Abamidiani oitetwe ere nigo arenge korokwa Kosibi. Suri ise nere orenge omotang’ani bwe chiamate chinde chi’Abamidiani.

english: Vex the Midianites , and smite them:
ekegusii: “Umokera Abamidiani, obasirie,

english: For they vex you with their wiles , wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor , and in the matter of Cozbi , the daughter of a prince of Midian , their sister , which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake .
ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo baabachandire ase okobaebereria gosasiima Peori, na ase amang’ana a Kosibi, omosubati oria bw’omonene bw’Abamidiani. Omosubati oria obo oitetwe ase rituko riria amaakwa achete ase engencho ya Peori.”

english: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods : and the people did eat , and bowed down to their gods .
ekegusii: Abwo bakarangeria Abaisraeli bagende ase emeyega y’ebing’wanso yarenge gokorerwa chinyasae chiabo, na barabwo bakabiria, naende bagasasiima chinyasae chi’Abamoabu.

english: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor : and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana n’enyasae yarenge korokwa Baali‐Peori, bakayesasiima. Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase bare.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the LORD against the sun , that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel .
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Musa, “Renta abatang’ani bonsi b’Abaisraeli, obasunge agwo ase obosio bwane erioba ribasambe, erinde endamwamu yane enene etige Abaisraeli.”

english: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel , Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor .
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abagaambi b’Abaisraeli, “Kera oyomo ase more, tiga aite abanto baye bonsi baria babwatanire na Baali‐Peori.”

english: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses , and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel , who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Omoisraeli oyomo agacha akarentana omokungu oyomo bw’Abamidiani ase eamate yaye, ase obosio bwa Musa amo nomoganda bwonsi kobateneine agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakorera.

english: And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand ;
ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, akaimoka korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akabogoria ritimo,

english: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent , and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel , and the woman through her belly . So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel .
ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria gochia ase akanyomba ka ime, akababeta ritimo bonsi babere, Omoisraeli oria amo nomokuungu oria, ase chinda chiabo. Ase igo amaakwa aria agatiga goita Abaisraeli.

english: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand .
ekegusii: Korende abanto abakwete ase ogoakwa okwo nigo babete chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

english: And the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up together with Korah , when that company died , what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men : and they became a sign .
ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka rikabamera amo na Kora, ekero omorero osambete na gosiria abanto amagana abere, na merongo etano. Ayio akaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokuurera.

english: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
ekegusii: Korende abana ba Kora barabwo tibaitetwe.)

english: The sons of Simeon after their families : of Nemuel , the family of the Nemuelites : of Jamin , the family of the Jaminites : of Jachin , the family of the Jachinites :
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Simioni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaanemweli, abarwete ase Nemweli, na Abayamini, abarwete ase Yamini, na Abayakini, abarwete ase Yakini,

english: Of Zerah , the family of the Zarhites : of Shaul , the family of the Shaulites .
ekegusii: na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera, na Abasauli, abarwete ase Saulo.

english: These are the families of the Simeonites , twenty and two thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere (22,200).

english: The children of Gad after their families : of Zephon , the family of the Zephonites : of Haggi , the family of the Haggites : of Shuni , the family of the Shunites :
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Gadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abazefoni, abarwete ase Zefoni, na Abahagi, abarwete ase Hagi, na

english: Of Ozni , the family of the Oznites : of Eri , the family of the Erites :
ekegusii: Abasuni, abarwete ase Suni, na Abaosini, abarwete ase Osini, na Abaeri, abarwete ase Eri,

english: Of Arod , the family of the Arodites : of Areli , the family of the Arelites .
ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.

english: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Gadi. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).

english: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan : and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Basinto ba Yuda, Eri na Onani, bagakwera agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.

english: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel , from twenty years old and upward , throughout their fathers’ house , all that are able to go to war in Israel .
ekegusii: “Mobare omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate. Moriike, abanto bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baranyare korwana esegi.”

english: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah , the family of the Shelanites : of Pharez , the family of the Pharzites : of Zerah , the family of the Zarhites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasela, abarwete ase Sela, na Abaperisi, abarwete ase Peresi, na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera.

english: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron , the family of the Hezronites : of Hamul , the family of the Hamulites .
ekegusii: Chiamate chia Peresi nigo chiarenge: Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abahamuli, abarwete ase Hamuli.

english: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano ebere na isano nemo, na amagana atano (76,500).

english: Of the sons of Issachar after their families : of Tola , the family of the Tolaites : of Pua , the family of the Punites :
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Isakaru nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abatola, abarwete ase Tola, na Abapua, abarwete ase Pua,

english: Of Jashub , the family of the Jashubites : of Shimron , the family of the Shimronites .
ekegusii: na Abayasubu, abarwete ase Yasubu, na Abashimuroni, abarwete ase Shimuroni.

english: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, n’amagana atato (64,300).

english: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families : of Sered , the family of the Sardites : of Elon , the family of the Elonites : of Jahleel , the family of the Jahleelites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Sabuloni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaseredi, abarwete ase Seredi, na Abaeloni, abarwete ase Eloni, na Abayaleeli, abarwete ase Yaleeli.

english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na amagana atano (60,500).

english: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim .
ekegusii: Ebisaku bia Yusufu nebi’abamura baye babere, Manase na Efraimu.

english: Of the sons of Manasseh : of Machir , the family of the Machirites : and Machir begat Gilead : of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Manase nao eamate ya Makiri yarwete. Makiri nere orenge ise Gileadi, na korwa ase are nao Abagileadi barwete.

english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho , saying ,
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakwana n’abanto baria ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, akabateebia,

english: These are the sons of Gilead : of Jeezer , the family of the Jeezerites : of Helek , the family of the Helekites :
ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Gileadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaieseri, abarwete ase Ieseri, na Abaheleki, abarwete ase Heleki,

english: And of Asriel , the family of the Asrielites : and of Shechem , the family of the Shechemites :
ekegusii: Abaasirieli, abarwete ase Asirieli, na Abasekemu, abarwete ase Sekemu,

english: And of Shemida , the family of the Shemidaites : and of Hepher , the family of the Hepherites .
ekegusii: na Abasemida, abarwete ase Semida, na Abaheferi, abarwete ase Heferi.

english: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons , but daughters : and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
ekegusii: Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, tabwate abana abamura, korende nabana abaiseke boka abwate, na amarieta y’abaiseke abwo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

english: These are the families of Manasseh , and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku kia Manase. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano abere (52,700).

english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families : of Shuthelah , the family of the Shuthalhites : of Becher , the family of the Bachrites : of Tahan , the family of the Tahanites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Efraimu nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasutela, abarwete ase Sutela, na Ababeekeri, abarwete ase Bekeri, na Abatahani, abarwete ase Tahani.

english: And these are the sons of Shuthelah : of Eran , the family of the Eranites .
ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa ase are nao Abaerani barwete.

english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred . These are the sons of Joseph after their families .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Efraimu. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na ibere, na amagana atano (32,500). Aba nabwo barenge abana ba Yusufu ne chiamate chiabo.

english: The sons of Benjamin after their families : of Bela , the family of the Belaites : of Ashbel , the family of the Ashbelites : of Ahiram , the family of the Ahiramites :
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Ababela, abarwete ase Bela, na Abaasibeli, abarwete ase Asibeli, na Abaahiramu, abarwete ase Ahiramu,

english: Of Shupham , the family of the Shuphamites : of Hupham , the family of the Huphamites .
ekegusii: na Abasefufamu, abarwete ase Sefufamu, na Abahufamu, abarwete ase Hufamu.

english: Take the sum of the people , from twenty years old and upward ; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel , which went forth out of the land of Egypt .
ekegusii: “Riika abanto bonsi abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.” Abaisraeli abwo barwete ense ya Misiri nabwo aba.

english: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman : of Ard , the family of the Ardites : and of Naaman , the family of the Naamites .
ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo Aridi na Naamani. Korwa ase Aridi nao Abaaridi barwete, na korwa ase Naamani nao Abanaamani barwete.

english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families : and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku gia Benjamini Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana atano na rimo (45,600).

english: These are the sons of Dan after their families : of Shuham , the family of the Shuhamites . These are the families of Dan after their families .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Dani nigo chiarenge chiamate chi’Abasuhamu, abarwete ase Suhamu. Aba nabwo abanto b’egesaku gia Dani ase chiamate chiabo.

english: All the families of the Shuhamites , according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: Abarwete ase chiamate chi’Abasuhamu nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana ane (64,400).

english: Of the children of Asher after their families : of Jimna , the family of the Jimnites : of Jesui , the family of the Jesuites : of Beriah , the family of the Beriites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Aseri nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaimuna, abarwete ase Imuna, na Abaisibi, abarwete ase Isibi, na Ababeria, abarwete ase Beria.

english: Of the sons of Beriah : of Heber , the family of the Heberites : of Malchiel , the family of the Malchielites .
ekegusii: Abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi ase eamate y’Abaheberi yarwete, na Malikieli, ase eamate y’Abamalikieli yarwete.

english: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah .
ekegusii: Omwana omoiseke o Aseri nigo arenge korokwa Sera.

english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na amagana ane (53,400).

english: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families : of Jahzeel , the family of the Jahzeelites : of Guni , the family of the Gunites :
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Nafutali nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abayaseli, abarwete ase Yaseli, na Abaguni, abarwete ase Guni,

english: Of Jezer , the family of the Jezerites : of Shillem , the family of the Shillemites .
ekegusii: na Abayeseri, abarwete ase Yeseri, na Abasilemu, abarwete ase Silemu.

english: Reuben , the eldest son of Israel : the children of Reuben ; Hanoch , of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites : of Pallu , the family of the Palluites :
ekegusii: Rubeni nere orenge omomura omotangi o Israeli. Ase egesaku kiaye nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abahanoki, abarwete ase Hanoki, na Abapalu, abarwete ase Palu,

english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families : and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana ane (45,400).

english: These were the numbered of the children of Israel , six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli abarigetwe nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na eyemo, na amagana atano abere na merongo etato (601,730).

english: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names .
ekegusii: Aatananere abanto aba chingongo chibe emiando yabo. Ochiatanane kobwatekana nomobaro bw’ abanto.

english: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance , and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance : to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng’ana nomobaro obo.

english: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot : according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit .
ekegusii: Ense yaatananwe ase ogoakerwa obomera. Abanto mbanyore omwando koreng’ana nomobaro bw’amarieta ’ebisaku bie chisokoro chiabo.

english: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few .
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna obomera boragwere abanto ba kera egesaku, ekenene gose egeke, nabo baranyore omwando obo.

english: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families : of Gershon , the family of the Gershonites : of Kohath , the family of the Kohathites : of Merari , the family of the Merarites .
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Lawi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abagerisoni, abarwete ase Gerisoni, na Abakohati, abarwete ase Kohati, na Abamerari, abarwete ase Merari.

english: These are the families of the Levites : the family of the Libnites , the family of the Hebronites , the family of the Mahlites , the family of the Mushites , the family of the Korathites . And Kohath begat Amram .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Lawi: Eamate y’Abalibini, na ey’Abaheburoni, na ey’Abamali na ey’Abamusi, na ey’Abakora. Kohati nere orenge ise Amuramu.

english: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed , the daughter of Levi , whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt : and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses , and Miriam their sister .
ekegusii: Moka Amuramu nigo arenge korokwa Yokebedi, mosubati o Lawi, oria oiboreretwe Lawi agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Omokungu oria akamoiborera Amuramu abana aba: Aroni, na Musa, na Miriamu, omoiseke omwabo.

english: Of Hezron , the family of the Hezronites : of Carmi , the family of the Carmites .
ekegusii: na Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abakarimi, abarwete ase Karimi.

english: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand , all males from a month old and upward : for they were not numbered among the children of Israel , because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase egati yabo oyo konya okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo abaretwe. Barabwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000). Abanto aba tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera tibaetwe omwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.

english: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest , who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bariigete ekero baabarete Abaisraeli agwo ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase Yorodani kororia Yeriko.

english: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered , when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai .
ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’ abanto aba onde tarengeo, nonya noyomo, ase baria Musa na Aroni Omokuani baabarete agwo ase erooro ya Sinai.

english: These are the families of the Reubenites : and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty .
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isato, na amagana atano abere, na merongo etato (43,730).

english: And the sons of Pallu ; Eliab .
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Palu n’Eliabu

english: And the sons of Eliab ; Nemuel , and Dathan , and Abiram . This is that Dathan and Abiram , which were famous in the congregation , who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah , when they strove against the LORD :
ekegusii: amo nabana baye: Nemweli, na Datani, na Abiiramu. (Aba nabwo Datani na Abiiramu bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda. Barabwo bakaamererania na Musa na Aroni, bakaba ase ekeombe gia Kora, ekero baamereranetie n’Omonene.

english: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abaiseke ba Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase bagaacha. Aba nigo barwete ase chiamate chia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, na amarieta abo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.

english: And if he have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren .
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo, omwando oye oirwe nabamura bamwabo ise.

english: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Na onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo ise, omwando oye oirwe nomoamate oye ore ang’e. Okwo nigo koraabe ogochika kw’oboronge ase Abaisraeli, buna inche Omonene nagochiikire.” Yoshua Ogochorwa Koba Ribaga Ria Musa (Okoir 31:1-8)

english: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .
ekegusii: Ekero kwayerorire, aye nigo orasangererekane amo n’abanto bao buna Aroni omino asangererekanete amo n’abanto baye,

english: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin , in the strife of the congregation , to sanctify me at the water before their eyes : that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin .
ekegusii: ekiagera timwaigwerete ring’ana riane agwo ase erooro ya Sini, rituko riria omoganda bwonsi bwemurunganetie, gose timwaorogetie ng’a inche nomochenu inde, ekero mware kobochorera abanto amaache.” (Aya namaache a Meriba ya Kadeshi ase erooro ya Sini).

english: And Moses spake unto the LORD , saying ,
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene akabora,

english: Let the LORD , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene Nyasae, aye oyokorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, chora omonto oraraae omoganda oyo,

english: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation ; and give him a charge in their sight .
ekegusii: Omorente atenene ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, erio ase amasio abo omorarie ng’a nere oirire ribaga ria’o.

english: And they stood before Moses , and before Eleazar the priest , and before the princes and all the congregation , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , saying ,
ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha ase obosio bwa Musa, na obwa Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’abatang’ani, na ase omoganda bwonsi, bagatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagateeba,

english: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .
ekegusii: Omoe okobua buna okwao, erio nario omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli oramoigwere.

english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :
ekegusii: Musa akaira Yoshua buna Omonene konya amochiikire, akamorenta ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani nomoganda bwonsi.

english: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .
ekegusii: “Tata nigo akwerete agwo ase erooro. Ere tarenge ase egati y’ekeombe keria giasangererekanete amo gekaba mamincha y’Omonene, ase abwo barenge ase ensemo ya Kora, korende ere nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene. Ekero akwete tatigete abana abamura

english: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family , because he hath no son ? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father .
ekegusii: Nase ki erieta ria tata rigosirigwa korwa ase eamate yaye ekiagera tabwate abana abamura? Toe naintwe omwando ase egati y’abamura bamwabo tata.”

english: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD .
ekegusii: Musa akaira amang’ana abo ase obosio bw’Omonene,

english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a man die , and have no son , then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter .
ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a omonto karakwe, onye ere tabwati omwana omomura, omwando bw’omonto oyio omwana oye omoiseke ayoire.

english: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati nonya nomwana omoiseke, omwando oye abamura bamwabo bayoire.

english: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera Esabato gekoruegwa amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo. Ekeng’wanso Kie Rituko Rie Ritang’ani Ri’omotienyi

english: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks , and one ram , seven lambs of the first year without spot ;
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ria kera omotienyi mobe mokorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene. Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi echitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram ;
ekegusii: Morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta y’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

english: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb ; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .
ekegusii: na amo na kera emanwa emingichi, obosie ebimunu bibere. Ebing’wanso ebio bi’ogosambwa nigo bire okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya kogosambwa n’omorero ase Omonene.

english: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock , and the third part of an hin unto a ram , and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb : this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year .
ekegusii: Ekenyugwa gekoruegwa amo na kera eeri nigo kerabe edivai ebituba bibere, na amo nemingichi eria, edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, na amo na kera emanwa emingichi edivai egetuba ekemo. Eke ’nkebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekoruegwa kera omotienyi ase emetienyi yonsi y’omwaka.

english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, morue egoree eyemo ase Omonene, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso bi’Amatuko Amanene y’Emegati Etabekiri Memera (Abal 23:5-14)

english: In the first day shall be an holy convocation ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

english: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :
ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them, My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obachike ng’a ase ekero keria gechiikire goika banduere ebing’wanso na okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.

english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ;
ekegusii: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

english: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isan’aibere obosie ebimunu bibere.

english: And one goat for a sin offering , to make an atonement for you.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.

english: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .
ekegusii: Igo morarue ebinto ebi amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko botambe.

english: After this manner ye shall offer daily , throughout the seven days , the meat of the sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD : it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio kera rituko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mokoruera Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Morue okoruegwa okwo amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.

english: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation ; ye shall do no servile work .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio. Ebing’wanso Bie Rituko Rie Rigesa (Abal 23:15-22)

english: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year ;
ekegusii: Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, amo ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Echi nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

english: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto one bullock , two tenth deals unto one ram ,
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

english: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs ;
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isano na ibere obosie ebimunu bibere.

english: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day , for a continual burnt offering .
ekegusii: “Obateebie: Eke nakio ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero moramoruere Omonene: Kera rituko botambe morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And one kid of the goats , to make an atonement for you.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.

english: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering , and his meat offering , (they shall be unto you without blemish ) and their drink offerings .
ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ekio amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera. Ching’iti echio chionsi chi’ebing’wanso chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chiruegwe amo n’okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.

english: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning , and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even ;
ekegusii: Eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia, na eyende mogoroba.

english: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .
ekegusii: Kera eyemo oyerue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni egetuba ekemo.

english: It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, ekio Musa aruete ritang’ani agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai gekaba rimisu rigiya, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.

english: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering .
ekegusii: Orue okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa egetuba ekemo, amo nemingichi eria entang’ani. Ekenyugwa eke egetindi keraumorwe agwo Aase Aachenu, ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even : as the meat offering of the morning , and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Emingichi eria ya kabere oyerue mogoroba amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna kwaruete eria ya mambia. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.” Ekeng’wanso gi’Esabato

english: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot , and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and the drink offering thereof:
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Amo nachirochio morue obosie obonuke ebimunu bine bwochoganirie amaguta y’amazeituni, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Morue boigo okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.

english: And in the seventh month , on the first day of the month , ye shall have an holy convocation ; ye shall do no servile work : it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere ’namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko. Rituko erio nigo rirabe rituko ri’okobugia ebiroria.

english: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi, chiria isan’aibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.

english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering ; beside the sin offering of atonement , and the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings .
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, kementwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogokora okobwatanigwa, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio. Ebing’wanso bi’Amatuko Amanane y’Ebigutu (Abal 23:26-32)

english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year ; they shall be without blemish :
ekegusii: Morue chieri ikomi na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari ne kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekengwanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks , two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams ,
ekegusii: Amo nechio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo na kera eyemo ye chieri chiria ikomi na isato morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo na kera eyemo ye chimingichi chiria ibere obosie ebimunu bine,

english: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs :
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria ikomi na inye obosie ebimunu bibere.

english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

english: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere morue chieri chinsae ikomi na ibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks , for the rams , and for the lambs , shall be according to their number , after the manner :
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruerwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings .
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi enene eyemo, ne chimingichi chimanwa isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

english: And on the third day eleven bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish ;
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato morue chieri ikomi nemo, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And on the fourth day ten bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
ekegusii: Rituko ria kane morue chieri ikomi, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks , for the rams , and for the lambs , shall be according to their number , after the manner :
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

english: And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
