ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano morue chieri kianda, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And on the sixth day eight bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo morue chieri isano na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

english: And one goat for a sin offering ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.

english: And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatan’akabere morue chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.

english: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.

english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the LORD : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
ekegusii: Morue eeri eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echi nachibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.

english: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock , for the ram , and for the lambs , shall be according to their number , after the manner :
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo neeri eria, na emingichi eria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.

english: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts , beside your vows , and your freewill offerings , for your burnt offerings , and for your meat offerings , and for your drink offerings , and for your peace offerings .
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio amo n’okoruegwa okwo goika mobirue ase Omonene ase chingaki chi’Amatuko aino Amanene achorire. Nabirobio bimentwe ase ebing’wanso biaino mwariete chiira ng’a morue, na ebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, onye nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose okw’ebinyugwa, gose ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.

english: And one tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
ekegusii: boigo ase kera eyemo ye chimanwa ye chimingichi chiria isano na ibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.

english: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi buna Omonene konya amochiikire.

english: Beside the burnt offering of the month , and his meat offering , and the daily burnt offering , and his meat offering , and their drink offerings , according unto their manner , for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ki’Omotienyi Omoyia, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gochiikire, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gokorentwa amo nebio, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire. Ebinto ebio bire ne rimisu rigiya, okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ebing’wanso Bie Rituko Ri’okobwatanigwa

english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year ; they shall be unto you without blemish :
ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.

english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,
ekegusii: Amo nachirochio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

english: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies : and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur .
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya Irianyi n’Abareubeni, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene na isanonemo, n’amagana atano (46,500).

english: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon : and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai .
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abasimeoni. Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred .
ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nakianda, n’amagana atato (59,300).

english: Then the tribe of Gad : and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel .
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abagadi. Eliasafu, mosinto o Reueli, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n’amagana atano nomo, na merongo etano (45,650).

english: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty , throughout their armies . And they shall set forth in the second rank .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori kia Rubeni, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano n’eyemo, n’amagana ane, namerongo etano (151,450). Aba nabwo barabe aba kabere komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

english: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp : as they encamp , so shall they set forward , every man in his place by their standards .
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakogeenda orogeendo, Eema y’Omosangererekano n’ebe ekobogorigwa n’Abalawi, na barabwo babe gati‐gati y’ebiombe binde. Ase omooroberio oyo abanto ’’mbabe bagotoora, naboigo barabe ko bakogeenda orogeendo. Kera omonto abe ensemo yaye inse y’ebendera yaye.

english: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies : and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud .
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya bosongo n’Abaefraimu, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).

english: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard , with the ensign of their father’s house : far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch .
ekegusii: “Ekero Abaisraeli baratoore, kera omonto abe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiaye, na inse y’ekemanyererio ki’eamate yaye; batoore baetanane Eema y’Omosangererekano, ne chiema chi’ abanto chirigererie Eema eria.

english: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh : and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur .
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abamanase. Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etato naibere, n’amagana abere (32,200).

english: Then the tribe of Benjamin : and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni .
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Ababenjamini. Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etato na isano, n’amagana ane (35,400).

english: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred , throughout their armies . And they shall go forward in the third rank .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gi’Efraimu, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na isano isato, ne’rigana erimo (108,100). Aba nabwo barabe aba gatato komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

english: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies : and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai .
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya sugusu n’Abadani, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nomo naibere, n’amagana atano abere (62,700).

english: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher : and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran .
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaaseri. Pagieli, mosinto bw’okirani, nere oraabe omotang’ani abo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo ene neyemo, na magana atano (41,500).

english: Then the tribe of Naphtali : and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan .
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abanafutali. Ahira, mosinto o Enani, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies : and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah .
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya moocha n’Abayuda, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: na omogaanda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na magana ane (53,400).

english: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred . They shall go hindmost with their standards .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gia Dani, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na merongo etano na isano ibere, na magana atano nomo (157,600). Aba nabwo barabe abamagega kegima komanora kogeenda orogeendo, babe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo.”

english: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers : all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abaisraeli barigetwe korwa ase kera eamate, ekeombe ase ekeombe. Omobaro obo nigo ore chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, namagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).

english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera nabo Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses : so they pitched by their standards , and so they set forward , every one after their families , according to the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Bagatoora inse ye chibendera chiabo, naende kobakogeenda orogeendo, bakageenda kera oyomo amo neamate yaye, n’enyomba yaye.

english: And his host , and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano ebere nainye, n’amagana atano nomo (74,600).

english: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar : and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar .
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaisakaru. Netaneli, mosinto o Suari, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano nainye, n’amagana ane (54,400).

english: Then the tribe of Zebulun : and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun .
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abasabuloni. Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,

english: And his host , and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred .
ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore n’abanto chilifu emerongo etano na isanaibere, n’amagana ane (57,400).

english: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred , throughout their armies . These shall first set forth .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori ki’Abayuda, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano netato na isanonemo, n’amagana ane (186,400). Aba nabwo barabe bagotang’ana komanora kogeenda orogeendo.

english: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded .
ekegusii: Musa agakwana nabatang’ani b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:

english: And if she vowed in her husband’s house , or bound her soul by a bond with an oath ;
ekegusii: “Onye omokungu ore bwoye ase omosacha oye oriete eira, gose agatiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,

english: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
ekegusii: na omosacha oye oyaigure, korende takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose komokania, omokungu oyio goika akore na goikerania kera egento akwanete.

english: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows , or concerning the bond of her soul , shall not stand : her husband hath made them void ; and the LORD shall forgive her.
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye okwanga eira yaye gose ogotiana kwaye, na kobikora bibe bosa ase rituko riria akoyaigwa, amang’ana yomokuungu oria akwanete tagoikeranigwa. Omonene naabere omokungu oria, ekiagera omosacha oye bwangire ng’a taikerania eira eria, gose ogotiana koria.

english: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void .
ekegusii: Eira ende yonsi, gose ogotiana konde gwonsi kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete, omokungu oria arakore, omosacha oye nabo aranyare koyianchera, gose koyianga.

english: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day ; then he establisheth all her vows , or all her bonds , which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oria okirete goika rituko ria kabere, takwanete ing’ana igoro y’ayio, rirorio nayiancherete, na omokungu oria goika aikeranie chiira chiaye chionsi ariete, gose ogotiana kwaye kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete. Omosacha oye nayianchete, ekiagera takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria ayaigwete.

english: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity .
ekegusii: Korende omosacha oria karasarie na kwanga amang’ana yomokuungu oye akwanete magega kayaigure, rirorio okomocha kw’ogotayaikerania nigo koraabe igoro y’omosaacha oria.”

english: These are the statutes , which the LORD commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father’s house .
ekegusii: Eye nero emeroberio echiikire, Omonene amoete Musa, yarenge koba ase egati y’omosaacha nomokuungu oye, na egati ya ise na omwana oye omoiseke otarasoka, ekero are ase omochie o ise.

english: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD , and bind herself by a bond , being in her father’s house in her youth ;
ekegusii: “Ekero omoiseke otarasoka korwa ase omochie o ise akoria eira ase Omonene, gose gotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,

english: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .
ekegusii: na ise karaigwe igoro y’eira eria y’omoiseke oye, korende takwana ring’ana, eira eria negenderere kobao. Kera egento omoiseke oria akwanire goika ageikeranie.

english: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth ; not any of her vows , or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul , shall stand : and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
ekegusii: Korende onye ise ase rituko riria araigwe ring’ana igoro y’eira eria na tayianchera, omoiseke oria tagwenereti koyeikerania. Omonene naabere omoiseke oria, ekiagera ise nangete ng’a eira eria tekobao.

english: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul ;
ekegusii: “Omoiseke oria onye onyuomirwe nomosaacha ritang’ani ataraikerania eira ariete, gose amang’ana akwanete ase ogotarengereria,

english: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand , and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
ekegusii: goika aikeranie onsi. Aya nigo arakoreke onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria aigwete amang’ana y’eira eria agakira, takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi.

english: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the LORD shall forgive her.
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria araigwe amang’ana y’eira eria tayianchera, erio eira eria omokungu oyio ariete, na amang’ana aya akwanete atarengereretie buya, tagoikeranigwa, n’Omonene naabere omokungu oyio.

english: But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her.
ekegusii: “Korende eira ende yonsi, gose amang’ana ande onsi omokungu omotakaanwa, gose oyotiganire nomosaacha oye arierete eira, gose aya atianete, goika aikeranigwe.

english: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt , and all their goodly castles , with fire .
ekegusii: Bagasamba emechie ase Abamidiani bamenyete, bagasamba nebitwori biabo bionsi bie chiema.

english: And they took all the spoil , and all the prey , both of men and of beasts .
ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa + 31:11 bagoosa: engencho yaye nokoira abanto babe abasomba abanto, boigo bakaira chitugo chionsi.

english: And they brought the captives , and the prey , and the spoil , unto Moses , and Eleazar the priest , and unto the congregation of the children of Israel , unto the camp at the plains of Moab , which are by Jordan near Jericho .
ekegusii: Erio bakarenta ebinto basakorete, na abanto boosete, ne chitugo, ase Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli otoorete ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, agwo ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko. Okoirana Kw’abarwani B’esegi

english: And Moses , and Eleazar the priest , and all the princes of the congregation , went forth to meet them without the camp .
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, amo na abaraai bonsi b’omoganda bw’ abanto, bagasoka korwa ase ebitwori, bakageenda korotota abarwani baria b’esegi.

english: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host , with the captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , which came from the battle .
ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa nabanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, baria bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi,

english: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive ?
ekegusii: akabora, “Inee! Ninki kiaba motaita abakungu?

english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones , and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him .
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono ita kera omwana omomura, naboigo moite kera omokungu obeire nomosaacha.

english: But all the women children , that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
ekegusii: Korende abaiseke bonsi abekungi timobaisa kobaita, mobaire babe abaino.

english: And do ye abide without the camp seven days : whosoever hath killed any person , and whosoever hath touched any slain , purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day , and on the seventh day .
ekegusii: Na bono, onde bwensi ore ase more oitire omonto, na onde bwensi okunire egetondo, goika abeere isiko y’egetwori ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, mwechene inwe abanyene, amo nabooswa baino.

english: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites : afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people .
ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo baabakorerete, erio magega yaye nokwe, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao.”

english: And purify all your raiment , and all that is made of skins , and all work of goats’ hair , and all things made of wood .
ekegusii: Naende mochene kera eanga, na kera egento keroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose korwa ase amanya ye chimbori, na ebinto bionsi bi’emete.”

english: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle , This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses ;
ekegusii: Na Eleazari Omokuani agateebia abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi, “Oyo n’oro omoroberio Omonene achiigete Musa:

english: Only the gold , and the silver , the brass , the iron , the tin , and the lead ,
ekegusii: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai, na ebioma ao ao,

english: Every thing that may abide the fire , ye shall make it go through the fire , and it shall be clean : nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation : and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water .
ekegusii: na ebinto binde bionsi bitanyare gosarigwa nomorero, ebio mobietie ase omorero ime ase okobirura, nabirobio nabicheneke. Nonya naboigo goika mobisibie namaache yogochena, na kera egento getanyare kobua omorero goika mogeetie ime ase amaache ayio.

english: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day , and ye shall be clean , and afterward ye shall come into the camp .
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mosibie chianga chiaino, nainwe ’namobe abachenekire; magega y’ayio monyare gosoa ase ebitwori.” Ogwatananwa kw’ebisakorwa

english: Take the sum of the prey that was taken , both of man and of beast , thou, and Eleazar the priest , and the chief fathers of the congregation :
ekegusii: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.

english: And divide the prey into two parts ; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle , and between all the congregation :
ekegusii: Erio bwatanane ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto booswa amo ne ching’iti ase chinsemo ibere. Ensemo eyemo ebe ey’abarwani b’esegi, na eyende ey’omoganda.

english: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle : one soul of five hundred , both of the persons , and of the beeves , and of the asses , and of the sheep :
ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo etungetie abarwani orusie omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto amagana atano aboosetwe abe oyo bw’Omonene. Naboigo orusie eng’iti eyemo korwa ase ching’iti amagana atano ase chiombe, chitigere, ching’ondi ne chimbori, chibe echia Omonene.

english: Take it of their half , and give it unto Eleazar the priest , for an heave offering of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baatananwe korwa ase ekeng’ese ekio baegwe Eleazari Omokuani, erio babe ekeegwa ase Omonene, naboigo ne ching’iti chiria.

english: And Moses spake unto the people , saying , Arm some of yourselves unto the war , and let them go against the Midianites , and avenge the LORD of Midian .
ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Babeeke ang’e abanto bare ase egati yaino, mobae ebirwanero bagende korwania Abamidiani, erinde bamoruserie Omonene egesiomba.

english: And of the children of Israel’s half , thou shalt take one portion of fifty , of the persons , of the beeves , of the asses , and of the flocks , of all manner of beasts , and give them unto the Levites , which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD .
ekegusii: Naende korwa ase ekeng’ese egetungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bwatanane omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye chiombe ase emerongo etano, naboigo ase chitigere, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori. Abanto abwo amo ne ching’iti echio chionsi oe Abalawi abwo bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.”

english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And the booty , being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught , was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep ,
ekegusii: Ebisakorwa ebiatigarete ase abarwani b’esegi, ebi barentete ekero babuete, nabio ebi: ching’ondi, amo ne chimbori, chilifu amagana atano nomo na merongo etano na ebere na isano (675,000),

english: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves ,
ekegusii: ne chiombe chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na ibere (72,000),

english: And threescore and one thousand asses ,
ekegusii: ne chitigere chilifu emerongo etano nomo na eyemo (61,000)

english: And thirty and two thousand persons in all , of women that had not known man by lying with him.
ekegusii: na abaiseke abekungi chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000).

english: And the half , which was the portion of them that went out to war , was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep :
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egiatungetie abarwani b’esegi nigo kiarenge: Ching’ondi amo ne chimbori chilifu amagana atato na merongo etato na isano ibere, na amagana atano (337,500).

english: And the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen .
ekegusii: Ebango y’Omonene yarusetigwe korwa ase ching’ondi echio, amo ne chimbori, nigo yarenge amagana atano rimo, na merongo etan’ebere, na isano (675).

english: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand ; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and twelve .
ekegusii: Chiombe baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000), na echia Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano na ebere, (72).

english: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred ; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and one .
ekegusii: Chitigere baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato, na amagana atano (30,500), na echi’Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano nomo, na eyemo (61).

english: Of every tribe a thousand , throughout all the tribes of Israel , shall ye send to the war .
ekegusii: Korwa ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli motome abanto elifu eyemo, bagende korwana esegi.”

english: And the persons were sixteen thousand ; of which the LORD’s tribute was thirty and two persons .
ekegusii: Abaiseke abekungi baetwe nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000) na aba Omonene nigo barenge emerongo etato, na babere (32).

english: And Moses gave the tribute , which was the LORD’s heave offering , unto Eleazar the priest , as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Musa akaa Eleazari Omokuani ensemo eria yaruetwe ase Omonene, buna ere konya achiikire Musa.

english: And of the children of Israel’s half , which Moses divided from the men that warred ,
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese giatungetie Abaisraeli, ekio Musa arusetie korwa ase abarwani baria b’esegi,

english: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep ,
ekegusii: nigo kiarenge ching’ondi chilifu amagana atato, emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500),

english: And thirty and six thousand beeves ,
ekegusii: ne chiombe chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000),

english: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred ,
ekegusii: ne chitigere chilifu emerongo etato, na amagana atano (30,500),

english: And sixteen thousand persons ;)
ekegusii: na abanto chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000).

english: Even of the children of Israel’s half , Moses took one portion of fifty , both of man and of beast , and gave them unto the Levites , which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese giatungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, Musa agaatanana oyomo bw’ abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye ching’iti emerongo etano, akaa Abalawi baria barenge gokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.

english: And the officers which were over thousands of the host , the captains of thousands , and captains of hundreds , came near unto Moses :
ekegusii: Erio abanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, bagaacha ase Musa,

english: And they said unto Moses , Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge , and there lacketh not one man of us.
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omonene, intwe abasomba bao, twabarire abarwani b’esegi abarenge inse y’oborendi bwaito, na twanyorire ng’a mbonsi bare, onde tasireti korwa ase tore.

english: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel , a thousand of every tribe , twelve thousand armed for war .
ekegusii: Ase ayio korwa ase Abaisraeli chilifu chinyinge bagachora abanto elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku. Abarwani bonsi bachoretwe kogeenda korwana esegi nigo baarenge chilifu ikomi na ibere.

english: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD , what every man hath gotten , of jewels of gold , chains , and bracelets , rings , earrings , and tablets , to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase ayio twarentire ebinto bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera: ebitange bi’amaboko, na ebigera, ne chibonyi, na ebigera bi’amato, ne chisonoi. Ebinto ebio twasakorete kera oyomo oito, na bono twabirentire, twabirure ase Omonene, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase tore ase obosio bwaye.”

english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels .
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora korwa ase abatang’ani abwo chitaabu chiria chiaroisetigwe ebinto bi’ogwechabera.

english: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD , of the captains of thousands , and of the captains of hundreds , was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels .
ekegusii: Chitaabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.

english: ( For the men of war had taken spoil , every man for himself.)
ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi konya basakoire ebinto, na kera oyomo obo konya oirire ebiaye bweka omonyene.

english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds , and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation , for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD .
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora chitaabu chiria korwa ase abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana, bagachiira ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Abaisraeli bakainyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: And Moses sent them to the war , a thousand of every tribe , them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , to the war , with the holy instruments , and the trumpets to blow in his hand .
ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto aba, elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku, bakageenda korwana esegi. Amo nabarabwo agatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari Omokuani. Ere akaira ebikorero bi’Obomenyo Obochenu na chitarumbeta bi’okobugigwa.

english: And they warred against the Midianites , as the LORD commanded Moses ; and they slew all the males .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaumokera Abamidiani, bakabarwania buna Omonene achiigete Musa, bagaita kera omosacha ase abanto abwo.

english: And they slew the kings of Midian , beside the rest of them that were slain ; namely , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , five kings of Midian : Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword .
ekegusii: Amo nabwo baitetwe nigo barenge abarwoti batano b’Abamidiani. Abarwoti abwo nabwo aba: Ebi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Boigo bagaita na Baalamu, mosinto o Beori n’omoro.

english: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives , and their little ones , and took the spoil of all their cattle , and all their flocks , and all their goods .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira abakungu b’Abamidiani amo nabana babo. Boigo bagasakora chiombe ne ching’ondi, n’ebinto bionsi bi’Abamidiani.

english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that, behold, the place was a place for cattle ;
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, nigo babwate amaicho amaange mono. Ekero barooche ense ya Yaeseri na eya Gileadi ng’a nigo chire chingiya ase oborisia,

english: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob ; because they have not wholly followed me:
ekegusii: Ekeene ase abanto bonsi baruete Misiri, aba bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, onde tari, nonya noyomo oranyare korora ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nimbae, ekiagera abanto aba bangire koba abegenwa asende.

english: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari oranyare goika aroro otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune Omokenisi, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Barabwo nabaike aroro, ekiagera babeire abegenwa ase ’nde, inche Omonene.

english: And the LORD’s anger was kindled against Israel , and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years , until all the generation , that had done evil in the sight of the LORD , was consumed .
ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akabatiga bakana‐goetanana ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika abanto bonsi b’ekiaare keria, abwo konya bakorire ebibe ase Omonene, bagasirigwa kegima.

english: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men , to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel .
ekegusii: Na bono, inwe oroiboro rw’ abanto abanyabibe, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge, na mwagerire Omonene omentire endamwamu yaye ase Abaisraeli.

english: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness ; and ye shall destroy all this people .
ekegusii: Inwe komoraange koigwera Omonene, ere nigo aratige abanto aba bonsi agwo ase erooro, nainwe mogere abanto aba bonsi basire.”

english: And they came near unto him, and said , We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle , and cities for our little ones :
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi bagaacha ase Musa bakaboora, “Toe ribaga toagache ameri amakong’u aiga ase chitugo chiaito chikobeera, naende toagache emechie egiteire chindwaki ase abana baito baramenye.

english: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .
ekegusii: Erio intwe toimokie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, twebeke ang’e totang’ane Abaisraeli korwana esegi goika tobaikie aase abo. Korende abana baito batigare aa, bamenyete ime yemechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde abanto b’ense eye tibaabaisa kobakorera bobe.

english: We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
ekegusii: Titokoirana ase chinka chiaito goika torore ng’a Abaisraeli baminto banyorire kera omonto orogongo rw’omwando oye.

english: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan , or forward ; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward .
ekegusii: Intwe titokonyora omwando oito amo nabarabwo agwo ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ekiagera twanyorire omwando oito aiga moocha ya Yorodani.”

english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses , and to Eleazar the priest , and unto the princes of the congregation , saying ,
ekegusii: bakageenda ase Musa, na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase abaraai b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, bakabateebia,

english: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the LORD to war ,
ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, agateeba, “Onye mogochia gokora bo, rirorio bogoria ebirwanero biaino bi’eseegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio mogende korwana esegi.

english: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase more, oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi nigo aramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ase obosio bw’Omonene: mobeereo goika ere abue ababisa baye barue ase are,

english: And the land be subdued before the LORD : then afterward ye shall return , and be guiltless before the LORD , and before Israel ; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD .
ekegusii: na ense eria ebe yabuirwe ase Omonene. Magega y’ayio nario moranyare koirana aiga motari na komocha, na igo monyore ense eye ebe eyaino, monyare komenya ase obosio bw’Omonene.

english: But if ye will not do so , behold, ye have sinned against the LORD : and be sure your sin will find you out .
ekegusii: Korende motaikeraneti chiira chiaino mwarire, ekeene rirorio mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, na mobe nobomaene ng’a nase engencho y’ebibe ebio biaino moranyore egesusuro.

english: Build you cities for your little ones , and folds for your sheep ; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth .
ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching’ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwariire chiira chiaino.”

english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses , saying , Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth .
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi na ab’ekia Rubeni bakamoteebia Musa, “Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao inatokore buna gwachiikire.

english: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our cattle , shall be there in the cities of Gilead :
ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.

english: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the LORD to battle , as my lord saith .
ekegusii: Korende intwe abasomba bao, kera oyomo oito oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’okorwana esegi agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene ’namboke gochia ng’umbu, buna aye omonene oito gwachiikire.”

english: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan , every man armed to battle , before the LORD , and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession :
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onye Abagadi na Abareubeni, abwo bonsi babogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, bakwamboka Yorodani amo nainwe korwana esegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, na inwe mobue ense eria, na koyeira, erio mobae ense ya Gileadi ebe eyabo.

english: Ataroth , and Dibon , and Jazer , and Nimrah , and Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Shebam , and Nebo , and Beon ,
ekegusii: “Ataroti, na Diboni, na Yaeseri, na Nimura, na Hesiboni, na Eleali, na Sibamu, na Nebo, na Beoni,

english: But if they will not pass over with you armed , they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi’eseegi bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.”

english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the LORD hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .
ekegusii: Abagadi na Abareubeni bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Bun’Omonene atochiikire intwe abasomba bao, nabo torakore.

english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan , that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
ekegusii: Intwe ’ntobogorie ebirwanero biaito bi’eseegi, na twamboke gochia ase ense ya Kaanani ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario toratware ense eye ere aa moocha ya Yorodani ebe eyaito.”

english: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , the land , with the cities thereof in the coasts , even the cities of the country round about .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaa abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi, na ab’ekia Rubeni, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na orw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Amo nechio akabaa boigo emechie y’ense eria amo ne chinse chiaetanaineo.

english: And the children of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth , and Aroer ,
ekegusii: Abagadi bakaagacha emechie ya Diboni, na Ataroti, na Aroeri,

english: And Atroth, Shophan , and Jaazer , and Jogbehah ,
ekegusii: na Ataroti‐Shofani, na Yaeseri, ne Yogibea,

english: And Beth-nimrah , and Beth-haran , fenced cities : and folds for sheep .
ekegusii: na Beti‐Nimura, na Beti‐Harani, emechie yagiteire chindwaki, naende yabwate ameri ye ching’ondi.

english: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kirjathaim ,
ekegusii: Abareubeni bakaagacha emechie ya Hesiboni, na Eleale, na Kiriataimu,

english: And Nebo , and Baal-meon , (their names being changed ,) and Shibmah : and gave other names unto the cities which they builded .
ekegusii: Nebo, na Baali‐Meoni (amarieta abo akaonchorwa), na Sibuma. Boigo bakaroka emechie eyio baagachete ase amarieta ande amayia.

english: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, bakageenda bakaumokera ense ya Gileadi, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo, erio bakaira ense eria.

english: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :
ekegusii: nemechie y’ense eyi’Omonene atigete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli okayebua, na ense eye nigo ere engiya ase oborisia bwe chitugo, na intwe abasomba bao nigo tobwate amaicho amaange ye chitugo.”

english: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh ; and he dwelt therein.
ekegusii: Musa akaa abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ense ya Gileadi, na barabwo bakamenyao.

english: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair .
ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yairi, mosinto o Manase, gekageenda, gekaumokera na koira emechie emeke y’ense ya Gileadi, bakayeroka Emechie ya Yairi.

english: And Nobah went and took Kenath , and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah , after his own name .
ekegusii: Na Noba nere akageenda akaumokera na koira Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo, nere akaroka Kenati Noba, erieta riaye omonyene.

english: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .
ekegusii: Naende bagateeba, “Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa korwa ase ore, tiga intwe, abasomba bao, toegwe ense eye ebe eyaito, korende tobaisa gotwambokia gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani komenyao.”

english: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here?
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto ba Gadi na abareubeni, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogeenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?

english: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
ekegusii: Nase ki inwe mogoita Abaisraeli emioyo, erinde tibaabaisa kwamboka gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na koira ense eri’Omonene abaeire?

english: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakageenda bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, na ekero barooche ense eria, bakairana bagaita Abaisraeli emioyo ase ogotageenda ase ense eri’Omonene konya abaeire.

english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel , which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron .
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’ebitwori bi’Abaisraeli, ekero baare ase orogeendo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase emeganda yabo inse y’oboraai bwa Musa na Aroni.

english: And they removed from Elim , and encamped by the Red sea .
ekegusii: Bakarua Elimu, bakageenda bagaika ang’e n’Enyancha Embariri, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from the Red sea , and encamped in the wilderness of Sin .
ekegusii: Bakarua aase aria bagaika erooro ya Sini, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin , and encamped in Dophkah .
ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sini, bakageenda bagaika Dofuka, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Dophkah , and encamped in Alush .
ekegusii: Bakarua Dofuka, bakageenda bagaika Alusi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Alush , and encamped at Rephidim , where was no water for the people to drink .
ekegusii: Bakarua Alusi, bakageenda bagaika Refidimu, aase abanto batanyorete amaache bakonywa, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Rephidim , and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai .
ekegusii: Bakarua Refidimu, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from the desert of Sinai , and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah .
ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sinai, bakageenda bagaika Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah , and encamped at Hazeroth .
ekegusii: Bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakageenda bagaika Haseroti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Hazeroth , and pitched in Rithmah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Haseroti, bakageenda bagaika Ritima, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Rithmah , and pitched at Rimmon-parez .
ekegusii: Bakarua Ritima, bakageenda bagaika Rimoni‐Peresi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD : and these are their journeys according to their goings out .
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achiigete Musa, nere akariika kera aase ase baare gotoora. Ebi nabio ebitwori biabo buna baare gotoora na koimoka kogeenda.

english: And they departed from Rimmon-parez , and pitched in Libnah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Rimoni‐Peresi, bakageenda bagaika Libuna, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Libnah , and pitched at Rissah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Libuna, bakageenda bagaika Risa, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they journeyed from Rissah , and pitched in Kehelathah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Risa, bakageenda bagaika Kehelata, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they went from Kehelathah , and pitched in mount Shapher .
ekegusii: Bakarua Kehelata, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa gia Seferi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from mount Shapher , and encamped in Haradah .
ekegusii: Bakarua egetunwa gia Seferi, bakageenda bagaika Harada, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Haradah , and pitched in Makheloth .
ekegusii: Bakarua Harada, bakageenda bagaika Makeloti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Makheloth , and encamped at Tahath .
ekegusii: Bakarua Makeloti bakageenda bagaika Tahati, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Tahath , and pitched at Tarah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Tahati, bakageenda bagaika Tera, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Tarah , and pitched in Mithcah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Tera, bakageenda bagaika Mitika, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they went from Mithcah , and pitched in Hashmonah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Mitika, bakageenda bagaika Hasimona, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Rameses in the first month , on the fifteenth day of the first month ; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians .
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, rituko ria ikomi na gatano, rituko riarenge kobwatia eri’Epasaka, Abaisraeli bakang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bakaimoka korwa Ramesesi, bare noboremu. Bakarua ase amasio y’Abamisiri,

english: And they departed from Hashmonah , and encamped at Moseroth .
ekegusii: Bakarua Hasimona, bakageenda bagaika Moseroti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Moseroth , and pitched in Bene-jaakan .
ekegusii: Bakarua Moseroti, bakageenda bagaika Bene‐Yakani, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Bene-jaakan , and encamped at Hor-hagidgad .
ekegusii: Bakarua Bene‐Yakani, bakageenda bagaika Hori‐Hagidigadi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they went from Hor-hagidgad , and pitched in Jotbathah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Hori‐Hagidigadi, bakageenda bagaika Yotibata, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Jotbathah , and encamped at Ebronah .
ekegusii: Bakarua Yotibata, bakageenda bagaika Aburona, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Ebronah , and encamped at Ezion-gaber .
ekegusii: Bakarua Aburona, bakageenda bagaika Esioni‐Geberi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Ezion-gaber , and pitched in the wilderness of Zin , which is Kadesh .
ekegusii: Bakarua Esioni‐Geberi, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sini (nao Kadeshi), bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Kadesh , and pitched in mount Hor , in the edge of the land of Edom .
ekegusii: Bakarua Kadeshi, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa kia Hori, ang’e norobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, bagatoora aroro.

english: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor .
ekegusii: Aroni konya okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, na etato (123), ekero akwerete agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori.

english: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn , which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments .
ekegusii: ekero barabwo barenge gotindeka abana babo abatangi, bari’Omonene aitete, naende akanachera chinyasae chiabo ekiina.

english: And they departed from mount Hor , and pitched in Zalmonah .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakageenda bagaika Salimona bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Zalmonah , and pitched in Punon .
ekegusii: Bakarua Salimona, bakageenda bagaika Punoni, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Punon , and pitched in Oboth .
ekegusii: Bakarua Punoni, bakageenda bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from Oboth , and pitched in Ije-abarim , in the border of Moab .
ekegusii: Bakarua Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, bagatoora aroro ase orobebe rwa Moabu.

english: And they departed from Iim , and pitched in Dibon-gad .
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Iyumu, bakageenda bagaika Diboni‐Gadi, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Dibon-gad , and encamped in Almon-diblathaim .
ekegusii: Bakarua Diboni‐Gadi, bakageenda bagaika Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim , and pitched in the mountains of Abarim , before Nebo .
ekegusii: Bakarua Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagaika ebitunwa bi’Abarimu kororia Nebo bagatoora aroro.

english: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim , and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
ekegusii: Bakarua ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, bakageenda bagaika ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they pitched by Jordan , from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab .
ekegusii: Bagatoora ang’e na Yorodani, na egetwori kiabo kegachaakera Beti‐Yesimoti, kegaikeera Abeli‐Sitimu, ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu. Abaisraeli Bagotebererigwa Ekero Bataramboka Orooche Rwa Yorodani

english: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses , and pitched in Succoth .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakageenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho , saying ,
ekegusii: Agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu mbarabare y’oro rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan ;
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraabe mwambokire Yorodani na mwaikire ase ense ya Kaanani,

english: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures , and destroy all their molten images , and quite pluck down all their high places :
ekegusii: moseerie abanto ababiare bonsi b’ense eria barue ase amasio aino. Naende mosarie emegwekano yabo eyio bagosasiima eroisirie korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, motagore aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasiimera.

english: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land , and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
ekegusii: Moire ense yabo ebe eyaino momenyeo, ekiagera nabayeere.

english: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes , and thorns in your sides , and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell .
ekegusii: Korende onye timogoseria ababiare b’ense eria barue ase more, rirorio baria moratige bamenye amo nainwe ’nababe buna chimbambo chinyoge chikobabeta amaiso aino, na buna amagwa akobabeta ase amakere aino; barabwo nababachaande ase ense eyio mogochia komenya.

english: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
ekegusii: Motabasereti, rirorio nimbakore inwe buna konya narengereirie kobakorera barabwo.”

english: And they departed from Succoth , and pitched in Etham , which is in the edge of the wilderness .
ekegusii: Bakarua Sukoti, bakageenda Etamu, ase ensinyo y’erooro, bagatoora aroro.

english: And they removed from Etham , and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth , which is before Baal-zephon : and they pitched before Migdol .
ekegusii: Bakarua Etamu, bakaonchoka bakairana bagaika Pi‐Hahiroti, moocha ya Baali‐Sefoni, bagatoora ang’e na Migidoli.

english: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth , and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness , and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham , and pitched in Marah .
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Pi‐Hahiroti, bakageenda bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro. Erio bakageenda orogeendo rw’amatuko atato ase erooro ya Etamu, bagatoora agwo Mara.

english: And they removed from Marah , and came unto Elim : and in Elim were twelve fountains of water , and threescore and ten palm trees ; and they pitched there.
ekegusii: Bakarua Mara, bakageenda bagaika Elimu, aase chinsoko chi’amaache ikomi na ibere chiarenge amo nemekendo emerongo etano na ebere, bagatoora aroro.

english: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham :
ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa moocha rochakere korwa Hasari‐Enani, roikere Sefamu,

english: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah , on the east side of Ain ; and the border shall descend , and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward :
ekegusii: naende rotirimboke gochia Ribula, moocha y’Aini, rotirimboke gochia moocha y’engegu y’enyancha ya Galili. + 34:11 Galili: Galili nero Kinereti

english: And the border shall go down to Jordan , and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea : this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about .
ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodani rotwomere Enyancha y’omonyoo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”

english: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers , and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers , have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance :
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo.

english: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward , toward the sunrising .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibere na ekeng’ese, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.” Abaraai Abagochia Gwatanana Ense

english: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun .
ekegusii: “Abanto aba nabwo bagochia kogokonya gwatanana ense: Ritang’ani Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.

english: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe , to divide the land by inheritance .
ekegusii: Naende ochore omoraai oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku aoboseemia gwatanana ense eria.”

english: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah , Caleb the son of Jephunneh .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachoretwe. Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.

english: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan ; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance , even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:

english: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon , Shemuel the son of Ammihud .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Semueli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.

english: Of the tribe of Benjamin , Elidad the son of Chislon .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Elidadi, mosinto o Kisiloni.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan , Bukki the son of Jogli .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Buki, mosinto o Yogili.

english: The prince of the children of Joseph , for the tribe of the children of Manasseh , Hanniel the son of Ephod .
ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim , Kemuel the son of Shiphtan .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Kemueli, mosinto o Sifutani.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun , Elizaphan the son of Parnach .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Elisafani, mosinto o Parinaki.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar , Paltiel the son of Azzan .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Palitieli, mosinto bw’Asani.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher , Ahihud the son of Shelomi .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.

english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali , Pedahel the son of Ammihud .
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Pedaheli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.

english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan .
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabw’Omone ne achiigete baatanane ense ya Kaanani ebe emiando y’Abaisraeli.

english: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom , and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward :
ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi, ense yaino eike ase erooro ya Sini, egenderere gochia ase orobebe rwa Edomu. Orobebe rwaino rwa Irianyi rochakere ensemo ya moocha ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo,

english: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim , and pass on to Zin : and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea , and shall go on to Hazar-addar , and pass on to Azmon :
ekegusii: naende roonchoke gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge roetere Sini, Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea. Korwa agwo rogenderere roike Hasari‐Adari, naende roete roike Asimoni,

english: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt , and the goings out of it shall be at the sea .
ekegusii: na korwa agwo Asimoni rogenderere kobwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri, roike Enyancha Enene.

english: And as for the western border , ye shall even have the great sea for a border : this shall be your west border .
ekegusii: “Enyancha Enene nero erabe orobebe rwaino rwa bosongo.

english: And this shall be your north border : from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor :
ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu ’ndochakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rogenderere gochia ase egetunwa kia Hori.

english: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath ; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad :
ekegusii: Korwa aroro rogenderere roike enchera ekogeenda Hamati, erio naende rogenderere goikera Sedadi,

english: And the border shall go on to Ziphron , and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan : this shall be your north border .
ekegusii: naende rogenderere gochia Sifuroni, na korwa aroro roike Hasari‐Enani. Oro narwo orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan ;
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika ense ya Kaanani,

english: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares .
ekegusii: mochore emechie erabe obotamero ase more, erinde omonto onde bwensi, ora’be oitire omonto onde mosiabano, natamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.

english: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger ; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nebe obotamero bwaino, erinde omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oria oitwa, omoiti oria aratamere gochiao, abeereo goika rituko arache korentwa kogambigwa ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi.

english: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio morachore ebe ey’obotamero nigo erabe etano nomo.

english: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan , and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan , which shall be cities of refuge .
ekegusii: Etato ebe moocha ya Yorodani, na etato ebe ase ense ya Kaanani. Eyio ebe emechie y’obotamero.

english: These six cities shall be a refuge , both for the children of Israel , and for the stranger , and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio etano nomo ebe ey’obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abageni bagoeta, na ase abanto bare abamenyi ase egati yabo, erinde monto onde bwensi oraite omonto mosiabano atancheti atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.

english: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron , so that he die , he is a murderer : the murderer shall surely be put to death .
ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oakire omonto onde negento buna ekioma, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe.

english: And if he smite him with throwing a stone , wherewith he may die , and he die , he is a murderer : the murderer shall surely be put to death .
ekegusii: Boigo onye omonto obwate rigena ase okoboko kwaye oakire omonto onde, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe, ekiagera ere nomoorominta.

english: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood , wherewith he may die , and he die , he is a murderer : the murderer shall surely be put to death .
ekegusii: Gose onye omonto oakire omonto onde nomote abwate ase okoboko kwaye, erinde omonto oria akwe, omoiti oyio nigo aita oria moeneno, nere goika aitwe akwe.

english: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer : when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
ekegusii: Omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oitetwe, nere oraite omoiti oria aande onsi ase araumerane nere.

english: Command the children of Israel , that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in ; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
ekegusii: “Chiika Abaisraeli ng’a korwa ase emiando eyio baranyore baatananere Abalawi emechie baramenye, amo noborisia boetanaineo.

english: But if he thrust him of hatred , or hurl at him by laying of wait , that he die ;
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogechete oyonde na komoita ase okomotwoma, gose komoruta egento moeneno, na komoita,

english: Or in enmity smite him with his hand , that he die : he that smote him shall surely be put to death ; for he is a murderer : the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer , when he meeteth him.
ekegusii: gose ase engencho y’obobisa bwarengeo agaaka oyonde nokoboko kwaye na komoita, rirorio omonto oria oaka oyonde na komoita, nere goika aitwe akwe. Ere nomoiti. Omonto oria okogania korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere oramoite aande onsi ase araumerane nere.

english: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity , or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait ,
ekegusii: “Eise koba ng’a omonto nigo atwomete oyonde atamogechete agwo ritang’ani, gose nigo amorutete egento mosiabano,

english: Or with any stone , wherewith a man may die , seeing him not , and cast it upon him, that he die , and was not his enemy , neither sought his harm :
ekegusii: gose omonto oria nigo arutete rigena, tamorooche, korende akamoaka akamoita atamogechete, gose taganetie komokorera bobe.

english: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments :
ekegusii: Onye ekoba bo, omosangererekano bw’ abanto n’oro oragaambe ekiina ase egati y’omonto oria oita omonto onde mosiabano na oria oganetie korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oitetwe, na onache ekiina koreng’ana nemeroberio echiikire.

english: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood , and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge , whither he was fled : and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest , which was anointed with the holy oil .
ekegusii: Omosangererekano bw’ abanto notoorie omoiti oria korwa ase oria oganetie korusia egesiomba. Bamotige airane abeere ase omochie oria bw’obotamero atamerete, amenye aroro goika Omokuani omonene bw’engaki eyio, oyoakire amagutwa, akwe.

english: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge , whither he was fled ;
ekegusii: Korende onye omoiti oria o mosiabano ase engaki ende yonsi ogosoka korwa ase omochie bw’obotamero, agwo ase atamerete,

english: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge , and the revenger of blood kill the slayer ; he shall not be guilty of blood :
ekegusii: na omonto oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo amonyore ore isiko y’omochie oria karamoite, rirorio takobarerwa okomocha ase okomoita.

english: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest : but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession .
ekegusii: Omonto oria oitete oyonde moeneno goika agenderere kobeera ase omochie oria bw’obotamero goika Omokuani bw’engaki eyio akwe. Korende Omokuani oria omonene gakuure, omonto oria nairane gochia ase ense yaye, na ase omwando oye.

english: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
ekegusii: Okwo nogochika kwa boronge koraabe ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aase aande onsi ase moraabe momenyete.

english: And the cities shall they have to dwell in ; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle , and for their goods , and for all their beasts .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio ebe eyabo baramenye, na ebitii bi’oborisia bakorisia chiombe chiabo ne ching’iti chiabo chinde chionsi.

english: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer , which is guilty of death : but he shall be surely put to death .
ekegusii: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire n’okomocha kw’ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.

english: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge , that he should come again to dwell in the land , until the death of the priest .
ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria omoiti o mosiabano otamire gochia ase oyomo bw’emechie y’obotamero takoboorigwa ng’a erio airane ase ense yaye ekero Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eyio atarakwa.

english: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land : and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, nigo morasarie ense eye ase momenyete na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti, ekiagera amanyinga agoiterwa nigo arakore ense ebe etachenegeti, na okobwatanigwa konde tikori korakorwe ase ense eria ase engencho y’amanyinga aiteirwe, otatiga ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ay’oria omoiti oka.

english: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit , wherein I dwell : for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Timokora ense eyio ase momenyete ebe etachenegeti, ekiagera inche nigo imenyete ase egati yaino. Inche ninche Omonene imenyete ase egati y’ abanto bane Abaisraeli.”

english: And the suburbs of the cities , which ye shall give unto the Levites , shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about .
ekegusii: Ebitii bi’oborisia morae Abalawi bichakere korwa ase chindwaki chi’omochie, bigareigwe gochia ase oboare bwechifuti elifu eyemo korwa ase kera ensemo y’omochie.

english: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits , and on the south side two thousand cubits , and on the west side two thousand cubits , and on the north side two thousand cubits ; and the city shall be in the midst : this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities .
ekegusii: Naende mobare isiko y’omochie, ensemo ya moocha ekerengo giechifuti chilifu ibere, na ensemo ya Irianyi, na eya sugusu, na eya bosongo boigo, chifuti chilifu ibere; omochie obe gati‐gati. Ebitii ebi bi’oborisia Abalawi baegwe amo ne’mechie yabo.

english: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge , which ye shall appoint for the manslayer , that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities .
ekegusii: Moe Abalawi emechie etan’omo y’obotamero, erinde ekero omonto aitire omonto onde mosiabano, anyare gotamerao, naende mobae emechie ende emeao emerongo ene na ebere.

english: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities : them shall ye give with their suburbs .
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi morabae nigo erabe emerongo ene, na etan’etato, amo nebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie eyio.

english: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel : from them that have many ye shall give many ; but from them that have few ye shall give few : every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth .
ekegusii: Emechie eyio morae Abalawi nigo morayerusie korwa ase eria Abaisraeli babwate. Morusie emechie emenge korwa ase egesaku keria kere ekenene kebwate emechie emenge, na korwa ase egesaku kere egeke kebwate emechie emeke morusie emekeo, koreng’ana nomobaro obo.” Emechie Y’obotamero (Okoir 19:1-3; Yosh 20:1-9)

english: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
ekegusii: Erio abanene b’egesaku kia Gileadi mosinto o Makiri mosinto o Manase abwo barenge korwa ase chinyomba chie egesaku kia Yusufu bagaacha na gokwana ase obosio bwa Musa, boigo ase abarai amo na abateneneri b’echinyomba chia Abaisraeli.

english: Even as the LORD commanded Moses , so did the daughters of Zelophehad :
ekegusii: Abaiseke ba Selofehadi bagakora buna Omonene Nyasae amochiigete Musa.

english: For Mahlah , Tirzah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Noah , the daughters of Zelophehad , were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons :
ekegusii: Abaiseke obwo ba Selofehadi; Maala, Teresa, Ogila, Milika, amo na Nuhu bakanywomwa n’abamwabo korwa are ororeeria rwa ise.

english: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph , and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father .
ekegusii: Bakanywomwa gochia ase emechie y’ororeria rwa Manase mosinto o Yusufu erio omwando oise ogatigara ase egesaku kiabo ime ase enyomba yabo.

english: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko n’emeroberio y’Omonene Nyasae, buna biaruetwe gochia ase Abaisraeli, goteera ase Musa agwo ase ense omweya ya Moabu ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani ang’e n’omochie o Yeriko.

english: And they said , The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
ekegusii: Bagateeba, “ekero Omonene Nyasae aruete ogochika buna ebisaku bigaberwe emegondo buna omwando obo ase obomera, nigo ateebete omwando o Selofehadi oegwe abaiseke baye.

english: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
ekegusii: Eraisa koba barabwo banywomirwe nabaanto b’ebisaku na omwando oyio obo korwa ase emegondo yaito ementeranigwe ase ebisaku biria basokerete; igo omwando bw’egesaku giaito nigo okoirwa korwa ase tore?

english: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .
ekegusii: Boigo ekero omwaka bw’echubiri ase Abaisraeli, engaki eria chinibo chionsi chiebisakore chikoiranerigwa abanyene, nenyarekane omwando ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi oriegwe na abasacha babo korwa ase ebisaku bia isiko”.

english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD , saying , The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarua ogochika ase Musa ogoteeba; ayio nekeene abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu bagokwana.

english: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi, barabwo ’mbare nobosibore konywomwa na monto onde bwensi banchete, korende omonto oyio goika arue ase egesaku kiabo.

english: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe : for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers .
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Naboigo kera Omoisraeli narende omwando oye omotungetie.

english: And every daughter , that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel , shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers .
ekegusii: Kera omoiseke ore omonyamwando ase egesaku kia Abaisraeli goika anywomwe ase omonto bw’egesaku kiaye, erio kera Omoisraeli anyare konyora omwando korwa ase ororeeria rwe chisokoro chiaye.

english: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nenyarekane ng’a omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Kera egesaku ase Abaisraeli ’nkenyare koegerera omwando oye ogetungetie.

english: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai .
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, na orwa Musa, ase engaki eri’Omonene akwanete na Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.

english: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons , and they shall wait on their priest’s office : and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
ekegusii: Obeeke Aroni amo n’abamura baye bakore emeremo y’obokuani, korende monto onde bwensi omoao aise gwesoyia ase emeremo eyio nigo araitwe akwe.”

english: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel , both man and beast : mine shall they be: I am the LORD .
ekegusii: ekiagera abana abatangi bonsi nabaane. Ase rituko riria naitete abana abatangi, ne ching’iti chintangi, agwo Misiri, nigo neatananerete abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli babe abaane, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Inche ninche Omonene.” Omobaro bw’Abalawi

english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai , saying ,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, Omonene agakwana nere, akamoteebia,

english: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers , by their families : every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
