ekegusii: “Bara Abalawi enyomba ase enyomba, na eamate ase eamate. Oriike kera omonto omosacha, naboigo kera omwana omomura okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania.”

english: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD , as he was commanded .
ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaabara, buna Omonene amochiigete.

english: And these were the sons of Levi by their names ; Gershon , and Kohath , and Merari .
ekegusii: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families ; Libni , and Shimei .
ekegusii: Abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei.

english: And the sons of Kohath by their families ; Amram , and Izehar , Hebron , and Uzziel .
ekegusii: Abana ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.

english: And the sons of Merari by their families ; Mahli , and Mushi . These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers .
ekegusii: Abana ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chisokoro chie chiamate chi’Abalawi, kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.

english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites , and the family of the Shimites : these are the families of the Gershonites .
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Libini na eya Simei, abwo nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gerisoni.

english: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males , from a month old and upward , even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred .
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano ibere, na magana atano (7,500).

english: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward .
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya bosongo magega y’Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael .
ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Laeli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni.

english: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle , and the tent , the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
ekegusii: Ase Eema y’Omosangererekano Abagerisoni nabwo barabe bakorenda Obomenyo obonyene, na ebimumeko biaye, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’Eema eria.

english: And the hangings of the court , and the curtain for the door of the court , which is by the tabernacle , and by the altar round about , and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
ekegusii: Naende babe bakorenda ebitambaa bigosungwa ase ogotuba eraaro, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo Obochenu, na egesasiimero, ne chingori chiabo. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

english: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites , and the family of the Izeharites , and the family of the Hebronites , and the family of the Uzzielites : these are the families of the Kohathites .
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate y’Amuramu, na eya Isari, na eya Heburoni, na eya Usieli; abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Kohati.

english: In the number of all the males , from a month old and upward , were eight thousand and six hundred , keeping the charge of the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano isato, na magana atano nomo (8,600). Abanto aba nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya Irianyi y’Obomenyo boria.

english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron , the priests which were anointed , whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office .
ekegusii: Abamura aba ba Aroni nabwo baagetwe amaguta na gwatananwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel .
ekegusii: Elisafani, mosinto bwa Usieli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’egesaku ki’Abakohati.

english: And their charge shall be the ark , and the table , and the candlestick , and the altars , and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister , and the hanging , and all the service thereof.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kwogotianania, n’emesa, n’ekebeekerero gie chitaaya, na ebisasimero, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Obomenyo boria, biria abakuani bagokorera emeremo, amo negetambaa getubete Aase Aachenu Mono. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites , and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oraabe omonene igoro ase abaraai b’Abalawi, naende omoteneneri bw’abaanto barabe bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites , and the family of the Mushites : these are the families of Merari .
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Mali, na eya Musi abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari.

english: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males , from a month old and upward , were six thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na magana abere (6,200).

english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail : these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo boria. Surieli, mosinto bw’Abihaili, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Merari.

english: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
ekegusii: Abamerari nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, n’emeriibo, ne chisiiro, ne chinterekerero, amo nebikorero biabo bionsi. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

english: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords .
ekegusii: Nabwo naende babegetwe korenda chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo na ebirochi, ne chingori chiabo.

english: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east , even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward , shall be Moses , and Aaron and his sons , keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel ; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death .
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni amo nabamura baye mbabe bagotoora kororia Obomenyo Obochenu ensemo ya moocha, bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Barabwo nigo barabe bagokora emeremo eganeirie gokorwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, na gotenenera emeremo ende yonsi erakorerwe Abaisraeli. Omonto onde bwensi otatananiri gokora emeremo eyio, korende aike ang’e ase Obomenyo Obochenu, nigo araitwe akwe.

english: All that were numbered of the Levites , which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD , throughout their families , all the males from a month old and upward , were twenty and two thousand .
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha b’Abalawi, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, abwo Musa na Aroni bariigete, eamate ase eamate, buna Omonene abachiigete, nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000). Abalawi Bakobekwa Ribaga Ri’abamura Abatangi B’Abaisraeli

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward , and take the number of their names .
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Bara abanto abasacha abatangi, n’abana abamura abatangi bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, obariike.

english: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD ) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel ; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene. Ase ayio Abalawi ’mbabe abaane. Obanyatananere ribaga ri’abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli. Naboigo ne ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli onyatananere ching’iti chi’Abalawi.”

english: And Moses numbered , as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Musa akabara na korika abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli, ne ching’iti chintangi, buna Omonene amochiigete.

english: And all the firstborn males by the number of names , from a month old and upward , of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abasacha abatangi n’abana abamura abatangi konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere, na merongo etano ebere, na batato (22,273).

english: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel , and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle ; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD .
ekegusii: “Ira Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’ abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli, naende oire ching’iti chi’Abalawi chibe echiane ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene.

english: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel , which are more than the Levites ;
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli nabange bare, mbaetanetie Abalawi ase amagana abere, na emerongo etano ebere na batato (273).

english: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll , after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs :)
ekegusii: Ase ayio oboorie kera oyomo obo ne chitaabu chie chisekeli isano, koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere).

english: And thou shalt give the money , wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed , unto Aaron and to his sons .
ekegusii: Omoe Aroni amo nabamura baye chitaabu echio chi’okobooria abatangi abwo baetanetie Abalawi.”

english: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites :
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa agasangereria chitaabu chiria chiabooretie abanto baria barenge abange goetania baria babooretigwe ekiagera Abalawi babete ribaga riabo.

english: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money ; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary :
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ abanto baria abatangi b’Abaisraeli, akanyora chitaabu chie chisekeli elifu eyemo, na amagana atato, na merongo etano nomo, na isano (1,365), koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons , according to the word of the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Musa akaa Aroni amo nabamura baye chitaabu chiria chi’okobooria, buna Omonene amochiigete.

english: Bring the tribe of Levi near , and present them before Aaron the priest , that they may minister unto him.
ekegusii: “Renta abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi, erinde obabeeke bamokorere Aroni, Omokuani.

english: And they shall keep his charge , and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation , to do the service of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Abalawi abwo ’mbakorere Aroni emeremo, boigo bakorere omoganda bwonsi agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekero bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the children of Israel , to do the service of the tabernacle .
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbatenenere ebinto bionsi bire ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase ogokora emeremo yonsi ase Obomenyo Obochenu nigo barabe bagokorera Abaisraeli bonsi.

english: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons : they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Aroni amo n’abamura baye baegwe Abalawi buna ekeegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.

english: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins , and shall put it upon a bar .
ekegusii: Nababeeke ekebeekerero ekio amo nebikorero biaye ase omobuko bwe risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.

english: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue , and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins , and shall put to the staves thereof:
ekegusii: “Naende baare egetambaa kere buru kegima igoro ase egesasiimero keroisirie korwa ase etaabu, na bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche; erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasiimero keria.

english: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry , wherewith they minister in the sanctuary , and put them in a cloth of blue , and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins , and shall put them on a bar :
ekegusii: Nabaimokie ebinto bionsi bigokorerwa ase emeremo agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Babibeke ime ase egetambaa kere buru kegima; erio babitube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.

english: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon:
ekegusii: Barabwo babuuche ribu, naende batube egesasiimero negetambaa kere monyinga.

english: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basons , all the vessels of the altar ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins , and put to the staves of it.
ekegusii: Igoro ase egesasiimero ekio babeeke ebikorero bionsi ebio bigokorerwa ase ogosasiima: chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chigami, na ebichiiko, ne chisani, naende baare risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche igoro ase ebio bionsi, babitube. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasiimero keria.

english: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary , and all the vessels of the sanctuary , as the camp is to set forward ; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing , lest they die . These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Ekero engaki eraike, abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, na ekero Aroni na abamura baye bakoorire gotuba Eema y’Omosangererekano, amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo, Abakohati bachiche babogorie ebinto ebi ebichenu, korende tibabikuna. Baise kobikuna, nigo barakwe. “Emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebio bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano nigo erabe ey’Abakohati.

english: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light , and the sweet incense , and the daily meat offering , and the anointing oil , and the oversight of all the tabernacle , and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary , and in the vessels thereof.
ekegusii: “Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oratenenere amaguta e chitaaya, na ubani egotioka buya, na okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, na amaguta akweakwa. Ase igo emeremo yaye ebe ey’okorenda Obomenyo Obochenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu ebire imeo.”

english: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :
ekegusii: “Timotiga abanto be chiamate chia Kohati basirigwe korwa ase Abalawi.

english: But thus do unto them, that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero barabe bagoika ang’e n’ebinto biria ebichenu mono, Aroni na abamura baye basoe aroro, bae kera oyomo obo emeremo, na komoteebia keria arabe ogokora na kobogoria. Erio nario barabe moyo, tibakwa.

english: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , after their families , by the house of their fathers ,
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare be chiamate chia Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba,

english: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered , lest they die .
ekegusii: Korende Abakohati baise gosoa na korora ebinto biria ebichenu, nonya netagika ensinini, nigo barakwe.” Emeremo Y’Abagerisoni

english: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon , throughout the houses of their fathers , by their families ;
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare b’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: Oriike abasacha bonsi abare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :
ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo abanto be chiamate chia Gerisoni barakore naende buna barabe bakobogoria ebinto ebi:

english: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabogorie ebitambaa bi’Obomenyo Obochenu amo nebitubo bi’Eema eria, ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche rikobituba, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema eria,

english: And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them: so shall they serve .
ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo boria na egesasiimero, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori chionsi chireo amo nebikorero bigokorerwao. Barabwo bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.

english: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites , in all their burdens , and in all their service : and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens .
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye nabwo barachike Abagerisoni ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria, na onsi aya barakore; inwe mobatige batenenere ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria.

english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
ekegusii: Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oratenenere emeremo abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Emeremo Y’Abamerari

english: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers ;
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare ab’ororeria rwa Merari, eamate ase eamate na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
ekegusii: abwo bare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
ekegusii: Emeremo yabo ase Eema eria ebe ey’okobogoria ebinto ebi: Chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,

english: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service : and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden .
ekegusii: ne chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na ebirochi, ne chingori, amo nebikorero bionsi bigokorerwao. Obaatorere ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakobogoria.

english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo y’ abanto be chiamate chia Merari barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, inse y’oboteneneri bwa Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani.” Omobaro bw’Abalawi

english: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
ekegusii: Musa, na Aroni, na abaraai b’omoganda bagakora omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :
ekegusii: Bakariika abasacha bonsi abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetwe ase chiamate chiabo nigo barenge chilifu ibere, amagana atano abere, nemerongo etano (2,750).

english: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Oyio n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abakohati abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

english: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakariikwa.

english: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation , about the most holy things :
ekegusii: Emeremo Abakohati barakore agwo ase Eema eria nokorenda ebinto bire ebichenu mono.

english: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu ibere, amagana atano nomo na merongo etato (2,630).

english: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD .
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni, abarigetwe, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete.

english: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers ,
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Merari, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu isato, n’amagana abere (3,200).

english: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abamerari, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

english: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
ekegusii: Musa, na Aroni, na abaraai b’Abaisraeli nigo baabarete Abalawi bonsi eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.

english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
ekegusii: Abwo abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,

english: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
ekegusii: nigo barenge abanto chilifu isano isato na amagana atano, na merongo etano netato (8,580).

english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo baabaretwe buna Omonene achiigete goetera ase Musa. Kera omonto agateebigwa emeremo yaye arakore na ebinto arabogorie buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

english: And when the camp setteth forward , Aaron shall come , and his sons , and they shall take down the covering vail , and cover the ark of testimony with it:
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, Aroni amo n’abamura baye babe bagosoa ase Eema ime, basungore egetambaa keria getubete Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na gotuba Esanduki eria negetambaa ekio.

english: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof.
ekegusii: Naende batube egetambaa ekio ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na igoro ase risankwa erio baare egetambaa kere buru kegima. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria Esanduki eria.

english: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue , and put thereon the dishes , and the spoons , and the bowls , and covers to cover withal : and the continual bread shall be thereon:
ekegusii: “Igoro ase emesa yemegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene baare egetambaa kere buru kegima, naende babeekeo chinteru, ne chisani ase ubani, amo n’ebitaabo n’ebitoono, ase ebio bagochia koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa. Emegati ekoruegwa botambe ase Omonene ebekweo boigo.

english: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins , and shall put in the staves thereof.
ekegusii: Baare egetambaa ekebariri igoro ase ebinto ebio, bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria emesa eria.

english: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
ekegusii: “Erio baimokie egetambaa kere buru kegima, batube ekebeekerero gie chitaaya amo ne chitaaya chiaye, na ebinachi, ne chindogio chiaye, ne chichuba chire n’amaguta y’amazeituni, ebinto bigokorerwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.

english: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest , it shall be his.
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi omonto araatanane koba ebichenu nigo birabe ebi’Omokuani oyio okobiegwa.” Abakungu Bagokagerwa Nabasaacha Babo Ng’a Tibari Abegenwa

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside , and commit a trespass against him,
ekegusii: Teebia Abaisraeli: Ebaise koba ng’a omokungu bw’omonto obeire otari omwegenwa’ ase are.

english: And a man lie with her carnally , and it be hid from the eyes of her husband , and be kept close , and she be defiled , and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
ekegusii: Omonto omoao kararaare nere ase obotomani, nonya ayio karabe abisekanete ase omosacha bw’omokuungu oyio, omokungu oyio bwekorire omosaria, nonya kirori onde tari okomoteeba ekiagera tabwatetwe okobokora.

english: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife , and she be defiled : or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife , and she be not defiled :
ekegusii: Omosacha oye karabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu akagere mok’aye ng’a bwekorire omosaria, nere abe okorete ayio, gose tayakorete,

english: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest , and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal ; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy , an offering of memorial , bringing iniquity to remembrance .
ekegusii: omosacha oye amoire ase Omokuani. Boigo arue obosie bw’esairi ebimunu bibere, ase engencho y’omokuungu oria. Taumora amaguta igoro y’okoruegwa okwo, gose ubani, ekiagera n’okoruegwa ase engencho ye risemi riaye. Okwo n’okoruegwa koragere okomocha koinyorwe.

english: And the priest shall bring her near , and set her before the LORD :
ekegusii: Omokuani arente omokungu oria amobeeke ase obosio bw’Omonene,

english: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel ; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take , and put it into the water :
ekegusii: aumore amaache amaachenu ase egetaabo ki’amaroba, naende aimokie amaroba korwa inse agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ayabeeke ime ase amaache aria.

english: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD , and uncover the woman’s head , and put the offering of memorial in her hands , which is the jealousy offering : and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse :
ekegusii: Omokuani abeeke omokungu oria ase obosio bw’Omonene, asansore etukia y’omotwe bw’omokuungu oria, naende abeeke okoruegwa koria gw’ekeinyorio ase amaboko ’omokuungu oria. Omokuani omonyene abwate ase okoboko kwaye egetaabo kere namaache amaroro, ayio akorenta okoragereria.

english: And the priest shall charge her by an oath , and say unto the woman , If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband , be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse :
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abeeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa, amoteebie: Onye omonto omoao taraarete naye, na igo tigwakorete obotomani ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, rirorio amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa takonyara kogokorera bobe bonde.

english: Command the children of Israel , that they put out of the camp every leper , and every one that hath an issue , and whosoever is defiled by the dead :
ekegusii: “Bachiike Abaisraeli barusie korwa ase ebitwori biabo kera omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, na omonto okorua amaache anga buna chimengere, na omonto onde bwensi bwesoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo.

english: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband , and if thou be defiled , and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband :
ekegusii: Korende onye gwatomanire nomonto omoao ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, na gwekorire omosaria,

english: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing , and the priest shall say unto the woman , The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people , when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot , and thy belly to swell ;
ekegusii: (agwo Omokuani abeeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa gw’okomotiania) rirori’Omonene nagere abanto bao bakoragererie na kogochaaya, karakore enda yao egombae na kobimba.

english: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels , to make thy belly to swell , and thy thigh to rot : And the woman shall say , Amen , amen .
ekegusii: Tiga amaache aya akorenta okoragereria kagosoa enda yao, ayekore ebimbe na kogombaa. Omokungu oria airanerie: Ee, ekeene, amina.

english: And the priest shall write these curses in a book , and he shall blot them out with the bitter water :
ekegusii: “Erio Omokuani ariike amang’ana ayio ay’okoragereria okwo ime ase egetabu, naende ayasibie namaache aria amaroro.

english: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse : and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter .
ekegusii: Erio ae omokungu oria amaache ayio anywe, na ekero amaache aya amaroro asoire ase enda yaye arente okoragererigwa na obororo.

english: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand , and shall wave the offering before the LORD , and offer it upon the altar :
ekegusii: Omokuani arusie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokuungu oria okoruegwa kwe endamwamu, na kogosungusia ase obosio bw’Omonene. Magega y’ayio akorente ase egesasiimero.

english: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering , even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar , and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water .
ekegusii: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y’ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.

english: And when he hath made her to drink the water , then it shall come to pass, that , if she be defiled , and have done trespass against her husband , that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter , and her belly shall swell , and her thigh shall rot : and the woman shall be a curse among her people .
ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria tabeete omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende bwekorire omosaria, amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa akore enda yaye ebimbe, naende egombae. Ase enchera eyio omokungu oyio abe ekiorokererio gi’okoragererigwa kegwatorwa ase egati y’ abanto baye.

english: And if the woman be not defiled , but be clean ; then she shall be free , and shall conceive seed .
ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria takorete obotomani korende nigo are omoikeranu, rirorio tagokorerwa bobe, otatiga aibore abana.

english: This is the law of jealousies , when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband , and is defiled ;
ekegusii: “Oko nogochika ase amang’ana ye endamwamu, ekero omokungu atari omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende akore obotomani na gwekora omosaria.

english: Both male and female shall ye put out , without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps , in the midst whereof I dwell .
ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa ase ebitwori abasacha na abakungu abwo babeire abatachenegeti babeere isiko, erinde tibaabaisa gokora ebitwori biabo bibe bitachenegeti, agwo ase inche imenyete ase egati y’ abanto bane.”

english: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him , and he be jealous over his wife , and shall set the woman before the LORD , and the priest shall execute upon her all this law .
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha arabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu na gokagera mok’aye ng’a nomotomani, omosacha oria amorente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omokuani akore onsi aya achiikire.

english: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity , and this woman shall bear her iniquity .
ekegusii: Omosacha oria takoba nokomocha, korende onye mok’aye okorire ogosaria okwo, goika aegwe egesusuro.”

english: And the children of Israel did so , and put them out without the camp : as the LORD spake unto Moses , so did the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Omonene atebeetie Musa. Bakarusia korwa ase ebitwori abanto abwo. Okorongeyia Ogokora Okobe

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit , to do a trespass against the LORD , and that person be guilty ;
ekegusii: “Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a, ekero omonto omosacha, gose omokungu, arakore ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora ase ogotaba abegenwa ase Omonene, na omonto oria oraabe omomochi,

english: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done : and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed .
ekegusii: omonto oyio goika aorokie ebibe biria. Boigo airanie ase omonto oria aurete rigori ri’eniibo eyio amourete, naende amente eyemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.

english: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD , even to the priest ; beside the ram of the atonement , whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okuure, naende omoamate oye tari okoiranerigwa egento ekio kiairetwe, rirorio kerentwe ase Omonene kebe eki’Omokuani. Amo nayio omonto oyio amente emingichi erakorerwe okobwatanigwa ase are.

english: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel , which they bring unto the priest , shall be his.
ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’ebinto ebichenu Abaisraeli baraarente ase Omokuani, ebinto ebio ’nabibe ebiaye.

english: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles , or two young pigeons , to the priest , to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, arente amaruma abere, gose amage y’amaruma abere, ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead , and shall hallow his head that same day .
ekegusii: Omokuani arue riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Omwerwa oria, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase ogoika ang’e negetondo. Ase rituko erio erio omonto oria achene omotwe oye,

english: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation , and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering : but the days that were before shall be lost , because his separation was defiled .
ekegusii: na eatanane ase Omonene naende, ase engaki eng’ana buna eria ariete eira koba Omwerwa agwo ritang’ani. Erio arente emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ekiagera amatuko aria aye amatang’ani eatananete ase Omonene buna Omwerwa oye takobarwa korende nigo arabe bosa, ekiagera okwerwa kwaye gwakorirwe ogotachenegeti.

english: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD , one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering , and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering , and one ram without blemish for peace offerings ,
ekegusii: Ere arue ekeng’wanso kiaye ase Omonene: emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na emanwa esigiti yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe; chionsi chibe chitari na bimocho ase emebere yabo.

english: And a basket of unleavened bread , cakes of fine flour mingled with oil , and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil , and their meat offering , and their drink offerings .
ekegusii: Boigo arente egetonga kere n’emagaati etabekiri memera, na arue amaandasi aroisirie n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta, na emagaati emeoo eakire amaguta, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo.

english: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD , and shall offer his sin offering , and his burnt offering :
ekegusii: “Omokuani arente ebinto ebio ase obosio bw’Omonene na arue ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa ase engencho y’omonto oria.

english: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , with the basket of unleavened bread : the priest shall offer also his meat offering , and his drink offering .
ekegusii: Boigo arue emingichi eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene, ayerue amo n’emagaati etabekiri memera ere egetonga ime, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.

english: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall take the hair of the head of his separation , and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings .
ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Omwerwa oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye ere ekemanyererio ng’a neatananete ase Omonene. Erio aire etukia yaye, ayerute ase omorero oria ore inse y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

english: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram , and one unleavened cake out of the basket , and one unleavened wafer , and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite , after the hair of his separation is shaven :
ekegusii: “Magega, ekero Omwerwa oria akoorire gokigita etukia yaye, Omokuani aimokie rireko ri’emingichi riaiyekirwe, na korwa ase egetonga arusie omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, na omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, ayebeke ase amaboko y’Omwerwa oria.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite , to separate themselves unto the LORD :
ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a ekero omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, akoria eira abe oyo bweatananire ase Omonene abe Omwerwa oye,

english: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD : this is holy for the priest , with the wave breast and heave shoulder : and after that the Nazarite may drink wine .
ekegusii: Omokuani arente ebinto ebio amo ne ritaana na ekenama bi’emingichi, abisungusie bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Ebinto ebio nigo biatananetwe ase Omokuani. Erio nario Omwerwa oria arabe ne ribaga konywa edivai.”

english: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed , and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation , beside that that his hand shall get : according to the vow which he vowed , so he must do after the law of his separation .
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase oyoriete eira ng’a abe Omwerwa Omonene, goika arue ase Omonene aya amorierete eira akorua ore Omwerwa oye, korende onye oriire eira arue goetania, goika ayeikeranie kegima koreng’ana nogochika gw’okwerwa. Ogosesenia Kw’Omonene Kogokwanwa N’abakuani

english: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons , saying , On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel , saying unto them,
ekegusii: Moteebie Aroni amo nabamura baye ng’a, ekero barabe bagosesenia Abaisraeli, bakwane amang’ana aya:

english: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
ekegusii: Omonene abasesenie, abareende;

english: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
ekegusii: Omonene abaraberie obosio bwaye, abaabere;

english: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace .
ekegusii: Omonene abaonchorere obosio bwaye, abae omorembe.

english: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel ; and I will bless them.
ekegusii: “Naboigo bararangerie erieta riane ribe igoro y’Abaisraeli ase okobasesenia, erio inche omonyene nimbasesenie.”

english: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree , from the kernels even to the husk .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa taria gento kende gionsi gekoroisigwa korwa ase emesabibu. Taria nonya ne chimbusururo gose amasabo y’amasabibu.

english: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head : until the days be fulfilled , in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD , he shall be holy , and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow .
ekegusii: “Tabaisa konacha etukia yaye gose gwekigita goika okoorire amatuko aye onsi ariete eira gweatanana koba Omwerwa Omonene. Ere nabe oyo bweatananire, na atige etukia y’omotwe oye ekiine.

english: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body .
ekegusii: Tageenda aike ang’e negetondo ase amatuko ayio onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa Omonene.

english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father , or for his mother , for his brother , or for his sister , when they die : because the consecration of his God is upon his head .
ekegusii: Ise nakwa, gose ng’ina, gose momura omwabo, gose omoiseke omwabo, tageenda ang’e negetondo na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka. Ere nigo abwate ase omotwe oye ekemanyererio ng’a bweatananire koba Omwerwa o Nyasae oye.

english: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe omochenu aase Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete.

english: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration ; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing , on the seventh day shall he shave it.
ekegusii: “Korende omonto karakwe mobosokano ang’e nere, na akore omotwe oye ore nekemanyererio gi’okwerwa kwaye abe otachenegeti, rirorio Omwerwa oyio aganye amatuko atan’abere erio akigite etukia yaye, na abe oyo’chenekire.

english: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle , and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Musa konya akoorire gotenenia Obomenyo Obochenu naende kaboakire amaguta na kobwatanana amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, naende gakoorire gwatanana egesasiimero na ebikorero biaye,

english: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed , even the princes offered their offering before the altar .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta, abatang’ani bakarenta okoruegwa kwabo bosio bw’egesasiimero.

english: And the LORD said unto Moses , They shall offer their offering , each prince on his day , for the dedicating of the altar .
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Kera rituko omotang’ani oyomo oyomo arue okoruegwa kwaye ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasiimero.”

english: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab , of the tribe of Judah :
ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu bw’egesaku kia Yuda, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And his offering was one silver charger , the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary ; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering :
ekegusii: Ere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yaare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: One spoon of ten shekels of gold , full of incense :
ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi, giaichire ubani.

english: One young bullock , one ram , one lamb of the first year , for a burnt offering :
ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emingichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,

english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering :
ekegusii: na egoree eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.

english: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar , prince of Issachar , did offer :
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Netaneli, mosinto o Suari bw’egesaku gia Isakaru, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: He offered for his offering one silver charger , the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary ; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering :
ekegusii: N’ere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo, na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yaare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: That the princes of Israel , heads of the house of their fathers , who were the princes of the tribes , and were over them that were numbered , offered :
ekegusii: abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli, abwo barenge abateneneri igoro ase baria baabaretwe,

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.

english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon , prince of the children of Zebulun , did offer:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni bw’egesaku gia Sabuloni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: His offering was one silver charger , the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary ; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering :
ekegusii: Nere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, negetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obuya bwochoganirie n’amaguta, bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: One golden spoon of ten shekels , full of incense :
ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi giaichire ubani.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.

english: And they brought their offering before the LORD , six covered wagons , and twelve oxen ; a wagon for two of the princes , and for each one an ox : and they brought them before the tabernacle .
ekegusii: bakarentera Omonene okoruegwa kwabo. Bakarua chigaari isan’emo chitubire, ne chiombe ikomi na ibere, egaari eyemo ase abatang’ani babere na kera eng’ombe eyemo ase omoraai oyomo. Bakarenta ebio agwo bosio bw’Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur , prince of the children of Reuben , did offer:
ekegusii: Rituko ria kane Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary ; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering :
ekegusii: Nere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo, na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta, bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.

english: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai , prince of the children of Simeon , did offer:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai bw’egesaku gia Simioni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua gwa Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

english: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel , prince of the children of Gad , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli bw’egesaku kia Gadi, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels , a silver bowl of seventy shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary ; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering :
ekegusii: N’ere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.

english: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud , prince of the children of Ephraim , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatan’akabere Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, bw’egesaku gi’Efraimu, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation ; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites , to every man according to his service .
ekegusii: “Ancha oire ebiegwa ebio korwa ase bare, erinde bikorerwe emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Obie Abalawi, kera omonto anyore buna emeremo yaye ere.”

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi.

english: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur , prince of the children of Manasseh :
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri bw’egesaku kia Manase, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri, ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.

english: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen , and gave them unto the Levites .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaira chigaari chiria ne chiombe, erio agachia Abalawi.

english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni , prince of the children of Benjamin , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria kianda Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni bw’egesaku gia Benjamini, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.

english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai , prince of the children of Dan , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai bw’egesaku gia Dani, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon , according to their service :
ekegusii: Akaa Abagerisoni chigaari ibere ne chiombe inye, buna emeremo yabo yarenge.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.

english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran , prince of the children of Asher , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na rimo Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani bw’egesaku gi’Aseri, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, nechimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua gwa Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.

english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan , prince of the children of Naphtali , offered:
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kabere Ahira, mosinto o Enani bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari , according unto their service , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
ekegusii: Naende akaa Abamerari chigaari inye, ne chiombe isanaisato, buna emeremo yabo yarenge inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani.

english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings , two oxen , five rams , five he goats , five lambs of the first year : this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan .
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Ahira, mosinto o Enani.

english: This was the dedication of the altar , in the day when it was anointed , by the princes of Israel : twelve chargers of silver , twelve silver bowls , twelve spoons of gold :
ekegusii: Omobaro bwonsi bw’ebinto biaruetwe nabatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasiimero ase rituko riria kiaagetwe amaguta nigo biabeete iga: Chisani ikomi na ibere chiaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu.

english: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels , each bowl seventy : all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary :
ekegusii: Kera esani y’efeta nigo yarenge n’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na kera egetaabo gi’efeta n’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere. Ase igo oborito bwonsi bw’echifeta chi’ebinto ebio nigo bwarenge chisekeli chilifu ibere, na amagana ane (2,400), koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.

english: The golden spoons were twelve , full of incense , weighing ten shekels apiece , after the shekel of the sanctuary : all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels .
ekegusii: Na ebitaabo biria ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu biichire na ubani, nigo biarenge kera ekemo n’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Oborito bwe chitaabu chi’ebinto ebio bionsi nigo bwarenge chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo ebere.

english: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks , the rams twelve , the lambs of the first year twelve , with their meat offering : and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve .
ekegusii: Ching’iti chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo chiarenge chieri ikomi na ibere, chimingichi ikomi na ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo ikomi na ibere, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gwachiikire amo, chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

english: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks , the rams sixty , the he goats sixty , the lambs of the first year sixty . This was the dedication of the altar , after that it was anointed .
ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe nigo chiabeete: Chieri emerongo ebere na inye, chimingichi emerongo etan’omo, chigoree emerongo etan’omo, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo emerongo etan’omo. Ebio nabio ebiegwa biaruetwe ekero egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta.

english: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony , from between the two cherubims : and he spake unto him.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoete ase Eema y’Omosangererekano gokwana n’Omonene, akaigwa eriogi rigokwana nere korwa ase Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, obwo bwarenge igoro ase Esanduki yarenge ne chibao chiriikire oborori. Eriogi erio rikarua ase egati y’Abamalaika babere babegete chimbaaba, rigakwana nere.

english: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none : because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders .
ekegusii: Korende Abakohati Musa tabaete gento kende, ekiagera barabwo nigo baetwe emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebichenu, na ebio goika bibogorigwe ase amareko.

english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD : and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites :
ekegusii: Ekero kwarentire Abalawi ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Abaisraeli goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe yabo.

english: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel , that they may execute the service of the LORD .
ekegusii: Naende Aroni arente Abalawi ase obosio bwane, babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa korwa ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo Abalawi baatananwe, babe ekeegwa ase ogonkorera inche Omonene.

english: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks : and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , unto the LORD , to make an atonement for the Levites .
ekegusii: Magega yaye Abalawi goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe ye chieri chiria, naye orusie eeri eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eyende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase ’nde inche Omonene, na igo okore okobwatanigwa ase Abalawi.

english: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron , and before his sons , and offer them for an offering unto the LORD .
ekegusii: “Obeeke Abalawi babe bagokonya Aroni na abamura baye, obaatanane babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase ’nde inche Omonene.

english: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel : and the Levites shall be mine.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio obaatanane Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli, barabwo ’mbabe abaane.

english: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation : and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering .
ekegusii: Ekero kwabachenire na kobaatanana babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa, barabwo basoe ase Eema y’Omosangererekano babe bagokora emeremo aroro.

english: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel ; instead of such as open every womb , even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel , have I taken them unto me.
ekegusii: Barabwo baruegwe kegima korwa ase Abaisraeli babe abaane, ekiagera nabachorire ribaga ri’abana abatangi b’Abaisraeli.

english: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Na bono nachorire Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli.

english: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel , to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation , and to make an atonement for the children of Israel : that there be no plague among the children of Israel , when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Narure Abalawi babe ekeegwa ase Aroni na abamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, erinde bakore emeremo ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Boigo bakore okobwatanigwa ase bare, erinde nintange amaakwa tabanyora ekero bagoika ang’e n’Aase Aachenu.”

english: Speak unto Aaron , and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps , the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick .
ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni ng’a, ekero arabeeke chitaaya isano na ibere ase ekebekerero gie chitaaya, achibeeke erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.”

english: And Moses , and Aaron , and all the congregation of the children of Israel , did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites , so did the children of Israel unto them.
ekegusii: Naboigo Musa, na Aroni, amo n’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Abalawi. Abaisraeli bakabakorera kera ring’ana Omonene konya achiikire Musa baabakorere.

english: And the Levites were purified , and they washed their clothes ; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD ; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
ekegusii: Abalawi bagechena korwa ase ebibe na bagasibia chianga chiabo, na Aroni akabaatanana bakaba buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase bare, na kobachena.

english: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron , and before his sons : as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites , so did they unto them.
ekegusii: Magega yayio Abalawi bakageenda ase obokoreri bwabo ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano inse y’oborendi bwa Aroni na abamura baye. Bun’Omonene konya achiikire Musa igoro y’Abalawi nabo Abaisraeli baabakorerete.

english: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites : from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation :
ekegusii: “Eye nero emeremo y’Abalawi: Abwo bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na etano, na goetania, nigo barabe bagokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof , and shall serve no more:
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire emiaka emerongo etano batige batimoke korwa ase emeremo eria.

english: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation , to keep the charge , and shall do no service . Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge .
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbabe ne ribaga ri’ogokonya baria bamwabo bare abakoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende tibaabaisa gokora emeremo eyio abanyene. Naboigo oraroberie Abalawi ase emeremo yabo.”

english: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick , as the LORD commanded Moses .
ekegusii: Aroni agakora bo, akabeeka ekebekerero gi’echitaaya echio, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio bw’ekebeekerero ekio, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

english: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold , unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work : according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses , so he made the candlestick .
ekegusii: Ekebekerero gie chitaaya na enterekerero yaye, amo n’emegwekano yaye y’ebisicha nigo biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chiturire. Nabo Musa aroisetie ekebeekerero ekio buna Omonene konya amochiikire. Abalawi Bagwatananwa Na Gochenwa

english: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel , and cleanse them.
ekegusii: “Atanana Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli na obachene.

english: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh , and let them wash their clothes , and so make themselves clean .
ekegusii: Ekero okobachena nigo orakore iga: Onyororokie amaache y’ogwesibia igoro yabo, na barabwo bakigite emebere yabo yonsi na basibie chianga chiabo. Erio babe bachenekire.

english: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering , even fine flour mingled with oil , and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering .
ekegusii: Naende barente eeri ensae amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera kw’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Naye oire eeri ende ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation : and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together :
ekegusii: Osangererie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli na orente Abalawi agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

english: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body , or be in a journey afar off , yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD .
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obateebie: Onye omonto onde oino, gose oyo bw’ororeria rwaino, obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo, gose nigo are aare ase orogeendo, na onye origetie korenda rituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene,

english: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs .
ekegusii: nigo ararirende ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba ase omotienyi o kabere. Narie emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka amo n’emagaati etabekiri ememera, ne chinyeni chindoro.

english: But the man that is clean , and is not in a journey , and forbeareth to keep the passover , even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people : because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season , that man shall bear his sin .
ekegusii: Korende omonto ochenegete gose otakari aare ase orogeendo, oretange tarenda rituko ri’Epasaka, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ere tarenteti okoruegwa kwaye ase Omonene ase engaki eria echiikire. Okomocha kw’ebibe kw’omonto oria ’nkobe igoro yaye.

english: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD ; according to the ordinance of the passover , and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do : ye shall have one ordinance , both for the stranger , and for him that was born in the land .
ekegusii: “Onye omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene nigo arakore koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachiigetwe. Mobe nogochika okomo ase omomenyi na ase omobiare.” Riire Igoro y’Obomenyo Obochenu (Okong’ 40:34-38)

english: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle , namely , the tent of the testimony : and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire , until the morning .
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Obomenyo boria Obochenu bwatenenetigwe, riire rigatuba Obomenyo obwo, engencho yaye Eema y’Oborori. Na korwa mogoroba goika mambia riire riria rikarorekana rire buna omorero.

english: So it was alway : the cloud covered it by day , and the appearance of fire by night .
ekegusii: Naboigo riire riagendererete botambe gotuba Obomenyo boria Obochenu; ase obotuko rirorekana rire buna omorero.

english: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle , then after that the children of Israel journeyed : and in the place where the cloud abode , there the children of Israel pitched their tents .
ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi riire riria riarenge koimokerera igoro korwa ase Eema eria, erio Abaisraeli nigo barenge komanora, bachaaka orogeendo rwabo. Na aase riire riria riarenge gotenena, aroro agwo nao Abaisraeli barenge gotoora.

english: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed , and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched : as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene nigo baare gochaaka orogeendo, na ase ogochika kwaye nigo baare gotoora. Engaki yonsi riire riria riagendererete kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria, abanto nigo baare kogenderera kobeera ase egetwori.

english: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days , then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD , and journeyed not.
ekegusii: Onye riire riria riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amaange, Abaisraeli nigo baigwerete Omonene, na barabwo tibarenge komanora kogeenda.

english: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season .
ekegusii: “Abaisraeli goika barende rituko ri’Epasaka ase engaki echiikire.

english: And so it was , when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle ; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed .
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amake oka. Bun’Omonene achiigete, abanto nigo baare kobeera ase egetwori, naende ekero Omonene arenge kobachiika, bachaaka kogeenda ase orogeendo rwabo.

english: And so it was , when the cloud abode from even unto the morning , and that the cloud was taken up in the morning , then they journeyed : whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up , they journeyed .
ekegusii: Chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria korwa mogoroba goika mambia rioka. Ekero kende gionsi riire riarenge koimokerera igoro, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo rwabo. Onye riarenge kobeera agwo omobaso na obotuko goika ekero riarenge koimokerera igoro naende, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo ekero ekio.

english: Or whether it were two days , or a month , or a year , that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle , remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up , they journeyed .
ekegusii: Onye riire riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko abere, gose omotienyi oyomo, gose engaki entambe, Abaisraeli nigo barenge kobeera ase egetwori, tibarenge komanora kogeenda, korende ekero riire riaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo.

english: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed : they kept the charge of the LORD , at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses .
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene arenge gochiika nigo barenge gotoora, batiga orogeendo, gose baimoka bachaaka orogeendo. Bakaba bakoigwera Omonene buna achiigete goetera ase Musa.

english: In the fourteenth day of this month , at even , ye shall keep it in his appointed season : according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyo, chinsa chia mogoroba, ’namorende rituko erio ase engaki echiikire koreng’ana n’emeroberio eria yachigetwe.”

english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , that they should keep the passover .
ekegusii: Ase igo Musa agateebia Abaisraeli ng’a barende rituko rinene ri’Epasaka.

english: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai : according to all that the LORD commanded Moses , so did the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Na abanto bagakora bo, bakarenda rituko riria rinene ri’Epasaka agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane riomotienyi bw’eritang’ani, chinsa chia mogoroba. Abaisraeli bagakora amang’ana onsi buna Omonene achiigete Musa.

english: And there were certain men , who were defiled by the dead body of a man , that they could not keep the passover on that day : and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day :
ekegusii: Korende ’mbarengeo abanto gete konya besoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo. Barabwo tibanyarete korenda rituko ri’Epasaka ase rituko riria. Ase ayio bakageenda ase Musa na Aroni ase rituko riria,

english: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man : wherefore are we kept back , that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel ?
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Intwe nigo twabeire abatachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo. Inee! Ninki kiagera twatangirwe titorua okoruegwa ase Omonene ase engaki Abaisraeli bachiikire komoruera okoruegwa kwabo?”

english: And Moses said unto them, Stand still , and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Ganya, inyigwe ay’Omonene arachiike igoro yaino.”

english: The vision of Obadiah . Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom ; We have heard a rumour from the LORD , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen , Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle .
ekegusii: Oko nokorora kw’Obadia. Aya naro Omonene agoteeba igoro y’egesaku kia Edomu. Omonene nae Abaedomu egesusuro ee, twaigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, na omotomwa otomirwe gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, ogoteeba: “Imoka, togende korwania Abaedomu esegi!”

english: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever .
ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.

english: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwatenenete ensemo ase rituko riria, ekero abanto b’ense engeni bairete chinibo chiabo, bagasoa ebiita bia Yerusalemu, bakayoakera obomera. Naboigo nainwe mwarenge buna barabwo.

english: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .
ekegusii: Anga timware kogoka ase rituko riria amabe acherete abanto bamino. Gose timware gochenga ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’Abayuda, gose timware gokwana noboenenu ase rituko ri’emechando yabo.

english: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity ; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity ;
ekegusii: Inwe anga timwasoete ase egeita ki’abaanto baane ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo; gose anga timwagokerete emechando yabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo, gose anga timwaramborete amaboko aino koira chinibo chiabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo.

english: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen : as thou hast done , it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head .
ekegusii: Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.

english: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain , so shall all the heathen drink continually , yea, they shall drink , and they shall swallow down , and they shall be as though they had not been.
