ekegusii: Buna babeire bakonywera egekombe ki’endamwamu yane igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore pi basire kegima. Obobui bw’Abaisraeli

english: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
ekegusii: “Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.

english: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire , and the house of Joseph a flame , and the house of Esau for stubble , and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau ; for the LORD hath spoken it .
ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo mbabe omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Yusufu mbabe buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, mbasirie ab’enyomba ya Esau buna omorero ogosamba amasakwe amomo. Nonya n’oyomo obo tagotoreeka. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.

english: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense ya Negebu mbaire Egetunwa gia Esau, na ab’ense omweya mbaire ense y’Abafilisti. Abaisraeli mbaire ense y’Abaefraimu na ey’Abasamaria chibe echiabo; na abanto ba Benjamini mbaire Gileadi ebe eyabo.

english: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen : thou art greatly despised .
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteebia egesaku kia Edomu “Rora, ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, obe kogochaywa mono na bonsi.

english: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .
ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense babue omochie o Foiniki goika Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya sugusu ya Yuda ebe eyabo.

english: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau ; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s .
ekegusii: Erio abatooria mbariine ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, bagambere Egetunwa gia Esau. Omonene omonyene nere orabe omorwoti.”

english: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro yao bwakong’ainire, aye omenyete ime y’emienya y’ebitare; agwo ase omenyete aimokererete igoro. Nigo ogokwana ase enkoro yao ime, gweteeba: Ning’o orang’iyerie gochia inse?”

english: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle , and though thou set thy nest among the stars , thence will I bring thee down , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Noisa koagacha egeswa kiao aaria igoro buna ekeongo, ee, nokebeke ase egati‐gati ye ching’enang’eni, inche ninkoiyerie korwa aroro.

english: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night , (how art thou cut off !) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes ?
ekegusii: “Abaibi gose abasakori baise kogochera botuko, aye nosirigwe kegima. Ekeene, nigo baraibe binde bionsi baganetie. Inee! Abasangereria b’amasabibu baare kogochera, tibarenge kogotigera nonya naria agotigara? Korende asore aye ababisa bao bagosiririe kegima.

english: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau chinibo chiaino chiasakoirwe; na obonda bwaino bwaibirwe bwonsi!

english: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
ekegusii: Abanto baria bonsi kwabwatanete nabarabwo bagoseririe gochia ase orobebe, abanto baria gwakorete omorembe nabarabwo bakong’ainire na gokobua. Abasani bao mokoria komo bagotegeire oboreba, bagoteeba: Ng’ai obong’aini bwao bore?”

english: Shall I not in that day , saith the LORD , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang’aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.

english: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
ekegusii: Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima. Ayakogera Abaedomu baegwe egesusuro

english: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,
ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omosibwa ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, boigo korwa ase oyominto Timotheo ase Filemoni, omwanchwa oito, omokori emeremo amo naintwe.

english: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :
ekegusii: Agwo kare tarenge taisainegento kende ase ore, korende bono obeire oyo bw’engeencho mono ase ore nainche boigo.

english: Whom I have sent again : thou therefore receive him , that is , mine own bowels :
ekegusii: Ere namotomire gocha ase ore, na nigo enga buna nigo abogoretie enkoro yane.

english: Whom I would have retained with me , that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel :
ekegusii: Naki inche nigo narenge kogania abeere aiga amo nainche ase nsibire ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde anyare gonkorera ribaga riao.

english: But without thy mind would I do nothing ; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity , but willingly .
ekegusii: Korende tindigeti okore ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogokobetereria erio aye onkoonye, korende erio ebe ase ogwancha kwao aye omonyene. Inche tinkonyara gokora ing’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aye gwancheranire narirorio.

english: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever ;
ekegusii: Aande nakio kiagerete Onesimo agaatananwa korwa ase ore ase ekero egeke, erinde airane koba ase ore ase ebiro bionsi.

english: Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
ekegusii: Naende ere bono tari buna omosomba, korende goetania omosomba; buna oyominto omwanchwa, ase Kristo. Asende mono, na ase ore mono kobua, buna omosomba, naende buna oyominto ase Omonene!

english: If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .
ekegusii: Gaki, onye kondengereretie inche buna omobwatani oo, omooroisie koreng’ana buna kware kondoisia inche.

english: If he hath wronged thee , or oweth thee ought , put that on mine account ;
ekegusii: Onye okomocheire ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose okoriete esira, oyeborie goetera ase ’nde.

english: I Paul have written it with mine own hand , I will repay it : albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides .
ekegusii: Inche Paulo nariikire aya nokoboko kwane omonyene, ning’akane. Amaene, ninyare kogoteebia, ng’a nore nesira ase ’nde, ase obogima bwao aye omonyene.

english: Yea , brother , let me have joy of thee in the Lord : refresh my bowels in the Lord .
ekegusii: Ee, oyominto, ninganetie obokonyi bokorwa ase ore, ekiagera noyo bw’Omonene ore. Buna oyominto ase Kristo, ong’e omoyo!

english: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene aiga buna ngokoriikera aya, ng’a nokore buna nagosabire ekiagera nomoigweri ore, naende ase ayio nimanyete ng’a nokore goetania.

english: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
ekegusii: Amo nayio, ondoiserie aase ngocha komenya, naki ninsemeretie ng’a Omonene Nyasae nayairanerie goetera ase ogosaba kwaino mwensi erio imbe nainwe. Amakwania y’ogokoorera

english: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae tata oito na Omonene Yeso Kristo abae obuya na omorembe. Obwanchani bwa Filemoni na okwegena kwaye

english: I thank my God , making mention of thee always in my prayers ,
ekegusii: Oyominto Filemoni, ase ogosaba kwane botambe nigo ngoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ekero ngokoinyora.

english: Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints ;
ekegusii: Ayio nase engencho nkoigwa amang’ana igoro y’obwanchani bwao ase abanto bonsi b’Omonene, na okwegena kwao obwate ase Omonene Yeso.

english: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a okobwatana gw’okwegena tore nakorokwo gokore emeremo, erinde omanye mono kobua kera egento ogosesenigwa kore ase tore intwe ase okobwatana na Kristo.

english: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
ekegusii: Naki oyominto, nigo nabeete nomogooko omonge na okoremigwa ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao! Chinkoro chi’abaanto b’Omonene bonsi chiasasokire. Paulo ogosabera Onesimo

english: Wherefore , though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ninde noboremu obonge buna momura omino ase Kristo kogochika eri ogwenerete okore.

english: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obwanchani bwane ase ore, nanchire kobua kogosorora, buna inche Paulo inde omotomwa, naende inde omosibwa o Kristo Yeso.

english: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;
ekegusii: erinde monyare komanya ayare amaya, naende mobe n’chinkoro chindemu, motari na komocha ase rituko ria Kristo.

english: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness , which are by Jesus Christ , unto the glory and praise of God .
ekegusii: Mwaichoirwe n’okwama kw’oboronge ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, ase obonene na ogotogigwa kwa Nyasae. Okoba moyo n’Kristo

english: But I would ye should understand , brethren , that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel ;
ekegusii: Korende baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a amang’ana aria onsi anyorete, abeire ase okogendereria gw’enchiri.

english: And many of the brethren in the Lord , waxing confident by my bonds , are much more bold to speak the word without fear .
ekegusii: Na abange ase abaminto abare ase Omonene Nyasae babeire n’okoremigwa ase engencho y’ogosibwa kwane, bamentekanire n’oboremu gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae batari nobwoba.

english: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :
ekegusii: Abande nigo bakorandia Kristo bare n’emoko n’eriomana, korende abande ase omoyo omuya,

english: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
ekegusii: abwo ase obwanchani, bamanyete ng’a nabekirwe ase okorwanerera enchiri.

english: But the other of love , knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel .
ekegusii: Aba bakoraria Kristo ase esuugu gose tari ase omoyo omorabu, bakorengereria komenta obororo bwane ase ogosibwa kwane.

english: What then ? notwithstanding , every way , whether in pretence , or in truth , Christ is preached ; and I there in do rejoice , yea , and will rejoice .
ekegusii: Inki rende? Nonya nabo, ase kera enchera Kristo nigo arararigwe, ase obong’ainereria gose ase ekeene, na ase ayio nagokire.

english: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer , and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,
ekegusii: Ee, ningooke, ekiagera namanyire ng’a aya nang’onchokere koba ase ogotooreka kwane, goetera ase ogosaba kwaino na ase ogokonya kw’Omoika o Yeso Kristo.

english: According to my earnest expectation and my hope , that in nothing I shall be ashamed , but that with all boldness , as always , so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body , whether it be by life , or by death .
ekegusii: Ninde nokoganyererera okonene n’ogosemeria ng’a tingosookigwa ase enchera ende yonsi, korende ase oboremu bwane bwonsi, bono buna botambe, Kristo naegwe ogosika ase omobere one, keraabe ase obogima gose ase ogokwa.

english: For to me to live is Christ , and to die is gain .
ekegusii: Naki ase ’nde inche, okoba moyo n’Kristo, na ogokwa nokonyora amange.

english: But if I live in the flesh , this is the fruit of my labour : yet what I shall choose I wot not .
ekegusii: Korende onye nkoba moyo ase omobere, aya nigo akondetera okwama kw’emeremo yane; gaki eri ndigetie gochora, tindimanyeti.

english: For I am in a strait betwixt two , having a desire to depart , and to be with Christ ; which is far better :
ekegusii: Nimigire mono ase egati y’amang’ana aya abere. Okogania kwane nigo kore ng’a ngende komenya amo na Kristo; ekiagera aya namaya kobua.

english: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you .
ekegusii: Korende gotigara ase omobere nkogwenerete kobua ase engencho yaino.

english: And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng’a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,

english: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .
ekegusii: erinde ogwetogia kwaino ase engencho yane konyare komenteka ase Kristo Yeso, ase engencho y’okoba kwane amo nainwe naende.

english: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;
ekegusii: Korende orogendo rwaino robe buna egwenerete enchiri ya Kristo, erinde onye ngocha kobarora inwe, gose tinkobao, nyigwe amang’ana aino ng’a moteneine bokong’u ase omoika oyomo, na ase omoyo oyomo mokorwanerera okwegena more nakwo ase enchiri amo.

english: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries : which is to them an evident token of perdition , but to you of salvation , and that of God .
ekegusii: Timoiroka abwo bakobaengereria ase ing’ana rinde rionsi. Eke nekemanyererio ase ogosira kwabo, korende ase more inwe nekemanyererio ki’ogotooreka. Eke nigo gekorwa ase Nyasae.

english: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ , not only to believe on him , but also to suffer for his sake ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera ase engencho ya Kristo mwaeirwe, tari okomwegena gwoka korende nogochandwa boigo ase engencho yaye.

english: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you ,
ekegusii: Igo nkomoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono chingaki chionsi nkobainyora,

english: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy ,
ekegusii: ekiagera botambe ase ogosaba kwane nigo nkobasabera inwe mwensi nomogooko,

english: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now ;
ekegusii: ase engencho y’okobwaterana kwaino ase enchiri korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika reero iga.

english: Being confident of this very thing , that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene, ng’a Nyasae oyochagete emeremo emiya ase emioyo yaino ime nayeikeranie goika rituko riria ria Kristo Yeso.

english: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
ekegusii: Igo bore boronge ase ’nde korengereria aya igoro ase more mwensi, ekiagera nababogoirie inwe ase enkoro yane ime. Naki ase ogosibwa kwane na ase emeremo y’okorwanerera enchiri na koyeorokia ng’a ero nechinguru, na inwe mwensi mwabwatanire nainche ase obuya obo naeirwe.

english: For God is my record , how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna ’nde namaiga ase more mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.

english: And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosaba kwane, ng’a obwanchani bwaino bomenteke, bobe obonge mono ase okomanya kw’ogwatanana gwonsi,

english: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ , if any comfort of love , if any fellowship of the Spirit , if any bowels and mercies ,
ekegusii: Obogima bwaino ime ya Kristo nigo bokobaa chinguru, n’obwanchani bwaye bwabaremia. Okobwatana kw’Omoika, karabe amaabera ande onsi na amabeebe,

english: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
ekegusii: na kera oromeme narobe kirori ng’a Yeso Kristo n’Omonene, ase obonene bwa Nyasae Tata. Okobara buna Omebaso ase Ense

english: Wherefore , my beloved , as ye have always obeyed , not as in my presence only , but now much more in my absence , work out your own salvation with fear and trembling .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanchwa baane, buna moigwerete botambe, tari ekero indeo rioka, korende kobua mono ekero ntaiyo, korera ogotooreka kwaino abanyene ase okwoboa na okoiguswa,

english: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nere ogokora emeremo ime yaino ase okorigia, naende ase ogokora ogwancha kwaye okuya.

english: Do all things without murmurings and disputings :
ekegusii: Mokore amang’ana onsi motari nokwemurungania na okoborania,

english: Holding forth the word of life ; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ , that I have not run in vain , neither laboured in vain .
ekegusii: Bwata ring’ana ri’obogima, erinde inyore engencho y’ogwetogia ase rituko riria ria Kristo, ng’a tinaminyogete bosa, gose tinakorete emeremo bosa.

english: Yea , and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith , I joy , and rejoice with you all .
ekegusii: Ee, kondaumorwe igoro y’ekeng’wanso na ogokora gw’okwegena kwaino, nagokire; ee, nagokire amo nainwe mwensi.

english: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
ekegusii: Nainwe boigo, goka, ee, goka amo nainche. Timotheo na Epafrodito

english: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you , that I also may be of good comfort , when I know your state .
ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ase Omonene Yeso gotoma Timotheo achiche bwango ase more, erinde inche ndemigwe, kondamanye buna more.

english: Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be like minded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
ekegusii: ikerania omogooko one ase okoba nokorengereria okwo okwo na obwanchani obomo; mobe nomoyo oyomo, na okorengereria okomo.

english: For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .
ekegusii: Naki tindi na monto onde ore nomoyo oyomo nainche, oyoranyare gochandekera chingencho chiaino,

english: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christ’s .
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi nigo bakorigia ebinto biabo abanyene, gose tari ebia Kristo Yeso.

english: But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .
ekegusii: Korende momanyete Timotheo na ogokora kwaye, buna akorerete enchiri amo nainche. Igo are koreng’ana buna omwana okomokorera ise.

english: Him therefore I hope to send presently , so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninganetie komotoma ase obwango ekero ndamanye buna amang’ana arabe ase ’nde.

english: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly .
ekegusii: Na inche nasemeirie ase Omonene ng’a inche omonyene boigo ninchiche bwango.

english: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .
ekegusii: Korende nkarora ng’a ningwenerete gotoma Epafrodito oyominto, omokori emeremo amo nainche, omorwani amo nainche, oyo mwatomire gonkorera ase okoremerwa kwane.

english: For he longed after you all , and was full of heaviness , because that ye had heard that he had been sick .
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge namaiga ase more mwensi, naende agaichana mono, ekiagera mwaigwete ng’a nigo arenge omorwaire.

english: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
ekegusii: Ere nomorwaire arenge ekeene, ang’e nogokwa, korende Nyasae akamororera amaabera, gose tari ere bweka, korende nonya ninche boigo, timba nomoichano igoro ase omoichano.

english: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nakorire omokia mono komotoma, erinde ekero moramorore naende, monyare kogoka, na inche nkeeanerigwe omoichano one.

english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness ; and hold such in reputation :
ekegusii: Momooroisie gaki ase Omonene ase omogooko bwonsi. Mosike abanto banga buna oyio,

english: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .
ekegusii: Timokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase okwegwenera na ase okweenenia, korende ase oboitongo kera omonto abare abande ng’a nabaya kobua ere omonyene.

english: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .
ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho y’emeremo ya Kristo akaba ang’e ase ogokwa, tarendete obogima bwaye ase ogoisanera ayaremete ase ogokora kwaino ase ’nde.

english: Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .
ekegusii: Kera omonto tarigereria ebinto biaye omonyene, korende arigererie ebinto bi’abaanto bande.

english: Let this mind be in you , which was also in Christ Jesus :
ekegusii: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

english: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
ekegusii: Ere omochakano nigo arenge oyomo na Nyasae, na tabarete ng’a okoba koreng’ana buna Nyasae negento gi’okobwaterera,

english: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :
ekegusii: korende agekora buna tarenge nobonene, akaimokia ekieni ki’omosomba, akaba omogwekano o Mwanyabaanto.

english: And being found in fashion as a man , he humbled himself , and became obedient unto death , even the death of the cross .
ekegusii: Naende agachia kororekana ore buna Mwanyabaanto omonyene, agekeyia, akaba omoigweri goika ogokwa, na korokwo nogokwa igoro ase omosalaba.

english: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro mono, akamoa erieta erio ribuete amarieta onsi,

english: Finally , my brethren , rejoice in the Lord . To write the same things to you , to me indeed is not grievous , but for you it is safe .
ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, goka ase Omonene! Kobariikera inwe amang’ana aria aria tandoseti inche, korende ase more nigo arabe obokonyi.

english: That I may know him , and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , being made conformable unto his death ;
ekegusii: Nindigetie komomanya Kristo ne chinguru chi’okobokigwa kwaye, inyare kobwatana nogochandwa kwaye, ngwekanigwe nere ase ogokwa kwaye;

english: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead .
ekegusii: erinde inyore ase enchera ende yonsi goikera okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure. Kominyoka goika ase Engori

english: Not as though I had already attained , either were already perfect : but I follow after , if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Tari ng’a naikire konyora aya, gose naikire koba omoikeranu, korende nakong’irie orogendo inyabwate, ekiagera nabwatirwe na Kristo Yeso.

english: Brethren , I count not myself to have apprehended : but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind , and reaching forth unto those things which are before ,
ekegusii: Abaminto, tinyekageti inche omonyene ng’a naikire koyabwata; korende ninkore egento ekemo gioka: kweba ayare magega, ndambaarie ayare bosio.

english: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Nakong’irie orogendo gochia aase ngokoorera, ng’ikere eng’eria y’okorangerigwa kwa igoro kwa Nyasae goetera ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
ekegusii: Gaki intwe abatore abaikeranu torengererie ayio. Komorabe mokorengereria ayande, ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, Nyasae nabamaanorere ayio naro.

english: Nevertheless , where to we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .
ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.

english: ( For many walk , of whom I have told you often , and now tell you even weeping , that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ :
ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b’omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang’ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.

english: Whose end is destruction , whose God is their belly , and whose glory is in their shame , who mind earthly things .)
ekegusii: Omoerio obo nogosareka, enyasae yabo nenda, obonene bwabo nigo bore ase obosooku bwabo, bakorengereria amang’ana ’ense.

english: Beware of dogs , beware of evil workers , beware of the concision .
ekegusii: Mwerende korwa ase chisese, mwerende na korwa ase abwo bagokora amabe, mwerende nabwo bakwenachanacha!

english: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Naki obobiare bwaito igoro, bore. Korwa agwo naende ntoganyete, Omotooria, Omonene Yeso Kristo,

english: Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .
ekegusii: oyoranyare koonchora emebere yaito y’obosareku enyare kogwekana nomobere oye bw’obonene, koreng’ana nokobua kwaye ase okwo aranyare kobeeka ebinto bionsi inse asare.

english: For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .
ekegusii: Naki intwe naba twarogete, abatogosasiima Nyasae ase Omoika oye, na gwetogia ase Kristo Yeso, na titosemereti ebia omobere.

english: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :
ekegusii: Nonya ninche ase ensemo yane ninyare gosemeria ebia omobere. Onye omonto onde okorora ng’a nare nengencho y’ogosemeria ebia omobere, inche nkobua,

english: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aria arenge okonyora ase ’nde nayabarire koba bosa ase engencho ya Kristo.

english: Yea doubtless , and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord : for whom I have suffered the loss of all things , and do count them but dung , that I may win Christ ,
ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng’a abeire bosa ase engencho y’obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,

english: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
ekegusii: naende ndorekane ime asare. Tinkoba noboronge bwane boria bokonyorekana ase amachiiko korende boria bokonyorekana ase okomwegena Kristo, oboronge boria bokorwa ase Nyasae, bokonyorekana ase okomwegena.

english: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane. Ogosorora

english: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly , that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; where in ye were also careful , but ye lacked opportunity .
ekegusii: Nagokire mono ase Omonene, ekiagera bono ase omoerio mwairanire ase ebirengererio biaino igoro y’okoremerwa kwane; nabo mwarenge kondengereria ritang’ani, korende timwanyora ribaga.

english: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .
ekegusii: Tari ng’a ngokwana aya ekiagera inde nokoremerwa, naki neorokereirie goisaneka ase engencho ende yonsi inde nero.

english: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .
ekegusii: Namanyire ogokeeigwa, naende namanyire okomenteka; ase engencho yonsi, na ase amang’ana onsi neorokereirie, okoigota na koigwa enchara, okomenteka na okoremerwa.

english: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .
ekegusii: Ninyare gokora amang’ana onsi asere oyokombeka chinguru.

english: Notwithstanding ye have well done , that ye did communicate with my affliction .
ekegusii: Korende mwakorete buya mokabwatana nainche ase emechando yane.

english: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .
ekegusii: Na inwe Abafilipi abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ase omochakano bw’enchiri, ekero naruete Makedonia, ekanisa ende tiyarenge yabwatanete nainche ase amang’ana ’okorua na okonyora, otatiga inwe mweka.

english: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .
ekegusii: Tari ng’a nindigetie ekeegwa keria, korende nigo ndigetie okwama koria gokomenteka koba okonge ase more.

english: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Na Nyasae one nabaichorerie kera ekimoganetie ase ekerengo ki’obonda bwaye ase obonene ase Kristo Yeso.

english: I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .
ekegusii: Namosoroire Ewodia, namosoroire na Sintike babe nomoyo oyomo ase Omonene.

english: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania ’ogokoorera

english: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .
ekegusii: Monkwanerie kera omochenu ase Kristo Yeso. Abaminto abare amo nainche baabakwanirie.

english: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household .
ekegusii: Abachenu bonsi baabakwanirie, mono kobua abwo bare b’enyomba y’omorwoti omonene.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen . It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

english: And I intreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .
ekegusii: Ee, naye bo, omosaiga bw’ekeene, nakoboririe okonye abakungu abwo bakorete emeremo y’enchiri amo nainche, na Klementi nere, na baria bande bakorete emeremo amo nainche, abwo amarieta abo are ime ase egetabu y’obogima.

english: Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .
ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene amatuko onsi; naende natebiire: Goka!

english: Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .
ekegusii: Obwororo bwaino bomanyekane ase abanto bonsi. Omonene ng’ang’e are.

english: Be careful for nothing ; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God .
ekegusii: Timwechandera ing’ana rinde rionsi; korende ase kera ring’ana ase ogosaba na ogosorora amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okorigia kwaino komanyekane ase Nyasae.

english: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
ekegusii: Na omorembe o Nyasae, oyobuete okomanya gwonsi, korende chinkoro chiaino na ebirengererio biaino ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .
ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, onsi ayare ay’ekeene, onsi ayare ay’ogosika, onsi ayare ay’oboronge, onsi ayare ay’oborabu, onsi ayagwenerete gwanchwa, onsi ayagokwanwa buya; koborabeo obuya bonde bwonsi, gose ogotogigwa, aya onsi yarengererie.

english: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya mweorokereretie na koyanyora, na koyaigwa, na koyarora korwa ase ’nde, moyakore, na Nyasae bw’omorembe nabe amo nainwe. Omogoko o Paulo ase ekeegwa korwa ase Abafilipi

english: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .
ekegusii: Eye nemebayeno ya Sulemani. Omwana omomura omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorentera ng’ina omoichano.

english: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .
ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

english: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo onga buna ensoko y’obogima, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.

english: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase omonwa bw’omonto omomanyi, korende oyo otari n’okomanya nigo agwenerete aakwe enyimbo ase omogongo oye.

english: Wise men lay up knowledge : but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction .
ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini nigo bakogaacha chiseemi, korende omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo okorenta ogosirigwa ang’e.

english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city : the destruction of the poor is their poverty .
ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bore ase are buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, korende obotaka nabwo ogosirigwa kw’abataka.

english: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
ekegusii: Okonyora kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokomoraa gochia ase obogima, korende ebitoki bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomoraa gochia ase ebibe.

english: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera okorongeigwa nigo akorobera ase enchera y’obogima, korende oyo okwanga korongeigwa nigo agosoa ase obosiru.

english: He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .
ekegusii: Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.

english: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokwana amang’ana amaange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong’aini.

english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death .
ekegusii: Chinibo chi’ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.

english: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .
ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echenire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibiri na igori rinde.

english: The lips of the righteous feed many : but fools die for want of wisdom .
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bikorenta amaya ase abanto abange, korende oboriri nigo bogoita.

english: The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it.
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene nakwo gokorenta obotenenku, na ere tari kobeeka obororo ase ogosesenigwa okwo.

english: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokora ebibe buna egosori, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo agokora ayare ay’obong’aini.

english: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .
ekegusii: Aria omokori amabe airogete naro akomochera, korende omonyene oboronge ’naikeranerigwe amagania aye.

english: As the whirlwind passeth , so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation .
ekegusii: Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu ogoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosirigwa, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotenena bokong’u kare na kare.

english: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to them that send him.
ekegusii: Buna obokang’iti bokoba ase amaino na erioki rikoba ase amaiso, naboigo omonto omworo akoba ase abwo bakomotoma abakorere emeremo.

english: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokomenta obomenyo ase obogima, korende emiaka y’omokori amabe nigo ekweng’eigwa.

english: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .
ekegusii: Ogosemeria kw’abanyene oboronge nigo kogoikeranigwa ase omogooko, korende okw’abakori amabe nokwabosa.

english: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
ekegusii: Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere egekengero egekong’u ase abanyene oboronge, korende nigo ere obosiru ase abanyabibe.

english: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .
ekegusii: Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.

english: The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogeenderera komenya ase ense.

english: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogokwana ay’obong’aini, korende oromeme rokong’ainereria ’ndonachwe.

english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable : but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness .
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bimanyete ayagwenerete, korende omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogokwana ay’atagwenereti.

english: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand : but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo n’amaboko amoro nigo akoba omotaka, korende amaboko are nomokia nigo akorenta obotenenku.

english: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
ekegusii: Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.

english: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.

english: The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .
ekegusii: Okoinyorwa kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokorenta ogosesenigwa, korende erieta ri’omokori amabe nigo riragunde.

english: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye nigo anchete amachiiko, korende oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.

english: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .
ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge nigo araarendwe buya, korende oyo okobwatia chiinchera chimbe nigo aramanyekane.

english: A false balance is abomination to the LORD : but a just weight is his delight .
ekegusii: Egepimo + 11:1 Egepimo: nkerokio naende gekorokwa “Ekerengero” ki’oborito ki’oborianania nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.

english: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bageendererete koba buya, abanto b’omochie nigo bakogoka, na ekero abakori amabe bagosira nigo bagoaka amariogi y’omochengo.

english: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted : but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .
ekegusii: Goetera ase ogosesenia kw’abanyene oboronge omochie nigo okoimokererigwa igoro, korende goetera ase chinkwana chi’abakori amabe nigo okoiyerigwa.

english: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde, oyio nigo aborire obong’aini, korende omonto omong’aini nigo agokira‐kiri.

english: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, korende oyobwate omoika bw’obwegenwa tari koorokia obobisi.

english: Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .
ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya ’mboreo.

english: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure .
ekegusii: Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.

english: A gracious woman retaineth honour : and strong men retain riches .
ekegusii: Omokungu omwesiki nigo akogeenderera gosikwa botambe. Abanto abatindi nabwo bakobogoria chinibo ase chinguru.

english: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’amaabera nigo akwerentera amaya, korende omonto omotindi nigo agwechaanda ere omonyene.

english: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’oborianania, korende oyo ogosimeka oboronge nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’ekeene.

english: As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omwegenwa, ase oboronge bwaye nabe moyo, korende oyo okorigia obobe na kobobwatia nakwe.

english: When pride cometh , then cometh shame : but with the lowly is wisdom .
ekegusii: Ekero oboenenu bwachire, nobosooku nario bogocha, korende obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase abanto abaitongo.

english: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD : but such as are upright in their way are his delight .
ekegusii: Abanto abakorekanu ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare n’orogendo ororonge nigo bakomogokia.

english: Though hand join in hand , the wicked shall not be unpunished : but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonto omobe goika anyore egesusuro, korende oroiboro rw’abanyene oboronge ’ndotoorigwe.

english: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
ekegusii: Omokungu omonyakieni otari nechiseemi nigo anga buna ebonyi y’etaabu ere ase chimioro chi’embeche.

english: The desire of the righteous is only good : but the expectation of the wicked is wrath .
ekegusii: Okogania kw’abanyene oboronge nigo gokorenta amaya, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo gokobarentera egesusuro.

english: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
ekegusii: Ere omonto okorua ebinto ebinge, nigo akomenteranigwa ebinge goetania, na nere oria omogooko otari korua, nigo akogeenderera kona‐koremerwa.

english: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
ekegusii: Omonto okorua n’omoyo bw’ogwancha natenenkigwe; nere oyokorua amaache agokendia erang’o, nere boigo ’naegwe amaache agokendia erang’o yaye.

english: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .
ekegusii: Omonto oria okwegimeria endagera ase obong’iti, nigo akoragererigwa nabaanto, korende ogosesenigwa nigo kore igoro ase omotwe bw’oria okoyeoonia.

english: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora omokia korigia ayare amaya, oyio nigo akonyora ayare amaya, korende oyokorigia ay’obobe, obobe nigo bokomonyoora.

english: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall : but the righteous shall flourish as a branch .
ekegusii: Omonto osemeretie chinibo chiaye nigo aragwe, korende abanyene oboronge ’mbareerete buna amato amarere y’emete.

english: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind : and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart .
ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto omong’aini.

english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
ekegusii: Obwegenwa bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokobaraa, korende obokorekanu bw’abatari abegenwa nigo bokobasiria.

english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life ; and he that winneth souls is wise .
ekegusii: Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, nere oyokong’usa emioyo y’abanto n’omonto omong’aini.

english: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
ekegusii: Chinibo tichiri gokonya kende ase rituko ri’endamwamu, korende oboronge nigo boratoorie korwa ase amakweri.

english: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way : but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .
ekegusii: Oboronge bw’omonto omoikeranu nigo borarongeyie chiinchera chiaye, korende omokori amabe, obobe bwaye ’mbomoiyerie.

english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .
ekegusii: Oboronge bw’abaanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe n’okogania kwabo okobe.

english: When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .
ekegusii: Ekero omokori amabe agokwa, ogosemeria kwaye nigo kogokwa amo nere, ee, aya abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae basemeretie nigo agosira.

english: The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa ase emechando, erio omokori amabe osoa ase emechando ribaga riaye.

english: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .
ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande n’amang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge ’mbatoorigwe.

english: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi bwanchete amorokererio yokomoorongeyia, oyio nigo anchete chiseemi, korende oyo ogechete ogokuurerwa n’omoriri.

english: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agochaandekera nonya n’obogima bwe chitugo chiaye, korende oboseera bw’enkoro y’omokori amabe nigo bore ase ogotogonya.

english: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye ’natware ebinge akoria, korende oyo ogotunyana amang’ana atagwenereti, ere ’mbosa.

english: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akogania ebionga bi’abaanto ababe, korende omori bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogoseboka bwama.

english: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips : but the just shall come out of trouble .
ekegusii: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.

english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana y’omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya akomoisanekia, na emeremo y’amaboko ’omonto nigo ekomoiranera.

english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omoriri nigo ekororekana ase amaiso aye ng’a nendonge, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoigwera ogoseemigwa.

english: A fool’s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
ekegusii: Okobeea kw’omonto omoriri nigo gokomanyekana rimo rioka, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoombia otuba obobe.

english: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw’oborimo nigo agokwana obong’ainereria.

english: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword : but the tongue of the wise is health .
ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto otari korengereria agokwana, nigo anga buna omoro ogokeba, korende oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rokorenta amang’ana akogwenia.

english: The lip of truth shall be established for ever : but a lying tongue is but for a moment .
ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana ekeene ’mbigeenderere kobao botambe, korende oromeme rogokwana oborimo nigo rokobao ase engaki enke yoka.

english: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akomonyoorera monto omuya ogwancherwa, korende omonachera ekiina oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe.

english: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil : but to the counsellors of peace is joy .
ekegusii: Obong’ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi’abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay’omorembe nigo bakogera omogooko oba.

english: There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .
ekegusii: Amabe takobanyora abanyene oboronge, korende abakori amabe ’mbanyorwe n’amabe amaange.

english: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD : but they that deal truly are his delight .
ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana oborimo nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare abegenwa ase ogokora kwabo nigo bakomogokia.

english: A prudent man concealeth knowledge : but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akobisa ay’amanyete, korende abariri nigo bakoraria oboriri korwa ase chinkoro chiabo.

english: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule : but the slothful shall be under tribute .
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia ’nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo y’obosomba.

english: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .
ekegusii: Ogoichana kore ase enkoro y’omonto nigo gokomoiyeria, korende ring’ana rigiya nigo rikomorentera omogooko.

english: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour : but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw’omogisangio oye, korende chiinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo chikobatang’ana chiabasiria.

english: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari koiyeka nonya n’eki arusirie ase orotwari rw’aye, korende omonyamokia nigo akoyerioseria enibo yaye rigori rekerengo ekenene.

english: In the way of righteousness is life ; and in the pathway thereof there is no death .
ekegusii: Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima ’mboreo, na amakweri tari gotooka ase boeto obwo.

english: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagaacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.

english: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .
ekegusii: Omokungu omuya nigo are eguutwa y’omosaacha oye, korende omokungu okorenta obosooku nigo are buna oboguundo ase amauga y’omosaacha oye.

english: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bire ebi’ekeene, korende ogoseemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.

english: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood : but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
ekegusii: Amang’ana yabakori amabe nigo akoboera na goitera amanyinga, korende aria abanyene oboronge bagokwana nigo agotooria abanto.

english: The wicked are overthrown , and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakoiyerigwa basira kegima, korende enyomba y’omonyene oboronge ’nemenye na gotenena.

english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agotogigwa buna obong’aini bwaye bore, korende oyore nebirengererio ebikorekanu nigo agochaaywa.

english: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread .
ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.

english: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction : but a scorner heareth not rebuke .
ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akoigwera amorokererio a ise, korende oyore omochaayi tari gwancha ogokuurerwa.

english: Only by pride cometh contention : but with the well advised is wisdom .
ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogoseemigwa nigo bakoba n’obong’aini.

english: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .
ekegusii: Enibo enyorire ase obwango ase enchera y’obobe nigo egosira, korende ey’ekonyorekana ase okoyekorera emeremo ’nementekane.

english: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .
ekegusii: Egesemeirie kogiatebanire nigo gekogera enkoro yarwara, korende ogosemeria kogwaikeraniigwe nigo kore omote bw’obogima.

english: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed : but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded .
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya Ring’ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng’eria y’obuya.

english: The law of the wise is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
ekegusii: Amorokererio y’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokoonya omonto tabwatwa n’omotego bw’amakweri.

english: Good understanding giveth favour : but the way of transgressors is hard .
ekegusii: Okomanya okuya nigo gokorenta ogwancherwa, korende enchera y’abatari abegenwa nigo ekoraa gochia ase obosiru.

english: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge : but a fool layeth open his folly .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo agokora emeremo yaye ne chiseemi, korende omonto omoriri nigo akoraria oboriri bwaye.

english: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief : but a faithful ambassador is health .
ekegusii: Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.

english: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .
ekegusii: Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomoorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nanyore amasikani.

english: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul : but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil .
ekegusii: Okogania gwaikeranigwe nigo kore ogwansu ase omoyo, korende okoonchoka gotiga amabe, okwo nigo kore okogechigwa ase abariri.

english: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo gokorigia obotindi.

english: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotaara n’abanto abang’aini nigo arabe omong’aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe n’amabe.

english: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .
ekegusii: Amang’ana amabe nigo agotunyana abanyene ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge ’nabaegwe amaya.

english: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .
ekegusii: Omonto omuya nigo agotiga omwando ase abana baye, na ase abachokoro baye, korende obotenenku bw’abanyene ebibe nigo bogacheire abanyene oboronge.

english: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
ekegusii: Oboremo oboyia bw’omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende ase engencho y’obobe, enyinge yasiara‐siarerwa yasira.

english: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .
ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oy’omwanchete tari goteebana komoorongeyia.

english: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo abwate endagera ekomoisanekia, korende enda y’omokori amabe nigo egotigara n’okogania.

english: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life : but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction .
ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyogokwana amang’ana ateriteti, goika asoe ase obosiru.

english: The soul of the sluggard desireth , and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agosanera ebinto, korende takonyora kende, ere o’yore omonyamokia nigo akonyora amagania aye onsi.

english: A righteous man hateth lying : but a wicked man is loathsome , and cometh to shame .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo ageechete oborimo, korende omokori amabe nigo agokora echaayo n’obosooku.

english: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way : but wickedness overthroweth the sinner .
ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bokorenda omonto omosike, korende ebibe nigo bikomosiria omokori amabe.

english: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
ekegusii: Omonto nare ogwekora ng’a n’omonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng’a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.

english: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches : but the poor heareth not rebuke .
ekegusii: Chinibo nachio chikobooria obogima bw’omonto omonda, korende omonto omotaka tari n’onde okomogosa.

english: The light of the righteous rejoiceth : but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out .
ekegusii: Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka n’omogooko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nigo enga ekebeya gekorima.

english: Every wise woman buildeth her house : but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands .
ekegusii: Omokungu omong’aini nigo akoagaacha mwaye, korende oyore omoriri nigo agotagora mwaye na maboko aye omonyene.

english: The heart knoweth his own bitterness ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
ekegusii: Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyaara gosanga ase omogooko bw’enkoro eyio.

english: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
ekegusii: Enyomba y’omokori amabe ’nesirigwe, korende ekegutu ki’omonyene oboronge ’nkegeenderere gosesenigwa.

english: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful ; and the end of that mirth is heaviness .
ekegusii: Nonya omonto ogoseka, enkoro yaye nabo eranyaare koba nomoichano, na omoerio bw’omogooko oyio nobororo.

english: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
ekegusii: Omonto ogure korwa ase okwegena kwaye, nabo araisaneke nechiinchera chiaye omonyene, na omonto omuya nigo agoisanekigwa n’omoyo oye.

english: The simple believeth every word : but the prudent man looketh well to his going .
ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti amaange nigo akwegena kera ring’ana, korende omong’aini nigo agoitona aase agochia.

english: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.

english: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .
ekegusii: Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay’oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay’obobe nigo akogechwa.

english: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
ekegusii: Abatamanyeti amaange, oboriri nigo bokoba omwando obo, korende abare nokomanya nigo bakoegwa chiseemi chiaba eguutwa yabo.

english: The evil bow before the good ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .
ekegusii: Abanto ababe goika bekumbe ase amasio y’abanto abaya, na abakori amabe bekumbe ase ebiita bi’abanyene oboronge.

english: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
ekegusii: Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y’oboronge, korende oyo omochaayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye.

english: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

english: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he.
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachaandegete amaabera ’nasesenigwe.

english: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .
ekegusii: Inee! Abwo bakoroberia ayare amabe tibari gosira? Na abwo bakoroberia amaya, Inee, tibari konyora amaabera na ekeene?

english: In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .
ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi egokorwa nigo ekorenta ebitoki, korende amang’ana amasa agokwanwa nigo gokorenta obotaka.

english: The crown of the wise is their riches : but the foolishness of fools is folly .
ekegusii: Eguutwa y’abanto abang’aini n’obonda bwabo, korende oboriri bwoka nabwo okonyora kwa abanto abariri.

english: A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .
ekegusii: Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oy’ogokwana oborimo nigo akorwa abande.

english: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
ekegusii: Oyo okomoiroka Omonene nigo are n’ogosemeria gw’okorendwa bokong’u, na abana baye ’mbanyore aase bagotamera.

english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y’obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase emetego y’amakweri.

english: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour : but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince .
ekegusii: Obonge bw’abaanto nabwo bore esiko y’omorwoti, korende ase abanto bare abake omogambi obo nigo agosirigwa.

english: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .
ekegusii: Omonto otari kogechigwa bwango nigo abwate okomanya okonene, korende oyo okoberoroka bwango nigo agokinia oboriri bwaye.

english: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
ekegusii: Aya omoriri agokwana nigo are enyimbo y’oboenenu, korende aya abang’aini bagokwana nigo akobarenda.

english: A sound heart is the life of the flesh : but envy the rottenness of the bones .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omogooko nigo ere obogima bw’omobere, korende ogosanera nigo kore oboguundo bw’amauga.

english: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokorera omotaka bobe nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi oye.

english: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness : but the righteous hath hope in his death .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotugutwa riarua ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agokwa ore n’ogosemeria.

english: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y’omonto ore n’okomanya, korende ase enkoro y’omoriri tibomanyekaneti nonya ’ng’ake.

english: Righteousness exalteth a nation : but sin is a reproach to any people .
ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bogokinia egesaku, korende ebibe nobosooku ase abanto bande bonsi.

english: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .
ekegusii: Omosomba ogokora emeremo n’obong’aini nigo agwancherwa n’omorwoti, korende endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo ekoba igoro ase oria okomorentera obosooku.

english: Where no oxen are , the crib is clean : but much increase is by the strength of the ox .
ekegusii: Ase chiombe chi’okorema chitari, ebiage nigo bikoba bosa, korende ase okong’usa gwe chintang’ana, endagera enyinge nigo ekonyorekana.

english: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .
ekegusii: Kirori ore omwegenwa tari gokwana oborimo, korende oy’otari omwegenwa nigo akoroka oborimo bwoka.

english: A scorner seeketh wisdom , and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omochecheria narigia obong’aini takobonyora, korende chiseemi nigo chikonyorekana bwango ase omonto ore omong’aini.

english: Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .
ekegusii: Karue ase omonto omoriri, ekiagera tokonyora obong’aini ase aria agokwana.

english: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way : but the folly of fools is deceit .
ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto ore n’okomanya nigo bokomokonya omanya buna chiinchera chiaye chire, korende obosooku bw’abaanto abariri nigo bokobang’aina.

english: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .
ekegusii: Abanto abariri nigo bagokora echeche n’ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge nigo bagwancherana barabwo ase barabwo.

english: A soft answer turneth away wrath : but grievous words stir up anger .
ekegusii: Okoiraneria kw’obwororo nigo kogokendia endamwamu, korende amang’ana y’obotindi nigo agoseegeta endamwamu.

english: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .
ekegusii: Egesusuro ekenene ’nkemonyore oyotigire enchera y’oboronge, nere oy’ogechete ogokuurerwa goika akwe.

english: Hell and destruction are before the LORD : how much more then the hearts of the children of men ?
ekegusii: Onye aase abakuure ne’chioora chi’obosiru bire maiso marore ase Omonene, inee! Tamanyeti chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto mono kobua?

english: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise .
ekegusii: Omonyacheche tancheti omonto okomokuurera, ere tagwancha kogeenda ase abang’aini.

english: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance : but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken .
ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omosasoko nigo ekorenta omogooko ase obosio, korende onye enkoro ere n’omoichano, omoyo nigo okoba nobororo.

english: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya nigo ekorigia chiseemi, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekwerageria oboriri.

english: All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .
ekegusii: Amatuko onsi ay’omonto ochaandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore n’enkoro y’omosasoko nigo akogeenderera koba n’omoyega o botambe.

english: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike amo n’okomoiroka Omonene, kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge amo nemechando.

english: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
ekegusii: Mbuya koria chinyeni more nobwanchani, kobua koria chinyama chi’echiombe chinoru na mogechaine.

english: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro ekoberoroka bwango nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyore omwororo nigo agokanya eriomana.

english: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns : but the way of the righteous is made plain .
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omworo nigo eribete buna orobago rw’amagwa, korende ey’abanyene oboronge nigo ere endonge naende engare.

english: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .
ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana chiseemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora oboriri.

english: A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish man despiseth his mother .
ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaaya ng’ina.

english: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .
ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bore omogooko ase omonto otabwati obomanyi, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge.

english: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .
ekegusii: Ase ogosemania gotari, emeroberio nigo egosareka, korende ase abaseemia abange abaya bare nigo egokiinigwa.

english: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth : and a word spoken in due season , how good is it !
ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogookera okoiraneria okuya gokorua ase omonwa oye, ne ring’ana rigokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete, nigo rire rigiya mono.

english: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omong’aini nigo egotiira gochia ase obogima, erinde omonto oyio tabaisa kogeenda inse agwo aase abakuure.

english: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y’omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi’omotakaanwa.

english: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .
ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebibe nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende amang’ana amaya nigo akomogokia.

english: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .
ekegusii: Omonto ore ne ribero ase okorigia ebitoki ase enchera etari endonge nigo akorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye, korende oyo ogechete riaaki nabe moyo.

english: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer : but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo egoitororoka ayare amabe.

english: The LORD is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are aare korwa ase abakori amabe, korende nigo agotegerera ogosaba kw’abanyene oboronge.

english: The eyes of the LORD are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie kera ase, nigo arooche ababe amo n’abaya.

english: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart : and a good report maketh the bones fat .
ekegusii: Okorigereria kore nomosasoko nigo gokogokia enkoro, na amang’ana amaya nigo akogokia amauga.

english: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotegerera na koigwera ogokuurerwa gokorenta obogima ’namenye amo n’abanto abang’aini.

english: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .
ekegusii: Omonto okwanga ogokuurera, oyio nigo agochaaya obogima bwaye omonyene, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akoba n’okomanya.

english: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom ; and before honour is humility .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, nakwo amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera esiko.

english: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life : but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit .
ekegusii: Oromeme rokoiraneria n’obokanyeku nigo rokogwenia, korende orokorubania nigo rogotandora enkoro.

english: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agochaaya amorokererio a ise y’okomorongeyia, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akong’ainia.

english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .
ekegusii: Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere n’obonge bw’obonda, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo bire n’obonge bw’emechando.

english: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge : but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’abang’aini nigo bikoraria chiseemi, korende chinkoro chi’abariri tichigokora boigo.

english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’abakori amabe nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende ogosaba kw’abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo gokomogokia.

english: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD : but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness .
ekegusii: Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oy’okobwatia oboronge.

english: The preparations of the heart in man , and the answer of the tongue , is from the LORD .
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.

english: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king : his mouth transgresseth not in judgment .
ekegusii: Chinkwana chinchenu ’nchigwenerete koba ase ebikoba bi’omorwoti, na omonwa oye tomocha ekero akonacha ebiina.

english: A just weight and balance are the LORD’s : all the weights of the bag are his work .
ekegusii: Ekerengero + 16:11 Ekerengero: Ekerengero engencho yaye n’egepimo korwa aase erieta ogopima gose okorenga obonge bwaye n’ebipimo ki’oborito gi’ekeene nigo gekorwa ase Omonene, na ebirengero bionsi bire ase chisaro nigo bire ogokora kwaye.

english: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness : for the throne is established by righteousness .
ekegusii: Ekero abarwoti bagokora amabe nigo bakorenta okogechia, ekiagera goetera ase oboronge ekerogo ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa.

english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings ; and they love him that speaketh right .
ekegusii: Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omorwoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana oboronge.

english: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it.
ekegusii: Endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo enga buna abatomwa bakorenta amakweri, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoyekanya.

english: In the light of the king’s countenance is life ; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain .
ekegusii: Omosasoko ore ase obosio bw’omorwoti nigo ore obogima, na ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna amare agotwa embura y’okwamia endagera.

english: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold ! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver !
ekegusii: Konyora obong’aini, ayio namaya kobua konyora etaabu, na okoba nobomanyi nigo kogwenerete kobua koba nefeta.

english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .
ekegusii: Ogweatanana korwa ase amabe, eyio nero enchera enene y’abanyene oboronge; na omonto orendete enchera yaye, nigo arendete obogima bwaye.

english: Pride goeth before destruction , and an haughty spirit before a fall .
ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bogotang’anera obosiru, na omoika bw’obomwenu nigo ogotang’anera okogwa.

english: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba n’omoyo bw’oboitongo na komenya amo nabataka kobua koria ebisakorwa amo nabaenenu.

english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes ; but the LORD weigheth the spirits .
ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’omonto nigo chikororekana ase are omonyene ng’a neching’ikeranu, korende Omonene nigo akorenga omoika o Mwanyabaanto.

english: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good : and whoso trusteth in the LORD , happy is he.
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera Ring’ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeri’Omonene nasesenirie.

english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chiseemi.

english: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ensoko y’obogima ase omong’aini, korende oboriri nigo bore egesusuro ase abariri.

english: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth , and addeth learning to his lips .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye oboseemia, naende yamenta ogotegererwa kw’ebikoba biaye.

english: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’okogokia nigo anga obooke bokorwa ase richoe, nigo are amansu ase omoyo naende nigo akogwenia omobere.

english: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokomobetereria gokora emeremo, ekiagera naganetie goisanekia enchara yaye omonyene.

english: An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .
ekegusii: Omonto otaisaini nigo akona‐gotukoria amabe, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chinga omorero okorura.

english: A froward man soweth strife : and a whisperer separateth chief friends .
ekegusii: Omonto omonyaborimo nigo akona‐gotaara‐taaria amang’ana akorenta eriomana, na omogenki nigo akorenta obobisa ase abanto banchaine.

english: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .
ekegusii: Omonto omotindi nigo akoebereria omonto onde omoraa gochia ase enchera embe.

english: Commit thy works unto the LORD , and thy thoughts shall be established .
ekegusii: Motweke Omonene emeremo yao, na emeroberio yao nesesenigwe.

english: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things : moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass .
