ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye nigo akoroberia amabe, na oyo ogotakuna omonwa oye nigo agoikerania amabe.

english: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .
ekegusii: Chimbuche chire ase omotwe neguutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorwa n’abanyaboronge.

english: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty ; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city .
ekegusii: Omonto otari omwango ase okogechigwa nigo abuete omorwani egeata, na oyomanyete kogambera enkoro yaye nigo abuete oyo okobua omochie na koyoira.

english: The lot is cast into the lap ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD .
ekegusii: Obomera nigo bokorutwa ase esaro ime, korende Omonene nere ogochora oyo bokogwera.

english: The LORD hath made all things for himself : yea, even the wicked for the day of evil .
ekegusii: Omonene okoreire kera egento engencho yaye, nonya nabakori amabe babeo ase engencho ye rituko ri’emechando.

english: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD : though hand join in hand , he shall not be unpunished .
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are kogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.

english: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil .
ekegusii: Ase amaabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene, omonto nigo agweatanana korwa ase amabe.

english: When a man’s ways please the LORD , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
ekegusii: Ekero chiinchera chi’omonto chiamogokirie Omonene Nyasae nigo agokora nonya nababisa b’omonto oyio babwatana nere.

english: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .
ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike ase oboronge kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge chikonyorwa ase oborianania.

english: A man’s heart deviseth his way : but the LORD directeth his steps .
ekegusii: Ase enkoro yaye ime omonto nigo akoroberia chiinchera chiaye, korende Omonene nere okoraa amabarato aye.

english: Better is a dry morsel , and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya konyora ritoronge eriomo ri’obokima na koba n’obotoereru kobua kobeera ase enyomba eichire endagera y’omoyega ere neriomana.

english: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool .
ekegusii: Kobua omonto omoriri otari kweorokereria korwa ase ogoakwa ebiranya rigana erimo, omonto omong’aini nigo akweorokereria korwa ase ogotogonyerwa okomo.

english: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
ekegusii: Omosaria okona-korigia gokora amabe oka, ere ’natomerwe omonto omotindi amoe egesusuro.

english: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .
ekegusii: Mbuya omonto aumerane n’obontindi bw’edubu enkuungu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, kobua koumerana n’omonto omoriri ase oboriri bwaye.

english: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .
ekegusii: Omonto ogoakana amabe ase amaya, obobe tibokorua ase enyomba yaye.

english: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water : therefore leave off contention , before it be meddled with.
ekegusii: Ogochaaka eriomana nigo konga buna amaache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang’ana y’eriomana atarabucha.

english: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonto ogwanchereria omokori amabe ng’a nomonyaboronge, nere oria okonachera omonyakeene ekiina, abwo bonsi nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene.

english: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom , seeing he hath no heart to it ?
ekegusii: Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari n’enkoro y’okomanya?

english: A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .
ekegusii: Omosani nigo akoba nobwanchani ase chingaki chionsi, na oyomino nigo aiboire agokoonye ase engaki y’emechando.

english: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .
ekegusii: Omonto oremeire chiseemi nigo akobwatana amaboko na kwerua koba intenenera ase omonto onde.

english: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete eriomana nigo anchete ogosaria, na oyokweimokereria igoro nigo akwerigeria ogosirigwa.

english: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .
ekegusii: Omosomba omong’aini nagambere omwana bw’omonene oye, oyio ogokora amang’ana ’obosooku, naende naatananerwe omwando amo nabana b’omonene oye.

english: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good : and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omokorekanu ase enkoro yaye tari goseseneka, na oyobwate oromeme rw’ogotantania nigo akonyorwa n’emechando.

english: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
ekegusii: Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba n’omoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba n’omogooko.

english: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine : but a broken spirit drieth the bones .
ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omogooko nigo ekogwenia buna eriogo, korende omoichano ore ase enkoro nigo okwomia emeseto y’amauga.

english: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chiinchera chi’ekina.

english: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
ekegusii: Botambe omonto omong’aini nigo akorora ay’obong’aini amoetanaine, korende omonto omoriri nigo akomaga-maga gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense.

english: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ng’ina oy’omoiborete.

english: Also to punish the just is not good , nor to strike princes for equity .
ekegusii: Tari buya komoa egesusuro omonto omooronge, boigo tari buya kwaguria abanto abasike ase engencho y’oboronge bwabo.

english: He that hath knowledge spareth his words : and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwerita ase amang’ana agokwana, na omonto omong’aini nigo abwate omoika bw’oboremereria.

english: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .
ekegusii: Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are. Ekero akomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.

english: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the LORD trieth the hearts .
ekegusii: Efeta nigo egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekoyenyititora, na etaabu yateemerwa ase omorero ekebemberi, korende Omonene nere okorenga chinkoro.

english: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotegerera oigwera amang’ana y’obokorekanu, na omonyaborimo nigo akoigwera chinkwana chi’ogosiria.

english: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .
ekegusii: Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oye, na oyokogookera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.

english: Children’s children are the crown of old men ; and the glory of children are their fathers .
ekegusii: Abachokoro nigo bare eguutwa ye chisokoro chiabo, na obonene bw’abana nigo bore ase abaibori babo.

english: Excellent speech becometh not a fool : much less do lying lips a prince .
ekegusii: Inaki omoriri tagosemerigwa koba n’amang’ana amaya, boigo n’omogaambi tagwenereti nonya ’ng’ake chinkwana chi’oborimo.

english: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
ekegusii: Riaaki nigo ringa buna rigena ri’ebisio ase amaiso y’omonto oria okoriegwa. Ere nigo akorengereria ng’a kende gionsi ararikorere nigo keramorentere ebisio.

english: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .
ekegusii: Omonto okorigia obwanchani nigo akwabera aya akomocherwa, korende oria okona‐koinyora nigo agosaria obasani.

english: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .
ekegusii: Omonto bweanchete omonyene, nigo akweganeria ayaye oka; nigo akwanga otindia nonya nase onsi ayare amaya.

english: The name of the LORD is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it, and is safe .
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene nigo rire orwaki orokong’u; omonyene oboronge nigo akorotamera oba orendire buya.

english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .
ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bonga buna omochie omokong’u, naende nigo bonga orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.

english: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro y’omonto nigo bogotang’anera ogosarigwa, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.

english: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him.
ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria ring’ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri ase are, na nigo akonyora obosooku.

english: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?
ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning’o orayoremererie omoika ore n’omoichano?

english: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekonyora chiseemi, na ogoto kwaye nigo kogochirigia.

english: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men .
ekegusii: Ebiegwa bi’omonto nigo bikomoigorera enchera na komobeeka amo n’abanto abanene.

english: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
ekegusii: Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a noboronge agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.

english: The lot causeth contentions to cease , and parteth between the mighty .
ekegusii: Obomera nabwo bogokoora okoamererania na gwatanana abanene abwo bakoamererania.

english: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city : and their contentions are like the bars of a castle .
ekegusii: Nigo ere aakong’u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong’u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y’ebiita bi’orwaki orokong’u.

english: A fool hath no delight in understanding , but that his heart may discover itself.
ekegusii: Omoriri tari kogokigwa nay’obong’aini, korende nigo anchete gokwana ayare ase enkoro yaye omonyene.

english: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth ; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled .
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agoisanekia enda yaye n’ogokwana kw’omonwa oye, okwama kw’omonwa oye kwamoigotia.

english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue : and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
ekegusii: Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi’oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo ’mbanyore okwama kwaye.

english: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.

english: The poor useth intreaties ; but the rich answereth roughly .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.

english: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .
ekegusii: Omonto obwate abasani abange nigo akwerentera emechando, korende n’are omosani bw’ekeene baigwanaine kobua oyomwabo.

english: When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .
ekegusii: Ekero ogokora amabe kogocha, ogochaaywa nigo kogocha nakorokwo, na ogochaaywa okwo nigo kogocha n’obosooku.

english: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonwa bw’omonto nigo anga buna amaache ye chindiba. Ensoko y’obong’aini nigo enga buna amaache y’orooche akominyoka.

english: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked , to overthrow the righteous in judgment .
ekegusii: Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekiina ki’omonto omooronge.

english: A fool’s lips enter into contention , and his mouth calleth for strokes .
ekegusii: Chinkwana chi’omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.

english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction , and his lips are the snare of his soul .
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omoriri nigo okomorentera ogosareka, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chikoba omoeto ase are.

english: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’omogenki nigo are buna endagera enyansu; naro nigo agotirimboka gochia ase enkoro ime.

english: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo yaye nobworo nigo are oyomwabo omosaria.

english: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity , than he that is perverse in his lips , and is a fool .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore omwegenwa nigo are omuya kobua oyore omong’ainereria ase chinkwana chiaye naende omoriri.

english: Delight is not seemly for a fool ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
ekegusii: Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya nonya ng’ake ng’a omosomba agaambere abagaambi.

english: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto nigo bokogera oremereria okogechigwa, na okoombia okomocha nigo kore obonene bwaye.

english: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti abeire nekeririanda nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, korende ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna riime rire ase obonyansi.

english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father : and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping .
ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotonya.

english: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the LORD .
ekegusii: Chinyomba ne chinibo nigo chire omwando abana bakonyora korwa ase abaise korende omokungu omong’aini nigo are ekeegwa korwa ase Omonene.

english: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep ; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger .
ekegusii: Obworo nigo bokorentera omonto chitoro chindito, na omonto buna oyio goika abe nenchara.

english: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .
ekegusii: Omonto orendete amachiiko, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyo otari korenda chiinchera chiaye nigo arakwe.

english: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .
ekegusii: Omonto okororera omotaka amaabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, n’Omonene ’namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.

english: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .
ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.

english: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’ekeririanda, ekeene goika anyore egesusuro; oise komotanga kagokora bobe nigo okomoseegeta.

english: Also, that the soul be without knowledge , it is not good ; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth .
ekegusii: Tari buya omonto aborwe okomanya ase omoyo oye, na oy’okegeenda bwango, nigo agosira.

english: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .
ekegusii: Igwera ogosemigwa naende bwanche okworokererigwa, igo nario oranyore obong’aini boragokoonye ase chingaki chire bosio.

english: There are many devices in a man’s heart ; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD , that shall stand .
ekegusii: Emeroberio emenge nere ase enkoro y’omonto, korende nonya naboigo emeroberio y’Omonene nero eraikerane.

english: The desire of a man is his kindness : and a poor man is better than a liar .
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokworokia obuya bwaye, na omonto omotaka nigo are omuya mono kobua omonyaborimo.

english: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life : and he that hath it shall abide satisfied ; he shall not be visited with evil .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokorenta obogima, na omonto ore nokoiroka okwo nigo agoisaneka, gose amabe takomonyoora.

english: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.

english: Smite a scorner , and the simple will beware : and reprove one that hath understanding , and he will understand knowledge .
ekegusii: Aka omonto omonyacheche, na abanto batamanyeti amaange mbeorokererie korwa ase ayio; togonyera omonto ore n’okomanya, ere nigo aranyore chiseemi.

english: He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .
ekegusii: Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaaya.

english: Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .
ekegusii: Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chiseemi.

english: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment : and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity .
ekegusii: Kirori omobe nigo agochecheria oboronge, na omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogworerete ebibe.

english: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .
ekegusii: Ekiina ki’abanyacheche nigo kenachire, na abariri ’mbang’wanigwe ebiranya ase emegongo yabo.

english: The foolishness of man perverteth his way : and his heart fretteth against the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase oboriri bw’omonto nigo agwesiria ase chiinchera chiaye omonyene, erio enkoro y’omonto oyio yamomochia Omonene.

english: Wealth maketh many friends ; but the poor is separated from his neighbour .
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akonyora abasani abange, korende omotaka nigo akwangwa nomosani oye.

english: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall not escape .
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na omonto ogokwana oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro kiaye.

english: Many will intreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwanchwa na abanene, na abange nigo bakoba abasani b’omonto okorua ebiegwa n’omoyo omorabu.

english: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akogechwa nabaanto bamwabo bonsi, gose tikori ogokumia ng’a abasani baye bamotigire. Nigo egenete amang’ana abo, ko aba bosa ase are.

english: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
ekegusii: Omonto okonyora obong’aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.

english: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na oyo ogokwana oborimo goika asire.

english: My son , if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.

english: If they say , Come with us, let us lay wait for blood , let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause :
ekegusii: Baise kogoteebia, “Inchuo ogeende amo naintwe; toboere abanto tobaite, toumokere onde bwensi otari na komocha.

english: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
ekegusii: Inchuo tobamere kobare moyo, buna aase abakuure akomera, bageende abagima ase embeera.

english: We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :
ekegusii: Erio tonyore chinibo chionsi chie rigori rinene, toichorie chinyomba chiaito nebisakorwa ebio.

english: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse :
ekegusii: Inchuo obwatane amo naintwe; tobe n’ekegaancha ekemo.”

english: My son , walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path :
ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa gotaara amo nabarabwo. Otange okogoro kwao tikobaisa gotacha ase bagoeta,

english: For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .
ekegusii: ekiagera amagoro abo nigo akominyoka gochia ase ogokora amabe, na nigo bare abaango ase ogoitera amanyinga.

english: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird .
ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.

english: And they lay wait for their own blood ; they lurk privily for their own lives .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, na koumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.

english: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain ; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chiinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora. Obong’aini Nkorangeria Bore

english: To know wisdom and instruction ; to perceive the words of understanding ;
ekegusii: Emebayeno eyio eragere abanto bamanye obong’aini na amorokererio y’okorongeyia, naende bamanye amang’ana are nengeencho.

english: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,
ekegusii: Nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase emesangererekano emenene y’abanto, naende ase ebiita bi’emechie, bwateeba.

english: How long, ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?
ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri inwe abamotamanyeti amaange moranche ogotamanya kwaino? Ngoika ririri abachecheria baregokie nogochecheria kwabo, na abariri bageche chiseemi?

english: Turn you at my reproof : behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
ekegusii: Moise koonchoka moigwe ogokuurera kw’ane, rirorio nimbaiterere omoika one, ’mbamanyie amang’ana ane.

english: Because I have called , and ye refused ; I have stretched out my hand , and no man regarded ;
ekegusii: Nabeire ’nkobarangeria, korende mwangire konyigwera; nabeire ’nkorambora okoboko kw’ane, korende monto onde tari okorigereirie.

english: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
ekegusii: Mwachaayire ogoseemia kw’ane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokuurera kw’ane.

english: I also will laugh at your calamity ; I will mock when your fear cometh ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nimbasekerere ekero emechando erabachere. Nimbachecherie ekero obwoba borabaachere;

english: When your fear cometh as desolation , and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind ; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
ekegusii: ee, ekero obwoba borabaachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabaachere.

english: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer ; they shall seek me early , but they shall not find me:
ekegusii: Erio barabwo ’mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; ’mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.

english: For that they hated knowledge , and did not choose the fear of the LORD :
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bageechete chiseemi tibancheti komoiroka Omonene.

english: To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity ;
ekegusii: Korwa ase ero abanto mbanyore amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboronge, na ekeene, na ogokora kw’oboronge.

english: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .
ekegusii: Tibancheti koigwera ring’ana riane ri’okobaseemia nonya nerimo; nigo bachaayete ogokuurera kw’ane gwonsi.

english: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ’mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo, baisaneke n’emeroberio yabo abanyene

english: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
ekegusii: Okoirana magega kw’abwo batamanyeti amaange ’nkobaite, na ogoisaneka kw’abariri ’nkobasirie barabwo abanyene.

english: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi oranyigwere namenye ase omorembe, ere nabe n’obotoereru na takoiroka bobe bonde.”

english: To give subtilty to the simple , to the young man knowledge and discretion .
ekegusii: Emebayeno eyio nigo erae abatamanyeti amaange bamanye chiseemi, naende nigo erorokererie ekegori egeke getware obomanyi na emeroberio emiya.

english: A wise man will hear , and will increase learning ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :
ekegusii: Ase okoigwa emebayeno eyio omonto omong’aini nigo akong’ainia goetania, na oyore nobomanyi bwenyorera ogosemigwa okuya.

english: To understand a proverb , and the interpretation ; the words of the wise , and their dark sayings .
ekegusii: Korwa ase emebayeno eyio abanto ’mbanyaare kweorokereria emebayeno na eki egoteeba; boigo ’mbamanye amang’ana y’abanto abang’aini na emebayeno yabo. Ogoseemia Ekiare Egeke

english: My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :
ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera amorokererio a iso, na tobaisa gotiga aria nyoko akogochika.

english: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head , and chains about thy neck .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti ria’o.

english: Wine is a mocker , strong drink is raging : and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise .
ekegusii: Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.

english: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the LORD .
ekegusii: Ebirengero + 20:10 Ebirengero: nabio ebipiimo bi’oborito, na ebi’obonge, bire ara kabere, nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene.

english: Even a child is known by his doings , whether his work be pure , and whether it be right .
ekegusii: Nonya nomwana nigo amanyekanete ase ogokora kwaye, gose orogendo rw’aye nigo rorabe ororonge na orw’ekeene.

english: The hearing ear , and the seeing eye , the LORD hath made even both of them.
ekegusii: Ogoto gokoigwa, na eriiso rikorora, bionsi bibere ’Omonene obikorete.

english: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha chitoro, obaise koba omotaka; ramokia amaiso ao, naye ’nonyore endagera enyinge.

english: It is naught , it is naught , saith the buyer : but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth .
ekegusii: Omogori egento nigo agoteeba: “Eke tigeisaini gento”, na ekero akeirire bwetogia.

english: There is gold , and a multitude of rubies : but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel .
ekegusii: Etaabu nereo, na amagena amaange ye rigori rinene, korende ebikoba bigokwana ay’obong’aini nigo binga buna amagena ye rigori rinene akomeka‐meka.

english: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger : and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
ekegusii: Bogoria eanga y’omonto bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto onde, ira biria abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.

english: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .
ekegusii: Endagera ekonyorwa ase enchera y’obong’ainereria, nigo ekoba enyansu ase omonto, korende magega yaye omonwa bw’omonto oyio nigo ogoichorwa n’omokenye.

english: Every purpose is established by counsel : and with good advice make war .
ekegusii: Emeroberio nigo egoikeranigwa goetera ase ogoseemia okuya na gokorwana esegi, yerwane n’obosemia obuya.

english: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, ase ayio tobaisa kobwatana n’omonto otari kweriita ase amang’ana aye.

english: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion : whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul .
ekegusii: Okogosa kw’omorwoti nigo konga buna okoruma kw’endo, na oyo okomogechia oba n’endamwamu, oyio nigo akogera obogima bwaye bosirigwe.

english: Whoso curseth his father or his mother , his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness .
ekegusii: Omonto oraragererie ise, gose ng’ina, oyio etaya yaye nerimigwe ekero ki’omosuunte ekerima.

english: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning ; but the end thereof shall not be blessed .
ekegusii: Oise gosanera konyora omwando bwango korwa omochakano, omoerio oye tori gosesenigwa.

english: Say not thou, I will recompense evil ; but wait on the LORD , and he shall save thee.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Goika ng’akane amabe nakoreirwe.” Oganye Omonene, nere oragokoonye.

english: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD ; and a false balance is not good .
ekegusii: Ebirengo + 20:23 rigereria 20:10 bi’oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero kioboriania nigo kere ekebe.

english: Man’s goings are of the LORD ; how can a man then understand his own way ?
ekegusii: Omonene nere okoraa chiinchera chi’omonto, ase ayio ’naki omonto aranyare komanya chiinchera chiaye?

english: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy , and after vows to make enquiry .
ekegusii: Nigo ekoba omoeto ase omonto karabe omwango ase ogwatanana egento kebe egechenu, na magega yaye oba okorengereria aya arierete eira.

english: A wise king scattereth the wicked , and bringeth the wheel over them.
ekegusii: Omorwoti ore omong’aini nigo akomanya abakori amabe obaatanana, erio obatacha n’amagoro ye chigaari.

english: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD , searching all the inward parts of the belly .
ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, n’oro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.

english: Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .
ekegusii: Obuya na obwegenwa, nabio bikorenda omorwoti, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obogaambi nigo kegokong’igwa namaabera.

english: The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .
ekegusii: Chinguru nachio chire obonene bw’abamura, korende chimbuche nigo chire obwari bw’abaanto abagotu.

english: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife : but every fool will be meddling .
ekegusii: Nigo are amasikani ase omonto ogwetanga korwa ase eriomana, korende kera omonto ore omoriri nigo akona‐kwomana.

english: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil : so do stripes the inward parts of the belly .
ekegusii: Obororo bw’ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw’ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.

english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari korema omogondo ase engaki egwenerete, na ekero rigesa riaikire, ere gakogeenda korata, takonyora gento.

english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .
ekegusii: Emeroberio ere ase enkoro y’omonto nigo enga buna amaache are ase endiba, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo akoyabuucha korwa aroro.

english: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakweraria ng’a nabaya bare, korende ning’o oranyaare konyora omonto omwegenwa bori?

english: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him.
ekegusii: Omonto omonyene oboronge obwatetie chiinchera chindonge, abana baye ’mbasesenigwe korwa magega yaye.

english: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes .
ekegusii: Omorwoti ogoikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegaambero nigo agoserebania amabe onsi namaiso aye.

english: Who can say , I have made my heart clean , I am pure from my sin ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare goteeba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro y’ane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?

english: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD , as the rivers of water : he turneth it whithersoever he will .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omorwoti nigo enga buna orooche rore ase okoboko kw’Omonene; n’Omonene nigo akomoraa gochia aande onsi buna aganetie.

english: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
ekegusii: Omoyo bw’omokori amabe nigo okogania gokora ebibe, na omonto oyio tari kororera omonto onde amaabera.

english: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyacheche akonyora egesusuro, oria otamanyeti amaange nigo akoba omong’aini; na ekero omonto omong’aini akworokererigwa nigo akonyora chiseemi.

english: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
ekegusii: Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo akorigereria enyomba y’omokori amabe; ere nigo akoiyeria abakori amabe inse basire.

english: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor , he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard .
ekegusii: Omonto oria ogosieka amato aye ng’a taigwa ekerero ki’omotaka, nere ekero ararere takoiguugwa.

english: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
ekegusii: Ekeegwa gekoruegwa bobisi nigo kegokendia endamwamu, ne riaaki ribisire ase eanga ime nigo rigokendia ekeririanda.

english: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
ekegusii: Ekero ekeene giakorirwe, ayio nigo akoba omogooko bw’abanyene oboronge, korende ase abakori amabe nomoichano.

english: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotiga enchera y’obomanyi, oyio nabeere ase omosangererekano bw’abaanto bakwete.

english: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete emegoko goika abe omotaka; na oyobwanchete kwegokia nedivai na amaguta takoba omonda.

english: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agosoa ase emechando y’omonyene oboronge, oba embooria yaye, na oyo otari omwegenwa oba embooria y’oyore n’enkoro endonge.

english: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ense y’erooro, kobua komenya n’omokuungu omonyariomana, naende omonyandamwamu.

english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes : but the LORD pondereth the hearts .
ekegusii: Kera enchera y’omonto nigo ekororekana ng’a neya boronge ase are, korende Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro.

english: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise ; but a foolish man spendeth it up .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akorenda chinibo chi’engeencho enene amo namaguta ase enka yaye, korende omoriri nigo agochiria bobe chiaera.

english: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
ekegusii: Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio ’nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.

english: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty , and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akoumokera omochie ore nabarwani esegi chituoni oyobua, erio otagora chindwaki chiria abanto abwo basemeretie.

english: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .
ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rw’aye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.

english: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
ekegusii: Omonto ore omoenenu na omwerori, na ogokora kwaye kore okw’obomwenu, nigo akorokwa “Omochecheria”.

english: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour .
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto omworo nigo gokomoita okwa, ekiagera nigo akwanga gokora emeremo namaboko aye.

english: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong’itia.

english: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination : how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind ?
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’omokori amabe nigo kere okogechia, Inee, tari bobe mono goetania ekero agokerua nebirengererio ebibe?

english: A false witness shall perish : but the man that heareth speaketh constantly .
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omotegereri omuya nageenderere gokwana.

english: A wicked man hardeneth his face : but as for the upright , he directeth his way .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokong’ia obosio bwaye, korende oyore nenkoro endonge nigo akorenda orogendo rw’aye.

english: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice .
ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.

english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD .
ekegusii: Obong’aini tibori, gose okomanya, gose ogoseemia, biranyaare koamererania n’Omonene.

english: The horse is prepared against the day of battle : but safety is of the LORD .
ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogeenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.

english: An high look , and a proud heart , and the plowing of the wicked , is sin .
ekegusii: Amaiso are noboenenu, na enkoro y’obomwenu, ebio nigo bire etaya y’abakori amabe, bikobaraa bakora ebibe.

english: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .
ekegusii: Emeroberio y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomorentera ebitoki ebinge, korende omonto okoayerera nigo akogeenderera koremerwa.

english: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .
ekegusii: Chinibo chikonyorwa ase oromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo chikoera buna omooki, nigo chire n’obosongo buna emetego ya amakweri.

english: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment .
ekegusii: Obourereria bw’abakori amabe ’mbobasirie barueo, ekiagera bangire gokora ayare ay’oboronge.

english: The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .
ekegusii: Enchera y’omomochi nigo ere enkorekanu, korende ogokora kw’oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo kore okoronge.

english: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo, kobua komenya amo ase enyomba n’omokuungu omonyariomana.

english: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .
ekegusii: Erieta rigiya nigo rigwenerete gochorwa kobua chinibo chinyinge, na ogwakwaneka okuya nigo kobuete efeta na etaabu.

english: Cast out the scorner , and contention shall go out ; yea, strife and reproach shall cease .
ekegusii: Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaaya ’mbisire.

english: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete enkoro echenegete, na ebikoba biaye bigokwana ayare ay’obuya, omorwoti nabe omosani oye.

english: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge , and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor .
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie na korenda oyore nokomanya, korende nigo akoonchorana na gosaria amang’ana ya abatari abegenwa.

english: The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko! Nigo ndabaise gochia goiterwa ase chiinchera.”

english: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omokuungu omotayayi nigo ore eirima entambe, na omonto onde bwensi Omonene agechiigwe nere goika agwe ase eirima eyio.

english: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bosiberanirie ime ase enkoro y’omwana, korende ekeranya gekorongeyia amamocho nigo gekoborusiao.

english: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .
ekegusii: Ere oyo ogokorera abataka bobe ase ogwetenenkia ere omonyene, gose okorua ebiegwa ase abanda, goika aremerwe. Amang’ana emerongo etato ay’obong’aini

english: Bow down thine ear , and hear the words of the wise , and apply thine heart unto my knowledge .
ekegusii: Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio ane ime ase enkoro yao.

english: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .
ekegusii: Nigo erabe buya korayarende ime yao, erinde abe ang’e ase ebikoba biao koyakwana.

english: That thy trust may be in the LORD , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee.
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.

english: The rich and poor meet together : the LORD is the maker of them all.
ekegusii: Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.

english: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
ekegusii: Inee! Tinkoriikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogoseemia na ay’amorokererio?

english: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth ; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
ekegusii: Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete. 1.

english: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :
ekegusii: Tobaisa koura omotaka ekiaye, ekiagera are omotaka, gose agwo ase egeita tobaisa komokorera bobe omonto ochaandegete.

english: For the LORD will plead their cause , and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abataka, na abwo bakobaurereria nabasirie. 2.

english: Make no friendship with an angry man ; and with a furious man thou shalt not go :
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora obosani n’omonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogeenda amo n’omonto ore nekeririanda.

english: Lest thou learn his ways , and get a snare to thy soul .
ekegusii: Oise kobwatana noyio, nigo orenarie chiinchera chiaye, erio obwatwe ase omotego. 3.

english: Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba oyomo bw’abaanto abwo bakobwatana amaboko, gose bakwerua koba intenenera ase chisira chi’abaanto bande.

english: If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
ekegusii: Nobaise kourwa oborere bwao okoraarera, ekiagera tobwati gento ogoakana. 4.

english: Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabeegete. 5.

english: Seest thou a man diligent in his business ? he shall stand before kings ; he shall not stand before mean men .
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto omanyete emeremo yaye buya, oyio natenene ase amasio y’abarwoti, tagokorera abanto bande emeremo.

english: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself: but the simple pass on , and are punished .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oy’otamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.

english: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches , and honour , and life .
ekegusii: Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.

english: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
ekegusii: Amagwa na emeeto nigo bitegire ase chiinchera chi’abaanto abakorekanu, korende oyo orendete omoyo oye goika eatanane korwa ase bire.

english: Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it.
ekegusii: Orokereria omwana abwatie enchera egwenerete, na ekero abeire omogotu takoyetiga.

english: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.

english: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .
ekegusii: Oy’ogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y’endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.

english: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed ; for he giveth of his bread to the poor .
ekegusii: Omonto obwate eriiso ri’amaabera nasesenigwe, ekiagera bwatananeire omotaka endagera.

english: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee:
ekegusii: Ekero ogoikaransa koria endagera amo nomogaambi, orengererie mono ng’a ning’o ore ase obosio bwao.

english: Remove not the old landmark ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro, gose totumana osoe ase emegondo ye chintakana,

english: For their redeemer is mighty ; he shall plead their cause with thee.
ekegusii: ekiagera Omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru, ere nachirwanerere akorwanie aye. 11.

english: Apply thine heart unto instruction , and thine ears to the words of knowledge .
ekegusii: Karue enkoro y’ao oigwe amorokererio, na amato ao aigwe amang’ana ye chiseemi. 12.

english: Withhold not correction from the child : for if thou beatest him with the rod , he shall not die .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga korongeyia omwana oo; koramoake ekeranya, tagochia gokwa.

english: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .
ekegusii: Ee, koramoake ekeranya nigo oratoorie obogima bwaye korwa aase abakuure. 13.

english: My son , if thine heart be wise , my heart shall rejoice , even mine .
ekegusii: Omwana one, onye enkoro yao ekoba n’obong’aini, rirorio enkoro y’ane nigo eragooke.

english: Yea, my reins shall rejoice , when thy lips speak right things .
ekegusii: Ekero ebikoba biao birakwane amang’ana amaronge, nigo ndabe nomogooko ime y’ane. 14.

english: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’ao tebaisa gosanera amang’ana yabanyene ebibe, korende aye ogeenderere komoiroka Omonene kera rituko.

english: For surely there is an end ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .
ekegusii: Ekeene, eng’eria nekare bosio, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa. 15.

english: Hear thou, my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa na obe n’obong’aini, naende orende enkoro y’ao ebwatie enchera endonge.

english: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .
ekegusii: Onye kore n’enchara, obeke omoyio ase ring’orong’oche ria’o.

english: Be not among winebibbers ; among riotous eaters of flesh :
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ase egati y’abagotinda nedivai, gose ase egati y’abakoria chinyama bobe,

english: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty : and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags .
ekegusii: ekiagera abagotinda, na abaria bobe, ’mbabe abataka; na obogondereria bwe chitoro nigo boraboyie omonto amachanchabe. 16.

english: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old .
ekegusii: Igwera iso okoiborete, na tobaisa komochaya nyoko ekero agotire.

english: Buy the truth , and sell it not; also wisdom , and instruction , and understanding .
ekegusii: Gora ekeene, na tobaisa gokeoonia; boigo gora obong’aini, na amorokererio, na obomanyi.

english: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
ekegusii: Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogooko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagookigwe nere.

english: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad , and she that bare thee shall rejoice .
ekegusii: Bagookie iso na nyoko, tiga oria okoiborete akogookere. 17.

english: My son , give me thine heart , and let thine eyes observe my ways .
ekegusii: Omwana one, ing’a enkoro yao, na amaiso ao tiga agookere chiinchera chiane.

english: For a whore is a deep ditch ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .
ekegusii: Omokungu omotayayi nigo anga engoro entambe gochia inse, na omokungu bw’omonto onde nigo anga egesiima ekegote.

english: She also lieth in wait as for a prey , and increaseth the transgressors among men .
ekegusii: Ee, omokungu oyio nigo akoboera buna omouri, nigo akomentekania abasaria ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto. 18.

english: Who hath woe ? who hath sorrow ? who hath contentions ? who hath babbling ? who hath wounds without cause ? who hath redness of eyes ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oyio ore nobobe? Ning’o oyio oichanete? Ning’o oyio okorwana na kwereera? Ning’o oyio oakirwe chingoma chitagwenerete aakwe? Ning’o oyio obariiretie amaiso?

english: Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanera chindagera chiaye chinyansu, ekiagera nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria. 7.

english: They that tarry long at the wine ; they that go to seek mixed wine .
ekegusii: Nabaanto abwo bakona-konywa edivai ase chingaki chintambe, na abwo bakona‐korigia konywa edivai yochoganirie n’eyende.

english: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red , when it giveth his colour in the cup , when it moveth itself aright .
ekegusii: Tobaisa korigereria edivai koyabariirire, ekero ekobera ase egekombe na koirana inse ng’ora ng’ora.

english: At the last it biteth like a serpent , and stingeth like an adder .
ekegusii: Omoerio nigo ekoroma buna eng’iti na korasa buna enchoka.

english: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo ararore amang’ana amageni, na ebirengererio biao ’mbibe ebikorekanu.

english: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
ekegusii: Nigo or’abe buna omonto oraire ase egati‐gati y’enyancha, gose buna omonto ore ase omote omotambe igoro okoirwa esiororia.

english: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick ; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again.
ekegusii: Aye nigo orateebe, “Nigo bang’agete bororo, korende tinyigweti bobe; nigo bang’wanetie bokong’u, korende tinyigweti kende. Indi ’ngocha koboka ingeende korigia eyende?.”

english: Labour not to be rich : cease from thine own wisdom .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwechaanda mono ng’a obe omonda; tobaisa gosemeria obong’aini bwao omonyene.

english: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings ; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven .
ekegusii: Tobirigereria ebio, obonda nigo bogochoma chimbaaba, bwairuruka buna ekeongo ekoiruruka yarimera igoro. 8.

english: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :
ekegusii: Tobaisa koria endagera y’omonto ogokomogorera, gose tobaisa gosanera chindagera chiaye chinyansu.

english: For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he: Eat and drink , saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
ekegusii: Buna omonto akorengereria ime ase enkoro yaye, naboigo are. Nigo akogotiotereria, “Karie na kanywe!”, Korende enkoro yaye tegwancheti.

english: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo aragere oroke endagera eria kwaria, naende amang’ana ao amaya asire bosa. 9.

english: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokwana amang’ana ao ase omonto omoriri aigwete, ekiagera nigo arachaaye obong’aini bw’amang’ana ao. 10.

english: Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them.
ekegusii: Aye tobaisa gosanera amang’ana yabakori amabe, gose togania koba amo nabarabwo,

english: If thou faint in the day of adversity , thy strength is small .
ekegusii: Korarose na gotang’ang’a ase engaki y’obokong’u rirorio aye nigo ore omoreu otari na nguru. 25.

english: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain ;
ekegusii: Tooria abwo bakoirwa gochia gokwa; irania abwo bakoirwa gochia goitwa.

english: If thou sayest , Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
ekegusii: Oise goteeba, “Intwe titwamanyete amang’ana aya”, Inee, oyio okorenga chinkoro tamanyeti ayio? Oyio origereretie omoyo oo nigo amanyete ayio, na nigo araakane kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore. 26.

english: My son , eat thou honey , because it is good ; and the honeycomb , which is sweet to thy taste :
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, karie obooke, ekiagera nobuya; obooke bogotonya korwa ase eriana nigo bore obwansu ase ore.

english: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
ekegusii: Manya ng’a obong’aini buna obwo ’mboganeirie ase omoyo oo, korabonyore, rirorio ’nonyore amaya ase amatuko agochi‐goocha, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa. 27.

english: Lay not wait , O wicked man , against the dwelling of the righteous ; spoil not his resting place :
ekegusii: Aye omokori amabe, tobaisa koboera omonyene oboronge ase amenyete, tosaria aase aye agotimokera.

english: For a just man falleth seven times , and riseth up again : but the wicked shall fall into mischief .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akogwa ara gatano na kabere, naende oboka, korende abakori amabe nigo bagosira ekero banyorire emechando. 28.

english: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth , and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth :
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogooka ekero omobisa oo agure, na enkoro yao tebaisa gosasoka ekero agochirwe.

english: Lest the LORD see it , and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ararore okogooka okwo agechigwe, erio aonchore endamwamu yaye erue ase omobisa oo. 29.

english: Fret not thyself because of evil men , neither be thou envious at the wicked ;
ekegusii: Aye togechigwa ase engencho y’abagokora amabe, gose tobaisa gosanera amang’ana y’abakori amabe.

english: For their heart studieth destruction , and their lips talk of mischief .
ekegusii: ekiagera ebirengererio biabo nigo bikoroberia ay’ogosiria, na ebikoba biabo nigo bigokwama ayakorenta emechando. 20.

english: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out .
ekegusii: Abagokora amabe tibakonyora amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha; etaya y’abakori amabe nerimigwe. 30.

english: My son , fear thou the LORD and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, omoiroke Omonene, oiroke na omorwoti, tobaisa gosang’anana nabasaria.

english: For their calamity shall rise suddenly ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?
ekegusii: Abwo nigo baranyore emechando ya mobosokano, na ning’o oranyaare komanya ogosirigwa kwabo? Amang’ana ande y’obong’aini

english: These things also belong to the wise . It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya boigo nay’abang’aini. Tari buya gwanchereria abanto ekero ebiina bikonachwa.

english: He that saith unto the wicked , Thou art righteous ; him shall the people curse , nations shall abhor him:
ekegusii: Oyo ogoteebia omonto omomochi ng’a: “Aye tori omonyaboronge”, oyio abanto ’mbamoragererie, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo baramogeche.

english: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them.
ekegusii: Korende abwo bakoa omomochi egesusuro ’mbanyore amaya amo nogosesenigwa okuya.

english: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer .
ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria amairanerio amaronge nigo anga okonyunyuntwa kw’ebikoba.

english: Prepare thy work without , and make it fit for thyself in the field ; and afterwards build thine house .
ekegusii: Roisia emeremo yao isiko onsi, naende kora emeremo y’ao ya mogondo eere, na magega y’ayio oagache enyomba y’ao.

english: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause ; and deceive not with thy lips .
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba kirori bosa igo mamincha y’omonto onde, na tobaisa kong’ainereria nebikoba biao.

english: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work .
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Goika nainche imokorere buna ankorera; goika imoakane buna ogokora kwaye kore.”

english: Through wisdom is an house builded ; and by understanding it is established :
ekegusii: Enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nobong’aini na yakong’igwa goetera ase okomanya.

english: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding ;
ekegusii: Ngaeta ase omogondo bw’omonto omworo, na ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omonto otari nobong’aini.

english: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns , and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down .
ekegusii: Nkarora omogondo oyio omerire amagwa, na amasa ayotubire, na amagena aagacheire chindwaki chiaye konya atagokire.

english: Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it, and received instruction .
ekegusii: Nkayorigereria na korengereria mono igoro y’omogondo oyio, nkanyora amorokererio aya:

english: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth ; and thy want as an armed man .
ekegusii: goika obotaka bogochere buna omouri, na oboremerwa kogochere buna omorwani esegi.

english: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches .
ekegusii: Ase chiseemi chire, chiero chi’enyomba eyio nigo chigoichorigwa n’ebinto ao ao bi’engeencho enene, na ebi’okogokia. 21.

english: A wise man is strong ; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo are ne chinguru, na oyore n’okomanya nigo akoorokia okobua okonene.

english: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war : and in multitude of counsellors there is safety .
ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia kw’obong’aini kore, nonyaare korwana esegi, na ase abasemia abange abaya bare, obobui nigo bokonyorekanao. 22.

english: Wisdom is too high for a fool : he openeth not his mouth in the gate .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore egento kere aare korwa ase omonto omoriri; ere tari komaanora omonwa oye agwo ase egeita. 23.

english: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .
ekegusii: Ere oyokoroberia gokora amabe narokwe omonto okorenta emechando.

english: The thought of foolishness is sin : and the scorner is an abomination to men .
ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’oboriri n’ebibe, na omonyacheche nigo are okogechia ase abanto. 24.

english: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
ekegusii: Eye nero emebayeno ya Sulemani, eyio abanto ba Hezekia omorwoti bw’Abayuda, basangereretie.

english: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .
ekegusii: Oise koboorokia, na omonto onde aise koigwa ayio, nigo aragosookie, na erieta ria’o risareke kogeenderera botambe.

english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .
ekegusii: Ring’ana rigokwanwa ase enchera egwenerete nigo ringa buna amatunda amororo amaya mono abekire ase egekabu keroisirie korwa ase efeta.

english: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini ogokuurera oyokoigwera nigo are buna ebonyi ne chisonoi biroseirie chitaabu.

english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters .
ekegusii: Omotomwa ore omwegenwa nigo are ase abwo bakomotoma buna amaache amakendu ase engaki ye rigesa, ekiagera nigo akogera emioyo yabo yaba emeyia.

english: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain .
ekegusii: Omonto ogwetogia ng’a nare nomoyo omorabu, ko tari korua ebiegwa, nigo anga amare na omwaga bitari korenta embura.

english: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
ekegusii: Oboremereria nigo bokwororobia omogambi, na oromeme rw’obwororo nigo rokobuna riuga.

english: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
ekegusii: Onye kwanyorire obooke, karie ekerengo kegoisaine; oise kogeetania nigo oraboroke.

english: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house ; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
ekegusii: Amagoro ao tanara kona‐kogeenda ase enyomba y’omosani oo, nigo arabaise korosa naye, erinde akogeche.

english: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .
ekegusii: Omonto okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase omonto onde nigo anga buna enungu y’eseegi, gose omoro, gose ensara enyonge.

english: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth , and a foot out of joint .
ekegusii: Ogosemeria omonto otari omwegenwa ase engaki y’emechando, nigo enga buna erino ribunegete gose okogoro goteng’eretie.

english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
ekegusii: Nigo bore obonene bwa Nyasae kobisa amang’ana; korende na obonene bw’abarwoti gokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio.

english: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
ekegusii: Omonto ogoteera amatera y’omogooko ase omonto obwate enkoro ere nobororo nigo anga buna okorusia eanga ase engaki y’obokendu gose kobeeka egento ekeroro ase riote.

english: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the LORD shall reward thee.
ekegusii: Igo nobeke omorero bw’amakara ase omotwe oye, n’Omonene nakoe eng’eria yao.

english: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .
ekegusii: Omwaga okogusa korwa sugusu nigo okorenta embura, naboigo nomonto omogenki akorenta okobeeana.

english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo igoro, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo n’omokungu omonyariomana.

english: As cold waters to a thirsty soul , so is good news from a far country .
ekegusii: Amang’ana amaya akorentwa korwa ase ense y’aare nigo anga buna amaache amakendu ase omonto ore n’erang’o.

english: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain , and a corrupt spring .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge okorua ribaga ase omokori amabe nigo anga buna orooche rore netintira na buna ensoko yasarekire.

english: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
ekegusii: Tari buya koria obooke obonge, na abwo bakwerigeria obonene, obonene bwabo nigo borabe bosa.

english: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti kwegambera omonyene nigo anga buna omochie chindwaki chiaye chiatagoirwe.

english: The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana igoro ere aare mono etatukwe emanywe, na ayare ase ense inse boigo, ne chinkoro chi’abarwoti tichigotukwa chimanywe.

english: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .
ekegusii: Rusia amabiria korwa ase efeta, na omoturi ’nanyore efeta akoroiseria egekorero ekiya.

english: Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .
ekegusii: Rusia abakori amabe korwa ase obosio bw’omorwoti, erio ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo kerageenderere gokong’igwa n’oboronge.

english: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .
ekegusii: Nigo er’abe buya mono ekero orateebigwe, “Inchuo gocha aa”, kobua goseerigwa gochia goikaransa magega korwa ase ribaga ri’abaanto abasike.

english: Go not forth hastily to strive , lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame .
ekegusii: Toba omwango kogeenda ase ekegambero. Inee! Inki orakore ase omoerio, ekero omonto oyio gwasoerete arakobue n’obe n’obosooku?

english: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another :
ekegusii: Onye aye omonyene kobwate amang’ana n’omonto onde, kwana nere, korende tobaisa koorokia obobisi bw’omonto omoao.

english: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana obokendu bogocha ase engaki y’egurugura, gose embura egotwa ase engaki ye rigesa, naboigo ere bobe omonto omoriri konyora amasikani.

english: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .
ekegusii: Omonto omanyete emeremo nigo agwekorera emeremo emiya, korende oyore omoriri nigo akoriika onde bwensi ogoeta, na emeremo yasareka.

english: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit ? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ogwekora omong’aini, ogosemeria ’nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.

english: The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way ; a lion is in the streets .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko, ee, endo nere ase chiinchera chi’omochie.”

english: As the door turneth upon his hinges , so doth the slothful upon his bed .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.

english: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom ; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.

english: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akwerora ng’a n’omong’aini are abuete abanto batano na babere barakwane amang’ana are n’engeencho.

english: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .
ekegusii: Omonto orenge goeta na gwesoyia ase eriomana ritarenge eriaye nigo anga buna oyo okobwata amato y’esese.

english: As a mad man who casteth firebrands , arrows , and death ,
ekegusii: -19 Omonto okong’aina omonto onde, na magega yaye omoteebia, “Negosori yoka nare kogokorera,” oyio nigo anga buna ebarimo ekoruta ebigenga bi’omorero, ne chinsara, chia amakweri.

english: As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .
ekegusii: Buna enchiro ekona‐koong’anya, na buna egesingororo gekoiruruka, naboigo na okoragereria gotari nengeencho gotaikere oria oragererigwe.

english: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out : so where there is no talebearer , the strife ceaseth .
ekegusii: Ase chinko chitari, omorero nigo okorima, naboigo nase omogenki atari, eriomana nigo rigosira.

english: As coals are to burning coals , and wood to fire ; so is a contentious man to kindle strife .
ekegusii: Omonyariomana ogoseegeta amariomana nigo anga buna amakara akogeenderera koyia, gose chinko chikogera omorero ogeenderera gwoka.

english: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross .
ekegusii: Omonto obwate amang’ana amansu ase ebikoba biaye, korende ore nobobe ase enkoro yaye, nigo anga buna egekorero ki’amaroba giatekire keoomire nefeta.

english: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him;
ekegusii: Omonto omogechi nigo akobisa ase ebikoba biaye, obong’ainereria bore ase enkoro yaye.

english: When he speaketh fair , believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart .
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana are amansu, tobaisa komwegena, ekiagera nabwate ay’okogechia atano na abere, ase enkoro yaye ime.

english: Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .
ekegusii: Naisa gotuba okogecha kwaye nobong’ainereria, obokayayu bwaye goika bomanyekane n’omosangererekano bwonsi.

english: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone , it will return upon him.
ekegusii: Omonto okorema eirima, nere omonyene oragwe imeo; na omonto ogoturunkania rigena, nere omonyene rirairanere rimogwere.

english: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin .
ekegusii: Omonto ore noromeme rogokwana oborimo, nigo akogecha abanto abwo amang’ana aye achaandire bobe, na omonwa ogokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia nigo okorenta ogosirigwa.

english: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool’s back .
ekegusii: Ekeranya nigo kere ase ogoaka ebarasi, na ekeokio ase okoraa etigere, naboigo n’enyimbo ere ase ogoaka omogongo bw’omonto omoriri.

english: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koiraneria omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, nigo orabaise koba omoriri buna are.

english: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
ekegusii: Moiranerie omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, tabaisa gwekaga ng’a nomong’aini are.

english: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotoma amang’ana ase okoboko kw’omonto omoriri, oyio nigo akobutora amaboko aye omonyene bwerentera emechando.

english: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio ogokwanwa n’omonwa bw’omoriri nigo onga buna omonto egesegora, okogoro kwaye gotari gokora emeremo.

english: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling , so is he that giveth honour to a fool .
ekegusii: Omonto okoa omoriri amasikani, nigo anga buna oyokoruta omobuko ore n’ebinto bi’erigori rinene ase etui y’amagena.

english: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio okorwa ase omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo onga buna rigwa rikobeta okoboko kw’omonto otindire amarwa.

english: Thine own friend , and thy father’s friend , forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity : for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba omosani oo, na omosani o iso; rituko kwanyorire emechando togeenda ase enka y’oyomino. Mbuya kogeenda bw’omogisangio ase engaki eyio, kobua korigia oyomino omenyete aare.

english: My son , be wise , and make my heart glad , that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
ekegusii: Omwana one, kabe n’obong’aini na ogokie enkoro y’ane, erio nario ’ndanyore ring’ana ’nkoiraneria omonto ogonchaaya.

english: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself; but the simple pass on , and are punished .
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando aare bwebisa, korende oyotamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.

english: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
ekegusii: Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.

english: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice , rising early in the morning , it shall be counted a curse to him.
ekegusii: Omonto okobooka mambia chuni oaka eriogi gosesenia omogisangio oye, oyio nabarerwe okoragererigwa.

english: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .
ekegusii: Omokungu omonyariomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotoonya.

english: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind , and the ointment of his right hand , which bewrayeth itself .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotanga omokungu buna oyio, okwo nigo konga ogotangwa kw’omwaga gose okobwata amaguta n’okoboko gw’okorio.

english: Iron sharpeneth iron ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .
ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kegotieria ekioma kende, naboigo n’omonto otieria omonto onde.

english: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .
ekegusii: Omonto okorenda omoko narie okwama kw’omoko oyio, na oyio okorenda omonene oye, oyio nanyore ogosikwa.

english: As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .
ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria ase amaache ime nigo okorora obosio bwao, naboigo nebirengererio bi’enkoro y’omonto bikororekana ase omonto onde.

english: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .
ekegusii: Aye omonyene tobaisa gwetogia, korende tiga omonto onde agotogie; tiga omonto omoao agotogie, korende tari ebikoba biao omonyene.

english: Hell and destruction are never full ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .
ekegusii: Buna aase abakuure na embeera bitari goisaneka, naboigo n’amaiso a Mwanyabaanto atari goisaneka.

english: As the fining pot for silver , and the furnace for gold ; so is a man to his praise .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana efeta egoteemerwa ase egetaabo gekonyititora, na etaabu ase omorero ekebemberi, naboigo omonto agoteemwa na komanyekana ase ogosikwa kwaye.

english: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri n’omobekerania ase ekonu ime, omoswageranie amo nobori, oboriri bwaye tibogosira.

english: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .
ekegusii: Manya buya chingencho chi’eching’ondi ne chimbori chiao, na orende riicho ria’o buya.

english: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?
ekegusii: Obonda tibori kogeenderera kobao botambe, na eguutwa y’obogambi teri kogeenderera kobao ekiaare ase ekiaare.

english: The hay appeareth , and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered .
ekegusii: Ekero obonyansi obokoro bwasirire, na oboyia nigo bokomera, na ebimeri bi’ebitunwa biasangererigwa,

english: The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .
ekegusii: ching’ondi nigo chikonachwa amarionya akoroisigwa chianga, ne chimbori chiaoonigwa ase okogora omogondo.

english: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food , for the food of thy household , and for the maintenance for thy maidens .
ekegusii: Erio nonyore amabeere ye chimbori agoisaine aye na abanto b’enka yao, boigo nase abasomba bao abaiseke.

english: A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty ; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both .
ekegusii: Rigena neririto na omokenye nomorito, korende okogechigwa kw’omonto omoriri nigo kore okorito kobua ebinto ebio bibere.

english: Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous ; but who is able to stand before envy ?
ekegusii: Endamwamu nentindi, na ekeririanda nigo kegosiria, korende ning’o oranyaare koremereria ribero?

english: Open rebuke is better than secret love .
ekegusii: Ogotogonyera kwa maiso marore nigo kore okuya kobua obwanchani bobisegete.

english: Faithful are the wounds of a friend ; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful .
ekegusii: Ogoakwa gokorwa ase omosani nigo kore okw’obwegenwa, korende okonyunyunta kw’omobisa nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.

english: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .
ekegusii: Omonto oigotete nigo agochaaya nonya nobooke, korende oyore n’enchara nonya n’endagera ere endoro nigo ekomwansera.

english: As a bird that wandereth from her nest , so is a man that wandereth from his place .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotama korwa bwoye nigo anga buna enyoni ekong’anya korwa ase egeswa kiaye.

english: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel .
ekegusii: Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato nigo bikogokia enkoro, naboigo bore obwororo bw’omosani oyo okorua ogoseemia okuya.

english: The wicked flee when no man pursueth : but the righteous are bold as a lion .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagotama nonya onde tari kobabwatia, korende abanyaboronge nigo bare abaremu buna chindo chinsae.

english: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way , he shall fall himself into his own pit : but the upright shall have good things in possession .
ekegusii: Omonto ogosiria abare ne chinkoro chindonge, na kobaraa ase enchera ende, oyio nagwe ase eirima eria aremire ere omonyene, korende abwo batari na komocha ’mbanyore omwando omuya.

english: The rich man is wise in his own conceit ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are, korende omonto omotaka ore n’okomanya nigo aramotuke amomanye.

english: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge babuire, okoiririata okonge nigo gokobao, korende ekero abakori amabe bakobua, abanto nigo bakwebisa.

english: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .
ekegusii: Omonto okobisa ebibe biaye tagosesenigwa, korende oyo okobiorokia na kobitiga narorerwe amaabera.

english: Happy is the man that feareth alway : but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong’etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.

english: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .
ekegusii: Omogambi omokaayayu okogambera abanto abataka nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, gose edubu yagechiigwe.

english: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .
ekegusii: Omogambi otari n’obong’aini nigo are omochaandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete okonyora ebitooki bitari bi’oboronge, nigo akogeenderera kogamba ase amatuko amaange.

english: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit ; let no man stay him.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oritoereirwe n’okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga y’omonto onde, tiga abe okona‐gotama goika akwe, na onde tagokoonya omonto oyio.

english: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
