ekegusii: Omonto otari na komocha ase chiinchera chiaye natoorigwe; korende oyore omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye nasire ase eyemo y’echio.

english: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye ’nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyokobwatia emeroberio etagwenereti nigo arabe omotaka omoraboku.

english: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .
ekegusii: Ekero ense yasaririe nigo ekoba n’abagaambi abange, korende eye ebwate abanto bare nobong’aini na okomanya, obogambi nigo bokogeenderera gotenena bokong’u.

english: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro endonge ’nanyore ogosesenigwa okonge, korende oyo okoayerera ase okoba omonda takomocha konyora egesusuro.

english: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’agasamunye k’omogati omonto nigo agwesaria ase ogwanchereria. Korende, tari buya gokora ogwanchereria nonya ’ng’ake.

english: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
ekegusii: Omonto omwegimeria nigo akoayerera koba omonda, gose tari korengereria ng’a obotaka ’mbomonyooore.

english: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotogonyera oyo oiranire magega ase okomoorongeyia ’nanyoore ogwancherwa kobua oria okomong’aina namang’ana amansu.

english: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother , and saith , It is no transgression ; the same is the companion of a destroyer .
ekegusii: Omonto okoura ise gose ng’ina enibo yabo, erio oteeba, “Ebi tibiri ebibe,” oyio nigo are omogisangio bw’oyogosiria.

english: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat .
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyosemeretie Omonene ’natenenkigwe.

english: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .
ekegusii: Oyobwesemeretie ere omonyene, oyio nomoriri, korende oyo okobwatia obong’aini natoorigwe.

english: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokoonya abataka takoremerwa, korende oyo ogotuba amaiso aye ng’a tarora abataka ’nanyore okoragererigwa okonge.

english: When the wicked rise , men hide themselves: but when they perish , the righteous increase .
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa, korende ekero basiriigwe, abanyaboronge nigo bakomentekana.

english: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore n’okobua ogokorera abataka bande bobe ase okobaurereria, nigo anga buna embura enyinge egosaria chindagera.

english: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them.
ekegusii: Abanto batigire amachiiko nigo bagotogia abakori amabe, korende abarendete amachiiko nigo bakoamererania nabwo.

english: Evil men understand not judgment : but they that seek the LORD understand all things .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibamanyeti ayare amaronge, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene nigo bayamanyete onsi.

english: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka okobwatia oboronge nigo are omuya kobua omonda ore omokorekanu.

english: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son : but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father .
ekegusii: Omwana orendete amachiiko nigo are omong’aini, korende oyore omogisangio bwa baria bobe nigo akorenta obosooku ase ise.

english: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
ekegusii: Omonto okomenta chinibo chiaye ase enchera etari ey’ekeene ase okogania ebitoki, oyio nigo agochisangereria chibe echi’omonto okororera abataka amaabera.

english: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .
ekegusii: Omonto okoonchora ogoto kwaye taigwera amachiiko, nonya n’ogosaba kwaye nigo kore okogechia.

english: He , that being often reproved hardeneth his neck , shall suddenly be destroyed , and that without remedy .
ekegusii: Omonto okona gokurerwa botambe ase okorongeigwa, korende okong’ia ebigoti, oyio nasirigwe mobosokano, tagokonywa.

english: The bloodthirsty hate the upright : but the just seek his soul .
ekegusii: Abanto bare nerang’o y’ogoitera amanyinga nigo bakogecha oyo otari na komocha, korende abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo bakomorenda.

english: A fool uttereth all his mind : but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards .
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agosokia endamwamu yaye yonsi, korende oyore omong’aini nigo akoyetanga otoerera.

english: If a ruler hearken to lies , all his servants are wicked .
ekegusii: Omogambi aise gwancha amang’ana y’oborimo, abasomba baye bonsi nigo barabe abakori amabe.

english: The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the LORD lighteneth both their eyes .
ekegusii: Omotaka na omochaandi nigo bamenyete amo; Omonene nere okobaa bonsi babere oborabu bw’amaiso.

english: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor , his throne shall be established for ever .
ekegusii: Omorwoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye ’mbogeenderere gotenena bokong’u.

english: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .
ekegusii: Ekeranya na ogotogonyera ase okorongeyia nigo bikorenta obong’aini, korende omwana ogotigwa okora buna anchete, nigo akorentera ng’ina obosooku.

english: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge ’mbarore okogwa kw’abwo.

english: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest ; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul .
ekegusii: Rongeyia omwana oo omomura, ere nakorentere ogotimoka, nigo araarente omosasoko omonge ase enkoro yao.

english: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he.
ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa kw’amang’ana gotari, abanto tibari gwetanga gokora amabe, korende nasesenirie oyo obwatete amachiiko.

english: A servant will not be corrected by words : for though he understand he will not answer .
ekegusii: Amang’ana oka amasa takorongeyia omosomba, ekiagera n’aba oyamanyete, takoyaigwera.

english: When the righteous are in authority , the people rejoice : but when the wicked beareth rule , the people mourn .
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakogaamba, abanto nigo bakoba n’omogooko, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogaamba, abanto nigo bagochaandeka na kweumia.

english: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words ? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ore omwango ase ogokwana, ogosemeria ’nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.

english: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotuga omosomba oye na omoa ebinto bionsi aganetie korwa obwana bwaye, omosomba oyio nabo araire omwando oye.

english: An angry man stirreth up strife , and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .
ekegusii: Omonto obwate endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, na oyo okogechigwa nigo akorenta ogosaria okonge.

english: A man’s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’omonto nigo bokomokeeyia, korende oyore n’Omoika bw’oboitongo nigo akonyoora ogosikwa okonene.

english: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omogisangio bw’omoibi nigo ageechete obogima bwaye obonyene; nigo akoigwa ogotianerwa gw’okoragereria, korende okira takoorokia gento.

english: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe .
ekegusii: Okobairoka Mwanyabaanto nigo gokoba omotego, korende omonto omosemeretie Omonene nigo arendire buya.

english: Many seek the ruler’s favour ; but every man’s judgment cometh from the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwancherwa gokorwa ase omogambi, korende kera omonto nigo akonyora oboronge korwa ase Omonene.

english: An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .
ekegusii: Omonto otari omooronge nigo are okogechia ase oyore omooronge, na oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo are okogechia ase omokori amabe.

english: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete obong’aini nigo akomogokia ise, korende oyogotaara amo nabakungu abatayayi nigo agosiria chinibo chiaye.

english: The king by judgment establisheth the land : but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
ekegusii: Omorwoti ogokora ay’oboronge nigo akogera ense yaye yageenderera gotenena bokong’u, korende oyo okorigia amaaki nigo akoyeiyeria.

english: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet .
ekegusii: Omonto okong’aina omonto onde namang’ana amansu, oyio nigo agwetegera omotego ase amagoro aye.

english: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
ekegusii: Omonto omonyabibe nigo agotegwa nobosareku bwaye, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agoteera n’omogooko na gochenga.

english: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agwechaandera oboronge bw’abataka, korende omokori amabe tamanyeti kende.

english: Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .
ekegusii: Abanyacheche nigo bakoburukania omochie, korende abanto abang’aini nigo bagokendia ekeririanda.

english: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omong’aini akoamererania nomoriri, oria omoriri nigo akogechigwa na goseka, tari gokira-kiri.

english: My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee;
ekegusii: Omwana one, ancha amang’ana ane, ogache amachiiko ane ase enkoro yao,

english: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul ;
ekegusii: na obong’aini ’mbosoe ase enkoro yao, ne chiseemi nigo chiragokie omoyo oo.

english: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
ekegusii: Emeroberio y’ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya ’ngokorende boigo.

english: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things ;
ekegusii: Obong’aini ’mbokorusie korwa ase chiinchera chi’obobe na korwa ase abanto bagokwana amang’ana y’obosiru.

english: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness ;
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chiinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chiinchera chi’omosunte.

english: Who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the frowardness of the wicked ;
ekegusii: Nigo bakogookera ase ogokora amabe, naende bagookera chingencho chi’oborubanu + 2:14 Oborubanu: engencho yaye nobokorekanu .

english: Whose ways are crooked , and they froward in their paths :
ekegusii: Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chiinchera chire borogochi.

english: To deliver thee from the strange woman , even from the stranger which flattereth with her words ;
ekegusii: Obong’aini obwo ’mbogokonye kwebachera omokungu onde bwensi omotayayi, oyio ogokwana amang’ana ogweansia korwa ase omonwa oye,

english: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth , and forgetteth the covenant of her God .
ekegusii: oyio otigire omwanchi bw’oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.

english: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
ekegusii: Ere amo nab’enyomba yaye nigo bagotirimboka gochia ase amakweri, ne chiinchera chiaye nigo chikobaraa gochia aase abakuure.

english: None that go unto her return again , neither take they hold of the paths of life .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogochiera omokungu oyio tari koirana naende, takoiranera chiinchera chi’obogima.

english: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom , and apply thine heart to understanding ;
ekegusii: erinde oigwe obong’aini, naende orue enkoro yao ebe nokomanya.

english: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men , and keep the paths of the righteous .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwatie enchera y’abanto abaya, na otaare ase oboeto bw’abanyaboronge.

english: For the upright shall dwell in the land , and the perfect shall remain in it.
ekegusii: Ekiagera abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase ense, na abaikeranu ’mbageenderere komenya aroro.

english: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth , and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe ’mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria ’mbasirigwe kegima.

english: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding ;
ekegusii: Obe gokorangeria korigia chiseemi, naende osorore onyore okomanya.

english: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures ;
ekegusii: Origie obong’aini buna okorigia chifeta, oboriga‐rigie buna okoriga‐rigia chinibo chibisire.

english: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD , and find the knowledge of God .
ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, rirorio nomanye komoiroka Omonene, naende nigo oranyaare komomanya Nyasae.

english: For the LORD giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .
ekegusii: Omonene nere okoa abanto obong’aini; chiseemi na okomanya nigo bikorwa ase omonwa oye.

english: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous : he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly .
ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chindonge Omonene nigo abagacherete obong’aini oboikeranu. Ere nigo are enguba ase abanto abwo bagotaara ase oboronge.

english: He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .
ekegusii: Nigo arendete chiinchera chi’abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chiinchera chi’abamoirogete.

english: Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity ; yea , every good path .
ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayaare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chiinchera chionsi chire chingiya,

english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana y’Aguri, mosinto o Yake o Masa. Omonto oyio agateebia Itieli na Ukali:

english: Accuse not a servant unto his master , lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogenka omosomba ase omonene oye, nigo arakoragererie, erinde obe nokomocha.

english: There is a generation that curseth their father , and doth not bless their mother .
ekegusii: Ekegori ’nkere gekoragereria abaise na tikeri gosesenia abaang’ina.

english: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes , and yet is not washed from their filthiness .
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare bakwerora ng’a nabaikeranu bare, korende tibachenegeti korwa ase obobe bwabo.

english: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare bagwekaga ng’a nabaya bare na korigereria namaiso aichire nobomwenu.

english: There is a generation , whose teeth are as swords , and their jaw teeth as knives , to devour the poor from off the earth , and the needy from among men .
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi’amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.

english: The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not, It is enough :
ekegusii: Rikorominyo ’ndibwate abaiseke babere; barabwo nigo bakorangeria, “Toe, toe!” Mbire ebinto bitato bitari goisaneka; ee, mbire bine bitari goteeba ng’a biaisanekire, nabio ebi;

english: The grave ; and the barren womb ; the earth that is not filled with water ; and the fire that saith not, It is enough .
ekegusii: aase abakuure, na enda engomba, ne riroba rirang’ete amaache, na omorero. Ebio tibiana goteeba, “Twaisanekire.”

english: The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it.
ekegusii: Eriso ri’omonto ogochecheria ise na gochaaya ng’ina ndirusigwe nebigonkoru bie rigoko na ririegwe namage ye chinsoti.

english: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
ekegusii: Ebinto mbire bitato bire bi’ogokumia ase ’nde; ee, mbire bine ebio ’ntamanyeti, nabio ebi:

english: The way of an eagle in the air ; the way of a serpent upon a rock ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea ; and the way of a man with a maid .
ekegusii: enchera y’ekeongo igoro, na ey’eng’iti igoro ase egetare, na ey’emeeri igoro ase amaache y’enyancha, na enchera omosacha akobua omoiseke.

english: Surely I am more brutish than any man , and have not the understanding of a man .
ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa Mwanyabaanto.

english: Such is the way of an adulterous woman ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
ekegusii: Eyio nenchera y’omokuungu omotomani: Nigo akoria na otinyia omonwa oye, erio oteeba, “Inche tindakora bonyaka bonde.”

english: For three things the earth is disquieted , and for four which it cannot bear :
ekegusii: Nare amang’ana atato akonyegeria ense, ee, nare ane etanyaare koyaremereria, naro aya:

english: For a servant when he reigneth ; and a fool when he is filled with meat ;
ekegusii: Ekero omosomba akoba omorwoti, na omonto omoriri akoigota endagera,

english: For an odious woman when she is married ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .
ekegusii: na ekero omoiseke otanchiri akonyuomwa, na omoiseke omosomba akoira ribaga ri’omokuungu oria agokorera emeremo.

english: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bine ebisinini mono ase ense, korende bire n’obong’aini obonge, nabio ebi:

english: The ants are a people not strong , yet they prepare their meat in the summer ;
ekegusii: Amage nigo are ebitongwa bitari ne chinguru, korende nigo akogaacha endagera yabo agocha koria engaki y’egurugura.

english: The conies are but a feeble folk , yet make they their houses in the rocks ;
ekegusii: Ebisengi tibibwati chinguru, korende nigo bikoroisia ase bikomenya ase ebitare ime.

english: The locusts have no king , yet go they forth all of them by bands ;
ekegusii: Chingige tichibwati omorwoti, korende nigo chikogeendera amo emegaanda ase emegaanda.

english: The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings’ palaces .
ekegusii: Ensagara nabo erabogorigwe nokoboko kw’omonto, korende nabo ekomenya ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.

english: There be three things which go well , yea, four are comely in going :
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitato bikogokia ase ogotaara kwabo, ee, mbire bine bire nogotaara okuya, nabio ebi.

english: I neither learned wisdom , nor have the knowledge of the holy .
ekegusii: Inche tineorokereretie obong’aini, erinde imomanye oyore Omochenu.

english: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any;
ekegusii: Endo ere ne chinguru chinyinge kobua ching’iti chinde, na teri kwoboigwa na ng’iti ende,

english: A greyhound ; an he goat also ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .
ekegusii: na etuoni egwesigoria, na egoree, na omorwoti okoraa abarwani baye b’esegi.

english: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
ekegusii: Onye kwabeire omoriri na kweimokereirie igoro, gose onye kwabeire gokorengereria amabe, beeka okoboko kwao ase omonwa oo, oyotube.

english: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .
ekegusii: Amabeere agotundwa nigo akorua amaguta, na okomintontoria emioro, amanyinga nigo akoruerao. Naboigo ogoseegeta na koba nendamwamu, ayio nigo akorenta okorwana.

english: Who hath ascended up into heaven , or descended ? who hath gathered the wind in his fists ? who hath bound the waters in a garment ? who hath established all the ends of the earth ? what is his name , and what is his son’s name , if thou canst tell ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oriinete gochia igoro na goika gocha aa inse? Ning’o osangereirie omwaga ase enkundi yaye? Ning’o obwatire amaache na koyaboa ase eanga yaye? Ning’o okong’etie chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense? Inaki oyio akorokwa, na omwana oye naki akorokwa? Nteebia onye koyamanyete!

english: Every word of God is pure : he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
ekegusii: Kera ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rienekirie ng’a neri’ekeene. Ere nenguba ase abwo bakomotamera, barendwe.

english: Add thou not unto his words , lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar .
ekegusii: Tobaisa komenta kende ase amang’ana aye, nigo arabaise kogotogonyera, naye obe omonyaborimo. Emebayeno ende

english: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die :
ekegusii: Amang’ana abere naro nagosabire, toyandina ntarakwa.

english: Remove far from me vanity and lies : give me neither poverty nor riches ; feed me with food convenient for me:
ekegusii: Orusie korwa ase ’nde ayare abosa na oborimo. Tobaisa kong’a obotaka gose obotenenku, korende ong’e endagera engwenerete.

english: Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the LORD ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
ekegusii: Oise konyigotia mono, nigo ’ndakwange ’nteebe, “Omonene nere ng’o?” Gose inse koba omotaka nigo ’ndabaisa koiba na ’ndetere erieta ria Nyasae one obosooku.

english: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Lemweli omorwoti orokereretigwe na ng’ina.

english: Who can find a virtuous woman ? for her price is far above rubies .
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare konyora omokungu omuya? Omokungu omuya nigo are n’engeencho enene kobua amagena ye rigori rinene.

english: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil .
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omosaacha oye nigo emwegenete, gose omosacha oyio takoremerwa konyora ebitoki.

english: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life .
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi omokungu oyio nigo agokorera omosacha oye amaya, gose tari korenta amabe ase are.

english: She seeketh wool , and flax , and worketh willingly with her hands .
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akorigia amarionya e ching’ondi ne chiusi chi’egatani, okora emeremo namaboko aye ore n’omoyo omuya.

english: She is like the merchants’ ships ; she bringeth her food from afar .
ekegusii: Nigo anga chimeeri chi’abaonchoreria; nigo akorenta endagera korwa ase ense y’aare.

english: She riseth also while it is yet night , and giveth meat to her household , and a portion to her maidens .
ekegusii: Nigo akoboka kobore botuko, oroiseria abanto b’enyomba yaye endagera, na oa abasomba baye abaiseke eyebatungetie.

english: She considereth a field , and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .
ekegusii: Nigo akorigia omogondo oyogora, na korwa ase ebitoki bi’emeremo y’amaboko aye nigo agosimeka emesabibu.

english: She girdeth her loins with strength , and strengtheneth her arms .
ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru buna orokini, okora emeremo emekong’u n’amaboko aye.

english: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good : her candle goeth not out by night .
ekegusii: Nigo akorora ng’a emeremo yaye nigo ekorenta ebitoki, na etaaya yaye teri korima nyomba mwaye botuko.

english: She layeth her hands to the spindle , and her hands hold the distaff .
ekegusii: Nigo abwate egekorero akoroiseria chiusi namaboko aye na egete agochiranderera nebiara biaye.

english: What, my son ? and what, the son of my womb ? and what, the son of my vows ?
ekegusii: Inaki aye omwana o’ne? Inaki aye omwana bw’enda y’ane? Ninki ndagoteebie, aye omwana bw’eira y’ane nariete?

english: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor ; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .
ekegusii: Nigo akorambora okoboko kwaye okonya abataka, ee, nabaremeire nigo akobaramborera amaboko aye.

english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household : for all her household are clothed with scarlet .
ekegusii: Ere tari kwoboa chingaki chi’obokendu, ekiagera abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye nigo babwate chianga chie riberera chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi chimonyinga.

english: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry ; her clothing is silk and purple .
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akweroiseria ebirarero; chianga chiaye nigo chiroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya ne chiusi chimbariri.

english: Her husband is known in the gates , when he sitteth among the elders of the land .
ekegusii: Omosacha bw’omokuungu oyio nigo amanyekanete ase ebiita bi’omochie, agwo ase agoikaransa ogaamba ebiina amo nabagaaka b’ense eyio.

english: She maketh fine linen , and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akoroisia chianga chi’egatani engiya, ochioonia; naende nigo akoroisia chinkini, ochiooneria abaonchoreria bande.

english: Strength and honour are her clothing ; and she shall rejoice in time to come .
ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru na amasikani, na igo nabe nomogooko ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.

english: She openeth her mouth with wisdom ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
ekegusii: Amorokererio akorua ase omonwa oye nigo are ay’obong’aini n’obuya, amo n’obwororo nigo bore ase oromeme rw’aye.

english: She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .
ekegusii: Nigo akoroberia buya amang’ana y’enyomba yaye, gose tari koria endagera atari gokorera emeremo.

english: Her children arise up , and call her blessed ; her husband also , and he praiseth her.
ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoboka bamoroka “Oyosesenirie”, naboigo n’omosaacha oye nigo akomotogia, oteeba.

english: Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all.
ekegusii: “Abakungu abange bakorire ayare amaya mono, korende aye kwababuire bonsi.”

english: Give not thy strength unto women , nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gochwara chinguru chiao ase abakungu, gose chiinchera chiao ase bare, ekiagera nigo bagosiria abarwoti.

english: Favour is deceitful , and beauty is vain : but a woman that feareth the LORD , she shall be praised .
ekegusii: Obonyakieni nigo bokong’ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.

english: Give her of the fruit of her hands ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .
ekegusii: Kae omokungu oyio okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko aye, na tiga atogigwe agwo ase ebiita ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

english: It is not for kings , O Lemuel , it is not for kings to drink wine ; nor for princes strong drink :
ekegusii: Aye Lemweli, okonywa edivai tikogwenereti abarwoti, gose abagaambi tibaabaisa kogania ebinyugwa bigotindia.

english: Lest they drink , and forget the law , and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted .
ekegusii: Baise konywa, nigo barebe amachiiko, na baonchorane oboronge bwa abachaandegete bonsi.

english: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish , and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts .
ekegusii: Moe ekenyugwa kegotindia oyo ogochia gosira, na edivai ase oyio oichanete ase omoyo oye.

english: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more.
ekegusii: Tiga banywe, erinde beebe tibaabaisa kona‐koinyora emechando yabo n’obotaka bwabo.

english: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachaandegete.

english: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, ogambe ebiina bi’ekeene, orwanerere oboronge bw’abataka na obaremeire. Omokungu omuya

english: My son , forget not my law ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :
ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kweba amorokererio ane, korende tiga enkoro yao ebwate amachiiko ane.

english: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .
ekegusii: Erio ebiage biao mbiichore n’endagera enyinge na ebimitero biao biichore n’edivai engiya.

english: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .
ekegusii: Nare n’omogooko omonto oyio onyorire obong’aini naende ore n’okomanya.

english: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver , and the gain thereof than fine gold .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate ebitoki ebinge kobua ebie chifeta na ebie chitaabu.

english: She is more precious than rubies : and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
ekegusii: Nigo bore n’engeencho enene kobua amagena akomeka‐meka ye rigori rinene, gose tokoboreng’ania na kende gionsi oganetie.

english: Length of days is in her right hand ; and in her left hand riches and honour .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate obogima bw’amatuko amaange ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee nigo bobwate obonda obonge amo n’ogosikwa.

english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .
ekegusii: Chinchera chiaye nigo chire echi’omogooko, na oboeto bwaye bwonsi nigo bore obw’omorembe.

english: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
ekegusii: Nigo bore omote bw’obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong’u nasesenirie.

english: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abeegete oboroso bw’ense n’obong’aini bwaye, na agakong’ia igoro nokomanya kwaye.

english: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee.
ekegusii: Ayio nagere omenye amatuko amaange, na emiaka emenge, naende ogeendererete koba nomorembe.

english: By his knowledge the depths are broken up , and the clouds drop down the dew .
ekegusii: Ase obong’aini bwaye chindiba nigo chikobochoria, na amare atonyia riime.

english: My son , let not them depart from thine eyes : keep sound wisdom and discretion :
ekegusii: Omwana one, bwata bokong’u obong’aini obuya na okomanya; tobaisa gotiga ebio birue ase obosio bwao.

english: So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .
ekegusii: Igo ebio mbibe obogima ase omoyo oo, na ogwechabera okuya ase rigoti ria’o.

english: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
ekegusii: Erio notaare ase enchera yao kore n’oborendi obuya, gose tokogoochwa okogoro kwao.

english: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea, thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .
ekegusii: Ekero ogochia korara, toba n’obwoba, koraire nonyore chitoro chingiya.

english: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kwoboa okogosa kogocha mobosokano, gose ogosirigwa kw’abanyabibe kogocha buna omoubera.

english: For the LORD shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .
ekegusii: Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase omotego.

english: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .
ekegusii: Tobaisa korina abaremerwa amaya ayabagwenerete konyora, onye ayio are ase okobua kwao kobakoonya.

english: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give ; when thou hast it by thee.
ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komoteebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”

english: Devise not evil against thy neighbour , seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora emeroberio gokorera omonto omino bobe; oyio omenyete amo naye, ogosemeretie ng’a anyore oborendi obuya.

english: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck ; write them upon the table of thine heart :
ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue ase ore; obisibe ase rigoti ria’o, na obiriike ase enkoro yao.

english: Strive not with a man without cause , if he have done thee no harm .
ekegusii: Tobaisa koamererania na monto onde engencho ende etaiyo, onye taragokorera bobe bonde.

english: Envy thou not the oppressor , and choose none of his ways .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanera amang’ana yomonto otari gokora ay’oboronge, gose tobaisa kwega chiinchera chiaye,

english: For the froward is abomination to the LORD : but his secret is with the righteous .
ekegusii: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked : but he blesseth the habitation of the just .
ekegusii: Okoragereria kw’Omonene nigo kore ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe, korende nigo agosesenia chinka chi’abanyene oboronge.

english: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini ’mbanyore omwando bw’obonene, korende abariri ’mbabogorie obosooku.

english: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene n’enkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.

english: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths .
ekegusii: Orengererie Omonene, omoorokie ase chiinchera chiao chionsi, nere narongeyie oboeto bwao.

english: It shall be health to thy navel , and marrow to thy bones .
ekegusii: Korakore igo, ayio nagwenie omobere oo abeeke emeseto y’amauga ao chinguru.

english: Honour the LORD with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :
ekegusii: Osike Omonene ne chinibo chiao chionsi na ogotongora kwao gwonsi kw’endagera.

english: Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, igwa amorokererio ane inche iso; tegerera mono, erinde monyaare koba n’okomanya.

english: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa amang’ana ane, oyaanche, igo nario emiaka y’obogima bwao er’abe emenge.

english: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom ; I have led thee in right paths .
ekegusii: Inche nakworokereirie enchera y’obong’aini; nakoraaire ase oboeto bore oboronge.

english: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
ekegusii: Ekero oraabe kogotaara, togotererigwa, na ekero oraabe gokominyoka, tokogoochwa.

english: Take fast hold of instruction ; let her not go : keep her; for she is thy life .
ekegusii: Bwata amorokererio bokong’u, toyatiga arue ase ore; yarende, ekiagera n’aro obogima bwao.

english: Enter not into the path of the wicked , and go not in the way of evil men .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y’abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chiinchera chi’abaanto ababe.

english: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away .
ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase enchera eyio, toyebwatia, korende ogobere oetere ensemo, ogeende bosio.

english: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari korara goika barore ng’a bakorire amabe. Onye tibarakorera omonto amabe, tibari korara chitoro.

english: For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .
ekegusii: Endagera yabo bakoria n’ogokora amabe, na edivai yabo bakonywa n’obotindi.

english: But the path of the just is as the shining light , that shineth more and more unto the perfect day .
ekegusii: Korende enchera y’abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogeenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.

english: The way of the wicked is as darkness : they know not at what they stumble .
ekegusii: Enchera y’abakori amabe nigo enga buna omosunte ekerima; tibari komanya ebinto bikobagocha.

english: For I give you good doctrine , forsake ye not my law .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkobaa amorokererio amaya; timotiga aya nabachiikeire.

english: My son , attend to my words ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .
ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ane! Igwera amang’ana ’nkogoteebia.

english: Let them not depart from thine eyes ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tabaisa korua ase amaiso ao. Yagache ime ase enkoro yao.

english: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.

english: Keep thy heart with all diligence ; for out of it are the issues of life .
ekegusii: Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.

english: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee.
ekegusii: Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana y’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.

english: Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie gochia bosio, na ebioge bi’amaiso ao biramokigwe boronge.

english: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left : remove thy foot from evil .
ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.

english: For I was my father’s son , tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, narenge na tata; nigo narenge omwororo nanchire na baba, ekiagera nigo narenge omomoima.

english: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .
ekegusii: Tata akanyorokereria, aganteebia, “Tiga amang’ana ane abeere ase enkoro yao ime; orende amachiiko ane, erio nario or’abe moyo.”

english: Get wisdom , get understanding : forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth .
ekegusii: Enyorere obong’aini na okomanya, tobaisa kobieba! Tibwanga koigwera amang’ana ’ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one.

english: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga obong’aini, ekiagera borobwo ’mbokorende. Obwanche, na borobwo ’mbogere ogeenderere koba buya.

english: Wisdom is the principal thing ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obw’engeencho enene. Ase ayio, enyorere obong’aini, na kende gionsi okorigia, rigia obe n’okomanya.

english: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour , when thou dost embrace her.
ekegusii: Obobare koba n’engeencho enene, na borobwo ’mbogokinie; koraboboanie nigo borakorentere ogosikwa.

english: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
ekegusii: Mbobeke ase omotwe oo ekiore gechabeire, naende bokoe eguutwa y’obonene.

english: My son , attend unto my wisdom , and bow thine ear to my understanding :
ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe obong’aini bwane! Igwera okomanya kw’ane!

english: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth ; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger ;
ekegusii: Naende abanto abaao nigo baraire chinibo chiao chionsi, na bionsi ebi gwakoreire emeremo biirwe nabaanto abwo.

english: And thou mourn at the last , when thy flesh and thy body are consumed ,
ekegusii: Omoerio oye norere, obokie amagombo ekero chinyama chi’omobere oo chiaerire,

english: And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof ;
ekegusii: ’noteebe, “Inaki nakorete ’nkageecha ogokuurerwa, na enkoro y’ane egachaaya okorongeigwa!

english: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
ekegusii: Tinaigwerete amorokererio yaborokia bane, gose tinategererete koigwera abarenge konyorokereria.

english: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly .
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete ang’e gosira ase obosooku kegima bosio bw’omogaanda ondigereretie.”

english: Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .
ekegusii: Kanywe amaache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.

english: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad , and rivers of waters in the streets .
ekegusii: Inee! Chinsooko chiao ’nchigwenerete gwesiarera gochia aare, ne chindooche chiao chi’amaache ase chiinchera?

english: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
ekegusii: Tiga chinsoko echio chibe echiao aye bweka na tari echi’abaanto abaao.

english: Let thy fountain be blessed : and rejoice with the wife of thy youth .
ekegusii: Tiga ensoko yao esesenigwe, naye ogookere omokungu bw’oboke bwao,

english: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times ; and be thou ravished always with her love .
ekegusii: oyore buna ensune eyanchire na buna engabi ensiani. Tiga obosiani bwaye bokong’use, na ogokigwe nere chingaki chionsi. Obwanchani bwaye tiga bokogokie kogeenderera.

english: That thou mayest regard discretion , and that thy lips may keep knowledge .
ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye korenda ebirengererio biao, na ebikoba biao birende chiseemi.

english: And why wilt thou, my son , be ravished with a strange woman , and embrace the bosom of a stranger ?
ekegusii: Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokuungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?

english: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD , and he pondereth all his goings .
ekegusii: Chinchera chi’omonto nigo chirorekanete maiso marore ase Omonene, n’Omonene nigo arigereretie ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

english: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins .
ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.

english: He shall die without instruction ; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokuurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene ’nasire.

english: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omokuungu omonyaka nigo bigotonyia ayaare amansu buna obooke, na omonwa oye nigo ore omoterere kobua amaguta akweakwa.

english: But her end is bitter as wormwood , sharp as a twoedged sword .
ekegusii: Korende omoerio bw’omokuungu oyio nigo ore omoororo buna ekemeri ekeroro, na omwoge buna omoyio o birende otieririe chinsemo chionsi ibere.

english: Her feet go down to death ; her steps take hold on hell .
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo akoraa gochia ase amakweri, na ogotacha kwaye kwaraa gochia aase abakuure.

english: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life , her ways are moveable , that thou canst not know them .
ekegusii: Ere tari gotaara enchera ekogeenda ase obogima; orogendo rw’aye nigo rokona‐koonchaonchoka, ere tamanyeti ayio.

english: Hear me now therefore, O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere; timobaisa gotiga amang’ana ane.

english: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house :
ekegusii: Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.

english: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :
ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa n’abanto batari n’amaabera.

english: My son , if thou be surety for thy friend , if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger ,
ekegusii: Omwana one, ande kweruure koba intenenera ase omonto omino, na kwarire eira ase omonto omoao na kobwatana nere amaboko.

english: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth , and thy want as an armed man .
ekegusii: obotaka ’mbogoochere buna omouri agoocha, na oboremerwa booche buna omonto obwate ebirwanero agocha.

english: A naughty person , a wicked man , walketh with a froward mouth .
ekegusii: Omonto otagwenereti kende ore omokori amabe nigo agoeta‐eta, ogokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye.

english: He winketh with his eyes , he speaketh with his feet , he teacheth with his fingers ;
ekegusii: Nigo agosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosumera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio n’amaboko aye.

english: Frowardness is in his heart , he deviseth mischief continually ; he soweth discord .
ekegusii: Ogoitania abanto nigo goichire ase enkoro yaye, botambe nigo akoroberia korenta amabe; nigo agosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogotaigwana.

english: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly ; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy .
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio emechando nemoochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobasokano atanyaare gotoorigwa.

english: These six things doth the LORD hate : yea, seven are an abomination unto him :
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitano nakemo Omonene ageechete, ee, mbire bitan’abibere bire okogeecha ase are, nabio ebi:

english: A proud look , a lying tongue , and hands that shed innocent blood ,
ekegusii: Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;

english: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations , feet that be swift in running to mischief ,
ekegusii: enkoro ekoroberia amabe, na amagoro akominyoka gochia gokora amabe;

english: A false witness that speaketh lies , and he that soweth discord among brethren .
ekegusii: kirori bw’oborimo, ogokwana oborimo, na omonto ogosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogoitania ase egati y’abanto abamo. Ogokuurerwa gw’okwanga obonyaka

english: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth , thou art taken with the words of thy mouth .
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana gwakwanete korwa ase omonwa oo akobwatire buna omotego.

english: My son , keep thy father’s commandment , and forsake not the law of thy mother :
ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera aya inche iso ’nkogochika, na totiga amorokererio a nyoko.

english: Bind them continually upon thine heart , and tie them about thy neck .
ekegusii: Yasibe, ageenderere kobeera ase enkoro yao botambe, naende oyasibe ase rigoti ria’o.

english: When thou goest , it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest , it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest , it shall talk with thee.
ekegusii: Ekero or’abe kogotaara, aro nakoraae; ekero or’abe koraire, ’nakorende, na ekero or’abe gokoboka, ayio nakwane naye.

english: For the commandment is a lamp ; and the law is light ; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life :
ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are etaya, na amorokererio nigo are oborabu; ogokuurera gw’okorongeigwa nigo kore enchera y’obogima.

english: To keep thee from the evil woman , from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman .
ekegusii: Nigo korakorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka, na korwa ase amang’ana y’oromeme rw’aye oroterere rokoebereria.

english: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart ; neither let her take thee with her eyelids .
ekegusii: Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y’ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong’usa.

english: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread : and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omokuungu omotayayi omonto nigo akoremerwa oborwa nonya negesamunye ki’omogati, na omokungu bw’omonto omoao nigo akorigia obogima bw’omonto obosaria.

english: Can a man take fire in his bosom , and his clothes not be burned ?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nabogorie omorero ayobeeke ase egekuba kiaye, ne chianga chiaye tichiyia?

english: Can one go upon hot coals , and his feet not be burned ?
ekegusii: Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?

english: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife ; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent .
ekegusii: Naboigo er’abe ase omonto ogotomana n’omokungu bw’omonto onde; onde bwensi okoba nomokuungu oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.

english: Do this now , my son , and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend ; go , humble thyself, and make sure thy friend .
ekegusii: Ase ayio omwana one, bono nigo ore inse y’okobua kw’omonto oyio, na onye korigetie gwetooria korwa ase are okore iga: Kabe omoitongo, ogende ase are omosorore, erinde agosibore korwa ase eira eyio.

english: Men do not despise a thief , if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry ;
ekegusii: Abanto tibari gochaaya omoibi onye ore koiba endagera ekiagera are n’enchara.

english: But if he be found , he shall restore sevenfold ; he shall give all the substance of his house .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omoibi oria kanyorirwe, goika airanie ara gatano na kabere; nigo araakane ebinto bionsi abwate nyomba mwaye.

english: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding : he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul .
ekegusii: Omonto ogotomana nomokuungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chiseemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.

english: A wound and dishonour shall he get ; and his reproach shall not be wiped away .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arabe n’amaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi. Obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boere.

english: For jealousy is the rage of a man : therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance .
ekegusii: Risemi nigo rigokora omosacha oba nekeririanda, na takoba n’amaabera ekero akorusia egesiomba.

english: He will not regard any ransom ; neither will he rest content , though thou givest many gifts .
ekegusii: Ere tagwancha embooria ende yonsi, naegwa ebiegwa ebinge takobiancha.

english: Give not sleep to thine eyes , nor slumber to thine eyelids .
ekegusii: Tobaisa korara gose gosundoka;

english: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter , and as a bird from the hand of the fowler .
ekegusii: minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.

english: Go to the ant , thou sluggard ; consider her ways , and be wise :
ekegusii: Aye ore omworo, geenda ase amage, origererie orore buna agokora emeremo n’omokia onyore obong’aini.

english: Which having no guide , overseer , or ruler ,
ekegusii: Aro tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,

english: Provideth her meat in the summer , and gathereth her food in the harvest .
ekegusii: korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo chingaki chi’egura gura, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.

english: How long wilt thou sleep , O sluggard ? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep ?
ekegusii: Aye omworo, ’ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri orabooke korwa ase chitoro chiao?

english: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee.
ekegusii: Omwana one, renda amang’ana ane, na obeke amachiiko ane abeere ime yao.

english: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
ekegusii: Rora, omokungu agacha akaumerana n’omomura oria. Omokungu oria nigo abeegete chianga chi’obotayayi orenge omong’ainereria ase enkoro yaye.

english: (She is loud and stubborn ; her feet abide not in her house :
ekegusii: Nigo arenge omonyariogi otari kogoma nyomba mwaye.

english: Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner .)
ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chiinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.

english: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaboania omomura oria na komonyunyunta, akomorigereria n’amaiso, atari nobosooku, akomoteebia,

english: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows .
ekegusii: “Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria reero nayeikeranirie.

english: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face , and I have found thee.
ekegusii: Ayio naro agera naacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie n’omokia ng’a ’nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.

english: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .
ekegusii: Naarire oborere bwane nebirarero ebiya, na ebitambaa bimatonto bikorwa Misiri.

english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .
ekegusii: Naboumoreire manemane, na amaguta y’omogaka, na ay’omodalasini botioke buya.

english: Come , let us take our fill of love until the morning : let us solace ourselves with loves .
ekegusii: Inchuo togokanie ase obotuko bwonsi goika mambia; inchwo twegokie n’obwanchani.

english: For the goodman is not at home , he is gone a long journey :
ekegusii: Omosacha one taiyo, ochiire orogendo orotambe.

english: Keep my commandments , and live ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .
ekegusii: Bwata amachiiko ane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio ane buna orendete endorero y’eriiso ria’o.

english: He hath taken a bag of money with him , and will come home at the day appointed .
ekegusii: Nigo aira chitaabu chichire omobuko na nigo arairane omotienyi oikire gochia gati,”

english: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaebereria omomura oria namang’ana amansu ao ao, na ase amang’ana y’ebikoba ebiterere akamobua.

english: He goeth after her straightway , as an ox goeth to the slaughter , or as a fool to the correction of the stocks ;
ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo omomura oria agatunyana omokungu oria buna eng’ombe ekoirwa konyenywa, gose buna omosibwa obwatirwe ogochia kobekwa chingataare.

english: Till a dart strike through his liver ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .
ekegusii: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abeete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.

english: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, ’ntegerera morengererie mono amang’ana ’nkobateebia.

english: Let not thine heart decline to her ways , go not astray in her paths .
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi’omokuungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rw’aye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.

english: For she hath cast down many wounded : yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio oiyeirie abanto abange, ee, oitire omogaanda omonene.

english: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .
ekegusii: Enyomba yaye nero enchera ekogeenda aase abakuure; ee, enchera eyio nigo egosoa ase chiero chi’amakweri.

english: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .
ekegusii: Oyasibe ase ebiara bi’amaboko ao, na oyariike oyabeeke ase enkoro ya’o.

english: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :
ekegusii: Teebia obong’aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,

english: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .
ekegusii: erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana y’okoebereria. Omokungu Omonyaka

english: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement ,
ekegusii: Nigo narigereretie isiko goetera ase ekebao ki’enyomba ya’ne na ebichanga bi’aroro.

english: And beheld among the simple ones , I discerned among the youths , a young man void of understanding ,
ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amaange, ’nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chiseemi.

english: Passing through the street near her corner ; and he went the way to her house ,
ekegusii: Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye

english: In the twilight , in the evening , in the black and dark night :
ekegusii: mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosuunte bw’obotuko.

english: Receive my instruction , and not silver ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .
ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio ane kobua efeta, ne chiseemi kobua etaabu echenire.

english: For wisdom is better than rubies ; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
ekegusii: “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng’anigwa n’ebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.

english: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
ekegusii: Inche obong’aini nakorire okomanya kwabeire obomenyo bwane, nigo inde ne chiseemi, naende nimanyete kogamba buya.

english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ’ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, norogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana y’obong’ainereria.

english: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom : I am understanding ; I have strength .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkorua ogoseemia na obong’aini bw’ekeene; nigo inde nokomanya na okobua.

english: By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .
ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abarwoti nigo bakogaamba, na abagaambi nigo bakobeeka amachiiko y’ekeene.

english: By me princes rule , and nobles , even all the judges of the earth .
ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abagaambi nigo bakorwa oboronge, boigo nabanene na abanachi ebiina bonsi.

english: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
ekegusii: Nigo nyanchete abwo banyanchete; na abwo bakondigia n’omokia ’mbanyore.

english: Riches and honour are with me; yea , durable riches and righteousness .
ekegusii: Ninche ’nkorua obonda, na esiko, boigo obotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.

english: My fruit is better than gold , yea, than fine gold ; and my revenue than choice silver .
ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu engiya, na ebitoki ’nkorua ’mbibuete efeta enchore.

english: She standeth in the top of high places , by the way in the places of the paths .
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotenena aase aimokererete igoro, ang’e n’enchera engendi, nigo bokobeera ase amatabekania ye chiinchera.

english: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ’ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.

english: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance ; and I will fill their treasures .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.

english: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was.
ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.

english: When there were no depths , I was brought forth ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .
ekegusii: Inche nigo naiboretwe chindiba chitarabao, nonya ne chinsoko chi’amaache.

english: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :
ekegusii: Nigo naiboretwe oboroso bw’ebitunwa botarabekwa, na ebigoro bitarabao,

english: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .
ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.

english: When he prepared the heavens , I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :
ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abeekerete amaache chimbebe.

english: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
ekegusii: Ekero abeegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abeegete chinsoko chigosokia amaache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,

english: When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :
ekegusii: na ekero abeekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amaache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abeegete amaroso y’ense nao narenge.

english: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .
ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ebiita bosio bw’omochie ase ebisoero bi’ebiita nigo bogokwana neriogi rinene, bwateeba;

english: Then I was by him , as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight , rejoicing always before him;
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge amo nere buna oyomanyete emeremo eyio buya. Kera rituko nigo arenge kogokigwa nainche, na inche ’nkaba inde nomogooko ase obosio bwaye botambe.

english: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth ; and my delights were with the sons of men .
ekegusii: Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabaanto, na nkaba nsasokerete Mwanyabaanto.

english: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
ekegusii: “Na bono, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere moigwe, mbare n’omogooko abwo barendete chiinchera chiane,

english: Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not.
ekegusii: Igwera amorokererio! Ancha obong’aini, timobwanga!

english: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio okonyigwera; oyio okorenda ase ebiita biane kera rituko, oganyete ase ebisieri biane.

english: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonto onyorire inche, oyio onyorire obogima; naende nancherwe n’Omonene.

english: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .
ekegusii: Korende oyio otari nainche nigo akwenachera ekiina ere omonyene. Bonsi abangechete nigo banchete amakweri.”

english: Unto you, O men , I call ; and my voice is to the sons of man .
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto, ninwe ’nkorangeria; eriogi riane nigo rigochera Mwanyabaanto.

english: O ye simple , understand wisdom : and, ye fools , be ye of an understanding heart .
ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti amaange, egera obong’aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.

english: Hear ; for I will speak of excellent things ; and the opening of my lips shall be right things .
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe, ekiagera nigo ’ndakwane amang’ana amaya mono; amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one nay’oboronge.

english: For my mouth shall speak truth ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ’ngokwana nay’ekeene; amang’ana y’obobe nigo are okogechia ase ebikoba biane.

english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ane onsi ’ngokwana nigo are ay’oboronge, ande tari are ay’oborimo, gose ay’obokorekanu.

english: They are all plain to him that understandeth , and right to them that find knowledge .
ekegusii: Nigo akoigweka buya ase omonto oyio okoyamanya, naende namaronge ase abwo banyorire chiseemi.

english: Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bweagacherete enyomba. Nigo bwebaacherete chisiiro isano na ibere.

english: For by me thy days shall be multiplied , and the years of thy life shall be increased .
ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa kw’ane amatuko ao nabe amaange, na emiaka y’obogima bwao nementwe.

english: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .
ekegusii: Korabe nobong’aini, borobwo ’mbooboseemia; korende korabe omochaayi, obochaayi obwo ’mbokoiranere.

english: A foolish woman is clamorous : she is simple , and knoweth nothing .
ekegusii: Omokungu omoriri nigo are omonyariogi. Ere nigo are bosa, na tamanyeti ring’ana rinde.

english: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
ekegusii: Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,

english: To call passengers who go right on their ways :
ekegusii: aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,

english: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him,
ekegusii: oteeba, “Onde bwensi otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri oteeba,

english: Stolen waters are sweet , and bread eaten in secret is pleasant .
ekegusii: “Amaache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase abobisi nigo ogwansa.”

english: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell .
ekegusii: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokuungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakuure.

english: She hath killed her beasts ; she hath mingled her wine ; she hath also furnished her table .
ekegusii: Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.

english: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,
ekegusii: Bwatomire abasomba baye abaiseke gochia aase aimokererete igoro mono yomochie korangeria abanto, bogoteeba:

english: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him,
ekegusii: “Oyo otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateeba:

english: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .
ekegusii: “Inchuo orie endagera y’ane, na onywe edivai nochoganirie!

english: Forsake the foolish , and live ; and go in the way of understanding .
ekegusii: Tiga oboriri bwao, erinde obe moyo! Obwatie enchera y’okonyora okomanya!”

english: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame : and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot .
ekegusii: Omonto ogokuurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaaywa.

english: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokuurera omonto omochaayi; oyio nigo arakogeche. Kuurera omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragwanche.

english: Give instruction to a wise man , and he will be yet wiser : teach a just man , and he will increase in learning .
ekegusii: Orokereria omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo arageenderere koba omong’aini goetania. Orokereria omonto omooronge, oyio namente koba ne chiseemi.

english: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all ye lands .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!

english: Serve the LORD with gladness : come before his presence with singing .
ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nomogooko, moche ase obosio bwaye na komoterera amatera ’omochengo!

english: Know ye that the LORD he is God : it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people , and the sheep of his pasture .
ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.

english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving , and into his courts with praise : be thankful unto him, and bless his name .
ekegusii: Soa ase ebiita biaye na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, soa ase chigoora chiaye na komotogia! Moakere ng’a mbuya mono, motogie erieta riaye!

english: I will sing of mercy and judgment : unto thee, O LORD , will I sing .
ekegusii: Nintere igoro y’amaabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.

english: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way . O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart .
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie na korenda enchera y’oboronge. Inee! Ndiriri orache ase ’nde? Nigo nganetie imbe norogendo ororonge ase enyomba yane imenyete.

english: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes : I hate the work of them that turn aside ; it shall not cleave to me.
ekegusii: Tinkobeeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abaanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.

english: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person .
ekegusii: Nimbeere aare korwa ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chi’obokorekanu, ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe ribe aare nainche.

english: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour , him will I cut off : him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer .
ekegusii: Ninsirie omonto okona‐gokwana bobe omonto onde bobisi, tinkoremereria omonto omoenenu na omweanchi.

english: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land , that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way , he shall serve me.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane narigereretie abegenwa bare ase ense, abwo mbamenye amo nainche. Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nabe ogonkorera.

english: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house : he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight .
ekegusii: Omonto okwenaria obong’ainereria takomenya ase enyomba yane, oyo ogoteeba oborimo takobeera ase obosio bwane.

english: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land ; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD .
ekegusii: Kera emambia nimbe ngosiria abakori amabe bonsi abare ase ense, nindusie abakori ebibe bonsi korwa ase omochie O’ Omonene.

english: Hear my prayer , O LORD , and let my cry come unto thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.

english: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath : for thou hast lifted me up , and cast me down .
ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nekeririanda na endamwamu ase ’nde. Aye kwambwatire na gwantugutire gochia aare.

english: My days are like a shadow that declineth ; and I am withered like grass .
ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.

english: But thou, O LORD , shalt endure for ever ; and thy remembrance unto all generations .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore omogambi goika kare na kare; erieta riao nigo rigendererete ase ebiaare bionsi.

english: Thou shalt arise , and have mercy upon Zion : for the time to favour her, yea, the set time , is come .
ekegusii: Aye noimokerere igoro ororere Sayoni amaabera; ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okoywancha; ee, engaki eria yachigetwe yaikire.

english: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones , and favour the dust thereof.
ekegusii: Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.

english: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD , and all the kings of the earth thy glory .
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi mbiiroke erieta ri’Omonene, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense mbairoke obonene bwaye.

english: When the LORD shall build up Zion , he shall appear in his glory .
ekegusii: Omonene naagache Sayoni naende, nere orarorekane aroro ore ase obonene bwaye.

english: He will regard the prayer of the destitute , and not despise their prayer .
ekegusii: Nabe okoigwa ogosaba kw’abaanto batigirwe bosa, tagochaaya ogosorora kwabo.

english: This shall be written for the generation to come : and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tiga arikwe agachwe ase engencho y’ekiaare kegochi‐gocha, erinde abanto abwo bataraiborwa, nabarabwo bache gotogia Omonene.

english: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary ; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth ;
ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro aase aye aachenu Omonene nigo arigereretie gocha aa, ee, nigo arigereretie gocha ase ense,

english: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble ; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobisa obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde ase engaki inde nemechando, integerere onyigwe, ong’iranerie bwango ase rituko ngokorangeria.

english: To hear the groaning of the prisoner ; to loose those that are appointed to death ;
ekegusii: erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekiina ki’ogokwa.

english: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion , and his praise in Jerusalem ;
ekegusii: Erio abanto banyare koraria erieta ri’Omonene ase Sayoni, na ogotogigwa kwaye agwo Yerusalemu,

english: When the people are gathered together , and the kingdoms , to serve the LORD .
ekegusii: ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbasangererekane amo namarwoti ase ogosasiima Omonene.

english: He weakened my strength in the way ; he shortened my days .
ekegusii: Ere okeeirie chinguru chiane konde ase orogendo, bweng’eirie amatuko aane.

english: I said , O my God , take me not away in the midst of my days : thy years are throughout all generations .
ekegusii: Nigo ngoteeba, Aye Nyasae one, takondusia aiga ekero inde ase egati‐gati y’obogima bwane. Omonene, aye nigo oreo kare na kare, ase ebiaare bionsi.

english: They shall perish , but thou shalt endure : yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment ; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed :
ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchisirigwe, korende aye nigo oreo kare na kare, echio chionsi nchigote buna eanga, ekiagera aye nigo ogochionchoreria buna eanga ekoonchorerigwa, ee, nigo chirasirigwe kegima.

english: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end .
ekegusii: Korende aye naye oria oria, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.

english: The children of thy servants shall continue , and their seed shall be established before thee.
ekegusii: Abana b’abasomba bao mbamenye ase oborendi obuya, ne chinderia chiabo chigenderere komenya ase obosio bwao.

english: For my days are consumed like smoke , and my bones are burned as an hearth .
ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango na gosira buna erioki, amauga ’omobere one nigo akoyia buna omorero bw’amakara.

english: My heart is smitten , and withered like grass ; so that I forget to eat my bread .
ekegusii: Enkoro yane yaakirwe yabeire buna obonyansi bwagekirwe na kwoma; nigo nkweba koria endagera yane,

english: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ngendererete korera na kweumia, amauga ’omobere one abwatanire ne chinyama chi’omobere one.

english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness : I am like an owl of the desert .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inga buna etigere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amatuuri.

english: I watch , and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top .
ekegusii: Tindi korara chitoro; nigo inga buna enyoni etigarete yoka kerama igoro.

english: Mine enemies reproach me all the day ; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagonchecheria omobaso boira; abwo bangechete, kobakoragereria nigo bagwatora erieta riane.

english: For I have eaten ashes like bread , and mingled my drink with weeping ,
ekegusii: Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,

english: Bless the LORD , O my soul : and all that is within me, bless his holy name .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, na bionsi ebire ime yane bitogie erieta riaye richenu.

english: He hath not dealt with us after our sins ; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities .
ekegusii: Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.

english: For as the heaven is high above the earth , so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna igoro ere aare mono korwa ase ense, naboigo obwanchani bwaye bore obonene ase abanto bamoirogete.

english: As far as the east is from the west , so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
ekegusii: Naende koreng’ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore biabeera aare.

english: Like as a father pitieth his children , so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namaabera ase bare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namaabera ase abwo bamoirogete.

english: For he knoweth our frame ; he remembereth that we are dust .
ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete buna totongire, nigo akoinyora ng’a nigo tore orotu bosa.

english: As for man , his days are as grass : as a flower of the field , so he flourisheth .
ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;

english: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
ekegusii: ekero omwaga ogocha, okerusiao giasira kegima, aase aye tari komanya ng’a nkiarengeo.

english: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children ;
ekegusii: Korwa kare goika kare na kare obwanchani bw’ Omonene nigo bore ase abwo bamoirogete, na oboronge bwaye nigo borabe ase chinderia chiabo

english: To such as keep his covenant , and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
ekegusii: ase abwo bakobwata okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, naende bakoinyora amachiiko aye na koyaigwera.

english: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens ; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abegete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene aaria igoro, na oborwoti bwaye nigo bokogambera onsi.

english: Bless the LORD , O my soul , and forget not all his benefits :
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, tobaisa kweba obuya bwaye bwonsi agokoreire.

english: Bless the LORD , ye his angels , that excel in strength , that do his commandments , hearkening unto the voice of his word .
ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika b’Omonene, motogie; inwe abamore ne chinguru chinene na mogokora aya agochika ekero mwaigure eriogi rie ring’ana riaye.

english: Bless ye the LORD , all ye his hosts ; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure .
ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe emeganda yaye yonsi, na inwe abasomba baye, aba mogokora ogwancha kwaye!

english: Bless the LORD , all his works in all places of his dominion : bless the LORD , O my soul .
ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe ebitongwa biaye bionsi, motogie aande onsi ase akogamba. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!

english: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities ; who healeth all thy diseases ;
ekegusii: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.

english: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction ; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies ;
ekegusii: Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namaabera.

english: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agoisanekia okogania kwao namaya, erinde otigara koba omosae buna ekeongo kegwekerora.

english: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed .
ekegusii: Omonene nere okorua oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.

english: He made known his ways unto Moses , his acts unto the children of Israel .
ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.

english: He will not always chide : neither will he keep his anger for ever .
ekegusii: Ere tari kona‐gotogonyera ase chingaki chionsi, gose takogenderera kogaacha endamwamu yaye botambe.

english: Bless the LORD , O my soul . O LORD my God , thou art very great ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.

english: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
