ekegusii: Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amaache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.

english: They give drink to every beast of the field : the wild asses quench their thirst .
ekegusii: Chinsoko echio nigo chikoa ching’iti chionsi amaache chianywa, ne chitigere chi’orosana nigo chikoyanywa, na erang’o yasira.

english: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikomenya ang’e na chirochio, nigo chikoba chigotera ekero chigwete ase chinsagia chi’emete.

english: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.

english: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle , and herb for the service of man : that he may bring forth food out of the earth ;
ekegusii: Nigo okomeria obonyansi ching’iti chikorisia, naende kwanyorera abanto ebimeri bagokorera, na igo kwabanyorera chindagera korwa ase riroba.

english: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man , and oil to make his face to shine , and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart .
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogooko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.

english: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon , which he hath planted ;
ekegusii: Emete y’Omonene nigo egoisaneka namaache, ee, emecharake ya Lebanoni, eyi’Omonene asimegete.

english: Where the birds make their nests : as for the stork , the fir trees are her house .
ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikoagacha ebiswa biabo ase emete eyio, amaagonga nigo akoagacha ebiswa biabo aroro ase emetarakwa.

english: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats ; and the rocks for the conies .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebitambe nabio bire obomenyo bwe chimbori chi’orosana, emienya y’ebitare nero obotamero bw’ebisengi.

english: He appointed the moon for seasons : the sun knoweth his going down .
ekegusii: Aye kwabekire omotienyi obeire ekemanyererio gie chingaki, na erioba nigo rimanyete boronge ekero rigwenerete kogwa.

english: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwetubete oborabu buna ogwetuba egetambaa gi’okwambara, kwaramboire igoro buna eema eramboire.

english: Thou makest darkness , and it is night : wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta omosunte bwaba botuko, erio ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana chiachaka gotaara.

english: The young lions roar after their prey , and seek their meat from God .
ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.

english: The sun ariseth , they gather themselves together , and lay them down in their dens .
ekegusii: Ekero erioba rigochia kooroka chiairana, chiagenda korara ase amakuruma abo.

english: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda ase emeremo yabo, bayekora goika mogoroba.

english: O LORD , how manifold are thy works ! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.

english: So is this great and wide sea , wherein are things creeping innumerable , both small and great beasts .
ekegusii: Enyancha nero enene naende engare; nigo eichire nebitongwa bire moyo bitari kobareka, ebike na ebinene.

english: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season .
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.

english: That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .
ekegusii: Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka n’ebinto bire ebiya.

english: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .
ekegusii: Ekero kwabisire obosio bwao, nigo bikoba nobwoba obonene; na ekero okobiura omoika obo, nigo bigokwa, biairana ase amaroba ime.

english: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwarete emiaro y’obomenyo bwao ase amaache, gwakorire amare abeire egari yao, nigo ogoeta kore ase chimbaaba chi’embeo.

english: Thou sendest forth thy spirit , they are created : and thou renewest the face of the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.

english: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever : the LORD shall rejoice in his works .
ekegusii: Tiga obonene bw’Omonene bogenderere kobao kare na kare; Omonene tiga agokere emeremo yaye.

english: He looketh on the earth , and it trembleth : he toucheth the hills , and they smoke .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorigereria ense, nero yatengecha, nigo agokuna ebitunwa, na birobio biasokia erioki.

english: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live : I will sing praise to my God while I have my being .
ekegusii: Ninterere Omonene ase obogima bwane bwonsi, nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia Nyasae one ekero inde moyo.

english: My meditation of him shall be sweet : I will be glad in the LORD .
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene agokigwe nebirengererio ebio biane, ekiagera inche nigo ngogete asare.

english: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth , and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD , O my soul . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanyabibe tiga basirigwe korwa ase ense, abakori amabe tibaabaisa kobao. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, Motogie Omonene!

english: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .
ekegusii: Aye nigo otenenetie ense bokong’u igoro ase amaroso aye, tebaisa konyegerigwa nonya ng’ake.

english: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment : the waters stood above the mountains .
ekegusii: Nigo kwayetubete chindiba buna eanga egotuba, amaache akabeera igoro ase ebitunwa.

english: At thy rebuke they fled ; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
ekegusii: Ekero gwatogonyerete amaache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.

english: They go up by the mountains ; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
ekegusii: Agatiira gochia ebitunwa igoro, na agatirimboka gochia ase amakura inse, agaika aase kwayachikerete.

english: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .
ekegusii: Nigo kwabegete chimbebe aase amaache atanyare goetania, erinde tabaisa gotuba ense yonsi naende.

english: O give thanks unto the LORD ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .
ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.

english: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance :
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe egetari oraire kebe omwando oo.”

english: When they were but a few men in number ; yea, very few , and strangers in it.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abanto abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento; nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.

english: Until the time that his word came : the word of the LORD tried him.
ekegusii: goika ayabaanete agaikerana. Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaenekia ng’a Yusufu nomooronge.

english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works .
ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia, raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia!

english: To bind his princes at his pleasure ; and teach his senators wisdom .
ekegusii: erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b’oborwoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b’oborwoti chisemi.

english: He turned their heart to hate his people , to deal subtilly with his servants .
ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chinkoro chi’Abamisiri, erinde bakagecha abanto baye, erio bagakorera abasomba b’Omonene amabe ay’obong’ainereria.

english: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaorokia ebimanyererio ase egati y’abanto, bagakora ebikone agwo ase ense ya Hamu.

english: He smote their vines also and their fig trees ; and brake the trees of their coasts .
ekegusii: Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y’ense eria ekabunwa.

english: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .
ekegusii: chikaria chigakoora ebimeri bi’ense eria, boigo chikaria okwama kwe riroba riabo.

english: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them.
ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo babete nomogooko ekero Abaisraeli bang’anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.

english: Seek the LORD , and his strength : seek his face evermore .
ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie obosio bwaye botambe.

english: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .
ekegusii: Omonene akainyora eira eria enchenu ariete, boigo akainyora Aburaamu, omosomba oye.

english: And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
ekegusii: Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagoteera nomogooko.

english: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, erinde Abaisraeli baigwere emeroberio yaye echiikire, naende barende amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!

english: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done ; his wonders , and the judgments of his mouth ;
ekegusii: Inyora emeremo yo’gokumia eria akorire, ebikone biaye na ebiina biaye bi’ekeene arure

english: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, omosomba O’ Omonene, ee, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene,

english: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
ekegusii: Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,

english: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .
ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ay’abaabagechete na kobabooria korwa ase chinguru chi’ababisa babo.

english: And the waters covered their enemies : there was not one of them left .
ekegusii: Amaache akamera kegima abachandi baria babo; onde tatigarete ore moyo nonya noyomo.

english: They soon forgat his works ; they waited not for his counsel :
ekegusii: Korende ase obwango bakeba ogokora kwaye, tibaganyete Omonene abasemie.

english: And he gave them their request ; but sent leanness into their soul .
ekegusii: Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.

english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .
ekegusii: riroba rikabwereka rikamera Datani, na rikamumekeria abanto b’ekeombe ki’Abiiramu.

english: And a fire was kindled in their company ; the flame burned up the wicked .
ekegusii: Boigo omorero ogatuboka agwo ase egati y’ekeombe kiabo, ekebemberi ki’omorero kegasamba abakori amabe baria.

english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD ? who can shew forth all his praise ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare goteeba ogokora okonene kw’Omonene, gose koraria obonene bwaye bwonsi?

english: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaonchoreria oyorenge obonene bwabo, bakaonchokera omogwekano bw’eng’ombe ekorisia obonyansi.

english: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt ;
ekegusii: Bakeba Nyasae, Omotooria obo, oria okorete amang’ana amanene aaria Misiri;

english: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .
ekegusii: oria okorete ogokora kw’ogokumia ase ense ya Hamu, naende agakora amang’ana ay’okoondokia aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.

english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarengereria ng’a abasirie, korende Musa, omochore oye, agatenena ase obosio bwaye buna omobwatania, ase ogotanga endamwamu yaye teita abanto.

english: But murmured in their tents , and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ekero barenge ase chiema chiabo ime nigo bemurunganetie, tibaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene.

english: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness :
ekegusii: Ase ayio akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro yaabo, agatiana ng’a abatige bakwere agwo ase erooro,

english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them.
ekegusii: Ase igo ogokora okwo kwabo gokagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu, na oborwaire bogoita bogatuboka ase egati yaabo.

english: Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bagokora oboronge, abwo bagokora oboronge ase chingaki chionsi.

english: Then stood up Phinehas , and executed judgment : and so the plague was stayed .
ekegusii: Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.

english: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.

english: Because they provoked his spirit , so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips .
ekegusii: Nigo bagechetie enkoro ya Musa, goika agakwana amang’ana nobororo, ase ogotarengereria buya.

english: But were mingled among the heathen , and learned their works .
ekegusii: Korende nigo basang’ananete n’abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.

english: And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them.
ekegusii: Nigo bakorerete emegwekano yaabo baare gosasiima, na eyio ekaba amareba + 106:36 Amareba: engencho yaye emetego ase bare.

english: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaaba abegenwa.

english: Remember me, O LORD , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation ;
ekegusii: Omonene, ong’inyore ekero okororera abanto bao amaabera, onchichere, ontoorie!

english: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen ; and they that hated them ruled over them.
ekegusii: Akababeka ase amaboko ya banto b’ebisaku, erinde abanto abwo baabagechete bakaba bakobagambera.

english: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand .
ekegusii: Ababisa babo bakabakorera bobe, bakababua bakababeeka inse yobogambi bwabo.

english: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel , and were brought low for their iniquity .
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge Omonene nigo arenge kobatooria, korende ase ogosemania kwabo bagachora gosaria asare: ase igo bakaba bagochandeka mono ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

english: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo nabechanderete ase emechando yaabo, akaigwa ekerero kiabo.

english: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .
ekegusii: Ase engencho yaabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.

english: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives .
ekegusii: Nigo agerete abwo babosete bakabarorera amaabera.

english: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting : and let all the people say , Amen . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe korwa kare goika kare na kare; na abanto bonsi pi bateebe, “Amina.” Togia Omonene!

english: That I may see the good of thy chosen , that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation , that I may glory with thine inheritance .
ekegusii: Erio inyare korora ebisio abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogooko bw’abaanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo n’abanto bare omwando oo.

english: We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .
ekegusii: Intwe twakorire ebibe buna chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; twakorire ayare amabe mono, ee, twakorire ayare amabe.

english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.

english: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , being bound in affliction and iron ;
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, nigo basibire ase emechando, basibeire chingataare,

english: Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
ekegusii: ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaaya ogoseemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.

english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour ; they fell down , and there was none to help .
ekegusii: Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakoonya.

english: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death , and brake their bands in sunder .
ekegusii: Akabarusia korwa ase omosunte ekerima, akabutora chingataare basibeire.

english: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.

english: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .
ekegusii: Ere nigo abunete ebisiekero bie chitaai + 107:16 chitaai: engencho yaye chichuma , na akabuna emekorogoto y’ebioma ekaba ebing’ese.

english: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
ekegusii: Abande bakariria, ekiagera babwatetie enchera y’ogosareka, na bakaba bagochaandeka ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

english: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
ekegusii: Kera endagera ekaba enguundo ase bare, bakaba ang’e gosoa ase ebiita bi’amakweri.

english: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy ;
ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene abooretie tiga bakwane igo, abwo aboretie korwa ase okoboko kw’omochaandi.

english: He sent his word , and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions .
ekegusii: Akabatomera ring’ana riaye, akabagwenia, akabatooria korwa ase chimbeera.

english: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving , and declare his works with rejoicing .
ekegusii: Tiga barue ebing’wanso bi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende bararie ogokora kwaye ase ogoteera n’omogooko.

english: They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters ;
ekegusii: Abwo bageendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,

english: These see the works of the LORD , and his wonders in the deep .
ekegusii: mbaarooche ogokora kw’Omonene, ee, ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ime ase chindiba.

english: For he commandeth , and raiseth the stormy wind , which lifteth up the waves thereof.
ekegusii: Ere agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu gekaimoka, kerokio gekaimokereria igoro emerindo y’enyancha,

english: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .
ekegusii: Emerindo eyio ekaimokerera igoro, naende ekairana inse, na ase ayio abanto bakerusia moyo ase omoichano.

english: They reel to and fro , and stagger like a drunken man , and are at their wits’ end .
ekegusii: Bakaba bakoong’anya na gotabataba buna abanto batiindire, na obong’aini bwabo bwonsi bokabaerera.

english: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble , and he bringeth them out of their distresses .
ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, nere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.

english: He maketh the storm a calm , so that the waves thereof are still .
ekegusii: Agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.

english: And gathered them out of the lands , from the east , and from the west , from the north , and from the south .
ekegusii: Obasangereirie obarentire korwa ase chinse ao ao, korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi.

english: Then are they glad because they be quiet ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .
ekegusii: Erio bakaba n’omogooko, ekiagera banyorete obotoereru, n’Omonene akabaikia ase ekiambokero keria baganetie.

english: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people , and praise him in the assembly of the elders .
ekegusii: Tiga baabake Omonene agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto, bamotogie nase abagaaka bagoikaransa kogaamba.

english: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground ;
ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsooko chikaba ense enyomo.

english: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
ekegusii: Akaonchora n’ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki’omonyo, ase engencho y’obobe bw’ abanto bamenyeteo.

english: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
ekegusii: Boigo akaonchora erooro ekaba ritibo riichire amaache, na ense enyomo egatuboka chinsooko chi’amaache.

english: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation ;
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare n’enchara; barabwo bakaagaacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.

english: And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobusura emegondo, naende basimeka emesabibu, bakanyora okwama okonene mono.

english: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .
ekegusii: Omonene akabasesenia bagasarara mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.

english: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .
ekegusii: Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y’ogokorerwa bobe na gochaandwa,

english: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way ; they found no city to dwell in.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakona goetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.

english: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
ekegusii: Omonene agachaaya abanene baria babachaandete, bakaba bakoong’anya ase chirooro chitari ne chinchera.

english: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akorusia abaremeire korwa ase emechando, na obuchia chiamate chiabo chiaba buna amaicho.

english: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
ekegusii: Abanyaboronge nigo bakorora amang’ana ayio na bagooka mono; korende abakori amabe nigo bagokira‐kiri baumata.

english: Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omong’aini, tiga aigwe amang’ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe.

english: Hungry and thirsty , their soul fainted in them.
ekegusii: Nigo babete n’enchara amo n’erang’o goika bakerusia moyo.

english: And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .
ekegusii: Akabaraa ase enchera endonge, goika akabaikia ase omochie banyaarete komenya.

english: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore n’erang’o, na oyore n’enchara omoigotia n’ebinto ebiya.

english: O God , my heart is fixed ; I will sing and give praise , even with my glory .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere n’oboremu! Nintere na gochenga! Omoyo one bwonsi, boka!

english: Who will bring me into the strong city ? who will lead me into Edom ?
ekegusii: Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?

english: Wilt not thou , O God , who hast cast us off ? and wilt not thou, O God , go forth with our hosts ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogeenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

english: Give us help from trouble : for vain is the help of man .
ekegusii: Tokoonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokoonywa gokorwa ase Mwanyabaanto mbosa.

english: Through God we shall do valiantly : for he it is that shall tread down our enemies .
ekegusii: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, ’natokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.

english: Awake , psaltery and harp : I myself will awake early .
ekegusii: Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

english: I will praise thee, O LORD , among the people : and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono ase egati y’ abanto, nimbe ’ngotera amatera y’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.

english: For thy mercy is great above the heavens : and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds .
ekegusii: Amaabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro, obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.

english: Be thou exalted , O God , above the heavens : and thy glory above all the earth ;
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

english: That thy beloved may be delivered : save with thy right hand , and answer me.
ekegusii: Intoorie n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya ’nkogosaba.

english: God hath spoken in his holiness ; I will rejoice , I will divide Shechem , and mete out the valley of Succoth .
ekegusii: Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteeba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti ni’nyiate chincherere.

english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head ; Judah is my lawgiver ;
ekegusii: Gileadi neyaane, na Manase neyaane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogaambi.

english: Moab is my washpot ; over Edom will I cast out my shoe ; over Philistia will I triumph .
ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera, nindute egekooroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”

english: Hold not thy peace , O God of my praise ;
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ningotogie, tobaisa gokira‐kiri.

english: Let his children be continually vagabonds , and beg : let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places .
ekegusii: Abana baye babe bakoombogana na kona‐gosaberera, bageende kona‐korigia endagera aare korwa ase amatuuri bamenyete.

english: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour .
ekegusii: Tiga abamoete ebinto singo bache baire ebinto biaye bionsi; abanto abaao bache basakore ebi bakorerete emeremo emekong’u.

english: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children .
ekegusii: Monto onde tabaisa koba omuya asare, gose onde taba n’amaabera ase abana baye bare chintakana.

english: Let his posterity be cut off ; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out .
ekegusii: Tiga ororeeria rwaye rosirigwe, na erieta riaye riebwe kegima ase ekiare gia kabere.

english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD ; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out .
ekegusii: Ebibe bie chisokoro chiaye biinyorwe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ebibe bia ng’ina tibibaisa gotinyigwa.

english: Let them be before the LORD continually , that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth .
ekegusii: Ebibe biabo tiga bigenderere kobeera ase obosio Omonene botambe; na barabwo tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake.

english: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy , but persecuted the poor and needy man , that he might even slay the broken in heart .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio tainyorete koorokia amaabera, korende abataka, na abaremerwa, na abasionoire chinkoro chiabo, nigo abachaandete goika ogokwa kwabo.

english: As he loved cursing , so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing , so let it be far from him.
ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.

english: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment , so let it come into his bowels like water , and like oil into his bones .
ekegusii: Nigo ambarete okoragererigwa buna akwambara egoti yaye; bono tiga konywere ase omobere oye buna amaache akonywera ase omobere, na buna amaguta akweakwa akonywera aika ase amauga aye.

english: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually .
ekegusii: Tiga okoragererigwa okwo kobe buna egetambaa akwambara, naende kobe buna orokini akweboeria botambe.

english: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe abare abang’ainereria nigo bagokwana igoro yane, ee, nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.

english: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD , and of them that speak evil against my soul .
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abaakane igo abwo bagonsoera, abwo bagokwana bobe igoro y’obogima bwane.

english: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord , for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good , deliver thou me.
ekegusii: Korende aye Nyasae, Omonene one, ondwanerere ase engencho y’erieta riao, intoorie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bore obuya.

english: For I am poor and needy , and my heart is wounded within me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omotaka oremeire mono, na nigo ’nde n’obororo ase enkoro yane ime.

english: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth : I am tossed up and down as the locust .
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba, nigo nkoirurukigwa buna chingige.

english: My knees are weak through fasting ; and my flesh faileth of fatness .
ekegusii: Amaru aborirwe chinguru ase engencho y’okweng’ata, na omobere one oreeire mono.

english: Help me, O LORD my God : O save me according to thy mercy :
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, inkonye! Intoorie, ekiagera aye nigo obwate amaabera amange!

english: That they may know that this is thy hand ; that thou, LORD , hast done it.
ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri abwo bamanye ng’a aya nigo arure ase okoboko kwao. Aye Omonene, naye gwakorire aya.

english: Let them curse , but bless thou: when they arise , let them be ashamed ; but let thy servant rejoice .
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga bandagererie, korende aye onsesenie. Tiga abwo bagonkorera bobe barore obosooku, korende inche, omosomba oo, nimbe n’omogooko.

english: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame , and let them cover themselves with their own confusion , as with a mantle .
ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.

english: They compassed me about also with words of hatred ; and fought against me without a cause .
ekegusii: Bang’etananire bagokwana amang’ana y’obobisa, nigo bakondwania ’ntari na komocha konde.

english: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth ; yea, I will praise him among the multitude .
ekegusii: Ning’iranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono kegima n’omonwa one, nimbe nkona‐komotogia ase egati y’ abanto abange.

english: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor , to save him from those that condemn his soul .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekiina ki’ogokwa.

english: For my love they are my adversaries : but I give myself unto prayer .
ekegusii: Nonya inche ’mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangeechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera ebisio.

english: And they have rewarded me evil for good , and hatred for my love .
ekegusii: Nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya aane na okogeecha ase obwanchani bwane.

english: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand .
ekegusii: Chora omonto omobe amogambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.

english: When he shall be judged , let him be condemned : and let his prayer become sin .
ekegusii: Ekero agambiigwe ekiina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya n’ogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.

english: Let his children be fatherless , and his wife a widow .
ekegusii: Tiga abana baye batigwe bare chintakana, na omokungu oye atigwe ore omoboraka.

english: Why standest thou afar off , O LORD ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?
ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwateneneire aare iga? Naki okwebisa, otari kororekana chingaki chi’emechando?

english: He croucheth , and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones .
ekegusii: Abaremerwa nigo bagosegenyigwa na koiyerigwa, barutwa endiba ime, abanto batari na gokonywa konde, obasiria n’echinguru chiaye.

english: He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face ; he will never see it .
ekegusii: Igo ase enkoro yaye ime orengereria iga: “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye tayarora nonya ng’ake.”

english: Arise , O LORD ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Aye Nyasae, rambora okoboko kwao, gaki tibweba bachandegete!

english: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki omonto omokori amabe akogochecheria, na gokaga ng’a aye tokomoa egesusuro?

english: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorora abachandeku na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.

english: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none .
ekegusii: Saria chinguru chi’abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.

english: The LORD is King for ever and ever : the heathen are perished out of his land .
ekegusii: Omonene n’Omorwoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.

english: LORD , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotegerera abanto abaitongo abakoganetie; nigo okobaigwa na kobeka chinkoro chiabo chinguru.

english: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .
ekegusii: Igo okoa chintakana na abachandeku oboronge bwabo, erinde monto onde bw’ense tabachanda naende.

english: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe barabwo abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y’obobe.

english: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the LORD abhorreth .
ekegusii: Omonto omokori ebibe nigo agwetogeria okogania okobe gw’enkoro yaye; na omonto ore ne ribero nigo akoragereri’Omonene ase okomochecheria.

english: The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe ase oboenenu bwaye nigo agoteeba ng’a Nyasae takomoa egesusuro. Ase ebirengerio biaye ime nigo agokaga ng’a Nyasae tari.

english: His ways are always grievous ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera gokiina ase chinchera chiaye. Ebina biao okonacha nigo bire igoro mono, takobimanya; nigo agochaaya ababisa baye bonsi.

english: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio ase enkoro yaye ime oteeba iga: “Tinkwoboa gento kende, tinkonyorwa na bobe bonde nonya ng’ake.”

english: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .
ekegusii: Nigo akwebisa ase emechie oboera abanto, oganya agwo ase ogoita abanto batari na komocha. Nigo agotengera konyora abanto batari na gokonywa konde,

english: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den : he lieth in wait to catch the poor : he doth catch the poor , when he draweth him into his net .
ekegusii: bw’ebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboerete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; obabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.

english: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion : rule thou in the midst of thine enemies .
ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogaambi ere n’okobua, ateebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”

english: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power , in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning : thou hast the dew of thy youth .
ekegusii: Abanto bao mberue n’ogwancha kwabo, ekero orasangererie abarwani bao b’esegi. Abamura bao mbaache asore beboetie oboseera obochenu, buna riime ria mambia.

english: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio; ere nasenyente abarwoti ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.

english: He shall judge among the heathen , he shall fill the places with the dead bodies ; he shall wound the heads over many countries .
ekegusii: Nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekiina, ense neichore n’ebitondo; nasenyente emetwe y’abagaambi b’ense engima.

english: He shall drink of the brook in the way : therefore shall he lift up the head .
ekegusii: Nabe okonywa amaache y’ensoko ekero are ase orogeendo rwaye, ase ayio naimokererie omotwe oye igoro kabuire.

english: Praise ye the LORD . I will praise the LORD with my whole heart , in the assembly of the upright , and in the congregation .
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Ning’ake ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene n’enkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: The works of the LORD are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okonene, Abwo bagokogookera nigo bagokweorokereria erinde bakomanye.

english: His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okw’ogosikwa okonene na obonene, na oboronge bwaye nigo bogendererete kobao goika kare na kare.

english: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered : the LORD is gracious and full of compassion .
ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are n’obuya na amaabera.

english: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant .
ekegusii: Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.

english: He hath shewed his people the power of his works , that he may give them the heritage of the heathen .
ekegusii: Oorokeirie abanto baye okobua kw’ogokora kwaye ase okobaa emiando y’ abanto b’ebisaku.

english: The works of his hands are verity and judgment ; all his commandments are sure .
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’amaboko aye nigo kore okw’obwegenwa na okw’oboronge, n’amachiiko aye onsi nay’obwegenwa.

english: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
ekegusii: Amachiiko ayio nigo ateneine bokong’u kare na kare, aikeranigwe ase ekeene na oboronge.

english: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
ekegusii: Ere otomeire abanto baye okoboorigwa, na ochiikire okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania kobeo goika kare na kare. Erieta riaye nigo rire richenu na eri’okoirokwa.

english: Praise ye the LORD . Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Nasesenirie omonto oyio omoirogete Omonene, na ogokirie mono koigwera amachiiko aye.

english: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyabibe akorora ayio, nigo agoichana ogeechigwa, oriania amaino aye, orea osira. Okogania kw’omonyabibe nigo kogosira.

english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ’ndobe n’okobua ase ense; ekiaare ki’abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’ngesesenigwe.

english: Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Obotenenku na obonda ’mbibe ase enyomba yaye, na oboronge bwaye ’mbogenderere kobao botambe.

english: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness : he is gracious , and full of compassion , and righteous .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaso okobara ase omosunte, Omonene nabo ogochera abanyaboronge, ore nobuya, n’amaabera, na oboronge.

english: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ore n’amaabera na okorua ebinto singo, boigo ogokora amang’ana aye onsi ase oboronge.

english: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .
ekegusii: Omonyaboronge takonyegerigwa nonya ng’ake, nabe okoinyorwa kare na kare.

english: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the LORD .
ekegusii: Ere takwoboa kagotebigwa amang’ana amabe, enkoro yaye nigo ere endemu esemeretie Omonene.

english: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .
ekegusii: Enkoro yaye teri koirianyeka gose kwoboa, ere nigo akoremereria goika abachaandi baye babugwe.

english: Praise ye the LORD . Praise , O ye servants of the LORD , praise the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie, ee, ritogie erieta riaye!

english: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore .
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ritogigwe korwa bono goika kare na kare!

english: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised .
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ribe rigotogigwa korwa ekero risase rikooroka goika ekero rikorimera!

english: The LORD is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.

english: Who is like unto the LORD our God , who dwelleth on high ,
ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,

english: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !
ekegusii: na origereretie goocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.

english: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill ;
ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,

english: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
ekegusii: obabeeka baikaransa amo n’abwo bare n’okobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.

english: He maketh the barren woman to keep house , and to be a joyful mother of children . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba n’omogooko ase obomenyo bwaye. Omonene atogigwe!

english: Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .
ekegusii: Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu a Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogaambi bwaye.

english: The mountains skipped like rams , and the little hills like lambs .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa bigatuma-tuma buna chimingichi, na ebigoro buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi.

english: What ailed thee, O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?
ekegusii: Aye enyancha, ninki kwarooche, erinde ogatama? Aye Yorodani, ninki kiabeete asore, erinde okanacheka okairana magega?

english: Ye mountains , that ye skipped like rams ; and ye little hills , like lambs ?
ekegusii: Inwe ebitunwa, ninki kiagerete mogatuma‐tuma buna chimingichi, nainwe ebigoro boigo buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi?

english: Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob ;
ekegusii: Aye ense, tengecha ase obosio Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.

english: Not unto us, O LORD , not unto us, but unto thy name give glory , for thy mercy , and for thy truth’s sake.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe titobaisa gotogigwa, korende erieta riao rioka ritogigwe, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, nase obwegenwa bwao.

english: O house of Aaron , trust in the LORD : he is their help and their shield .
ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

english: Ye that fear the LORD , trust in the LORD : he is their help and their shield .
ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

english: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel ; he will bless the house of Aaron .
ekegusii: Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni.

english: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children .
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abamentekanie, inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino.

english: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth .
ekegusii: Mosesenigwe n’Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense.

english: The heaven , even the heavens , are the LORD’s : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .
ekegusii: Igoro yonsi na aase aye ere Omonene ore igoro, korende ense ero oyeire Mwanyabaanto.

english: The dead praise not the LORD , neither any that go down into silence .
ekegusii: Abakuure tibari gotogia Omonene, na ase abwo bagendire aase aakiriru onde tari okomotogia.

english: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore . Praise the LORD .
ekegusii: Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!

english: Wherefore should the heathen say , Where is now their God ?
ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku baraborie, “Nyasae oyio obo ng’ai are?”

english: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
ekegusii: Nyasae oito niigoro are, naende nigo agokora rinde rionsi aganetie.

english: They have mouths , but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
ekegusii: Nigo ebwate omonwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora.

english: They have ears , but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
ekegusii: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

english: They have hands , but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat .
ekegusii: Nebwate amaboko, korende teri kobwata gento, nebwate amagoro, korende teri gotaara; gose tebwati eriogi ri’ogokwana korwa ase emioyo yaabo.

english: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nabo barabe buna ero ere; na baria bayiegenete boigo.

english: O Israel , trust thou in the LORD : he is their help and their shield .
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.

english: I love the LORD , because he hath heard my voice and my supplications .
ekegusii: Nigo inyanchete Omonene, ekiagera ere oiguure eriogi riane na ogosaba kwane.

english: I said in my haste , All men are liars .
ekegusii: na ase okwegosa kwane ’ngateeba, “Kere omonto nomonyaborimo.”

english: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
ekegusii: Ngento ki ’ndarue ing’akane Omonene ase engencho y’amaya aya ankoreire?

english: I will take the cup of salvation , and call upon the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ninyimokie egekombe ki’ogotooreka, ’ndangerie ase erieta ri’Omonene.

english: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people .
ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio y’ abanto baye bonsi.

english: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints .
ekegusii: Nigo ere engencho enene ase amaiso y’Omonene ekero abanto baye abachenu bagokwa.

english: O LORD , truly I am thy servant ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
ekegusii: Nagosoroire, Omonene, inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo; nigo ’nde omosomba oo, omwana bw’omokuungu ore omosomba oo. Aye gwachisiboire chingataare korwa ase amagoro ane.

english: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call upon the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninkoruere okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende ’ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene.

english: In the courts of the LORD’s house , in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Ime ase chigoora chi’enyomba y’Omonene gati‐gati yao aye Yerusalemu; Omonene atogigwe!

english: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .
ekegusii: Ere ontegereire onyiguure, ase ayio, ekero ’nde moyo nimbe ’nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.

english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow .
ekegusii: Ebisibo bi’amakweri nigo biang’etananete; ekeondoko gi’aase abakuure gekambwata; nigo nabeete n’emechando na omoichano.

english: Then called I upon the name of the LORD ; O LORD , I beseech thee, deliver my soul .
ekegusii: Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ’ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire ontoorie omoyo one.”

english: Gracious is the LORD , and righteous ; yea, our God is merciful .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Ere, Nyasae oito nigo are omonyamaabera.

english: The LORD preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenda abanto abakanyeku; ekero nabeete ing’ichaanete, nigo antooretie.

english: Return unto thy rest , O my soul ; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, irana ase n’obotoereru bwao, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.

english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwarusirie omoyo one ase amakweri, gwatinyirie amariga korwa ase amaiso aane, kwarendire amagoro aane tindichaniwa ingwe.

english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosio Omonene, ’nde ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.

english: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene ase tore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!

english: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nigo bang’etananete kondwania, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

english: They compassed me about ; yea, they compassed me about : but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
ekegusii: Nigo bamboerete korwa chinsinyo chionsi, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.

english: They compassed me about like bees ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
ekegusii: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

english: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall : but the LORD helped me.
ekegusii: Nigo natwometwe bokong’u ng’a ingwe, korende Omonene agankonya.

english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly .
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amateera y’omogooko igoro y’ogotoreka, ayio akorwa ase chiema ase abanyene oboronge bamenyete, agoteeba, “Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.

english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted : the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly .
ekegusii: Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo koimokererete igoro, ee, okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.”

english: I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the LORD .
ekegusii: Inche tingokwa, korende nimbe moyo, erio ning’iranerere amakumia a Omonene.

english: The LORD hath chastened me sore : but he hath not given me over unto death .
ekegusii: Omonene obeire okong’a egesusuro ekenene gi’okondongeyia, korende tang’ereretie gochia ase amakweri.

english: Open to me the gates of righteousness : I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD :
ekegusii: Inyigorere ebiita bi’oboronge, erio insoe aroro ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene.

english: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

english: This gate of the LORD , into which the righteous shall enter .
ekegusii: Eke nakio egeita kia Omonene, agwo nao abanyene oboronge barasoere.

english: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation .
ekegusii: Nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyiguure, naende kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.

english: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes .
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, eri neriogokumia ase amaiso aito.

english: This is the day which the LORD hath made ; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Omonene akorire, tiga tobe n’omogooko, tochenge ase rirorio.

english: God is the LORD , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .
ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae, ere otorabeirie ensaakia. Bogoria chinsagia chi’emete, mochaake rituko rinene, moroobere gochia ase egesasiimero kere n’emegwekano ye ching’unchara!

english: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee: thou art my God , I will exalt thee.
ekegusii: Aye naye Nyasae one, nimbe ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono; Nyasae one, nimbe nkona‐gokobaka.

english: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: Let the house of Aaron now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

english: Let them now that fear the LORD say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bairogete Omonene bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

english: I called upon the LORD in distress : the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place .
ekegusii: Ekero nareenge n’emechando nkamorangeri’Omonene; nere akang’iraneria, akambeeka aase aagare.

english: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ase ensemo y’abarwanereri baane; ningoke ase engencho yokobugwa kw’abwo bangeechete.

english: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene, kobua gosemeria Mwanyabaanto.

english: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes .
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene kobua gosemeria omonyamwando bw’obogaambi.

english: Blessed are the undefiled in the way , who walk in the law of the LORD .
ekegusii: Inaki bagasesenirie abwo chinchera chiabo chire chindonge! Barabwo abagendererete kobwatia amachiiko y’Omonene!

english: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokorigia nenkoro yane yonsi; ondende timbaisa gotiga amachiiko ao.

english: I understand more than the ancients , because I keep thy precepts .
ekegusii: Nigo ’manyete amange kobua abanto abagotu, ekiagera ’mbwatete amachiiko ao.

english: I have refrained my feet from every evil way , that I might keep thy word .
ekegusii: Nigo ’ntangete amagoro aane tabaisa kobwatia enchera ende yonsi y’obobe, erinde ’nyaare korenda ring’ana riao.

english: I have not departed from thy judgments : for thou hast taught me.
ekegusii: Tindi gotiga aya gwachiikire, ekiagera naye kwanyorokereirie.

english: How sweet are thy words unto my taste ! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth !
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao naki are amansu ase ’nde! Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.

english: Through thy precepts I get understanding : therefore I hate every false way . נ NUN.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao ang’eire obong’aini, ase ayio nigo ’ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria. Omobaso Okorwa ase Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet , and a light unto my path .
ekegusii: Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane na omobaso ase enchera ’ngoeta.

english: I have sworn , and I will perform it , that I will keep thy righteous judgments .
ekegusii: Natianire ng’a ning’ikeranie eira eyio yane; nimbwatie aria onsi gwachiikire ase oboronge.

english: I am afflicted very much : quicken me, O LORD , according unto thy word .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nchaandegete mono, ing’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

english: Accept , I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth , O LORD , and teach me thy judgments .
ekegusii: Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende onyorokererie aya gwachiikire.

english: My soul is continually in my hand : yet do I not forget thy law .
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chionsi tinaboegererete obogima bwane, na tinebete amachiiko ao.

english: Thy word have I hid in mine heart , that I might not sin against thee.
ekegusii: Nagachire ring’ana riao ase enkoro yane ime, ng’a tinkora ebibe asore.

english: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe babeekire omoeto ase ’ngoeta, korende tintantaniri korwa ase amachiiko ao.

english: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever : for they are the rejoicing of my heart .
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare, ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.

english: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway , even unto the end .
ekegusii: Narure enkoro yane erende amachiiko ao, botambe goika omoerio. Oborendi Obuya Bokorwa Ase Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: I hate vain thoughts : but thy law do I love .
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngeechete abanyamenwa ebere, korende nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao.

english: Thou art my hiding place and my shield : I hope in thy word .
ekegusii: Aye naye ore obwebisero bwane, na enguba yane, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

english: Depart from me, ye evildoers : for I will keep the commandments of my God .
ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe, karue ase ’nde, erinde ’nyaare korenda amachiiko a Nyasae one.

english: Uphold me according unto thy word , that I may live : and let me not be ashamed of my hope .
ekegusii: Ing’a chinguru buna kwariire eira, erinde imbe moyo. Tobaisa gontiga ’ndore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.

english: Hold thou me up , and I shall be safe : and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually .
ekegusii: Imboanie kegima, ’ngitere buya, inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes : for their deceit is falsehood .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echiikire; ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.

english: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross : therefore I love thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Aye nigo obarete abakori amabe bonsi b’ense koba bosa buna amabiria; ase ayio inche nigo inyanchete oborori bwao.

english: Blessed art thou, O LORD : teach me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo osesenegete. Inyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments . ע AIN.
ekegusii: Omobere one nigo okoiguswa ore n’obwoba asore, naende nairokire ebiina biao. Okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: I have done judgment and justice : leave me not to mine oppressors .
ekegusii: Inche nakorire amang’ana are ay’ekeene na ay’oboronge; tontiga ase abachandi baane.

english: Be surety for thy servant for good : let not the proud oppress me.
ekegusii: Ontenenere inche omosomba oo inyore ebisio; totiga abanto abamwenu bankorere bobe.

english: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation , and for the word of thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore, amo nogoikeranigwa kw’eira yao y’oboronge.

english: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy , and teach me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Nkorere amaya inche omosomba oo koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, naende onyorokererie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: I am thy servant ; give me understanding , that I may know thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde ’manye oborori bwao.

english: It is time for thee , LORD , to work : for they have made void thy law .
ekegusii: Engaki yaikire aye Omonene ogwenerete gokora ogokora kwao, ekiagera basaririe amachiiko ao.

english: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold ; yea, above fine gold .
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu enkenonoku.

english: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right ; and I hate every false way . פ PE.
ekegusii: Na ase ayio nigo ndoche ng’a amachiiko ao onsi namaronge. Nigo ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria. Okogania Gw’okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thy testimonies are wonderful : therefore doth my soul keep them.
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore obw’ogokumia, ase ayio nigo mbobwatete nomoyo one bwonsi.

english: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐koraria aya onsi gwanchiikire nomonwa oo.

english: The entrance of thy words giveth light ; it giveth understanding unto the simple .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ao amaanoirwe nigo akorua omobaso na kobaa abatamanyeti amange obong’aini.

english: I opened my mouth , and panted : for I longed for thy commandments .
ekegusii: Nigo ngwasamia omonwa one na gwesesa, ekiagera nigo ’nde namaiga imanye amachiiko ao.

english: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name .
ekegusii: Ndigererie, ondorere amaabera buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.

english: Order my steps in thy word : and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
ekegusii: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.

english: Deliver me from the oppression of man : so will I keep thy precepts .
ekegusii: Mboorie korwa ase ogochaandwa kwa Mwanyabaanto, erio nario ndanyaare korenda amachiiko ao.

english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant ; and teach me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Mbarerie inche omosomba oo obosio bwao, na onyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes , because they keep not thy law . צ TZADDI.
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera, naitera amariga amange mono, ekiagera abanto tibarendeti amachiiko ao. Oboronge bw’amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Righteous art thou, O LORD , and upright are thy judgments .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omonyene oboronge, na okogaambera kwao n’okwaboronge.

english: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful .
ekegusii: Gwachiikire oborori bwao ase oboronge, na ase obwegenwa bwonsi.

english: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words .
ekegusii: Risemi riane riandire, ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.

english: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies , as much as in all riches .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase obonene bwe chinkuma chiao; kobua koba nobotenenku obonene.

english: Thy word is very pure : therefore thy servant loveth it.
ekegusii: Ring’ana riao riateemirwe, nigo riteneine bokong’u, na inche omosomba oo nigo ndianchete.

english: I am small and despised : yet do not I forget thy precepts .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nde oyo otasikiri, naende inchayire, korende nonya naboigo tinkweba amachiiko ao.

english: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness , and thy law is the truth .
ekegusii: Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare, n’amachiiko ao nigo are ay’ekeene.

english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights .
ekegusii: Emechando na omoichano bianyorire, korende nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.

english: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting : give me understanding , and I shall live . ק KOPH.
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore oboronge goika kare na kare; on g’e okomanya, erinde imbe moyo. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogotooreka

english: I cried with my whole heart ; hear me, O LORD : I will keep thy statutes .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe, na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera asore, ontoorie, erinde ’mbwate oborori bwao.

english: I prevented the dawning of the morning , and cried : I hoped in thy word .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka mambia chuni gokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ninsemeretie amang’ana ao.

english: Mine eyes prevent the night watches , that I might meditate in thy word .
ekegusii: Nigo nkogeesa botuko bokia, mbe nkona‐koiranerera ring’ana riao.

english: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness : O LORD , quicken me according to thy judgment .
ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana noboronge bwao.

english: I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’amachiiko ao, naende ’mbe ’nkorigereria chinchera chiao chionsi.

english: They draw nigh that follow after mischief : they are far from thy law .
ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera amabe bambereire ang’e; abwo nigo bare aare korwa ase amachiiko ao.

english: Thou art near , O LORD ; and all thy commandments are truth .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore ang’e, n’amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene.

english: Concerning thy testimonies , I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever . ר RESH.
ekegusii: Korwa kare nimanyete korwa ase oborori bwao ng’a naye kwabobegete bobeo goika kare na kare. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogokoonywa

english: Consider mine affliction , and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law .
ekegusii: Rigereria emechando yane, ontoorie, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.

english: Plead my cause , and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word .
ekegusii: Indwanerere, omboorie, ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

english: Salvation is far from the wicked : for they seek not thy statutes .
ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo kore aare korwa ase abakori amabe, ekiagera barabwo tibari korigia emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: Great are thy tender mercies , O LORD : quicken me according to thy judgments .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaabera ao nigo are amanene; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogaamba kwao.

english: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies ; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Abagonchaanda na abare ababisa baane nigo bare abange, korende tinkogobera ase okorwa oborori bwao.

english: I beheld the transgressors , and was grieved ; because they kept not thy word .
ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria abatari abegenwa nigo nkogeechigwa nabarabwo, ekiagera tibabwateti ring’ana riao.

english: Consider how I love thy precepts : quicken me, O LORD , according to thy lovingkindness .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rora buna nyanchete amachiiko ao! Ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera.

english: I will delight myself in thy statutes : I will not forget thy word . ג GIMEL.
ekegusii: Ningokere emeroberio yao echiikire; tinkweba ring’ana riao. Omogooko bw’okorenda amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thy word is true from the beginning : and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao onsi nay’ekeene, na okogaamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare. Okwerua Ase Okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause : but my heart standeth in awe of thy word .
ekegusii: Abagaambi nigo bagonchaanda bosa ’ntari na komocha, korende enkoro yane nigo eirogete amang’ana ao.

english: I rejoice at thy word , as one that findeth great spoil .
ekegusii: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.

english: I hate and abhor lying : but thy law do I love .
ekegusii: Nigo ngeechete kegima oborimo bonde bwonsi, korende nigo nyanchete amachiiko ao.

english: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments .
ekegusii: Ara gatan’akabere ase rituko nigo ’nkogotogia, ase engencho y’emeroberio yao y’oboronge echiikire.

english: Great peace have they which love thy law : and nothing shall offend them.
ekegusii: Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagoocha.

english: LORD , I have hoped for thy salvation , and done thy commandments .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nganyete ng’a ontoorie, naende nigo ’ngokora buna amachiiko ao agoteeba.

english: My soul hath kept thy testimonies ; and I love them exceedingly .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo obwatete oborori bwao, nigo ’mbwanchete mono.

english: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies : for all my ways are before thee. ת TAU.
ekegusii: Nigo imbwatete amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, ekiagera nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogokonywa

english: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD : give me understanding according to thy word .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tiga okorera kwane goike ase obosio bwao; ing’a obong’aini koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!

english: Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
ekegusii: ’nkorere amaya, inche omosomba oo, erio nario ’ndabe moyo, ’mbwate ring’ana riao.

english: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word .
ekegusii: Tiga ogosaba kwane goike asore; ontoorie koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!

english: My lips shall utter praise , when thou hast taught me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐kogotogia nebikoba biane, ekiagera aye kwanyorokereirie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: My tongue shall speak of thy word : for all thy commandments are righteousness .
ekegusii: Oromeme rwane ’ndoteere ring’ana riao, ekiagera amachiiko ao onsi nigo are amaronge.

english: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts .
ekegusii: Okoboko kwao, tiga kobe ang’e gonkonya, ekiagera nachoorire kobwatia amachiiko ao.

english: I have longed for thy salvation , O LORD ; and thy law is my delight .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nde namaiga ng’a ontoorie, n’amachiiko ao nigo angogetie mono.

english: Let my soul live , and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
ekegusii: Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ’ngotogie, na aya gwachiikire, tiga ankonye.

english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep ; seek thy servant ; for I do not forget thy commandments .
ekegusii: Inche nasirire buna eng’ondi ensiru, ’ndigie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.

english: Open thou mine eyes , that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law .
ekegusii: Ndamokie amaiso, inyare korora amang’ana y’ogokumia y’amachiiko ao.

english: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omoeti ase ense, tobaisa kombisa amachiiko ao.

english: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies , and that seek him with the whole heart .
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,

english: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times .
ekegusii: Enkoro yane yarang’ire namaiga, chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya okogania kwao.

english: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotogonyera abanto abaenenu, abwo baragereirie, baria batigire kobwata amachiiko ao.

english: Remove from me reproach and contempt ; for I have kept thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Onduserie ogochecherigwa na ogochaaywa kwabo, ekiagera inche nigo ’ndendete oborori bwao.

english: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .
ekegusii: Abagaambi nabaikaransa amo koroberia bankorere bobe, korende inche, omosomba oo, nigo nkona‐koiranerera emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors .
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonseemia. Okogania gw’okoigwera amachiiko Omonene

english: My soul cleaveth unto the dust : quicken thou me according to thy word .
ekegusii: Omoyo one otiringeirwe inse, ’ng’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

english: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Ekero naorogetie amakora aane nigo kwanyigwete; ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire!

english: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts : so shall I talk of thy wondrous works .
ekegusii: Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi’amachiiko ao, nimbe ’nkona koiranerera ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

english: My soul melteth for heaviness : strengthen thou me according unto thy word .
ekegusii: Omoyo one obuirwe n’emechando, ’mbeeke chinguru koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

english: Remove from me the way of lying : and grant me thy law graciously .
ekegusii: Nduserie chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare korwa ase ’nde, ase obuya bwao ’nyorokererie amachiiko ao.

english: They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .
ekegusii: abwo batari gokora amabe, korende nigo bakobwatia chinchera chiaye.

english: I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
ekegusii: Inche nachoorire enchera y’ekeene, nayabeekire motwe aria gwanchiikire.

english: I have stuck unto thy testimonies : O LORD , put me not to shame .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nabwatereire oborori bwao, tobaisa gontiga ’nsookigwe.

english: I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart . ה HE.
ekegusii: Ekero oramanyie enkoro yane obuya bwao, niminyoke ’nyigwere amachiiko ao. Ogosaba gw’okoegwa okomanya

english: Teach me, O LORD , the way of thy statutes ; and I shall keep it unto the end .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’nyorokererie enchera y’emeroberio yao echiikire; na inche nin’yerende goika omoerio.

english: Give me understanding , and I shall keep thy law ; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart .
ekegusii: Imanyie amachiiko ao, erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.

english: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments ; for therein do I delight .
ekegusii: Indaae ’mbwatie enchera y’amachiiko ao, ekiagera inche nigo ’ngokirie naro.

english: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies , and not to covetousness .
ekegusii: Oonchore enkoro yane. Yanche oborori bwao, na toyetiga ebe nokogania kwe ribero.

english: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity ; and quicken thou me in thy way .
ekegusii: Oyaonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti; ing’a obogima oboyia ’mbwatie chinchera chiao.

english: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .
ekegusii: Ikerania ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo, eira kwandierete, eira eyio okoa abakoirogete.

english: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .
ekegusii: Induserie amang’ana y’ogochaaywa inyirogete, ekiagera aya gwachiikire nigo are amaya.

english: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .
ekegusii: Aye gwatoeire amachiiko ao, toyarende nomokia.

english: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness . ו VAU.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo ’nganetie koigwera amachiiko ao; ing’a obogima oboyia goetera ase oboronge bwao. Ogosemeria amachiiko Omonene

english: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, orokia ase ’nde obwanchani bwao botakoera, naende ontoorie buna kwandierete eira.

english: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word .
ekegusii: Erio inyore ring’ana ’ndairanerie abwo bagonchecheria, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete ring’ana riao.

english: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .
ekegusii: Tobaisa korusia nonya ng’ake ring’ana ri’ekeene korwa ase omonwa one, ekiagera nigo ’nsemeretie aria gwachiikire.

english: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkoigwera amachiiko ao botambe goika kare na kare.

english: And I will walk at liberty : for I seek thy precepts .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosibore, ekiagera neorokereirie amachiiko ao.

english: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings , and will not be ashamed .
ekegusii: Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y’abarwoti ’ntari nobosooku.

english: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao, ekiagera ayio nin’yanchete.

english: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved ; and I will meditate in thy statutes . ז ZAIN.
ekegusii: Nindambore amaboko aane ’mbwate amachiiko ao nyanchete, na nimbe ’nkorengereria igoro y’emeroberio yao echiikire. Okwegena Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Remember the word unto thy servant , upon which thou hast caused me to hope .
ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riao gwakwanete ase ’nde inche omosomba oo, ekiagera ase rirorio kwang’eire ogosemeria.

english: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie ng’a chinchera chiane chibe chindonge, erinde ndende emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me.
ekegusii: Egekondemia ase emechando yane n’eke: Ring’ana riao nigo rigonkora naba omoyia.

english: The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bagonchecheria mono, nonya naboigo tindi gotiga amachiiko ao.

english: I remembered thy judgments of old , O LORD ; and have comforted myself.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero ’nkoinyora okogaamba kwao korwa kare, nigo ’nkoba nokoremigwa.

english: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .
