ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’okogeechigwa okonene ase engencho y’abakori amabe, ekiagera bagosaria amachiiko ao.

english: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage .
ekegusii: Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni, nabeire ’nkona‐gotererera emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: I have remembered thy name , O LORD , in the night , and have kept thy law .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkoinyora erieta riao botuko, nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao.

english: This I had, because I kept thy precepts . ח CHETH.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenigwa kwane, ng’a nabeire ’ndendete amachiiko ao. Okwerua koigwera amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thou art my portion , O LORD : I have said that I would keep thy words .
ekegusii: Omonene, aye negetare kiane; nariire eira koigwera amang’ana ao.

english: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosorora nenkoro yane yonsi: Ondorere amaabera koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

english: I thought on my ways , and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Nigo nareengereretie igoro ye chinchera chiane, ’nkaonchora amagoro aane ’nkabwatia oborori bwao.

english: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .
ekegusii: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero ’ndabe ’ndigereretie amachiiko ao onsi.

english: I made haste , and delayed not to keep thy commandments .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoayerera, tingotebana koigwera amachiiko ao.

english: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law .
ekegusii: Chingori chi’abakori amabe chiang’etananire, korende tinkweba amachiiko ao.

english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka botuko gati kogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okogaamba kwao nokoronge.

english: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omogisangio bw’abwo bonsi bakoirogete, abwo barendete amachiiko ao.

english: The earth , O LORD , is full of thy mercy : teach me thy statutes . ט TETH.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo boichire ase ense, ’nyorokererie imanye emeroberio yao echiikire. Engencho enene ere ase amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant , O LORD , according unto thy word .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.

english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye kogaamba buya na imbe ne chisemi, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete amachiiko ao.

english: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .
ekegusii: Ekero konya ’ntaraegwa egesusuro, nigo nareenge omosiru, korende bono nigo ’ndendete ring’ana riao.

english: Thou art good , and doest good ; teach me thy statutes .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omuya, naende nigo ogokora amaya, ase ayio ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane, korende inche nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.

english: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .
ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe neorokereirie okogaamba kwao kw’oboronge, rirorio nimbe nkona‐kogotogia nenkoro endonge.

english: Their heart is as fat as grease ; but I delight in thy law .
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chinorete buna ebitinya, korende inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao.

english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted ; that I might learn thy statutes .
ekegusii: Nigo yabeete buya mono ase ’nde konyora egesusuro keria, ekiagera ayio naro agerete neorokereirie emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver . י JOD.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao gwakwanete nigo are amaya ase ’nde, kobua chitaabu ne chifeta chilifu chinyinge. Oboronge bore ase amachiiko y’Omonene

english: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
ekegusii: Amaboko ao naro ambombete akandoisia, ing’a obong’aini, erinde inyare kweorokereria amachiiko ao.

english: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakoirogete ’mbandore bagoke, ekiagera ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

english: I know , O LORD , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nimanyete ng’a ebiina biao nebia boronge, naende ase bwegenwa bwao, nigo kwang’eire egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

english: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort , according to thy word unto thy servant .
ekegusii: Tiga obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe bondemie, koreng’ana buna kwariire eira ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.

english: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
ekegusii: Ondorere amaabera, erinde imbe moyo; inche nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.

english: Let the proud be ashamed ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abamwenu barore obosooku, ekiagera bankoreire bobe engencho ende etaiyo, korende inche nigo ’nkona koiranerera amachiiko ao.

english: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bakoirogete bache ase ’nde. Abwo bamanyete oborori bwao.

english: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly . ב BETH.
ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiiko ao; tobaisa gontiga. Okoigwera amachiiko Omonene

english: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes ; that I be not ashamed . כ CAPH.
ekegusii: Tiga enkoro yane ebe etari na komocha ase emeroberio yao echiikire, erinde timbaisa konyora obosooku. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogotoorigwa

english: My soul fainteth for thy salvation : but I hope in thy word .
ekegusii: Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.

english: Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me?
ekegusii: Amaiso aane asundokire ase okoganya ring’ana riao, nigo ’nkoboria, “Indi aye orache kondemia?”

english: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke ; yet do I not forget thy statutes .
ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna ekerandi gi’edivai gekorire korwa ase risankwa kere ase erioki, nonya naboigo, tindeba emeroberio yao echiikire.

english: How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo ’ndagenderere koremereria? Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?

english: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law .
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu batabwateti amachiiko ao nigo bankuunyeire emetaro + 119:85 emetaro: ase ekegusii egekoro ne “chiirima” .

english: All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully ; help thou me.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene, korende abanto nigo bagonchaanda ase okong’aacha. Koranche onkonye!

english: They had almost consumed me upon earth ; but I forsook not thy precepts .
ekegusii: Barabwo babeire ang’e gonsiria aiga ase ense, nonya naboigo, tintigeti amachiiko ao.

english: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth . ל LAMED.
ekegusii: Ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, erinde ’mbwatie oborori bwao gwakwanete. Okoba Nokwegena ase Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: For ever , O LORD , thy word is settled in heaven .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.

english: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
ekegusii: Naki omonto omosae arakore arende obochenu bw’obogima bwaye? Nase okorenda orogeendo rwaye kobwatekana ne ring’ana riao.

english: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth , and it abideth .
ekegusii: Obwegenwa bwao nigo bogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi; aye gwatenenirie ense aase aye, ero nigo eteneine bokong’u.

english: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nigo bigendererete kobao goika reero buna aye kwabichiigete, ekiagera bionsi nigo bikogokorera.

english: Unless thy law had been my delights , I should then have perished in mine affliction .
ekegusii: Onye ogochika kwao gotarenge omogooko one nanga nigo nasirete ase emechando yane.

english: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me.
ekegusii: Inche tinkonyaara kweba amachiiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.

english: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts .
ekegusii: Inche noyoo, ntoorie! Nigo nabeire ’nkona‐koinyora amachiiko ao.

english: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakomboera ng’a bansirie, korende nigo ’nyigwerete oborori bwao.

english: I have seen an end of all perfection : but thy commandment is exceeding broad . מ MEM.
ekegusii: Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu, korende amachiiko ao namaikeranu. Okoba Nobwanchani ase Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: O how love I thy law ! it is my meditation all the day .
ekegusii: Aa! Naki inyanchete amachiiko ao! Naro nkona‐koiranerera omobaso boira.

english: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao nigo agonkora naba omong’aini kobua ababisa baane, ekiagera ayio nigo are ase ’nde chingaki chionsi.

english: I have more understanding than all my teachers : for thy testimonies are my meditation .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde nokomanya okonge kobua aborokia baane, ekiagera nigo ’nkona‐korengereria mono igoro y’oborori bwao.

english: In the LORD put I my trust : how say ye to my soul , Flee as a bird to your mountain ?
ekegusii: Omonene nere obotemero bwane! Nase ki rende mogonteebia: “Iruruka buna enyoni ogende gochia ebitunwa igoro?

english: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow , they make ready their arrow upon the string , that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart .
ekegusii: Rigereria abakori amabe buna batingire amata abo, babekire chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: If the foundations be destroyed , what can the righteous do ?
ekegusii: Onye amaroso atagoirwe, ngento ki omonto omooronge arakore?”

english: The LORD is in his holy temple , the LORD’s throne is in heaven : his eyes behold , his eyelids try , the children of men .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ime ye Hekalu yaye enchenu, ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene naaria igoro kere. Amaiso aye nigo amongerete, nigo arigereretie na korenga Mwanyabaanto.

english: The LORD trieth the righteous : but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth .
ekegusii: Omonene arengete abare abaronge na abakori amabe, korende omoyo oye nigo ogechete abakori amabe na abagoita abande ase obotindi bwa bosa.

english: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares , fire and brimstone , and an horrible tempest : this shall be the portion of their cup .
ekegusii: Natwerie abakori amabe omorero bw’amakara, amagena agosamba na omwaga ore n’oroguto rw’omorero, ’ng’a bibe egesusuro kiabo.

english: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness ; his countenance doth behold the upright .
ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nigo anchete ogokora kw’oboronge; abanto abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbarore obosio bwaye.

english: In my distress I cried unto the LORD , and he heard me.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nde n’emechando nigo ’nkorera ase Omonene, ere nigo akonyigwa.

english: Deliver my soul , O LORD , from lying lips , and from a deceitful tongue .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto abanyaborimo, bare ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria.

english: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue ?
ekegusii: Inwe abamore ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria, ngento ki moraegwe, na mang’ana ki naende morakorerwe?

english: Sharp arrows of the mighty , with coals of juniper .
ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe n’omorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.

english: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech , that I dwell in the tents of Kedar !
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera ’nde omomenyi agwo Meseki, nigo imenyete ase egati y’Abakedari.

english: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace .
ekegusii: Nabeire imenyete ase engaki entambe ase egati y’ abanto bageechete omorembe.

english: I am for peace : but when I speak , they are for war .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokora omorembe, korende ekero ’ngokwana, barabwo nigo baganetie esegi.

english: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills , from whence cometh my help .
ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane gochia ase ebitunwa. Ogokonywa kwane, ng’ai korarwe?

english: My help cometh from the LORD , which made heaven and earth .
ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwane nigo korarwe ase Omonene, oyotongete igoro na ense.

english: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved : he that keepeth thee will not slumber .
ekegusii: Ere tagotiga okogoro kwao gotererigwe; oyokorendete tagosundoka.

english: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep .
ekegusii: Ee, ere omorendi bw’Abaisraeli tagosundoka, gose takorara.

english: The LORD is thy keeper : the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand .
ekegusii: Omonene nere omorendi oo, nere ekiriri kiao ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao kwa borio.

english: The sun shall not smite thee by day , nor the moon by night .
ekegusii: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

english: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil : he shall preserve thy soul .
ekegusii: Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.

english: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore .
ekegusii: Omonene nakorende kogosoa na kogosoka, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

english: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Nigo nagogete na baria banteebetie, “Inchuo, togende ase enyomba y’Omonene!”

english: Our feet shall stand within thy gates , O Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, bono amagoro aito nigo ateneine aa ase ebiita biao.

english: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together :
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu kwaagachirwe naende aye n’omochie obwateranirie amo.

english: Whither the tribes go up , the tribes of the LORD , unto the testimony of Israel , to give thanks unto the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Agwo nao ebisaku bigotiira gochia, ebio bire ebisaku bi’Omonene. Abaisraeli abwo nigo bachigetwe ng’a babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta ri’Omonene.

english: For there are set thrones of judgment , the thrones of the house of David .
ekegusii: Agwo nao ebirogo bi’abanachi ebiina bire, ebirogo bi’obonene bi’enyomba ya Daudi.

english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem : they shall prosper that love thee.
ekegusii: Sabera Yerusalemu, erinde obe n’omorembe! Abanto abwo bagwanchete tiga basesenigwe.

english: Peace be within thy walls , and prosperity within thy palaces .
ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase chindwaki chiao ime, na ogosesenigwa kobe ase chinyomba chiao chi’oborwoti.

english: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say , Peace be within thee.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’abaminto na abagisangio baane, nigo ’ngokoganeria omorembe.

english: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oito ningosabere ebisio.

english: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes , O thou that dwellest in the heavens .
ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane goocha agwo asore, igoro ase obomenyo bwao.

english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters , and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress ; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God , until that he have mercy upon us.
ekegusii: Ama! Buna koreng’ana abasomba basemeretie omonene obo, na abasomba abaiseke basemeretie omoteneneri obo omokungu; naboigo naintwe tosemeretie Omonene Nyasae oito, goika abe otororeire amaabera.

english: Have mercy upon us, O LORD , have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otororere amaabera, koranche otororere amaabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.

english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease , and with the contempt of the proud .
ekegusii: Twaichoirwe n’echaayo y’abwo beisanekerete, na ogochecherigwa kw’abamwenu.

english: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say ;
ekegusii: Inee! Naki yare goocha koba onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito? Tiga Abaisraeli bairanerie.

english: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
ekegusii: Onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito, ekero abanto batoumokerete gotorwania,

english: Then they had swallowed us up quick , when their wrath was kindled against us:
ekegusii: nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete n’endamwamu enene ase tore;

english: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul :
ekegusii: naende emerindo nigo yarenge goocha gotokorobanania, eooro nigo yarenge goocha goeta igoro yaito;

english: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul .
ekegusii: ee, amaache aichoreranete nigo arenge goocha gotomera kegima.

english: Blessed be the LORD , who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth .
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino y’ abanto abwo.

english: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers : the snare is broken , and we are escaped .
ekegusii: Emioyo yaito yatoorekire buna enyoni egotooreka korwa ase egesuguni ki’omotegi. Egesuguni kiabutokire, naintwe twaminchoirie na gotama.

english: Our help is in the name of the LORD , who made heaven and earth .
ekegusii: Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.

english: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion , which cannot be removed , but abideth for ever .
ekegusii: Abwo bamosemeretie Omonene nigo banga buna egetunwa gia Sayoni getari konyegerigwa, korende nigo kegendererete kobao botambe.

english: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem , so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever .
ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo Omonene abaetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

english: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous ; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity .
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi y’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’ abanto abaronge; abwo baabaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.

english: Do good , O LORD , unto those that be good , and to them that are upright in their hearts .
ekegusii: Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chinyegenwa!

english: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways , the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity : but peace shall be upon Israel .
ekegusii: Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!

english: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion , we were like them that dream .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene atoiraneretie intwe Abasayoni ebisio bieito, nigo twabeete buna abakoroota!

english: Then was our mouth filled with laughter , and our tongue with singing : then said they among the heathen , The LORD hath done great things for them.
ekegusii: Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera as’omogooko. Erio abanto b’ebisaku bagateebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang’ana amanene.”

english: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad .
ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otokoreire amang’ana amanene; ase igo ntore n’omogooko.

english: Turn again our captivity , O LORD , as the streams in the south .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranerie ebisio biaito, buna okoirania chindooche ase Ense ya Irianyi.

english: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy .
ekegusii: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.

english: He that goeth forth and weepeth , bearing precious seed , shall doubtless come again with rejoicing , bringing his sheaves with him .
ekegusii: Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare n’omochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.

english: Except the LORD build the house , they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city , the watchman waketh but in vain .
ekegusii: Onye Omonene takoagaacha enyomba, abwo bakoyeagaacha nigo bagokora emeremo ya bosa. Onye Omonene takorenda omochie omonto oyio okoyorenda nigo akorenda bosa.

english: It is vain for you to rise up early , to sit up late , to eat the bread of sorrows : for so he giveth his beloved sleep .
ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa ase more kobooka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechaandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.

english: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD : and the fruit of the womb is his reward .
ekegusii: Rora, abana nigo bare omwando okorwa ase Omonene, ekiagera oroiboro rokorwa ase enda nigo rore ekeegwa.

english: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man ; so are children of the youth .
ekegusii: Abana omonto akonyora kare ne’chinguru chi’obosae bwaye, nigo banga buna chinsara chire koboko kw’omorwani etuoni.

english: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed , but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase ekegambero gia’etureti.

english: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD ; that walketh in his ways .
ekegusii: Naki agasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene, naende obwatete chinchera chiaye!

english: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands : happy shalt thou be , and it shall be well with thee.
ekegusii: Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.

english: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house : thy children like olive plants round about thy table .
ekegusii: Mokao nabe ase enyomba yao buna omosabibu okwama amasabibu; abana bao nigo barabe buna ebisabo bi’omozeituni, baikaranse baetanane emesa yao.

english: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD .
ekegusii: Ama! Naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.

english: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion : and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life .
ekegusii: Omonene agosesenie korwa Sayoni! Erio orore obuya bwa Yerusalemu ase amatuko onsi ore moyo,

english: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children , and peace upon Israel .
ekegusii: naende orore abaachokoro bao. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!

english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth , may Israel now say :
ekegusii: “Ababisa nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito.” Nabo Abaisraeli bagoteeba.

english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth : yet they have not prevailed against me.
ekegusii: “Ee, barabwo nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito, korende tibana‐gotobua.

english: The plowers plowed upon my back : they made long their furrows .
ekegusii: Bakang’ororia emegongo yaito buna emegondo. Bakayetambeyia emeng’ororia yaabo.”

english: The LORD is righteous : he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi’abakori amabe.

english: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bageechete Sayoni, taga basookigwe na koiranigwa magega.

english: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops , which withereth afore it groweth up :
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna obonyansi bore kerama igoro, bogosusana botarakina;

english: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand ; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom .
ekegusii: tibori goichora okoboko kw’omosangereria, gose kobogwa omosaima okoboko.

english: Neither do they which go by say , The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto bagoeta inchera tibakonyaara goteeba, “Omonene abasesenie!” Gose goteeba, “Nkobasesenia tore inwe ase erieta ri’Omonene!”

english: Help , LORD ; for the godly man ceaseth ; for the faithful fail from among the children of men .
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ayerera totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase Mwanyabaanto.

english: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour : with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi nigo bagoteebania amang’ana ’oborimo; nigo bare okong’o nyamenwa ebere na gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.

english: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips , and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koranche kiria emenwa y’abwo egokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, ne chimeme chi’abwo bagwetogia ase amang’ana y’oboenenu.

english: Who have said , With our tongue will we prevail ; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Ase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito ntore ne chinguru, aya togokwana nigo agotokonya. Ning’o ore Omonene gotobua?”

english: For the oppression of the poor , for the sighing of the needy , now will I arise , saith the LORD ; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Bono ninchiche, ekiagera abataka baregirwe na abaremerwa nkorera bare. Nindwe oborendi obuya kegima ase abwo basemeretie kobonyora.”

english: The words of the LORD are pure words : as silver tried in a furnace of earth , purified seven times .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ’Omonene nigo are ay’obwegenwa naende n’amaachenu, nigo agwekaine efeta yasambirwe ase riera ri’omorero na koumorwa inse, yachenirwe ara gatano na kabere.

english: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD , thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otorende! Otorende botambe korwa ase obobe bw’ekegori eke.

english: The wicked walk on every side , when the vilest men are exalted .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagoetanana chinsemo chionsi, na obonyaka bonde bwonsi botogigwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

english: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, korwa ase chindiba ime.

english: Lord , hear my voice : let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications .
ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane; tegerera oigwe eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.

english: If thou, LORD , shouldest mark iniquities , O Lord , who shall stand ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onye ’nkware gokora omobaro bw’ebibe, ning’o ore konyaara gotenena ase obosio bwao?

english: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared .
ekegusii: Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyaare koirokwa.

english: I wait for the LORD , my soul doth wait , and in his word do I hope .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nganyete Omonene, ee, omoyo one nigo omoganyete; nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riaye.

english: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning : I say, more than they that watch for the morning .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Omonene, kobua buna abarendi bakoganya ogokiamoka, ee, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie.

english: Let Israel hope in the LORD : for with the LORD there is mercy , and with him is plenteous redemption .
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nigo are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe, na ogotooreka okonge nigo gokorwa asare.

english: LORD , my heart is not haughty , nor mine eyes lofty : neither do I exercise myself in great matters , or in things too high for me.
ekegusii: Omonene, ase enkoro yane tindi kweimokereria igoro, gose tindi omwerori. Inche tinyechaandeti kwerigeria amang’ana amanene, gose ayaare amakong’u mono ase ’nde.

english: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself , as a child that is weaned of his mother : my soul is even as a weaned child .
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.

english: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever .
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene korwa bono na goika kare na kare.

english: LORD , remember David , and all his afflictions :
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oinyore Daudi, ase engencho y’obokong’u bwonsi bwamonyoorete.

english: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed .
ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba oo, tobaisa kwanga korigereria omoakwa amaguta oo.

english: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore .
ekegusii: Abana bao kobarabwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na oborori bwane ’ndaborokererie, rirorio abana baabo boigo ’mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi kogenderera botambe.”

english: For the LORD hath chosen Zion ; he hath desired it for his habitation .
ekegusii: Omonene ochorire Sayoni; nigo aganetie obe obomenyo bwaye, oteebire,

english: This is my rest for ever : here will I dwell ; for I have desired it.
ekegusii: “Aase aa nao obotimokero bwane bwa botambe, aa nao ’ndabe ’nkomenya, ekiagera naanchire.

english: I will abundantly bless her provision : I will satisfy her poor with bread .
ekegusii: Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe n’ebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.

english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation : and her saints shall shout aloud for joy .
ekegusii: Nimboyie abakuani b’omochie oyo nogotooreka, na abachenu baye ’mbabe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.

english: His enemies will I clothe with shame : but upon himself shall his crown flourish .
ekegusii: Ninsookie ababisa baye kegima, korende egutwa y’omotwe oye omonyene negenderere komekameka.”

english: How he sware unto the LORD , and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob ;
ekegusii: Oinyore buna ariete eira na gotiana asore aye Omonene ore Chinguru chia Yakobo, agateeba,

english: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house , nor go up into my bed ;
ekegusii: “Tingosoa nyomba mwane, gose tinkoriina borere korara;

english: I will not give sleep to mine eyes , or slumber to mine eyelids ,
ekegusii: tingwancha korara chitoro, gose gosundoka,

english: Until I find out a place for the LORD , an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob .
ekegusii: goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”

english: We will go into his tabernacles : we will worship at his footstool .
ekegusii: “Inchuo togende ase obomenyo bw’Omonene, tosasiime agwo ase egeteni kiaye kia amagoro!”

english: Arise , O LORD , into thy rest ; thou, and the ark of thy strength .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduki eria ekworokia okobua kwao.

english: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness ; and let thy saints shout for joy .
ekegusii: Tiga abakuani bao beboyie oboronge, na abanto bao abachenu babe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.

english: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity !
ekegusii: Rora buna ere buya na okogokia okonene ekero abanto abamo bakomenya amo, baigwanaine.

english: It is like the precious ointment upon the head , that ran down upon the beard , even Aaron’s beard : that went down to the skirts of his garments ;
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna amaguta akweakwa are amaya mono, akonyororoka gochia ase chinderu chia Aroni, aitekera omokoba bwe rigoti ri’omwambaro oye.

english: As the dew of Hermon , and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion : for there the LORD commanded the blessing , even life for evermore .
ekegusii: Naende nigo anga buna riime ria Herimoni, rigotonya igoro y’ebitunwa bia Sayoni. Aroro agwo Omonene ochiikire ogosesenigwa na obogima botari nomoerio.

english: Behold, bless ye the LORD , all ye servants of the LORD , which by night stand in the house of the LORD .
ekegusii: Inchuo motogie Omonene, inwe abasomba baye mwensi, inwe abamokomokorera ase enyomba yaye botuko.

english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary , and bless the LORD .
ekegusii: Rambora amaboko aino gochia Aase Aachenu, motogie Omonene!

english: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion .
ekegusii: Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense, agosesenie korwa Sayoni!

english: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the name of the LORD ; praise him , O ye servants of the LORD .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Togia erieta ri’Omonene! Inwe abasomba ba Omonene, motogie!

english: Who smote great nations , and slew mighty kings ;
ekegusii: Omonene nigo asiretie ebisaku ebinge, na agaita abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru;

english: Sihon king of the Amorites , and Og king of Bashan , and all the kingdoms of Canaan :
ekegusii: Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani; boigo agasiria amarwoti onsi a Kaanani.

english: And gave their land for an heritage , an heritage unto Israel his people .
ekegusii: Ense y’ebisaku ebio akayea Abaisraeli, abanto baye, ekaba omwando obo.

english: Thy name , O LORD , endureth for ever ; and thy memorial , O LORD , throughout all generations .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, erieta riao nigo rigendererete kobao goika kare na kare. Nobe gokoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi.

english: For the LORD will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .
ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abanto baye, narorere abasomba baye amaabera.

english: They have mouths , but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
ekegusii: Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora,

english: They have ears , but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths .
ekegusii: nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, gose tebwati omoika bw’okoeyana.

english: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nigo banga buna ero, ee, naboigo abwo bonsi bayiegenete.

english: Bless the LORD , O house of Israel : bless the LORD , O house of Aaron :
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, togia Omonene! Nainwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, togia Omonene!

english: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD , in the courts of the house of our God ,
ekegusii: Inwe aba mogotenena ase enyomba y’Omonene, agwo ase chigoora chi’enyomba ya Nyasae oito, motogie!

english: Bless the LORD , O house of Levi : ye that fear the LORD , bless the LORD .
ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Lawi, togia Omonene! Nainwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie!

english: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene tiga atogigwe korwa Sayoni, Omonene oria omenyete Yerusalemu. Motogie Omonene!

english: Praise the LORD ; for the LORD is good : sing praises unto his name ; for it is pleasant .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.

english: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure .
ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire Yakobo, bwechooreire Abaisraeli koba aba aye bori.

english: For I know that the LORD is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .
ekegusii: Inche nigo imanyete ng’a Omonene nigo are omonene; ee, Omonene oito nigo are igoro ye’chinyasae chionsi.

english: Whatsoever the LORD pleased , that did he in heaven , and in earth , in the seas , and all deep places .
ekegusii: Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokeraabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.

english: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth ; he maketh lightnings for the rain ; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries .
ekegusii: Nere okorenta amare korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense; nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga okogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.

english: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .
ekegusii: Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.

english: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his servants .
ekegusii: Nere okorete ebikone na amakumia ase egati yao, aye Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye.

english: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Akabarusia aroro n’okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Erio akaambokeria Abaisraeli aroro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Ere akarimeria Farao amo nemeganda yaye ase Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Ere nigo araaete abanto baye goetera ase erooro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: To him which smote great kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: And slew famous kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti abaakumete, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae, oyobuete chinyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: And gave their land for an heritage : for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw’ abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Chinse echio chikaba omwando bw’Abaisraeli, abasomba baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: Who remembered us in our low estate : for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Ere nigo atoinyorete ekero twarenge aboororo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Ere nigo atotooretie korwa ase ababisa baito, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: Who giveth food to all flesh : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: O give thanks to the Lord of lords : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Nere bweka okorete amakumia amanene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: The sun to rule by day : for his mercy endureth for ever :
ekegusii: Akabeeka risase rigambe mobaso, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: The moon and stars to rule by night : for his mercy endureth for ever .
ekegusii: Akabeeka omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigambe botuko, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

english: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea, we wept , when we remembered Zion .
ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babiloni, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.

english: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo twasungete amakano aito ase emete enga buna emesobeti.

english: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .
ekegusii: Abanto baria batwosete bakagania tobaterere, abachandi abwo baito bakagania tobagokie, bagateeba, “Toterere ogoteera gwa Sayoni.”

english: How shall we sing the LORD’s song in a strange land ?
ekegusii: Naki torakore totere ogoteera kw’Omonene ase ense engeni?

english: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem , let my right hand forget her cunning .
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, inse gokweba, rirorio okoboko kwane gw’okorio kogatae.

english: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .
ekegusii: Onye tingokoinyora aye Yerusalemu, erinde obe omogooko one omonene mono, rirorio tiga oromeme rwane robwatane namang’ang’ura.

english: Remember , O LORD , the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem ; who said , Rase it , rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora amabe aya abanto b’Edomu bakorete ase rituko riria Yerusalemu obwatetwe; buna bateebete, “Yotagore kegima! Yotagore amo noboroso bwaye!”

english: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones .
ekegusii: Nachenge omonto oyio ogochia koira abana baino abake na kobaakera ase amagena y’Ebitare.

english: I will praise thee with my whole heart : before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono n’enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

english: I will worship toward thy holy temple , and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth : for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosasiima ndigereretie gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu, naaka ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao. Aye gwakorire eira yao koba enene goetania onsi aya erieta riao riatoteebetie.

english: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul .
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nakorangeretie, nigo kwanyigwete, okaremia omoyo one, okambeeka chinguru.

english: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD , when they hear the words of thy mouth .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abarwoti bonsi b’ense ’mbagotogie, ekero baraigwe amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo;

english: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD : for great is the glory of the LORD .
ekegusii: ’mbabe bagotera igoro y’ogokora kwao, aye Omonene, ekiagera obonene bwao nigo bore obonene mono.

english: Though the LORD be high , yet hath he respect unto the lowly : but the proud he knoweth afar off .
ekegusii: Nony’Omonene ore igoro aare, nigo arooche abanto abaitongo, korende abare abaenenu nigo akobamanya kobare aare.

english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble , thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies , and thy right hand shall save me.
ekegusii: Nimba ngoeta ase egati y’emechando, aye nigo ondendete ngenderere koba moyo; aye nigo okorambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ababisa baane bare n’endamwamu, n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio gwantooria.

english: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy , O LORD , endureth for ever : forsake not the works of thine own hands .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nonyare goikerania aria kwandierete eira, ekiagera obwanchani bwao nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare. Tobaisa kweba emeremo y’amaboko ao.

english: O LORD , thou hast searched me, and known me .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwariga‐rigirie ime yane, kwamanyire inche.

english: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
ekegusii: nonya naroro okoboko kwao ’nkondaae, ee, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ’nkombwate.

english: If I say , Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me .
ekegusii: Ninsa goteeba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,

english: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day : the darkness and the light are both alike to thee .
ekegusii: nonya nomosunte tori omosunte asore, obotuko nigo bokoraba se, bwaba buna omobaso, asore omusunte na oborabu nigo bigwekaine.

english: For thou hast possessed my reins : thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb .
ekegusii: Naye gwatongete ebire ase enda yane ime, nigo kwambwatanetie amo ase enda ya baba.

english: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made : marvellous are thy works ; and that my soul knoweth right well .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, na ey’ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw’ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang’ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.

english: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret , and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth .
ekegusii: Amauga y’omobere one tabisekanete asore, ekero natongetwe bobisi, ekero nabombetwe ase ense ime.

english: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect ; and in thy book all my members were written , which in continuance were fashioned , when as yet there was none of them.
ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo andoche ekero nareenge inche ase enda ya baba ime, amatuko aane onsi nigo arigetwe ase egetabu yao, na akaroberigwa ritang’ani rituko rinde ritaraika.

english: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God ! how great is the sum of them!
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u ase ’nde kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyaare kobareka.

english: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand : when I awake , I am still with thee.
ekegusii: Inse kobibara, nigo bire ebinge goetania omokenye. Ekero ’nkobooka, nigo ’ngendererete kobeera amo naye.

english: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked , O God : depart from me therefore, ye bloody men .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, naki yare goocha koba buya onye ’ngwaita abakori amabe, onye abagoitera amanyinga ’mbarua ase ’nde.

english: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising , thou understandest my thought afar off .
ekegusii: Aye nigo omanyete ekero ing’ikaransete, na ekero ’nkoimoka. Nigo omanyete ebirengererio biane bionsi kore aare.

english: For they speak against thee wickedly , and thine enemies take thy name in vain .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagokwana bobe igoro yao; nigo bare abaenenu bagokora ebibe asore.

english: Do not I hate them, O LORD , that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
ekegusii: Omonene, Inee, tingeecheti abwo bakogeechete? Tinkonyinyera abwo bagosaria asore?

english: I hate them with perfect hatred : I count them mine enemies .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo ’mbageechete mono, nigo ’mbaabarete ng’a nababisa baane.

english: Search me, O God , and know my heart : try me, and know my thoughts :
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ndiga‐rigie omanye enkoro yane. Nteeme omanye ebirengererio biane.

english: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting .
ekegusii: Origererie timbwatia enchera y’obosiru, na ondaae ase enchera ya kare na kare.

english: Thou compassest my path and my lying down , and art acquainted with all my ways .
ekegusii: Ekero ’ngotaara gose kondaire nigo omanyete; aye nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.

english: For there is not a word in my tongue , but , lo, O LORD , thou knowest it altogether.
ekegusii: Nonya nekero ’ntarakwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, Naama, aye Omonene nigo orimanyete kegima.

english: Thou hast beset me behind and before , and laid thine hand upon me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ong’etanaine ase chinsemo chionsi, na nigo obegete okoboko kwao igoro yane ondendete.

english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high , I cannot attain unto it.
ekegusii: Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw’ogokumia ase ’nde; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyaara gokomanya.

english: Whither shall I go from thy spirit ? or whither shall I flee from thy presence ?
ekegusii: Ng’ai ’ndagende, erinde ntigane n’Omoika oo? Gose ng’ai ’ndatame gochia, ’ndue ase obosio bwao?

english: If I ascend up into heaven , thou art there: if I make my bed in hell , behold, thou art there .
ekegusii: Ninsa koriina gochia igoro, aye nao ore; ninsa kwara ekerarero kiane agwo aase abakuure, aye nao ore.

english: If I take the wings of the morning , and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea ;
ekegusii: Ninsa koirurukigwa namasase a mambia, ingende komenya ase chinsinyo chi’enyancha,

english: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD ? for ever ? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere konyeba? Ngoika kare na kare? Ngoika ririri orabe kobisete obosio bwao ng’a tondora?

english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul , having sorrow in my heart daily ? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ndabe ndemereretie emechando ase omoyo one, imbe nobororo ase enkoro yane rituko ase rituko? Ngoika ririri omobisa one arabe okogokera emechando yane?

english: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God : lighten mine eyes , lest I sleep the sleep of death ;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Nyasae one, ondigererie, ong’iranerie ase ogosaba kwane! Ondamokie amaiso aane, timbaisa korara chitoro chi’amakweri.

english: Lest mine enemy say , I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved .
ekegusii: Totiga omobisa one ateebe ng’a ombuire, na ababisa baane bonsi bachengere okogwa kwane.

english: But I have trusted in thy mercy ; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation .
ekegusii: Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.

english: I will sing unto the LORD , because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.

english: Deliver me, O LORD , from the evil man : preserve me from the violent man ;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto ababe; indende korwa ase abanto abatindi!

english: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire ; into deep pits , that they rise not up again .
ekegusii: Tiga omorero bw’amakara obagwere, barabwo batugutwe ase omorero, barutwe ase chingoro chintambe tibaruao.

english: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth : evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him .
ekegusii: Totiga abagenki bagenderere koba ase ense. Obobe nigo bogotwara abanto abatindi ase omoayerero bw’abasiria.

english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted , and the right of the poor .
ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a aye Omonene norwanerere abagokorerwa bobe, noe abataka oboronge bwabo.

english: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name : the upright shall dwell in thy presence .
ekegusii: Ekeene, abanyene oboronge ’mbaake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase obosio bwao.

english: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart ; continually are they gathered together for war .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe ase chinkoro chiabo ime, baba bakona‐korwana esegi botambe.

english: Keep me, O LORD , from the hands of the wicked ; preserve me from the violent man ; who have purposed to overthrow my goings .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, indende korwa ase amaboko y’abakori amabe; intoorie korwa ase abanto abatindi, abwo barobeirie kobeeka ebigoocha ase ’ngoeta.

english: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords ; they have spread a net by the wayside ; they have set gins for me. Selah .
ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babeekire oboreba bobisi ase ’ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babeekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.

english: I said unto the LORD , Thou art my God : hear the voice of my supplications , O LORD .
ekegusii: Nateebirie Omonene: Aye Nyasae one, aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.

english: O GOD the Lord , the strength of my salvation , thou hast covered my head in the day of battle .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, Omonene, Omotooria one omokong’u, aye nigo ogotuba omotwe one ase engaki y’eseegi.

english: Grant not, O LORD , the desires of the wicked : further not his wicked device ; lest they exalt themselves. Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yaabo emebe, baabaise gwetogia.

english: As for the head of those that compass me about , let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
ekegusii: Totiga ababisa abwo bang’etananire babue, tiga obobe bw’amang’ana bagokwana bobairanere abanyene.

english: LORD , I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice , when I cry unto thee.
ekegusii: Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria, ayerera oche bwango! Tegerera oigwe eriogi riane ekero ’ngokorangeria.

english: Let the wicked fall into their own nets , whilst that I withal escape .
ekegusii: Tiga abakori amabe abwo bagwe ase ebichanga biabo abanyene, korende inche ’ntooreke.

english: Set a watch , O LORD , before my mouth ; keep the door of my lips .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, beeka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.

english: Incline not my heart to any evil thing , to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity : and let me not eat of their dainties .
ekegusii: Totiga enkoro yane egobere yanche amang’ana amabe. Tontiga inare gokora ayaare amabe amo nabwo bagokora ebibe; tingosanga amo nabarabwo ase emeyega.

english: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness : and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil , which shall not break my head : for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities .
ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.

english: When their judges are overthrown in stony places , they shall hear my words ; for they are sweet .
ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baabo baraturunkanigwe ase egetare, abanto ’mbaanche amang’ana aane ng’a n’amaya.

english: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth , as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth .
ekegusii: Amauga aito nigo asiareire ase egesieri + 141:7 egesieri: nerieta riikoro engencho yaye egesieri gose omogwa n’erieta riikoro engencho yaye egesieri gose omogwa bw’embeera, buna ebisamunye bie chiinko, gose ebi’amagena bigosiarerwa ase riroba igoro.

english: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord : in thee is my trust ; leave not my soul destitute .
ekegusii: Korende amaiso aane nigo arigereretie goocha asore, aye Omonene; naye ’ngotamera, tibwanga omoyo one.

english: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity .
ekegusii: Indende korwa ase emeeto bantegeire; na korwa ase amareba y’abakori amabe.

english: I cried unto the LORD with my voice ; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera neriogi ase ogokorangeri’Omonene, naaka eriogi ase okomosaba amaabera.

english: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorenta obokong’u bwane ase obosio bwaye na komoteebia emechando yane.

english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path . In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ’ngoetera. Agwo ase ’ngoeta ababisa bambeekeire amareba.

english: I looked on my right hand , and beheld , but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul .
ekegusii: Ekero ’nkorigereria ase ensemo yane y’okorio, tindi korora monto aroro ogonkonya; gose tindi korora aase ’ndatamere, monto onde tari okonyechaandera.

english: I cried unto thee, O LORD : I said , Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkorera asore; nigo ’ngoteeba: Naye ore obotamero bwane, na egetare kiane aiga ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.

english: Attend unto my cry ; for I am brought very low : deliver me from my persecutors ; for they are stronger than I.
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe ekerero kiane, ekiagera nachaandekire mono! Ntoorie korwa ase abanto abwo bagonchaanda, ekiagera nigo babwate chinguru kombua.

english: Bring my soul out of prison , that I may praise thy name : the righteous shall compass me about ; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
ekegusii: Osibore omoyo one korwa ase obosibwa, erinde imbe ’ngotogia erieta riao. Abanyene oboronge ’mbang’etanane, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya.

english: Hear my prayer , O LORD , give ear to my supplications : in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe ogosaba kwane; ase engencho y’oboronge bwao otegerere ogosorora kwane, ong’iranerie ase engencho y’obwegenwa bwao.

english: Teach me to do thy will ; for thou art my God : thy spirit is good ; lead me into the land of uprightness .
ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.

english: Quicken me, O LORD , for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’erieta riao; na ase engencho y’oboronge bwao rusia omoyo one korwa ase emechando.

english: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies , and destroy all them that afflict my soul : for I am thy servant .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; basirie kegima bonsi abagochaanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo.

english: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul ; he hath smitten my life down to the ground ; he hath made me to dwell in darkness , as those that have been long dead .
ekegusii: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.

english: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate .
ekegusii: Ase ayio omoika ore ime yane oborirwe chinguru, na enkoro yane yairianyekire.

english: I remember the days of old ; I meditate on all thy works ; I muse on the work of thy hands .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoinyora amatuko a kare, na korengereria igoro y’ogokora kwao gwonsi, naba ’nkona‐koiranerera emeremo y’amaboko ao.

english: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land . Selah .
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorambora amaboko aane goocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riroba rirang’ete embura.

english: Hear me speedily , O LORD : my spirit faileth : hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranerie bwango! Omoika ’nkong’erera ore! Tombisa obosio bwao mbaise koba buna abwo bakogeenda ase abakuure.

english: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning ; for in thee do I trust : cause me to know the way wherein I should walk ; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
ekegusii: Kera emambia omanyie obwanchani bwao bogenderere botambe, ekiagera naye ’nyegenete. Inyorokererie enchera ’ngwenerete kobwatia, ekiagera narure omoyo one asore.

english: Deliver me, O LORD , from mine enemies : I flee unto thee to hide me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.

english: Blessed be the LORD my strength , which teacheth my hands to war , and my fingers to fight :
ekegusii: Atogigwe Omonene, oyore egetare kiane; bworokereirie amaboko aane amanye korwana esegi, ne ebiara bimanye korwana.

english: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings : who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoa abarwoti obobui, naye gwatooretie Daudi, omosomba oo, korwa ase omoro bw’obobe.

english: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children , whose mouth speaketh vanity , and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood :
ekegusii: Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.

english: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth ; that our daughters may be as corner stones , polished after the similitude of a palace :
ekegusii: Tiga abamura baito ase oboke bwabo babe buna ebimeri biakinire bire ne’chinguru, na abaiseke baito babe buna ebisigisa bie chikoona bibaachire buya bikogwenera chinyomba chi’oborwoti.

english: That our garners may be full , affording all manner of store : that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets :
ekegusii: Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.

english: That our oxen may be strong to labour ; that there be no breaking in , nor going out ; that there be no complaining in our streets .
ekegusii: Tiga chiombe chiaito chibe ne’chinguru, ende tebaisa korekera, gose goochia bogima. Ekerero kende gionsi tikeba ase chinchera chiaito.

english: Happy is that people , that is in such a case : yea , happy is that people , whose God is the LORD .
ekegusii: Mbare n’omogooko abanto bakonyora ogosesenigwa okwo. Ee, ’mbare n’omogooko abanto abw’Omonene are Nyasae obo.

english: My goodness , and my fortress ; my high tower , and my deliverer ; my shield , and he in whom I trust ; who subdueth my people under me.
ekegusii: Ere nomwegenwa ase ’nde, naende norwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ’ngotamera, ekiagera nabeeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.

english: Man is like to vanity : his days are as a shadow that passeth away .
ekegusii: Omonto nigo are buna omooki, amatuko aye nigo anga buna omorengari ogoeta.

english: Bow thy heavens , O LORD , and come down : touch the mountains , and they shall smoke .
ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.

english: Cast forth lightning , and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows , and destroy them.
ekegusii: Mesia chinkoba chiao oserebanie ababisa, ruta chinsara chiao obasirie kegima!

english: Send thine hand from above ; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters , from the hand of strange children ;
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni,

english: Whose mouth speaketh vanity , and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood .
ekegusii: abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.

english: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God : upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogoteera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinge ikomi.

english: I will extol thee, my God , O king ; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one na omorwoti one, ninkobaake, nimbe ’ngotogia erieta riao goika kare na kare.

english: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD ; and thy saints shall bless thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ebitongwa biao bionsi nigo bikogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, na abachenu bao bonsi mbagotogie.

english: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom , and talk of thy power ;
ekegusii: Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oborwoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,

english: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts , and the glorious majesty of his kingdom .
ekegusii: bamanyie Mwanyabaanto ogokora kwao okonene, na obonene bw’ogosikwa kw’oborwoti bwao.

english: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations .
ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

english: The LORD upholdeth all that fall , and raiseth up all those that be bowed down .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.

english: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season .
ekegusii: Amaiso y’ebitongwa bionsi nigo akorigereretie nogosemeria, naye nigo okobia chindagera chiabo ase chingaki chigwenerete.

english: Thou openest thine hand , and satisfiest the desire of every living thing .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomaanora okoboko kwao, kwarua ebisio na goisanekia kera egetongwa kere moyo.

english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways , and holy in all his works .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, na omuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

english: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.

english: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry , and will save them.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.

english: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Kera rituko nimbe ’nkogotogia, nintogie erieta riao goika kare na kare.

english: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arendete bonsi abamwanchete; korende nasirie abakori amabe bonsi.

english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD : and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw’Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.

english: Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised ; and his greatness is unsearchable .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene, nagwenerete atogigwe mono; obonene bwaye tibokomanyekana buna bore.

english: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts .
ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.

english: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty , and of thy wondrous works .
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’obonene bwao bw’ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia.

english: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts : and I will declare thy greatness .
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe ’nkoraria obonene bwao.

english: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness , and shall sing of thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Mbararie chinkuma chi’obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.

english: The LORD is gracious , and full of compassion ; slow to anger , and of great mercy .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amaabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba n’endamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.

english: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase abanto bonsi, naende nigo are namaabera ase ebitongwa biaye bionsi.

english: Praise ye the LORD . Praise the LORD , O my soul .
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!

english: The LORD shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene nagambe goika kare na kare; aye Sayoni, Nyasae oo nagambere ebiaare bionsi.

english: While I live will I praise the LORD : I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
ekegusii: Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.

english: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria abagaambi, gose Mwanyabaanto abwo batanyaare gokonya kende.

english: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth ; in that very day his thoughts perish .
ekegusii: Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.

english: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the LORD his God :
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae o Yakobo are ogokonywa kwaye, oyio osemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oye,

english: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed : which giveth food to the hungry . The LORD looseth the prisoners :
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoa abwo bagokorerwa bobe oboronge bwabo, na abare nenchara nigo akobaa endagera. Omonene nigo agosibora abwo basibire.

english: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind : the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down : the LORD loveth the righteous :
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoramokia emeuko amaiso na kogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse. Omonene nigo anchete abanyaboronge.

english: The LORD preserveth the strangers ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenda abanto abageni, nigo akoa chintakana na ababoraka ogosemeria, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo agochisiria.

english: Praise ye the LORD : for it is good to sing praises unto our God ; for it is pleasant ; and praise is comely .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Nigo ere buya komoterera Nyasae oito ase okomotogia, ayio naro amaya mono na atogwenerete.

english: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .
ekegusii: Omonene tagokiri ne’chinguru chi’echibarasi, gose ase omoayerero bw’omonto,

english: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy .
ekegusii: korende nigo agokirie n’abanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.

english: Praise the LORD , O Jerusalem ; praise thy God , O Zion .
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, togia Omonene! Aye Sayoni, togia Nyasae oo!

english: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates ; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokong’ia emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino; nigo agosesenia abana bamenyete ime yao.

english: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeeka omorembe oba ase chimbebe chiao, naende nigo agoichoria engano ere engiya mono.

english: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth : his word runneth very swiftly .
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma amachiiko aye goocha ase ense, ne ring’ana riaye riaranda bwango.

english: He giveth snow like wool : he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amagena y’embura agwekaine amarionya amarabu, oyasiarera buna agosiara ribu.

english: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?
ekegusii: Nigo agosiarera amagena ayio buna amaemba enkomba. Ning’o oraremererie obokendu bwaye?

english: He sendeth out his word , and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow , and the waters flow .
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma ring’ana riaye, na amagena ayio amakendu anyititoke. Erio ogusia embeo amaache ageenda.

english: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyia abanto ba Yakobo ring’ana riaye, ee, Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye n’amachiiko aye.

english: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
ekegusii: Omonene naagache Yerusalemu naende, nasangererie amo Abaisraeli abwo baserebaanetigwe.

english: He hath not dealt so with any nation : and as for his judgments , they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!

english: He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .
ekegusii: Nigo akogwenia abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasionoirwe, na koboa amaote abo.

english: He telleth the number of the stars ; he calleth them all by their names .
ekegusii: Nigo amanyete omobaro bwe ching’enang’eni chionsi; boigo kera eyemo nigo ayerogete erieta.

english: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .
ekegusii: Omonene oito nigo are omonene mono, ne’chinguru chiaye nechinyinge; obong’aini bwaye tibokorengeka.

english: The LORD lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, korende abakori amabe nigo akobaiyeria inse.

english: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving ; sing praise upon the harp unto our God :
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano n’amariogi amaya!

english: Who covereth the heaven with clouds , who prepareth rain for the earth , who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotuba igoro n’amare, bwariganeria ense embura, nigo akomeria obonyansi ase ebitunwa.

english: He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .
ekegusii: Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yaabo, naende orageria amage y’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.

english: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the LORD from the heavens : praise him in the heights .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene korwa agwo igoro! Momotogie agwo igoro mono!

english: Beasts , and all cattle ; creeping things , and flying fowl :
ekegusii: nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!

english: Kings of the earth , and all people ; princes , and all judges of the earth :
ekegusii: Motogie inwe abarwoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagaambi na abanachi ebiina mwensi,

english: Both young men , and maidens ; old men , and children :
ekegusii: nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.

english: Let them praise the name of the LORD : for his name alone is excellent ; his glory is above the earth and heaven .
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi, togia erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera erieta riaye nario rioka rire rinene rikobakwa; obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine ense na igoro.

english: He also exalteth the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints ; even of the children of Israel , a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Omonene omeririe abanto baye ching’unchara, erinde abachenu baye bonsi bamotogie; ee, Abaisraeli abwo bare ang’e nere bamotogie! Motogie Omonene!

english: Praise ye him, all his angels : praise ye him, all his hosts .
ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika baye mwensi, motogie, nainwe emeganda yaye yonsi, motogie!

english: Praise ye him, sun and moon : praise him, all ye stars of light .
ekegusii: Aye risase, na aye omotienyi, motogie, nainwe ching’enang’eni chionsi chikobara, motogie.

english: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .
ekegusii: Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amaache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!

english: Let them praise the name of the LORD : for he commanded , and they were created .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio bionsi tiga bitogie erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera nere ochiigete, na ebio bigatongwa.

english: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever : he hath made a decree which shall not pass .
ekegusii: Omonene obibeekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibeekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.

english: Praise the LORD from the earth , ye dragons , and all deeps :
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!

english: Fire , and hail ; snow , and vapour ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :
ekegusii: Motogie, inwe omorero na amagena y’embura, na obokeng’entu, na amare, na aye omwaga omotindi ogoikerania aya achiigete!

english: Mountains , and all hills ; fruitful trees , and all cedars :
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, inwe ebitunwa na ebigoro bionsi, nainwe emete ekwama amatunda, na emecharake yonsi,

english: Praise ye the LORD . Sing unto the LORD a new song , and his praise in the congregation of saints .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Terera Omonene ogoteera okoyia, motogie ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto abegenwa.

english: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .
ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omorwoti obo!

english: Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .
ekegusii: Batogie erieta riaye ase ogotenga, babe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano.

english: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people : he will beautify the meek with salvation .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokirie n’abanto baye; abwo bare abaitongo nigo akobachabera ogotooreka.

english: Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .
ekegusii: Tiga abegenwa bachenge ase obonene, babe bagotera n’omogooko kobare ase amarere abo.

english: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth , and a twoedged sword in their hand ;
ekegusii: Tiga ogotogigwa okonene kwa Nyasae kobe ase emenwa yaabo, na ase amaboko abo babogorie emeyio ya birende ere nobwoge chinsemo ibere,

english: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people ;
ekegusii: erinde barusie egesiomba ase egesaku, na bae abanto egesusuro.

english: To bind their kings with chains , and their nobles with fetters of iron ;
ekegusii: Boigo banyaare gosiba abarwoti baabo nebinyuri, na abanene baabo ne chingataare chi’ekioma,

english: To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: erinde baabanachere ekiina keriikire. Obo nabwo obonene bw’abegenwa bonsi bw’Omonene. Motogie Omonene!

english: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men , to see if there were any that did understand , and seek God .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro, arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.

english: They are all gone aside , they are all together become filthy : there is none that doeth good , no, not one .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi basirire enchera, bonsi amo bagundire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge ? who eat up my people as they eat bread , and call not upon the LORD .
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeri’Omonene abakoonye.

english: There were they in great fear : for God is in the generation of the righteous .
ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto abwo mbasogwe nomoondoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo nabaanto abaronge.

english: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor , because the LORD is his refuge .
ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe nigo mogochaaya omooroberio bw’omonto otari na nguru, korende Omonene nere obotamero bwaye.

english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion ! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people , Jacob shall rejoice , and Israel shall be glad .
ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Omonene arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.
