english: Praise ye the LORD . Praise God in his sanctuary : praise him in the firmament of his power .
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!

english: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
ekegusii: Motogie ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okonene; motogie koreng’ana nobonene bwaye bore ne’chinguru chinyinge goetania!

english: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .
ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia ebitureeri; motogie ase okobugia amakano onsi!

english: Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia chinchigiri na gotenga; motogie ase okobugia amakano na ebiroria!

english: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .
ekegusii: Motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are inse; motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are igoro!

english: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .
ekegusii: Tiga ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo bitogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene!

english: LORD , who shall abide in thy tabernacle ? who shall dwell in thy holy hill ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’monto ki oranyare komenya ase obomenyo bwao? Ning’o oranyare komenya ase egetunwa kiao egechenu?

english: He that walketh uprightly , and worketh righteousness , and speaketh the truth in his heart .
ekegusii: Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang’ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay’ekeene,

english: He that backbiteth not with his tongue , nor doeth evil to his neighbour , nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour .
ekegusii: naende ere tari omogenki, omonto oyio tari gokorera monto onde bobe, gose tari gokwana onde bobe.

english: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned ; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD . He that sweareth to his own hurt , and changeth not.
ekegusii: Ere nigo achayete oyobwangire na Nyasae, korende osika abwo bamoirogete Omonene. Karire eira na gotiana tari koonchoka, nonya egochia komorentera obokong’u.

english: He that putteth not out his money to usury , nor taketh reward against the innocent . He that doeth these things shall never be moved .
ekegusii: Ekero akorua chitaabu chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira risoya, erio kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.

english: Preserve me, O God : for in thee do I put my trust .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, gaki ondende, ekiagera naye ngotamera.

english: O my soul , thou hast said unto the LORD , Thou art my Lord : my goodness extendeth not to thee;
ekegusii: Nigo ngoteebia Omonene iga: “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi ’nde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”

english: But to the saints that are in the earth , and to the excellent , in whom is all my delight .
ekegusii: Abanto abachenu bare ase ense nigo bare nobonene bokumete; abwo nabwo bangogeetie mono.

english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer , nor take up their names into my lips .
ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera chinyasae ching’ao, nigo bakwementera emechando. Tinkoumora okoruegwa kw’amanyinga okwo bakorua, gose tingwatora amarieta abo n’ebikoba biane.

english: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup : thou maintainest my lot .
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane; nere okong’a onsi aya ’ngwenerete konyora; ere igo arendete aya antungetie.

english: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage .
ekegusii: Ebintungetie biangwereire agwo aase are aagiya, ee, omwando one nigo ore omuya mono kegima.

english: I will bless the LORD , who hath given me counsel : my reins also instruct me in the night seasons .
ekegusii: Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egonteebereria gokora igo.

english: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand , I shall not be moved .
ekegusii: Botambe, nigo ndigereretie Omonene; ere nigo are ensemo yane y’okorio, igo tinkwoboa.

english: Therefore my heart is glad , and my glory rejoiceth : my flesh also shall rest in hope .
ekegusii: Ase igo, enkoro yane amo n’omoyo one nigo bire nomosasoko; nonya n’omobere one nigo omenyete ase ogosemeria.

english: Hear the right , O LORD , attend unto my cry , give ear unto my prayer , that goeth not out of feigned lips .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe okogania kwane kw’ogokorerwa oboronge, igwa okorera kwane na ogosaba kwane, omonwa one tori gokwana obong’ainereria.

english: They are inclosed in their own fat : with their mouth they speak proudly .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bare ne chinkoro chitari namaabera nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.

english: They have now compassed us in our steps : they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth ;
ekegusii: Bono bang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi; banaaririe, erinde bambwate na konyiyeria inse.

english: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey , and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna endo eganetie orotwari; buna endo ensae eboete ase egesarara.

english: Arise , O LORD , disappoint him , cast him down : deliver my soul from the wicked , which is thy sword :
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki imoka! Orwanie ababisa baane obabue! Ntoorie korwa ase abakori amabe ase okobarwania n’omoro oo.

english: From men which are thy hand , O LORD , from men of the world , which have their portion in this life , and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children , and leave the rest of their substance to their babes .
ekegusii: Ee, Omonene, ntoorie nokoboko kwao korwa ase abanto abwo. Barabwo nabaanto b’ense eye, egetari kiabo neki’obogima obo. Chinda chiabo chiisaneke n’ebinto ebio kwabagacheire, biisane nase abana babo, naende abachokoro babo batigerwe ebiatigaire.

english: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness : I shall be satisfied , when I awake , with thy likeness .
ekegusii: Korende inche nindore obosio bwao inde noboronge; ekero ndabokigwe ning’isaneke ase ogokorora.

english: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence ; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal .
ekegusii: Aye omonyene onachere ekiina gi’okong’a oboronge, amaiso ao nigo akorora ayare ay’ekeene.

english: Thou hast proved mine heart ; thou hast visited me in the night ; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna-unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.

english: Concerning the works of men , by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer .
ekegusii: Mang’ana ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.

english: Hold up my goings in thy paths , that my footsteps slip not.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chiao botambe; amagoro aane tana-gotererigwa.

english: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God : incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech .
ekegusii: Nyasae, nigo ngokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ekiagera aye nong’itabere; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokoboria.

english: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness , O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them .
ekegusii: Aye Omotooria bw’abagotamera okoboko kwao kwa borio korwa ase ababisa babo, oorokia obwanchani bwao bw’ogokumia.

english: Keep me as the apple of the eye , hide me under the shadow of thy wings ,
ekegusii: Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao;

english: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies , who compass me about .
ekegusii: mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.

english: I will love thee, O LORD , my strength .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!

english: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind .
ekegusii: Akariina egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, akairuruka, agacha ng’ora igoro ye chimbaaba chi’embeo.

english: He made darkness his secret place ; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies .
ekegusii: Agakora omosunte koba egietubo kiaye ere omonyenye, na amare amarito aichire amaache.

english: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed , hail stones and coals of fire .
ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka-meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigasoka goetera ase amare aye.

english: The LORD also thundered in the heavens , and the Highest gave his voice ; hail stones and coals of fire .
ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro; na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa; amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigacha.

english: Yea, he sent out his arrows , and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings , and discomfited them.
ekegusii: Akaruta emegwe yaye, agaserebania ababisa baye; akamesia chinkoba, akabatantania.

english: Then the channels of waters were seen , and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke , O LORD , at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils .
ekegusii: Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na amaroso ’ense akaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase ogwoka kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.

english: He sent from above , he took me, he drew me out of many waters .
ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amange.

english: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase omobisa one ore ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.

english: He brought me forth also into a large place ; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
ekegusii: Akang’ira aase arenge aagare; agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.

english: The LORD is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer ; my God , my strength , in whom I will trust ; my buckler , and the horn of my salvation , and my high tower .
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane y’ogokumia, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane ’ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bw’echinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong’u.

english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness ; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omooronge, nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.

english: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkorenda amachiiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echiikire.

english: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omoikeranu asare, nkerenda korwa ase obobe.

english: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness , according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight .
ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.

english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful ; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright ;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa, nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.

english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure ; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu; nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.

english: For thou wilt save the afflicted people ; but wilt bring down high looks .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende abwo bare namaiso ’oboenenu nigo okobairania inse.

english: For thou wilt light my candle : the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness .
ekegusii: Ee, naye ogontongeria etaya yane; Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo akomoreka omosunte ore asende oba oborabu.

english: For by thee I have run through a troop ; and by my God have I leaped over a wall .
ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi; na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.

english: I will call upon the LORD , who is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies .
ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.

english: As for God , his way is perfect : the word of the LORD is tried : he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu, amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.

english: It is God that girdeth me with strength , and maketh my way perfect .
ekegusii: Nyasae nere okomboyia chinguru na kondenda ase enchera yane.

english: He teacheth my hands to war , so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .
ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gotinga obota bw’etai.

english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation : and thy right hand hath holden me up , and thy gentleness hath made me great .
ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.

english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip .
ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.

english: I have pursued mine enemies , and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed .
ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabaikeera inchera; gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.

english: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise : they are fallen under my feet .
ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.

english: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle : thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.

english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid .
ekegusii: Obororo bw’amakweri bokong’etanana, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.

english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies ; that I might destroy them that hate me.
ekegusii: Ogakora ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende; abangechete nkabasiria kegima.

english: They cried , but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakarera ng’a bakonywe, korende onde tarenge obatooretie, bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.

english: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind : I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets .
ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.

english: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people ; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen : a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabaanto, kwambekire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.

english: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
ekegusii: Ekero baigure chinkuma chiane nigo bakonyigwera; abamenyi nigo bagocha bebeka inse yane.

english: The strangers shall fade away , and be afraid out of their close places .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.

english: The LORD liveth ; and blessed be my rock ; and let the God of my salvation be exalted .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane aimokererigwe igoro.

english: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.

english: He delivereth me from mine enemies : yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.

english: Great deliverance giveth he to his king ; and sheweth mercy to his anointed , to David , and to his seed for evermore .
ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omorwoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye. Inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.

english: In my distress I called upon the LORD , and cried unto my God : he heard my voice out of his temple , and my cry came before him, even into his ears .
ekegusii: Ase emechando yane nkarangeri’Omonene, nkarera ase Nyasae one ng’a ankonye. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.

english: Then the earth shook and trembled ; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken , because he was wroth .
ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso ’ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.

english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down : and darkness was under his feet .
ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, agacha; riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.

english: The heavens declare the glory of God ; and the firmament sheweth his handywork .
ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae; na eaanga ya igoro eraria emeremo y’amaboko aye.

english: More to be desired are they than gold , yea, than much fine gold : sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb .
ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.

english: Moreover by them is thy servant warned : and in keeping of them there is great reward .
ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo ogokuurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene y’obuya.

english: Who can understand his errors ? cleanse thou me from secret faults .
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.

english: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright , and I shall be innocent from the great transgression .
ekegusii: Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi’obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.

english: Let the words of my mouth , and the meditation of my heart , be acceptable in thy sight , O LORD , my strength , and my redeemer .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Egetare kiane na Omobooria one, anchera amang’ana aane na ebirengererio bire ase enkoro yane.

english: Day unto day uttereth speech , and night unto night sheweth knowledge .
ekegusii: Rituko erimo riatebia erinde obonene obo, na obotuko obomo bwarareria obotuko bonde ayio ayio.

english: There is no speech nor language , where their voice is not heard .
ekegusii: Chinkwana chinde tichiri aroro, gose omonwa onde ogokwanwa tori, na eriogi riabo tiriri koigugwa.

english: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber , and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race .
ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonywomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.

english: His going forth is from the end of the heaven , and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
ekegusii: Nigo rigosoka korwa ensemo eyemo ya igoro, naende riekumba riagenda gochia ensemo ende; gento kende tikeri gekobisekana korwa ase riberera riaye. Amachiiko y’Omonene

english: The law of the LORD is perfect , converting the soul : the testimony of the LORD is sure , making wise the simple .
ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekeene, nigo akong’ainiyia oyotamanyeti amange.

english: The statutes of the LORD are right , rejoicing the heart : the commandment of the LORD is pure , enlightening the eyes .
ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaronge, nigo akogokia enkoro; ring’an’Omonene achiikire nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.

english: The fear of the LORD is clean , enduring for ever : the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether .
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.

english: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, n’otari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose otari gosanga amo nabwo bagochecheria.

english: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
ekegusii: Korende richiko ri’Omonene nigo rikomogokia mono, na okorengereria kwaye gwonsi nigo kore ase richiko erio, omobaso na obotuko.

english: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.

english: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abakori amabe tibagocha gwekengera ase rituko ri’ekiina, gose abanyabibe tibagosangererekana amo n’abanyene oboronge.

english: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoraa enchera y’abanyene oboronge, korende enchera y’abakori amabe nesire.

english: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble ; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y’emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.

english: Send thee help from the sanctuary , and strengthen thee out of Zion ;
ekegusii: Ere nagotomere ogokonywa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, na akoe chinguru korwa ase Sayoni.

english: Remember all thy offerings , and accept thy burnt sacrifice ; Selah .
ekegusii: Tiga ainyore okorua kwao gwonsi, anche na kogokera ebing’wanso biao bionsi bi’ogosambwa.

english: Grant thee according to thine own heart , and fulfil all thy counsel .
ekegusii: Tiga akoe okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aikeranie emeroberio yao yonsi.

english: We will rejoice in thy salvation , and in the name of our God we will set up our banners : the LORD fulfil all thy petitions .
ekegusii: Erio toake amariogi yomogooko ase engencho y’obobui bwao, toimokererie igoro ebendera y’erieta ria Nyasae oito! Tiga Omonene aikeranie okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo.

english: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed ; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand .
ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nae omoakwa amaguta oye obobui, namoiranerie korwa aase aye aachenu aaria igoro, namoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

english: Some trust in chariots , and some in horses : but we will remember the name of the LORD our God .
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi’esegi, na abande chibarasi chi’esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito.

english: They are brought down and fallen : but we are risen , and stand upright .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baragochwe bagwe inse korende intwe nigo toragororoke totenene boronge.

english: Save , LORD : let the king hear us when we call .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kae omorwoti oo gwachorire obobui; otoiranerie ekero togokorangeria!

english: The king shall joy in thy strength , O LORD ; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice !
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omorwoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.

english: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth , and their seed from among the children of men .
ekegusii: Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase Mwanyabaanto.

english: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device , which they are not able to perform .
ekegusii: Kobarabe bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora bobe, gose korengereria chinchera chi’okorenta emechando, tibakobua,

english: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back , when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
ekegusii: ekiagera nobaserie batame, nobarenge emegwe ase amasio abo.

english: Be thou exalted , LORD , in thine own strength : so will we sing and praise thy power .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene otogigwe ase engencho ye chinguru chiao, intwe ntobe togotera ogoteera kw’ogotogia okobua kwao.

english: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire , and hast not withholden the request of his lips . Selah .
ekegusii: Kwamoeire okogania gw’enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.

english: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness : thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head .
ekegusii: Aye kwamorenteire ogosesenigwa okuya; kwamobekeire egutwa y’etaabu echenire ase omotwe oye.

english: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Akagosaba ng’a omoe obogima, naye okabomoa; okamoa amatuko amange amenye kogenderera botambe.

english: His glory is great in thy salvation : honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
ekegusii: Amasikani ’omorwoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.

english: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever : thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance .
ekegusii: Ee, kwamokorire koba ogoseseneka gwa kare na kare, kwamogokeire, ekiagera ore amo nere botambe.

english: For the king trusteth in the LORD , and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved .
ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.

english: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies : thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omorwoti, noikeere ababisa bao bonsi; nobwate nokoboko kwao gw’okorio abwo bakogechete.

english: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger : the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath , and the fire shall devour them.
ekegusii: Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.

english: I was cast upon thee from the womb : thou art my God from my mother’s belly .
ekegusii: Nigo narutetwe asore korwa ase okoiborwa kwane, na korwa ekero narenge ase enda ya baba naye kwarenge Nyasae one.

english: Be not far from me; for trouble is near ; for there is none to help .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende, ekiagera emechando nigo ere ange, na monto onde tari orankonye.

english: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round .
ekegusii: Chieri chinyinge nching’etanaine, ee, chieri chiria chia Basani chire ne chinguru nigo ching’etanaine.

english: They gaped upon me with their mouths , as a ravening and a roaring lion .
ekegusii: Baasamirie emenwa yabo gocha asende, yabeire buna chindo chikoronya na koruma.

english: I am poured out like water , and all my bones are out of joint : my heart is like wax ; it is melted in the midst of my bowels .
ekegusii: Nabeire buna amaache aiteirwe ’nse; amauga onsi ay’omobere one atengokire na achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.

english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd ; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws ; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death .
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chiang’ereire, omoyo one bwomire pa buna ekegonkorio, oromeme rwane rwabwatanire namang’ang’ura; aye kwanyareirie ase amaroba nkwete.

english: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bang’etanaine korwa kera aase, ee, nigo bang’etanaine korwa chinsemo chionsi buna ekeombe gie chisese; bambetire ebisanyi bi’amaboko, na ebi’amagoro boigo.

english: I may tell all my bones : they look and stare upon me.
ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongororokire nabo ’nkoyabara; abanto nigo bakondigereria na kogokera obobe bwane.

english: But be not thou far from me, O LORD : O my strength , haste thee to help me.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, koranche, ayerera onkonye!

english: O my God , I cry in the daytime , but thou hearest not; and in the night season , and am not silent .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one! Nigo nkorera botuko bokia, korende tori kong’iraneria; nase obotuko boigo, korende tindi konyora ogotimoka.

english: Deliver my soul from the sword ; my darling from the power of the dog .
ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase omoro bw’amakweri, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!

english: Save me from the lion’s mouth : for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns .
ekegusii: Ntoorie, ondusie ase emenwa ye chindo chiria; nkonya korwa ase ching’unchara chie ching’era!

english: Ye that fear the LORD , praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob , glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel .
ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie! Inwe mwensi ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, togia obonene bwaye! Inwe Abaisraeli bonsi, moiroke!

english: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted ; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard .
ekegusii: Omonene tari gochaaya emechando y’abwo bachandegete, gose koyegecha, gose tabiseti obosio bwaye korwa ase bare; korende ekero bamorangeretie nigo abaigwete.

english: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation : I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nde ase omosangererekano omonene ningotogie. Chiira nariete ning’ikeranie agwo ase obosio bw’abaanto bamoirogete Omonene.

english: The meek shall eat and be satisfied : they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever .
ekegusii: Abwo bare abaitongo mbanyore endagera barie baigote. Abanto bakorigia Omonene mbabe bakomotogia, ne chinkoro chiaino nchigenderere koba moyo goika kare na kare.

english: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD : and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
ekegusii: Abanto b’echinsemo chionsi chi’ense mbainyore Omonene, bamoonchokere; chiamate chionsi chi’ebisaku nchimosasime.

english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s : and he is the governor among the nations .
ekegusii: Omogambi Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.

english: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship : all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul .
ekegusii: Ee, abanto abatenenku bonsi bare ase ense goika batung’ame ase obosio bw’Omonene, abwo bonsi bakogenda ase chimbeera ime mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nabwo batanyare korenda obogima bwabo bogenderere.

english: But thou art holy , O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; obonene nobwao, naye ogotogigwa n’Abaisraeli.

english: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbabe bakomokorera; mbabe bagokwana igoro y’Omonene ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha.

english: They shall come , and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born , that he hath done this .
ekegusii: Oboronge bwaye mbobe bokorarigwa ase abanto bataraiborwa, ng’a ere oikeranirie onsi.

english: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted , and thou didst deliver them.
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.

english: They cried unto thee, and were delivered : they trusted in thee, and were not confounded .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barerete asore, bakanyora ogotooreka, nigo babete bagosemeretie, na tibasoogetigwe.

english: But I am a worm , and no man ; a reproach of men , and despised of the people .
ekegusii: Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa na gochaywa n’abanto.

english: But thou art he that took me out of the womb : thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts .
ekegusii: Omonene, naye kwandusetie ase enda ya baba; naye kwabete gokondenda buya ase amaboko a baba.

english: The LORD is my shepherd ; I shall not want .
ekegusii: Omonene nomorisia one, tinkoremerwa kende,

english: He restoreth my soul : he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokora omoyo one koba omoyia na kondaa ase chinchera chiaye chia boronge, ase engencho y’erieta riaye.

english: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death , I will fear no evil : for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
ekegusii: Ninsa goeta ase omwenya bw’ekiriri ki’amakweri, tinkoiroka bobe bonde, ekiagera aye Omonene nigo ore amo nainche, enyimbo yao na enungu yao nabindemie.

english: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies : thou anointest my head with oil ; my cup runneth over .
ekegusii: Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio ’ababisa baane; kwang’akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.

english: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life : and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever .
ekegusii: Ekeene, obuya na obwanchani botari koera nabintunyane amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane; nainche nimenye ase enyomba y’Omonene goika kare na kare.

english: Who is this King of glory ? The LORD of hosts , he is the King of glory . Selah .
ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere n’Omorwoti bw’Obonene.

english: For he hath founded it upon the seas , and established it upon the floods .
ekegusii: Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong’ia igoro ase chindooche.

english: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD ? or who shall stand in his holy place ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa kia Omonene? Ning’o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?

english: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD , and righteousness from the God of his salvation .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.

english: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face , O Jacob . Selah .
ekegusii: Naboigo ekegori ki’abakomorigia kere; abwo bakorigia barore obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.

english: Lift up your heads , O ye gates ; and be ye lift up , ye everlasting doors ; and the King of glory shall come in .
ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emekorogoto yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!

english: Who is this King of glory ? The LORD strong and mighty , the LORD mighty in battle .
ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene ore ne chinguru na okobua, ere Omonene, omobui ase chiseegi.

english: Lift up your heads , O ye gates ; even lift them up , ye everlasting doors ; and the King of glory shall come in .
ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emetwe yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!

english: Unto thee, O LORD , do I lift up my soul .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngocha nde asore nomoyo one bwonsi.

english: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies .
ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’ Omonene nigo chire echi’obwanchani, na echi’obwegenwa, ase abwo barendete okobwatana kwaye na oborori bwaye.

english: For thy name’s sake, O LORD , pardon mine iniquity ; for it is great .
ekegusii: Omonene, ase engencho y’erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.

english: What man is he that feareth the LORD ? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose .
ekegusii: Kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, eri’Omonene amworokereria enchera agwenerete gochora.

english: His soul shall dwell at ease ; and his seed shall inherit the earth .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagenderere gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.

english: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omosani bw’abaanto bamoirogete, nigo akobamanyia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

english: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD ; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net .
ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkoba imorigereretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.

english: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted .
ekegusii: Aye omonene, ing’iranere ondorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo inde inche bweka, naende nchandegete.

english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged : O bring thou me out of my distresses .
ekegusii: Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong’u bwane,

english: Look upon mine affliction and my pain ; and forgive all my sins .
ekegusii: ndigererie orore obororo bwane na ogochandwa kwane, na onyabere ebibe biane bionsi.

english: Consider mine enemies ; for they are many ; and they hate me with cruel hatred .
ekegusii: Rora ababisa baane bonsi buna bare abange; na buna bangechete nobotindi obonge.

english: O my God , I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed , let not mine enemies triumph over me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, naye nsemeretie, tontiga nsookigwe; totiga ababisa baane bagokere okobugwa kwane.

english: O keep my soul , and deliver me: let me not be ashamed ; for I put my trust in thee.
ekegusii: Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.

english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
ekegusii: Tiga obwegenwa na oboronge bindende, ekiagera naye nsemeretie.

english: Redeem Israel , O God , out of all his troubles .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

english: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed : let them be ashamed which transgress without cause .
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogosemeretie totiga asookigwe; korende abwo batigire obwegenwa engencho ende etaiyo basookigwe.

english: Shew me thy ways , O LORD ; teach me thy paths .
ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.

english: Lead me in thy truth , and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation ; on thee do I wait all the day .
ekegusii: Ondaae ase ekeene kiao na onyorokererie, ekiagera aye Nyasae nogotooreka kwane, aye nigo ngosemeretie.

english: Remember , O LORD , thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses ; for they have been ever of old .
ekegusii: Omonene, inyora amaabera ao na obwanchani bwao botari koera, ekiagera nao biarenge korwa kare.

english: Remember not the sins of my youth , nor my transgressions : according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tobaisa koinyora ebibe na ogosaria bi’obosae bwane; ong’inyore ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase engencho y’obuya bwao.

english: Good and upright is the LORD : therefore will he teach sinners in the way .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

english: The meek will he guide in judgment : and the meek will he teach his way .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoraa abanto bare abaitongo ase enchera endonge, naende aborokereria komanya enchera yaye.

english: Judge me, O LORD ; for I have walked in mine integrity : I have trusted also in the LORD ; therefore I shall not slide .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a oboronge bwane; ekiagera nabeire ntari na komocha; naboigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene ntari ne chitang’u‐tang’u.

english: In whose hands is mischief , and their right hand is full of bribes .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio y’obonyaka, na amaboko abo a borio nigo aichire namaaki.

english: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity : redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde norogendo rotari na komocha; indorere amaabera na omboorie.

english: My foot standeth in an even place : in the congregations will I bless the LORD .
ekegusii: Amagoro aane nigo agotenena aase ateremu; nintogie Omonene ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.

english: Examine me, O LORD , and prove me; try my reins and my heart .
ekegusii: Omonene, inteeme na ondenge; orenge enkoro yane na ebirengererio biane.

english: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes : and I have walked in thy truth .
ekegusii: Nigo ndigereretie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe na gotaara ase obwegenwa bwao.

english: I have not sat with vain persons , neither will I go in with dissemblers .
ekegusii: Tindi gosanga nabanyaborimo, gose tindi kogosoria nabang’ainereria.

english: I have hated the congregation of evil doers ; and will not sit with the wicked .
ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabaanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabaanto abakayayu.

english: I will wash mine hands in innocency : so will I compass thine altar , O LORD :
ekegusii: Nigo ngoisaba amaboko aane ase okoorokia ng’a tindi na komocha, erio naetanana egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene,

english: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving , and tell of all thy wondrous works .
ekegusii: imba ngoteera neriogi rinene gokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na koraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

english: LORD , I have loved the habitation of thy house , and the place where thine honour dwelleth .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nyanchete obomenyo bwao, aase obonene bwao bore.

english: Gather not my soul with sinners , nor my life with bloody men :
ekegusii: Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.

english: The LORD is my light and my salvation ; whom shall I fear ? the LORD is the strength of my life ; of whom shall I be afraid ?
ekegusii: Omonene nere omobaso one, na ogotooreka kwane, ning’o ndanyare koiroka? Omonene nere eburi ekengerete obogima bwane, monto ki ndanyare kwoboa?

english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up .
ekegusii: Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.

english: Teach me thy way , O LORD , and lead me in a plain path , because of mine enemies .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao; indaae ong’eterie aase ateremu, ntooreke korwa ase ababisa baane.

english: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies : for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kondua ase ababisa baane bankore buna banchete; birori b’oborimo banyimokeire, bagontianera nobotindi.

english: I had fainted , unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living .
ekegusii: Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’ Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.

english: Wait on the LORD : be of good courage , and he shall strengthen thine heart : wait , I say, on the LORD .
ekegusii: Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!

english: When the wicked , even mine enemies and my foes , came upon me to eat up my flesh , they stumbled and fell .
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakong’umokera ng’a bamere, ababisa baane abwo bangechete nigo baragochwe na kogwa.

english: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear : though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident .
ekegusii: Neba omoganda omonene bw’esegi ong’etananire, enkoro yane tekoba nobwoba; gose abanto nabachicha kondwania esegi, inche nigo ndagenderere koba noboremu.

english: One thing have I desired of the LORD , that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life , to behold the beauty of the LORD , and to enquire in his temple .
ekegusii: Nasabire ring’ana erimo korwa ase Omonene. Erio nario nganetie: Imenye ase enyomba y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane, erinde ndore oboseera bw’Omonene na kona‐koboiranerera ase Hekalu yaye.

english: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion : in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock .
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emechando nantube ase ekiriri kiaye; nambise ase eema yaye ime, Nanyimokie ambeke ase egetare igoro.

english: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy ; I will sing , yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD .
ekegusii: Ninyimokererigwa igoro ase ababisa baane bang’etanaine. Ase eema yaye ime nindue ebing’wanso inde nomochengo; ninterere Omonene na komotogia.

english: Hear , O LORD , when I cry with my voice : have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe okorera kwane, indorere amaabera na oiranerie ogosaba kwane.

english: When thou saidst , Seek ye my face ; my heart said unto thee, Thy face , LORD , will I seek .
ekegusii: Aye gwatebire: “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogoteebia: “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”

english: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger : thou hast been my help ; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one ore ogotooreka kwane, tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende; tontiga kore nendamwamu. Aye kwabeire kogonkonya botambe, tontuguta gose tontiga.

english: Unto thee will I cry , O LORD my rock ; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, egetare kiane, naye nkorangeria, tibwanga konyigwa. Oise gokira, inche nigo ndabe oyomo bw’abakogenda ase chimbeera.

english: Hear the voice of my supplications , when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle .
ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane, ekero nkorera asore onkonye, ekero ndamborete amaboko aane igoro gocha ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

english: Draw me not away with the wicked , and with the workers of iniquity , which speak peace to their neighbours , but mischief is in their hearts .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gonsiria amo nabakori amabe na abasaria, abanto abagokwana amang’ana yo omorembe nabaanto bande, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo baabagechete.

english: Because they regard not the works of the LORD , nor the operation of his hands , he shall destroy them, and not build them up .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.

english: Blessed be the LORD , because he hath heard the voice of my supplications .
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Ere oigure okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo.

english: The LORD is my strength and my shield ; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped : therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth ; and with my song will I praise him.
ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane na enguba yane; nere nsemeretie ase enkoro yane, ere nankonyete. Ase ayio ninde nomosasoko ase enkoro yane; nimbe nkomoterera na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

english: The LORD is their strength , and he is the saving strength of his anointed .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.

english: Save thy people , and bless thine inheritance : feed them also, and lift them up for ever .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tooria abanto bao abare omwando oo, obe omorisia obo, obabogorie goika kare na kare.

english: The LORD sitteth upon the flood ; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kogambera chioora; Omonene nere omorwoti ase ekerogo kiaye kare na kare.

english: The LORD will give strength unto his people ; the LORD will bless his people with peace .
ekegusii: Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.

english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name ; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness .
ekegusii: Togia erieta ri’Omonene rire nobonene obonge; mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu.

english: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters : the God of glory thundereth : the LORD is upon many waters .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka ase chinyancha igoro; Nyasae bw’obonene nigo agoaka enkoba, Omonene nigo akogukura igoro ye chinyancha chinyinge.

english: The voice of the LORD is powerful ; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka rire nokobua; eriogi ri’Omonene nigo riichire nobonene.

english: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars ; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikobuna emete emecharake, ee, nigo rikobuna emecharake ya Lebanoni.

english: He maketh them also to skip like a calf ; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn .
ekegusii: Nigo agotira‐tiria emete eyio buna emori egotiria, na ebitunwa bia Lebanoni na Sirioni + 29:6 Sirioni: nakio Herimoni buna eng’era ensae.

english: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikomesia chinsase chi’omorero.

english: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness ; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh .
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rigotengechia erooro; ee, nigo rigotengechia erooro ya Kadeshi.

english: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve , and discovereth the forests : and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory .
ekegusii: Eriogi erio ri’Omonene nigo rikorekeria chingabi, nigo rigosabora emete y’amanani yaba bosa. Ase Hekalu yaye ebitongwa bionsi biatogia obonene bwaye.

english: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings : be instructed , ye judges of the earth .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarwoti, mobe abang’aini, inwe abagaambi b’ense, igwera ogokuurerwa oko:

english: Serve the LORD with fear , and rejoice with trembling .
ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nobwoba na okoiguswa.

english: Kiss the Son , lest he be angry , and ye perish from the way , when his wrath is kindled but a little . Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
ekegusii: Tugama inse na kworokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.

english: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together , against the LORD , and against his anointed , saying ,
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagaambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Omoakwa Amaguta oye.

english: Let us break their bands asunder , and cast away their cords from us.
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Tobutore ebisibo biabo, totugute chingori chiabo batosiberete!”

english: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
ekegusii: Omonene oria oikaransete aaria igoro, nigo agoseka na kobachecheria.

english: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath , and vex them in his sore displeasure .
ekegusii: Erio nabatogonyere ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteeba:

english: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion .
ekegusii: “Nabeekire omorwoti one ase Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu.”

english: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
ekegusii: Omborie, na inche ninkoe ebisaku bionsi bibe omwando oo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’ense nchibe echiao.

english: I will extol thee, O LORD ; for thou hast lifted me up , and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ningotogie, ekiagera kwanyimokirie korwa inse, tigwatigete ababisa baane betogie igoro yane.

english: Hear , O LORD , and have mercy upon me: LORD , be thou my helper .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amaabera! Omonene, inkonye!

english: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing : thou hast put off my sackcloth , and girded me with gladness ;
ekegusii: Aye kwaonchoire omoichano one okaba omochengo; kwandusirie eanga y’emechando, kwambekeire ey’omogooko.

english: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent . O LORD my God , I will give thanks unto thee for ever .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.

english: O LORD my God , I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
ekegusii: Aye, Omonene Nyasae one, nigo narerete asore ng’a onkonye, na bono kwangwenirie.

english: O LORD , thou hast brought up my soul from the grave : thou hast kept me alive , that I should not go down to the pit .
ekegusii: Omonene, gwatooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure kwang’iraneirie obogima tingenda ase oboina ime.

english: Sing unto the LORD , O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
ekegusii: Inwe abachenu baye, tera amatera ay’okobaka Omonene, iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

english: For his anger endureth but a moment ; in his favour is life : weeping may endure for a night , but joy cometh in the morning .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoba nendamwamu ase engaki ensinini yoka, korende obuya bwaye nigo bokoba ase obogima bw’omonto. Ekerero nabo keranyare kobao ase omogoroba, korende mambia omogooko na omochengo nigo bigocha.

english: And in my prosperity I said , I shall never be moved .
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng’a tinkobugwa.

english: LORD , by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong : thou didst hide thy face , and I was troubled .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho y’obuya bwao ogakora egetunwa kiane kegatenena bokong’u, korende ekero kwabisete obosio bwao nkaba nobwoba.

english: I cried to thee, O LORD ; and unto the LORD I made supplication .
ekegusii: Erio nkarera asore, aye Omonene, ngakoboria ase oboitongo:

english: What profit is there in my blood , when I go down to the pit ? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth ?
ekegusii: Mbitoki ki aye oranyore onye ngokwa na gosoa ase oboina ime? Inee! Orotu rw’amaroba ndonyare kogotogia? Ndonyare koraria obwegenwa bwao?

english: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust ; let me never be ashamed : deliver me in thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

english: For my life is spent with grief , and my years with sighing : my strength faileth because of mine iniquity , and my bones are consumed .
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga yomobere one omire pa.

english: I was a reproach among all mine enemies , but especially among my neighbours , and a fear to mine acquaintance : they that did see me without fled from me.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi nigo bagonchecheria, na abasani baane boigo. Abanto baamanyete banyoboire; bonsi abakondora ase enchera nigo bagontama.

english: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind : I am like a broken vessel .
ekegusii: Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okuure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.

english: For I have heard the slander of many : fear was on every side : while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life .
ekegusii: Nigo nkoigwa ababisa baane bakomonyererana; okogosa nigo kong’etanaine. Abwo nigo bagosangererekana amo kogamba, bagokora omooroberio bw’okong’ita.

english: But I trusted in thee, O LORD : I said , Thou art my God .
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteeba: “Aye naye Nyasae one.”

english: My times are in thy hand : deliver me from the hand of mine enemies , and from them that persecute me.
ekegusii: Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.

english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant : save me for thy mercies’ sake.
ekegusii: Ing’onchorere obosio bwao, inche omosomba oo, ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

english: Let me not be ashamed , O LORD ; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed , and let them be silent in the grave .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tontiga nsookigwe, ekiagera nigo ngokorangeria. Tiga abakori amabe basookigwe, bagende aase abakuure babe amamama.

english: Let the lying lips be put to silence ; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous .
ekegusii: Kiria emenwa yabwo bagokwana amang’ana ’oborimo, abwo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro y’oyore omooronge, na gokwana amang’ana yoboenenu na ay’ogochaaya.

english: Oh how great is thy goodness , which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men !
ekegusii: Naki obuya bwao bore obonge na obw’ogokumigwa, obwo kwagacheire abanto abakoirogete, ase amasio a Mwanyabaanto nigo okoboorokia ase abakogotamera.

english: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily : be thou my strong rock , for an house of defence to save me.
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong’u, na ontoorie!

english: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man : thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues .
ekegusii: Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.

english: Blessed be the LORD : for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city .
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Nigo anyorogetie obwanchani bwaye bw’ogokumia; akandenda ase omochie omokong’u.

english: For I said in my haste , I am cut off from before thine eyes : nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobwoba nigo narengereretie, ngateeba; “Bono naserigwe gochia aare korwa ase obosio bwao!” Korende nigo kwaigwete okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, ekero narerete asore ng’a onkonye.

english: O love the LORD , all ye his saints : for the LORD preserveth the faithful , and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer .
ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, inwe abachenu baye mwensi! Omonene nigo akobarenda buya abanto bare abegenwa, korende nigo akorua egesusuro ase oyore omomwenu.

english: Be of good courage , and he shall strengthen your heart , all ye that hope in the LORD .
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi aba momosemeretie Omonene, kabe ne chinguru, mobe abaremu!

english: For thou art my rock and my fortress ; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
ekegusii: Aye naye egetare kiane na eburi yane; ase engencho y’erieta riao ondaae na kondenda.

english: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength .
ekegusii: Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.

english: I have hated them that regard lying vanities : but I trust in the LORD .
ekegusii: Nigo ngechete abanto bagosasiima emegwekano ere bosa, korende nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene.

english: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy : for thou hast considered my trouble ; thou hast known my soul in adversities ;
ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.

english: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy : thou hast set my feet in a large room .
ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko ’omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.

english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD , for I am in trouble : mine eye is consumed with grief , yea , my soul and my belly .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ndorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.

english: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked : but he that trusteth in the LORD , mercy shall compass him about.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nare namaakwa amange, korende oyomosemeretie Omonene, Omonene nigo amoetananeretie nobwanchani botari koera.

english: Be glad in the LORD , and rejoice , ye righteous : and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart .
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogooko.

english: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity , and in whose spirit there is no guile .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyi’Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.

english: When I kept silence , my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.

english: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer . Selah .
ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amaache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.

english: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid . I said , I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD ; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin . Selah .
ekegusii: Erio ngakoorokeria ebibe biane, gose tinakobisete okomocha kwane, ngateeba: “Nimoorokerie Omonene ogosaria kwane,” erio okanyabera ebibe biane bionsi.

english: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found : surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kera omonto oyokoirogete tiga agosabe ase engaki y’emechando. Ekero amaache amange agotirimboka gocha bwango, tabaisa komoikera.

english: Thou art my hiding place ; thou shalt preserve me from trouble ; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye naye obwebiso bwane, nondendete korwa ase emechando, nimbe nomogooko na omochengo, ekiagera gwantooririe.

english: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go : I will guide thee with mine eye .
ekegusii: Ninkworokererie na gokoraa ase enchera ogwenerete kogenda; ningosemie, na amaiso aane nakorigererie.

english: Be ye not as the horse , or as the mule , which have no understanding : whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle , lest they come near unto thee.
ekegusii: Timoba buna chibarasi ne chibarasi chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.

english: Rejoice in the LORD , O ye righteous : for praise is comely for the upright .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto abaronge, mochengere Omonene! Inwe abamore ne chinkoro chindonge goika motogie Omonene!

english: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa Mwanyabaanto kwaba bosa.

english: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
ekegusii: Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
ekegusii: Ngesesenirie egesaku eke Omonene are Nyasae obo, abanto aba achorete babe omwando oye.

english: The LORD looketh from heaven ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie korwa igoro, orooche Mwanyabaanto bonsi.

english: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .
ekegusii: Korwa agwo ase aikaransete, nigo akobagambera bonsi abamenyete ase ense.

english: He fashioneth their hearts alike ; he considereth all their works .
ekegusii: Nere otongete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.

english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host : a mighty man is not delivered by much strength .
ekegusii: Omorwoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene Nyasae bw’abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.

english: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .
ekegusii: Gosemeria chibarasi chi’esegi, ayio mbosa, tichikonyara kobua, chinguru chiabo chinyinge tichigotooria omonto.

english: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy ;
ekegusii: Rora amaiso a Omonene nigo abarigereretie abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye botari koera.

english: To deliver their soul from death , and to keep them alive in famine .
ekegusii: Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.

english: Praise the LORD with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase okobugia amakano yebirigisa, motogie ase okobugia amakano are ne chinga ikomi!

english: Our soul waiteth for the LORD : he is our help and our shield .
ekegusii: Emioyo yaito nigo emoganyete Omonene, ere nere ogokonywa gwaito, na enguba yaito.

english: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name .
ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.

english: Let thy mercy , O LORD , be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
ekegusii: Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera bobe amo naintwe, ekiagera naye togosemeretie.

english: Sing unto him a new song ; play skilfully with a loud noise .
ekegusii: Moteerere ogoteera okoyia, na kobugia ase eriogi rireng’aine buya na komochengera!

english: For the word of the LORD is right ; and all his works are done in truth .
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire boronge, na ogokora kwaye gwonsi nigo agokora ase obwegenwa.

english: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD .
ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete ayare boronge na ekeene, na ense nigo eichire nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera.

english: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .
ekegusii: Ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ri’Omonene igoro egatongwa, na ase okobua kwe ring’ana riaye erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigatongwa.

english: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .
ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amaache yenyancha, buna amaache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.

english: Let all the earth fear the LORD : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
ekegusii: Ense yonsi neiroke Omonene, na bonsi abamenyete ase ense bamwoboe.

english: For he spake , and it was done; he commanded , and it stood fast .
ekegusii: Naki ere agakwana, na ayio agakoreka; agachiika, na ayio akabao.

english: I will bless the LORD at all times : his praise shall continually be in my mouth .
ekegusii: Nimbake Omonene chingaki chionsi, ase omonwa one nimotogie botambe.

english: The young lions do lack , and suffer hunger : but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing .
ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.

english: Come , ye children , hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD .
ekegusii: Abana baane, inchwo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.

english: Keep thy tongue from evil , and thy lips from speaking guile .
ekegusii: Rirorio tanga oromeme rwao tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biao tibikwana obong’ainereria.

english: Depart from evil , and do good ; seek peace , and pursue it.
ekegusii: Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.

english: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous , and his ears are open unto their cry .
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.

english: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil , to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth .
ekegusii: Obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore mamincha y’abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.

english: The righteous cry , and the LORD heareth , and delivereth them out of all their troubles .
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakorera ng’a bakonywe, Omonene nigo akobaigwa na kobatooria korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.

english: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart ; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.

english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous : but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akonyora emechando emenge, korende Omonene namotoorie korwa ase eyio yonsi;

english: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD : the humble shall hear thereof , and be glad .
ekegusii: Ase omoyo one ninyetogerie Omonene, abwo bachayire tiga bayaigwe bagoke.

english: Evil shall slay the wicked : and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate .
ekegusii: Obobe nigo boraite omokori amabe, na abwo bagechete omonyene oboronge nabagaambigwe, banyore egesusuro.

english: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants : and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobooria emioyo y’abasomba baye, gose onde tari ase abwo bakomotamera orache kogambigwa.

english: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together .
ekegusii: Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

english: I sought the LORD , and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears .
ekegusii: Nkarangeria Omonene, nere akang’iraneria, akandusia korwa ase obwoba bwane bwonsi.

english: They looked unto him, and were lightened : and their faces were not ashamed .
ekegusii: Abwo bamorigereretie nigo bakomeka‐meka bare nomogooko, gose amasio abo takororekana are nobosooku.

english: This poor man cried , and the LORD heard him , and saved him out of all his troubles .
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akorera, n’Omonene omoigwa, omotooria korwa ase emechando yaye yonsi.

english: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene nigo akorenda na goetanana abwo bamoirogete Omonene na kobatooria.

english: O fear the LORD , ye his saints : for there is no want to them that fear him.
ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene, inwe abachenu baye, naki abwo bamoirogete tibakoremerwa kende.

english: Plead my cause , O LORD , with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!

english: All my bones shall say , LORD , who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay’omobere one nateebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye Omonene, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”

english: False witnesses did rise up ; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
ekegusii: Birori bi’oborimo nigo bakonyimokera, bakomboria ase amang’ana ntamanyeti.

english: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya, nerusirie moyo.

english: But as for me, when they were sick , my clothing was sackcloth : I humbled my soul with fasting ; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo barwarete nigo neboyetie eanga y’okweumia na goichana; ngechanda ase okweng’ata, ngasaba nturegete omotwe.

english: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother : I bowed down heavily , as one that mourneth for his mother .
ekegusii: Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y’okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng’ina akuure.

english: But in mine adversity they rejoiced , and gathered themselves together : yea , the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me , and ceased not:
ekegusii: Korende ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo basangererekanete amo bakagoka. Abanto batagwenerete, aba ntamanyeti bakaba bagonchecheria batari gotiga.

english: With hypocritical mockers in feasts , they gnashed upon me with their teeth .
ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.

english: Lord , how long wilt thou look on ? rescue my soul from their destructions , my darling from the lions .
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri orabe koyarigereretie rioka? Intaborie korwa ase ogosiria barobeirie, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase chindo echio!

english: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation : I will praise thee among much people .
ekegusii: Erio ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw’abaanto.

english: Take hold of shield and buckler , and stand up for mine help .
ekegusii: Bogoria enguba na eng’aya, imoka onkonye!

english: For they speak not peace : but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari gokwana amang’ana akorenta omorembe; nigo bakona-korigia amang’ana yobong’ainereria igoro y’abanto abwo bare abatoereru ase ense.

english: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said , Aha , aha , our eye hath seen it .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”

english: This thou hast seen , O LORD : keep not silence : O Lord , be not far from me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarorire amang’ana ayio, tokirakiri. Omonene, tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende!

english: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment , even unto my cause , my God and my Lord .
ekegusii: Omonene one, ore Nyasae one, tabobora, oimokerere igoro, erinde orwanerere oboronge bwane na amang’ana aane.

english: Judge me, O LORD my God , according to thy righteousness ; and let them not rejoice over me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekiina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.

english: Let them not say in their hearts , Ah , so would we have it : let them not say , We have swallowed him up .
ekegusii: Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamobuire.”

english: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt : let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogokera emechando yane, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe; abwo bagwetogia igoro yane, tiga baboigwe obosooku na ogochaywa.

english: Let them shout for joy , and be glad , that favour my righteous cause : yea, let them say continually , Let the LORD be magnified , which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo banchete ng’a ng’egwe oboronge bwane, tiga baake eriogi ri’omogooko na omochengo, bagenderere goteeba: “Omonene noyo bw’obonene! Ee, nigo agokirie namaya omosomba oye akonyora!”

english: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.

english: Draw out also the spear , and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul , I am thy salvation .
ekegusii: Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one: “Ninche Omotooria oo.”

english: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul : let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, tiga babugwe na gosookigwa. Abwo bagokora emeroberio emebe y’okong’ita, tiga bairanigwe babe nobosooku.

english: Let them be as chaff before the wind : and let the angel of the LORD chase them .
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobaiyeria.

english: Let their way be dark and slippery : and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
ekegusii: Omosunte na oboterere bibe ase enchera bagoetera, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobabwata abasirie.

english: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit , which without cause they have digged for my soul .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bambekeire oboreba bobisi engencho ende etaiyo, na bakunyire eirima ng’a basirie obogima bwane.

english: Let destruction come upon him at unawares ; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall .
ekegusii: Ogosirigwa tiga kobanyore mobosokano; oboreba obwo bantegeire tiga bobabwate barabwo abanyene, tiga bagwe imeo abanyene na gosirigwa.

english: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD : it shall rejoice in his salvation .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nogoke ase Omonene na gochenga ase engencho y’ogotooreka kwaye.

english: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart .
ekegusii: Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
ekegusii: Totiga amagoro ya abaenenu ang’ike ang’e kondwania, gose amaboko ya abakori amabe anserie.

english: There are the workers of iniquity fallen : they are cast down , and shall not be able to rise .
ekegusii: Rora aase abakori amabe bagure inse, baiyerigwe tibakonyara koboka naende.

english: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes , until his iniquity be found to be hateful .
ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.

english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit : he hath left off to be wise , and to do good .
ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto oyio agokwana nigo are ay’ogosaria na obong’ainereria; ere otigire gokora amang’ana ’obong’aini na ayare amaya.

english: He deviseth mischief upon his bed ; he setteth himself in a way that is not good ; he abhorreth not evil .
ekegusii: Ekero araire borere bwaye nigo agokora emeroberio y’amabe, na kobwatia chinchera chitari chingiya, tari kwanga obobe bonde bwonsi. Obuya bwa Nyasae

english: Thy mercy , O LORD , is in the heavens ; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera nigo bogoika aaria igoro, na obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete ase amare igoro.

english: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains ; thy judgments are a great deep : O LORD , thou preservest man and beast .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u buna ebitunwa biao. Okogamba kwao nigo kore buna chindiba chintambe, aye nigo orendete Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti boigo.

english: How excellent is thy lovingkindness , O God ! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings .
ekegusii: Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabaanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.

english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house ; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures .
