ekegusii: Nigo bagoisanekigwa nobonoru bokorwa ase enyomba yao, aye nobae banywe korwa ase orooche rwao rw’okogokia.

english: For with thee is the fountain of life : in thy light shall we see light .
ekegusii: Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.

english: Fret not thyself because of evildoers , neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity .
ekegusii: Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.

english: For yet a little while , and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place , and it shall not be .
ekegusii: Netigarete engaki ensinini, na omokori amabe asirigwe; nobe gokorigereria mono aase aye, takonyorekana oreo.

english: The wicked plotteth against the just , and gnasheth upon him with his teeth .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokora omooroberio bw’ogoita oyore omooronge, na komoriananeria amaino.

english: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming .
ekegusii: Omonene nasekerere omokori amabe, ekiagera aroche ng’a rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye ndichiche.

english: The wicked have drawn out the sword , and have bent their bow , to cast down the poor and needy , and to slay such as be of upright conversation .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagosomora emeyio yabo na batinga amata abo, erinde baite abanto abataka na abaremeire, baite na abakobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge.

english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart , and their bows shall be broken .
ekegusii: Emeyio yabo nebete chinkoro chiabo abanyene, na amata abo nabunwe.

english: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked .
ekegusii: Ebinto ebike omonto omonyaboronge abwate, nigo bire ebiya kobua ebinge biria abakori amabe abange babwate.

english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken : but the LORD upholdeth the righteous .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe mbaurwe chinguru echi babwate, korende Omonene nagenderere koa abanyaboronge chinguru.

english: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright : and their inheritance shall be for ever .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete amatuko ya abamoirogete, na omwando obo nogenderere kobao kare na kare.

english: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time : and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.

english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass , and wither as the green herb .
ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirigwe bwango, basire buna obonyansi basusane buna ebimeri ebibese.

english: But the wicked shall perish , and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs : they shall consume ; into smoke shall they consume away .
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbasirigwe; ababisa ba Omonene nigo bare buna obuya bw’ebisicha, nigo barasire, ee, mbasire buna erioki rigosira kegima.

english: The wicked borroweth , and payeth not again : but the righteous sheweth mercy , and giveth .
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoira egento singo tagokeirania, korende omonto omooronge nigo are namaabera na korua ebiegwa,

english: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth ; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off .
ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene asesenirie mbaire ense ebe eyabo, korende abwo aragereirie mbasirigwe kegima.

english: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD : and he delighteth in his way .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka orogendo rw’omonto omooronge chinguru, na kogokigwa nabarabwo.

english: Though he fall , he shall not be utterly cast down : for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa kogochwa, takogwa inse, ekiagera Omonene namobwatete okoboko kwaye.

english: I have been young , and now am old ; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken , nor his seed begging bread .
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, bono nagotire, korende tinana-korora omonto omooronge ogotigwa bosa, gose abana baye bakoborwa endagera.

english: He is ever merciful , and lendeth ; and his seed is blessed .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona-korua ebiegwa na korua singo, abana baye nigo barasesenigwe.

english: Depart from evil , and do good ; and dwell for evermore .
ekegusii: Tiga gokora amabe, kora ayare amaya, igo nario orachie kare.

english: For the LORD loveth judgment , and forsaketh not his saints ; they are preserved for ever : but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete oboronge; tagotiga abachenu baye. Barabwo mbarendwe goika kare na kare, korende ororeria rw’abakori amabe ndosirigwe kegima.

english: The righteous shall inherit the land , and dwell therein for ever .
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbaire ense ebe eyabo, erio bagenderere komenyao botambe.

english: Trust in the LORD , and do good ; so shalt thou dwell in the land , and verily thou shalt be fed .
ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.

english: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom , and his tongue talketh of judgment .
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonto omooronge nigo agokwana amang’ana yobong’aini, na oromeme rwaye nigo rogosokia ay’ekeene.

english: The law of his God is in his heart ; none of his steps shall slide .
ekegusii: Amachiiko a Nyasae oye nigo abeerete ase enkoro y’omonto oyio; ase agoeta tari gotererigwa.

english: The wicked watcheth the righteous , and seeketh to slay him.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotengera omonto omooronge, erio origia chinchera chi’okomoita.

english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand , nor condemn him when he is judged .
ekegusii: Omonene tagotiga omonto omooronge ase okobua kw’omokori amabe, gose takomotiga abugwe ekero asoeirwe ase ekegambero.

english: Wait on the LORD , and keep his way , and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land : when the wicked are cut off , thou shalt see it .
ekegusii: Gany’Omonene na obwatie enchera yaye, nere nakoimokererie igoro akoe ense ebe eyao; erio norigererie orore buna abanyabibe bagosirigwa.

english: I have seen the wicked in great power , and spreading himself like a green bay tree .
ekegusii: Narorire omokori amabe otindire ase obomwenu, akaba okoranda buna emecharake egokina ase amaroba amatobu.

english: Yet he passed away , and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found .
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake ngaetera aase agwo, korende tarengeo, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora aande.

english: Mark the perfect man , and behold the upright : for the end of that man is peace .
ekegusii: Rigereria omonto omoikeranu, ee, origererie omonto ore nenkoro endonge, norore ng’a omonto ogokora omorembe nere orachie kare.

english: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together : the end of the wicked shall be cut off .
ekegusii: Korende abasaria mbasirigwe bonsi pi, na ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirokogenderera.

english: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD : he is their strength in the time of trouble .
ekegusii: Ogotooreka kw’abanyaboronge nigo gokorwa ase Omonene, ere nere obotamero bwabo ase chingaki chi’emechando.

english: Delight thyself also in the LORD ; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart .
ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.

english: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked , and save them, because they trust in him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobakonya na kobatooria; nigo akobarusia korwa ase abakori amabe, obatooria, ekiagera bakomotamera.

english: Commit thy way unto the LORD ; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass .
ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie ere bweka, nere naoboseemia.

english: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light , and thy judgment as the noonday .
ekegusii: Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.

english: Rest in the LORD , and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way , because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass .
ekegusii: Obe n’obotoereru ase obosio bw’Omonene, omoganye noboremereria. Togechigwa nomonto okogenderera buya ase enchera yaye, omonto oyio okoroberia ogosaria.

english: Cease from anger , and forsake wrath : fret not thyself in any wise to do evil .
ekegusii: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.

english: For evildoers shall be cut off : but those that wait upon the LORD , they shall inherit the earth .
ekegusii: Abanyabibe mbasirigwe kegima, korende abamoganyete Omonene mbaire ense ebe omwando obo.

english: O LORD , rebuke me not in thy wrath : neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure .
ekegusii: Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu, tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.

english: My heart panteth , my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes , it also is gone from me.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, chinguru chiang’ereire; amaiso aane asoirwe orotutu, tindi korora.

english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore ; and my kinsmen stand afar off .
ekegusii: Abanchi na abasani baane babeereire aare korwa ase amaakwa aane, na abanto baminto boigo bambeereire aare.

english: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things , and imagine deceits all the day long.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baganetie gosiria obogima bwane bantegeire oboreba; na abwo baganetie gonkora bobe nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’ogosirigwa kwane, bakorengereria amang’ana yobong’ainereria omobaso boira.

english: But I, as a deaf man , heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth .
ekegusii: Korende inche nabeire buna omotino, tindi koigwa, nabeire buna omonto rimama, tindi gokwana.

english: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs .
ekegusii: Ee, inche nabeire buna omonto otari koigwa, buna oyo omonwa oye otabwati amang’ana okoiraneria.

english: For in thee, O LORD , do I hope : thou wilt hear , O Lord my God .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene, naye nsemereretie. Omonene, Nyasae one, naye oranyare koiraneria.

english: For I said , Hear me , lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth , they magnify themselves against me.
ekegusii: Nigo nkogosaba ng’a ababisa baane tibagokera emechando yane; na tibetogeria okogwa kwane.

english: For I am ready to halt , and my sorrow is continually before me.
ekegusii: Inche nabeereire ang’e kogwa, na obororo bwane nigo bogendererete kobeera asende.

english: For I will declare mine iniquity ; I will be sorry for my sin .
ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.

english: But mine enemies are lively , and they are strong : and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied .
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bare abagima, naende bare ne chinguru, abwo bangechete bosa nabange bare.

english: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore .
ekegusii: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.

english: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries ; because I follow the thing that good is .
ekegusii: Abwo bagoakana amabe ase amaya nigo babeire ababisa baane, ekiagera ngokora ayare amaya.

english: Forsake me not, O LORD : O my God , be not far from me.
ekegusii: Omonene, tontiga! Aye Nyasae one, tobaisa kombeera aare!

english: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogotooreka kwane, ayerera onkonye!

english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger ; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ekeririanda kiao omobere one bwensi orwarire, nase engencho y’ebibe biane amauga aane nigo akonyatia.

english: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head : as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
ekegusii: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.

english: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness .
ekegusii: Amaote aane agundire atiokire bobe ase engencho y’oboriri bwane.

english: I am troubled ; I am bowed down greatly ; I go mourning all the day long.
ekegusii: Igo ng’umaime na koumata, nigo ingendererete korera na goichana omobaso boira.

english: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh .
ekegusii: Chibachwa chiane nigo chikoyia buna omorero, omobere one bwonsi orwarire.

english: I am feeble and sore broken : I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart .
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chionsi chiaerire, nasenyentekire, nigo nkona‐kweumia ase engencho y’obororo bw’enkoro yane.

english: Lord , all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo omanyete okogania kwane gwonsi, na ogochandeka kwane tikobisekaneti asore.

english: I said , I will take heed to my ways , that I sin not with my tongue : I will keep my mouth with a bridle , while the wicked is before me.
ekegusii: Ngateeba: “Nindende orogendo rwane, timbaisa gokora ebibe ekero ngokwana. Nimbeke omonwa one ekeokio ekero abakori amabe bare ase obosio bwane.”

english: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand .
ekegusii: Rusia egesusuro kiao asende; naerire ase ogoakwa gw’okoboko kwao.

english: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity , thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth : surely every man is vanity . Selah .
ekegusii: Ekero okorongeyia omonto ase okomotogonyera ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo ogosiria obonene bwaye, koreng’ana buna ebigwankwa bikoria chianga. Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo anga buna omwaga.

english: Hear my prayer , O LORD , and give ear unto my cry ; hold not thy peace at my tears : for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner , as all my fathers were .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, otegerere okorera kwane; tokira‐kiri ekero nkoiyeria amariga, ekiagera inche nomogeni oo inde, na omoeti buna chisokoro chiane chiarenge.

english: O spare me, that I may recover strength , before I go hence , and be no more.
ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

english: I was dumb with silence , I held my peace , even from good ; and my sorrow was stirred .
ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,

english: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned : then spake I with my tongue ,
ekegusii: enkoro yane ekaba ekoyia omorero ime yane. Ekero naare ndengereretie aya, omorero ogoka, tinare konyara gwetanga ogokwana kwane.

english: LORD , make me to know mine end , and the measure of my days , what it is; that I may know how frail I am .
ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie omoerio bw’amatuko aane, na ekerengo ki’amatuko aane naki keng’ana, erinde imanye ng’a obogima bwane nobweng’e.

english: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth ; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity . Selah .
ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko kwang’ete nameng’e mono. Engaki y’obogima bwane nigo ere buna teri gento ase obosio bwao. Amaene, kera omonto, nonya bwetenenerete bokong’u, nigo agoeta bwango buna omwaga.

english: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew : surely they are disquieted in vain : he heapeth up riches , and knoweth not who shall gather them.
ekegusii: Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo agotaara ore buna omogwekano okorora ase okorota; nigo agwechanda bosa; asangereria enibo, korende tamanyeti gose ning’o orache koyeria.

english: And now, Lord , what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
ekegusii: Nabono aye Omonene, inki nganyete? Naye bweka nsemeretie.

english: Deliver me from all my transgressions : make me not the reproach of the foolish .
ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase ogosaria kwane, tontiga nsekererwe noyio ore omoriri.

english: I was dumb , I opened not my mouth ; because thou didst it .
ekegusii: Nigo nkirete‐kiri, tindi komumora omonwa one, ekiagera aye naye gwakorete ayio.

english: LORD , how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ababisa baane mbarenga bare! Abange banyimokeire gonkorera bobe.

english: Many there be which say of my soul , There is no help for him in God . Selah .
ekegusii: Abange nigo bagokwana igoro yane, bateeba: Nyasae tancheti komotooria. + 3:2 Nyasae tancheti komotooria: Aiga Ekeiberania nigo kerikire “Sela”; naboigo ase chinsemo chinde ase Zaburi. Ring’ana erio nigo rigwatorwa amo neriogi ri’amatera.

english: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; my glory , and the lifter up of mine head .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, aye naye enguba yane, na naye obonene bwane, nigo okong’iraneria oboremu bw’obobui bwane.

english: I cried unto the LORD with my voice , and he heard me out of his holy hill . Selah .
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera na gokuura ase Omonene ng’a ankonye, nere nigo akong’iraneria korwa ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.

english: I laid me down and slept ; I awaked ; for the LORD sustained me.
ekegusii: Nigo ngwetoora na korara chitoro, erio naboka naende, ekiagera Omonene nigo agendererete kondenda.

english: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people , that have set themselves against me round about .
ekegusii: Tindi koiroka ababisa chilifu chinyinge, abwo mamincha yane, bakondia korwa chinsemo chiane chionsi.

english: Arise , O LORD ; save me, O my God : for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone ; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene imoka, gaki, inchwo! Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie! Aye gwaakire ababisa baane bonsi oroe ase chinsea chiabo, kwabunire amaino ’abakori amabe kwabakorire bosa.

english: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD : thy blessing is upon thy people . Selah .
ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa asore aye bweka Omonene; ase ayio, sesenia abanto bao.

english: I waited patiently for the LORD ; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry .
ekegusii: Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.

english: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart ; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation : I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation .
ekegusii: Tinyegachereti inche bweka oboronge bwao ase enkoro yane ime; korende nararirie obwegenwa bwao, na ogotooreka kwao. Timbiseti obuya bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, korwa ase omosangererekano omonene.

english: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD : let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tondina amaabera ao! Obuya na obwegenwa bwao bindende botambe. Ogosaba gw’okonyora ooboseemiaka (Zab 70)

english: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up ; they are more than the hairs of mine head : therefore my heart faileth me.
ekegusii: Amabe amange atari kobareka nigo ang’etanaine. Ebibe biane biambuire, goika tinkonyara korora; biabeire ebinge kobua etukia y’omotwe one, goika nerusirie moyo.

english: Be pleased , O LORD , to deliver me: O LORD , make haste to help me.
ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

english: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi barigetie kong’ita, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe bonsi amo, na abwo baganetie obobe bonyore, tiga bairanigwe magega barore obosooku.

english: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha , aha .
ekegusii: Abwo bagonsiereria bagoteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe‐kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually , The LORD be magnified .
ekegusii: Korende abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao bateebe botambe, “Omonene nigo are omonene!”

english: But I am poor and needy ; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer ; make no tarrying , O my God .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa, korende Omonene nigo akonyechandera. Naye ore ogokonywa kwane, na ogotooreka kwane. Aye Nyasae one, totebana!

english: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit , out of the miry clay , and set my feet upon a rock , and established my goings .
ekegusii: Ere akandusia korwa ase engoro y’obosareku, korwa ase etintira na esike; agatenenia amagoro aane ase egetare igoro, agankong’ia ase ngoeta.

english: And he hath put a new song in my mouth , even praise unto our God : many shall see it , and fear , and shall trust in the LORD .
ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.

english: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust , and respecteth not the proud , nor such as turn aside to lies .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria omosemeretie Omonene, otari kweonchora gochia ase abanto abaenenu, gose ase abwo bagosira ase okoonchokera chinyasae chi’oborimo.

english: Many , O LORD my God , are thy wonderful works which thou hast done , and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them , they are more than can be numbered .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ogokora kwao na ebirengererio biao ase tore nebi’ogokumia; onde tari orareng’anigwe naye. Ninganetie koraria ayio na koyakwana, korende namange mono, takobareka.

english: Then said I, Lo, I come : in the volume of the book it is written of me,
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba: “Rigereria, nachire; ase egetabu nigo eriikire aya ngwenerete gokora.

english: I delight to do thy will , O my God : yea, thy law is within my heart .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ninganetie nkore ogwancha kwao, amachiiko ao nigo are ase enkoro yane ime.”

english: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation : lo, I have not refrained my lips , O LORD , thou knowest .
ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano omonene narandirie amang’ana amaya ay’oboronge; aye Omonene, nomanyete ng’a tingotanga ebikoba biane tibiyakwana.

english: Blessed is he that considereth the poor : the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo ogwechandera abataka. Ekero aranyorwe nemechando, Omonene namokonye.

english: But thou, O LORD , be merciful unto me, and raise me up , that I may requite them.
ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ngwenie, erinde ing’akane ababisa baane obobe bwabo.

english: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane tibagochenga igoro yane. Ase ayio nimanye ng’a aye nogokirie nainche.

english: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity , and settest me before thy face for ever .
ekegusii: Aye gwankonyire, ekiagera tindi na komocha, kwambekire gotenena ase obosio bwao kogenderera botambe.

english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive ; and he shall be blessed upon the earth : and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies .
ekegusii: Omonene amorende na komokorera agenderere koba moyo, erinde arokwe oyosesenirie ase ense. Omonene tagotiga ababisa bamokorere buna banchete.

english: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing : thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness .
ekegusii: Omonene namorende ekero are borere arwarete, namogusuerie oborwaire bwaye.

english: I said , LORD , be merciful unto me: heal my soul ; for I have sinned against thee.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nateebete: “Omonene, indorera amaabera, ingwenie omoyo one, ekiagera nakorire ebibe asore.”

english: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die , and his name perish ?
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro yane, bateba, “Omonto oyo indi arakwe na erieta riaye riebwe kegima?”

english: And if he come to see me , he speaketh vanity : his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad , he telleth it .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogocha kondora nigo agokwana amang’ana yoborimo, enkoro yaye nigo egosangereria amabe, erio ogenda isiko oraria amang’ana ayio amabe.

english: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bangechete nigo bakomonyererana igoro yane, nigo bakorire omooroberio bw’ogonkora bobe.

english: An evil disease , say they , cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Noborwaire boramoite bwamonyorire, takoboka naende korwa ase araire”.

english: As the hart panteth after the water brooks , so panteth my soul after thee, O God .
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana engabi ekogania amaache a rooche, naboigo omoyo one okoganetie aye Nyasae.

english: As with a sword in my bones , mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God ?
ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bagonchecheria, nigo nkoigwa buna amauga aane akonyatia. Nigo bagendererete kona‐komboria, “Nyasae oo, ng’ai are?”

english: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God : for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.

english: My soul thirsteth for God , for the living God : when shall I come and appear before God ?
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?

english: My tears have been my meat day and night , while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God ?
ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera, na amariga abeire endagera yane; botambe abanto nigo bakomboria: “Nyasae oo ng’ai are?”

english: When I remember these things , I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude , I went with them to the house of God , with the voice of joy and praise , with a multitude that kept holyday .
ekegusii: Nigo nkoumora ayare ase omoyo one ime, ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aetire, buna narenge kogenda amo nomoganda bw’abaanto gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae, nkaba ngotera nomogooko neriogi rinene na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono amo nabwo barenge koinyora na korenda Rituko Rinene.

english: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God : for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.

english: O my God , my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan , and of the Hermonites , from the hill Mizar .
ekegusii: Nyasae one, enkoro yane yabeire nomoichano, ase ayio, nakoinyoire ekero inde ase ense ya Yorodani, na ase egetunwa kia Herimoni na ekia Misari.

english: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts : all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
ekegusii: Endiba y’amaache nigo ekorangeria endiba ende, ekero amaache ’ebieera akoeera; chiooro chiao chionsi na emerindo yao biantubire.

english: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime , and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life .
ekegusii: Ase omobaso Omonene nigo akong’a obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na ase obotuko nigo nkomotogia namatera na gosaba Nyasae oyore obogima bwane.

english: I will say unto God my rock , Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?
ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Nyasae ore egetare kiane, “Nase ki aye kwanyebire? Nase ki ngendererete korera ngochandwa nababisa baane?”

english: Judge me, O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ing’a oboronge bwane, ndwanerere nkonye korwa ase abanto batakoirogeti, ntoorie korwa ase abanto abang’ainereria, abatari abanyakeene.

english: For thou art the God of my strength : why dost thou cast me off ? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore obotamero bwane, naki gwantigire? Ninki gekogera inche ngendererete kweumia, na ababisa baane bagendererete gonkorera bobe?

english: O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .
ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong’ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.

english: Then will I go unto the altar of God , unto God my exceeding joy : yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God .
ekegusii: Erio ngende ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Nyasae, Nyasae, aye oyore omogooko one omonene, nimbugie obokano na goteera ogoteera gw’okogotogia, aye Nyasae ore Nyasae one.

english: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae, ekiagera ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.

english: We have heard with our ears , O God , our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days , in the times of old .
ekegusii: Nyasae, intwe tweigwereire namato aito, chisokoro chiaito nchiatotebetie amang’ana gwakorete ase amatuko a kare.

english: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy : and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
ekegusii: Gwatokorire gotama ababisa baito, na barabwo babeire bagosakora ebinto biaito.

english: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat ; and hast scattered us among the heathen .
ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching’ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku.

english: Thou sellest thy people for nought , and dost not increase thy wealth by their price .
ekegusii: Aye kwaoonirie abanto bao ase rigori risinini mono; tikwababeekerete rigori rinene.

english: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours , a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba okogechia ase abanto baito; twabeire togochaywa na gosekererwa nabaanto batoetanaine.

english: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen , a shaking of the head among the people .
ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba omorabaaro ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, twabeire togosingiserigwa emetwe nabaanto.

english: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
ekegusii: Ogochaywa kwane nigo kogendererete asende omobaso boira, na obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane

english: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth ; by reason of the enemy and avenger .
ekegusii: ekero nkoigwa amang’ana ’abagonchecheria na gonkwana bobe, na ekero nkorora obosio bw’omobisa na obw’oyo okorusia egesiomba.

english: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant .
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya onsi atonyorire, nonya intwe titoraba togokweba, gose titorasaria okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania.

english: Our heart is not turned back , neither have our steps declined from thy way ;
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaito tichionchogeti chigotige, gose titotigeti kobwatia enchera yao,

english: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons , and covered us with the shadow of death .
ekegusii: erinde otoake na gototuguta ase chisese chi’orosana chimenyete, gose gototuba ekiriri ki’amakweri.

english: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand , and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people , and cast them out .
ekegusii: Aye omonyene nigo gwaseretie abanto b’ebisaku nokoboko kwao, korende chisokoro chiaito okabarenta okabasimeka aroro; nigo kwarentete emechando ase abanto b’ebisaku, korende chisokoro chiaito okabamentekania bakaranda.

english: If we have forgotten the name of our God , or stretched out our hands to a strange god ;
ekegusii: Onye ntwebire erieta ria Nyasae oito, gose ntwaramboire amaboko aito ase ogosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao.

english: Shall not God search this out ? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart .
ekegusii: Inee, Nyasae tari komanya amang’ana ayio? Ere nigo amanyete obobisi bwonsi bore ime ase enkoro.

english: Awake , why sleepest thou, O Lord ? arise , cast us not off for ever .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, boka oimokerere igoro? Nase ki oraire? Boka, tototuguta kegima!

english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face , and forgettest our affliction and our oppression ?
ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase tore? Nase ki aye kwebire emechando yaito na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito?

english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust : our belly cleaveth unto the earth .
ekegusii: Amaene, emioyo yaito yaiyerigwe inse ase orotu, emebere yaito yabwateranigwe inse ase riroba.

english: Arise for our help , and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
ekegusii: Imokerera igoro, ochiche otokonye! Ototoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

english: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword , neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand , and thine arm , and the light of thy countenance , because thou hadst a favour unto them.
ekegusii: Abanto bao tibairete ense eria ase okoyerwania nemioro, gose tari chinguru chi’amaboko abo chiabarenterete obobui, korende nokoboko kwao gw’okorio ne chinguru chi’amaboko ao, amo noborabu bwaruete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera aye nigo kwagogetigwe nabarabwo.

english: Thou art my King , O God : command deliverances for Jacob .
ekegusii: Aye naye omorwoti one, na Nyasae one, ase ayio, chiika ng’a abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baegwe obobui.

english: Through thee will we push down our enemies : through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
ekegusii: Ase chinguru chiao nigo toraiyerie inse ababisa baito; goetera ase erieta riao nigo toratiringere inse abwo bagocha gotorwania esegi.

english: For I will not trust in my bow , neither shall my sword save me.
ekegusii: Inche tinsemeretie obota bwane; gose omoro one tong’a obobui.

english: But thou hast saved us from our enemies , and hast put them to shame that hated us.
ekegusii: Korende naye gwatoete obobui igoro y’ababisa baito, abwo batogechete nigo kwabasoogetie.

english: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever . Selah .
ekegusii: Intwe ntogenderere gwetogia asore aye Nyasae, ntobe tokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao kogenderera botambe.

english: But thou hast cast off , and put us to shame ; and goest not forth with our armies .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo gwatotigire na gotosookia, tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

english: My heart is inditing a good matter : I speak of the things which I have made touching the king : my tongue is the pen of a ready writer .
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo eichire namang’ana amaya, engero yane nigo ere igoro y’omorwoti; oromeme rwane nigo rore buna ekaramu y’omoriki omuya.

english: Hearken , O daughter , and consider , and incline thine ear ; forget also thine own people , and thy father’s house ;
ekegusii: Aye omoiseke, igwa! Ntegerera mono! Eba bono abanto baino na ab’enyomba ya iso.

english: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty : for he is thy Lord ; and worship thou him.
ekegusii: Oboseera bwao mbogere omorwoti agosanere, ekiagera ere nomonene oo, goika bwekumbe ase obosio bwaye.

english: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift ; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Turo, abare abanda mono, nigo barakorentere ebiegwa, barigie ogwancherwa kwao.

english: The king’s daughter is all glorious within : her clothing is of wrought gold .
ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omorwoti nigo are ime ase eero yaye ore nobonene, obegete eganchwa yaye eroiseirie etaabu.

english: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework : the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
ekegusii: Nigo akoirwa ase omorwoti obegete chiganchwa chi’ebieni ao ao, nigo agotunyanwa nabaiseke abekungi abare abagisangio baye; bonsi nigo bakoirwa ase omorwoti.

english: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought : they shall enter into the king’s palace .
ekegusii: Nigo bakoirwa bare nomogooko na omochengo, erio basoigwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti.

english: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children , whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth .
ekegusii: Abana bao abamura mbabe ribaga rie chisokoro chiao, naye nobabeeke babe abagaambi igoro ase ense yonsi.

english: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations : therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Ninkore erieta riao ribe rikoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi; ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku mbabe bakogotogia goika kare na kare.

english: Thou art fairer than the children of men : grace is poured into thy lips : therefore God hath blessed thee for ever .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omoseera kobua abanto bonsi; ebikoba biao nigo bigokwana amang’ana ’obwanchani. Ase ayio Nyasae ogosesenirie goika kare na kare.

english: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh , O most mighty , with thy glory and thy majesty .
ekegusii: Aye omobui, eboeranie omoyio o birende ase ekenema kiao, aye nigo ore nobonene na ogosikwa okonene.

english: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness ; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things .
ekegusii: Genda bosio nobobui na obonene,! Okengere ekeene, na obwororo, na oboronge; na okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokworokererie amang’ana ’ogokumia.

english: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies ; whereby the people fall under thee.
ekegusii: Emegwe yao nigo ere emioge, nigo ekobeta chinkoro chi’ababisa bao aye omorwoti abanto nigo bakogwa inse yao.

english: Thou lovest righteousness , and hatest wickedness : therefore God , thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete oboronge na kogechete ebibe. Ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.

english: All thy garments smell of myrrh , and aloes , and cassia , out of the ivory palaces , whereby they have made thee glad .
ekegusii: Chiganchwa chiao nigo chikouboka rimisu ri’amaguta a manemane, na ay’omogaka, na aya kasia. Korwa ase chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu abanto nigo bakobugia amakano na gokogokia.

english: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women : upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir .
ekegusii: Abaiseke b’abarwoti nigo bare amo nabwo bakogokorera ase amasikani; eting’ana bwechaberete netaabu ekorwa Ofiri, nigo ateneine ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio.

english: God is our refuge and strength , a very present help in trouble .
ekegusii: Nyasae nobotamero bwaito, ne chinguru chiaito, botambe nigo are ang’e gotokonya ase engaki y’emechando.

english: Be still , and know that I am God : I will be exalted among the heathen , I will be exalted in the earth .
ekegusii: “Toerera, momanye ng’a ninche Nyasae; inche inde omonene ase abanto b’ebisaku, omonene ase ense.”

english: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge . Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.

english: Therefore will not we fear , though the earth be removed , and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio titokwoboa, ense neisa gotengechigwa na ebitunwa birutwe ase chindiba chi’enyancha,

english: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled , though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah .
ekegusii: gose emerindo y’enyancha neba ekoruma na koimokerera igoro, na ebitunwa bibe bigotengechigwa ase ogoturubanigwa okwo.

english: There is a river , the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God , the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High .
ekegusii: Orooche ndoreo chindooche chiaye chikogokia omochie o Nyasae, omochie ore obomenyo obochenu bw’Oyore Igoro Mono.

english: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved : God shall help her, and that right early .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amenyete imeo, tokonyegerigwa, ere nayokonye kobogokia mambia.

english: The heathen raged , the kingdoms were moved : he uttered his voice , the earth melted .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku babeire neburuburu, amagambi aiyerigwe; Nyasae ogoaka eriogi riaye, ense nenyititoke.

english: Come , behold the works of the LORD , what desolations he hath made in the earth .
ekegusii: Inchuo morore ay’Omonene akorire, orentire ogosirigwa ase ense.

english: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth ; he breaketh the bow , and cutteth the spear in sunder ; he burneth the chariot in the fire .
ekegusii: Otangire chiseegi ase ense engima, obunire amata, osenyentire amatimo, osambire chigari nomorero.

english: O clap your hands , all ye people ; shout unto God with the voice of triumph .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera ’omogooko neriogi rinene!

english: For the LORD most high is terrible ; he is a great King over all the earth .
ekegusii: Omonene ore Igoro Mono nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia, ere nomorwoti omonene bw’ense yonsi.

english: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet .
ekegusii: Omonene obekire abanto inse yaito, otoeire okobua kogambera abanto b’ebisaku.

english: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved . Selah .
ekegusii: Nigo atochorerete omwando, oyio ore obwari bwa Yakobo, ori’Omonene anchete.

english: God is gone up with a shout , the LORD with the sound of a trumpet .
ekegusii: Nyasae otiirire namariogi ay’ogochengerwa, Omonene nigo akobugerigwa ebitureeri.

english: Sing praises to God , sing praises : sing praises unto our King , sing praises .
ekegusii: Tera amatera ay’ogotogia Nyasae, tera amatera ay’ogotogia! Tera amatera ay’ogotogia omorwoti oito, tera amatera ay’ogotogia!

english: For God is the King of all the earth : sing ye praises with understanding .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omorwoti bw’ense yonsi, motogie namatera are nengencho.

english: God reigneth over the heathen : God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness .
ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.

english: The princes of the people are gathered together , even the people of the God of Abraham : for the shields of the earth belong unto God : he is greatly exalted .
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto basangererekanire amo, babe abanto ba Nyasae o Aburaamu. Chinguba chi’ense nigo chire echia Nyasae; ere oimokererigwe igoro mono kegima.

english: Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised in the city of our God , in the mountain of his holiness .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe; ere goika atogigwe agwo ase omochie o Nyasae oito, ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.

english: According to thy name , O God , so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth : thy right hand is full of righteousness .
ekegusii: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.

english: Let mount Zion rejoice , let the daughters of Judah be glad , because of thy judgments .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’egetunwa gia Sayoni bagoke; boigo nab’emechie y’Abayuda, ekiagera aye nigo okonacha ebiina bia boronge.

english: Walk about Zion , and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
ekegusii: Taara moetanane Sayoni, mobare emerobiri yaye.

english: Mark ye well her bulwarks , consider her palaces ; that ye may tell it to the generation following .
ekegusii: Rigereria chindwaki chiaye, eta motaare ime ase chiburi chiaye; erio nario morache goteebia ebigori bigochi-gocha:

english: For this God is our God for ever and ever : he will be our guide even unto death .
ekegusii: “Omonene oyo nere Nyasae oito o kare na kare. Ere nabe omoraai oito kogenderera botambe.”

english: God is known in her palaces for a refuge .
ekegusii: Agwo ase chiburi chi’omochie oyio, Nyasae bweorokirie ng’a nere obotamero bw’ogwekengera.

english: For, lo, the kings were assembled , they passed by together .
ekegusii: Rora, abarwoti nigo basangererekanete, bagacha amo.

english: They saw it, and so they marvelled ; they were troubled , and hasted away .
ekegusii: Ekero baroche omochie oria, nigo bakumetie, bakaondoka, bagatama.

english: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain , as of a woman in travail .
ekegusii: Bagasogwa nobwoba, bakaiguswa, bagaichana na koba nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore.

english: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind .
ekegusii: Nigo kwababunete buna chimeeri chia Tarisisi nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha.

english: As we have heard , so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts , in the city of our God : God will establish it for ever . Selah .
ekegusii: Amang’ana twaigwete, bono twayarorire agwo ase omochie Omonene bw’Emeganda, omochie o Nyasae oito. Nyasae nigo ayorendete na koyokong’ia goika kare na kare.

english: We have thought of thy lovingkindness , O God , in the midst of thy temple .
ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.

english: Hear this, all ye people ; give ear , all ye inhabitants of the world :
ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Tegerera moigwe, inwe mwensi momenyete ase ense,

english: For he seeth that wise men die , likewise the fool and the brutish person perish , and leave their wealth to others .
ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bamanyete ng’a nonya nabaanto abang’aini ngokwa bare, naboigo nabare abariri na amachara, erio batiga abanto abaao bakoira chinibo chiabo.

english: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever , and their dwelling places to all generations ; they call their lands after their own names .
ekegusii: Nigo bakorengereria ng’a nigo chirabeo kare na kare, na obomenyo bwabo ebiaare ase ebiaare; nigo bagwatora emegondo yabo ase amarieta abo.

english: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish .
ekegusii: Korende Mwanyabaanto takonyara kogenderera koba nogosikwa, ere nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.

english: This their way is their folly : yet their posterity approve their sayings . Selah .
ekegusii: Obwo nabwo obosiru bw’abaanto abwo besemeretie abanyene, omoerio obo abwo begenete amang’ana abo.

english: Like sheep they are laid in the grave ; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning ; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling .
ekegusii: Buna riicho rie ching’ondi nigo bakoirwa gochia aase abakuure amakweri naro arabe omorisia obo. Abwo bare abaronge mbaabagambere kobogokiamoka, na ebieni biabo mbisirere agwo aase abakuure aase are obomenyo bwabo.

english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave : for he shall receive me. Selah .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae naboorie omoyo one, ayorusie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakuure erinde ang’ire imenye asare.

english: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich , when the glory of his house is increased ;
ekegusii: Tobaisa koiroka ekero omonto abeire omotenenku, na ebinto bire ase enyomba yaye biamentekanire.

english: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away : his glory shall not descend after him.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto oyio arakwe, takoira gento kende, obonene bwaye tibokomotunyana bogende inse aaria amo nere.

english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul : and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
ekegusii: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng’a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,

english: He shall go to the generation of his fathers ; they shall never see light .
ekegusii: ere goika akwe, asangerereke ase chisokoro chiaye chire, echio chitarore oborabu naende.

english: Both low and high , rich and poor , together .
ekegusii: inwe mwensi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka mwensi amo tegerera!

english: Man that is in honour , and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish .
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto oyio osikire otabwati obong’aini, nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.

english: My mouth shall speak of wisdom ; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding .
ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang’ana ’obong’aini, na ebirengererio bi’enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi’okomanya.

english: I will incline mine ear to a parable : I will open my dark saying upon the harp .
ekegusii: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ’gokobugia obokano.

english: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil , when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
ekegusii: Inche tinkoba nobwoba ase chingaki chi’emechando, ekero amabe ’abachandi baane arabe ang’etananire.

english: They that trust in their wealth , and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches ;
ekegusii: Tinkwoboa abanto abwo basemeretie obotenenku bwabo; barabwo nigo bare bakoenenera obonda bwabo bore obonge.

english: None of them can by any means redeem his brother , nor give to God a ransom for him:
ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari oranyare kobooria oyomwabo, gose koa Nyasae embooria y’ogotooria obogima bwaye.

english: (For the redemption of their soul is precious , and it ceaseth for ever :)
ekegusii: Rigori ri’okobooria omoyo oye nigo rire rinene mono, na mbooria ende teri eraisanere rigori erio,

english: That he should still live for ever , and not see corruption .
ekegusii: eyio eragere omonto agenderere koba moyo botambe, tabaisa kogenda ase embeera.

english: Hear me when I call , O God of my righteousness : thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress ; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, aye okong’a oboronge, ong’iranerie ekero ngokorangeria! Ekero narenge nkomiga‐migwa nobokong’u nigo kwang’ete ribaga rigare. Indorera amaabera, na oigwe ogosaba kwane!

english: O ye sons of men , how long will ye turn my glory into shame ? how long will ye love vanity , and seek after leasing ? Selah .
ekegusii: Inwe Mwanyabaanto, ngoika ririri moragenderere korenta emechando na kobeka echayo ase obonene bwane? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwancha amang’ana abosa na korigia ay’oborimo?

english: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
ekegusii: Korende manya ng’a Omonene bwechoreire omonyene oboronge. Omonene nigo akonyigwa ekero nkomosaba.

english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness , and put your trust in the LORD .
ekegusii: Karue ebing’wanso bi’oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.

english: There be many that say , Who will shew us any good ? LORD , lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
ekegusii: Abanto abange bagokwana iga: “Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwanyora ayare amaya.” Aye Omonene, tiga omobaso bw’obosio bwao otomorekere.

english: Thou hast put gladness in my heart , more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased .
ekegusii: Kwang’eire omogooko ase enkoro yane ime ore omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.

english: I will both lay me down in peace , and sleep : for thou, LORD , only makest me dwell in safety .
ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.

english: The mighty God , even the LORD , hath spoken , and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
ekegusii: Nyasae omonguru, Nyasae Omonene, nigo agokwana, nigo agokwana na korangeria ense yonsi korwa moocha goika bosongo.

english: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills .
ekegusii: ekiagera ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nechiane, ne chiombe chilifu chire ase ebigoro nechiane.

english: I know all the fowls of the mountains : and the wild beasts of the field are mine .
ekegusii: Nimanyete chinyoni chionsi chire ase ebitunwa, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chikonagoetanana ase ense nechiane.

english: If I were hungry , I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
ekegusii: “Onye narenge nenchara, tinare kogotebia, ekiagera ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo nebiane.

english: Will I eat the flesh of bulls , or drink the blood of goats ?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche ne chinyama chie chieri nkoria? Gose namanyinga e chimbori nkonywa?

english: Offer unto God thanksgiving ; and pay thy vows unto the most High :
ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.

english: And call upon me in the day of trouble : I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
ekegusii: Ndangerie ase engaki y’emechando; inche ninoboseemia, naye nontogie.”

english: But unto the wicked God saith , What hast thou to do to declare my statutes , or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth ?
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotebia omokori amabe, “Naye mboronge ki obwate okonagwatora amachiiko aane? Gose kona‐gokwana‐kwana okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania?

english: Seeing thou hatest instruction , and castest my words behind thee.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogechete amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, gwatugutire amang’ana aane gochia magega.

english: When thou sawest a thief , then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers .
ekegusii: Ekero okorora omoibi, nigo ogwancherana nere, boigo nigo okobwatana nabatomani.

english: Thou givest thy mouth to evil , and thy tongue frameth deceit .
ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang’ana ’obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.

english: Out of Zion , the perfection of beauty , God hath shined .
ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw’oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.

english: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother ; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoikaransa na konakogamba abanto bamino bobe; nigo okona‐kong’acha oyomino morwete enda eyemo.

english: These things hast thou done , and I kept silence ; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes .
ekegusii: Kwabeire gokona‐gokora ayio, nainche nkirete‐kiri, nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo inde buna aye. Korende bono nkogotogonyera nde na kobeka ayio ase obosio bwao.

english: Now consider this, ye that forget God , lest I tear you in pieces , and there be none to deliver .
ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwanyebire inche Nyasae, rengereria amang’ana aya mono; onye taibo, nimbaake mbatandorane, na monto onde tari orabatoorie.

english: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God .
ekegusii: Onde bwensi okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okwo nakwo ekeng’wanso ki’ogonsika, na onde bwensi okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nimorentere ogotooreka kwane inche Nyasae.”

english: Our God shall come , and shall not keep silence : a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
ekegusii: Nyasae oito ngocha are, tagokirakiri; omorero okoria nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, omwaga omotindi nigo omoetanaine.

english: He shall call to the heavens from above , and to the earth , that he may judge his people .
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorangeria igoro na ense chibe birori, ekero akonachera abanto baye ekiina, ogoteeba:

english: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice .
ekegusii: “Sangereria abanto baane abegenwa bache asende, abwo bakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainche ase okorua ebing’wanso.”

english: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness : for God is judge himself. Selah .
ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoraria oboronge bwa Nyasae; Nyasae omonyene nere omonachi ebiina.

english: Hear , O my people , and I will speak ; O Israel , and I will testify against thee: I am God , even thy God .
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.

english: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings , to have been continually before me.
ekegusii: Tinkobatogonyera ase engencho y’ebing’wanso biaino; ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa nigo bire ase obosio bwane botambe.

english: I will take no bullock out of thy house , nor he goats out of thy folds .
ekegusii: Tingwanchera chieri chikorwa ase ameeri aino, gose chigoree chikorwa ase amaicho aino;

english: Have mercy upon me, O God , according to thy lovingkindness : according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ’ndorere amaabera koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera; ase engencho y’obonge bw’amaabera ao otinyie ogosaria kwane.

english: Create in me a clean heart , O God ; and renew a right spirit within me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ontongere enkoro endabu, okore omoika ore ime yane obe omoyia na oyokong’ie.

english: Cast me not away from thy presence ; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
ekegusii: Tonyatanana korwa ase obosio bwao, nonya n’Omoika Omochenu toyorusia asende.

english: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation ; and uphold me with thy free spirit .
ekegusii: Ong’iranerie omogooko okorwa ase ogotooreka kwao, okong’ie omoika one obe omoigweri.

english: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways ; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
ekegusii: Erio inyorokererie abasaria chinchera chiao, na abanyene ebibe mbairane asore.

english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness , O God , thou God of my salvation : and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, ontoorie, ting’itera amanyinga ’abaanto, na oromeme rwane rotere n’oboronge bwao.

english: O Lord , open thou my lips ; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ong’igore ebikoba biane, na omonwa one norarie ogotogigwa kwao.

english: For thou desirest not sacrifice ; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering .
ekegusii: Togokiri nekeng’wanso, ninsa gokerua; aye toganeti ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.

english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit : a broken and a contrite heart , O God , thou wilt not despise .
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso biancheire na Nyasae omoyo omokanyeku na bw’okweitia; enkoro yasionokire na gwekeyia, aye Nyasae, tokoyechaya.

english: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion : build thou the walls of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene okorere Sayoni amaya ase amaabera ao; oagache chindwaki chia Yerusalemu.

english: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness , with burnt offering and whole burnt offering : then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar .
ekegusii: Erio nario oragokigwe n’ogosambwa kw’bing’wanso bi’ekeene; erio chieri nchiruegwe igoro ase egesasiimero kiao.

english: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity , and cleanse me from my sin .
ekegusii: Onsibie korwa obobe bwane kegima, na onchene korwa ase ebibe biane.

english: For I acknowledge my transgressions : and my sin is ever before me.
ekegusii: Inche namanyire ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane nigo bire bosio bwane botambe.

english: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity ; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo naiboretwe inde ne chingencho chi’ebibe; nigo narenge omonyabibe korwa ekero natongetwe ase enda yabaaba.

english: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts : and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom .
ekegusii: Rora, aye nigo oganetie ekeene ase enkoro ime; ase ayio inyorokererie obong’aini bwao ase enkoro yane ime.

english: Purge me with hyssop , and I shall be clean : wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow .
ekegusii: Onsibie ne chinsagia chia hisopo, na inche nincheneke; onsibie erio imbe omorabu se goetania amagena ’embura.

english: Make me to hear joy and gladness ; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice .
ekegusii: Ong’ichorie n’omogooko na omochengo, amauga aane aya gwasenyentete n’agoke.

english: Hide thy face from my sins , and blot out all mine iniquities .
ekegusii: Togaacha etobo y’ebibe biane bosio bwao, torora ebibe biane; ontinyie obobe bwane bwonsi.

english: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief , O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually .
ekegusii: Aye omonto ore nokobua, nase ki ogwetogeria amabe aya ogokora? Obwanchani bwa Nyasae nigo bogendererete kare na kare.

english: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs ; like a sharp razor , working deceitfully .
ekegusii: Aye omong’ainereria, oromeme rwao nigo rokoroberia amang’ana ’ogosaria; nigo ronga buna omoyio otukia omwoge.

english: Thou lovest evil more than good ; and lying rather than to speak righteousness . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete amabe kobua amaya, nigo bwanchete gokwana oborimo kobua ekeene.

english: Thou lovest all devouring words , O thou deceitful tongue .
ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.

english: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever , he shall take thee away , and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place , and root thee out of the land of the living . Selah .
ekegusii: Nyasae nakoiyerie inse kare na kare, nakobwate na kogotaboria korwa nyomba mwao, nagosimore korwa ase ense y’abare moyo.

english: The righteous also shall see , and fear , and shall laugh at him:
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbarore ayio boboe, bamosekerere bateebe;

english: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength ; but trusted in the abundance of his riches , and strengthened himself in his wickedness .
ekegusii: “Rora, omonto oyo bwangete gokora Nyasae abe obotamero bwaye, nigo egenete obonge bw’obonda bwaye omonyene, na akeenenia ase chinguru chiaye chi’ogosaria.”

english: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God : I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo inga buna omozeituni osebogete ase enyomba ya Nyasae ime. Nigo nsemeretie obwanchani bwa Nyasae botari koera goika kare na kare.

english: I will praise thee for ever , because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name ; for it is good before thy saints .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kare na kare, ekiagera gwakorire ayio. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bare abegenwa nindarie erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.

english: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men , to see if there were any that did understand , that did seek God .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.

english: Every one of them is gone back : they are altogether become filthy ; there is none that doeth good , no, not one .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bairanire magega, bonsi amo basarekire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge ? who eat up my people as they eat bread : they have not called upon God .
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto abwo bagokora amabe, tibamanyeti gento? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari kondangeria inche Nyasae mbakonye.

english: There were they in great fear , where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame , because God hath despised them.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagosogwa nomoondoko omonene mono, omoondoko buna oyio tona‐komanyekana nonya ndinde, Nyasae nasiarere amauga ’emebere y’ababisa abwo bakonaaretie. Nyasae nabasookie, ekiagera obaangire.

english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion ! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people , Jacob shall rejoice , and Israel shall be glad .
ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Nyasae arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.

english: Save me, O God , by thy name , and judge me by thy strength .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ntoorie ase engencho y’erieta riao, ong’e oboronge bwane goetera ase okobua kwao.

english: Hear my prayer , O God ; give ear to the words of my mouth .
ekegusii: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokwana.

english: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul : they have not set God before them. Selah .
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu bang’umokeire kong’ita, na abanto abatindi nigo baganetie obogima bwane; abwo tibakoirogeti aye Nyasae.

english: Behold, God is mine helper : the Lord is with them that uphold my soul .
ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a Nyasae nere omokonyi one, Omonene nere orendete obogima bwane.

english: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies : cut them off in thy truth .
ekegusii: Nairanerie ababisa baane obobe bwabo. Aye Omonene, obasirie, ekiagera igo ore omwegenwa.

english: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name , O LORD ; for it is good .
ekegusii: Omonene, ninkoruere ekeng’wanso inde nenkoro y’ogwancha, nimbe nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.

english: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble : and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies .
ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe ase emechando yonsi, na amaiso aane nigo arigereretie ababisa baane inde nomochengo.

english: Give ear to my prayer , O God ; and hide not thyself from my supplication .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, tobaisa kwebisa toigwa ogosaba kw’ogosorora kwane.

english: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
ekegusii: bikoyoetanana igoro ase chindwaki omobaso na obotuko; amabe a mobosokano na emechando bire ase omochie oyio.

english: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets .
ekegusii: Obosareku nigo boichire ime yaye, obong’ainereria na ogokorera abande bobe tibikorua ase chinchera chiaye.

english: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
ekegusii: Onye nomobisa ore gonchecheria, nanga nigo nare koremereria; naende onye nomobisa ore gonkorera bobe ase oboenenu, nanga nigo nare kwebisa.

english: But it was thou, a man mine equal , my guide , and mine acquaintance .
ekegusii: Korende bono naye ogonkorera bobe, aye oyo kwarenge obomo nainche, omosani tomanyaine.

english: We took sweet counsel together , and walked unto the house of God in company .
ekegusii: Nigo tware koba tokogamba amo amang’ana amaya ay’ogosemania, naende nigo tware koba togosasiima amo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.

english: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell : for wickedness is in their dwellings , and among them.
ekegusii: Tiga amakweri abachere ababisa baane mobosokano, bagende gochia aase abakuure bare moyo; obobe nigo bore ase obomenyo bwabo, na ase chinkoro chiabo.

english: As for me, I will call upon God ; and the LORD shall save me.
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkomorangeria Nyasae, nere Omonene nantoorie.

english: Evening , and morning , and at noon , will I pray , and cry aloud : and he shall hear my voice .
ekegusii: Kera omogoroba, na emambia, na mobaso gati, nigo nkwereera ase engencho y’emechando yane, n’Omonene naigwe eriogi riane.

english: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
ekegusii: Ere nantoorie, andende buya korwa ase esegi eyio nkorwana, ekiagera ababisa abange banyimokeire.

english: God shall hear , and afflict them, even he that abideth of old . Selah . Because they have no changes , therefore they fear not God .
ekegusii: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.

english: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint , and make a noise ;
ekegusii: Inyigwe na ong’iranerie; inche nigo nkona‐korera na kweumia inde nobororo.

english: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant .
ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.

english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter , but war was in his heart : his words were softer than oil , yet were they drawn swords .
ekegusii: Chinkwana chiaye nigo chiarenge chinyororo kobua amaguta atundire, korende ebirengererio biaye nebi’esegi; amang’ana aye nigo arenge amororo kobua amaguta, nonya naboigo nigo akonachanacha buna emioro.

english: Cast thy burden upon the LORD , and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved .
ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.

english: But thou, O God , shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction : bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days ; but I will trust in thee.
ekegusii: Korende abanto abaiti na abang’ainereria aye Nyasae nobaturunkanie gochia ase eoromomo, ekero bataraika ase ekeng’ese ki’obogima bwabo, korende inche nimbe nkwegenete aye Omonene.

english: Because of the voice of the enemy , because of the oppression of the wicked : for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
ekegusii: Ninde nobwoba ase engencho y’amariogi ’ababisa baane, na ase engencho y’obobe bw’abakori amabe. Abanto abwo nigo bakondetera amaakwa, bakongecha bare nendamwamu.

english: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nomoichano, nasoirwe nokogoswa kw’amakweri.

english: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
ekegusii: Nasoirwe nobwoba na okoiguswa, nabuirwe nomoichano omonene.

english: And I said , Oh that I had wings like a dove ! for then would I fly away , and be at rest .
ekegusii: Bono nigo ngoteeba: “Onye ndiria nabwate chimbaaba buna riruma, nanga nigo nare koiruruka ngende gotimoka.

english: Lo, then would I wander far off , and remain in the wilderness . Selah .
ekegusii: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.

english: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest .
ekegusii: Nigo nare kominyoka chimbero, erinde inyenyorere aase nkwebisa, korwa ase omwaga omotindi na ekembugu‐mbugu.”

english: Destroy , O Lord , and divide their tongues : for I have seen violence and strife in the city .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, saria emeroberio y’abanto abwo, otantanie chimeme chiabo tibaigwana. Narorire obotindi na amariomana bire agwo ase omochie,

english: Be merciful unto me, O God : for man would swallow me up ; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorere amaabera, ekiagera abanto nigo baganetie ng’a bang’ite bansirie kegima; omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondwania esegi.

english: In God will I praise his word : in the LORD will I praise his word .
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye; ee, ase okobua kw’Omonene nintogie ring’ana riaye.

english: In God have I put my trust : I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
ekegusii: Nigo nsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki aranyare gonkorera?

english: Thy vows are upon me, O God : I will render praises unto thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, goika ng’ikeranie chiira nakorierete; naende ninkoruere ebing’wanso bi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death : wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling , that I may walk before God in the light of the living ?
ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.

english: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High .
ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondigia baamere, ee, mbare abange mono bakondwania ase oboenenu.

english: What time I am afraid , I will trust in thee.
ekegusii: Ekero inde nobwoba, nigo ngosemeretie.

english: In God I will praise his word , in God I have put my trust ; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye, ninsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki baranyare gonkorera?

english: Every day they wrest my words : all their thoughts are against me for evil .
ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakoonchorana amang’ana aane; ebirengererio biabo bionsi nigo bire ebibe igoro yane.

english: They gather themselves together , they hide themselves, they mark my steps , when they wait for my soul .
ekegusii: Nigo bagosangererekana amo baroberia komboera, barigererie kera egento ngokora; naboigo bagendererete korigia obogima bwane babosirie.

english: Shall they escape by iniquity ? in thine anger cast down the people , O God .
ekegusii: Inee! Nabatooreke korwa ase obobe buna obwo? Taibo. Aye Nyasae, basirie abanto abwo kegima nendamwamu yao entindi.

english: Thou tellest my wanderings : put thou my tears into thy bottle : are they not in thy book ?
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nomanyete okoong’anya kwane, nigo osangereretie amariga aane okayabeka ase egetono kiao. Inee! Ayio onsi tarikiri ase egetabu yao?

english: When I cry unto thee , then shall mine enemies turn back : this I know ; for God is for me.
ekegusii: Ekero ndarangerie Omonene, ababisa baane mbairanigwe gochia magega. Nimanyete kegima ng’a Nyasae nigo are ase ensemo yane.

english: Be merciful unto me, O God , be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge , until these calamities be overpast .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, indorera amaabera, ekiagera naye natameire nomoyo one. Nintame nyebise inse ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao, goika omwaga bw’ogosiria oete.

english: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens , and thy truth unto the clouds .
ekegusii: Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro; obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.

english: Be thou exalted , O God , above the heavens : let thy glory be above all the earth .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

english: I will cry unto God most high ; unto God that performeth all things for me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkorera ase Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, ase Nyasae oria okong’ikeraneria onsi.

english: He shall send from heaven , and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up . Selah . God shall send forth his mercy and his truth .
ekegusii: Omonene nantomere ogotooreka korwa igoro, nababue abwo bagonkorera bobe babe nobosooku. Nyasae naorokie amaabera aye na ekeene kiaye.

english: My soul is among lions : and I lie even among them that are set on fire , even the sons of men , whose teeth are spears and arrows , and their tongue a sharp sword .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oetananire ne chindo, nigo ndaire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto bagoutoka omorero, amaino abo nigo are amoge buna amatimo ne chinsara, chimeme chiabo nigo chire emioro emioge.

english: Be thou exalted , O God , above the heavens ; let thy glory be above all the earth .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.

english: They have prepared a net for my steps ; my soul is bowed down : they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves . Selah .
ekegusii: Ababisa bantegeire oboreba ase ngoeta, bamionogoreire inse. Bakunyire eirima ase enchera yane, korende mbarabwo abanyene bagure imeo.

english: My heart is fixed , O God , my heart is fixed : I will sing and give praise .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere noboremu, ee, nigo ere noboremu; nintere na gochenga.

english: Awake up , my glory ; awake , psaltery and harp : I myself will awake early .
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

english: I will praise thee, O Lord , among the people : I will sing unto thee among the nations .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase egati y’abanto ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.

english: Do ye indeed speak righteousness , O congregation ? do ye judge uprightly , O ye sons of men ?
ekegusii: Inwe abamokogamba, Inee, ngokwana more amang’ana ’ekeene? Inee! Nkonachera more abanto ebiina bire boronge?

english: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance : he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abaanto abanyabibe.

english: So that a man shall say , Verily there is a reward for the righteous : verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bateebe, “Ekeene, abanyaboronge nigo bakonyora eng’eria yabo; ekeene, Nyasae nareo okonacha ebiina ase ense.”

english: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness ; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth .
ekegusii: Yaya, nigo more nemeroberio emekorekanu ime ase chinkoro chiaino, amaboko aino nigo agokora obotindi bw’oborianania ase ense.

english: The wicked are estranged from the womb : they go astray as soon as they be born , speaking lies .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo basirete korwa chinda chi’abang’ina, abanyaborimo nigo bakoba abatantanu korwa engaki y’okoiborwa kwabo.

english: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent : they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear ;
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate obosongo bonga buna obw’eng’iti, nigo banga buna rirubi rigoticha amato aye,

english: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers , charming never so wisely .
ekegusii: erinde tiriigwa amariogi abanyamosira, gose ay’abaebia b’obong’aini.

english: Break their teeth , O God , in their mouth : break out the great teeth of the young lions , O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obune amaino ’emenwa yabo; aye Omonene, gokora amagegu e chindo chinsae!

english: Let them melt away as waters which run continually : when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows , let them be as cut in pieces .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga basirigwe kegima buna amaache omogooko agoeta asira; ekero bakoruta emegwe yabo, eburoke.

english: As a snail which melteth , let every one of them pass away : like the untimely birth of a woman , that they may not see the sun .
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna amakorominyo akonyititoka amarenda aera, na buna oborito bw’omokuungu bokogwa botaraika engaki yaye.

english: Before your pots can feel the thorns , he shall take them away as with a whirlwind , both living , and in his wrath .
ekegusii: Omonene nabasirie bwango, ee, bwango kobua chinyongo chiaino chitarabwata riberera ri’omorero bw’amagwa, karabe amabese gose amasusanu.

english: Deliver me from mine enemies , O my God : defend me from them that rise up against me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, indende korwa ase abanto aba banyimokeire gonkora bobe.

english: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies .
