ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y’ababisa baane.

english: Slay them not, lest my people forget : scatter them by thy power ; and bring them down , O Lord our shield .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, enguba yaito, tobaisa kobaita! Abanto baane nigo barabaise kweba. Obaomboganie ase chinguru chiao, erio omanye kobasiria.

english: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride : and for cursing and lying which they speak .
ekegusii: Ebibe nigo bire ase emenwa yabo, na amang’ana bagokwana namabe. Ase igo, tiga oboenenu bwabo bobabwate buna oboreba bokobwata. Barabwo nigo bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’oborimo.

english: Consume them in wrath , consume them , that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth . Selah .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obasirie nendamwamu yao; basirie kegima, onde tanyorekana ore moyo nonya noyomo, erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nere okogambera abanto ba Yakobo.

english: And at evening let them return ; and let them make a noise like a dog , and go round about the city .
ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.

english: Let them wander up and down for meat , and grudge if they be not satisfied .
ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.

english: But I will sing of thy power ; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning : for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble .
ekegusii: Korende inche nintere igoro y’okobua kwao, kera emambia nintere neriogi rinene igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, ekiagera ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo kwabeire egekengero kiane na obotamero bwane.

english: Unto thee, O my strength , will I sing : for God is my defence , and the God of my mercy .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nintere ogoteera gw’okogotogia; aye naye egekengero kiane, aye naye Nyasae onyanchete mono.

english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity , and save me from bloody men .
ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.

english: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul : the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression , nor for my sin , O LORD .
ekegusii: Rora, abanto aba bebisete na komboera bang’ite, abanto abatindi basangererekanire amo bankore bobe; Omonene, ayio tari ase engencho y’ogosaria gose ebibe nakorire.

english: They run and prepare themselves without my fault : awake to help me, and behold .
ekegusii: Tindakora bobe bonde bokogera baminyoke gocha gonkora bobe. Omonene imoka, orore amang’ana ayio, onkonye!

english: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts , the God of Israel , awake to visit all the heathen : be not merciful to any wicked transgressors . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, naye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli! Imoka, orue egesusuro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tobaisa gotigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo ase abwo bagokora amabe ase obong’ainereria.

english: Behold, they belch out with their mouth : swords are in their lips : for who, say they , doth hear ?
ekegusii: Oise kobarigereria, orore buna bakona‐gokwana‐kwana! Ebikoba biabo nigo bire buna emioro emioge, bateba: “Ning’o oranyare gotoigwa?”

english: But thou, O LORD , shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo okobasekerera, aye nigo ogochecheria abanto bonsi batakomanyeti.

english: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nimbe nkoganyete, ekiagera naye ore obotamero obokong’u.

english: Give ear to my words , O LORD , consider my meditation .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane; oiraneria egekoe kiane.

english: Destroy thou them, O God ; let them fall by their own counsels ; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions ; for they have rebelled against thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obae egesusuro ase ebibe biabo: emeroberio eyio bakorire tiga egere bagwe. Obaserie kegima, ekiagera basaririe asore, na ekiagera bangire gokoigwera.

english: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice : let them ever shout for joy , because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakogotamera mbabe nomogooko, barabwo mbatere kogenderera botambe na gochenga. Aye igo orakengere abwo banchete erieta riao, erio banyare koba nomogooko omonene ase engencho yao.

english: For thou, LORD , wilt bless the righteous ; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ogosesenia omonyene oboronge na komotuba n’obuya bwao bw’amaabera buna enguba.

english: Hearken unto the voice of my cry , my King , and my God : for unto thee will I pray .
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti one, aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ’okorera kwane, ekiagera naye ngosaba.

english: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning , O LORD ; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up .
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba kwane maambia; kobogokiamoka nigo nkobeka okogania kwane obosio bwao, erio naganya ntegesetie.

english: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness : neither shall evil dwell with thee.
ekegusii: Aye tori Nyasae bwanchete ogokora okobe. Oyogokora ebibe takonyara komenya amo naye.

english: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight : thou hatest all workers of iniquity .
ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu tibakonyara gotenena obosio bwao, nigo ogechete abakori amabe bonsi.

english: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing : the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man .
ekegusii: Aye nigo orasirie abanyaborimo bonsi; aye Omonene nigo ogechete abaiteri amanyinga na abang’ainereria.

english: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy : and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple .
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obonge bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera ninsoe nyomba mwao; nigo ndasasime ndigereretie Hekalu yao Enchenu na nimbe ngokoiroka.

english: Lead me, O LORD , in thy righteousness because of mine enemies ; make thy way straight before my face .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.

english: O God , thou hast cast us off , thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased ; O turn thyself to us again .
ekegusii: Nyasae, aye gwatwangire na gwatosiareire, kwabeire kore nendamwamu, toiranerie amaya aito.

english: Wilt not thou, O God , which hadst cast us off ? and thou , O God , which didst not go out with our armies ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

english: Thou hast made the earth to tremble ; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh .
ekegusii: Aye gwatengechirie ense na koyetandora; iraneria naende amatandoku ayio, ekiagera nigo egotengecha mono.

english: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things : thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment .
ekegusii: Gwakorire abanto bao babeire nemechando emekong’u; gwatonyoisirie edivai yatotindirie na gotoong’anyia.

english: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye kwaeire abanto abwo bakoirogete ekemanyererio, kenyare koimokererigwa igoro ase ogotenenera ekeene.

english: That thy beloved may be delivered ; save with thy right hand , and hear me.
ekegusii: Igo nonyare gotooria abanto abwo gwanchete; otoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio, oigwe ogosaba gwaito.

english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head ; Judah is my lawgiver ;
ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.

english: Moab is my washpot ; over Edom will I cast out my shoe : Philistia , triumph thou because of me.
ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera; nindute egekoroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”

english: Hear my cry , O God ; attend unto my prayer .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, igwa ekerero kiane; tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.

english: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed : lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane yarusirie moyo, nigo ngokorangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Aye ondaae gochia egetare keria kere egetambe mono kombua.

english: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy .
ekegusii: Aye naye obotamero bwane, eburi enkong’u egonkengera korwa ase ababisa baane.

english: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever : I will trust in the covert of thy wings . Selah .
ekegusii: Ing’a ribaga ingenderere komenya botambe ase eema yao; ninganetie inyore oborendi obuya inse y’ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.

english: For thou, O God , hast heard my vows : thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae kwaigure chiira chiane narire ase ogotiana, abanto bairogete erieta riao kwabaeire omwando obo.

english: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life : and his years as many generations .
ekegusii: Omentere omorwoti amatuko agenderere koba moyo; emiaka yaye ebe ey’ebiaare ebinge.

english: He shall abide before God for ever : O prepare mercy and truth , which may preserve him.
ekegusii: Tiga agenderere botambe koba omorwoti ase obosio bwao aye Nyasae; obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwao, bimorende.

english: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever , that I may daily perform my vows .
ekegusii: Igo nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia erieta riao botambe, naende rituko ase rituko imbe ngoikerania chiira chiane.

english: Truly my soul waiteth upon God : from him cometh my salvation .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogotooreka kwane nigo gokorwa asare.

english: Trust not in oppression , and become not vain in robbery : if riches increase , set not your heart upon them .
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria obourereria, timobaisa koba nogosemeria kwa bosa ase ebinto bi’oboibi. Onye obotenenku bwaino bwabeire obonge, timobaisa kobosemeria.

english: God hath spoken once ; twice have I heard this ; that power belongeth unto God .
ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire ara rimo, ee, nabeire nkoyaigwa chintunda ibere, ng’a Nyasae nere omonyene okobua.

english: He only is my rock and my salvation ; he is my defence ; I shall not be greatly moved .
ekegusii: Ere nere bweka egetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, nere orwaki rwane, tinkonyegerigwa mono.

english: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man ? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence .
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe mwensi, ngoika ririri moragenderere korwania omonto ore bweka, erinde momoakere inse, inwe mwensi amo, buna nigo are enyasi ere ang’e kogwa na orwaki rwatandokire?

english: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency : they delight in lies : they bless with their mouth , but they curse inwardly . Selah .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia bamoiyerie korwa ase obonene bwaye. Barabwo nigo bakogokigwa mono gokwana oborimo; nigo bagosesenia nebikoba biabo bosa, korende ase chinkoro chiabo ime nigo bakoragereria.

english: My soul , wait thou only upon God ; for my expectation is from him.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo omoganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogosemeria kwane nigo gokorwa asare.

english: He only is my rock and my salvation : he is my defence ; I shall not be moved .
ekegusii: Ere bweka negetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u; tinkonyegerigwa.

english: In God is my salvation and my glory : the rock of my strength , and my refuge , is in God .
ekegusii: Ogotooreka kwane, na obonene bwane, nigo bikonyorekana ase Nyasae. Nyasae negetare kiane gie chinguru, na obotamero bwane.

english: Trust in him at all times ; ye people , pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.

english: Surely men of low degree are vanity , and men of high degree are a lie : to be laid in the balance , they are altogether lighter than vanity .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Mwanyabaanto nigo bare buna omooki rioka, abanto baeire obonene nigo bare bosa; ekero bakorengwa nigo bare abagusu; bonsi nigo bare abagusu kobua omooki.

english: O God , thou art my God ; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land , where no water is;
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae one, naye ngotang’ana korigia. Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, na omobere one nigo okoganetie, ase ense y’eguru‐gura enyomo pa etari namaache.

english: They shall fall by the sword : they shall be a portion for foxes .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bararuegwe baitwe nemioro, babe endagera ye chisese chi’orosana.

english: But the king shall rejoice in God ; every one that sweareth by him shall glory : but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omorwoti nabe okogoka ase Nyasae, na abanto bonsi abagotiana asare mbabe bagwetogia, korende emenwa y’abanto bagokwana oborimo nekirigwe.

english: To see thy power and thy glory , so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Nabeire ngokorigia ase Obomenyo Obochenu, erinde ndore okobua kwao na obonene bwao.

english: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life , my lips shall praise thee.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.

english: Thus will I bless thee while I live : I will lift up my hands in thy name .
ekegusii: Nimbe nkona‐kogotogia ase obogima bwane bwonsi, ase erieta riao nindambore amaboko aane gochia igoro.

english: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness ; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips :
ekegusii: Omoyo one oisanekire buna oyorire obonoru bw’emeseto na ebitinya, nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one ore nebikoba bire nomogooko.

english: When I remember thee upon my bed , and meditate on thee in the night watches .
ekegusii: Ekero indaire ase oborere bwane, nigo nkoba nkorengereretie, ase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biane nigo bikona‐gokoiranerera.

english: Because thou hast been my help , therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice .
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire botambe ogokonya kwane, na inse y’ekiiriri gie chimbaaba chiao nintere nomogooko.

english: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nokobwaterere mono, ekiagera aye nonsiirete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio.

english: But those that seek my soul , to destroy it , shall go into the lower parts of the earth .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, mbagende gochia inse kegima y’ense.

english: Hear my voice , O God , in my prayer : preserve my life from fear of the enemy .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, igwa eriogi riane ekero nkorera; renda obogima bwane korwa ase omobisa oyo okongosa.

english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD , and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory .
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbabe nomogooko ase Omonene na komotamera. Abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabe bagwetogia.

english: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked ; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity :
ekegusii: Imbise korwa ase emeroberio ya bobisi y’abakori amabe, korwa ase eburu-buru y’abakori ebibe.

english: Who whet their tongue like a sword , and bend their bows to shoot their arrows , even bitter words :
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagotieria chimeme chiabo buna emioro, amang’ana bagokwana nigo are nobororo, anga buna chinsara.

english: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect : suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
ekegusii: Korwa ase baboeete nigo bakorasa omonto otari na komocha, bamorasa chinsara mobosokano batari nobwoba.

english: They encourage themselves in an evil matter : they commune of laying snares privily ; they say , Who shall see them?
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobeekana chinguru ase ogokora ebibe ebio barobeirie; nigo bagokwana amo igoro y’ogotegera abande oboreba bobisi, bagoteebania: “Ning’o torooche?”

english: They search out iniquities ; they accomplish a diligent search : both the inward thought of every one of them , and the heart , is deep .
ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio emebe, bagoteeba, “Bono twakorire omooroberio oito omoikeranu.” Ekeene, ebirengererio bia ime bi’omonto, na enkoro yaye, nigo bisinyete.

english: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow ; suddenly shall they be wounded .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nabarase ensara yaye, na barabwo baraswe mobosokano.

english: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away .
ekegusii: Nasirie abanto abwo ase engencho y’amang’ana amabe bagokwana; bonsi abarabe bakobarora mbasingisie emetwe yabo ase ogoichana.

english: And all men shall fear , and shall declare the work of God ; for they shall wisely consider of his doing .
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbairoke, babe bakoraria emeremo ya Nyasae na komanya mono ayakorire.

english: Praise waiteth for thee, O God , in Sion : and unto thee shall the vow be performed .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Sayoni, ogotogigwa nokwao; goika togoikeranerie chiira chiaito.

english: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly : thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers : thou blessest the springing thereof.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta embura ase chinchwara chi’emegondo y’ense; nigo okwarania aase aimokererete igoro, erio gwatoma embura yororobia riroba na gosesenia ebigokina ase emegondo.

english: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness ; and thy paths drop fatness .
ekegusii: Kwabeekeire omwaka egutwa y’obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.

english: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness : and the little hills rejoice on every side .
ekegusii: Amarisia e chirooro nigo agotonya boigo, na ebigoro nigo bieboetie omogooko.

english: The pastures are clothed with flocks ; the valleys also are covered over with corn ; they shout for joy , they also sing .
ekegusii: Ebirubo nigo biichire namaicho e ching’ondi, na amakura nigo atubire ne chindagera. Kera egento nigo kegochenga nomogooko.

english: O thou that hearest prayer , unto thee shall all flesh come .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba, ase ayio abanto bonsi mbache asore.

english: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions , thou shalt purge them away .
ekegusii: Nonya ebibe biambuire aye nigo okwabera ogosaria okwo.

english: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest , and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts : we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house , even of thy holy temple .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio gwachorire na komoikia ang’e, amenye naye ase chigoora chiao. Intwe ntoisaneke nobuya bw’enyomba yao, Hekalu yao Enchenu.

english: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation ; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth , and of them that are afar off upon the sea :
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase ogokora kw’ogokumia ogotoigwa ase oboronge bwao; naye ore ogosemeria kw’abaanto bamenyete ase ense, nonya ngoika chinsinyo chi’ense, na ase chinyancha chi’aare.

english: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains ; being girded with power :
ekegusii: Aye gwakong’irie ebitunwa ne chinguru chiao, ekiagera aye nigo bweboetie okobua.

english: Which stilleth the noise of the seas , the noise of their waves , and the tumult of the people .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotoereria enyancha ekoruma, na emerindo yaye, naboigo namarorooche a Mwanyabaanto.

english: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens : thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice .
ekegusii: Abamenyete ase chinsinyo chi’ense nigo bagokumia ebimanyererio biao. Abare ase erioba rigosoka korwa goikera ase rikogwa gochia, nigo okogera batera nomogooko.

english: Thou visitest the earth , and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God , which is full of water : thou preparest them corn , when thou hast so provided for it.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogwechandera ense, kwayerentera embura, nigo okoyea obotenenku obonge mono; chindooche chiao aye Nyasae nigo chiichire namaache. Ase okoroisia riroba igo nigo okoa abanto endagera.

english: Make a joyful noise unto God , all ye lands :
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae;

english: For thou, O God , hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae gwatoteemire, ee, gwatoteemire buna efeta egoteemwa ase omorero.

english: Thou broughtest us into the net ; thou laidst affliction upon our loins .
ekegusii: Nigo gwatotigete tokagwa ase egesibo aye nigo gwatotwegete egurube endito.

english: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads ; we went through fire and through water : but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place .
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwarentete ababisa baito bagatotacha emetwe. Intwe nigo twaetete ime y’omorero na amaache, korende nonya nabo, ogatorusiao, ogatobeka ase obuya obonge bore.

english: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings : I will pay thee my vows ,
ekegusii: Ninchiche ase enyomba yao, indetane ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ning’ikeranie chiira nakorierete ase ogotiana,

english: Which my lips have uttered , and my mouth hath spoken , when I was in trouble .
ekegusii: chiira chiria nakwanete nomonwa one, echio nariete ekero narenge ase emechando.

english: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings , with the incense of rams ; I will offer bullocks with goats . Selah .
ekegusii: Ninkorentere ching’iti chire chinoru chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ninchirue amo nekeng’wanso gie chimingichi kere ne rimisu rigiya. Nindue ne chieri ne chimbori chibe ebing’wanso.

english: Come and hear , all ye that fear God , and I will declare what he hath done for my soul .
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamoirogete Nyasae, inchwo moigwe, nainche nimbatebie ay’Omonene ankoreire.

english: I cried unto him with my mouth , and he was extolled with my tongue .
ekegusii: Inche nigo narerete neriogi rinene asare, na ogotogigwa kwaye nigo kwarenge ase oromeme rwane.

english: If I regard iniquity in my heart , the Lord will not hear me:
ekegusii: Onye nabete ndengereretie amabe ase enkoro yane, Omonene anga tantegererete.

english: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer .
ekegusii: Korende ekeene, Nyasae ontegereire; ee, oigure eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.

english: Sing forth the honour of his name : make his praise glorious .
ekegusii: terera obonene bw’erieta riaye, moe obonene ase okomotogia!

english: Blessed be God , which hath not turned away my prayer , nor his mercy from me.
ekegusii: Nyasae atogigwe, ekiagera tangeti koigwa ogosaba kwane, gose tarusetie korwa asende obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.

english: Say unto God , How terrible art thou in thy works ! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.

english: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name . Selah .
ekegusii: Ense engima nigo ekogosasiima na kogotogia, abanto bonsi nigo bagotera na gotogia erieta riao.

english: Come and see the works of God : he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men .
ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Nyasae akorire. Aya akorire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto nigo are ay’okwoboyia.

english: He ruleth by his power for ever ; his eyes behold the nations : let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba ase okobua kwaye kare na kare; amaiso aye nigo arigereretie ebisaku bionsi, ase igo abasaria tibaabaisa kweimokereria igoro.

english: O bless our God , ye people , and make the voice of his praise to be heard :
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Nyasae oito, tiga eriogi ri’okomotogia riigweke.

english: Which holdeth our soul in life , and suffereth not our feet to be moved .
ekegusii: Omonene nere otorendete tore moyo, tatotigeti totererigwe amagoro.

english: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah .
ekegusii: Nyasae atororere amaabera, atosesenie, atoraberie obosio bwaye.

english: That thy way may be known upon earth , thy saving health among all nations .
ekegusii: Tiga enchera yao emanyekane ase ense, na okobua kwao kw’ogotooria komanyekane ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

english: Let the people praise thee, O God ; let all the people praise thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tiga abanto bagotogie; ee, abanto bonsi tiga bagotogie!

english: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy : for thou shalt judge the people righteously , and govern the nations upon earth . Selah .
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bagoke na oteera nomochengo; ekiagera aye nigo okonachera abanto ebiina ase oboronge. Aye naye okoraa ebisaku bire ase ense.

english: Then shall the earth yield her increase ; and God , even our own God , shall bless us.
ekegusii: Ense yamire okwama kwaye okonge, Nyasae, aye ore Nyasae oito, otosesenie!

english: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
ekegusii: Nyasae otosesenirie; ase igo, tiga abanto bare ase ense engima bamoiroke!

english: Let God arise , let his enemies be scattered : let them also that hate him flee before him.
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.

english: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God , hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor .
ekegusii: Omoganda oo okanyora obomenyo aase agwo. Aye Nyasae, ase engencho y’obuya bwao, kwaeire abanto abataka aya baremeire.

english: The Lord gave the word : great was the company of those that published it .
ekegusii: Nyasae akarua ogochika, na omoganda omonene bw’abakungu bakararia amang’ana ayio:

english: Kings of armies did flee apace : and she that tarried at home divided the spoil .
ekegusii: “Abarwoti b’abarwani esegi batamire, ee, batamire!” Abakungu batigarete ase chinka ngwatanana bare ebisakorwa.

english: Though ye have lien among the pots , yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver , and her feathers with yellow gold .
ekegusii: Nonya bagendererete kobeera ase ameri e ching’ondi, nigo bare buna amaruma are ne chimbaaba chiatubire nefeta, na amarionya abo atubire netaabu ekomeka‐meka.

english: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Omobui asiarerete abarwoti b’aase agwo, amagena ’embura agatwa ase egetunwa gia Salimoni.

english: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan ; an high hill as the hill of Bashan .
ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo ore egetunwa kia Nyasae, aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo obwate ebichuria ebinge.

english: Why leap ye, ye high hills ? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in ; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever .
ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ki’ebichuria ebinge, nase ki okorigereria ne ribero ase egetunwa ekio Nyasae achorire koba obomenyo bwaye? Ee, Omonene ochorire komenya aroro kogenderera botambe.

english: The chariots of God are twenty thousand , even thousands of angels : the Lord is among them, as in Sinai , in the holy place .
ekegusii: Chigari chia Nyasae nigo chire chilifu chinyinge mono, Omonene nigo are ase egati yabo buna nase Sinai, Aase aye aachenu.

english: Blessed be the Lord , who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation . Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

english: As smoke is driven away , so drive them away : as wax melteth before the fire , so let the wicked perish at the presence of God .
ekegusii: Tiga baserigwe gochia aare, buna erioki rikoirwa aa n’aaria; Tiga abakori amabe basirigwe kegima, barue ase obosio bwa Nyasae, basirigwe buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero.

english: He that is our God is the God of salvation ; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death .
ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are Nyasae ogotooria. Nyasae oito, Omonene nigo agototooria korwa ase amakweri.

english: But God shall wound the head of his enemies , and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses .
ekegusii: Nyasae nasenyente emetwe y’ababisa baye, nasenyente ebiore bire netukia bi’abwo bakogenderera ne chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe.

english: The Lord said , I will bring again from Bashan , I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea :
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agateeba: “Ning’iranie abanto abwo korwa Basani, mbarente korwa ase chindiba chi’enyancha,

english: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies , and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
ekegusii: erinde motache amanyinga abo namagoro aino, ne chisese chiaino chinyore ebitari biabo biababisa baino.”

english: They have seen thy goings , O God ; even the goings of my God , my King , in the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, omoganda oo ogotaara ororekanire; ee, aye Nyasae one, na omorwoti one, omoganda oria oo ogosoa ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.

english: The singers went before , the players on instruments followed after ; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels .
ekegusii: Abateri nigo batang’aine bosio, magega yabo abakobugia amakano, na ase egati yabo abaiseke bakobugia chinchigiri:

english: Bless ye God in the congregations , even the Lord , from the fountain of Israel .
ekegusii: “Inwe abamore ab’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, motogie Nyasae ase egati y’omosangererekano Omonene.”

english: There is little Benjamin with their ruler , the princes of Judah and their council , the princes of Zebulun , and the princes of Naphtali .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Benjamini, abare abasinini mono ase egati yabo, nao bare baabatang’aine, na abanene b’Abayuda nao bare amo nomoganda obo, na abanene b’Abasabuloni na ab’Abanafutali.

english: Thy God hath commanded thy strength : strengthen , O God , that which thou hast wrought for us.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.

english: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
ekegusii: Abarwoti nigo bagokorentera ebiegwa ime ase Hekalu yao ere agwo Yerusalemu.

english: But let the righteous be glad ; let them rejoice before God : yea, let them exceedingly rejoice .
ekegusii: Korende abanyene oboronge tiga babe nomogooko omonene kegima, tiga babe nomochengo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, babe bagoteera bare nomogooko.

english: Rebuke the company of spearmen , the multitude of the bulls , with the calves of the people , till every one submit himself with pieces of silver : scatter thou the people that delight in war .
ekegusii: Togonyera eng’iti eria y’orosana emenyete ase ebitonto ime, na amaicho e chieri amo ne chimori chiabo, nabwo abanto. Togonyera abanto goika bekeyie na gokoruera chifeta chiabo. Osiarere abanto banchete esegi.

english: Princes shall come out of Egypt ; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God .
ekegusii: Abanto bare ne chinguru mbarue Misiri, na abanto b’Ethiopia baayerere koramborera Nyasae amaboko abo.

english: Sing unto God , ye kingdoms of the earth ; O sing praises unto the Lord ; Selah :
ekegusii: Inwe amarwoti are ase ense, tera motogie Nyasae; tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene!

english: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens , which were of old ; lo, he doth send out his voice , and that a mighty voice .
ekegusii: Moteerere ere oria oriinete igoro, igoro eria yarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare. Rora, nigo agoaka eriogi riaye rire ne chinguru riaigugwa.

english: Ascribe ye strength unto God : his excellency is over Israel , and his strength is in the clouds .
ekegusii: Inwe raria okobua kwa Nyasae, oyio obonene bwaye bore igoro y’Abaisraeli, na okobua kwaye nigo kore igoro onsi.

english: O God , thou art terrible out of thy holy places : the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people . Blessed be God .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are oyo bw’okogosa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu; ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; nigo akoa abanto baye okobua ne chinguru. Omonene atogigwe!

english: Sing unto God , sing praises to his name : extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah , and rejoice before him.
ekegusii: Moteerere Nyasae, tera amatera agotogia erieta riaye. Moroiserie enchera ere agoetera ase chirooro. Erieta riaye n’Omonene, kabe nomochengo ase obosio bwaye!

english: A father of the fatherless , and a judge of the widows , is God in his holy habitation .
ekegusii: Nyasae oria omenyete aase aye aachenu, nere ise bwe chintakana, na omorendi bw’ababoraka.

english: God setteth the solitary in families : he bringeth out those which are bound with chains : but the rebellious dwell in a dry land .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo kegima.

english: O God , when thou wentest forth before thy people , when thou didst march through the wilderness ; Selah :
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero gwatang’anete abanto bao na ogotaara ase erooro,

english: Thou, O God , didst send a plentiful rain , whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance , when it was weary .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo kwarentete embura enyinge mono, na igo omwando oo oria konya orosire okayoiraneria chinguru.

english: Save me, O God ; for the waters are come in unto my soul .
ekegusii: Nyasae, intoorie, ekiagera amaache aichoire, aikire ase omoyo one.

english: When I wept , and chastened my soul with fasting , that was to my reproach .
ekegusii: Ekero nabete nkorera ase omoyo one na kweng’ata, ngachaywa na gokwanwa bobe.

english: I made sackcloth also my garment ; and I became a proverb to them.
ekegusii: Ekero neboyetie chigunia ase okweumia bakaba bakondabaara.

english: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards .
ekegusii: Inche ’ngokwanwa bobe nabwo bagoikaransa ang’e negeita kogamba, abakonywa na gotinda bakoroisia amatera ay’ogonchecheria.

english: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD , in an acceptable time : O God , in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngosaba ase engaki yancheire. Aye Nyasae, inyigwere, ekiagera nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, naende nigo ore omwegenwa ase ogotooria.

english: Deliver me out of the mire , and let me not sink : let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters .
ekegusii: Ntoorie, tindimera ase etintira ime! Ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, na korwa ase amaache ’endiba entambe.

english: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up , and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
ekegusii: Gaki totiga emerindo entube, gose chindiba chimere, gose engoro emumekerie.

english: Hear me, O LORD ; for thy lovingkindness is good : turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies .
ekegusii: Omonene, ing’iranerie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya, ing’iranere, ekiagera amaabera ao namange mono.

english: And hide not thy face from thy servant ; for I am in trouble : hear me speedily .
ekegusii: Tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende inche omosomba oo; inyigwe bwango, ekiagera inche nigo inde ase emechando emenene.

english: Draw nigh unto my soul , and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies .
ekegusii: Inchuo ang’e asende, omboorie, onsibore korwa ase ababisa baane!

english: Thou hast known my reproach , and my shame , and my dishonour : mine adversaries are all before thee.
ekegusii: Aye nomanyete amabe nakoreirwe, na buna nasookigwe na gochaywa; nigo omanyete ababisa baane bonsi.

english: I sink in deep mire , where there is no standing : I am come into deep waters , where the floods overflow me.
ekegusii: Nigo ngendererete korimera endiba y’etintira ime, aase tari ase ngotacha n’amagoro. Narimeire ase amaache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.

english: Reproach hath broken my heart ; and I am full of heaviness : and I looked for some to take pity , but there was none; and for comforters , but I found none.
ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.

english: Let their eyes be darkened , that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake .
ekegusii: Oukorie amaiso abo: otengechie chibachwa chiabo kogenderera.

english: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
ekegusii: Obaumorere ekeririanda kiao, na endamwamu yao yoke igoro yabo.

english: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten ; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bachandete omonto oria kwaagete, na bagokwana igoro y’obororo bw’oyio kwabetete.

english: Add iniquity unto their iniquity : and let them not come into thy righteousness .
ekegusii: Menta obobe igoro ase obobe bwabo; tobatiga basoe ase oboronge bwao.

english: But I am poor and sorrowful : let thy salvation , O God , set me up on high .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde ase emechando n’obororo; aye Nyasae, ogotooreka kwao konyimokererie igoro.

english: I am weary of my crying : my throat is dried : mine eyes fail while I wait for my God .
ekegusii: Narosire ekiagera nkona-korera, omoyo one bwomire kegima. Amaiso aane abeire orotutu, nganyete Nyasae one.

english: I will praise the name of God with a song , and will magnify him with thanksgiving .
ekegusii: Nintogie erieta ria Nyasae ase okomoterera; nindarie obonene bwaye ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.

english: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs .
ekegusii: Ayio naro aragokie Omonene kobua komoruera eng’ombe koba ekeng’wanso, gose komoruera eeri ere ne ching’unchara na ebitaago.

english: The humble shall see this, and be glad : and your heart shall live that seek God .
ekegusii: Abwo bakoreire bobe mbarore ayio, bagoke; inwe aba mokorigia Nyasae, tiga chinkoro chiaino chikorwe chinyia.

english: For the LORD heareth the poor , and despiseth not his prisoners .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoigwa abanto baria baremeire; ere tari gochaaya abanto baye abwo bare ase obosibwa.

english: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas , and every thing that moveth therein.
ekegusii: Tiga igoro na ense chitogie Omonene, naboigo na enyancha, na ebitongwa bionsi bire imeo.

english: For God will save Zion , and will build the cities of Judah : that they may dwell there, and have it in possession .
ekegusii: Nyasae natoorie Sayoni na aagache emechie y’Abayuda naende, abasomba baye mbayeire ebe eyabo na komenya aroro.

english: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba b’Omonene mbayeire ebe eyabo, boigo nabaanto baria banchete erieta ri’Omonene mbamenye aroro.

english: O God , thou knowest my foolishness ; and my sins are not hid from thee.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nomanyete oboriri bwane, naki amamocho aane tabisekaneti korwa asore.

english: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts , be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, totiga abanto abwo bagosemeretie, bare ime yane, barore obosooku. Aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, totiga abanto abwo bagokorigia, bare ime yane, bachaywe.

english: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach ; shame hath covered my face .
ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.

english: I am become a stranger unto my brethren , and an alien unto my mother’s children .
ekegusii: Inche nabeire omogeni ase abanto baminto, na omoeti ase abaminto twaiboretwe korwa ase enda eyemo.

english: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed : let them return and be ashamed suddenly .
ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono kegima, mbairane gochia magega bwango bare nobosooku.

english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; for I am weak : O LORD , heal me; for my bones are vexed .
ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ekiagera ’nde omonyanyuru. Aye Omonene, ’ngwenie, ekiagera amauga aane nigo akonyegerigwa.

english: My soul is also sore vexed : but thou, O LORD , how long?
ekegusii: Omoyo one ochandekire nomoondoko. Omonene, ngoika ririri orenane otarankonya?

english: Return , O LORD , deliver my soul : oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranere omboorie! Ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera.

english: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks ?
ekegusii: Ase abwo bakuure onde tari oranyare gokoinyora. Inee! Ning’o oranyare kogotogia korwa aase abakuure?

english: I am weary with my groaning ; all the night make I my bed to swim ; I water my couch with my tears .
ekegusii: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw’obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia namariga ase oborere bwane, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.

english: Mine eye is consumed because of grief ; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies .
ekegusii: Obosio bwane bwomire pa ase engencho y’emechando, bwareeire ase engencho y’ababisa baane bonsi.

english: The LORD hath heard my supplication ; the LORD will receive my prayer .
ekegusii: Omonene oigure okoboria kwane gw’okonyora amaabera, nere bwancheire ogosaba kwane.

english: Make haste , O God , to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!

english: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul : let them be turned backward , and put to confusion , that desire my hurt .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetie gosiria obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gotantanigwa, na abwo baganetie ng’a obobe bonyore inche, tiga bairanigwe magega na gochaywa.

english: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say , Aha , aha .
ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.

english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually , Let God be magnified .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao, tiga bagenderere goteeba: “Nyasae atogigwe!”

english: But I am poor and needy : make haste unto me, O God : thou art my help and my deliverer ; O LORD , make no tarrying .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa; aye Nyasae, inchwo bwango onkonye! Aye naye Omokonyi one, na Omotooria one. Aye Omonene, totebana!

english: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
ekegusii: Omonene, naye natameire, tontiga nsookigwe.

english: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bakongamba, basangererekanire gokora omooroberio bw’ogonsiria,

english: Saying , God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him .
ekegusii: bateeba: “Nyasae omotigire, inchwo tomotunye, erinde tomobwate, onde tari oranyare komotooria.”

english: O God , be not far from me: O my God , make haste for my help .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tombeera aare, Nyasae one, inchwo bwango onkonye!

english: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul ; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt .
ekegusii: Ababisa abwo bakorigia obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gosirigwa kegima; abwo bakorigia gonkora bobe, tiga bachaywe na gochecherigwa mono.

english: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .
ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nogosemeria botambe, na nimbe nkona-kogotogia mono goetania.

english: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day ; for I know not the numbers thereof .
ekegusii: Nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao kw’oboronge nomonwa one. Omobaso boira nimbe nkonagwatora ogotooreka kwao; okwo kore okonene ntanyare gokorenga.

english: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao okonene, nimbe nkona-gotogia oboronge bwao, ee, ningotogie aye bweka.

english: O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, kwabeire gokonyorokereria korwa obwana bwane, goika reero iga ningenderere konakoraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

english: Now also when I am old and grayheaded , O God , forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation , and thy power to every one that is to come .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, namerire chimbuche chiarabire se, goika imbe narareirie abanto b’ebiaare bigochi-gocha chinguru chiao, na okobua kwao.

english: Thy righteousness also, O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee!
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao boigete aaria igoro mono. Aye nigo gwakorete amang’ana amanene mono. Ee, Nyasae, ning’o ore buna aye?

english: Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
ekegusii: Nkonye na onsibore goetera ase oboronge bwao; ntegerere, ontoorie!

english: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles , shalt quicken me again , and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth .
ekegusii: Ekero gwatotigete, nigo twaroche emechando emenge, korende nonyare gotokora abayia naende; torusie, ototiirie korwa ase chiirima chire ase ense.

english: Thou shalt increase my greatness , and comfort me on every side .
ekegusii: Aye omente obonene bwane, na ondemie naende.

english: I will also praise thee with the psaltery , even thy truth , O my God : unto thee will I sing with the harp , O thou Holy One of Israel .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, nimbe nkobugia obokano ase okogotogia, ekiagera aye nigo ore omwegenwa. Nimbe nkogoterera ase okobugia obokano bw’ebirigisa, aye Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

english: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .
ekegusii: Ning’ake eriogi rinene ri’omogooko nomonwa one, ekero ndabe ngotera amatera akogotogia. Nintere nomoyo one boigo, ekiagera aye gwantooririe.

english: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .
ekegusii: Omobaso boira oromeme rwane ndobe rokona-gokwana igoro y’oboronge bwao, erinde abwo barigetie gonkora bobe basookigwe na gochaywa.

english: Be thou my strong habitation , whereunto I may continually resort : thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress .
ekegusii: Aye kabe egetare kiane ki’obotamero ase nkogenda botambe, aye gwanchire gontooria. Naki aye negetare kiane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u.

english: Deliver me, O my God , out of the hand of the wicked , out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokori amabe, indusie korwa ase okobua kw’oyo otari omooronge, na oyore omotindi.

english: For thou art my hope , O Lord GOD : thou art my trust from my youth .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ogosemeria kwane, nabeire nkwegenete korwa obwana bwane.

english: By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee.
ekegusii: Kwabeire gontenenerete korwa ekero ntaraiborwa, naye kwandusetie korwa ase enda ya baba. Naye ndabe nkona-gotogia botambe.

english: I am as a wonder unto many ; but thou art my strong refuge .
ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna egento ki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto abange, korende aye naye obotamero bwane obokong’u.

english: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .
ekegusii: Omonwa one noichorigwe nogotogigwa kwao, na omobaso boira ninkobake.

english: Cast me not off in the time of old age ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, tontiga ekero chinguru chirabe chiang’ereire.

english: Give the king thy judgments , O God , and thy righteousness unto the king’s son .
ekegusii: Nyasae, kae omorwoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omorwoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.

english: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents : the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts .
ekegusii: Abarwoti ba Tarisisi na ab’ebisinka ’mbabe bakomorentera ebiegwa; naboigo nabarwoti ba Sheba na Seba mbamorentere ebango.

english: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
ekegusii: Abarwoti bonsi ’mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbamokorere.

english: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth ; the poor also, and him that hath no helper .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria oyoremeire gakorangeria, naboigo nomotaka na oyotabwati onde okomokonya.

english: He shall spare the poor and needy , and shall save the souls of the needy .
ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y’abaremeire.

english: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence : and precious shall their blood be in his sight .
ekegusii: Nigo akobooria emioyo yabo korwa ase abachandi babo na korwa ase obotindi. Amanyinga abo nigo are nengencho enene asare.

english: And he shall live , and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba : prayer also shall be made for him continually ; and daily shall he be praised .
ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti agenderere koba moyo. Chitaabu chi’ense ya Seba chirentwe asare, tiga abanto babe bakomosabera botambe, boigo tiga abe okona-gosesenigwa kera rituko.

english: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains ; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon : and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth .
ekegusii: Tiga endagera yame enyinge ase ense, nonya nase ebitunwa igoro. Chindagera echio tiga china-konyegerigwa buna emete ya Lebanoni. Abanto b’emechie tiga babuche babe buna obonyansi bw’ense.

english: His name shall endure for ever : his name shall be continued as long as the sun : and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed .
ekegusii: Erieta riaye tiga rigenderere kobao botambe, rikume koreng’ana buna erioba rigendererete kobao. Abanto mbabe bagosesenigwa ime yaye; abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga bamoroke oyosesenirie.

english: Blessed be the LORD God , the God of Israel , who only doeth wondrous things .
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga atogigwe, nere bweka ogokora amakumia.

english: And blessed be his glorious name for ever : and let the whole earth be filled with his glory ; Amen , and Amen .
ekegusii: Tiga erieta riaye ri’obonene ritogigwe goika kare na kare; obonene bwaye tiga boichore ase ense yonsi. Amina, Amina!

english: He shall judge thy people with righteousness , and thy poor with judgment .
ekegusii: Erio amanye konachera abanto bao ebiina bi’oboronge na gokora ekeene ase abataka.

english: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended .
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoerio bw’ogosaba gwa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

english: The mountains shall bring peace to the people , and the little hills , by righteousness .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa na ebigoro mbirentere abanto omorembe goetera ase oboronge.

english: He shall judge the poor of the people , he shall save the children of the needy , and shall break in pieces the oppressor .
ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okorwanerera abataka, na atoorie abana b’abaremeire, korende asenyente abanto bagokorera abande bobe.

english: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure , throughout all generations .
ekegusii: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng’ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth .
ekegusii: Ere tiga aike korwa igoro buna embura egotwa ase obonyansi oborere, na buna omonyirira ogotwa igoro ase riroba.

english: In his days shall the righteous flourish ; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
ekegusii: Tiga omonyaboronge asesenigwe ase amatuko aye, na omorembe ogenderere kobao goika ekero omotienyi otabeo.

english: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust .
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase erooro mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, n’ababisa baye bamene orotu.

english: Truly God is good to Israel , even to such as are of a clean heart .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo are omuya mono ase Abaisraeli, ee, ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chichenegete.

english: Therefore his people return hither : and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto babo nigo bakoonchoka baababwatia, nigo bakwong’otera amaache abo are amange.

english: And they say , How doth God know ? and is there knowledge in the most High ?
ekegusii: Erio bateeba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”

english: Behold, these are the ungodly , who prosper in the world ; they increase in riches .
ekegusii: Naama! Naboigo abakori amabe bare; botambe nigo bare buya na bagendererete komenta obotenenku bwabo.

english: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain , and washed my hands in innocency .
ekegusii: Ekeene, mbosa nabeire ndendete enkoro yane ebe echenegete, mbosa nabeire ngoisaba amaboko aane ng’a timba nokomocha.

english: For all the day long have I been plagued , and chastened every morning .
ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.

english: If I say , I will speak thus ; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children .
ekegusii: Onye nakwanete amang’ana buna ayio, nigo narenge gocha koba oyotari omwegenwa ase ebiaare bi’abaanto bao.

english: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me ;
ekegusii: Bono ekero nabeete nkorengereria komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio, amang’ana ayio akaba amakong’u ase ’nde,

english: Until I went into the sanctuary of God ; then understood I their end .
ekegusii: goika ekero nasoete ime ase obomenyo obochenu bwa Nyasae, erio nario namanyete omoerio bw’abanyabibe buna ore.

english: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places : thou castedst them down into destruction .
ekegusii: Ekeene, aye Omonene nigo okobabeeka aase are aaterere, aye nigo okobaturunkania kwabasiria kegima.

english: How are they brought into desolation , as in a moment ! they are utterly consumed with terrors .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagosirigwa rioka, omoerio obo nomoondoko okobasiria.

english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone ; my steps had well nigh slipped .
ekegusii: Amagoro aane konya abeire ang’e kogochwa, konya nabeire ang’e gotererigwa,

english: As a dream when one awaketh ; so , O Lord , when thou awakest , thou shalt despise their image .
ekegusii: Nigo banga buna chindoto omonto akweba mambia gakoboka. Aye Omonene, naboigo bare asore buna omogwekano okororwa ase okorota, ekero okoimoka nigo okweba ebieni biabo.

english: Thus my heart was grieved , and I was pricked in my reins .
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobororo ase omoyo ime, na enkoro yane ekaba buna eyabetirwe.

english: So foolish was I, and ignorant : I was as a beast before thee.
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete omoriri mono, tinamanya gento; nkaba buna eng’iti y’orosana ase obosio bwao.

english: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, inche nigo ngendererete kobeera asore botambe, aye nigo obwatete okoboko kwane gw’okorio.

english: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel , and afterward receive me to glory .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y’ayio noche kong’ira onsoyie ase obonene.

english: Whom have I in heaven but thee ? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o naende imbwate aaria igoro, otatiga aye bweka? Ekero nkobwate, gento tikeri aiga ase ense nganetie.

english: My flesh and my heart faileth : but God is the strength of my heart , and my portion for ever .
ekegusii: Omobere one na enkoro yane nabo biranyare koborwa chinguru, korende aye Nyasae, naye ore egetare gi’enkoro yane, naende naye egetare kiane goika kare na kare.

english: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish : thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo bagweatanana korwa asore nabasire; aye nigo orasirie abwo batari abegenwa asore.

english: But it is good for me to draw near to God : I have put my trust in the Lord GOD , that I may declare all thy works .
ekegusii: Korende ase ’nde inche, nigo ere buya mono kobeera ang’e na Nyasae. Omonene obeire obotamero bwane, ninyare koraria emeremo yaye yonsi.

english: For I was envious at the foolish , when I saw the prosperity of the wicked .
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.

english: For there are no bands in their death : but their strength is firm .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari konyorwa nobokong’u bonde ase obogima bwabo; emebere yabo nigo ere emiya, naende emenoru.

english: They are not in trouble as other men ; neither are they plagued like other men .
ekegusii: Tibabwati emechando buna abanto bande babwate; tibari konyora amaakwa buna abande.

english: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain ; violence covereth them as a garment .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwerori nigo boetanaine amagoti abo, na obotindi nabwo beboyetie buna eanga.

english: Their eyes stand out with fatness : they have more than heart could wish .
ekegusii: Amaiso abo nigo akogirigenta nobonoru, obotantanu bw’ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo nobonge mono.

english: They are corrupt , and speak wickedly concerning oppression : they speak loftily .
ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abande na gokwana ase okobakorera bobe. Nigo bakweimokereria igoro na kobatianera.

english: They set their mouth against the heavens , and their tongue walketh through the earth .
ekegusii: Emenwa yabo nigo egokwana amang’ana amabe are mamincha ya igoro; ne chimeme chiabo chiasokia ayakogenda ase ense engima.

english: O God , why hast thou cast us off for ever ? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching’ondi chi’oborisia bwao?

english: O God , how long shall the adversary reproach ? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngoika ririri ababisa barabe bakona‐gochecheria? Inee! Ababisa aba nigo bagochia kona‐korama erieta riao kogenderera botambe?

english: Why withdrawest thou thy hand , even thy right hand ? pluck it out of thy bosom .
ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwaringire okoboko kwao gw’okorio? Korambore korwa ase egekuba kiao, obasirie kegima.

english: For God is my King of old , working salvation in the midst of the earth .
ekegusii: Nyasae, aye nigo ore omorwoti one, kwarengeo korwa kare, naye kwabeire kogokora emeremo y’ogotooria ense engima.

english: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood : thou driedst up mighty rivers .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amaache ye chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.

english: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun .
ekegusii: Omobaso noyoo, na obotuko nobwao, naye gwatongete omotienyi na erioba.

english: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth : thou hast made summer and winter .
ekegusii: Naye gwachiigete aase chimbebe chionsi chi’ense chikobeera, naende ogakora chingaki chi’egura gura n’etoigo.

english: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached , O LORD , and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.

english: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever .
ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omoyo one, inche riruma riao, ase omoganda oria omobe; tibweba nonya ng’ake abanto bao abwo baregire.

english: Remember thy congregation , which thou hast purchased of old ; the rod of thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed ; this mount Zion , wherein thou hast dwelt .
ekegusii: Inyora omoganda bw’abaanto bao, abwo kwenyorerete ase chingaki chia kare. Aye nigo kwababooretie babe egesaku kere omwando oo. Inyora egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase kwabeire komenyete.

english: Have respect unto the covenant : for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty .
ekegusii: Oinyore okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe; ense nigo eichire nobobe ase kera ensemo y’omosunte.

english: O let not the oppressed return ashamed : let the poor and needy praise thy name .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga abanto abwo bagokorerwa bobe basookigwe; tiga abanto abataka na abwo baremeire batogie erieta riao.

english: Arise , O God , plead thine own cause : remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily .
ekegusii: Nyasae, imoka bwerwanerere aye omonyene; inyora buna abatakoirogeti bakogokorera echeche kera rituko.

english: Forget not the voice of thine enemies : the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually .
ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba okwoga kw’ababisa bao, ne rirorooche ri’abakogochecheria rigotiira botambe.

english: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations ; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary .
ekegusii: Inchuo otaare aase agwo agendererete gosareka; ababisa nigo basaretie bionsi ebiarenge ime ase obomenyo boria obochenu.

english: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations ; they set up their ensigns for signs .
ekegusii: Ababisa bao nigo bakwoga aase abanto bao basangererekanete, barabwo batenenirie chibendera chiabo koba ebimanyererio biabo.

english: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees .
ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabaanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.

english: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers .
ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.

english: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary , they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground .
ekegusii: Nigo basambete nomorero Obomenyo bwao Obochenu, bakaiyeria inse Obomenyo Obochenu bw’erieta riao, na bakabokora bokaba obotachenegeti.

english: They said in their hearts , Let us destroy them together : they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateeba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.

english: We see not our signs : there is no more any prophet : neither is there among us any that knoweth how long .
ekegusii: Titorochi ebimanyererio biaito, na ababani tibaiyo, na onde tari ase egati yaito omanyete ngoika ririri aya arabe.

english: Unto thee, O God , do we give thanks , unto thee do we give thanks : for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo togokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende mbuya mono, ekiagera erieta riao nigo rire ang’e, nigo tokoraareria emeremo yao y’ogokumia.

english: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off ; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted .
ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima ching’unchara chi’abakori amabe, korende echi’abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.

english: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly .
ekegusii: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekiina kia boronge.

english: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved : I bear up the pillars of it. Selah .
ekegusii: Ekero ense egotengechigwa amo na bonsi abamenyeteo, ninche omonyene nigo nkobwata chisiiro chiaye bokong’u.

english: I said unto the fools , Deal not foolishly : and to the wicked , Lift not up the horn :
ekegusii: Nigo ngokania abanto bagwetogia: Timobaisa gwetogia, naende nintebie abakori amabe: Timobaisa komera ching’unchara chi’obomwenu.

english: Lift not up your horn on high : speak not with a stiff neck .
ekegusii: Ee, timobaisa gochiimokereria igoro ase ogwekaga, gose gokwana amabe, inwe abamore abanyabigoti bikong’u.”

english: For promotion cometh neither from the east , nor from the west , nor from the south .
ekegusii: Obonene tibori korwa moocha, gose korwa bosongo, gose tibori korwa ase ebitunwa bi’erooro.

english: But God is the judge : he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekiina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.

english: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup , and the wine is red ; it is full of mixture ; and he poureth out of the same : but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out , and drink them .
ekegusii: Omonene nabwate egekombe ase okoboko kwaye, geichire nedivai entindi yochoganirie, nayeumorere abakori amabe bonsi b’ense na kobabetereria bayenywe, bayekoore amo neturubo yaye.

english: But I will declare for ever ; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob .
ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nkona‐koraria kobeeka kogenderera botambe; nimbe nkona‐goteera ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae o Yakobo.

english: In Judah is God known : his name is great in Israel .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amanyekanete ase Abayuda, erieta riaye rire rinene mono ase Abaisraeli.

english: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain .
ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto nenyare kogera aye otogigwe; eyeratigare noyieboyie buna orokini.

english: Vow , and pay unto the LORD your God : let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared .
ekegusii: Inwe karie chiira ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, na mochiikeranie. Abanto bonsi bamoetanaine, tiga bamorentere ebiegwa, ere oria ogwenerete koirokwa.

english: He shall cut off the spirit of princes : he is terrible to the kings of the earth .
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokeyia abare abaenenu ase ense, abarwoti bonsi b’ense nigo bamwoboete.

english: In Salem also is his tabernacle , and his dwelling place in Zion .
ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu nigo bore agwo Salemu, ere nigo amenyete agwo Sayoni.

english: There brake he the arrows of the bow , the shield , and the sword , and the battle . Selah .
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nabunete chinsara chi’amata chikomesa, boigo naende akabutorana chinguba, na emioro na ebirwanero binde bi’esegi.

english: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomeka‐meka oichire nobonene kogocha korwa ase ebitunwa biababisa kwabuire.

english: The stouthearted are spoiled , they have slept their sleep : and none of the men of might have found their hands .
ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chimwenu baurirwe ebinto konya basakoire, bono bararire chitoro chindito. Abarwani esegi bonsi basinyirwe korwana namaboko abo.

english: At thy rebuke , O God of Jacob , both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Yakobo, ekero gwatogonyerete abanto bariinete chibarasi, barabwo nigo bagwete inse, bakaba buna nigo bakwete, amo ne chibarasi chiabo.

english: Thou, even thou, art to be feared : and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry ?
ekegusii: Aye bweka nigo ore oyo bw’okoondokia mono. Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao, ekero kwabeire nendamwamu?

english: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven ; the earth feared , and was still ,
ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, nigo kwamanyetie ense ebiina biao; na ense ekoboa egakira‐kiri,

english: When God arose to judgment , to save all the meek of the earth . Selah .
ekegusii: ekero aye Nyasae gwatenenete konacha ekiina na kobatooria abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.

english: I cried unto God with my voice , even unto God with my voice ; and he gave ear unto me.
ekegusii: Nkorera nde ase Nyasae neriogi rinene, nigo nkorera mono asare ng’a anyigwe.

english: And I said , This is my infirmity : but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High .
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obo nobororo bwane, eye nengaki okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore Igoro Mono gwantomeire.”

english: I will remember the works of the LORD : surely I will remember thy wonders of old .
ekegusii: Ning’inyore ogokora kwao aye Omonene; ee, ning’inyore amakumia ao a kare.

english: I will meditate also of all thy work , and talk of thy doings .
ekegusii: Nimbe nkorengereria igoro y’emeremo yao yonsi, na imbe nkona‐koiranerera ogokora kwao gwe chinguru.

english: Thy way , O God , is in the sanctuary : who is so great a God as our God ?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, chinchera chiao nigo chire chinchenu. Nenyasae ereri ere enene buna Nyasae oito?

english: Thou art the God that doest wonders : thou hast declared thy strength among the people .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

english: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people , the sons of Jacob and Joseph . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatooretie abanto bao nokoboko kwao koramboire. Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo na orwa Yusufu.

english: The waters saw thee, O God , the waters saw thee; they were afraid : the depths also were troubled .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero amaache akorooche, ee, ekero akorooche, nigo akwoboete, ne chindiba chikanyegerigwa.

english: The clouds poured out water : the skies sent out a sound : thine arrows also went abroad .
ekegusii: Amare agaitera amaache; ne chinkoba chigaaka korwa igoro, chinsara chiao chikamesa ase chinsemo chionsi.

english: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven : the lightnings lightened the world : the earth trembled and shook .
ekegusii: Okogukura gw’enkoba nigo kwarenge ime ase ekerambauti, na ense egatengecha.

english: Thy way is in the sea , and thy path in the great waters , and thy footsteps are not known .
ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete enchera yao ase enyancha, oboeto bwao bokaba ime ase amaache amange mono, korende nonya naboigo amabarato ao tarorekanete aroro.

english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord : my sore ran in the night , and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted .
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo nkorigia Omonene; ase obotuko nigo nkorambora okoboko kwane ase ogosaba ntari korosa, omoyo one nigo okwanga koremigwa.

english: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron .
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaraaete abanto bao buna riicho rikoraagwa, ee, okabaraa goetera ase amaboko a Musa na Aroni.

english: I remembered God , and was troubled : I complained , and my spirit was overwhelmed . Selah .
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora Nyasae, nigo nkorera, na ekero nkomorengereria, nigo ngokwa omoyo.

english: Thou holdest mine eyes waking : I am so troubled that I cannot speak .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotanga amaiso aane takonyora chitoro. Nigo nchandegete mono, tinkonyara gokwana.

english: I have considered the days of old , the years of ancient times .
ekegusii: Nigo nkoba nkorengereria igoro y’amatuko a kare, nkoinyora emiaka ya kare buna yarenge.

english: I call to remembrance my song in the night : I commune with mine own heart : and my spirit made diligent search .
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obogima nigo nkoinyora amatera aane: nigo nkoba nkorengereria ase enkoro yane ime, neriga‐rigia na kweboria:

english: Will the Lord cast off for ever ? and will he be favourable no more?
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene natotigire kegima? Tagotororera amaabera rinde?

english: Is his mercy clean gone for ever ? doth his promise fail for evermore ?
ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe mbwaerire kegima? Chiira chiaye nchiaikire omoerio?

english: Hath God forgotten to be gracious ? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies ? Selah .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo ebire koba omonyamaabera? Inee! Nigo abeire nendamwamu, goika osiekire amabeebe?”

english: Give ear , O my people , to my law : incline your ears to the words of my mouth .
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa amang’ana nkoborokereria, tegerera moigwe amang’ana ’omonwa one.

english: They kept not the covenant of God , and refused to walk in his law ;
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae, naende nigo bangete kobwatia amachiiko aye.

english: And forgat his works , and his wonders that he had shewed them.
ekegusii: Bakeba amang’an’Omonene konya akorire, na ebikone biria konya aorokirie ase bare.

english: He clave the rocks in the wilderness , and gave them drink as out of the great depths .
ekegusii: Ere agatandora ebitare agwo ase erooro, agasokeria abanto amaache amange mono buna aye chindooche chinene.

english: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto abwo nigo bamentete gokora ebibe ase Omonene, agwo ase erooro nigo basaretie ase Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.

english: Yea, they spake against God ; they said , Can God furnish a table in the wilderness ?
ekegusii: Bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Nyasae, bagateeba, “Inee! Nyasae nanyare gototerekera endagera eisaine aa ase erooro?

english: Behold, he smote the rock , that the waters gushed out , and the streams overflowed ; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people ?
ekegusii: Ee, amaene ere naagete egetare na amaache agacharara korwao, ne chindooche chi’amaache amange chikarwao, korende, Inee, nanyare boigo koa intwe abanto baye endagera? Nanyare gotoa na enyama torie?”

english: Therefore the LORD heard this , and was wroth : so a fire was kindled against Jacob , and anger also came up against Israel ;
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Omonene aigwete ayio, agaichorwa nekeririanda, akarwania abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo nomorero, ekiagera nigo abeete nendamwamu enene mono ase Abaisraeli.

english: Because they believed not in God , and trusted not in his salvation :
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, ekiagera tibamwegenete Nyasae, naende tibegenete ng’a ere nanyare kobatooria.

english: Though he had commanded the clouds from above , and opened the doors of heaven ,
ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo, ere nigo achigete igoro, akaigora ebisieri bi’aroro;

english: Man did eat angels’ food : he sent them meat to the full .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Mwanyabaanto bakaria endagera y’abamalaika; Omonene akabatomera endagera enyinge mono.

english: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven : and by his power he brought in the south wind .
ekegusii: Akarenta omwaga o moocha okagusa igoro, na ase okobua kwaye akagusia omwaga korwa Irianyi.

english: He rained flesh also upon them as dust , and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea :
ekegusii: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;

english: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp , round about their habitations .
ekegusii: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y’egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.

english: So they did eat , and were well filled : for he gave them their own desire ;
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaria chinyama bakaigota, ekiagera Nyasae nigo abaete eke basanerete.

english: Which we have heard and known , and our fathers have told us.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio twaigwete na koyamanya, ayio chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie.

english: They were not estranged from their lust . But while their meat was yet in their mouths ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero chinyama chiarenge ase emenwa yabo bagendererete gochitakuna, naende konya bataraisanekia obogworu bwabo.

english: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel .
ekegusii: Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare, agaita abanto abwo barenge ne chinguru goetania abande, agakoora kegima abamura b’Abaisraeli.

english: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works .
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, abanto abwo nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe, nonya ere okorete amakumia, tibamwegenete.

english: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity , and their years in trouble .
ekegusii: Ase ayio agakoora amatuko abo, akayasiria, na emiaka yabo ekaera ase okoondokia.

english: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God .
ekegusii: Ekero aitete abanto abatigari nigo bamorigetie; nigo baonchogete, bakamorigia ase ekeene.

english: And they remembered that God was their rock , and the high God their redeemer .
ekegusii: Nigo bainyorete ng’a Nyasae nere egetare kiabo; naende ng’a Nyasae Oyore Igoro Mono, nere Omobooria obo.

english: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth , and they lied unto him with their tongues .
ekegusii: Korende nigo bakwanete amang’ana amansu ase okomong’aina, bagakwana oborimo nemenwa yabo.

english: But he, being full of compassion , forgave their iniquity , and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away , and did not stir up all his wrath .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge namaabera, akaba okwabera ebibe biabo tabasiria; ase chingaki chinyinge nigo arenge gotanga endamwamu yaye, gose tarenge gotiga ekeririanda kiaye gioke mono.

english: For he remembered that they were but flesh ; a wind that passeth away , and cometh not again .
ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng’a barabwo Mwanyabaanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.

english: We will not hide them from their children , shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD , and his strength , and his wonderful works that he hath done .
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio titokoyabisa ase abana babo; goika toteebie ebiaare bigochi‐gocha ogokora kw’obonene bw’Omonene, na amakumia aye ay’okobua akorire.

english: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness , and grieve him in the desert !
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge nigo babete bagosaria ase Omonene agwo ase erooro; bakaba bakomoichania aroro agwo.

english: Yea, they turned back and tempted God , and limited the Holy One of Israel .
ekegusii: Nigo babete bakomoteema naende, bakaba bakomogechia ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.

english: They remembered not his hand , nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy .
ekegusii: Ti babete bakoinyora chinguru chi’okoboko kwaye, gose tibabete bakoinyora rituko riria ababooretie korwa ase ababisa babo,

english: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt , and his wonders in the field of Zoan :
ekegusii: na buna akorete ebikone ebinge ase ense ya Misiri, na amakumia agwo ase orogongo rwa Soani.

english: He gave up their cattle also to the hail , and their flocks to hot thunderbolts .
ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura agaita chiombe chiabo, ne chinkoba chigaita ching’ondi ne chimbori chiabo.

english: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger , wrath , and indignation , and trouble , by sending evil angels among them .
