ekegusii: Omonene akabatomera endamwamu yaye enene, na ekeririanda kiaye, na okogechigwa kwaye na emechando yonsi, ekeombe ekio ki’abamalaika b’ogosiria.

english: For he established a testimony in Jacob , and appointed a law in Israel , which he commanded our fathers , that they should make them known to their children :
ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.

english: He made a way to his anger ; he spared not their soul from death , but gave their life over to the pestilence ;
ekegusii: Ere akaroiseria endamwamu yaye enchera; akabeeka emioyo yabo ase amakweri, akabarentera oborwaire bokabaita.

english: But turned back , and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers : they were turned aside like a deceitful bow .
ekegusii: Nigo baonchogete tibaaba abegenwa, buna chisokoro chiabo chitabeete abegenwa, bakaba abasaria buna obota bosaregete.

english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places , and moved him to jealousy with their graven images .
ekegusii: Bakagechia Omonene ase engencho y’aase abo aimokererete igoro bagosasimera, na ekiagera basasimete emegwekano, Omonene akaba ne risemi.

english: When God heard this , he was wroth , and greatly abhorred Israel :
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.

english: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born ; who should arise and declare them to their children :
ekegusii: Nigo aganetie ng’a abanto b’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha bayamanye, ee, nonya nabana b’ebiaare konya bataraiborwa, naende abwo bayateebie abana babo.

english: He gave his people over also unto the sword ; and was wroth with his inheritance .
ekegusii: Ere nigo abeete nendamwamu ase abanto abwo barenge omwando oye, akabarua bagaitwa nemioro.

english: The fire consumed their young men ; and their maidens were not given to marriage .
ekegusii: Omorero ogaita abamura babo, na abaiseke babo bakaborwa abakobanyuoma.

english: Their priests fell by the sword ; and their widows made no lamentation .
ekegusii: Abakuani babo nigo baitetwe nemioro, na ababoraka babo tibanyarete kobareera.

english: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep , and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine .
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaboka buna nigo araire chitoro, na akaba buna omonto etuoni onyure edivai ogoaka eriogi;

english: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts : he put them to a perpetual reproach .
ekegusii: agaaka abachandi baye bagatama gochia ase barwete, akababeeka ase obosooku goika kare na kare.

english: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph , and chose not the tribe of Ephraim :
ekegusii: Omonene akaanga abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, gose tachorete abanto b’egesaku gi’Efraimu,

english: But chose the tribe of Judah , the mount Zion which he loved .
ekegusii: korende agachora abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, na egetunwa gia Sayoni ekio anchete.

english: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces , like the earth which he hath established for ever .
ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobere igoro mono, nabobe obokong’u buna ense ekong’irie kogenderera botambe.

english: That they might set their hope in God , and not forget the works of God , but keep his commandments :
ekegusii: Erio nario barabe bagosemeria Nyasae, na tibaabaisa kweba emeremo yaye, korende babe bakobwata amachiiko aye.

english: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people , and Israel his inheritance .
ekegusii: Ee, akamorusia korwa ase arenge gotunyana ching’ondi chiare ne chimanwa chikogonka, akamokora akaba omorisia bw’ororeria rwa Yakobo, abanto baye, nabwo Abaisraeli omwando oye.

english: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart ; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands .
ekegusii: Daudi akaba omorisia bw’abaanto abwo ore nenkoro endonge, akaba okobaraa nokoboko kw’obong’aini.

english: And might not be as their fathers , a stubborn and rebellious generation ; a generation that set not their heart aright , and whose spirit was not stedfast with God .
ekegusii: Barabwo tibaabaisa koba buna chisokoro chiabo, chiria chitaigwerete, naende chiasaretie; tichiarenge ne chinkoro chindonge, gose tichiarenge chinyegenwa ase Nyasae ase emioyo yabo.

english: The children of Ephraim , being armed , and carrying bows , turned back in the day of battle .
ekegusii: Abanto b’Efraimu, abwo babogoretie amata, bakaonchoka bagatama ase rituko ri’esegi.

english: Wherefore should the heathen say , Where is their God ? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed .
ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b’ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’abasomba bao.

english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die ;
ekegusii: Tiga ekerero ki’abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekiina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.

english: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach , wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abanto abwo bamenyete ang’e bagochecheirie na kogochaaya, obairanerie amabe ayio abo ara gatano na kabere.

english: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever : we will shew forth thy praise to all generations .
ekegusii: Erio intwe, abanto bao, abatore abe riicho ri’oborisia bwao, natokoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera botambe, na ebiaare ase ebiaare natobe tokogotogia.

english: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven , the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth .
ekegusii: Baeire chinyoni emebere y’abasomba bao chiyerie, ee, chinyama chi’emebere y’abachenu bao ase ching’iti chi’orosana.

english: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem ; and there was none to bury them .
ekegusii: Baiteire amanyinga abo buna amaache ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, abakobatindeka baborire.

english: We are become a reproach to our neighbours , a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
ekegusii: Intwe twabeire okogechia ase abanto bamenyete ang’e naintwe, abanto batoetanaine nigo bagotochecheria na gotosekerera.

english: How long, LORD ? wilt thou be angry for ever ? shall thy jealousy burn like fire ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu ase tore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?

english: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name .
ekegusii: Umora endamwamu yao igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti, na igoro ase amagambi ayio atari gokorangeria oyakonye.

english: For they have devoured Jacob , and laid waste his dwelling place .
ekegusii: Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.

english: O remember not against us former iniquities : let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low .
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotoa intwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito; otorotote namaabera ao bwango, ekiagera twabeire bosa kegima.

english: Help us, O God of our salvation , for the glory of thy name : and deliver us, and purge away our sins , for thy name’s sake.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y’obonene bw’erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y’erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!

english: O LORD my God , in thee do I put my trust : save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
ekegusii: Omonene one, Nyasae one, naye ngotamera, intoorie korwa ase abachandi baane, ’nkonye!

english: My defence is of God , which saveth the upright in heart .
ekegusii: Nyasae nere enguba yane, ere nigo agotooria abare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: God judgeth the righteous , and God is angry with the wicked every day .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omogambi omooronge, na kera rituko nigo akoba nekeririanda ase abakori amabe.

english: If he turn not, he will whet his sword ; he hath bent his bow , and made it ready .
ekegusii: Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye abobeke ang’e.

english: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death ; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors .
ekegusii: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ebiogoita omonto buna oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.

english: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity , and hath conceived mischief , and brought forth falsehood .
ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo aichire nobobe, nigo are morito, oborito bw’ogosaria na gakoibora oibara oborimo.

english: He made a pit , and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made .
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo agokunya eirima entambe, korende ogwa ime y’eirima eyio ere omonyene.

english: His mischief shall return upon his own head , and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate .
ekegusii: Emechando yaye nigo ekomoiranera; na ogokora kwaye okobe kwamogwera ere omonyene.

english: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness : and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high .
ekegusii: Ning’akere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye; nimotererie Omonene ogoteera kw’ogotogia erieta riaye, oyore Igoro Mono kegima.

english: Lest he tear my soul like a lion , rending it in pieces , while there is none to deliver .
ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, ’mbankurure gochia aase omonto onde otache gontooria.

english: O LORD my God , if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands ;
ekegusii: Omonene one, Nyasae one, onye nakorire amang’ana aya, onye nakorire amabe namaboko aane,

english: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy :)
ekegusii: onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one ase engencho ende etaiyo,

english: Let the enemy persecute my soul , and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth , and lay mine honour in the dust . Selah .
ekegusii: rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse egere asirie obogima bwane, erio ansarerie amasikani.

english: Arise , O LORD , in thine anger , lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies : and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki’ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikiire ekiina.

english: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about : for their sakes therefore return thou on high .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane; obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene aaria igoro.

english: The LORD shall judge the people : judge me, O LORD , according to my righteousness , and according to mine integrity that is in me.
ekegusii: Omonene, naye okogamba na konachera abanto bonsi ekiina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekiina koreng’ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.

english: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars .
ekegusii: Ekiriri ki’omosabibu oyio nigo giatubete ebitunwa, ne chinsagia chiaye chikaranda gochia aase emecharake ya Nyasae ere.

english: She sent out her boughs unto the sea , and her branches unto the river .
ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chikaranda chigaikeera Enyancha Enene, na emeseboka yaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.

english: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges , so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
ekegusii: Nase ki rende aye gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye, erinde bonsi abagoeta ase enchera batabora amasabibu aye?

english: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
ekegusii: Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.

english: Return , we beseech thee, O God of hosts : look down from heaven , and behold , and visit this vine ;
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, yoiranere naende, rigereria korwa agwo igoro orore; bwechandere omosabibu oyio.

english: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted , and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
ekegusii: Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.

english: It is burned with fire , it is cut down : they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance .
ekegusii: Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!

english: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand , upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
ekegusii: Orende nokoboko kwao omonto oyio gwachorire nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, Mwanyabaanto abwo aye gwechoreire.

english: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name .
ekegusii: Erio titokoonchoka togotige; torende togenderere koba moyo, na intwe ntobe togotogia erieta riao.

english: Turn us again , O LORD God of hosts , cause thy face to shine ; and we shall be saved .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength , and come and save us.
ekegusii: Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na Ababenjamini, na Abamanase, na oche ototoorie!

english: Turn us again , O God , and cause thy face to shine ; and we shall be saved .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, otokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

english: O LORD God of hosts , how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abaanto bao?

english: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears ; and givest them tears to drink in great measure .
ekegusii: Aye gwakorire amariga ’omoichano koba endagera yabo, kwabanyoisirie amariga amange mono.

english: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours : and our enemies laugh among themselves.
ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire abakwomanerwa ase egati y’abanto bare ang’e naintwe, na ababisa baito nigo bagendererete gotochecheria.

english: Turn us again , O God of hosts , and cause thy face to shine ; and we shall be saved .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otoonchore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.

english: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt : thou hast cast out the heathen , and planted it.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo kwarentete omosabibu korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio ogaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa aase abo, okayosimeka aroro.

english: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root , and it filled the land .
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.

english: Sing aloud unto God our strength : make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob .
ekegusii: Moterere Nyasae neriogi rinene, ekiagera nere chinguru chiaito, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae o Yakobo.

english: I am the LORD thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt : open thy mouth wide , and I will fill it.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ase ayio, asamia emenwa yaino ebe yasie, na inche imbaragerie.

english: But my people would not hearken to my voice ; and Israel would none of me.
ekegusii: “Korende abanto baane tibaigwete eriogi riane; Abaisraeli abwo nigo bangete kegima konyigwera.

english: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust : and they walked in their own counsels .
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabatiga babwatie obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo, erinde bakore buna koreng’ana konya barobeirie abanyene.

english: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways !
ekegusii: Onye ndiria abanto abwo baane bantegererete! Onye Abaisraeli mbabwatetie chinchera chiane!

english: I should soon have subdued their enemies , and turned my hand against their adversaries .
ekegusii: Rirorio nanga nabuete ababisa babo bwango, na okoboko kwane nkoba kware mamincha yabo.

english: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever .
ekegusii: Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung’ama ase ’nde bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.

english: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat : and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo narenge gocha kobaa engano enoru, na kobaisanekia nobooke korwa ase egetare.”

english: Take a psalm , and bring hither the timbrel , the pleasant harp with the psaltery .
ekegusii: Tera ogoteera kw’ogotogia, mobugie chinchigiri amo namakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande.

english: For this was a statute for Israel , and a law of the God of Jacob .
ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omooroberio ochikiire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achiikire.

english: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony , when he went out through the land of Egypt : where I heard a language that I understood not.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aetete ense ya Misiri, agachiika omooroberio oyio ase abanto ba Yusufu. Nkaigwa enkwana y’omonwa ntamanyete egoteeba:

english: I removed his shoulder from the burden : his hands were delivered from the pots .
ekegusii: “Ninche narusetie chigurube korwa ase amareko aino, na ngasibora amaboko aino korwa ase ebitonga bi’okobogoria chigurube.

english: Hear , O my people , and I will testify unto thee: O Israel , if thou wilt hearken unto me;
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa ekero nkob akuurera! Inwe Abaisraeli, onye ndiria mware konyigwera!

english: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty ; he judgeth among the gods .
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotenena ase omosangererekano oye omochenu, ase egati ye chinyasae nigo akonacha ekiina.

english: How long will ye judge unjustly , and accept the persons of the wicked ? Selah .
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri moragenderere konacha ebiina bitari noboronge? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwanchereria abanto ababe?

english: Defend the poor and fatherless : do justice to the afflicted and needy .
ekegusii: Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.

english: Deliver the poor and needy : rid them out of the hand of the wicked .
ekegusii: Tooria abatari na nguru, na abatabwati kende, basibore korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.”

english: They know not, neither will they understand ; they walk on in darkness : all the foundations of the earth are out of course .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.

english: But ye shall die like men , and fall like one of the princes .
ekegusii: Korende nigo morakwe buna Mwanyabaanto bande, na obogima bwaino boere buna obw’abanene b’ense.”

english: Arise , O God , judge the earth : for thou shalt inherit all nations .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekiina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.

english: Keep not thou silence , O God : hold not thy peace , and be not still , O God .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tokira‐kiri! Nyasae, totoerera na gotimoka.

english: Which perished at Endor : they became as dung for the earth .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo baiteretwe agwo EniDori; bakaba esike ase riroba.

english: Who said , Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession .
ekegusii: ekiagera bateebete, “Inchuo toire amarisio a Nyasae abe ayaito.”

english: O my God , make them like a wheel ; as the stubble before the wind .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, tiga abanto abwo bairurukigwe buna orotu, ee, buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.

english: As the fire burneth a wood , and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire ;
ekegusii: Buna omorero ogokoora rinani, na buna ekebemberi ki’omorero kegosamba ebitunwa,

english: So persecute them with thy tempest , and make them afraid with thy storm .
ekegusii: naboigo batunyanerie omwaga oo bw’omoubera, na obaondokie nekembugu‐mbugu kiao.

english: Fill their faces with shame ; that they may seek thy name , O LORD .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.

english: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever ; yea, let them be put to shame , and perish :
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga babe nobosooku na omoichano goika kare na kare; ee, tiga basookigwe na basire kegima.

english: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH , art the most high over all the earth .
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng’a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y’ense yonsi.

english: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult : and they that hate thee have lifted up the head .
ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora rirorooche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.

english: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people , and consulted against thy hidden ones .
ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio y’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto bao; abwo nigo bagosemania kobakorera bobe abanto bao abwo orendete.

english: They have said , Come , and let us cut them off from being a nation ; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance .
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Inchuo tobasirie tibaaba egesaku naende, tiga erieta ri’Abaisraeli riebwe kegima!”

english: For they have consulted together with one consent : they are confederate against thee:
ekegusii: Abanto abagaambire ase omoyo oyomo na bakorire okobwatana mamincha yao nabwo aba;

english: The tabernacles of Edom , and the Ishmaelites ; of Moab , and the Hagarenes ;
ekegusii: abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;

english: Gebal , and Ammon , and Amalek ; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre ;
ekegusii: Abagebali, na Abaamoni, na Abaamaleki; Abafirisiti amo nabamenyete Turo.

english: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot . Selah .
ekegusii: Boigo Abaasuri babwatanire nabwo ase ogokonya abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti.

english: How amiable are thy tabernacles , O LORD of hosts !
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, naki obomenyo bwao bore oboseera!

english: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand . I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God , than to dwell in the tents of wickedness .
ekegusii: Mbuya kobeera ase enyomba yao rituko erimo rioka kobua kobeera amatuko chilifu chinyinge aande onsi; mbuya koba omorendi bw’egesieri ki’enyomba yao aye Nyasae one, kobua kobeera ase obomenyo bw’abakori amabe.

english: For the LORD God is a sun and shield : the LORD will give grace and glory : no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are erioba na enguba, ere nigo agotoa amaabera na obonene; ere takorina abare ne chinkoro chindonge gento kende gionsi kere ekiya.

english: O LORD of hosts , blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.

english: My soul longeth , yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD : my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chia Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogooko omonene.

english: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house , and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young , even thine altars , O LORD of hosts , my King , and my God .
ekegusii: Enchiro nigo ekonyora obomenyo, na egesingororo nigo gekwenyorera egeswa ase amage aye akobeera, agwo ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, aye Omorwoti one, na Nyasae one.

english: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house : they will be still praising thee. Selah .
ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamenyete ase enyomba yao, abwo bakona‐goteera botambe ase okogotogia.

english: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them .
ekegusii: Mbare nomogooko abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.

english: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well ; the rain also filleth the pools .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo bagoeta ase Rigoko ria Baka, nigo bakorikora riaba aase e chinsoko chi’amaache; na embura ye ritang’ani nigo ekorirentera ogosesenigwa okonge.

english: They go from strength to strength , every one of them in Zion appeareth before God .
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.

english: O LORD God of hosts , hear my prayer : give ear , O God of Jacob . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.

english: Behold , O God our shield , and look upon the face of thine anointed .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore enguba yaito, origererie obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta oo.

english: LORD , thou hast been favourable unto thy land : thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob .
ekegusii: Omonene, kare nigo kwarenge namaabera ase ense yao, nigo kwairaneretie abanto ba Yakobo amaya abo.

english: Mercy and truth are met together ; righteousness and peace have kissed each other .
ekegusii: Aase agwo obwanchani bogendererete botambe na ekeene mbiumerane, boigo oboronge na omorembe mbinyunyuntane.

english: Truth shall spring out of the earth ; and righteousness shall look down from heaven .
ekegusii: Aase agwo obwegenwa mbooroke ase ense, na oboronge mborigererie korwa igoro.

english: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good ; and our land shall yield her increase .
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene narue ayare amaya, na orogongo rwaito rorue okwama kwaye.

english: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps .
ekegusii: Oboronge mbotang’ane bosio bwaye, naende bobwatie ase aetete.

english: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people , thou hast covered all their sin . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaberete abanto bao obobe bwabo, nigo gwatubete ebibe biabo bionsi.

english: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath : thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger .
ekegusii: Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.

english: Turn us, O God of our salvation , and cause thine anger toward us to cease .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Omotooria oito, otoiranere, rusia ekeririanda kiao korwa ase tore.

english: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever ? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations ?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogochia koba nendamwamu ase tore kogenderera botambe? Inee! Endamwamu yao nigo egendererete koba ase ebiaare bionsi?

english: Wilt thou not revive us again : that thy people may rejoice in thee?
ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?

english: Shew us thy mercy , O LORD , and grant us thy salvation .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.

english: I will hear what God the LORD will speak : for he will speak peace unto his people , and to his saints : but let them not turn again to folly .
ekegusii: Nimbe nkoigwa amang’an’Omonene Nyasae agokwana; ere nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase abanto baye abachenu, tobatiga baonchokere oboriri naende.

english: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land .
ekegusii: Ekeene, ogotooreka kwaye nigo kore ang’e ase abanto bairogete Omonene; obonene mbobe bomenyete ase ense yaito.

english: Bow down thine ear , O LORD , hear me: for I am poor and needy .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, integerera, onyigwe na ong’iranerie, ekiagera nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa.

english: For thou art great , and doest wondrous things : thou art God alone.
ekegusii: Aye naye ore omonene, nigo ogokora amakumia; aye naye bweka ore Nyasae.

english: Teach me thy way , O LORD ; I will walk in thy truth : unite my heart to fear thy name .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao, nigo nganetie kobwatia ekeene kiao; renda enkoro yane, erinde inyiroke erieta riao.

english: I will praise thee, O Lord my God , with all my heart : and I will glorify thy name for evermore .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae one, nigo nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, nindarie obonene bw’erieta riao goika kare na kare.

english: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell .
ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene ase ’nde; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure.

english: O God , the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul ; and have not set thee before them.
ekegusii: Nyasae, abanto abaenenu banyimokeire kondwania esegi; ekeombe ki’abaanto abatindi nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane, abwo tibakoirogeti nonya ng’ake.

english: But thou, O Lord , art a God full of compassion , and gracious , longsuffering , and plenteous in mercy and truth .
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore Nyasae bw’amaabera na obuya; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.

english: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant , and save the son of thine handmaid .
ekegusii: Ing’iranerie na ondorere amaabera, ong’e inche omosomba oo chinguru chiao, intoorie inche omwana bw’omosomba oo omokungu.

english: Shew me a token for good ; that they which hate me may see it , and be ashamed : because thou, LORD , hast holpen me, and comforted me.
ekegusii: Inyorokie ekemanyererio ki’obuya bwao, erinde abanto bangechete bakerore na gosookigwa, ekiagera aye Omonene gwankonyire na kondemia.

english: Preserve my soul ; for I am holy : O thou my God , save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
ekegusii: Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.

english: Be merciful unto me, O Lord : for I cry unto thee daily .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, ekiagera nigo nkorera asore omobaso boira.

english: Rejoice the soul of thy servant : for unto thee, O Lord , do I lift up my soul .
ekegusii: Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.

english: For thou, Lord , art good , and ready to forgive ; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.

english: Give ear , O LORD , unto my prayer ; and attend to the voice of my supplications .
ekegusii: Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki’ogosorora kwane.

english: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
ekegusii: Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong’iraneria.

english: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord ; neither are there any works like unto thy works .
ekegusii: Omonene, enyasae teri enga buna aye, gose emeremo ende teri enga buna eyao.

english: His foundation is in the holy mountains .
ekegusii: Omochie oria obegetwe oboroso n’Omonene nigo oteneine igoro ase ebitunwa ebichenu.

english: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete ebiita bia Sayoni kobua aande onsi ase abanto ba Yakobo bamenyete.

english: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God . Selah .
ekegusii: Aye omochie o Nyasae, amang’ana ’obonene nigo agokwanwa igoro yao.

english: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia , and Tyre , with Ethiopia ; this man was born there.
ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo bamanyete inche ninyatore Rahabu, + 87:4 Rahabu: aiga okorabaarwa kwa Misiri na Abaababeli, na Abafirisiti, na Abaturo, amo nabaanto b’Ethiopia, na goteeba, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

english: And of Zion it shall be said , This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
ekegusii: Igoro ya Sayoni amang’ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” n’Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong’ia.

english: The LORD shall count , when he writeth up the people , that this man was born there. Selah .
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw’abaanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

english: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
ekegusii: Ekero bagotera na bagotenga nigo bagoteeba, “Chinsoko chiaito chionsi nigo chire ime yao.”

english: O LORD God of my salvation , I have cried day and night before thee:
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera asore ng’a onkonye.

english: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead ? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah .
ekegusii: Inee! Abakuure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?

english: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave ? or thy faithfulness in destruction ?
ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwao ngokwanwa bore ime ase chimbeera, gose obwegenwa bwao agwo aase aasareku?

english: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark ? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness ?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao ay’ogokumia namanyire agwo ase omosunte ime? Gose oboronge bwao mbomanyire agwo ase ense y’okwebwa?

english: But unto thee have I cried , O LORD ; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, onkonye, nonya nemambia ogosaba kwane nigo kogoika asore.

english: LORD , why castest thou off my soul ? why hidest thou thy face from me?
ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde?

english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted .
ekegusii: Korwa obwana bwane nabeire inde nemechando, nabeire ang’e nogokwa, ndemereretie okogosa kwao, tindi nogokonywa konde nonya nogoke.

english: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off .
ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.

english: They came round about me daily like water ; they compassed me about together .
ekegusii: Nigo ang’etanaine buna amaache omobaso boira; abwatanire amo, na amigire inche.

english: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness .
ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.

english: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry ;
ekegusii: Ogosaba kwane tiga goike ase obosio bwao, tegerera oigwe okorera kwane.

english: For my soul is full of troubles : and my life draweth nigh unto the grave .
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang’e kogenda aase abakuure.

english: I am counted with them that go down into the pit : I am as a man that hath no strength :
ekegusii: Inche nabareranigwe amo nabwo bakogenda ase embeera, chinguru chiang’ereire.

english: Free among the dead , like the slain that lie in the grave , whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand .
ekegusii: Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakuure buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.

english: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit , in darkness , in the deeps .
ekegusii: Kwambekire inse kegima ase embeera ime; agwo aase are omosunte na aatambe gochia inse.

english: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves . Selah .
ekegusii: Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.

english: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up , and I cannot come forth .
ekegusii: Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia ase bare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.

english: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction : LORD , I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane amwamire ase okweumia; Aye Omonene, kera rituko nigo ngokorangeria, ndamborete amaboko aane gocha asore.

english: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever : with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

english: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces , as one that is slain ; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm .
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete enchoka eria Rahabu + 89:10 Rahabu: rora Ayubu 9:13 ekaba buna egetondo, nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru ogasiarera ababisa bao.

english: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
ekegusii: Igoro neyao, na ense neyao, ense na ebinto bionsi bireo naye kwabitongete.

english: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name .
ekegusii: Naye gwatongete sugusu na Irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogooko.

english: Thou hast a mighty arm : strong is thy hand , and high is thy right hand .
ekegusii: Okoboko kwao nigo kore nokobua, ee, nigo kore ne chinguru; okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo koimokererete igoro.

english: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne : mercy and truth shall go before thy face .
ekegusii: Oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’okogamba kwao, obwanchani bwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa, nigo bitang’aine bosio bwao.

english: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound : they shall walk , O LORD , in the light of thy countenance .
ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamanyete goaka eriogi ri’omogooko asore, abwo bagotaara ase oborabu bokorwa ase obosio bwao aye Omonene.

english: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day : and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted .
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagochengera erieta riao omobaso boira; na goetera ase oboronge bwao nigo bakoimokererigwa igoro.

english: For thou art the glory of their strength : and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted .
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore obonene bwabo ne chinguru chiabo; ase engencho y’ogwancherwa kwao ching’unchara chiaito chiakinire.

english: For the LORD is our defence ; and the Holy One of Israel is our king .
ekegusii: Oyore enguba yaito n’oyore Omonene, ee, omorwoti oito noyo bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli. Nyasae okoriera Daudi chiira

english: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one , and saidst , I have laid help upon one that is mighty ; I have exalted one chosen out of the people .
ekegusii: Kare ngwakwanete nabegenwa bao ase okorora, okabateebia, “Narentire ogokonywa goetera ase oyomo ore nokobua, naimokereirie igoro oyomo nachorire korwa ase egati y’abanto.

english: For I have said , Mercy shall be built up for ever : thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens .
ekegusii: Ninkwane ng’a obwanchani bwao mbogendererete botambe bwakorirwe kobao goika kare na kare; aaria igoro nigo okong’etie obwegenwa bwao.

english: With whom my hand shall be established : mine arm also shall strengthen him.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nkobe amo nere botambe, ee, okoboko kwane nkomobeke chinguru.

english: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.

english: And I will beat down his foes before his face , and plague them that hate him.
ekegusii: Ninsenyente ababisa baye ase obosio bwaye, abwo bamogechete nimbae amaakwa.

english: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted .
ekegusii: Obwegenwa na obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe mbibe amo nere; ase erieta riane orogunchara rwaye ndokine.

english: I will set his hand also in the sea , and his right hand in the rivers .
ekegusii: Nimbeke enyancha inse y’okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

english: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father , my God , and the rock of my salvation .
ekegusii: Ere nabe okorera ase ’nde na goteeba; Aye naye Tata, naye Nyasae one, na Egetare kiane ki’ogotooreka.

english: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore , and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.

english: His seed also will I make to endure for ever , and his throne as the days of heaven .
ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwaye rogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao buna igoro erabe ereo.

english: I have made a covenant with my chosen , I have sworn unto David my servant ,
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwateebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.

english: If his children forsake my law , and walk not in my judgments ;
ekegusii: “Onye abanto b’ororeria rwaye bagochia gotiga amachiiko aane, bange koigwera emeroberio yane echiikire,

english: If they break my statutes , and keep not my commandments ;
ekegusii: na onye bagochia gosaria aya nachiikire. Bange kobwata amachiiko aane,

english: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod , and their iniquity with stripes .
ekegusii: rirorio nimbae egesusuro, mbaake nenyimbo ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo, na mbang’wanie ebiranya ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.

english: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail .
ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.

english: My covenant will I not break , nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips .
ekegusii: Tinkonyara gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, gose tinkoonchora ring’ana nakwanire nomonwa one.

english: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David .
ekegusii: “Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.

english: His seed shall endure for ever , and his throne as the sun before me.
ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.

english: It shall be established for ever as the moon , and as a faithful witness in heaven . Selah .
ekegusii: Nkegenderere kobao buna omotienyi, oborori obwo bwa igoro nigo bore obwegenwa.” Okweumia ase engencho y’okobugwa kw’omorwoti

english: But thou hast cast off and abhorred , thou hast been wroth with thine anointed .
ekegusii: Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.

english: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant : thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground .
ekegusii: Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.

english: Thou hast broken down all his hedges ; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin .
ekegusii: Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.

english: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagoetera aase agwo nigo bakomosakora, abamenyete ang’e nere nigo bakomochecheria.

english: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries ; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice .
ekegusii: Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.

english: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword , and hast not made him to stand in the battle .
ekegusii: Kwairanirie omoro oye bw’esegi, tori komoa chinguru chi’okorwana esegi.

english: Thou hast made his glory to cease , and cast his throne down to the ground .
ekegusii: Kwamourire obonene bwaye, gwaakeire inse ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi.

english: The days of his youth hast thou shortened : thou hast covered him with shame . Selah .
ekegusii: Kwanachire amatuko aye ay’obosae abeire ameng’e, boigo kwamotubire nobosooku obonge mono. Ogosaba gw’okonyora ogotoorigwa

english: How long, LORD ? wilt thou hide thyself for ever ? shall thy wrath burn like fire ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?

english: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain ?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng’e, nigo gwatongete Mwanyabaanto bonsi bakwe igo.

english: What man is he that liveth , and shall not see death ? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave ? Selah .
ekegusii: Monto ki orabe moyo otakwe? Ning’o oranyare gotooria omoyo oye korwa ase chinguru chi’amakweri?

english: Lord , where are thy former lovingkindnesses , which thou swarest unto David in thy truth ?
ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?

english: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders , O LORD : thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igoro nchitogie emeremo yao y’ogokumia, naende obwegenwa bwao boigo ase omosangererekano bw’abachenu bao.

english: Remember , Lord , the reproach of thy servants ; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people ;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.

english: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached , O LORD ; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed .
ekegusii: Omonene, ababisa bao nigo bagonchecheria, ee, nigo bagochecheria amabarato ’omoakwa amaguta oo.

english: Blessed be the LORD for evermore . Amen , and Amen .
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.

english: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD ? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD ?
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore agwo igoro oranyare koreng’anigwa n’Omonene? Nkereki ase ebitongwa bia Nyasae kenga buna ere?

english: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints , and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
ekegusii: Ere nigo are Nyasae oirokire ase ekegambero ki’abachenu, bonsi abamoetanaine nigo bamoirogete.

english: O LORD God of hosts , who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ning’o obwate okobua buna okwao? Ee, Omonene, obwegenwa bwao nigo bogoetanaine.

english: Thou rulest the raging of the sea : when the waves thereof arise , thou stillest them.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okogambera enyancha ekoimokerera igoro; ekero emerindo yaye ekoimokerera igoro, aye nigo okoyotoereria.

english: O LORD our Lord , how excellent is thy name in all the earth ! who hast set thy glory above the heavens .
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki riakuma iga ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.

english: When I consider thy heavens , the work of thy fingers , the moon and the stars , which thou hast ordained ;
ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni, ebi kwabegete kera ekemo ase aaye;

english: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels , and hast crowned him with glory and honour .
ekegusii: Kwamokorire koba inse kegima asore aye omonyene, Nyasae; korende kwamoboirie obonene na amasikani.

english: All sheep and oxen , yea, and the beasts of the field ;
ekegusii: ching’ondi chionsi ne chiombe, amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana,

english: The fowl of the air , and the fish of the sea , and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas .
ekegusii: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.

english: O LORD our Lord , how excellent is thy name in all the earth !
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, naki erieta riao riakuma ense yonsi!

english: Lord , thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations .
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore obotamero bwaito ebiaare ase ebiaare.

english: The days of our years are threescore years and ten ; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years , yet is their strength labour and sorrow ; for it is soon cut off , and we fly away .
ekegusii: Emiaka y’obogima bwaito nemerongo etano na ebere; onye tore ne chinguru, eba emerongo etano na etato; na obogima obo nigo boichire nobokong’u na emechando, nigo bogoeta bwango, na intwe tweiruruka twasira.

english: Who knoweth the power of thine anger ? even according to thy fear , so is thy wrath .
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?

english: So teach us to number our days , that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom .
ekegusii: Tworokererie, tomanye obweng’e bw’obogima bwaito, erinde chinkoro chiaito chibe nobong’aini.

english: Return , O LORD , how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants .
ekegusii: Omonene, irana ase tore! Ngoika ririri orabe kogoteebana? Otororere intwe, abasomba bao, amaabera!

english: O satisfy us early with thy mercy ; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days .
ekegusii: Kobogokia mambia, otoisanekie nobwanchani bwao botari koera, erinde tochenge na kogoka amatuko aito onsi.

english: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil .
ekegusii: Otogokie amatuko ang’ana buna ayio twachandegete, na emiaka eng’ana buna eria twanyorete amabe.

english: Let thy work appear unto thy servants , and thy glory unto their children .
ekegusii: Tworokie intwe, abasomba bao, ogokora kwao, na abana baito oborokie obonene bwao.

english: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
ekegusii: Obosiani bw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y’amaboko aito oyesesenie ase tore, ee, osesenie emeremo y’amaboko aito!

english: Before the mountains were brought forth , or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world , even from everlasting to everlasting , thou art God .
ekegusii: Ritang’ani ebigoro bitarabao, gose konya otaratonga ense, korwa kare na kare aye naye Nyasae.

english: Thou turnest man to destruction ; and sayest , Return , ye children of men .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoonchorana abanto bairana, baba amaroba naende, gwateba, “Inwe Mwanyabaanto, irana!”

english: Thou carriest them away as with a flood ; they are as a sleep : in the morning they are like grass which groweth up .
ekegusii: Nigo ogokorobanania Mwanyabaanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;

english: In the morning it flourisheth , and groweth up ; in the evening it is cut down , and withereth .
ekegusii: mambia nigo bogokina bwasicha, mogoroba bwanachwa bwoma.

english: For we are consumed by thine anger , and by thy wrath are we troubled .
ekegusii: Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.

english: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance .
ekegusii: Amabe aya twakorire nigo oyabegete ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito bia bobisi nigo bire maiso marore asore.

english: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath : we spend our years as a tale that is told .
ekegusii: Obogima bwaito bwonsi nigo bokoera bwango inse y’ekeririanda kiao, nigo togokoora emiaka yaito buna ogoita egekoe

english: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
ekegusii: Ere oyomenyete inse y’oborendi bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki’oyore Omobui,

english: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
ekegusii: amabe ande onsi tagokonyora, na amaakwa ande onsi tagocha ase enka yao.

english: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high , because he hath known my name .
ekegusii: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.

english: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble ; I will deliver him, and honour him.
ekegusii: Ekero arandangerie, inche nimoitabere, inche nigo inde amo nere ase engaki y’emechando. Nimotoorie, naende nimoe ogosika.

english: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation .
ekegusii: Nimoisanekie nobogima obotambe na komwoorokia ogotooreka kwane.

english: I will say of the LORD , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God ; in him will I trust .
ekegusii: oyio nigo aranyare goteeba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”

english: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .
ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase omoeto bw’omotegi, na korwa ase amarwaire amabe agoita.

english: He shall cover thee with his feathers , and under his wings shalt thou trust : his truth shall be thy shield and buckler .
ekegusii: Ere nagotube namarionya aye, ase chimbaaba chiaye ime nonyore obotamero. Obwegenwa bwaye nenguba na eng’aya asore.

english: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day ;
ekegusii: Tokwoboa okogoswa ekero kia botuko, gose omogwe okorutwa mobaso,

english: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .
ekegusii: nonya namarwaire amabe agoeta ase omosunte, gose amabe ande onsi agoita mobaso.

english: A thousand shall fall at thy side , and ten thousand at thy right hand ; but it shall not come nigh thee.
ekegusii: Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.

english: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
ekegusii: Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.

english: Because thou hast made the LORD , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabekire Omonene obeire egekengano kiao, na Oyore Igoro Mono obotamero bwao,

english: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD , and to sing praises unto thy name , O most High :
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gokoakera aye Omonene Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, na goteera ase ogotogia erieta riao, aye Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.

english: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn : I shall be anointed with fresh oil .
ekegusii: Gwakinirie orogunchara rwane rwabeire buna orw’eng’era, kwang’umoreire amaguta amayia.

english: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies , and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
ekegusii: Narorire namaiso aane ababisa baane bakobugwa, naigure namato aane igoro y’abakori amabe abanyimokerete.

english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree : he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon .
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge naseboke buna omokendo, nakine buna omocharake o Lebanoni.

english: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God .
ekegusii: Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.

english: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age ; they shall be fat and flourishing ;
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakogenderera goseboka nonya bagotire, nigo baragenderere kobesea.

english: To shew that the LORD is upright : he is my rock , and there is no unrighteousness in him.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.

english: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning , and thy faithfulness every night ,
ekegusii: Kera emambia nigo ere buya koraria obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kera obotuko koraria obwegenwa bwao,

english: Upon an instrument of ten strings , and upon the psaltery ; upon the harp with a solemn sound .
ekegusii: ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.

english: For thou, LORD , hast made me glad through thy work : I will triumph in the works of thy hands .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ogokora kwao nigo kongogetie; ninchenge ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko ao.

english: O LORD , how great are thy works ! and thy thoughts are very deep .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.

english: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri takonyara kobimanya, na oyo otari nobong’aini takonyara komanya amang’ana buna ayio.

english: When the wicked spring as the grass , and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish ; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever :
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nabaisa koreereta buna obonyansi, na abakori ebibe bonsi babe bagosicha buya, korende omoerio obo nogosirigwa goika kare na kare.

english: But thou, LORD , art most high for evermore .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.

english: For, lo, thine enemies , O LORD , for, lo, thine enemies shall perish ; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Naama! Ababisa bao mbasirigwe; na abakori ebibe bonsi mbasiarerwe gochia aande onsi.

english: The LORD reigneth , he is clothed with majesty ; the LORD is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .
ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba, nigo eboetie obonene. Omonene nigo asiberanetie chinguru. Ase ayio ense nigo eteneine bokong’u tekonyegerigwa.

english: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .
ekegusii: Ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kiabekire aroro korwa kare, ekiagera aye nao kwarenge korwa kare.

english: The floods have lifted up , O LORD , the floods have lifted up their voice ; the floods lift up their waves .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaache aimokereire igoro, amaache nkoeera are neriogi, ee, aimokereirie emerindo yaye igoro.

english: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea, than the mighty waves of the sea .
ekegusii: Omonene nere obwate okobua okonene aria igoro; okobua kwaye nigo kobuete okoruma kw’amaache, ee, okw’amaache amange na okw’emerindo y’enyancha.

english: Thy testimonies are very sure : holiness becometh thine house , O LORD , for ever .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oborori bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u. Obochenu nabwo bore ogochaberwa kw’enyomba yao goika kare na kare.

english: O LORD God , to whom vengeance belongeth; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.

english: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?
ekegusii: Oyo okorongeyia ebisaku, tari korua ebisusuro? Ere nigo akworokereria Mwanyabaanto bamanye obong’aini.

english: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest , O LORD , and teachest him out of thy law ;
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio aye Omonene okorongeyia na komworokereria amachiiko ao,

english: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
ekegusii: naende kwamoa ogotimoka ase amatuko ’emechando, goika ekero abakori amabe baraaremerwe chimbeera chiabo.

english: For the LORD will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .
ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta abanto baye, takonyara gotiga abwo bare omwado oye.

english: But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
ekegusii: Ebiina mbinachwe ase oboronge naende, na abanto bonsi bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabobwatie.

english: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oratenene andwanerie abakori amabe? Ning’o oratenene ankonye korwa ase abakori ebibe?

english: Unless the LORD had been my help , my soul had almost dwelt in silence .
ekegusii: Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw’amakweri bwango.

english: When I said , My foot slippeth ; thy mercy , O LORD , held me up .
ekegusii: Ekero naroche ng’a natererigwe, aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bwansiirete tinagwa.

english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul .
ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.

english: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth : render a reward to the proud .
ekegusii: Aye omonachi ebiina bw’ense, imoka oe abanto abaenenu eng’eria koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore!

english: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law ?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto b’ekegambero egekorekanu mbabwatane naye? Abwo nigo bakorenta obokong’u ase okoonchorana amachiiko.

english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
ekegusii: Nigo bakoumokera amo omoyo bw’oyore omonyaboronge, banachera oyotari nokomocha ekiina ki’ogokwa.

english: But the LORD is my defence ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.

english: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness ; yea , the LORD our God shall cut them off .
ekegusii: Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.

english: LORD , how long shall the wicked , how long shall the wicked triumph ?
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe baragenderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?

english: How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
ekegusii: Abakori amabe bonsi nigo bagwetogia, nigo bagokwana‐kwana amang’ana amabe.

english: They break in pieces thy people , O LORD , and afflict thine heritage .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abwo nigo bagosamunyorana abanto bao, na gochanda abanto bare omwando oo.

english: They slay the widow and the stranger , and murder the fatherless .
ekegusii: Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;

english: Yet they say , The LORD shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .
ekegusii: erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”

english: Understand , ye brutish among the people : and ye fools , when will ye be wise ?
ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti gento, kabe nokomanya! Inwe abariri, ndiriri morabe abang’aini?

english: He that planted the ear , shall he not hear ? he that formed the eye , shall he not see ?
ekegusii: Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?

english: O come , let us sing unto the LORD : let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation .
ekegusii: Inchuo, tomoterere Omonene Nyasae nomogooko, inchwo, tomochengere oyore egetare ki’ogotooreka gwaito!

english: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nigo nagechetigwe nekiaare keria, ngateba, “Abanto aba nabasareku ase chinkoro chiabo ime, tibaraareti chinchera chiane.”

english: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving , and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms .
ekegusii: Inchuo, togende ase obosio bwaye ase okomoakera ng’a mbuya mono, tomochengere namatera ay’ogotogia!

english: For the LORD is a great God , and a great King above all gods .
ekegusii: Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omorwoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.

english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatete amakura ’ense ase okoboko kwaye, naboigo nebitunwa ebitambe bire ebiaye.

english: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land .
ekegusii: Enyancha neyaye, ekiagera nere oyetongete, okoboko kwaye nakwo kwabombete ense enyomo.

english: O come , let us worship and bow down : let us kneel before the LORD our maker .
ekegusii: Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.

english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work .
ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.

english: O sing unto the LORD a new song : sing unto the LORD , all the earth .
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, aye ense yonsi, moterere Omonene!

english: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
ekegusii: Teebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekiina atari gwanchereria.”

english: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof.
ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!

english: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
ekegusii: Emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yabo! Erio emete yonsi ye rinani netere nomogooko,

english: Before the LORD : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .
ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are, ee, ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Nigo aranachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na anachere abanto ekiina ase obwegenwa.

english: Sing unto the LORD , bless his name ; shew forth his salvation from day to day .
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, motogie erieta riaye, mobe mokoraria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko.

english: For the LORD is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, goika airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.

english: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .
ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na oboseera nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu.

english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .
ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye, moche ase chigoora chiaye, morentane ebiegwa.

english: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness : fear before him, all the earth .
ekegusii: Mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu! Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye.

english: The LORD reigneth ; let the earth rejoice ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .
ekegusii: Omonene nere omorwoti. Aye ense, goka! Na inwe ebisinka ebinge, chenga!

english: Ye that love the LORD , hate evil : he preserveth the souls of his saints ; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked .
ekegusii: Inwe abamwanchete Omonene, gecha obobe! Ere nigo akorenda emioyo y’abachenu baye; nigo akobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.

english: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .
ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bokomocheera oyore omooronge, na omogooko obachera abare ne chinkoro chindonge.

english: Rejoice in the LORD , ye righteous ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Nyasae, moake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

english: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .
ekegusii: Amare na omosunte ekerima nigo bimoetanaine; oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.

english: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about .
ekegusii: Omorero nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, oro nigo ogosamba ababisa baye abwo bamoetanaine.

english: His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .
ekegusii: Okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo gokomoreka ense eye; ense nigo ekorora okomesa okwo yatengechigwa.

english: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD , at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth .
ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo bikonyititoka buna obochoe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense yonsi.

english: The heavens declare his righteousness , and all the people see his glory .
ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nigo chikoraria oboronge bwaye, na abanto bonsi barora obonene bwaye.

english: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him, all ye gods .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagosasiima emegwekano nigo bagosookigwa, ee, abwo bagwetogeria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere bosa; inwe chinyasae chionsi, tung’ama ase obosio bwaye.

english: Zion heard , and was glad ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebiina.

english: For thou, LORD , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ore omonene goetania ense yonsi, aye kwaimokererigwe igoro kobua chinyasae chionsi.

english: O sing unto the LORD a new song ; for he hath done marvellous things : his right hand , and his holy arm , hath gotten him the victory .
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, ekiagera okorire amang’ana ay’ogokumia; obuire nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio, ee, nokoboko kwaye ogochenu.

english: The LORD hath made known his salvation : his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen .
ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio ’abaanto b’ebisaku;

english: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel : all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God .
ekegusii: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.

english: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all the earth : make a loud noise , and rejoice , and sing praise.
ekegusii: Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Omonene, tera ogoteera kw’omogooko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.

english: Sing unto the LORD with the harp ; with the harp , and the voice of a psalm .
ekegusii: Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.

english: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD , the King .
ekegusii: Moake amariogi ’omogooko ase Omonene ore omorwoti ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureeri.

english: Let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof; the world , and they that dwell therein.
ekegusii: Tiga enyancha ebe ekoruma amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, boigo nense na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo.

english: Let the floods clap their hands : let the hills be joyful together
ekegusii: Chindooche tiga chiake chinkobi, na ebitunwa tiga bitere nomogooko amo,

english: Before the LORD ; for he cometh to judge the earth : with righteousness shall he judge the world , and the people with equity .
ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Ere nanachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na abanto nabanachere ekiina atari gwanchereria.

english: The LORD is great in Zion ; and he is high above all the people .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene ase Sayoni, oimokererigwe igoro kobua abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.

english: Let them praise thy great and terrible name ; for it is holy .
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.

english: The king’s strength also loveth judgment ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti ore nokobua, nigo bwanchete ekeene, aye gwakorire oboronge botenene bokong’u, nigo okonacha ebiina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.

english: Exalt ye the LORD our God , and worship at his footstool ; for he is holy .
ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.

english: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name ; they called upon the LORD , and he answered them.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni nigo barenge abamo b’abakuani b’Omonene, boigo Samweli nigo arenge oyomo bw’abaanto barenge korangeria erieta riaye. Abanto abwo nigo barangeretie Omonene ng’a abakoonye, nere akabaigwa.

english: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.

english: Exalt the LORD our God , and worship at his holy hill ; for the LORD our God is holy .
ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro! Inchuo mosasimere ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are omochenu.

english: I will praise thee , O LORD , with my whole heart ; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works .
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ningoakere mbuya mono kegima n’enkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y’ogokumia.

english: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bamanyete erieta riao, nigo bagosemeretie, ekiagera aye Omonene togotiga abwo bagokorigia.

english: Sing praises to the LORD , which dwelleth in Zion : declare among the people his doings .
ekegusii: Tera amatera ase ogotogia Omonene oyomenyete Sayoni! Teebia ebisaku bionsi buna ogokora kwaye gokumete!

english: When he maketh inquisition for blood , he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble .
ekegusii: Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, Omonene tari kweba ekerero ki’abwo bagokorerwa bobe.

english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death :
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ndorere amaabera! Rora emechando eye abanto bangechete bakondetera. Aye kwandusirie korwa ase ebiita bi’amakweri,

english: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion : I will rejoice in thy salvation .
ekegusii: erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, ase ebiita biabo nimbatebie amang’ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.

english: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made : in the net which they hid is their own foot taken .
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bagure ase eirima bakunyete, na ase oboreba babisete bombwate, babwatirwe barabwo abanyene.

english: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth : the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands . Higgaion . Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene bwemanyekanirie ase okonacha ebiina bia boronge; abakori amabe babwatirwe ase ogokora kwabo abanyene.

english: The wicked shall be turned into hell , and all the nations that forget God .
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakogenda gochia aase abakuure, naboigo gochia ase nabaanto bonsi b’ebisaku abwo bebire Nyasae.

english: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten : the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever .
ekegusii: Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.

english: Arise , O LORD ; let not man prevail : let the heathen be judged in thy sight .
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Totiga abanto babue, tiga abanto b’Ebisaku banacherwe ekiina ase obosio bwao.

english: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name , O thou most High .
ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga mono kegima ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono Kegima.

english: Put them in fear , O LORD : that the nations may know themselves to be but men . Selah .
ekegusii: Omonene, obaondokie! Tiga bamanye ng’a barabwo botaambe nigo bare Mwanyabaanto.

english: When mine enemies are turned back , they shall fall and perish at thy presence .
ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bakoirana magega, bagwe inse na gosirigwa bosio bwao.

english: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause ; thou satest in the throne judging right .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okonacha ekiina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kore omonachi ebiina omooronge.

english: Thou hast rebuked the heathen , thou hast destroyed the wicked , thou hast put out their name for ever and ever .
ekegusii: Aye gwatogonyeire abanto b’ebisaku na gosiria abakori amabe, gwasiririe amarieta abo kegima, tibakoinyorwa goika kare na kare.

english: O thou enemy , destructions are come to a perpetual end : and thou hast destroyed cities ; their memorial is perished with them .
ekegusii: Ababisa baerire, basirigwe kegima, gwatagoire emechie yabo, barabwo bebirwe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.

english: But the LORD shall endure for ever : he hath prepared his throne for judgment .
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo are omorwoti o kare na kare, obekire ang’e ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, erinde anache ekiina.

english: And he shall judge the world in righteousness , he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekiina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.

english: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed , a refuge in times of trouble .
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are obotamero ase abwo bagokorerwa bobe, nere obotamero ase chingaki chi’emechando.

english: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven , clothed with a cloud : and a rainbow was upon his head , and his face was as it were the sun , and his feet as pillars of fire :
ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika onde bw’echinguru ogoika korwa igoro oboirie riire. Nigo arenge nomokubinyongo bw’embura oetanaine omotwe oye, na obosio bwaye nigo bwarenge buna erioba, na amagoro aye buna chisiiro chi’omorero.

english: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand , and ate it up ; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey : and as soon as I had eaten it , my belly was bitter .
ekegusii: Nkabogoria egetabu eria enke korwa ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria, nkayeria. Ase omonwa one ekaba enyansu buna obooke, korende ase enda yane ekambekera obororo.

english: And he said unto me , Thou must prophesy again before many peoples , and nations , and tongues , and kings .
ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Nekogwenerete obaane naende igoro ase abanto, na ebisaku, na emenwa, na abarwoti abange.”

english: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,
ekegusii: Narenge na egetabu egeke kiaigoire ase okoboko kwaye. Akabeka okogoro kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase enyancha na ogw’okobee igoro ase ense enyomo,

english: And cried with a loud voice , as when a lion roareth : and when he had cried , seven thunders uttered their voices .
