english: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
ekegusii: Inyora obuya na obotindi bwa Nyasae, obotindi ase baria baguure; korende ase ore obuya bwa Nyasae, korabeere ase obuya bwaye. Onye taibo, naye boigo nonachwe korwa aroro.

english: And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be graffed in : for God is able to graff them in again .
ekegusii: Nonya nabwo bande, onye tibakogenderera ase ogot’egena kwabo, rirorio nabachomwe, ekiagera Nyasae n’are n’okobua kobachoma naende.

english: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be graffed into their own olive tree ?
ekegusii: Inaki onye aye kwanachetwe korwa ase omozeituni bw’orosana, ogachomwa ase ogochomwa gotanaretwe bo, ase omozeituni oy’osimekire, tari kobua mono chinsagia chie ritina rinyene chichomwe ase omozeituni obo omonyene. Ogwancha kw’oboikeranu kwa Nyasae nigo gokorentera bonsi amaabera

english: For I would not , brethren , that ye should be ignorant of this mystery , lest ye should be wise in your own conceits ; that blindness in part is happened to Israel , until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in .
ekegusii: Inaki baminto, timwerora ng’a nigo more abanyene obong’aini; nindigetie momanye obobisi obo. Obokong’u bwanyorire abande b’Abaisraeli, goika ogoikerana kw’Ebisaku goike.

english: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes .
ekegusii: Naboigo ase amanag’ana y’enchiri babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochoorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.

english: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance .
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae tari gweiteria ebiegwa biaye na okorangeria kwaye.

english: For as ye in times past have not believed God , yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief :
ekegusii: Inaki buna inwe kare motarenge koigwera Nyasae, korende bono mwanyorire amaabera ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo,

english: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .
ekegusii: naboigo na barabwo bono bataigwereti, erinde ase amaabera aya mwanyorire inwe, nabarabwo boigo banyore amaabera.

english: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief , that he might have mercy upon all .
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae osibire bonsi ase ogotaigwera, erinde aborokie bonsi amaabera.

english: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace .
ekegusii: Nabo ekero kia bono ’mbare abatigari abachoorirwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.

english: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .
ekegusii: Korende onye nase obuya, rirorio tibokoba ase ogokora, onye taibo, obuya tibokoba obuya + 11:6 obuya tibokoba obuya: Na onye nase ogokora, rirorio tibokoba obuya naende, naende ngwo ogokora tikwabeete ogokora. .

english: What then ? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for ; but the election hath obtained it , and the rest were blinded
ekegusii: Inaki rende abeire? Egento keria Abaisraeli baare korigia tibakenyorete, Baria bachoretwe, mbarabwo bakenyorete, korende abatigarete bagakorwa koba abakong’u ase chinkoro chiabo,

english: I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, nabasoroire mono ase amaabera a Nyasae, morue emebere yaino ebe ekeng’wanso kere moyo, egechenu, ekeranyare gwanchwa na Nyasae, nakio ogosasiima kwaino gw’ekeene.

english: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love ; in honour preferring one another ;
ekegusii: Obwanchani bw’obomino bobe ase egati yaino; mobe ab’eritang’ani kworokia abamino amasikani.

english: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;
ekegusii: Ase omokia oino timoba aboro; mobe n’Omoika ogwoka, mogokorera Omonene.

english: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;
ekegusii: Mogoke ase ogosemeria, moremererie ase emechando, mogenderere n’ogosaba.

english: Distributing to the necessity of saints ; given to hospitality .
ekegusii: Mobe ang’e gokoonya abachenu ase okoremerwa kwabo, mobe abanyamokia ase okoroisia abageni.

english: Rejoice with them that do rejoice , and weep with them that weep .
ekegusii: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.

english: Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .
ekegusii: Timoakana omonto obobe ase obobe, tang’ania ayare amaya ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi.

english: If it be possible , as much as lieth in you , live peaceably with all men .
ekegusii: Keranyarekane ase ensemo yaino, mobe n’omorembe n’abanto bonsi.

english: And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .
ekegusii: Gose timwereng’ania ne chingencho chi’ense eye; korende moonchorwe, mokorwe koba abayia ase emioyo yaino, monyare korigia na komanya boronge ogwancha kwa Nyasae, na erire rigiya, na eriranchwe, na oboikeranu. Buna etogwenerete tokore nebiegwa bi’Omoika

english: Be not overcome of evil , but overcome evil with good .
ekegusii: Tobugwa n’obobe, korende obue obobe ase obuya.

english: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .
ekegusii: Inaki ase obuya naetwe nigo ngoteebia kera omonto oyore ase more, tabaisa kweenenia ere omonyene ase ebirengererio biaye kobua buna emogwenerete korengereria; korende abe n’ebirengererio ebironge koreng’ana buna Nyasae aeire kera omonto ekerengo gi’okwegena.

english: So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .
ekegusii: naboigo naintwe, nonya tore abange, nigo tore omobere oyomo ase Kristo, na intwe twensi nigo tore buna ebiimo kera oyomo ase oy’omwabo.

english: Or ministry , let us wait on our ministering : or he that teacheth , on teaching ;
ekegusii: onye n’ogokorera, tobeo ase ogokorera gwaito; oyo okworokereria abe ase okworokereria kwaye;

english: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .
ekegusii: oyo okoremia abe ase okoremia kwaye; oyo okorua arue ase omoyo omorabu; oyo ogotenenera atenenere ase omokia; oyo okororera amaabera arorere amaabera n’omogooko. Emeroberio y’obogima bw’obokristo

english: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .
ekegusii: Obwanchani bobe botari n’obong’ainereria. Gecha erire riibe, bwatana n’erire rigiya.

english: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers . For there is no power but of God : the powers that be are ordained of God .
ekegusii: Tiga kera omonto abe omoigweri ase abare n’okobua, ekiagera okobua konde tikori gotarueti ase Nyasae, na koria koreo nokobekire na Nyasae.

english: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .
ekegusii: Obwanchani tibogokorera omogisangio oo bobe; naboigo, obwanchani nabwo bogoikerania amachiiko. Ogocha kw’erituko ria Kristo

english: And that , knowing the time , that now it is high time to awake out of sleep : for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed .
ekegusii: Kora ayio, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amatuko aikire, na engaki yaino y’okoboka korwa ase chitoro yabeire ang’e. Inaki bono ogotooreka nigo kore ang’e naintwe kobua ekero keria twachaagete kwegena.

english: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
ekegusii: Obotuko bwaisire koera, omobaso obeire ang’e. Torusie ogokora kw’omosunte; tweboyie ebirwanero bi’omobaso.

english: Let us walk honestly , as in the day ; not in rioting and drunkenness , not in chambering and wantonness , not in strife and envying .
ekegusii: Totaare buna egwenerete ase omobaso; tari ase okoria bobe na gotinda, tari ase obotomani na ase obonyaka, tari ase eriomana ne ribero.

english: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ , and make not provision for the flesh , to fulfil the lusts thereof.
ekegusii: Korende mweboyie Omonene Yeso Kristo, timoa omobere ribaga goikerania okogania kwaye kw’ebibe.

english: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .
ekegusii: Naboigo oy’otari koigwera oyore n’okobua, nigo akoamererania naya Nyasae achiikire; na barabwo abakoamererania inabenyorere ekiina.

english: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
ekegusii: Inaki abakogaamba tibari kogosa abanto ase engencho y’ogokora okuya, korende nase engencho y’ogokora okobe. Inee! Torigeti komoiroka oyore n’okobua? Kora ayare amaya, na aye nonyore ogotogigwa ase amaya aria.

english: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .
ekegusii: Inaki oyore n’okobua, ere n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogokonyorera amaya. Korende korakore amabe nekogwenerete oiroke; inaki ere tabogoreti omoro bosa, ekiagera n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogoakana egesiomba ase omokori amabe na komoa egesusuro.

english: Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .
ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete kera oyomo aigwere, tari ase engencho y ’endamwamu ya Nyasae yoka, korende aigwere boigo, erinde enkoro yaye temogaambia.

english: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .
ekegusii: Bae bonsi ebiaboronge biabo: omonto bw’ebango, ebango; na omonto bw’ogochooga, ogochooga; oyogwenerete koirokwa, tiga airokwe; na oyogwenerete gosikwa, tiga asikwe. Mobe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe

english: Owe no man any thing , but to love one another : for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law .
ekegusii: Timoba n’esira ase onde bwensi otatiga ogwanchana, ekiagera oy’omwanchete omogisangio oye oikeranirie amachiiko.

english: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God .
ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto ore ase egati yaito naache gwekwanera ere omonyene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: Let us not therefore judge one another any more : but judge this rather , that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, titoba nkona‐kogaambania tore, korende anga mbuya kobua togaambe ng’a onde tabeekera oy’omwabo egento gekomogocha gose gekomotanga.

english: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .
ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng’a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng’a negento ekebe.

english: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .
ekegusii: Onye oy’omino okoba n’ogwechanda ase engencho y’endagera okoria aye, gwatigire gotaara ase obwanchani. Ase engencho y’endagera yao tomobeyia omonto oria, ere Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.

english: Let not then your good be evil spoken of :
ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya ase more atorwe ng’a n’amabe.

english: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Inaki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogooko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.

english: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .
ekegusii: Ere oy’ogokorera Kristo ase amang’ana aya onsi nigo akogwenera Nyasae, naende nigo agwancherwa na Mwanyabaanto.

english: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
ekegusii: Ase igo, tiga torigie chingencho chi’omorembe ne chingencho chigwenerete ase okoagachana.

english: For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bwegenete ng’a nanyare koria bionsi, korende ere oy’otari na nguru nigo akoria chinyeni.

english: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endagera tosaria emeremo ya Nyasae. Bionsi nebichenu; korende ’mbobe omonto oragere abande bagochwe ase engencho y’ebiakoria.

english: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .
ekegusii: Mbuya gotaria enyama, nonya ’nkonywa edivai, gose gokora gento kende gionsi keragoche oy’omino.

english: Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .
ekegusii: Okwegena okwo ore nakwo, obe nakorokwo ase egati yao na Nyasae. Nasesenirie omonto oria otenachereti ekiina ase ring’ana riria anchete.

english: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat , because he eateth not of faith : for whatsoever is not of faith is sin .
ekegusii: Korende oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u onye okoria, onacheirwe ekiina, ekiagera tarieti ase okwegena; na ogokora konde gwonsi gotarueti ase okwegena nebibe.

english: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not ; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth : for God hath received him .
ekegusii: Oyokoria tachaaya oria otari koria, na oria otari koria tagaambia oria okoria, ekiagera Nyasae omwancheire.

english: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant ? to his own master he standeth or falleth . Yea , he shall be holden up : for God is able to make him stand .
ekegusii: Aye naye ning’o okogaambia omosomba bw’omonto onde? Ase omonene oye omonyene nigo ateneine gose nigo akogwa. Ee, natenene, ekiagera Omonene nere ore n’okobua gw’okomotenenia.

english: One man esteemeth one day above another : another esteemeth every day alike . Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng’a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng’a amatuko onsi nigo areng’aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.

english: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .
ekegusii: Ere oyokorenda rituko, nigo akorirenda ase Omonene, na ere oyokoria, nigo akoria ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo agoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono; ere oy’otari koria, nigo agokora bo ase Omonene, na aakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono.

english: For none of us liveth to himself , and no man dieth to himself .
ekegusii: Ekiagera onde tari ase egati yaito ore moyo ase engencho yaye omonyene; na onde tari ogokwa ase engencho yaye omonyene.

english: For whether we live , we live unto the Lord ; and whether we die , we die unto the Lord : whether we live therefore , or die , we are the Lord’s .
ekegusii: Inaki onye tore moyo, nigo tore moyo ase Omonene; gose gatorakwe, nigo torakwe ase Omonene. Naboigo, onye tore moyo, gose gatorakwe, nigo tore aba Omonene.

english: For to this end Christ both died , and rose , and revived , that he might be Lord both of the dead and living .
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nigo akwete, naende akaba moyo, erinde abe Omonene ase abare moyo na ase abakuure boigo.

english: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .
ekegusii: Intwe abatore ne chinguru netogwenerete kobogoria oboreu bw’abatari ne chinguru, tetogwenereti kwegwenera intwe abanyene.

english: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae bw’ogosemerigwa abaichorie n’omogooko bwonsi na omorembe ase okwegena, monyare komenta mono ase ogosemeria ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Paulo ogosaba ogwancherwa ase oboremu bwaye bw’okoriika

english: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .
ekegusii: Abaminto, inche omonyene naenekerigwe igoro yaino ng’a mwaichoirwe n’amaya, naende mwaichoirwe ne chisemi chionsi, na monyare kworokererania.

english: Nevertheless , brethren , I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort , as putting you in mind , because of the grace that is given to me of God ,
ekegusii: Korende nabariikeire ase oboremu kobua ase chinsemo chinde chie riirube eri, nkobainyoria ase obuya boria naetwe na Nyasae,

english: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .
ekegusii: erinde imbe omosomba o Kristo Yeso ase ogokorera abanto b’Ebisaku, emeremo y’obokuani ase okorandia enchiri ya Nyasae, erinde ekeng’wanso kiabo giancherwe, gechenwe n’Omoika Omochenu.

english: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God .
ekegusii: Bono ninde n’engencho y’okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
ekegusii: Inaki tinkonyara gwatora ring’ana rinde otatiga eri Kristo akorete goetera ase emeremo y’ane, erinde abanto b’Ebisaku banyare koigwera ase engencho ye ring’ana na ogokora,

english: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .
ekegusii: ase chinguru chi’ebikone na amakumia, ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Naikire korandia enchiri ya Kristo ase Yerusalemu ne chinsemo chionsi chietanaine goika Iluriko.

english: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification .
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase egati yaito tiga agwenere omogisangio oye, anyore obuya, erinde tonyare koagachana,

english: Yea , so have I strived to preach the gospel , not where Christ was named , lest I should build upon another man’s foundation :
ekegusii: Naboigo nakorete omokia one korandia enchiri, korende tari aase erieta ria Kristo riaikire koigugwa, erinde timbaisa koagacha ase oboroso bw’omonto onde,

english: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;
ekegusii: Korende bono tindi ne ribaga rinde ri’ogokora emeremo ase chinsemo echi, naende korwa emiaka emenge inarenge namaiga gocha ase more.

english: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
ekegusii: Ekero nkogenda gochia Hispania ninganetie ng’etere seino, ’mbarore. Na magega konabeire amo nainwe ase ogokonyana ase ekero egeke, namonkoobe.

english: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Inaki agweneire abanto ba Makedonia na Akaya gosangereria ebiegwa bi’ogokonya abachenu ba Yerusalemu, baria bare abataka.

english: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
ekegusii: Naboigo kondaikeranie ring’ana eri na kobaa ebiegwa ebi biasangererigwe, ekero nabibekire ekemanyererio, ning’etere seino konde orogendo rw’ane gochia Hispania.

english: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .
ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a kondache ase more, ninchiche nogoichorwa kw’ogosesenigwa gwa Kristo.

english: Now I beseech you , brethren , for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake , and for the love of the Spirit , that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me ;
ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ase obwanchani bw’Omoika Omochenu, mobe n’omokia amo nainche ase ogosaba kwaino ase engencho y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae;

english: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea ; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints ;
ekegusii: erinde nsiborwe korwa ase baria bategeneti ase Boyahudi, naende emeremo imbwate aaria Yerusalemu yancheirwe n’abachenu.

english: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
ekegusii: Igo niny’are gocha ase more n’omogooko, Nyasae karanche, na konyora ogotimoka amo nainwe.

english: Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

english: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning , that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope .
ekegusii: Inaki onsi ayatang’anete koriikwa korwa kare nigo arigetwe ase ogotworokereria intwe, erinde ase oboremereria na ase okoremigwa tokonyora korwa ase amariiko, tonyare koba nogosemeria.

english: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :
ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’oboremereria na bw’okoremia abakoonye mobe n’omoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe ase omogwekano o Kristo Yeso;

english: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: erio ase omoyo oyomo monyare komobaka Nyasae Tata n’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Enchiri ase abanto b’Ebisaku

english: Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .
ekegusii: Naboigo moroisanie buna Kristo nere abaroisetie inwe, erinde Nyasae abaakwe.

english: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, ng’a Kristo akaba omosomba bw’abaarogete ase okoorokia ng’a Nyasae noyo bw’ekeene, erinde aikeranie chiira echi abagaaka baito ba kare baetwe.

english: I commend unto you Phebe our sister , which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea :
ekegusii: Nabekire oyominto Febe ase amaboko aino. Ere nomosubati omokoreri ore ase ekanisa gia Kenkrea.

english: Salute Apelles approved in Christ . Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Apele oyo bwancheretwe ase Kristo. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba y’Aristobulu.

english: Salute Herodion my kinsman . Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus , which are in the Lord .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Herodioni, omoamate one. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba ya Narikiso bare ase Omonene.

english: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Turufena na Turufosa, abakori emeremo ase Omonene. Nkwanerie Perisi omwanchwa, oyokorire omokia mono ase Omonene.

english: Salute Asyncritus , Phlegon , Hermas , Patrobas , Hermes , and the brethren which are with them .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Asunkrito, Felegoni, Herme, Patiroba, Herama na abaminto abare amo nabarabwo.

english: Salute Philologus , and Julia , Nereus , and his sister , and Olympas , and all the saints which are with them .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Fililogo, Yuli, Nereu na mosubati omwabo, Olimpa na abachenu bonsi abare amo n’abarabwo.

english: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
ekegusii: Kwanania inwe ase inwe ase okonyunyuntana. Chikanisa chionsi chia Kristo chiabakwanirie.

english: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .
ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto, morigererie baria bakorenta ogwatananekana ne chingencho chikogera abanto bagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, chire mamincha y’okworokererigwa mworokereretigwe; mweatanane korwa ase barabwo.

english: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ , but their own belly ; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple .
ekegusii: Inaki abanto banga buna abwo tibari gokorera Omonene oito Kristo, korende nechinda chiabo bagokorera abanyene; na ase amang’ana amororo na ay’okwegwenia bang’aina emioyo y’ abanto batetenenereti ase ebirengererio biabo.

english: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .
ekegusii: Inaki oboigweri bwaino bwamanyekanire ase abanto bonsi. Naboigo nagokire ase engencho yaino, korende nindigetie mobe abang’aini ase amang’ana amaya, na abariri ase amang’ana amabe.

english: That ye receive her in the Lord , as becometh saints , and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you : for she hath been a succourer of many , and of myself also .
ekegusii: Momooroisie ase Omonene, buna egwenerete abachenu, momokonye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi araganie ase more, ekiagera ere obeire ogokonya abanto abange, nonya ninche omonyene nankonyete.

english: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y’amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.

english: I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
ekegusii: Inche Teretio, omoriki bwe riirube eri, nabakwanirie ase Omonene.

english: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel , and the preaching of Jesus Christ , according to the revelation of the mystery , which was kept secret since the world began ,
ekegusii: Bono ase are ere oyoranyare kobakong’ia ase enchiri y’ane, na ase okorandigwa kwa Yeso Kristo, na ase okomaanorerwa kw’obobisi boria bwabisegete korwa kare,

english: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
ekegusii: korende bono bwaorokiigwe ase amariiko y’ababani, bwamanyekanire ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi buna Nyasae o kare na kare achiigete, erinde baigwere na kwegena,

english: To God only wise , be glory through Jesus Christ for ever . Amen . Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
ekegusii: ase Nyasae, omonyene obong’aini bweka, ogotogigwa kare na kare ase Yeso Kristo! Amina.

english: Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .
ekegusii: ababete ang’e korua obogima bwabo ase engencho y’ane. Nabaakeire ng’a mbuya mono, gose tari inche bweka, korende nonya n’Ebirisia bionsi bi’abaanto b’Ebisaku.

english: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie boigo ekanisa kere ase enyomba yabo. Nkwanerie Epaineto omwanchwa one, nere orenge bw’eritang’ani ase Asia koonchoka ase Kristo.

english: Greet Mary , who bestowed much labour on us .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Mariamu oyokorete emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino.

english: Salute Andronicus and Junia , my kinsmen , and my fellowprisoners , who are of note among the apostles , who also were in Christ before me .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Androniko na Yunia, abaamate baane, abasibetwe ano nainche, abatomwa bagwatorwa ng’a nabaya; barabwo nigo bantang’anerete koba ime ase Kristo.

english: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Ampiliato, omwanchwa one ase Omonene.

english: Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Urubano omokori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo, na Staku omwanchwa one.

english: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, n’omotomwa nachoretwe nakorangerigwa, korandia enchiri ya Nyasae,

english: Making request , if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you .
ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngosaba ng’a Nyasae karanche konyigorera enchera engiya, inchiche ase more.

english: For I long to see you , that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift , to the end ye may be established ;
ekegusii: Nigo inde n’amaiga kororana nainwe na kobaa ekeegwa ase enchera y’Omoika Omochenu, erio mobekwe chinguru,

english: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .
ekegusii: erinde toremanie inche nainwe, kera omonto ase okwegena kw’oyonde, okwaino na okwane.

english: I am debtor both to the Greeks , and to the Barbarians ; both to the wise , and to the unwise .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninde n’esiira ase Abagiriki na ase abatari Abagiriki, ase abanyasemi na ase abariri.

english: So, as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .
ekegusii: Ase ensemo yane nigo nganetie mono korandia enchiri nonya nase more abamomenyete Rumi. Chinguru chi’enchiri

english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men , who hold the truth in unrighteousness ;
ekegusii: Inaki endamwamu ya Nyasae yaorokiigwe korwa igoro, ase ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwonsi na obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto, abagotanga ekeene nobobe bwabo.

english: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .
ekegusii: Bono ayaranyare komanywa igoro ya Nyasae aorokigwe ase bare, ekiagera Nyasae nabaorokeretie.

english: ( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures ,)
ekegusii: eye Nyasae atang’anete koria eira ase emenwa y’ababani baye ase amariiko amachenu.

english: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen , being understood by the things that are made , even his eternal power and Godhead ; so that they are without excuse :
ekegusii: Inaki chingencho chiaye, echi chitari kororekana, engencho yaye okobua kwaye gwa kare na kare, na obonyasae bwaye, nchimanyekanete korwa ase ogotongwa gw’ense ase ebinto atongete. Ase igo tibari naya bagotaamera.

english: Professing themselves to be wise , they became fools ,
ekegusii: Bagateeba ng’a mbare nobong’aini, korende bakaririeka.

english: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabatiga ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiabo, batunyane obonyaka goika bagasarerania ogosika ase emebere yabo barabwo ase barabwo,

english: Who changed the truth of God into a lie , and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator , who is blessed for ever . Amen .
ekegusii: ekiagera batigete ekeene kia Nyasae, bagachoora oborimo, bagasasiima na gokorera ebitongwa ribaga ri’Omotongi, oyorabaakwe kare na kare! Amina.

english: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections : for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature :
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Nyasae akabatiga batunyane okogania kwabo kw’obosooku, goika abakungu babo bakaonchoreria okomenyana kw’omobere kwa boronge ase oko gotari kwa boronge.

english: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .
ekegusii: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw’obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw’ogosaria kwabo.

english: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge , God gave them over to a reprobate mind , to do those things which are not convenient ;
ekegusii: Ekiagera batabarete ng’a ngento komomanya Nyasae, Nyasae akabatiga ase ebirengererio bie chingencho chiabo chimbe, bakore aya’atagwenereti.

english: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,
ekegusii: Bagaichorwa ne chingencho chionsi chitari boronge, na obobe, na okogania okobe, na okorengereria okobe, ne ribero, na oboiti, na eriomana, na obong’ainereria, na okogeechana. Bakaba abagenkani,

english: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh ;
ekegusii: Eye nenchiri igoro y’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito. Ere akaiborwa buna Mwanyabaanto ase ororeria rwa Daudi,

english: Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,
ekegusii: abaitania, abamogechete Nyasae, abachaayi, abaenenu, abetogia, abaroisia amabe, abatari koigwera abaibori babo,

english: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
ekegusii: abariri, abatari abegenwa, abatari nobwanchani, abatari n’amaabera.

english: Who knowing the judgment of God , that they which commit such things are worthy of death , not only do the same , but have pleasure in them that do them .
ekegusii: Barabwo abanyene mbamanyete mono ekiina kia Nyasae kia boronge, ng’a abagokora ayaiga nebagwenerete amakweri; tibakorete aya oka, korende nigo bagwancherana nabwo bakoyakora.

english: And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :
ekegusii: naende ase okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure na ase chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Obochenu akaorokigwa koba Omwana o Nyasae.

english: By whom we have received grace and apostleship , for obedience to the faith among all nations , for his name :
ekegusii: Asare ere ntwanyorete obuya na obotomwa, erio ase engencho y’erieta riaye tworokererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, erinde banyare koba nokoigwera gw’okwegena

english: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: amo nainwe abanyene, inwe abamwarangeretigwe koba aba Yeso Kristo.

english: To all that be in Rome , beloved of God , called to be saints : Grace to you and peace from God our Father , and the Lord Jesus Christ .
ekegusii: Nabariikeire inwe mwensi abamomenyete Rumi, abanchwa ba Nyasae, abamwarangeretigwe koba abachenu. Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosaba kw’ogoaka mbuya mono

english: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .
ekegusii: Ritang’ani naakeire Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo ase engencho yaino inwe mwensi, ekiagera okwegena kwaino kwamanyekanire ase ense yonsi.

english: For God is my witness , whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son , that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae, oyo ’ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchiri y’Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng’a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.

english: But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
ekegusii: korende obonene na ogosika, na omorembe nigo bire ase kera oyomo oyogokora amaya, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.

english: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law : and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law ;
ekegusii: Inaki Abagiriki bakorire ebibe batari namachiiko a Musa, inabasire batari namachiiko; na Abayahudi bakorire ebibe bare namachiiko, nabo baranacherwe ekiina ase amachiiko.

english: ( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
ekegusii: Inaki tari abwo bakoigwa amachiiko bare abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende mbaria bagoikerania amachiiko, nabwo baraegwe oboronge.

english: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :
ekegusii: Abanto b’Ebisaku batari namachiiko, ekero bagokora buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere aya amachiiko are korigia, nonya abwo tibari namachiiko, babeire amachiiko boka abanyene.

english: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ;)
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakoorokia ng’a aya amachiiko are korigia ariikirwe ime ase chinkoro chiabo. Okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime nigo gokobabera kirori, na ebirengererio biabo nigo bikobasoera gose kobaegerera.

english: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .
ekegusii: Nabo arache koba ase rituko riria, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia, Nyasae kagochi‐gocha nanachere obobisi bwa Mwanyabaanto ekiina, goetera ase Kristo Yeso. Abayahudi n’amachiiko

english: Behold , thou art called a Jew , and restest in the law , and makest thy boast of God ,
ekegusii: Korende aye okweroka Omoyahudi, na gosemeretie amachiiko, na gwetogia ase Nyasae.

english: And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;
ekegusii: Kwamanyire ogwancha kwaye, naende nomanyete buya amang’ana ayare amaya, ekiagera kworokererigwe amachiiko.

english: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,
ekegusii: Nore nobomaene ng’a aye omonyene nigo ore omoraai bw’emeuko, na omobaso bw’abare ase omosunte ime.

english: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things .
ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae nigo kere boronge igoro ase abwo bagokora ayio.

english: An instructor of the foolish , a teacher of babes , which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law .
ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiiko.

english: Thou therefore which teachest another , teachest thou not thyself ? thou that preachest a man should not steal , dost thou steal ?
ekegusii: Aye okworokereria abande, Inee, tokweorokereria aye omonyene? Aye okorandia ng’a omonto taiba, tori koiba aye omonyene?

english: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?
ekegusii: Aye ogoteeba ng’a omonto tatomana, tori gotomana aye omonyene? Aye ogechete emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, aye tori koiba korwa ase chi Hekalu?

english: Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
ekegusii: Aye ogwetogeria amachiiko, Inee, nigo ogosareria Nyasae ogosika ase ogosaria kwao kw’amachiiko?

english: For circumcision verily profiteth , if thou keep the law : but if thou be a breaker of the law , thy circumcision is made uncircumcision .
ekegusii: Okwaroka nigo kogwenerete onye kore omoigweri bw’amachiiko, korende onye kore omosaria bw’amachiiko, okwaroka kwao kwabeire ogotaaroka.

english: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law , shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision ?
ekegusii: Karabe ere oyotaarogeti okobwata amachiiko, Inee, ogotaaroka kwaye tigokobarwa ng’a kwabeire okwaroka?

english: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature , if it fulfil the law , judge thee , who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law ?
ekegusii: Ere oyotaarogeti ase omobere, onye obwatete amachiiko, Inee, tagokonachera ekiina aye, oyore namachiiko na okwaroka, naende osaririe amachiiko?

english: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :
ekegusii: Inaki ere oyore Omoyahudi ase isiko oka, tari Omoyahudi bw’ekeene, gose okwaroka koria gokorire isiko ase omobere, tikori okwaroka gw’ekeene.

english: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?
ekegusii: Aye omonto oyokogaambia baria bagokora ayio, naye omonyene naro ayio ogokora, Inee, nokagete ng’a aye notame korwa ase ekiina kia Nyasae?

english: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?
ekegusii: Gose ngwachaayire obonge bw’obuya bwaye, na oboremereria bwaye, na okoganya kwaye, na tomanyeti ng’a obuya bwa Nyasae nigo borigetie gokoraa gochia ase okoonchoka?

english: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;
ekegusii: Korende ase obokong’u bwao na enkoro yao etari nokoonchoka, kwegacheire endamwamu ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu, ekero ekiina kia boronge kia Nyasae kerache koorokigwa,

english: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
ekegusii: nabae obogima bwa kare na kare baria bakorigia obonene, na ogosika, na ogotasareka, na gokora amaya ase oboremereria.

english: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
ekegusii: Korende endamwamu na ekeririanda inabibe igoro ase baria beanchete abanyene, batari koigwera ekeene, korende bakoigwera ayatari boronge.

english: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
ekegusii: Emechando na obororo inabibe igoro ase kera oyomo bw’abana ba Mwanyabaanto oyogokora amabe, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo;

english: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?
ekegusii: Gaki rende, Omoyahudi inki abuete abande? Na okwaroka inki kogwenerete?

english: There is none that understandeth , there is none that seeketh after God .
ekegusii: onde tari okomanya, onde tari okorigia Nyasae.

english: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no, not one .
ekegusii: Bonsi bachiire bogeeka korwa ase Nyasae, bonsi babeire bosa; onde tari oy’ogokora amaya, nonya n’oyomo.

english: Destruction and misery are in their ways :
ekegusii: obosareku na emechando nigo bire ase chinchera chiabo.

english: And the way of peace have they not known :
ekegusii: Enchera y’omorembe tibayemanyeti.

english: Now we know that what things soever the law saith , it saith to them who are under the law : that every mouth may be stopped , and all the world may become guilty before God .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amang’ana onsi agokwanwa n’amachiiko nigo agokwanwa ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko, erinde kera omonwa osiekwe, na ense yonsi ebekwe inse ase ekiina kia Nyasae.

english: Much every way : chiefly , because that unto them were committed the oracles of God .
ekegusii: Nkogwenerete mono ase kera enchera. Ritang’ani, Abayahudi mbegenetwe konyora ring’ana ria Nyasae.

english: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;
ekegusii: Korende bono oboronge bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe machiiko ataiyo, obwaberetwe kirori namachiiko na ababani,

english: For all have sinned , and come short of the glory of God ;
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe n’obonene bwa Nyasae;

english: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :
ekegusii: baeirwe oboronge buna ekeegwa ase obuya bwaye, ase enchera y’okoboorigwa kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood , to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past , through the forbearance of God;
ekegusii: Ere Nyasae omobekire koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase amanyinga aye, erinde tomonyoore ase enchera y’okwegena. Igo Nyasae oorokirie oboronge bwaye, ekiagera ase okoremereria kwaye atigete ebibe biria biatang’anete.

english: To declare , I say , at this time his righteousness : that he might be just , and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus .
ekegusii: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.

english: Where is boasting then ? It is excluded . By what law ? of works ? Nay : but by the law of faith .
ekegusii: Ng’ai rende ogwetogia gwaito kore? Kende tikeri. Ase ogochika ki? Ase ogochika kw’ogokora? Yaya, korende ase ogochika gw’okwegena.

english: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .
ekegusii: Naboigo, tokobara ng’a omonto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase okwegena kore ao nogokora kw’amachiiko.

english: Is he the God of the Jews only ? is he not also of the Gentiles ? Yes , of the Gentiles also :
ekegusii: Gose Nyasae nigo are Nyasae bw’Abayahudi boka? Tari Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo? Ee, ere ’Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo.

english: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?
ekegusii: Inki rende onye abande tibari abegenwa? Inee! Ogotegenwa kwabo nakonyaare gokora obwegenwa bwa Nyasae bobe bosa?

english: Do we then make void the law through faith ? God forbid : yea , we establish the law .
ekegusii: Inee! Ntwaonchoire amachiiko abe bosa ase okwegena okwo? Yaya, taibo! Nigo togwanchera amachiiko.

english: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God , what shall we say ? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance ? (I speak as a man )
ekegusii: Korende ker’abe ng’a obobe bwaito bokoorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, inki torateebe rende? Nyasae noy’otari omooronge ekero akorenta endamwamu? (Nakwanire buna Mwanyabaanto).

english: God forbid : for then how shall God judge the world ?
ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Onye nabo, inaki rende Nyasae aranyare kogaambia ense?

english: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?
ekegusii: Korende onye oboene obonge bwa Nyasae bwamentekire ase obonene bwaye ase engencho y’oborimo bwane, nase ki inche nonya mbono nkona‐kogambigwa buna omonyene ebibe?

english: And not rather , ( as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say ,) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .
ekegusii: Inaki rende totagokora obobe, erinde obuya boche? Buna abande bagoteeba ase ogotoitania. Okogambigwa kwabo nigo kore boronge. Onde tari ore omooronge

english: What then ? are we better than they ? No , in no wise : for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles , that they are all under sin ;
ekegusii: Ninki rende? Intwe Abayahudi n’abaya tore kobua abande? Yaya, nonya ng’ake! Inaki nasoereire Abayahudi amo n’Abagiriki ng’a bonsi nigo bare inse y’okobua kw’ebibe;

english: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
ekegusii: Inki rende toratebe? Aburaamu sokoro yaito bw’ororeria inki anyorete?

english: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
ekegusii: Indi abareretwe ayio? Nekero konya arokire gose nekero konya ataraaroka? Tari ekero konya arokire, korende nekero konya ataraaroka.

english: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only , but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham , which he had being yet uncircumcised .
ekegusii: Naboigo akaba ise bw’abaarogete, tari ng’a baarogete rioka, korende boigo abagotunyana chimbaratero chi’okwegena kwaye sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oko arenge nakorokwo ekero konya ataraaroka. Eira ekoenekigwa ase okwegena

english: Because the law worketh wrath : for where no law is , there is no transgression .
ekegusii: Ekiagera ogochika nakwo gokorenta endamwamu; na aase ogochika gotari, komocha tikoiyo.

english: For if Abraham were justified by works , he hath whereof to glory ; but not before God .
ekegusii: Ekiagera onye Aburaamu oetwe oboronge ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye, nare neki agwetogeria, korende tari ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

english: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief ; but was strong in faith , giving glory to God ;
ekegusii: gose tabeete na tang’u‐tang’u chinde ase eira eria ya Nyasae ase ogotegena, korende nigo abegetwe chinguru ase okwegena kwaye, akamotogia Nyasae.

english: And being fully persuaded that , what he had promised , he was able also to perform .
ekegusii: Akamanya boronge ng’a Nyasae nanyare gokora aria arierete eira.

english: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness .
ekegusii: Ase ayio ase okwegena kwaye “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.”

english: Now it was not written for his sake alone , that it was imputed to him ;
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge” tarigetwe ase engencho yaye bweka,

english: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;
ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwa ase abakuure,

english: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
ekegusii: Korende ase omonto oy’ogokora emeremo, eng’eria yaye teri kobarwa buna nobuya, korende nigo ekoba ogoakanwa ase emeremo yaye.

english: But to him that worketh not , but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly , his faith is counted for righteousness .
ekegusii: Ase omonto otari gosemeria ogokora kw’emeremo yaye, korende nigo egenete ere oria okoa abanyabibe oboronge, okwegena kwaye omonto oyio kwamobarire ng’a n’are noboronge.

english: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man , unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works ,
ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi agoteeba, ng’a nasesenirie omonto oria ere Nyasae abarire koba noboronge atari nogokora kw’amachiiko,

english: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ori’Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”

english: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .
ekegusii: Inee! Ogosesenigwa oko nigo kore ase abwo baarogete, gose nase abwo batarogeti boigo? Nigo togoteeba, ng’a Aburaamu ase okwegena kwaye akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.

english: Therefore being justified by faith , we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ :
ekegusii: Ase igo ekero twaeirwe oboronge ase okwegena, ntore nomorembe na Nyasae goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.

english: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .
ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri y’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, magega gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;

english: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .
ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo ere ase are twanyorire okobwatanigwa. Amakweri goetera ase Adamu, obogima goetera ase Kristo

english: ( For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
ekegusii: Inaki ebibe nao biarenge ase ense amachiiko atarabekwa, korende ebibe tibikobarwa amachiiko ataiyo.

english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .
ekegusii: Korende amakweri nigo agaambete korwa Adamu goika Musa, nonya niigoro y’abwo batakorete ebibe koreng’ana nogosaria kw’Adamu, oyorenge omogwekano bw’oyio ogochi‐gocha.

english: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Inaki ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amaabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki’amaabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.

english: And not as it was by one that sinned , so is the gift : for the judgment was by one to condemnation , but the free gift is of many offences unto justification .
ekegusii: Ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo, ekiagera ekiina keria nigo giachete ase enchera y’ogosaria okomo, gekarenta okogambigwa, korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera kegaacha ase engencho y’ogosaria okonge, gekarenta oboronge.

english: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one ; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one , Jesus Christ .)
ekegusii: Onye ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo amakweri agaambete ase engencho y’omonto oria oyomo, kobua mono abwo banyorire amaabera amange na ekeegwa ki’oboronge nabagaambe ase obogima goetera ase omonto oyomo, Yeso Kristo.

english: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .
ekegusii: Naboigo, buna ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abanto bonsi bakanacherwa ekiina, ee, naboigo ase ogokora kw’oboronge kw’omonto oyomo, abanto bonsi bakaegwa oboronge na obogima.

english: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners , so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous .
ekegusii: Inaki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwa kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.

english: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand , and rejoice in hope of the glory of God .
ekegusii: Goetera ase are twaigoreirwe enchera ase okwegena goikera ase obuya obo toteneine ime yaye, naende nigo tokogoka ase ogosemeria kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.

english: Moreover the law entered , that the offence might abound . But where sin abounded , grace did much more abound :
ekegusii: Amachiiko agasoa, erinde ogosaria kobe okonene mono. Korende aase ebibe biamentegete, amaabera akamenteka akaba amange kobua,

english: That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .
ekegusii: erinde, buna ebibe biagaambete ase amakweri, naboigo ase enchera y’oboronge amaabera agaambe goika obogima bwa kare na kare goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito.

english: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka nonya nase emechando yaito, ekiagera ntomanyete ng’a emechando nigo ekorenta oboremereria;

english: And patience , experience ; and experience , hope :
ekegusii: na oboremereria nigo bokorenta oboremu bw’omoyo, na oboremu bw’omoyo nigo bokorenta ogosemeria.

english: And hope maketh not ashamed ; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us .
ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n’Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe. Obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe ase ogokwa gwa Kristo

english: For when we were yet without strength , in due time Christ died for the ungodly .
ekegusii: Amaene ekero totarenge ne chinguru, ekero engaki yaigete, Kristo agakwa ase engencho y’abanyabibe.

english: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .
ekegusii: Inaki naakong’u omonto gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omonyene oboronge, korende nenyarekane omonto koremereria gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omuya.

english: But God commendeth his love toward us , in that , while we were yet sinners , Christ died for us .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oorokirie obwanchani bwaye ase tore ase ogotoma Kristo gokwa ase engencho yaito, ekero twarenge abanyene ebibe.

english: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
ekegusii: Naboigo kobua mono, gatwaeirwe oboronge ase amanyinga aye, ere natotoorie korwa ase endamwamu ya Nyasae.

english: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

english: For in that he died , he died unto sin once : but in that he liveth , he liveth unto God .
ekegusii: Ase ogokwa koria akwete nigo akwerete ebibe ara rimo rioka, korende obogima boria are nabwo nigo are nabwo ase Nyasae.

english: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe mwebare ng’a mwabeire abakuure ase ebibe, korende mwabeire moyo ase Nyasae ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body , that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof .
ekegusii: Bono timotiga ebibe bigaambe ime ase emebere yaino ey’ekonyorekana n’amakweri, na timobaisa koigwera okogania kwabo okobe.

english: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin : but yield yourselves unto God , as those that are alive from the dead , and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God .
ekegusii: Timobaisa korua ebiimo biaino bikore ebibe buna ebikorero bi’obobe, korende mwerue abanyene ase Nyasae buna abanto barusetigwe korwa ase ogokwa na babekirwe ase obogima, na ebiimo biaino ase Nyasae bibe ebikorero bi’oboronge.

english: For sin shall not have dominion over you : for ye are not under the law , but under grace .
ekegusii: Inaki ebibe tibikobaagaambera inwe, ekiagera timori inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera. Okworokereria korwa ase obosomba

english: What then ? shall we sin , because we are not under the law , but under grace ? God forbid .
ekegusii: Ninki rende? Tokore ebibe ekiagera totari inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera? Yaya taibo!

english: Know ye not , that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey , his servants ye are to whom ye obey ; whether of sin unto death , or of obedience unto righteousness ?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a onye mwerure ase omonto onde koba abasomba baye na komoigwera, nigo more abasomba baye ere oria moigwerete, onye n’obosomba bw’ebibe obokoraa gochia ase amakweri, gose obosomba bw’okoigwera obokoraa gochia ase oboronge?

english: But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inwe, abamwarenge abasomba b’ebibe, mwabeire abaigweri ase chinkoro chiaino ase okworokereria koria mwaetwe,

english: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .
ekegusii: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.

english: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh : for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity ; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness .
ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’oboreu bwaino bwa Mwanyabaanto, Inaki koreng’ana buna inwe ritang’ani mwaruete ebiimo biaino bibe ebisomba bi’obonyaka na ase ogosaria okonene mono, naboigo na bono karue ebiimo biaino bikorere oboronge, monyare gokorwa koba abachenu.

english: God forbid . How shall we , that are dead to sin , live any longer therein ?
ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Intwe abatwakuure korwa ase ebibe, inaki toranyare komenya ase ebibe naende?

english: For when ye were the servants of sin , ye were free from righteousness .
ekegusii: Inaki ekero mwarenge abasomba b’ebibe nigo mwarenge abasibore korwa ase oboronge.

english: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .
ekegusii: Nkwama ki rende mwanyorete korwa ase ebinto biria bikobarentera obosooku bono? Inaki omoerio bw’ebinto ebi n’amakweri.

english: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .
ekegusii: Korende bono ekero mwasiboirwe korwa ase ebibe na gokorwa koba abasomba ba Nyasae, okwama kwaino more nakwo noko, ng’a mokorwe koba abachenu, na omoerio oye nobogima bwa kare na kare.

english: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .
ekegusii: Inaki eng’eria y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende ekeegwa kia Nyasae nobogima bwa kare na kare ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.

english: Know ye not , that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death ?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a intwe twensi abatwabatisetwe ase Kristo Yeso nigo twabatisetwe ase amakweri aye?

english: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :
ekegusii: Inaki onye twabwatanire nere ase amakweri buna ayaye, naboigo torabwatane nere ase okobokigwa buna ok’waye.

english: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a obo Mwanyabaanto bwaito bwa kare nigo bwabambetwe amo nere, erinde omobere bw’ebibe osirigwe, titoba abasomba b’ebibe naende.

english: For he that is dead is freed from sin .
ekegusii: Inaki ere oy okuure osiboirwe korwa ase ebibe.

english: Now if we be dead with Christ , we believe that we shall also live with him :
ekegusii: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng’a inatobe moyo amo nere.

english: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more ; death hath no more dominion over him .
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakuure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogaambera naende.

english: Know ye not , brethren , ( for I speak to them that know the law ,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiiko) ng’a amachiiko nigo akogaambera omonto ekero are moyo?

english: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
ekegusii: Ogochika koria gw’okong’a obogima, gokarorekana gokondetera amakweri.

english: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .
ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko namachenu, na ogochika nogochenu, na okwa boronge, na okuya.

english: Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
ekegusii: Bono inee, riria erire rigiya ndiabeire amakweri ase ’nde? Yaya, taibo! Ebibe bikang’ita ase enchera y’erire rigiya, erio ebibe birorekane ng’a nebibe, erinde ase ogochika koria ebibe bimenteke koba bitari nekerengo. Chingencho ibere chia Mwanyabaanto

english: For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .
ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a amachiiko nay’Omoika, korende inche n’omonto bw’engencho y’ebibe; nigo naonetigwe inse ase obosomba bw’ebibe.

english: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
ekegusii: Korende onye ngokora aya ntancheti, rirorio nanchire ng’a amachiiko n’amaya.

english: Now then it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tari inche nkoyakora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.

english: For I know that in me ( that is , in my flesh ,) dwelleth no good thing : for to will is present with me ; but how to perform that which is good I find not .
ekegusii: Inaki namanyire ng’a ime ase ’nde, ase engencho y’ane y’obobe, kende kiya tikeiyo; okorigia kw’ogokora okuya nkoreo, korende tinkonyara kogokora.

english: For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .
ekegusii: Inaki keria kere ekiya nyanchete, tindi kogekora, korende keria kere ekebe ntancheti, nakio ngokora.

english: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
ekegusii: Inaki omokungu onyuomire igo asibire n’amachiiko ase omosacha oye, ekero ere are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko aria amosibete ase omosacha oria.

english: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
ekegusii: Onye ngokora keria ntancheti, bono tari inche nkogekora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.

english: I find then a law , that , when I would do good , evil is present with me .
ekegusii: Narorire ogochika oko, ng’a kondigetie gokora ekere ekiya, ekere ekebe nigo kenyesungetie.

english: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man :
ekegusii: Inaki nigo ngosasoka mono ase omoyo one ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae,

english: But I see another law in my members , warring against the law of my mind , and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members .
ekegusii: korende ase ebiimo biane narorire ogochika konde nkoreo, gokorwana esegi n’ogochika gw’okomanya kw’ane na kogonkora koba omosakorwa bw’ogochika koria kw’ebibe kore ase ebiimo biane.

english: O wretched man that I am ! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane inche Mwanyabaanto! Ning’o oransibore korwa ase omobere oyo bw’amakweri?

english: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord . So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God ; but with the flesh the law of sin .
ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo Omonene oito! Inaki inche omonyene ase okomanya kw’ane nigo ngokorera amachiiko a Nyasae, korende ase engencho y’obobe bwane nigo ngokorera amachiiko y’ebibe.

english: So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha oye are moyo, aise koba nomosaacha onde nigo akorokwa omotomani; korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko ayio. Naisa konyuomwa nomosaacha onde, takorokwa omotomani.

english: Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, nainwe mwakwereire amachiiko ase enchera y’omobere o Kristo, erinde monyare koba ab’omoao, abaye ere oy’obogetigwe korwa ase abakuure, erinde tomwamere Nyasae okwama.

english: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .
ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ime y’engencho yaito y’ebibe okogania gwaito kw’ebibe gokabooka ase engencho y’amachiiko, kogakora emeremo ase ebiimo biaito goika tokaamera amakweri okwama.

english: But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .
ekegusii: Korende bono twasiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko, twakwereire ay’atosibete, erinde tonyare gokorera ase obogima oboyia bw’Omoika, tari inse y’amachiiko a kare ayariikire. Amachiiko na ebibe

english: But sin , taking occasion by the commandment , wrought in me all manner of concupiscence . For without the law sin was dead .
ekegusii: Korende ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikabokia ime ase ’nde chingencho chionsi chi’okogania okobe. Ase amachiiko atari, rirorio ebibe mbikwete.

english: For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
ekegusii: Inche iga narenge moyo agwo ritang’ani ekero ntarenge n’amachiiko, korende ekero ogochika koria gwachete, ebibe bikaboka, na inche ’ngakwa.

english: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
ekegusii: Na bono kogaambigwa tikori ase abwo bare ime ase Kristo Yeso.

english: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
ekegusii: Na Kristo kar’abe ime yaino, nonya emebere yaino ekwete ase engencho y’ebibe, emeika yaino moyo ere ase engencho y’oboronge obo mwanyorete.

english: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, igo tore abasiira, korende tari ase chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe,

english: For if ye live after the flesh , ye shall die : but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body , ye shall live .
ekegusii: inaki komoratunyane chingencho chi’ebibe, nigo morakwe, korende komoraite ogokora kw’omobere ase chinguru chi’Omoika, inamobe moyo. Abana ba Nyasae

english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God , they are the sons of God .
ekegusii: Inaki bonsi abakoraagwa n’Omoika o Nyasae, abwo nabwo abana ba Nyasae.

english: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit , that we are the children of God :
ekegusii: Omoika omonyene obeire kirori amo n’emeika yaito, ng’a intwe nabana ba Nyasae.

english: And if children , then heirs ; heirs of God , and joint-heirs with Christ ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together .
ekegusii: Onye tore abana, naboigo tore abanyamwando, abanyamwando ba Nyasae, abaraire omwando amo na Kristo, gatorachandwe amo nere, erinde tonyore obonene amo nere. Obonene bogochi‐gocha

english: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us .
ekegusii: Nabarire emechando y’ekero kia bono, ng’a teri gento onye ekoreng’anigwa nobonene boria bogocha koorokigwa ase tore.

english: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God .
ekegusii: Nabo ebitongwa bionsi nigo biganyete n’okogania okonene mono ase rituko riria Abana ba Nyasae bagocha koorokigwa.

english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death .
ekegusii: Inaki ogochika kw’Omoika bw’obogima boria bore ime ase Kristo Yeso gwansiboire korwa ase ogochika kw’ebibe na amakweri.

english: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God .
ekegusii: ekiagera ebitongwa ebinyene nabisiborwe korwa ase obosibwa bwabo bw’ogosareka, bisoe ime ase ogosiborwa kw’obonene bw’abaana ba Nyasae.

english: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .
ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a ebitongwa bionsi nigo bire n’ogwechanda, naende nigo bire n’obororo nonya ngoika bono,

english: For we are saved by hope : but hope that is seen is not hope : for what a man seeth , why doth he yet hope for ?
ekegusii: Inaki nigo twatooretigwe ase ogosemeria. Korende egento keria gesemeirie gokiarorekanire, rirorio gosemeria tikori. Inaki ning’o orasemerie eki aroche?

english: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
ekegusii: Korende gatorasemerie egento totarakerora, nigo togokeganya ase oboremereria.

english: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
ekegusii: Naboigo n’Omoika nere nigo ogotokoonya ase oboreu bwaito. Inaki titomanyeti gosaba buna etogwenerete, korende Omoika omonyene nigo agotosabera ase ogwechanda gotanyare gokwanwa.

english: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
ekegusii: Na ere oyokoriga‐rigia chinkoro chi’ abanto, namanyete okorengereria kw’Omoika, ekiagera Omoika oyo nigo ogosabera abachenu buna Nyasae anchete.

english: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .
ekegusii: Na twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana onsi amo na baria bamwanchete, erio abanyorere amaya, baria barangerigwe ase omooroberio oye.

english: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .
ekegusii: Inaki baria amanyete korwa kare akabachoora korwa kare, bareng’anigwe n’omogwekano bw’Omwana oye, erinde ere abe omotangi bw’abamwabo abange.

english: For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :
ekegusii: Inaki aria amachiiko atare konyara gokora, ekiagera nigo arenge amareu ase engencho y’ebibe bi’emebere ya Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae agakora ase ogotoma Omwana oye omonyene ase omogwekano bw’engencho yaito y’ebibe, na ase engencho y’ebibe, akagaambia ebibe ase omobere oye o Mwanyabaanto,

english: Moreover whom he did predestinate , them he also called : and whom he called , them he also justified : and whom he justified , them he also glorified .
ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo. Obwanchani bwa Nyasae

english: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe ase ayio? Onye Nyasae ore ensemo yaito, ning’o oranyare gotobua?

english: He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?
ekegusii: Ere otarorerete Omwana oye amaabera, korende akamorua ase engencho yaito intwe twensi, inaki aramoche gotoa ebinto bionsi amo nere?

english: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect ? It is God that justifieth .
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gosoera abachoore ba Nyasae? Nyasae nere okobaa oboronge.

english: Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobanachera ekiina? Kristo Yeso nere okwete, ee, na kobua ase aya obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure; ere nigo are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende nere ogotosabera.

english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ ? shall tribulation , or distress , or persecution , or famine , or nakedness , or peril , or sword ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oratwatanane korwa ase obwanchani bwa Kristo? Inee! Nogochandwa, gose nobororo, gose nokorosigwa, gose nenchara, gose ngesobono, gose n’obobe, gose n’omoro?

english: Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .
ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana aya onsi twabeire ababui, na goetania ababui, goetera ase are oyotwanchete.

english: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene bw’okomanya, ng’a nonya namakweri, nonya nobogima, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nabare ne chinguru, nonya n’ebinto ebireo, nonya nebi gochi‐gocha, nonya n’okobua,

english: Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .
ekegusii: nonya nayare igoro, nonya nayare inse, nonya negetongwa kende gionsi, tibikonyara gotwatanana korwa ase obwanchani bwa Nyasae obore ime ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito.

english: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
ekegusii: erinde ekerigirie ime ase amachiiko geikeranigwe ime yaito, aba totari gotunyana chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika.

english: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh ; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit .
ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.

english: For to be carnally minded is death ; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace .
ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria kw’engencho y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende okorengereria kw’engencho y’Omoika nobogima na omorembe.

english: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .
ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria koria kw’engencho y’ebibe nobobisa igoro ase Nyasae, ekiagera tikori gwancha koigwera amachiiko a Nyasae, gose tikori koyaigwera nonya ng’ake.

english: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .
ekegusii: Abagotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe tibakonyara kogwenera Nyasae.

english: But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
ekegusii: Onye Omoika o Nyasae kamenyete ime yaino, rirorio timori gotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika. Onde bwensi otari n’Omoika o Kristo, oyio tari omonto oye.

english: I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ekeene ase Kristo, tindi goteeba oborimo. Okomanya gw’enkoro y’ane ime, gokwamorekirwe n’Omoika Omochenu, kwambereire kirori,

english: And not only this ; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one , even by our father Isaac ;
ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende Rebeka nere nabogoretie oborito ase omosacha oyomo, nere Isaka sokoro yaito.

english: ( For the children being not yet born , neither having done any good or evil , that the purpose of God according to election might stand , not of works , but of him that calleth ;)
ekegusii: -12 - 9:11,12: Omoch 25:23 ekero abana baria konya bataraiborwa na batarakora amaya gose amabe, ng’ina nigo atebetigwe, “Oyo omonene namokorere oyio omoke.” Igo omoroberio o Nyasae bw’ogochoora goika ogenderere, tari ase engencho y’ogokora kw’ abanto, korende ase okorangeria kwaye.

english: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ogotaba boronge nkore ase Nyasae? Yaya, taibo!
