english: So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .
ekegusii: Ase igo, tari ng’a nigo ere ase ogwancha kw’omonto, gose nokw’oria ogokora omokia, korende nokw’oria okororera amaabera, nere Nyasae.

english: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy , and whom he will he hardeneth .
ekegusii: Ase igo, oyo arigetie kororera amaabera, nigo akomoororera amaabera, na oyo arigetie gokora abe omokong’u ase enkoro yaye, nigo akomokora abe omokong’u. Nyasae n’omogaambi omonene

english: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
ekegusii: Aande gose nonteebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase Mwanyabaanto? Inaki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”

english: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
ekegusii: ng’a ninde nobororo obonge na ogwechanda kogendererete ase enkoro y’ane.

english: Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?
ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari n’okobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?

english: What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :
ekegusii: Inaki rende onye Nyasae okorigia koorokia endamwamu yaye, na komanyia abanto okobua kwaye, na ase oboremereria obonge akabogorerania n’ebinto biria bi’endamwamu biakorirwe ase ogosareka,

english: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy , which he had afore prepared unto glory ,
ekegusii: erinde aorokie obonda bw’obonene bwaye, ase ebinto biria bi’amaabera ebiaroisetie korwa kare binyore obonene?

english: Even us , whom he hath called , not of the Jews only , but also of the Gentiles ?
ekegusii: Abwo nintwe, twarangeretigwe nere, tari korwa ase Abayahudi boka, korende nonya nkorwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku boigo.

english: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .
ekegusii: inaki Omonene n’ache ase ense agaambe ekiina, akenache na kogekoora.”

english: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :
ekegusii: Inaki nanga naganetie ng’a ndagererigwe inche omonyene na gwatananwa korwa ase Kristo ase engencho y’abaminto abare b’eamate y’ane ase egesaku giaito.

english: What shall we say then ? That the Gentiles , which followed not after righteousness , have attained to righteousness , even the righteousness which is of faith .
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku, abatarenge korigia oboronge ’mbanyorete oboronge boria bw’okwegena;

english: But Israel , which followed after the law of righteousness , hath not attained to the law of righteousness .
ekegusii: korende Abaisraeli abare korigia oboronge bokorwa ase amachiiko, tibaikerete oboronge boria.

english: Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;
ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera tibarenge koborigia ase enchera y’okwegena, korende nase enchera y’ogokora, bakagochwa igoro ase rigena riria rikogocha;

english: Whose are the fathers , and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came , who is over all , God blessed for ever . Amen .
ekegusii: Inaki abagaaka baito ba kare nabaabo, na korwa ase bare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna Mwanyabaanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oy’orabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina. Chiira chia Nyasae tichiamochete goikeranigwa

english: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :
ekegusii: Tari ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae ndiasinyire goikeranigwa. Inaki tari bonsi abare b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli bare Abaisraeli b’ekeene;

english: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .
ekegusii: Engencho yaye, tari abana b’ororeria bare Abana ba Nyasae, korende n’abana b’eira bakobarwa ng’a noroiboro rw’aye.

english: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled , that there was a famine in the land . And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab , he, and his wife , and his two sons .
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero abagaambi ebiina barenge kogambera Abaisraeli, enchara enene ekaba ase ense yabo. Ase ayio, omonto oyomo o Bethlehemu, y’Aboyahudi, akaimoka amo na mokaye na abamura baye babere, akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamoabu.

english: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Yaya, titokogotiga! Nigo torigetie kogenda amo naye ase abanto baino.”

english: And Naomi said , Turn again , my daughters : why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb , that they may be your husbands ?
ekegusii: Korende Naomi akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Abana baane, irana mogende seino! Nase ki moganetie kogenda amo nainche? Inee! Ninyare naende korwa ase enda yane koibora abana bagochia kobanyuoma?

english: Turn again , my daughters , go your way; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons ;
ekegusii: Abana baane, irana mogende seino, ekiagera inche nagotire mono, tinkonyuomwa naende. Nonya nare korengereria ng’a ninde nogosemeria, na onye nare konyora omosacha reero, nyibore abana abamura.

english: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay, my daughters ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
ekegusii: Inee, nkoganya mware goika bakine? Gose ngwetanga mware timonyuomwa nabasaacha bande? Taibo, abana baane! Amang’ana ane namakong’u mono ase more ase engencho Omonene ong’onchokeire.”

english: And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law ; but Ruth clave unto her.
ekegusii: Naende bagachaaka korera mono goetania. Erio Oripa akanyunyunta ng’ina biara, akamotiga, korende Rutu akaanga komotiga.

english: And she said , Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people , and unto her gods : return thou after thy sister in law .
ekegusii: Ase igo Naomi agateebia Rutu, “Naama! Oripa, moka momura omwabo omosacha oo, oiranire ase abanto baye, na ase enyasae yaye. Naye irana, mogende komo!”

english: And Ruth said , Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest , I will go ; and where thou lodgest , I will lodge : thy people shall be my people , and thy God my God :
ekegusii: Korende Rutu akamoiraneria, “Tagonsorora ng’a ngotige. Tiga ngende amo naye. Aande onsi ase aye ogochia, nainche nao ndachie; na aande onsi ase aye oramenye, nainche nao ndamenye. Abanto bao mbabe abanto baane, na Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one.

english: Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.
ekegusii: Aase aye orakwere, nainche nao ndakwere, na ntindekwe aroro. Tiga Omonene ang’e egesusuro ekenene kegima bono na kogenderera onye gento kende kegochia konyatanana korwa asore, otatiga amakweri oka.”

english: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.
ekegusii: Ekero Naomi arooche ng’a Rutu bwerure kogeenda amo nere, takwana gento kende.

english: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem . And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem , that all the city was moved about them, and they said , Is this Naomi ?
ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo babere bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, goika bagaika Bethlehemu. Ekero baigete aroro, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakaeegaeega ase engencho yabo, na abakungu bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Inee! Oyo Naomi?”

english: And the name of the man was Elimelech , and the name of his wife Naomi , and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion , Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah . And they came into the country of Moab , and continued there.
ekegusii: Omonto oria nigo arenge korokwa Elimeleki, na mokaye Naomi, na abamura baye babere Mahaloni na Kilioni. Barabwo nigo barenge Abaefarati ba Beteremu ya Boyahudi. Barabwo bakang’anya gochia ense ya Moabu bakamenya aroro.

english: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
ekegusii: Naomi akabateebia, “Timondoka Naomi, ndoke Mara, + 1:20 Mara: engencho yaye: obororo ekiagera Nyasae Omobui ondeteire obororo obonge.”

english: I went out full , and the LORD hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
ekegusii: Ekero nagendete nigo narenge omonda, korende Omonene ong’iranirie inde namaboko amasa. Nase ki rende mokondoka Naomi bono, ekero Omonene Omobui ang’onchokeire na ondeteire amaakwa?

english: So Naomi returned , and Ruth the Moabitess , her daughter in law , with her, which returned out of the country of Moab : and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest .
ekegusii: Naboigo Naomi airanete korwa ase ense y’Abamoabu amo na Rutu, oria Omomoabu, moka momura oye. Barabwo bagaika Bethlehemu ekero abanto konya bachakire kogesa esairi.

english: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died ; and she was left , and her two sons .
ekegusii: Elimeleki omosacha o Naomi agakwa, agatiga Naomi ore omotakaanwa, ore nabamura baye babere.

english: And they took them wives of the women of Moab ; the name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other Ruth : and they dwelled there about ten years .
ekegusii: Barabwo bakanyuoma abaiseke b’Abamoabu; oyomo nigo are korokwa Oripa na oyonde Rutu. Magega kabamenyire aroro koreng’ana emiaka ikomi,

english: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .
ekegusii: Mahaloni na Kilioni nabarabwo bagakwa. Igo Naomi agakwerwa omosacha oye na abamura baye babere. Naomi na Rutu bakoirana gochia Bethlehemu

english: Then she arose with her daughters in law , that she might return from the country of Moab : for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread .
ekegusii: Naomi kare agwo ase ense y’Abamoabu akaigwa ng’a Omonene ororeire abanto baye amaabera, obaeire endagera naende; ase ayio akamanora korua ense eria amo na baka bamura baye babere.

english: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .
ekegusii: Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, bagachaaka orogendo koirana gochia ase ense y’Abayuda,

english: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law , Go , return each to her mother’s house : the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead , and with me.
ekegusii: Naomi agateebia baka bamura baye babere ng’a bairane, na kera oyomo agende komenya mwa ng’ina. Naende akabora, “Tiga Omonene abakorere amaya, buna inwe mwakoreire baria bakuure, boigo nainche mwankoreire.”

english: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice , and wept .
ekegusii: Omonene abanchere kera oyomo oino anyuomwe naende, na anyore mwaye. Erio Naomi akabanyunyunta ase okobatiga. Korende barabwo bagachaaka korera mono,

english: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech ; and his name was Boaz .
ekegusii: Naomi nabwate omoamate oyomo ore korokwa Boazi, omonto omonda na bwesiko bw’eamate y’Elimeleki, omosacha oye. Ere nigo arenge omonto bwomong’uso, naende omonda.

english: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger ?
ekegusii: Rutu agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaboria Boazi, “Naki gwakora kwanyechandera na gonkorera buya iga, na inche nomomenyi inde aa?”

english: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
ekegusii: Boazi akamoiraneria, “Nateebigwe amang’ana onsi gwakoreire nyoko biara korwa ekero omosacha oo akwete. Namanyire buna gwatigire iso na nyoko, na ense yao kwaiboreretwe, ogaacha komenya nabaanto otamanyete agwo ritang’ani.

english: The LORD recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .
ekegusii: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”

english: Then she said , Let me find favour in thy sight , my lord ; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid , though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens .
ekegusii: Rutu akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, kwabeire omuya mono ase ’nde, kwandemirie ase ogokwana nobwororo nainche, omosomba oo, nonya tindenga’aini oyomo bw’abasomba bao abaiseke.”

english: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither , and eat of the bread , and dip thy morsel in the vinegar . And she sat beside the reapers : and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat , and was sufficed , and left .
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachete koragera, Boazi agateebia Rutu, “Inchuo aa, orie omogati otongerie ase omosori ore nedivai.” Naboigo Rutu agaikaransa amo nabagesi baria, na Boazi akamoa ebigara bisambire. Rutu akaria, akaigota, naende eyende egatigara.

english: And when she was risen up to glean , Boaz commanded his young men , saying , Let her glean even among the sheaves , and reproach her not:
ekegusii: Na ekero Rutu agendete gochora ebigara naende, Boazi agachiika abasomba baye, akabateebia, “Momotige achore ebigara nonya nase egati y’emesaima, timomokania.

english: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not.
ekegusii: Naende momoruserie ebigara korwa ase emesaima, momotigere abichore, timobaisa komotanga.”

english: So she gleaned in the field until even , and beat out that she had gleaned : and it was about an ephah of barley .
ekegusii: Igo Rutu akagenderera gochora ebigara ase omogondo oria goika mogoroba, na ekero abibungete akanyora ng’a biaisanire ebitonga bibere.

english: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .
ekegusii: Erio agetweka ebitonga biria, akairana gochia omochie, akaorokia ng’ina biara ebio achorete. Naende akamoa endagera eria yatigarete ekero ariete akaigota.

english: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .
ekegusii: Naomi akamobooria, “Ng’ai kware gochora ebigara reero? Nase omogondo o ng’o kware gokora emeremo? Asesenigwe omonto oyio ogwechandera kogokonya!” Rutu agateebia Naomi ng’a nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase omogondo bw’omonto ore korokwa Boazi.

english: And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
ekegusii: Naende Rutu, Omomoabu oria, akamoteebia, “Amo nayio ere nigo anteebia ng’a mbeere amo nabasomba baye goika bakoore rigesa riaye rionsi.”

english: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law , It is good , my daughter , that thou go out with his maidens , that they meet thee not in any other field .
ekegusii: Erio Naomi ageteebia Rutu, “Ee, omwana one, mbuya mono kobua asore okore emeremo nabaiseke abwo bakomokorera Boazi. Oise kogenda ase omogondo bw’omonto omoao, abanto bare aroro mbaabaise kogokorera bobe.”

english: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest ; and dwelt with her mother in law .
ekegusii: Ase ayio Rutu agakora emeremo amo nabaiseke baria, akaba ogochora ebigara goika bagakoora rigesa ri’esairi + 2:23 Esairi: nendagera enga buna engano na eri’engano. Korende akagenderera komenya amo na ng’ina biara.

english: And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu akagenda ase omogondo gete, akaba ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y’abagesi. english: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem , and said unto the reapers , The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
ekegusii: Erio agwo Boazi agacha aroro korwa Bethlehemu, agakwania abagesi, ogoteeba, “Omonene abe amo nainwe!” Nabarabwo bakairaneria, “Omonene agosesenie!”

english: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this?
ekegusii: Boazi akaboria omoteneneri bw’abagesi baye, “Inee! Omosubati oyo, noyo ng’o?”

english: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria bw’abakori emeremo akamoiraneria, “Oyo nomosubati bw’Abamoabu, oria ochicha na Naomi korwa ase ense yabo.

english: And she said , I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house .
ekegusii: Nigo aboria ribaga ri’ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y’abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”

english: Then said Boaz unto Ruth , Hearest thou not, my daughter ? Go not to glean in another field , neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens :
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agakwana na Rutu, akamoteebia, “Mwana one, ntegerera! Tobaisa kogenda gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo omoao; obeere aa oka, obe kogokora emeremo na abaiseke aba.

english: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap , and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst , go unto the vessels , and drink of that which the young men have drawn .
ekegusii: Origererie orore ase bakogesa obabwatie korwa magega! Nakanirie abanto baane tibakogochanda. Gokorang’a, ogende ase chinsiongo echio baichoirie amaache, otaae onywe!”

english: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Naomi agateebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Narorire ng’a mbuya nkonyorere omosacha, erinde onyore enka yao.

english: And he said , Blessed be thou of the LORD , my daughter : for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning , inasmuch as thou followedst not young men , whether poor or rich .
ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamoteebia, “Mwana one, Omonene agosesenie. Aye bono kworokirie amasikani kobua buna kworogetie ritang’ani. Aye torarigia abasacha bande, abataka gose abanda.

english: And now, my daughter , fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .
ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwana one, toiroka, ekiagera abanto bonsi ase omochie oyo nigo bamanyete ng’a aye nomokuungu omweriti. Ningokorere ande onsi oraganie.

english: Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well ; let him do the kinsman’s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth : lie down until the morning .
ekegusii: Bono beera aa ase obotuko obo goika mambia, torore gose omonyamwando + 3:13 omonyamwando: omonto oeire ribaga koba omoteneneri bw’ebinto bw’omonto okuure oria onde ore ang’e kombua nanche gokorenda. Karakore igo mbuya. Onye tagwancha, rirorio ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, inche ninkorende. Bono rara aiga goika mambia.”

english: And she lay at his feet until the morning : and she rose up before one could know another . And he said , Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor .
ekegusii: Ase igo omokungu oria akarara ase amagoro aye maate goika mambia, korende mambia chuni botarakiamoka akaimoka kogenda, erinde monto onde tamorora, ekiagera Boazi tatagete monto onde amanye ng’a omokungu oria nachete ase ekeooreri kiaye.

english: Also he said , Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley , and laid it on her: and she went into the city .
ekegusii: Naende Boazi akamoteebia, “Renta egetambaa ekio bwambarete, okiaare.” Na Rutu agakiaara. Erio Boazi akamorengera esairi + 3:15 Esairi: Endagera enga buna engano eisaine ebitita + 3:15 Ebitita: ebitonga ebisinini bitano na ekemo, akamoyetweka. Erio omokungu oria akairana gochia ase omochie.

english: And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou, my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
ekegusii: Ekero Rutu aigete ase ng’ina biara, ere akamobooria, “Mang’ana ki, omwana one?” Rutu akamoteebia amang’ana onsi Boazi amokorerete.

english: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law .
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Boazi nigo anteebia ng’a tinkonyara koirana gocha asore namaboko amasa. Ase igo ong’a esairi eye ebitita bitano na ekemo.”

english: Then said she, Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .
ekegusii: Naomi akamoteebia, “Bono omwana one, remereria oganye goika orore aya arabe asore. Boazi tagokira reero goika arore ng’a oroisirie amang’ana ao.”

english: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
ekegusii: Nomanyete ng’a Boazi, oria ase konya ogokora emeremo nabasomba baye, nigo are omonyamwando ominto? Naama! Ase omogoroba o reero nache abe okoora esairi ase ekeooreri kiaye.

english: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor : but make not thyself known unto the man , until he shall have done eating and drinking .
ekegusii: Ase ayio esibie, bweake amaguta agotioka buya, obeke chianga chiao chingiya. Erio otirimboke gochia ase ekeooreri, korende tobaisa kweorokia ase omonto oria goika ekero akoorire koragera na konywa.

english: And it shall be, when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
ekegusii: Ekero ararire, origererie omanye aase aria. Erio ogende aroro, otubore ekiebisio kiaye korwa ase amagoro aye maate, oraareo nere nagoteebie aya ogwenerete gokora.”

english: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do .
ekegusii: Rutu akairaneria, “Aya onsi gwanteebia ninyakore.”

english: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu agatirimboka gochia ase ekeooreri, agakora buna ng’ina biara konya amotebirie.

english: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .
ekegusii: Boazi kariire na konywa akaigwa buya ase omoyo oye erio, akagenda ang’e netui y’esairi, akarara aroro. Erio Rutu agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, agatubora ekiebisio korwa ase amagoro a Boazi, akarara aroro.

english: And it came to pass at midnight , that the man was afraid , and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet .
ekegusii: Na kobwabeire botuko gati, Boazi agataboboka. Ani! Omokungu naraire magoro aye maate.

english: And he said , Who art thou? And she answered , I am Ruth thine handmaid : spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid ; for thou art a near kinsman .
ekegusii: Boazi akamobooria, “Naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Rutu omosomba oo, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonyamwando o tata biara. Ase igo koranche nywome.”

english: Then went Boaz up to the gate , and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said , Ho , such a one ! turn aside , sit down here. And he turned aside , and sat down .
ekegusii: Boazi akagenda agaikaransa ase etureti + 4:1 Etureti: Ase emesangererekano egokorerwa agwo ase egeita ki’omochie. Ekaba ng’a omonto oria omonyamwando bw’Elimeleki ore ang’e kobua Boazi, oria Boazi akwanete igoro yaye, ngoeta arenge. Boazi akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Oyominto, gobera gocha aa, oikaranse!” Omonto oria akagobera, agaikaransa.

english: So Boaz took Ruth , and she was his wife : and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception , and she bare a son .
ekegusii: Ase igo Boazi akaira Rutu, na ere akaba mokaye. Erio bakamenyana, n’Omonene aganchera Rutu koba morito, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia.

english: And the women said unto Naomi , Blessed be the LORD , which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman , that his name may be famous in Israel .
ekegusii: Erio abakungu b’omochie oyio bagateebia Naomi, “Omonene atogigwe! Ere tagotigeti; reero okoeire omonyamwando, oyio erieta riaye riramanyekane ase egati y’Abaisraeli!

english: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life , and a nourisher of thine old age : for thy daughter in law , which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons , hath born him.
ekegusii: Nere oragotimokie, abe chinguru chiao abe ogokorageria ase obogotu bwao. Moka momura oo nigo agwanchete; ere ogokoreire amaya kobua abamura batano na babere, na bono oiboire omwana oyio.”

english: And Naomi took the child , and laid it in her bosom , and became nurse unto it.
ekegusii: Naomi akaimokia omwana oria, akamoagata, akaba okomorera.

english: And the women her neighbours gave it a name , saying , There is a son born to Naomi ; and they called his name Obed : he is the father of Jesse , the father of David .
ekegusii: Abakungu abarenge abagisangio baye bakaboora, “Naomi oiboreirwe omwana omochokoro omomura”, bakamoroka Obedi. Obedi oyio nere orenge ise Yese, na Yese akaba ise Daudi. Chisokoro chia Daudi

english: Now these are the generations of Pharez : Pharez begat Hezron ,
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo ororeria rwa Peresi: Peresi akaibora Hezironi;

english: And Hezron begat Ram , and Ram begat Amminadab ,
ekegusii: Hezironi akaibora Ramu, na Ramu akaibora Aminadabu;

english: And he took ten men of the elders of the city , and said , Sit ye down here. And they sat down .
ekegusii: Naende Boazi akarangeria abagaaka ikomi b’omochie baikaranse aroro, ase igo bagaikaransa.

english: And Amminadab begat Nahshon , and Nahshon begat Salmon ,
ekegusii: Aminadabu akaibora Nahesoni, na Nahesoni akaibora Salimoni;

english: And Salmon begat Boaz , and Boaz begat Obed ,
ekegusii: Salimoni akaibora Boazi, na Boazi akaibora Obedi;

english: And Obed begat Jesse , and Jesse begat David .
ekegusii: Obedi akaibora Yese, na Yese akaibora Daudi.

english: And he said unto the kinsman , Naomi , that is come again out of the country of Moab , selleth a parcel of land , which was our brother Elimelech’s :
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y’Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw’Elimeleki ominto.

english: And I thought to advertise thee, saying , Buy it before the inhabitants , and before the elders of my people . If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know : for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said , I will redeem it .
ekegusii: Inche nigo narengereretie gokomanyia amang’ana aya. Bono nonyare kobogora aiga ase amasio abagaaka b’abanto baane aba, na ase aba bonsi baikaransete igaa. Onye kogwancha kobogora, bogore, korende onye taibo, ntebie imanye, ekiagera naye ore omonyamwando ore ang’e, na magega yao ninche.” Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ee, nimbogore.”

english: Then said Boaz , What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi , thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess , the wife of the dead , to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance .
ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamoteebia, “Korende onye gokogora oboremo korwa ase Naomi, rirorio oire Rutu, Omomoabu oria, moka oria okwete, abe mokao, naye omotenenerie oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye.”

english: And the kinsman said , I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance : redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it .
ekegusii: Omonyamwando oria akairaneria, akabora, “Onye naboigo, rirorio tinkobogora, mbaise gosiria omwando one. Ribaga riane ri’okobogora, aye riire; tinkonyara kobogora.”

english: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz , Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe .
ekegusii: Ase igo omonyamwando oria agateebia Boazi, “Aye bogore”, na akamosomorera egekoroto kiaye.

english: And Boaz said unto the elders , and unto all the people , Ye are witnesses this day , that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s , and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s , of the hand of Naomi .
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia abagaaka baria na abanto bonsi abarengeo, “Inwe mbirori more reero ng’a nagorire korwa ase amaboko a Naomi bionsi ebiarenge ebi’Elimeleki, na ebia Kilioni amo nebia Mahaloni.

english: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels , thy neck with chains of gold .
ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nechinseera, chichabeire n’ebinto bi’oboseera, ne rigoti riao nigo richabeire ne chisonoi.

english: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver .
ekegusii: Intwe ntokoroiserie ebinyuri bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera, ebitonire ne chifeta. (Omoriakari)

english: While the king sitteth at his table , my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.

english: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts .
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are ase ’nde buna omobuko o manemane, oyo nkobeeka ase egekuba kiane gati gati yechimbeere chiane.

english: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi .
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are ase ’nde buna egesago ki’ebisicha bikorokwa hena, bire ase emegondo y’emesabibu y’Eni‐Gedi. (Omonyuomi)

english: Behold, thou art fair , my love ; behold, thou art fair ; thou hast doves’ eyes .
ekegusii: Naama! Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera mono! Ee, nabo ore omoseera mono. Ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma. (Omoriakari)

english: Behold, thou art fair , my beloved , yea, pleasant : also our bed is green .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera. Ee, aye nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, oborere bwaito nigo borabe obonyansi bore machani.

english: The beams of our house are cedar , and our rafters of fir .
ekegusii: Ebisigisa bi’enyomba yaito nebi’emecharake, ne chindote nechi’emetarakwa.

english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth : for thy love is better than wine .
ekegusii: Tiga anyunyunte nokonyunyunta kw’omonwa oye. Ekiagera obwanchani bwao nobuya kobua edivai.

english: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth , therefore do the virgins love thee.
ekegusii: Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abakungu nigo bagwanchete.

english: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers : we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine : the upright love thee.
ekegusii: Ing’use nkobwatie, tominyoke kogenda. Omorwoti ondetire ase enyomba yaye. Ntokogokere na kogochengera, ntotogie obwanchani bwao kobua edivai. Ekeene, nakio abakungu bagwancherete.

english: I am black , but comely , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , as the tents of Kedar , as the curtains of Solomon .
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, inche nigo inde omomwamu ti, noyo bw’okogokia. Nigo inga buna chiema chia Kedari, naende buna ebitambaa bi’ogosungwa bia Sulemani.

english: Look not upon me, because I am black , because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards ; but mine own vineyard have I not kept .
ekegusii: Timobaisa kondigereria, ekiagera inde omomwamu ti; nomobaso bw’erioba onsambire. Abamura ba baba nigo bambeete, bakambeeka korenda emegondo y’emesabibu, korende omogondo one bw’emesabibu tinarendete.

english: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth , where thou feedest , where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon : for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions ?
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi bw’omoyo one, nteebie ng’ai okorisia riicho riao. Ng’ai okoriira riakenderera mobaso gati? Nase ki ndabe nkona‐gotayaya ase egati y’amaicho ’abagisangio bao? (Omonyuomi)

english: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women , go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock , and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents .
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi; onye tomanyeti, bwatia amabarato e riicho, obe gokorisia chimanwa chiao chie chimbori ang’e ne chiema chi’abarisia.

english: I have compared thee, O my love , to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ngokoreng’ania nebarasi eaberi ekong’usa egari ya Farao.

english: I am the rose of Sharon , and the lily of the valleys .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inga egesicha gia Saroni gekorokwa rosi, naende egesicha ekiya kie rikura. (Omonyuomi)

english: My beloved spake , and said unto me, Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .
ekegusii: Omwanchi ngokwana are na gonteebia. (Omonyuomi) Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omuya, imoka, inchwo togende,

english: For, lo, the winter is past , the rain is over and gone ;
ekegusii: ekiagera bono engaki y’etoigo yaerire, boigo engaki y’embura yaerire ne mbura yachiire.

english: The flowers appear on the earth ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land ;
ekegusii: Ebisicha biasichire ase ense, engaki y’amatera yaikire, ee, eriogi ri’amatera ’amaruma riaigurwe ase ense yaito.

english: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs , and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell . Arise , my love , my fair one , and come away .
ekegusii: Emeko yachakire kwama amako, na emesabibu yachakire gosicha, nigo egotioka rimisu rigiya. Aye omosani one omuya, imoka togende!

english: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .
ekegusii: Aye riruma riane ore ase omwenya bw’egetare, agwo ase obwebiso bw’egetare, tiga indore obosio bwao, naende inyigwe eriogi riao, ekiagera eriogi riao neriansu, na obosio bwao noboseera.

english: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .
ekegusii: Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete. (Omoriakari)

english: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere noyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.

english: Until the day break , and the shadows flee away , turn , my beloved , and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether .
ekegusii: Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, aye omwanchi one, onchoka gocha ase ’nde, ominyoke buna engabi, gose buna ensune ensae igoro ase egetunwa kere chinchwara.

english: As the lily among thorns , so is my love among the daughters .
ekegusii: Ee, koreng’ana buna egesicha ekiya kere ase egati y’amagwa, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abaiseke. (Omoriakari)

english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , and his fruit was sweet to my taste .
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna omote bw’amapera osimekire ase egati y’emete y’orosana, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abamura. Nigo ngokirie goikaransa ase ekiriri kiaye, na amatunda aye akanyansera.

english: He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .
ekegusii: Ere akang’ira ase enyomba y’omoyega, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bore buna ebendera igoro yane.

english: Stay me with flagons , comfort me with apples : for I am sick of love .
ekegusii: Inyigotie na amasabibu amomo na ongokie na amapera, ekiagera amaiga ’obwanchani anyarire.

english: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi + 2:6 bomosi: Okoboko gwokobee nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio + 2:6 Borio: Okoboko gwokorio nigo komboanetie.

english: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe Engaki yaye yaikeranire. Ogoteera Gwa Kabere (Omoriakari)

english: The voice of my beloved ! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe eriogi ri’omwanchi one! Rora oyio ogocha! Nigo agocharoka‐charoka igoro ase ebitunwa, na gocharara ase ebigoro.

english: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold, he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo anga engabi gose ensune ensae. Rora, bono nigo ateneine magega y’enyasi y’enyomba yaito. Origereretie gocha ime goetera ase chitirisa, goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange.

english: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth : I sought him, but I found him not.
ekegusii: Botuko ekero naraire borere bwane, nkamorigia oria omoyo one bwanchete, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.

english: He made the pillars thereof of silver , the bottom thereof of gold , the covering of it of purple , the midst thereof being paved with love , for the daughters of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Amagoro aye kegotenenera nigo aroiseirie chifeta, na ekiegeko kiaye nigo kiaroiseirie chitaabu; egeikaransero kiaye nigo giatubire negetambaa kere monyinga. Abakungu ba Yerusalemu nigo bagechaberete ime, bare nomoyo bw’ogwancha.

english: Go forth , O ye daughters of Zion , and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals , and in the day of the gladness of his heart .
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Sayoni, inchwo morore Sulemani omorwoti obegeete ekiore keria ng’ina amobeekerete ase rituko riria Sulemani akoreretwe enyangi, rituko riria ri’omogooko bw’enkoro yaye.

english: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets , and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth : I sought him, but I found him not.
ekegusii: “Erio nkaimoka nkagenda ase omochie, ng’aeta ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, nkarigia omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.

english: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said , Saw ye him whom my soul loveth ?
ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, na inche nkababooria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”

english: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth : I held him, and would not let him go , until I had brought him into my mother’s house , and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo naruete ase abarendi abwo, nkanyora omwanchi bw’omoyo one. Nkamotarera tinamotiga agende; nigo namorentete mwa baba, nkamosoyia gochia ase akanyomba gokorara.

english: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke , perfumed with myrrh and frankincense , with all powders of the merchant ?
ekegusii: Ngeto ki keria kegocha korwa ase erooro kenga buna rikundesi ri’erioki? Ninki eke keagete amaguta a manemane na ubani, ebinto ebio bikoonigwa nabakori ebiasara.

english: Behold his bed , which is Solomon’s ; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel .
ekegusii: Rora aaria, ekerogo gi’okobogoreria Sulemani, geetananire nabasaacha emerongo etano nomo, abare chituoni chi’Abaisraeli.

english: They all hold swords , being expert in war : every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night .
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo beboeranetie emeyio ya birende, na nigo bare abanto bamanyete korwana esegi. Kera oyomo nigo abogoreti omoyio obirende, orendete ase okogoswa kwa botuko.

english: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon .
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani nigo eroiseretie ekerogo keria korwa ase emete ya Lebanoni.

english: Behold, thou art fair , my love ; behold, thou art fair ; thou hast doves’ eyes within thy locks : thy hair is as a flock of goats , that appear from mount Gilead .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera! Naama! Nigo ore omoseera! Korwa ime y’egietubo kiao ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, nigo chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.

english: How fair is thy love , my sister , my spouse ! how much better is thy love than wine ! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices !
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, obwanchani bwao naki bore obuya mono! Naki bore obuya mono kobua edivai! Ne rimisu ri’amaguta ao ogweaka nigo ribuete ebinsari bionsi!

english: Thy lips , O my spouse , drop as the honeycomb : honey and milk are under thy tongue ; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon .
ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, ebikoba biao nigo bikonyororokia obooke; obooke na amabeere nigo bire inse y’oromeme rwao. Rimisu rie chianga chiao nigo ringa eria Lebanoni.

english: A garden inclosed is my sister , my spouse ; a spring shut up , a fountain sealed .
ekegusii: Moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, naye omogondo ogiteire, naye ensoko y’amaache egiteire, na entuboka emumekire na ebekire ekemanyererio.

english: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates , with pleasant fruits ; camphire , with spikenard ,
ekegusii: Buna omogondo ore namakomomanga aye nigo okwama amatunda amaya mono, na ebisicha bikorokwa hena mbireo, na ebimeri bikorokwa narada,

english: Spikenard and saffron ; calamus and cinnamon , with all trees of frankincense ; myrrh and aloes , with all the chief spices :
ekegusii: na ebimeri bigosegwa safarani; boigo kalamusi, na omodalasini, na emete yonsi ya ubani, na manemane, na omogaka, amo nebinsari ebiya mono.

english: A fountain of gardens , a well of living waters , and streams from Lebanon .
ekegusii: Aye nigo onga buna ensoko y’amaache are moyo ere mogondo, naende nigo onga buna chindooche chikorwa Lebanoni. (Omoriakari)

english: Awake , O north wind ; and come , thou south ; blow upon my garden , that the spices thereof may flow out . Let my beloved come into his garden , and eat his pleasant fruits .
ekegusii: Aye embeo ekorwa sugusu, imoka! Na aye eyekorwa Irianyi, inchwo! Gusa igoro y’omogondo one, tiga rimisu riaye rigiya rirurukigwe rirande. Tiga omwanchi one ache ase omogondo oye, arie amatunda are amaya mono.

english: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn , which came up from the washing ; whereof every one bear twins , and none is barren among them.
ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga ching’ondi chiaaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri gokwa.

english: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet , and thy speech is comely : thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks .
ekegusii: Ebikoba biao nigo binga eusi embariri, omonwa oo nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, chinsea chiao chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao; nigo chinga buna ebing’ese bie ritunda rikorokwa rikomomanga.

english: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury , whereon there hang a thousand bucklers , all shields of mighty men .
ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omoorobiri o Daudi, oyio oagachetwe nao ebirwanero bw’esegi biare kogachwa. Agwo nao chinguba elifu eyemo chisungire, chionsi nigo chire echi’abasikari bare chituoni.

english: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins , which feed among the lilies .
ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao ibere nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere buna chisare chi’engabi chikorisia agwo ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.

english: Until the day break , and the shadows flee away , I will get me to the mountain of myrrh , and to the hill of frankincense .
ekegusii: Ekero bogochi koira na emerengari egochia gosira, ningende ase egetunwa ase manemane ekoruerwa na ase ekegoro ki’ogosambera ubani.

english: Thou art all fair , my love ; there is no spot in thee.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera bori, tori na kemoa kende!

english: Come with me from Lebanon , my spouse , with me from Lebanon : look from the top of Amana , from the top of Shenir and Hermon , from the lions’ dens , from the mountains of the leopards .
ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, togende torue aa Lebanoni, torue Lebanoni, togende komo. Otirimboke korwa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa ki’Amana, na ekia Seniri na Herimoni. Orue ase amakuruma e chindo, na ase ebitunwa chingo chimenyete.

english: Thou hast ravished my heart , my sister , my spouse ; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes , with one chain of thy neck .
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, kwang’usire enkoro yane na kwangokirie, okorigereria kw’amaiso ao kwang’usire enkoro yane, ee, esonoi eyemo yoka ye chisonoi chia igoti riao yang’usire.

english: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends ; drink , yea, drink abundantly , O beloved .
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu) Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono goika moichorwe nobwanchani! Ogoteera Gwa Kane (Omoriakari)

english: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are omorabu se okomeka‐meka, naende omobariri; nigo are nogwatananekana korwa ase abanto chilifu ikomi.

english: His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .
ekegusii: Omotwe oye nigo ore omuya onga etaabu echenire, etukia yaye nigo ere omosamugoku bw’obwari; nigo ere emwamu ti buna amarionya ’ekegonkoru.

english: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo agwekaine amaruma are ase chindooche, ee, nigo anga amaruma asibigwe namabeere, naende nigo anga amagena akomeka‐meka achokire buya.

english: His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .
ekegusii: Chinsea chiaye nigo chinga buna ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari, bigotioka rimisu rigiya. Ebikoba biaye nigo binga buna ebisicha ebiya, nigo bigotonyia manemane.

english: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .
ekegusii: Amaboko aye nigo anga buna etaabu ebombire buya, echabeire amagena akomeka‐meka. Omobere oye nigo onga buna amaino e chinchogu aroisirie buya, na gochaberwa namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro.

english: His legs are as pillars of marble , set upon sockets of fine gold : his countenance is as Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo anga chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu se akomeka‐meka, abeekire ase chinterekerero chi’echitaabu chingiya. Okororekana kwaye nigo konga buna okwa Lebanoni, ekieni kiaye nigo kere ekiya buna eki’emecharake,

english: His mouth is most sweet : yea, he is altogether lovely . This is my beloved , and this is my friend , O daughters of Jerusalem .
ekegusii: Chinkwana chiaye nigo chire chinyansu mono, chingencho chiaye chionsi nigo chire echi’ogosanerwa mono. Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, naboigo omwanchi one are, oyio ore omosani one.

english: I sleep , but my heart waketh : it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh , saying , Open to me, my sister , my love , my dove , my undefiled : for my head is filled with dew , and my locks with the drops of the night .
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge indaire, korende enkoro yane nigo yategesetie. Igwa! Omwanchi one oyio ogokongonta egesieri ogontura. (Omonyuomi) Moiseke ominto, omwanchi one, riruma riane na omoikeranu one, inyigorere! Inyigorere, ekiagera omotwe one otoorire riime, na etukia yane yanyiire nembura ya botuko. (Omoriakari)

english: I have put off my coat ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet ; how shall I defile them?
ekegusii: Narusirie eanga, inee, inyebeeke naende? Nesibirie amagoro, inee, inyabeeke eubi naende?

english: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him.
ekegusii: Erio omwanchi one akabeeka okoboko kwaye ase ekebao, erio nkaba nomosasoko omonene ime ase enkoro yane.

english: I rose up to open to my beloved ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .
ekegusii: Nkaimoka gochia koigorera omwanchi one, amaboko aane akanyororokia manemane, na ebiara biane bigatonyia manemane ekero nabwatete echabi yegesieri.

english: I opened to my beloved ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer .
ekegusii: Ngachia koigorera omwanchi one, korende nkanyora ng’a ochiire. Omoyo one okairianyeka ekero akwanete. Nkaba nkomorigia, korende tinamonyorete. Nkamorangeria, korende taitabete.

english: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, bakang’aka chingoma; bakang’ura egetambaa gi’okwambara, abarendi baria barendete chindwaki.

english: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him, that I am sick of love .
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora ng’a mokonyora omwanchi one, momoteebie ng’a amaiga ’obwanchani anyaarire. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)

english: What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us?
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, inee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande? Ee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande, goika gwatosoroire iga? (Omoriakari)

english: Whither is thy beloved gone , O thou fairest among women ? whither is thy beloved turned aside ? that we may seek him with thee.
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, ng’ai omwanchi oo achiire? Omwanchi oyio oo, ng’ai aonchokire gochia? Togende amo naye tomorigie. (Omoriakari)

english: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning , fair as the moon , clear as the sun , and terrible as an army with banners ?
ekegusii: Ning’o oyio okorigereria buna erioba rigotonga mambia? Ning’o oyio ore omuya buna omotienyi, na okomeka‐meka buna erioba? Ere nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia buna abasikari babogoretie chibendera chiabo.

english: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley , and to see whether the vine flourished , and the pomegranates budded .
ekegusii: Inche nigo natirimbogete gochia ase omogondo bw’emete enga buna emelozi; nkagenda ase rikura korora ebimeri ebiya buna bikoreereta, na korora gose emesabibu yachakire goseboka. Na emekomomanga gose yachakire gosicha.

english: Or ever I was aware , my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib .
ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaramanya, omoyo one okang’ira, okambeka ase egari y’omogambi bw’abaanto baane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)

english: Return , return , O Shulamite ; return , return , that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite ? As it were the company of two armies .
ekegusii: Irana! Irana, aye Omosulamiti! Irana! Irana, erinde tokorigererie! (Omoriakari) Nase ki mokondigereria inche Omosulamiti, buna mokorigereria ogotenga kw’ebiombe bibere bi’abasikari?

english: My beloved is gone down into his garden , to the beds of spices , to feed in the gardens , and to gather lilies .
ekegusii: Omwanchi one mogondo agenda, ogendire ase ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari. Ogendire korisia riicho riaye ase emegondo, naende nao akare kona‐gosangereria ebisicha ebiya.

english: I am my beloved’s , and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere nigo are oyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye agwo ase ebisicha ebiya bire. Ogoteera Kwa Gatano (Omonyuomi)

english: Thou art beautiful , O my love , as Tirzah , comely as Jerusalem , terrible as an army with banners .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera buna omochie o Tirisa; nigo ore bw’okogokia buna Yerusalemu, na oyo bw’okoirokia buna abasikari babogoretie ebendera.

english: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead .
ekegusii: Onchora amaiso ao otige kondigereria, ekiagera ambuire; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.

english: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing , whereof every one beareth twins , and there is not one barren among them.
ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga riicho rie ching’ondi chiabeeri chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri egokwa.

english: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks .
ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nigo chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao, nigo chinga buna chimbaara chie ritunda rikorokwa rikomomanga.

english: There are threescore queens , and fourscore concubines , and virgins without number .
ekegusii: Mbareo abakungu chiting’ana chi’omorwoti emerongo etano nomo, na abakungu ba sere‐sere emerongo etano na etato, boigo mbareo abaiseke abekungi abange batari kobareka.

english: My dove , my undefiled is but one ; she is the only one of her mother , she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea , the queens and the concubines , and they praised her.
ekegusii: Korende oyomo bweka nere omwanchi one, nere riruma riane omoikeranu. Ere nigo are omwana omomoima ng’ina abwate, oyo omoiborete nigo amwanchete. Abaiseke abwo bakamorora, bakamoroka oyosesenirie; abakungu baria chiting’ana na baria ba sere‐sere boigo bakamorora, bakamotogia.

english: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince’s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .
ekegusii: Aye omoiseke bw’omogambi, naki ebisanyi bi’amagoro ao bire ebiya ase ebikoroto ime! Naki ebibwato biao bimerete buya, nigo bire buna emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini.

english: I am my beloved’s , and his desire is toward me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, ere nigo are namaiga ase ’nde.

english: Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field ; let us lodge in the villages .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, inchwo togende ase amaremo aito, tobeere ase emechie botuko,

english: Let us get up early to the vineyards ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
ekegusii: toimoke mambia chuni togende ase emegondo y’emesabibu, torore gose yachakire goseboka, naende gose amasabibu amanokire na gosicha, boigo gose amakomomanga asichire. Aroro agwo ninkoboanie nobwanchani bwane.

english: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, amatunda amansu nigo agotioka rimisu rigiya mono, na igoro y’ebisieri biaito nareo amatunda ao ao are amaya mono, amakoro na amayia; ayio nasangereirie ase ogokogachera.

english: Thy navel is like a round goblet , which wanteth not liquor : thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies .
ekegusii: Ekenyobu kiao nigo keborongosire buya buna egetaabo getari koererwa edivai yochoganirie. Enda yao nigo ere buna etui y’engano, eetananeirie ebisicha ebiya.

english: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins .
ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere chire chisare chi’engabi.

english: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath-rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .
ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omoorobiri oroiseirie amaino e chinchogu, amaiso ao nigo anga buna amatibo a Hesiboni, ang’e negeita kia Bati‐Rabimu. Emioro yao nigo enga buna omoorobiri o Lebanoni orochie Damesiki.

english: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple ; the king is held in the galleries .
ekegusii: Omotwe oo nigo osongoire buna egetunwa gia Karimeli. Etukia y’omotwe oo ekona‐gosanyoka nigo ere ekieni kemonyinga; eyio yang’usire omorwoti.

english: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love , for delights !
ekegusii: Naki aye ore omoseera naende oyo bw’okogokia mono! Aye omwanchi bw’okogokia!

english: This thy stature is like to a palm tree , and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .
ekegusii: Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi’amasabibu.

english: I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples ;
ekegusii: Nkarengereria: Nkoriina inde omokendo oyo, imbwaterere chinsagia chiaye. Naki yare koba buya onye chimbeere chiao nchiaba buna ebisago bi’amasabibu, ne rimisu ri’omonwa oo ribe buna eri’amapera,

english: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved , that goeth down sweetly , causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak .
ekegusii: na omonwa oo obe buna edivai ere engiya mono. (Omoriakari) Ee, edivai eyio nigo egetirimboka gochia ime y’omwanchi one, naende yanyororoka ng’ora ng’ora, yakuna ebikoba bi’abwo baraire.

english: O that thou wert as my brother , that sucked the breasts of my mother ! when I should find thee without , I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised .
ekegusii: Onye ndiria kwarenge koba momura ominto, kwagongete orobeere rwa baba! Onye ndiria naumeranete naye isiko, nanga nigo nare gokonyunyunta, na onde tare gonchaya.

english: I am a wall , and my breasts like towers : then was I in his eyes as one that found favour .
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde orwaki, ne chimbeere chiane nigo chinga buna emerobiri; ase ayio nkaba ase amaiso aye buna oyo onyorire omorembe. (Omonyuomi)

english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon ; he let out the vineyard unto keepers ; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver .
ekegusii: Sulemani nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Baali‐Hamoni, akayotigera abarendi, na kera omorendi nigo arenge korenta chitaabu chi’echifeta elifu eyemo goakanera amatunda.

english: My vineyard , which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon , must have a thousand , and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred .
ekegusii: Korende omogondo bw’emesabibu oyore oyone bori ninche omonyene nyorendete. Aye Sulemani, ira chilifu chiao, na abarendi b’amatunda baire amagana abere.

english: Thou that dwellest in the gardens , the companions hearken to thy voice : cause me to hear it .
ekegusii: Aye oria omenyete ase emegondo, abagisangio baane nigo bategererete baigwe eriogi riao, tiga nainche indiigwe. (Omoriakari)

english: Make haste , my beloved , and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices .
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, minyoka bwango, obe buna engabi gose ensune ensae ekominyoka igoro ase ebitunwa bire nebimeri bigotioka buya.

english: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house , who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate .
ekegusii: Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amaache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.

english: His left hand should be under my head , and his right hand should embrace me.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi + 8:3 bomosi: okoboko gwokobee nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio + 8:3 Borio: okoboko gwokorio komboanetie.

english: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , until he please .
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora na kobatiania ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani na koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene. Ogoteera Kwa Gatano na Rimo (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)

english: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness , leaning upon her beloved ? I raised thee up under the apple tree : there thy mother brought thee forth : there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
ekegusii: Monto ki oria ogotiira gocha aa korwa ase erooro, oyio bweegegete omwanchi oye? (Omoriakari) Agwo inse y’omote bw’amapera inche nigo nagoturete oboke. Aroro agwo nyoko nigo arenge nobororo bw’okobina akoibore, ee, agwo nao nyoko akoiborerete ore nobororo.

english: Set me as a seal upon thine heart , as a seal upon thine arm : for love is strong as death ; jealousy is cruel as the grave : the coals thereof are coals of fire , which hath a most vehement flame .
ekegusii: Imbeke ase enkoro yao imbe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, ee, buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao. Obwanchani nigo bore ne chinguru buna amakweri, ne ribero nigo rire ritindi buna embeera. Ogwoka kw’obwanchani nigo konga ebibemberi bi’omorero, ee, nekebemberi gekorwa ase Omonene.

english: Many waters cannot quench love , neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love , it would utterly be contemned .
ekegusii: Amaache are amange mono takonyara gokendia obwanchani, gose chindooche tichikonyara koboiranana. Omonto naisa korua obotenenku bwonsi bw’enyomba yaye konyora obwanchani, oyio nigo arachaywe. (Abamura bamwabo omoriakari)

english: We have a little sister , and she hath no breasts : what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for ?
ekegusii: Intwe ntobwate omoiseke ominto ore omoke, korende tabwati mbeere; ekero engaki yaye erache akorigigwa anyuomwe, ninki torakorere omoiseke oyio ominto?

english: If she be a wall , we will build upon her a palace of silver : and if she be a door , we will inclose her with boards of cedar .
ekegusii: Ere karabe orwaki, ntoagache igoro yaye omoorobiri oroiseirie efeta, korende karabe egesieri, rirorio ntomosiekere ne chibao chi’emecharake. (Omoriakari)

english: Paul , a servant of God , and an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the faith of God’s elect , and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness ;
ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo. Inche nigo narangeretigwe naboigo gotomwa ogokonya okwegena kw’abachoore ba Nyasae, erinde baike ase ayare ay’ekeene, ayio akworokererigwa ase okwegena gwaito,

english: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
ekegusii: Inaki mbare abange, mono korwa ase Abayahudi baria baonchokire batari koigwera, abagokwana amang’ana atari nengeencho, abakong’aina abande ase ayio.

english: Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre’s sake .
ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete bakirigwe, ekiagera nkoonchorana bare abanto b’echinyomba chingima ase okworokereria aya’atagwenereti, naende ase obosooku, barabwo nigo bakorigia kwenyorera chitaabu.

english: One of themselves , even a prophet of their own , said , The Cretians are alway liars , evil beasts , slow bellies .
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo obo Omokirete, omobani obo abanyene, oteebire, “Abanto ba Kirete nabanyaborimo botambe, ne ching’iti chintindi chi’orosana, abaribobe aboro.”

english: This witness is true . Wherefore rebuke them sharply , that they may be sound in the faith ;
ekegusii: Ase igo nekogwenerete kobatogonyera bokong’u erio batware okwegena kore buya.

english: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
ekegusii: Naende totwara ribaga ri’ogotegerera emegano y’Abayahudi, gose amachiiko y’abanto abwo bakwanga ekeene.

english: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase abwo bare abachenu, korende tikeri ekere egechenu ase abwo batachenegeti na abategeneti, ekiagera ebirengererio biabo na okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime biabeire ebitachenegeti.

english: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba ng’a mbamomanyete Nyasae, korende ase ogokora kwabo bagekaana. Nigo bare abokogeechia, abatari koigwera, na ase ayio tibakonyaara gokora ogokora konde gwonsi okuya.

english: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;
ekegusii: ekio keigekire ase ogosemeria kw’obogima bwa kare na kare. Obogima obo Nyasae ariete eira korwa kare na kare.

english: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
ekegusii: Na ekero engaki yaye yaigete akabomaanora ase ring’ana riaye, eri inche negenirwe korandia ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.

english: For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :
ekegusii: Nkagotiga Kirete, erinde oroisie aria aganetie gokorwa erio ochore abagaaka ime ase kera omochie. Inyora buna nagochigeete.

english: For a bishop must be blameless , as the steward of God ; not selfwilled , not soon angry , not given to wine , no striker , not given to filthy lucre ;
ekegusii: Ase engencho omotang’ani bw’ekanisa agotenera ebire ebia Nyasae, ere abe omoikeranu. Ere taaba omonto omoenenu, gose omwango bw’okobea, gose oy’ogotinda, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, gose rinyandambe ase okonyora chitaabu.

english: But a lover of hospitality , a lover of good men , sober , just , holy , temperate ;
ekegusii: Korende abe omooroisia abageni, oyobwanchete amaya, oyobwerendete ase onsi, omooronge, omochenu, na oy’omanyete kweriita ase onsi.

english: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .
ekegusii: Ere nigo emogwenerete abwate ring’ana ri’ekeene buna riorokereretigwe, erinde anyare koremia abanto ase okworokereria gw’ekeene, na korongeyia abakoengererania nario.

english: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine :
ekegusii: Korende aye, nekobetereretie gokwana amang’ana agwenerete okworokereria gw’okwegena.

english: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .
ekegusii: tibaaba abakobaibera. Korende babaorokie obwegenwa obuya ase onsi, erinde ase amang’ana onsi yogokora kwabo abe ekiorokererio ekiya gi’okworokereria kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.

english: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men ,
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae oorokriie obuya bwaye ase ogotooreka ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi.

english: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
ekegusii: Obo nigo bogotworokereria okwanga amang’ana atari y’obonyasae ase obomenyo bwaito, na okogania okobe gw’ense eye, erinde tonyaare kwerenda ase onsi, na koba noboronge amo ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ime ase ense eye,

english: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ ;
ekegusii: gatoganyete ogoikeranigwa ogosemeria kwe Rituko Risesenirie, na okooroka kw’obonene bwa Nyasae omonene, na Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso,

english: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana aya, ase okobua gwonsi ore nakwo, kuurera, na gotogonyera abategereri bao. Tibwanchera omonto onde bwensi agochaaye.

english: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .
ekegusii: Oorokererie abagaaka babe aberiiti, abare n’ogosika, aberendete ase onsi, babe abagima ase okwegena, ase obwanchani, na ase oboremereria.

english: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;
ekegusii: Naboigo oorokererie abakungu abagotu babe norogendo rw’obochenu, tibaaba abang’aachi, gose abasomba gochia ase edivai. Yababetereirie barabwo babe aborokia b’ayare amaya,

english: That they may teach the young women to be sober , to love their husbands , to love their children ,
ekegusii: erinde borokererie abakungu abake banche abasacha babo, na abana babo.

english: To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
ekegusii: Naende babe aberendete ase onsi, abachenu, abagokora emeremo ase chinka chiabo, abaya, abaigwerete abasacha babo abanyene, erinde ring’ana ria Nyasae tiriramwa nonde bwensi.

english: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .
ekegusii: Naboigo, obasorore abamura babe aberiti ase onsi.

english: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana onsi, aye omonyene bweorokie koba ekiorokererio ki’ogokora okuya. Okwane ayare ekeene na kworokereria nokwerwa gwonsi.

english: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .
ekegusii: Ogokwana kwao kobe ogoikeranu, okwo gotanyaare gosoerwa, erinde omoengereria onde bwensi asooke, taaba ne ring’ana riibe agokwana igoro yaito.

english: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters , and to please them well in all things ; not answering again ;
ekegusii: Abasomba mbagwenerete baigwere naboigo kobagokia abanene babo ase amang’ana onsi, na tibaaba abakobairaneria bobe,

english: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers , to obey magistrates , to be ready to every good work ,
ekegusii: Oinyorie abanto bao bekeyie ase abagaambi, na ase abare nokobua, naende babe abaigweri, ase kera enchera bebeke ang’e gokora ogokora okuya.

english: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject ;
ekegusii: Omoe omonto oraarente okweatanana ogokuurera goika kabere, korwa agwo, aye tobaisa koba n’ering’ana rinde asare ere.

english: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
ekegusii: Nomanyete buna omonto onga buna oyio nomosareku, naende ebibe biaye biamwatananire, nere omonyene bwegaambirie. Ogotebereria ase y’ogokoorera

english: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .
ekegusii: Na abanto baito tiga beorokererie kwerua ase ogokora okuya, na gokoonya aase oboremerwa bore ase ekeene, erinde tibaaba abataisaini kende gionsi.

english: All that are with me salute thee . Greet them that love us in the faith . Grace be with you all . Amen . It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi bare amo nainche bagokwanirie. Tokwanerie baria abasani baito ase okwegena. Obuya bwa Nyasae Omobui bobe ase more mwensi. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.

english: To speak evil of no man , to be no brawlers , but gentle , shewing all meekness unto all men .
ekegusii: Obateebie tibakwana bobe igoro ya monto onde bwensi, korende barabwo babe abanto b’omorembe n’obosaani, babe abaremereria naende abakoorokia obwororo ase abanto bonsi.

english: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish , disobedient , deceived , serving divers lusts and pleasures , living in malice and envy , hateful , and hating one another .
ekegusii: Inaki agwo ritang’ani naintwe nigo twarenge abariri, abaenenu, na abang’ainegete. Nigo twarenge abosomba b’okogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao ase okwegokia. Tokamenya ase obobe n’emoko, tokogeechigwa na kogeechana.

english: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared ,
ekegusii: Korende ekero oboitongo na obwanchani bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito bwaorogetigwe,

english: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
ekegusii: ere agatotooria, tari ase ogokora kw’oboronge twakorete intwe, korende ase amaabera aye ere omonyene ogosibigwa goetera ase Omoika Omochenu oyio ogotoa okoiborwa okoyia, na obogima oboyia.

english: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;
ekegusii: Oyo atoitererete Omoika Omochenu ase obonge goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omotooria oito,

english: That being justified by his grace , we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life .
ekegusii: erinde obuya bwaye, tonyore oboronge ase ere Nyasae Omobui erio, tonyaare koba abanyamwando b’obogima bwa kare na kare, obwo tosemeretie.

english: This is a faithful saying , and these things I will that thou affirm constantly , that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works . These things are good and profitable unto men .
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene. Igoro y’amang’ana ayio nindigetie oyakwane ne chinguru, erinde abwo bamwegenete Nyasae banyaare kwerua ase ogokora okuya. Amang’ana aya namaya, naende nanyare gokoonya abanto bonsi.

english: But avoid foolish questions , and genealogies , and contentions , and strivings about the law ; for they are unprofitable and vain .
ekegusii: Korende aye, bweatanane korwa ase amaborio y’oboriri, n’omoroberio omotambe bwe chinderia chi’echisokoro, na eriomana, na okoamererania igoro y’amachiiko, ekiagera tibigokoonya kende, naende tibiri nengeencho.

english: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain ; so the LORD shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .
ekegusii: Inwe saba Omonene abatwerie embura y’okwamia endagera ase engaki yaye. Omonene natonge amare akomesa, na atwerie abanto embura na koa kera oyomo endagera korwa mogondo.

english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt , and gather them out of Assyria ; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon ; and place shall not be found for them.
ekegusii: Nimbairanie inka korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nimbasangererie korwa ase ense y’Asuri; mbabeeke ase ense ya Gileadi na ase Lebanoni, mbaichore aroro goika baborwe aase bakomenya.

english: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction , and shall smite the waves in the sea , and all the deeps of the river shall dry up : and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down , and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away .
ekegusii: Ekero baraete ase egati y’enyancha y’emechando, inche Omonene ning’ake emerindo yaye, ne chindiba chionsi chi’orooche rwa Naeli nchikame; na igo oboenenu bw’Abaasuri mbotiringerwe inse, na enyimbo y’obogambi ya Misiri nesirigwe.

english: And I will strengthen them in the LORD ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the LORD .
ekegusii: Inche nimbeke abanto baane chinguru ime yane inche Omonene, barabwo mbabe bagotaara ase erieta riane.” Omonene okwanire ayio.

english: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
ekegusii: “Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abarisia, ning’ee chigoree chiria egesusuro, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ndendete riicho riane nabwo abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda; nindikore ribe ebarasi yane engiya y’esegi.

english: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .
ekegusii: Rigena ri’ekoona narinyorekane korwa ase abanto abwo. Boigo korwa ase bare ekeroochi ki’eema na obota bw’esegi mbinyorekane, naende kera omogambi nanyorekane korwa ase bare.

english: And they shall be as mighty men , which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle : and they shall fight , because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded .
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, batiringere ababisa babo inse buna eubi ere ase chinchera. Mbarwane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde amo nabarabwo, basookie abariini be chibarasi.

english: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the LORD their God , and will hear them.
ekegusii: “Ning’ee Abayuda chinguru, ee, nintoorie abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu. Nimbairanie bamenye inka, ekiagera nabaroreire amaabera; barabwo mbarorekane buna inche konya timbaangeti, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo, ninyigwe ogosaba kwabo.

english: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea, their children shall see it , and be glad ; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD .
ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, bagoke ase chinkoro chiabo buna abanyure edivai. Abana babo mbarore ayio, bagoke, mbagokere Omonene ase chinkoro chiabo ime.

english: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased .
ekegusii: “Nimbasime, mbasangererie amo, ekiagera nababooririe, na barabwo mbamentekane babe abange buna barenge kare.

english: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .
ekegusii: Nonya nabasiarerete gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mbabe bakong’inyora ase chinse chiria chi’aare. Barabwo mbabe moyo amo nabana babo, naende bairane inka.

english: Open thy doors , O Lebanon , that the fire may devour thy cedars .
ekegusii: Aye Lebanoni, igora ebisieri biao, erinde omorero osambe emecharake yao.
